input.title: Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition
input.request:
Formalize Ian Xiao's complete paper, including every labelled or distinct unnumbered diagram identity and the supporting theorems, examples, finite-parabolic results, and counterexamples. Use the exact paper under source/ in the project as well as its published URL. Inventory diagrams from the original page or TikZ when the extracted text loses geometry. Keep an explicit source-to-declaration map, with boundary and finite-index hypotheses. Use the project's shared MackeyDiagrams Lean language for the identity endpoints and compare evaluations of genuinely typed diagrams, with left and right composites reflected in constructors or explicit subdiagram terms. Preserve the distinction between a conjugation embedding, its centralizer coset, an actual group-element dot, linear combinations of dots, and equality of evaluation at a fixed boundary. Keep both shapes as syntax data. Horizontal evaluation is balancing over the middle group algebra (a balanced product of group bisets and linearization is a useful implementation), vertical evaluation is map composition. Model arbitrary direct sums as pointwise finite and treat a standalone reverse cup at finite index separately from an infinite-index crossing with finite surviving support. For Cases 1–6 preserve the exact directional conclusions, sums, obstructions and coefficient-ring assumptions. Use paper numbering and record mathematically supported defects for the owner. Do not use sorry, axioms or weakened stand-ins for the identities. Keep a project-local DIAGRAMS.md with exact, current syntax and semantics, which must also be incorporated into the final README.md; document the actual declarations and checks. Use prior literature and Mathlib as reviewed suppliers where the exact hypotheses match. Private proof workspace, no push.

Owner clarification, 27 November 2026: Every dot at every marked strand vertex is a finite C-linear combination of eligible group elements, each term satisfying the exact adjacent-embedding intertwining condition. Group-element dots are the coefficient-one singleton special case. This applies uniformly, including ordinary dots and dots in expanded crossings and curls. Dot coefficient values, number of nonzero summands, and the constructor used to build a dot are not part of its geometric shape. Preserve the ordered oriented wiring, marked vertices, genuine arithmetic expression scopes, trivalent orientations, and fixed boundary groups and centralizer cosets. Separate arbitrary group-algebra intertwiners from this termwise-eligible dot language; do not silently identify all bimodule maps with eligible dot labels. Read the complete original paper and its rendered diagrams, and use the project shared language rather than inventing a private shape grammar in one theorem type.
Use the current DIAGRAMS.md and shared MackeyDiagrams.DotLabels, Trivalent and PlanarShape APIs. For the shape preorder, use genuine LabelledDrawing.Shapes at a common ordered orientation boundary and ShapeReplaces. Prove insertion/removal of the coefficient-one identity dot as an evaluation theorem for both orientations; retain marked syntax and distinguish it from equality of evaluated morphisms. Recheck every saved translation after this clarification; preserve original statements and all prior evidence.

Final closeout context: the owner requires the 35 necessary lecture-note results in this same repository, now in prerequisites/. Two unused unproved choice-free auxiliary endpoints were retired under the owner's necessary-results-only direction, with complete prior state retained in evidence/retired-prerequisites-*.json. All 143 inventoried paper statements and 151 active endpoints have registered proof artifacts. The fresh deterministic actual-dependency and axiom audit is evidence/article-dependency-extraction/mechanical-audit.json. Supplemental unfinished inspection files in evidence/supplemental-article-inspection/ include an unaccepted draft proposal; these are supporting evidence only, not a coordinator verdict. Resume this original Step 4 coordinator and independently verify actual compiled proof links and axioms for every active endpoint before Step 5.

ConjugationEmbeddingCentralizerCoset.type:
∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
  (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
  (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα).toHom =
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ).toHom ↔
  LeftCosetEquivalence (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U) : Set U) α β
ConjugationEmbeddingCentralizerCoset.sourceReason: Ian Xiao, § 1.2, unnumbered, p. 2. The published PDF matched the project copy, and the article webpage reproduced this endpoint. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404. The task context supplied only the original article endpoint.

FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks.type:
∀ {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (X : ι → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (X i)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (X i) (X j)) →
  ∀ α : ↥(Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}),
    let blockProduct : (ι → Finset Nat) → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
      fun blocks => iSup (fun i =>
        MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ blocks i)))
    Subgroup.map
        (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (α : Equiv.Perm Nat)))
        (blockProduct X) =
      blockProduct (fun i => Finset.image (α : Equiv.Perm Nat) (X i))
FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks.sourceReason: Ian Xiao, § 7, Proposition 7.1, Conjugation, p. 28. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and the plan supplies no portal correction for this endpoint. Mathlib identifies the swap closure with the finitely supported permutations. The supremum of the disjoint embedded block factors represents their product. The empty index type gives the trivial group, and singleton padding contributes only trivial factors.

Bimodule.type:
Prod
  (∀ (S : Type u) (R : Type v) (N : Type w) [Ring S] [Ring R] [AddCommGroup N],
    Type (max u v w))
  (Prod
    (∀ (R : Type v) [Ring R],
      Subtype (fun B : Sigma (fun left : Module R R =>
        Subtype (fun right : Module (MulOpposite R) R =>
          letI : SMul R R := left.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
          letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) R := right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
          SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) R R)) =>
        letI : SMul R R := B.1.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
        letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) R := B.2.1.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
        (∀ s n : R, s • n = s * n) ∧
        (∀ n r : R, MulOpposite.op r • n = n * r)))
    (∀ (R : Type v) (N : Type w) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup N] [left : Module R N],
      Subtype (fun B : Sigma (fun l : Module R N =>
        Subtype (fun right : Module (MulOpposite R) N =>
          letI : SMul R N := l.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
          letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) N := right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
          SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) R N)) =>
        B.1 = left ∧
        (letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) N := B.2.1.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
         ∀ (r : R) (n : N), MulOpposite.op r • n = r • n))))
Bimodule.value:
⟨(fun S R N _ _ _ =>
    Sigma (fun left : Module S N =>
      Subtype (fun right : Module (MulOpposite R) N =>
        letI : SMul S N := left.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
        letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) N := right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
        SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S N))),
  ⟨(fun R _ =>
      let left : Module R R := Semiring.toModule
      let right : Module (MulOpposite R) R := Semiring.toOppositeModule
      letI : SMul R R := left.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
      letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) R := right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
      ⟨⟨left, ⟨right,
          show SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) R R from Semigroup.opposite_smulCommClass⟩⟩,
        ⟨(fun _ _ => rfl), (fun _ _ => rfl)⟩⟩),
    (fun R N _ _ left =>
      letI : Module R N := left
      let right : Module (MulOpposite R) N :=
        Module.compHom N (RingHom.fromOpposite (RingHom.id R) (fun a b => mul_comm a b))
      letI : SMul R N := left.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
      letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) N := right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
      ⟨⟨left, ⟨right, show SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) R N from
          ⟨fun r s n => show MulOpposite.unop r • (s • n) = s • (MulOpposite.unop r • n) from
            by
              simpa only [← mul_smul] using
                congrArg (fun a : R => a • n) (mul_comm (MulOpposite.unop r) s)⟩⟩⟩,
        ⟨rfl, (fun _ _ => rfl)⟩⟩)⟩⟩
Bimodule.sourceReason: Alphabeta Math, (S,R)-bimodules and commuting left and right scalar actions (def-bimodule), https://alphabetamath.cc/item/def-bimodule. The plan supplies this portal definition as the sole endpoint. The notation ${}_S N_R$ corresponds to Bimodule.1 S R N, with the right action encoded as a left Module over MulOpposite R. The other projections supply the regular-ring and commutative-ring constructions and their action formulas. The defect report at https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects returned HTTP 404, so its contents could not be reviewed.

SurvivingCosetRepresentative.type:
∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  Kα ≤ G → Hβ ≤ G →
  let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
  let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let L := fun j : J =>
      Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
    let C := fun j : J =>
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
    ∀ (I : J → Type*) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
      (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! u : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
      (j : J) (g : G),
      let surviving : Set (I j) :=
        {u | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
      (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → ∃! u : I j, u ∈ surviving) ∧
        (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → surviving = ∅)
SurvivingCosetRepresentative.sourceReason: Ian Xiao, Lemma 2.3 (The surviving coset representative), p. 6, with the right coset convention in (2.4) and the data in (2.1)–(2.2). The published PDF matches the project copy. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and the task context supplied no correction for this lemma.

FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks.type:
∀ {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (X : Finset Nat)
    (A : ι → Finset Nat) (B : κ → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ A i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ j, n ∈ B j) →
  let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  (iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))) ⊓ (iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))) =
    iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j => blockSym (A i ∩ B j)))
FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks.sourceReason: Ian Xiao, § 7, Proposition 7.1, Intersection, pp. 28–29. The published PDF matched the project copy byte for byte, and the article webpage reproduced the formula. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and the task context supplied no correction for this endpoint. Each block permutation is extended by the identity on its complement in Nat. The subgroup supremum represents the product of the disjoint block factors, with empty intersections contributing trivial subgroups.

let smallInModules := fun (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) =>
  CategoryTheory.Projective P ∧ CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P ∧
    ∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
      (CategoryTheory.Discrete I)
      (CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P))
let progenerator := fun (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) =>
  Module.Finite B P ∧ Module.Projective B P ∧ CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P
⟨(fun (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C]
      [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfSize.{v,v} C] (P : C) =>
    CategoryTheory.Projective P ∧ CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P ∧
      ∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
        (CategoryTheory.Discrete I)
        (CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P))),
  ⟨smallInModules, ⟨progenerator,
    ⟨(show ∀ (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B),
        smallInModules B P ↔ progenerator B P from

ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (M : Type v) (N : Type w) [Ring R]
  [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module (MulOpposite R) M] [Module R N],
  let F := Finsupp (Prod M N) Int
  let gen : Prod M N → F := fun p => Finsupp.single p 1
  let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
    { x | (∃ (m m' : M) (n : N),
        x = gen (m + m', n) - gen (m, n) - gen (m', n)) ∨
      (∃ (m : M) (n n' : N),
        x = gen (m, n + n') - gen (m, n) - gen (m, n')) ∨
      (∃ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N),
        x = gen (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) - gen (m, r • n)) }
  let T := HasQuotient.Quotient F H
  let τ : Prod M N → T := fun p => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen p)
  ((∀ (m m' : M) (n : N), τ (m + m', n) = τ (m, n) + τ (m', n)) ∧
    (∀ (m : M) (n n' : N), τ (m, n + n') = τ (m, n) + τ (m, n')) ∧
    (∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), τ (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) = τ (m, r • n))) ∧
  (∀ (A : Type z) [AddCommGroup A],
    let Bal := { b : Prod M N → A //
      (∀ (m m' : M) (n : N), b (m + m', n) = b (m, n) + b (m', n)) ∧
      (∀ (m : M) (n n' : N), b (m, n + n') = b (m, n) + b (m, n')) ∧
      (∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), b (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) = b (m, r • n)) }
    (∀ b : Bal, ∃! lift : AddMonoidHom T A, ∀ m n, lift (τ (m, n)) = b.val (m, n)) ∧
    (∃ e : Equiv (AddMonoidHom T A) Bal, ∀ f p, (e f).val p = f (τ p)))
ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.sourceReason: Alphabeta Math, Universal property of M⊗_RN, Statement (thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products), https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products. The plan selects this portal statement as the endpoint and supplies no article statement. The tensor product uses the quotient of the free abelian group of finitely supported integer coefficients on pairs by the two additivity relations and the scalar balance relation. The elementary tensor is the image of its basis generator. The right R-action is written as a left action of MulOpposite R. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, so the report could not be read. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

RegularModuleRightAction.type:
∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [Ring A] [Ring B]
  (F : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (ModuleCat.{w} B))
  [CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F],
  let regular := ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{z} A)
  let lift := LinearEquiv.symm (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{z} A ≃ₗ[A] A)
  let M := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj F regular
  ∃ N : Bimodule.1 B A M,
    N.1 = ModuleCat.isModule M ∧
    ∀ (a : A) (m : M),
      @SMul.smul (MulOpposite A) M
        N.2.1.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul (MulOpposite.op a) m =
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F
          (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv lift (LinearMap.mulRight A a)))) m
RegularModuleRightAction.sourceReason:
The plan designates the statement from Alphabeta Math, F(A) is a (B,A)-bimodule for every additive functor F (lem-evaluation-on-the-regular-module-has-a-commuting-right-action), as the endpoint. https://alphabetamath.cc/item/lem-evaluation-on-the-regular-module-has-a-commuting-right-action

ULift represents the regular left A-module in the source carrier universe and transports right multiplication to that representative. The Lean check constructed the specified bimodule without choice. The defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, so its contents could not be reviewed. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctors.type:
∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [Ring A] [Ring B],
  let Bimod := Sigma (fun M : ModuleCat.{w} B =>
    { D : Bimodule.1 B A M // D.1 = (inferInstance : Module B M) })
  let right := fun (M : Bimod) (m : M.1) (a : A) =>
    letI : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
    MulOpposite.op a • m
  let AMod := ModuleCat.{max u x} A
  let BMod := ModuleCat.{max u w x} B
  let regular := ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{x} A)
  let Balanced := fun (M : Bimod) (X : AMod) (Y : BMod)
      (p : ↥M.1 → X → Y) =>
    (∀ m n : ↥M.1, ∀ a : X, p (m + n) a = p m a + p n a) ∧
    (∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ a b : X, p m (a + b) = p m a + p m b) ∧
    (∀ b : B, ∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ a : X, p (b • m) a = b • p m a) ∧
    (∀ a : A, ∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ y : X, p (right M m a) y = p m (a • y))
  let TensorFunctor := fun (M : Bimod) =>
    { D : Sigma (fun F : CategoryTheory.Functor (AMod) (BMod) =>
        ∀ X : AMod, ↥M.1 → X → F.obj X) //
      (∀ X : AMod, Balanced M X (D.1.obj X) (D.2 X)) ∧
      (∀ (X : AMod) (Y : BMod) (p : ↥M.1 → X → Y),
        Balanced M X Y p →
        ∃! k : LinearMap (RingHom.id B) (D.1.obj X) Y,
          ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (y : X), k (D.2 X m y) = p m y) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : AMod) (h : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (m : ↥M.1) (y : X),
        (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (D.1.map h)) (D.2 X m y) = D.2 Y m ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom h) y)) }
  let NatCode := fun (M N : Bimod) =>
    {f : LinearMap (RingHom.id B) M.1 N.1 //
      ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (a : A), f (right M m a) = right N (f m) a}
  let Component := fun {M N : Bimod}
      (T : TensorFunctor M) (S : TensorFunctor N) (X : AMod) =>
    LinearMap (RingHom.id B) (T.1.1.obj X) (S.1.1.obj X)
  let NatGraph := fun {M N : Bimod}
      (T : TensorFunctor M) (S : TensorFunctor N) =>
    { G : ∀ X : AMod, Component T S X → Prop //
      (∀ X : AMod, ∃! k : Component T S X, G X k) ∧
      (∀ (X Y : AMod) (h : ModuleCat.Hom X Y)
          (k : Component T S X) (l : Component T S Y),
        G X k → G Y l →
        LinearMap.comp (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (S.1.1.map h)) k =
          LinearMap.comp l (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (T.1.1.map h))) }
  let Unitor := fun {M : Bimod} (T : TensorFunctor M) =>
    LinearEquiv (RingHom.id B) (T.1.1.obj (regular)) M.1
  let IsUnitor := fun {M : Bimod} {T : TensorFunctor M}
      (rho : Unitor T) =>
    (∀ (m : ↥M.1) (a : A), rho (T.1.2 (regular) m (ULift.up a)) = right M m a) ∧
    (∀ m : ↥M.1, rho.symm m = T.1.2 (regular) m (ULift.up (1 : A)))
  let eval := fun {M N : Bimod} {T : TensorFunctor M}
      {S : TensorFunctor N} (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S)
      (k : Component T S (regular)) =>
    LinearMap.comp sigma.toLinearMap (LinearMap.comp k rho.symm.toLinearMap)
  let Pure := fun {M N : Bimod} {T : TensorFunctor M}
      {S : TensorFunctor N} (f : NatCode M N) (X : AMod)
      (k : Component T S X) =>
    ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (y : X), k (T.1.2 X m y) = S.1.2 X (f.1 m) y
  let Represents := fun {M N : Bimod}
      {T : TensorFunctor M} {S : TensorFunctor N}
      (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (eta : NatGraph T S) (f : NatCode M N) =>
    (∀ k : Component T S (regular), eta.1 (regular) k →
      f.1 = eval rho sigma k ∧
      ∀ m : ↥M.1, f.1 m = sigma (k (T.1.2 (regular) m (ULift.up (1 : A))))) ∧
    (∀ (X : AMod) (k : Component T S X), eta.1 X k → Pure f X k)
  let InverseAssignments := fun {M N : Bimod}
      {T : TensorFunctor M} {S : TensorFunctor N}
      (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) =>
    (∀ eta : NatGraph T S, ∃! f : NatCode M N, Represents rho sigma eta f) ∧
    (∀ f : NatCode M N, ∃! eta : NatGraph T S, Represents rho sigma eta f)
  let Addition := fun {M N : Bimod}
      {T : TensorFunctor M} {S : TensorFunctor N}
      (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) =>
    ∀ eta theta : NatGraph T S,
      ∃ sum : NatGraph T S,
        (∀ (X : AMod) (k l : Component T S X),
          eta.1 X k → theta.1 X l → sum.1 X (k + l)) ∧
        (∀ (k l : Component T S (regular)),
          eta.1 (regular) k → theta.1 (regular) l →
          eval rho sigma (k + l) = eval rho sigma k + eval rho sigma l)
  let Identity := fun {M : Bimod} {T : TensorFunctor M}
      (rho : Unitor T) =>
    ∃ identity : NatGraph T T,
      (∀ X : AMod, identity.1 X LinearMap.id) ∧
      eval rho rho LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id
  let Composition := fun {M N P : Bimod}
      {T : TensorFunctor M} {S : TensorFunctor N}
      {U : TensorFunctor P}
      (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (tau : Unitor U) =>
    ∀ (eta : NatGraph T S) (theta : NatGraph S U),

∀ (R : Type u) (S : Type v) [Ring R] [Ring S],
  let Middle := Sigma (fun N : ModuleCat.{x} R =>
    { right : Module (MulOpposite S) N //
      letI := right
      SMulCommClass (MulOpposite S) R N })

  let middle := fun (X : Triple) => X.2.1.1
  let last := fun (X : Triple) => X.2.2
  let rightMiddle := fun (X : Triple) => X.2.1.2.val
  let innerLeft := fun (X : Triple) =>
    let M := first X
    let N := middle X
    let F := Finsupp (Prod M N) Int
    let gen : M → N → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : M) (b : N),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : M) (b b' : N),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨
            (∃ (r : R) (a : M) (b : N),
              z = gen (MulOpposite.op r • a) b - gen a (r • b)) }
    (⟨H, fun m n => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen m n)⟩ :
      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => M → N → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let innerRight := fun (X : Triple) =>
    let N := middle X
    let P := last X
    letI := rightMiddle X
    let F := Finsupp (Prod N P) Int
    let gen : N → P → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : N) (b : P),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : N) (b b' : P),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨
            (∃ (r : S) (a : N) (b : P),
              z = gen (MulOpposite.op r • a) b - gen a (r • b)) }
    (⟨H, fun n p => QuotientAddGroup.mk' H (gen n p)⟩ :
      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => N → P → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let MN := fun (X : Triple) =>
    HasQuotient.Quotient (Finsupp (Prod (first X) (middle X)) Int) (innerLeft X).1
  let NP := fun (X : Triple) =>
    HasQuotient.Quotient (Finsupp (Prod (middle X) (last X)) Int) (innerRight X).1

    let M := first X.1
    let N := middle X.1
    let P := last X.1
    let A := MN X.1
    letI := X.2.val.1
    let F := Finsupp (Prod A P) Int
    let gen : A → P → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : A) (b : P),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : A) (b b' : P),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨

      Sigma (fun K : AddSubgroup F => M → N → P → HasQuotient.Quotient F K))
  let right := fun (X : Parenthesized) =>
    let M := first X.1
    let N := middle X.1
    let P := last X.1
    let B := NP X.1
    letI := X.2.val.2
    let F := Finsupp (Prod M B) Int
    let gen : M → B → F := fun a b => Finsupp.single (a, b) 1
    let H : AddSubgroup F := AddSubgroup.closure
      { z | (∃ (a a' : M) (b : B),
              z = gen (a + a') b - gen a b - gen a' b) ∨
            (∃ (a : M) (b b' : B),
              z = gen a (b + b') - gen a b - gen a b') ∨

  let T := fun (X : Parenthesized) =>

          aT.smul c (tT X m n p) = tT X (c • m) n p) ∧
        (∀ (c : C) (q : L X), α X (aL.smul c q) = aT.smul c (α X q))) ∧
    (∀ (X : Parenthesized) (D : Type t) [Ring D] [Module (MulOpposite D) (last X.1)]
        [SMulCommClass S (MulOpposite D) (last X.1)],
      ∃ (aL : Module (MulOpposite D) (L X)) (aT : Module (MulOpposite D) (T X)),
        (∀ (d : D) (m : first X.1) (n : middle X.1) (p : last X.1),
          aL.smul (MulOpposite.op d) (tL X m n p) = tL X m n (MulOpposite.op d • p) ∧
          aT.smul (MulOpposite.op d) (tT X m n p) = tT X m n (MulOpposite.op d • p)) ∧
        (∀ (d : D) (q : L X),
          α X (aL.smul (MulOpposite.op d) q) = aT.smul (MulOpposite.op d) (α X q))) ∧
    (∀ (X Y : Parenthesized)
        (f : LinearMap (RingHom.id (MulOpposite R)) (first X.1) (first Y.1))
        (g : LinearMap (RingHom.id R) (middle X.1) (middle Y.1))
        (h : LinearMap (RingHom.id S) (last X.1) (last Y.1)),
      (∀ (s : S) (n : middle X.1),
        g ((rightMiddle X.1).smul (MulOpposite.op s) n) =
          (rightMiddle Y.1).smul (MulOpposite.op s) (g n)) →
      let TensorMaps := Prod (AddMonoidHom (L X) (L Y)) (AddMonoidHom (T X) (T Y))
      let induced := fun (maps : TensorMaps) =>
        ∀ (m : first X.1) (n : middle X.1) (p : last X.1),
          maps.1 (tL X m n p) = tL Y (f m) (g n) (h p) ∧
          maps.2 (tT X m n p) = tT Y (f m) (g n) (h p)

∀ (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [Ring A] [Ring B]
  (F : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (ModuleCat.{w} B))
  [CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F],
  let regular := ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{z} A)
  let down : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id A) (ULift.{z} A) A := ULift.moduleEquiv
  let FX : ModuleCat.{max u z} A → ModuleCat.{w} B := CategoryTheory.Functor.obj F
  let M := FX regular
  let right : A → M → M := fun a m =>
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv (LinearEquiv.symm down)
        (LinearMap.mulRight A a)))) m
  let ell : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), X → ModuleCat.Hom regular X :=
    fun _X x => ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.smulRight (LinearEquiv.toLinearMap down) x)
  let beta : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), M → X → ModuleCat.carrier (FX X) :=
    fun X m x => ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.map F (ell X x)) m
  let Free := fun (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) => Finsupp (Prod M X) Int
  let gen : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), M → X → Free X :=
    fun _X m x => Finsupp.single (m, x) 1
  let relations : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), AddSubgroup (Free X) := fun X =>
    AddSubgroup.closure
      { p | (∃ (m m' : M) (x : X), p = gen X (m + m') x - gen X m x - gen X m' x) ∨
        (∃ (m : M) (x x' : X), p = gen X m (x + x') - gen X m x - gen X m x') ∨
        (∃ (a : A) (m : M) (x : X), p = gen X (right a m) x - gen X m (a • x)) }
  let Tensor := fun X => HasQuotient.Quotient (Free X) (relations X)
  let pure : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), M → X → Tensor X :=
    fun X m x => QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations X) (gen X m x)
  (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A),
    (∀ (m m' : M) (x : X), beta X (m + m') x = beta X m x + beta X m' x) ∧
    (∀ (m : M) (x x' : X), beta X m (x + x') = beta X m x + beta X m x') ∧
    (∀ (a : A) (m : M) (x : X), beta X (right a m) x = beta X m (a • x)) ∧
    (∀ (b : B) (m : M) (x : X), beta X (b • m) x = b • beta X m x)) ∧
  (∃ (tensorModule : ∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A), Module B (Tensor X)),
    let obj : ModuleCat.{max u z} A → ModuleCat.{max u z w} B := fun X =>
      @ModuleCat.of B _ (Tensor X) (QuotientAddGroup.Quotient.addCommGroup (relations X))
        (tensorModule X)
    ∃ (map : ∀ {X Y : ModuleCat.{max u z} A}, ModuleCat.Hom X Y → ModuleCat.Hom (obj X) (obj Y))
      (mapId : ∀ X, @map X X (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X) =
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (obj X))
      (mapComp : ∀ {X Y Z : ModuleCat.{max u z} A} (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (g : ModuleCat.Hom Y Z),
        @map X Z (@CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp _ _ X Y Z f g) =
          @CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp _ _ (obj X) (obj Y) (obj Z)
            (@map X Y f) (@map Y Z g)),
      let T : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (ModuleCat.{max u z w} B) :=
        CategoryTheory.Functor.mk obj (@map) mapId (@mapComp)
      let liftedF := CategoryTheory.Functor.comp F (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{max u z, w} B)
      ∃ tau : CategoryTheory.NatTrans T liftedF,
        (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (b : B) (m : M) (x : X),
          letI : Module B (Tensor X) := tensorModule X
          b • pure X m x = pure X (b • m) x) ∧
        (∀ (X Y : ModuleCat.{max u z} A) (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (m : M) (x : X),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Functor.map T f) (pure X m x) =
            pure Y m (ModuleCat.Hom.hom f x)) ∧
        (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u z} A),
          letI : Module B (Tensor X) := tensorModule X
          let tauX : LinearMap (RingHom.id B) (Tensor X) (FX X) := LinearMap.comp
            (LinearEquiv.toLinearMap (ULift.moduleEquiv :
              LinearEquiv (RingHom.id B) (ULift.{max u z} (FX X)) (FX X)))
            (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app tau X))
          (∀ (m : M) (x : X), tauX (pure X m x) = beta X m x) ∧
          (∀ h : AddMonoidHom (Tensor X) (FX X),
            (∀ (m : M) (x : X), h (pure X m x) = beta X m x) →
              h = LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom tauX)))

  let sum := fun (T : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (xs : List T) => List.sum xs
  let left := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} (M : Bimod B A) => M.2.1.smul
  let right := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} (M : Bimod B A) (a : A) =>
    M.2.2.val.smul (MulOpposite.op a)
  let Equivariant := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} (M N : Bimod B A) (f : M.1 → N.1) =>
    (∀ (b : B) (m : M.1), f (left M b m) = left N b (f m)) ∧
    (∀ (a : A) (m : M.1), f (right M a m) = right N a (f m))
  let Hom := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} (M N : Bimod B A) =>
    { f : AddMonoidHom M.1 N.1 // Equivariant M N f }
  let Iso := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} (M N : Bimod B A) =>
    { e : AddEquiv M.1 N.1 // Equivariant M N e }
  let isoHom := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} {M N : Bimod B A} (e : Iso M N) =>
    (⟨e.val.toAddMonoidHom, e.property⟩ : Hom M N)
  let idMap := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} (M : Bimod B A) =>
    (⟨AddMonoidHom.id M.1, ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩⟩ : Hom M M)
  let comp := fun {B A : RingCat.{u}} {M N P : Bimod B A}
      (g : Hom N P) (f : Hom M N) =>
    (⟨g.val.comp f.val,
      ⟨fun b m => (congrArg g.val (f.property.1 b m)).trans (g.property.1 b (f.val m)),
       fun a m => (congrArg g.val (f.property.2 a m)).trans (g.property.2 a (f.val m))⟩⟩ :
      Hom M P)
  let regular := fun (A : RingCat.{u}) =>
    (⟨AddCommGrpCat.of A, (Bimodule.{u,u,u}.2.1 A).val⟩ : Bimod A A)
  let IsBalanced := fun {C B A : RingCat.{u}} (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
      (T : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (t : G.1 → F.1 → T) =>
    (∀ (g g' : G.1) (f : F.1), t (g + g') f = t g f + t g' f) ∧
    (∀ (g : G.1) (f f' : F.1), t g (f + f') = t g f + t g f') ∧
    (∀ (b : B) (g : G.1) (f : F.1), t (right G b g) f = t g (left F b f))

      (x y : FreeAddGroup (Prod G.1 F.1)) =>
    let gen := fun (g : G.1) (f : F.1) => FreeAddGroup.of (g, f)

    (∃ (g g' : G.1) (f : F.1), x = gen (g + g') f ∧ y = gen g f + gen g' f) ∨
    (∃ (g : G.1) (f f' : F.1), x = gen g (f + f') ∧ y = gen g f + gen g f') ∨
    (∃ (b : B) (g : G.1) (f : F.1), x = gen (right G b g) f ∧ y = gen g (left F b f))

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
  (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
  (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let C := (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U) : Set U)
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let ψ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
  let up := fun t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) t)
  let down := fun t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) t)
  (φ = ψ ↔ LeftCosetEquivalence C α β) ∧
  (∀ d : G,
    let rightMul := fun x : B => x * MonoidAlgebra.single d 1
    let intertwines := ∀ h : H,
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * d = d * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h
    ((∀ (x : B) (r : A), rightMul (x * φ r) = rightMul x * ψ r) ↔ intertwines) ∧
    (intertwines ↔ (d : U) ∈ Set.image (fun c : U => α * c * β⁻¹) C) ∧
    (intertwines ↔ ∃ α' β' : U, LeftCosetEquivalence C α α' ∧
      LeftCosetEquivalence C β β' ∧ (d : U) = α' * (β')⁻¹) ∧
    (intertwines ↔ ∃ t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t = d)) ∧
  (∀ (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) (x : B),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (up t) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) =
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t) 1) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (down t) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) =
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff (MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)⁻¹ 1 * x)) ∧
  (∀ t s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b,
    let sameElement := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s
    (up t = up s ↔ sameElement) ∧ (down t = down s ↔ sameElement))

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
    (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
  let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb

    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs

  let A := eα.toHom.range
  let B := eβ.toHom.range
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B s
    let orbit := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)

      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H
    let Limage := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (α * a))) L
    let finiteIndex := Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex Limage Ls
    let n := Subgroup.relIndex Limage Ls

    let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb

    (∀ (k : K) (h : H), q (X.pair Y k h) = eα.toHom k * s * eβ.toHom h) ∧
    (∀ w : (X.tensor Y).carrier,
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ι).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q w)) 1) ∧

    (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → finiteIndex → Nat.card (fiber g) = n) ∧
    (finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex) ∧
    (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → ¬ finiteIndex → Set.Infinite (fiber g)) ∧
    ((∀ h : H, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCapBasis eb w = h}) ↔
      Subgroup.FiniteIndex eb.toHom.range) ∧
    (∀ (T : Set H), rightTransversal T → ∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → ¬ finiteIndex →
      Set.Infinite (survives T g)) ∧
    (∀ hf : finiteFibers,
      let p := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d hf
      let evalOnBasis := fun g : G =>
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval p).toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1)
      (∀ g : G, evalOnBasis g = Finset.sum
        (hf (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)).toFinset
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) ∧

        ∃ ht : Set.Finite (survives T g), evalOnBasis g = Finset.sum ht.toFinset
          (fun t => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex eα (traceArg g t))

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let traceCap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap (R := Complex) a
  let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval traceCap
  let pairDI := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex down.basis up.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let pairID := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex up.basis down.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let basisG := fun g : G => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)
  let E : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B A :=
    LinearMap.comp (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex a))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap)
  (∀ g : G, g ∈ S →
    ∃ h : H, (h : U) = α⁻¹ * (g : U) * α ∧ E (basisG g) = MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) ∧
  (∀ g : G, g ∉ S → E (basisG g) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (r s : A) (x : B), E (φ r * x * φ s) = r * E x * s) ∧
  (∀ x y : B, cap.toLinearMap (pairDI x y) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (E (x * y))) ∧
  (∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    let reverseCup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite
    let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval reverseCup
    let IsTransversal := fun T : Finset G =>
      ∀ g : G, ∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S
    let toRep : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (Rep.{max u v} Complex H) :=
      Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra
    let Ind : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) :=
      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp toRep (Rep.indFunctor Complex a.toHom))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G))
    let Res : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) :=
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.toRingHom

      let ρ := Rep.ρ (toRep.obj X)
      show Ind.obj X from
        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind a.toHom ρ)).symm
          (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex
            (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk a.toHom ρ g⁻¹ x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff b))

    (∀ (T : Finset G), IsTransversal T →
      let leftTerm := fun (t : G) (x : B) => basisG (t⁻¹) * φ (E (basisG t * x))

        Finset.sum T (fun t => rightTerm t x) = x) ∧

        (∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, rightTerm t.val (basisG g) ≠ 0))) ∧

         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit down)
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical

               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit down))))

         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit up)
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal reverseCup idUp)
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate up down up)
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUp traceCap)
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit up))))

        (∀ g : G,

            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG (t⁻¹)) (basisG (t * g)))) ∧
        (∀ (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (g : G) (z : Y),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.unit.app Y) (basisG g • z) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t =>
              pure (Res.obj Y) (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t • z)))))

let Mod := fun A : RingCat.{u} => ModuleCat.{max u v} A
let Actions := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (M : Mod S) =>
  { d : Bimodule.1 S R M // d.1 = ModuleCat.isModule M }
let Bimod := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) => Sigma (Actions S R)
let right := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (M : Bimod S R) (m : M.1) (r : R) =>
  letI : Module (MulOpposite R) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  MulOpposite.op r • m
let Hom := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (M N : Bimod S R) =>
  { f : LinearMap (RingHom.id S) M.1 N.1 //
    ∀ (m : M.1) (r : R), f (right S R M m r) = right S R N (f m) r }
letI : ∀ S R : RingCat.{u}, CategoryTheory.Category (Bimod S R) := fun S R =>
  { Hom := Hom S R
    id := fun _ => ⟨LinearMap.id, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    comp := fun f g =>
      ⟨LinearMap.comp g.val f.val, fun m r =>
        Eq.trans (congrArg (fun x => g.val x) (f.property m r))
          (g.property (f.val m) r)⟩
    id_comp := fun _ => Subtype.ext (LinearMap.id_comp _)
    comp_id := fun _ => Subtype.ext (LinearMap.comp_id _)
    assoc := fun _ _ _ => Subtype.ext (LinearMap.comp_assoc _ _ _) }
let forgetBimod : ∀ S R : RingCat.{u}, CategoryTheory.Functor (Bimod S R) (Mod S) :=
  fun _ _ =>
    { obj := fun M => M.1
      map := fun f => ModuleCat.ofHom f.val
      map_id := fun _ => rfl
      map_comp := fun _ _ => rfl }
let Good := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (F : CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod R) (Mod S)) =>
  CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F ∧
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
  ∀ I : Type (max u v), CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
    (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) F
let PreservingFunctors := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) => CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (Good S R)
let incl := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) => CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι (Good S R)
let regular := fun (R : RingCat.{u}) => ModuleCat.of R (ULift.{v} R)
let rho : ∀ (R : RingCat.{u}), R → ModuleCat.Hom (regular R) (regular R) :=
  fun R r =>
    ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv
      (LinearEquiv.symm (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{v} R ≃ₗ[R] R)) (LinearMap.mulRight R r))
let eval := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) =>
  CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (incl S R)
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.evaluation (Mod R) (Mod S)) (regular R))
let Balanced := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X : Mod R) (Y : Mod S)
    (p : B.1 → X → Y) =>
  (∀ (b b' : B.1) (x : X), p (b + b') x = p b x + p b' x) ∧
  (∀ (b : B.1) (x x' : X), p b (x + x') = p b x + p b x') ∧
  (∀ (s : S) (b : B.1) (x : X), p (s • b) x = s • p b x) ∧
  (∀ (r : R) (b : B.1) (x : X), p (right S R B b r) x = p b (r • x))
∃ EW : ∀ S R : RingCat.{u}, CategoryTheory.Equivalence (Bimod S R) (PreservingFunctors S R),
  let tensor := fun (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (incl S R) ((EW S R).functor.obj B)
  ∃ pure : ∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X : Mod R), B.1 → X → (tensor S R B).obj X,
    (∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X : Mod R),
      Balanced S R B X ((tensor S R B).obj X) (pure S R B X) ∧
      ∀ (Y : Mod S) (p : B.1 → X → Y), Balanced S R B X Y p →
        ∃! f : LinearMap (RingHom.id S) ((tensor S R B).obj X) Y,
          ∀ (b : B.1) (x : X), f (pure S R B X b x) = p b x) ∧
    (∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B : Bimod S R) (X Y : Mod R)
      (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (b : B.1) (x : X),
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((tensor S R B).map f) (pure S R B X b x) =
        pure S R B Y b (ModuleCat.Hom.hom f x)) ∧
    (∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) (B B' : Bimod S R) (f : Hom S R B B')
      (X : Mod R) (b : B.1) (x : X),
      ModuleCat.Hom.hom
        (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.app ((incl S R).map ((EW S R).functor.map f)) X)
        (pure S R B X b x) = pure S R B' X (f.val b) x) ∧
    (∀ S R : RingCat.{u},
      ∃ h : CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (EW S R).inverse (forgetBimod S R) = eval S R,
        ∀ (F : PreservingFunctors S R),
          let toEval := cast (congrArg ModuleCat.carrier (CategoryTheory.Functor.congr_obj h F))

            toEval (right S R ((EW S R).inverse.obj F) m r) =
              ModuleCat.Hom.hom (F.obj.map (rho R r)) (toEval m)) ∧
    (∀ (T S R : RingCat.{u}) (C : Bimod T S) (B : Bimod S R),
      ∃ a : Actions T R ((tensor T S C).obj B.1),
        let CB : Bimod T R := ⟨(tensor T S C).obj B.1, a⟩
        (∀ (c : C.1) (b : B.1) (r : R),
          right T R CB (pure T S C B.1 c b) r = pure T S C B.1 c (right S R B b r)) ∧
        ∃ i : CategoryTheory.Iso (tensor T R CB)
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (tensor S R B) (tensor T S C)),
          ∀ (X : Mod R) (c : C.1) (b : B.1) (x : X),
            ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.hom.app X) (pure T R CB X (pure T S C B.1 c b) x) =
              pure T S C ((tensor S R B).obj X) c (pure S R B X b x)) ∧
    (∀ R : RingCat.{u}, ∃ a : Actions R R (regular R),
      let RR : Bimod R R := ⟨regular R, a⟩
      (∀ (x : ULift.{v} R) (r : R), right R R RR x r = ULift.up (x.down * r)) ∧
      ∃ i : CategoryTheory.Iso (tensor R R RR) (CategoryTheory.Functor.id (Mod R)),
        ∀ (X : Mod R) (r : ULift.{v} R) (x : X),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.hom.app X) (pure R R RR X r x) = r.down • x)

          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b inner))

    let loop := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ

        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)

      let upper := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp p loop)

        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lower p) (upper p)

        Subgroup.index S = Subgroup.index (Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype H) K)) ∧

          (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
          (hd : α * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
        let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ

          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd

        let loopIdentity := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down loop))

        let inside := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lower a)

        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret above) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot))) ∧

      (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)

    let upMergeR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp g a)) mergedUp
    let upSplitL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical

    let upSplitR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical mergedUp
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp g' b))
    let downMergeL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical legDotsDown
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g' b))
    let downMergeR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g a)) mergedDown
    let downSplitL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g a)) legDotsDown
    let downSplitR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical mergedDown
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g' b))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upMergeL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upMergeR) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upSplitL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upSplitR) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downMergeL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downMergeR) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downSplitL) =

∀ (S R : RingCat.{u}) [Algebra Complex S] [Algebra Complex R],
  let ew := Classical.choose _root_.EilenbergWatts S R
  let Bimod := Sigma (fun M : ModuleCat.{max u v} S =>
    { a : _root_.Bimodule.1 S R M // a.1 = ModuleCat.isModule M })
  let Good := fun F : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (ModuleCat.{max u v} S) =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F ∧
    CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
    ∀ I : Type (max u v),
      CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) F
  let GoodFunctors := CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory Good
  letI : CategoryTheory.Category.{max u v} Bimod :=
    (fun (c : CategoryTheory.Category.{max u v} Bimod)
      (_ : @CategoryTheory.Equivalence Bimod GoodFunctors c inferInstance) => c) _ ew
  let EqualScalars : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty Bimod := fun B =>
    letI : Module (MulOpposite R) B.1 := B.2.1.2.1
    ∀ (z : Complex) (b : B.1),
      algebraMap Complex S z • b = MulOpposite.op (algebraMap Complex R z) • b
  let ComplexLinear : CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty GoodFunctors := fun F =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear Complex F.obj
  (∀ B : Bimod, EqualScalars B ↔ ComplexLinear (ew.functor.obj B)) ∧
  ∃ restricted : CategoryTheory.Equivalence
      (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory EqualScalars)
      (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory ComplexLinear),
    CategoryTheory.Functor.comp restricted.functor (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι ComplexLinear) =
      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι EqualScalars) ew.functor

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let C := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
      ∀ (I : J → Type v) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
        (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! i : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
        (j : J),
        let s := σ j
        let l := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
        let r := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r) :=
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let kg := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
        let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
        let kl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l
        let lh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r
        let leftMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (a.comp l)
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
        let Mj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kl lh
        let traceArg := fun (g : G) (i : I j) =>
          α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α
        let surviving := fun g : G => {i : I j | traceArg g i ∈ K}
        let inclusionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) := [(1, d)]
        let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r inclusionLabel
        let expandedInclusion : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a l))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh)))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate kg leftMiddle lh))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d 1))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp b r)))))
        let tracedTerm := fun (z : M.basis.carrier) (i : I j) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.term
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b l r d)
            z (MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.unitPair r (hRep j i))
        ∃ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite
            {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z})
          (hs : ∀ g, Set.Finite (surviving g)),
          let projectionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :=
            [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b l r projectionLabel
          let expandedProjection : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection a b l r projectionLabel
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.junction MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.junction
          let crossings : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι
          let expandedCrossings : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical expandedProjection expandedInclusion

            surviving (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z)) ∧
          (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
            (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ι)).toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair kl.basis lh.basis k h) 1) =
            Finsupp.single
              (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b (a.toHom k * s * b.toHom h)) 1) ∧
          (∀ g : G, (hs g).toFinset.card ≤ 1 ∧
            (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret p)).toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g) 1) =
            Finset.sum (hs g).toFinset.attach (fun i =>
              Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair kl.basis lh.basis
                ⟨traceArg g i.val, (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset (hs g)).mp i.property⟩
                (hRep j i.val)) 1)) ∧
          (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ι) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret expandedInclusion)) ∧
          (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret crossings) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret expandedCrossings)) ∧
          (∀ hi : Subgroup.FiniteIndex r.toHom.range,
            let finiteProjection : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
              MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown b r hi)))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex)
                        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse d) 1))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate kg leftMiddle lh))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a l))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh)))))
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret crossings) =
              MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical finiteProjection expandedInclusion)))

MackeyIdentityDiagram.type:
∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let d := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (r j)) from
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      ∃ hf : ∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j) w = z},
        let inclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
        let projection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (hf j)
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up)
        let crossed : J → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (projection j) (inclusion j)
        let term := fun (x : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) (j : J) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (crossed j)) x
        (∃ finite : ∀ x, Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)),
          let sum : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex M M J :=
            ⟨fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (crossed j), finite⟩
          ∀ x, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight) x =
            sum.evalAt x) ∧
        (∀ j : J,
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion j) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (Mj j))) ∧
        (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion i) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j)))

Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 2.2, first identity diagram in the proof of Theorem 2.2, p. 7, with the conventions of (2.1)–(2.3). The archived source and current published PDF differ; the archived page reference here is to source/mackey-bimodules.pdf. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The context supplied no correction for this endpoint. The straight strands are a horizontal identity pair and each summand is the typed projection followed by the typed inclusion at the same boundary. The sum ranges over the support on each input and permits arbitrary subgroup indices. The two clauses of the supplied split equation for the reverse order appear as the diagonal and off-diagonal equalities of evaluated bimodule maps. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The displayed Mackey identity has one sum over the complete double-coset index, pointwise finite on inputs. PointwiseIndexedDrawing retains that full indexed scope and the individual crossing shapes independently of input; its evaluation is the same pointwise sum. The corrected proposition and existing proof compile together, and Equivalence.lean checks that the old and corrected propositions are definitionally equivalent using Iff.rfl. The infinite pointwise sum is not asserted to be an element of the finite formal diagram algebra. Independent statement review remains required.

MackeySummandProjection.type:
∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let C := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
      ∀ (I : J → Type v) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
        (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! i : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
        (j : J),
        let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
          (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
        let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
          (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
        let s := σ j
        let l := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
        let r := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change ((s : U) * β) * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b r) :=
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let kg := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
        let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
        let kl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l
        let lh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r
        let middle := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l)
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
        let Mj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kl lh
        let surviving := fun (g : G) =>
          {i : I j | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
        ∃ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite
            {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z})
          (hs : ∀ g : G, Set.Finite (surviving g)),
          let projectionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :=
            [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
          let inclusionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b r)) :=
            [(1, d)]
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b l r projectionLabel
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r inclusionLabel
          let expandedProjection : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection a b l r projectionLabel
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.junction MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.junction
          let expandedInclusion : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                  (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a l))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh)))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate kg middle lh))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d 1))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp b r)))))
          let composite : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι
          let expandedComposite : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical expandedProjection expandedInclusion
          let compositeEval := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret composite)
          compositeEval = MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret expandedComposite) ∧
          (∀ g : G,
            let z := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g
            let image := compositeEval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex))
            image = Finsupp.single z (Finset.card (Set.Finite.toFinset (hs g)) : Complex) ∧
              (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → image = Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) ∧
              (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → image = 0))

∀ (A : Type u) (E : Type w)
    [CategoryTheory.Category.{v} A] [CategoryTheory.Category.{v} E]
    [CategoryTheory.Abelian A] [CategoryTheory.Abelian E]
    [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasCoproducts.{v} A]
    [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasCoproducts.{v} E]
    (P : A) (Q : E),
  CategoryTheory.Projective P →
  CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P →
  (∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
    (CategoryTheory.Discrete I)
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyoneda (Opposite.op P))) →
  CategoryTheory.Projective Q →
  CategoryTheory.IsSeparator Q →
  (∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
    (CategoryTheory.Discrete I)
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyoneda (Opposite.op Q))) →
  let R := MulOpposite (CategoryTheory.End P)
  let S := MulOpposite (CategoryTheory.End Q)
  let HP : CategoryTheory.Functor A (ModuleCat.{v} R) :=
    CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyonedaObj P
  let HQ : CategoryTheory.Functor E (ModuleCat.{v} S) :=
    CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyonedaObj Q
  let Good := fun F : CategoryTheory.Functor A E =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Additive F ∧
      CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
      ∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
        (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) F
  let Functors := CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory Good
  let incl := CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι Good
  let eval := CategoryTheory.Functor.comp incl
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.obj (CategoryTheory.evaluation A E) P) HQ)
  let Actions := fun (M : ModuleCat.{v} S) =>
    { d : Sigma (fun left : Module S M =>
        Subtype (fun right : Module (MulOpposite R) M =>
          letI : SMul S M := left.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
          letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) M :=
            right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
          SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S M)) //
      d.1 = ModuleCat.isModule M }

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
  (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
  (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let ψ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
  let orbit := fun g : G =>
    Set.range (fun h : H =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * g * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h)⁻¹)
  let OrbitIndex := {s : Finset G // ∃ g : G, (s : Set G) = orbit g}
  let orbitSum := fun i : OrbitIndex =>
    Finset.sum (Subtype.val i) (fun g => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex))
  let HomSpace : Submodule Complex (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B B) :=
    { carrier := { f |
        (∀ s x : B, f (s * x) = s * f x) ∧
        (∀ (r : A) (x : B), f (x * φ r) = f x * ψ r) }
      zero_mem' := by
        simp
      add_mem' := by
        rintro f g ⟨hfL, hfR⟩ ⟨hgL, hgR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL, hgL, mul_add],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR, hgR, add_mul]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c f ⟨hfL, hfR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR]⟩ }
  ∃ basis : Module.Basis OrbitIndex Complex HomSpace,
    (∀ (i : OrbitIndex) (x : B), Subtype.val (basis i) x = x * orbitSum i) ∧
    (∀ g : G, (∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d = g) ↔ orbit g = {g}) ∧
    (Finite H → ∀ i : OrbitIndex,
      ∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b),
        ∀ x : B,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) =
            MonoidAlgebra.coeff (Subtype.val (basis i) x))

∀ {ι : Type*} {κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (X : Finset Nat)
    (A : ι → Finset Nat) (B : κ → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ A i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ j, n ∈ B j) →
  let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  let block : Sum ι κ → Finset Nat := Sum.elim A B
  let graph : SimpleGraph (Sum ι κ) := SimpleGraph.fromRel fun u v =>
    match u, v with
    | Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j => Finset.Nonempty (A i ∩ B j)
    | _, _ => False
  let componentBlock : SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent graph → Finset Nat := fun c =>
    let inComponent : Nat → Prop := fun n =>
      ∃ v : Sum ι κ, SimpleGraph.connectedComponentMk graph v = c ∧ n ∈ block v
    @Finset.filter Nat inComponent (Classical.decPred inComponent) X
  ((iSup fun i => blockSym (A i)) ⊔ (iSup fun j => blockSym (B j))) =
    iSup fun c => blockSym (componentBlock c)
