∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      let W := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M
      let Wj := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (Mj j)
      let V := Finsupp W.carrier Complex
      let Vj := fun j : J => Finsupp (Wj j).carrier Complex
      let groupAlgebra := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
      let coordinates : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) V groupAlgebra :=
        LinearEquiv.trans
          (Finsupp.domLCongr (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv a b))
          (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm
      let groupAlgebraAction := fun (g : K × H) (x : groupAlgebra) =>
        MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g.1) * x *
          MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b g.2)⁻¹)
      let Mod := fun S : Subgroup U => ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
      let Res := fun {S T : Subgroup U} (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T) =>
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)).toRingHom :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod T) (Mod S))
      let Ind := fun {S T : Subgroup U} (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T) =>
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
          (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
            (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
            (Rep.indFunctor Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)))
          (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))
      let summand := fun j : J => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (r j)) (Ind (l j))
      (∀ (g : K × H) (x : V),
        coordinates (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex W g x) =
          groupAlgebraAction g (coordinates x)) ∧
      ∃ (projection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j))
        (inclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M),
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up)
        let term := fun (x : V) (j : J) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (projection j) (inclusion j))) x
        (∃ finite : ∀ x : V, Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)),
          ∀ x : V, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight) x =
            Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finite x)) (term x)) ∧
        (∀ j : J,
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion j) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (Mj j))) ∧
        (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion i) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j))) ∧
        (∃ e : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) groupAlgebra (DFinsupp Vj),
          (∀ (x : V) (j : J),
            e (coordinates x) j = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (projection j)) x) ∧
          (∀ (g : K × H) (x : groupAlgebra) (j : J),
            e (groupAlgebraAction g x) j =
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (Wj j) g (e x j))) ∧
        Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind b) (Res a))
          (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj summand))

FiniteOrbitSumDiagram.type:
∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
  (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
  (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let ψ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
  let action := fun (h : H) (g : G) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * g * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h)⁻¹
  let orbit := fun g : G => Set.range (fun h : H => action h g)
  let OrbitIndex := {s : Finset G // ∃ g : G, (s : Set G) = orbit g}
  let orbitSum := fun i : OrbitIndex =>
    Finset.sum (Subtype.val i) (fun g => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex))
  let HomSpace : Submodule Complex (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B B) :=
    { carrier := { f |
        (∀ s x : B, f (s * x) = s * f x) ∧
        (∀ (r : A) (x : B), f (x * φ r) = f x * ψ r) }
      zero_mem' := by
        simp
      add_mem' := by
        rintro f g ⟨hfL, hfR⟩ ⟨hgL, hgR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL, hgL, mul_add],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR, hgR, add_mul]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c f ⟨hfL, hfR⟩
        exact ⟨fun s x => by simp [hfL],
          fun r x => by simp [hfR]⟩ }
  ∃ basis : Module.Basis OrbitIndex Complex HomSpace,
    (∀ (i : OrbitIndex) (x : B), Subtype.val (basis i) x = x * orbitSum i) ∧
    (∀ g : G, (∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d = g) ↔ orbit g = {g}) ∧
    (∀ [Finite H],
      let T : Subgroup U := ⊥
      let j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T H :=
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (1 : U) (by
          intro t
          have ht : (t : U) = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp t.property
          simp [ht])
      let finiteIndex : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j)) :=
        Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite
      let p := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
      let q := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up j
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down j
      let groupElements : Finset H := @Finset.univ H (Fintype.ofFinite H)
      ∀ g : G,
        let finiteOrbit : Set.Finite (orbit g) := Set.finite_range (fun h : H => action h g)
        let i : OrbitIndex :=
          ⟨Set.Finite.toFinset finiteOrbit, ⟨g, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset finiteOrbit⟩⟩
        let order : Complex := (Nat.card {h : H // action h g = g} : Complex)
        let dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a j)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b j) :=
          { element := g
            intertwines := by
              intro t
              have ht : t = 1 := Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp t.property)
              rw [ht, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one] }
        let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) j finiteIndex)
        let merge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a j) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down)
        let dotStep := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) dot) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down)
        let split := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) b j) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down)
        let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id q) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap (R := Complex) j)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex p q :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit p)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cup
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p up down)
                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical merge
                  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical dotStep
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical split
                      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate q up down)
                        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit q))))))))
        let sumOverH : B := Finset.sum groupElements (fun t =>
          MonoidAlgebra.single
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a t⁻¹ * g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b t)
            (1 : Complex))
        IsUnit order ∧
        (∀ x : B,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d)
              (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * sumOverH) ∧
          x * sumOverH = x * (order • orbitSum i)) ∧
        (∀ x : B,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale order⁻¹ d))
              (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (Subtype.val (basis i) x)))

let A : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 6
let B : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 7 12
let supportK : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 3
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let subgroupProduct : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) →
    Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun S T => Set.image2 (fun x y => x * y) (S : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat))
    (T : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat))
let G := blockSym A ⊔ blockSym B
let H := G
let K := blockSym supportK
let Hhat := blockSym (A ∪ B)
let Khat := blockSym supportK
let β : Equiv.Perm Nat := 1
∃ (α : Equiv.Perm Nat)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : Equiv.Perm Nat) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : Equiv.Perm Nat) * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  Finset.image α A = B ∧
  Finset.image α B = A ∧
  α ∈ subgroupProduct G Hhat ∧
  β ∈ subgroupProduct H Khat ∧
  (∀ γ ∈ subgroupProduct G Khat, Finset.image γ A = A ∧ Finset.image γ B = B) ∧
  Set.MapsTo (⇑(α * β)) (supportK : Set Nat) (B : Set Nat) ∧
  α * β ∉ subgroupProduct G Khat ∧
  ¬ ∃ (γ : Equiv.Perm Nat) (_ : γ ∈ subgroupProduct G Khat)
      (hγ : ∀ k : K, γ * (k : Equiv.Perm Nat) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G),
    MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ =
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ)

OrdinaryMackeyDecomposition.type:
∀ {G : Type u} [Group G] (K H : Subgroup G),
  let I := DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : I → G) (_ : ∀ i : I, DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i) = i),
    let L := fun i : I => K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i))) H
    let incLK := fun i : I =>
      Subgroup.inclusion (show L i ≤ K from inf_le_left)
    let μ := fun i : I =>
      MonoidHom.codRestrict
        (MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i)⁻¹)) (Subgroup.subtype (L i)))
        H (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨h, hh, he⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change σ i * h * (σ i)⁻¹ = (ℓ : G) at he
          change h ∈ H at hh
          change (σ i)⁻¹ * (ℓ : G) * ((σ i)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
          rw [← he]
          convert hh using 1
          group)
    let Mod := fun A : Type u => fun [Group A] => ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A)
    let Res := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B) =>
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
        CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod B) (Mod A))
    let Ind := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B) =>
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
          (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := A))
          (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := B)) :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod A) (Mod B))
    let F := CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind (Subgroup.subtype H)) (Res (Subgroup.subtype K))
    let S := fun i : I => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (μ i)) (Ind (incLK i))
    let regular := fun (A : Type u) [Group A] =>
      ModuleCat.of (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (ULift.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A))
    let regularH := regular H
    let regularG := regular G
    let rightMulH := fun a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H =>
      (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{v, u} (MonoidAlgebra Complex H)).map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulRight (MonoidAlgebra Complex H) a))
    let tmul := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B)
        (M : Mod A) (b : B) (m : ↥M) =>
      let N := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := A)).obj M
      let x : ↥N := (RestrictScalars.addEquiv Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (↥M)).symm m
      let y : ↥(Rep.ind f N) := (Representation.IndV.mk f N.ρ b⁻¹) x
      (show ↥((Ind f).obj M) from
        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Rep.ind f N).ρ).symm y)
    let targetBasis : G → ↥(F.obj regularH) := fun g =>
      tmul (Subgroup.subtype H) regularH g (ULift.up (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H))
    let summandTmul : ∀ i : I, K → H → ↥((S i).obj regularH) := fun i k h =>
      tmul (incLK i) ((Res (μ i)).obj regularH) k (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex H h))
    ∃ (e : CategoryTheory.Iso F (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj S))
      (c : CategoryTheory.Iso (F.obj regularH) ((Res (Subgroup.subtype K)).obj regularG)),
      (∀ g : G, c.hom (targetBasis g) = ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G g)) ∧
      (∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (x : ↥(F.obj regularH)),
        c.hom ((F.map (rightMulH a)) x) =
          ULift.up (ULift.down (c.hom x) *
            MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.subtype H) a)) ∧
      (∀ (i : I) (k : K) (h : H),
        c.hom (e.inv.app regularH
          ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι S i).app regularH (summandTmul i k h))) =
            ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((k : G) * σ i * (h : G))))

∀ {ι κ : Type*} (X : ι → Set Nat) (Y : κ → Set Nat),
  (∀ i, Set.Nonempty (X i)) → (∀ j, Set.Nonempty (Y j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (X i) (X i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (Y j) (Y j')) →
  let U := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
  let blockSym := fun B : Set Nat => _root_.fixingSubgroup (↥U) Bᶜ
  let H := iSup (fun i => blockSym (X i))
  let G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (Y j))
  ∀ (α β : ↥U)
      (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : ↥U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : ↥U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let inBlock := fun (σ : ↥U) (i : ι) (j : κ) =>
      Set.MapsTo (⇑(σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)) (X i) (Y j)
    (∀ i, Set.Nontrivial (X i) →
      (∃ j, inBlock α i j) ∧ (∃ j, inBlock β i j)) ∧
    (Nonempty (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) ↔
      ∀ i, Set.Nontrivial (X i) → ∃ j, inBlock α i j ∧ inBlock β i j)

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α γ : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a
  let upG := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up g
  let upA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let upGA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ga
  let downA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let downG := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down g
  let downGA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ga
  let straight := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upG
  let leftCap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal straight
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap a)
  let leftSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp g a) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id downA)
  let left := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical leftSplit
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upG upA downA)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical leftCap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit upG)))
  let rightCup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id downA)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup (R := Complex) g)
  let rightBranch := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit downA)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical rightCup
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downA downG upG)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown g a) straight)))
  let rightCap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap ga) straight
  let right := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id upGA) rightBranch)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGA downGA upG)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical rightCap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit upG)))
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
    (finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α))),
  let composite := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α
  let downComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down composite
  let upComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up composite
  let downGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ
  let upGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ
  let upAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α
  let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α
  let input := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma
  let idOutput := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) output
  let left : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input output :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id upGamma))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate output downGamma upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idOutput (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit output)))
  let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite output) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id upGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup α finite))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGamma upAlpha output)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α) idOutput)))

let B₁ : Set Nat := {1, 2, 3}
  let B₂ : Set Nat := {4, 5, 6}
  let B₃ : Set Nat := {7, 8, 9}
  let B₄ : Set Nat := {10, 11, 12}
  let X : Fin 4 → Set Nat := ![B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄]
  let Y : Fin 2 → Set Nat := ![B₁ ∪ B₂, B₃ ∪ B₄]
  let U := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
  let blockSym := fun B : Set Nat => _root_.fixingSubgroup (↥U) Bᶜ
  let H := iSup (fun i => blockSym (X i))
  let G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (Y j))
  let swap := fun (i j : Nat) (hij : i ≠ j) =>
    (⟨Equiv.swap i j, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩⟩ : ↥U)
  let α := swap 4 7 (by decide) * swap 5 8 (by decide) * swap 6 9 (by decide)
  let β : ↥U := 1
  ∃ (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : ↥U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : ↥U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let orbit := Set.range (fun h : H =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h * (1 : G) *
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h)⁻¹)
    (∀ (g : G) (j : Fin 2), Set.MapsTo (⇑((g : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat)) (Y j) (Y j)) ∧
    (∃ t : H,
      ((t : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) = Equiv.swap 4 5 ∧
      (((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a t : G) : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) =
        Equiv.swap 7 8 ∧
      (((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b t : G) : ↥U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) =
        Equiv.swap 4 5) ∧
    ¬ Nonempty (MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) ∧
    ∃ s : Finset G, (s : Set G) = orbit ∧
      let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
      let orbitSum : B := Finset.sum s (fun g => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex))
      ∃ d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b),
        let f := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval d)

  swapInU 4 7 (by decide) * swapInU 5 8 (by decide) * swapInU 6 9 (by decide)

  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj σ)) L
(∀ σ : U, conj σ K ≤ G → conj (σ * β⁻¹) H ≤ G) ∧
  conj α K = K ∧ α ∉ H ∧
  ∃ (hKH : K ≤ H) (hHG : H ≤ G) (hα : α ∈ G),
    let ιKH : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β (fun k => by
        change (1 : U) * (k : U) * (1 : U)⁻¹ ∈ H
        simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using hKH k.property)
    let ιHG : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun h => by
        simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using hHG h.property)
    let incl := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ιHG ιKH
    let target : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α (fun k =>
        G.mul_mem (G.mul_mem hα (hHG (hKH k.property))) (G.inv_mem hα))
    let input := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ιHG) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ιKH)

      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d = (⟨α, hα⟩ : G) ∧

          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing

            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal

              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing label))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp ιHG b))
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U),
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let Hβ := conjSubgroup β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G)
    (ha : conjSubgroup a L ≤ K) (hb : conjSubgroup b L ≤ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun x => hK ⟨(x : U), x.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun y => hH ⟨(y : U), y.property, rfl⟩)
    let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := K) a
      (fun ℓ => ha ⟨(ℓ : U), ℓ.property, rfl⟩)
    let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := H) b
      (fun ℓ => hb ⟨(ℓ : U), ℓ.property, rfl⟩)
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          group)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          group) hs
    let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ i : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ i) = i)
      (j : J) (_ : DoubleCoset.mk A B s = j) (k : K) (h : H)
      (_ : s = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα k * σ j *
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ h),
      let Lj := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let Ls := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
      let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
      let Lprime := conjSubgroup (α * (k : U)⁻¹ * a) L
      let leftJ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj) (G := K) α⁻¹
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := ℓ.property.1
          change α * x * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at he
          rw [← he]
          change x ∈ K at hx
          convert hx using 1
          group)
      let rightJ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj) (G := H)
        (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change ((σ j : U) * β) * y * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at he
          rw [← he]
          change y ∈ H at hy
          convert hy using 1
          group)
      ∃ hSub : Lprime ≤ Lj,
        let leftPrime := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator
          (H := Lprime) (G := K) α⁻¹ (fun ℓ =>
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom leftJ ⟨(ℓ : U), hSub ℓ.property⟩).property)
        let rightPrime := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator
          (H := Lprime) (G := H) (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (fun ℓ =>
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom rightJ ⟨(ℓ : U), hSub ℓ.property⟩).property)
        let dprime : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα leftPrime)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ rightPrime) :=
          ⟨σ j, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
              (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let X := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ea
        let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb
        let Xprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction leftPrime
        let Yprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction rightPrime
        let W := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor X Y
        let Wprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor Xprime Yprime
        let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
        let qprime :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime
        let ι := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex)
          eα eβ ea eb [(1, d)]
        let ιprime := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex)
          eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime [(1, dprime)]
        ∃ (e : W.carrier ≃ Wprime.carrier)
          (he : ∀ (g : K × H) (w : W.carrier),
            e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act W g w) = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Wprime g (e w)),

            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ofFunction e he

            e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair X Y x y) =
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair Xprime Yprime (x * k) (h * y)) ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical transport (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ιprime)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ι) ∧

              (hfprime : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | qprime w = z}),
            let p := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex)
              eα eβ ea eb [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
            let pprime := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex)
              eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime [(1, ⟨dprime, hfprime⟩)]
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret p)) transport =
              MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret pprime)) ∧
          Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Subgroup.subgroupOf Lprime Lj))) =
            Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Subgroup.subgroupOf Limage Ls)))

      (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
      (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
    let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs

    let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
    let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
      let Lj := fun j : J => conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let leftJ := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change k ∈ K at hk
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let rightJ := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change h ∈ H at hh
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let _Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (leftJ j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (rightJ j))
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ)
      let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ea) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eb)
      let Ls := conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
      let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
      let n := Subgroup.relIndex Limage Ls
      let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
      let q := fun w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis w)
      Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex Limage Ls →
        ∃ hf : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
            Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z},
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex ML M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ ea eb [(1, d)]
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ ea eb [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
          let pThenIota := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι
          let iotaThenP := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical ι p
          let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex ML ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ML)
          let evaluate := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
              (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
          let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
          let P := fun j : J =>
            show ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex]
                ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) from by
              classical
              exact Finsupp.lsum Complex (fun z =>
                if MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ z ∈ orbit j
                then Finsupp.lsingle z else 0)
          let finiteQ := fun z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
            show Set.Finite {w | q w = q z} from
              Set.Finite.subset (hf (qBasis z)) (by
                intro w hw
                exact (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective hw)

            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate pThenIota) =
              (n : Complex) • P j ∧
            (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate iotaThenP)
                  (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) =
                Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finiteQ z))
                  (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex))) ∧
            (evaluate iotaThenP = evaluate straight ↔
              n = 1) ∧
            (1 < n → ∀ c : Complex,
              evaluate (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale c iotaThenP) ≠
                evaluate straight)

    (hβ' : ∀ k : K, β' * (k : U) * (β')⁻¹ ∈ H'),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let c := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let f := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α' hα'
  let b' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β' hβ'
  let u := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let v := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp c f
  let w := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'
  let evalDrawing {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K G}
      (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let singleton {p q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot p q) :
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex p q :=
    Finsupp.single d 1
  let twoCrossings (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u v)
      (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex v w) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown a b c f (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms D))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown c f a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms E))

    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown a b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing label)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)

        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2

        change (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H

        change h ∈ H at hh
        convert hh using 1
        group)

          intro ℓ

      let rightJ := right Lj (le_refl Lj)

          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ hJFinite

        let outerJ := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pJ iotaJ

          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval iotaL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) =
            Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q z)) 1) ∧
        (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit →
          Nat.card (fiber g) = n ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval pL)
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) = fiberSum g) ∧

          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL)

    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),

  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD

  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC

  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF

  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce

      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)

  let top := word gc ce ef

    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))

    fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂)

    fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)

  let rightEval := fun d : RightLabels => MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (rightDiagram d))

  let rightSetoid := Setoid.ker rightEval

    (∀ d : LeftLabels, rightMultiplier (φ d) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ e : RightLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ e) = rightMultiplier e) ∧

      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b)) =>
    ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (down α) (up β))).carrier,
      Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b d w = z}
  let multiply := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b), fun _ => True,
      fun x _ => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β a b
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x)⟩ :
      Stage (tensor (up a) (down b)) (tensor (down α) (up β)))
  let projectionTerms := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b))
      (hx : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, finiteFibers α β a b d) =>
    (Finset.toList (Finset.attach (Finsupp.support x))).map fun d =>
      (x d.val, (⟨d.val, hx d.val d.property⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β a b))
  let project := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b), finiteFibers α β a b,
      fun x hx => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β a b
        (projectionTerms α β a b x hx)⟩ :
      Stage (tensor (down α) (up β)) (tensor (up a) (down b)))
  let eval := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret d)
  let planar := fun (bottom top : List Bool) (wiring : List MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent) =>
    (⟨bottom, top, Quotient.mk MackeyDiagrams.PlanarCode.setoid wiring⟩ :
      MackeyDiagrams.PlanarShape)
  let leftShape := fun (bottom top : List Bool) (a b c : MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind) =>
    planar bottom top
      [MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 0 a, MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 1 b,
        MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 0 c]
  let rightShape := fun (bottom top : List Bool) (a b c : MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind) =>
    planar bottom top
      [MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 1 a, MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 0 b,
        MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 1 c]
  let realizes := fun {K H : Subgroup U}
      {bottom p q top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (first : Stage bottom p) (second : Stage p q) (third : Stage q top)
      (shape : MackeyDiagrams.PlanarShape) =>
    ∀ (x : Finsupp first.1 Complex) (y : Finsupp second.1 Complex)
      (z : Finsupp third.1 Complex)
      (hx : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, first.2.1 d)
      (hy : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support y, second.2.1 d)
      (hz : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support z, third.2.1 d),
      let d₁ := first.2.2 x hx
      let d₂ := second.2.2 y hy
      let d₃ := third.2.2 z hz
      let drawing := stack d₁ (stack d₂ d₃)
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape drawing = shape ∧
        eval drawing = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (eval d₁)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (eval d₂) (eval d₃))
  (∀ {A B : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B) (p : U)
      (_ : ∀ x : A, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a x : U) = MulAut.conj p (x : U)),
    {q : U | ∀ x : A, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a x : U) = MulAut.conj q (x : U)} =
      {q : U | p⁻¹ * q ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (A : Set U)}) ∧
  (∀ {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b)),
    let inner := tensor (up a) (down b)
    let q := fun (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis inner).carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b d w)
    let traceDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse d
    let traceInput := fun (z : G) (t : H) =>
      z * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β t)⁻¹ * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element traceDot
    let traceSurvivors := fun (T : Set H) (z : G) =>
      {t : H | t ∈ T ∧ traceInput z t ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α)}
    (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
      q (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b) k h) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α k * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β h) ∧
    (∀ w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis inner).carrier,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) α β a b d))
          (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β (q w)) 1) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element traceDot = (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d)⁻¹ ∧
    (∀ hf : ∀ z : G, Set.Finite {w | q w = z},
      let diagram := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β a b d
        (fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hf (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β z))
          (fun _ hw => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β) hw))
      let valueAt := fun z : G => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval diagram)
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β z) 1)
      (∀ z : G, valueAt z = Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hf z))
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Set H)
          (_ : ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H, t ∈ T ∧
            h * t⁻¹ ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b))
          (z : G),
        ∃ hs : Set.Finite (traceSurvivors T z),
          valueAt z = Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset hs) (fun t =>
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex α (traceInput z t))
              (Finsupp.single t 1))))) ∧
  (∀ {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b)),
    (∀ w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (up a) (down b))).carrier,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval ((multiply α β a b).2.2 x (fun _ _ => True.intro)))
          (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        List.sum (List.map (fun term =>
          term.1 • Finsupp.single
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b term.2 w) 1)
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))) ∧
    (∀ hx : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, finiteFibers α β a b d,
      let terms := projectionTerms α β a b x hx
      let drawing := (project α β a b).2.2 x hx
      eval drawing = eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection α β a b terms
        MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.cupAndMerge MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.splitAndTrace) ∧
      (∀ z : G,
        let basis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β z
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval drawing) (Finsupp.single basis 1) =
          List.sum (List.map (fun term =>
            term.1 • Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset
              (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite
                (multiplication := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b)
                term.2 basis)) (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) terms)))) ∧
  (∀ {G A D F C E B B' : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
      (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G) (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D)
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B) (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
    let left₁ := at₁ (project a b r s) (up c)
    let left₂ := at₂ (up r) (project s c t f)
    let left₃ := at₁ (parallel r t d e) (down f)
    let right₁ := at₂ (down a) (parallel b c u' w)
    let right₂ := at₁ (project a u' d v) (up w)
    let right₃ := at₂ (up d) (project v w e f)
    let left₁' := at₁ (parallel d e r t) (down f)
    let left₂' := at₂ (up r) (multiply s c t f)
    let left₃' := at₁ (multiply a b r s) (up c)
    let right₁' := at₂ (up d) (multiply v w e f)
    let right₂' := at₁ (multiply a u' d v) (up w)
    let right₃' := at₂ (down a) (parallel u' w b c)
    let projectLeft := realizes left₁ left₂ left₃
      (leftShape [false, true, true] [true, true, false]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp)
    let projectRight := realizes right₁ right₂ right₃
      (rightShape [false, true, true] [true, true, false]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection)
    let multiplyLeft := realizes left₁' left₂' left₃'
      (leftShape [true, true, false] [false, true, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication)
    let multiplyRight := realizes right₁' right₂' right₃'
      (rightShape [true, true, false] [false, true, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp)
    let cases : List (Nat × (Prop × Prop)) :=
      [(1, (projectLeft, projectRight)), (2, (projectRight, projectLeft)),
       (3, (multiplyLeft, multiplyRight)), (4, (multiplyRight, multiplyLeft))]
    ∀ direction ∈ cases, direction.2.1 ∧ direction.2.2) ∧
  (∀ {G A D F C E B B' : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
      (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
      (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B) (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F) (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
    let left₁ := at₁ (multiply u' v a b) (up d)
    let left₂ := at₂ (down u') (parallel v d w f)
    let left₃ := at₁ (project u' w c e) (up f)
    let right₁ := at₂ (up a) (project b d i j)
    let right₂ := at₁ (parallel a i c k) (down j)
    let right₃ := at₂ (up c) (multiply e f k j)
    let mixedLeft := realizes left₁ left₂ left₃
      (leftShape [true, false, true] [true, false, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection)
    let mixedRight := realizes right₁ right₂ right₃
      (rightShape [true, false, true] [true, false, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication)
    let cases : List (Nat × (Prop × Prop)) :=
      [(5, (mixedLeft, mixedRight)), (6, (mixedRight, mixedLeft))]
    ∀ direction ∈ cases, direction.2.1 ∧ direction.2.2)
MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention.sourceReason:
Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.2, unnumbered mixed-crossing convention, printed pp. 21–22 of the archived project PDF `source/mackey-bimodules.pdf` (SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2). The archived drawings for Cases 1–2, 3–4 and 5–6 are on printed pp. 22, 24 and 25, respectively.

The 27 November 2026 published revision has the same convention on printed pp. 23–24 and the corresponding drawings on printed pp. 24, 26 and 27. Its SHA-256 is 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e, matching the project copy `article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf`. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The designated defect report returned HTTP 404 with and without the trailing slash. No correction for this endpoint could be verified, so the archived article supplies the statement. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The owner clarification dated 27 November 2026 in `input.request` supplies the finite complex label convention. The supplied request has no separate ID. Each marked crossing vertex carries a finite complex linear combination of termwise eligible group elements, with a coefficient-one singleton for a group-element dot. The typed composites retain the fixed boundary embeddings and their centralizer cosets, the bottom-to-top crossing order, and the six numbered directions. Each supported projection term uses the inverse trace dot and requires finite fibers, including when the standalone cup has infinite index. The singleton multiplication formula is explicitly over `Complex`. Lean elaborated the complete type with the registered `MixedCrossingFiberMaps` prerequisite through the shared slot.

ParabolicBlockOperationExample.sourceReason: Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 7.1 [ex:parabolic-block-operations], p. 29. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte, and the article webpage gives the same example. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no statement correction for this example. Both block families include the prescribed singleton blocks. Each factor fixes its complement in Nat pointwise, so all groups in the calculation consist of finitely supported permutations. The supremum of the disjoint block factors represents their product. The join of A and B is the subgroup generated by their union. The product of swaps defining α sends 1 to 4, 4 to 6, and 6 to 1. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  let bcf := comp bc f
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
      (drawId (down f))
  let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
  let finiteFibers := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}
  let Parameter := MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f
  let Q := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a bc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a bc de f p w)
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f
        (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p)))
  let intersection := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) =>
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a) ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p)))
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc))
  let lower := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ade)
  let terms := fun {X : Type u} (label : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    List.map (fun x => (label x, x)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label))
  let evaluates := fun {X Y Z : Type u}
      (drawing : List (Complex × X) → List (Complex × Y) → List (Complex × Z) →
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    (∀ (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z), ∃! p : Parameter,
      eval (drawing [(1, x)] [(1, y)] [(1, z)]) = Qstar p) ∧
    (∀ (xs : Finsupp X Complex) (ys : Finsupp Y Complex) (zs : Finsupp Z Complex),
      ∃! coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
        eval (drawing (terms xs) (terms ys) (terms zs)) =
          Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p))
  (∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf,
    lower ≤ intersection p ∧
    (finiteFibers a bc de f p ↔ Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf lower (intersection p))) ∧
    (∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      Q p (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc h)) ∧
  (∀ (p : Parameter) (z : A),
    Qstar p (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z) 1) =
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z)))
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1) ∧
    (z ∈ Set.range (Q (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)) →
      Nat.card {w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier // Q (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) w = z} =
        Subgroup.relIndex lower (intersection (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)))) ∧
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
    evaluates (fun
      (xs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s))
      (ys : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f))
      (zs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de)) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s xs) (drawId (up c)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f ys))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e zs) (drawId (down f)))))) ∧
  (∀ {B' : Subgroup U} (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
    evaluates (fun
      (ells : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u' w)))
      (ms : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a u' d v))
      (ns : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (atRight (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c u' w ells))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a u' d v ms) (drawId (up w)))

∀ (X : Finset Nat) (r c : Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset ↥X) (B : Fin c → Finset ↥X),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ j, x ∈ B j) →
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
  let K : Subgroup G := iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))
  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))
  let Mat := {R : Fin r → Fin c → Nat //
    (∀ i, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R i) = Finset.card (A i)) ∧
    (∀ j, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => R i j) = Finset.card (B j))}
  let rank := fun (S : Finset ↥X) (x : ↥S) =>
    ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
  ∃ classify : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G) ≃ Mat,
    (∀ (σ : G) i j, (classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H σ)).val i j =
      Finset.card (A i ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (B j))) ∧
    ∀ R : Mat, ∃ σ : G,
      DoubleCoset.mk K H σ = classify.symm R ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (x : ↥(A i)) (y : ↥(B j)),
        σ y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin (R.val i j),
            rank (A i) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio j) (fun j' => R.val i j') + k.val ∧
            rank (B j) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio i) (fun i' => R.val i' j) + k.val

∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
    let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
    let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
    let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
    let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
    let sourcePair := tensor (up a) (down b)
    let targetPair := tensor (up c) (down e)
    let targetBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis targetPair
    let bottom := tensor sourcePair (up d)
    let top := tensor targetPair (up f)
    let RDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α a) (comp β b)
    let TDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp β d) (comp γ f)
    let SDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α c) (comp γ e)
    let q := fun (s : SDot) (p : targetBasis.carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α γ c e s p)
    let finiteFibers := fun (s : SDot) => ∀ z : B, Set.Finite {p | q s p = z}
    let projectionDot := fun (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) =>
      (⟨s, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hs (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ z))
        (fun _ hz => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ) hz)⟩ :
          MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)
    let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
    let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
    let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
    let drawing := fun (rs : List (Complex × RDot)) (ts : List (Complex × TDot))
        (ss : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)) =>
      (stack
        (juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β a b rs)
          (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up d))))
        (stack
          (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down α) (up β) (up d)))
          (stack
            (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down α)))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp β d γ f ts))
            (stack
              (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down α) (up γ) (up f)))
              (juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α γ c e ss)
                (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up f))))))) :
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis sourcePair)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b) g x) 1
    let output := fun (p : targetBasis.carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair targetBasis (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction f) p 1
    let evaluates := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
        (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret diagram))
        (Finsupp.single (input g x) 1)
    let fiberSum := fun (r : RDot) (t : TDot) (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D) =>
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hs
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β x * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)))
        (fun p => Finsupp.single (output p) (1 : Complex))
    (∀ (r : RDot) (t : TDot) (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D),
      evaluates (drawing [(1, r)] [(1, t)] [(1, projectionDot s hs)]) g x =
        fiberSum r t s hs g x) ∧
    (∀ (rs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp α a) (comp β b))
        (ts : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp β d) (comp γ f))
        (ss : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp α c) (comp γ e))
        (hs : ∀ s ∈ Finsupp.support ss, finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D),
      let supported := Finset.attach (Finsupp.support ss)
      let terms := List.map (fun s =>
        (ss (Subtype.val s), projectionDot (Subtype.val s) (hs (Subtype.val s) (Subtype.property s))))
        (Finset.toList supported)
      evaluates (drawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts) terms) g x =
        Finsupp.sum rs (fun r cr =>
          Finsupp.sum ts (fun t ct =>
            Finset.sum supported (fun s =>
              (cr * ct * ss (Subtype.val s)) •
                fiberSum r t (Subtype.val s) (hs (Subtype.val s) (Subtype.property s)) g x))))) ∧
  (∀ (B' : Subgroup U)
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
    let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
    let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
    let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
    let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
    let ga := up a
    let ad := down b
    let df := up d
    let ai := up i
    let fj := down j
    let gc := up c
    let ck := up k
    let ce := down e
    let ef := up f
    let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
    let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
    let LowerDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j)
    let MiddleDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
    let UpperDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
    let FiberWord := tensor ai fj
    let q := fun (r : LowerDot) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis FiberWord).carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w)
    let finiteFibers := fun (r : LowerDot) => ∀ x : D, Set.Finite {w | q r w = x}
    let projectionTerm := fun (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r) =>
      (⟨r, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hr (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d z))
        (fun _ hw => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d) hw)⟩ :
          MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
    let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
    let rightDrawing := fun
        (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
        (middle : List (Complex × MiddleDot)) (upper : List (Complex × UpperDot)) =>
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga)
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k middle) (drawId fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc)
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper))))) :
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
        (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
        (Finsupp.single
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)) 1)
    let formula := fun (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r)
        (t : MiddleDot) (s : UpperDot) (g : G) (x : D) =>
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hr x)) (fun w =>
        let representative : A × F := Quotient.out w
        Finsupp.single
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef))
            (g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a representative.1 *
              MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f
              (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s *
                MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f representative.2))) (1 : Complex))
    (∀ (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r) (t : MiddleDot) (s : UpperDot) (g : G) (x : D),
      evaluate (rightDrawing [(1, projectionTerm r hr)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]) g x =
        formula r hr t s g x) ∧
    (∀ (R : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b i) (comp d j))
        (T : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
        (S : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j))
        (hR : ∀ r ∈ Finsupp.support R, finiteFibers r) (g : G) (x : D),
      let lowerSupport := Finset.attach (Finsupp.support R)
      let lowerTerms := List.map (fun r : {r // r ∈ Finsupp.support R} =>
        (R r.val, projectionTerm r.val (hR r.val r.property))) (Finset.toList lowerSupport)
      evaluate (rightDrawing lowerTerms (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms T)
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms S)) g x =
        Finset.sum lowerSupport (fun r =>
          Finset.sum (Finsupp.support T) (fun t =>
            Finset.sum (Finsupp.support S) (fun s =>
              (R r.val * T t * S s) • formula r.val (hR r.val r.property) t s g x)))))

∀ (X : Finset Nat) (r c : Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset ↥X) (B : Fin c → Finset ↥X),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (A i)) →
  (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (B j)) →
  Pairwise (fun i i' => Disjoint (A i) (A i')) →
  Pairwise (fun j j' => Disjoint (B j) (B j')) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) →
  (∀ x : ↥X, ∃ j, x ∈ B j) →
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
  let K : Subgroup G := iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))
  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))
  ∀ σ : G,
    K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj σ)) H =
      iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j =>
        blockSym (A i ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (B j))))

∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let ga := up a
  let ad := down b
  let df := up d
  let gc := up c
  let ce := down e
  let ef := up f
  let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
  let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
  let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
  let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
  let Pair := X.carrier × Y.carrier
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
      mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
  let orbit : Pair → Set Pair := MulAction.orbit (G × F)
  let coefficient := fun (M : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (z : Pair) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)) z.2
  let MiddleLabel := fun (P : Subgroup U)
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A) (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P C) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
  let UpperLabel := fun (P : Subgroup U)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F) (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P C) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
  let ProjectionTerm := fun (P : Subgroup U)
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let rightDrawing := fun (P : Subgroup U)
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P C)
      (lower : List (Complex × ProjectionTerm P i j))
      (middle : List (Complex × MiddleLabel P i k))
      (upper : List (Complex × UpperLabel P j k)) =>
    let ai := up i
    let fj := down j
    let ck := up k
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k middle) (drawId fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc)
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper))))) :
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
  let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let IsRightTerm := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    ∃ (P : Subgroup U) (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F) (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P C)
      (lower : List (Complex × ProjectionTerm P i j))
      (middle : List (Complex × MiddleLabel P i k))
      (upper : List (Complex × UpperLabel P j k)),
      drawing = rightDrawing P i j k lower middle upper
  ∀ (M : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y),
    let supported : Set (Set Pair) := {O | ∃ z : Pair, O = orbit z ∧ coefficient M z ≠ 0}
    (∃ (I : type_of% U) (weight : I → Complex)
        (diagram : I → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top),
      (∀ i, IsRightTerm (diagram i)) ∧
      let summand := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (weight i) (diagram i)
      ∃ finite : ∀ v : Finsupp X.carrier Complex,
          Set.Finite (Function.support fun i =>
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval (summand i)) v),
        let expansion : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex bottom top I :=
          ⟨summand, finite⟩
        M = MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing.evalHom expansion) ∧
    ((∃ terms : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top),
        (∀ term ∈ terms, IsRightTerm term.2) ∧
        let expansion : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top (Fin terms.length) :=
          ⟨Finset.univ, fun i =>
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (terms.get i).1 (terms.get i).2⟩
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M = MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval expansion) ↔
      Set.Finite supported)
ExpansionIntoRightDiagrams.sourceReason:
Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.3.1, Theorem 6.7 [thm:three-orbits], printed p. 26 of the archived project PDF source/mackey-bimodules.pdf. The archive gives the mixed-crossing convention on p. 22 and the fixed boundary and right shape on p. 25. The corresponding printed pages in the current published PDF are 28, 24 and 27, respectively. The current download has SHA-256 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61. Its convention on printed p. 6 specifies equality of evaluated bimodule maps at a common boundary, including pointwise-finite indexed sums. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

For each bimodule map at the fixed boundary, the pointwise sum has an existential index type, arbitrary complex weights on typed right diagrams, finite support on each input, and evaluation equal to the map. The independent finite-sum criterion compares evaluated finite combinations, including the empty combination, with finiteness of the supported simultaneous G × F orbits. The specific displayed identity for a left diagram on archived p. 27 and published p. 29 is the separate CaseFivePointwiseFiniteDiagramIdentity endpoint.

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification recorded in translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139 gives each of the three marks an independent finite complex linear label of termwise eligible group elements, including zero. The lower mixed projection requires finite fibers for each term’s multiplication parameter, the inverse of its trace dot. The middle mark is a parallel induction crossing and the upper mark is a mixed multiplication.

let T : Subgroup U := ⊥
let P : Subgroup U := ⊤
let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id T

    hasRepresentative := ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩ }

let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
let boundary := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up b))
let openRight := tensor (tensor (up a) (up a)) (down a)

  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) w)
let associate := fun {K H J F : Subgroup U}
    (x : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) (y : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J)
    (z : MackeyDiagrams.Word J F) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (R := Complex) x y z)

    (x : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) (y : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J)
    (z : MackeyDiagrams.Word J F) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) x y z)
