    (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M) (h : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H M)
    (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp f l) (comp h r)) =>
  ({ dot := d
     finite := fun z => by
       let : Finite U := inferInstanceAs (Finite (ZMod 2))
       let : Finite ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (up l) (down r))).carrier) := by
         change Finite (Quotient (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.balance
           (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction l) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction r)))
         infer_instance
       exact Set.toFinite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis f h l r d w = z}
    } : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed f h l r)

    (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp p b) (comp p b))
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp p b)) =>

  let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp p b p b
    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms t)
  let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b p a b
    (List.map (fun cs => (cs.1, projectionTerm b p a b cs.2)) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms s))

    (r : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a))
    (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a a) (comp a a))
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a)) =>

  (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval mergeToApex))
  (eval (rightBelow r))

let rightDot := fun x : U =>
  ({ element := Subgroup.topEquiv.symm x
     intertwines := fun h => by
       have hh : h = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _

    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) (comp a a)) (Finsupp.single (rightDot s) 1)

  Finsupp.single
    (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b))) 1
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b b (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm x))) (1 : Complex)
eval left = LinearMap.id ∧
  Nonempty ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis apex).carrier ≃ Unit) ∧
  (∀ (r : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a a) (comp a a))

    eval (rightDrawing r t s) = LinearMap.comp (fromApex t s) (toApex r) ∧
    eval (rightDrawing r t s) ≠ eval left) ∧
  eval left = eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add (singletonRight 1 1) (singletonRight g g)) ∧

∀ (n n1 n2 : Nat), 1 ≤ n1 → n1 < n → 1 ≤ n2 → n2 < n →
  let X : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 n
  let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
  let interval := fun lo hi : Nat =>
    Finset.filter (fun x : ↥X => lo ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ hi) Finset.univ
  let XBlock : Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun r =>
    if r = 0 then interval 1 n1 else interval (n1 + 1) n
  let YBlock : Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun c =>
    if c = 0 then interval 1 n2 else interval (n2 + 1) n
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
  let K : Subgroup G := iSup (fun r => blockSym (XBlock r))
  let H : Subgroup G := iSup (fun c => blockSym (YBlock c))
  let s := Nat.min n1 n2
  let t := Nat.max n1 n2
  let m := Nat.min s (n - t)
  let a : Fin (m + 1) → Int := fun i => Int.ofNat s - Int.ofNat i.val
  ∃ (left right : Fin m → ↥X) (σ : Fin (m + 1) → G),
    (∀ j : Fin m, (left j).val = s - j.val ∧ (right j).val = t + j.val + 1) ∧
    let τ : Fin m → G := fun j => Equiv.swap (left j) (right j)
    σ 0 = 1 ∧
    (∀ j : Fin m, σ (Fin.succ j) = τ j * σ (Fin.castSucc j)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (Equiv.Perm.support (τ j)) (Equiv.Perm.support (τ k))) ∧
    Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i)) ∧
    Set.BijOn a Set.univ
      (Set.Icc (max 0 (Int.ofNat n1 + Int.ofNat n2 - Int.ofNat n)) (Int.ofNat s)) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
      let C : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun r c =>
        XBlock r ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (σ i)) (YBlock c)
      let size := fun r c => Int.ofNat (Finset.card (C r c))
      size 0 0 = a i ∧
      size 0 1 = Int.ofNat n1 - a i ∧
      size 1 0 = Int.ofNat n2 - a i ∧
      size 1 1 = Int.ofNat n - Int.ofNat n1 - Int.ofNat n2 + a i ∧
      (∀ r c, ∃ lo hi : Nat, C r c = interval lo hi) ∧
      K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i))) H =
        iSup (fun p : {p : Fin 2 × Fin 2 // Finset.Nonempty (C p.1 p.2)} =>
          blockSym (C p.val.1 p.val.2))

  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) →
  (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (A a)) →
  (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (B b)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) →
  Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (A a) (A a')) →
  Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (B b) (B b')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ A a) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ B b) →
  let blockSym := fun S : Finset Nat =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  let G : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i))
  let K₀ : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a))
  let H₀ : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))
  K₀ ≤ G → H₀ ≤ G →
  let K := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) K₀
  let H := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) H₀
  let Gᵢ := fun i : Fin g => Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)
  let rows := fun i : Fin g =>
    Finset.filter (fun a : Fin r => A a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
  let cols := fun i : Fin g =>
    Finset.filter (fun b : Fin c => B b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
  let row := fun (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
    Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
      (A ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val))
  let col := fun (i : Fin g) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
    Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
      (B ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val))
  let localSym := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : ↥(D i) => n ∈ S))
  let Kᵢ := fun i : Fin g => iSup (fun a => localSym i (row i a))
  let Hᵢ := fun i : Fin g => iSup (fun b => localSym i (col i b))
  let Mat := fun i : Fin g =>
    {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
      (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
      (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
  let rank := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) (x : ↥S) =>
    ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
  let Q := DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G)
  let Qᵢ := fun i : Fin g => DoubleCoset.Quotient (Kᵢ i : Set (Gᵢ i)) (Hᵢ i : Set (Gᵢ i))
  let extend := fun (i : Fin g) (σ : Gᵢ i) =>
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i) σ
  (∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i) ∧
  (∀ b, ∃ i, B b ⊆ D i) ∧
  ∃ (split : G ≃* (∀ i, Gᵢ i)) (quotientSplit : Q ≃ (∀ i, Qᵢ i))
    (classify : ∀ i, Qᵢ i ≃ Mat i) (localRep : ∀ i, Mat i → Gᵢ i)
    (rep : (∀ i, Mat i) → G),
    (∀ (σ : G) (i : Fin g) (x : ↥(D i)),
      (split σ i x).val = (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x.val) ∧
    (∀ σ : G, (σ ∈ K ↔ ∀ i, split σ i ∈ Kᵢ i) ∧
      (σ ∈ H ↔ ∀ i, split σ i ∈ Hᵢ i)) ∧
    (∀ (σ : G) i,
      quotientSplit (DoubleCoset.mk K H σ) i = DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split σ i)) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin g) (σ : Gᵢ i) a b,

    (∀ (i : Fin g) (R : Mat i),
      DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (localRep i R) = (classify i).symm R) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin g) (R : Mat i), Kᵢ i ≠ ⊤ → Hᵢ i ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        localRep i R y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin (R.val a b),
            rank i (row i a) x = Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => R.val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank i (col i b) y = Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => R.val a' b) + k.val) ∧
    (∀ i, (Kᵢ i = ⊤ ∨ Hᵢ i = ⊤) → ∀ R : Mat i, localRep i R = 1) ∧

let P := Equiv.Perm Nat

let conj := fun (s : P) => MulAut.conj s
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj s)) S
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let forward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : conjugate p S ≤ T) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
    (MonoidHom.subgroupMap (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj p)) S)
let backward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : T ≤ conjugate p S) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulEquiv.subgroupMap (conj p) S).symm)
    (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
let Mod := fun S : Subgroup P => ModuleCat.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
let Res := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod T) (Mod S))
let Ind := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
      (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
      (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
    (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))

  (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (A a)) →
  (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (B b)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) →
  Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (A a) (A a')) →
  Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (B b) (B b')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ A a) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ B b) →

  Kα = iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a)) →
  Hβ = iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b)) →

    let left := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let right := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ

      Finset.filter (fun a : Fin r => A a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let cols := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun b : Fin c => B b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ

      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (A ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val))
    let col := fun (i : Fin g) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (B ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val))

      {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //

        (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}

      (∀ R : J, DoubleCoset.mk left right (σ R) = classify.symm R) ∧

        backward ((σ R : P) * (β : P))

          blockSym (A a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (σ R : P)) (B b))))) ∧
      Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind βmap) (Res αmap))
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj

          MonoidHom.subgroupMap
            (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj (σ R : P)⁻¹)) (L R)
        ∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hHG : H ≤ G) (hLK : ∀ R : J, L R ≤ K) (hTH : ∀ R : J, T R ≤ H),
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
              (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion hHG)) (Res (Subgroup.inclusion hKG)))
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj (fun R : J =>
              CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                  (Res (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R))) (Res (transport R)))
                (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R)))))))

let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))

  parabolic K → parabolic H → parabolic G →
  let conjugate := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S

  let Hβ := conjugate β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)

    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J => Kα ⊓ conjugate ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹ (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
          change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          change k ∈ K at hk
          change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
          rw [← heq]
          convert hk using 1
          group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)

          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (r j)) := fun j =>
        ⟨σ j, by
          intro ℓ
          apply Subtype.ext
          change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
            (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *

          group⟩

      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b

      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))

          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j) w = z}),

          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) [(1, d j)]
        let p : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b (l j) (r j)

        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))

          fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j))))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))))
        let eval := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
            (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
        let indices : Finset J := @Finset.univ J finiteJ
        let summands : J → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (p j) (ι j)

          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval straight) ∧

FiniteParabolicBimoduleBicategory.sourceReason:
Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Corollary 7.5 [cor:parabolic-bicategory], p. 32. The published PDF matches the project PDF. The object data are the disjoint finite block products in the group of finitely supported permutations of Nat. The two legs of each span are conjugation embeddings in that group. The shared induction–restriction word gives the balanced biset basis of each displayed complex group-algebra tensor, and its disjoint union over a finite family gives the direct sum. Product-group representations encode the two commuting actions, with inverse right action for the second factor. All bimodules isomorphic to these sums and all bimodule maps between them are included. The balanced universal property specifies composition, and the regular bimodules, canonical maps, and coherence laws specify the bicategory. Lean checked the proposition and its implication from the translated prerequisite FiniteParabolicBicategoryComposition. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

    {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}

  change MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom =
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex b.toHom ↔
      LeftCosetEquivalence (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U) : Set U) α β

    apply coset.mp
    apply MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro h
    have coeffEq := congrArg (fun f :
        MonoidAlgebra Complex H →ₐ[Complex] MonoidAlgebra Complex G =>

FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks.proof:
by
  intro ι finite X nonempty disjoint α
  dsimp only
  rw [Subgroup.map_iSup]
  congr 1
  funext i
  let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := α
  let Y := (X i).image σ
  have mem_image (n : Nat) : n ∈ X i ↔ σ n ∈ Y := by
    simp [Y, Finset.mem_image]
  let e : {n // n ∈ X i} ≃ {n // n ∈ Y} := σ.subtypeEquiv mem_image
  have commute (f : Equiv.Perm {n // n ∈ X i}) :
      MulAut.conj σ (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype f) =
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (e.permCongr f) := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro n
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := σ.surjective n
    change σ (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype f (σ.symm (σ m))) =
      Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (e.permCongr f) (σ m)
    rw [σ.symm_apply_apply]
    by_cases hm : m ∈ X i
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem f hm,
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem _ ((mem_image m).mp hm)]
      change (e (f ⟨m, hm⟩) : Nat) = (e.permCongr f (e ⟨m, hm⟩) : Nat)
      simp
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f hm,
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ (fun h => hm ((mem_image m).mpr h))]
  apply Subgroup.ext
  intro τ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨e.permCongr f, (commute f).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := e.permCongr.surjective g
    exact ⟨Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype f, ⟨f, rfl⟩, commute f⟩

FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks.proof:
by
  intro ι κ _ _ X A B _ _ disjointA disjointB coverA coverB blockSym
  -- Steps 1–3 expand the Intersection argument in Xiao, Proposition 7.1.
  -- The context supplies no separate numbered Alphabeta Math proof for this endpoint.
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro σ hσ
    -- Step 1. Disjointness makes each factor preserve every block of its own partition.
    -- The ambient carrier is Nat, so also track the points outside the common finite set.
    obtain ⟨preserveA, fixOutside⟩ :=
      finiteParabolicIntersection_preserves_and_fixes X A disjointA coverA σ hσ.1
    obtain ⟨preserveB, _⟩ :=
      finiteParabolicIntersection_preserves_and_fixes X B disjointB coverB σ hσ.2
    -- Step 2. To pass from preservation to membership in the subgroup supremum,
    -- use Mathlib’s swap-closure criterion. The moved points lie in X, and a swap
    -- within the common refinement puts each moved x and σ x in the same orbit.
    let swaps : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) := {s | ∃ i j, ∃ x y : Nat,
      x ∈ A i ∩ B j ∧ y ∈ A i ∩ B j ∧ x ≠ y ∧ s = Equiv.swap x y}
    have genuine : ∀ s ∈ swaps, Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s := by
      rintro s ⟨i, j, x, y, _, _, hxy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩
    have swaps_le : Subgroup.closure swaps ≤
        iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j => blockSym (A i ∩ B j))) := by
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro s ⟨i, j, x, y, hx, hy, _, rfl⟩
      apply Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem i
      apply Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem j
      exact ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩
    apply swaps_le
    apply (mem_closure_isSwap genuine).mpr
    constructor
    · refine X.finite_toSet.subset ?_
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxX
      exact hx (fixOutside x hxX)
    · intro x
      apply MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · exact ⟨1, h.symm⟩
      · have hx : x ∈ X := by
          by_contra hxX
          exact h (fixOutside x hxX)
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (coverA x).mp hx
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (coverB x).mp hx
        have hswap : Equiv.swap x (σ x) ∈ Subgroup.closure swaps :=
          Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, x, σ x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi, hj⟩,
            Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨preserveA i x hi, preserveB j x hj⟩, Ne.symm h, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨Equiv.swap x (σ x), hswap⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩
  · -- Step 3. A factor of the refinement embeds into each parent factor.
    -- This restriction argument also applies to the empty block, whose extension is trivial.
    have block_mono {S T : Finset Nat} (hST : S ⊆ T) : blockSym S ≤ blockSym T := by
      rintro f ⟨g, rfl⟩
      have fix (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ T) : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g x = x :=
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g (fun hxS => hx (hST hxS))
      have preserve (x : Nat) : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g x ∈ T ↔ x ∈ T := by
        by_cases hx : x ∈ S
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem g hx]
          exact iff_of_true (hST (g ⟨x, hx⟩).property) (hST hx)
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g hx]
      exact ⟨(Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g).subtypePerm preserve,
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserve (fun x hm => by
          by_contra hx
          exact hm (fix x hx))⟩
    refine iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun j => le_inf ?_ ?_
    · exact (block_mono Finset.inter_subset_left).trans (le_iSup (fun k => blockSym (A k)) i)
    · exact (block_mono Finset.inter_subset_right).trans (le_iSup (fun k => blockSym (B k)) j)
FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks.support:
private theorem finiteParabolicIntersection_preserves_and_fixes {ι : Type*} (X : Finset Nat)
    (D : ι → Finset Nat) (disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (cover : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ D i) (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)
    (hσ : σ ∈ iSup (fun i =>
      MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ D i)))) :
    (∀ i x, x ∈ D i → σ x ∈ D i) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ X → σ x = x) := by
  classical
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction _ (C := fun f : Equiv.Perm Nat =>
    (∀ i x, x ∈ D i → f x ∈ D i) ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ X → f x = x)) hσ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro j f hf
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hf
    constructor
    · intro i x hx
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem g x).mpr hx
      · have hxj : x ∉ D j := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint hij) hx h
        rwa [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g hxj]
    · intro x hx
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g
        (fun h => hx ((cover x).mpr ⟨j, h⟩))
  · exact ⟨fun _ _ hx => hx, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  · intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨fun i x hx => hf.1 i (g x) (hg.1 i x hx), ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    change f (g x) = x
    rw [hg.2 x hx, hf.2 x hx]

external.usage: The identity extension defines each block factor and shows that its elements preserve the block and fix its complement. For a refinement factor, apply ofSubtype_subtypePerm after proving preservation of each parent block and pointwise fixing of its complement.
When both endpoints belong to a refinement block, the swap on the block subtype extends to the required ambient swap. This puts each generator in the corresponding factor of the subgroup supremum.

Apply the reverse direction to genuine swaps within refinement blocks. The common finite carrier contains all moved points, and the identity or the swap of a point with its image supplies each orbit witness.

ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.proof:
by
  intro R M N _ _ _ _ _ F gen H T τ
  -- The right action is an action of the opposite ring, as in Bimodule.
  -- Mathlib's TensorProduct.liftAddHom needs a commutative base semiring.
  -- The present quotient and the additive suppliers work for the given Ring R.
  let q : F →+ T := QuotientAddGroup.mk' H
  have killRelation (x : F) (hx : x ∈ H) : q x = 0 := by
    apply AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mp
    rwa [QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk']
  -- Alphabeta Math 1.2 uses balance of elementary tensors from its presentation
  -- hypothesis L1. Here we first prove that balance in the specified quotient.
  have addLeft (m m' : M) (n : N) :
      τ (m + m', n) = τ (m, n) + τ (m', n) := by
    have h := killRelation (gen (m + m', n) - gen (m, n) - gen (m', n))
      (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨m, m', n, rfl⟩))
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have addRight (m : M) (n n' : N) :
      τ (m, n + n') = τ (m, n) + τ (m, n') := by
    have h := killRelation (gen (m, n + n') - gen (m, n) - gen (m, n'))
      (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨m, n, n', rfl⟩)))
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have balance (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
      τ (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) = τ (m, r • n) := by
    have h := killRelation (gen (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) - gen (m, r • n))
      (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, m, n, rfl⟩)))
    rw [map_sub] at h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  refine ⟨⟨addLeft, addRight, balance⟩, ?_⟩
  intro A _ Bal
  -- Step 1.2 now restricts each additive homomorphism to elementary tensors.
  let restrict (f : T →+ A) : Bal :=
    ⟨fun p => f (τ p),
      fun m m' n => (congrArg f (addLeft m m' n)).trans (map_add f _ _),
      fun m n n' => (congrArg f (addRight m n n')).trans (map_add f _ _),
      fun r m n => congrArg f (balance r m n)⟩
  -- Steps 1.1 and 2.1 use the integer scalar action on A. The additive
  -- Finsupp equivalence extends the maps k ↦ k • b(p) on the basis summands.
  let extend (b : Bal) : F →+ A :=
    Finsupp.liftAddHom (fun p => zmultiplesHom A (b.val p))
  have extendGen (b : Bal) (p : M × N) : extend b (gen p) = b.val p := by
    change Finsupp.liftAddHom (fun p => zmultiplesHom A (b.val p))
      (Finsupp.single p (1 : ℤ)) = b.val p
    rw [Finsupp.liftAddHom_apply_single]
    change (1 : ℤ) • b.val p = b.val p
    exact one_zsmul _
  -- Step 3.1 kills all generators using the three balanced-map laws,
  -- and closure then gives the kernel containment for the full subgroup.
  have relationKernel (b : Bal) : H ≤ (extend b).ker := by
    apply (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).2
    intro x hx
    apply AddMonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr
    rcases hx with ⟨m, m', n, rfl⟩ | ⟨m, n, n', rfl⟩ | ⟨r, m, n, rfl⟩
    · rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, extendGen, extendGen, extendGen, b.property.1, sub_self]
    · rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, extendGen, extendGen, extendGen, b.property.2.1, sub_self]
    · rw [map_sub, extendGen, extendGen, b.property.2.2, sub_self]
  -- Step 4.1 descends explicitly. Normality follows from commutativity of F.
  let descend (b : Bal) : T →+ A :=
    QuotientAddGroup.lift H (extend b) (relationKernel b)
  have descendGen (b : Bal) (p : M × N) : descend b (τ p) = b.val p := by
    exact (QuotientAddGroup.lift_mk H (relationKernel b) (gen p)).trans (extendGen b p)
  -- Step 5.1 uses quotient surjectivity and extensionality on the integer
  -- summands. An additive homomorphism out of ℤ is determined by its value at 1.
  have tensorExt (f g : T →+ A) (h : ∀ p, f (τ p) = g (τ p)) : f = g := by
    have hfree : f.comp q = g.comp q := by
      apply Finsupp.addHom_ext'
      intro p
      apply (zmultiplesHom A).symm.injective
      change f (τ p) = g (τ p)
      exact h p
    apply AddMonoidHom.ext
    intro t
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk'_surjective H t
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfree x
  -- These inverse laws give both conclusions. Step 6.1 covers zero modules
  -- and the zero ring through the same construction, so no case split is needed.
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro b
    refine ⟨descend b, fun m n => descendGen b (m, n), ?_⟩
    intro f hf
    exact tensorExt f (descend b) (fun p => (hf p.1 p.2).trans (descendGen b p).symm)
  · refine ⟨⟨restrict, descend, ?_, ?_⟩, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
    · intro f
      exact tensorExt (descend (restrict f)) f (descendGen (restrict f))
    · intro b
      exact Subtype.ext (funext (descendGen b))

external.usage: In Steps 1.1 and 2.1 the additive Finsupp equivalence extends the integer-summand maps. Its singleton formula at coefficient 1 gives the prescribed generator values.

In Step 4.1 the lift descends the free additive map through the exact subgroup of relations. The ambient group is abelian and Step 3.1 supplies the kernel containment. The quotient lift formula evaluates the descended map at each generator.
In Step 5.1 surjectivity of the additive quotient map transfers equality on all Finsupp representatives to equality on the tensor quotient.
The kernel formula kills all relations used to prove the balance and two additivity laws needed in Step 1.2.
In Step 3.1 closure extends vanishing on the three relation families to containment of their generated additive subgroup in the kernel.
In Step 5.1 equality on the integer summands determines equality of the two additive homomorphisms on the free group.
In Step 2.1 this equivalence gives the additive map from integers taking 1 to the supplied value. In Step 5.1 its inverse is evaluation at 1, so equality there gives agreement on the whole summand.

FiniteParabolicJoinBlocks.proof:
by
  intro ι κ _ _ X A B _ _ _ _ coversA coversB blockSym block graph componentBlock
  let swaps (S : Finset Nat) : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    {σ | ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ σ = Equiv.swap x y}
  have swap_mem_block (S : Finset Nat) {x y : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) :
      Equiv.swap x y ∈ blockSym S :=
    ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩
  -- Alphabeta Math, "Every finite permutation is a product of transpositions",
  -- steps 1.1 and 2.1 generate the finite symmetric group by factoring cycles.
  -- For a block embedded in Nat we use the finitary swap-closure criterion.
  -- Distinct endpoints give genuine swaps, the block bounds the support, and
  -- the swap of a moved point with its image witnesses the orbit condition.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
  have blockSym_eq_closure (S : Finset Nat) : blockSym S = Subgroup.closure (swaps S) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
      have genuine : ∀ f ∈ swaps S, Equiv.Perm.IsSwap f := by
        rintro f ⟨x, _, y, _, hxy, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩
      apply (mem_closure_isSwap genuine).2
      have fixesOutside (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ S) : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ x = x :=
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hx
      refine ⟨S.finite_toSet.subset ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x hx
        by_contra hxS
        exact hx ((MulAction.mem_fixedBy).2 (fixesOutside x hxS))
      · intro x
        by_cases heq : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ x = x
        · rw [heq]
          exact MulAction.mem_orbit_self x
        · have hx : x ∈ S := by
            by_contra hx
            exact heq (fixesOutside x hx)
          have hy : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ x ∈ S := by
            rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem τ hx]
            exact (τ ⟨x, hx⟩).property
          have hs : Equiv.swap (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ x) x ∈ Subgroup.closure (swaps S) :=
            Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨_, hy, _, hx, heq, rfl⟩
          exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨⟨_, hs⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_right _ _⟩
    · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
      rintro σ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, _, rfl⟩
      exact swap_mem_block S hx hy
  have mem_component (c : graph.ConnectedComponent) (x : Nat) :
      x ∈ componentBlock c ↔ x ∈ X ∧
        ∃ v : Sum ι κ, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v :=
    @Finset.mem_filter Nat _ (Classical.decPred _) _ _
  -- In Proposition 7.1 each input block lies in the union indexed by the
  -- component of its vertex. Here coverage puts that block inside X.
  -- Every generating swap acts inside that component and fixes its complement,
  -- giving the containment of the input join by the closure description.
  have subset_component (v : Sum ι κ) : block v ⊆ componentBlock (graph.connectedComponentMk v) := by
    intro x hx
    apply (mem_component _ _).2
    refine ⟨?_, v, rfl, hx⟩
    cases v with
    | inl i => exact (coversA x).2 ⟨i, hx⟩
    | inr j => exact (coversB x).2 ⟨j, hx⟩
  have block_le_component (v : Sum ι κ) :
      blockSym (block v) ≤ iSup (fun c => blockSym (componentBlock c)) := by
    apply le_trans _ (le_iSup (fun c => blockSym (componentBlock c)) (graph.connectedComponentMk v))
    rw [blockSym_eq_closure (block v)]
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    rintro σ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, _, rfl⟩
    exact swap_mem_block _ (subset_component v hx) (subset_component v hy)
  let joined := (iSup fun i => blockSym (A i)) ⊔ (iSup fun j => blockSym (B j))
  have block_le_join (v : Sum ι κ) : blockSym (block v) ≤ joined := by
    cases v with
    | inl i => exact le_trans (le_iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i)) i) le_sup_left
    | inr j => exact le_trans (le_iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j)) j) le_sup_right
  have edge_overlap {u v : Sum ι κ} (h : graph.Adj u v) :
      ∃ x : Nat, x ∈ block u ∧ x ∈ block v := by
    cases u <;> cases v
    · exact False.elim (h.2.elim id id)
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.2.resolve_right id
      exact ⟨x, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.2.resolve_left id
      exact ⟨x, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).2, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1⟩
    · exact False.elim (h.2.elim id id)
  -- Alphabeta Math, "Adjacent transpositions generate the symmetric group",
  -- step 1.1 combines swaps along an interval of letters. For the overlap
  -- chains of Proposition 7.1, walk induction picks one point per overlap.
  -- Mathlib's swap_mem_trans handles the conjugation and repeated points.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-adjacent-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
  have walk_swap {u v : Sum ι κ} (p : graph.Walk u v) :
      ∀ {x y : Nat}, x ∈ block u → y ∈ block v → Equiv.swap x y ∈ joined := by
    induction p with
    | nil =>
        intro x y hx hy
        exact block_le_join _ (swap_mem_block _ hx hy)
    | cons huv _ ih =>
        intro x y hx hy
        obtain ⟨z, hzu, hzv⟩ := edge_overlap huv
        exact SubmonoidClass.swap_mem_trans joined
          (block_le_join _ (swap_mem_block _ hx hzu)) (ih hzv hy)
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact sup_le (iSup_le fun i => block_le_component (Sum.inl i))
      (iSup_le fun j => block_le_component (Sum.inr j))
  -- As in step 2.1 of the adjacent-transposition proof, containing every
  -- endpoint swap gives the entire symmetric group, here in each component.
  · apply iSup_le
    intro c
    rw [blockSym_eq_closure (componentBlock c)]
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    rintro σ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, _, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨_, u, hu, hxu⟩ := (mem_component c x).1 hx
    obtain ⟨_, v, hv, hyv⟩ := (mem_component c y).1 hy
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.exact (hu.trans hv.symm)
    exact walk_swap p hxu hyv

external.usage: Identifies the closure of genuine block swaps with the extended symmetric group of the block. For an extended permutation, the block bounds the moved points; a moved point and its image are in the same orbit via their swap.
Identifies the extension of the block subtype swap with the corresponding ambient swap.
Composes swaps in the input join at a common point of successive blocks. The lemma includes the degenerate equalities that can occur along a walk.

SmallProjectiveGenerator.proof:
let smallInModules := fun (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) =>
  CategoryTheory.Projective P ∧ CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P ∧
    ∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
      (CategoryTheory.Discrete I)
      (CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P))
let progenerator := fun (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) =>
  Module.Finite B P ∧ Module.Projective B P ∧ CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P
⟨(fun (C : Type u) [CategoryTheory.Category.{v} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C]
      [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimitsOfSize.{v,v} C] (P : C) =>
    CategoryTheory.Projective P ∧ CategoryTheory.IsSeparator P ∧
      ∀ I : Type v, CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape
        (CategoryTheory.Discrete I)
        (CategoryTheory.preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P))),
  ⟨smallInModules, ⟨progenerator,
    ⟨(show ∀ (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B),
        smallInModules B P ↔ progenerator B P from
      SmallProjectiveGenerator_module_iff),
     (show ∀ (B : Type v) [Ring B], smallInModules B (ModuleCat.of B B) from
      SmallProjectiveGenerator_regular)⟩⟩⟩⟩

private noncomputable abbrev sumCocone {B : Type v} [Ring B] {I : Type v}
    (Y : Discrete I ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} B) : Cocone Y := by
  classical
  exact
    { pt := ModuleCat.of B (DFinsupp fun i : I => Y.obj ⟨i⟩)
      ι :=
        { app := fun j => ModuleCat.ofHom
            (DFinsupp.lsingle (R := B) (M := fun i : I => ↑(Y.obj ⟨i⟩)) j.as)
          naturality := by
            intro j k f
            have h : j = k := IsDiscrete.eq_of_hom f
            subst k
            have hf : f = 𝟙 j := Subsingleton.elim _ _
            simp [hf] } }

private noncomputable def sumIsColimit {B : Type v} [Ring B] {I : Type v}
    (Y : Discrete I ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} B) : IsColimit (sumCocone Y) := by
  classical
  let legs (s : Cocone Y) (i : I) : (Y.obj ⟨i⟩) →ₗ[B] s.pt := (s.ι.app ⟨i⟩).hom
  refine
    { desc := fun s => ModuleCat.ofHom (DFinsupp.lsum ℕ (legs s))
      fac := ?_
      uniq := ?_ }
  · rintro s ⟨i⟩
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact DFinsupp.lsum_single ℕ (legs s) i x
  · intro s f hf
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply DFinsupp.lhom_ext
    intro i x
    calc
      f.hom (DFinsupp.single i x) = (legs s i) x :=
        congrArg (fun g : Y.obj ⟨i⟩ ⟶ s.pt => g.hom x) (hf ⟨i⟩)
      _ = _ := (DFinsupp.lsum_single ℕ (legs s) i x).symm

private noncomputable def comparison {B : Type v} [Ring B] {I : Type v}
    (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) (Y : Discrete I ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} B) :
    (sumCocone (Y ⋙ preadditiveCoyonedaObj P)).pt ⟶
      (preadditiveCoyonedaObj P).obj (sumCocone Y).pt :=
  (sumIsColimit (Y ⋙ preadditiveCoyonedaObj P)).desc
    ((preadditiveCoyonedaObj P).mapCocone (sumCocone Y))

private noncomputable def comparisonHom {B : Type v} [Ring B] {I : Type v}
    (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) (Y : Discrete I ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} B) :
    (DFinsupp fun i : I => P ⟶ Y.obj ⟨i⟩) →ₗ[(End P)ᵐᵒᵖ]
      (P ⟶ ModuleCat.of B (DFinsupp fun i : I => Y.obj ⟨i⟩)) :=
  (comparison P Y).hom

private theorem comparison_apply {B : Type v} [Ring B] {I : Type v}
    (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) (Y : Discrete I ⥤ ModuleCat.{v} B)
    (i : I) (a : DFinsupp fun j : I => P ⟶ Y.obj ⟨j⟩) (x : P) :
    (comparisonHom P Y a).hom x i = (a i).hom x := by
  classical
  induction a using DFinsupp.induction with
  | h0 => simp
  | ha j f a hj hf ih =>
    have h := (sumIsColimit (Y ⋙ preadditiveCoyonedaObj P)).fac
      ((preadditiveCoyonedaObj P).mapCocone (sumCocone Y)) ⟨j⟩
    have hsingle : comparisonHom P Y (DFinsupp.single j f) =
        f ≫ (sumCocone Y).ι.app ⟨j⟩ :=
      congrArg (fun g =>
        (g : (preadditiveCoyonedaObj P).obj (Y.obj ⟨j⟩) ⟶ _).hom f) h
    rw [map_add]
    simp only [ModuleCat.hom_add, LinearMap.add_apply, DFinsupp.add_apply, ih]
    congr 1
    rw [hsingle]
    change DFinsupp.single (β := fun j : I => ↑(Y.obj ⟨j⟩)) j (f.hom x) i =
      (DFinsupp.single (β := fun j : I => P ⟶ Y.obj ⟨j⟩) j f i).hom x
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · subst j
      simp
    · rw [DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij), DFinsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hij)]
      simp

/- Alphabeta Math, Step 1.1.
   https://alphabetamath.cc/item/lem-small-projective-modules-are-exactly-finitely-generated-projective-modules
   Use the dependent direct sum both before and after taking Hom.
   We prove that the coproduct comparison is bijective, using its coordinate formula.
   Compute the comparison on modules over the opposite endomorphism ring. The additive
   forgetful functor preserves and reflects the coproducts, connecting this computation
   to the abelian-group-valued Hom functor in the statement.
   This direction uses only finite generation. -/
private theorem preservesCoproductsOfFinite {B : Type v} [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B)
    (hP : Module.Finite B P) (I : Type v) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P)) := by
  classical
  let F := preadditiveCoyonedaObj P
  have : PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) F := by
    constructor
    intro Y
    apply preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone (sumIsColimit Y)
    have hbij : Function.Bijective (comparisonHom P Y) := by
      constructor
      · intro a b hab
        apply DFinsupp.ext
        intro i
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        rw [← comparison_apply P Y i a x, ← comparison_apply P Y i b x, hab]
      · intro f
        obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hP.fg_top
        let s : Finset I := g.biUnion fun x => (f.hom x).support
        let coord (i : I) : P ⟶ Y.obj ⟨i⟩ :=
          ModuleCat.ofHom ((DFinsupp.lapply (R := B) (M := fun j : I => ↑(Y.obj ⟨j⟩)) i).comp f.hom)
        have coord_eq_zero (i : I) (hi : i ∉ s) : coord i = 0 := by
          have hle : Submodule.span B (g : Set P) ≤ LinearMap.ker (coord i).hom := by
            apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
            intro x hx
            apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
            change f.hom x i = 0
            apply DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp
            intro hmem
            exact hi (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, hx, hmem⟩)
          rw [hg, top_le_iff] at hle
          apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
          simpa only [ModuleCat.hom_zero] using LinearMap.ker_eq_top.mp hle
        let a : DFinsupp fun i : I => P ⟶ Y.obj ⟨i⟩ := DFinsupp.mk s (fun i => coord i)
        have ha (i : I) : a i = coord i := by
          by_cases hi : i ∈ s
          · exact DFinsupp.mk_of_mem hi
          · exact (DFinsupp.mk_of_notMem hi).trans (coord_eq_zero i hi).symm
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro x
        apply DFinsupp.ext
        intro i
        rw [comparison_apply, ha]
        rfl
    have : IsIso ((sumIsColimit (Y ⋙ F)).desc (F.mapCocone (sumCocone Y))) :=
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (comparison P Y)).mpr hbij
    exact (sumIsColimit (Y ⋙ F)).ofPointIso
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat (End P)ᵐᵒᵖ) AddCommGrpCat
  have : PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) U :=
    ModuleCat.forget₂PreservesColimitsOfShape (End P)ᵐᵒᵖ (Discrete I)
  change PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (F ⋙ U)
  infer_instance

/- Alphabeta Math Step 1.2. Use the direct sum of copies of the regular module as the
   free cover. The explicit injections give its generators and show the cover is onto.
   This realizes the free cover in the direct-sum model used by the projection formula.
   The summand maps send b to b • p. The auxiliary scalars ℕ in DFinsupp.lsum
   commute with the B-action for every ring B. The lift uses projectivity of P.
   The comparison forces the section’s coordinates to vanish outside one finite set of
   indices, so the corresponding generators span P. -/
private theorem finiteOfPreservesCoproducts {B : Type v} [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B)
    [Projective P] (h :
      ∀ I : Type v, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
        (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P))) : Module.Finite B P := by
  classical
  let F := preadditiveCoyonedaObj P
  let Y := Discrete.functor (fun _ : P => ModuleCat.of B B)
  let cover : (sumCocone Y).pt ⟶ P :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (DFinsupp.lsum (R := B) (M := fun _ : P => B) ℕ
      (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton B P))
  have : Epi cover := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective cover).mpr (by
    intro p
    refine ⟨DFinsupp.single (β := fun _ : P => B) p 1, ?_⟩
    change DFinsupp.lsum (R := B) (M := fun _ : P => B) ℕ
      (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton B P) (DFinsupp.single p 1) = p
    rw [DFinsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one])
  let sectionMap : P ⟶ (sumCocone Y).pt := Projective.factorThru (𝟙 P) cover
  have section_comp : sectionMap ≫ cover = 𝟙 P := Projective.factorThru_comp _ _
  let U := forget₂ (ModuleCat (End P)ᵐᵒᵖ) AddCommGrpCat
  have : PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete P) (F ⋙ U) := h P
  have : ReflectsColimit (Y ⋙ F) U :=
    (ModuleCat.reflectsColimitsOfShape (End P)ᵐᵒᵖ (Discrete P)).reflectsColimit
  have hmap : IsColimit (F.mapCocone (sumCocone Y)) :=
    isColimitOfReflects U (isColimitOfPreserves (F ⋙ U) (sumIsColimit Y))
  have : IsIso (comparison P Y) :=
    ((sumIsColimit (Y ⋙ F)).nonempty_isColimit_iff_isIso_desc).mp ⟨hmap⟩
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (comparisonHom P Y) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (comparison P Y)).2
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hsurj sectionMap
  refine ⟨⟨a.support, top_unique ?_⟩⟩
  intro p _
  have hsplit : cover.hom (sectionMap.hom p) = p :=
    congrArg (fun f : P ⟶ P => f.hom p) section_comp
  rw [← hsplit]
  change DFinsupp.lsum (R := B) (M := fun _ : P => B) ℕ
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton B P) (sectionMap.hom p) ∈ _
  rw [DFinsupp.lsum_apply_apply, DFinsupp.sumAddHom_apply, DFinsupp.sum]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i hi
  have hai : i ∈ a.support := by
    apply DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    intro hz
    have hcoord := comparison_apply P Y i a p
    rw [ha, hz, ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hcoord
    exact DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi hcoord
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span hai)

end SmallProjectiveGeneratorProof

open SmallProjectiveGeneratorProof

/- Alphabeta Math Steps 2.1 and 3.1. The separator condition is shared.
   The projectivity bridge applies because the ring has the module universe. -/
theorem SmallProjectiveGenerator_module_iff (B : Type v) [Ring B] (P : ModuleCat.{v} B) :
    (Projective P ∧ IsSeparator P ∧ ∀ I : Type v,
      PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op P))) ↔
    (Module.Finite B P ∧ Module.Projective B P ∧ IsSeparator P) := by
  have hproj : Module.Projective B P ↔ Projective P :=
    IsProjective.iff_projective (R := B) P
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hs, hc⟩
    have : Projective P := hp
    exact ⟨finiteOfPreservesCoproducts P hc, hproj.mpr hp, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hp, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hproj.mp hp, hs, preservesCoproductsOfFinite P hf⟩

/- Alphabeta Math Step 2.2. The regular module is finite and projective by its rank-one
   free module structure. Evaluation at 1 on maps from the regular module detects
   equality of morphisms by testing each x with the map b ↦ b • x.
   This proves separation directly from cancellation. The reverse direction of the
   equivalence supplies smallness. -/
theorem SmallProjectiveGenerator_regular (B : Type v) [Ring B] :
    Projective (ModuleCat.of B B) ∧ IsSeparator (ModuleCat.of B B) ∧
      ∀ I : Type v, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
        (preadditiveCoyoneda.obj (Opposite.op (ModuleCat.of B B))) := by
  apply (SmallProjectiveGenerator_module_iff B (ModuleCat.of B B)).mpr
  refine ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, (isSeparator_def _).mpr ?_⟩
  intro X Y f g h
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hx := h (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton B X x))
  simpa only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom,
    LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one] using
      congrArg (fun k : ModuleCat.of B B ⟶ Y => k.hom (1 : B)) hx

Converts the surjectivity of the direct sum free cover to an epimorphism for the projective lift.

Constructs coproduct descents and the free cover over the possibly noncommutative ring. The auxiliary scalar ring is Nat. The single-coordinate evaluation formula checks the coproduct legs and the cover on free generators.
Composes the coproduct preservation proof for endomorphism-ring-valued Hom with the additive-group forgetful functor. Discrete colimits exist in the same-universe category of abelian groups.
Reflects the coproduct preserved by additive-group-valued Hom to the module category over the opposite endomorphism ring, so its direct-sum comparison is an isomorphism.

SurvivingCosetRepresentative.proof:
by
  intro U _ K H G α β Kα Hβ hK hH A B J σ hσ L C I hRep hTrans j g surviving
  let s : U := (σ j : U)

  /- Ian Xiao, Lemma 2.3 (project PDF p. 6, published PDF p. 7).
     The article page gives the same proof and numbers the data in (2.1),
     (2.2), and (2.4). It has no separately numbered proof steps.
     ConjugationEmbeddingCentralizerCoset characterizes equality of strand
     labels. The membership calculations here use the given subgroup images. -/
  have mem_conjugate (S : Subgroup U) (a x : U) :
      x ∈ S.map (MulAut.conj a).toMonoidHom ↔ a⁻¹ * x * a ∈ S := by
    rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]

  -- For (2.1), DoubleCoset.eq gives the product in G. The hypothesis hσ
  -- supplies the representative, so no choice of Quotient.out is needed.
  have factor :
      DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j ↔
        ∃ k ∈ Kα, ∃ h : H, (g : U) = k * s * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹) := by
    rw [← hσ j, eq_comm (a := DoubleCoset.mk A B g), DoubleCoset.eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hg⟩
      change (a : U) ∈ Kα at ha
      change (b : U) ∈ Hβ at hb
      obtain ⟨h, hh, eh⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hb
      change β * h * β⁻¹ = (b : U) at eh
      refine ⟨(a : U), ha, ⟨h, hh⟩, ?_⟩
      change (g : U) = (a : U) * s * (β * h * β⁻¹)
      rw [eh]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hg
    · rintro ⟨k, hk, h, hg⟩
      have hb : β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ Hβ := ⟨h, h.property, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨k, hK hk⟩, hk, ⟨_, hH hb⟩, hb, Subtype.ext hg⟩

  have surviving_iff (u : I j) :
      u ∈ surviving ↔ (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * s⁻¹ ∈ Kα := by
    let x : U := (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * s⁻¹
    change α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * α ∈ K ↔
      x ∈ K.map (MulAut.conj α).toMonoidHom
    rw [mem_conjugate]
    have he : α⁻¹ * x * α =
        α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * s⁻¹ * α := by
      dsimp only [x]
      group
    rw [he]

  -- The conjugated term already belongs to the H side of (2.2).
  have transversal_iff (h : H) (u : I j) :
      (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j ↔
        (s * β) * ((h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹) * (s * β)⁻¹ ∈ Kα := by
    let x : U := (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹
    let y : U := (s * β) * x * (s * β)⁻¹
    change x ∈ (L j).map (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * s⁻¹)).toMonoidHom ↔ y ∈ Kα
    rw [mem_conjugate, show (β⁻¹ * s⁻¹)⁻¹ * x * (β⁻¹ * s⁻¹) = y by
      dsimp only [y]
      group]
    change (y ∈ Kα ∧ y ∈ H.map (MulAut.conj (s * β)).toMonoidHom) ↔ y ∈ Kα
    have hx : x ∈ H := H.mul_mem h.property (H.inv_mem (hRep j u).property)
    have hy : y ∈ H.map (MulAut.conj (s * β)).toMonoidHom := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simp only [hy, and_true]

  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨k, hk, h, hg⟩ := factor.mp hg
    -- Cancel the left factor inside Kα, then use the unique index in (2.4).
    have tests_agree (u : I j) :
        u ∈ surviving ↔ (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j := by
      rw [surviving_iff, transversal_iff, hg]
      let y : U := (s * β) * ((h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹) * (s * β)⁻¹
      have he : k * s * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ *
          β⁻¹ * s⁻¹ = k * y := by
        dsimp only [y]
        group
      rw [he]
      change k * y ∈ Kα ↔ y ∈ Kα
      refine ⟨?_, Kα.mul_mem hk⟩
      intro hky
      simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_left] using Kα.mul_mem (Kα.inv_mem hk) hky
    obtain ⟨u, hu, unique⟩ := hTrans j h
    exact ⟨u, (tests_agree u).mpr hu, fun v hv => unique v ((tests_agree v).mp hv)⟩
  · intro hne
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro u hu
    -- A surviving index yields a factorization in (2.1).
    exact hne (factor.mpr ⟨_, (surviving_iff u).mp hu, hRep j u, by group⟩)

ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives.proof:
by
  intro X r c A B _ _ hdA hdB hcA hcB G blockSym K H Mat rank
  -- Xiao, Proposition 7.3 and the two numbered construction steps in §7.2.
  -- The project PDF has this passage on p. 30 and the live PDF on p. 31.
  -- Both give the same classification and ordered matching.
  -- The project records no separate Alphabeta Math proof for this endpoint.
  let count : G → Mat := fun p => ⟨fun i j => (tableauCell A B p i j).card, by
    constructor
    · exact tableauCell_card A B hdB hcB p
    · intro j
      simp_rw [tableauCell_card_symm A B p]
      exact tableauCell_card B A hdA hcA p.symm j⟩
  -- Descend the count to the quotient using the left/right factors in DoubleCoset.eq.
  let onCosets : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G) → Mat :=
    Quotient.lift count fun p q hpq =>
      Subtype.ext (funext fun i => funext fun j =>
        tableauCount_invariant A B hdA hcA hdB hcB p q (DoubleCoset.eq''.mpr hpq) i j)
  have chosen (R : Mat) : ∃ p : G, count p = R ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (x : ↥(A i)) (y : ↥(B j)),
        p y.val = x.val ↔ ∃ k : Fin (R.val i j),
          rank (A i) x = (∑ t ∈ Finset.Iio j, R.val i t) + k.val ∧
          rank (B j) y = (∑ t ∈ Finset.Iio i, R.val t j) + k.val := by
    obtain ⟨p, hcount, hrank⟩ := tableauOrdered A B hdA hcA hdB hcB R.val R.property.1 R.property.2
    refine ⟨p, ?_, hrank⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i j
    change (tableauCell A B p i j).card = R.val i j
    exact hcount i j
  have bij : Function.Bijective onCosets := by
    constructor
    · intro a b
      refine Quotient.inductionOn' a (fun p => ?_)
      refine Quotient.inductionOn' b (fun q hpq => ?_)
      exact tableauCount_injective A B hdA hcA hdB hcB p q fun i j =>
        congrArg (fun R : Mat => R.val i j) hpq
    · intro R
      obtain ⟨p, hp, _⟩ := chosen R
      exact ⟨DoubleCoset.mk K H p, hp⟩
  let classify := Equiv.ofBijective onCosets bij
  refine ⟨classify, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun R => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hrank⟩ := chosen R
  exact ⟨p, (classify.eq_symm_apply).mpr hp, hrank⟩
ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives.support:
section
variable {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {ι κ : Type*}

private def tableauBlockGroup (D : ι → Finset α) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α) :=
  ⨆ i, MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x => x ∈ D i))

/- Proposition 7.3 uses the block products on the finite carrier X. The registered
   Proposition 7.1 supplier, FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks, gives an intersection
   equality on ambient Nat. It does not give the block-preserving membership criterion
   on X needed here. Use its disjoint-block and transposition argument on X directly. -/
private theorem tableauBlockGroup_mem [Finite α] (D : ι → Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j))) (hc : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ D i)
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) :
    p ∈ tableauBlockGroup D ↔ ∀ i x, x ∈ D i → p x ∈ D i := by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    refine Subgroup.iSup_induction _ (C := fun f : Equiv.Perm α =>
      ∀ i x, x ∈ D i → f x ∈ D i) hp ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro j _ ⟨g, rfl⟩ i x hx
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem g x).mpr hx
      · have h : x ∉ D j := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd hij) hx h
        rwa [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g h]
    · exact fun _ _ hx => hx
    · exact fun f g hf hg i x hx => hf i (g x) (hg i x hx)
  · intro hp
    let swaps : Set (Equiv.Perm α) := {s | ∃ i x y,
      x ∈ D i ∧ y ∈ D i ∧ x ≠ y ∧ s = Equiv.swap x y}
    have hs : ∀ s ∈ swaps, Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s := by
      rintro s ⟨i, x, y, hx, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩
    have hle : Subgroup.closure swaps ≤ tableauBlockGroup D := by
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro s ⟨i, x, y, hx, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
      apply Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem i
      exact ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩
    apply hle
    refine (mem_closure_isSwap hs).mpr ⟨Set.toFinite _, fun x => ?_⟩
    apply MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr
    by_cases h : p x = x
    · exact ⟨1, h.symm⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hc x
      have hswap : Equiv.swap x (p x) ∈ Subgroup.closure swaps :=
        Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, x, p x, hi, hp i x hi, Ne.symm h, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨_, hswap⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩

private theorem tableauBlockGroup_preserve [Finite α] (D : ι → Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j))) (hc : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ D i)
    {p : Equiv.Perm α} (hp : p ∈ tableauBlockGroup D) (i : ι) (x : α) :
    p x ∈ D i ↔ x ∈ D i := by
  refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, (tableauBlockGroup_mem D hd hc p).mp hp i x⟩
  have h := (tableauBlockGroup_mem D hd hc p⁻¹).mp
    ((tableauBlockGroup D).inv_mem hp) i (p x) hx
  simpa [Equiv.Perm.inv_def] using h

omit [DecidableEq α] in
private theorem tableauIndex_unique (D : ι → Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    {i j : ι} {x : α} (hi : x ∈ D i) (hj : x ∈ D j) : i = j := by
  by_contra h
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd h) hi hj

private noncomputable def tableauPartition (D : ι → Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j))) (hc : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ D i) :
    (Σ i, ↥(D i)) ≃ α :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun z => z.2.val) (by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, x⟩ ⟨j, y⟩ hxy
      change x.val = y.val at hxy
      have h : i = j := tableauIndex_unique D hd x.property (hxy.symm ▸ y.property)
      subst j
      exact congrArg (Sigma.mk i) (Subtype.ext hxy)
    · intro x
      obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hc x
      exact ⟨⟨i, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩, rfl⟩)

omit [DecidableEq α] in
private theorem tableauPartition_index (D : ι → Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j))) (hc : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ D i)
    (x : α) (i : ι) : ((tableauPartition D hd hc).symm x).1 = i ↔ x ∈ D i := by
  let z := (tableauPartition D hd hc).symm x
  have hz : z.2.val = x := (tableauPartition D hd hc).apply_symm_apply x
  have hmem : x ∈ D z.1 := hz ▸ z.2.property
  exact ⟨fun h => h ▸ hmem, tableauIndex_unique D hd hmem⟩

private def tableauCell (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α) (p : Equiv.Perm α)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) : Finset α :=
  A i ∩ (B j).map p.toEmbedding

private theorem tableauCell_mem (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) (i : ι) (j : κ) (x : α) :
    x ∈ tableauCell A B p i j ↔ x ∈ A i ∧ p.symm x ∈ B j := by
  simp only [tableauCell, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_map_equiv]

private theorem tableauCell_card [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j))) (hc : ∀ x, ∃ j, x ∈ B j)
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) (i : ι) :
    ∑ j, (tableauCell A B p i j).card = (A i).card := by
  let label := fun x => ((tableauPartition B hd hc).symm (p.symm x)).1
  rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := label) (t := Finset.univ)
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [tableauCell_mem, Finset.mem_filter]
  exact and_congr_right' (tableauPartition_index B hd hc (p.symm x) j).symm

private theorem tableauCell_transport (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (p q k : Equiv.Perm α)
    (hA : ∀ i x, k x ∈ A i ↔ x ∈ A i)
    (hB : ∀ j x, q.symm (k x) ∈ B j ↔ p.symm x ∈ B j) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (tableauCell A B p i j).card = (tableauCell A B q i j).card := by
  let e := k.subtypeEquiv (p := fun x => x ∈ tableauCell A B p i j)
    (q := fun x => x ∈ tableauCell A B q i j) (fun x => by
      simp only [tableauCell_mem, hA, hB])
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr e

private theorem tableauCell_card_symm (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (tableauCell A B p i j).card = (tableauCell B A p.symm j i).card := by
  let e := p.symm.subtypeEquiv (p := fun x => x ∈ tableauCell A B p i j)
    (q := fun x => x ∈ tableauCell B A p.symm j i) (fun x => by
      simp only [tableauCell_mem, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, and_comm])
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr e

private theorem tableauCount_invariant [Finite α] (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (hdA : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j))) (hcA : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ A i)
    (hdB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j))) (hcB : ∀ x, ∃ j, x ∈ B j)
    (p q : Equiv.Perm α)
    (hpq : DoubleCoset.mk (tableauBlockGroup A) (tableauBlockGroup B) p =
      DoubleCoset.mk (tableauBlockGroup A) (tableauBlockGroup B) q) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (tableauCell A B p i j).card = (tableauCell A B q i j).card := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, h, hh, rfl⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp hpq
  apply tableauCell_transport A B p (k * p * h) k (tableauBlockGroup_preserve A hdA hcA hk)
  intro j x
  have he : (k * p * h).symm (k x) = h.symm (p.symm x) := by
    apply (k * p * h).injective
    simp [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
  rw [he]
  exact tableauBlockGroup_preserve B hdB hcB ((tableauBlockGroup B).inv_mem hh) j (p.symm x)

private theorem tableauCells_disjoint (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (hdA : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)))
    (hdB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j))) (p : Equiv.Perm α) :
    Pairwise (fun u v : ι × κ =>
      Disjoint (tableauCell A B p u.1 u.2) (tableauCell A B p v.1 v.2)) := by
  intro u v huv
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hy
  obtain ⟨hxi, hxj⟩ := (tableauCell_mem A B p u.1 u.2 x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨hyi, hyj⟩ := (tableauCell_mem A B p v.1 v.2 x).mp hy
  exact huv (Prod.ext (tableauIndex_unique A hdA hxi hyi) (tableauIndex_unique B hdB hxj hyj))

private theorem tableauCells_cover (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (hcA : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ A i) (hcB : ∀ x, ∃ j, x ∈ B j)
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) (x : α) :
    ∃ u : ι × κ, x ∈ tableauCell A B p u.1 u.2 := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcA x
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcB (p.symm x)
  exact ⟨(i, j), (tableauCell_mem A B p i j x).mpr ⟨hi, hj⟩⟩

private theorem tableauCount_injective [Finite α] (A : ι → Finset α) (B : κ → Finset α)
    (hdA : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j))) (hcA : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ A i)
    (hdB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j))) (hcB : ∀ x, ∃ j, x ∈ B j)
    (p q : Equiv.Perm α) (he : ∀ i j, (tableauCell A B p i j).card =
      (tableauCell A B q i j).card) :
    DoubleCoset.mk (tableauBlockGroup A) (tableauBlockGroup B) p =
      DoubleCoset.mk (tableauBlockGroup A) (tableauBlockGroup B) q := by
  -- Match the two tableaux cell by cell. The bijection of positions fixes row
  -- labels, and transporting it back through the two tableaux fixes column labels.
  let D := fun (f : Equiv.Perm α) (u : ι × κ) => tableauCell A B f u.1 u.2
  let split := fun f => tableauPartition (D f) (tableauCells_disjoint A B hdA hdB f)
    (tableauCells_cover A B hcA hcB f)
  let matchCells : (Σ u, ↥(D p u)) ≃ (Σ u, ↥(D q u)) :=
    Equiv.sigmaCongrRight fun u => Finset.equivOfCardEq (he u.1 u.2)
  let k : Equiv.Perm α := ((split p).symm.trans matchCells).trans (split q)
  have sameCell (u : ι × κ) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ D p u) : k x ∈ D q u := by
    have h := (matchCells ⟨u, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩).2.property
    have hx' : (split p).symm x = ⟨u, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩ :=
      (Equiv.symm_apply_eq (split p)).mpr rfl
    change (matchCells ⟨u, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩).2.val ∈ D q u at h
    change ((split q) (matchCells ((split p).symm x))) ∈ D q u
    rw [hx']
    exact h
  let l : Equiv.Perm α := q⁻¹ * k * p
  have hk : k ∈ tableauBlockGroup A := by
    apply (tableauBlockGroup_mem A hdA hcA k).mpr
    intro i x hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcB (p.symm x)
    exact ((tableauCell_mem A B q i j _).mp
      (sameCell (i, j) x ((tableauCell_mem A B p i j x).mpr ⟨hx, hj⟩))).1
  have hl : l ∈ tableauBlockGroup B := by
    apply (tableauBlockGroup_mem B hdB hcB l).mpr
    intro j y hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcA (p y)
    have hmem : p y ∈ D p (i, j) :=
      (tableauCell_mem A B p i j _).mpr ⟨hi, by simpa using hy⟩
    exact ((tableauCell_mem A B q i j _).mp (sameCell (i, j) _ hmem)).2
  exact DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
    ⟨k, hk, l⁻¹, (tableauBlockGroup B).inv_mem hl, by simp [l, mul_assoc]⟩
end

section
variable {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]

private noncomputable def tableauRank (S : Finset α) (x : ↥S) : Nat :=
  ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val

private noncomputable def tableauSlice {n : Nat} (S : Finset α)
    (sizes : Fin n → Nat) (hs : ∑ j, sizes j = S.card) :
    (Σ j, Fin (sizes j)) ≃ ↥S :=
  finSigmaFinEquiv.trans (Finset.orderIsoOfFin S hs.symm).toEquiv

private theorem tableauSlice_rank {n : Nat} (S : Finset α)
    (sizes : Fin n → Nat) (hs : ∑ j, sizes j = S.card) (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (sizes j)) :
    tableauRank S (tableauSlice S sizes hs ⟨j, k⟩) =
      (∑ t ∈ Finset.Iio j, sizes t) + k.val := by
  have hv : tableauRank S (tableauSlice S sizes hs ⟨j, k⟩) =
      (finSigmaFinEquiv (n := sizes) ⟨j, k⟩).val := by
    have hr {m : Nat} (h : S.card = m) (u : Fin m) :
        tableauRank S (Finset.orderIsoOfFin S h u) = u.val := by
      subst m
      exact congrArg Fin.val ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm_apply_apply u)
    exact hr hs.symm _
  rw [hv, finSigmaFinEquiv_apply]
  congr 1
  have hIio : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin j.val)).map (Fin.castLEEmb j.isLt.le) =
      Finset.Iio j := by
    ext t
    simp only [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iio]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
      exact u.isLt
    · intro h
      exact ⟨⟨t.val, h⟩, Fin.ext rfl⟩
  rw [← hIio, Finset.sum_map]
  rfl
end

private def tableauFlip {r c : Nat} (R : Fin r → Fin c → Nat) :
    (Σ i, Σ j, Fin (R i j)) ≃ (Σ j, Σ i, Fin (R i j)) where
  toFun z := ⟨z.2.1, z.1, z.2.2⟩
  invFun z := ⟨z.2.1, z.1, z.2.2⟩
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

section
variable {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [DecidableEq α]

private theorem tableauOrdered {r c : Nat}
    (A : Fin r → Finset α) (B : Fin c → Finset α)
    (hdA : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j))) (hcA : ∀ x, ∃ i, x ∈ A i)
    (hdB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j))) (hcB : ∀ x, ∃ j, x ∈ B j)
    (R : Fin r → Fin c → Nat) (hr : ∀ i, ∑ j, R i j = (A i).card)
    (hc : ∀ j, ∑ i, R i j = (B j).card) :
    ∃ p : Equiv.Perm α, (∀ i j, (tableauCell A B p i j).card = R i j) ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (x : ↥(A i)) (y : ↥(B j)),
        p y.val = x.val ↔ ∃ k : Fin (R i j),
          tableauRank (A i) x = (∑ t ∈ Finset.Iio j, R i t) + k.val ∧
          tableauRank (B j) y = (∑ t ∈ Finset.Iio i, R t j) + k.val := by
  -- Xiao §7.2, step 1: concatenate cells in each ordered row block.
  let rowSlice := fun i => tableauSlice (A i) (R i) (hr i)
  let rows := (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight rowSlice).trans (tableauPartition A hdA hcA)
  -- Step 2: concatenate in each ordered column block. Use the same cell offsets
  -- as for the rows, so matching on the shared coordinate type is order preserving.
  let colSlice := fun j => tableauSlice (B j) (fun i => R i j) (hc j)
  let cols := (tableauFlip R).trans
    ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight colSlice).trans (tableauPartition B hdB hcB))
  let p : Equiv.Perm α := cols.symm.trans rows
  have forward (z : Σ i, Σ j, Fin (R i j)) : p (cols z) = rows z := by
    simp [p]
  have backward (z : Σ i, Σ j, Fin (R i j)) : p.symm (rows z) = cols z := by
    simp [p]
  have row_mem (z : Σ i, Σ j, Fin (R i j)) : rows z ∈ A z.1 :=
    (rowSlice z.1 z.2).property
  have col_mem (z : Σ i, Σ j, Fin (R i j)) : cols z ∈ B z.2.1 :=
    (colSlice z.2.1 ⟨z.1, z.2.2⟩).property
  have cell_mem (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (k : Fin (R i j)) :
      rows ⟨i, j, k⟩ ∈ tableauCell A B p i j := by
    apply (tableauCell_mem A B p i j _).mpr
    refine ⟨row_mem ⟨i, j, k⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [backward]
    exact col_mem ⟨i, j, k⟩
  have coordinates (i : Fin r) (j : Fin c) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ A i)
      (hy : p.symm x ∈ B j) :
      ∃ k : Fin (R i j), rows ⟨i, j, k⟩ = x := by
    obtain ⟨⟨a, b, k⟩, hz⟩ := rows.surjective x
    have ha : a = i := tableauIndex_unique A hdA (row_mem ⟨a, b, k⟩) (hz ▸ hx)
    have hb : b = j := by
      apply tableauIndex_unique B hdB (col_mem ⟨a, b, k⟩)
      rwa [← backward, hz]
    subst a
    subst b
    exact ⟨k, hz⟩
  have rank_injective (S : Finset α) : Function.Injective (tableauRank S) := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply (Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm.injective
    exact Fin.ext hxy
  refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    -- Each matrix entry counts exactly the offsets in its cell.
    let f : Fin (R i j) → ↥(tableauCell A B p i j) :=
      fun k => ⟨rows ⟨i, j, k⟩, cell_mem i j k⟩
    have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
      constructor
      · intro a b h
        have hrow : rows ⟨i, j, a⟩ = rows ⟨i, j, b⟩ :=
          congrArg (fun x : ↥(tableauCell A B p i j) => x.val) h
        have hcoords := rows.injective hrow
        have hinner : (⟨j, a⟩ : Σ t, Fin (R i t)) = ⟨j, b⟩ :=
          eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hcoords).2
        exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj hinner).2
      · intro x
        obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := (tableauCell_mem A B p i j _).mp x.property
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := coordinates i j x.val hi hj
        exact ⟨k, Subtype.ext hk⟩
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_coe] using
      (Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f hf)).symm
  · intro i j x y
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hxy : p.symm x.val = y.val := (Equiv.symm_apply_eq p).mpr h.symm
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := coordinates i j x.val x.property (hxy ▸ y.property)
      have hk' : cols ⟨i, j, k⟩ = y.val := by rw [← backward, hk, hxy]
      have ex : rowSlice i ⟨j, k⟩ = x := Subtype.ext hk
      have ey : colSlice j ⟨i, k⟩ = y := Subtype.ext hk'
      exact ⟨k, ex ▸ tableauSlice_rank (A i) (R i) (hr i) j k,
        ey ▸ tableauSlice_rank (B j) (fun t => R t j) (hc j) i k⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hx, hy⟩
      have ex : x = rowSlice i ⟨j, k⟩ := rank_injective _ (hx.trans
        (tableauSlice_rank (A i) (R i) (hr i) j k).symm)
      have ey : y = colSlice j ⟨i, k⟩ := rank_injective _ (hy.trans
        (tableauSlice_rank (B j) (fun t => R t j) (hc j) i k).symm)
      subst x
      subst y
      exact forward ⟨i, j, k⟩
end

external.usage: The quotient indexes the K–H double cosets of permutations of the finite carrier.
Its forward direction writes q = k * p * h for invariance. The cell matching gives the same factorization in the reverse direction for injectivity.
The extension defines the factors. Its membership and complement evaluation lemmas show that every factor preserves all blocks of its own partition.
A swap inside one block extends to the ambient transposition, putting it in that factor of the supremum.
The finite ambient carrier supplies finite support. The identity or a single genuine in-block swap witnesses the orbit condition for every point, proving membership in the block subgroup.
Decode ranks using the inherited natural order on each block and use the inverse order isomorphism to recover the exact ranks.
Concatenate cell-offset types into block rank types. Its application formula is converted to the specified Iio prefix sum by mapping the smaller Fin type into the block index type.
Match each pair of equal-cardinality cells by a bijection to build the row permutation in the injectivity proof.

by
  classical
  intro U _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro H G α hα A B a φ up down Ind Res TensorsOnRight
    have single (h : H) (c : Complex) :
        φ (MonoidAlgebra.single h c) = MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) c :=
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single
    refine ⟨single, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro β hβ
      exact ConjugationEmbeddingCentralizerCoset H G α β hα hβ
    -- The two arrows in § 1.2 use the same carrier. Pull back the right
    -- regular action for the up-strand and the left regular action for the
    -- down-strand. The right action is a module over the opposite ring.
    let I : Bimodule.1 B A B := strandBimodule (RingHom.id B) φ.toRingHom
    let D : Bimodule.1 A B B := strandBimodule φ.toRingHom (RingHom.id B)
    refine ⟨I, D, (fun _ _ => rfl), (fun _ _ => rfl), (fun _ _ => rfl),
      (fun _ _ => rfl), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro g h x
      -- The second coordinate of the biset action acts by an inverse.
      change MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
          (Finsupp.lmapDomain Complex Complex (fun z : G => g * z * (a.toHom h⁻¹)⁻¹) x.coeff) =
        MonoidAlgebra.single g 1 * (x * φ (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1))
      rw [single]
      simpa only [map_inv, inv_inv] using strandBasisMultiplication g (a.toHom h) x
    · intro h g x
      change MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
          (Finsupp.lmapDomain Complex Complex (fun z : G => a.toHom h * z * (g⁻¹)⁻¹) x.coeff) =
        φ (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) * (x * MonoidAlgebra.single g 1)
      rw [single]
      simpa only [inv_inv] using strandBasisMultiplication (a.toHom h) g x
    · exact strandInductionTensor φ.toRingHom (F := Ind)
        (strandInductionAdjunction.{0, u, v} (k := Complex) a.toHom)
    · exact strandRestrictionTensor φ.toRingHom
  · intro K L J p q
    exact strandBalancedProduct p.basis q.basis
  · intro K L J p p' q q' d e x y
    exact MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear d.interpret.eval e.interpret.eval x y
  · intro K H p q r bottom top
    -- Evaluate the typed stack from bottom to top.
    rfl

private abbrev strandTensorsOnRight.{u, v} := fun (S R : Type u) [Ring S] [Ring R]
  (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N]
  (left : S → N → N) (right : R → N → N)
  (F : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (ModuleCat.{max u v} S)) =>
let Balanced := fun (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} S)
    (p : N → X → Y) =>
  (∀ n n' : N, ∀ x : X, p (n + n') x = p n x + p n' x) ∧
  (∀ n : N, ∀ x x' : X, p n (x + x') = p n x + p n x') ∧
  (∀ (s : S) (n : N) (x : X), p (left s n) x = s • p n x) ∧
  (∀ (r : R) (n : N) (x : X), p (right r n) x = p n (r • x))
∃ τ : ∀ X : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, N → X → F.obj X,
  (∀ X, Balanced X (F.obj X) (τ X)) ∧
  (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} S)
      (p : N → X → Y), Balanced X Y p →
    ∃! f : LinearMap (RingHom.id S) (F.obj X) Y,
      ∀ (n : N) (x : X), f (τ X n x) = p n x) ∧
  (∀ (X Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (f : Quiver.Hom X Y) (n : N) (x : X),
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom (F.map f) (τ X n x) = τ Y n (ModuleCat.Hom.hom f x))
