open CategoryTheory
universe i u v

-- Alphabeta Math, Universal property of M⊗_RN, Steps 1.2, 4.1 and 5.1.
-- For this realization the adjunction unit provides the generator at 1. The
-- Hom equivalence descends a balanced map with its exterior linearity, and
-- injectivity gives uniqueness. ModuleTensorUniversalProperty constructs the
-- additive quotient; the Hom equivalence here works in the required module
-- category and supplies naturality in the tensor argument.
private theorem strandInductionTensor {A B : Type u} [Ring A] [Ring B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {F : ModuleCat.{max u v} A ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} B}
    (adj : F ⊣ ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ) :
    strandTensorsOnRight B A B (fun s n => s * n) (fun r n => n * φ r) F := by
  let η (X : ModuleCat A) (x : X) : F.obj X := (adj.unit.app X).hom x
  have ηadd (X : ModuleCat A) (x y : X) : η X (x + y) = η X x + η X y :=
    (adj.unit.app X).hom.map_add x y
  have ηsmul (X : ModuleCat A) (r : A) (x : X) : η X (r • x) = φ r • η X x :=
    (adj.unit.app X).hom.map_smul r x
  have homEquiv_apply (X : ModuleCat A) (Y : ModuleCat B) (f : F.obj X ⟶ Y) (x : X) :
      ((adj.homEquiv X Y) f).hom x = f.hom (η X x) := by
    rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
    rfl
  refine ⟨fun X n x => n • η X x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X
    refine ⟨fun n m x => add_smul n m _, ?_, fun s n x => mul_smul s n _, ?_⟩
    · intro n x y
      change n • η X (x + y) = n • η X x + n • η X y
      rw [ηadd, smul_add]
    · intro r n x
      change (n * φ r) • η X x = n • η X (r • x)
      rw [ηsmul, mul_smul]
  · intro X Y p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨_, hadd, hleft, hbal⟩
    have at_one (n : B) (x : X) : p n x = n • p 1 x := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using hleft n 1 x
    let base : X ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj Y :=
      ModuleCat.ofHom (X := X) (Y := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj Y)
        { toFun := p 1
          map_add' := hadd 1
          map_smul' := fun r x => by
            change p 1 (r • x) = φ r • p 1 x
            calc
              p 1 (r • x) = p (1 * φ r) x := (hbal r 1 x).symm
              _ = p (φ r) x := by rw [one_mul]
              _ = φ r • p 1 x := at_one (φ r) x }
    let lift := (adj.homEquiv X Y).symm base
    have on_unit : ∀ x : X, lift.hom (η X x) = p 1 x := by
      intro x
      rw [← homEquiv_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rfl
    refine ⟨lift.hom, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n x
      change lift.hom (n • η X x) = p n x
      rw [map_smul, on_unit]
      exact (at_one n x).symm
    · intro candidate hcandidate
      have heq : ModuleCat.ofHom candidate = lift := by
        apply (adj.homEquiv X Y).injective
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        ext x
        rw [homEquiv_apply, homEquiv_apply, on_unit]
        change candidate (η X x) = p 1 x
        simpa only [one_smul] using hcandidate 1 x
      exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom heq
  · intro X Y f n x
    have hf : (F.map f).hom (η X x) = η Y (f.hom x) := by
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.unit_naturality f)) x
    change (F.map f).hom (n • η X x) = n • η Y (f.hom x)
    rw [map_smul, hf]

-- Steps 1.2 and 5.1 specialize here to multiplication on the regular tensor
-- factor. Balancing expresses p(n,x) as p(1,n • x).
private theorem strandRestrictionTensor {A B : Type u} [Ring A] [Ring B]
    (φ : A →+* B) :
    strandTensorsOnRight A B B (fun r n => φ r * n) (fun s n => n * s)
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max u v} φ) := by
  refine ⟨fun X n x => n • x, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X
    exact ⟨fun n m x => add_smul n m x, fun n x y => smul_add n x y,
      fun r n x => mul_smul (φ r) n x, fun s n x => mul_smul n s x⟩
  · intro X Y p hp
    rcases hp with ⟨_, hadd, hleft, hbal⟩
    have at_one (n : B) (x : X) : p n x = p 1 (n • x) := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using hbal n 1 x
    let lift : ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj X) →ₗ[A] Y :=
      { toFun := p 1
        map_add' := hadd 1
        map_smul' := fun r x => by
          let y : X := x
          change p 1 (φ r • y) = r • p 1 y
          rw [← at_one]
          simpa only [mul_one] using hleft r 1 y }
    refine ⟨lift, fun n x => (at_one n x).symm, ?_⟩
    intro candidate hcandidate
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    let y : X := x
    change candidate (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj X from y) = p 1 y
    have hc : candidate (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).obj X from (1 : B) • y) = p 1 y :=
      hcandidate 1 y
    simpa only [one_smul] using hc
  · intro X Y f n x
    exact f.hom.map_smul n x

-- The two restriction functors agree on the action of the middle group
-- algebra. Check the identity on carriers first on group elements and then
-- extend it by the group algebra's universal property.
private noncomputable def strandRestrictionIso
    {k : Type i} {G H : Type u} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Group H] (f : H →* G) :
    (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ (Rep.resFunctor f ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra)) ≅
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max i u v} (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom k k f).toRingHom := by
  let A := MonoidAlgebra k H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra k G
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom k k f
  let F : ModuleCat.{max i u v} B ⥤ ModuleCat.{max i u v} A :=
    Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ (Rep.resFunctor f ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra)
  let R := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max i u v} φ.toRingHom
  change F ≅ R
  have action (X : ModuleCat B) (r : A) (x : F.obj X) : r • x = φ r • (show X from x) := by
    let ρ := Representation.ofModule (k := k) (G := G) X
    let σ : Representation k H (RestrictScalars k B X) := ρ.comp f
    have hf : σ.asAlgebraHom = ρ.asAlgebraHom.comp φ := by
      apply (MonoidAlgebra.lift k _ H).symm.injective
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro h
      change σ.asAlgebraHom (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) =
        ρ.asAlgebraHom (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain f (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1))
      rw [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one,
        Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
      rfl
    change σ.asAlgebraHom r x = _
    rw [hf]
    exact Representation.ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply X (φ r) x
  refine NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => ?_) (fun g => ?_)
  · let e : (F.obj X) ≃ₗ[A] (R.obj X) :=
      { toEquiv := Equiv.refl X
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := fun r x => action X r x }
    exact e.toModuleIso
  · apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext x
    rfl

private noncomputable def strandInductionAdjunction
    {k : Type i} {G H : Type u} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Group H] (f : H →* G) :
    ((Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ Rep.indFunctor.{max i u v} k f) ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra) ⊣
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{max i u v} (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom k k f).toRingHom :=
  (((Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := k) (G := H)).symm.toAdjunction.comp
    (Rep.indResAdjunction k f)).comp
      (Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := k) (G := G)).toAdjunction).ofNatIsoRight
        (strandRestrictionIso.{i, u, v} f)

end

section
open MackeyDiagrams
universe u w

-- Alphabeta Math, Steps 3.1, 4.1 and 5.1. For two linearized bisets the
-- additive relations already hold by bilinearity. The orbit quotient enforces
-- diagonal group balance. Extend this to the middle group algebra by linearity.
private theorem strandBalancedProduct {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
    (X : Biset K H) (Y : Biset H J) :
    let right := fun (r : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (x : X.carrier →₀ Complex) =>
      freeLift Complex (fun h : H => X.actLinear Complex (1, h⁻¹) x) r.coeff
    let left := fun (r : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (y : Y.carrier →₀ Complex) =>
      freeLift Complex (fun h : H => Y.actLinear Complex (h, 1) y) r.coeff
    let pair := Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y
    (∀ r x y, pair (right r x) y = pair x (left r y)) ∧
    (∀ (M : Type w) [AddCommGroup M] [Module Complex M]
        (f : (X.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (Y.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] M),
      (∀ r x y, f (right r x) y = f x (left r y)) →
      ∃! lift : ((X.tensor Y).carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] M,
        ∀ x y, lift (pair x y) = f x y) := by
  intro right left pair
  have undo (h : H) (x : X.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      X.actLinear Complex (1, h⁻¹) (X.actLinear Complex (1, h) x) = x := by
    have comp_eq :
        (X.actLinear Complex (1, h⁻¹)).comp (X.actLinear Complex (1, h)) =
          LinearMap.id := by
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
      intro a c
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, Biset.actLinear_single, ← X.mul_act,
        Prod.mk_mul_mk, one_mul, inv_mul_cancel, ← Prod.one_eq_mk, X.one_act]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun comp_eq x
  have right_single (h : H) (x : X.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      right (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) x = X.actLinear Complex (1, h⁻¹) x := by
    simp [right]
  have left_single (h : H) (y : Y.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      left (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) y = Y.actLinear Complex (h, 1) y := by
    simp [left]
  constructor
  · intro r x y
    let l := (pair.flip y).comp
      (freeLift Complex (fun h : H => X.actLinear Complex (1, h⁻¹) x))
    let m := (pair x).comp
      (freeLift Complex (fun h : H => Y.actLinear Complex (h, 1) y))
    have hlm : l = m := by
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
      intro h c
      change pair (freeLift Complex _ (Finsupp.single h c)) y =
        pair x (freeLift Complex _ (Finsupp.single h c))
      simp only [freeLift_single, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
      -- Reindex the inverse in the first slot of diagonal balance.
      have heq := Biset.pairLinear_balance Complex X Y h
        (X.actLinear Complex (1, h⁻¹) x) y
      have hinv := undo h⁻¹ x
      simp only [inv_inv] at hinv
      rw [hinv] at heq
      exact congrArg (fun z => c • z) heq.symm
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hlm r.coeff
  · intro M _ _ f hf
    have diagonal : Biset.IsBalanced f := by
      intro h x y
      have heq := hf (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) (X.actLinear Complex (1, h) x) y
      rw [right_single, left_single, undo] at heq
      exact heq.symm
    exact ⟨Biset.liftBalanced f diagonal, Biset.liftBalanced_pairLinear f diagonal,
      fun g hg => Biset.liftBalanced_unique f diagonal g hg⟩

-- A pair of group elements acts by left and right multiplication on basis
-- vectors. Both expressions extend to the whole group algebra by linearity.
private theorem strandBasisMultiplication {G : Type u} [Group G] (a b : G)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) :
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (Finsupp.lmapDomain Complex Complex (fun z : G => a * z * b) x.coeff) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single a 1 * (x * MonoidAlgebra.single b 1) := by
  induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of z =>
    simp [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
      mul_assoc]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_add, add_mul,
      mul_add, hx, hy]
  | smul r x hx =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, map_smul, MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_smul,
      smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, hx]

-- Pull back each regular action along the prescribed ring homomorphism.
private noncomputable def strandBimodule {S R B : Type u} [Ring S] [Ring R] [Ring B]
    (leftHom : S →+* B) (rightHom : R →+* B) : Bimodule.1 S R B :=
  let left : Module S B := Module.compHom B leftHom
  let right : Module (MulOpposite R) B := Module.compHom B (RingHom.op rightHom)
  letI : SMul S B := left.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
  letI : SMul (MulOpposite R) B := right.toDistribMulAction.toMulAction.toSemigroupAction.toSMul
  ⟨left, ⟨right, show SMulCommClass (MulOpposite R) S B from
    ⟨fun r s x => show (leftHom s * x) * rightHom (MulOpposite.unop r) =
      leftHom s * (x * rightHom (MulOpposite.unop r)) from mul_assoc _ _ _⟩⟩⟩

end

universe u v w

external.usage: For InductionRestrictionBimoduleStrands, apply the adjunction to the underlying conjugation homomorphism and transfer it to module categories. The unit at 1 gives the natural pure tensor map, and the Hom equivalence gives the unique exterior-linear lift.

For InductionRestrictionBimoduleStrands, use the source and target equivalences to transport Rep.indResAdjunction. Check the resulting right adjoint against restriction along the induced group-algebra map by the identity on carriers, extending the equality of actions on group generators.

InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits.proof:
by
  intro U inst L H G α β hα hβ a b ab φ upA upB downA downB upPair downPair upMerge upSplit downMerge downSplit
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp a b,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp_mergeUp a b,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown_splitDown a b,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown_mergeDown a b⟩
  · intro l
    simp only [ab, a, b, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp_apply,
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_apply]
    group
  · intro x y
    induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear generalizing y with
    | zero => simp
    | add x₁ x₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      rcases ih₁ y with ⟨up₁,down₁⟩
      rcases ih₂ y with ⟨up₂,down₂⟩
      exact ⟨by simp [add_mul, up₁, up₂], by simp [mul_add, down₁, down₂]⟩
    | single g r =>
      induction y using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
      | zero => simp
      | add y₁ y₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
        rcases ih₁ with ⟨up₁,down₁⟩
        rcases ih₂ with ⟨up₂,down₂⟩
        simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single] at up₁ up₂ down₁ down₂
        exact ⟨by simp [mul_add, up₁, up₂], by simp [add_mul, down₁, down₂]⟩
      | single h t =>
        change
          upMerge.eval.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex upA.basis upB.basis
            (Finsupp.single g r) (Finsupp.single h t)) = _ ∧
          downMerge.eval.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex downB.basis downA.basis
            (Finsupp.single h t) (Finsupp.single g r)) = _
        simp only [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear_single]
        change (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval.toLinearMap
            (Finsupp.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a).pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction b) g h) (r*t)) = _ ∧
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) a b).eval.toLinearMap
            (Finsupp.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b).pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a) h g) (t*r)) = _
        rw [MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_mergeDown_single]
        have hp : φ (MonoidAlgebra.single h t) = MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) t := by
          change MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain a.toHom (MonoidAlgebra.single h t) = _
          rw [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single]
        rw [hp]
        change
          Finsupp.single (g * a.toHom h) (r * t) =
            (MonoidAlgebra.single g r * MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) t).coeff ∧
          Finsupp.single (a.toHom h * g) (t * r) =
            (MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) t * MonoidAlgebra.single g r).coeff
        simp only [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, and_self]
  · intro z
    induction z using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add z₁ z₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
      exact ⟨by simp [ih₁.1, ih₂.1], by simp [ih₁.2, ih₂.2]⟩
    | single g r =>
      change upSplit.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g r) =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex upA.basis upB.basis (Finsupp.single g r)
          (Finsupp.single 1 1) ∧
        downSplit.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g r) =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex downB.basis downA.basis (Finsupp.single 1 1)
          (Finsupp.single g r)
      simp only [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one, one_mul]
      exact ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_splitUp_single a b g r,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_splitDown_single a b g r⟩

GroupElementDotCriterion.proof:
by
  intro U inst H G α β hα hβ A B C a b φ ψ up down
  have onA (h : H) (r : Complex) :
      φ (MonoidAlgebra.single h r) = MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) r :=
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single
  have onB (h : H) (r : Complex) :
      ψ (MonoidAlgebra.single h r) = MonoidAlgebra.single (b.toHom h) r :=
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single
  have singleInject : Function.Injective (fun k : G => MonoidAlgebra.single k (1 : Complex)) := by
    intro k l hel
    have hs := congrArg MonoidAlgebra.coeff hel
    change Finsupp.single k (1 : Complex) = Finsupp.single l 1 at hs
    by_contra hn
    have hv := DFunLike.congr_fun hs k
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hn] at hv
    exact one_ne_zero hv
  refine ⟨ConjugationEmbeddingCentralizerCoset H G α β hα hβ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d rightMul intertwines
    have hlin : (∀ (x : B) (r : A), rightMul (x * φ r) = rightMul x * ψ r) ↔ intertwines := by
      constructor
      · intro he h
        have ha := he 1 (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1)
        dsimp only [rightMul] at ha
        rw [one_mul, one_mul, onA, onB, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
          MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul] at ha
        exact singleInject ha
      · intro h x r
        have he : φ r * MonoidAlgebra.single d 1 = MonoidAlgebra.single d 1 * ψ r := by
          induction r using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
          | zero => simp
          | add r s hr hs => simp [add_mul, mul_add, hr, hs]
          | single z c =>
            rw [onA, onB, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
              MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one, one_mul, h z]
        change (x * φ r) * MonoidAlgebra.single d 1 =
          (x * MonoidAlgebra.single d 1) * ψ r
        rw [mul_assoc, he, ← mul_assoc]
    have hcent : intertwines ↔ (d : U) ∈ Set.image (fun c : U => α * c * β⁻¹) C := by
      constructor
      · intro he
        refine ⟨α⁻¹ * (d : U) * β, ?_, by group⟩
        apply Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mpr
        intro k hk
        have h := congrArg Subtype.val (he ⟨k,hk⟩)
        change (α*k*α⁻¹) * (d : U) = (d : U) * (β*k*β⁻¹) at h
        calc
          k * (α⁻¹ * (d : U) * β) = α⁻¹ * ((α*k*α⁻¹) * (d : U)) * β := by group
          _ = α⁻¹ * ((d : U) * (β*k*β⁻¹)) * β := by rw [h]
          _ = (α⁻¹ * (d : U) * β) * k := by group
      · rintro ⟨c,hc,hd⟩ h
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (α*(h : U)*α⁻¹) * (d : U) = (d : U) * (β*(h : U)*β⁻¹)
        have he := Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mp hc (h : U) h.property
        rw [← hd]
        calc
          (α * (h : U) * α⁻¹) * (α*c*β⁻¹) = α * ((h : U) * c) * β⁻¹ := by group
          _ = α * (c * (h : U)) * β⁻¹ := by rw [he]
          _ = (α*c*β⁻¹) * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹) := by group
    refine ⟨hlin, hcent, hcent.trans ?_, ?_⟩
    · constructor
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, hd⟩
        refine ⟨α*c, β, ?_, rfl, hd.symm⟩
        apply (leftCoset_eq_iff (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U))).mpr
        simpa [C] using hc
      · rintro ⟨x,y,hx,hy,hd⟩
        have hx' := (leftCoset_eq_iff (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U))).mp hx
        have hy' := (leftCoset_eq_iff (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U))).mp hy
        refine ⟨(α⁻¹*x) * (β⁻¹*y)⁻¹,
          (Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U)).mul_mem hx'
            ((Subgroup.centralizer (H : Set U)).inv_mem hy'), ?_⟩
        rw [hd]
        group
    · exact ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨d,h⟩,rfl⟩, fun ⟨t,h⟩ k => by rw [← h]; exact t.intertwines k⟩
  · intro t x
    constructor
    · change (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) t).eval.toLinearMap x.coeff = _
      rw [← MackeyDiagrams.AlgebraUpDot.eval_ofGroupDot]
      rfl
    · exact MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_downDot_groupAlgebra t x
  · intro t s sameElement
    let unitVector := Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex)
    constructor
    · constructor
      · intro h
        have e := congrArg (fun d => d.toLinearMap unitVector) h
        dsimp only [up, down, unitVector] at e
        change (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) t).eval.toLinearMap
            (Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex)) =
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) s).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex)) at e
        rw [MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_upDot_single, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_upDot_single,
          one_mul, one_mul] at e
        exact singleInject (congrArg MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff e)
      · intro h
        exact congrArg up (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ext h)
    · constructor
      · intro h
        have e := congrArg (fun d => d.toLinearMap unitVector) h
        dsimp only [up, down, unitVector] at e
        change (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) t).eval.toLinearMap
            (Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex)) =
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) s).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex)) at e
        rw [MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_downDot_single, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_downDot_single,
          mul_one, mul_one] at e
        exact inv_injective (singleInject (congrArg MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff e))
      · intro h
        exact congrArg down (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ext h)

TransportToMackeyRepresentative.proof:
by
  open MackeyDiagrams TransportToMackeyRepresentativeAux in
  intro U _ K H G L α β a b conjSubgroup Kα Hβ hK hH ha hb hs
    eα eβ ea eb d s A B J σ hσ j hj k h hsplit Lj Ls Limage Lprime leftJ rightJ
  -- Ian Xiao, Lemma 5.2 (p. 16), starts from the displayed factorization
  -- of s. Its proof has no separately numbered steps. Equations (2.1)
  -- and (2.2) specify the representative and its intersection subgroup.
  -- The hypothesis hsplit supplies the two multipliers. DoubleCoset.eq
  -- would recover a factorization from membership, and
  -- SurvivingCosetRepresentative requires a right-coset transversal
  -- to select a surviving term. Here the factorization is explicit.
  -- ConjugationEmbeddingCentralizerCoset compares presentations of
  -- embeddings. The typed embeddings here already come with their
  -- conjugation formulas. The index comparison uses ordinary left cosets,
  -- while the candidate FLT result concerns double cosets.
  have hs_val : (s : U) = (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ := rfl
  have hsplit_val : (s : U) =
      (α * (k : U) * α⁻¹) * (σ j : U) * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hsplit
  let c : U := α * (k : U)⁻¹ * α⁻¹
  let t : U := α * (k : U)⁻¹ * a
  have ht : t = (σ j : U) * β * (h : U) * b := by
    calc
      t = c * ((s : U) * (β * b)) := by
        rw [hs_val]
        dsimp only [c, t]
        group
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hsplit_val]
        dsimp only [c]
        group
  -- The two expressions for t give the two inclusions into the intersection.
  have hSub : Lprime ≤ Lj := by
    rintro _ ⟨ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩
    change t * ℓ * t⁻¹ ∈ Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
    constructor
    · have haℓ : a * ℓ * a⁻¹ ∈ K := ha ⟨ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(k : U)⁻¹ * (a * ℓ * a⁻¹) * (k : U),
        K.mul_mem (K.mul_mem (K.inv_mem k.property) haℓ) k.property, ?_⟩
      change α * ((k : U)⁻¹ * (a * ℓ * a⁻¹) * (k : U)) * α⁻¹ = t * ℓ * t⁻¹
      dsimp only [t]
      group
    · have hbℓ : b * ℓ * b⁻¹ ∈ H := hb ⟨ℓ, hℓ, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(h : U) * (b * ℓ * b⁻¹) * (h : U)⁻¹,
        H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem h.property hbℓ) (H.inv_mem h.property), ?_⟩
      change ((σ j : U) * β) * ((h : U) * (b * ℓ * b⁻¹) * (h : U)⁻¹) *
        ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = t * ℓ * t⁻¹
      rw [ht]
      group
  -- Conjugation by c carries both subgroup pairs to each other. Work
  -- with the actual left-coset quotient to include infinite indices.
  have hc : c ∈ Kα := ⟨(k : U)⁻¹, K.inv_mem k.property, rfl⟩
  have hleft : conjSubgroup c Kα = Kα :=
    Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp (Kα.le_normalizer hc)
  have hrightFixed : conjSubgroup (h : U) H = H :=
    Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq.mp (H.le_normalizer h.property)
  have hcRight : c * ((s : U) * β) = ((σ j : U) * β) * (h : U) := by
    rw [hsplit_val]
    dsimp only [c]
    group
  have hright : conjSubgroup c (conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H) =
      conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H := calc
    _ = conjSubgroup (c * ((s : U) * β)) H := conjugate_mul _ _ _
    _ = conjSubgroup (((σ j : U) * β) * (h : U)) H := by rw [hcRight]
    _ = conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) (conjSubgroup (h : U) H) :=
      (conjugate_mul _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := congrArg (conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β)) hrightFixed
  have hmapJ : conjSubgroup c Ls = Lj := by
    change (Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H).map (MulAut.conj c).toMonoidHom = _
    rw [Subgroup.map_inf _ _ _ (MulAut.conj c).injective]
    change conjSubgroup c Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup c (conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H) = Lj
    rw [hleft, hright]
  have hmapImage : conjSubgroup c Limage = Lprime := by
    calc
      _ = conjSubgroup (c * (α * a)) L := conjugate_mul _ _ _
      _ = conjSubgroup t L := by
        apply congrArg (fun z => conjSubgroup z L)
        dsimp only [c, t]
        group
      _ = _ := rfl
  have hindex :
      Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Lprime.subgroupOf Lj))) =
        Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Limage.subgroupOf Ls))) := by
    let cosetCard (S T : Subgroup U) :=
      Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (T.subgroupOf S)))
    change cosetCard Lj Lprime = cosetCard Ls Limage
    rw [← hmapJ, ← hmapImage]
    exact (coset_card_of_map (MulAut.conj c) Ls Limage).symm
  refine ⟨hSub, ?_⟩
  intro leftPrime rightPrime dprime X Y Xprime Yprime W Wprime q qprime ι ιprime
  -- Lemma 5.2 computes the restricted embeddings on t ℓ t⁻¹.
  -- These two formulas transport the generating balance relation both ways.
  let f : L ≃ Lprime := ((MulAut.conj t).subgroupMap L).toEquiv
  have hf_val (ℓ : L) : (f ℓ : U) = t * (ℓ : U) * t⁻¹ := rfl
  have hl (ℓ : L) : leftPrime.toHom (f ℓ) = k⁻¹ * ea.toHom ℓ * k := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change α⁻¹ * (f ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ =
      (k : U)⁻¹ * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * (k : U)
    rw [hf_val]
    dsimp only [t]
    group
  have hr (ℓ : L) : rightPrime.toHom (f ℓ) = h * eb.toHom ℓ * h⁻¹ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (f ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ =
      (h : U) * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * (h : U)⁻¹
    rw [hf_val, ht]
    group
  let e : W.carrier ≃ Wprime.carrier := shiftBasis ea eb leftPrime rightPrime k h f hl hr
  have he : ∀ g w, e (W.act g w) = Wprime.act g (e w) :=
    shiftBasis_equivariant ea eb leftPrime rightPrime k h f hl hr
  have he_pair (x : K) (y : H) :
      e (X.pair Y x y) = Xprime.pair Yprime (x * k) (h * y) := rfl
  -- Crossing values agree on the balanced-pair representatives. The
  -- equality identifies the fibers, which suffices for finite transfers.
  have hcomm (w : W.carrier) : qprime (e w) = q w := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
    change qprime (e (X.pair Y x y)) = q (X.pair Y x y)
    rw [he_pair]
    change Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (eα.toHom (x * k) * σ j * eβ.toHom (h * y)) =
      Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (eα.toHom x * s * eβ.toHom y)
    apply congrArg (Generator.mixedPair eα eβ)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hsplit]
    group
  refine ⟨e, he, he_pair, ?_, ?_, hindex⟩
  · -- The reviewed syntax interprets a coefficient-one singleton drawing
    -- as the associated basis pushforward.
    rw [show ιprime.interpret.eval = _ from eval_multiplication_singleton
          eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime,
      show ι.interpret.eval = _ from eval_multiplication_singleton eα eβ ea eb d]
    exact multiplication_commutes e he q qprime
      (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant eα eβ ea eb d)
      (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime) hcomm
  · -- The paper uses the inverse trace labels. The compact drawings
    -- implement those projections by transfer along the forward maps.
    intro hf hfprime p pprime
    rw [show p.interpret.eval = _ from eval_projection_singleton eα eβ ea eb d hf,
      show pprime.interpret.eval = _ from eval_projection_singleton
          eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime hfprime]
    exact projection_commutes e he q qprime
      (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant eα eβ ea eb d)
      (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime)
      hcomm hf hfprime
TransportToMackeyRepresentative.support:
namespace TransportToMackeyRepresentativeAux

open MackeyDiagrams

universe u v

section Quotients

variable {U : Type u} [Group U]

private theorem conjugate_mul (c d : U) (S : Subgroup U) :
    (S.map (MulAut.conj d).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj c).toMonoidHom =
      S.map (MulAut.conj (c * d)).toMonoidHom := by
  rw [Subgroup.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  change c * (d * x * d⁻¹) * c⁻¹ = (c * d) * x * (c * d)⁻¹
  group

private theorem coset_card_of_map (e : U ≃* U) (S T : Subgroup U) :
    Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (T.subgroupOf S))) =
      Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel
        ((T.map e.toMonoidHom).subgroupOf (S.map e.toMonoidHom)))) := by
  let f := e.subgroupMap S
  apply Cardinal.mk_congr
  refine Quotient.congr f.toEquiv (fun x y => ?_)
  rw [QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply, QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply]
  change x⁻¹ * y ∈ T.subgroupOf S ↔
    (f x)⁻¹ * f y ∈ (T.map e.toMonoidHom).subgroupOf (S.map e.toMonoidHom)
  rw [← map_inv, ← map_mul]
  change ((x : U)⁻¹ * (y : U)) ∈ T ↔
    e ((x : U)⁻¹ * (y : U)) ∈ T.map e.toMonoidHom
  rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, e.symm_apply_apply]

end Quotients

section Transport

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G L L' : Subgroup U}
variable (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
variable (l' : ConjEmbedding L' K) (r' : ConjEmbedding L' H)
variable (k : K) (h : H) (f : L ≃ L')

private def shiftBasis
    (hl : ∀ t, l'.toHom (f t) = k⁻¹ * l.toHom t * k)
    (hr : ∀ t, r'.toHom (f t) = h * r.toHom t * h⁻¹) :
    ((Biset.induction l).tensor (Biset.restriction r)).carrier ≃
      ((Biset.induction l').tensor (Biset.restriction r')).carrier := by
  refine Quotient.congr ((Equiv.mulRight k).prodCongr (Equiv.mulLeft h)) (fun x y => ?_)
  change
    (∃ t : L, 1 * x.1 * (l.toHom t)⁻¹ = y.1 ∧
      r.toHom t * x.2 * (1 : H)⁻¹ = y.2) ↔
    (∃ t : L', 1 * (x.1 * k) * (l'.toHom t)⁻¹ = y.1 * k ∧
      r'.toHom t * (h * x.2) * (1 : H)⁻¹ = h * y.2)
  simp only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]
  have left (t : L) : (x.1 * k) * (l'.toHom (f t))⁻¹ =
      (x.1 * (l.toHom t)⁻¹) * k := by
    rw [hl]
    group
  have right (t : L) : r'.toHom (f t) * (h * x.2) = h * (r.toHom t * x.2) := by
    rw [hr]
    group
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, hx, hy⟩
    exact ⟨f t, (left t).trans (congrArg (· * k) hx), (right t).trans (congrArg (h * ·) hy)⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, hx, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := f.surjective t
    exact ⟨t, mul_right_cancel ((left t).symm.trans hx),
      mul_left_cancel ((right t).symm.trans hy)⟩

private theorem shiftBasis_equivariant
    (hl : ∀ t, l'.toHom (f t) = k⁻¹ * l.toHom t * k)
    (hr : ∀ t, r'.toHom (f t) = h * r.toHom t * h⁻¹)
    (g : K × H) (w : ((Biset.induction l).tensor (Biset.restriction r)).carrier) :
    shiftBasis l r l' r' k h f hl hr
        (((Biset.induction l).tensor (Biset.restriction r)).act g w) =
      ((Biset.induction l').tensor (Biset.restriction r')).act g
        (shiftBasis l r l' r' k h f hl hr w) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change (Biset.induction l').pair (Biset.restriction r')
      ((g.1 * x * (l.toHom 1)⁻¹) * k) (h * (r.toHom 1 * y * g.2⁻¹)) =
    (Biset.induction l').pair (Biset.restriction r')
      (g.1 * (x * k) * (l'.toHom 1)⁻¹) (r'.toHom 1 * (h * y) * g.2⁻¹)
  simp only [map_one, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, mul_assoc]

end Transport

section Linear

variable {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
variable {X X' Y : Biset K H} {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
variable (e : X.carrier ≃ X'.carrier)
variable (he : ∀ g x, e (X.act g x) = X'.act g (e x))
variable (q : X.carrier → Y.carrier) (q' : X'.carrier → Y.carrier)
variable (hq : ∀ g x, q (X.act g x) = Y.act g (q x))
variable (hq' : ∀ g x, q' (X'.act g x) = Y.act g (q' x))

private theorem multiplication_commutes (hcomm : ∀ x, q' (e x) = q x) :
    (Biset.Hom.ofFunction e he : Biset.Hom R X X').vertical (Biset.Hom.ofFunction q' hq') =
      Biset.Hom.ofFunction q hq := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro x c
  simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical, LinearMap.comp_apply, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, hcomm]

private theorem projection_commutes (hcomm : ∀ x, q' (e x) = q x)
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}) (hf' : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q' w = z}) :
    (Biset.Hom.transfer R q hq hf).vertical (Biset.Hom.ofFunction e he) =
      Biset.Hom.transfer R q' hq' hf' := by
  classical
  -- Each finite transfer has coefficient one at a preimage. Comparing
  -- coefficients at corresponding preimages avoids choosing a fiber order.
  have hpush : (Biset.Hom.ofFunction e he : Biset.Hom R X X').toLinearMap =
      Finsupp.lmapDomain R R e := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro x c
    simp
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z c
  simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical, LinearMap.comp_apply, Biset.Hom.transfer_single, map_smul]
  congr 1
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro x'
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := e.surjective x'
  rw [hpush, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective e.injective,
    Biset.Hom.transferBasis_apply, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_apply, hcomm]

end Linear

section Drawings

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G L : Subgroup U}
variable {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]
variable (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
variable (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
variable (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r))

private theorem eval_multiplication_singleton :
    (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := R) a b l r [(1, d)]).interpret.eval =
      Generator.mixedMultiplication a b l r d R := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  unfold LabelledDrawing.interpret
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval, Diagram.eval]

private theorem eval_projection_singleton
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z}) :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) a b l r [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]).interpret.eval =
      Generator.mixedProjection a b l r d R hf := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  unfold LabelledDrawing.interpret
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval, Diagram.eval]

end Drawings

end TransportToMackeyRepresentativeAux

external.usage: Used in Lemma 5.2 to show that conjugation by αk⁻¹α⁻¹ fixes the conjugate of K and conjugation by h fixes H. The required normalizer memberships follow from subgroup membership. These equalities identify the two factors of the transported intersection. Lean checked both applications through the existing project imports.

ParallelInductionProductDotAdmissibility.proof:
by
  intro U inst G K H B H' α β γ δ α' β' hα hβ hγ hδ hα' hβ'
    u v w bottom middle top C
  have composedRepresentative {L : Subgroup U} (a b : U)
      (ha : ∀ l : L, a * (l : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hb : ∀ k : K, b * (k : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ L) (k : K) :
      ((((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha).comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb)).toHom k : G) : U) =
        (a * b) * (k : U) * (a * b)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp_apply,
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_apply]
    group
  have centralizes {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} {p q : U}
      (ha : ∀ k : K, (a.toHom k : U) = p * (k : U) * p⁻¹)
      (hb : ∀ k : K, (b.toHom k : U) = q * (k : U) * q⁻¹)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) :
      p⁻¹ * (d.element : U) * q ∈ C := by
    apply Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mpr
    intro k hk
    have commute := congrArg (fun g : G => (g : U)) (d.intertwines ⟨k, hk⟩)
    change (a.toHom ⟨k, hk⟩ : U) * (d.element : U) =
      (d.element : U) * (b.toHom ⟨k, hk⟩ : U) at commute
    rw [ha, hb] at commute
    calc
      k * (p⁻¹ * (d.element : U) * q) =
          p⁻¹ * ((p * k * p⁻¹) * (d.element : U)) * q := by group
      _ = p⁻¹ * ((d.element : U) * (q * k * q⁻¹)) * q := by rw [commute]
      _ = (p⁻¹ * (d.element : U) * q) * k := by group
  constructor
  · intro d e
    let product := d.vertical e
    refine ⟨⟨product, rfl⟩,
      centralizes (composedRepresentative α β hα hβ)
        (composedRepresentative α' β' hα' hβ') product, ?_⟩
    intro unit
    apply MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro k
    have commute := product.intertwines k
    change bottom.toHom k * (d.element * e.element) =
      (d.element * e.element) * top.toHom k at commute
    simpa only [unit, mul_one, one_mul] using commute
  · intro d
    exact ⟨d.inverse, rfl, centralizes (composedRepresentative γ δ hγ hδ)
      (composedRepresentative α β hα hβ) d.inverse,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.then_inverse d, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse_then d⟩

ParabolicMackeyIntersectionBlocks.proof:
by
  intro X r c A B nonemptyA nonemptyB disjointA disjointB coverA coverB G blockSym K H σ
  let point : ↥X ↪ Nat := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩
  let extend : Equiv.Perm ↥X →* Equiv.Perm Nat :=
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X)
  have extend_injective : Function.Injective extend := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_injective
  let liftBlock (S : Finset ↥X) : Finset Nat := S.map point
  let blockNat (T : Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ T))
  -- Xiao, §7.2 after Prop. 7.3 (project PDF p. 30, published PDF p. 32),
  -- applies the conjugation and intersection formulas of Prop. 7.1.
  -- The registered formulas act on Nat, so extend by the identity outside X
  -- and identify each extended block factor there.
  have block_extension (S : Finset ↥X) :
      (blockSym S).map extend = blockNat (liftBlock S) := by
    have mem_lift (x : ↥X) : (x : Nat) ∈ liftBlock S ↔ x ∈ S :=
      Finset.mem_map' point
    have in_carrier {n : Nat} (hn : n ∈ liftBlock S) : n ∈ X := by
      obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hn
      exact x.property
    let e : ↥S ≃ ↥(liftBlock S) :=
      { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.val.val, (mem_lift x.val).mpr x.property⟩
        invFun := fun n =>
          ⟨⟨n.val, in_carrier n.property⟩, (mem_lift _).mp n.property⟩
        left_inv := fun _ => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext rfl)
        right_inv := fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl }
    have commute (g : Equiv.Perm ↥S) :
        extend (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g) = Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (e.permCongr g) := by
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro n
      by_cases hn : n ∈ X
      · let x : ↥X := ⟨n, hn⟩
        rw [show extend (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g) n =
          ((Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g) x : Nat) from
            Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem _ hn]
        by_cases hx : x ∈ S
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem g hx,
            Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem _ ((mem_lift x).mpr hx)]
          rfl
        · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g hx,
            Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _
              (fun h => hx ((mem_lift x).mp h))]
      · rw [show extend (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g) n = n from
          Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ hn,
          Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ (fun h => hn (in_carrier h))]
    apply Subgroup.ext
    intro f
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e.permCongr g, (commute g).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨f, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := e.permCongr.surjective f
      exact ⟨Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g, ⟨g, rfl⟩, commute g⟩
  have lift_partition {ι : Type} (D : ι → Finset ↥X)
      (nonempty : ∀ i, (D i).Nonempty)
      (disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
      (cover : ∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ D i) :
      (∀ i, (liftBlock (D i)).Nonempty) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (liftBlock (D i)) (liftBlock (D j))) ∧
        (∀ n, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ liftBlock (D i)) := by
    refine ⟨fun i => (nonempty i).map, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      exact (Finset.disjoint_map point).mpr (disjoint hij)
    · intro n
      constructor
      · intro hn
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := cover ⟨n, hn⟩
        exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_map_of_mem point hi⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hi
        exact x.property
  -- Alphabeta Math's §7.2, steps 1–2 after Proposition 7.3, order and
  -- match the pieces to construct a representative from a matrix.
  -- The next paragraph applies to every representative. Take σ as given
  -- and use its column images directly. The classification theorem
  -- ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives is unnecessary for this formula.
  let C (j : Fin c) : Finset ↥X := (B j).map σ.toEmbedding
  have nonemptyC (j : Fin c) : (C j).Nonempty := (nonemptyB j).map
  have disjointC : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (C i) (C j)) :=
    fun _ _ hij => (Finset.disjoint_map σ.toEmbedding).mpr (disjointB hij)
  have coverC (x : ↥X) : ∃ j, x ∈ C j := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := coverB (σ.symm x)
    exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_map_equiv.mpr hj⟩
  obtain ⟨nonemptyA', disjointA', coverA'⟩ :=
    lift_partition A nonemptyA disjointA coverA
  obtain ⟨nonemptyB', disjointB', _⟩ :=
    lift_partition B nonemptyB disjointB coverB
  obtain ⟨nonemptyC', disjointC', coverC'⟩ :=
    lift_partition C nonemptyC disjointC coverC
  -- The conjugation supplier requires a finitary permutation of Nat.
  -- Every moved point of the extension lies in the finite set X.
  have finitary : extend σ ∈ Subgroup.closure {τ : Equiv.Perm Nat | τ.IsSwap} := by
    apply mem_closure_isSwap'.mpr
    apply X.finite_toSet.subset
    intro n hn
    by_contra hnX
    exact hn (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem σ hnX)
  have image_block (j : Fin c) :
      (liftBlock (B j)).image (extend σ) = liftBlock (C j) := by
    calc
      _ = (liftBlock (B j)).map (extend σ).toEmbedding :=
        (Finset.map_eq_image _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by
        change ((B j).map point).map (extend σ).toEmbedding =
          ((B j).map σ.toEmbedding).map point
        rw [Finset.map_map, Finset.map_map]
        have commute : point.trans (extend σ).toEmbedding = σ.toEmbedding.trans point :=
          Function.Embedding.ext fun x => Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_coe σ x
        rw [commute]
  have map_conj :
      extend.comp (MulAut.conj σ).toMonoidHom =
        (MulAut.conj (extend σ)).toMonoidHom.comp extend := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro τ
    change extend (σ * τ * σ⁻¹) = extend σ * extend τ * (extend σ)⁻¹
    simp only [map_mul, map_inv]
  have extended_conjugate :
      (Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj σ).toMonoidHom H).map extend =
        iSup (fun j => blockNat (liftBlock (C j))) := by
    change ((iSup (fun j => blockSym (B j))).map (MulAut.conj σ).toMonoidHom).map extend = _
    rw [Subgroup.map_map, map_conj, ← Subgroup.map_map]
    simp only [Subgroup.map_iSup (f := extend), block_extension]
    have conjugate := FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks
      (fun j => liftBlock (B j)) nonemptyB' disjointB' ⟨extend σ, finitary⟩
    change Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj (extend σ)).toMonoidHom
        (iSup (fun j => blockNat (liftBlock (B j)))) =
      iSup (fun j => blockNat ((liftBlock (B j)).image (extend σ))) at conjugate
    simpa only [image_block] using conjugate
  -- Apply the registered intersection formula after conjugation, then
  -- return to Sym(X) by injectivity of extension.
  have intersection := FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks X
    (fun i => liftBlock (A i)) (fun j => liftBlock (C j))
    nonemptyA' nonemptyC' disjointA' disjointC' coverA' coverC'
  change (iSup (fun i => blockNat (liftBlock (A i)))) ⊓
      (iSup (fun j => blockNat (liftBlock (C j)))) =
    iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j => blockNat (liftBlock (A i) ∩ liftBlock (C j)))) at intersection
  apply Subgroup.map_injective extend_injective
  rw [Subgroup.map_inf _ _ extend extend_injective, extended_conjugate]
  change (iSup (fun i => blockSym (A i))).map extend ⊓
      iSup (fun j => blockNat (liftBlock (C j))) =
    (iSup (fun i => iSup (fun j => blockSym (A i ∩ C j)))).map extend
  simp only [Subgroup.map_iSup, block_extension]
  have lift_inter (S T : Finset ↥X) :
      liftBlock (S ∩ T) = liftBlock S ∩ liftBlock T := Finset.map_inter S T
  simpa only [lift_inter] using intersection

external.usage: Extend permutations of the finite carrier to Nat by the identity outside X. The evaluation lemmas identify a block factor after two extensions with the single extension of the corresponding block in Nat. Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_coe identifies the extended image of each point of X, and Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_injective lets us reflect equality of the extended subgroups back to Sym(X).
The reverse implication shows the identity extension of σ belongs to the swap closure, as required by FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks. The complement of the fixed points is contained in X.
Move the extension through the block suprema and their intersection. Preservation of the intersection uses the checked injectivity of the extension.

by
  intro U group K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he g a b e rightDot merge
  -- Xiao, Proposition 3.1, eq. (3.1), and the first slide diagram in § 3.2.
  -- The current published PDF matches article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf.
  -- The equation, calculation and TikZ diagram agree with the original source/.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- The historical checked connection (InductionMergeDotSlide-35669a6fda70c55531a695d34dfb2ab3)
  -- uses ordinary Diagram syntax. Recheck its basis argument here with the current
  -- imports, then identify only the evaluations of the coefficient-one labels.
  -- No numbered Alphabeta proof is recorded for this endpoint.
  -- GroupElementDotCriterion and InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits give
  -- the corresponding group-algebra formulas. The route's eval_upDot_single
  -- and eval_mergeUp_single give their basis versions directly at these words.
  have singletonEval {L M : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L M}
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot p q) :
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single t (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval =
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) t).eval := by
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.eval_upDrawing]
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_ext
    intro z r
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply,
      MackeyDiagrams.freeLift_single, one_smul]
  constructor
  · intro γ' hγ' hd g' d lifted merged left right
    have both :
        (((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).horizontal
          (.upDot e)).vertical (.mergeUp g' b)).eval =
          ((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) g a).vertical
            (.upDot merged)).eval := by
      apply MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_ext
      intro z r
      refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun xy => ?_)
      rcases xy with ⟨x, y⟩
      change G at x
      change H at y
      change (((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).horizontal
          (.upDot e)).vertical (.mergeUp g' b)).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.up g).basis.pair
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a).basis x y) r) =
        ((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) g a).vertical
          (.upDot merged)).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.up g).basis.pair
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a).basis x y) r)
      -- First equality in the paper's proof of (3.1): right multiplication
      -- on the two inputs followed by multiplication through the outer embedding.
      rw [MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_vertical_apply,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_vertical_apply,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_horizontal_single,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_upDot_single,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_upDot_single,
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
      simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      rw [MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single,
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_upDot_single]
      congr 1
      -- Second equality: the dot eligibility equation moves d across g'(y).
      change (x * d.element) * g'.toHom (y * e.element) =
        (x * g.toHom y) * (d.element * g'.toHom e.element)
      rw [map_mul, ← mul_assoc (x * d.element), mul_assoc x d.element,
        ← d.intertwines y]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
    change
      ((MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval.horizontal
        rightDot.interpret.eval).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) g' b).eval =
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) g a).eval.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval
    rw [show rightDot = MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex)) from rfl,
      singletonEval d, singletonEval e, singletonEval merged]
    exact both
  · -- The rendered slide in § 3.2 has a genuinely unmarked left input.
    have inner := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp_slide_right (R := Complex) g e
    intro left right
    change
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (.up g)).eval.horizontal
        rightDot.interpret.eval).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) g b).eval =
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) g a).eval.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
          (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval
    rw [show rightDot = MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex)) from rfl,
      singletonEval e, singletonEval (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e)]
    exact inner

ProductParabolicDoubleCosets.proof:
by
  classical
  intro X g r c D A B _ hna hnb hd hda hdb coverD coverA coverB blockSym G K₀ H₀ hleK hleH K H
    Gᵢ rows cols row col localSym Kᵢ Hᵢ Mat rank Q Qᵢ extend
  -- Xiao, § 7.3: transpositions force refinement. Nonemptiness supplies a point in
  -- each row and column, and common coverage places it inside an ambient block.
  have hA : ∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i :=
    parBlockRefines D A hd hna (fun a x hx => (coverD x).mp ((coverA x).mpr ⟨a, hx⟩)) hleK
  have hB : ∀ b, ∃ i, B b ⊆ D i :=
    parBlockRefines D B hd hnb (fun b x hx => (coverD x).mp ((coverB x).mpr ⟨b, hx⟩)) hleH
  have hcoverA (x : Nat) (hx : ∃ i, x ∈ D i) : ∃ a, x ∈ A a :=
    (coverA x).mp ((coverD x).mpr hx)
  have hcoverB (x : Nat) (hx : ∃ i, x ∈ D i) : ∃ b, x ∈ B b :=
    (coverB x).mp ((coverD x).mpr hx)
  have partA := parBlockPart_partition D A hd hna hda hA (fun i x hx => hcoverA x ⟨i, hx⟩)
  have partB := parBlockPart_partition D B hd hnb hdb hB (fun i x hx => hcoverB x ⟨i, hx⟩)

  -- Restriction gives the product isomorphism. The inverse uses the increasing
  -- Fin list order specified in Lean. At any point at most one factor can act.
  let split : G ≃* ∀ i, Gᵢ i := parBlockSplit D hd
  have hK (p : G) : p ∈ K ↔ ∀ i, split p i ∈ Kᵢ i :=
    parBlockSplit_mem D A hd hda hA hcoverA (fun i => (partA i).2) p
  have hH (p : G) : p ∈ H ↔ ∀ i, split p i ∈ Hᵢ i :=
    parBlockSplit_mem D B hd hdb hB hcoverB (fun i => (partB i).2) p
  let quotientSplit : Q ≃ ∀ i, Qᵢ i := parBlockQuotientSplit split K H Kᵢ Hᵢ hK hH
  have hquot (p : G) (i : Fin g) :
      quotientSplit (DoubleCoset.mk K H p) i = DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split p i) := rfl

  -- Proposition 7.3, steps 1 and 2 in the published HTML, split the ordered
  -- rows and columns and match the corresponding pieces in order. Apply the
  -- compiled supplier to each restricted partition after checking coverage,
  -- nonemptiness and disjointness. Its rank formula retains both step orders.
  have tableaux (i : Fin g) :=
    ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives (D i) (rows i).card (cols i).card (row i) (col i)
      (partA i).1 (partB i).1 (partA i).2.1 (partB i).2.1 (partA i).2.2 (partB i).2.2
  choose classify hcount htable using tableaux
  choose tableau htableClass htableRank using htable
  -- Section 7.3 chooses 1 when either subgroup is the entire factor. In
  -- this branch both the tableau and 1 represent the unique double coset,
  -- so substitute 1 here and keep the ordered matching for the proper factors.
  let localRep (i : Fin g) (R : Mat i) : Gᵢ i :=
    if Kᵢ i = ⊤ ∨ Hᵢ i = ⊤ then 1 else tableau i R
  have hlocalClass (i : Fin g) (R : Mat i) :
      DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (localRep i R) = (classify i).symm R := by
    by_cases h : Kᵢ i = ⊤ ∨ Hᵢ i = ⊤
    · simpa only [localRep, ite_eq_left h] using parBlockCoset_one (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) h ((classify i).symm R)
    · simpa only [localRep, ite_eq_right h] using htableClass i R
  let rep (R : ∀ i, Mat i) : G := split.symm (fun i => localRep i (R i))
  have hrep (R : ∀ i, Mat i) (i : Fin g) :
      quotientSplit (DoubleCoset.mk K H (rep R)) i = (classify i).symm (R i) := by
    rw [hquot]
    change DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split (split.symm _) i) = _
    rw [split.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hlocalClass i (R i)
  refine ⟨hA, hB, split, quotientSplit, classify, localRep, rep, ?_, ?_, hquot, hcount, hlocalClass,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p i x
    rfl
  · exact fun p => ⟨hK p, hH p⟩
  · intro i R hk hh a b x y
    simpa only [localRep, ite_eq_right (not_or.mpr ⟨hk, hh⟩)] using htableRank i R a b x y
  · intro i h R
    simp only [localRep, ite_eq_left h]
  · intro R i j hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    have hxi : x ∈ D i := by
      by_contra h
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem (localRep i (R i)) h)
    have hxj : x ∈ D j := by
      by_contra h
      exact hy (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem (localRep j (R j)) h)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd hij) hxi hxj
  · intro R
    rfl
  · constructor
    · intro R S h
      change DoubleCoset.mk K H (rep R) = DoubleCoset.mk K H (rep S) at h
      funext i
      apply (classify i).symm.injective
      rw [← hrep R i, ← hrep S i, h]
    · intro q
      let R : ∀ i, Mat i := fun i => classify i (quotientSplit q i)
      refine ⟨R, quotientSplit.injective (funext fun i => ?_)⟩
      rw [hrep]
      exact (classify i).symm_apply_apply _
ProductParabolicDoubleCosets.support:
private abbrev parBlockExt {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) :
    Equiv.Perm ↥S →* Equiv.Perm α :=
  Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : α => x ∈ S)

private abbrev parBlockGroup {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α) :=
  ⨆ i, MonoidHom.range (parBlockExt (D i))

private def parBlockProduct {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (p : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)) : Equiv.Perm α :=
  (List.ofFn (fun i => parBlockExt (D i) (p i))).prod

private theorem parBlockList_fixes {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (p : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i))
    (l : List (Fin n)) (x : α) (hx : ∀ i ∈ l, x ∉ D i) :
    (l.map (fun i => parBlockExt (D i) (p i))).prod x = x := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i l ih =>
    change parBlockExt (D i) (p i) ((l.map (fun j => parBlockExt (D j) (p j))).prod x) = x
    rw [ih (fun j hj => hx j (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hj))]
    exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ (hx i (List.mem_cons_self ..))

private theorem parBlockProduct_apply {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (p : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)) (i : Fin n) (x : ↥(D i)) :
    parBlockProduct D p x.val = (p i x).val := by
  have hnot (j : Fin n) (hj : j ≠ i) (y : ↥(D i)) : y.val ∉ D j :=
    fun hy => Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd hj) hy y.property
  suffices h : ∀ (l : List (Fin n)), l.Nodup → i ∈ l →
      (l.map (fun j => parBlockExt (D j) (p j))).prod x.val = (p i x).val by
    simpa only [parBlockProduct, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_id] using
      h (List.ofFn id) (List.nodup_ofFn.mpr fun _ _ e => e) (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  intro l hn hi
  induction l with
  | nil => exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil hi)
  | cons j l ih =>
    rw [List.nodup_cons] at hn
    change parBlockExt (D j) (p j) ((l.map (fun j => parBlockExt (D j) (p j))).prod x.val) = _
    by_cases e : j = i
    · subst j
      rw [parBlockList_fixes D p l x.val (fun k hk => hnot k (by
        rintro rfl
        exact hn.1 hk) x)]
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_coe _ x
    · rw [ih hn.2 ((List.mem_cons.mp hi).resolve_left (Ne.symm e))]
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ (hnot j e (p i x))

private theorem parBlockProduct_fixes {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (p : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)) (x : α)
    (hx : ∀ i, x ∉ D i) : parBlockProduct D p x = x := by
  simpa only [parBlockProduct, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_id] using
    parBlockList_fixes D p (List.ofFn id) x (fun i _ => hx i)

private theorem parBlockProduct_mem {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (p : ∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)) :
    parBlockProduct D p ∈ parBlockGroup D := by
  apply Subgroup.list_prod_mem
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hσ
  exact Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem i ⟨p i, rfl⟩

private theorem parBlockPreserve {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    {p : Equiv.Perm α} (hp : p ∈ parBlockGroup D) :
    (∀ i x, x ∈ D i → p x ∈ D i) ∧ (∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ D i) → p x = x) := by
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction _ (C := fun f : Equiv.Perm α =>
    (∀ i x, x ∈ D i → f x ∈ D i) ∧ (∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ D i) → f x = x))
    hp ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro j _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, fun x hx => Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g (hx j)⟩
    intro i x hx
    by_cases e : i = j
    · subst j
      exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem g x).mpr hx
    · have hj : x ∉ D j := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd e) hx h
      rwa [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g hj]
  · exact ⟨fun _ _ hx => hx, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  · intro f g hf hg
    refine ⟨fun i x hx => hf.1 i (g x) (hg.1 i x hx), fun x hx => ?_⟩
    change f (g x) = x
    rw [hg.2 x hx, hf.2 x hx]

private theorem parBlockPreserve_iff {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    {p : Equiv.Perm α} (hp : p ∈ parBlockGroup D) (i : Fin n) (x : α) :
    p x ∈ D i ↔ x ∈ D i := by
  refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, (parBlockPreserve D hd hp).1 i x⟩
  simpa using (parBlockPreserve D hd ((parBlockGroup D).inv_mem hp)).1 i (p x) hx

private theorem parBlockProduct_restrict {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) (hp : ∀ i x, p x ∈ D i ↔ x ∈ D i)
    (hfix : ∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ D i) → p x = x) :
    parBlockProduct D (fun i => p.subtypePerm (hp i)) = p := by
  ext x
  by_cases h : ∃ i, x ∈ D i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    exact parBlockProduct_apply D hd _ i ⟨x, hi⟩
  · have hx : ∀ i, x ∉ D i := fun i hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [parBlockProduct_fixes D _ x hx, hfix x hx]

private noncomputable def parBlockSplit {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j))) :
    parBlockGroup D ≃* (∀ i, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i)) where
  toFun p i := p.val.subtypePerm (parBlockPreserve_iff D hd p.property i)
  invFun q := ⟨parBlockProduct D q, parBlockProduct_mem D q⟩
  left_inv p := Subtype.ext (parBlockProduct_restrict D hd p.val
    (parBlockPreserve_iff D hd p.property) (parBlockPreserve D hd p.property).2)
  right_inv q := funext fun i => Equiv.ext fun x =>
    Subtype.ext (parBlockProduct_apply D hd q i x)
  map_mul' _ _ := funext fun _ => Equiv.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl

private theorem parBlockGroup_of_preserve {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {n : Nat}
    (D : Fin n → Finset α) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (p : Equiv.Perm α) (hp : ∀ i x, x ∈ D i → p x ∈ D i)
    (hfix : ∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ D i) → p x = x) :
    p ∈ parBlockGroup D := by
  have hperm (i : Fin n) (x : α) : p x ∈ D i ↔ x ∈ D i := by
    refine ⟨fun h => ?_, hp i x⟩
    classical
    let f : ↥(D i) → ↥(D i) := fun y => ⟨p y.val, hp i y.val y.property⟩
    have hf : Function.Injective f := fun y z he => Subtype.ext (p.injective (congrArg Subtype.val he))
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Finite.injective_iff_surjective.mp hf) (⟨p x, h⟩ : ↥(D i))
    have e : y.val = x := p.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hy)
    exact e ▸ y.property
  rw [← parBlockProduct_restrict D hd p hperm hfix]
  exact parBlockProduct_mem D _

private theorem parBlockRefines {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j))) (hna : ∀ a, (A a).Nonempty)
    (hcover : ∀ a x, x ∈ A a → ∃ i, x ∈ D i)
    (hle : parBlockGroup A ≤ parBlockGroup D) :
    ∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i := by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hna a
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover a x hx
  refine ⟨i, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  have hswap : Equiv.swap x y ∈ parBlockGroup A :=
    Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem a
      ⟨Equiv.swap (⟨x, hx⟩ : ↥(A a)) ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩
  simpa using (parBlockPreserve D hd (hle hswap)).1 i x hi

private def parBlockIndices {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat)
    (i : Fin g) : Finset (Fin r) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun a => A a ⊆ D i)

private noncomputable def parBlockIndex {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) :
    Fin (parBlockIndices D A i).card ≃o ↥(parBlockIndices D A i) :=
  Finset.orderIsoOfFin _ rfl

private noncomputable def parBlockPart {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (parBlockIndices D A i).card) :
    Finset ↥(D i) :=
  (A (parBlockIndex D A i a).val).subtype (fun x => x ∈ D i)

private theorem parBlockPart_subset {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (parBlockIndices D A i).card) :
    A (parBlockIndex D A i a).val ⊆ D i :=
  (Finset.mem_filter.mp (parBlockIndex D A i a).property).2

private theorem parBlockPart_of_subset {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) (a : Fin r) (ha : A a ⊆ D i) :
    ∃ j, (parBlockIndex D A i j).val = a := by
  let j : ↥(parBlockIndices D A i) := ⟨a, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ha⟩⟩
  exact ⟨(parBlockIndex D A i).symm j,
    congrArg Subtype.val ((parBlockIndex D A i).apply_symm_apply j)⟩

private theorem parBlockPart_partition {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (hna : ∀ a, (A a).Nonempty) (hda : Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (A a) (A b)))
    (href : ∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i)
    (hcover : ∀ i x, x ∈ D i → ∃ a, x ∈ A a) (i : Fin g) :
    (∀ a, (parBlockPart D A i a).Nonempty) ∧
    Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (parBlockPart D A i a) (parBlockPart D A i b)) ∧
    ∀ x : ↥(D i), ∃ a, x ∈ parBlockPart D A i a := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hna (parBlockIndex D A i a).val
    exact ⟨⟨x, parBlockPart_subset D A i a hx⟩, Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hx⟩
  · intro a b hab
    have hne : (parBlockIndex D A i a).val ≠ (parBlockIndex D A i b).val :=
      fun h => hab ((parBlockIndex D A i).injective (Subtype.ext h))
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hy =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hda hne) (Finset.mem_subtype.mp hx) (Finset.mem_subtype.mp hy)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcover i x.val x.property
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := href a
    have e : i = j := by
      by_contra h
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd h) x.property (hj ha)
    subst j
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := parBlockPart_of_subset D A i a hj
    exact ⟨b, Finset.mem_subtype.mpr (hb.symm ▸ ha)⟩

private theorem parBlockSplit_mem {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat)
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (hda : Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (A a) (A b)))
    (href : ∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i)
    (hcover : ∀ x, (∃ i, x ∈ D i) → ∃ a, x ∈ A a)
    (hlocal : ∀ i, Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (parBlockPart D A i a) (parBlockPart D A i b)) ∧
      ∀ x : ↥(D i), ∃ a, x ∈ parBlockPart D A i a)
    (p : parBlockGroup D) :
    p.val ∈ parBlockGroup A ↔
      ∀ i, parBlockSplit D hd p i ∈ parBlockGroup (parBlockPart D A i) := by
  constructor
  · intro hp i
    refine parBlockGroup_of_preserve _ (hlocal i).1 _ (fun a x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
    · exact Finset.mem_subtype.mpr
        ((parBlockPreserve A hda hp).1 (parBlockIndex D A i a).val x.val
          (Finset.mem_subtype.mp hx))
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (hlocal i).2 x
      exact False.elim (hx a ha)
  · intro hp
    refine parBlockGroup_of_preserve A hda p.val (fun a x hx => ?_) (fun x hx => ?_)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := href a
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := parBlockPart_of_subset D A i a hi
      let y : ↥(D i) := ⟨x, hi hx⟩
      have hy : y ∈ parBlockPart D A i b := Finset.mem_subtype.mpr (hb.symm ▸ hx)
      have hz : parBlockSplit D hd p i y ∈ parBlockPart D A i b :=
        (parBlockPreserve _ (hlocal i).1 (hp i)).1 b y hy
      have hz' := Finset.mem_subtype.mp hz
      change p.val x ∈ A (parBlockIndex D A i b).val at hz'
      rwa [hb] at hz'
    · apply (parBlockPreserve D hd p.property).2 x
      intro i hi
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hcover x ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact hx a ha

-- Section 7.3's componentwise equality follows by applying Mathlib's DoubleCoset.eq
-- in both directions. The reverse direction assembles the chosen left and right
-- factors via split.symm and uses the two subgroup membership equivalences.
private theorem parBlockCoset_eq {G ι : Type*} [Group G] {P : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Group (P i)] (split : G ≃* ∀ i, P i)
    (K H : Subgroup G) (Kᵢ Hᵢ : ∀ i, Subgroup (P i))
    (hK : ∀ x, x ∈ K ↔ ∀ i, split x i ∈ Kᵢ i)
    (hH : ∀ x, x ∈ H ↔ ∀ i, split x i ∈ Hᵢ i) (x y : G) :
    DoubleCoset.mk K H x = DoubleCoset.mk K H y ↔
      ∀ i, DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split x i) =
        DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split y i) := by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    obtain ⟨k, hk, l, hl, rfl⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp h
    refine DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨split k i, (hK k).mp hk i, split l i, (hH l).mp hl i, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    rfl
  · intro h
    have f i := DoubleCoset.eq.mp (h i)
    choose k hk l hl e using f
    refine DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨split.symm k, (hK _).mpr (fun i => ?_),
      split.symm l, (hH _).mpr (fun i => ?_), ?_⟩
    · rw [split.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hk i
    · rw [split.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hl i
    · apply split.injective
      simp only [map_mul, split.apply_symm_apply]
      exact funext e

private noncomputable def parBlockQuotientSplit {G ι : Type*} [Group G] {P : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, Group (P i)] (split : G ≃* ∀ i, P i)
    (K H : Subgroup G) (Kᵢ Hᵢ : ∀ i, Subgroup (P i))
    (hK : ∀ x, x ∈ K ↔ ∀ i, split x i ∈ Kᵢ i)
    (hH : ∀ x, x ∈ H ↔ ∀ i, split x i ∈ Hᵢ i) :
    DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) H ≃
      (∀ i, DoubleCoset.Quotient (Kᵢ i : Set (P i)) (Hᵢ i)) := by
  let f : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) H → ∀ i, DoubleCoset.Quotient (Kᵢ i : Set (P i)) (Hᵢ i) :=
    Quotient.lift (fun x i => DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split x i))
      (fun x y h => funext ((parBlockCoset_eq split K H Kᵢ Hᵢ hK hH x y).mp (Quotient.sound h)))
  refine Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q q'
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ q q' (fun x y h => ?_)
    exact (parBlockCoset_eq split K H Kᵢ Hᵢ hK hH x y).mpr (congrFun h)
  · intro q
    refine ⟨DoubleCoset.mk K H (split.symm fun i => (q i).out), funext fun i => ?_⟩
    change DoubleCoset.mk (Kᵢ i) (Hᵢ i) (split (split.symm fun i => (q i).out) i) = q i
    rw [split.apply_symm_apply]
    exact DoubleCoset.out_eq' (q i)

private theorem parBlockCoset_one {G : Type*} [Group G] (K H : Subgroup G)
    (h : K = ⊤ ∨ H = ⊤) (q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) H) :
    DoubleCoset.mk K H 1 = q := by
  rw [← DoubleCoset.out_eq' q]
  apply DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
  rcases h with hK | hH
  · exact ⟨q.out, (fun x : G => hK ▸ Subgroup.mem_top x) q.out, 1, H.one_mem, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨1, K.one_mem, q.out, (fun x : G => hH ▸ Subgroup.mem_top x) q.out, by simp⟩
