The reverse implication lifts the chosen coordinate factors through the group equivalence using the two subgroup membership equivalences. The same criterion identifies the class of 1 with every local class when either local subgroup is top. Checked at the pinned revision via the compiled Proofs.ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives import.

RestrictionMergeDotSlide.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he
  -- Proposition 3.1, equation (3.3), and the third drawing in §3.2.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:curl
  -- The published PDF matches the local article-revision copy. The local
  -- source copy is a different PDF revision with the same equation and TikZ.
  -- Dot.ofRepresentatives uses he and hd to put the relative conjugators
  -- in the target subgroups and verifies the required intertwining.
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let down := fun {A B : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B}
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single t (1 : Complex))
  let merge := fun (outer : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (inner : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown outer inner)
  -- The route's downDrawing_basis computes on coefficient 1. Its companion
  -- eval_downDrawing and eval_linearDownDot_apply give the singleton formula
  -- at arbitrary coefficient, including after the merge.
  have dotBasis {A B : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B}
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot p q) (x : B) (r : Complex) :
      (down t).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r) =
        Finsupp.single (t.element⁻¹ * x) r := by
    dsimp only [down]
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.eval_downDrawing,
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_linearDownDot_apply,
      MackeyDiagrams.freeLift_single, one_smul, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_downDot_single]
  have slide (g' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G) (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g') :
      let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (g.comp a) (g'.comp a) :=
        ⟨d.element, fun k => d.intertwines (a.toHom k)⟩
      let merged := lifted.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
      (((down e).horizontal (down d)).vertical (merge g' b)).interpret.eval =
        ((merge g a).vertical (down merged)).interpret.eval := by
    dsimp only
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z r
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun xy => ?_)
    rcases xy with ⟨x, y⟩
    change H at x
    change G at y
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (g.comp a) (g'.comp a) :=
      ⟨d.element, fun k => d.intertwines (a.toHom k)⟩
    let merged := lifted.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let input := Finsupp.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a).pair
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction g) x y) r
    -- Follow the simple-tensor calculation for (3.1) in Proposition 3.1.
    -- For (3.3), represent simple tensors by balanced pairs in the reversed
    -- restriction order and use Diagram.eval_mergeDown_single. The registered
    -- dot and merge endpoints give the corresponding group-algebra formulas.
    -- The shared drawing interpreter composes evaluated maps, so use
    -- Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, the map formula underlying eval_horizontal_single.
    change (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown g' b).eval.toLinearMap
        (((down e).interpret.eval.horizontal (down d).interpret.eval).toLinearMap input) =
      (down merged).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
        ((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown g a).eval.toLinearMap input)
    dsimp only [input]
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, dotBasis, dotBasis,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul,
      mul_one, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_mergeDown_single,
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_mergeDown_single, dotBasis]
    -- The downward dots invert the group elements termwise. The outer dot's
    -- inverse intertwiner moves d⁻¹ past g'(x) in that order.
    -- Inverting the composite dot gives g'(e⁻¹) * d⁻¹, the multiplier of (3.3).
    have commute : g'.toHom x * d.element⁻¹ = d.element⁻¹ * g.toHom x :=
      d.inverse.intertwines x
    congr 1
    change g'.toHom (e.element⁻¹ * x) * (d.element⁻¹ * y) =
      (d.element * g'.toHom e.element)⁻¹ * (g.toHom x * y)
    simp only [map_mul, mul_inv_rev, map_inv, mul_assoc]
    rw [← mul_assoc (g'.toHom x) d.element⁻¹ y, commute, mul_assoc]
  change (∀ (γ' : U) (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G), _) ∧ _
  constructor
  · intro γ' hγ' hd
    exact slide (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ')
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd)
  · -- In the third drawing of §3.2 the outer leg is unmarked. Specialize to
    -- d = 1 and use the downward identity-dot evaluation theorem on that leg.
    have hs := slide g (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id g)
    dsimp only at hs
    have hmerged :
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical
          (⟨(MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id g).element,
            fun k => (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id g).intertwines (a.toHom k)⟩ :
            MackeyDiagrams.Dot (g.comp a) (g.comp a))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e := by
      apply MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ext
      exact one_mul _
    rw [hmerged] at hs
    change ((down e).interpret.eval.horizontal
        ((down (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id g)).interpret.eval)).vertical
          (merge g b).interpret.eval =
      (merge g a).interpret.eval.vertical
        (down (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e)).interpret.eval at hs
    rw [show (down (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id g)).interpret.eval =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down g).basis from
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing_identity g] at hs
    exact hs

InductionRestrictionAdjunction.proof:
by
  intro U _ H G α hα A B a φ up down downUp cup cap pairDI pairID toRep Ind Res pure
  -- Xiao, § 1.2, pp. 3–4. The ordinary cup starts at the empty H
  -- boundary, and the multiplication cap ends at the empty G boundary.
  -- The project TeX and PDF and the current published PDF give the same
  -- formulas and oriented boundaries here.
  -- The strand theorem supplies the image of every group-algebra singleton.
  have hφ := ((InductionRestrictionBimoduleStrands.{u, 0, 0}).1 H G α hα).1
  have hCup : ∀ h : A, cup.toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff h) = pairDI (φ h) 1 :=
    InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.ordinaryCup_pair a hφ
  have hCap : ∀ x y : B, cap.toLinearMap (pairID x y) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * y) :=
    InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.multiplicationCap_pair a
  let m := InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.downUpLinear a
  have hm : ∀ x y : B, m (pairDI x y) = x * y :=
    InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.downUpLinear_pair a
  refine ⟨hCup, hCap, m, hm, InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.downUpLinear_action a, ?_⟩
  let adj : CategoryTheory.Adjunction Ind Res :=
    InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.adjunction a.toHom
  refine ⟨adj, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X h x
    rw [hCup, hm, mul_one]
    exact InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.unitAtScalar a.toHom X h x
  · intro Y x y z
    rw [hCap]
    exact (InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport.counitAtPure a.toHom Y x (y • z)).trans
      (mul_smul x y z).symm
InductionRestrictionAdjunction.support:
namespace InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport

open MackeyDiagrams
universe u

section
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {H G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H G)

local notation "B" => MonoidAlgebra Complex G
local notation "φ" => MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom
local notation "D" => Biset.restriction a
local notation "I" => Biset.induction a

-- The middle actions on D and I are regular. In their balanced quotient
-- [x,y] = [x*y,1]. This is the group-basis form of Alphabeta Math's tensor
-- universal property, Steps 3.1, 4.1 and 5.1. The diagonal action encodes
-- the balance relation, and linearization supplies additivity. This special
-- case has an explicit inverse because the two middle actions are regular.
private def downUpProduct : (Biset.tensor D I).carrier ≃ G where
  toFun := Quotient.lift (fun p : G × G => p.1 * p.2) (by
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨x', y'⟩ ⟨g, hx, hy⟩
    change (a.toHom 1 * x * g⁻¹ = x') at hx
    change (g * y * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹ = y') at hy
    change x * y = x' * y'
    rw [← hx, ← hy]
    simp [mul_assoc])
  invFun x := Biset.pair D I x 1
  left_inv z := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z ?_
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    apply Quotient.sound (s := Biset.balance D I)
    refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change a.toHom 1 * (x * y) * y⁻¹ = x
      simp [mul_assoc]
    · change y * 1 * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹ = y
      simp
  right_inv x := mul_one x

private noncomputable def downUpLinear : ((Biset.tensor D I).carrier →₀ Complex) ≃ₗ[Complex] B :=
  (Finsupp.domLCongr (downUpProduct a)).trans (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm

private theorem downUpLinear_single (x y : G) (c : Complex) :
    downUpLinear a (Finsupp.single (Biset.pair D I x y) c) = MonoidAlgebra.single (x * y) c := by
  simp only [downUpLinear, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Finsupp.domLCongr_single]
  rfl

-- Compare both bilinear maps on group elements with arbitrary coefficients.
private theorem bilinear_eq_of_single {G₁ G₂ : Type u} {V : Type u}
    [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    {p q : (G₁ →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (G₂ →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] V}
    (hs : ∀ (g : G₁) (h : G₂) (r s : Complex),
      p (Finsupp.single g r) (Finsupp.single h s) =
        q (Finsupp.single g r) (Finsupp.single h s)) : p = q := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro g r
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro h s
  exact hs g h r s

private noncomputable def coeffProduct {G : Type u} [Group G] :
    (G →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (G →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] MonoidAlgebra Complex G :=
  ((LinearMap.mul Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)).compl₂
    (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
    (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap

private theorem downUpLinear_pair (x y : B) :
    downUpLinear a (Biset.pairLinear Complex D I x.coeff y.coeff) = x * y := by
  have he : (Biset.pairLinear Complex D I).compr₂ (downUpLinear a).toLinearMap =
      coeffProduct := by
    apply bilinear_eq_of_single
    intro g h r s
    change downUpLinear a (Biset.pairLinear Complex D I (Finsupp.single g r)
      (Finsupp.single h s)) = MonoidAlgebra.single g r * MonoidAlgebra.single h s
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, downUpLinear_single, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun he x.coeff) y.coeff

private theorem downUpLinear_action (k l : H) (z : (Biset.tensor D I).carrier →₀ Complex) :
    downUpLinear a (Biset.actLinear Complex (Biset.tensor D I) (k, l⁻¹) z) =
      φ (MonoidAlgebra.single k 1) * downUpLinear a z * φ (MonoidAlgebra.single l 1) := by
  let left : B →ₗ[Complex] B :=
    LinearMap.mul Complex B (φ (MonoidAlgebra.single k 1))
  let right : B →ₗ[Complex] B :=
    (LinearMap.mul Complex B).flip (φ (MonoidAlgebra.single l 1))
  have he :
      (downUpLinear a).toLinearMap.comp (Biset.actLinear Complex (Biset.tensor D I) (k, l⁻¹)) =
        right.comp (left.comp (downUpLinear a).toLinearMap) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro q c
    refine Quotient.inductionOn q ?_
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    change downUpLinear a (Biset.actLinear Complex (Biset.tensor D I) (k, l⁻¹)
        (Finsupp.single (Biset.pair D I x y) c)) =
      φ (MonoidAlgebra.single k 1) * downUpLinear a (Finsupp.single (Biset.pair D I x y) c) *
        φ (MonoidAlgebra.single l 1)
    rw [Biset.actLinear_single]
    change downUpLinear a (Finsupp.single (Biset.pair D I (a.toHom k * x * (1 : G)⁻¹)
        ((1 : G) * y * (a.toHom l⁻¹)⁻¹)) c) = _
    simp only [downUpLinear_single, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, map_inv, inv_inv]
    change _ = MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain a.toHom (MonoidAlgebra.single k 1) * _ *
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain a.toHom (MonoidAlgebra.single l 1)
    simp [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_assoc]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun he z

private theorem ordinaryCup_pair
    (hφ : ∀ (h : H) (c : Complex), φ (MonoidAlgebra.single h c) = MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) c)
    (h : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) :
    (Diagram.ordinaryCup (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap h.coeff =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex D I (φ h).coeff (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : B)) := by
  let coeff := MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv (M := G) (S := Complex) Complex
  let q := (Biset.pairLinear Complex D I).flip (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : B))
  have he :
      (Diagram.ordinaryCup (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap =
        q.comp (coeff.toLinearMap.comp ((φ).toLinearMap.comp
          (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap)) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro k c
    change (Diagram.ordinaryCup (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single k c) =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex D I (φ (MonoidAlgebra.single k c)).coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1)
    rw [hφ, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one,
      Diagram.eval_ordinaryCup_single]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun he h.coeff

private theorem multiplicationCap_pair (x y : B) :
    (Diagram.multiplicationCap (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap
      (Biset.pairLinear Complex I D x.coeff y.coeff) = (x * y).coeff := by
  let coeff := MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv (M := G) (S := Complex) Complex
  let cap := (Diagram.multiplicationCap (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap
  apply coeff.symm.injective
  have he : (Biset.pairLinear Complex I D).compr₂ (coeff.symm.toLinearMap.comp cap) =
      coeffProduct := by
    apply bilinear_eq_of_single
    intro g h r s
    change MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (cap (Biset.pairLinear Complex I D
      (Finsupp.single g r) (Finsupp.single h s))) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single g r * MonoidAlgebra.single h s
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, Diagram.eval_multiplicationCap_single,
      MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun he x.coeff) y.coeff

end

open CategoryTheory MackeyDiagrams
universe u v

section
variable {H G : Type u} [Group H] [Group G] (f : H →* G)

local notation "A" => MonoidAlgebra Complex H
local notation "B" => MonoidAlgebra Complex G
local notation "φ" => MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f

private noncomputable abbrev ind :
    ModuleCat.{max u v} A ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} B :=
  (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex f) ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra

private noncomputable abbrev res :
    ModuleCat.{max u v} B ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} A :=
  ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ).toRingHom

private noncomputable abbrev restrictedRep :
    ModuleCat.{max u v} B ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} A :=
  Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ (Rep.resFunctor f ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra)

-- The carrier is unchanged by both restrictions. The actions agree on the
-- group basis, so the identity is linear for every element of the group algebra.
private theorem restrictionAction (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B)
    (r : A) (y : (restrictedRep f).obj Y) :
    r • y = φ r • (show Y from y) := by
  let ρ := Representation.ofModule (k := Complex) (G := G) Y
  let σ : Representation Complex H (RestrictScalars Complex B Y) := ρ.comp f
  have hf : σ.asAlgebraHom = ρ.asAlgebraHom.comp φ := by
    apply (MonoidAlgebra.lift Complex _ H).symm.injective
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro h
    change σ.asAlgebraHom (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) =
      ρ.asAlgebraHom (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain f (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1))
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one,
      Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
    rfl
  change σ.asAlgebraHom r y = _
  rw [hf]
  exact Representation.ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply Y (φ r) y

private noncomputable def restrictionIso : restrictedRep.{u,v} f ≅ res.{u,v} f :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun Y =>
    (show (restrictedRep f).obj Y ≃ₗ[A] (res f).obj Y from
      { toEquiv := Equiv.refl Y
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := restrictionAction f Y }).toModuleIso) (by
          intro X Y g
          apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
          ext x
          rfl)

-- The coordinator's representation adjunction works for this homomorphism
-- at arbitrary index. Transport both sides with the module equivalences.
private noncomputable def adjunction : ind.{u,v} f ⊣ res.{u,v} f :=
  (((Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).symm.toAdjunction.comp
    (Rep.indResAdjunction Complex f)).comp
      (Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G)).toAdjunction).ofNatIsoRight
        (restrictionIso f)

private noncomputable abbrev pureTensor (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (b : B) (x : X) :
    (ind f).obj X :=
  let ρ := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X |>.ρ
  (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind f ρ)).symm
    (freeLift Complex (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x) b.coeff)

private theorem unitAtOne (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (x : X) :
    ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom x = pureTensor f X 1 x := by
  let ρ := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X |>.ρ
  let x' : (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X := x
  let σ := Representation.ind f ρ
  have hp : pureTensor f X 1 x = σ.asModuleEquiv.symm (Representation.IndV.mk f ρ 1 x') := by
    change σ.asModuleEquiv.symm
      (freeLift Complex (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x')
        (Finsupp.single 1 1)) = _
    rw [freeLift_single, inv_one, one_smul]
  exact (show ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom x =
    σ.asModuleEquiv.symm (Representation.IndV.mk f ρ 1 x') from rfl).trans hp.symm

private theorem pureTensor_smul_unit (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (b : B) (x : X) :
    pureTensor f X b x = (b • (pureTensor f X 1 x) : (ind f).obj X) := by
  let ρ := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X |>.ρ
  let σ := Representation.ind f ρ
  apply σ.asModuleEquiv.injective
  change freeLift Complex (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x) b.coeff =
    σ.asAlgebraHom b (freeLift Complex (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x)
      (Finsupp.single (1 : G) 1))
  rw [freeLift_single, inv_one, one_smul]
  induction b using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of g =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, freeLift_single, one_smul,
      Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
    let x' : (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X := x
    change Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x' = (Representation.ind f ρ) g
      (Representation.IndV.mk f ρ 1 x')
    rw [Representation.ind_mk, one_mul]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, ha, hb]
  | smul c b hb =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hb]

-- The inverse index converts Mathlib's right multiplication on the group
-- index into left multiplication on the group-algebra input.
private theorem unitAtScalar (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (h : A) (x : X) :
    ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom (h • x) = pureTensor f X (φ h) x := by
  have he : ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom (h • x) =
      ((φ h) • (show (ind f).obj X from ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom x) :
        (ind f).obj X) := ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom.map_smul h x
  exact he.trans ((congrArg (fun z : (ind f).obj X => φ h • z) (unitAtOne f X x)).trans
    (pureTensor_smul_unit f X (φ h) x).symm)

-- The right triangle evaluates the counit on the generator at 1.
-- Its B-linearity then evaluates every pure tensor.
private theorem counitAtPure (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (b : B) (y : Y) :
    ((adjunction f).counit.app Y).hom (pureTensor f ((res f).obj Y) b y) = b • y := by
  let X := (res f).obj Y
  let y' : X := y
  let e : (ind f).obj X →ₗ[B] Y := ((adjunction f).counit.app Y).hom
  have h := (adjunction f).right_triangle_components Y
  have h₁ : e (((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom y') = y :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom h) y
  have hu : (show (ind f).obj X from ((adjunction f).unit.app X).hom y') =
      pureTensor f X 1 y' := unitAtOne f X y'
  have h₂ : e (pureTensor f X 1 y') = y := by
    rw [← hu]
    exact h₁
  change e (pureTensor f X b y') = b • y
  rw [pureTensor_smul_unit f X b y', map_smul, h₂]

end
end InductionRestrictionAdjunctionSupport

external.usage: Transport the representation adjunction across the equivalences for H and G. The identity on each carrier then compares transported restriction with restriction of scalars, by checking the group action on singletons.

Apply the categorical adjunction at the underlying conjugation homomorphism with complex coefficients and arbitrary index. Its unit on the identity-index generator follows from the definition through Rep.indResHomEquiv. Representation.ind_mk computes the action on generators and accounts for the inverse group index in the reviewed pure tensor.

After transport, apply the right triangle component at a B-module Y and evaluate the resulting map on y. This computes the counit at the identity-index tensor in Ind(Res Y). B-linearity then gives left multiplication on general pure tensors.

RegularModuleRightAction.proof:
by
  intro A B _ _ F _ regular lift M
  -- Xiao, Theorem 1.1, gives the action formula on the regular module.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=2
  -- Alphabeta Math 1.1–1.4. Right multiplication represents Aᵐᵒᵖ in
  -- the endomorphism ring of the regular left A-module. Multiplication
  -- in Aᵐᵒᵖ accounts for the reversal in step 1.3.
  -- Conjugate by the ULift equivalence to use the specified source universe.
  let regularAction : MulOpposite A →+* CategoryTheory.End regular :=
    (ModuleCat.endRingEquiv regular).symm.toRingHom.comp
      ((LinearEquiv.conjRingEquiv lift).toRingHom.comp
        (RingEquiv.moduleEndSelf A).toRingHom)
  -- Functoriality handles the unit and multiplication. Additivity handles
  -- sums and zero, so the induced map on endomorphisms is a ring homomorphism.
  let mapEnd : CategoryTheory.End regular →+* CategoryTheory.End M :=
    { F.mapEnd regular with
      map_zero' := by
        apply CategoryTheory.End.ext
        exact F.map_zero _ _
      map_add' := by
        intro f g
        apply CategoryTheory.End.ext
        exact F.map_add }
  let action : MulOpposite A →+* Module.End B M :=
    (ModuleCat.endRingEquiv M).toRingHom.comp (mapEnd.comp regularAction)
  -- Pull back the evaluation action to package the right-module laws of
  -- steps 1.1–1.4, including additivity in the module argument and both zero laws.
  let right : Module (MulOpposite A) M := Module.compHom M action
  -- Step 2.1. The images of the right multiplications are B-linear.
  -- Step 3.1. The witness retains the original B-module structure.
  refine ⟨⟨ModuleCat.isModule M, ⟨right, ⟨?_⟩⟩⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  · intro a b m
    show action a (b • m) = b • action a m
    exact (action a).map_smul b m
  · intro a m
    -- At op a the regular-module equivalence reduces to LinearMap.mulRight A a.
    rfl

external.usage: Supplies the opposite-ring homomorphism acting by right multiplication for the unital ring A. Its value at MulOpposite.op a is definitionally LinearMap.mulRight A a.
Conjugates the endomorphism ring along the supplied A-linear ULift equivalence and preserves the exact action formula.
Supplies the unit and multiplication laws on mapped endomorphisms. Additivity of F gives the two additional ring homomorphism fields.
Restricts the evaluation module over Module.End B M along the constructed homomorphism from MulOpposite A. Its scalar action is definitionally evaluation of the image endomorphism.

LeftUpReidemeisterCurl.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a up loopDown loopUp straight cup middle cap curl
  have hmid :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeUp Complex a d).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.splitUp Complex a d) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a).basis.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d).basis) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp a d
  have hcup :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.ordinaryCup Complex a).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceCap Complex a) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup_traceCap a
  simp only [curl, middle, cup, cap, straight, up, loopDown, loopUp,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval, hmid, MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_id, ← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate_unassociate, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Generator.ordinaryCup Complex a).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d))),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical, hcup,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  exact MackeyDiagrams.Biset.insertLeftUnit_leftUnit

TwoBlockDoubleCosetMatrices.proof:
by
  intro X A B hA hB hdA hdB hcA hcB n c d R
  -- Xiao, §7.3 (project PDF p. 30, published PDF p. 32), gives the same
  -- classification as the article portal. The portal has no separate numbered
  -- proof here. Its two numbered tableau steps in §7.2 are already proved in
  -- ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives: split each row into consecutive
  -- pieces (step 1), then split each column and match the pieces (step 2).
  obtain ⟨classify, count, chooseRepresentative⟩ :=
    ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives X 2 2 A B hA hB hdA hdB hcA hcB
  -- Sum the two disjoint blocks of either covering partition.
  have total (D : Fin 2 → Finset ↥X)
      (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
      (hc : ∀ x : ↥X, ∃ i, x ∈ D i) :
      ((D 0).card : Int) + ((D 1).card : Int) = n := by
    have cover : D 0 ∪ D 1 = Finset.univ := by
      apply Finset.eq_univ_of_forall
      intro x
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hc x
      fin_cases i
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hi
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ hi
    have h := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (hd (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1))
    rw [cover, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_coe] at h
    change ((D 0).card : Int) + ((D 1).card : Int) = (X.card : Int)
    exact_mod_cast h.symm
  have secondRow : ((A 1).card : Int) = n - c := by
    have h : c + ((A 1).card : Int) = n := total A hdA hcA
    omega
  have secondCol : ((B 1).card : Int) = n - d := by
    have h : d + ((B 1).card : Int) = n := total B hdB hcB
    omega
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    -- Proposition 7.3 gives Nat margins. Expand the two-term sums and do
    -- the parameter calculation in Int, where the article's differences live.
    let M := classify (DoubleCoset.mk _ _ σ)
    have entry (i j : Fin 2) : R i j = (M.val i j : Int) := by
      rw [hσ i j]
      exact congrArg Int.ofNat (count σ i j).symm
    have row (i : Fin 2) : R i 0 + R i 1 = ((A i).card : Int) := by
      have h := M.property.1 i
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      rw [entry i 0, entry i 1]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have col (j : Fin 2) : R 0 j + R 1 j = ((B j).card : Int) := by
      have h := M.property.2 j
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
      rw [entry 0 j, entry 1 j]
      exact_mod_cast h
    have nonneg (i j : Fin 2) : 0 ≤ R i j := by
      rw [entry i j]
      exact Int.natCast_nonneg _
    have r₀ : R 0 0 + R 0 1 = c := row 0
    have r₁ : R 1 0 + R 1 1 = n - c := (row 1).trans secondRow
    have c₀ : R 0 0 + R 1 0 = d := col 0
    refine ⟨R 0 0, ⟨?_, ?_, rfl, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact max_le (nonneg 0 0) (by have h := nonneg 1 1; omega)
    · exact le_min (by have h := nonneg 0 1; omega) (by have h := nonneg 1 0; omega)
    · intro a ha
      exact ha.2.2.1.symm
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨lower, upper, h00, h01, h10, h11⟩, _⟩
    have ha₀ := (le_max_left 0 (c + d - n)).trans lower
    have ha₁ := (le_max_right 0 (c + d - n)).trans lower
    have hac := upper.trans (min_le_left c d)
    have had := upper.trans (min_le_right c d)
    -- The weak bounds allow zero cells. Show nonnegativity before converting
    -- to the Nat matrix of Proposition 7.3, so Int.toNat preserves every entry.
    have nonneg : ∀ i j : Fin 2, 0 ≤ R i j := by
      simp only [Fin.forall_fin_two]
      exact ⟨⟨h00.symm ▸ ha₀, by omega⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    let M : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Nat := fun i j => (R i j).toNat
    have entry (i j : Fin 2) : (M i j : Int) = R i j :=
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg (nonneg i j)
    have rows (i : Fin 2) : Finset.sum Finset.univ (M i) = (A i).card := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have h : R i 0 + R i 1 = ((A i).card : Int) := by
        fin_cases i
        · change R 0 0 + R 0 1 = c
          omega
        · change R 1 0 + R 1 1 = ((A 1).card : Int)
          omega
      have h₀ := entry i 0
      have h₁ := entry i 1
      omega
    have cols (j : Fin 2) :
        Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun i => M i j) = (B j).card := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      have h : R 0 j + R 1 j = ((B j).card : Int) := by
        fin_cases j
        · change R 0 0 + R 1 0 = d
          omega
        · change R 0 1 + R 1 1 = ((B 1).card : Int)
          omega
      have h₀ := entry 0 j
      have h₁ := entry 1 j
      omega
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, _⟩ := chooseRepresentative ⟨M, rows, cols⟩
    refine ⟨σ, fun i j => ?_⟩
    have h := count σ i j
    rw [hσ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    exact (entry i j).symm.trans (congrArg Int.ofNat h)

external.usage: Expands each two-term row and column sum in the Nat matrix from ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives, both when extracting the margins and when certifying the matrix supplied to its representative construction. Checked from Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin through the existing imports.

FiniteParabolicClosure.proof:
by
  classical
  intro blockSym parabolicOn parabolic
  -- Xiao, Proposition 7.1 (project PDF p. 28, published PDF p. 30).
  -- Reindex the finite block families by the Fin indices in the statement.
  -- This also works when the index type is empty.
  have ofFamily {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (X : Finset Nat)
      (blocks : ι → Finset Nat)
      (nonempty : ∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty)
      (disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)))
      (cover : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ blocks i) :
      parabolicOn X (iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))) := by
    let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
    let e := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
    refine ⟨Fintype.card ι, blocks ∘ e, fun i => nonempty (e i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      exact disjoint (fun he => hij (e.injective he))
    · intro x
      rw [cover x]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨e.symm i, by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, e.apply_symm_apply] using hi⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨e i, hi⟩
    · exact (e.iSup_comp (g := fun i => blockSym (blocks i))).symm
  constructor
  · -- Proposition 7.1, conjugation. Use FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks on
    -- the supplied finitary conjugator, and transport the common block witnesses.
    rintro H ⟨X, n, A, hA, dA, coverA, rfl⟩ α
    let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := α
    rw [FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks A hA dA α]
    refine ⟨X.image σ, n, fun i => (A i).image σ, ?_, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
    · intro i
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hA i
      exact ⟨σ x, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    · intro i j hij
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hxi hxj
      obtain ⟨u, hu, hux⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxi
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hvx⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxj
      have huv := σ.injective (hux.trans hvx.symm)
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (dA hij) hu (huv ▸ hv)
    · intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (coverA y).mp hy
        exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hi, rfl⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, (coverA y).mpr ⟨i, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro X H K ⟨n, A, hA, dA, coverA, rfl⟩ ⟨m, B, hB, dB, coverB, rfl⟩
    have sameBlock {ι : Type} {blocks : ι → Finset Nat}
        (disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)))
        {i j} {x : Nat} (hi : x ∈ blocks i) (hj : x ∈ blocks j) : i = j := by
      by_contra h
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint h) hi hj
    constructor
    · -- Proposition 7.1, intersection. The registered formula includes all
      -- cells. The partition omits empty cells, whose extensions fix every point.
      rw [FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks X A B hA hB dA dB coverA coverB]
      let Cell := {ij : Fin n × Fin m // (A ij.1 ∩ B ij.2).Nonempty}
      let cell : Cell → Finset Nat := fun ij => A ij.val.1 ∩ B ij.val.2
      have omitEmpty :
          (⨆ i, ⨆ j, blockSym (A i ∩ B j)) = ⨆ ij, blockSym (cell ij) := by
        apply le_antisymm
        · refine iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun j => ?_
          by_cases h : (A i ∩ B j).Nonempty
          · exact le_iSup (fun ij => blockSym (cell ij)) (⟨(i, j), h⟩ : Cell)
          · rintro f ⟨g, rfl⟩
            have eqOne : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype g = (1 : Equiv.Perm Nat) := by
              apply Equiv.ext
              intro x
              exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g (fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩)
            rw [eqOne]
            exact Subgroup.one_mem _
        · refine iSup_le fun ij => ?_
          exact (le_iSup (fun j => blockSym (A ij.val.1 ∩ B j)) ij.val.2).trans
            (le_iSup (fun i => ⨆ j, blockSym (A i ∩ B j)) ij.val.1)
      rw [omitEmpty]
      refine ofFamily X cell (fun ij => ij.property) ?_ ?_
      · intro ij kl h
        apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
        intro x hx hy
        obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
        obtain ⟨hk, hl⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hy
        exact h (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (sameBlock dA hi hk) (sameBlock dB hj hl)))
      · intro x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (coverA x).mp hx
          obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (coverB x).mp hx
          have hxCell := Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi, hj⟩
          exact ⟨⟨(i, j), ⟨x, hxCell⟩⟩, hxCell⟩
        · rintro ⟨ij, hx⟩
          exact (coverA x).mpr ⟨ij.val.1, (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1⟩
    · -- Proposition 7.1, generated subgroup. FiniteParabolicJoinBlocks uses
      -- walk induction to compose swaps along overlaps, as in steps 1.1 and 2.1 of
      -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-adjacent-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
      -- It uses a finitary swap-closure criterion in place of the cycle factorization
      -- in steps 1.1 and 2.1 of
      -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
      -- The disjoint nonempty covers supply the formula's partition hypotheses.
      -- Keep the index types abstract to match its overlap relation before
      -- specializing to Fin. Recover the partition using its exact filter on X.
      have onJoin {ι κ : Type} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (A : ι → Finset Nat)
          (B : κ → Finset Nat) (hA : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) (hB : ∀ j, (B j).Nonempty)
          (dA : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)))
          (dB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j)))
          (coverA : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ A i)
          (coverB : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ j, x ∈ B j) :
          parabolicOn X ((⨆ i, blockSym (A i)) ⊔ (⨆ j, blockSym (B j))) := by
        let block : ι ⊕ κ → Finset Nat := Sum.elim A B
        let overlap : (ι ⊕ κ) → (ι ⊕ κ) → Prop := fun u v =>
          match u, v with
          | Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j => (A i ∩ B j).Nonempty
          | _, _ => False
        let graph := SimpleGraph.fromRel overlap
        let componentBlock : graph.ConnectedComponent → Finset Nat := fun c =>
          let inComponent : Nat → Prop := fun x =>
            ∃ v, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v
          @Finset.filter Nat inComponent (Classical.decPred inComponent) X
        have memComponent (c : graph.ConnectedComponent) (x : Nat) :
            x ∈ componentBlock c ↔ x ∈ X ∧
              ∃ v, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v :=
          @Finset.mem_filter Nat _ (Classical.decPred _) _ _
        have blockNonempty (v : ι ⊕ κ) : (block v).Nonempty := by
          cases v with
          | inl i => exact hA i
          | inr j => exact hB j
        have blockSubset (v : ι ⊕ κ) : block v ⊆ X := by
          intro x hx
          cases v with
          | inl i => exact (coverA x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩
          | inr j => exact (coverB x).mpr ⟨j, hx⟩
        have overlap_component {u v : ι ⊕ κ} {x : Nat}
            (hu : x ∈ block u) (hv : x ∈ block v) :
            graph.connectedComponentMk u = graph.connectedComponentMk v := by
          cases u with
          | inl i =>
            cases v with
            | inl j => rw [sameBlock dA hu hv]
            | inr j =>
              apply SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
              apply (SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj overlap _ _).mpr
              exact ⟨Sum.inl_ne_inr, Or.inl ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hu, hv⟩⟩⟩
          | inr j =>
            cases v with
            | inl i =>
              apply SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
              apply (SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj overlap _ _).mpr
              exact ⟨Sum.inr_ne_inl, Or.inr ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hv, hu⟩⟩⟩
            | inr k => rw [sameBlock dB hu hv]
        have joinFormula :
            ((⨆ i, blockSym (A i)) ⊔ (⨆ j, blockSym (B j))) =
              ⨆ c, blockSym (componentBlock c) :=
          FiniteParabolicJoinBlocks X A B hA hB dA dB coverA coverB
        rw [joinFormula]
        let _ : Finite (ι ⊕ κ) := by
          let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
          let _ : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
          exact Finite.of_fintype _
        refine ofFamily X componentBlock ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro c
          induction c using SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.ind with
          | h v =>
            obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := blockNonempty v
            exact ⟨x, (memComponent _ x).mpr ⟨blockSubset v hx, v, rfl, hx⟩⟩
        · intro c d h
          apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
          intro x hx hy
          obtain ⟨_, u, huc, hu⟩ := (memComponent c x).mp hx
          obtain ⟨_, v, hvd, hv⟩ := (memComponent d x).mp hy
          exact h (huc.symm.trans ((overlap_component hu hv).trans hvd))
        · intro x
          constructor
          · intro hx
            obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (coverA x).mp hx
            exact ⟨graph.connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl i),
              (memComponent _ x).mpr ⟨hx, Sum.inl i, rfl, hi⟩⟩
          · rintro ⟨c, hx⟩
            exact ((memComponent c x).mp hx).1
      exact onJoin A B hA hB dA dB coverA coverB

  intro U inst G A D F C E repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF
    hGA hAD hDF hGC hCE hEF ga ad df gc ce ef u v bottomPair topPair
    bottomEmbedding topEmbedding word bottom top straightDrawing mergeDrawing splitDrawing
    splitBottom mergeTop evaluate mergedEvaluation multiplier alongBoundary dotValueBoundary
    allowed realizes crossing crossLeft crossRight
  have hBottom (f : F) : (bottomEmbedding.toHom f : U) = u * (f : U) * u⁻¹ := by
    simp only [bottomEmbedding, bottomPair, ga, ad, df, u, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply,
      ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_apply]
    group
  have hTop (f : F) : (topEmbedding.toHom f : U) = v * (f : U) * v⁻¹ := by
    simp only [topEmbedding, topPair, gc, ce, ef, v, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply,
      ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_apply]
    group
  have hu (f : F) : u * (f : U) * u⁻¹ ∈ G := hBottom f ▸ (bottomEmbedding.toHom f).property
  have hv (f : F) : v * (f : U) * v⁻¹ ∈ G := hTop f ▸ (topEmbedding.toHom f).property
  have hbe : bottomEmbedding = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator u hu :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext (fun f => Subtype.ext (hBottom f)))
  have hte : topEmbedding = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator v hv :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext (fun f => Subtype.ext (hTop f)))
  -- Fixed-boundary part of the proof of Lemma 6.1. Evaluate at the regular
  -- generator and use the inverse trivalent maps to recover the original map.
  refine ⟨fun f => ⟨hBottom f, hTop f⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro map z
    calc
      map z = map (z • 1) := congrArg map (mul_one z).symm
      _ = z * map 1 := map.map_smul z 1
  · intro drawing z
    exact evalAtOne ((splitThree ga ad df).vertical
      (drawing.interpret.eval.vertical (mergeThree gc ce ef))) z
  · intro d e
    exact recoverEvaluation (a := bottomEmbedding) (b := topEmbedding) (splitThree ga ad df) (mergeThree ga ad df)
      (mergeThree gc ce ef) (splitThree gc ce ef) (mergeThree_splitThree ga ad df)
      (mergeThree_splitThree gc ce ef) d.interpret.eval e.interpret.eval
  · intro p rightMul rightLinear intertwines
    have he : (∀ f : F, bottomEmbedding.toHom f * p = p * topEmbedding.toHom f) ↔

      constructor
      · intro h f
        simpa only [intertwines, Subgroup.coe_mul, hBottom, hTop] using
          congrArg Subtype.val (h f)
      · intro h f
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa only [Subgroup.coe_mul, hBottom, hTop] using h f
    refine ⟨?_, he.symm.trans (centralizer_iff hBottom hTop p)⟩
    have hl := ((GroupElementDotCriterion F G u v hu hv).2.1 p).1

      dsimp only [rightLinear, rightMul, alongBoundary]
      rw [hbe, hte]

  -- Each eligible summand stays eligible under whiskering and multiplication.
  · intro B gb bd be x₁ x₂ x₃ left

    rw [formula] at hp

        (splitThree ga ad df) (mergeThree ga ab' b'f) (splitThree ga ab' b'f)

        (rightCross gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃)

ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers.support:
/-!
Ian Xiao, *Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition*,
§ 6.1, pp. 19–20, fixed-boundary setup and proof of Lemma 6.1.
The route has no verified Alphabeta counterpart with numbered proof steps.

InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits gives the merge formula after choosing
representatives of the symbolic embeddings. GroupElementDotCriterion gives
right-linearity for basis multipliers and evaluation of each eligible group dot.
The inverse merge and split lemmas and the associator basis rule identify the
two ways of merging three strands. Horizontal composition then evaluates on
balanced pairs and eval_linearUpDot_apply extends group-dot evaluation to
finite labels at the single marked vertex.

For support, the article expands the three labels. Here containment of the
product support gives contributing factors, with their eligibility inherited
from the typed dot labels. This also covers zero labels and canceled terms.
-/

namespace ThreeInductionMultiplierProof

open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped Pointwise

noncomputable section

variable {U : Type*} [Group U]
variable {P Q Q' S S' T : Subgroup U}

private abbrev GA (P : Subgroup U) := MonoidAlgebra Complex P

private abbrev along (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) :=
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom

private abbrev dotValue {a b : ConjEmbedding Q P} (x : DotLabel Complex a b) : GA P :=
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element x)

private abbrev merge (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q) :=
  (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval

private abbrev split (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q) :=
  (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a b).eval

private abbrev straight (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) :=
  Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.up a).basis

private abbrev dot {a b : ConjEmbedding Q P} (x : DotLabel Complex a b) :=
  x.upDrawing.interpret.eval

private abbrev assoc (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :=
  (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.up a) (.up b) (.up c)).eval

private abbrev unassoc (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :=
  (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) (.up a) (.up b) (.up c)).eval

private abbrev pair (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q) :=
  Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.up a).basis (Word.up b).basis

private def mergeThree (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :=
  ((merge a b).horizontal (straight c)).vertical (merge (a.comp b) c)

private def splitThree (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :=
  (split (a.comp b) c).vertical ((split a b).horizontal (straight c))

private theorem mergeSplit (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q) :
    (merge a b).vertical (split a b) = Biset.Hom.id _ :=
  Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp a b

private theorem splitMerge (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q) :
    (split a b).vertical (merge a b) = Biset.Hom.id _ :=
  Diagram.splitUp_mergeUp a b

private theorem mergeThree_splitThree (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :
    (mergeThree a b c).vertical (splitThree a b c) = Biset.Hom.id _ := by
  unfold mergeThree splitThree
  refine Biset.Hom.cancel_middle _ _ _ _ (mergeSplit _ _) ?_
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, mergeSplit, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]

private theorem mergeThree_assoc (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :
    mergeThree a b c = (assoc a b c).vertical
      (((straight a).horizontal (merge b c)).vertical (merge a (b.comp c))) := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro t r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn t (fun xy => ?_)
  rcases xy with ⟨xy, z⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn xy (fun xy => ?_)
  rcases xy with ⟨x, y⟩
  let A := Word.up a
  let B := Word.up b
  let C := Word.up c
  let input := Finsupp.single ((A.basis.tensor B.basis).pair C.basis
    (A.basis.pair B.basis x y) z) r
  change (merge (a.comp b) c).toLinearMap
      (((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b) (Diagram.id C)).eval).toLinearMap input) =
    (merge a (b.comp c)).toLinearMap
      (((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id A) (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) b c)).eval).toLinearMap
        ((assoc a b c).toLinearMap input))
  dsimp only [input]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.mergeUp a b) (Diagram.id C),
    Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  simp only [map_smul]
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_associate_single A B C,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id A) (Diagram.mergeUp b c),
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  simp only [map_smul]
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single]
  simp only [ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, map_mul, mul_assoc]

private theorem splitThree_assoc (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) :
    (splitThree a b c).vertical (assoc a b c) =
      (split a (b.comp c)).vertical ((straight a).horizontal (split b c)) := by
  let m := ((straight a).horizontal (merge b c)).vertical (merge a (b.comp c))
  let s := (split a (b.comp c)).vertical ((straight a).horizontal (split b c))
  have hm : m.vertical s = Biset.Hom.id _ := by
    refine Biset.Hom.cancel_middle _ _ _ _ (mergeSplit _ _) ?_
    rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, mergeSplit, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
  have hs : (splitThree a b c).vertical (mergeThree a b c) = Biset.Hom.id _ := by
    unfold splitThree mergeThree
    simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
    rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((split a b).horizontal (straight c)),
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, splitMerge, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_id, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, splitMerge]
  have step : (splitThree a b c).vertical (assoc a b c) =
      ((splitThree a b c).vertical (mergeThree a b c)).vertical s := by
    rw [mergeThree_assoc]
    change (splitThree a b c).vertical (assoc a b c) =
      ((splitThree a b c).vertical ((assoc a b c).vertical m)).vertical s
    rw [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (assoc a b c), ←
      Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (splitThree a b c), hm, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]
  rw [hs] at step
  exact step

private theorem mergePair (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (x : GA P) (y : GA Q) :
    (merge a b).toLinearMap (pair a b x.coeff y.coeff) = (x * along a y).coeff := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := b.hasRepresentative
  have hr' (q : Q) : r * (q : U) * r⁻¹ ∈ P := hr q ▸ (a.toHom q).property
  have hs' (q : S) : s * (q : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ Q := hs q ▸ (b.toHom q).property
  have ha : a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator r hr' :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext (fun q => Subtype.ext (hr q)))
  have hb : b = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hs' :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext (fun q => Subtype.ext (hs q)))
  subst a
  subst b
  exact ((InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits S Q P r s hr' hs').2.1 x y).1

private theorem splitPair (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (x : GA P) :
    (split a b).toLinearMap x.coeff = pair a b x.coeff (1 : GA Q).coeff := by
  induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | add y z hy hz =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hz]
  | single g r =>
    change (split a b).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g r) =
      pair a b (Finsupp.single g r) (Finsupp.single 1 1)
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one]
    exact Diagram.eval_splitUp_single a b g r

private theorem dotEval {a b : ConjEmbedding Q P} (x : DotLabel Complex a b) (z : GA P) :
    (dot x).toLinearMap z.coeff = (z * dotValue x).coeff := by
  change x.upDrawing.interpret.eval.toLinearMap z.coeff = _
  rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing, Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply]
  unfold dotValue
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero =>
    simp
  | add f g hf hg =>
    simp only [map_add, hf, hg, Finsupp.mapDomain_add, MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_add,
      mul_add, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add]
  | single d r =>
    rw [freeLift_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := b.hasRepresentative
    have hu' (q : Q) : u * (q : U) * u⁻¹ ∈ P := hu q ▸ (a.toHom q).property
    have hv' (q : Q) : v * (q : U) * v⁻¹ ∈ P := hv q ▸ (b.toHom q).property
    have ha : a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator u hu' :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext (fun q => Subtype.ext (hu q)))
    have hb : b = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator v hv' :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext (fun q => Subtype.ext (hv q)))
    subst a
    subst b
    rw [((GroupElementDotCriterion Q P u v hu' hv').2.2.1 d z).1]
    have h : (MonoidAlgebra.single d.element r : GA P) =
        r • MonoidAlgebra.single d.element 1 := by simp [MonoidAlgebra.smul_single]
    change r • (z * MonoidAlgebra.single d.element 1).coeff =
      (z * MonoidAlgebra.single d.element r).coeff
    rw [h, mul_smul_comm]
    rfl

private abbrev cross {a : ConjEmbedding Q P} {b : ConjEmbedding S Q}
    {a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P} {b' : ConjEmbedding S Q'}
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :=
  (merge a b).vertical ((dot x).vertical (split a' b'))

private abbrev leftCross (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : ConjEmbedding S Q') (c : ConjEmbedding T S)
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :=
  (cross (a := a) (b := b) (a' := a') (b' := b') x).horizontal (straight c)

private abbrev rightCross (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) (b' : ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : ConjEmbedding T S')
    (x : DotLabel Complex (b.comp c) (b'.comp c')) :=
  (assoc a b c).vertical (((straight a).horizontal
    (cross (a := b) (b := c) (a' := b') (b' := c') x)).vertical (unassoc a b' c'))

private theorem cross_cancel (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : ConjEmbedding S Q')
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :
    (split a b).vertical ((cross x).vertical (merge a' b')) = dot x := by
  simp only [cross, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
  rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (split a b), splitMerge, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    splitMerge, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]

-- Section 6.1, proof of Lemma 6.1. A crossing on the left contributes the
-- dot itself. The split–merge equalities identify its two merged boundaries.
private theorem leftCross_rule (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : ConjEmbedding S Q') (c : ConjEmbedding T S)
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) (z : GA P) :
    ((splitThree a b c).vertical ((leftCross a b a' b' c x).vertical
      (mergeThree a' b' c))).toLinearMap z.coeff = (z * dotValue x).coeff := by
  have h : (splitThree a b c).vertical ((leftCross a b a' b' c x).vertical
      (mergeThree a' b' c)) = (split (a.comp b) c).vertical
        (((dot x).horizontal (straight c)).vertical (merge (a'.comp b') c)) := by
    unfold splitThree mergeThree leftCross
    simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
    rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((_ : Biset.Hom Complex _ _).horizontal (straight c))
          ((merge a' b').horizontal (straight c)),
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
      ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((split a b).horizontal (straight c)),
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, cross_cancel]
  rw [h]
  change (merge (a'.comp b') c).toLinearMap
    (((dot x).horizontal (straight c)).toLinearMap
      ((split (a.comp b) c).toLinearMap z.coeff)) = _
  rw [splitPair, Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear, dotEval]
  change (merge (a'.comp b') c).toLinearMap
    (pair (a'.comp b') c (z * dotValue x).coeff (1 : GA S).coeff) = _
  rw [mergePair, map_one, mul_one]

-- On the right we associate before crossing. The merge evaluates the right
-- label through the exterior embedding, including when its coefficients cancel.
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private theorem rightCross_rule (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) (b' : ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : ConjEmbedding T S')
    (x : DotLabel Complex (b.comp c) (b'.comp c')) (z : GA P) :
    ((splitThree a b c).vertical ((rightCross a b c b' c' x).vertical
      (mergeThree a b' c'))).toLinearMap z.coeff = (z * along a (dotValue x)).coeff := by
  have finish : (unassoc a b' c').vertical (mergeThree a b' c') =
      ((straight a).horizontal (merge b' c')).vertical (merge a (b'.comp c')) := by
    rw [mergeThree_assoc]
    have cancel : (unassoc a b' c').vertical (assoc a b' c') = Biset.Hom.id _ :=
      Biset.unassociate_associate
    rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (unassoc a b' c'), cancel, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  have h : (splitThree a b c).vertical ((rightCross a b c b' c' x).vertical
      (mergeThree a b' c')) = (split a (b.comp c)).vertical
        (((straight a).horizontal (dot x)).vertical (merge a (b'.comp c'))) := by
    unfold rightCross
    simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
    rw [finish, ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc (splitThree a b c),
      splitThree_assoc]
    simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
    rw [
      ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((straight a).horizontal (cross x)),
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
      ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc ((straight a).horizontal (split b c)),
      Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, cross_cancel]
  rw [h]
  change (merge a (b'.comp c')).toLinearMap
    (((straight a).horizontal (dot x)).toLinearMap
      ((split a (b.comp c)).toLinearMap z.coeff)) = _
  rw [splitPair, Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear, dotEval, one_mul]
  change (merge a (b'.comp c')).toLinearMap
    (pair a (b'.comp c') z.coeff (dotValue x).coeff) = _
  rw [mergePair]

private abbrev Supported {a b : ConjEmbedding Q P} (x : GA P) :=
  ∀ p ∈ x.coeff.support, ∀ q, a.toHom q * p = p * b.toHom q

-- The article expands triples of dots. Membership in the support of a product
-- gives a contributing pair even when other terms cancel in the coefficient.
private theorem supportedMul {a b c : ConjEmbedding Q P} {x y : GA P}
    (hx : Supported (a := a) (b := b) x) (hy : Supported (a := b) (b := c) y) :
    Supported (a := a) (b := c) (x * y) := by
  classical
  intro p hp q
  obtain ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩ :=
    Finset.mem_mul.mp (MonoidAlgebra.support_coeff_mul_subset x y hp)
  simp only [← mul_assoc, hx s hs q]
  rw [mul_assoc s, hy t ht q, ← mul_assoc]

private theorem supportedDot {a b : ConjEmbedding Q P} (x : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    Supported (a := a) (b := b) (dotValue x) := by
  classical
  intro p hp
  change p ∈ (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element x).support at hp
  obtain ⟨d, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hp)
  exact d.intertwines

private theorem supportedLeft (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : ConjEmbedding S Q') (c : ConjEmbedding T S)
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :
    Supported (a := (a.comp b).comp c) (b := (a'.comp b').comp c) (dotValue x) :=
  fun p hp t => supportedDot x p hp (c.toHom t)

private theorem supportedRight (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (c : ConjEmbedding T S) (b' : ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : ConjEmbedding T S')
    (x : DotLabel Complex (b.comp c) (b'.comp c')) :
    Supported (a := (a.comp b).comp c) (b := (a.comp b').comp c')
      (along a (dotValue x)) := by
  classical
  intro p hp t
  change p ∈ (Finsupp.mapDomain a.toHom (dotValue x).coeff).support at hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hp)
  simpa only [map_mul, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] using congrArg a.toHom (supportedDot x q hq t)

private theorem merged_vertical {A B C D E F : Biset P T}
    (s : Biset.Hom Complex A B) (d : Biset.Hom Complex B C)
    (m : Biset.Hom Complex C D) (t : Biset.Hom Complex D C)
    (e : Biset.Hom Complex C E) (n : Biset.Hom Complex E F)
    (h : m.vertical t = Biset.Hom.id _) :
    s.vertical ((d.vertical e).vertical n) =
      (s.vertical (d.vertical m)).vertical (t.vertical (e.vertical n)) := by
  simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
  rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc m, h, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]

private theorem leftAct (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (g : P) (z : GA P) :
    (Word.up a).basis.actLinear Complex (g, 1) z.coeff =
      (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1 * z).coeff := by
  induction z using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, mul_add, hx, hy]
  | single x r =>
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Biset.actLinear_single,
      MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single]
    change Finsupp.single (g * x * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹) r = Finsupp.single (g * x) r
    simp

private theorem evalAtOne {a b : ConjEmbedding Q P}
    (f : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up a).basis (Word.up b).basis) (z : GA P) :
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (f.toLinearMap z.coeff) =
      z * MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (f.toLinearMap (1 : GA P).coeff) := by
  induction z using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_add, add_mul, hx, hy]
  | single g r =>
    have he := f.commutes (g, 1) (1 : GA P).coeff
    have h₁ := leftAct a g (1 : GA P)
    rw [mul_one] at h₁
    rw [h₁] at he
    have h₂ := leftAct b g (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (f.toLinearMap (1 : GA P).coeff))
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_ofCoeff] at h₂
    rw [h₂] at he
    have hr : (MonoidAlgebra.single g r : GA P) = r • MonoidAlgebra.single g 1 := by
      simp [MonoidAlgebra.smul_single]
    rw [hr, smul_mul_assoc]
    change MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (f.toLinearMap
        (r • (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1 : GA P).coeff)) = _
    rw [map_smul, he]
    rfl

private theorem threeStage {a b c d : ConjEmbedding T P} {W X Y Z : Biset P T}
    (s₀ : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up a).basis W)
    (m₁ : Biset.Hom Complex X (Word.up b).basis)
    (s₁ : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up b).basis X)
    (m₂ : Biset.Hom Complex Y (Word.up c).basis)
    (s₂ : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up c).basis Y)
    (m₃ : Biset.Hom Complex Z (Word.up d).basis)
    (f : Biset.Hom Complex W X) (g : Biset.Hom Complex X Y)
    (h : Biset.Hom Complex Y Z)
    (i₁ : m₁.vertical s₁ = Biset.Hom.id _) (i₂ : m₂.vertical s₂ = Biset.Hom.id _)
    (r₁ r₂ r₃ : GA P)
    (e₁ : ∀ z : GA P, (s₀.vertical (f.vertical m₁)).toLinearMap z.coeff = (z * r₁).coeff)
    (e₂ : ∀ z : GA P, (s₁.vertical (g.vertical m₂)).toLinearMap z.coeff = (z * r₂).coeff)
    (e₃ : ∀ z : GA P, (s₂.vertical (h.vertical m₃)).toLinearMap z.coeff = (z * r₃).coeff) :
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      ((s₀.vertical ((f.vertical (g.vertical h)).vertical m₃)).toLinearMap (1 : GA P).coeff) =
      r₁ * r₂ * r₃ := by
  rw [merged_vertical s₀ f m₁ s₁ (g.vertical h) m₃ i₁,
    merged_vertical s₁ g m₂ s₂ h m₃ i₂]
  change MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff ((s₂.vertical (h.vertical m₃)).toLinearMap
    ((s₁.vertical (g.vertical m₂)).toLinearMap
      ((s₀.vertical (f.vertical m₁)).toLinearMap (1 : GA P).coeff))) = _
  rw [e₁, one_mul, e₂, e₃, MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_coeff]

private theorem recoverEvaluation {a b : ConjEmbedding T P} {W X : Biset P T}
    (s : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up a).basis W)
    (m₀ : Biset.Hom Complex W (Word.up a).basis)
    (m : Biset.Hom Complex X (Word.up b).basis)
    (s₁ : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up b).basis X)
    (hs : m₀.vertical s = Biset.Hom.id _) (hm : m.vertical s₁ = Biset.Hom.id _)
    (f g : Biset.Hom Complex W X) :
    f = g ↔ MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
        ((s.vertical (f.vertical m)).toLinearMap (1 : GA P).coeff) =
      MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff ((s.vertical (g.vertical m)).toLinearMap (1 : GA P).coeff) := by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    rfl
  · intro e
    have hc : s.vertical (f.vertical m) = s.vertical (g.vertical m) := by
      apply Biset.Hom.ext
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro w
      let z : GA P := MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff w
      have hz := (evalAtOne (s.vertical (f.vertical m)) z).trans
        ((congrArg (fun x => z * x) e).trans (evalAtOne (s.vertical (g.vertical m)) z).symm)
      exact congrArg MonoidAlgebra.coeff hz
    have he := congrArg (fun k : Biset.Hom Complex (Word.up a).basis (Word.up b).basis =>
      (m₀.vertical k).vertical s₁) hc
    simpa only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc, ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc m, hm, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
      Biset.Hom.vertical_id, ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc m₀ s, hs] using he

private theorem centralizer_iff {a b : ConjEmbedding T P} {u v : U}
    (ha : ∀ t : T, (a.toHom t : U) = u * (t : U) * u⁻¹)
    (hb : ∀ t : T, (b.toHom t : U) = v * (t : U) * v⁻¹) (p : P) :
    (∀ t : T, a.toHom t * p = p * b.toHom t) ↔
      u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (T : Set U) := by
  rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h t ht
    have he : (u * t * u⁻¹) * (p : U) = (p : U) * (v * t * v⁻¹) := by
      simpa only [Subgroup.coe_mul, ha, hb] using congrArg Subtype.val (h ⟨t, ht⟩)
    calc
      t * (u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v) = u⁻¹ * ((u * t * u⁻¹) * (p : U)) * v := by group
      _ = u⁻¹ * ((p : U) * (v * t * v⁻¹)) * v := by rw [he]
      _ = (u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v) * t := by group
  · intro h t
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [Subgroup.coe_mul, Subgroup.coe_mul, ha, hb]
    calc
      (u * (t : U) * u⁻¹) * (p : U) = u * ((t : U) * (u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v)) * v⁻¹ := by group
      _ = u * ((u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v) * (t : U)) * v⁻¹ := by rw [h _ t.property]
      _ = (p : U) * (v * (t : U) * v⁻¹) := by group

end

end ThreeInductionMultiplierProof

external.usage: Extract an ordered contributing pair from a nonzero coefficient in a product. Iteration over the two binary products supplies the termwise group-element eligibility argument in Section 6.1.

MixedCrossingFiberMaps.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G L α β a b hα hβ ha hb hs eα eβ ea eb d s A B J σ hσ
    j orbit Ls Limage finiteIndex n X Y qBasis q fiber ι finiteFibers traceArg survives
    rightTransversal
  -- Article §5.1, Proposition 5.1 proof. The shared balanced basis and typed
  -- generators supply the balancing, intertwining, multiplication and trace
  -- rules. The functor-level strand and adjunction comparisons are unnecessary
  -- for these basis columns.
  have hLimage : MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal eα ea = Limage :=
    MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal_range α a hα ha
  have hLs : MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.intersection eα eβ s = Ls := by
    change (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.leftHom eα).range ⊓
      (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.rightHom eβ s).range = _
    rw [MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.leftHom_range α hα,
      MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.rightHom_range β hβ s]
  have hLe := MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal_le eα eβ ea eb d
  change MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal eα ea ≤
    MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.intersection eα eβ s at hLe
  rw [hLimage, hLs] at hLe
  have hsOrbit : s ∈ orbit := by
    change s ∈ DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    exact DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset.2 (DoubleCoset.eq.1 (hσ j))
  have hRange : Set.range q = orbit :=
    (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.range_q eα eβ ea eb d).trans
      (DoubleCoset.doubleCoset_eq_of_mem hsOrbit)
  have hcard (g : G) (hg : g ∈ orbit) : Nat.card (fiber g) = n := by
    have hc := MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.fiber_card eα eβ ea eb d g (hRange.symm ▸ hg)
    change Nat.card (fiber g) =
      (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal eα ea).relIndex
        (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.intersection eα eβ s) at hc
    rw [hLimage, hLs] at hc
    exact hc
  have hfinite : finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex := by
    have hf := MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.all_finite_iff eα eβ ea eb d
    change finiteFibers ↔ (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal eα ea).IsFiniteRelIndex
      (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.intersection eα eβ s) at hf
    rw [hLimage, hLs] at hf
    exact hf
  have hinfinite (g : G) (hg : g ∈ orbit) (hi : ¬ finiteIndex) : Set.Infinite (fiber g) := by
    have hf := MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.fiber_finite eα eβ ea eb d g (hRange.symm ▸ hg)
    change (fiber g).Finite ↔ (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.diagonal eα ea).IsFiniteRelIndex
      (MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.intersection eα eβ s) at hf
    rw [hLimage, hLs] at hf
    exact fun h => hi (hf.1 h)
  refine ⟨hLe, MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.q_pair eα eβ ea eb d,
    MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.multiplication_eval eα eβ ea eb d, hRange,
    fun g hg _ => hcard g hg, hfinite, hinfinite, MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.cap_finite_iff eb,
    fun T hT g hg hi => MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.survivors_infinite eα eβ ea eb d T hT g
      (hinfinite g hg hi), ?_⟩
  intro hf
  exact ⟨MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.projection_eval eα eβ ea eb d hf,
    MixedCrossingFiberMapsAux.projection_transversal eα eβ ea eb d hf⟩
