universe u v

namespace FiniteIndexReverseAdjunctionSupport

open MackeyDiagrams CategoryTheory Representation

noncomputable section

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {H G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H G)

local notation "A" => MonoidAlgebra Complex H
local notation "B" => MonoidAlgebra Complex G
local notation "Img" => a.toHom.range
local notation "φ" => MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom
local notation "bG" => fun g : G => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)
local notation "bH" => fun h : H => MonoidAlgebra.single h (1 : Complex)

private def trace : B →ₗ[Complex] A :=
  (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    freeLift Complex (Generator.traceBasis Complex a) ∘ₗ
    (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap

private theorem trace_single (g : G) (c : Complex) :
    trace a (MonoidAlgebra.single g c) =
      MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (c • Generator.traceBasis Complex a g) := by
  change MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
    (freeLift Complex (Generator.traceBasis Complex a) (Finsupp.single g c)) = _
  rw [freeLift_single]

private theorem trace_image (h : H) : trace a (bG (a.toHom h)) = bH h := by
  rw [trace_single, Generator.traceBasis_image, one_smul]
  rfl

private theorem trace_outside (g : G) (hg : g ∉ Img) : trace a (bG g) = 0 := by
  rw [trace_single, Generator.traceBasis_outside _ _ _ hg, smul_zero]
  rfl

private theorem phi_single (h : H) : φ (bH h) = bG (a.toHom h) := by
  change MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain a.toHom (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) = _
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single]

private theorem trace_bimodule (r s : A) (x : B) :
    trace a (φ r * x * φ s) = r * trace a x * s := by
  induction r using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | add r r' hr hr' => simp only [map_add, add_mul, hr, hr']
  | smul c r hr => simp only [map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, hr]
  | of h =>
    induction s using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
    | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, mul_add, hs, hs']
    | smul c s hs => simp only [map_smul, mul_smul_comm, hs]
    | of k =>
      induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
      | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [mul_add, add_mul, map_add, hx, hx']
      | smul c x hx => simp only [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, hx]
      | of g =>
        simp only [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, phi_single]
        by_cases hg : g ∈ Img
        · obtain ⟨l,rfl⟩ := hg
          simp only [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one, ← map_mul, trace_image]
        · have hn : a.toHom h * g * a.toHom k ∉ Img := by
            rintro ⟨l,hl⟩
            apply hg
            refine ⟨h⁻¹ * l * k⁻¹, ?_⟩
            simp only [map_mul, map_inv, hl]
            group
          simp only [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one, trace_outside a _ hg,
            trace_outside a _ hn, mul_zero, zero_mul]

private theorem cap_pair (x y : B) :
    (Diagram.traceCap (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap
      (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.down a).basis (Word.up a).basis x.coeff y.coeff) =
      (trace a (x * y)).coeff := by
  let p := Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.down a).basis (Word.up a).basis
  let cap := (Diagram.traceCap (R := Complex) a).eval.toLinearMap
  let coeff := MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv (M := G) (S := Complex) Complex
  let coeffA := MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv (M := H) (S := Complex) Complex
  let prod := ((LinearMap.mul Complex B).compl₂ coeff.symm.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ coeff.symm.toLinearMap
  have he : p.compr₂ cap = prod.compr₂ (coeffA.toLinearMap ∘ₗ trace a) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro g c
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro t d
    change cap (p (Finsupp.single g c) (Finsupp.single t d)) =
      (trace a (MonoidAlgebra.single g c * MonoidAlgebra.single t d)).coeff
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, Diagram.eval_traceCap_single,
      MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, trace_single]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun he x.coeff) y.coeff

private abbrev IsTransversal (T : Finset G) :=
  ∀ g : G, ∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ Img

private def quotientEquiv (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    {t : G // t ∈ T} ≃ Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel Img) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun t => Quotient.mk _ t.val) (by
    constructor
    · intro t s h
      obtain ⟨r, _, hu⟩ := hT (t : G)
      exact (hu t (by simp)).trans
        (hu s (QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply.mp (Quotient.exact h.symm))).symm
    · intro q
      refine Quotient.inductionOn q (fun g => ?_)
      obtain ⟨t, ht, _⟩ := hT g
      exact ⟨t, Quotient.sound (QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply.mpr ht)⟩)

private theorem transversal_exists (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    ∃ T : Finset G, IsTransversal a T := by
  classical
  let := finite
  let : Fintype (G ⧸ Img) := Subgroup.fintypeQuotientOfFiniteIndex
  let : Fintype (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel Img)) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv (G ⧸ Img) (QuotientGroup.quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel Img).symm
  let T := Finset.univ.image (Quotient.out (s := QuotientGroup.rightRel Img))
  refine ⟨T, fun g => ?_⟩
  let q := Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.rightRel Img) g
  refine ⟨⟨q.out, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨q, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply.mp (Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq q))
  · intro t ht
    apply Subtype.ext
    obtain ⟨p, _, hp⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp t.property
    have he : Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.rightRel Img) (t : G) = q :=
      Quotient.sound (QuotientGroup.rightRel_apply.mpr ht)
    rw [← hp, ← he, ← hp, Quotient.out_eq]

private theorem cup_fiberSum (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (g : G) :
    (Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
      ∑ p ∈ (Generator.multiplicationCap_finiteFiber a finite g).toFinset, Finsupp.single p 1 := by
  classical
  change (Generator.reverseCup Complex a finite).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) = _
  unfold Generator.reverseCup Biset.Hom.transfer
  rw [Biset.Hom.ofBasis_single, one_smul]
  ext p
  rw [Biset.Hom.transferBasis_apply]
  let ev : (((Biset.induction a).tensor (Biset.restriction a)).carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] Complex :=
    Finsupp.lapply p
  change _ = ev (∑ q ∈ _, Finsupp.single q 1)
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [ev, Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]

-- A right transversal enumerates the entire multiplication-cap fiber.
private theorem cup_leftSum (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (T : Finset G)
    (hT : IsTransversal a T) (g : G) :
    (Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ T, Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) (g * t⁻¹) t) 1 := by
  classical
  rw [cup_fiberSum]
  symm
  let e := (quotientEquiv a T hT).trans (Generator.rightCosetEquivCapFiber a g)
  have he (t : G) (ht : t ∈ T) :
      (e ⟨t,ht⟩).val = (Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) (g * t⁻¹) t := rfl
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun t ht => (e ⟨t,ht⟩).val) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro t ht
    exact (Generator.multiplicationCap_finiteFiber a finite g).mem_toFinset.mpr
      (e ⟨t,ht⟩).property
  · intro t ht r hr h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective (Subtype.ext h))
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := e.surjective ⟨p,
      (Generator.multiplicationCap_finiteFiber a finite g).mem_toFinset.mp hp⟩
    exact ⟨t.val,t.property,congrArg Subtype.val ht⟩
  · intro t ht
    rw [he]

private theorem transversal_mul (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) (g : G)
    [DecidableEq G] : IsTransversal a (T.image (· * g)) := by
  intro q
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := hT (q * g⁻¹)
  have hm (x : G) : q * (x * g)⁻¹ = q * g⁻¹ * x⁻¹ := by group
  refine ⟨⟨(t : G) * g, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t, t.property, rfl⟩⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change q * ((t : G) * g)⁻¹ ∈ Img
    rwa [hm]
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrg⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp s.property
    have hqr : q * g⁻¹ * r⁻¹ ∈ Img := by
      rw [← hm, hrg]
      exact hs
    exact Subtype.ext (hrg.symm.trans (congrArg (fun x : {x // x ∈ T} =>
      (x : G) * g) (hu ⟨r,hr⟩ hqr)))

-- Right multiplication by g permutes right cosets. Using t * g in
-- the left formula gives the same balanced class with first leg t⁻¹.
private theorem cup_rightSum (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (T : Finset G)
    (hT : IsTransversal a T) (g : G) :
    (Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ T, Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) t⁻¹ (t * g)) 1 := by
  classical
  rw [cup_leftSum a finite (T.image (· * g)) (transversal_mul a T hT g),
    Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h => mul_right_cancel h)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  have h : g * (t * g)⁻¹ = t⁻¹ := by group
  rw [h]
section Representations

local notation "f" => a.toHom
local notation "τ" => fun g : G => trace a (bG g)

private theorem trace_left (h : H) (g : G) : τ (f h * g) = bH h * τ g := by
  have e := trace_bimodule a (bH h) 1 (bG g)
  rw [map_one, mul_one, mul_one, phi_single] at e
  simpa only [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one] using e

private theorem trace_right (h : H) (g : G) : τ (g * f h) = τ g * bH h := by
  have e := trace_bimodule a 1 (bH h) (bG g)
  rw [map_one, one_mul, one_mul, phi_single] at e
  simpa only [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one] using e

variable (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H)

private def kernel (t q : G) : X →ₗ[Complex] X :=
  X.ρ.asAlgebraHom (τ (q * t⁻¹))

private theorem kernel_left (t q : G) (h : H) (x : X) :
    kernel a X t (f h * q) x = X.ρ h (kernel a X t q x) := by
  simp only [kernel, mul_assoc, trace_left, map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp,
    Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]

private theorem kernel_balance (t q : G) (h : H) (x : X) :
    kernel a X (f h * t) q (X.ρ h x) = kernel a X t q x := by
  simp only [kernel, mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, ← map_inv, trace_right, map_mul,
    mul_apply_eq_comp, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
  have hh : X.ρ h⁻¹ (X.ρ h x) = x := by
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one]
    rfl
  simp only [hh]

private theorem kernel_at (t : G) (x : X) : kernel a X t t x = x := by
  have h : t * t⁻¹ = f 1 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel, map_one]
  unfold kernel
  rw [h]
  change X.ρ.asAlgebraHom (trace a (bG (f 1))) x = x
  rw [trace_image, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one, map_one]
  rfl

private theorem kernel_off (t q : G) (h : q * t⁻¹ ∉ Img) (x : X) :
    kernel a X t q x = 0 := by
  simp only [kernel, trace_outside a _ h, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

-- The coordinator's Mathlib comparison is stated for a subgroup inclusion.
-- Adapt Rep.indToCoind, Rep.coindToInd and Rep.indCoindNatIso to the
-- given embedding by pulling the image-subgroup action back along
-- the unique preimage in the typed trace. This implements the transport
-- on generators and keeps the reviewed IndV presentation.
private def kernelMap (t : G) : X →ₗ[Complex] coindV f X.ρ :=
  (LinearMap.pi (kernel a X t)).codRestrict _ (by
    intro x h q
    exact kernel_left a X t q h x)

private def toCoindLinear : IndV f X.ρ →ₗ[Complex] coindV f X.ρ :=
  Coinvariants.lift _
    (TensorProduct.lift <| freeLift Complex (kernelMap a X) ∘ₗ
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap) (by
    intro h
    ext t x q
    simp [kernelMap]
    exact kernel_balance a X t q h x)

private theorem toCoind_mk (t q : G) (x : X) :
    (toCoindLinear a X (IndV.mk f X.ρ t x)).val q = kernel a X t q x := by
  simp [toCoindLinear]
  rfl

private def toCoind : Rep.ind f X ⟶ Rep.coind f X :=
  Rep.ofHom ⟨toCoindLinear a X, fun g => by
    apply IndV.hom_ext
    intro t
    ext x q
    change (toCoindLinear a X (ind f X.ρ g (IndV.mk f X.ρ t x))).val q =
      (toCoindLinear a X (IndV.mk f X.ρ t x)).val (q * g)
    rw [ind_mk, toCoind_mk, toCoind_mk]
    simp [kernel, mul_assoc]⟩

private def fromCoind (T : Finset G) : coindV f X.ρ →ₗ[Complex] IndV f X.ρ :=
  ∑ t ∈ T, (IndV.mk f X.ρ t) ∘ₗ (LinearMap.proj t) ∘ₗ (coindV f X.ρ).subtype

private theorem fromCoind_apply (T : Finset G) (w : coindV f X.ρ) :
    fromCoind a X T w = ∑ t ∈ T, IndV.mk f X.ρ t (w.val t) := by
  simp [fromCoind]

-- Each inverse check reduces to the unique t with q in Img * t.
-- These are the one-term reductions in Xiao's dual-basis argument.
private theorem toCoind_fromCoind (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    toCoindLinear a X ∘ₗ fromCoind a X T = LinearMap.id := by
  ext w q
  let ev : coindV f X.ρ →ₗ[Complex] X := (LinearMap.proj q) ∘ₗ (coindV f X.ρ).subtype
  change ev (toCoindLinear a X (fromCoind a X T w)) = w.val q
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := hT q
  rw [fromCoind_apply, map_sum, map_sum]
  change (∑ r ∈ T, (toCoindLinear a X (IndV.mk f X.ρ r (w.val r))).val q) = _
  simp only [toCoind_mk]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (t : G) t.property]
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := ht
    have hq : q = f h * (t : G) := by rw [hh]; group
    rw [hq, kernel_left, kernel_at]
    exact (w.property h t).symm
  · intro r hr hrt
    exact kernel_off a X r q (fun hn => hrt (congrArg Subtype.val (hu ⟨r,hr⟩ hn))) _

private theorem fromCoind_toCoind (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    fromCoind a X T ∘ₗ toCoindLinear a X = LinearMap.id := by
  apply IndV.hom_ext
  intro q
  ext x
  change fromCoind a X T (toCoindLinear a X (IndV.mk f X.ρ q x)) = IndV.mk f X.ρ q x
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := hT q
  rw [fromCoind_apply]
  simp only [toCoind_mk]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem (t : G) t.property]
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := ht
    have hq : q = f h * (t : G) := by rw [hh]; group
    have hker : kernel a X q t x = X.ρ h⁻¹ x := by
      have he : (t : G) * q⁻¹ = f h⁻¹ := by rw [hq, map_inv]; group
      unfold kernel
      rw [he]
      change X.ρ.asAlgebraHom (trace a (bG (f h⁻¹))) x = _
      rw [trace_image, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
    rw [hker, hq]
    have he : f h * (t : G) = f h⁻¹⁻¹ * (t : G) := by rw [inv_inv]
    rw [he]
    simp
  · intro r hr hrt
    have hn : r * q⁻¹ ∉ Img := fun hm => hrt (congrArg Subtype.val
      (hu ⟨r,hr⟩ (by simpa using a.toHom.range.inv_mem hm)))
    rw [kernel_off a X q r hn, map_zero]

private def indCoind (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    Rep.ind f X ≅ Rep.coind f X :=
  Rep.mkIso (.mk (.ofLinearMap (toCoindLinear a X) (fromCoind a X T)
    (toCoind_fromCoind a X T hT) (fromCoind_toCoind a X T hT)) (toCoind a X).hom.2)

private theorem indCoind_inv_independent (T T' : Finset G)
    (hT : IsTransversal a T) (hT' : IsTransversal a T') :
    fromCoind a X T = fromCoind a X T' := by
  ext w
  have hi : Function.Injective (toCoindLinear a X) :=
    (show Function.LeftInverse (fromCoind a X T) (toCoindLinear a X) from
      fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun (fromCoind_toCoind a X T hT) x).injective
  apply hi
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (toCoind_fromCoind a X T hT) w).trans
    (LinearMap.congr_fun (toCoind_fromCoind a X T' hT') w).symm

private def indCoindNat (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    Rep.indFunctor Complex f ≅ Rep.coindFunctor Complex f :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun X => indCoind a X T hT) (by
    intro X Y l
    apply Rep.hom_ext
    apply Representation.IntertwiningMap.toLinearMap_injective
    apply IndV.hom_ext
    intro t
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext q
    change (toCoindLinear a Y (IndV.mk f Y.ρ t (l.hom x))).val q =
      l.hom ((toCoindLinear a X (IndV.mk f X.ρ t x)).val q)
    rw [toCoind_mk, toCoind_mk]
    by_cases hm : q * t⁻¹ ∈ Img
    · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hm
      unfold kernel
      rw [← hh]
      change Y.ρ.asAlgebraHom (trace a (bG (f h))) (l.hom x) =
        l.hom (X.ρ.asAlgebraHom (trace a (bG (f h))) x)
      rw [trace_image, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one,
        Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
      exact (Rep.hom_comm_apply l h x).symm
    · rw [kernel_off a X t q hm, kernel_off a Y t q hm, map_zero])

end Representations

section Modules

local notation "f" => a.toHom

private abbrev Ind : ModuleCat.{max u v} A ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} B :=
  (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex f) ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra

private abbrev Res : ModuleCat.{max u v} B ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} A :=
  ModuleCat.restrictScalars (φ).toRingHom

private abbrev restrictedRep : ModuleCat.{max u v} B ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v} A :=
  (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra ⋙ Rep.resFunctor f) ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra

private theorem restrictionAction (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B)
    (r : A) (y : (restrictedRep a).obj Y) :
    r • y = φ r • (show Y from y) := by
  let ρ := Representation.ofModule (k := Complex) (G := G) Y
  let σ : Representation Complex H (RestrictScalars Complex B Y) := ρ.comp f
  have hf : σ.asAlgebraHom = ρ.asAlgebraHom.comp φ := by
    apply (MonoidAlgebra.lift Complex _ H).symm.injective
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro h
    change σ.asAlgebraHom (bH h) = ρ.asAlgebraHom (φ (bH h))
    rw [phi_single, Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one,
      Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
    rfl
  change σ.asAlgebraHom r y = _
  rw [hf]
  exact Representation.ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply Y (φ r) y

private def restrictionIso : restrictedRep.{u,v} a ≅ Res.{u,v} a :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun Y =>
    (show (restrictedRep a).obj Y ≃ₗ[A] (Res a).obj Y from
      { toEquiv := Equiv.refl Y
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := restrictionAction a Y }).toModuleIso) (by
          intro X Y g
          apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
          ext x
          rfl)

-- Use Rep.resCoindAdjunction for the given homomorphism. The
-- finite-index comparison supplies the change of right adjoint.
private def repAdj (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    Rep.resFunctor.{max u v} f ⊣ Rep.indFunctor Complex f :=
  (Rep.resCoindAdjunction Complex f).ofNatIsoRight (indCoindNat.{u,v} a T hT).symm

private def adjunction (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) :
    Res.{u,v} a ⊣ Ind.{u,v} a :=
  (((Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G)).symm.toAdjunction.comp
    (repAdj.{u,v} a T hT)).comp
      (Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).toAdjunction).ofNatIsoLeft
        (restrictionIso a)

private abbrev pureTensor (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (b : B) (x : X) :
    (Ind a).obj X :=
  let ρ := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X |>.ρ
  (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind f ρ)).symm
    (freeLift Complex (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x) b.coeff)

private theorem pure_single (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (g : G) (x : X) :
    pureTensor a X (bG g) x =
      let ρ := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X |>.ρ
      (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind f ρ)).symm
        (Representation.IndV.mk f ρ g⁻¹ x) := by
  simp only [pureTensor, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, freeLift_single, one_smul]
  rfl

private theorem counit_pure (T : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T)
    (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (b : B) (x : X) :
    ((adjunction a T hT).counit.app X).hom (pureTensor a X b x) = trace a b • x := by
  let Xr := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X
  let ev : coindV f Xr.ρ →ₗ[Complex] Xr := (LinearMap.proj 1) ∘ₗ (coindV f Xr.ρ).subtype
  let x' : Xr := x
  change ev (toCoindLinear a Xr (freeLift Complex (fun g : G => IndV.mk f Xr.ρ g⁻¹ x') b.coeff)) =
    trace a b • x
  have hact : ∀ r : A, (Xr.ρ.asAlgebraHom r) x' = r • x :=
    fun r => Representation.ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply X r x'
  rw [← hact]
  induction b using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of g =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, freeLift_single, one_smul]
    change (toCoindLinear a Xr (IndV.mk f Xr.ρ g⁻¹ x')).val 1 = _
    rw [toCoind_mk]
    simp [kernel]
  | add b c hb hc =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, hb, hc]
    rfl
  | smul c b hb =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul, map_smul, hb]
    rfl

private theorem unit_sum (T T' : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T) (hT' : IsTransversal a T')
    (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (y : Y) :
    ((adjunction a T hT).unit.app Y).hom y =
      ∑ t ∈ T', pureTensor a ((Res a).obj Y) (bG t⁻¹) (bG t • y) := by
  let Yr := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G)).obj Y
  let X := Rep.res f Yr
  let y' : Yr := y
  let c : coindV f X.ρ := ⟨fun t => Yr.ρ t y', by
    intro h t
    change Yr.ρ (f h * t) y' = Yr.ρ (f h) (Yr.ρ t y')
    rw [map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]⟩
  -- Both changes of source representation act by the identity
  -- on the coefficient of each tensor generator.
  let F := Rep.indFunctor Complex f ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra
  let transport := F.map (Rep.unitIso X).hom
  let comparison := (Ind a).map ((restrictionIso a).hom.app Y)
  let mapFromInd : F.obj X ⟶ (Ind a).obj ((Res a).obj Y) := transport ≫ comparison
  let gen (t : G) : F.obj X :=
    (ind f X.ρ).asModuleEquiv.symm (IndV.mk f X.ρ t (c.val t))
  let raw : F.obj X := (ind f X.ρ).asModuleEquiv.symm (fromCoind a X T c)
  have hsum : raw = ∑ t ∈ T', gen t := by
    change (ind f X.ρ).asModuleEquiv.symm (fromCoind a X T c) =
      ∑ t ∈ T', (ind f X.ρ).asModuleEquiv.symm (IndV.mk f X.ρ t (c.val t))
    rw [indCoind_inv_independent a X T T' hT hT', fromCoind_apply, map_sum]
  change mapFromInd.hom raw = _
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  let Z := (Res a).obj Y
  let z : Z := bG t • y
  change mapFromInd.hom (gen t) = pureTensor a Z (bG t⁻¹) z
  rw [pure_single a Z t⁻¹ z, inv_inv]
  have ht : Yr.ρ t y' = bG t • y := by
    rw [← Representation.asAlgebraHom_single_one]
    exact Representation.ofModule_asAlgebraHom_apply_apply Y (bG t) y'
  change mapFromInd.hom (show F.obj X from (ind f X.ρ).asModuleEquiv.symm
    (IndV.mk f X.ρ t (Yr.ρ t y'))) = _
  rw [ht]
  rfl

private theorem unit_at_generator (T T' : Finset G) (hT : IsTransversal a T)
    (hT' : IsTransversal a T') (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (g : G) (z : Y) :
    ((adjunction a T hT).unit.app Y).hom (bG g • z) =
      ∑ t ∈ T', pureTensor a ((Res a).obj Y) (bG (g * t⁻¹)) (bG t • z) := by
  classical
  rw [unit_sum a T (T'.image (· * g⁻¹)) hT (transversal_mul a T' hT' g⁻¹),
    Finset.sum_image (fun _ _ _ _ h => mul_right_cancel h)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  rw [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, ← mul_smul, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one,
    inv_mul_cancel_right]

end Modules

end
end FiniteIndexReverseAdjunctionSupport

external.usage: Used in adjunction to transport restriction and reverse induction from Rep to ModuleCat for each group algebra. restrictionIso checks scalar restriction for the given conjugation embedding on group generators. unit_sum checks both resulting source comparison maps on the coefficient of each induction generator.

Used in repAdj for the actual embedding homomorphism. Its counit is evaluation at 1 and its unit sends y to the function t ↦ ρ(t)y. The local finite-index natural isomorphism changes the right adjoint from coinduction to induction.

Adapted the finite-index inclusion comparison in local Lean declarations. The kernel pulls the image-subgroup action back by the conjugation embedding using the project trace. With the given image finite index, transversal_exists supplies the finite right transversal. The two inverse checks reduce the sums to the unique representative, and the right-coset orientation gives the inverse index in each pure tensor. The adapted maps and their connection to the exact endpoint are compiled in this proof.

ParabolicBlockOperationExample.proof:
by
  intro blockSym blocksA blocksB A B α
  -- Xiao, Example 7.1, after Proposition 7.1. Reindex the two specified
  -- families by Fin 4 so finite checks use the same singleton blocks as the paper.
  -- The archived project PDF (p. 29) and revised published PDF (p. 31) have
  -- different SHA-256 hashes and give the same claims in this example.
  -- FiniteParabolicClosure gives existence of block presentations. The three
  -- registered formulas used below identify the explicit output blocks.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  let a : Fin 4 → Finset Nat := ![{1, 2, 3}, {4, 5}, {6}, {7}]
  let b : Fin 4 → Finset Nat := ![{2, 3, 4}, {6, 7}, {1}, {5}]
  let X : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 7
  have familySup (f : Fin 4 → Finset Nat) (blocks : Finset (Finset Nat))
      (h : Finset.univ.image f = blocks) :
      (⨆ i : ↥blocks, blockSym i.val) = ⨆ i, blockSym (f i) := by
    subst blocks
    rw [iSup_subtype, Finset.iSup_finset_image]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, iSup_pos]
  have hA : A = ⨆ i, blockSym (a i) := familySup a blocksA (by decide)
  have hB : B = ⨆ i, blockSym (b i) := familySup b blocksB (by decide)
  have nonemptyA : ∀ i, (a i).Nonempty := by decide
  have nonemptyB : ∀ i, (b i).Nonempty := by decide
  have disjointA : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (a i) (a j)) := by
    change ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (a i) (a j)
    decide
  have disjointB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (b i) (b j)) := by
    change ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (b i) (b j)
    decide
  have coverOfUnion (f : Fin 4 → Finset Nat) (h : Finset.univ.biUnion f = X)
      (x : Nat) : x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ f i := by
    rw [← h, Finset.mem_biUnion]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have coverA := coverOfUnion a (by decide)
  have coverB := coverOfUnion b (by decide)
  have smallBlock (S : Finset Nat) (hS : S.card ≤ 1) : blockSym S = ⊥ := by
    apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
    rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem f hx]
      exact Finset.card_le_one_iff.mp hS (f ⟨x, hx⟩).property hx
    · exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f hx
  rw [hA, hB]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Conjugation. Alphabeta Math's transposition-generation steps 1.1 and
    -- 2.1 factor cycles and then concatenate the factors. The conjugator here
    -- is already given as two genuine swaps, so closure under multiplication
    -- supplies the finitary hypothesis directly.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
    have swapInClosure {x y : Nat} (hne : x ≠ y) :
        Equiv.swap x y ∈ Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | σ.IsSwap} :=
      Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨x, y, hne, rfl⟩
    have hα : α ∈ Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | σ.IsSwap} :=
      Subgroup.mul_mem _ (swapInClosure (by decide : (1 : Nat) ≠ 4))
        (swapInClosure (by decide : (4 : Nat) ≠ 6))
    rw [FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks a nonemptyA disjointA ⟨α, hα⟩]
    let images : Fin 4 → Finset Nat := ![{2, 3, 4}, {5, 6}, {1}, {7}]
    -- The concrete image check evaluates the two swaps on each input block.
    have imageEq : ∀ i, (a i).image α = images i := by decide
    change (⨆ i, blockSym ((a i).image α)) = _
    simp only [imageEq]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply iSup_le
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact le_sup_left
      · exact le_sup_right
      · rw [smallBlock (images _) (by decide)]
        exact bot_le
      · rw [smallBlock (images _) (by decide)]
        exact bot_le
    · exact sup_le (le_iSup (fun i => blockSym (images i)) 0)
        (le_iSup (fun i => blockSym (images i)) 1)
  · -- Intersection. The formula keeps every cell of the common refinement.
    -- Cells with at most one point contribute the trivial subgroup.
    rw [FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks X a b nonemptyA nonemptyB disjointA disjointB
      coverA coverB]
    change (⨆ i, ⨆ j, blockSym (a i ∩ b j)) = blockSym {2, 3}
    have cells : ∀ i j, a i ∩ b j = {2, 3} ∨ (a i ∩ b j).card ≤ 1 := by decide
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun j => ?_
      obtain h | h := cells i j
      · rw [h]
      · rw [smallBlock _ h]
        exact bot_le
    · have cell00 : a 0 ∩ b 0 = {2, 3} := by decide
      rw [← cell00]
      exact (le_iSup (fun j => blockSym (a 0 ∩ b j)) 0).trans
        (le_iSup (fun i => ⨆ j, blockSym (a i ∩ b j)) 0)
  · -- Generation. Keep the carrier filter in the registered join formula.
    -- Tag every input block by the proposed component. The six explicit
    -- overlap edges give paths to the two representatives, and every edge
    -- preserves the tag because the two output blocks are disjoint.
    have join := FiniteParabolicJoinBlocks X a b nonemptyA nonemptyB disjointA disjointB
      coverA coverB
    -- Retain the supplier’s elaborated graph and component filter.
    extract_lets block graph componentBlock at join
    let V := Sum (Fin 4) (Fin 4)
    let part : Bool → Finset Nat := fun t => if t then {6, 7} else {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}
    let tag : V → Bool := fun v => decide (block v ⊆ part true)
    let rep : Bool → V := fun t => .inr (if t then 1 else 0)
    have blockSubset : ∀ v, block v ⊆ part (tag v) := by decide
    have partSubset : ∀ t, part t ⊆ X := by decide
    have partDisjoint : ∀ t u, t ≠ u → Disjoint (part t) (part u) := by decide
    have cover (x : Nat) (hx : x ∈ X) : ∃ v, x ∈ block v := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (coverA x).mp hx
      exact ⟨.inl i, hi⟩
    have edgeOverlap {v w : V} (h : graph.Adj v w) :
        (block v ∩ block w).Nonempty := by
      cases v <;> cases w
      · exact False.elim (h.2.elim id id)
      · exact h.2.elim id False.elim
      · rw [Finset.inter_comm]
        exact h.2.elim False.elim id
      · exact False.elim (h.2.elim id id)
    have edge (i j : Fin 4) (h : (a i ∩ b j).Nonempty) :
        graph.Adj (.inl i) (.inr j) :=
      ⟨by simp, Or.inl h⟩
    have e00 := (edge 0 0 (by decide)).reachable
    have e10 := (edge 1 0 (by decide)).reachable
    have e02 := (edge 0 2 (by decide)).reachable
    have e13 := (edge 1 3 (by decide)).reachable
    have e21 := (edge 2 1 (by decide)).reachable
    have e31 := (edge 3 1 (by decide)).reachable
    have paths (v : V) : graph.Reachable v (rep (tag v)) := by
      cases v with
      | inl i =>
        fin_cases i
        · exact e00
        · exact e10
        · exact e21
        · exact e31
      | inr j =>
        fin_cases j
        · exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
        · exact SimpleGraph.Reachable.rfl
        · exact e02.symm.trans e00
        · exact e13.symm.trans e10
    have repTag : ∀ t, tag (rep t) = t := by decide
    obtain ⟨componentEq, componentCover⟩ := parabolicExample_components graph X block part tag
      rep blockSubset partSubset (fun h => partDisjoint _ _ h) cover edgeOverlap repTag paths
    have componentEq' (t : Bool) : componentBlock (graph.connectedComponentMk (rep t)) = part t :=
      componentEq t
    have result : (⨆ c, blockSym (componentBlock c)) =
        blockSym (part false) ⊔ blockSym (part true) := by
      apply le_antisymm
      · apply iSup_le
        intro c
        obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := componentCover c
        rw [componentEq']
        cases t
        · exact le_sup_left
        · exact le_sup_right
      · apply sup_le
        · rw [← componentEq' false]
          exact le_iSup (fun c => blockSym (componentBlock c)) (graph.connectedComponentMk (rep false))
        · rw [← componentEq' true]
          exact le_iSup (fun c => blockSym (componentBlock c)) (graph.connectedComponentMk (rep true))
    exact join.trans result
  · -- The endpoint transposition follows the paper's overlapping-block path
    -- using 1–2–4–5. Each edge is a swap of two points of a single input block.
    have swapInBlock (S : Finset Nat) {x y : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) :
        Equiv.swap x y ∈ blockSym S :=
      ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩
    let L := (⨆ i, blockSym (a i)) ⊔ (⨆ j, blockSym (b j))
    have leftLe : (⨆ i, blockSym (a i)) ≤ L := le_sup_left
    have rightLe : (⨆ j, blockSym (b j)) ≤ L := le_sup_right
    have h12 : Equiv.swap (1 : Nat) 2 ∈ L :=
      leftLe (Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (swapInBlock (a 0) (by decide) (by decide)))
    have h24 : Equiv.swap (2 : Nat) 4 ∈ L :=
      rightLe (Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (swapInBlock (b 0) (by decide) (by decide)))
    have h45 : Equiv.swap (4 : Nat) 5 ∈ L :=
      leftLe (Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem 1 (swapInBlock (a 1) (by decide) (by decide)))
    exact SubmonoidClass.swap_mem_trans L (SubmonoidClass.swap_mem_trans L h12 h24) h45
ParabolicBlockOperationExample.support:
private theorem parabolicExample_components
    {V : Type} (graph : SimpleGraph V) (X : Finset Nat)
    (block : V → Finset Nat) (part : Bool → Finset Nat)
    (tag : V → Bool) (rep : Bool → V)
    (blockSubset : ∀ v, block v ⊆ part (tag v))
    (partSubset : ∀ t, part t ⊆ X)
    (partDisjoint : ∀ {t u}, t ≠ u → Disjoint (part t) (part u))
    (cover : ∀ x ∈ X, ∃ v, x ∈ block v)
    (edgeOverlap : ∀ {v w}, graph.Adj v w → (block v ∩ block w).Nonempty)
    (repTag : ∀ t, tag (rep t) = t)
    (paths : ∀ v, graph.Reachable v (rep (tag v))) :
    let componentBlock : graph.ConnectedComponent → Finset Nat := fun c =>
      let inComponent : Nat → Prop := fun x =>
        ∃ v, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v
      @Finset.filter Nat inComponent (Classical.decPred inComponent) X
    (∀ t, componentBlock (graph.connectedComponentMk (rep t)) = part t) ∧
      (∀ c, ∃ t, graph.connectedComponentMk (rep t) = c) := by
  intro componentBlock
  have walkTag {v w : V} (p : graph.Walk v w) : tag v = tag w := by
    induction p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons h _ ih =>
      refine Eq.trans ?_ ih
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := edgeOverlap h
      obtain ⟨hv, hw⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (partDisjoint hne) (blockSubset _ hv) (blockSubset _ hw)
  have memComponent (c : graph.ConnectedComponent) (x : Nat) :
      x ∈ componentBlock c ↔
        x ∈ X ∧ ∃ v, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v :=
    @Finset.mem_filter Nat _ (Classical.decPred _) _ _
  constructor
  · intro t
    ext x
    rw [memComponent]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, v, hv, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨p⟩ := SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mp hv
      have htag := (walkTag p).trans (repTag t)
      exact htag ▸ blockSubset v hx
    · intro hx
      have hxX := partSubset t hx
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := cover x hxX
      have htag : tag v = t := by
        by_contra hne
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (partDisjoint hne) (blockSubset v hv) hx
      exact ⟨hxX, v, htag ▸ SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mpr (paths v), hv⟩
  · intro c
    refine c.ind fun v => ?_
    exact ⟨tag v, (SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.eq.mpr (paths v)).symm⟩

by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a S finite curl straight scaled
  -- Xiao's Theorem 4.1, equation (4.1), is on p. 14 of the archived
  -- original PDF and p. 16 of the revised published PDF. The unnumbered
  -- proof is on pp. 15 and 17, respectively. Both drawings have the
  -- same two mixed junctions and require finite index of δKδ⁻¹ in H.
  -- The undotted part of Proposition 3.1 gives the same cup and cap
  -- calculation. The cap-fiber proof uses the representative
  -- (z * t⁻¹, t) for a right coset of the inner image over z in H.
  -- The earlier ReviewedRightUpCurl uses an explicit cup, cap, merge
  -- and split. Here the two trivalent vertices stay in the statement.
  -- Their interpretations give those same maps at the fixed boundary.
  exact RightUpCurlSupport.eval_trivalent a d finite

open MackeyDiagrams in
private theorem rightUpCurl_assemble {L M : Type u} [Group L] [Group M]
    {W X Y A B : Biset L M}
    (insert : Biset.Hom Complex W X) (cup : Biset.Hom Complex X Y)
    (reassoc : Biset.Hom Complex Y A) (merge : Biset.Hom Complex A B)
    (split : Biset.Hom Complex B A) (assoc : Biset.Hom Complex A Y)
    (cap : Biset.Hom Complex Y X) (remove : Biset.Hom Complex X W) (n : Complex)
    (hMiddle : (reassoc.vertical merge).vertical (split.vertical assoc) = Biset.Hom.id Y)
    (hLoop : cup.vertical cap = (Biset.Hom.id X).scale n)
    (hUnits : insert.vertical remove = Biset.Hom.id W) :
    (insert.vertical (cup.vertical (reassoc.vertical merge))).vertical
        (split.vertical (assoc.vertical (cap.vertical remove))) =
      (Biset.Hom.id W).scale n := by
  calc
    _ = insert.vertical (Biset.Hom.vertical
          (cup.vertical ((reassoc.vertical merge).vertical (split.vertical assoc)))
          (cap.vertical remove)) := by
        simp only [Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
    _ = insert.vertical ((cup.vertical cap).vertical remove) := by
        rw [hMiddle, Biset.Hom.vertical_id, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
    _ = (Biset.Hom.id W).scale n := by
        rw [hLoop, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
          Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right, hUnits]

open MackeyDiagrams in
private theorem rightUpCurl_tensorInverse {L M N : Type u} [Group L] [Group M] [Group N]
    {X Y : Biset L M} (f : Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (g : Biset.Hom Complex Y X)
    (Z : Biset M N) (h : f.vertical g = Biset.Hom.id X) :
    (f.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Z)).vertical (g.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Z)) =
      Biset.Hom.id (X.tensor Z) := by
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, h, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]

open MackeyDiagrams in
private theorem rightUpCurl_tensorScalar {L M : Type u} [Group L] [Group M]
    (X : Biset L M) {Y Z : Biset M M} (cup : Biset.Hom Complex Y Z)
    (cap : Biset.Hom Complex Z Y) (n : Complex)
    (h : cup.vertical cap = (Biset.Hom.id Y).scale n) :
    ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal cup).vertical ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal cap) =
      (Biset.Hom.id (X.tensor Y)).scale n := by
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, h,
    Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_right, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]

namespace RightUpCurlSupport

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}
  (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (d : ConjEmbedding K H)

local notation "UpBasis" => Biset.induction a
local notation "LoopUpBasis" => Biset.induction d
local notation "LoopDownBasis" => Biset.restriction d
local notation "StraightMap" => Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) UpBasis
local notation "InsertUnit" => Biset.insertRightUnit UpBasis Complex
local notation "RemoveUnit" => Biset.rightUnit UpBasis Complex
local notation "Reassociate" => Biset.unassociate UpBasis LoopUpBasis LoopDownBasis Complex
local notation "Associate" => Biset.associate UpBasis LoopUpBasis LoopDownBasis Complex
local notation "Merge" => Biset.Hom.horizontal (Generator.mergeUp Complex a d) (Biset.Hom.id LoopDownBasis)
local notation "Split" => Biset.Hom.horizontal (Generator.splitUp Complex a d) (Biset.Hom.id LoopDownBasis)
local notation "Cup[" f "]" => Biset.Hom.horizontal StraightMap (Generator.reverseCup Complex d f)
local notation "Cap" => Biset.Hom.horizontal StraightMap (Generator.multiplicationCap Complex d)
local notation "IndexScalar" => (d.toHom.range.index : Complex)

-- The merge and split are inverse on the upward pair. Carry the
-- downward identity through both and cancel the two rebracketings.
private theorem middle :
    ((Reassociate).vertical Merge).vertical ((Split).vertical Associate) =
      Biset.Hom.id ((UpBasis).tensor ((LoopUpBasis).tensor LoopDownBasis)) := by
  have h :
      (Generator.mergeUp Complex a d).vertical (Generator.splitUp Complex a d) =
        Biset.Hom.id ((UpBasis).tensor LoopUpBasis) :=
    Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp (R := Complex) a d
  exact Biset.Hom.cancel_middle Reassociate Merge Split Associate
    (rightUpCurl_tensorInverse _ _ LoopDownBasis h)
    (Biset.unassociate_associate (R := Complex))

-- The finite cap fiber gives the same terms as the article's right
-- transversal sum. Generator.capFiber_card counts these terms via
-- Subgroup.index_eq_card and the right-to-left quotient equivalence.
-- The reverse cup's finiteness evidence is precisely for d.toHom.range.
private theorem loop (finite : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    (Cup[finite]).vertical Cap = (Biset.Hom.id ((UpBasis).tensor (Biset.regular H))).scale IndexScalar := by
  have h : (Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite).vertical (Generator.multiplicationCap Complex d) =
      (Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular H)).scale IndexScalar :=
    Diagram.reverseCup_multiplicationCap (R := Complex) d finite
  exact rightUpCurl_tensorScalar UpBasis _ _ IndexScalar h

private theorem calculation (finite : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    ((InsertUnit).vertical ((Cup[finite]).vertical ((Reassociate).vertical Merge))).vertical
        ((Split).vertical ((Associate).vertical ((Cap).vertical RemoveUnit))) = (StraightMap).scale IndexScalar :=
  rightUpCurl_assemble InsertUnit (Cup[finite]) Reassociate Merge Split Associate Cap RemoveUnit IndexScalar
    (middle a d) (loop a d finite) (Biset.insertRightUnit_rightUnit (R := Complex))

end RightUpCurlSupport

-- By definitional equality, interpret then eval expands exactly the
-- two junctions via TrivalentVertex.expand and BentVertex.expand.
open MackeyDiagrams in
private theorem RightUpCurlSupport.eval_trivalent {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (d : ConjEmbedding K H) (finite : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    let lower := LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite)
    let upper := LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d)
    let straight := LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.up a))
    (lower.vertical upper).interpret.eval =
      (straight.scale (d.toHom.range.index : Complex)).interpret.eval :=
  RightUpCurlSupport.calculation a d finite

external.usage: In RightUpReidemeisterCurl, used through MackeyDiagrams.Generator.capFiber_card and MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup_multiplicationCap to identify the finite multiplication-cap fiber cardinality with the index of the image of the inner conjugation embedding. The endpoint supplies finite index of that same image. The Mathlib source at the recorded revision matches the pinned project checkout.

MackeyInclusionAndProjectionCrossings.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U _ K H G α β Kα Hβ hK hH a b A B J σ hσ L C I hRep hTrans j
    s l r d kg gh kl lh leftMiddle M Mj traceArg surviving inclusionLabel ι
    expandedInclusion tracedTerm
  /- Ian Xiao, § 2.2, Theorem 2.2 and Lemma 2.3. The archived
     source/mackey-bimodules.pdf has (2.1)–(2.2) on p. 5 and (2.4), the
     crossing formulas and the displayed composite on p. 6. The revised
     published PDF at https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
     has these on pp. 7 and 8 respectively. Both copies give the same
     hypotheses, formulas and wiring for this endpoint.
     Alphabeta Math's article, § 2.2, gives the argument in the prose of
     Lemma 2.3 and Theorem 2.2 with numbered equations and no numbered
     proof steps. Its diagram-05 stacks projection below inclusion;
     the inverse dot is on the lower branch. The finite complex label
     at each mark is a coefficient-one singleton.
     The proof uses the shared balanced basis and typed generators for
     the actions, intertwining, cup and cap. Those evaluated maps give
     the crossing formulas directly from the representations supplied
     by the endpoint. The functor-level strand and adjunction results
     and the abstract centralizer-coset classification are imported
     project dependencies for the setup. Here d carries the explicit
     intertwining proof at the supplied representative. -/
  let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d
  have ha (k : K) : (a.toHom k : U) = α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ := rfl
  have hb (h : H) : (b.toHom h : U) = β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ := rfl
  have hd : d.element = s := rfl
  have hl (t : L j) : (l.toHom t : U) = α⁻¹ * (t : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ := rfl
  -- Use the full intersection (2.2) to verify the injectivity supplier's hypothesis.
  have hintersection (k : K) (h : H)
      (e : a.toHom k = d.element * b.toHom h * d.element⁻¹) : k ∈ l.toHom.range := by
    have eU := congrArg Subtype.val e
    change (a.toHom k : U) = (d.element : U) * (b.toHom h : U) * (d.element : U)⁻¹ at eU
    rw [hd, ha, hb] at eU
    have hleft : (a.toHom k : U) ∈ Kα := ⟨(k : U), k.property, (ha k).symm⟩
    have hright : (a.toHom k : U) ∈ Subgroup.map
        (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H := by
      refine ⟨(h : U), h.property, ?_⟩
      change (s : U) * β * (h : U) * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (a.toHom k : U)
      rw [ha, eU]
      group
    let t : L j := ⟨(a.toHom k : U), hleft, hright⟩
    refine ⟨t, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change (l.toHom t : U) = (k : U)
    rw [hl]
    change α⁻¹ * (a.toHom k : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ = (k : U)
    rw [ha]
    group
  have hinj : Function.Injective q :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.injective_mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d hintersection
  have hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z} :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.finiteFiber_of_injective a b l r d hinj
  -- Lemma 2.3 is applied to the supplied right transversal (2.4).
  have hsurv (g : G) :
      (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → ∃! i : I j, i ∈ surviving g) ∧
      (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → surviving g = ∅) :=
    SurvivingCosetRepresentative K H G α β hK hH σ hσ I hRep hTrans j g
  have hsub (g : G) : (surviving g).Subsingleton := by
    intro i hi i' hi'
    by_cases hclass : DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j
    · obtain ⟨t, _, ht⟩ := (hsurv g).1 hclass
      exact (ht i hi).trans (ht i' hi').symm
    · rw [(hsurv g).2 hclass] at hi
      exact hi.elim
  have hs (g : G) : Set.Finite (surviving g) := (hsub g).finite
  have harg (g : G) (i : I j) (k : K) :
      a.toHom k = g * (b.toHom (hRep j i)⁻¹ * d.element⁻¹) ↔
        (k : U) = traceArg g i :=
    MackeyCrossingProof.trace_eq_iff a b l r d α β ha hb g (hRep j i) k
  -- The range supplier gives the factorization in (2.1). The quotient
  -- equality puts it in the class of the actual representative σ j.
  have hcover (g : G) (hg : MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g ∈ Set.range q) :
      ∃ i : I j, i ∈ surviving g := by
    obtain ⟨k, h, he⟩ := (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedRange_eq_doubleCoset a b l r d g).mp hg
    have hka : a.toHom k ∈ A := ⟨(k : U), k.property, (ha k).symm⟩
    have hhb : b.toHom h ∈ B := ⟨(h : U), h.property, (hb h).symm⟩
    have hclass : DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = DoubleCoset.mk A B g :=
      DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨a.toHom k, hka, b.toHom h, hhb, he⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi, _⟩ := (hsurv g).1 (hclass.symm.trans (hσ j))
    exact ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine ⟨hf, hs, ?_⟩
  intro projectionLabel p expandedProjection crossings expandedCrossings
  have hinc : ι.interpret.eval = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication
      (R := Complex) a b l r d).eval := MackeyCrossingProof.compact_inclusion a b l r d
  have hproj : p.interpret.eval = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection
      (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).eval := MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection a b l r d hf
  have hei : ι.interpret.eval = expandedInclusion.interpret.eval :=
    hinc.trans (MackeyCrossingProof.eval_inclusion_expansion a b l r d).symm
  have hep : p.interpret.eval = expandedProjection.interpret.eval :=
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.eval_expandProjection a b l r projectionLabel
      .junction .junction).symm
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hei, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact MackeyCrossingProof.trace_support a b l r d (hRep j) traceArg harg
  · intro k h
    rw [hinc]
    change (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplication a b l r d Complex).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (kl.basis.pair lh.basis k h) 1) = _
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplication,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
    rfl
  · intro g
    constructor
    · exact Finset.card_le_one.mpr (fun i hi i' hi' =>
        hsub g ((hs g).mem_toFinset.mp hi) ((hs g).mem_toFinset.mp hi'))
    · rw [hproj]
      exact MackeyCrossingProof.projection_sum a b l r d (hRep j) traceArg harg
        hinj hf g (hs g) (fun _ _ hi hi' => hsub g hi hi') (hcover g)
  · change p.interpret.eval.vertical ι.interpret.eval =
      expandedProjection.interpret.eval.vertical expandedInclusion.interpret.eval
    rw [hep, hei]
  · intro hi finiteProjection
    have hfinite : p.interpret.eval = finiteProjection.interpret.eval :=
      hproj.trans (MackeyCrossingProof.eval_finite_expansion a b l r d hi hf).symm
    change p.interpret.eval.vertical ι.interpret.eval =
      finiteProjection.interpret.eval.vertical expandedInclusion.interpret.eval
    rw [hfinite, hei]
MackeyInclusionAndProjectionCrossings.support:
namespace MackeyCrossingProof
open MackeyDiagrams

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000

noncomputable section

universe u
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G L : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
variable (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
variable (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r))

local notation "κγ" => Word.down a
local notation "γη" => Word.up b
local notation "κλ" => Word.up l
local notation "λη" => Word.down r
local notation "γλ" => Word.up (a.comp l)
local notation "ℳ" => Word.tensor κγ γη
local notation "ℳⱼ" => Word.tensor κλ λη
local notation "ψ" => Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d

theorem singleton_scope {p t : Word K H} (f : ScopedDiagram Complex p t) :
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, f)]).eval = f.eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp

theorem compact_inclusion :
    (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r [(1, d)]).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) a b l r d).eval :=
  singleton_scope (.ordinary (.mixedMultiplication a b l r d))

theorem compact_projection (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | ψ w = z}) :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b l r [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).eval :=
  singleton_scope (.ordinary (.mixedProjection a b l r d hf))

theorem dot_single {K G : Subgroup U} {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) :
    (DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d 1)).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).eval := by
  classical
  rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing]
  apply Diagram.eval_ext_on_generators
  intro x
  rw [Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single]
  simp

theorem cup_junction_single (k : K) :
    ((BentVertex.ordinaryCup a l).expand (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single k 1) =
      Finsupp.single ((κγ).basis.pair (γλ).basis 1 (a.toHom k)) 1 := by
  let c : Diagram Complex _ _ := .ordinaryCup a
  let gk := Word.up a
  change (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id κγ) (Diagram.mergeUp a l)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.associate κγ gk κλ).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.horizontal c (Diagram.id κλ)).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.insertLeftUnit κλ).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single k 1)))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_insertLeftUnit_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_ordinaryCup_single, map_one, Biset.pairLinear_single,
    one_mul, Diagram.eval_associate_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

theorem cap_junction_single (x : G) (h : H) :
    ((BentVertex.multiplicationCap b r).expand (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Word.up (b.comp r)).basis.pair (λη).basis x h) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (x * b.toHom h) 1 := by
  let hr := Word.up r
  change (Diagram.rightUnit γη (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id γη) (Diagram.multiplicationCap r)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.associate γη hr λη).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.splitUp b r) (Diagram.id λη)).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((Word.up (b.comp r)).basis.pair (λη).basis x h) 1)))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_associate_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single,
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_multiplicationCap_single, one_mul,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_rightUnit_single]
  change Finsupp.single (1 * x * (b.toHom h⁻¹)⁻¹) 1 = _
  simp only [one_mul, map_inv, inv_inv]

def inclusion_expansion : LabelledDrawing Complex ℳⱼ ℳ :=
  .vertical
    (.horizontal (.trivalent (.upToDownUp a l)) (.ordinary (.id λη)))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate κγ γλ λη))
      (.vertical
        (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id κγ))
          (.horizontal (DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d 1))
            (.ordinary (.id λη))))
        (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id κγ)) (.trivalent (.upDownToUp b r)))))

/-
Diagram.eval_expandedMackeyInclusion has the same source, target and compact
map. Its left side is a different assembly of ordinary cup/cap primitives
in MackeyDiagrams.MackeyInclusionExpansion. The reviewed drawing uses the
shared trivalent vertices and a singleton linear label. The basis checks
cup_junction_single, dot_single and cap_junction_single evaluate precisely
those vertices, giving a direct comparison with the compact crossing.
-/
theorem eval_inclusion_expansion :
    (inclusion_expansion a b l r d).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) a b l r d).eval := by
  classical
  let cup : Diagram Complex _ _ := (BentVertex.ordinaryCup a l).expand
  let cap : Diagram Complex _ _ := (BentVertex.multiplicationCap b r).expand
  let body := Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id κγ)
    (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d) (Diagram.id λη))
  have he : (inclusion_expansion a b l r d).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.vertical (.horizontal cup (.id λη))
        (.vertical (.associate κγ γλ λη)
          (.vertical body (.horizontal (.id κγ) cap)))).eval := by
    simp only [inclusion_expansion, LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval,
      TrivalentVertex.expand, Diagram.eval, body, cup, cap, dot_single]
  rw [he]
  apply Diagram.eval_ext_on_generators
  intro w
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w fun ⟨k, h⟩ => ?_
  change (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id κγ) cap).eval.toLinearMap
    (body.eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.associate κγ γλ λη).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.horizontal cup (Diagram.id λη)).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((κλ).basis.pair (λη).basis k h) 1)))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  rw [show cup.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single k 1) = _ from cup_junction_single a l k,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_associate_single]
  dsimp only [body]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_upDot_single,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  rw [show cap.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single _ 1) = _ from
      cap_junction_single b r (a.toHom k * d.element) h,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  change _ = (Generator.mixedMultiplication a b l r d Complex).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single ((κλ).basis.pair (λη).basis k h) 1)
  rw [Generator.mixedMultiplication, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  apply congrArg (fun z => Finsupp.single z 1)
  have hw := Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct a b
    ((κγ).basis.pair (γη).basis 1 (a.toHom k * d.element * b.toHom h))
  change Generator.mixedPair a b (1 * (a.toHom k * d.element * b.toHom h)) = _ at hw
  rw [one_mul] at hw
  exact hw.symm

theorem insert_right_single {A B : Subgroup U} (p : Word A B) (x : p.basis.carrier) :
    (Diagram.insertRightUnit (R := Complex) p).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (Biset.regular B) x 1) 1 := by
  change (Biset.insertRightUnit p.basis Complex).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) = _
  rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]

def finite_expansion (hi : Subgroup.FiniteIndex r.toHom.range) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex ℳ ℳⱼ :=
  .vertical
    (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id κγ)) (.trivalent (.upToUpDown b r hi)))
    (.vertical
      (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id κγ))
        (.horizontal (DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d.inverse 1))
          (.ordinary (.id λη))))
      (.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate κγ γλ λη))
        (.horizontal (.trivalent (.downUpToUp a l)) (.ordinary (.id λη)))))

/-
RightCupTrace.eval_eq_reverseCup supplies the standalone cup at finite index.
Compare the explicit trivalent drawing and that scoped evaluation on each term
of the same cup fiber. The other projection clauses need only finite support
through the tail, supplied by injectivity and the trace calculations below.
-/
theorem eval_finite_expansion (hi : Subgroup.FiniteIndex r.toHom.range)
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | ψ w = z}) :
    (finite_expansion a b l r d hi).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).eval := by
  classical
  let hl := Word.up r
  let rightMid := Word.up (b.comp r)
  let cup := reverseCupWord r
  let reverse : Diagram Complex (.empty H) cup := .reverseCup r hi
  let merge : Diagram Complex ((γη).tensor hl) rightMid := .mergeUp b r
  let expand : Diagram Complex γη (rightMid.tensor λη) :=
    (BentVertex.reverseCup b r hi).expand
  let dot : Diagram Complex rightMid γλ := .upDot d.inverse
  let finish : Diagram Complex ((κγ).tensor (rightMid.tensor λη)) ℳⱼ :=
    .vertical (.horizontal (.id κγ) (.horizontal dot (.id λη)))
      (.vertical (.unassociate κγ γλ λη)
        (.horizontal (.traceCapOnLeft a l) (.id λη)))
  let tail := Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b l r d
  let scope := RightCupTrace.ofFiniteAfter tail
    (RightCupTrace.mixedProjectionTail_finiteAfter a b l r d hf)
  have hsyntax : (finite_expansion a b l r d hi).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.vertical (.horizontal (.id κγ) expand) finish).eval := by
    simp only [finite_expansion, LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval,
      TrivalentVertex.expand, finish, expand, dot, Diagram.eval, dot_single]
  have hscope : scope.eval = (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).eval :=
    ScopedDiagram.eval_expandedMixedProjection a b l r d hf
  rw [hsyntax, ← hscope, RightCupTrace.eval_eq_reverseCup scope hi]
  apply Diagram.eval_ext_on_generators
  intro w
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_
  let fiber := Generator.multiplicationCap_finiteFiber r hi (1 : H)
  let openingTail : Diagram Complex ((γη).tensor cup) (rightMid.tensor λη) :=
    .vertical (.unassociate γη hl λη) (.horizontal merge (.id λη))
  have hcup : reverse.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) =
      ∑ z ∈ fiber.toFinset, Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex) := by
    change (Generator.reverseCup Complex r hi).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) = _
    rw [Generator.reverseCup, Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum]
  have hexpand : expand.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =
      ∑ z ∈ fiber.toFinset, openingTail.eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((γη).basis.pair cup.basis y z) 1) := by
    change openingTail.eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.horizontal (.id γη) reverse).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.insertRightUnit γη).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1))) = _
    rw [insert_right_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
      Diagram.eval_id_apply, hcup, map_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  change finish.eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id κγ) expand).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((κγ).basis.pair (γη).basis x y) 1)) =
    tail.eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id ℳ) reverse).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.insertRightUnit ℳ).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((κγ).basis.pair (γη).basis x y) 1)))
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, hexpand, map_sum, map_sum,
    insert_right_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, hcup, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => ?_
  change finish.eval.toLinearMap
    (Biset.pairLinear Complex (κγ).basis (rightMid.tensor λη).basis (Finsupp.single x 1)
      (openingTail.eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((γη).basis.pair cup.basis y (hl.basis.pair (λη).basis h₁ h₂)) 1))) =
    tail.eval.toLinearMap
      (Biset.pairLinear Complex (ℳ).basis cup.basis
        (Finsupp.single ((κγ).basis.pair (γη).basis x y) 1)
        (Finsupp.single (hl.basis.pair (λη).basis h₁ h₂) 1))
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  have hopen : openingTail.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((γη).basis.pair cup.basis y ((hl.basis).pair (λη).basis h₁ h₂)) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (rightMid.basis.pair (λη).basis (y * b.toHom h₁) h₂) 1 := by
    change (Diagram.horizontal merge (Diagram.id λη)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.unassociate γη hl λη).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((γη).basis.pair cup.basis y (hl.basis.pair (λη).basis h₁ h₂)) 1)) = _
    rw [Diagram.eval_unassociate_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
      Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [hopen, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_mixedProjectionTail_single]
  change (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.traceCapOnLeft a l) (Diagram.id λη)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.unassociate κγ γλ λη).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id κγ) (Diagram.horizontal dot (Diagram.id λη))).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((κγ).basis.pair (rightMid.tensor λη).basis x
          (rightMid.basis.pair (λη).basis (y * b.toHom h₁) h₂)) 1))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    show dot.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (y * b.toHom h₁) 1) = _ from
      Diagram.eval_upDot_single d.inverse (y * b.toHom h₁) 1,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
    Diagram.eval_unassociate_single]
  rfl

theorem trace_eq_iff (α β : U)
    (ha : ∀ k : K, (a.toHom k : U) = α * (k : U) * α⁻¹)
    (hb : ∀ h : H, (b.toHom h : U) = β * (h : U) * β⁻¹)
    (g : G) (h : H) (k : K) :
    a.toHom k = g * (b.toHom h⁻¹ * d.element⁻¹) ↔
      (k : U) = α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (h : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (d.element : U)⁻¹ * α := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    have e := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change (a.toHom k : U) = (g : U) * ((b.toHom h⁻¹ : U) * (d.element : U)⁻¹) at e
    rw [ha, hb] at e
    change α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ =
      (g : U) * ((β * (h : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹) * (d.element : U)⁻¹) at e
    calc
      (k : U) = α⁻¹ * (α * (k : U) * α⁻¹) * α := by group
      _ = _ := by rw [e]; group
  · intro he
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (a.toHom k : U) = (g : U) * ((b.toHom h⁻¹ : U) * (d.element : U)⁻¹)
    rw [ha, hb]
    change α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ =
      (g : U) * ((β * (h : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹) * (d.element : U)⁻¹)
    rw [he]
    group

/-
MixedCrossingFiberMaps, Proposition 5.1, uses a dot reconstructed from
products of conjugating elements and a transversal given as a subset of H.
For the actual supplied eligible dot and the indexed representatives of
(2.4), apply RightCupTrace.projectionTerm_image and projectionTerm_outside
directly. The preceding conjugation calculation gives exactly the test of
Lemma 2.3. LabelledDrawing.eval_expandProjection then compares the two
typed projection drawings with the same label and finite-fiber witness.
-/
theorem trace_support {ι : Type*} (rep : ι → H) (arg : G → ι → U)
    (harg : ∀ g i (k : K),
      a.toHom k = g * (b.toHom (rep i)⁻¹ * d.element⁻¹) ↔ (k : U) = arg g i)
    (z : (ℳ).basis.carrier) :
    Function.support (fun i => RightCupTrace.term
      (Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b l r d) z
      (RightCupTrace.unitPair r (rep i))) =
      {i | arg (Generator.mixedProduct a b z) i ∈ K} := by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).symm.surjective z
  ext i
  change RightCupTrace.term (Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b l r d)
      (Generator.mixedPair a b g) (RightCupTrace.unitPair r (rep i)) ≠ 0 ↔
      arg (Generator.mixedProduct a b (Generator.mixedPair a b g)) i ∈ K
  rw [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
  constructor
  · intro hn
    by_contra hout
    apply hn
    apply RightCupTrace.projectionTerm_outside
    rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact hout ((harg g i k).mp hk ▸ k.property)
  · intro hin
    rw [RightCupTrace.projectionTerm_image a b l r d g (rep i) ⟨arg g i, hin⟩
      ((harg g i ⟨arg g i, hin⟩).mpr rfl)]
    simp

/-
Enumerate the transfer fiber by the supplied right coset representatives.
The coset lemma gives uniqueness on the index side and the full intersection
gives injectivity on the balanced-pair side.
-/
theorem projection_sum {ι : Type*} (rep : ι → H) (arg : G → ι → U)
    (harg : ∀ g i (k : K),
      a.toHom k = g * (b.toHom (rep i)⁻¹ * d.element⁻¹) ↔ (k : U) = arg g i)
    (hinj : Function.Injective ψ)
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | ψ w = z})
    (g : G) (hs : Set.Finite {i | arg g i ∈ K})
    (huniq : ∀ i j, arg g i ∈ K → arg g j ∈ K → i = j)
    (hcover : Generator.mixedPair a b g ∈ Set.range ψ → ∃ i, arg g i ∈ K) :
    (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair a b g) 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ hs.toFinset.attach,
        Finsupp.single ((κλ).basis.pair (λη).basis
          ⟨arg g i.val, hs.mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩ (rep i.val)) 1 := by
  classical
  let z := Generator.mixedPair a b g
  let liftRep : {i // i ∈ hs.toFinset} → (ℳⱼ).basis.carrier := fun i =>
    (κλ).basis.pair (λη).basis ⟨arg g i.val, hs.mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩ (rep i.val)
  have hlift (i : {i // i ∈ hs.toFinset}) : ψ (liftRep i) = z := by
    change Generator.mixedPair a b
      (a.toHom ⟨arg g i.val, hs.mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩ * d.element * b.toHom (rep i.val)) =
      Generator.mixedPair a b g
    apply congrArg (Generator.mixedPair a b)
    rw [(harg g i.val _).mpr rfl, map_inv]
    group
  change (Generator.mixedProjection a b l r d Complex hf).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single z 1) = ∑ i ∈ hs.toFinset.attach, Finsupp.single (liftRep i) 1
  rw [Generator.mixedProjection, Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun i _ => liftRep i) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun i _ => (hf z).mem_toFinset.mpr (hlift i)
  · intro i _ j _ _
    exact Subtype.ext (huniq _ _ (hs.mem_toFinset.mp i.property) (hs.mem_toFinset.mp j.property))
  · intro w hw
    have hw' : ψ w = z := (hf z).mem_toFinset.mp hw
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover ⟨w, hw'⟩
    let t : {i // i ∈ hs.toFinset} := ⟨i, hs.mem_toFinset.mpr hi⟩
    exact ⟨t, Finset.mem_attach _ _, hinj ((hlift t).trans hw'.symm)⟩
  · intros
    rfl

end
end MackeyCrossingProof

LeftDownReidemeisterCurl.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a S finite curl straight scaled
  -- Ian Xiao, Theorem 4.1, (4.4). The archived project PDF has the
  -- figure on p. 14 and its proof on p. 15. The revised published PDF
  -- has the figure on p. 16 and its proof on p. 17.
  -- The plan supplies no Alphabeta Math item for this endpoint.
  -- Steps 1–3 follow the calculation in the paper's §4.
  -- Step 1 (expand the two junctions): expose the reverse cup and the
  -- multiplication cap. The given finite index is for d.toHom.range in H.
  -- The earlier ReviewedLeftDownCurl calculation uses the expanded Diagram.
  -- Here interpret the actual trivalent drawings and reassociate only their
  -- evaluated vertical maps to recover that calculation.
  simp only [curl, scaled, straight, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret,
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval, MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.expand,
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval, MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
  -- Step 2 (compose the restriction maps): cancel the merge and split
  -- between the two tensor rebracketings using the down merge–split
  -- identity from InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits.
  have hmid :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeDown Complex a d).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.splitDown Complex a d) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d).tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a)) :=
    (InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits K H G α δ hα hδ).2.2.2.2.2.1
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id _).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeDown Complex a d)),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical, hmid, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.associate_unassociate, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  -- Step 3 (evaluate the finite coset sum): count the fibers of multiplication
  -- in H before acting on the down-strand. The transfer theorem counts the
  -- same right cosets as the paper's transversal and sends each term to the
  -- same generator. This replaces the explicit transversal calculation in
  -- FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction. The resulting scalar acts on the outer
  -- strand by horizontal interchange and the left unitor.
  have hcup :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCap Complex d) =
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H)).scale
        (S.index : Complex) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup_multiplicationCap d finite
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Generator.reverseCup Complex d finite).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a))),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    hcup, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_left,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.insertLeftUnit_leftUnit]

InductionSplitDotSlide.proof:
by
  intro U group K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he g a b e rightDot split
  -- Xiao, Proposition 3.1, (3.2), and the induction-split drawing in § 3.2.
  -- The archived source/mackey-bimodules.pdf has (3.2) on p. 8 and the drawing
  -- on p. 9. The revised published PDF has them on pp. 10 and 11, respectively.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- The source proves (3.1) by the multiplication formula and the intertwining
  -- identity. Apply the compiled InductionMergeDotSlide to the same conjugators
  -- and membership hypotheses. For (3.2), compose with the source and target
  -- splits using the two inverse equations in MackeyDiagrams.Parallel.
  -- These equations apply at the given bracketed words over Complex.
  have cancelMerge
      (sourceOuter targetOuter : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (sourceInner targetInner : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H)
      (legs : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex
        ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.up sourceOuter).tensor (.up sourceInner)).basis
        ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.up targetOuter).tensor (.up targetInner)).basis)
      (stem : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (sourceOuter.comp sourceInner)).basis
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (targetOuter.comp targetInner)).basis)
      (square : legs.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp targetOuter targetInner).eval =
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp sourceOuter sourceInner).eval.vertical stem) :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp sourceOuter sourceInner).eval.vertical legs =
        stem.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp targetOuter targetInner).eval := by
    let splitSource := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) sourceOuter sourceInner).eval
    let mergeSource := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) sourceOuter sourceInner).eval
    let mergeTarget := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) targetOuter targetInner).eval
    let splitTarget := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) targetOuter targetInner).eval
    have sourceInverse : splitSource.vertical mergeSource = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id _ :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp_mergeUp sourceOuter sourceInner
    have targetInverse : mergeTarget.vertical splitTarget = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id _ :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp targetOuter targetInner
    change splitSource.vertical legs = stem.vertical splitTarget
    calc
      splitSource.vertical legs =
          ((splitSource.vertical legs).vertical mergeTarget).vertical splitTarget := by
        rw [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc, targetInverse,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_id]
      _ = (splitSource.vertical (mergeSource.vertical stem)).vertical splitTarget := by
        rw [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc splitSource legs, square]
      _ = stem.vertical splitTarget := by
        rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc splitSource mergeSource,
          sourceInverse, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  obtain ⟨mergeBoth, mergeRight⟩ := InductionMergeDotSlide K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he
  constructor
  · intro γ' hγ' hd g' d lifted merged left right
    exact cancelMerge g g' a b
      ((MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval.horizontal
        rightDot.interpret.eval)
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval
      (mergeBoth γ' hγ' hd)
  · intro left right
    -- In the second slide of § 3.2, the outer leg is unmarked. Use the
    -- separate right-leg merge square and its ordinary identity strand.
    exact cancelMerge g g a b
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (.up g)).eval.horizontal rightDot.interpret.eval)
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval
      mergeRight

RightDownReidemeisterCurl.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G δ α hδ hα d a curl straight
  -- Theorem 4.1, (4.2), is on p. 14 of the archived source PDF
  -- (bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2)
  -- and p. 16 of the revised published PDF
  -- (6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e).
  -- Both give the right-hand G-loop on the K–H down-strand.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- The retained ReviewedRightDownCurl uses a pre-expanded Diagram. Here we
  -- unfold both typed junctions via LabelledDrawing.interpret and the
  -- TrivalentVertex and BentVertex expansions. Interchange identifies the
  -- two separately whiskered generators with the retained middle map.
  -- Alphabeta Math's module tensor universal property, Steps 3.1, 4.1 and
  -- 5.1, motivate balance, descent and determination on elementary tensors.
  -- The project implements those steps by linearizing the balanced biset:
  -- mergeDown_splitDown uses the balance of [x,y] and [1,a(x)*y].
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  have hmerge :
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeDown Complex a d).horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a))).vertical
        ((MackeyDiagrams.Generator.splitDown Complex a d).horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a))) =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id
          (((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d).tensor
            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a)).tensor
            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)) := by
    have hmid :
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeDown Complex a d).vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.splitDown Complex a d) =
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d).tensor
            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a)) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown_splitDown a d
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, hmid,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_id, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
  -- The ordinary cup and trace act with coefficient one at arbitrary index.
  -- The routed InductionRestrictionAdjunction and
  -- InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits describe the individual generators.
  -- The cancellation lemmas below and above give the needed identities
  -- directly on the corresponding evaluated composites.
  have hcup :
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.ordinaryCup Complex a).vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceCap Complex a) =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup_traceCap a
  simp only [curl, straight, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret,
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval, MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.expand,
    MackeyDiagrams.BentVertex.expand, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval,
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
  -- The opening junction uses unassociate and the closing uses associate,
  -- so the inverse lemma has the order unassociate_associate.
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mergeDown Complex a d).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a))),
    hmerge, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    ← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction a) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a) Complex),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.unassociate_associate, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  rw [← MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction d)).horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.ordinaryCup Complex a)),
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical, hcup,
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  exact MackeyDiagrams.Biset.insertRightUnit_rightUnit

MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst up down tensor stack juxtapose plain Stage place at₁ at₂ parallel finiteFibers
    multiply projectionTerms project eval planar leftShape rightShape realizes
  refine ⟨MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux.representativeCoset, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Proposition 5.1 identifies the projection column in group coordinates.
    -- Match that fiber with the shared balanced basis before comparing the sums.
    intro K H G L α β a b d inner q traceDot traceInput traceSurvivors
    obtain ⟨hq, hm, hp⟩ := MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux.singletonColumns α β a b d
    refine ⟨hq, hm, rfl, ?_⟩
    intro hf diagram valueAt
    have hf' : finiteFibers α β a b d :=
      fun z => (hf (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β z)).subset
        (fun _ hw => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β) hw)
    obtain ⟨hcolumn, htrace⟩ := hp hf'
    refine ⟨?_, htrace⟩
    intro z
    refine (hcolumn z).trans ?_
    congr 1
    ext w
    simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    exact Set.ext_iff.mp (MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux.groupFiber α β a b d z) w

    -- The expansion theorem uses finite surviving columns even at infinite cup index.

    refine ⟨MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux.multiplyColumn α β a b
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x), ?_⟩
    intro hx terms drawing
    exact ⟨(MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.eval_expandProjection α β a b terms
      .cupAndMerge .splitAndTrace).symm, fun z =>
      MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux.projectColumn α β a b terms
