  · -- Cases 1–4 use the drawings on archived pp. 22 and 24 (published pp. 24 and 26).
    -- The tensor reassociations are straight wiring. Projection labels affect
    -- evaluation through the per-term finite witness and leave the vertex in place.
    intro G A D F C E B B' a b c d e f r s t u' v w
      left₁ left₂ left₃ right₁ right₂ right₃ left₁' left₂' left₃' right₁' right₂' right₃'

    have hpr : projectRight := by intro x y z hx hy hz; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hml : multiplyLeft := by intro x y z hx hy hz; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hmr : multiplyRight := by intro x y z hx hy hz; exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    intro direction hd
    change direction ∈ [(1, (projectLeft, projectRight)), (2, (projectRight, projectLeft)),

    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hd
    rcases hd with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨hpl, hpr⟩
    · exact ⟨hpr, hpl⟩
    · exact ⟨hml, hmr⟩
    · exact ⟨hmr, hml⟩

    intro G A D F C E B B' a b d c e f u' v w i j k

    simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hd

MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention.support:
namespace MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U]

private theorem embedding_eq_of_rep {A B : Subgroup U} (e : ConjEmbedding A B) (p : U)
    (hp : ∀ x : A, (e.toHom x : U) = p * (x : U) * p⁻¹) :
    e = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator p (fun x => hp x ▸ (e.toHom x).property) := by
  apply ConjEmbedding.ext
  exact MonoidHom.ext (fun x => Subtype.ext (hp x))

private theorem representativeCoset {A B : Subgroup U} (e : ConjEmbedding A B) (p : U)
    (hp : ∀ x : A, (e.toHom x : U) = MulAut.conj p (x : U)) :
    {q : U | ∀ x : A, (e.toHom x : U) = MulAut.conj q (x : U)} =
      {q : U | p⁻¹ * q ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (A : Set U)} := by
  ext q
  change (∀ x : A, (e.toHom x : U) = q * (x : U) * q⁻¹) ↔
    p⁻¹ * q ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (A : Set U)
  rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hq x hx
    have he := (hp ⟨x, hx⟩).symm.trans (hq ⟨x, hx⟩)
    change p * x * p⁻¹ = q * x * q⁻¹ at he
    calc
      x * (p⁻¹ * q) = p⁻¹ * (p * x * p⁻¹) * q := by group
      _ = p⁻¹ * (q * x * q⁻¹) * q := by rw [he]
      _ = (p⁻¹ * q) * x := by group
  · intro h x
    calc
      (e.toHom x : U) = p * (x : U) * p⁻¹ := hp x
      _ = p * ((x : U) * (p⁻¹ * q)) * q⁻¹ := by group
      _ = p * ((p⁻¹ * q) * (x : U)) * q⁻¹ := by rw [h _ x.property]
      _ = q * (x : U) * q⁻¹ := by group

section
variable {K H G L : Subgroup U}
variable (α : ConjEmbedding K G) (β : ConjEmbedding H G)
variable (a : ConjEmbedding L K) (b : ConjEmbedding L H)
variable (d : Dot (α.comp a) (β.comp b))

private abbrev qBasis := Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b d
private abbrev q (w : ((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).basis.carrier) : G :=
  Generator.mixedProduct α β (qBasis α β a b d w)
private abbrev traceInput (z : G) (t : H) :=
  z * (β.toHom t)⁻¹ * d.element⁻¹

private theorem groupFiber (z : G) :
    {w | qBasis α β a b d w = Generator.mixedPair α β z} = {w | q α β a b d w = z} := by
  ext w
  change qBasis α β a b d w = Generator.mixedPair α β z ↔ q α β a b d w = z
  constructor
  · intro hw
    show Generator.mixedProduct α β (qBasis α β a b d w) = z
    rw [hw, Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
  · intro hw
    apply (Generator.mixedEquiv α β).injective
    change q α β a b d w = Generator.mixedProduct α β (Generator.mixedPair α β z)
    rw [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair, hw]

private abbrev Columns : Prop :=
    (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
      q α β a b d ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) k h) =
        α.toHom k * d.element * β.toHom h) ∧
    (∀ w,
      (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) α β a b d).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α β (q α β a b d w)) 1) ∧
    (∀ hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | qBasis α β a b d w = z},
      let diagram := Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β a b d hf
      let valueAt := fun z : G => diagram.eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α β z) 1)
      (∀ z : G, valueAt z = Finset.sum (hf (Generator.mixedPair α β z)).toFinset
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Set H) (_ : ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H, t ∈ T ∧ h * t⁻¹ ∈ b.toHom.range)
        (z : G),
        ∃ hs : Set.Finite {t : H | t ∈ T ∧ traceInput α β a b d z t ∈ α.toHom.range},
          valueAt z = Finset.sum hs.toFinset (fun t =>
            Biset.pairLinear Complex (Biset.induction a) (Biset.restriction b)
              (Generator.traceBasis Complex α (traceInput α β a b d z t)) (Finsupp.single t 1))))

/- Article §6.2, finite-fiber convention, invoking Proposition 5.1.
   The portal supplies no numbered proof for this convention. The registered
   MixedCrossingFiberMaps works with representative conjugators and a section.
   The dot equation lets us pick a representative of the inner left embedding
   so that (p * s) * (r * t)⁻¹ is the given dot. This realizes the representative
   equation in the first paragraph of the proof of Proposition 5.1. The section
   exists for every double-coset quotient. The transversal for
   the trace formula is the one supplied by the endpoint. -/
private theorem singletonColumns : Columns α β a b d := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := α.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := β.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := b.hasRepresentative
  let s : U := p⁻¹ * (d.element : U) * (r * t)
  have hs : ∀ x : L, (a.toHom x : U) = s * (x : U) * s⁻¹ := by
    intro x
    have hd := congrArg (fun y : G => (y : U)) (d.intertwines x)
    change (α.toHom (a.toHom x) : U) * (d.element : U) =
      (d.element : U) * (β.toHom (b.toHom x) : U) at hd
    rw [hp, hr, ht] at hd
    calc
      (a.toHom x : U) =
          p⁻¹ * ((p * (a.toHom x : U) * p⁻¹) * (d.element : U)) *
            (d.element : U)⁻¹ * p := by group
      _ = p⁻¹ * ((d.element : U) * (r * (t * (x : U) * t⁻¹) * r⁻¹)) *
            (d.element : U)⁻¹ * p := by rw [hd]
      _ = s * (x : U) * s⁻¹ := by dsimp [s]; group
  have hquot : (p * s) * (r * t)⁻¹ = (d.element : U) := by dsimp [s]; group
  have hdG : (p * s) * (r * t)⁻¹ ∈ G := hquot ▸ d.element.property
  have hpG : ∀ k : K, p * (k : U) * p⁻¹ ∈ G := fun k => hp k ▸ (α.toHom k).property
  have hrG : ∀ h : H, r * (h : U) * r⁻¹ ∈ G := fun h => hr h ▸ (β.toHom h).property
  have hsK : ∀ x : L, s * (x : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ K := fun x => hs x ▸ (a.toHom x).property
  have htH : ∀ x : L, t * (x : U) * t⁻¹ ∈ H := fun x => ht x ▸ (b.toHom x).property
  let eα := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator p hpG
  let eβ := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator r hrG
  let ea := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hsK
  let eb := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator t htH
  let e : Dot (eα.comp ea) (eβ.comp eb) :=
    Dot.ofRepresentatives (p * s) (r * t)
      (by intro x; change p * (s * (x : U) * s⁻¹) * p⁻¹ = _; group)
      (by intro x; change r * (t * (x : U) * t⁻¹) * r⁻¹ = _; group) hdG
  have supplied := MixedCrossingFiberMaps K H G L p r s t hpG hrG hsK htH hdG
    (fun j => j.out) DoubleCoset.out_eq'
  obtain ⟨_, hpair, hpush, _, _, _, _, _, _, hpull⟩ := supplied
  have transport (α' : ConjEmbedding K G) (β' : ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a' : ConjEmbedding L K) (b' : ConjEmbedding L H)
      (e' : Dot (α'.comp a') (β'.comp b'))
      (hα' : α = α') (hβ' : β = β') (ha' : a = a') (hb' : b = b')
      (he' : (e'.element : U) = (d.element : U))
      (columns : Columns α' β' a' b' e') : Columns α β a b d := by
    cases hα'
    cases hβ'
    cases ha'
    cases hb'
    have heq : e' = d := Dot.ext (Subtype.ext he')
    subst e'
    exact columns
  exact transport eα eβ ea eb e (embedding_eq_of_rep α p hp) (embedding_eq_of_rep β r hr)
    (embedding_eq_of_rep a s hs) (embedding_eq_of_rep b t ht) hquot
    ⟨hpair, hpush, hpull⟩

private theorem multiplyColumn (label : List (Complex × Dot (α.comp a) (β.comp b)))
    (w : ((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).basis.carrier) :
    (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β a b label).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single w 1) =
      (label.map fun term => term.1 •
        Finsupp.single (qBasis α β a b term.2 w) 1).sum := by
  unfold LabelledDrawing.interpret
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro term _
  change term.1 • ((Generator.mixedMultiplication α β a b term.2 Complex).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single w 1)) = _
  rw [Generator.mixedMultiplication, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]

private theorem projectColumn (label : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed α β a b))
    (z : ((Word.down α).tensor (.up β)).basis.carrier) :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β a b label).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single z 1) =
      (label.map fun term => term.1 • Finset.sum (term.2.finite z).toFinset
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)).sum := by
  unfold LabelledDrawing.interpret
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro term _
  change term.1 • ((Generator.mixedProjection α β a b term.2.dot Complex
    term.2.finite).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1)) = _
  rw [Generator.mixedProjection, Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum]

end
end MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConventionAux

external.usage: MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention applies Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff to p⁻¹ * q in the ambient group to identify the set of representatives of the given boundary embedding.

MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention chooses Quotient.out as the section required by the registered MixedCrossingFiberMaps theorem and verifies the section equation with DoubleCoset.out_eq'. No finite double-coset space or finite standalone cup index is required.

MixedCrossingComposites.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G L α β a b hα hβ ha hb hs eα eβ ea eb d s A B J σ hσ
    conjSubgroup Lj leftJ rightJ Mj M ML Ls Limage n qBasis q hIndex
  -- This item has no matching Alphabeta Math portal entry in the reviewed plan.
  -- Steps 1–3 of the argument in Xiao, §5.1, Proposition 5.1: the typed
  -- generators encode the balanced push and the reverse-cup/trace fiber sum.
  -- MixedCrossingFiberMaps supplies the image and stabilizer index at s,
  -- with finite relative index hIndex. This computes the cardinal directly
  -- at the original label, so Lemma 5.2's transport is unnecessary.
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, range_q, card_q, finite_q, _⟩ :=
    MixedCrossingFiberMaps K H G L α β a b hα hβ ha hb hs σ hσ
  have hf : ∀ z : M.basis.carrier, Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z} := finite_q.mpr hIndex
  refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
  intro ι p pThenIota iotaThenP straight evaluate orbit P finiteQ j hj
  -- Mathlib's DoubleCoset.eq converts s ∈ orbit j into the equality of classes
  -- using hσ. This connects the supplier's chosen class to the requested P j.
  have hj_eq : DoubleCoset.mk A B s = j := by
    rw [← hσ j]
    exact (DoubleCoset.eq.mpr (DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset.mp hj)).symm
  have hRange : Set.range q = orbit j := by
    rw [← hj_eq]
    exact range_q
  have hCard (g : G) (hg : g ∈ orbit j) : Nat.card {w | q w = g} = n := by
    rw [← hj_eq] at hg
    exact card_q g hg hIndex
  have hp : evaluate p = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d hf).eval :=
    MixedCrossingCompositesAux.projection_eval eα eβ ea eb d hf
  have hι : evaluate ι = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d).eval :=
    MixedCrossingCompositesAux.multiplication_eval eα eβ ea eb d
  let outer := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ
  have memOuter (z : M.basis.carrier) (w : ML.basis.carrier) :
      w ∈ (hf z).toFinset ↔ q w = outer z := by
    rw [(hf z).mem_toFinset]
    change qBasis w = z ↔ outer (qBasis w) = outer z
    exact outer.injective.eq_iff.symm
  have outerCard (z : M.basis.carrier) (hz : outer z ∈ orbit j) :
      (hf z).toFinset.card = n := by
    have hFinite : Set.Finite {w | q w = outer z} :=
      (hf z).subset fun _ hw => outer.injective hw
    exact (MixedCrossingCompositesAux.fiberCard q (outer z) hFinite _ (memOuter z)).symm.trans
      (hCard (outer z) hz)
  have innerFinset (z : ML.basis.carrier) :
      (hf (qBasis z)).toFinset = (finiteQ z).toFinset :=
    Finset.ext fun w => (memOuter (qBasis z) w).trans (finiteQ z).mem_toFinset.symm
  have innerCard (z : ML.basis.carrier) : (finiteQ z).toFinset.card = n := by
    rw [← innerFinset]
    exact outerCard (qBasis z) (hRange ▸ ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  -- Step 4: compose transfer and push in both orders. The compact
  -- projection needs only finite surviving fibers, as in the paragraph
  -- following the proof. The singleton evaluation adapters preserve
  -- the two labelled drawing stacks in the statement.
  have hInner (z : ML.basis.carrier) :
      (evaluate iotaThenP).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) =
        (finiteQ z).toFinset.sum (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex)) := by
    change ((evaluate ι).vertical (evaluate p)).toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [hp, hι, ← innerFinset]
    exact MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.inclusion_then_projection_single Complex eα eβ ea eb d hf z
  have hOuter (z : M.basis.carrier) :
      (evaluate pThenIota).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) =
        Finsupp.single z ((hf z).toFinset.card : Complex) := by
    change ((evaluate p).vertical (evaluate ι)).toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [hp, hι]
    exact MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.projection_then_inclusion_single Complex eα eβ ea eb d hf z
  -- Step 5: an identity column has its own
  -- coefficient one and every other coefficient zero. The scaled
  -- column therefore imposes incompatible equations when n > 1.
  let z₀ : ML.basis.carrier := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ea) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb) 1 1
  have self_mem (z : ML.basis.carrier) : z ∈ (finiteQ z).toFinset :=
    (finiteQ z).mem_toFinset.mpr rfl
  have strict_fiber (hn : 1 < n) :
      ∃ w ∈ (finiteQ z₀).toFinset, w ≠ z₀ := by
    by_contra! h
    have hle := Finset.card_le_one.mpr
      (fun w hw v hv => (h w hw).trans (h v hv).symm)
    exact (not_le_of_gt hn) ((innerCard z₀) ▸ hle)
  have straight_column (z : ML.basis.carrier) :
      (evaluate straight).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) = Finsupp.single z 1 := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, hInner, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro z
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    change (evaluate pThenIota).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) =
      ((n : Complex) • P j) (Finsupp.single z 1)
    rw [hOuter]
    have hP : (P j) (Finsupp.single z 1) =
        if outer z ∈ orbit j then Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex) else 0 := by
      dsimp only [P]
      rw [Finsupp.lsum_single]
      change (if outer z ∈ orbit j then Finsupp.lsingle z else 0) (1 : Complex) = _
      by_cases hz : outer z ∈ orbit j <;> simp [hz]
    rw [LinearMap.smul_apply, hP]
    by_cases hz : outer z ∈ orbit j
    · rw [ite_eq_left hz, outerCard z hz, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    · have hEmpty : (hf z).toFinset = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro w hw
        exact hz (hRange ▸ ⟨w, (memOuter z w).mp hw⟩)
      simp [hz, hEmpty]
  · constructor
    · intro hEq
      have hle : n ≤ 1 := by
        by_contra! hn
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hne⟩ := strict_fiber hn
        have h := hInner z₀
        rw [hEq, straight_column] at h
        have hwEq := congrArg (fun v : ML.basis.carrier →₀ Complex => v w) h
        change Finsupp.single z₀ (1 : Complex) w = _ at hwEq
        rw [MixedCrossingCompositesAux.sum_single_apply, ite_eq_left hw, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne] at hwEq
        exact zero_ne_one hwEq
      rw [← innerCard z₀]
      exact Nat.le_antisymm ((innerCard z₀).symm ▸ hle)
        (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨z₀, self_mem z₀⟩)
    · intro hn
      apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
      intro z
      apply LinearMap.ext_ring
      change (evaluate iotaThenP).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) =
        (evaluate straight).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1)
      rw [hInner, straight_column]
      have hOne : (finiteQ z).toFinset = {z} :=
        Finset.card_eq_one.mp ((innerCard z).trans hn) |>.elim fun w hw => by
          have hz := self_mem z
          rw [hw, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
          simpa [hz] using hw
      rw [hOne, Finset.sum_singleton]
  · intro hn c hEq
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hne⟩ := strict_fiber hn
    have hScaled : c • (evaluate iotaThenP).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z₀ 1) =
        (evaluate straight).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z₀ 1) :=
      congrArg (fun f => f.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z₀ 1)) hEq
    rw [hInner, straight_column] at hScaled
    have hzEq := congrArg (fun v : ML.basis.carrier →₀ Complex => v z₀) hScaled
    have hwEq := congrArg (fun v : ML.basis.carrier →₀ Complex => v w) hScaled
    change (_ • _ : ML.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) z₀ = _ at hzEq
    change (_ • _ : ML.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) w = _ at hwEq
    rw [Finsupp.smul_apply, MixedCrossingCompositesAux.sum_single_apply,
      ite_eq_left (self_mem z₀), Finsupp.single_eq_same, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hzEq
    rw [Finsupp.smul_apply, MixedCrossingCompositesAux.sum_single_apply,
      ite_eq_left hw, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hwEq
    exact one_ne_zero (hzEq.symm.trans hwEq)

namespace MixedCrossingCompositesAux

open MackeyDiagrams

-- The typed singleton labels have the ordinary crossing evaluations.
section Drawings

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G L : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
variable (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
variable (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r))
variable (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z})

private theorem multiplication_eval :
    (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) a b l r [(1, d)]).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) a b l r d).eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  unfold LabelledDrawing.interpret
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval]

private theorem projection_eval :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) a b l r [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  unfold LabelledDrawing.interpret
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval]

end Drawings

private theorem fiberCard {X Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) (y : Y)
    (hf : Set.Finite {x | f x = y}) (S : Finset X)
    (hS : ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ f x = y) :
    Nat.card {x | f x = y} = S.card := by
  have h : hf.toFinset = S := Finset.ext fun x => hf.mem_toFinset.trans (hS x).symm
  let := hf.fintype
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← hf.card_toFinset, h]

private theorem sum_single_apply {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X] (S : Finset X) (w : X) :
    (S.sum (fun x => Finsupp.single x (1 : Complex))) w =
      if w ∈ S then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  change (Finsupp.lapply w : (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] Complex) _ = _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']

end MixedCrossingCompositesAux

ExtremalParabolicsOfFiniteGroup.proof:
by
classical
  intro blockSym parabolicOn parabolic P _ hP lower orbitBlocks upper
  -- Xiao, Lemma 7.2, archived project PDF p. 29 and revised published PDF p. 31.
  -- The forward swap-closure criterion makes each support finite. Finiteness
  -- of P then gives one carrier for both the lower joins and the upper blocks.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  let moved : Set Nat := ⋃ g : P, (MulAction.fixedBy Nat (g : Equiv.Perm Nat))ᶜ
  have finiteMoved : moved.Finite :=
    Set.finite_iUnion fun g : P =>
      (mem_closure_isSwap (fun _ h => h)).mp (hP g.property) |>.1
  let X := finiteMoved.toFinset
  have memX (x : Nat) : x ∈ X ↔ ∃ g : P, (g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ≠ x := by
    simp only [X, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, moved, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_compl_iff,
      MulAction.mem_fixedBy, Equiv.Perm.smul_def]

  have lowerOn : parabolicOn X lower := by
    -- Apply the join part of Prop. 7.1 (FiniteParabolicClosure.2) at
    -- each insertion. Singleton blocks put the new swap group on X.
    let T : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) := {f | f ∈ P ∧ f.IsSwap}
    have hT : T.Finite :=
      (Set.finite_range fun g : P => (g : Equiv.Perm Nat)).subset
        (fun f hf => ⟨⟨f, hf.1⟩, rfl⟩)
    change parabolicOn X (Subgroup.closure T)
    refine Set.Finite.induction_on_subset (motive := fun A _ => parabolicOn X (Subgroup.closure A))
      T hT ?_ ?_
    · rw [Subgroup.closure_empty]
      exact extremalTrivialOn X
    · intro f A hf _ _ ih
      have insertOn : parabolicOn X (Subgroup.closure {f}) := by
        obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hf.2
        have ha : a ∈ X :=
          (memX a).mpr ⟨⟨Equiv.swap a b, hf.1⟩, by simpa using hab.symm⟩
        have hb : b ∈ X :=
          (memX b).mpr ⟨⟨Equiv.swap a b, hf.1⟩, by simpa using hab⟩
        rw [← extremalPairGenerated hab]
        refine extremalPaddedBlock X ?_ ⟨a, by simp⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases (show x = a ∨ x = b by simpa using hx) with rfl | rfl
        · exact ha
        · exact hb
      rw [← Set.singleton_union, Subgroup.closure_union]
      exact (FiniteParabolicClosure.2 X _ _ insertOn ih).2

  have orbitOfBlock {S : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ orbitBlocks) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) :
      (S : Set Nat) = MulAction.orbit P x := by
    obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, _⟩ := hS
    have hx' : x ∈ MulAction.orbit P y := hy ▸ (show x ∈ (S : Set Nat) from hx)
    exact hy.trans ((MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hx').symm)
  have orbitMoves {x : Nat} (hne : (MulAction.orbit P x).Nontrivial) :
      ∃ g : P, (g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ≠ x := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, hyz⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp hy
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp hz
    by_cases hfix : (g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x
    · refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      intro hfix'
      exact hyz (hg.symm.trans (hfix.trans (hfix'.symm.trans hh)))
    · exact ⟨g, hfix⟩
  have orbitSubset {S : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ orbitBlocks) : S ⊆ X := by
    intro x hx
    have hnontrivial : (MulAction.orbit P x).Nontrivial :=
      orbitOfBlock hS hx ▸ hS.2
    exact (memX x).mpr (orbitMoves hnontrivial)
  have blockOfMoved {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ X) : ∃ S : ↥orbitBlocks, x ∈ S.val := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (memX x).mp hx
    have hne : (MulAction.orbit P x).Nontrivial :=
      ⟨(g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x, ⟨g, rfl⟩, x, MulAction.mem_orbit_self x, hg⟩
    let S := X.filter (fun y => y ∈ MulAction.orbit P x)
    have hS : (S : Set Nat) = MulAction.orbit P x := by
      ext y
      change y ∈ S ↔ y ∈ MulAction.orbit P x
      rw [Finset.mem_filter]
      refine ⟨And.right, fun hy => ⟨?_, hy⟩⟩
      have hne' : (MulAction.orbit P y).Nontrivial :=
        (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hy).symm ▸ hne
      exact (memX y).mpr (orbitMoves hne')
    exact ⟨⟨S, ⟨x, hS⟩, hS.symm ▸ hne⟩,
      show x ∈ (S : Set Nat) from hS.symm ▸ MulAction.mem_orbit_self x⟩

  constructor
  · refine ⟨⟨⟨X, lowerOn⟩, (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr fun _ h => h.1⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro H ⟨⟨Y, n, A, _, _, _, rfl⟩, hH⟩
    apply iSup_le
    intro i
    change extremalBlockSym (A i) ≤ lower
    rw [extremalBlockGenerated]
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure
      ⟨hH ((le_iSup (fun j => blockSym (A j)) i) (extremalSwapInBlock ha hb)), ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩⟩
  · -- Every nonsingleton orbit fits in X. Its powerset gives a finite index
    -- type, and the orbit equality criterion gives pairwise disjointness.
    let embed : ↥orbitBlocks → ↥X.powerset := fun S =>
      ⟨S.val, Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (orbitSubset S.property)⟩
    let _ : Finite ↥orbitBlocks := Finite.of_injective embed (fun _ _ h =>
      Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun T : ↥X.powerset => T.val) h))
    refine ⟨⟨⟨X, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · apply extremalOfFamily X (fun S : ↥orbitBlocks => S.val)
      · intro S
        obtain ⟨x, hx, _, _, _⟩ := S.property.2
        exact ⟨x, hx⟩
      · intro S T hST
        apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
        intro x hx hy
        exact hST (Subtype.ext (Finset.coe_injective
          ((orbitOfBlock S.property hx).trans (orbitOfBlock T.property hy).symm)))
      · intro x
        exact ⟨blockOfMoved, fun ⟨S, hx⟩ => orbitSubset S.property hx⟩
    · -- A moved point and its image lie in one of the upper blocks, so the
      -- swap-closure criterion applies to the ambient finitary permutation.
      intro f hf
      apply extremalMemOfMoves ((mem_closure_isSwap (fun _ h => h)).mp (hP hf)).1
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨S, hxS⟩ := blockOfMoved ((memX x).mpr ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, hx⟩)
      have hfx : f x ∈ S.val :=
        show f x ∈ (S.val : Set Nat) from (orbitOfBlock S.property hxS).symm ▸
          (show f x ∈ MulAction.orbit P x from ⟨⟨f, hf⟩, rfl⟩)
      exact (le_iSup (fun T : ↥orbitBlocks => blockSym T.val) S) (extremalSwapInBlock hxS hfx)
    · -- A point in a nonsingleton orbit is moved by some element of P.
      -- The overgroup fixes every point outside its blocks, so the point
      -- lies in a block. Block invariance puts its whole orbit there.
      rintro H ⟨⟨Y, n, A, _, disjoint, _, rfl⟩, hH⟩
      apply iSup_le
      intro S
      obtain ⟨x, hx, _, _, _⟩ := S.property.2
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (memX x).mp (orbitSubset S.property hx)
      have covered : ∃ i, x ∈ A i := by
        by_contra h
        exact hg ((extremalBlockAction disjoint (hH g.property)).2 x (fun i hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩))
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := covered
      have hsub : S.val ⊆ A i := by
        intro y hy
        have hy' : y ∈ MulAction.orbit P x := orbitOfBlock S.property hx ▸
          (show y ∈ (S.val : Set Nat) from hy)
        obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mp hy'
        exact (extremalBlockAction disjoint (hH p.property)).1 i x hi
      exact (extremalBlockMono hsub).trans (le_iSup (fun j => blockSym (A j)) i)
ExtremalParabolicsOfFiniteGroup.support:
private abbrev extremalBlockSym (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ S))

private abbrev extremalParabolicOn (X : Finset Nat) (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧
    H = iSup (fun i => extremalBlockSym (blocks i))

private theorem extremalOfFamily (X : Finset Nat) {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (A : ι → Finset Nat)
    (nonempty : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty)
    (disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)))
    (cover : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ A i) :
    extremalParabolicOn X (⨆ i, extremalBlockSym (A i)) := by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  refine ⟨Fintype.card ι, A ∘ e, fun i => nonempty (e i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact disjoint (fun h => hij (e.injective h))
  · intro x
    rw [cover x]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨e.symm i, by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, e.apply_symm_apply] using hi⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨e i, hi⟩
  · exact (e.iSup_comp (g := fun i => extremalBlockSym (A i))).symm

private theorem extremalFixesOutside {S : Finset Nat} {f : Equiv.Perm Nat}
    (hf : f ∈ extremalBlockSym S) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ S) : f x = x := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hf
  exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g hx

private theorem extremalPreservesBlock {S : Finset Nat} {f : Equiv.Perm Nat}
    (hf : f ∈ extremalBlockSym S) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) : f x ∈ S := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hf
  exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem g x).mpr hx

private theorem extremalBlockMono {S T : Finset Nat} (hST : S ⊆ T) : extremalBlockSym S ≤ extremalBlockSym T := by
  classical
  intro f hf
  have fixed (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ T) : f x = x :=
    extremalFixesOutside hf (fun hs => hx (hST hs))
  have movedIn (x : Nat) (hx : f x ≠ x) : x ∈ T := by
    by_contra hout
    exact hx (fixed x hout)
  have invariant (x : Nat) : f x ∈ T ↔ x ∈ T := by
    by_cases h : f x = x
    · rw [h]
    · exact iff_of_true (by
        apply movedIn
        exact fun he => h (f.injective he)) (movedIn x h)
  exact ⟨f.subtypePerm invariant, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm invariant movedIn⟩

private theorem extremalSwapInBlock {S : Finset Nat} {a b : Nat} (ha : a ∈ S) (hb : b ∈ S) :
    Equiv.swap a b ∈ extremalBlockSym S := by
  classical
  exact ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩,
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq (⟨a, ha⟩ : {x // x ∈ S}) ⟨b, hb⟩⟩

-- Alphabeta Math, steps 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1, show that transpositions generate
-- a finite symmetric group by factoring cycles and concatenating the factors.
-- Here the ambient carrier is Nat. Use the checked finitary closure criterion
-- with finite support and a single internal swap witnessing each moved image.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
private theorem extremalMemOfMoves {H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} {f : Equiv.Perm Nat}
    (hf : (MulAction.fixedBy Nat f)ᶜ.Finite)
    (hs : ∀ x, f x ≠ x → Equiv.swap x (f x) ∈ H) : f ∈ H := by
  classical
  let T : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) := {g | g ∈ H ∧ g.IsSwap}
  have hT : ∀ g ∈ T, g.IsSwap := fun _ h => h.2
  have inClosure : f ∈ Subgroup.closure T := by
    apply (mem_closure_isSwap hT).mpr
    refine ⟨hf, fun x => ?_⟩
    by_cases h : f x = x
    · rw [h]
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit_self x
    · have hswap : Equiv.swap x (f x) ∈ T := ⟨hs x h, ⟨x, f x, Ne.symm h, rfl⟩⟩
      exact ⟨⟨Equiv.swap x (f x), Subgroup.subset_closure hswap⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩
  exact ((Subgroup.closure_le H).mpr (show T ⊆ H from fun _ h => h.1)) inClosure

private theorem extremalBlockGenerated (S : Finset Nat) :
    extremalBlockSym S = Subgroup.closure {f : Equiv.Perm Nat |
      ∃ a ∈ S, ∃ b ∈ S, a ≠ b ∧ f = Equiv.swap a b} := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro f hf
    have supportIn : (MulAction.fixedBy Nat f)ᶜ ⊆ (S : Set Nat) := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hout
      exact hx (extremalFixesOutside hf hout)
    apply extremalMemOfMoves ((S.finite_toSet).subset supportIn)
    intro x hx
    have hxs := supportIn (show x ∈ (MulAction.fixedBy Nat f)ᶜ from hx)
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨x, hxs, f x, extremalPreservesBlock hf hxs, hx.symm, rfl⟩
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, _, rfl⟩
    exact extremalSwapInBlock ha hb

private theorem extremalSingleton (a : Nat) : extremalBlockSym {a} = ⊥ := by
  classical
  rw [extremalBlockGenerated, ← Subgroup.closure_empty]
  congr 1
  ext f
  simp

-- A transposition generates its two-point block group. Singleton padding
-- puts all these two-point groups on the common carrier required by Prop. 7.1.
private theorem extremalPairGenerated {a b : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    extremalBlockSym {a, b} = Subgroup.closure {Equiv.swap a b} := by
  classical
  rw [extremalBlockGenerated]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv, rfl⟩
    have hu' : u = a ∨ u = b := by simpa using hu
    have hv' : v = a ∨ v = b := by simpa using hv
    rcases hu' with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hv' with rfl | rfl
    · exact (huv rfl).elim
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _)
    · rw [Equiv.swap_comm]
      exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_singleton _)
    · exact (huv rfl).elim
  · apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    intro f hf
    obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hf
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨a, by simp, b, by simp, hab, rfl⟩

private theorem extremalTrivialOn (X : Finset Nat) : extremalParabolicOn X ⊥ := by
  classical
  let A : ↥X → Finset Nat := fun i => {i.val}
  have hSup : (⨆ i, extremalBlockSym (A i)) = ⊥ := by
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i => ?_) bot_le
    exact (extremalSingleton i.val).le
  rw [← hSup]
  refine extremalOfFamily X A (fun i => ⟨i.val, by simp [A]⟩) ?_ ?_
  · intro i j hij
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    have hx' : x = i.val := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
    have hy' : x = j.val := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy
    exact hij (Subtype.ext (hx'.symm.trans hy'))
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, by simp [A]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hi]
      exact i.property

private theorem extremalPaddedBlock (X : Finset Nat) {S : Finset Nat} (hS : S ⊆ X) (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    extremalParabolicOn X (extremalBlockSym S) := by
  classical
  let A : Option ↥(X \ S) → Finset Nat := fun i =>
    match i with
    | none => S
    | some x => {x.val}
  have hSup : (⨆ i, extremalBlockSym (A i)) = extremalBlockSym S := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply iSup_le
      intro i
      cases i with
      | none => exact le_rfl
      | some x => exact (extremalSingleton x.val).le.trans bot_le
    · exact le_iSup (fun i => extremalBlockSym (A i)) none
  rw [← hSup]
  refine extremalOfFamily X A ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i
    cases i with
    | none => exact hne
    | some x => exact ⟨x.val, by simp [A]⟩
  · intro i j hij
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    cases i <;> cases j
    next => exact hij rfl
    next v =>
      have hxv : x = v.val := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp v.property).2 (hxv ▸ hx)
    next u =>
      have hxu : x = u.val := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp u.property).2 (hxu ▸ hy)
    next u v =>
      have hxu : x = u.val := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
      have hxv : x = v.val := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy
      exact hij (congrArg some (Subtype.ext (hxu.symm.trans hxv)))
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_cases hs : x ∈ S
      · exact ⟨none, hs⟩
      · exact ⟨some ⟨x, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx, hs⟩⟩, by simp [A]⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      cases i with
      | none => exact hS hi
      | some v =>
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hi]
        exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp v.property).1

private theorem extremalBlockAction {ι : Type} {A : ι → Finset Nat}
    (disjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j))) {f : Equiv.Perm Nat} (hf : f ∈ ⨆ i, extremalBlockSym (A i)) :
    (∀ i x, x ∈ A i → f x ∈ A i) ∧
    (∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ A i) → f x = x) := by
  classical
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun i => extremalBlockSym (A i)) hf
    (C := fun f => (∀ i x, x ∈ A i → f x ∈ A i) ∧
      (∀ x, (∀ i, x ∉ A i) → f x = x)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro j f hj
    refine ⟨?_, fun x hx => extremalFixesOutside hj (hx j)⟩
    intro i x hx
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j
      exact extremalPreservesBlock hj hx
    · rw [extremalFixesOutside hj (fun hy => Finset.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint h) hx hy)]
      exact hx
  · exact ⟨fun _ _ hx => hx, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  · intro f g hf hg
    exact ⟨fun i x hx => hf.1 i (g x) (hg.1 i x hx), fun x hx =>
      show f (g x) = x from (congrArg f (hg.2 x hx)).trans (hf.2 x hx)⟩

external.usage: Used in both directions on Nat. The forward implication supplies finite support for members of P from the ambient swap-closure hypothesis. For the reverse implication, use the set of genuine swaps in the target subgroup. Each moved point and its image are connected by their swap, while fixed points use the identity. This proves generation of each finite block group and containment of P in the orbit-block supremum. Checked with MackeyDiagrams and the registered Proofs.FiniteParabolicClosure import.

RestrictionSplitDotSlide.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he
  -- Proposition 3.1, (3.3) and (3.4), and the fourth drawing of §3.2.
  -- The archived original PDF (source/) has (3.4) on p. 8 and the
  -- fourth drawing on p. 9. The revised published PDF (article-revision/)
  -- has them on pp. 10 and 11 respectively. The two editions agree here.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:curl
  -- The proof of (3.1) computes on simple tensors. Here the checked
  -- restriction merge square supplies its downward counterpart (3.3).
  -- The dots satisfy their intertwining conditions by Dot.ofRepresentatives
  -- using he and hd for the two subgroup memberships. This is the representative
  -- case of GroupElementDotCriterion, with intertwining carried by the Dot type.
  -- RestrictionMergeDotSlide supplies both evaluated squares in tensor order
  -- H then G, with merged multiplier γ'(e⁻¹)d⁻¹, where γ' acts by conjugation.
  have mergeSquares := RestrictionMergeDotSlide K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he
  -- Derive (3.4) by composing (3.3) with the source and target splits.
  -- The source split followed by merge is identity on the composite strand.
  -- The target merge followed by split is identity on the two-strand word.
  -- These are the last two clauses of InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits,
  -- which uses Diagram.mergeDown_splitDown and Diagram.splitDown_mergeDown.
  -- The drawing interpreter reduces the trivalent vertices to these maps
  -- and vertical stacking to Biset.Hom.vertical.
  have splitSquare {X Y W Z : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K G}
      (merge : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y)
      (split : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex Y X)
      (merge' : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex W Z)
      (split' : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex Z W)
      (legs : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X W)
      (merged : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex Y Z)
      (sourceInverse : split.vertical merge = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id Y)
      (targetInverse : merge'.vertical split' = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id W)
      (mergeSquare : legs.vertical merge' = merge.vertical merged) :
      split.vertical legs = merged.vertical split' := by
    calc
      split.vertical legs = split.vertical ((legs.vertical merge').vertical split') := by
        rw [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc legs merge' split', targetInverse,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_id]
      _ = split.vertical ((merge.vertical merged).vertical split') := by rw [mergeSquare]
      _ = (split.vertical merge).vertical (merged.vertical split') := by
        simp only [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
      _ = merged.vertical split' := by
        rw [sourceInverse, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, sourceInverse⟩ :=

open MackeyDiagrams

namespace MultipliersUnderRelabellingProof

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {H K : Subgroup U}

private noncomputable abbrev dotValue {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    MonoidAlgebra Complex K :=
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element label)

private theorem dotValue_identity (a : ConjEmbedding H K) :
    dotValue (DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) a) = 1 := by
  simp only [dotValue, DotLabel.identity, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

private theorem dotElement_injective {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} :
    Function.Injective (Dot.element (a := a) (b := b)) :=
  fun _ _ h => Dot.ext h

private noncomputable def liftMultiplier {a b : ConjEmbedding H K}
    (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex K) : DotLabel Complex a b :=
  Finsupp.comapDomain Dot.element m.coeff dotElement_injective.injOn

private theorem liftMultiplier_value {a b : ConjEmbedding H K}
    (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex K)
    (eligible : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, ∀ f : H,
      a.toHom f * p = p * b.toHom f) :
    dotValue (liftMultiplier (a := a) (b := b) m) = m := by
  have inRange : (↑m.coeff.support : Set K) ⊆ Set.range (Dot.element (a := a) (b := b)) := by
    intro p hp
    exact ⟨⟨p, eligible p hp⟩, rfl⟩
  exact congrArg MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
    (Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain Dot.element dotElement_injective m.coeff inRange)

private theorem eligibleOfCentralizer {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} {u v : U}
    (ha : ∀ f : H, (a.toHom f : U) = u * (f : U) * u⁻¹)
    (hb : ∀ f : H, (b.toHom f : U) = v * (f : U) * v⁻¹)
    (p : K)
    (he : ∀ f : H, (u * (f : U) * u⁻¹) * (p : U) =
      (p : U) * (v * (f : U) * v⁻¹)) :
    ∀ f : H, a.toHom f * p = p * b.toHom f := by
  intro f
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (a.toHom f : U) * (p : U) = (p : U) * (b.toHom f : U)
  rw [ha f, hb f]
  exact he f

section Relabel

variable {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
variable (ga : ConjEmbedding A G) (ad : ConjEmbedding D A) (df : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (gc : ConjEmbedding C G) (ce : ConjEmbedding E C) (ef : ConjEmbedding F E)

private abbrev LeftLabels :=
  Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : ConjEmbedding B G)
    (bd : ConjEmbedding D B) (be : ConjEmbedding E B),
    DotLabel Complex (ga.comp ad) (gb.comp bd) × DotLabel Complex (bd.comp df) (be.comp ef) ×
    DotLabel Complex (gb.comp be) (gc.comp ce)

private abbrev RightLabels :=
  Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : ConjEmbedding B' A) (cb' : ConjEmbedding B' C)
    (b'f : ConjEmbedding F B'),
    DotLabel Complex (ad.comp df) (ab'.comp b'f) × DotLabel Complex (ga.comp ab') (gc.comp cb') ×
    DotLabel Complex (cb'.comp b'f) (ce.comp ef)

private noncomputable abbrev along (a : ConjEmbedding H K) :=
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom

private theorem relabel
    (leftMultiplier : LeftLabels ga ad df gc ce ef → MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
    (rightMultiplier : RightLabels ga ad df gc ce ef → MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
    (allowed : G → Prop)
    (intertwines : ∀ p : G, allowed p → ∀ f : F,
      ((ga.comp ad).comp df).toHom f * p = p * ((gc.comp ce).comp ef).toHom f)
    (hLeft : ∀ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : ConjEmbedding D B) (be : ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : DotLabel Complex (ga.comp ad) (gb.comp bd))
      (x₂ : DotLabel Complex (bd.comp df) (be.comp ef))
      (x₃ : DotLabel Complex (gb.comp be) (gc.comp ce)),
      let m := leftMultiplier ⟨B, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩
      m = dotValue x₁ * along gb (dotValue x₂) * dotValue x₃ ∧
        ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p)
    (hRight : ∀ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : ConjEmbedding B' A) (cb' : ConjEmbedding B' C)
      (b'f : ConjEmbedding F B')
      (y₁ : DotLabel Complex (ad.comp df) (ab'.comp b'f))
      (y₂ : DotLabel Complex (ga.comp ab') (gc.comp cb'))
      (y₃ : DotLabel Complex (cb'.comp b'f) (ce.comp ef)),
      let m := rightMultiplier ⟨B', ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩
      m = along ga (dotValue y₁) * dotValue y₂ * along gc (dotValue y₃) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p) :
    ∃ (φ : LeftLabels ga ad df gc ce ef → RightLabels ga ad df gc ce ef)
      (ψ : RightLabels ga ad df gc ce ef → LeftLabels ga ad df gc ce ef),
      (∀ d, rightMultiplier (φ d) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
      (∀ d, leftMultiplier (ψ d) = rightMultiplier d) ∧
      (∀ d, leftMultiplier (ψ (φ d)) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
      (∀ d, rightMultiplier (φ (ψ d)) = rightMultiplier d) := by
  classical
  let bottomPair := ga.comp ad
  let topPair := gc.comp ce
  let middle := fun m =>
    liftMultiplier (a := bottomPair.comp df) (b := topPair.comp ef) m
  -- Constructions of φ and ψ in Lemma 6.1. The article uses representatives
  -- pv and v for each p in the support. Use the equivalent pointwise
  -- intertwining law to form Dot and pull back coefficients along Dot.element.
  -- Composing the homomorphisms gives definitional equality of the differently
  -- bracketed middle embeddings and of the outer embeddings at identity dots.
  let ab' := ad.comp df
  let cb' := ce.comp ef
  let b'f := ConjEmbedding.id F
  let gb := ConjEmbedding.id G
  let y₁ := DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) ab'
  let y₃ := DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) cb'
  let x₁ := DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) bottomPair
  let x₃ := DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) topPair
  let makeRight : MonoidAlgebra Complex G → RightLabels ga ad df gc ce ef :=
    fun m => ⟨F, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, middle m, y₃⟩
  let makeLeft : MonoidAlgebra Complex G → LeftLabels ga ad df gc ce ef :=
    fun m => ⟨G, gb, bottomPair, topPair, x₁, middle m, x₃⟩
  have rightValue (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p) :
      rightMultiplier (makeRight m) = m := by
    have middleValue : dotValue (middle m) = m :=
      liftMultiplier_value m fun p hp => intertwines p (hm p hp)
    calc
      _ = along ga (dotValue y₁) * dotValue (middle m) * along gc (dotValue y₃) :=
        (hRight F ab' cb' b'f y₁ (middle m) y₃).1
      _ = m := by
        rw [dotValue_identity ab', dotValue_identity cb', map_one, map_one,
          one_mul, mul_one, middleValue]
  have leftValue (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p) :
      leftMultiplier (makeLeft m) = m := by
    have middleValue : dotValue (middle m) = m :=
      liftMultiplier_value m fun p hp => intertwines p (hm p hp)
    calc
      _ = dotValue x₁ * along gb (dotValue (middle m)) * dotValue x₃ :=
        (hLeft G gb bottomPair topPair x₁ (middle m) x₃).1
      _ = m := by
        rw [dotValue_identity bottomPair, dotValue_identity topPair, one_mul, mul_one, middleValue]
        change MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MonoidHom.id G) m = m
        simp only [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom_id, AlgHom.id_apply]
  have hφ (d : LeftLabels ga ad df gc ce ef) : rightMultiplier (makeRight (leftMultiplier d)) =
      leftMultiplier d := by
    rcases d with ⟨B, g, bd, be, x, y, z⟩
    exact rightValue _ (hLeft B g bd be x y z).2
  have hψ (d : RightLabels ga ad df gc ce ef) : leftMultiplier (makeLeft (rightMultiplier d)) =
      rightMultiplier d := by
    rcases d with ⟨B', ab, cb, bf, x, y, z⟩
    exact leftValue _ (hRight B' ab cb bf x y z).2
  -- Round-trip calculations in Lemma 6.1 follow by composing preservation.
  exact ⟨fun d => makeRight (leftMultiplier d), fun d => makeLeft (rightMultiplier d),
    hφ, hψ, fun d => (hψ _).trans (hφ d), fun d => (hφ _).trans (hψ d)⟩

end Relabel
end MultipliersUnderRelabellingProof

open MultipliersUnderRelabellingProof

open MackeyDiagrams in
private theorem reidemeisterOne_leftUpExpansion {U : Type u} [Group U]
    {K H G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (d : ConjEmbedding K H) :
  let up := Word.up d
  let loopDown := Word.down a
  let loopUp := Word.up a
  let straight := Diagram.id (R := Complex) up
  let cup := Diagram.horizontal
    (Diagram.ordinaryCup a) straight
  let middle := Diagram.horizontal
    (Diagram.id loopDown)
    (Diagram.vertical
      (Diagram.mergeUp a d)
      (Diagram.splitUp a d))
  let cap := Diagram.horizontal
    (Diagram.traceCap a) straight
  let expanded :=
    Diagram.vertical
      (Diagram.insertLeftUnit up)
      (Diagram.vertical cup
        (Diagram.vertical
          (Diagram.associate loopDown loopUp up)
          (Diagram.vertical middle
            (Diagram.vertical
              (Diagram.unassociate loopDown loopUp up)
              (Diagram.vertical cap
                (Diagram.leftUnit up))))))
  let lower := LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a d)
  let upper := LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a d)
  (lower.vertical upper).interpret.eval = expanded.eval := by
  intro up loopDown loopUp straight cup middle cap expanded lower upper
  -- Alphabeta Math's tensor product proof uses balance in Step 2.1,
  -- quotient descent in Step 3.1, and generation by elementary tensors
  -- in Step 4.1. Here the middle algebra is a complex group algebra.
  -- The project linearizes the balanced biset, and horizontal_vertical
  -- establishes interchange by evaluating the two composites on the
  -- classes of elementary pairs. The left tensor factor is an identity.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  have interchange :
      (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Biset.restriction a)).horizontal
          ((Generator.mergeUp Complex a d).vertical (Generator.splitUp Complex a d)) =
        ((Biset.Hom.id (Biset.restriction a)).horizontal (Generator.mergeUp Complex a d)).vertical
          ((Biset.Hom.id (Biset.restriction a)).horizontal (Generator.splitUp Complex a d)) := by
    rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  simp only [lower, upper, expanded, middle, cap, cup, straight, up, loopDown, loopUp,
    LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, TrivalentVertex.expand, BentVertex.expand,
    Diagram.traceCapOnLeft, Diagram.eval, Word.basis, interchange, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
