namespace CaseSixRightShapeEvaluationAux

open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped BigOperators

private noncomputable def weighted {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U}
    {p q : Word K H} {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex)
    (term : ι → Diagram Complex p q) : ScopedDiagram Complex p q :=
  .linearCombination (I.toList.map fun i => (weight i, .ordinary (term i)))

private theorem weighted_apply {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U}
    {p q : Word K H} {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex)
    (term : ι → Diagram Complex p q) (z : p.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    (weighted I weight term).eval.toLinearMap z =
      ∑ i ∈ I, weight i • (term i).eval.toLinearMap z := by
  rw [weighted, ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, List.map_map]
  exact Finset.sum_map_toList I _

private theorem frameLeft {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H J : Subgroup U}
    (p : Word K H) {q q' : Word H J} {ι : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex) (term : ι → Diagram Complex q q') :
    ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (weighted I weight term).eval).toLinearMap =
      ∑ i ∈ I, weight i • ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (term i).eval).toLinearMap := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (weighted I weight term).eval).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r) =
    (∑ i ∈ I, weight i • ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (term i).eval).toLinearMap)
      (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r)
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single,
    weighted_apply, map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm r (weight i)]

private theorem frameRight {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H J : Subgroup U}
    {p p' : Word K H} (q : Word H J) {ι : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex) (term : ι → Diagram Complex p p') :
    ((weighted I weight term).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap =
      ∑ i ∈ I, weight i • ((term i).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change ((weighted I weight term).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r) =
    (∑ i ∈ I, weight i • ((term i).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap)
      (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r)
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single,
    weighted_apply]
  let pair := (Biset.pairLinear Complex p'.basis q.basis).flip
    ((Biset.Hom.id q.basis).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1))
  change r • pair (∑ i ∈ I, weight i • (term i).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) =
    ∑ i ∈ I, weight i • (r • pair ((term i).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)))
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm r (weight i)]

section
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B' : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
variable (i : ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : ConjEmbedding B' F) (k : ConjEmbedding B' C)

private abbrev Inner := (Word.up i).tensor (.down j)
private abbrev Lower := Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)
private abbrev Middle := Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)
private abbrev Upper := Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)
private abbrev Bottom := (Word.up a).tensor ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d))
private abbrev Top := (Word.up c).tensor ((Word.down e).tensor (.up f))

private abbrev Fibers (r : Lower b d i j) :=
  ∀ x : D, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedProduct b d
    (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w) = x}

private def projectionDot (r : Lower b d i j) (hr : Fibers b d i j r) :
    ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j :=
  ⟨r, fun z => (hr (Generator.mixedProduct b d z)).subset
    (fun _ hw => congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct b d) hw)⟩

private abbrev projection (r : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)) (Inner i j) :=
  .mixedProjection b d i j r.dot r.finite

private abbrev parallel (t : Middle a c i k) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (.up i)) ((Word.up c).tensor (.up k)) :=
  .parallelUp a i c k t

private abbrev multiply (s : Upper e f j k) :
    Diagram Complex (Inner k j) ((Word.down e).tensor (.up f)) :=
  .mixedMultiplication e f k j s

private abbrev unassoc : Diagram Complex
    ((Word.up a).tensor (Inner i j)) (((Word.up a).tensor (.up i)).tensor (.down j)) :=
  .unassociate (.up a) (.up i) (.down j)

private abbrev assoc : Diagram Complex
    (((Word.up c).tensor (.up k)).tensor (.down j)) ((Word.up c).tensor (Inner k j)) :=
  .associate (.up c) (.up k) (.down j)

private noncomputable def drawing
    (lower : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (middle : List (Complex × Middle a c i k)) (upper : List (Complex × Upper e f j k)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (Bottom a b d) (Top c e f) :=
  .vertical
    (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.up a))) (.compactProjection b d i j lower))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (unassoc a i j))
      (.vertical (.horizontal (.parallelUp a i c k middle) (.ordinary (.id (.down j))))
        (.vertical (.ordinary (assoc c j k))
          (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.up c))) (.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper)))))

private noncomputable def input (g : G) (x : D) : (Bottom a b d).basis.carrier →₀ Complex :=
  Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis
    g (Generator.mixedPair b d x)) 1

private noncomputable def output (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k)
    (g : G) (α : A) (h : F) : (Top c e f).basis.carrier →₀ Complex :=
  Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction c).pair ((Word.down e).tensor (.up f)).basis
    (g * a.toHom α * t.element) (Generator.mixedPair e f (s.element * f.toHom h))) 1

private noncomputable def column (r : Lower b d i j) (hr : Fibers b d i j r)
    (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (Top c e f).basis.carrier →₀ Complex :=
  ∑ w ∈ (hr x).toFinset, output a c e f i j k t s g (Quotient.out w).1 (Quotient.out w).2

private noncomputable def tail (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (Inner i j)) (Top c e f) :=
  (unassoc a i j).vertical (((parallel a c i k t).horizontal (.id (.down j))).vertical
    ((assoc c j k).vertical ((Diagram.id (.up c)).horizontal (multiply e f j k s))))

private theorem tail_pair (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k) (g : G) (α : A) (h : F) :
    (tail a c e f i j k t s).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Inner i j).basis g
        ((Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) α h)) 1) =
    output a c e f i j k t s g α h := by
  -- Step 2 of the right-hand calculation: horizontal balancing is made explicit
  -- by reassociation. The shared merge, dot and split rules take basis vectors
  -- directly. InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits packages these rules for
  -- chosen conjugators and group-algebra inputs.
  have hm : (parallel a c i k t).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.induction i) g α) 1) =
      Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction c).pair (Biset.induction k)
        (g * a.toHom α * t.element) 1) 1 := by
    change (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) c k).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.upDot t).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.mergeUp a i).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.induction i) g α) 1))) = _
    rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single (R := Complex) a i g α 1,
      Diagram.eval_upDot_single (R := Complex) t (g * a.toHom α) 1,
      Diagram.eval_splitUp_single (R := Complex) c k (g * a.toHom α * t.element) 1]
  -- Step 3: the unit inserted by the split leaves just the upper dot and f(h).
  have hp : (multiply e f j k s).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction k).pair (Biset.restriction j) (1 : C) h) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair e f (s.element * f.toHom h)) 1 := by
    change (Generator.mixedMultiplication e f k j s Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [Generator.mixedMultiplication, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
    change Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair e f (e.toHom 1 * s.element * f.toHom h)) 1 = _
    rw [map_one, one_mul]
  change ((Diagram.id (.up c)).horizontal (multiply e f j k s)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((assoc c j k).eval.toLinearMap
      (((parallel a c i k t).horizontal (Diagram.id (.down j))).eval.toLinearMap
        ((unassoc a i j).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Inner i j).basis g
            ((Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) α h)) 1)))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_unassociate_single (R := Complex) (.up a) (.up i) (.down j) g α h 1,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (parallel a c i k t) (Diagram.id (.down j)),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, hm, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
    Diagram.eval_associate_single (R := Complex) (.up c) (.up k) (.down j),
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id (.up c)) (multiply e f j k s),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, hp, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rfl

private theorem projectionColumn (r : Lower b d i j) (hr : Fibers b d i j r) (x : D) :
    (projection b d i j (projectionDot b d i j r hr)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair b d x) 1) =
    ∑ w ∈ (hr x).toFinset, Finsupp.single w 1 := by
  -- Step 1: use the transfer column of Proposition 5.1 with the given finite
  -- group fiber. The registered MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention packages
  -- trace and shape results with the column. Here transferBasis_sum and
  -- mixedEquiv identify the two fibers directly at the specified input.
  let dot := projectionDot b d i j r hr
  have hf : (dot.finite (Generator.mixedPair b d x)).toFinset = (hr x).toFinset := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    change Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w = Generator.mixedPair b d x ↔
      Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w) = x
    constructor
    · intro hw
      rw [hw, Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
    · intro hw
      apply (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).injective
      exact hw.trans (Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair b d x).symm
  change (Generator.mixedProjection b d i j dot.dot Complex dot.finite).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair b d x) 1) = _
  rw [Generator.mixedProjection, Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul,
    Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum, hf]

private theorem oneTerm (r : Lower b d i j) (hr : Fibers b d i j r)
    (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (tail a c e f i j k t s).eval.toLinearMap
      (((Diagram.id (.up a)).horizontal (projection b d i j (projectionDot b d i j r hr))).eval.toLinearMap
        (input a b d g x)) =
    column a b d c e f i j k r hr t s g x := by
  rw [input, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id (.up a))
    (projection b d i j (projectionDot b d i j r hr)),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, projectionColumn b d i j r hr x, map_sum, map_sum]
  unfold column
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  have hw : (Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) (Quotient.out w).1 (Quotient.out w).2 = w :=
    Quotient.out_eq' w
  calc
    _ = (tail a c e f i j k t s).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Inner i j).basis g
          ((Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) (Quotient.out w).1 (Quotient.out w).2)) 1) :=
      congrArg (fun v => (tail a c e f i j k t s).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Inner i j).basis g v) 1)) hw.symm
    _ = _ := tail_pair a c e f i j k t s g (Quotient.out w).1 (Quotient.out w).2

private theorem projectionWeighted {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex)
    (term : ι → ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j
      (I.toList.map fun u => (weight u, term u))).interpret =
      weighted I weight (fun u => projection b d i j (term u)) := by
  simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, weighted, List.map_map]
  rfl

private theorem parallelWeighted {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex)
    (term : ι → Middle a c i k) :
    (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k (I.toList.map fun u => (weight u, term u))).interpret =
      weighted I weight (fun u => parallel a c i k (term u)) := by
  simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, weighted, List.map_map]
  rfl

private theorem multiplyWeighted {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (weight : ι → Complex)
    (term : ι → Upper e f j k) :
    (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j (I.toList.map fun u => (weight u, term u))).interpret =
      weighted I weight (fun u => multiply e f j k (term u)) := by
  simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, weighted, List.map_map]
  rfl

private theorem weightedCase {ι₁ ι₂ ι₃ : Type*}
    (I : Finset ι₁) (J : Finset ι₂) (K : Finset ι₃)
    (l : ι₁ → Complex) (m : ι₂ → Complex) (n : ι₃ → Complex)
    (r : ι₁ → Lower b d i j) (hr : ∀ u, Fibers b d i j (r u))
    (t : ι₂ → Middle a c i k) (s : ι₃ → Upper e f j k) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (drawing a b d c e f i j k
      (I.toList.map fun u => (l u, projectionDot b d i j (r u) (hr u)))
      (J.toList.map fun v => (m v, t v)) (K.toList.map fun w => (n w, s w))).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
        (input a b d g x) =
    ∑ u ∈ I, ∑ v ∈ J, ∑ w ∈ K,
      (l u * m v * n w) • column a b d c e f i j k (r u) (hr u) (t v) (s w) g x := by
  -- Step 4: linearity on the three supported labels. Use Finset-indexed sums
  -- through the shared, genuinely horizontal frames, then multiply the weights.
  let project u := projectionDot b d i j (r u) (hr u)
  let D₁ := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j (I.toList.map fun u => (l u, project u))
  let D₂ := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k (J.toList.map fun v => (m v, t v))
  let D₃ := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j (K.toList.map fun w => (n w, s w))
  change ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.up c).basis).horizontal D₃.interpret.eval).toLinearMap
    ((assoc c j k).eval.toLinearMap
      ((D₂.interpret.eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down j).basis)).toLinearMap
        ((unassoc a i j).eval.toLinearMap
          (((Biset.Hom.id (Word.up a).basis).horizontal D₁.interpret.eval).toLinearMap
            (input a b d g x))))) = _
  have h₁ : D₁.interpret = weighted I l (fun u => projection b d i j (project u)) :=
    projectionWeighted b d i j I l project
  have h₂ : D₂.interpret = weighted J m (fun v => parallel a c i k (t v)) :=
    parallelWeighted a c i k J m t
  have h₃ : D₃.interpret = weighted K n (fun w => multiply e f j k (s w)) :=
    multiplyWeighted e f j k K n s
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  rw [frameLeft, frameRight, frameLeft]
  simp only [LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_sum, map_smul,
    Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  exact congrArg ((l u * m v * n w) • ·) (oneTerm a b d c e f i j k (r u) (hr u) (t v) (s w) g x)

end
end CaseSixRightShapeEvaluationAux

CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluation.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst G A D F C E B a b d c e f α β γ up down tensor comp
    sourcePair targetPair targetBasis bottom top RDot TDot SDot q finiteFibers projectionDot
    stack juxtapose ordinary drawing input output evaluates fiberSum
  constructor
  · intro r t s hs g x
    have h := CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluationAux.stackedColumn a b d c e f α β γ
      [(1, r)] [(1, t)] [(1, ⟨s, hs⟩)] g x
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, one_mul, one_smul,
      add_zero] at h
    exact h
  · intro rs ts ss hs g x supported terms
    let projectionLabels :
        List (Complex × {s : SDot // finiteFibers s}) :=
      supported.toList.map fun s => (ss s.1, ⟨s.1, hs s.1 s.2⟩)
    have h := CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluationAux.stackedColumn a b d c e f α β γ
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts) projectionLabels g x
    have hlabels :
        (projectionLabels.map fun (k,s) => (k, projectionDot s.1 s.2)) = terms := by
      rw [show projectionLabels = _ from rfl, List.map_map]
      rfl
    change evaluates (drawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts)
        (projectionLabels.map fun (k,s) => (k, projectionDot s.1 s.2))) g x = _ at h
    rw [hlabels] at h
    rw [h]
    -- The finite lists enumerate the two coefficient supports and the attached
    -- projection support. The index retains the evidence needed for each fiber.
    simp only [MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms, projectionLabels, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
      Finset.sum_map_toList, Finsupp.sum]
    rfl
CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluation.support:
universe u

/- Case 5 on the left of Xiao, Lemma 6.6, equation (6.3). The rendered
   s₁s₂s₁ drawing and its equation are on archived p. 25 and revised
   published p. 27. The local proof follows the three operations in the
   proof of Lemma 6.6, with the mixed finite-fiber convention from § 6.2
   (archived p. 22, revised published p. 24). -/
namespace CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluationAux

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
variable (α : ConjEmbedding G B) (β : ConjEmbedding D B) (γ : ConjEmbedding E B)

private abbrev RDot := Dot (α.comp a) (β.comp b)
private abbrev TDot := Dot (β.comp d) (γ.comp f)
private abbrev SDot := Dot (α.comp c) (γ.comp e)

private noncomputable abbrev ev {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  drawing.interpret.eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev input (g : G) (x : D) :=
  ((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).basis.pair (Word.up d).basis
    ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) g x) 1

private abbrev middleBasis {J : Subgroup U} (η : ConjEmbedding J B) (j : ConjEmbedding F J) (z : B) :=
  ((Word.down α).tensor (.up η)).basis.pair (Word.up j).basis (Generator.mixedPair α η z) 1

private abbrev targetBasis := ((Word.up c).tensor (.down e)).basis

private abbrev output (p : (targetBasis c e).carrier) :=
  (targetBasis c e).pair (Word.up f).basis p 1

private abbrev finiteFibers (s : SDot c e α γ) :=
  ∀ z : B, Set.Finite {p | Generator.mixedProduct α γ
    (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α γ c e s p) = z}

private abbrev projectionDot (s : SDot c e α γ) (hs : finiteFibers c e α γ s) :
    ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e :=
  ⟨s, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hs (Generator.mixedProduct α γ z))
    (fun _ hz => congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct α γ) hz)⟩

private noncomputable abbrev column (s : SDot c e α γ) (hs : finiteFibers c e α γ s) (z : B) :=
  (hs z).toFinset.sum fun p => Finsupp.single (output c e f p) (1 : Complex)

private abbrev first (rs : List (Complex × RDot a b α β)) : LabelledDrawing Complex
    (((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).tensor (.up d))
    (((Word.down α).tensor (.up β)).tensor (.up d)) :=
  .horizontal (.mixedMultiplication α β a b rs) (.ordinary (.id (.up d)))

private abbrev second (ts : List (Complex × TDot d f β γ)) : LabelledDrawing Complex
    (((Word.down α).tensor (.up β)).tensor (.up d))
    (((Word.down α).tensor (.up γ)).tensor (.up f)) :=
  .vertical (.ordinary (.associate (.down α) (.up β) (.up d)))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.down α))) (.parallelUp β d γ f ts))
      (.ordinary (.unassociate (.down α) (.up γ) (.up f))))

private abbrev third (ss : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)) : LabelledDrawing Complex
    (((Word.down α).tensor (.up γ)).tensor (.up f))
    (((Word.up c).tensor (.down e)).tensor (.up f)) :=
  .horizontal (.compactProjection α γ c e ss) (.ordinary (.id (.up f)))

/- Xiao, Lemma 6.6, equation (6.3) and its proof, first operation: the lower
   multiplication gives u(g) r v(x). The typed spectator contributes its
   unit. The Dot type supplies the first vertex condition, as required by
   the registered finite-fiber convention's multiplication formulas. -/
private theorem firstColumn (rs : List (Complex × RDot a b α β)) (g : G) (x : D) :
    ev (first a b d α β rs) (Finsupp.single (input a b d g x) 1) =
      (rs.map fun (k, r) => k • Finsupp.single
        (middleBasis α β d (α.toHom g * r.element * β.toHom x)) 1).sum := by
  let w := (Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) g x
  let X := ((Word.down α).tensor (.up β)).basis
  let Y := (Word.up d).basis
  let frame := (Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y).flip (Finsupp.single 1 1)
  let terms := rs.map fun (k,r) => (k, ScopedDiagram.ordinary
    (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) α β a b r))
  change ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.horizontal
    (Diagram.id (.up d)).eval).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (input a b d g x) 1) = _
  rw [show Finsupp.single (input a b d g x) (1 : Complex) =
    Biset.pairLinear Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).basis Y
      (Finsupp.single w 1) (Finsupp.single 1 1) by
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]]
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  change frame ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single w 1)) = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, map_list_sum]
  simp only [terms, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ⟨k,r⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
  obtain ⟨hprod, hpush, _⟩ := (MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention (U := U)).2.1 α β a b r
  change k • frame ((Diagram.mixedMultiplication α β a b r).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single w 1)) = _
  rw [hpush w, hprod g x]
  change k • Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y
    (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α β _) 1) (Finsupp.single 1 1) = _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

/- Lemma 6.6, second operation: the induction dot right-multiplies by t.
   The paper suppresses reassociation and the split's unit factor. After
   merging, multiplying and splitting, rebracket and use the inverse law
   of mixedEquiv (which is proved by balancing) to normalize (z,t) to
   (z*t,1). The induction merge and split are the basis rules underlying
   InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits, valid for the given embeddings
   without choosing representatives. -/
private theorem secondColumn (ts : List (Complex × TDot d f β γ)) (z : B) :
    ev (second d f α β γ ts) (Finsupp.single (middleBasis α β d z) 1) =
      (ts.map fun (k, t) => k • Finsupp.single (middleBasis α γ f (z * t.element)) 1).sum := by
  let P := Word.down α
  let Q := (Word.up β).tensor (.up d)
  let S := (Word.up γ).tensor (.up f)
  let frame := (Biset.pairLinear Complex P.basis S.basis) (Finsupp.single z 1)
  let unassoc := (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) P (.up γ) (.up f)).eval.toLinearMap
  let terms := ts.map fun (k,t) => (k, ScopedDiagram.ordinary
    (Diagram.parallelUp (R := Complex) β d γ f t))
  change unassoc (((Diagram.id P).eval.horizontal
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval).toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.associate (R := Complex) P (.up β) (.up d)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (middleBasis α β d z) 1))) = _
  rw [show Finsupp.single (middleBasis α β d z) (1 : Complex) =
    Finsupp.single ((P.basis.tensor (Word.up β).basis).pair (Word.up d).basis
      (P.basis.pair (Word.up β).basis z 1) 1) 1 from rfl,
    Diagram.eval_associate_single P (.up β) (.up d) z 1 1 1]
  rw [show Finsupp.single (P.basis.pair Q.basis z ((Word.up β).basis.pair (Word.up d).basis 1 1)) (1 : Complex) =
    Biset.pairLinear Complex P.basis Q.basis (Finsupp.single z 1)
      (Finsupp.single ((Word.up β).basis.pair (Word.up d).basis 1 1) 1) by rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]]
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  change unassoc (frame ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single ((Word.up β).basis.pair (Word.up d).basis 1 1) 1))) = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, map_list_sum, map_list_sum]
  simp only [terms, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ⟨k,t⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
  have hpar :
      (Diagram.parallelUp (R := Complex) β d γ f t).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((Word.up β).basis.pair (Word.up d).basis 1 1) 1) =
      Finsupp.single ((Word.up γ).basis.pair (Word.up f).basis t.element 1) 1 := by
    change (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) γ f).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.upDot t).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.mergeUp β d).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single ((Word.up β).basis.pair (Word.up d).basis 1 1) 1))) = _
    rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single β d, map_one, mul_one,
      Diagram.eval_upDot_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single]
  change k • unassoc (frame ((Diagram.parallelUp β d γ f t).eval.toLinearMap _)) = _
  rw [hpar]
  change k • unassoc (Biset.pairLinear Complex P.basis S.basis
    (Finsupp.single z 1) (Finsupp.single ((Word.up γ).basis.pair (Word.up f).basis t.element 1) 1)) = _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  unfold unassoc
  rw [Diagram.eval_unassociate_single P (.up γ) (.up f) z t.element 1 1]
  let w := (Biset.restriction α).pair (Biset.induction γ) z t.element
  have hw : w = Generator.mixedPair α γ (z * t.element) :=
    (Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct α γ w).symm
  change k • Finsupp.single (((Word.down α).tensor (.up γ)).basis.pair
    (Word.up f).basis w 1) 1 = _
  rw [hw]

/- Lemma 6.6, third operation: take the fiber of the upper multiplication
   over the value computed by the lower two crossings. The registered
   finite-fiber convention supplies the projection column with exactly the
   termwise group-fiber hypothesis here. Framing pairs each output with
   the spectator unit and preserves its coefficient. -/
private theorem thirdColumn (ss : List (Complex × {s : SDot c e α γ // finiteFibers c e α γ s}))
    (z : B) :
    ev (third c e f α γ (ss.map fun (k,s) => (k, projectionDot c e α γ s.1 s.2)))
      (Finsupp.single (middleBasis α γ f z) 1) =
      (ss.map fun (k,s) => k • column c e f α γ s.1 s.2 z).sum := by
  let X := ((Word.down α).tensor (.up γ)).basis
  let Y := (Word.up f).basis
  let frame := (Biset.pairLinear Complex (targetBasis c e) Y).flip (Finsupp.single 1 1)
  let labels := ss.map fun (k,s) => (k, projectionDot c e α γ s.1 s.2)
  let terms := labels.map fun (k,s) => (k, ScopedDiagram.ordinary
    (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α γ c e s.dot s.finite))
  change ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.horizontal
    (Diagram.id (.up f)).eval).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (middleBasis α γ f z) 1) = _
  rw [show Finsupp.single (middleBasis α γ f z) (1 : Complex) =
    Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α γ z) 1)
      (Finsupp.single 1 1) by
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]]
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  change frame ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α γ z) 1)) = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, map_list_sum]
  simp only [terms, List.map_map]
  simp only [labels, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ⟨k,s⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hproj⟩ := (MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention (U := U)).2.1 α γ c e s.1
  change k • frame ((Diagram.mixedProjection α γ c e s.1
    (projectionDot c e α γ s.1 s.2).finite).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α γ z) 1)) = _
  have hcolumn :
      (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α γ c e s.1
        (projectionDot c e α γ s.1 s.2).finite).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair α γ z) 1) =
      (s.2 z).toFinset.sum (fun p => Finsupp.single p 1) := (hproj s.2).1 z
  rw [hcolumn, map_sum]
  simp only [frame, LinearMap.flip_apply, column, output, Y]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

/- Lemma 6.6, linear labels: expand the three marked stages in evaluation.
   Linearity at the two composition interfaces gives one product of
   coefficients for each ordered triple. Each projection term keeps
   its own finite-fiber certificate, including when no terms are present. -/
private theorem stackedColumn (rs : List (Complex × RDot a b α β))
    (ts : List (Complex × TDot d f β γ))
    (ss : List (Complex × {s : SDot c e α γ // finiteFibers c e α γ s}))
    (g : G) (x : D) :
    ev (.vertical (first a b d α β rs) (.vertical (second d f α β γ ts)
      (third c e f α γ (ss.map fun (k,s) => (k, projectionDot c e α γ s.1 s.2)))))
      (Finsupp.single (input a b d g x) 1) =
    (rs.map fun (cr,r) =>
      (ts.map fun (ct,t) =>
        (ss.map fun (cs,s) => (cr * ct * cs) •
          column c e f α γ s.1 s.2 (α.toHom g * r.element * β.toHom x * t.element)).sum).sum).sum := by
  let next := ev (second d f α β γ ts)
  let last := ev (third c e f α γ (ss.map fun (k,s) => (k, projectionDot c e α γ s.1 s.2)))
  change last (next (ev (first a b d α β rs) (Finsupp.single (input a b d g x) 1))) = _
  rw [firstColumn, map_list_sum, map_list_sum]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ⟨cr,r⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
  let z := α.toHom g * r.element * β.toHom x
  change cr • last (ev (second d f α β γ ts) (Finsupp.single (middleBasis α β d z) 1)) = _
  rw [secondColumn, map_list_sum, List.map_map]
  rw [show cr • (List.map _ ts).sum = _ from map_list_sum (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ cr) _]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ⟨ct,t⟩ _
  change cr • last (ct • Finsupp.single (middleBasis α γ f (z * t.element)) 1) = _
  rw [map_smul, smul_smul]
  change (cr * ct) • ev (third c e f α γ _) (Finsupp.single (middleBasis α γ f (z * t.element)) 1) = _
  rw [thirdColumn]
  rw [show (cr * ct) • (List.map _ ss).sum = _ from map_list_sum (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ (cr * ct)) _]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro ⟨cs,s⟩ _
  exact smul_smul (cr * ct) cs _

end CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluationAux

MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G α β hα hβ eα eβ A B J σ hσ j s orbit a b Lj left right dot
    L hL hIndex leftL rightL leftJ rightJ dL dJ M ML MJ qBasis qBasisJ q fiber n
  -- Xiao, §5.1, “Smaller internal groups and intersections,” following
  -- Proposition 5.1. There is no matching numbered Alphabeta Math proof in
  -- the reviewed plan. As in steps 1–3 of the registered MixedCrossingComposites
  -- proof, use the balanced push and its finite-fiber transfer. Here both
  -- subgroup choices use the fixed representative s. The registered
  -- MixedCrossingFiberMaps theorem supplies the stabilizer calculation
  -- directly, so neither representative transport nor a coset tower is needed.
  have haComp : α * a = 1 := mul_inv_cancel α
  have hbComp : β * b = (s : U)⁻¹ := mul_inv_cancel_left β _
  have hsVal : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ = (s : U) := by
    rw [haComp, hbComp, inv_inv, one_mul]
  have hsG : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G := hsVal ▸ s.property
  have fiberData (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) (hIndexS : S.IsFiniteRelIndex Lj) :
      let l := left S hS
      let r := right S hS
      let d := dot S hS
      let f := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ l r d
      let qS := fun w => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (f w)
      Set.range qS = orbit ∧
      (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
        qS (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction l)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction r) k h) = eα.toHom k * s * eβ.toHom h) ∧
      (∀ w, (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) eα eβ l r d).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (qS w)) 1) ∧
      (∀ g ∈ orbit, Nat.card {w | qS w = g} = S.relIndex Lj) ∧
      (∀ z, Set.Finite {w | f w = z}) := by
    intro l r d f qS
    have ha (ℓ : S) : a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K := (l.toHom ℓ).property
    have hb (ℓ : S) : b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H := (r.toHom ℓ).property
    let d' : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (eα.comp l) (eβ.comp r) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hsG
    have hs' : d'.element = s := Subtype.ext hsVal
    have hd : d' = d := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ext hs'
    have hc : DoubleCoset.mk A B d'.element = j := hs' ▸ hσ j
    have hImage : Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj (α * a)).toMonoidHom S = S := by
      rw [haComp]
      ext x
      simp [Subgroup.mem_map]
    let Ls := Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj α).toMonoidHom K ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj ((d'.element : U) * β)).toMonoidHom H
    have hLs : Ls = Lj := by
      dsimp only [Ls]
      rw [hs']
    let orbit' := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ (DoubleCoset.mk A B d'.element)) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    have hOrbit : orbit' = orbit := by
      dsimp only [orbit']
      rw [hc]
    let f' := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ l r d'
    let q' := fun w => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (f' w)
    have hf' : f' = f := congrArg
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ l r) hd
    have hq' : q' = qS := congrArg
      (fun m w => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (m w)) hf'
    obtain ⟨_, hPair, hPush, hRange, hCard, hFinite, _⟩ :=
      MixedCrossingFiberMaps K H G S α β a b hα hβ ha hb hsG σ hσ
    change Set.range q' = orbit' at hRange
    change ∀ g ∈ orbit', (Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj (α * a)).toMonoidHom S).IsFiniteRelIndex Ls →
      Nat.card {w | q' w = g} = (Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj (α * a)).toMonoidHom S).relIndex Ls at hCard
    change (∀ z, Set.Finite {w | f' w = z}) ↔
      (Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj (α * a)).toMonoidHom S).IsFiniteRelIndex Ls at hFinite
    change ∀ k h, q' ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction l).pair
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction r) k h) = eα.toHom k * d'.element * eβ.toHom h at hPair
    change ∀ w, (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) eα eβ l r d').eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single w 1) = Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q' w)) 1 at hPush
    rw [hq', hOrbit] at hRange
    rw [hOrbit, hImage, hLs, hq'] at hCard
    rw [hImage, hLs, hf'] at hFinite
    rw [hq', hs'] at hPair
    rw [hq', hd] at hPush
    exact ⟨hRange, hPair, hPush, fun g hg => hCard g hg hIndexS, hFinite.mpr hIndexS⟩
  have hJIndex : Lj.IsFiniteRelIndex Lj :=
    Subgroup.isFiniteRelIndex_iff_relIndex_ne_zero.mpr (by rw [Subgroup.relIndex_self]; decide)
  obtain ⟨hRangeL, hPairL, hPushL, hCardL, hLFinite⟩ := fiberData L hL hIndex
  obtain ⟨hRangeJ, _, _, hCardJ, hJFinite⟩ := fiberData Lj (le_refl Lj) hJIndex
  refine ⟨hLFinite, hJFinite, ?_⟩
  intro hf fiberSum iotaL pL iotaJ pJ outerL outerJ innerL straight
  let outer := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ
  -- Step 4 of MixedCrossingComposites checks the two orders on basis columns.
  -- The endpoint already uses ordinary typed crossings, i.e. the
  -- coefficient-one singleton terms, so the labelled-drawing adapters of
  -- that proof are unnecessary. Use the two checked column identities.
  have outerCard {X : Type u} (f : X → M.basis.carrier)
      (finite : ∀ y, Set.Finite {w | f w = y}) (m : Nat)
      (hRange : Set.range (fun w => outer (f w)) = orbit)
      (hCard : ∀ g ∈ orbit, Nat.card {w | outer (f w) = g} = m)
      (y : M.basis.carrier) :
      (finite y).toFinset.card = if outer y ∈ orbit then m else 0 := by
    by_cases hy : outer y ∈ orbit
    · have hSet : {w | f w = y} = {w | outer (f w) = outer y} :=
        Set.ext fun w => outer.injective.eq_iff.symm
      rw [ite_eq_left hy, MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroupAux.fiberCard, hSet]
      exact hCard (outer y) hy
    · rw [ite_eq_right hy]
      apply Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro w hw
      have heq : f w = y := (finite y).mem_toFinset.mp hw
      exact hy (hRange ▸ ⟨w, congrArg outer heq⟩)
  have hOuter : outerL.eval = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (n : Complex) outerJ).eval := by
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro y
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    change outerL.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =
      (n : Complex) • outerJ.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1)
    rw [show outerL.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =
        Finsupp.single y ((hLFinite y).toFinset.card : Complex) from
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.projection_then_inclusion_single Complex eα eβ leftL rightL dL hLFinite y,
      show outerJ.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =
        Finsupp.single y ((hJFinite y).toFinset.card : Complex) from
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.projection_then_inclusion_single Complex eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ hJFinite y,
      outerCard qBasis hLFinite n hRangeL hCardL,
      outerCard qBasisJ hJFinite (Lj.relIndex Lj) hRangeJ hCardJ,
      Subgroup.relIndex_self]
    by_cases hy : outer y ∈ orbit <;> simp [hy, Finsupp.smul_single]
  have hFinset (g : G) :
      (hLFinite (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)).toFinset = (hf g).toFinset := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro w
    rw [(hLFinite _).mem_toFinset, (hf g).mem_toFinset]
    change qBasis w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g ↔ q w = g
    calc
      _ ↔ q w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ
          (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) := outer.injective.eq_iff.symm
      _ ↔ q w = g := by rw [MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
  have hProject (g : G) :
      pL.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) =
        fiberSum g := by
    change (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.transfer Complex qBasis
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant eα eβ leftL rightL dL) hLFinite).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) =
        Finset.sum (hf g).toFinset (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum, hFinset]
  have hInner (z : ML.basis.carrier) :
      innerL.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) = fiberSum (q z) := by
    have hF := hFinset (q z)
    rw [show MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q z) = qBasis z from
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis z)] at hF
    change _ = Finset.sum (hf (q z)).toFinset (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)
    rw [← hF]
    exact MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.inclusion_then_projection_single Complex eα eβ leftL rightL dL hLFinite z
  refine ⟨hOuter, hRangeL, hPairL, hPushL, fun g hg => ⟨hCardL g hg, hProject g⟩, hInner, ?_⟩
  -- Step 5 of MixedCrossingComposites detects the identity from the support
  -- of a column. Every fiber over q z contains z and has cardinal n.
  have hSelf (z : ML.basis.carrier) : z ∈ (hf (q z)).toFinset :=
    (hf (q z)).mem_toFinset.mpr rfl
  have hSize (z : ML.basis.carrier) : (hf (q z)).toFinset.card = n := by
    rw [MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroupAux.fiberCard]
    exact hCardL (q z) (hRangeL ▸ ⟨z, rfl⟩)
  constructor
  · intro hIdentity
    let z : ML.basis.carrier :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction leftL)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction rightL) 1 1
    have hz := hInner z
    rw [hIdentity] at hz
    change Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex) =
      Finset.sum (hf (q z)).toFinset (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1) at hz
    have hOnly (w : ML.basis.carrier) (hw : w ∈ (hf (q z)).toFinset) : w = z := by
      by_contra hne
      have hCoeff := congrArg (fun v : ML.basis.carrier →₀ Complex => v w) hz
      rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne, MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroupAux.sumSingleApply,
        ite_eq_left hw] at hCoeff
      exact zero_ne_one hCoeff
    have hSingleton : (hf (q z)).toFinset = {z} := by
      apply Finset.ext
      intro w
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
      exact ⟨hOnly w, fun hw => hw.symm ▸ hSelf z⟩
    have hn : n = 1 := by rw [← hSize z, hSingleton, Finset.card_singleton]
    exact le_antisymm hL (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mp hn)
  · intro hEq
    have hn : n = 1 := by
      change L.relIndex Lj = 1
      rw [hEq, Subgroup.relIndex_self]
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro z
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    change innerL.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) = Finsupp.single z 1
    rw [hInner]
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp ((hSize z).trans hn)
    have hz := hSelf z
    rw [hw, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
    change Finset.sum (hf (q z)).toFinset (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex)) = _
    rw [hw, Finset.sum_singleton, hz]
MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup.support:
namespace MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroupAux

private theorem fiberCard {X Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) (y : Y)
    (hf : Set.Finite {x | f x = y}) :
    (hf.toFinset).card = Nat.card {x | f x = y} := by
  let := hf.fintype
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hf.card_toFinset]

private theorem sumSingleApply {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X] (S : Finset X) (w : X) :
    (S.sum (fun x => Finsupp.single x (1 : Complex))) w =
      if w ∈ S then 1 else 0 := by
  change (Finsupp.lapply w : (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] Complex) _ = _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']

end MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroupAux

external.usage: Used through the registered MixedCrossingFiberMaps theorem at both L and Lj. The supplier identifies the balanced fiber with the stabilizer coset quotient and uses Subgroup.index_eq_card to compute its cardinality. The specialization identifies the stabilizer with Lj and the diagonal image with the chosen subgroup. The finite-relative-index hypotheses are checked for both applications.
A singleton column forces L.relIndex Lj = 1. This supplies Lj ≤ L, which combines with the given L ≤ Lj to identify the two subgroups.
The self-index of Lj is one and therefore nonzero. This supplies the finite-relative-index hypothesis for the full-subgroup instance of MixedCrossingFiberMaps.

MackeySummandProjection.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U _ K H G α β Kα Hβ hK hH A B J σ hσ L C I hRep hTrans j
    a b s l r d kg gh kl lh middle M Mj surviving
  /- Ian Xiao, § 2.2, Theorem 2.2. The archived PDF shows the two
     composites on p. 6 and (2.5) on p. 7. The revised published PDF
     places these on pp. 8 and 9. The web article has diagram-05 and the
     same numbered equations in the prose of the proof.
     https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#eq:first-chain -/
  -- Theorem 2.2 uses the double-coset representative (2.1), the full
  -- intersection (2.2), and the right transversal (2.4). Supply all
  -- three to the registered crossing theorem, with the same σ and hRep.
  obtain ⟨hf, hs, _, hι, hp, _, hstack, _⟩ :=
    MackeyInclusionAndProjectionCrossings K H G α β hK hH σ hσ I hRep hTrans j
  refine ⟨hf, hs, ?_⟩
  intro projectionLabel inclusionLabel p ι expandedProjection expandedInclusion
    composite expandedComposite compositeEval
  refine ⟨hstack, ?_⟩
  intro g z image
  let traceArg (i : I j) : U :=
    α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α
  let indices := (hs g).toFinset
  let k (i : {i // i ∈ indices}) : K :=
    ⟨traceArg i.val, (hs g).mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩
  let inc := ι.interpret.eval.toLinearMap
  have hproj :
      p.interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1) =
        ∑ i ∈ indices.attach, Finsupp.single (kl.basis.pair lh.basis (k i) (hRep j i.val)) 1 :=
    (hp g).2
  have ha (x : K) : (a.toHom x : U) = α * (x : U) * α⁻¹ := rfl
  have hb (x : H) : (b.toHom x : U) = β * (x : U) * β⁻¹ := rfl
  -- In (2.5), the inclusion cancels the inverse dot and the inverse
  -- transversal factor in each surviving term. Work in G after using
  -- the trace equation to identify the element of K.
  have hproduct (i : {i // i ∈ indices}) :
      a.toHom (k i) * s * b.toHom (hRep j i.val) = g := by
    have htrace := (MackeyCrossingProof.trace_eq_iff a b l r d α β ha hb
      g (hRep j i.val) (k i)).mpr rfl
    change a.toHom (k i) = g * (b.toHom (hRep j i.val)⁻¹ * s⁻¹) at htrace
    rw [htrace, map_inv]
    group
  have hterm (i : {i // i ∈ indices}) :
      inc (Finsupp.single (kl.basis.pair lh.basis (k i) (hRep j i.val)) 1) =
        Finsupp.single z 1 := by
    change ι.interpret.eval.toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [hι, hproduct]
  -- Finite-fiber transfer supplies the finite sum at each input.
  -- This is the scoped projection of the paper, so no standalone
  -- reverse cup or finite subgroup-index hypothesis is used.
  have himage : image = Finsupp.single z (indices.card : Complex) := by
    change inc (p.interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1)) = _
    rw [hproj, map_sum]
    simp only [hterm, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_attach,
      ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul Complex, Finsupp.smul_single_one]
  have hsurv :
      (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → ∃! i : I j, i ∈ surviving g) ∧
        (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → surviving g = ∅) :=
    SurvivingCosetRepresentative K H G α β hK hH σ hσ I hRep hTrans j g
  -- Lemma 2.3 gives exactly one term on the class j and zero outside it.
  refine ⟨himage, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hclass
    obtain ⟨i, hi, huniq⟩ := hsurv.1 hclass
    have hcard : indices.card = 1 :=
      Finset.card_eq_one_iff_existsUnique.mpr
        ⟨i, (hs g).mem_toFinset.mpr hi, fun t ht => huniq t ((hs g).mem_toFinset.mp ht)⟩
    simpa only [hcard, Nat.cast_one] using himage
  · intro hclass
    have hempty : indices = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro i hi
      have hm : i ∈ surviving g := (hs g).mem_toFinset.mp hi
      rw [hsurv.2 hclass] at hm
      exact hm
    simpa only [hempty, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.single_zero] using himage

BlockwiseGroupElementDotCriterion.proof:
by
  classical
  intro ι κ X Y _ _ hX hY U blockSym H G α β hα hβ a b inBlock
  -- Xiao §3.4, “A criterion for group-element dots,” agrees in the archived
  -- source/mackey-bimodules.tex (line 1057) and the revised
  -- article-revision/mackey-bimodules.tex (line 1225). The archive and published
  -- PDFs have different SHA-256 digests. The reviewed Lean type is used as given.
  -- The plan supplies no numbered Alphabeta Math proof for this endpoint.
  -- The finite conjugate-block and extremal-parabolic theorems require finite
  -- input data. Here the block sets and the index types can be infinite.
  have aBlock := bwEmbedsBlock X Y hY α hα
  have bBlock := bwEmbedsBlock X Y hY β hβ
  refine ⟨fun i hi => ⟨aBlock i hi, bBlock i hi⟩, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · -- Necessity: test a genuine transposition in any nontrivial source block.
    rintro ⟨t⟩ i hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := aBlock i hi
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := bBlock i hi
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := hi
    let s : H := ⟨bwSwap x y, Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem i (bwSwapInBlock hx hy)⟩
    let d : ↥U := t.element.1
    have he := congrArg (fun g : G => g.1.1 (β.1 x)) (t.intertwines s)
    change (α * bwSwap x y * α⁻¹).1 (d.1 (β.1 x)) =
      d.1 ((β * bwSwap x y * β⁻¹).1 (β.1 x)) at he
    rw [bwConjSwap, bwConjSwap, Equiv.swap_apply_left] at he
    have moved : Equiv.swap (α.1 x) (α.1 y) (d.1 (β.1 x)) ≠ d.1 (β.1 x) :=
      fun h => hxy (β.1.injective (d.1.injective (h.symm.trans he)))
    have hin : d.1 (β.1 x) ∈ Y j := by
      by_cases h : d.1 (β.1 x) = α.1 x
      · exact h.symm ▸ hj hx
      · by_cases h' : d.1 (β.1 x) = α.1 y
        · exact h'.symm ▸ hj hy
        · exact (moved (Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h h')).elim
    have hkj : k = j := by
      by_contra hne
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hY hne) (bwPreserve Y hY k t.element.2 (hk hx)) hin
    exact ⟨j, hj, hkj ▸ hk⟩

private abbrev bwFinitary : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}

private abbrev bwBlock (B : Set Nat) : Subgroup ↥bwFinitary :=
  fixingSubgroup (↥bwFinitary) Bᶜ

private abbrev bwGroup {ι : Type*} (B : ι → Set Nat) : Subgroup ↥bwFinitary :=
  ⨆ i, bwBlock (B i)

private theorem bwFixOutside {B : Set Nat} {p : ↥bwFinitary}
    (hp : p ∈ bwBlock B) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ B) : p.1 x = x :=
  (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mp hp x hx

private theorem bwFactorMaps {B : Set Nat} {p : ↥bwFinitary}
    (hp : p ∈ bwBlock B) : Set.MapsTo p.1 B B := by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hy
  have he : p.1 x = x := p.1.injective (bwFixOutside hp hy)
  exact hy (he.symm ▸ hx)

private theorem bwPreserve {ι : Type*} (B : ι → Set Nat)
    (hB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j))) (j : ι)
    {p : ↥bwFinitary} (hp : p ∈ bwGroup B) :
    Set.MapsTo p.1 (B j) (B j) := by
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun i => bwBlock (B i))
    (C := fun q => Set.MapsTo q.1 (B j) (B j)) hp ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i q hq
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      exact bwFactorMaps hq
    · intro x hx
      have hxi : x ∉ B i := fun hi => Set.disjoint_left.1 (hB hij) hi hx
      exact bwFixOutside hq hxi |>.symm ▸ hx
  · exact fun _ hx => hx
  · exact fun _ _ hq hr _ hx => hq (hr hx)

-- This also covers points lying in singleton factors.
private theorem bwFix {ι : Type*} (B : ι → Set Nat) {x : Nat}
    (hx : ∀ i, x ∈ B i → ∀ y ∈ B i, y = x)
    {p : ↥bwFinitary} (hp : p ∈ bwGroup B) : p.1 x = x := by
  classical
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun i => bwBlock (B i))
    (C := fun q => q.1 x = x) hp ?_ rfl ?_
  · intro i q hq
    by_cases hi : x ∈ B i
    · exact hx i hi _ (bwFactorMaps hq hi)
    · exact bwFixOutside hq hi
  · intro q r hq hr
    change q.1 (r.1 x) = x
    rw [hr, hq]

private theorem bwMovedInBlock {ι : Type*} (B : ι → Set Nat)
    (hB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j)))
    {p : ↥bwFinitary} (hp : p ∈ bwGroup B) {x : Nat} (hx : p.1 x ≠ x) :
    ∃ j, x ∈ B j ∧ p.1 x ∈ B j := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ j, x ∈ B j := by
    by_contra h
    exact hx (bwFix B (fun j hj => (h ⟨j, hj⟩).elim) hp)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨j, hj, bwPreserve B hB j hp hj⟩

private def bwSwap (x y : Nat) : ↥bwFinitary :=
  ⟨Equiv.swap x y, by
    by_cases h : x = y
    · subst y
      rw [Equiv.swap_self]
      exact bwFinitary.one_mem
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨x, y, h, rfl⟩⟩

private theorem bwSwapInBlock {B : Set Nat} {x y : Nat}
    (hx : x ∈ B) (hy : y ∈ B) : bwSwap x y ∈ bwBlock B := by
  apply (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mpr
  intro z hz
  exact Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (fun h => hz (h.symm ▸ hx))
    (fun h => hz (h.symm ▸ hy))

private theorem bwConjApply (p q : ↥bwFinitary) (x : Nat) :
    (p * q * p⁻¹).1 (p.1 x) = p.1 (q.1 x) := by
  change (p.1 * q.1 * p.1⁻¹) (p.1 x) = _
  simp [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]

private theorem bwEmbedsBlock {ι κ : Type*} (X : ι → Set Nat) (Y : κ → Set Nat)
    (hY : Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (Y j) (Y k)))
    (p : ↥bwFinitary) (hp : ∀ h : bwGroup X, p * h.1 * p⁻¹ ∈ bwGroup Y)
    (i : ι) (hi : Set.Nontrivial (X i)) :
    ∃ j, Set.MapsTo p.1 (X i) (Y j) := by
  classical
  have pair {x y : Nat} (hx : x ∈ X i) (hy : y ∈ X i) (hne : x ≠ y) :
      ∃ j, p.1 x ∈ Y j ∧ p.1 y ∈ Y j := by
    let s := bwSwap x y
    have hmem : s ∈ bwGroup X := Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem i (bwSwapInBlock hx hy)
    have heq : (p * s * p⁻¹).1 (p.1 x) = p.1 y := by
      rw [bwConjApply]
      exact congrArg p.1 (Equiv.swap_apply_left x y)
    obtain ⟨j, hjx, hjy⟩ := bwMovedInBlock Y hY (hp ⟨s, hmem⟩)
      (fun he => hne (p.1.injective (he.symm.trans heq)))
    exact ⟨j, hjx, heq ▸ hjy⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj, _⟩ := pair hx hy hxy
  refine ⟨j, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  by_cases h : x = z
  · exact h ▸ hj
  · obtain ⟨k, hkx, hkz⟩ := pair hx hz h
    have hkj : k = j := by
      by_contra hne
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hY hne) hkx hj
    exact hkj ▸ hkz

private theorem bwConjSwap (p : ↥bwFinitary) (x y : Nat) :
    (p * bwSwap x y * p⁻¹).1 = Equiv.swap (p.1 x) (p.1 y) :=
  (Equiv.swap_apply_apply p.1 x y).symm

private theorem bwFiniteMoves (p : ↥bwFinitary) :
    {x : Nat | p.1 x ≠ x}.Finite :=
  mem_closure_isSwap'.mp p.2

-- Restrict the partial bijection to a finite slice before extending it.
private theorem bwExtendSlice (τ : ↥bwFinitary) (B D : Set Nat)
    (hB : Set.MapsTo τ.1 (D ∩ B) B) :
    ∃ q : ↥bwFinitary, q ∈ bwBlock B ∧ ∀ x ∈ D ∩ B, q.1 x = τ.1 x := by
  classical
  let S : Set Nat := {x : Nat | τ.1 x ≠ x} ∩ B
  let : Finite S := ((bwFiniteMoves τ).inter_of_left B).to_subtype
  let P : Set S := {x | x.1 ∈ D}
  let f : P → S := fun x =>
    ⟨τ.1 x.1.1, Equiv.Perm.set_support_apply_mem.mpr x.1.2.1, hB ⟨x.2, x.1.2.2⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact τ.1.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  let e := Equiv.ofInjective f hf
  let q : Equiv.Perm Nat := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x => x ∈ S) e.extendSubtype
  have hfix {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ S) : q x = x :=
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ hx
  have hq : q ∈ bwFinitary := by
    apply mem_closure_isSwap'.mpr
    apply ((bwFiniteMoves τ).inter_of_left B).subset
    intro x hx
    change q x ≠ x at hx
    by_contra h
    exact hx (hfix h)
  refine ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mpr (fun x hx => hfix (fun h => hx h.2)), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  change q x = τ.1 x
  by_cases h : x ∈ S
  · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem e.extendSubtype h,
      Equiv.extendSubtype_apply_of_mem e ⟨x, h⟩ hx.1]
    rfl
  · rw [hfix h]
    by_contra hne
    exact h ⟨(fun he => hne he.symm), hx.2⟩

private theorem bwAssemble {κ : Type*} [DecidableEq κ] (Y : κ → Set Nat)
    (hY : Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (Y j) (Y k))) (J : Finset κ)
    (q : κ → ↥bwFinitary) (hq : ∀ j, q j ∈ bwBlock (Y j)) :
    ∃ p : ↥bwFinitary, p ∈ bwGroup Y ∧
      ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Y j, p.1 x = if j ∈ J then (q j).1 x else x := by
  classical
  induction J using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨1, (bwGroup Y).one_mem, ?_⟩
    intro j x _
    simp only [Finset.notMem_empty, ite_false]
    rfl
  | insert j J hj ih =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp, happ⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨p * q j, (bwGroup Y).mul_mem hp (Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem j (hq j)), ?_⟩
    intro k x hx
    change p.1 ((q j).1 x) = _
    by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      rw [happ j _ (bwFactorMaps (hq j) hx), ite_eq_right hj, ite_eq_left (Finset.mem_insert_self j J)]
    · rw [bwFixOutside (hq j) (fun h => Set.disjoint_left.1 (hY hkj) hx h),
        happ k x hx]
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, hkj, false_or]

private theorem bwExtendOnBlocks {κ : Type*} (Y : κ → Set Nat)
    (hY : Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (Y j) (Y k))) (τ : ↥bwFinitary) (D : Set Nat)
    (hmaps : ∀ j, Set.MapsTo τ.1 (D ∩ Y j) (Y j))
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ D, ∃ j, x ∈ Y j) :
    ∃ p : ↥bwFinitary, p ∈ bwGroup Y ∧ ∀ x ∈ D, p.1 x = τ.1 x := by
  classical
  choose q hq happ using fun j => bwExtendSlice τ (Y j) D (hmaps j)
  let J : Set κ := ⋃ (x : Nat) (_ : x ∈ {x : Nat | τ.1 x ≠ x}), {j | x ∈ Y j}
  have hJ : J.Finite := (bwFiniteMoves τ).biUnion fun x _ => Set.Subsingleton.finite (by
    intro j hj k hk
    by_contra h
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hY h) hj hk)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpapp⟩ := bwAssemble Y hY hJ.toFinset q hq
  refine ⟨p, hp, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcover x hx
  rw [hpapp j x hj]
  by_cases h : j ∈ hJ.toFinset
  · rw [ite_eq_left h]
    exact happ j x ⟨hx, hj⟩
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    by_contra hne
    apply h
    exact hJ.mem_toFinset.mpr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨x, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨(fun he => hne he.symm), hj⟩⟩)

(SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2)
and revised published p. 26
(SHA-256 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e).
The numbered Cases determine the two directions. The plan provides no
matching numbered Alphabeta Math proof for this endpoint.

The merge–dot–split calculation uses `Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single`,
`Diagram.eval_upDot_single`, `Diagram.eval_splitUp_single` and
`Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp` for arbitrary chosen embeddings. The registered
`InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits` packages the merge, split and inverse
laws at embeddings presented by explicit conjugators. The shared lemmas
take the boundary embeddings of this theorem directly.

The weighted mixed column uses the multiplication conjunct of
`MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention` for the exact `DotLabel`; mixed
projection and the finite-index cup play no role in Cases 3 and 4.
The parallel column expands with `ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply`.
Horizontal frames use `Biset.Hom.horizontal_single` and
`Biset.pairLinear_single`, with the reassociation columns
`Diagram.eval_associate_single` and `Diagram.eval_unassociate_single`.
`Generator.mixedEquiv` identifies the resolved target pair with its group
coordinate, and `Biset.associate_unassociate` supplies the structural
inverse at the target. Expanding the three finite supports keeps each
marked vertex in the original drawing and allows repeated products to
combine or cancel in the group algebra.
