namespace TwoMultiplicationsAux
open MackeyDiagrams

universe u
variable {U : Type u} [Group U]
variable {G A D F C E B K H J I L : Subgroup U}

private abbrev model {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) := p.basis.carrier →₀ Complex

private noncomputable abbrev run {p q : Word K H} (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
    model p →ₗ[Complex] model q :=
  drawing.interpret.eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev plain {p q : Word K H} := @LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _ K H p q

private abbrev ident (p : Word K H) := plain (Diagram.id p)

private abbrev stack {p q s : Word K H} := @LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _ K H p q s

private abbrev juxtapose {p p' : Word K H} {q q' : Word H J} :=
  @LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _ K H J p p' q q'

private abbrev pair (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) := p.basis.pair q.basis

private noncomputable def onLastTwo (p : Word K H) {q : Word H J} {s : Word J L}
    {q' : Word H I} {s' : Word I L}
    (crossing : LabelledDrawing Complex (q.tensor s) (q'.tensor s')) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex ((p.tensor q).tensor s) ((p.tensor q').tensor s') :=
  stack (plain (Diagram.associate p q s))
    (stack (juxtapose (ident p) crossing)
      (plain (Diagram.unassociate p q' s')))

private noncomputable abbrev col {K H : Subgroup U} {p : Word K H} (x : p.basis.carrier) :
    model p := Finsupp.single x 1

private theorem run_stack {p q s : Word K H} (f : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (g : LabelledDrawing Complex q s) (x : model p) :
    run (stack f g) x = run g (run f x) := rfl

private theorem firstColumn {p p' : Word K H} {q : Word H J}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p p') (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier)
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → Complex) (z : ι → p'.basis.carrier)
    (hd : run d (col (p := p) x) = ∑ i ∈ s, w i • col (p := p') (z i)) :
    run (juxtapose d (ident q)) (col (p := p.tensor q) (pair p q x y)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, w i • col (p := p'.tensor q) (pair p' q (z i) y) := by
  change (d.interpret.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id q).eval).toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, hd]
  let P := (Biset.pairLinear Complex p'.basis q.basis).flip (col (p := q) y)
  change P (∑ i ∈ s, w i • col (p := p') (z i)) = _
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change w i • Biset.pairLinear Complex p'.basis q.basis (Finsupp.single (z i) 1)
    (Finsupp.single y 1) = _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

private theorem lastColumn {p : Word K H} {q : Word H J} {t : Word J L}
    {q' : Word H I} {t' : Word I L}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (q.tensor t) (q'.tensor t'))
    (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier) (z : t.basis.carrier)
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → Complex)
    (y' : ι → q'.basis.carrier) (z' : ι → t'.basis.carrier)
    (hd : run d (col (p := q.tensor t) (pair q t y z)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, w i • col (p := q'.tensor t') (pair q' t' (y' i) (z' i))) :
    run (onLastTwo p d) (col (p := (p.tensor q).tensor t)
      (pair (p.tensor q) t (pair p q x y) z)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, w i • col (p := (p.tensor q').tensor t')
        (pair (p.tensor q') t' (pair p q' x (y' i)) (z' i)) := by
  change (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) p q' t').eval.toLinearMap
    (((Diagram.id p).eval.horizontal d.interpret.eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.associate (R := Complex) p q t).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (pair (p.tensor q) t (pair p q x y) z) 1))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, hd, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_smul, map_smul]
  change w i • (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) p q' t').eval.toLinearMap
    (Biset.pairLinear Complex p.basis (q'.tensor t').basis
      (Finsupp.single x 1) (Finsupp.single (pair q' t' (y' i) (z' i)) 1)) = _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_unassociate_single]

private theorem mixedColumn (a : ConjEmbedding K A) (b : ConjEmbedding H A)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (m : DotLabel Complex (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) (x : K) (y : H) :
    run (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r m.terms)
      (Finsupp.single (pair (.up l) (.down r) x y) 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ m.support, m i • Finsupp.single
        (pair (.down a) (.up b) (a.toHom x * i.element * b.toHom y) 1) 1 := by
  -- The registered convention supplies the weighted multiplication column.
  -- Its per-term finite-fiber condition belongs to the projection conjunct.
  calc
    _ = (m.terms.map fun term => term.1 • Finsupp.single
        (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r term.2 (pair (.up l) (.down r) x y)) 1).sum :=
      ((MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention (U := U)).2.2.1 a b l r m).1
        (pair (.up l) (.down r) x y)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [DotLabel.terms, List.map_map, Finset.sum_map_toList]
      rfl

private theorem parallelColumn (a : ConjEmbedding H A) (b : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding J A) (b' : ConjEmbedding L J)
    (m : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) (x : A) (y : H) :
    run (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b a' b' m.terms)
      (Finsupp.single (pair (.up a) (.up b) x y) 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ m.support, m i • Finsupp.single
        (pair (.up a') (.up b') (x * a.toHom y * i.element) 1) 1 := by
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination
    (m.terms.map fun (c,i) => (c, ScopedDiagram.ordinary
      (Diagram.parallelUp (R := Complex) a b a' b' i)))).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, DotLabel.terms, List.map_map, List.map_map,
    Finset.sum_map_toList]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change m i • (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a' b').eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.upDot i).eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeUp a b).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (pair (.up a) (.up b) x y) 1))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single]

variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev bottom := ((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f)
private abbrev top := ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c)
private abbrev bottom' := (Word.up (d.comp e)).tensor (.down f)
private abbrev top' := (Word.down a).tensor (.up (b.comp c))

private noncomputable def split :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom' d e f) (bottom d e f) :=
  juxtapose (.trivalent (.splitUp d e)) (ident (.down f))

private noncomputable def merge :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (top a b c) (top' a b c) :=
  stack (plain (Diagram.associate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)))
    (juxtapose (ident (.down a)) (.trivalent (.mergeUp b c)))

private theorem splitColumn (g : G) (h : F) :
    run (split d e f) (Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (pair ((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)) (.down f)
        (pair (.up d) (.up e) g 1) h) 1 := by
  change (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.splitUp d e) (Diagram.id (.down f))).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

private theorem mergeColumn (p q : A) (r : D) :
    run (merge a b c) (Finsupp.single (pair ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)) (.up c)
      (pair (.down a) (.up b) p q) r) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c) (p * (q * b.toHom r))) 1 := by
  change (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (.down a)) (Diagram.mergeUp b c)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.associate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (pair ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)) (.up c)
        (pair (.down a) (.up b) p q) r) 1)) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  congr 1
  apply (Generator.mixedEquiv a (b.comp c)).injective
  change p * (q * b.toHom r) = (p * (q * b.toHom r)) * 1
  rw [mul_one]

private noncomputable def left (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D)
    (t : ConjEmbedding E B) (x : DotLabel Complex (d.comp e) (r.comp t))
    (y : DotLabel Complex (s.comp t) (c.comp f))
    (z : DotLabel Complex (a.comp r) (b.comp s)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom d e f) (top a b c) :=
  stack (juxtapose (.parallelUp d e r t x.terms) (ident (.down f)))
    (stack (onLastTwo (.up r) (.mixedMultiplication s c t f y.terms))
      (juxtapose (.mixedMultiplication a b r s z.terms) (ident (.up c))))

private noncomputable def right (u' : ConjEmbedding B A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B)
    (w : ConjEmbedding F B) (x : DotLabel Complex (v.comp e) (w.comp f))
    (y : DotLabel Complex (a.comp d) (u'.comp v))
    (z : DotLabel Complex (u'.comp w) (b.comp c)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom d e f) (top a b c) :=
  stack (onLastTwo (.up d) (.mixedMultiplication v w e f x.terms))
    (stack (juxtapose (.mixedMultiplication a u' d v y.terms) (ident (.up w)))
      (onLastTwo (.down a) (.parallelUp u' w b c z.terms)))

private noncomputable abbrev combined (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom d e f) (top a b c)) :=
  stack (split d e f) (stack drawing (merge a b c))


private abbrev eligible (a b : ConjEmbedding E A) (p : A) :=
  ∀ v : E, a.toHom v * p = p * b.toHom v

private def admissible (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) :=
  ∀ p ∈ M.coeff.support, eligible (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f) p

private noncomputable def as
    (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom d e f) (top a b c))
    (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) :=
  ∀ (g : G) (h : F),
    run (combined a b c d e f drawing)
      (Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h) 1) =
    Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c))
      (MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom g) 1 * M *
        MonoidAlgebra.single ((b.comp c).toHom h) 1).coeff

private noncomputable def productLabel {α β γ : Type*}
    (X : α →₀ Complex) (Y : β →₀ Complex) (Z : γ →₀ Complex)
    (p : α → β → γ → A) : MonoidAlgebra Complex A :=
  ∑ i ∈ X.support, ∑ j ∈ Y.support, ∑ k ∈ Z.support,
    MonoidAlgebra.single (p i j k) (X i * (Y j * Z k))

private theorem productAdmissible {α β γ : Type*}
    (X : α →₀ Complex) (Y : β →₀ Complex) (Z : γ →₀ Complex) (p : α → β → γ → A)
    (hp : ∀ i j k, eligible (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f) (p i j k)) :
    admissible a b c d e f (productLabel X Y Z p) := by
  classical
  intro x hx
  by_contra hn
  apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hx
  simp only [productLabel, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro k _
  exact Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (fun he => hn (he ▸ hp i j k))

private theorem productColumn {α β γ : Type*}
    (X : α →₀ Complex) (Y : β →₀ Complex) (Z : γ →₀ Complex) (p : α → β → γ → A)
    (g : G) (h : F) :
    Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c))
      (MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom g) 1 * productLabel X Y Z p *
        MonoidAlgebra.single ((b.comp c).toHom h) 1).coeff =
      ∑ i ∈ X.support, ∑ j ∈ Y.support, ∑ k ∈ Z.support, (X i * (Y j * Z k)) •
        Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)
          (a.toHom g * p i j k * (b.comp c).toHom h)) 1 := by
  simp only [productLabel, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
    MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_single, one_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul]

variable (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
variable (u' : ConjEmbedding B A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B) (w : ConjEmbedding F B)

private def leftTerm (i : Dot (d.comp e) (r.comp t)) (j : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f))
    (k : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s)) : A :=
  a.toHom i.element * k.element * b.toHom j.element

private def rightTerm (i : Dot (v.comp e) (w.comp f)) (j : Dot (a.comp d) (u'.comp v))
    (k : Dot (u'.comp w) (b.comp c)) : A :=
  j.element * u'.toHom i.element * k.element

private theorem leftEligible (i : Dot (d.comp e) (r.comp t)) (j : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f))
    (k : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s)) :
    eligible (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f) (leftTerm a b c d e f r s t i j k) := by
  intro x
  have hi := congrArg a.toHom (i.intertwines x)
  have hj := congrArg b.toHom (j.intertwines x)
  have hk := k.intertwines (t.toHom x)
  simp only [map_mul, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] at hi hj hk ⊢
  unfold leftTerm
  calc
    _ = (a.toHom (d.toHom (e.toHom x)) * a.toHom i.element) * k.element *
        b.toHom j.element := by group
    _ = a.toHom i.element * (a.toHom (r.toHom (t.toHom x)) * k.element) *
        b.toHom j.element := by rw [hi]; group
    _ = a.toHom i.element * k.element * (b.toHom (s.toHom (t.toHom x)) *
        b.toHom j.element) := by rw [hk]; group
    _ = _ := by rw [hj]; group

private theorem rightEligible (i : Dot (v.comp e) (w.comp f)) (j : Dot (a.comp d) (u'.comp v))
    (k : Dot (u'.comp w) (b.comp c)) :
    eligible (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f) (rightTerm a b c d e f u' v w i j k) := by
  intro x
  have hi := congrArg u'.toHom (i.intertwines x)
  have hj := j.intertwines (e.toHom x)
  have hk := k.intertwines (f.toHom x)
  simp only [map_mul, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] at hi hj hk ⊢
  unfold rightTerm
  calc
    _ = (a.toHom (d.toHom (e.toHom x)) * j.element) * u'.toHom i.element *
        k.element := by group
    _ = j.element * (u'.toHom (v.toHom (e.toHom x)) * u'.toHom i.element) *
        k.element := by rw [hj]; group
    _ = j.element * u'.toHom i.element * (u'.toHom (w.toHom (f.toHom x)) *
        k.element) := by rw [hi]; group
    _ = _ := by rw [hk]; group

private theorem leftAs
    (X : DotLabel Complex (d.comp e) (r.comp t))
    (Y : DotLabel Complex (s.comp t) (c.comp f))
    (Z : DotLabel Complex (a.comp r) (b.comp s)) :
    as a b c d e f (left a b c d e f r s t X Y Z)
      (productLabel X Y Z (leftTerm a b c d e f r s t)) := by
  -- The left shape is the target of the Case 4 replacement. Its parallel
  -- vertex merges, multiplies by its dot and splits with a unit. The two
  -- mixed vertices then push pairs forward.
  intro g h
  unfold left
  unfold combined
  rw [run_stack, run_stack, run_stack, run_stack, splitColumn, productColumn]
  rw [firstColumn (q := .down f) (.parallelUp d e r t X.terms) (pair (.up d) (.up e) g 1) h X.support X
    (fun i => pair (.up r) (.up t) (g * d.toHom 1 * i.element) 1)
    (parallelColumn d e r t X g 1)]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [lastColumn (p := .up r) (.mixedMultiplication s c t f Y.terms) _ 1 h Y.support Y
    (fun j => s.toHom 1 * j.element * c.toHom h) (fun _ => 1)
    (mixedColumn s c t f Y 1 h)]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [firstColumn (q := .up c) (.mixedMultiplication a b r s Z.terms) _ 1 Z.support Z
    (fun k => pair (.down a) (.up b)
      (a.toHom (g * d.toHom 1 * i.element) * k.element *
        b.toHom (s.toHom 1 * j.element * c.toHom h)) 1)
    (mixedColumn a b r s Z (g * d.toHom 1 * i.element) (s.toHom 1 * j.element * c.toHom h))]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [mergeColumn]
  simp only [map_one, one_mul, mul_one, smul_smul, leftTerm,
    map_mul, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, mul_assoc]

private theorem rightAs
    (X : DotLabel Complex (v.comp e) (w.comp f))
    (Y : DotLabel Complex (a.comp d) (u'.comp v))
    (Z : DotLabel Complex (u'.comp w) (b.comp c)) :
    as a b c d e f (right a b c d e f u' v w X Y Z)
      (productLabel X Y Z (rightTerm a b c d e f u' v w)) := by
  -- The right shape is the target of the Case 3 replacement. Its last dot
  -- commutes past the F-coordinate by its own intertwining equation.
  intro g h
  unfold right
  unfold combined
  rw [run_stack, run_stack, run_stack, run_stack, splitColumn, productColumn]
  rw [lastColumn (p := .up d) (.mixedMultiplication v w e f X.terms) g 1 h X.support X
    (fun i => v.toHom 1 * i.element * w.toHom h) (fun _ => 1)
    (mixedColumn v w e f X 1 h)]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [firstColumn (q := .up w) (.mixedMultiplication a u' d v Y.terms) _ 1 Y.support Y
    (fun j => pair (.down a) (.up u')
      (a.toHom g * j.element * u'.toHom (v.toHom 1 * i.element * w.toHom h)) 1)
    (mixedColumn a u' d v Y g (v.toHom 1 * i.element * w.toHom h))]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [lastColumn (p := .down a) (.parallelUp u' w b c Z.terms) _ 1 1 Z.support Z
    (fun k => 1 * u'.toHom 1 * k.element) (fun _ => 1)
    (parallelColumn u' w b c Z 1 1)]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [mergeColumn]
  have hk := k.intertwines h
  simp only [ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] at hk
  simp only [map_one, one_mul, mul_one, smul_smul, rightTerm, map_mul,
    ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, mul_assoc, hk]


private noncomputable def flatten {a b : ConjEmbedding E A}
    (label : DotLabel Complex a b) : MonoidAlgebra Complex A :=
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element label)

private noncomputable def labelFrom {a b : ConjEmbedding E A} (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) :
    DotLabel Complex a b :=
  (M.coeff.subtypeDomain (eligible a b)).mapDomain (fun p => ⟨p.val, p.property⟩)

private theorem flatten_labelFrom {a b : ConjEmbedding E A} (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A)
    (hM : ∀ p ∈ M.coeff.support, eligible a b p) :
    flatten (labelFrom (a := a) (b := b) M) = M := by
  apply MonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
  change Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element
    ((M.coeff.subtypeDomain (eligible a b)).mapDomain _) = M.coeff
  rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  change (M.coeff.subtypeDomain (eligible a b)).mapDomain Subtype.val = _
  ext p
  by_cases hp : eligible a b p
  · exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective Subtype.val_injective _ ⟨p, hp⟩
  · rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ (by rintro ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, rfl⟩; exact hp hq)]
    exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (fun h => hp (hM p h))).symm

private theorem flatten_sum {a b : ConjEmbedding E A} (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    flatten label = ∑ p ∈ label.support, MonoidAlgebra.single p.element (label p) := by
  apply MonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum]
  change Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element label = _
  rfl

private theorem realizeLeft (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (hM : admissible a b c d e f M) :
    ∃ (X : DotLabel Complex (d.comp e) ((d.comp e).comp (ConjEmbedding.id E)))
      (Y : DotLabel Complex ((c.comp f).comp (ConjEmbedding.id E)) (c.comp f))
      (Z : DotLabel Complex (a.comp (d.comp e)) (b.comp (c.comp f))),
      as a b c d e f (left a b c d e f (d.comp e) (c.comp f) (ConjEmbedding.id E) X Y Z) M := by
  -- Case 4 of Theorem 6.5 uses the original E as the middle group. These
  -- coefficient-one unit labels retain their marked vertices.
  let i : Dot (d.comp e) ((d.comp e).comp (ConjEmbedding.id E)) :=
    ⟨1, fun x => by change _ * 1 = 1 * (d.comp e).toHom x; rw [mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let j : Dot ((c.comp f).comp (ConjEmbedding.id E)) (c.comp f) :=
    ⟨1, fun x => by change (c.comp f).toHom x * 1 = 1 * _; rw [mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let Z : DotLabel Complex (a.comp (d.comp e)) (b.comp (c.comp f)) := labelFrom M
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single i 1, Finsupp.single j 1, Z, ?_⟩
  have hprod : productLabel (Finsupp.single i 1) (Finsupp.single j 1) Z
      (leftTerm a b c d e f (d.comp e) (c.comp f) (ConjEmbedding.id E)) = M := by
    calc
      _ = flatten Z := by
        rw [flatten_sum]
        simp only [productLabel, Finsupp.support_single _ one_ne_zero, Finset.sum_singleton,
          Finsupp.single_eq_same, leftTerm, i, j, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]
      _ = M := flatten_labelFrom M hM
  rw [← hprod]
  exact leftAs a b c d e f (d.comp e) (c.comp f) (ConjEmbedding.id E) _ _ _

private theorem realizeRight (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (hM : admissible a b c d e f M) :
    ∃ (X : DotLabel Complex ((a.comp d).comp e) ((b.comp c).comp f))
      (Y : DotLabel Complex (a.comp d) ((ConjEmbedding.id A).comp (a.comp d)))
      (Z : DotLabel Complex ((ConjEmbedding.id A).comp (b.comp c)) (b.comp c)),
      as a b c d e f (right a b c d e f (ConjEmbedding.id A) (a.comp d) (b.comp c) X Y Z) M := by
  -- Case 3 uses A as the middle group and puts the whole eligible
  -- combination on the first mixed vertex. The two other marks stay present.
  let X : DotLabel Complex ((a.comp d).comp e) ((b.comp c).comp f) := labelFrom M
  let j : Dot (a.comp d) ((ConjEmbedding.id A).comp (a.comp d)) :=
    ⟨1, fun x => by change _ * 1 = 1 * (a.comp d).toHom x; rw [mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let k : Dot ((ConjEmbedding.id A).comp (b.comp c)) (b.comp c) :=
    ⟨1, fun x => by change (b.comp c).toHom x * 1 = 1 * _; rw [mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  refine ⟨X, Finsupp.single j 1, Finsupp.single k 1, ?_⟩
  have hprod : productLabel X (Finsupp.single j 1) (Finsupp.single k 1)
      (rightTerm a b c d e f (ConjEmbedding.id A) (a.comp d) (b.comp c)) = M := by
    calc
      _ = flatten X := by
        rw [flatten_sum]
        simp only [productLabel, Finsupp.support_single _ one_ne_zero, Finset.sum_singleton,
          Finsupp.single_eq_same, rightTerm, j, k, one_mul, mul_one]
        rfl
      _ = M := flatten_labelFrom M hM
  rw [← hprod]
  exact rightAs a b c d e f (ConjEmbedding.id A) (a.comp d) (b.comp c) _ _ _

private theorem splitRightInverse :
    let S := (split d e f).interpret.eval
    let M := (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.mergeUp d e)
      (Diagram.id (.down f))).eval
    M.vertical S = Biset.Hom.id (bottom d e f).basis := by
  dsimp only
  change ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) d e).eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down f)).eval).vertical
    ((Diagram.splitUp d e).eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down f)).eval) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical]
  change (((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) d e).vertical (Diagram.splitUp d e)).eval).horizontal
    (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down f).basis) = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

private theorem mergeLeftInverse :
    let M := (merge a b c).interpret.eval
    let S := ((Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (.down a))
      (Diagram.splitUp b c)).vertical (Diagram.unassociate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c))).eval
    M.vertical S = Biset.Hom.id (top a b c).basis := by
  dsimp only
  change ((Biset.associate (Word.down a).basis (Word.up b).basis (Word.up c).basis Complex).vertical
    ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp b c).eval)).vertical
    (((Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal (Diagram.splitUp b c).eval).vertical
      (Biset.unassociate (Word.down a).basis (Word.up b).basis (Word.up c).basis Complex)) = _
  refine Biset.Hom.cancel_middle _ _ _ _ ?_ Biset.associate_unassociate
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  change (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal
    (((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) b c).vertical (Diagram.splitUp b c)).eval) = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

private theorem eval_eq_iff
    {D₁ D₂ : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom d e f) (top a b c)}
    {M N : MonoidAlgebra Complex A}
    (h₁ : as a b c d e f D₁ M) (h₂ : as a b c d e f D₂ N) :
    D₁.interpret.eval = D₂.interpret.eval ↔ M = N := by
  constructor
  · intro he
    -- The merged identity pair detects the multiplier as in Theorem 6.5.
    have hs : run (combined a b c d e f D₁) = run (combined a b c d e f D₂) := by
      change ((split d e f).interpret.eval.vertical
        (D₁.interpret.eval.vertical (merge a b c).interpret.eval)).toLinearMap =
        ((split d e f).interpret.eval.vertical
          (D₂.interpret.eval.vertical (merge a b c).interpret.eval)).toLinearMap
      rw [he]
    have hM := h₁ 1 1
    rw [hs] at hM
    have h := hM.symm.trans (h₂ 1 1)
    apply MonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
    apply Finsupp.mapDomain_injective (Generator.mixedEquiv a (b.comp c)).symm.injective
    change Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)) M.coeff =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)) N.coeff
    simpa only [map_one, show MonoidAlgebra.single (1 : A) (1 : Complex) = 1 from rfl,
      one_mul, mul_one] using h
  rintro rfl
  -- Compare the full maps via the inverse boundary maps. Equal columns on
  -- merged pairs suffice by quotient induction and complex linearity.
  have eq : (combined a b c d e f D₁).interpret.eval =
      (combined a b c d e f D₂).interpret.eval := by
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z coef
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨g,h⟩ => ?_
    change run (combined a b c d e f D₁)
        (Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h) coef) =
      run (combined a b c d e f D₂)
        (Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h) coef)
    have hs : Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h) coef =
        coef • Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h) (1 : Complex) := by
      rw [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hs, map_smul, map_smul]
    exact congrArg (fun x : model (top' a b c) => coef • x) ((h₁ g h).trans (h₂ g h).symm)
  let P := (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.mergeUp d e)
    (Diagram.id (.down f))).eval
  let Q := ((Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (.down a))
      (Diagram.splitUp b c)).vertical (Diagram.unassociate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c))).eval
  let S := (split d e f).interpret.eval
  let T := (merge a b c).interpret.eval
  change S.vertical (D₁.interpret.eval.vertical T) = S.vertical (D₂.interpret.eval.vertical T) at eq
  have h := congrArg (fun x => (P.vertical x).vertical Q) eq
  change (P.vertical (S.vertical (D₁.interpret.eval.vertical T))).vertical Q =
    (P.vertical (S.vertical (D₂.interpret.eval.vertical T))).vertical Q at h
  have hP : P.vertical S = Biset.Hom.id (bottom d e f).basis := splitRightInverse d e f
  have hQ : T.vertical Q = Biset.Hom.id (top a b c).basis := mergeLeftInverse a b c
  simpa only [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc P S, hP, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc _ T Q, hQ, Biset.Hom.vertical_id] using h


private theorem quotientReplacement {Left Right Result : Type*}
    (leftEval : Left → Result) (rightEval : Right → Result)
    (hLeft : ∀ l, ∃ r, rightEval r = leftEval l)
    (hRight : ∀ r, ∃ l, leftEval l = rightEval r) :
    ∃ (replaceCase3 : Left → Right) (replaceCase4 : Right → Left)
      (replacement : Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval) ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval)),
      (∀ l, rightEval (replaceCase3 l) = leftEval l ∧
        replacement (Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker leftEval) l) =
          Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker rightEval) (replaceCase3 l)) ∧
      (∀ r, leftEval (replaceCase4 r) = rightEval r ∧
        replacement.symm (Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker rightEval) r) =
          Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker leftEval) (replaceCase4 r)) := by
  classical
  let toRight l := Classical.choose (hLeft l)
  let toLeft r := Classical.choose (hRight r)
  have hr l : rightEval (toRight l) = leftEval l := Classical.choose_spec (hLeft l)
  have hl r : leftEval (toLeft r) = rightEval r := Classical.choose_spec (hRight r)
  let forward : Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval) → Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval) :=
    Quotient.map toRight (fun {_ _} h => (hr _).trans (h.trans (hr _).symm))
  let backward : Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval) → Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval) :=
    Quotient.map toLeft (fun {_ _} h => (hl _).trans (h.trans (hl _).symm))
  let E : Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval) ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval) :=
    ⟨forward, backward,
      fun x => Quotient.inductionOn x (fun l => Quotient.sound ((hl (toRight l)).trans (hr l))),
      fun x => Quotient.inductionOn x (fun r => Quotient.sound ((hr (toLeft r)).trans (hl r)))⟩
  exact ⟨toRight, toLeft, E, fun l => ⟨hr l, rfl⟩, fun r => ⟨hl r, rfl⟩⟩

end TwoMultiplicationsAux

NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctors.proof:
by
  intro A B instA instB
  exact @NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctorsProof.assemble.{u,v,w,x} A B instA instB
NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctors.support:
namespace NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctorsProof

universe u v w x
variable {A : Type u} {B : Type v} [Ring A] [Ring B]

/-
The named types factor the reviewed endpoint for elaboration. The left action
is the bundled ModuleCat action, and equality with the left action in Bimodule
transports its commuting-actions proof. The pointwise universal property
supplies all tensor lifts used below.
-/
private abbrev Bimod (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [Ring A] [Ring B] :=
  Sigma (fun M : ModuleCat.{w} B =>
    { D : Bimodule.1 B A M // D.1 = (inferInstance : Module B M) })

private abbrev AMod (A : Type u) [Ring A] := ModuleCat.{max u x} A
private abbrev BMod (B : Type v) [Ring B] := ModuleCat.{w} B

private abbrev regular (A : Type u) [Ring A] : AMod.{u,x} A :=
  ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{x} A)

private def right (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (m : M.1) (a : A) : M.1 :=
  letI : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  MulOpposite.op a • m

private def Balanced (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (X : AMod.{u,x} A)
    (Y : BMod.{v,max u w x} B) (p : ↥M.1 → X → Y) : Prop :=
  (∀ m n : ↥M.1, ∀ a : X, p (m + n) a = p m a + p n a) ∧
  (∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ a b : X, p m (a + b) = p m a + p m b) ∧
  (∀ b : B, ∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ a : X, p (b • m) a = b • p m a) ∧
  (∀ a : A, ∀ m : ↥M.1, ∀ y : X, p (right M m a) y = p m (a • y))

private abbrev TensorFunctor (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) :=
  { D : Sigma (fun F : CategoryTheory.Functor (AMod.{u,x} A) (BMod.{v,max u w x} B) =>
      ∀ X : AMod.{u,x} A, ↥M.1 → X → F.obj X) //
    (∀ X : AMod.{u,x} A, Balanced M X (D.1.obj X) (D.2 X)) ∧
    (∀ (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (Y : BMod.{v,max u w x} B) (p : ↥M.1 → X → Y),
      Balanced M X Y p →
      ∃! k : (D.1.obj X) →ₗ[B] Y,
        ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (y : X), k (D.2 X m y) = p m y) ∧
    (∀ (X Y : AMod.{u,x} A) (h : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (m : ↥M.1) (y : X),
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (D.1.map h)) (D.2 X m y) = D.2 Y m ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom h) y)) }

variable {M N P : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B}
variable {T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M} {S : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} N}
variable {U : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} P}

private abbrev NatCode (M N : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) :=
  {f : M.1 →ₗ[B] N.1 // ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (a : A), f (right M m a) = right N (f m) a}

private abbrev Component (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M)
    (S : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} N) (X : AMod.{u,x} A) :=
  T.1.1.obj X →ₗ[B] S.1.1.obj X

private abbrev NatGraph (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M) (S : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} N) :=
  { G : ∀ X : AMod.{u,x} A, Component T S X → Prop //
    (∀ X : AMod.{u,x} A, ∃! k : Component T S X, G X k) ∧
    (∀ (X Y : AMod.{u,x} A) (h : ModuleCat.Hom X Y)
        (k : Component T S X) (l : Component T S Y),
      G X k → G Y l →
      (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (S.1.1.map h)).comp k =
        l.comp (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (T.1.1.map h))) }

private abbrev Unitor (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M) :=
  T.1.1.obj (regular.{u,x} A) ≃ₗ[B] M.1

private def IsUnitor (rho : Unitor T) : Prop :=
  (∀ (m : ↥M.1) (a : A), rho (T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up a)) = right M m a) ∧
  (∀ m : ↥M.1, rho.symm m = T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up (1 : A)))

private def eval (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (k : Component T S (regular A)) :
    M.1 →ₗ[B] N.1 :=
  sigma.toLinearMap.comp (k.comp rho.symm.toLinearMap)

private def Pure (f : NatCode M N) (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (k : Component T S X) : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (y : X), k (T.1.2 X m y) = S.1.2 X (f.1 m) y

private def Represents (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (eta : NatGraph T S)
    (f : NatCode M N) : Prop :=
  (∀ k : Component T S (regular A), eta.1 (regular A) k →
    f.1 = eval rho sigma k ∧
    ∀ m : ↥M.1, f.1 m = sigma (k (T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up (1 : A))))) ∧
  (∀ (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (k : Component T S X), eta.1 X k → Pure f X k)

private def InverseAssignments (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) : Prop :=
  (∀ eta : NatGraph T S, ∃! f : NatCode M N, Represents rho sigma eta f) ∧
  (∀ f : NatCode M N, ∃! eta : NatGraph T S, Represents rho sigma eta f)

private def Addition (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) : Prop :=
  ∀ eta theta : NatGraph T S,
    ∃ sum : NatGraph T S,
      (∀ (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (k l : Component T S X),
        eta.1 X k → theta.1 X l → sum.1 X (k + l)) ∧
      (∀ (k l : Component T S (regular A)),
        eta.1 (regular A) k → theta.1 (regular A) l →
        eval rho sigma (k + l) = eval rho sigma k + eval rho sigma l)

private def Identity (rho : Unitor T) : Prop :=
  ∃ identity : NatGraph T T,
    (∀ X : AMod.{u,x} A, identity.1 X LinearMap.id) ∧
    eval rho rho LinearMap.id = LinearMap.id

private def Composition (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (tau : Unitor U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (eta : NatGraph T S) (theta : NatGraph S U),
    ∃ composite : NatGraph T U,
      (∀ (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (k : Component T S X) (l : Component S U X),
        eta.1 X k → theta.1 X l → composite.1 X (l.comp k)) ∧
      (∀ (k : Component T S (regular A)) (l : Component S U (regular A)),
        eta.1 (regular A) k → theta.1 (regular A) l →
        eval rho tau (l.comp k) = (eval sigma tau l).comp (eval rho sigma k))

private theorem right_add (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (m n : M.1) (a : A) :
    right M (m + n) a = right M m a + right M n a := by
  let _ : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  exact smul_add (MulOpposite.op a) m n

private theorem right_add_scalar (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (m : M.1) (a b : A) :
    right M m (a + b) = right M m a + right M m b := by
  let _ : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  exact add_smul (MulOpposite.op a) (MulOpposite.op b) m

private theorem right_one (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (m : M.1) :
    right M m 1 = m := by
  let _ : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  exact one_smul (MulOpposite A) m

private theorem right_mul (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (m : M.1) (a b : A) :
    right M (right M m a) b = right M m (a * b) := by
  let _ : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.1.2.1
  exact (mul_smul (MulOpposite.op b) (MulOpposite.op a) m).symm

private theorem right_smul (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) (b : B) (m : M.1) (a : A) :
    right M (b • m) a = b • right M m a := by
  rcases M with ⟨L, ⟨⟨left, ⟨rightAction, comm⟩⟩, h⟩⟩
  change left = ModuleCat.isModule L at h
  subst left
  exact comm.smul_comm (MulOpposite.op a) b m

private theorem tensor_ext (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M) (X : AMod.{u,x} A)
    (Y : BMod.{v,max u w x} B) (f g : T.1.1.obj X →ₗ[B] Y)
    (h : ∀ (m : ↥M.1) (y : X), f (T.1.2 X m y) = g (T.1.2 X m y)) :
    f = g := by
  let p : ↥M.1 → X → Y := fun m y => g (T.1.2 X m y)
  have ht := T.2.1 X
  have hp : Balanced M X Y p := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro m n y
      change g (T.1.2 X (m + n) y) = g (T.1.2 X m y) + g (T.1.2 X n y)
      rw [ht.1, map_add]
    · intro m y z
      change g (T.1.2 X m (y + z)) = g (T.1.2 X m y) + g (T.1.2 X m z)
      rw [ht.2.1, map_add]
    · intro b m y
      change g (T.1.2 X (b • m) y) = b • g (T.1.2 X m y)
      rw [ht.2.2.1, map_smul]
    · intro a m y
      change g (T.1.2 X (right M m a) y) = g (T.1.2 X m (a • y))
      rw [ht.2.2.2]
  obtain ⟨q, _, hq⟩ := T.2.2.1 X Y p hp
  exact (hq f h).trans (hq g (fun _ _ => rfl)).symm

private abbrev liftedCarrier (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) : BMod.{v,max u w x} B :=
  ModuleCat.of B (ULift.{max u x} ↥M.1)

private theorem regular_balance (M : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B) :
    Balanced M (regular.{u,x} A) (liftedCarrier.{u,v,w,x} M)
      (fun m r => ULift.up (right M m r.down)) := by
  exact ⟨fun m n r => congrArg ULift.up (right_add M m n r.down),
    fun m r s => congrArg ULift.up (right_add_scalar M m r.down s.down),
    fun b m r => congrArg ULift.up (right_smul M b m r.down),
    fun a m r => congrArg ULift.up (right_mul M m a r.down)⟩

private theorem pure_right_regular (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M)
    (m : M.1) (a : A) :
    T.1.2 (regular A) (right M m a) (ULift.up (1 : A)) =
      T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up a) := by
  rw [(T.2.1 (regular A)).2.2.2]
  exact congrArg (T.1.2 (regular A) m) (congrArg ULift.up (mul_one a))

/-
Alphabeta Math Step 1.1 uses [F1]. The two B-linear unit maps here come from
the pointwise universal property and the explicit map m ↦ m ⊗ 1.
The lift allows the target to have the universe required by that property.
The inverse identity on the tensor module follows by uniqueness on pure tensors.
-/
private theorem exists_unitor (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M) :
    ∃ rho : Unitor T, IsUnitor rho := by
  let X : AMod.{u,x} A := regular A
  let Y : BMod.{v,max u w x} B := liftedCarrier M
  let p : ↥M.1 → X → Y := fun m r => ULift.up (right M m r.down)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, _⟩ := T.2.2.1 X Y p (regular_balance M)
  let down : Y →ₗ[B] M.1 :=
    (ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{max u x} ↥M.1 ≃ₗ[B] M.1).toLinearMap
  let f : T.1.1.obj X →ₗ[B] M.1 := down.comp d
  let g : M.1 →ₗ[B] T.1.1.obj X :=
    { toFun := fun m => T.1.2 X m (ULift.up (1 : A))
      map_add' := fun m n => (T.2.1 X).1 m n _
      map_smul' := fun b m => (T.2.1 X).2.2.1 b m _ }
  have hf (m : M.1) (a : A) : f (T.1.2 X m (ULift.up a)) = right M m a := by
    exact congrArg down (hd m (ULift.up a))
  have hfg : f.comp g = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro m
    exact (hf m 1).trans (right_one M m)
  have hgf : g.comp f = LinearMap.id := by
    apply tensor_ext T X (T.1.1.obj X)
    intro m r
    change g (f (T.1.2 X m (ULift.up r.down))) = T.1.2 X m r
    rw [hf]
    exact pure_right_regular T m r.down
  let rho : Unitor T := LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap f g hfg hgf
  exact ⟨rho, hf, fun _ => rfl⟩

private theorem eval_on_one (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S)
    (hrho : IsUnitor rho) (k : Component T S (regular A)) (m : M.1) :
    eval rho sigma k m = sigma (k (T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up (1 : A)))) := by
  change sigma (k (rho.symm m)) = _
  rw [hrho.2 m]

private abbrev fromRegular (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (y : X) : ModuleCat.Hom (regular A) X :=
  ModuleCat.ofHom ((ULift.moduleEquiv : ULift.{x} A ≃ₗ[A] A).toLinearMap.smulRight y)

private theorem fromRegular_one (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (y : X) :
    (fromRegular X y).hom (ULift.up (1 : A)) = y :=
  one_smul A y

private theorem out_of_regular (rho : Unitor T) (hrho : IsUnitor rho)
    (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (y : X) (z : T.1.1.obj (regular A)) :
    (T.1.1.map (fromRegular X y)).hom z = T.1.2 X (rho z) y := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← rho.symm_apply_apply z, hrho.2]
  rw [T.2.2.2, fromRegular_one]

private theorem natural_at (eta : NatGraph T S) {X Y : AMod.{u,x} A}
    (h : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) {k : Component T S X} {l : Component T S Y}
    (hk : eta.1 X k) (hl : eta.1 Y l) (z : T.1.1.obj X) :
    (S.1.1.map h).hom (k z) = l ((T.1.1.map h).hom z) :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (eta.2.2 X Y h k l hk hl) z

/-
Alphabeta Math Step 1.1 uses naturality at right multiplication by a.
On the lifted regular module this is fromRegular with y = up a, since
r • a = r * a there. The unitor computation supplies the required right-linearity.
-/
private theorem eval_right (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S)
    (hrho : IsUnitor rho) (hsigma : IsUnitor sigma) (eta : NatGraph T S)
    (k : Component T S (regular A)) (hk : eta.1 (regular A) k)
    (m : M.1) (a : A) :
    eval rho sigma k (right M m a) = right N (eval rho sigma k m) a := by
  rw [eval_on_one rho sigma hrho, eval_on_one rho sigma hrho]
  let z : T.1.1.obj (regular A) := T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up (1 : A))
  rw [pure_right_regular T]
  have hn := natural_at eta (fromRegular (regular A) (ULift.up a)) hk hk z
  rw [out_of_regular sigma hsigma, out_of_regular rho hrho, hrho.1, right_one] at hn
  rw [← hn, hsigma.1]

-- Alphabeta Math Step 2.1 applies naturality at r ↦ r • y to m ⊗ 1.
private theorem graph_member_pure (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S)
    (hrho : IsUnitor rho) (hsigma : IsUnitor sigma) (eta : NatGraph T S)
    (k : Component T S (regular A)) (hk : eta.1 (regular A) k)
    (f : NatCode M N) (hf : f.1 = eval rho sigma k)
    (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (l : Component T S X) (hl : eta.1 X l) :
    Pure f X l := by
  intro m y
  have hn := natural_at eta (fromRegular X y) hk hl (T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up (1 : A)))
  rw [out_of_regular sigma hsigma, out_of_regular rho hrho, hrho.1, right_one] at hn
  rw [hf, eval_on_one rho sigma hrho]
  exact hn.symm

private theorem pure_exists (f : NatCode M N) (X : AMod.{u,x} A) :
    ∃! k : Component T S X, Pure f X k := by
  let p : ↥M.1 → X → S.1.1.obj X := fun m y => S.1.2 X (f.1 m) y
  have hs := S.2.1 X
  have hp : Balanced M X (S.1.1.obj X) p := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro m n y
      change S.1.2 X (f.1 (m + n)) y = _
      rw [map_add]
      exact hs.1 (f.1 m) (f.1 n) y
    · intro m y z
      exact hs.2.1 (f.1 m) y z
    · intro b m y
      change S.1.2 X (f.1 (b • m)) y = _
      rw [map_smul]
      exact hs.2.2.1 b (f.1 m) y
    · intro a m y
      change S.1.2 X (f.1 (right M m a)) y = _
      rw [f.2]
      exact hs.2.2.2 a (f.1 m) y
  exact T.2.2.1 X (S.1.1.obj X) p hp

/-
Alphabeta Math Step 1.2 uses the induced tensor maps of [F5].
Here each component is specified by its pure-tensor equation. The given
universal property supplies pointwise witnesses and proves naturality on
pure tensors. The graph avoids selecting a dependent family of witnesses.
-/
private def pureGraph (f : NatCode M N) : NatGraph T S := by
  refine ⟨Pure f, pure_exists f, ?_⟩
  intro X Y h k l hk hl
  apply tensor_ext T X (S.1.1.obj Y)
  intro m y
  change (S.1.1.map h).hom (k (T.1.2 X m y)) =
    l ((T.1.1.map h).hom (T.1.2 X m y))
  rw [hk m y, T.2.2.2, S.2.2.2, hl m (h.hom y)]

private theorem pureGraph_represents (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S)
    (hrho : IsUnitor rho) (hsigma : IsUnitor sigma) (f : NatCode M N) :
    Represents rho sigma (pureGraph f) f := by
  refine ⟨?_, fun _ _ h => h⟩
  intro k hk
  have hp : Pure f (regular A) k := hk
  have h (m : M.1) :
      f.1 m = sigma (k (T.1.2 (regular A) m (ULift.up (1 : A)))) := by
    rw [hp m, hsigma.1, right_one]
  exact ⟨LinearMap.ext (fun m => (h m).trans (eval_on_one rho sigma hrho k m).symm), h⟩

-- Alphabeta Math Step 3.1 uses component uniqueness and graph extensionality.
private theorem inverse_assignments (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S)
    (hrho : IsUnitor rho) (hsigma : IsUnitor sigma) :
    InverseAssignments rho sigma := by
  constructor
  · intro eta
    obtain ⟨k, hk, uniq⟩ := eta.2.1 (regular A)
    let f : NatCode M N := ⟨eval rho sigma k, eval_right rho sigma hrho hsigma eta k hk⟩
    refine ⟨f, ⟨?_, graph_member_pure rho sigma hrho hsigma eta k hk f rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · intro l hl
      rw [uniq l hl]
      exact ⟨rfl, eval_on_one rho sigma hrho k⟩
    · intro g hg
      exact Subtype.ext ((hg.1 k hk).1)
  · intro f
    refine ⟨pureGraph f, pureGraph_represents rho sigma hrho hsigma f, ?_⟩
    intro eta heta
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext X k
    apply propext
    refine ⟨heta.2 X k, ?_⟩
    intro hk
    obtain ⟨l, hl, _⟩ := eta.2.1 X
    obtain ⟨q, _, hq⟩ := pure_exists (T := T) (S := S) f X
    have hkl := (hq k hk).trans (hq l (heta.2 X l hl)).symm
    exact hkl ▸ hl

/-
Alphabeta Math Step 4.1 takes operations componentwise. The graphs for
addition and composition use existential witnesses at the single object in
question. Their uniqueness and naturality use the original graphs at those
objects. Evaluation is conjugation by the unitors.
-/
private theorem add_graphs (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) :
    Addition rho sigma := by
  intro eta theta
  let G (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (s : Component T S X) : Prop :=
    ∃ k l : Component T S X, eta.1 X k ∧ theta.1 X l ∧ s = k + l
  have unique (X : AMod.{u,x} A) : ∃! s, G X s := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, uk⟩ := eta.2.1 X
    obtain ⟨l, hl, ul⟩ := theta.2.1 X
    refine ⟨k + l, ⟨k, l, hk, hl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro s ⟨k', l', hk', hl', rfl⟩
    rw [uk k' hk', ul l' hl']
  let sum : NatGraph T S := ⟨G, unique, by
    rintro X Y h _ _ ⟨k, l, hk, hl, rfl⟩ ⟨k', l', hk', hl', rfl⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change (S.1.1.map h).hom (k z + l z) =
      k' ((T.1.1.map h).hom z) + l' ((T.1.1.map h).hom z)
    rw [map_add, natural_at eta h hk hk' z, natural_at theta h hl hl' z]⟩
  refine ⟨sum, fun _ k l hk hl => ⟨k, l, hk, hl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro k l _ _
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  change sigma (k (rho.symm m) + l (rho.symm m)) =
    sigma (k (rho.symm m)) + sigma (l (rho.symm m))
  exact map_add sigma _ _

private theorem identity_graph (rho : Unitor T) : Identity rho := by
  let identity : NatGraph T T :=
    ⟨fun _ k => k = LinearMap.id, fun _ => ⟨LinearMap.id, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩,
      by
        rintro X Y h _ _ rfl rfl
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro z
        rfl⟩
  refine ⟨identity, fun _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  exact rho.apply_symm_apply m

private theorem compose_graphs (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (tau : Unitor U) :
    Composition rho sigma tau := by
  intro eta theta
  let G (X : AMod.{u,x} A) (s : Component T U X) : Prop :=
    ∃ (k : Component T S X) (l : Component S U X), eta.1 X k ∧ theta.1 X l ∧ s = l.comp k
  have unique (X : AMod.{u,x} A) : ∃! s, G X s := by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, uk⟩ := eta.2.1 X
    obtain ⟨l, hl, ul⟩ := theta.2.1 X
    refine ⟨l.comp k, ⟨k, l, hk, hl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro s ⟨k', l', hk', hl', rfl⟩
    rw [uk k' hk', ul l' hl']
  let composite : NatGraph T U := ⟨G, unique, by
    rintro X Y h _ _ ⟨k, l, hk, hl, rfl⟩ ⟨k', l', hk', hl', rfl⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    change (U.1.1.map h).hom (l (k z)) = l' (k' ((T.1.1.map h).hom z))
    rw [natural_at theta h hl hl', natural_at eta h hk hk']⟩
  refine ⟨composite, fun _ k l hk hl => ⟨k, l, hk, hl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  intro k l _ _
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  change tau (l (k (rho.symm m))) = tau (l (sigma.symm (sigma (k (rho.symm m)))))
  rw [sigma.symm_apply_apply]

private theorem assemble (M N P : Bimod.{u,v,w} A B)
    (T : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} M) (S : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} N)
    (U : TensorFunctor.{u,v,w,x} P) :
    ∃ (rho : Unitor T) (sigma : Unitor S) (tau : Unitor U),
      IsUnitor rho ∧ IsUnitor sigma ∧ IsUnitor tau ∧
      InverseAssignments rho sigma ∧ InverseAssignments sigma tau ∧ InverseAssignments rho tau ∧
      Addition rho sigma ∧ Identity rho ∧ Composition rho sigma tau := by
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho⟩ := exists_unitor T
  obtain ⟨sigma, hsigma⟩ := exists_unitor S
  obtain ⟨tau, htau⟩ := exists_unitor U
  exact ⟨rho, sigma, tau, hrho, hsigma, htau,
    inverse_assignments rho sigma hrho hsigma, inverse_assignments sigma tau hsigma htau,
    inverse_assignments rho tau hrho htau, add_graphs rho sigma, identity_graph rho,
    compose_graphs rho sigma tau⟩

end NaturalTransformationsOfTensorFunctorsProof

namespace EvaluationForTwoProjectionsAux

open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped BigOperators

universe u
noncomputable section
set_option maxHeartbeats 1500000

private abbrev Vec (X : Type*) := X →₀ Complex

-- A contravariant basis map acts by precomposition on coefficients.
private def Pulls {X Y : Type*} (L : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Vec Y) (y : Y) (x : X) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, L v y = v x

private theorem pulls_single {X Y : Type*} (L : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Vec Y) (y : Y) (x : X)
    (h : ∀ i : X, L (Finsupp.single i 1) y = Finsupp.single i (1 : Complex) x) :
    Pulls L y x := by
  let l := (Finsupp.lapply y : Vec Y →ₗ[Complex] Complex).comp L
  have he : l = (Finsupp.lapply x : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Complex) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro i w
    have hs : Finsupp.single i w = w • Finsupp.single i (1 : Complex) := by
      simp [Finsupp.smul_single]
    rw [hs, map_smul, map_smul]
    exact congrArg (w • ·) (h i)
  exact fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun he v

private theorem pulls_of_single {X Y : Type*} {L : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Vec Y}
    {forward : X → Y} {x : X} {y : Y} (inv : ∀ i, forward i = y ↔ i = x)
    (h : ∀ i : X, L (Finsupp.single i 1) = Finsupp.single (forward i) 1) :
    Pulls L y x := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  intro i
  rw [h i]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, inv]

private theorem pulls_mixed {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (d : ConjEmbedding L K) (e : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e)
    (y : ((Word.up d).tensor (.down e)).basis.carrier) :
    Pulls (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b d e p.dot p.finite).eval.toLinearMap
      y (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot y) := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  intro i
  change (Biset.Hom.transfer Complex (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot)
    (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b d e p.dot) p.finite).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single i 1) y = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : i = Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot y
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

section Balanced
variable {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
variable {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}

-- The unchanged strand makes the balancing parameter unique at a fixed output
-- representative. Thus no orbit multiplicity is introduced by tensoring a pullback.
private theorem pulls_horizontal_right (L : Biset.Hom Complex X X')
    (free : ∀ (s : Y.carrier) (h : H), Y.act (h, 1) s = s → h = 1)
    {x' : X'.carrier} {x : X.carrier} (hx : Pulls L.toLinearMap x' x) (s : Y.carrier) :
    Pulls (L.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Y)).toLinearMap (X'.pair Y x' s) (X.pair Y x s) := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  refine fun z => Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨i,t⟩ => ?_)
  change (L.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Y)).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y i t) 1)
    (X'.pair Y x' s) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1))
    (Finsupp.single t 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) = Finsupp.single (X.pair Y i t) 1 (X.pair Y x s)
  by_cases ht : ∃ h : H, Y.act (h, 1) t = s
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := ht
    have he : X.pair Y i t = X.pair Y (X.act (1,h) i) s := by
      rw [← hh, Biset.pair_orbit]
    have heval : ∀ v : Vec X'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y v (Finsupp.single s 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) = v x' := by
      apply pulls_single ((Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y).flip (Finsupp.single s 1))
      intro j
      change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (Finsupp.single j 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)
        (X'.pair Y x' s) = _
      rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one]
      have hi : X'.pair Y j s = X'.pair Y x' s ↔ j = x' := by
        constructor
        · intro hp
          obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
          have hk1 := free s k hs
          subst k
          exact (X'.one_act j).symm.trans hk
        · intro hp
          rw [hp]
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
    -- Rechoose the input representative before using the horizontal basis formula.
    have hre := congrArg (fun w => (L.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Y)).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single w 1) (X'.pair Y x' s)) he
    rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul] at hre
    change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1))
      (Finsupp.single t 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.act (1,h) i) 1))
      (Finsupp.single s 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) at hre
    rw [hre, heval, hx _ , he]
    have hi : X.pair Y (X.act (1,h) i) s = X.pair Y x s ↔ X.act (1,h) i = x := by
      constructor
      · intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        have hk1 := free s k hs
        subst k
        exact (X.one_act _).symm.trans hk
      · intro hp
        rw [hp]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
  · have heval : ∀ v : Vec X'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y v (Finsupp.single t 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) = 0 := by
      have he : (Finsupp.lapply (X'.pair Y x' s) : Vec (X'.tensor Y).carrier →ₗ[Complex] Complex).comp
          ((Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y).flip (Finsupp.single t 1)) = 0 := by
        apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
        intro j r
        change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (Finsupp.single j r) (Finsupp.single t 1)
          (X'.pair Y x' s) = 0
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
        intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun he v
    rw [heval, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
    intro hp
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
    exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩

private theorem pulls_horizontal_left (L : Biset.Hom Complex Y Y')
    (free : ∀ (s : X.carrier) (h : H), X.act (1, h) s = s → h = 1)
    {y' : Y'.carrier} {y : Y.carrier} (hy : Pulls L.toLinearMap y' y) (s : X.carrier) :
    Pulls ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal L).toLinearMap (X.pair Y' s y') (X.pair Y s y) := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  refine fun z => Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨t,i⟩ => ?_)
  change ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal L).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y t i) 1)
    (X.pair Y' s y') = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  change Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1)
    (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1)) (X.pair Y' s y') = Finsupp.single (X.pair Y t i) 1 (X.pair Y s y)
  by_cases ht : ∃ h : H, X.act (1, h) t = s
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := ht
    have he : X.pair Y t i = X.pair Y s (Y.act (h,1) i) := by
      rw [← hh, Biset.pair_orbit]
    have heval : ∀ v : Vec Y'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single s 1) v (X.pair Y' s y') = v y' := by
      apply pulls_single (Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single s 1))
      intro j
      rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
      have hi : X.pair Y' s j = X.pair Y' s y' ↔ j = y' := by
        constructor
        · intro hp
          obtain ⟨k, hs, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
          have hk1 := free s k hs
          subst k
          exact (Y'.one_act j).symm.trans hk
        · intro hp
          rw [hp]
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
    have hre := congrArg (fun w => ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal L).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single w 1) (X.pair Y' s y')) he
    rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul] at hre
    change Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1)
      (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1)) (X.pair Y' s y') =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single s 1)
      (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (Y.act (h,1) i) 1)) (X.pair Y' s y') at hre
    rw [hre, heval, hy _ , he]
    have hi : X.pair Y s (Y.act (h,1) i) = X.pair Y s y ↔ Y.act (h,1) i = y := by
      constructor
      · intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, hs, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        have hk1 := free s k hs
        subst k
        exact (Y.one_act _).symm.trans hk
      · intro hp
        rw [hp]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
  · have heval : ∀ v : Vec Y'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1) v (X.pair Y' s y') = 0 := by
      have he : (Finsupp.lapply (X.pair Y' s y') : Vec (X.tensor Y').carrier →ₗ[Complex] Complex).comp
          (Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1)) = 0 := by
        apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
        intro j r
        change Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1) (Finsupp.single j r)
          (X.pair Y' s y') = 0
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
        intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, hk, _⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun he v
    rw [heval, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
    intro hp
    obtain ⟨k, hk, _⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
    exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩

end Balanced

end
