private theorem weighted_atLeft {I : Type*} {p q : Word K H} {r : Word H J}
    (S : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (s : I → LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (xs : List (Complex × I))
    (he : ev S = weighted (fun i => ev (s i)) xs) :
    ev (atLeft S r) = weighted (fun i => ev (atLeft (s i) r)) xs := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro w c
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨x,y⟩ => ?_)
  let T := c • (((Biset.pairLinear Complex q.basis r.basis).flip
    (Finsupp.single y 1)).comp (preapply (Finsupp.single x (1 : Complex))))
  have col (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
      ev (atLeft d r) (Finsupp.single (pair p r x y) c) = T (ev d) := by
    exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_single d.interpret.eval (Biset.Hom.id r.basis) x y c
  change ev (atLeft S r) (Finsupp.single (pair p r x y) c) =
    preapply (Finsupp.single (pair p r x y) c) (weighted (fun i => ev (atLeft (s i) r)) xs)
  rw [col S, he, map_weighted T, map_weighted]
  exact congrArg (fun v => weighted v xs) (funext fun i => (col (s i)).symm)

end WeightedCrossings

private theorem weighted_terms {I M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Complex M]
    (coeff : I →₀ Complex) (term : I → M) :
    weighted term (coeff.support.toList.map (fun i => (coeff i, i))) =
      coeff.sum (fun i c => c • term i) := by
  classical
  unfold weighted Finsupp.sum
  rw [List.map_map]
  exact Finset.sum_map_toList coeff.support (fun i => coeff i • term i)

end
end CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstructionAux

namespace CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstructionAux

open MackeyDiagrams
universe u
noncomputable section

variable {U : Type u} [Group U]

private abbrev crossingIntersection {K H P : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P) (p : P) : Subgroup P :=
  a.toHom.range ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom b.toHom.range

private abbrev FiberSize {X Y : Type u} (q : X → Y) (n : Nat) :=
  ∀ z ∈ Set.range q, Nat.card {w : X // q w = z} = n

section FiberIndex

variable {K H P L : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P)
  (d : ConjEmbedding L K) (e : ConjEmbedding L H)

-- Lemma 6.3 and (6.1). Insert identity embeddings to use the registered
-- calculation for a single crossing. mixedEquiv changes only its target
-- coordinates, so the fiber subtypes have the same cardinality.
private theorem crossingIndex (p : Dot (a.comp d) (b.comp e)) :
    (a.comp d).toHom.range ≤ crossingIntersection a b p.element ∧
      ((∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p w = z}) ↔
        ((a.comp d).toHom.range.subgroupOf (crossingIntersection a b p.element)).FiniteIndex) := by
  have h := (EvaluationForTwoProjections a b (ConjEmbedding.id H) d (ConjEmbedding.id L) e).1 p
  exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩

private theorem crossingFiberSize (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e) :
    FiberSize (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot)
      ((a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a b p.dot.element)) := by
  intro z hz
  have hinj := (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).injective
  have h := (EvaluationForTwoProjections a b (ConjEmbedding.id H) d (ConjEmbedding.id L) e).2.1 p
    (Generator.mixedProduct a b z) |>.2 (by obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz; exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
  refine (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun w => ?_))).trans h
  exact ⟨congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct a b), fun he => hinj he⟩

private theorem crossingCardBound (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e) (n : Nat)
    (h : (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a b p.dot.element) ≤ n) :
    ∀ z, Nat.card {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w = z} ≤ n := by
  intro z
  by_cases hz : z ∈ Set.range (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot)
  · rw [crossingFiberSize a b d e p z hz]
    exact h
  · have empty : IsEmpty {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w = z} :=
      ⟨fun w => hz ⟨w.1, w.2⟩⟩
    exact (Nat.card_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inl empty)).le.trans (Nat.zero_le n)

end FiberIndex

private theorem rangeComp_le {K H P : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (b : ConjEmbedding K H) : (a.comp b).toHom.range ≤ a.toHom.range := by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨b.toHom x, rfl⟩

private theorem compId {K H : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K H) :
    a.comp (ConjEmbedding.id K) = a := by
  apply ConjEmbedding.ext
  exact MonoidHom.ext fun _ => rfl

private def unitDot {K H : Subgroup U} {a b : ConjEmbedding K H} (h : a = b) : Dot a b where
  element := 1
  intertwines x := by subst b; simp

section FullIntersection

variable {G A D F E : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
  (de : ConjEmbedding E G) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev internalGroup (p : A) :=
  (Subgroup.comap a.toHom (crossingIntersection a b p)).map G.subtype

-- Theorem 6.4(2), full-intersection construction. B is a subgroup of the
-- ambient group in the drawing syntax, so transport the comap along G.subtype.
private theorem transportedEmbeddings (p : Dot (a.comp de) ((b.comp c).comp f)) :
    let B := internalGroup a b p.element
    ∃ (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B),
      (∀ v : B, (r.toHom v : U) = (v : U)) ∧
      (∀ v : B, b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.element) ∧
      r.comp t = de ∧ s.comp t = c.comp f ∧
      (a.comp r).toHom.range = crossingIntersection a b p.element := by
  let I := crossingIntersection a b p.element
  let J := I.comap a.toHom
  let B := J.map G.subtype
  have hBG : B ≤ G := by
    rintro _ ⟨v, _, rfl⟩
    exact v.property
  let r : ConjEmbedding B G :=
    ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hBG, ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩
  have hr (v : B) : a.toHom (r.toHom v) ∈ I := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hval⟩ := v.property
    have eq : r.toHom v = w := Subtype.ext hval.symm
    rw [eq]
    exact hw
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := b.hasRepresentative
  let σ : U := β⁻¹ * (p.element : U)⁻¹ * α
  have candidate (v : B) :
      ∃ w : D, (w : U) = σ * (v : U) * σ⁻¹ ∧
        b.toHom w = p.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.element := by
    obtain ⟨y, ⟨w, rfl⟩, hy⟩ := (hr v).2
    change p.element * b.toHom w * p.element⁻¹ = a.toHom (r.toHom v) at hy
    have hw : b.toHom w = p.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.element := by rw [← hy]; group
    refine ⟨w, ?_, hw⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun x : A => (x : U)) hw
    change (b.toHom w : U) = (p.element : U)⁻¹ * (a.toHom (r.toHom v) : U) * (p.element : U) at he
    rw [hβ, hα] at he
    change β * (w : U) * β⁻¹ =
      (p.element : U)⁻¹ * (α * (v : U) * α⁻¹) * (p.element : U) at he
    calc
      (w : U) = β⁻¹ * (β * (w : U) * β⁻¹) * β := by group
      _ = σ * (v : U) * σ⁻¹ := by rw [he]; dsimp [σ]; group
  let s : ConjEmbedding B D := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator σ (fun v => by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, _⟩ := candidate v
    exact hw ▸ w.property)
  have hs (v : B) : b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.element := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := candidate v
    have eq : s.toHom v = w := Subtype.ext hw.symm
    rw [eq, he]
  have hlo := (crossingIndex a (b.comp c) de f p).1
  have hI : crossingIntersection a (b.comp c) p.element ≤ I :=
    inf_le_inf_left _ (Subgroup.map_mono (rangeComp_le b c))
  have ht (v : E) : (de.toHom v : U) ∈ B :=
    ⟨de.toHom v, hI (hlo ⟨v, rfl⟩), rfl⟩
  let t : ConjEmbedding E B := ⟨(G.subtype.comp de.toHom).codRestrict B ht, de.hasRepresentative⟩
  have hrt : r.comp t = de := ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun _ => rfl)
  have hst : s.comp t = c.comp f := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply b.injective
    change b.toHom (s.toHom (t.toHom v)) = b.toHom (c.toHom (f.toHom v))
    rw [hs]
    change p.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (de.toHom v) * p.element = _
    have hp := p.intertwines v
    change a.toHom (de.toHom v) * p.element = p.element * b.toHom (c.toHom (f.toHom v)) at hp
    rw [mul_assoc, hp, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  refine ⟨r, s, t, fun _ => rfl, hs, hrt, hst, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact hr v
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hx.1
    refine ⟨⟨v, ⟨v, ?_, rfl⟩⟩, hv⟩
    change a.toHom v ∈ I
    rwa [hv]

private theorem transportedIndex (p : Dot (a.comp de) ((b.comp c).comp f))
    {B : Subgroup U} (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
    (hs : ∀ v : B, b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.element)
    (hrt : r.comp t = de) (hI : (a.comp r).toHom.range = crossingIntersection a b p.element) :
    (s.comp t).toHom.range.relIndex (s.toHom.range ⊓ c.toHom.range) =
      (a.comp de).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a (b.comp c) p.element) := by
  -- ConjEmbedding.injective applies to b. Conjugation by p is an
  -- automorphism, giving the injectivity required by the index transport.
  let φ : D →* A := (MulAut.conj p.element).toMonoidHom.comp b.toHom
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := (MulAut.conj p.element).injective.comp b.injective
  have hrs (v : B) : φ (s.toHom v) = a.toHom (r.toHom v) := by
    change p.element * b.toHom (s.toHom v) * p.element⁻¹ = _
    rw [hs]
    group
  have hsMap : s.toHom.range.map φ = (a.comp r).toHom.range := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.range_comp]
    congr 1
    exact MonoidHom.ext hrs
  have htMap : (s.comp t).toHom.range.map φ = (a.comp de).toHom.range := by
    rw [← MonoidHom.range_comp, ← hrt]
    congr 1
    exact MonoidHom.ext fun v => hrs (t.toHom v)
  have hcMap : c.toHom.range.map φ =
      (b.comp c).toHom.range.map (MulAut.conj p.element).toMonoidHom := by
    rw [← Subgroup.map_map, ← MonoidHom.range_comp]
    rfl
  have hcLe := Subgroup.map_mono (f := (MulAut.conj p.element).toMonoidHom) (rangeComp_le b c)
  have upperMap : (s.toHom.range ⊓ c.toHom.range).map φ =
      crossingIntersection a (b.comp c) p.element := by
    rw [Subgroup.map_inf _ _ _ hφ, hsMap, hI, hcMap]
    change (_ ⊓ _) ⊓ _ = a.toHom.range ⊓ _
    rw [inf_assoc, inf_eq_right.mpr hcLe]
  rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ hφ, htMap, upperMap]

end FullIntersection

end
end CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstructionAux

namespace CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstructionAux

open MackeyDiagrams
universe u
noncomputable section

variable {U : Type u} [Group U]
variable {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
  (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private theorem mkFinite {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (α : ConjEmbedding K P) (β : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (η : ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : ConjEmbedding L H) (p : Dot (α.comp η) (β.comp θ))
    (h : (α.comp η).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection α β p.element) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ p w = z} :=
  (crossingIndex α β η θ p).2.mpr (Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mpr h)

private theorem crossingIntersection_one {K H P : Subgroup U}
    (α : ConjEmbedding K P) (β : ConjEmbedding H P) :
    crossingIntersection α β 1 = α.toHom.range ⊓ β.toHom.range := by
  change α.toHom.range ⊓ Subgroup.map _ β.toHom.range = _
  have h : (MulAut.conj (1 : P)).toMonoidHom = MonoidHom.id P :=
    MonoidHom.ext fun x => by simp
  rw [h, Subgroup.map_id]

private def lowerDot (p : Parameter a b c d e f)
    (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D)
    (hs : ∀ v : B,
      b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.dot.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.dot.element) :
    Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s) where
  element := p.dot.element
  intertwines v := by
    change a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.dot.element = p.dot.element * b.toHom (s.toHom v)
    rw [hs]
    group

private theorem fullCrossings (p : Parameter a b c d e f)
    (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
    (hs : ∀ v : B, b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.dot.element⁻¹ * a.toHom (r.toHom v) * p.dot.element)
    (hrt : r.comp t = d.comp e) (hst : s.comp t = c.comp f)
    (hI : (a.comp r).toHom.range = crossingIntersection a b p.dot.element) :
    ∃ (x : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s) (y : ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f)
      (z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e)),
      x.dot.element = p.dot.element ∧ y.dot.element = 1 ∧ z.element = 1 ∧
      FiberSize (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b r s x.dot) 1 ∧
      FiberSize (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis s c t f y.dot)
        ((a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a (b.comp c) p.dot.element)) := by
  let xDot := lowerDot a b c d e f p r s hs
  have hx : (a.comp r).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a b xDot.element) = 1 := by
    change (a.comp r).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a b p.dot.element) = 1
    rw [hI, Subgroup.relIndex_self]
  let x : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s := ⟨xDot, mkFinite a b r s xDot (by rw [hx]; decide)⟩
  let yDot : Dot _ _ := unitDot hst
  have hy : (s.comp t).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection s c yDot.element) =
      (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection a (b.comp c) p.dot.element) := by
    change (s.comp t).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection s c 1) = _
    rw [crossingIntersection_one]
    exact transportedIndex a b c (d.comp e) f p.dot r s t hs hrt hI
  have houter := (crossingIndex a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f p.dot).2.mp p.finite
  let y : ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f :=
    ⟨yDot, mkFinite s c t f yDot (by rw [hy]; exact houter.index_ne_zero)⟩
  refine ⟨x, y, unitDot hrt, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hx]
    exact crossingFiberSize a b r s x
  · rw [← hy]
    exact crossingFiberSize s c t f y

-- Theorem 6.4(2), common region E. The first intermediate subgroup lies
-- between the image of E and a(G). The finite ambient index gives a
-- nonzero index throughout this tower and bounds the first fiber size.
private theorem commonLower (h : (d.comp e).toHom.range.FiniteIndex)
    (p : Parameter a b c d e f) :
    ∃ x : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b (d.comp e) (c.comp f), x.dot.element = p.dot.element ∧
      ∀ z, Nat.card {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (d.comp e) (c.comp f) x.dot w = z} ≤
        (d.comp e).toHom.range.index := by
  let de := d.comp e
  let cf := c.comp f
  let xDot : Dot (a.comp de) (b.comp cf) := p.dot
  let L := (a.comp de).toHom.range
  let M := crossingIntersection a b xDot.element
  let H := a.toHom.range
  have hlm : L ≤ M := (crossingIndex a b de cf xDot).1
  have hmh : M ≤ H := inf_le_left
  have hwhole : L.relIndex H = de.toHom.range.index := by
    change (a.toHom.comp de.toHom).range.relIndex a.toHom.range = de.toHom.range.index
    rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, MonoidHom.range_eq_map a.toHom,
      Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ a.injective, Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
  have hnonzero : L.relIndex H ≠ 0 := hwhole ▸ h.index_ne_zero
  have hpart : L.relIndex M ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hmul := Subgroup.relIndex_mul_relIndex L M H hlm hmh
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hmul
    exact hnonzero hmul.symm
  let x : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b de cf := ⟨xDot, mkFinite a b de cf xDot hpart⟩
  refine ⟨x, rfl, crossingCardBound a b de cf x _ ?_⟩
  exact (Subgroup.relIndex_le_of_le_right hmh hnonzero).trans_eq hwhole

private theorem commonUpper :
    let t := ConjEmbedding.id E
    ∃ y : ProjectionDot.Mixed (c.comp f) c t f,
      y.dot.element = 1 ∧ FiberSize (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis (c.comp f) c t f y.dot) 1 := by
  let cf := c.comp f
  let t := ConjEmbedding.id E
  let yDot : Dot (cf.comp t) (c.comp f) := unitDot (compId cf)
  have hy : (cf.comp t).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection cf c yDot.element) = 1 := by
    change (cf.comp t).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingIntersection cf c 1) = 1
    rw [crossingIntersection_one, compId, inf_eq_left.mpr (rangeComp_le c f), Subgroup.relIndex_self]
  let y : ProjectionDot.Mixed cf c t f := ⟨yDot, mkFinite cf c t f yDot (by rw [hy]; decide)⟩
  refine ⟨y, rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [← hy]
  exact crossingFiberSize cf c t f y

-- The linear combination at one crossing keeps one crossing vertex in the
-- drawing. Linearity is used on the evaluation of its surrounding diagram.
private theorem linearLeftEval (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D)
    (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
    (xs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s))
    (y : ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f) (z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e)) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (leftDrawing a b c d e f r s t xs [(1,y)] [(1,z)]) =
    weighted (fun x =>
      mergedEval a b c d e f (leftDrawing a b c d e f r s t [(1,x)] [(1,y)] [(1,z)])) xs := by
  let first := fun xs => atLeft (.compactProjection a b r s xs) (.up c)
  let middle := atRight (.up r) (.compactProjection s c t f [(1,y)])
  let last := atLeft (.parallelUp r t d e [(1,z)]) (.down f)
  let post := ev (before middle (before last (mergeTop d e f)))
  let frame := composeAround (ev (splitBottom a b c)) post
  change frame (ev (first xs)) = weighted (fun x => frame (ev (first [(1,x)]))) xs
  rw [weighted_atLeft _ _ xs (weighted_compact a b r s xs), map_weighted]

private theorem sumEval (terms : Parameter a b c d e f →
    LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom a b c) (top d e f)) (xs : List (Complex × Parameter a b c d e f)) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f
      (xs.foldr (fun term total => .add (.scale term.1 (terms term.2)) total)
        (.ordinary (.zero _ _))) =
    weighted (fun p => mergedEval a b c d e f (terms p)) xs := by
  let frame := composeAround (ev (splitBottom a b c)) (ev (mergeTop d e f))
  let fold := fun xs : List (Complex × Parameter a b c d e f) =>
    xs.foldr (fun term total => LabelledDrawing.add (.scale term.1 (terms term.2)) total)
        (.ordinary (.zero _ _))
  have h (xs : List (Complex × Parameter a b c d e f)) :
      ev (fold xs) = weighted (fun p => ev (terms p)) xs := by
    induction xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      change x.1 • ev (terms x.2) + ev (fold xs) =
        x.1 • ev (terms x.2) + weighted (fun p => ev (terms p)) xs
      rw [ih]
  change frame (ev (fold xs)) = weighted (fun p => frame (ev (terms p))) xs
  rw [h, map_weighted]

end
end CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstructionAux

open MackeyDiagrams CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstructionAux

external.usage: Apply the index tower to the image of de(E), the first crossing intersection, and a(G). The nonzero index of de(E) in G forces the lower relative index to be nonzero.
Transport the second crossing index along conjugation by p composed with b in the full-intersection construction. Use a to transport the ambient index in the common-region construction.
Bound the first fiber size in the common-region construction by the ambient index. The transported ambient index is nonzero by the finite-index hypothesis.

RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst G A D F C E a b d c e f up down tensor comp ga ad df gc ce ef bottom top
    X Y Pair input output orbit stabilizer projected coefficient LowerLabel MiddleLabel
    UpperLabel Fiber lowerMap finiteFibers ProjectionTerm projectionTerm drawId rightDrawing
    singletonDrawing eval IsRightTerm
  -- Ian Xiao, § 6.3.1, Theorem 6.7, archived p. 26 and revised published
  -- p. 28. Equation (6.4) is on archived p. 25 and revised p. 27.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- Alphabeta Math presents this proof in paragraphs. These step numbers
  -- follow the published construction and its finite-support converse.
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Step 1. Equivariance transports the entire finitely supported column.
    rintro M z z' ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact ProjectedRightOrbitAux.coefficient_smul a b d c e f M q z
  · -- Step 2. Normalize the first G-coordinate by a simultaneous left action.
    exact ProjectedRightOrbitAux.normalize a b d c e f
  · -- Step 3. Recover the conjugation embeddings and three vertex conditions
    -- from the full stabilizer, using the inverse on the action's F-coordinate.
    intro r t s z₀ P O
    refine ⟨ProjectedRightOrbitAux.projected_equations a b d c e f r t s,
      ProjectedRightOrbitAux.orbit_range a b d c e f r t s, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro g g' x h
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using ProjectedRightOrbitAux.point_eq a b d g' g (r * d.toHom h) x
    · obtain ⟨i, j, k, rDot, tDot, sDot, hj, hr, ht, hs, graph⟩ :=
        ProjectedRightOrbitAux.graph_and_dots a b d c e f r t s
      -- Step 4. The graph yields the exact balance relation on representatives.
      -- MathlibOrbitStabilizer identifies the action quotient. The graph and
      -- the project balance relation identify its classes on this fiber.
      have bij (g : G) (x : D) :
          Set.BijOn (ProjectedRightOrbitAux.fiberOutput a c e f i j t s g)
            {w | lowerMap P i j rDot w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x}
            {y | (input g x, y) ∈ O} :=
        ProjectedRightOrbitAux.fiber_bij a b d c e f r t s g x i j rDot hr graph
      refine ⟨i, j, k, rDot, tDot, sDot, hj, hr, ht, hs, graph, bij, ?_⟩
      -- Step 5. Column support proves finite fibers. Apply the registered
      -- CaseSixRightShapeEvaluation singleton clause and count the unique preimage.
      intro M hM
      have hf := ProjectedRightOrbitAux.finite_supported_orbit a b d c e f M z₀ hM
      refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
      have fin : finiteFibers P i j rDot := by
        intro z
        let x := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d z
        have hx : MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x = z :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct b d z
        have h := (bij 1 x).finite_iff_finite.mpr (hf (input 1 x))
        rw [hx] at h
        exact h
      refine ⟨fin, fun z => ?_⟩
      have hbij (g : G) (x : D) :
          Set.BijOn (ProjectedRightOrbitAux.fiberOutput a c e f i j tDot.element sDot.element g)
            {w | lowerMap P i j rDot w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x}
            {y | (input g x, y) ∈ ProjectedRightOrbitAux.orbit a b d c e f
              rDot.element tDot.element sDot.element} := by
        simpa only [hr, ht, hs] using bij g x
      have hc := ProjectedRightOrbitAux.column_indicator a b d c e f i j k
        rDot tDot sDot fin hbij z
      simpa only [hr, ht, hs] using hc
  · -- Step 6. Every allowed singleton triple is confined to the orbit of its labels.
    intro P
    exact ProjectedRightOrbitAux.singleton_nonzero a b d c e f
  · -- Step 7. The three finite labels and the outer finite sum give finitely
    -- many possible orbits, without requiring that any of the orbits be finite.
    intro terms hterms drawing
    apply ProjectedRightOrbitAux.activeOrbits_fold a b d c e f terms
    intro term hterm
    obtain ⟨P, i, j, k, lower, middle, upper, h⟩ := hterms term hterm
    rw [h]
    exact ProjectedRightOrbitAux.activeOrbits_drawing a b d c e f i j k lower middle upper
  · -- Step 8. At a fixed input, project the column's finite support to orbits.
    intro M p
    apply ((M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single p 1)).support.finite_toSet.image
      (fun y => orbit (p, y))).subset
    rintro O ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hy, rfl⟩
RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer.support:
namespace ProjectedRightOrbitAux

open MackeyDiagrams

section
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E P : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)

private abbrev bottom := (Word.up a).tensor ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d))

private abbrev point (g : G) (x : D) : (bottom a b d).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis g (Generator.mixedPair b d x)

private theorem point_surjective (z : (bottom a b d).basis.carrier) :
    ∃ (g : G) (x : D), point a b d g x = z := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨g, y⟩ => ?_
  exact ⟨g, Generator.mixedProduct b d y, by rw [point, Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct]; rfl⟩

private theorem point_eq (g' g : G) (x' x : D) :
    point a b d g' x' = point a b d g x ↔
      ∃ α : A, g' = g * a.toHom α ∧ x = b.toHom α * x' := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨α, hg, hx⟩ := Quotient.exact h
    change 1 * g' * (a.toHom α)⁻¹ = g at hg
    have hx' := congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct b d) hx
    change (b.toHom α * x' * (1 : D)⁻¹) * (1 * 1 * (d.toHom 1)⁻¹) =
      Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedPair b d x) at hx'
    exact ⟨α, (mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp (by simpa using hg)), (by simpa using hx'.symm)⟩
  · rintro ⟨α, rfl, rfl⟩
    apply Quotient.sound
    refine ⟨α, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change 1 * (g * a.toHom α) * (a.toHom α)⁻¹ = g
      simp
    · change (Biset.restriction b).pair (Biset.induction d)
        (b.toHom α * x' * (1 : D)⁻¹) (1 * 1 * (d.toHom 1)⁻¹) = _
      simp [Generator.mixedPair]

private theorem act_point (q : G × F) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (bottom a b d).basis.act q (point a b d g x) =
      point a b d (q.1 * g) (x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹) := by
  change (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis
    (q.1 * g * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹)
    ((Biset.restriction b).pair (Biset.induction d)
      (b.toHom 1 * x * (1 : D)⁻¹) (1 * 1 * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹)) = _
  simp only [map_one, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, point]
  congr 1
  apply (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).injective
  change x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹ =
    Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedPair b d (x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹))
  simp

private abbrev Pair := (bottom a b d).basis.carrier × (bottom c e f).basis.carrier

private abbrev pairAction : MulAction (G × F) (Pair a b d c e f) where
  smul q z := ((bottom a b d).basis.act q z.1, (bottom c e f).basis.act q z.2)
  one_smul z := Prod.ext ((bottom a b d).basis.one_act z.1) ((bottom c e f).basis.one_act z.2)
  mul_smul q q' z := Prod.ext ((bottom a b d).basis.mul_act q q' z.1)
    ((bottom c e f).basis.mul_act q q' z.2)

private abbrev act (q : G × F) (z : Pair a b d c e f) :=
  (pairAction a b d c e f).smul q z

private abbrev pairOrbit (z : Pair a b d c e f) :=
  @MulAction.orbit (G × F) _ (pairAction a b d c e f).toSMul z

private abbrev base (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) : Pair a b d c e f :=
  (point a b d 1 r, point c e f t s)

private abbrev orbit (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) :=
  pairOrbit a b d c e f (base a b d c e f r t s)

private abbrev stab (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) :=
  @MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) _ _ (pairAction a b d c e f) (base a b d c e f r t s)

private abbrev proj (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) :=
  (stab a b d c e f r t s).map (F.subtype.comp (MonoidHom.snd G F))

private theorem orbit_range (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) :
    orbit a b d c e f r t s = Set.range (fun q : G × F =>
      (point a b d q.1 (r * d.toHom q.2), point c e f (q.1 * t) (s * f.toHom q.2))) := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    refine ⟨(q.1, q.2⁻¹), ?_⟩
    change ((bottom a b d).basis.act q (point a b d 1 r),
      (bottom c e f).basis.act q (point c e f t s)) = z at hq
    rw [act_point a b d, act_point c e f, mul_one] at hq
    simpa only [map_inv] using hq
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    refine ⟨(q.1, q.2⁻¹), ?_⟩
    change ((bottom a b d).basis.act (q.1, q.2⁻¹) (point a b d 1 r),
      (bottom c e f).basis.act (q.1, q.2⁻¹) (point c e f t s)) = z
    rw [act_point a b d, act_point c e f, mul_one]
    simpa only [map_inv, inv_inv] using hq

private theorem stabilizer_equations (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) (q : G × F) :
    q ∈ stab a b d c e f r t s ↔ ∃ (α : A) (κ : C),
      r * d.toHom q.2 * r⁻¹ = b.toHom α ∧ s * f.toHom q.2 * s⁻¹ = e.toHom κ ∧
      q.1 = a.toHom α ∧ a.toHom α = t * c.toHom κ * t⁻¹ := by
  change ((bottom a b d).basis.act q (point a b d 1 r),
    (bottom c e f).basis.act q (point c e f t s)) = base a b d c e f r t s ↔ _
  rw [Prod.ext_iff]
  change ((bottom a b d).basis.act q (point a b d 1 r) = point a b d 1 r ∧
    (bottom c e f).basis.act q (point c e f t s) = point c e f t s) ↔ _
  rw [act_point a b d, act_point c e f, mul_one, point_eq a b d, point_eq c e f]
  simp only [one_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨α, hg, hx⟩, ⟨κ, ht, hy⟩⟩
    refine ⟨α, κ, ?_, ?_, hg, ?_⟩
    · rw [← mul_assoc, eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq] at hx
      rw [hx, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    · rw [← mul_assoc, eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq] at hy
      rw [hy, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    · rw [eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq, ← hg, ht]
  · rintro ⟨α, κ, hx, hy, hg, ht⟩
    refine ⟨⟨α, hg, ?_⟩, ⟨κ, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [← hx]; group
    · rw [hg, ht]; group
    · rw [← hy]; group

private theorem projected_equations (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) (h : F) :
    (h : U) ∈ proj a b d c e f r t s ↔ ∃ (α : A) (κ : C),
      r * d.toHom h * r⁻¹ = b.toHom α ∧ s * f.toHom h * s⁻¹ = e.toHom κ ∧
      a.toHom α = t * c.toHom κ * t⁻¹ := by
  change (∃ q : G × F, q ∈ stab a b d c e f r t s ∧ (q.2 : U) = (h : U)) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨g, h'⟩, hq, hh⟩
    have : h' = h := Subtype.ext hh
    subst h'
    obtain ⟨α, κ, hx, hy, _, ht⟩ := (stabilizer_equations a b d c e f r t s (g, h)).mp hq
    exact ⟨α, κ, hx, hy, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨α, κ, hx, hy, ht⟩
    exact ⟨(a.toHom α, h), (stabilizer_equations a b d c e f r t s _).mpr
      ⟨α, κ, hx, hy, rfl, ht⟩, rfl⟩

private theorem coefficient_smul (M : Biset.Hom Complex (bottom a b d).basis (bottom c e f).basis)
    (q : G × F) (z : Pair a b d c e f) :
    M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (act a b d c e f q z).1 1) (act a b d c e f q z).2 =
      M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2 := by
  change M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single ((bottom a b d).basis.act q z.1) 1)
    ((bottom c e f).basis.act q z.2) = _
  rw [← Biset.actLinear_single, M.commutes]
  -- The output action permutes the basis, so a transported column keeps its coefficient.
  classical
  let Y := (bottom c e f).basis
  let evaluate : (Y.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] Complex :=
    Finsupp.lapply (Y.act q z.2)
  have he : evaluate.comp (Y.actLinear Complex q) = Finsupp.lapply z.2 := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro y r
    change Y.actLinear Complex q (Finsupp.single y r) (Y.act q z.2) = _
    rw [Biset.actLinear_single]
    have heq : Y.act q y = Y.act q z.2 ↔ y = z.2 := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have hh := congrArg (Y.act q⁻¹) h
        simpa only [← Y.mul_act, inv_mul_cancel, Y.one_act] using hh
      · exact congrArg (Y.act q)
    simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, heq]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun he _

private theorem normalize (z : Pair a b d c e f) :
    ∃ (r : D) (t : G) (s : E), z ∈ orbit a b d c e f r t s := by
  obtain ⟨g, r, hg⟩ := point_surjective a b d z.1
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht⟩ := point_surjective c e f z.2
  refine ⟨r, g⁻¹ * t, s, ?_⟩
  rw [orbit_range a b d c e f]
  refine ⟨(g, 1), Prod.ext ?_ ?_⟩
  · change point a b d g (r * d.toHom 1) = z.1
    simpa using hg
  · change point c e f (g * (g⁻¹ * t)) (s * f.toHom 1) = z.2
    simpa using ht

private theorem graph_and_dots (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) :
    let P := proj a b d c e f r t s
    ∃ (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)
      (rDot : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (tDot : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
      (sDot : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)),
      (∀ h : P, (j.toHom h : U) = (h : U)) ∧
      rDot.element = r ∧ tDot.element = t ∧ sDot.element = s ∧
      ∀ q : G × F, q ∈ stab a b d c e f r t s ↔
        ∃ h : P, q = (a.toHom (i.toHom h), j.toHom h) := by
  intro P
  have hPF : P ≤ F := by
    rintro _ ⟨q, _, hq⟩
    exact hq ▸ q.2.property
  let j : ConjEmbedding P F := ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hPF, ⟨1, by simp⟩⟩
  have hj (h : P) : (j.toHom h : U) = (h : U) := rfl
  have hw (h : P) := (projected_equations a b d c e f r t s (j.toHom h)).mp h.property
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := b.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := d.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨ε, hε⟩ := e.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := f.hasRepresentative
  let I := β⁻¹ * (r : U) * δ
  let K := ε⁻¹ * (s : U) * φ
  have hi (h : P) (α : A) (he : r * d.toHom (j.toHom h) * r⁻¹ = b.toHom α) :
      I * (h : U) * I⁻¹ = (α : U) := by
    have he' := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change (r : U) * (d.toHom (j.toHom h) : U) * (r : U)⁻¹ = (b.toHom α : U) at he'
    rw [hδ, hj, hβ] at he'
    calc
      I * (h : U) * I⁻¹ =
          β⁻¹ * ((r : U) * (δ * (h : U) * δ⁻¹) * (r : U)⁻¹) * β := by dsimp [I]; group
      _ = (α : U) := by rw [he']; group
  have hk (h : P) (κ : C) (he : s * f.toHom (j.toHom h) * s⁻¹ = e.toHom κ) :
      K * (h : U) * K⁻¹ = (κ : U) := by
    have he' := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change (s : U) * (f.toHom (j.toHom h) : U) * (s : U)⁻¹ = (e.toHom κ : U) at he'
    rw [hφ, hj, hε] at he'
    calc
      K * (h : U) * K⁻¹ =
          ε⁻¹ * ((s : U) * (φ * (h : U) * φ⁻¹) * (s : U)⁻¹) * ε := by dsimp [K]; group
      _ = (κ : U) := by rw [he']; group
  let i : ConjEmbedding P A := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator I fun h => by
    obtain ⟨α, _, hx, _, _⟩ := hw h
    rw [hi h α hx]
    exact α.property
  let k : ConjEmbedding P C := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator K fun h => by
    obtain ⟨_, κ, _, hy, _⟩ := hw h
    rw [hk h κ hy]
    exact κ.property
  have hEq (h : P) :
      r * d.toHom (j.toHom h) * r⁻¹ = b.toHom (i.toHom h) ∧
      s * f.toHom (j.toHom h) * s⁻¹ = e.toHom (k.toHom h) ∧
      a.toHom (i.toHom h) = t * c.toHom (k.toHom h) * t⁻¹ := by
    obtain ⟨α, κ, hx, hy, ht⟩ := hw h
    have hα : i.toHom h = α := Subtype.ext (hi h α hx)
    have hκ : k.toHom h = κ := Subtype.ext (hk h κ hy)
    exact ⟨hα ▸ hx, hκ ▸ hy, by rw [hα, hκ, ht]⟩
  let rDot : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j) := ⟨r, fun h => by
    change b.toHom (i.toHom h) * r = r * d.toHom (j.toHom h)
    rw [← (hEq h).1, inv_mul_cancel_right]⟩
  let tDot : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k) := ⟨t, fun h => by
    change a.toHom (i.toHom h) * t = t * c.toHom (k.toHom h)
    rw [(hEq h).2.2, inv_mul_cancel_right]⟩
  let sDot : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j) := ⟨s, fun h => by
    change e.toHom (k.toHom h) * s = s * f.toHom (j.toHom h)
    rw [← (hEq h).2.1, inv_mul_cancel_right]⟩
  refine ⟨i, j, k, rDot, tDot, sDot, hj, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    let h : P := ⟨q.2, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩⟩
    have hq₂ : j.toHom h = q.2 := rfl
    refine ⟨h, Prod.ext ?_ hq₂.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨α, κ, hx, _, hq₁, _⟩ := (stabilizer_equations a b d c e f r t s q).mp hq
    rw [hq₁, b.injective (hx.symm.trans (by simpa only [hq₂] using (hEq h).1))]
  · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
    exact (stabilizer_equations a b d c e f r t s _).mpr
      ⟨i.toHom h, k.toHom h, (hEq h).1, (hEq h).2.1, rfl, (hEq h).2.2⟩

private abbrev fiber (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) :=
  ((Word.up i).tensor (.down j)).basis.carrier

private abbrev innerPoint (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (v : A × F) :
    fiber i j := (Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) v.1 v.2

private abbrev parameters (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) (g : G) (v : A × F) :
    Pair a b d c e f :=
  (point a b d (g * a.toHom v.1) (r * d.toHom v.2),
    point c e f (g * a.toHom v.1 * t) (s * f.toHom v.2))

private theorem parameters_action (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) (g : G) (v : A × F) :
    parameters a b d c e f r t s g v =
      act a b d c e f (g * a.toHom v.1, v.2⁻¹) (base a b d c e f r t s) := by
  change (_, _) = ((bottom a b d).basis.act _ _, (bottom c e f).basis.act _ _)
  rw [act_point a b d, act_point c e f]
  simp only [map_inv, inv_inv, mul_one]

private theorem parameters_eq (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) (g : G)
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F)
    (graph : ∀ q : G × F, q ∈ stab a b d c e f r t s ↔
      ∃ h : P, q = (a.toHom (i.toHom h), j.toHom h)) (u v : A × F) :
    parameters a b d c e f r t s g u = parameters a b d c e f r t s g v ↔
      innerPoint i j u = innerPoint i j v := by
  -- The full stabilizer identifies exactly the representatives of one balanced class.
  let := pairAction a b d c e f
  let z := base a b d c e f r t s
  let qu : G × F := (g * a.toHom u.1, u.2⁻¹)
  let qv : G × F := (g * a.toHom v.1, v.2⁻¹)
  rw [parameters_action a b d c e f, parameters_action a b d c e f]
  change qu • z = qv • z ↔ _
  let S := MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) z
  let equiv := (MulAction.orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer (G × F) z).symm
  have hcoset : qu • z = qv • z ↔ qv⁻¹ * qu ∈ S := by
    rw [← QuotientGroup.eq]
    change (equiv (QuotientGroup.mk qu)).val = (equiv (QuotientGroup.mk qv)).val ↔ _
    exact ⟨fun h => (equiv.injective (Subtype.ext h)).symm,
      fun h => congrArg (fun q => (equiv q).val) h.symm⟩
  have hgraph : qu • z = qv • z ↔
      ∃ h : P, qu = qv * (a.toHom (i.toHom h), j.toHom h) := by
    rw [hcoset]
    change qv⁻¹ * qu ∈ stab a b d c e f r t s ↔ _
    simp only [graph, inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul]
  rw [hgraph]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hp
    have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd hp
    change g * a.toHom u.1 = g * a.toHom v.1 * a.toHom (i.toHom p) at h1
    change u.2⁻¹ = v.2⁻¹ * j.toHom p at h2
    have ha : u.1 = v.1 * i.toHom p := a.injective (by
      rw [map_mul]
      rw [mul_assoc] at h1
      exact mul_left_cancel h1)
    have hf : u.2 = (j.toHom p)⁻¹ * v.2 := by
      simpa only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] using congrArg Inv.inv h2
    apply Quotient.sound
    refine ⟨p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change 1 * u.1 * (i.toHom p)⁻¹ = v.1
      simp only [ha, one_mul, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    · change j.toHom p * u.2 * (1 : F)⁻¹ = v.2
      simp only [hf, inv_one, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel_left]
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, h1, h2⟩ := Quotient.exact h
    change 1 * u.1 * (i.toHom p)⁻¹ = v.1 at h1
    change j.toHom p * u.2 * (1 : F)⁻¹ = v.2 at h2
    simp only [one_mul] at h1
    simp only [inv_one, mul_one] at h2
    refine ⟨p, Prod.ext ?_ ?_⟩
    · change g * a.toHom u.1 = g * a.toHom v.1 * a.toHom (i.toHom p)
      rw [← h1, map_mul, map_inv]
      group
    · change u.2⁻¹ = v.2⁻¹ * j.toHom p
      rw [← h2, mul_inv_rev]
      group

private abbrev fiberMap (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F)
    (rDot : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) :=
  Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j rDot

private noncomputable abbrev fiberOutput (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F)
    (t : G) (s : E) (g : G) (w : fiber i j) :=
  point c e f (g * a.toHom (Quotient.out w).1 * t) (s * f.toHom (Quotient.out w).2)

private theorem fiber_source (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F)
    (rDot : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (x : D) (w : fiber i j) :
    fiberMap b d i j rDot w = Generator.mixedPair b d x ↔
      b.toHom (Quotient.out w).1 * rDot.element * d.toHom (Quotient.out w).2 = x := by
  have he : fiberMap b d i j rDot w =
      Generator.mixedPair b d
        (b.toHom (Quotient.out w).1 * rDot.element * d.toHom (Quotient.out w).2) :=
    congrArg (fiberMap b d i j rDot) (Quotient.out_eq' w).symm
  rw [he]
  exact (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).symm.injective.eq_iff

private theorem fiber_maps (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F)
    (rDot : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : G) (s : E) (g : G) (x : D) :
    Set.MapsTo (fiberOutput a c e f i j t s g)
      {w | fiberMap b d i j rDot w = Generator.mixedPair b d x}
      {y | (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f rDot.element t s} := by
  intro w hw
  change (point a b d g x, fiberOutput a c e f i j t s g w) ∈ orbit a b d c e f rDot.element t s
  rw [orbit_range a b d c e f]
  refine ⟨(g * a.toHom (Quotient.out w).1, (Quotient.out w).2), Prod.ext ?_ rfl⟩
  change point a b d (g * a.toHom (Quotient.out w).1)
    (rDot.element * d.toHom (Quotient.out w).2) = point a b d g x
  exact (point_eq a b d _ _ _ _).mpr
    ⟨(Quotient.out w).1, rfl, by rw [← mul_assoc]; exact ((fiber_source b d i j rDot x w).mp hw).symm⟩

private theorem fiber_bij (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) (g : G) (x : D)
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F)
    (rDot : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (hr : rDot.element = r)
    (graph : ∀ q : G × F, q ∈ stab a b d c e f r t s ↔
      ∃ h : P, q = (a.toHom (i.toHom h), j.toHom h)) :
    Set.BijOn (fiberOutput a c e f i j t s g)
      {w | fiberMap b d i j rDot w = Generator.mixedPair b d x}
      {y | (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f r t s} := by
  subst r
  have source_eq (w : fiber i j)
      (hw : fiberMap b d i j rDot w = Generator.mixedPair b d x) :
      (parameters a b d c e f rDot.element t s g (Quotient.out w)).1 = point a b d g x := by
    apply (point_eq a b d _ _ _ _).mpr
    exact ⟨(Quotient.out w).1, rfl, by
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      exact ((fiber_source b d i j rDot x w).mp hw).symm⟩
  refine ⟨fiber_maps a b d c e f i j rDot t s g x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu v hv huv
    have he := Prod.ext ((source_eq u hu).trans (source_eq v hv).symm) huv
    have he' := (parameters_eq a b d c e f rDot.element t s g i j graph _ _).mp he
    exact (Quotient.out_eq' u).symm.trans (he'.trans (Quotient.out_eq' v))
  · intro y hy
    change (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f rDot.element t s at hy
    rw [orbit_range a b d c e f] at hy
    obtain ⟨⟨g', h⟩, hpair⟩ := hy
    have hg := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
    have hy := congrArg Prod.snd hpair
    change point a b d g' (rDot.element * d.toHom h) = point a b d g x at hg
    change point c e f (g' * t) (s * f.toHom h) = y at hy
    obtain ⟨α, hα, hx⟩ := (point_eq a b d _ _ _ _).mp hg
    let w := innerPoint i j (α, h)
    have hw : innerPoint i j (Quotient.out w) = innerPoint i j (α, h) := Quotient.out_eq' w
    refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change Generator.mixedPair b d (b.toHom α * rDot.element * d.toHom h) = Generator.mixedPair b d x
      rw [mul_assoc, hx]
    · have hp := (parameters_eq a b d c e f rDot.element t s g i j graph _ _).mpr hw
      have he := congrArg Prod.snd hp
      change fiberOutput a c e f i j t s g w = point c e f (g * a.toHom α * t) (s * f.toHom h) at he
      rwa [← hα, hy] at he

private abbrev Lower (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) :=
  Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)

private abbrev Middle (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (k : ConjEmbedding P C) :=
  Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)

private abbrev Upper (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C) :=
  Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)

private abbrev Fibers (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (r : Lower b d i j) :=
  ∀ z : ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis.carrier, Set.Finite {w | fiberMap b d i j r w = z}

private abbrev drawId {H K : Subgroup U} (p : Word H K) :=
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)

private noncomputable abbrev drawing
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)
    (lower : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (middle : List (Complex × Middle a c i k)) (upper : List (Complex × Upper e f j k)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom a b d) (bottom c e f) :=
  .vertical
    (.horizontal (drawId (.up a)) (.compactProjection b d i j lower))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.up a) (.up i) (.down j)))
      (.vertical (.horizontal (.parallelUp a i c k middle) (drawId (.down j)))
        (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate (.up c) (.up k) (.down j)))
          (.horizontal (drawId (.up c)) (.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper)))))

private noncomputable abbrev singleton
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)
    (r : Lower b d i j) (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k) (finite : Fibers b d i j r) :=
  drawing a b d c e f i j k [(1, ⟨r, finite⟩)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]

private noncomputable abbrev coef
    (M : Biset.Hom Complex (bottom a b d).basis (bottom c e f).basis) (z : Pair a b d c e f) :=
  M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2

private theorem singleton_eval
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)
    (r : Lower b d i j) (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k)
    (finite : Fibers b d i j r) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (singleton a b d c e f i j k r t s finite).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1) =
    ∑ w ∈ (finite (Generator.mixedPair b d x)).toFinset,
      Finsupp.single (fiberOutput a c e f i j t.element s.element g w) 1 := by
  -- The registered equation (6.4) uses mixedProduct-valued fibers.
  -- mixedPair and mixedProduct are inverse, so the supplied finiteness gives
  -- the required hypothesis, and the two finite sums use the same classes.
  have eq (y : D) (w : fiber i j) :
      Generator.mixedProduct b d (fiberMap b d i j r w) = y ↔
        fiberMap b d i j r w = Generator.mixedPair b d y := by
    constructor
    · intro hw
      apply (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).injective
      exact hw.trans (Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair b d y).symm
    · intro hw
      rw [hw, Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
  have h (y : D) : Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedProduct b d (fiberMap b d i j r w) = y} :=
    (finite (Generator.mixedPair b d y)).subset (fun w hw => (eq y w).mp hw)
  have hFinset : (h x).toFinset = (finite (Generator.mixedPair b d x)).toFinset := by
    ext w
    simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using eq x w
  have supplied := (CaseSixRightShapeEvaluation G A D F C E P a b d c e f i j k).1 r h t s g x
  change (singleton a b d c e f i j k r t s finite).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1) =
      ∑ w ∈ (h x).toFinset, Finsupp.single (fiberOutput a c e f i j t.element s.element g w) 1 at supplied
  rwa [hFinset] at supplied

private theorem singleton_nonzero
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)
    (r : Lower b d i j) (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k)
    (finite : Fibers b d i j r) (z : Pair a b d c e f) :
    coef a b d c e f (singleton a b d c e f i j k r t s finite).interpret.eval z ≠ 0 →
      z ∈ orbit a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨g, x, hx⟩ := point_surjective a b d z.1
  have hz : z = (point a b d g x, z.2) := Prod.ext hx.symm rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [hz]
  conv_rhs => rw [hz]
  intro hn
  by_contra hout
  apply hn
  change (singleton a b d c e f i j k r t s finite).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1) z.2 = 0
  rw [singleton_eval a b d c e f, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro w hw
  have hmem := fiber_maps a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hw)
  have hne : fiberOutput a c e f i j t.element s.element g w ≠ z.2 := by
    intro he
    exact hout (he ▸ hmem)
  exact Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne.symm

private theorem column_indicator
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)
    (r : Lower b d i j) (t : Middle a c i k) (s : Upper e f j k)
    (finite : Fibers b d i j r)
    (bij : ∀ (g : G) (x : D), Set.BijOn (fiberOutput a c e f i j t.element s.element g)
      {w | fiberMap b d i j r w = Generator.mixedPair b d x}
      {y | (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element})
    (z : Pair a b d c e f) :
    coef a b d c e f (singleton a b d c e f i j k r t s finite).interpret.eval z =
      @ite Complex (z ∈ orbit a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hz : z ∈ orbit a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element
  · rw [ite_eq_left hz]
    obtain ⟨g, x, hx⟩ := point_surjective a b d z.1
    have hmem : z.2 ∈ {y | (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element} :=
      (Prod.ext hx rfl : (point a b d g x, z.2) = z) ▸ hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw, he⟩ := (bij g x).surjOn hmem
    change (singleton a b d c e f i j k r t s finite).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2 = 1
    rw [← hx, singleton_eval a b d c e f, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
      Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem w ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr hw)]
    · rw [he, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    · intro v hv hne
      apply Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne
      exact fun hv' => hne ((bij g x).injOn ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mp hv) hw (hv'.symm.trans he.symm))
  · rw [ite_eq_right hz]
    exact not_ne_iff.mp (mt (singleton_nonzero a b d c e f i j k r t s finite z) hz)

private theorem finite_supported_orbit
    (M : Biset.Hom Complex (bottom a b d).basis (bottom c e f).basis)
    (z₀ : Pair a b d c e f) (hn : coef a b d c e f M z₀ ≠ 0)
    (p : (bottom a b d).basis.carrier) :
    Set.Finite {y | (p, y) ∈ pairOrbit a b d c e f z₀} := by
  apply (M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single p 1)).support.finite_toSet.subset
  rintro y ⟨q, hq⟩
  have he := coefficient_smul a b d c e f M q z₀
  change act a b d c e f q z₀ = (p, y) at hq
  change coef a b d c e f M (act a b d c e f q z₀) = coef a b d c e f M z₀ at he
  rw [hq] at he
  apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
  change coef a b d c e f M (p, y) ≠ 0
  rwa [he]

end

section ListLinearity

variable {V W Z I : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [AddCommMonoid W] [AddCommMonoid Z]
variable [Module Complex V] [Module Complex W] [Module Complex Z]

private abbrev weightedMaps (terms : List (Complex × I)) (m : I → V →ₗ[Complex] W) :=
  (terms.map fun p => p.1 • m p.2).sum

private theorem weightedMaps_apply (terms : List (Complex × I)) (m : I → V →ₗ[Complex] W)
    (x : V) (T : W →ₗ[Complex] Z) :
    T (weightedMaps terms m x) = (terms.map fun p => p.1 • T (m p.2 x)).sum := by
  induction terms with
  | nil => simp [weightedMaps]
  | cons p terms ih =>
    simp only [weightedMaps, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add, map_smul]
    rw [ih]

private theorem weightedMaps_zero (terms : List (Complex × I)) (m : I → V →ₗ[Complex] W)
    (x : V) (T : W →ₗ[Complex] Z) (h : ∀ p ∈ terms, T (m p.2 x) = 0) :
    T (weightedMaps terms m x) = 0 := by
  rw [weightedMaps_apply]
  apply List.sum_eq_zero
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hz
  rw [h p hp, smul_zero]

end ListLinearity

section DiagramLinearity
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H J : Subgroup U} {I : Type*}

private noncomputable abbrev weighted {p q : Word K H} (terms : List (Complex × I))
    (diagr : I → Diagram Complex p q) :=
  ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (terms.map fun p => (p.1, .ordinary (diagr p.2)))

private theorem frameLeft (p : Word K H) {q q' : Word H J}
    (terms : List (Complex × I)) (diagr : I → Diagram Complex q q') :
    ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (weighted terms diagr).eval).toLinearMap =
      weightedMaps terms (fun i => ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (diagr i).eval).toLinearMap) := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (weighted terms diagr).eval).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single]
  let pair := Biset.pairLinear Complex p.basis q'.basis ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single x 1))
  let T := (LinearMap.lsmul Complex _ r).comp pair
  change T ((weighted terms diagr).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1)) = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, List.map_map, map_list_sum]
  rw [← LinearMap.id_apply (R := Complex) (weightedMaps _ _ _), weightedMaps_apply]
  simp only [List.map_map, LinearMap.id_apply]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro term _
  change T (term.1 • (diagr term.2).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1)) = term.1 •
    ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal (diagr term.2).eval).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r)
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single]
  exact map_smul T term.1 _

private theorem frameRight {p p' : Word K H} (q : Word H J)
    (terms : List (Complex × I)) (diagr : I → Diagram Complex p p') :
    ((weighted terms diagr).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap =
      weightedMaps terms (fun i => ((diagr i).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap) := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change ((weighted terms diagr).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single]
  let pair := (Biset.pairLinear Complex p'.basis q.basis).flip ((Biset.Hom.id q.basis).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single y 1))
  let T := (LinearMap.lsmul Complex _ r).comp pair
  change T ((weighted terms diagr).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, List.map_map, map_list_sum]
  rw [← LinearMap.id_apply (R := Complex) (weightedMaps _ _ _), weightedMaps_apply]
  simp only [List.map_map, LinearMap.id_apply]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro term _
  change T (term.1 • (diagr term.2).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) = term.1 •
    ((diagr term.2).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id q.basis)).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis x y) r)
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single]
  exact map_smul T term.1 _

end DiagramLinearity

section FiniteLabels
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E P : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
variable (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (k : ConjEmbedding P C)

private noncomputable abbrev projection (r : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)) ((Word.up i).tensor (.down j)) :=
  .mixedProjection b d i j r.dot r.finite

private noncomputable abbrev middle (t : Middle a c i k) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (.up i)) ((Word.up c).tensor (.up k)) :=
  .parallelUp a i c k t

private noncomputable abbrev multiplication (s : Upper e f j k) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up k).tensor (.down j)) ((Word.down e).tensor (.up f)) :=
  .mixedMultiplication e f k j s

private noncomputable abbrev firstMap (r : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) :=
  ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.up a).basis).horizontal (projection b d i j r).eval).toLinearMap

private noncomputable abbrev secondMap (t : Middle a c i k) :=
  ((middle a c i k t).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down j).basis)).toLinearMap

private noncomputable abbrev thirdMap (s : Upper e f j k) :=
  ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.up c).basis).horizontal (multiplication e f j k s).eval).toLinearMap

private noncomputable abbrev unassoc :=
  (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) (.up a) (.up i) (.down j)).eval.toLinearMap

private noncomputable abbrev assoc :=
  (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.up c) (.up k) (.down j)).eval.toLinearMap

private theorem drawing_eval
    (l : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (m : List (Complex × Middle a c i k)) (n : List (Complex × Upper e f j k))
    (x : (bottom a b d).basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    (drawing a b d c e f i j k l m n).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x =
      weightedMaps n (thirdMap c e f j k)
        (assoc c j k (weightedMaps m (secondMap a c i j k)
          (unassoc a i j (weightedMaps l (firstMap a b d i j) x)))) := by
  change ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.up c).basis).horizontal
      (weighted n (multiplication e f j k)).eval).toLinearMap
    (assoc c j k (((weighted m (middle a c i k)).eval.horizontal
      (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down j).basis)).toLinearMap
      (unassoc a i j (((Biset.Hom.id (Word.up a).basis).horizontal
        (weighted l (projection b d i j)).eval).toLinearMap x)))) = _
  rw [frameLeft (.up a) l (projection b d i j),
    frameRight (.down j) m (middle a c i k), frameLeft (.up c) n (multiplication e f j k)]

private noncomputable abbrev labelOrbits
    (l : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (m : List (Complex × Middle a c i k)) (n : List (Complex × Upper e f j k)) :=
  l.flatMap fun r => m.flatMap fun t => n.map fun s =>
    orbit a b d c e f r.2.dot.element t.2.element s.2.element

private theorem drawing_support
    (l : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (m : List (Complex × Middle a c i k)) (n : List (Complex × Upper e f j k))
    (z : Pair a b d c e f)
    (hn : coef a b d c e f (drawing a b d c e f i j k l m n).interpret.eval z ≠ 0) :
    pairOrbit a b d c e f z ∈ labelOrbits a b d c e f i j k l m n := by
  -- The three lists expand independently and allow repeated elements and
  -- explicit zero coefficients. The supplier's weighted clause uses Finsupp.
  classical
  by_contra hout
  apply hn
  let x : (bottom a b d).basis.carrier →₀ Complex := Finsupp.single z.1 1
  let coeff : ((bottom c e f).basis.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] Complex :=
    Finsupp.lapply z.2
  let lMap := firstMap a b d i j
  let mMap := secondMap a c i j k
  let nMap := thirdMap c e f j k
  let pre := unassoc a i j
  let post := assoc c j k
  let allN := weightedMaps n nMap
  let allM := weightedMaps m mMap
  change coeff ((drawing a b d c e f i j k l m n).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x) = 0
  rw [drawing_eval a b d c e f i j k]
  change (coeff.comp (allN.comp (post.comp (allM.comp pre)))) (weightedMaps l lMap x) = 0
  apply weightedMaps_zero
  intro r hr
  change (coeff.comp (allN.comp post)) (weightedMaps m mMap (pre (lMap r.2 x))) = 0
  apply weightedMaps_zero
  intro t ht
  change coeff (weightedMaps n nMap (post (mMap t.2 (pre (lMap r.2 x))))) = 0
  apply weightedMaps_zero
  intro s hs
  let one := singleton a b d c e f i j k r.2.dot t.2 s.2 r.2.finite
  have hzero : coef a b d c e f one.interpret.eval z = 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hout
    have hm := singleton_nonzero a b d c e f i j k r.2.dot t.2 s.2 r.2.finite z h
    have horbit := (@MulAction.orbit_eq_iff _ _ _ (pairAction a b d c e f) _ _).mpr hm
    change pairOrbit a b d c e f z = orbit a b d c e f r.2.dot.element t.2.element s.2.element at horbit
    rw [horbit]
    exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨r, hr, List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨t, ht, List.mem_map.mpr ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  change coeff (one.interpret.eval.toLinearMap x) = 0 at hzero
  unfold one at hzero
  rw [singleton, drawing_eval a b d c e f i j k] at hzero
  simpa only [weightedMaps, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil,
    add_zero, one_smul] using hzero

private abbrev Drawing := LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom a b d) (bottom c e f)

private noncomputable abbrev activeOrbits (drawing : Drawing a b d c e f) : Set (Set (Pair a b d c e f)) :=
  {O | ∃ z, O = pairOrbit a b d c e f z ∧ coef a b d c e f drawing.interpret.eval z ≠ 0}

private theorem activeOrbits_drawing
    (l : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (m : List (Complex × Middle a c i k)) (n : List (Complex × Upper e f j k)) :
    (activeOrbits a b d c e f (drawing a b d c e f i j k l m n)).Finite := by
  apply (labelOrbits a b d c e f i j k l m n).finite_toSet.subset
  rintro O ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩
  exact drawing_support a b d c e f i j k l m n z hz

private noncomputable abbrev foldDrawings (terms : List (Complex × Drawing a b d c e f)) :=
  terms.foldr (fun term rest => LabelledDrawing.add (LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 term.2) rest)
    (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.zero (R := Complex) (bottom a b d) (bottom c e f)))

private theorem activeOrbits_fold (terms : List (Complex × Drawing a b d c e f))
    (hf : ∀ term ∈ terms, (activeOrbits a b d c e f term.2).Finite) :
    (activeOrbits a b d c e f (foldDrawings a b d c e f terms)).Finite := by
  induction terms with
  | nil =>
    apply Set.finite_empty.subset
    rintro O ⟨z, _, hz⟩
    exact False.elim (hz (by rfl))
  | cons term terms ih =>
    have h₁ := hf term (List.mem_cons_self)
    have h₂ := ih (fun t ht => hf t (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ht))
    apply (h₁.union h₂).subset
    rintro O ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩
    by_contra hout
    have hterm : coef a b d c e f term.2.interpret.eval z = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hout (Or.inl ⟨z, rfl, hn⟩)
    have hrest : coef a b d c e f (foldDrawings a b d c e f terms).interpret.eval z = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hout (Or.inr ⟨z, rfl, hn⟩)
    apply hz
    let v := Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)
    change (term.1 • term.2.interpret.eval.toLinearMap v +
      (foldDrawings a b d c e f terms).interpret.eval.toLinearMap v) z.2 = 0
    change term.2.interpret.eval.toLinearMap v z.2 = 0 at hterm
    change (foldDrawings a b d c e f terms).interpret.eval.toLinearMap v z.2 = 0 at hrest
    rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, hterm, hrest, smul_zero, add_zero]

end FiniteLabels
end ProjectedRightOrbitAux

external.usage: Instantiated on the diagonal action of G × F at the chosen pair. The inverse equivalence sends a stabilizer coset to the corresponding translated pair. Its injectivity identifies equal translated pairs with equal cosets, so the checked stabilizer graph gives the exact balance relation on the projection fiber. Column support supplies the finiteness separately.

FiniteParabolicJoinOfFamily.proof:
by
  classical
  intro blockSym parabolicOn parabolic ι _ A hA J
  -- Xiao, § 7.5, applies Proposition 7.1 to a finite family.
  -- The endpoint is on p. 33 of the archived source/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- (SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2)
  -- and p. 35 of the revised published PDF, matching article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- (SHA-256 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e).
  -- The saved source note conflates the two copies. Both pages state this endpoint.
  -- Reindex any finite partition by Fin, including the empty partition.
  have ofFamily {κ : Type} [Finite κ] (X : Finset Nat) (blocks : κ → Finset Nat)
      (hne : ∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty)
      (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)))
      (hc : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ blocks i) :
      parabolicOn X (⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)) := by
    let _ : Fintype κ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
    let e := (Fintype.equivFin κ).symm
    refine ⟨Fintype.card κ, blocks ∘ e, fun i => hne (e i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact fun i j hij => hd (fun he => hij (e.injective he))
    · intro x
      rw [hc x]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨e.symm i, by simpa only [Function.comp_apply, e.apply_symm_apply] using hi⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨e i, hi⟩
    · exact (e.iSup_comp (g := fun i => blockSym (blocks i))).symm
  have singletonSym (x : Nat) : blockSym {x} = ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
    have hτ : τ = 1 := by
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro y
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp (τ y).property).trans
        (Finset.mem_singleton.mp y.property).symm
    rw [hτ, map_one]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  -- The binary formula takes two partitions of the same finite set.
  -- Padding by singleton blocks adds only trivial symmetric factors.
  have pad {X Y : Finset Nat} {H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} (hXY : X ⊆ Y)
      (hH : parabolicOn X H) : parabolicOn Y H := by
    obtain ⟨n, B, hne, hd, hc, rfl⟩ := hH
    let blocks : Fin n ⊕ ↥(Y \ X) → Finset Nat := Sum.elim B (fun y => {y.val})
    have hsup : (⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)) = ⨆ i, blockSym (B i) := by
      rw [iSup_sum]
      suffices h : (⨆ j : ↥(Y \ X), blockSym {j.val}) = ⊥ by
        change (⨆ i, blockSym (B i)) ⊔ (⨆ j : ↥(Y \ X), blockSym {j.val}) = _
        rw [h, sup_bot_eq]
      simp only [singletonSym, iSup_bot]
    rw [← hsup]
    refine ofFamily Y blocks ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro (i | y)
      · exact hne i
      · exact Finset.singleton_nonempty _
    · intro i j hij
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hy
      cases i with
      | inl i =>
          cases j with
          | inl j => exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd (fun h => hij (congrArg Sum.inl h))) hx hy
          | inr y =>
              exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp y.property).2
                ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy) ▸ (hc x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
      | inr y =>
          cases j with
          | inl j =>
              exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp y.property).2
                ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx) ▸ (hc x).mpr ⟨j, hy⟩)
          | inr z =>
              exact hij (congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext
                ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).symm.trans (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy))))
    · intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        by_cases hxX : x ∈ X
        · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (hc x).mp hxX
          exact ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx, hxX⟩⟩, Finset.mem_singleton_self x⟩
      · rintro ⟨i | y, hx⟩
        · exact hXY ((hc x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
        · exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).symm ▸ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp y.property).1
  -- Proposition 7.1 uses swaps along overlapping blocks. The compiled supplier
  -- proves that step by walk induction, as in Alphabeta Math's adjacent
  -- transposition proof, steps 1.1 and 2.1, with overlaps in place of consecutive
  -- integers. It generates each component group by the finitary swap-closure
  -- criterion, in place of the cycle factorization in steps 1.1 and 2.1 of the
  -- general transposition proof. Here we verify the resulting partition.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-adjacent-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
  have joinOn (X : Finset Nat) {κ ν : Type} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ν]
      (B : κ → Finset Nat) (C : ν → Finset Nat)
      (hneB : ∀ i, (B i).Nonempty) (hneC : ∀ j, (C j).Nonempty)
      (hdB : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (B i) (B j)))
      (hdC : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (C i) (C j)))
      (hcB : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ B i)
      (hcC : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ j, x ∈ C j) :
      parabolicOn X ((⨆ i, blockSym (B i)) ⊔ (⨆ j, blockSym (C j))) := by
    let block : κ ⊕ ν → Finset Nat := Sum.elim B C
    let overlap : (κ ⊕ ν) → (κ ⊕ ν) → Prop := fun u v =>
      match u, v with
      | Sum.inl i, Sum.inr j => (B i ∩ C j).Nonempty
      | _, _ => False
    let graph := SimpleGraph.fromRel overlap
    let componentBlock (c : graph.ConnectedComponent) : Finset Nat :=
      let inComponent : Nat → Prop := fun x =>
        ∃ v, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v
      @Finset.filter Nat inComponent (Classical.decPred inComponent) X
    have memComponent (c : graph.ConnectedComponent) (x : Nat) :
        x ∈ componentBlock c ↔ x ∈ X ∧ ∃ v, graph.connectedComponentMk v = c ∧ x ∈ block v :=
      @Finset.mem_filter Nat _ (Classical.decPred _) _ _
    have blockNonempty (v : κ ⊕ ν) : (block v).Nonempty := by
      cases v with
      | inl i => exact hneB i
      | inr j => exact hneC j
    have blockSubset (v : κ ⊕ ν) : block v ⊆ X := by
      intro x hx
      cases v with
      | inl i => exact (hcB x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩
      | inr j => exact (hcC x).mpr ⟨j, hx⟩
    have sameBlock {μ : Type} {blocks : μ → Finset Nat}
        (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)))
        {i j : μ} {x : Nat} (hi : x ∈ blocks i) (hj : x ∈ blocks j) : i = j := by
      by_contra h
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd h) hi hj
    have across {i j} {x : Nat} (hi : x ∈ B i) (hj : x ∈ C j) :
        graph.connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl i) = graph.connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr j) := by
      apply SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj
      exact (SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj overlap _ _).mpr
        ⟨Sum.inl_ne_inr, Or.inl ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hi, hj⟩⟩⟩
    have sameComponent {u v : κ ⊕ ν} {x : Nat} (hu : x ∈ block u) (hv : x ∈ block v) :
        graph.connectedComponentMk u = graph.connectedComponentMk v := by
      cases u <;> cases v
      · rw [sameBlock hdB hu hv]
      · exact across hu hv
      · exact (across hv hu).symm
      · rw [sameBlock hdC hu hv]
    have joinFormula :
        ((⨆ i, blockSym (B i)) ⊔ (⨆ j, blockSym (C j))) = ⨆ c, blockSym (componentBlock c) :=
      FiniteParabolicJoinBlocks X B C hneB hneC hdB hdC hcB hcC
    rw [joinFormula]
    refine ofFamily X componentBlock ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro c
      induction c using SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.ind with
      | h v =>
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := blockNonempty v
        exact ⟨x, (memComponent _ x).mpr ⟨blockSubset v hx, v, rfl, hx⟩⟩
    · intro c d h
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hy
      obtain ⟨_, u, huc, hu⟩ := (memComponent c x).mp hx
      obtain ⟨_, v, hvd, hv⟩ := (memComponent d x).mp hy
      exact h (huc.symm.trans ((sameComponent hu hv).trans hvd))
    · intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (hcB x).mp hx
        exact ⟨graph.connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl i), (memComponent _ x).mpr ⟨hx, Sum.inl i, rfl, hi⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨c, hx⟩
        exact ((memComponent c x).mp hx).1
  have parabolicSup {H K : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} (hH : parabolic H) (hK : parabolic K) :
      parabolic (H ⊔ K) := by
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := hH
    obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := hK
    obtain ⟨n, B, hneB, hdB, hcB, rfl⟩ := pad (Y := X ∪ Y) Finset.subset_union_left hX
    obtain ⟨m, C, hneC, hdC, hcC, rfl⟩ := pad (Y := X ∪ Y) Finset.subset_union_right hY
    exact ⟨X ∪ Y, joinOn _ B C hneB hneC hdB hdC hcB hcC⟩
  have parabolicBot : parabolic ⊥ := by
    let blocks : Fin 0 → Finset Nat := Fin.elim0
    have h := ofFamily ∅ blocks (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (by simp)
    exact ⟨∅, by simpa only [iSup_of_empty] using h⟩
  -- Iterate the binary formula starting at the trivial subgroup.
  have parabolicFinset (s : Finset ι) : parabolic (s.sup A) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simpa only [Finset.sup_empty] using parabolicBot
    | insert i s _ ih =>
      rw [Finset.sup_insert]
      exact parabolicSup (hA i) ih
  let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  -- The generated-subgroup minimality used in Alphabeta Math's transposition
  -- proof, step 3.1, applies to this union as a subset of the ambient permutation
  -- group. Union membership supplies the generators and checks their containment.
  have member_le (i : ι) : A i ≤ J := fun g hg =>
    Subgroup.subset_closure (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hg⟩)
  have least (P : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) (hP : ∀ i, A i ≤ P) : J ≤ P := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    intro g hg
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hg
    exact hP i hi
  have closure_eq : J = ⨆ i, A i :=
    le_antisymm (least _ (le_iSup A)) (iSup_le member_le)
  have sup_univ : (Finset.univ : Finset ι).sup A = ⨆ i, A i :=
    le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le_iff.mpr (fun i _ => le_iSup A i))
      (iSup_le fun i => Finset.le_sup (f := A) (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have parabolicJ : parabolic J := by
    rw [closure_eq, ← sup_univ]
    exact parabolicFinset _
  exact ⟨⟨⟨parabolicJ, member_le⟩, fun P hP => least P hP.2⟩, least⟩

external.usage: Use a vertex representative for an arbitrary connected component. The corresponding nonempty input block lies in the common finite carrier and supplies a point in the filtered component block.

Two input blocks on opposite sides sharing a point are adjacent in the bipartite overlap graph. Equality of their connected components gives the cross-side case in pairwise disjointness of component blocks.

StandardTwoBlockRepresentatives.proof:
by
  intro n n1 n2 hn1 h1n hn2 h2n X G interval XBlock YBlock blockSym K H s t m a
  have hs₁ : s ≤ n1 := min_le_left ..
  have hs₂ : s ≤ n2 := min_le_right ..
  have ht₁ : n1 ≤ t := le_max_left ..
  have ht₂ : n2 ≤ t := le_max_right ..
  have hst : s ≤ t := hs₁.trans ht₁
  have htn : t ≤ n := max_le h1n.le h2n.le
  have hms : m ≤ s := min_le_left ..
  have hmt : m ≤ n - t := min_le_right ..
  have hsum : s + t = n1 + n2 := by
    rcases le_total n1 n2 with h | h
    · simp [s, t, min_eq_left h, max_eq_right h]
    · simp [s, t, min_eq_right h, max_eq_left h, Nat.add_comm]
  -- Xiao, §7.3 (archived pp. 30–31, revised published pp. 32–33),
  -- specifies a recursive family of actual transpositions. In Lean the
  -- article's step j+1 is indexed by j : Fin m.
  let left (j : Fin m) : ↥X :=
    ⟨s - j.val, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by have := j.isLt; omega, by omega⟩⟩
  let right (j : Fin m) : ↥X :=
    ⟨t + j.val + 1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, by have := j.isLt; omega⟩⟩
  let τ (j : Fin m) : G := Equiv.swap (left j) (right j)
  let σ : Fin (m + 1) → G :=
    Fin.induction (motive := fun _ => G) 1 (fun j prev => τ j * prev)
  have hzero : σ 0 = 1 := by simp only [σ, Fin.induction_zero]
  have hsucc (j : Fin m) : σ j.succ = τ j * σ j.castSucc := by
    simp only [σ, Fin.induction_succ]
  have himage (i : Fin (m + 1)) (x : ↥X) :
      ((σ i).symm x).val ≤ n2 ↔
        x.val ≤ s - i.val ∨ (s < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n2) ∨
          (t < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ t + i.val) := by
    induction i using Fin.induction generalizing x with
    | zero =>
        rw [hzero]
        change x.val ≤ n2 ↔
          x.val ≤ s - 0 ∨ (s < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n2) ∨ (t < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ t + 0)
        omega
    | succ j ih =>
        rw [hsucc]
        have hj := j.isLt
        exact twoBlockSwapImage hs₂ ht₂ (by omega) (left j) (right j) rfl rfl
          (σ j.castSucc) ih x
  let C (f : G) (r c : Fin 2) := XBlock r ∩ (YBlock c).map f.toEmbedding
  have hcells (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
      C (σ i) 0 0 = twoBlockInterval n 1 (s - i.val) ∧
      C (σ i) 0 1 = twoBlockInterval n (s - i.val + 1) n1 ∧
      C (σ i) 1 0 = twoBlockInterval n (n1 + 1) (t + i.val) ∧
      C (σ i) 1 1 = twoBlockInterval n (t + i.val + 1) n := by
    have hi := i.isLt
    exact twoBlockCellIntervals rfl rfl (by omega) (σ i) (himage i)
  have hsizes (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
      ((C (σ i) 0 0).card : Int) = a i ∧
      ((C (σ i) 0 1).card : Int) = (n1 : Int) - a i ∧
      ((C (σ i) 1 0).card : Int) = (n2 : Int) - a i ∧
      ((C (σ i) 1 1).card : Int) = (n : Int) - (n1 : Int) - (n2 : Int) + a i := by
    have hi := i.isLt
    obtain ⟨h00, h01, h10, h11⟩ := hcells i
    exact twoBlockCellSizes h1n.le (by omega) hs₁ ht₁ (by omega) hsum
      (C (σ i)) h00 h01 h10 h11
  have ha : Set.BijOn a Set.univ
      (Set.Icc (max 0 ((n1 : Int) + (n2 : Int) - (n : Int))) (s : Int)) :=
    twoBlockParameter hsum htn rfl
  obtain ⟨hneX, hdX, hcX⟩ := twoBlockPartitionFacts hn1 h1n
  obtain ⟨hneY, hdY, hcY⟩ := twoBlockPartitionFacts hn2 h2n
  -- Alphabeta Math's §7.2 steps 1–2 match ordered cell pieces to
  -- construct a representative. To verify the particular product of
  -- transpositions in §7.3, use the classification equivalence from
  -- Proposition 7.3 with the entries computed above.
  obtain ⟨classify, hclass, _⟩ :=
    ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives X 2 2 XBlock YBlock hneX hneY hdX hdY hcX hcY
  have hmat (f : G) :=
    (TwoBlockDoubleCosetMatrices X XBlock YBlock hneX hneY hdX hdY hcX hcY
      (fun r c => ((C f r c).card : Int))).mp ⟨f, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  have cardX : X.card = n := by
    change (Finset.Icc 1 n).card = n
    rw [Nat.card_Icc]
    omega
  have cardX₀ : (XBlock 0).card = n1 := by
    change (twoBlockInterval n 1 n1).card = n1
    rw [twoBlockCardInterval le_rfl h1n.le]
    omega
  have cardY₀ : (YBlock 0).card = n2 := by
    change (twoBlockInterval n 1 n2).card = n2
    rw [twoBlockCardInterval le_rfl h2n.le]
    omega
  refine ⟨left, right, σ, fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hzero, hsucc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j k hjk
    have hj := j.isLt
    have hk := k.isLt
    have hjk' : j.val ≠ k.val := fun e => hjk (Fin.ext e)
    have hl (l : Fin m) : (left l).val = s - l.val := rfl
    have hr (l : Fin m) : (right l).val = t + l.val + 1 := rfl
    have hne (l : Fin m) : left l ≠ right l := by
      intro e
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val e
      rw [hl, hr] at h
      omega
    simp only [Equiv.Perm.support_swap (hne _), Finset.disjoint_left,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    intro x hx hy
    rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rcases hy with hy | hy <;>
      have he := congrArg Subtype.val (hx.symm.trans hy) <;>
      simp only [hl, hr] at he <;>
      omega
  · constructor
    · intro i j hij
      have he := congrArg (fun q => ((classify q).val 0 0 : Int)) hij
      change ((classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i))).val 0 0 : Int) =
        ((classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ j))).val 0 0 : Int) at he
      rw [hclass, hclass, (hsizes i).1, (hsizes j).1] at he
      exact ha.2.1 (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) he
    · intro q
      let f : G := q.out
      have hf : DoubleCoset.mk K H f = q := DoubleCoset.out_eq' q
      obtain ⟨z, ⟨hlo, hhi, hz00, hz01, hz10, hz11⟩, _⟩ := hmat f
      simp only [cardX, cardX₀, cardY₀] at hlo hhi hz01 hz10 hz11
      have hhi' : z ≤ (s : Int) := by
        change z ≤ ((min n1 n2 : Nat) : Int)
        rw [Lean.Omega.Int.ofNat_min]
        exact hhi
      obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := ha.2.2 (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hlo, hhi'⟩)
      change a i = z at hi
      refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
      change DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i) = q
      rw [← hf]
      apply classify.injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext r c
      rw [hclass, hclass]
      obtain ⟨hi00, hi01, hi10, hi11⟩ := hsizes i
      rw [hi] at hi00 hi01 hi10 hi11
      have he00 := hi00.trans hz00.symm
      have he01 := hi01.trans hz01.symm
      have he10 := hi10.trans hz10.symm
      have he11 := hi11.trans hz11.symm
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c
      · exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp he00
      · exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp he01
      · exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp he10
      · exact Int.ofNat_inj.mp he11
  · exact ha
  · intro i C' size
    obtain ⟨h00, h01, h10, h11⟩ := hsizes i
    refine ⟨h00, h01, h10, h11, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r c
      obtain ⟨e00, e01, e10, e11⟩ := hcells i
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c
      · exact ⟨_, _, e00⟩
      · exact ⟨_, _, e01⟩
      · exact ⟨_, _, e10⟩
      · exact ⟨_, _, e11⟩
    · -- The registered block formula includes empty cells. Each empty
      -- cell contributes only the identity subgroup, so omit those cells
      -- as in §7.3.
      exact (ParabolicMackeyIntersectionBlocks X 2 2 XBlock YBlock
        hneX hneY hdX hdY hcX hcY (σ i)).trans (twoBlockOmitEmpty (C (σ i)))
StandardTwoBlockRepresentatives.support:
private def twoBlockInterval (n lo hi : Nat) : Finset ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n) :=
  Finset.filter (fun x => lo ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ hi) Finset.univ

private theorem twoBlockBounds {n : Nat} (x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n)) :
    1 ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n :=
  Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property

private theorem twoBlockMemInterval {n lo hi : Nat} {x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n)} :
    x ∈ twoBlockInterval n lo hi ↔ lo ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ hi := by
  simp [twoBlockInterval]

private theorem twoBlockCardInterval {n lo hi : Nat} (hlo : 1 ≤ lo) (hhi : hi ≤ n) :
    (twoBlockInterval n lo hi).card = hi + 1 - lo := by
  let val : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n) ↪ Nat := ⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩
  have himage : (twoBlockInterval n lo hi).map val = Finset.Icc lo hi := by
    ext z
    simp only [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      exact twoBlockMemInterval.mp hx
    · intro hz
      have hz' : z ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr
        ⟨hlo.trans hz.1, hz.2.trans hhi⟩
      exact ⟨⟨z, hz'⟩, twoBlockMemInterval.mpr hz, rfl⟩
  rw [← Finset.card_map val, himage, Nat.card_Icc]

private def twoBlockPartition (n cut : Nat) (r : Fin 2) : Finset ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n) :=
  if r = 0 then twoBlockInterval n 1 cut else twoBlockInterval n (cut + 1) n

private theorem twoBlockPartitionFacts {n cut : Nat} (hc : 1 ≤ cut) (hcn : cut < n) :
    (∀ r, (twoBlockPartition n cut r).Nonempty) ∧
    Pairwise (fun r c => Disjoint (twoBlockPartition n cut r) (twoBlockPartition n cut c)) ∧
    ∀ x, ∃ r, x ∈ twoBlockPartition n cut r := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    by_cases h : r = 0
    · let x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n) := ⟨1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, by omega⟩⟩
      rw [twoBlockPartition, ite_eq_left h]
      exact ⟨x, twoBlockMemInterval.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hc⟩⟩
    · let x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n) := ⟨cut + 1, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
      rw [twoBlockPartition, ite_eq_right h]
      exact ⟨x, twoBlockMemInterval.mpr ⟨le_rfl, hcn⟩⟩
  · intro r c hrc
    have h : r = 0 ∨ c = 0 := by
      by_contra! hn
      have hr : r.val < 2 := r.isLt
      have hcv : c.val < 2 := c.isLt
      have hr0 : r.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hn.1 (Fin.ext h)
      have hc0 : c.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hn.2 (Fin.ext h)
      exact hrc (Fin.ext (by omega))
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    rcases h with hr | hc'
    · have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := fun h => hrc (hr.trans h.symm)
      simp only [twoBlockPartition, ite_eq_left hr, ite_eq_right hc0, twoBlockMemInterval] at hx hy
      omega
    · have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := fun h => hrc (h.trans hc'.symm)
      simp only [twoBlockPartition, ite_eq_right hr0, ite_eq_left hc', twoBlockMemInterval] at hx hy
      omega
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := twoBlockBounds x
    by_cases hx : x.val ≤ cut
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa [twoBlockPartition, twoBlockMemInterval] using And.intro hx₁ hx⟩
