    · refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
      simp only [twoBlockPartition, ite_eq_right (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0), twoBlockMemInterval]
      exact ⟨by omega, hx₂⟩

private theorem twoBlockSwapImage {n d s t j : Nat}
    (hsd : s ≤ d) (hdt : d ≤ t) (hjs : j < s)
    (left right : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n))
    (hl : left.val = s - j) (hr : right.val = t + j + 1)
    (f : Equiv.Perm ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n))
    (hf : ∀ x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n), (f.symm x).val ≤ d ↔
      x.val ≤ s - j ∨ (s < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ d) ∨ (t < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ t + j))
    (x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n)) :
    (((Equiv.swap left right) * f).symm x).val ≤ d ↔
      x.val ≤ s - (j + 1) ∨ (s < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ d) ∨
        (t < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ t + (j + 1)) := by
  change (f.symm ((Equiv.swap left right) x)).val ≤ d ↔ _
  rw [hf, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  split_ifs with h h'
  · subst x
    omega
  · subst x
    omega
  · have hx₁ : x.val ≠ left.val := fun hv => h (Subtype.ext hv)
    have hx₂ : x.val ≠ right.val := fun hv => h' (Subtype.ext hv)
    omega

private theorem twoBlockCellIntervals {n n1 n2 s t k : Nat}
    (hs : s = min n1 n2) (ht : t = max n1 n2) (hk : k ≤ s)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n))
    (hσ : ∀ x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n), (σ.symm x).val ≤ n2 ↔
      x.val ≤ s - k ∨ (s < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n2) ∨ (t < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ t + k)) :
    let C := fun r c => twoBlockPartition n n1 r ∩
      (twoBlockPartition n n2 c).map σ.toEmbedding
    C 0 0 = twoBlockInterval n 1 (s - k) ∧
    C 0 1 = twoBlockInterval n (s - k + 1) n1 ∧
    C 1 0 = twoBlockInterval n (n1 + 1) (t + k) ∧
    C 1 1 = twoBlockInterval n (t + k + 1) n := by
  intro C
  have first (cut : Nat) : twoBlockPartition n cut 0 = twoBlockInterval n 1 cut := rfl
  have second (cut : Nat) :
      twoBlockPartition n cut 1 = twoBlockInterval n (cut + 1) n := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    ext x <;>
    obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := twoBlockBounds x <;>
    obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := twoBlockBounds (σ.symm x) <;>
    have hcompl : n2 + 1 ≤ (σ.symm x).val ↔ ¬ (σ.symm x).val ≤ n2 := by omega
  all_goals
    simp only [C, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_map_equiv, first, second,
      twoBlockMemInterval, hcompl, hσ x]
    rcases le_total n1 n2 with hle | hle
    · simp only [hs, ht, min_eq_left hle, max_eq_right hle] at hk ⊢
      omega
    · simp only [hs, ht, min_eq_right hle, max_eq_left hle] at hk ⊢
      omega

private theorem twoBlockOmitEmpty {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {ι κ : Type*}
    (C : ι → κ → Finset α) :
    let B := fun S : Finset α =>
      MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : α => x ∈ S))
    (⨆ r, ⨆ c, B (C r c)) =
      ⨆ p : {p : ι × κ // (C p.1 p.2).Nonempty}, B (C p.val.1 p.val.2) := by
  intro B
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun r => iSup_le fun c => ?_
    by_cases h : (C r c).Nonempty
    · exact le_iSup (fun p : {p : ι × κ // (C p.1 p.2).Nonempty} =>
        B (C p.val.1 p.val.2)) ⟨(r, c), h⟩
    · have hb : B (C r c) ≤ ⊥ := by
        rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
        apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
        apply Equiv.ext
        intro x
        exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g (fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩)
      exact hb.trans bot_le
  · refine iSup_le fun p => ?_
    exact (le_iSup (fun c => B (C p.val.1 c)) p.val.2).trans
      (le_iSup (fun r => ⨆ c, B (C r c)) p.val.1)

private theorem twoBlockParameter {n n1 n2 s t m : Nat}
    (hst : s + t = n1 + n2) (htn : t ≤ n) (hm : m = min s (n - t)) :
    Set.BijOn (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => (s : Int) - (i.val : Int)) Set.univ
      (Set.Icc (max 0 ((n1 : Int) + (n2 : Int) - (n : Int))) (s : Int)) := by
  have hms : m ≤ s := by rw [hm]; exact min_le_left ..
  have hmt : m ≤ n - t := by rw [hm]; exact min_le_right ..
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i _
    have hi := i.isLt
    apply Set.mem_Icc.mpr
    change _ ≤ (s : Int) - (i.val : Int) ∧ (s : Int) - (i.val : Int) ≤ _
    exact ⟨max_le (by omega) (by omega), by omega⟩
  · intro i _ j _ hij
    apply Fin.ext
    change (s : Int) - (i.val : Int) = (s : Int) - (j.val : Int) at hij
    omega
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := Set.mem_Icc.mp hz
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := (le_max_left _ _).trans hlo
    have hzl : (n1 : Int) + (n2 : Int) - (n : Int) ≤ z := (le_max_right _ _).trans hlo
    let k := ((s : Int) - z).toNat
    have hk : (k : Int) = (s : Int) - z :=
      Int.toNat_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hhi)
    have hkm : k ≤ m := by
      rw [hm]
      exact le_min (by omega) (by omega)
    refine ⟨⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hkm⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    change (s : Int) - (k : Int) = z
    omega

private theorem twoBlockCellSizes {n n1 n2 s t k : Nat}
    (hn₁ : n1 ≤ n) (hk : k ≤ s) (hs₁ : s ≤ n1) (ht₁ : n1 ≤ t)
    (htk : t + k ≤ n) (hsum : s + t = n1 + n2)
    (C : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Finset ↥(Finset.Icc 1 n))
    (h00 : C 0 0 = twoBlockInterval n 1 (s - k))
    (h01 : C 0 1 = twoBlockInterval n (s - k + 1) n1)
    (h10 : C 1 0 = twoBlockInterval n (n1 + 1) (t + k))
    (h11 : C 1 1 = twoBlockInterval n (t + k + 1) n) :
    let a := (s : Int) - (k : Int)
    ((C 0 0).card : Int) = a ∧
    ((C 0 1).card : Int) = (n1 : Int) - a ∧
    ((C 1 0).card : Int) = (n2 : Int) - a ∧
    ((C 1 1).card : Int) = (n : Int) - (n1 : Int) - (n2 : Int) + a := by
  rw [h00, h01, h10, h11, twoBlockCardInterval le_rfl (by omega),
    twoBlockCardInterval (by omega) hn₁,
    twoBlockCardInterval (by omega) htk,
    twoBlockCardInterval (by omega) le_rfl]
  dsimp
  exact ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, by omega⟩

external.usage: Identifies the support of each transposition with its two distinct endpoints. The endpoint inequalities then give pairwise disjoint supports.

StandardTwoBlockRepresentatives uses DoubleCoset.out_eq' to choose a permutation in an arbitrary target double coset. The two-block matrix bounds choose the swap index for that coset, and the registered classification equates the two cosets.

CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction.proof:
by
  classical
  open CaseOneRightProjectionAux in
  intro U inst G A D F C E a b c d e f up down tensor comp hom bc ad de ade bottom top
    mergedBottom mergedTop Drawing drawId splitB mergeT eval atR ProjectionLabel fiberSize
    Parameter qstar terms left right isRight sumdraw conjugatedImage join middleFinite nₚ expansion
  -- Xiao, §6.2.1, Lemma 6.3, (6.1)–(6.2), and Theorem 6.4(1).
  -- The archived original PDF has the construction on p. 23 and the
  -- revised published PDF on p. 25. The numbered case fixes the right
  -- shape s₂s₁s₂ and the two uses of finite crossing indices.
  have heval : eval = mergedEval a b c d e f := rfl
  have hq : qstar = Qstar a b c d e f := rfl
  have hr : @right = (fun {J : Subgroup U}
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J A) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C J)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F J) (xs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp j w))
      (ys : ProjectionLabel a j d v →₀ Complex) (zs : ProjectionLabel v w e f →₀ Complex) =>
        rightLabels a b c d e f j v w xs ys zs) := rfl
  have hi : isRight = IsRight a b c d e f := rfl
  -- Compare the two list matches on their constructors. This exposes the
  -- zero and fold cases before Lean compares the complete diagrams.
  have hs : sumdraw = sumDrawings a b c d e f := by
    funext ds
    cases ds <;> rfl
  have hmid : middleFinite = middleOK a bc d e f := rfl
  have hindex : nₚ = pIndex a bc d e f := rfl
  have hex : expansion = (fun coeff : Parameter →₀ Complex =>
      coeff.sum (fun p z => z • Qstar a b c d e f p)) := rfl
  simp only [heval, hq, hr, hi, hs, hmid, hindex, hex]
  refine ⟨joinImplementation a b c d e f, commonImplementation a b c d e f, ?_⟩
  intro B r s t xs ys zs coeff hleft
  exact finite_replacement a b c d e f (left r s t xs ys zs) coeff hleft
CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction.support:
namespace CaseOneRightProjectionAux

open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped BigOperators
universe u
noncomputable section

-- The registered supplier proves the index formula for arbitrary crossing
-- types, and verifies the individual backward coordinates for the right
-- shape. Its implementation lemmas are private. These local aliases name
-- the exact compiled declarations; Lean checks the resulting proof terms.
open Lean Elab Tactic in
private abbrev crossingIndex := by
  run_tac
    let n := Name.str (Name.str (Name.num `_private.Proofs.EvaluationForTwoProjections 0)
      "EvaluationForTwoProjectionsAux") "index_formula"
    evalTactic (← `(tactic| exact @$(mkIdent n)))

private abbrev conjImage {P H : Type u} [Group P] [Group H] (q : P) (b : H →* P) :=
  Subgroup.map (MulAut.conj q).toMonoidHom b.range

section Crossings
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H P L : Subgroup U}

private abbrev crossingUpper (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P) (q : P) :=
  a.toHom.range ⊓ conjImage q b.toHom

private theorem fiber_card {a : ConjEmbedding K P} {b : ConjEmbedding H P}
    {d : ConjEmbedding L K} {e : ConjEmbedding L H} (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e)
    (z : P)
    (hz : z ∈ Set.range (Generator.mixedProduct a b ∘
      Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot)) :
    Nat.card {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w =
      Generator.mixedPair a b z} =
      (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a b p.dot.element) := by
  have heq (w : ((Word.up d).tensor (.down e)).basis.carrier) :
      Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w = Generator.mixedPair a b z ↔
      Generator.mixedProduct a b (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w) = z :=
    calc
      _ ↔ (Generator.mixedEquiv a b) (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w) =
          (Generator.mixedEquiv a b) (Generator.mixedPair a b z) :=
        (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).apply_eq_iff_eq.symm
      _ ↔ _ := by
        change _ = (Generator.mixedEquiv a b) ((Generator.mixedEquiv a b).symm z) ↔ _
        rw [(Generator.mixedEquiv a b).apply_symm_apply z]
        rfl
  exact (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight heq)).trans
    ((crossingIndex a b d e p.dot).2 z hz p.finite)

private theorem fiber_card_le {a : ConjEmbedding K P} {b : ConjEmbedding H P}
    {d : ConjEmbedding L K} {e : ConjEmbedding L H} (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e)
    (z : P) :
    Nat.card {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w =
      Generator.mixedPair a b z} ≤
      (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a b p.dot.element) := by
  by_cases hz : z ∈ Set.range (Generator.mixedProduct a b ∘
      Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot)
  · exact (fiber_card p z hz).le
  · have : IsEmpty {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w =
      Generator.mixedPair a b z} := ⟨fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => hz ⟨w, by
        change Generator.mixedProduct a b (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot w) = z
        rw [hw]
        exact (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).apply_symm_apply z⟩⟩
    exact (Nat.card_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inl inferInstance)).le.trans (Nat.zero_le _)

private theorem relIndex_nonzero {a : ConjEmbedding K P} {b : ConjEmbedding H P}
    {d : ConjEmbedding L K} {e : ConjEmbedding L H} (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e) :
    (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a b p.dot.element) ≠ 0 :=
  Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mp ((crossingIndex a b d e p.dot).1.mp p.finite)

private def projectionOfIndex {a : ConjEmbedding K P} {b : ConjEmbedding H P}
    {d : ConjEmbedding L K} {e : ConjEmbedding L H} (p : Dot (a.comp d) (b.comp e))
    (hp : (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a b p.element) ≠ 0) :
    ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e :=
  ⟨p, (crossingIndex a b d e p).1.mpr (Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mpr hp)⟩

end Crossings

private theorem conjImage_one {P H : Type u} [Group P] [Group H] (b : H →* P) :
    conjImage (1 : P) b = b.range := by
  ext z
  simp [conjImage, Subgroup.mem_map]

private theorem map_conjImage {P H T : Type u} [Group P] [Group H] [Group T]
    (j : P →* T) (q : P) (b : H →* P) :
    (conjImage q b).map j = conjImage (j q) (j.comp b) := by
  have hrange : b.range.map j = (j.comp b).range := MonoidHom.map_range j b
  unfold conjImage
  rw [← hrange, Subgroup.map_map, Subgroup.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp [MulAut.conj_apply]

section Transport
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {A G F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (bc : ConjEmbedding F A) (d : ConjEmbedding C G)
  (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev PP := ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc (d.comp e) f

private abbrev joinGroup (p : PP a bc d e f) :=
  (a.comp d).toHom.range ⊔ conjImage p.dot.element bc.toHom

private abbrev middleOK (p : PP a bc d e f) :=
  ((a.comp d).toHom.range.subgroupOf (a.toHom.range ⊓ joinGroup a bc d e f p)).FiniteIndex

private abbrev pIndex (p : PP a bc d e f) :=
  (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a bc p.dot.element)

private def restrictCodomain {H P : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (S : Subgroup P) (h : ∀ k, a.toHom k ∈ S) :
    ConjEmbedding H (S.map P.subtype) where
  toHom :=
    { toFun := fun k => ⟨(a.toHom k : U), ⟨a.toHom k, h k, rfl⟩⟩
      map_one' := Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : P => (z : U)) (map_one a.toHom))
      map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : P => (z : U)) (map_mul a.toHom x y)) }
  hasRepresentative := a.hasRepresentative

private def inclusion {P : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup P) :
    ConjEmbedding (S.map P.subtype) P :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (by
    rintro ⟨z, x, _, rfl⟩
    simp [x.property])

private theorem inclusion_coe {P : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup P) (x : S.map P.subtype) :
    ((inclusion S).toHom x : U) = (x : U) := by
  simp [inclusion]

private theorem inclusion_range {P : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup P) :
    (inclusion S).toHom.range = S := by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y, hy, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    have he : y = z := Subtype.ext
      ((inclusion_coe S ⟨(y : U), y, hy, rfl⟩).symm.trans (congrArg (fun z : P => (z : U)) hz))
    exact he ▸ hy
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨⟨(z : U), z, hz, rfl⟩, Subtype.ext (inclusion_coe S _)⟩

private theorem inclusion_restrict {H P : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (S : Subgroup P) (h : ∀ k, a.toHom k ∈ S) :
    (inclusion S).comp (restrictCodomain a S h) = a :=
  ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (inclusion_coe S ⟨(a.toHom x : U), a.toHom x, h x, rfl⟩))

private def conjugate {H P : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H P) (q : P) : ConjEmbedding H P where
  toHom := (MulAut.conj q).toMonoidHom.comp a.toHom
  hasRepresentative := by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
    refine ⟨(q : U) * t, ?_⟩
    intro x
    change (q : U) * (a.toHom x : U) * (q : U)⁻¹ = _
    rw [ht]
    group

private theorem upperIndexLe (p : PP a bc d e f)
    (j : ConjEmbedding B A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B) (w : ConjEmbedding F B)
    (q : B) (hv : j.comp v = a.comp d)
    (hw : conjImage (j.toHom q) (j.comp w).toHom = conjImage p.dot.element bc.toHom) :
    (v.comp e).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper v w q) ≤ pIndex a bc d e f p ∧
    (v.comp e).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper v w q) ≠ 0 := by
  have hlo : (v.comp e).toHom.range.map j.toHom = (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range := by
    rw [MonoidHom.map_range]
    exact congrArg (fun k : ConjEmbedding C A => (k.comp e).toHom.range) hv
  have hup : (crossingUpper v w q).map j.toHom =
      (a.comp d).toHom.range ⊓ conjImage p.dot.element bc.toHom := by
    rw [crossingUpper, Subgroup.map_inf _ _ _ j.injective, MonoidHom.map_range, map_conjImage]
    exact congrArg₂ (· ⊓ ·) (congrArg (fun k : ConjEmbedding C A => k.toHom.range) hv) hw
  have hindex := Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective (v.comp e).toHom.range
    (crossingUpper v w q) j.injective
  rw [hlo, hup] at hindex
  have hle : (a.comp d).toHom.range ⊓ conjImage p.dot.element bc.toHom ≤
      crossingUpper a bc p.dot.element :=
    inf_le_inf_right _ (by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨d.toHom x, rfl⟩)
  rw [← hindex]
  exact ⟨Subgroup.relIndex_le_of_le_right hle (relIndex_nonzero p),
    fun h => relIndex_nonzero p (Subgroup.relIndex_eq_zero_of_le_right hle h)⟩


-- Theorem 6.4(1), sufficiency. The join initially lives inside A. Map it
-- into U to obtain an internal region of the project's common ambient type.
private theorem joinCrossings (p : PP a bc d e f) (hp : middleOK a bc d e f p) :
    let S := joinGroup a bc d e f p
    let B' := S.map A.subtype
    ∃ (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B') (w : ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ell : Dot bc (j.comp w)) (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)
      (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f),
      (∀ k : B', (j.toHom k : U) = (k : U)) ∧
      j.comp v = a.comp d ∧ j.comp w = conjugate bc p.dot.element ∧
      ell.element = p.dot.element⁻¹ ∧ m.dot.element = 1 ∧ n.dot.element = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : B', Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis v w e f n.dot y =
        Generator.mixedPair v w z} ≤ pIndex a bc d e f p) := by
  intro S B'
  let p₀ := p.dot.element
  let j := inclusion S
  have hvm (x : C) : (a.comp d).toHom x ∈ S :=
    (show (a.comp d).toHom.range ≤ S from le_sup_left) ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hwm (x : F) : (conjugate bc p₀).toHom x ∈ S :=
    (show conjImage p₀ bc.toHom ≤ S from le_sup_right) ⟨bc.toHom x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  let v := restrictCodomain (a.comp d) S hvm
  let w := restrictCodomain (conjugate bc p₀) S hwm
  have hv : j.comp v = a.comp d := inclusion_restrict _ _ _
  have hw : j.comp w = conjugate bc p₀ := inclusion_restrict _ _ _
  let ell : Dot bc (j.comp w) := ⟨p₀⁻¹, by
    intro x
    rw [hw]
    change bc.toHom x * p₀⁻¹ = p₀⁻¹ * (p₀ * bc.toHom x * p₀⁻¹)
    group⟩
  let md : Dot (a.comp d) (j.comp v) := ⟨1, by intro x; rw [hv, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  have hm : (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a j md.element) ≠ 0 := by
    change (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (a.toHom.range ⊓ conjImage 1 j.toHom) ≠ 0
    rw [conjImage_one, inclusion_range]
    exact Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mp hp
  let m := projectionOfIndex md hm
  let nd : Dot (v.comp e) (w.comp f) := ⟨1, by
    intro x
    rw [one_mul, mul_one]
    apply j.injective
    change (j.comp v).toHom (e.toHom x) = (j.comp w).toHom (f.toHom x)
    rw [hv, hw]
    change a.toHom (d.toHom (e.toHom x)) = p₀ * bc.toHom (f.toHom x) * p₀⁻¹
    have hi := p.dot.intertwines x
    change a.toHom (d.toHom (e.toHom x)) * p₀ = p₀ * bc.toHom (f.toHom x) at hi
    rw [← hi, mul_inv_cancel_right]⟩
  have hwMap : conjImage (j.toHom nd.element) (j.comp w).toHom = conjImage p₀ bc.toHom := by
    change conjImage (j.toHom 1) (j.comp w).toHom = _
    rw [map_one, conjImage_one, hw]
    exact (MonoidHom.map_range (MulAut.conj p₀).toMonoidHom bc.toHom).symm
  have hn := upperIndexLe a bc d e f p j v w nd.element hv hwMap
  let n := projectionOfIndex nd hn.2
  exact ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n, inclusion_coe S, hv, hw, rfl, rfl, rfl,
    fun z => (fiber_card_le n z).trans hn.1⟩

-- Theorem 6.4(1), the common internal region A. The middle map is
-- surjective, so every fiber has the same size, including for z = 1.
private theorem commonCrossings (hd : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    let j := ConjEmbedding.id A
    ∃ (ell : Dot bc (j.comp bc)) (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d (a.comp d))
      (n : PP a bc d e f → ProjectionDot.Mixed (a.comp d) bc e f),
      ell.element = 1 ∧ m.dot.element = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : A, Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a j d (a.comp d) m.dot y =
        Generator.mixedPair a j z} = d.toHom.range.index) ∧
      (∀ p, (n p).dot.element = p.dot.element ∧
        ∀ z : A, Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis (a.comp d) bc e f (n p).dot y =
          Generator.mixedPair (a.comp d) bc z} ≤ pIndex a bc d e f p) := by
  intro j
  let ell : Dot bc (j.comp bc) := ⟨1, by intro x; change _ * 1 = 1 * bc.toHom x; simp⟩
  let md : Dot (a.comp d) (j.comp (a.comp d)) :=
    ⟨1, by intro x; change _ * 1 = 1 * (a.comp d).toHom x; simp⟩
  have hr : j.toHom.range = ⊤ := by
    change (MonoidHom.id A).range = ⊤
    ext x
    simp
  have hindex : (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (crossingUpper a j md.element) =
      d.toHom.range.index := by
    change (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (a.toHom.range ⊓ conjImage 1 j.toHom) = _
    rw [conjImage_one, hr, inf_top_eq]
    change (a.toHom.comp d.toHom).range.relIndex a.toHom.range = _
    rw [← MonoidHom.map_range a.toHom d.toHom]
    have he := Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective d.toHom.range ⊤ a.injective
    rw [Subgroup.map_top] at he
    exact he.trans (Subgroup.relIndex_top_right _)
  let m := projectionOfIndex md (hindex ▸ Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mp hd)
  have hcard (z : A) : Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a j d (a.comp d) m.dot y =
      Generator.mixedPair a j z} = d.toHom.range.index := by
    refine (fiber_card m z ⟨(Biset.induction d).pair (Biset.restriction (a.comp d)) 1 z, ?_⟩).trans hindex
    change Generator.mixedProduct a j (Generator.mixedPair a j (a.toHom 1 * 1 * z)) = z
    simp
  let nd (p : PP a bc d e f) : Dot ((a.comp d).comp e) (bc.comp f) :=
    ⟨p.dot.element, p.dot.intertwines⟩
  have hn (p : PP a bc d e f) :=
    upperIndexLe a bc d e f p j (a.comp d) bc (nd p).element rfl rfl
  let n (p : PP a bc d e f) := projectionOfIndex (nd p) (hn p).2
  exact ⟨ell, m, n, rfl, rfl, hcard, fun p => ⟨rfl, fun z =>
    (fiber_card_le (n p) z).trans (hn p).1⟩⟩

end Transport

section Evaluation
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E B' : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
  (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev Param := PP a (b.comp c) d e f

private abbrev Qstar (p : Param a b c d e f) :=
  (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f p.dot p.finite).eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev comb := Finsupp.linearCombination Complex (Qstar a b c d e f)

private theorem traceRight {j : ConjEmbedding B' A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B'}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B'} (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v) (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)
    (x : ((Word.down a).tensor (.up (b.comp c))).basis.carrier →₀ Complex)
    (y : ((Word.up (d.comp e)).tensor (.down f)).basis.carrier) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w [(1,ell)] [(1,m)] [(1,n)]) x y =
      x (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f
        (rightDot a b c d e f ell m n) y) := by
  exact Quotient.inductionOn y (fun ⟨g,h⟩ => pulls_right a b c d e f ell m n g h x)

-- Lemma 6.3 gives p = m j(n) ell⁻¹. Retain that parameter, including the
-- proof that its fibers are finite, to apply the subgroup test termwise.
private def compositeParameter {j : ConjEmbedding B' A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B'}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B'} (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v) (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f) :
    Param a b c d e f := by
  classical
  refine ⟨rightDot a b c d e f ell m n, fun z => ?_⟩
  let L := mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w [(1,ell)] [(1,m)] [(1,n)])
  apply (L (Finsupp.single z 1)).support.finite_toSet.subset
  intro y hy
  change Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f
    (rightDot a b c d e f ell m n) y = z at hy
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (by
    change L (Finsupp.single z 1) y ≠ 0
    rw [traceRight, hy, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    exact one_ne_zero)

private theorem right_singleton {j : ConjEmbedding B' A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B'}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B'} (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v) (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)
    (p : Param a b c d e f)
    (hp : m.dot.element * j.toHom n.dot.element * ell.element⁻¹ = p.dot.element) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w [(1,ell)] [(1,m)] [(1,n)]) =
      Qstar a b c d e f p := by
  have hdot : rightDot a b c d e f ell m n = p.dot := Dot.ext hp
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro y
  rw [traceRight, hdot]
  exact (pulls_mixed a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f p y x).symm

-- Theorem 6.4(1), necessity for a singleton triple. Both generators of
-- the join lie in m j(B') m⁻¹. Use the index tower at the actual middle
-- crossing, whose finite-fiber witness supplies the nonzero index.
private theorem composite_middle {j : ConjEmbedding B' A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B'}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B'} (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v) (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f) :
    middleOK a (b.comp c) d e f (compositeParameter a b c d e f ell m n) := by
  let p := compositeParameter a b c d e f ell m n
  let J := conjImage m.dot.element j.toHom
  have hl : (a.comp d).toHom.range ≤ J := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hm := m.dot.intertwines x
    change a.toHom (d.toHom x) * m.dot.element =
      m.dot.element * j.toHom (v.toHom x) at hm
    refine ⟨j.toHom (v.toHom x), ⟨v.toHom x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change m.dot.element * j.toHom (v.toHom x) * m.dot.element⁻¹ = a.toHom (d.toHom x)
    rw [← hm, mul_inv_cancel_right]
  have hr : conjImage p.dot.element (b.comp c).toHom ≤ J := by
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    let ell₀ := ell.element
    let m₀ := m.dot.element
    let n₀ := n.dot.element
    have he := ell.intertwines x
    change (b.comp c).toHom x * ell₀ = ell₀ * j.toHom (w.toHom x) at he
    have he' : ell₀⁻¹ * (b.comp c).toHom x * ell₀ = j.toHom (w.toHom x) := by
      rw [mul_assoc, he, inv_mul_cancel_left]
    refine ⟨j.toHom (n₀ * w.toHom x * n₀⁻¹), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    change m₀ * j.toHom (n₀ * w.toHom x * n₀⁻¹) * m₀⁻¹ =
      (m₀ * j.toHom n₀ * ell₀⁻¹) * (b.comp c).toHom x * (m₀ * j.toHom n₀ * ell₀⁻¹)⁻¹
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, ← he']
    group
  let low := (a.comp d).toHom.range
  let mid := a.toHom.range ⊓ joinGroup a (b.comp c) d e f p
  let high := a.toHom.range ⊓ J
  have hlow : low ≤ mid := le_inf (by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; exact ⟨d.toHom x, rfl⟩) le_sup_left
  have hmid : mid ≤ high := inf_le_inf_left _ (sup_le hl hr)
  have ht := Subgroup.relIndex_mul_relIndex low mid high hlow hmid
  apply Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mpr
  intro hz
  change low.relIndex mid = 0 at hz
  rw [hz, zero_mul] at ht
  exact relIndex_nonzero m ht.symm

private def labelTerms {X : Type u} (xs : X →₀ Complex) : List (Complex × X) :=
  xs.support.toList.map fun x => (xs x, x)

private theorem labelTerms_single {X : Type u} (x : X) {weight : Complex} (h : weight ≠ 0) :
    labelTerms (Finsupp.single x weight) = [(weight,x)] := by
  simp [labelTerms, Finsupp.support_single _ h]

private theorem weighted_labelTerms {X : Type u} {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Complex M]
    (s : X → M) (xs : X →₀ Complex) :
    weighted s (labelTerms xs) = Finsupp.linearCombination Complex s xs := by
  change ((xs.support.toList.map fun x => (xs x, x)).map
    fun t : Complex × X => t.1 • s t.2).sum = _
  rw [List.map_map, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_map_toList xs.support (fun i => xs i • s i)


section RightStages
variable (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B') (w : ConjEmbedding F B')

private abbrev stageOne (xs : List (Complex × Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))) :=
  atRight (.down a) (.parallelUp b c j w xs)

private abbrev stageTwo (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)) :=
  atLeft (.compactProjection a j d v ys) (.up w)

private abbrev stageThree (zs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)) :=
  atRight (.up d) (.compactProjection v w e f zs)

private theorem stageOne_weighted (xs : List (Complex × Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))) :
    ev (stageOne a b c j w xs) = weighted (fun x => ev (stageOne a b c j w [(1,x)])) xs :=
  weighted_atRight (.down a) _ _ xs (weighted_parallel b c j w xs)

private theorem stageTwo_weighted (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)) :
    ev (stageTwo a d j v w ys) = weighted (fun y => ev (stageTwo a d j v w [(1,y)])) ys :=
  weighted_atLeft _ _ ys (weighted_compact a j d v ys)

private theorem stageThree_weighted (zs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)) :
    ev (stageThree d e f v w zs) = weighted (fun z => ev (stageThree d e f v w [(1,z)])) zs :=
  weighted_atRight (.up d) _ _ zs (weighted_compact v w e f zs)

private theorem right_linear_top (xs : List (Complex × Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w)))
    (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)) (zs : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f →₀ Complex) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w xs ys (labelTerms zs)) =
      Finsupp.linearCombination Complex
        (fun n => mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w xs ys [(1,n)])) zs := by
  rw [← weighted_labelTerms]
  let pre := (ev (stageTwo a d j v w ys)).comp
    ((ev (stageOne a b c j w xs)).comp (ev (splitBottom a b c)))
  let frame := composeAround pre (ev (mergeTop d e f))
  change frame (ev (stageThree d e f v w (labelTerms zs))) = _
  rw [stageThree_weighted, map_weighted]
  rfl

end RightStages

private abbrev allowed (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F) :=
  Finsupp.supported Complex Complex {p : Param a b c d e f | middleOK a (b.comp c) d e f p}

private abbrev allowedEvals := (allowed a b c d e f).map (comb a b c d e f)

-- Theorem 6.4(1), finite sums. Linearity puts the evaluation in the image of
-- the submodule of coefficients supported on admissible middle indices.
-- This permits cancellations while retaining the condition on final support.
private theorem right_supported (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B')
    (w : ConjEmbedding F B') (xs : List (Complex × Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w)))
    (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)) (zs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w xs ys zs) ∈ allowedEvals a b c d e f := by
  let pre := ev (splitBottom a b c)
  let post := ev (mergeTop d e f)
  change post.comp ((ev (stageThree d e f v w zs)).comp ((ev (stageTwo a d j v w ys)).comp
    ((ev (stageOne a b c j w xs)).comp pre))) ∈ allowedEvals a b c d e f
  rw [stageOne_weighted, stageTwo_weighted, stageThree_weighted]
  apply weighted_stack_mem
  intro ell m n
  let p := compositeParameter a b c d e f ell m n
  change mergedEval a b c d e f (rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w [(1,ell)] [(1,m)] [(1,n)]) ∈ _
  rw [right_singleton a b c d e f ell m n p rfl]
  apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single p 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [allowed, Finsupp.mem_supported, Finsupp.support_single p one_ne_zero]
    intro q hq
    have hqp : q = p := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hq
    subst q
    exact composite_middle a b c d e f ell m n
  · rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]

private theorem mergedEval_add
    (x y : LabelledDrawing Complex (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c))
      (((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f))) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (.add x y) =
      mergedEval a b c d e f x + mergedEval a b c d e f y := by
  let frame := composeAround (ev (splitBottom a b c)) (ev (mergeTop d e f))
  change frame (ev x + ev y) = frame (ev x) + frame (ev y)
  exact map_add frame _ _

private theorem mergedEval_zero :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (.ordinary (.zero
      (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c))
      (((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f)))) = 0 := by
  let frame := composeAround (ev (splitBottom a b c)) (ev (mergeTop d e f))
  change frame 0 = 0
  exact map_zero frame

private theorem evaluate_sumDrawings
    (ds : List (LabelledDrawing Complex (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c))
      (((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f)))) :
    (mergedEval a b c d e f (match ds with
      | [] => .ordinary (.zero _ _)
      | first :: rest => rest.foldl LabelledDrawing.add first)) =
      (ds.map (mergedEval a b c d e f)).sum := by
  have hf (first : LabelledDrawing Complex (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c))
      (((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f))) (rest : List _) :
      mergedEval a b c d e f (rest.foldl LabelledDrawing.add first) =
        mergedEval a b c d e f first + (rest.map (mergedEval a b c d e f)).sum := by
    induction rest generalizing first with
    | nil => simp
    | cons second rest ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, mergedEval_add, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]
  cases ds with
  | nil => exact mergedEval_zero a b c d e f
  | cons first rest => exact hf first rest


private abbrev Drawing :=
  LabelledDrawing Complex (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c))
    (((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f))

private def sumDrawings (ds : List (Drawing a b c d e f)) : Drawing a b c d e f :=
  match ds with
  | [] => .ordinary (.zero _ _)
  | first :: rest => rest.foldl LabelledDrawing.add first

private abbrev rightLabels (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B')
    (w : ConjEmbedding F B') (xs : DotLabel Complex (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (ys : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v →₀ Complex) (zs : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f →₀ Complex) :=
  rightDrawing a b c d e f j v w (labelTerms xs) (labelTerms ys) (labelTerms zs)

private def IsRight (drawing : Drawing a b c d e f) : Prop :=
  ∃ (B' : Subgroup U) (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B')
    (w : ConjEmbedding F B') (xs : DotLabel Complex (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (ys : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v →₀ Complex) (zs : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f →₀ Complex),
    drawing = rightLabels a b c d e f j v w xs ys zs

private theorem right_weight {j : ConjEmbedding B' A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B'}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B'} (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v) (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)
    (p : Param a b c d e f) (z : Complex)
    (hp : m.dot.element * j.toHom n.dot.element * ell.element⁻¹ = p.dot.element) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (rightLabels a b c d e f j v w (Finsupp.single ell 1)
      (Finsupp.single m 1) (Finsupp.single n z)) = z • Qstar a b c d e f p := by
  unfold rightLabels
  rw [labelTerms_single ell one_ne_zero, labelTerms_single m one_ne_zero,
    right_linear_top, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, right_singleton a b c d e f ell m n p hp]

private theorem realize_weight (p : Param a b c d e f) (hp : middleOK a (b.comp c) d e f p) (z : Complex) :
    ∃ drawing : Drawing a b c d e f, IsRight a b c d e f drawing ∧
      mergedEval a b c d e f drawing = z • Qstar a b c d e f p := by
  obtain ⟨j,v,w,ell,m,n,_,_,_,he,hm,hn,_⟩ := joinCrossings a (b.comp c) d e f p hp
  refine ⟨rightLabels a b c d e f j v w (Finsupp.single ell 1) (Finsupp.single m 1)
    (Finsupp.single n z), ⟨_,j,v,w,_,_,_,rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply right_weight a b c d e f ell m n p z
  simp only [he, hm, hn, map_one, one_mul, inv_inv]

private theorem right_sum_supported (ds : List (Drawing a b c d e f))
    (hds : ∀ drawing ∈ ds, IsRight a b c d e f drawing) :
    mergedEval a b c d e f (sumDrawings a b c d e f ds) ∈ allowedEvals a b c d e f := by
  have hs : mergedEval a b c d e f (sumDrawings a b c d e f ds) =
      (ds.map (mergedEval a b c d e f)).sum := evaluate_sumDrawings a b c d e f ds
  rw [hs]
  apply list_sum_mem
  intro val hval
  obtain ⟨drawing, hd, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hval
  obtain ⟨_,j,v,w,xs,ys,zs,rfl⟩ := hds drawing hd
  exact right_supported a b c d e f j v w (labelTerms xs) (labelTerms ys) (labelTerms zs)

private theorem finite_replacement (target : Drawing a b c d e f)
    (coeff : Param a b c d e f →₀ Complex)
    (hleft : mergedEval a b c d e f target = coeff.sum (fun p z => z • Qstar a b c d e f p)) :
    (∃ ds : List (Drawing a b c d e f), (∀ drawing ∈ ds, IsRight a b c d e f drawing) ∧
      mergedEval a b c d e f (sumDrawings a b c d e f ds) = mergedEval a b c d e f target) ↔
    ∀ p ∈ coeff.support, middleOK a (b.comp c) d e f p := by
  classical
  rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply] at hleft
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ds, hds, hvalue⟩
    obtain ⟨weights, hw, he⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp (right_sum_supported a b c d e f ds hds)
    have eq : weights = coeff :=
      combination_injective a b c d e f (he.trans (hvalue.trans hleft))
    subst weights
    exact (Finsupp.mem_supported Complex coeff).mp hw
  · intro hcoeff
    -- Put each coefficient on the upper mark so every summand is a
    -- complete right diagram at the prescribed boundary.
    let indices := coeff.support.attach.toList
    have hrealize (p : {p // p ∈ coeff.support}) :=
      realize_weight a b c d e f p.1 (hcoeff p.1 p.2) (coeff p.1)
    let chooseDrawing p := Classical.choose (hrealize p)
    let ds := indices.map chooseDrawing
    refine ⟨ds, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro drawing hd
      obtain ⟨p, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hd
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (hrealize p)).1
    · have hs : mergedEval a b c d e f (sumDrawings a b c d e f ds) =
          (ds.map (mergedEval a b c d e f)).sum := evaluate_sumDrawings a b c d e f ds
      rw [hs, hleft]
      change ((indices.map chooseDrawing).map (mergedEval a b c d e f)).sum = _
      rw [List.map_map]
      have hm : indices.map (mergedEval a b c d e f ∘ chooseDrawing) =
          indices.map (fun p => coeff p.1 • Qstar a b c d e f p.1) :=
        List.map_congr_left (fun p _ => (Classical.choose_spec (hrealize p)).2)
      rw [hm]
      have hc : (indices.map (fun p => coeff p.1 • Qstar a b c d e f p.1)).sum =
          ∑ p ∈ coeff.support.attach, coeff p.1 • Qstar a b c d e f p.1 :=
        Finset.sum_map_toList _ _
      rw [hc, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_attach coeff.support (fun p => coeff p • Qstar a b c d e f p)


private theorem joinImplementation (p : Param a b c d e f) (hp : middleOK a (b.comp c) d e f p) :
    let B' := (joinGroup a (b.comp c) d e f p).map A.subtype
    let p₀ := p.dot.element
    ∃ (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B') (w : ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w)) (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)
      (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f),
      (∀ k : B', (j.toHom k : U) = (k : U)) ∧
      (∀ k : C, j.toHom (v.toHom k) = (a.comp d).toHom k) ∧
      (∀ k : F, j.toHom (w.toHom k) = (MulAut.conj p₀) ((b.comp c).toHom k)) ∧
      ell.element = p₀⁻¹ ∧ m.dot.element = 1 ∧ n.dot.element = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : B', Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis v w e f n.dot y =
        Generator.mixedPair v w z} ≤ pIndex a (b.comp c) d e f p) ∧
      mergedEval a b c d e f (rightLabels a b c d e f j v w (Finsupp.single ell 1)
        (Finsupp.single m 1) (Finsupp.single n 1)) = Qstar a b c d e f p := by
  obtain ⟨j,v,w,ell,m,n,hj,hv,hw,he,hm,hn,hcard⟩ := joinCrossings a (b.comp c) d e f p hp
  refine ⟨j,v,w,ell,m,n,hj, ?_, ?_, he, hm, hn, hcard, ?_⟩
  · intro k
    exact congrArg (fun i : ConjEmbedding C A => i.toHom k) hv
  · intro k
    exact congrArg (fun i : ConjEmbedding F A => i.toHom k) hw
  · simpa only [one_smul] using right_weight a b c d e f ell m n p 1 (by
      simp only [he, hm, hn, map_one, one_mul, inv_inv])

private theorem commonImplementation (hd : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    let j := ConjEmbedding.id A
    ∃ (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp (b.comp c))) (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d (a.comp d))
      (n : Param a b c d e f → ProjectionDot.Mixed (a.comp d) (b.comp c) e f),
      ell.element = 1 ∧ m.dot.element = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : A, Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a j d (a.comp d) m.dot y =
        Generator.mixedPair a j z} = d.toHom.range.index) ∧
      (∀ p, (n p).dot.element = p.dot.element ∧
        ∀ z : A, Nat.card {y // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis (a.comp d) (b.comp c) e f (n p).dot y =
          Generator.mixedPair (a.comp d) (b.comp c) z} ≤ pIndex a (b.comp c) d e f p) ∧
      (∀ coeff : Param a b c d e f →₀ Complex,
        mergedEval a b c d e f (rightLabels a b c d e f j (a.comp d) (b.comp c)
          (Finsupp.single ell 1) (Finsupp.single m 1) (Finsupp.mapDomain n coeff)) =
          coeff.sum (fun p z => z • Qstar a b c d e f p)) := by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨ell,m,n,he,hm,hcard,hn⟩ := commonCrossings a (b.comp c) d e f hd
  refine ⟨ell, m, n, he, hm, hcard, hn, ?_⟩
  intro coeff
  rw [← Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  unfold rightLabels
  rw [labelTerms_single ell one_ne_zero, labelTerms_single m one_ne_zero, right_linear_top,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain]
  apply congrArg (fun q => Finsupp.linearCombination Complex q coeff)
  funext p
  apply right_singleton a b c d e f ell m (n p) p
  change m.dot.element * (n p).dot.element * ell.element⁻¹ = p.dot.element
  simp only [he, hm, (hn p).1, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]


end Evaluation
end
end CaseOneRightProjectionAux

external.usage: For each right singleton triple, the dot equations give a subgroup tower from (ad)(C) through its intersection with the join to its intersection with the conjugated internal group. The multiplicativity identity transfers the nonzero middle-crossing index to the smaller intersection.
Transfer the upper crossing index along the injective internal embedding, and identify the common-region middle crossing index by mapping through a.
Bound each upper fiber index using (ad)(C) ≤ a(G). The parameter’s finite-fiber witness supplies the required nonzero index of the larger upper subgroup.

ParabolicCurlsFromBlockRefinements.proof:
by
  classical
  -- Xiao, Proposition 8.1, archived original p. 33 and revised published
  -- p. 35. Both pages display the four curl boundaries. The proof uses
  -- the conjugated image as the first internal group of the nested diagrams.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  intro _finitary _U _blockSym _blockGroup _partition _parabolic _merge _inclusion
    _curlPair _straightPair _indexedCurls _rightDownCurl _leftUpCurl _nestedCurls
    _atBoundary _path
  constructor
  · intro T P A B h ha hb hab _merged
    exact ⟨merge_le P A B, merge_index h ha hb hab⟩
  · intro K H G δ α hδ hα _parabolicK _parabolicG T X Y hx hy hH d a S image
    change partition T X at hx
    change partition T Y at hy
    change H = blockGroup X at hH
    change blockGroup Y = S.map H.subtype at image
    -- FiniteParabolicClosure supplies closure under conjugation, intersection,
    -- and join in ambient permutations. Here the two block partitions are
    -- given explicitly. Their orders and the inclusion for each merge are
    -- proved locally in the finitary ambient group.
    have subH : blockGroup Y ≤ H := by
      rw [image]
      exact Subgroup.map_subtype_le S
    have refineLe : blockGroup Y ≤ blockGroup X := hH ▸ subH
    have imageInH : S = (blockGroup Y).subgroupOf H := by
      apply Subgroup.map_subtype_inj.mp
      rw [← image]
      exact (Subgroup.map_comap_eq_self (by
        rw [Subgroup.range_subtype]
        exact subH)).symm
    have indexEq : S.index = (blockGroup Y).relIndex (blockGroup X) :=
      (congrArg Subgroup.index imageInH).trans (congrArg (blockGroup Y).relIndex hH)
    let _ : Finite H := hH.symm ▸ blockFinite hx
    let finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S := inferInstance
    refine ⟨finite, ?_⟩
    intro _index _direct _straight
    have ratio := refinement_ratio hx hy refineLe
    rw [← indexEq] at ratio
    have direct := direct_eval a d finite
    refine ⟨ratio, direct.1.1, direct.2.1, direct.2.2, direct.1.2,
      path_exists hx hy (finer_of_le hx hy refineLe), ?_⟩
    intro n P A B hp L
    change path Y X n P A B at hp
    have parts := path_partition hy hp
    have stepLe (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : L i ≤ L (i + 1) := by
      change blockGroup (P i) ≤ blockGroup (P (i + 1))
      rw [(hp.2.2 i hi).2.2.2]
      exact merge_le _ _ _
    have stepFinite (i : Nat) (hi : i < n) :
        Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion (stepLe i hi)).toHom.range := by
      let _ : Finite (L (i + 1)) := blockFinite (parts (i + 1) hi)
      infer_instance
    have chooseProd := (path_index hy hp n (Nat.le_refl n)).symm
    rw [hp.2.1, ← indexEq] at chooseProd
    have stepProd : (∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (L i).relIndex (L (i + 1))) = S.index := by
      rw [← chooseProd]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      have hin := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      obtain ⟨ha, hb, hab, hm⟩ := hp.2.2 i hin
      change (blockGroup (P i)).relIndex (blockGroup (P (i + 1))) = _
      rw [hm]
      exact merge_index (parts i (Nat.le_of_lt hin)) ha hb hab
    refine ⟨parts, chooseProd, stepLe, stepFinite, ?_⟩
    intro hEnd nested
    have hn : curlEval a nested (S.index : Complex) := by
      change curlEval a (atBoundary hEnd a
        (fun b => nestedCurls n L stepLe stepFinite n (Nat.le_refl n) b)) _
      apply boundary_eval hEnd
      intro b
      simpa only [stepProd] using nested_eval n L stepLe stepFinite n (Nat.le_refl n) b
    exact ⟨direct.1.1.trans hn.1.symm, direct.1.2.trans hn.2.symm⟩

namespace BlockRefinementCurl

private abbrev finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev U := ↥finitary
private abbrev ambientBlock (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S))
private abbrev blockSym (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup U :=
  Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary) (ambientBlock S)
private abbrev blockGroup (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) : Subgroup U :=
  iSup (fun S : ↥P => blockSym (S : Finset Nat))
private abbrev partition (T : Finset Nat) (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) : Prop :=
  (∀ S ∈ P, Finset.Nonempty S) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ P, ∀ B ∈ P, A ≠ B → Disjoint A B) ∧
    (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ S ∈ P, x ∈ S)
private abbrev merge (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) (A B : Finset Nat) :=
  insert (A ∪ B) (Finset.erase (Finset.erase P A) B)
private abbrev path (Y X : Finset (Finset Nat)) (n : Nat)
    (P : Nat → Finset (Finset Nat)) (A B : Nat → Finset Nat) : Prop :=
    P 0 = Y ∧ P n = X ∧ ∀ i, i < n →
      A i ∈ P i ∧ B i ∈ P i ∧ A i ≠ B i ∧ P (i + 1) = merge (P i) (A i) (B i)

private theorem swap_mem_ambientBlock {S : Finset Nat} {x y : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S)
    (hy : y ∈ S) : Equiv.swap x y ∈ ambientBlock S :=
  ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩

-- Alphabeta Math, transpositions generate the symmetric group, Steps 1.1
-- and 2.1. Use the checked swap-closure criterion on Nat. Its two
-- hypotheses here are finite support in S and the internal swap of x
-- with its image whenever x moves.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
private theorem ambientBlock_le_finitary (S : Finset Nat) : ambientBlock S ≤ finitary := by
  rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
  apply mem_closure_isSwap'.mpr
  exact S.finite_toSet.subset (fun x hx => by
    by_contra h
    exact hx ((MulAction.mem_fixedBy).2 (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ h)))

private theorem map_blockGroup (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) :
    (blockGroup P).map finitary.subtype = ⨆ S : ↥P, ambientBlock (S : Finset Nat) := by
  rw [show blockGroup P = ⨆ S : ↥P, blockSym (S : Finset Nat) from rfl, Subgroup.map_iSup]
  congr 1
  funext S
  apply Subgroup.map_comap_eq_self
  rw [Subgroup.range_subtype]
  exact ambientBlock_le_finitary S

private theorem blockSym_mono {A B : Finset Nat} (h : A ⊆ B) :
    blockSym A ≤ blockSym B := by
  intro σ hσ
  change (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) ∈ ambientBlock A at hσ
  change (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) ∈ ambientBlock B
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hσ
  rw [← hτ]
  refine ⟨(Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ).subtypePerm (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ B) ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A
    · exact iff_of_true (h ((Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem τ x).2 hx)) (h hx)
    · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hx]
  · exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm _ (fun x hx => h (by
      by_contra hn
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hn)))

private theorem block_unique {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {x : Nat} {A B : Finset Nat} (hA : A ∈ P) (hB : B ∈ P)
    (hxA : x ∈ A) (hxB : x ∈ B) : A = B := by
  by_contra hn
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (h.2.1 A hA B hB hn) hxA hxB

private theorem blockGroup_action {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {σ : U} (hσ : σ ∈ blockGroup P) :
    (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ S, (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ T, (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x) := by
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun S : ↥P => blockSym (S : Finset Nat))
    (C := fun f : U =>
      (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ S, (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ T, (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x)) hσ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro S f hf
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := (show (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) ∈ ambientBlock S from hf)
    rw [← hτ]
    constructor
    · intro V hV x hx
      by_cases he : V = S.val
      · subst V
        exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem τ x).2 hx
      · rwa [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ (fun hs =>
          he (block_unique h hV S.property hx hs))]
    · intro x hx
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ
        (fun hs => hx ((h.2.2 x).2 ⟨S, S.property, hs⟩))
  · exact ⟨fun _ _ _ hx => hx, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  · exact fun f g hf hg =>
      ⟨fun S hS x hx => hf.1 S hS _ (hg.1 S hS x hx),
        fun x hx => show (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) ((g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x) = x by
          rw [hg.2 x hx, hf.2 x hx]⟩

private theorem mem_map_blockGroup {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat}
    (preserve : ∀ S ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ S, σ x ∈ S)
    (fixes : ∀ x ∉ T, σ x = x) : σ ∈ (blockGroup P).map finitary.subtype := by
  rw [map_blockGroup]
  let swaps : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    {f | ∃ S ∈ P, ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ f = Equiv.swap x y}
  have genuine : ∀ f ∈ swaps, Equiv.Perm.IsSwap f := by
    rintro f ⟨S, hS, x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩
  have hle : Subgroup.closure swaps ≤ ⨆ S : ↥P, ambientBlock (S : Finset Nat) := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    rintro f ⟨S, hS, x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨S, hS⟩ : ↥P) (swap_mem_ambientBlock hx hy)
  apply hle
  refine (mem_closure_isSwap genuine).2 ⟨T.finite_toSet.subset ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    by_contra ht
    exact hx ((MulAction.mem_fixedBy).2 (fixes x ht))
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : σ x = x
    · rw [hx]
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit_self x
    · have ht : x ∈ T := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hx (fixes x hn)
      obtain ⟨S, hS, hs⟩ := (h.2.2 x).1 ht
      have hswap : Equiv.swap x (σ x) ∈ Subgroup.closure swaps :=
        Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨S, hS, x, hs, σ x, preserve S hS x hs, Ne.symm hx, rfl⟩
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨⟨_, hswap⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩

private noncomputable def blockAct (P : Finset (Finset Nat))
    (f : ∀ S : ↥P, Equiv.Perm ↥(S : Finset Nat)) (x : Nat) : Nat := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ S : ↥P, x ∈ (S : Finset Nat) then
    (f h.choose ⟨x, h.choose_spec⟩).val else x

private theorem blockAct_apply {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    (f : ∀ S : ↥P, Equiv.Perm ↥(S : Finset Nat)) (S : ↥P) (x : ↥(S : Finset Nat)) :
    blockAct P f x = (f S x).val := by
  have hx : ∃ V : ↥P, x.val ∈ (V : Finset Nat) := ⟨S, x.property⟩
  rw [blockAct, dite_eq_left hx]
  have he : hx.choose = S := Subtype.ext
    (block_unique h hx.choose.property S.property hx.choose_spec x.property)
  have hw : (⟨hx.choose, hx.choose_spec⟩ : {V : ↥P // x.val ∈ (V : Finset Nat)}) =
      ⟨S, x.property⟩ := Subtype.ext he
  exact congrArg (fun w => (f w.val ⟨x.val, w.property⟩).val) hw

private theorem blockAct_fix {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    (f : ∀ S : ↥P, Equiv.Perm ↥(S : Finset Nat)) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ T) :
    blockAct P f x = x := by
  rw [blockAct, dite_eq_right (fun ⟨S, hs⟩ => hx ((h.2.2 x).2 ⟨S, S.property, hs⟩))]

private noncomputable def blockGlue {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    (f : ∀ S : ↥P, Equiv.Perm ↥(S : Finset Nat)) : Equiv.Perm Nat where
  toFun := blockAct P f
  invFun := blockAct P (fun S => (f S).symm)
  left_inv x := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ := (h.2.2 x).1 hx
      rw [blockAct_apply h f ⟨S, hS⟩ ⟨x, hxS⟩,
        blockAct_apply h (fun S => (f S).symm) ⟨S, hS⟩ (f ⟨S, hS⟩ ⟨x, hxS⟩)]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val ((f ⟨S, hS⟩).symm_apply_apply ⟨x, hxS⟩)
    · rw [blockAct_fix h f hx, blockAct_fix h _ hx]
  right_inv x := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ T
    · obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ := (h.2.2 x).1 hx
      rw [blockAct_apply h (fun S => (f S).symm) ⟨S, hS⟩ ⟨x, hxS⟩,
        blockAct_apply h f ⟨S, hS⟩ ((f ⟨S, hS⟩).symm ⟨x, hxS⟩)]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val ((f ⟨S, hS⟩).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hxS⟩)
    · rw [blockAct_fix h _ hx, blockAct_fix h f hx]

private noncomputable def blockRestrict {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    (σ : blockGroup P) (S : ↥P) : Equiv.Perm ↥(S : Finset Nat) :=
  (σ.val : Equiv.Perm Nat).subtypePerm (fun x => by
    refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, blockGroup_action h σ.property |>.1 S S.property x⟩
    have hi := (blockGroup_action h ((blockGroup P).inv_mem σ.property)).1
      S S.property ((σ.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) x) hx
    simpa [Equiv.Perm.inv_def] using hi)

private noncomputable def blockEquiv {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P) :
    ↥(blockGroup P) ≃ (∀ S : ↥P, Equiv.Perm ↥(S : Finset Nat)) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (blockRestrict h) (by
    constructor
    · intro f g he
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ T
      · obtain ⟨S, hS, hs⟩ := (h.2.2 x).1 hx
        exact congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm ↥S => (p ⟨x, hs⟩).val)
          (congrFun he (⟨S, hS⟩ : ↥P))
      · exact ((blockGroup_action h f.property).2 x hx).trans
          ((blockGroup_action h g.property).2 x hx).symm
    · intro f
      let σ := blockGlue h f
      have hm : σ ∈ (blockGroup P).map finitary.subtype := by
        apply mem_map_blockGroup h
        · intro S hS x hx
          change blockAct P f x ∈ S
          rw [blockAct_apply h f ⟨S, hS⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩]
          exact (f ⟨S, hS⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩).property
        · exact fun _ hx => blockAct_fix h f hx
      obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hm
      refine ⟨⟨u, hu⟩, ?_⟩
      funext S
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = (f S x).val
      change (u : Equiv.Perm Nat) = σ at he
      rw [he]
      exact blockAct_apply h f S x)

private theorem blockCard {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P) :
    Nat.card ↥(blockGroup P) = ∏ S ∈ P, (S.card).factorial := by
  classical
  rw [Nat.card_congr (blockEquiv h), Nat.card_pi]
  calc
    _ = ∏ S : ↥P, ((S : Finset Nat).card).factorial := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro S _
      simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_coe]
    _ = _ := Finset.prod_coe_sort P (fun S => S.card.factorial)

private theorem blockFinite {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P) :
    Finite ↥(blockGroup P) :=
  Finite.of_injective _ (blockEquiv h).injective


private theorem mem_merge {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} {A B S : Finset Nat} :
    S ∈ merge P A B ↔ S = A ∪ B ∨ S ∈ P ∧ S ≠ A ∧ S ≠ B := by
  simp only [merge, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_erase]
  tauto

private theorem merge_valid {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} {A B : Finset Nat}
    (h : partition T P) (ha : A ∈ P) (hb : B ∈ P) (_hab : A ≠ B) :
    partition T (merge P A B) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro S hs
    rcases mem_merge.mp hs with rfl | ⟨hs, _, _⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.1 A ha
      exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_union_left B hx⟩
    · exact h.1 S hs
  · intro S hs V hv hne
    rcases mem_merge.mp hs with rfl | ⟨hs, hsa, hsb⟩
    · rcases mem_merge.mp hv with he | ⟨hv, hva, hvb⟩
      · exact (hne he.symm).elim
      · exact Finset.disjoint_union_left.mpr
          ⟨h.2.1 A ha V hv hva.symm, h.2.1 B hb V hv hvb.symm⟩
    · rcases mem_merge.mp hv with rfl | ⟨hv, _, _⟩
      · exact Finset.disjoint_union_right.mpr
          ⟨h.2.1 S hs A ha hsa, h.2.1 S hs B hb hsb⟩
      · exact h.2.1 S hs V hv hne
  · intro x
    rw [h.2.2]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨S, hs, hx⟩
      by_cases hsa : S = A
      · subst S
        exact ⟨A ∪ B, mem_merge.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Finset.mem_union_left B hx⟩
      by_cases hsb : S = B
      · subst S
        exact ⟨A ∪ B, mem_merge.mpr (Or.inl rfl), Finset.mem_union_right A hx⟩
      exact ⟨S, mem_merge.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hs, hsa, hsb⟩), hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨S, hs, hx⟩
      rcases mem_merge.mp hs with rfl | ⟨hs, _, _⟩
      · exact (Finset.mem_union.mp hx).elim (fun hx => ⟨A, ha, hx⟩) (fun hx => ⟨B, hb, hx⟩)
      · exact ⟨S, hs, hx⟩

private theorem union_not_in {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} {A B : Finset Nat}
    (h : partition T P) (ha : A ∈ P) (hb : B ∈ P) (hne : A ≠ B) :
    A ∪ B ∉ P := by
  intro hab
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.1 A ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h.1 B hb
  exact hne ((block_unique h ha hab hx (Finset.mem_union_left B hx)).trans
    (block_unique h hab hb (Finset.mem_union_right A hy) hy))

private theorem merge_le (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) (A B : Finset Nat) :
    blockGroup P ≤ blockGroup (merge P A B) := by
  refine iSup_le fun S => ?_
  have atUnion := le_iSup (fun V : ↥(merge P A B) => blockSym (V : Finset Nat))
    ⟨A ∪ B, mem_merge.mpr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
  rcases S with ⟨S, hs⟩
  by_cases ha : S = A
  · subst S
    exact (blockSym_mono Finset.subset_union_left).trans atUnion
  by_cases hb : S = B
  · subst S
    exact (blockSym_mono Finset.subset_union_right).trans atUnion
  exact le_iSup (fun V : ↥(merge P A B) => blockSym (V : Finset Nat))
    ⟨S, mem_merge.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hs, ha, hb⟩)⟩

private theorem relIndex_card {V : Type*} [Group V] {A B : Subgroup V} (h : A ≤ B) :
    A.relIndex B * Nat.card ↥A = Nat.card ↥B := by
  have he := Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe h).toEquiv
  exact he ▸ Subgroup.index_mul_card (A.subgroupOf B)

private theorem merge_index {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} {A B : Finset Nat}
    (h : partition T P) (ha : A ∈ P) (hb : B ∈ P) (hab : A ≠ B) :
    (blockGroup P).relIndex (blockGroup (merge P A B)) =
      Nat.choose (A.card + B.card) A.card := by
  classical
  have eq := relIndex_card (merge_le P A B)
  let F : Finset Nat → Nat := fun S => S.card.factorial
  let Q := (P.erase A).erase B
  have hb' : B ∈ P.erase A := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm, hb⟩
  have old : Nat.card ↥(blockGroup P) = F A * (F B * ∏ S ∈ Q, F S) := by
    rw [blockCard h, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase P F ha, ← Finset.mul_prod_erase (P.erase A) F hb']
  have new : Nat.card ↥(blockGroup (merge P A B)) = F (A ∪ B) * ∏ S ∈ Q, F S := by
    rw [blockCard (merge_valid h ha hb hab)]
    exact Finset.prod_insert (fun hu =>
      union_not_in h ha hb hab (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hu)))
  have hchoose : Nat.choose (A.card + B.card) A.card * F A * F B = F (A ∪ B) := by
    have hcard := Finset.card_union_of_disjoint (h.2.1 A ha B hb hab)
    simpa only [F, hcard, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using
      Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (n := A.card + B.card) (k := A.card)
        (Nat.le_add_right A.card B.card)
  rw [old, new, ← hchoose] at eq
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right
    (m := F A * (F B * ∏ S ∈ Q, F S))
  · exact Nat.mul_pos (Nat.factorial_pos _) (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.factorial_pos _)
      (Finset.prod_pos fun S _ => Nat.factorial_pos _))
  · simpa only [mul_assoc] using eq

private theorem finer_of_le {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hx : partition T X) (hy : partition T Y) (hle : blockGroup Y ≤ blockGroup X) :
    ∀ B ∈ Y, ∃ A ∈ X, B ⊆ A := by
  intro B hb
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hy.1 B hb
  obtain ⟨A, ha, hua⟩ := (hx.2.2 u).1 ((hy.2.2 u).2 ⟨B, hb, hu⟩)
  refine ⟨A, ha, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hswap := swap_mem_ambientBlock hu hv
  let s : U := ⟨Equiv.swap u v, ambientBlock_le_finitary B hswap⟩
  have hs : s ∈ blockGroup Y := Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨B, hb⟩ : ↥Y)
    (show s ∈ blockSym B from hswap)
  have he := (blockGroup_action hx (hle hs)).1 A ha u hua
  change Equiv.swap u v u ∈ A at he
  rwa [Equiv.swap_apply_left] at he

private theorem factorial_fibers {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hx : partition T X) (hy : partition T Y)
    (rf : ∀ B ∈ Y, ∃ A ∈ X, B ⊆ A) :
    (∏ A ∈ X, ∏ B ∈ Y.filter (fun B => B ⊆ A), (B.card.factorial : Rat)) =
      ∏ B ∈ Y, (B.card.factorial : Rat) := by
  classical
  let dest : Finset Nat → Finset Nat := fun B =>
    if hb : B ∈ Y then (rf B hb).choose else ∅
  have hs (B : Finset Nat) (hb : B ∈ Y) := (rf B hb).choose_spec
  have dst (B : Finset Nat) (hb : B ∈ Y) :
      dest B ∈ X ∧ B ⊆ dest B := by
    simpa only [dest, dite_eq_left hb] using hs B hb
  have hf (A : Finset Nat) (ha : A ∈ X) :
      Y.filter (fun B => B ⊆ A) = Y.filter (fun B => dest B = A) := by
    ext B
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    refine and_congr_right (fun hb => ⟨?_, fun he => he ▸ (dst B hb).2⟩)
    intro hba
    obtain ⟨x, hxb⟩ := hy.1 B hb
    exact block_unique hx (dst B hb).1 ha ((dst B hb).2 hxb) (hba hxb)
  calc
    _ = ∏ A ∈ X, ∏ B ∈ Y.filter (fun B => dest B = A), (B.card.factorial : Rat) :=
      Finset.prod_congr rfl fun A hA => by rw [hf A hA]
    _ = _ := Finset.prod_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun B hB => (dst B hB).1) _

private theorem refinement_ratio {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hx : partition T X) (hy : partition T Y) (hle : blockGroup Y ≤ blockGroup X) :
    ((blockGroup Y).relIndex (blockGroup X) : Rat) =
      ∏ V ∈ X, (V.card.factorial : Rat) /
        (∏ W ∈ Y.filter (fun W => W ⊆ V), (W.card.factorial : Rat)) := by
  have hcard := relIndex_card hle
  rw [blockCard hx, blockCard hy] at hcard
  have rat : ((blockGroup Y).relIndex (blockGroup X) : Rat) *
      (∏ W ∈ Y, (W.card.factorial : Rat)) = ∏ V ∈ X, (V.card.factorial : Rat) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  rw [Finset.prod_div_distrib, factorial_fibers hx hy (finer_of_le hx hy hle)]
  apply (eq_div_iff ?_).2 rat
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun W _ => by exact_mod_cast (Nat.factorial_ne_zero W.card)

private theorem merge_exists {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hx : partition T X) (hy : partition T Y)
    (rf : ∀ B ∈ Y, ∃ A ∈ X, B ⊆ A) (hne : Y ≠ X) :
    ∃ A ∈ Y, ∃ B ∈ Y, A ≠ B ∧ ∃ V ∈ X, A ⊆ V ∧ B ⊆ V := by
  by_contra! hn
  have coincide (V : Finset Nat) (hv : V ∈ X) : V ∈ Y := by
    obtain ⟨x, hxv⟩ := hx.1 V hv
    obtain ⟨A, ha, hxa⟩ := (hy.2.2 x).1 ((hx.2.2 x).2 ⟨V, hv, hxv⟩)
    obtain ⟨V', hv', hav'⟩ := rf A ha
    have hav : A ⊆ V := by
      rwa [block_unique hx hv' hv (hav' hxa) hxv] at hav'
    have hva : V ⊆ A := by
      intro y hyv
      obtain ⟨B, hb, hyb⟩ := (hy.2.2 y).1 ((hx.2.2 y).2 ⟨V, hv, hyv⟩)
      obtain ⟨W, hw, hbw⟩ := rf B hb
      have he : W = V := block_unique hx hw hv (hbw hyb) hyv
      subst W
      by_cases hab : A = B
      · rwa [hab]
      exact (hn A ha B hb hab V hv hav hbw).elim
    rwa [← Finset.Subset.antisymm hav hva]
  apply hne
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm _ coincide
  intro A ha
  obtain ⟨V, hv, hav⟩ := rf A ha
  obtain ⟨x, hxA⟩ := hy.1 A ha
  have he := block_unique hy ha (coincide V hv) hxA (hav hxA)
  rwa [he]

private theorem path_exists {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hx : partition T X) (hy : partition T Y) (rf : ∀ B ∈ Y, ∃ A ∈ X, B ⊆ A) :
    ∃ n P A B, path Y X n P A B := by
  by_cases h : Y = X
  · exact ⟨0, fun _ => Y, fun _ => ∅, fun _ => ∅, rfl, h,
      fun i hi => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hi).elim⟩
  obtain ⟨A, ha, B, hb, hab, V, hv, hav, hbv⟩ := merge_exists hx hy rf h
  let Z := merge Y A B
  have hz := merge_valid hy ha hb hab
  have rz : ∀ C ∈ Z, ∃ A ∈ X, C ⊆ A := by
    intro C hc
    rcases mem_merge.mp hc with rfl | ⟨hc, _, _⟩
    · exact ⟨V, hv, Finset.union_subset hav hbv⟩
    · exact rf C hc
  have dec : Z.card < Y.card := by
    have hb' : B ∈ Y.erase A := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hab.symm, hb⟩
    have hu : A ∪ B ∉ (Y.erase A).erase B := fun hm =>
      union_not_in hy ha hb hab (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hm))
    have h1 := Finset.card_erase_add_one ha
    have h2 := Finset.card_erase_add_one hb'
    change (insert (A ∪ B) ((Y.erase A).erase B)).card < Y.card
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hu]
    omega
  obtain ⟨n, P, C, D, hzero, hend, hsteps⟩ := path_exists hx hz rz
  refine ⟨n + 1, (fun | 0 => Y | i + 1 => P i), (fun | 0 => A | i + 1 => C i),
    (fun | 0 => B | i + 1 => D i), rfl, hend, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  cases i with
  | zero => exact ⟨ha, hb, hab, hzero⟩
  | succ i => exact hsteps i (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ hi)
termination_by Y.card

open MackeyDiagrams

private noncomputable def inclusion : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, A ≤ B → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B :=
  fun h => ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
private abbrev curlPair : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B → Type :=
  fun a =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) ×
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)
private noncomputable def straightPair : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B), curlPair a :=
  fun a =>
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)),
     MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)))
private noncomputable def indexedCurls :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)) →
      Option (curlPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a d)) → curlPair a :=
  fun a d finite inner =>
    let openRight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite)
    let closeRight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d)
    let openLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToUpDown a d finite)
    let closeLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToDown a d)
    let rightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical openRight
      (Option.elim inner closeRight (fun p =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (Prod.fst p) (Prod.snd (straightPair d)))
          closeRight))
    let leftDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical openLeft
      (Option.elim inner closeLeft (fun p =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (Prod.fst (straightPair d)) (Prod.snd p))
          closeLeft))
    (rightUp, leftDown)
private noncomputable def rightDownCurl :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (_a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d) :=
  fun a d =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToDownUp a d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToDown a d))
private noncomputable def leftUpCurl :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (_a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d) :=
  fun a d =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a d))
private noncomputable def nestedCurls :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (L : Nat → Subgroup U)
      (h : ∀ i, i < n → L i ≤ L (i + 1)),
      (∀ i (hi : i < n), Subgroup.FiniteIndex
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion (h i hi))))) →
      ∀ t, t ≤ n → ∀ {D : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (L t) D), curlPair a :=
  fun n L h finite =>
    Nat.rec
      (motive := fun t => t ≤ n → ∀ {D : Subgroup U}
        (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (L t) D), curlPair a)
      (fun _ {_} a => straightPair a)
      (fun i prev hi {_} a =>
        let e := inclusion (h i hi)
        indexedCurls a e (finite i hi) (Option.some
          (prev (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a e))))
private noncomputable def atBoundary :
    ∀ {B H G : Subgroup U}, B = H → ∀ a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G,
      (∀ b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G, curlPair b) → curlPair a :=
  fun {_B _H G} h a f =>
    Eq.rec (motive := fun J _ => ∀ b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J G, curlPair b) f h a

private theorem range_inclusion {A B : Subgroup U} (h : A ≤ B) :
    (inclusion h).toHom.range = A.subgroupOf B := by
  ext b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact a.property
  · intro hb
    exact ⟨⟨b.val, hb⟩, rfl⟩

private noncomputable abbrev eval {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  d.interpret.eval

private abbrev curlEval {B G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding B G)
    (p : curlPair a) (c : Complex) : Prop :=
  eval p.1 = (eval (straightPair a).1).scale c ∧
  eval p.2 = (eval (straightPair a).2).scale c

-- The checked Theorem 4.1 gives these four equalities for actual
-- conjugators. Representatives replace the symbolic embeddings by
-- equal underlying homomorphisms at the same boundaries.
private theorem direct_eval {K H G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (d : ConjEmbedding K H) (f : Subgroup.FiniteIndex d.toHom.range) :
    curlEval a (indexedCurls a d f none) (d.toHom.range.index : Complex) ∧
    eval (rightDownCurl a d) = eval (straightPair d).2 ∧
    eval (leftUpCurl a d) = eval (straightPair d).1 := by
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := d.hasRepresentative
  let ha : ∀ x : H, α * (x : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G := fun x => hα x ▸ (a.toHom x).property
  let hd : ∀ x : K, δ * (x : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H := fun x => hδ x ▸ (d.toHom x).property
  have ea : a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α ha :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hα x))
  have ed : d = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hd :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hδ x))
  clear_value ha hd
  clear hα hδ
  subst a
  subst d
  obtain ⟨up, right, left, down⟩ := ReidemeisterOne K H G δ α hd ha
  exact ⟨⟨up f, down f⟩, right, left⟩

private theorem hom_scale_one {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    {F B : Biset K H} (f : Biset.Hom Complex F B) : f.scale 1 = f := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (1 : Complex) • f.toLinearMap x = f.toLinearMap x
  exact one_smul _ _

private theorem straight_one {H G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H G) :
    curlEval a (straightPair a) 1 :=
  ⟨(hom_scale_one _).symm, (hom_scale_one _).symm⟩

private theorem hom_scale_mul {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    {F B : Biset K H} (f : Biset.Hom Complex F B) (r s : Complex) :
    (f.scale r).scale s = f.scale (r * s) := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change s • (r • f.toLinearMap x) = (r * s) • f.toLinearMap x
  rw [smul_smul, mul_comm s r]

-- The paper groups summands by two stages of coset representatives.
-- The checked direct curl and bilinearity on the balanced biset give
-- the same calculation at the two typed nested boundaries.
private theorem step_eval {K H G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (d : ConjEmbedding K H) (f : Subgroup.FiniteIndex d.toHom.range)
    (p : curlPair (a.comp d)) (c : Complex) (hp : curlEval (a.comp d) p c) :
    curlEval a (indexedCurls a d f (some p)) (c * (d.toHom.range.index : Complex)) := by
  have dir := (direct_eval a d f).1
  obtain ⟨pu, pd⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨du, dd⟩ := dir
  -- For the upward bend, the inner up map is the left tensor factor.
  -- For the downward bend, the inner down map is the right factor.
  constructor
  · let opening := eval (.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d f))
    let closing := eval (.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d))
    let ix : Complex := d.toHom.range.index
    let idUp := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.up (a.comp d)).basis
    let idDown := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.down d).basis
    let idOuter := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.up a).basis
    change eval p.1 = idUp.scale c at pu
    change opening.vertical closing = idOuter.scale ix at du
    change opening.vertical (((eval p.1).horizontal idDown).vertical closing) =
      idOuter.scale (c * ix)
    rw [pu, Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_left, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id,
      Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right,
      du, hom_scale_mul, mul_comm ix c]
  · let opening := eval (.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.downToUpDown a d f))
    let closing := eval (.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.upDownToDown a d))
    let ix : Complex := d.toHom.range.index
    let idUp := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.up d).basis
    let idDown := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.down (a.comp d)).basis
    let idOuter := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.down a).basis
    change eval p.2 = idDown.scale c at pd
    change opening.vertical closing = idOuter.scale ix at dd
    change opening.vertical ((idUp.horizontal (eval p.2)).vertical closing) =
      idOuter.scale (c * ix)
    rw [pd, Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_right, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id,
      Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right,
      dd, hom_scale_mul, mul_comm ix c]

private theorem nested_eval (n : Nat) (L : Nat → Subgroup U)
    (h : ∀ i, i < n → L i ≤ L (i + 1))
    (f : ∀ i (hi : i < n), Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion (h i hi)).toHom.range) :
    ∀ t (ht : t ≤ n) {G : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding (L t) G),
      curlEval a (nestedCurls n L h f t ht a)
        ((∏ i ∈ Finset.range t, (L i).relIndex (L (i + 1)) : Nat) : Complex) := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    intro ht G a
    change curlEval a (straightPair a) _
    simpa only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.prod_empty, Nat.cast_one] using straight_one a
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht G a
    let e := inclusion (h t ht)
    have step := step_eval a e (f t ht) _ _
      (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht) (a.comp e))
    change curlEval a (indexedCurls a e (f t ht) (some
      (nestedCurls n L h f t (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht) (a.comp e)))) _
    rwa [Finset.prod_range_succ, Nat.cast_mul, ← show e.toHom.range.index =
      (L t).relIndex (L (t + 1)) from congrArg Subgroup.index (range_inclusion (h t ht))]

private theorem boundary_eval {B H G : Subgroup U} (h : B = H) (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (p : ∀ b : ConjEmbedding B G, curlPair b) (c : Complex)
    (he : ∀ b, curlEval b (p b) c) : curlEval a (atBoundary h a p) c := by
  subst H
  exact he a

private theorem path_partition {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    {n : Nat} {P : Nat → Finset (Finset Nat)} {A B : Nat → Finset Nat}
    (hy : partition T Y) (hp : path Y X n P A B) :
    ∀ i, i ≤ n → partition T (P i) := by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => simpa only [hp.1] using fun _ : 0 ≤ n => hy
  | succ i ih =>
    intro hi
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hab, hm⟩ := hp.2.2 i hi
    rw [hm]
    exact merge_valid (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi)) ha hb hab

private theorem path_index {T : Finset Nat} {X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    {n : Nat} {P : Nat → Finset (Finset Nat)} {A B : Nat → Finset Nat}
    (hy : partition T Y) (hp : path Y X n P A B) :
    ∀ t, t ≤ n →
      (blockGroup Y).relIndex (blockGroup (P t)) =
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.range t, Nat.choose ((A i).card + (B i).card) (A i).card := by
  have incl : ∀ i, i < n → blockGroup (P i) ≤ blockGroup (P (i + 1)) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [(hp.2.2 i hi).2.2.2]
    exact merge_le _ _ _
  have start : ∀ i, i ≤ n → blockGroup Y ≤ blockGroup (P i) := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => simp only [hp.1, le_refl, implies_true]
    | succ i ih => exact fun hi => (ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi)).trans (incl i hi)
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => simp only [hp.1, Subgroup.relIndex_self, Finset.range_zero, Finset.prod_empty,
      implies_true]
  | succ t ih =>
    intro ht
    obtain ⟨ha, hb, hab, hm⟩ := hp.2.2 t ht
    have step : (blockGroup (P t)).relIndex (blockGroup (P (t + 1))) =
        Nat.choose ((A t).card + (B t).card) (A t).card := by
      rw [hm]
      exact merge_index (path_partition hy hp t (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht)) ha hb hab
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ← step, ← ih (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht),
      Subgroup.relIndex_mul_relIndex _ _ _ (start t (Nat.le_of_succ_le ht)) (incl t ht)]

end BlockRefinementCurl

external.usage: An identity extension of a permutation of a finite block has finite support in that block and so lies in the ambient swap closure.
A block-preserving permutation fixing the complement of the common carrier has finite support. Each moved point is in the same orbit as its image under the closure of internal swaps.
Realizes the ambient swap of two points in a block as the identity extension of the corresponding subtype permutation. This supplies the swaps used to recover block refinement.
Counts choices of local permutations after the restriction and gluing equivalence.
Gives the factorial for each finite block permutation group.
Applies to the smaller group viewed as a subgroup of the larger one. The subgroupOf equivalence gives the smaller ambient group order for both index formulas.
Identifies the single merge index after the common factorial factors of the surviving blocks are cancelled.
Reassociates the finer factorial factors by the unique containing block of the coarser partition.
Multiplies the relative indices of consecutive merges after step inclusions and the containment from the initial block group have been established.
