namespace BalancedTensorAssoc

noncomputable section

variable {R S C M N P A M' N' P' : Type*}
variable [Ring R] [Ring S]
variable [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P] [AddCommGroup A]

private abbrev generator (m : M) (n : N) : (M × N) →₀ ℤ :=
  Finsupp.single (m, n) 1

private abbrev relations (R : Type*) [Ring R] (M N : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N] :
    AddSubgroup ((M × N) →₀ ℤ) :=
  AddSubgroup.closure
    { z | (∃ (m m' : M) (n : N),
          z = generator (m + m') n - generator m n - generator m' n) ∨
        (∃ (m : M) (n n' : N),
          z = generator m (n + n') - generator m n - generator m n') ∨
        (∃ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N),
          z = generator (MulOpposite.op r • m) n - generator m (r • n)) }

private abbrev Tensor (R : Type*) [Ring R] (M N : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N] :=
  HasQuotient.Quotient ((M × N) →₀ ℤ) (relations R M N)

variable [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N] [Module S P]

private abbrev pure (R : Type*) [Ring R] {M N : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N]
    (m : M) (n : N) : Tensor R M N :=
  QuotientAddGroup.mk' (relations R M N) (generator m n)

private theorem pure_add_left (m m' : M) (n : N) :
    pure R (m + m') n = pure R m n + pure R m' n :=
  (ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.{_, _, _, 0} R M N).1.1 m m' n

private theorem pure_add_right (m : M) (n n' : N) :
    pure R m (n + n') = pure R m n + pure R m n' :=
  (ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.{_, _, _, 0} R M N).1.2.1 m n n'

private theorem pure_balance (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    pure R (MulOpposite.op r • m) n = pure R m (r • n) :=
  (ModuleTensorUniversalProperty.{_, _, _, 0} R M N).1.2.2 r m n

private abbrev additive {B : Type*} [AddZeroClass B] (f : B → A)
    (hf : ∀ x y, f (x + y) = f x + f y) : B →+ A where
  toFun := f
  map_add' := hf
  map_zero' := by
    have h := hf 0 0
    rw [zero_add] at h
    exact (add_left_cancel (show f 0 + 0 = f 0 + f 0 by rw [add_zero]; exact h)).symm

private def pureLeft (n : N) : M →+ Tensor R M N :=
  additive (fun m => pure R m n) (fun m m' => pure_add_left m m' n)

private def pureRight (m : M) : N →+ Tensor R M N :=
  additive (pure R m) (pure_add_right m)

private theorem liftExists (f : M × N → A)
    (hl : ∀ m m' n, f (m + m', n) = f (m, n) + f (m', n))
    (hr : ∀ m n n', f (m, n + n') = f (m, n) + f (m, n'))
    (hb : ∀ (r : R) m n, f (MulOpposite.op r • m, n) = f (m, r • n)) :
    ∃! F : Tensor R M N →+ A, ∀ m n, F (pure R m n) = f (m, n) :=
  ((ModuleTensorUniversalProperty R M N).2 A).1 ⟨f, hl, hr, hb⟩

-- Alphabeta Math, thm-associativity-of-balanced-tensor-products.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-associativity-of-balanced-tensor-products
-- The coordinator's quotient adapters are definitional: the curried generator
-- here has the same pair of indices and the same three subgroup generators.
-- The registered universal property already performs the free additive extension
-- and quotient descent in Proofs.ModuleTensorUniversalProperty. This
-- endpoint allows classical choice, which extracts the unique lifts below.
private def descend (f : M →+ N →+ A)
    (hb : ∀ (r : R) m n, f (MulOpposite.op r • m) n = f m (r • n)) :
    Tensor R M N →+ A :=
  Classical.choose (liftExists (fun p => f p.1 p.2)
    (fun m m' n => DFunLike.congr_fun (map_add f m m') n)
    (fun m n n' => map_add (f m) n n') hb)

private theorem descend_pure (f : M →+ N →+ A)
    (hb : ∀ (r : R) m n, f (MulOpposite.op r • m) n = f m (r • n)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    descend f hb (pure R m n) = f m n :=
  (Classical.choose_spec (liftExists (fun p => f p.1 p.2)
    (fun m m' n => DFunLike.congr_fun (map_add f m m') n)
    (fun m n n' => map_add (f m) n n') hb)).1 m n

private theorem hom_ext (f g : Tensor R M N →+ A)
    (h : ∀ m n, f (pure R m n) = g (pure R m n)) : f = g := by
  obtain ⟨F, _, unique⟩ := liftExists (fun p => g (pure R p.1 p.2))
    (fun m m' n => by rw [pure_add_left, map_add])
    (fun m n n' => by rw [pure_add_right, map_add])
    (fun r m n => by rw [pure_balance])
  exact (unique f h).trans (unique g (fun _ _ => rfl)).symm

variable [AddCommGroup M'] [AddCommGroup N'] [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M'] [Module R N']

private def tensorMap (f : M →ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N') :
    Tensor R M N →+ Tensor R M' N' :=
  descend
    (additive (fun m => (pureRight (R := R) (f m)).comp g.toAddMonoidHom)
      (fun m m' => AddMonoidHom.ext fun n => by
        change pure R (f (m + m')) (g n) = pure R (f m) (g n) + pure R (f m') (g n)
        rw [map_add, pure_add_left]))
    (fun r m n => by
      change pure R (f (MulOpposite.op r • m)) (g n) = pure R (f m) (g (r • n))
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, pure_balance])

private theorem tensorMap_pure (f : M →ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N')
    (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorMap f g (pure R m n) = pure R (f m) (g n) := by
  rw [tensorMap, descend_pure]
  rfl

section OuterAction

variable [Ring C]

private def scalarMap (T B : Type*) [Ring T] [AddCommGroup B] [Module T B] [Module C B]
    [SMulCommClass C T B] (c : C) : B →ₗ[T] B where
  toFun b := c • b
  map_add' := smul_add c
  map_smul' t b := smul_comm c t b

@[instance_reducible] private def moduleFromMaps {B : Type*} [AddCommGroup B] (f : C → B →+ B)
    (one : f 1 = AddMonoidHom.id B)
    (mul : ∀ c d, f (c * d) = (f c).comp (f d))
    (add : ∀ c d, f (c + d) = f c + f d)
    (zero : f 0 = 0) : Module C B where
  smul c b := f c b
  one_smul b := DFunLike.congr_fun one b
  mul_smul c d b := DFunLike.congr_fun (mul c d) b
  smul_zero c := map_zero (f c)
  smul_add c := map_add (f c)
  add_smul c d b := DFunLike.congr_fun (add c d) b
  zero_smul b := DFunLike.congr_fun zero b

-- The portal assumes the two inner actions in L1. We construct them, including
-- the module laws, by descending the commuting scalar maps and testing on pairs.
@[instance_reducible] private def leftModule [Module C M] [SMulCommClass C (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] :
    Module C (Tensor R M N) :=
  moduleFromMaps (fun c => tensorMap (scalarMap (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M c) (LinearMap.id (R := R)))
    (hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R ((1 : C) • m) n = pure R m n
      rw [one_smul])
    (fun c d => hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tensorMap_pure, tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R ((c * d) • m) n = pure R (c • d • m) n
      rw [mul_smul])
    (fun c d => hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, tensorMap_pure, tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R ((c + d) • m) n = pure R (c • m) n + pure R (d • m) n
      rw [add_smul, pure_add_left])
    (hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R ((0 : C) • m) n = 0
      rw [zero_smul]
      exact map_zero (pureLeft n))

private theorem leftModule_pure [Module C M] [SMulCommClass C (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M]
    (c : C) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (leftModule (C := C) (R := R) (M := M) (N := N)).smul c (pure R m n) =
      pure R (c • m) n :=
  tensorMap_pure _ _ m n

@[instance_reducible] private def rightModule [Module C N] [SMulCommClass C R N] :
    Module C (Tensor R M N) :=
  moduleFromMaps (fun c => tensorMap (LinearMap.id (R := Rᵐᵒᵖ)) (scalarMap R N c))
    (hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R m ((1 : C) • n) = pure R m n
      rw [one_smul])
    (fun c d => hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, tensorMap_pure, tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R m ((c * d) • n) = pure R m (c • d • n)
      rw [mul_smul])
    (fun c d => hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure, AddMonoidHom.add_apply, tensorMap_pure, tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R m ((c + d) • n) = pure R m (c • n) + pure R m (d • n)
      rw [add_smul, pure_add_right])
    (hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      rw [tensorMap_pure]
      change pure R m ((0 : C) • n) = 0
      rw [zero_smul]
      exact map_zero (pureRight m))

private theorem rightModule_pure [Module C N] [SMulCommClass C R N]
    (c : C) (m : M) (n : N) :
    (rightModule (C := C) (R := R) (M := M) (N := N)).smul c (pure R m n) =
      pure R m (c • n) :=
  tensorMap_pure _ _ m n

end OuterAction

section Triple

variable [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M N)] [Module R (Tensor S N P)]

private abbrev LeftTensor (R S : Type*) [Ring R] [Ring S] (M N P : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P]
    [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M N)] [Module S P] :=
  Tensor S (Tensor R M N) P

private abbrev RightTensor (R S : Type*) [Ring R] [Ring S] (M N P : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P]
    [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N] [Module S P] [Module R (Tensor S N P)] :=
  Tensor R M (Tensor S N P)

private abbrev leftPure (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) : LeftTensor R S M N P :=
  pure S (pure R m n) p

private abbrev rightPure (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) : RightTensor R S M N P :=
  pure R m (pure S n p)

private abbrev LeftActionLaw (R S M N : Type*) [Ring R] [Ring S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N]
    [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M N)] :=
  ∀ (s : S) (m : M) (n : N), MulOpposite.op s • pure R m n =
    pure R m (MulOpposite.op s • n)

private abbrev RightActionLaw (R S N P : Type*) [Ring R] [Ring S]
    [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N] [Module S P]
    [Module R N] [Module R (Tensor S N P)] :=
  ∀ (r : R) (n : N) (p : P), r • pure S n p = pure S (r • n) p

private structure TriplePairing (R S M N P A : Type*) [Ring R] [Ring S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N] [AddCommGroup P] [AddCommGroup A]
    [Module (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M] [Module R N] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N] [Module S P] where
  run : M → N → P → A
  add_first : ∀ m m' n p, run (m + m') n p = run m n p + run m' n p
  add_middle : ∀ m n n' p, run m (n + n') p = run m n p + run m n' p
  add_last : ∀ m n p p', run m n (p + p') = run m n p + run m n p'
  balance_R : ∀ (r : R) m n p, run (MulOpposite.op r • m) n p = run m (r • n) p
  balance_S : ∀ (s : S) m n p, run m (MulOpposite.op s • n) p = run m n (s • p)

variable {f : TriplePairing R S M N P A}

-- Step 1.1 first descends the R-balanced pairing, with P →+ A as
-- target. This keeps additivity in p bundled before the second descent.
private def leftInner (f : TriplePairing R S M N P A) : Tensor R M N →+ (P →+ A) :=
  descend
    (additive (fun m => additive (fun n => additive (f.run m n) (f.add_last m n))
      (fun n n' => AddMonoidHom.ext fun p => f.add_middle m n n' p))
      (fun m m' => AddMonoidHom.ext fun n => AddMonoidHom.ext fun p => f.add_first m m' n p))
    (fun r m n => AddMonoidHom.ext fun p => f.balance_R r m n p)

omit [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M N)] [Module R (Tensor S N P)] in
private theorem leftInner_pure (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    leftInner f (pure R m n) p = f.run m n p := by
  rw [leftInner, descend_pure]
  rfl

-- Step 2.1 compares two additive maps on MN to verify S-balance.
private def leftLift (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (f : TriplePairing R S M N P A) :
    LeftTensor R S M N P →+ A :=
  descend (leftInner f) (fun s x p => by
    let e : Tensor R M N →+ A :=
      ((AddMonoidHom.eval p).comp (leftInner f)).comp
        (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ (MulOpposite.op s))
    let g : Tensor R M N →+ A := (AddMonoidHom.eval (s • p)).comp (leftInner f)
    have eq : e = g := hom_ext _ _ fun m n => by
      change leftInner f (MulOpposite.op s • pure R m n) p = leftInner f (pure R m n) (s • p)
      rw [hL, leftInner_pure, leftInner_pure]
      exact f.balance_S s m n p
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x)

private theorem leftLift_pure (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N)
    (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    leftLift hL f (leftPure m n p) = f.run m n p := by
  unfold leftLift
  exact (descend_pure _ _ (pure R m n) p).trans (leftInner_pure m n p)

-- Steps 1.2 and 2.2 first descend the S-balanced pairing for each m.
-- Extensionality on N ⊗ P proves additivity in m and R-balance.
private def rightInner (f : TriplePairing R S M N P A) (m : M) : Tensor S N P →+ A :=
  descend (additive (fun n => additive (f.run m n) (f.add_last m n))
    (fun n n' => AddMonoidHom.ext fun p => f.add_middle m n n' p))
    (f.balance_S · m)

omit [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M N)] [Module R (Tensor S N P)] in
private theorem rightInner_pure (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    rightInner f m (pure S n p) = f.run m n p := by
  unfold rightInner
  exact descend_pure _ _ n p

private def rightLift (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P) (f : TriplePairing R S M N P A) :
    RightTensor R S M N P →+ A :=
  descend (additive (rightInner f) (fun m m' => hom_ext _ _ fun n p => by
    rw [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, rightInner_pure, rightInner_pure, rightInner_pure]
    exact f.add_first m m' n p)) (fun r m y => by
    let g := (rightInner f m).comp (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ r)
    have eq : rightInner f (MulOpposite.op r • m) = g := hom_ext _ _ fun n p => by
      change rightInner f (MulOpposite.op r • m) (pure S n p) = rightInner f m (r • pure S n p)
      rw [hT, rightInner_pure, rightInner_pure]
      exact f.balance_R r m n p
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq y)

private theorem rightLift_pure (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P)
    (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    rightLift hT f (rightPure m n p) = f.run m n p := by
  unfold rightLift
  exact (descend_pure _ _ m (pure S n p)).trans (rightInner_pure m n p)

omit [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N] [Module R (Tensor S N P)] in
private theorem left_ext (f g : LeftTensor R S M N P →+ A)
    (h : ∀ m n p, f (leftPure m n p) = g (leftPure m n p)) : f = g := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro x p
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (hom_ext (f.comp (pureLeft p)) (g.comp (pureLeft p))
    (fun m n => h m n p)) x

omit [Module R N] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M N)] in
private theorem right_ext (f g : RightTensor R S M N P →+ A)
    (h : ∀ m n p, f (rightPure m n p) = g (rightPure m n p)) : f = g := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m y
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (hom_ext (f.comp (pureRight m)) (g.comp (pureRight m))
    (fun n p => h m n p)) y

private def leftPairing (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) :
    TriplePairing R S M N P (LeftTensor R S M N P) where
  run := leftPure
  add_first m m' n p := by rw [leftPure, leftPure, leftPure, pure_add_left, pure_add_left]
  add_middle m n n' p := by rw [leftPure, leftPure, leftPure, pure_add_right, pure_add_left]
  add_last m n p p' := pure_add_right (pure R m n) p p'
  balance_R r m n p := congrArg (fun x => pure S x p) (pure_balance r m n)
  balance_S s m n p := by rw [leftPure, leftPure, ← hL, pure_balance]

private def rightPairing (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P) :
    TriplePairing R S M N P (RightTensor R S M N P) where
  run := rightPure
  add_first m m' n p := pure_add_left m m' (pure S n p)
  add_middle m n n' p := by rw [rightPure, rightPure, rightPure, pure_add_left, pure_add_right]
  add_last m n p p' := by rw [rightPure, rightPure, rightPure, pure_add_right, pure_add_right]
  balance_R r m n p := by rw [rightPure, rightPure, ← hT, pure_balance]
  balance_S s m n p := congrArg (pure R m) (pure_balance s n p)

-- Step 3.1 uses the two descents twice for extensionality on pure triples.
private def reassoc (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P) :
    LeftTensor R S M N P ≃+ RightTensor R S M N P :=
  let f := leftLift hL (rightPairing hT)
  let g := rightLift hT (leftPairing hL)
  have fg : f.comp g = AddMonoidHom.id _ := right_ext _ _ fun m n p => by
    change f (g (rightPure m n p)) = rightPure m n p
    rw [show g (rightPure m n p) = leftPure m n p from rightLift_pure hT m n p]
    exact leftLift_pure hL m n p
  have gf : g.comp f = AddMonoidHom.id _ := left_ext _ _ fun m n p => by
    change g (f (leftPure m n p)) = leftPure m n p
    rw [show f (leftPure m n p) = rightPure m n p from leftLift_pure hL m n p]
    exact rightLift_pure hT m n p
  { toFun := f
    invFun := g
    left_inv := DFunLike.congr_fun gf
    right_inv := DFunLike.congr_fun fg
    map_add' := map_add f }

private theorem reassoc_pure (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P)
    (m : M) (n : N) (p : P) :
    reassoc hL hT (leftPure m n p) = rightPure m n p :=
  leftLift_pure hL m n p

private theorem reassoc_unique (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P)
    (e : LeftTensor R S M N P ≃+ RightTensor R S M N P) :
    (∀ m n p, e (leftPure m n p) = rightPure m n p) ↔ e = reassoc hL hT := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have eq : e.toAddMonoidHom = (reassoc hL hT).toAddMonoidHom :=
      left_ext _ _ fun m n p => (h m n p).trans (reassoc_pure hL hT m n p).symm
    apply AddEquiv.ext
    intro q
    exact congrArg (fun k : LeftTensor R S M N P →+ RightTensor R S M N P => k q) eq
  · rintro rfl
    exact reassoc_pure hL hT

-- Step 3.2. Descend the C-action on the right nesting, where it acts on
-- the first factor. Transfer it through the additive equivalence to obtain
-- the action on the left nesting and check its required pure-tensor formula.
private theorem left_compatibility [Ring C] [Module C M] [SMulCommClass C (Rᵐᵒᵖ) M]
    (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P) :
    ∃ (aL : Module C (LeftTensor R S M N P)) (aT : Module C (RightTensor R S M N P)),
      (∀ (c : C) (m : M) (n : N) (p : P),
        aL.smul c (leftPure m n p) = leftPure (c • m) n p ∧
        aT.smul c (rightPure m n p) = rightPure (c • m) n p) ∧
      ∀ c q, reassoc hL hT (aL.smul c q) = aT.smul c (reassoc hL hT q) := by
  let aT : Module C (RightTensor R S M N P) := leftModule
  let e := reassoc hL hT
  let aL := e.module C
  refine ⟨aL, aT, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c m n p
    have hp : aT.smul c (rightPure m n p) = rightPure (c • m) n p :=
      leftModule_pure c m (pure S n p)
    refine ⟨?_, hp⟩
    change e.symm (aT.smul c (e (leftPure m n p))) = leftPure (c • m) n p
    rw [show e (leftPure m n p) = rightPure m n p from reassoc_pure hL hT m n p, hp]
    exact e.symm_apply_eq.mpr (reassoc_pure hL hT (c • m) n p).symm
  · intro c q
    exact e.apply_symm_apply (aT.smul c (e q))

-- The right exterior action is a left action of the opposite ring. Descend it
-- on the left nesting, where it acts on the last factor.
private theorem right_compatibility [Ring C] [Module (Cᵐᵒᵖ) P] [SMulCommClass S (Cᵐᵒᵖ) P]
    (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P) :
    ∃ (aL : Module (Cᵐᵒᵖ) (LeftTensor R S M N P))
      (aT : Module (Cᵐᵒᵖ) (RightTensor R S M N P)),
      (∀ (c : C) (m : M) (n : N) (p : P),
        aL.smul (MulOpposite.op c) (leftPure m n p) = leftPure m n (MulOpposite.op c • p) ∧
        aT.smul (MulOpposite.op c) (rightPure m n p) = rightPure m n (MulOpposite.op c • p)) ∧
      ∀ (c : C) q, reassoc hL hT (aL.smul (MulOpposite.op c) q) =
        aT.smul (MulOpposite.op c) (reassoc hL hT q) := by
  let _ := SMulCommClass.symm S (Cᵐᵒᵖ) P
  let aL : Module (Cᵐᵒᵖ) (LeftTensor R S M N P) := rightModule
  let e := reassoc hL hT
  let aT := e.symm.module (Cᵐᵒᵖ)
  refine ⟨aL, aT, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro c m n p
    have hp : aL.smul (MulOpposite.op c) (leftPure m n p) =
        leftPure m n (MulOpposite.op c • p) := rightModule_pure (MulOpposite.op c) (pure R m n) p
    refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
    change e (aL.smul (MulOpposite.op c) (e.symm (rightPure m n p))) =
      rightPure m n (MulOpposite.op c • p)
    rw [show e.symm (rightPure m n p) = leftPure m n p from
      e.symm_apply_eq.mpr (reassoc_pure hL hT m n p).symm, hp]
    exact reassoc_pure hL hT m n (MulOpposite.op c • p)
  · intro c q
    change e (aL.smul (MulOpposite.op c) q) =
      e (aL.smul (MulOpposite.op c) (e.symm (e q)))
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]

section Naturality

variable [AddCommGroup P'] [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) N'] [Module S P']
variable [Module (Sᵐᵒᵖ) (Tensor R M' N')] [Module R (Tensor S N' P')]

private def pullPairing (f : M →ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N') (h : P →ₗ[S] P')
    (hg : ∀ (s : S) n, g (MulOpposite.op s • n) = MulOpposite.op s • g n)
    (b : TriplePairing R S M' N' P' A) : TriplePairing R S M N P A where
  run m n p := b.run (f m) (g n) (h p)
  add_first m m' n p := by rw [map_add, b.add_first]
  add_middle m n n' p := by rw [map_add, b.add_middle]
  add_last m n p p' := by rw [map_add, b.add_last]
  balance_R r m n p := by rw [map_smul, map_smul, b.balance_R]
  balance_S s m n p := by rw [hg, map_smul, b.balance_S]

-- Step 3.2 also supplies the two induced maps by descent and proves the
-- naturality square for any pair of maps with the stated generator formulas.
private theorem reassoc_natural
    (hL : LeftActionLaw R S M N) (hT : RightActionLaw R S N P)
    (hL' : LeftActionLaw R S M' N') (hT' : RightActionLaw R S N' P')
    (f : M →ₗ[Rᵐᵒᵖ] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N') (h : P →ₗ[S] P')
    (hg : ∀ (s : S) n, g (MulOpposite.op s • n) = MulOpposite.op s • g n) :
    let Maps := (LeftTensor R S M N P →+ LeftTensor R S M' N' P') ×
      (RightTensor R S M N P →+ RightTensor R S M' N' P')
    let induced := fun (maps : Maps) => ∀ m n p,
      maps.1 (leftPure m n p) = leftPure (f m) (g n) (h p) ∧
      maps.2 (rightPure m n p) = rightPure (f m) (g n) (h p)
    (∃ maps : Maps, induced maps) ∧
      (∀ maps : Maps, induced maps → ∀ q,
        reassoc hL' hT' (maps.1 q) = maps.2 (reassoc hL hT q)) := by
  intro Maps induced
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨⟨leftLift hL (pullPairing f g h hg (leftPairing hL')),
      rightLift hT (pullPairing f g h hg (rightPairing hT'))⟩,
      fun m n p => ⟨leftLift_pure hL m n p, rightLift_pure hT m n p⟩⟩
  · intro maps hm q
    have eq : (reassoc hL' hT').toAddMonoidHom.comp maps.1 =
        maps.2.comp (reassoc hL hT).toAddMonoidHom := by
      apply left_ext
      intro m n p
      change reassoc hL' hT' (maps.1 (leftPure m n p)) =
        maps.2 (reassoc hL hT (leftPure m n p))
      rw [(hm m n p).1, reassoc_pure, reassoc_pure, (hm m n p).2]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq q

end Naturality

by
  classical
  intro finitary U blockSym parabolic G A D F C E B hG hA hD hF hC hE hB
    a b d c e f u v w up down tensor comp r t s upperProduct
  -- Xiao, Prop. 8.7, first proof paragraph (archived pp. 39–40,
  -- revised published pp. 41–42). The online proof uses paragraphs.
  -- Steps 1–4 below follow its coefficient, equivariance, stabilizer
  -- and right-orbit arguments. Equation (6.3) is on archived p. 25
  -- and revised published p. 27. Theorem 6.7 is on pp. 26 and 28.
  -- The saved source note's byte-identity claim refers to the earlier publication.
  -- Archived source/mackey-bimodules.pdf has SHA-256
  -- bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2.
  -- The revised published PDF hashes to 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e.
  -- The cited argument agrees on the verified pages of both copies.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  have hfinite : ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | upperProduct p = z} := by
    let : Finite G := parabolic_finite hG
    let : Finite E := parabolic_finite hE
    let : Finite (upBasis c e).carrier :=
      Finite.of_surjective (fun p : G × E => (Biset.induction c).pair (Biset.restriction e) p.1 p.2)
        (fun p => Quotient.inductionOn p (fun q => ⟨q, rfl⟩))
    exact fun _ => Set.toFinite _
  refine ⟨hfinite, ?_⟩
  intro ga ad df gc ce ef du uv uw bottom top X Y input output stack juxtapose ordinary
    first middle last leftDiagram Pair orbit stabilizer project inAmbient
    projectedSource projectedTarget projectedPair coefficient actB
  let sourceMap := ambientMap a b d u v r t.element
  let targetMap := ambientMap c e f u w s 1
  have hsRep (g : G) (x : D) : sourceMap (input g x) =
      u.toHom g * r.element * v.toHom x * t.element :=
    ambientMap_point a b d u v r t.element g x
  have htRep (h : G) (y : E) : targetMap (output h y) = u.toHom h * s.element * w.toHom y := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using ambientMap_point c e f u w s 1 h y
  -- Step 1. The group-element singleton crosses the projection fiber once.
  have hentry (z : Pair) :
      coefficient leftDiagram z =
        @ite Complex (sourceMap z.1 = targetMap z.2) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0 := by
    obtain ⟨p, q⟩ := z
    obtain ⟨g, x, rfl⟩ := point_surjective a b d p
    obtain ⟨h, y, rfl⟩ := point_surjective c e f q
    show coefficient leftDiagram (input g x, output h y) = _
    rw [show sourceMap (input g x, output h y).1 = _ from hsRep g x,
      show targetMap (input g x, output h y).2 = _ from htRep h y]
    exact coefficient_on_points a b d c e f u v w r t s hfinite g x h y
  -- Step 2. The crossing labels give quotient descent and equivariance,
  -- including v(d(k)) * t = t * w(f(k)) for the middle crossing.
  have hsAct (q : G × F) (p : X.carrier) :
      sourceMap (Biset.act X q p) = actB q (sourceMap p) :=
    ambientMap_act a b d u v r t.element (w.toHom.comp f.toHom) t.intertwines q p
  have htAct (q : G × F) (p : Y.carrier) :
      targetMap (Biset.act Y q p) = actB q (targetMap p) :=
    ambientMap_act c e f u w s 1 (w.toHom.comp f.toHom) (fun k => by simp) q p
  have hsupport (z : Pair) :
      coefficient leftDiagram z ≠ 0 ↔ sourceMap z.1 = targetMap z.2 := by
    rw [hentry]
    by_cases h : sourceMap z.1 = targetMap z.2 <;> simp [h]
  refine ⟨sourceMap, targetMap, hsRep, htRep, hsAct, htAct, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    have himage := (hsupport z).mp hz
    -- Step 3. Fixing the shared image pins down the same first component
    -- for both lifts of any k in the intersection of projections.
    have hpair : projectedPair z = projectedSource z.1 ⊓ projectedTarget z.2 := by
      ext k
      change (∃ q : G × F, (X.act q z.1, Y.act q z.2) = z ∧ q.2 = k) ↔
        (∃ q : G × F, X.act q z.1 = z.1 ∧ q.2 = k) ∧
        (∃ q : G × F, Y.act q z.2 = z.2 ∧ q.2 = k)
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨q, hq, hk⟩
        exact ⟨⟨q, congrArg Prod.fst hq, hk⟩, ⟨q, congrArg Prod.snd hq, hk⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨q₁, k₁⟩, h₁, rfl⟩, ⟨⟨q₂, k₂⟩, h₂, hk⟩⟩
        change k₂ = k₁ at hk
        subst k₂
        have hleft := hsAct (q₁, k₁) z.1
        have hright := htAct (q₂, k₁) z.2
        rw [h₁] at hleft
        rw [h₂, ← himage] at hright
        have he : q₁ = q₂ := u.injective (mul_right_cancel (mul_right_cancel
          (hleft.symm.trans hright)))
        exact ⟨(q₁, k₁), Prod.ext h₁ (he.symm ▸ h₂), rfl⟩
    have hsPar : parabolic (inAmbient (projectedSource z.1)) := by
      obtain ⟨g, x, hx⟩ := SupportedLeftOrbitAux.point_surjective a b d z.1
      change input g x = z.1 at hx
      rw [← hx]
      rw [show projectedSource (input g x) = _ from
        SupportedLeftOrbitAux.projection_formula a b d g x]
      exact SupportedLeftOrbitAux.projected_parabolic hA hF b d x
    have htPar : parabolic (inAmbient (projectedTarget z.2)) := by
      obtain ⟨h, y, hy⟩ := SupportedLeftOrbitAux.point_surjective c e f z.2
      change output h y = z.2 at hy
      rw [← hy]
      rw [show projectedTarget (output h y) = _ from
        SupportedLeftOrbitAux.projection_formula c e f h y]
      exact SupportedLeftOrbitAux.projected_parabolic hC hF e f y
    refine ⟨hpair, hsPar, htPar, ?_, by rw [hentry, ite_eq_left himage]⟩
    rw [hpair]
    change parabolic ((projectedSource z.1 ⊓ projectedTarget z.2).map F.subtype)
    rw [Subgroup.map_inf _ _ _ F.subtype_injective]
    exact SupportedLeftOrbitAux.parabolic_inf hsPar htPar
  · intro x h y z₀ hz
    refine ⟨SupportedLeftOrbitAux.projection_formula a b d 1 x,
      SupportedLeftOrbitAux.projection_formula c e f h y, ?_⟩
    -- Step 4. Theorem 6.7 requires a nonzero entry of an equivariant
    -- finitely supported column. Use the evaluated left drawing itself.
    intro P
    have hP : P = (stabilizer z₀).map (F.subtype.comp (MonoidHom.snd G F)) :=
      Subgroup.map_map (stabilizer z₀) F.subtype (MonoidHom.snd G F)
    rw [hP]
    have hR := ((RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer G A D F C E a b d c e f
      ).2.2.1 x h y).2.2.2
    obtain ⟨i, j, k, r', t', s', hj, hr, ht, hs, _, _, horbit⟩ := hR
    obtain ⟨_, finite, heval⟩ := horbit leftDiagram.interpret.eval hz
    exact ⟨i, j, k, r', t', s', hj, hr, ht, hs, finite, heval⟩

namespace SupportedLeftOrbitAux

open MackeyDiagrams

private abbrev finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev blockSym (S : Finset Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
private abbrev ParabolicPerm (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat), (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧ H = ⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)
private abbrev Parabolic (H : Subgroup finitary) := ParabolicPerm (H.map finitary.subtype)

private theorem parabolic_of_family {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (blocks : ι → Finset Nat)
    (hne : ∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty)
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j))) :
    ParabolicPerm (⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)) := by
  let := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin ι).symm
  exact ⟨_, blocks ∘ e, fun i => hne (e i),
    fun i j hij => hdisj (fun h => hij (e.injective h)),
    (e.iSup_comp (g := fun i => blockSym (blocks i))).symm⟩

private theorem parabolic_conj {H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} (hH : ParabolicPerm H)
    (z : finitary) : ParabolicPerm (H.map (MulAut.conj (z : Equiv.Perm Nat)).toMonoidHom) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, A, hA, hdisj, rfl⟩ := hH
  rw [FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks A hA hdisj z]
  refine parabolic_of_family _ (fun i => (hA i).image _) ?_
  intro i j hij
  have hmap (S : Finset Nat) : S.map (z : Equiv.Perm Nat).toEmbedding =
      S.image (z : Equiv.Perm Nat) := Finset.map_eq_image _ _
  rw [← hmap, ← hmap]
  exact (Finset.disjoint_map _).mpr (hdisj hij)

private theorem parabolic_inf_perm {H K : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)}
    (hH : ParabolicPerm H) (hK : ParabolicPerm K) : ParabolicPerm (H ⊓ K) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, A, hA, hdA, rfl⟩ := hH
  obtain ⟨m, B, hB, hdB, rfl⟩ := hK
  let X := (Finset.univ.biUnion A) ∪ (Finset.univ.biUnion B)
  -- Prop. 7.1 uses two partitions of one finite set. Singleton padding
  -- adds trivial factors and supplies exactly the common-carrier hypotheses.
  have pad {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → Finset Nat)
      (hne : ∀ i, (D i).Nonempty)
      (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
      (hsub : Finset.univ.biUnion D ⊆ X) :
      let blocks : ι ⊕ ↥(X \ Finset.univ.biUnion D) → Finset Nat :=
        Sum.elim D (fun y => {y.val})
      (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧
        Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
        (∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ blocks i) ∧
        (⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)) = ⨆ i, blockSym (D i) := by
    intro blocks
    have memUnion (x : Nat) : x ∈ Finset.univ.biUnion D ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ D i := by
      simp
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro (i | y)
      · exact hne i
      · exact Finset.singleton_nonempty _
    · intro i j hij
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro x hx hy
      cases i with
      | inl i =>
        cases j with
        | inl j => exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd (fun h => hij (congrArg Sum.inl h))) hx hy
        | inr y =>
          exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp y.property).2
            ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy) ▸ (memUnion x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
      | inr y =>
        cases j with
        | inl j =>
          exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp y.property).2
            ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx) ▸ (memUnion x).mpr ⟨j, hy⟩)
        | inr w =>
          exact hij (congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext
            ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).symm.trans (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy))))
    · intro x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        by_cases h : x ∈ Finset.univ.biUnion D
        · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (memUnion x).mp h
          exact ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x, Finset.mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hx, h⟩⟩, Finset.mem_singleton_self x⟩
      · rintro ⟨i | y, hx⟩
        · exact hsub ((memUnion x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)
        · exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).symm ▸ (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp y.property).1
    · rw [iSup_sum]
      change (⨆ i, blockSym (D i)) ⊔ (⨆ j : ↥(X \ Finset.univ.biUnion D), blockSym {j.val}) = _
      have singletonSym (x : Nat) : blockSym {x} = ⊥ := by
        refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
        rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
        have hτ : τ = 1 := by
          apply Equiv.ext
          intro y
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp (τ y).property).trans
            (Finset.mem_singleton.mp y.property).symm
        rw [hτ, map_one]
        exact Subgroup.one_mem _
      simp only [singletonSym, iSup_bot, sup_bot_eq]
  let A' : Fin n ⊕ ↥(X \ Finset.univ.biUnion A) → Finset Nat :=
    Sum.elim A (fun y => {y.val})
  let B' : Fin m ⊕ ↥(X \ Finset.univ.biUnion B) → Finset Nat :=
    Sum.elim B (fun y => {y.val})
  obtain ⟨ha, da, ca, ea⟩ := pad A hA hdA Finset.subset_union_left
  obtain ⟨hb, db, cb, eb⟩ := pad B hB hdB Finset.subset_union_right
  change (⨆ i, blockSym (A' i)) = _ at ea
  change (⨆ i, blockSym (B' i)) = _ at eb
  rw [← ea, ← eb, FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks X A' B' ha hb da db ca cb]
  let Cell := {ij : _ × _ // (A' ij.1 ∩ B' ij.2).Nonempty}
  let cell (ij : Cell) := A' ij.val.1 ∩ B' ij.val.2
  have omitEmpty : (⨆ i, ⨆ j, blockSym (A' i ∩ B' j)) = ⨆ ij, blockSym (cell ij) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine iSup_le fun i => iSup_le fun j => ?_
      by_cases h : (A' i ∩ B' j).Nonempty
      · exact le_iSup (fun ij => blockSym (cell ij)) (⟨(i, j), h⟩ : Cell)
      · rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
        have hone : Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ = (1 : Equiv.Perm Nat) := by
          apply Equiv.ext
          intro x
          exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ (fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩)
        rw [hone]
        exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · refine iSup_le fun ij => ?_
      exact (le_iSup (fun j => blockSym (A' ij.val.1 ∩ B' j)) ij.val.2).trans
        (le_iSup (fun i => ⨆ j, blockSym (A' i ∩ B' j)) ij.val.1)
  rw [omitEmpty]
  refine parabolic_of_family cell (fun ij => ij.property) ?_
  intro ij kl hne
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hy
  obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
  obtain ⟨hk, hl⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hy
  have hik : ij.val.1 = kl.val.1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (da h) hi hk
  have hjl : ij.val.2 = kl.val.2 := by
    by_contra h
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (db h) hj hl
  exact hne (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hik hjl))

private theorem parabolic_inf {H K : Subgroup finitary}
    (hH : Parabolic H) (hK : Parabolic K) : Parabolic (H ⊓ K) := by
  change ParabolicPerm ((H ⊓ K).map finitary.subtype)
  rw [Subgroup.map_inf _ _ _ finitary.subtype_injective]
  exact parabolic_inf_perm hH hK

private theorem projected_parabolic {A D F : Subgroup finitary} (hA : Parabolic A)
    (hF : Parabolic F) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D) (x : D) :
    Parabolic (((MonoidHom.range b.toHom).map (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).toMonoidHom).comap
      d.toHom |>.map F.subtype) := by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := b.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := d.hasRepresentative
  let z : finitary := δ⁻¹ * (x : finitary)⁻¹ * β
  let projected := (((MonoidHom.range b.toHom).map (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).toMonoidHom).comap
    d.toHom).map F.subtype
  have hproj : projected.map finitary.subtype =
      F.map finitary.subtype ⊓ (A.map finitary.subtype).map
        (MulAut.conj (z : Equiv.Perm Nat)).toMonoidHom := by
    ext σ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨k, ⟨_, ⟨α, rfl⟩, hk⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨(k : finitary), k.property, rfl⟩, _, ⟨(α : finitary), α.property, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change ((z * (α : finitary) * z⁻¹ : finitary) : Equiv.Perm Nat) =
        ((k : finitary) : Equiv.Perm Nat)
      apply congrArg (fun g : finitary => (g : Equiv.Perm Nat))
      have hk' := congrArg (fun y : D => (y : finitary)) hk
      change (x : finitary)⁻¹ * (b.toHom α : finitary) * ((x⁻¹ : D) : finitary)⁻¹ =
        (d.toHom k : finitary) at hk'
      rw [hβ, hδ] at hk'
      change (x : finitary)⁻¹ * (β * (α : finitary) * β⁻¹) *
        ((x : finitary)⁻¹)⁻¹ = δ * (k : finitary) * δ⁻¹ at hk'
      calc
        z * (α : finitary) * z⁻¹ =
            δ⁻¹ * ((x : finitary)⁻¹ * (β * (α : finitary) * β⁻¹) *
              ((x : finitary)⁻¹)⁻¹) * δ := by dsimp only [z]; group
        _ = k := by rw [hk']; group
    · rintro ⟨⟨k, hk, rfl⟩, _, ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩, h⟩
      change ((z * α * z⁻¹ : finitary) : Equiv.Perm Nat) = (k : Equiv.Perm Nat) at h
      have hz : z * α * z⁻¹ = k := Subtype.ext h
      refine ⟨k, ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, ⟨b.toHom ⟨α, hα⟩, ⟨⟨α, hα⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (x : finitary)⁻¹ * (b.toHom ⟨α, hα⟩ : finitary) *
        ((x⁻¹ : D) : finitary)⁻¹ = (d.toHom ⟨k, hk⟩ : finitary)
      rw [hβ, hδ]
      change (x : finitary)⁻¹ * (β * α * β⁻¹) * ((x : finitary)⁻¹)⁻¹ =
        δ * k * δ⁻¹
      rw [← hz]
      dsimp only [z]
      group
  show ParabolicPerm (projected.map finitary.subtype)
  rw [hproj]
  exact parabolic_inf_perm hF (parabolic_conj hA z)

private theorem parabolic_finite {H : Subgroup finitary} (hH : Parabolic H) : Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, A, _, _, hA⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion A
  have hsub : H.map finitary.subtype ≤ blockSym X := by
    rw [hA]
    refine iSup_le fun i σ hs => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
    let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ
    have moved_mem (x : Nat) (hx : σ x ≠ x) : x ∈ X := by
      by_contra hn
      have hi : x ∉ A i := fun hx' => hn (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx'⟩)
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hi)
    have preserves (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · rw [h]
      · have hy : σ (σ x) ≠ σ x := fun hh => h (σ.injective hh)
        exact iff_of_true (moved_mem (σ x) hy) (moved_mem x h)
    exact ⟨σ.subtypePerm preserves, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserves moved_mem⟩
  let : Finite (blockSym X) :=
    (Set.finite_range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))).to_subtype
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun h : H => (⟨(h.val : Equiv.Perm Nat), hsub ⟨h.val, h.property, rfl⟩⟩ : blockSym X))
    (fun _ _ hh => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y : blockSym X => y.val) hh)))

end SupportedLeftOrbitAux

section Basis

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)

private abbrev word := (Word.up a).tensor ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d))
private abbrev point (g : G) (x : D) : (word a b d).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis g (Generator.mixedPair b d x)

private theorem point_surjective (z : (word a b d).basis.carrier) :
    ∃ (g : G) (x : D), point a b d g x = z := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨g, y⟩ => ?_
  exact ⟨g, Generator.mixedProduct b d y, by rw [point, Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct]; rfl⟩

private theorem point_eq (g' g : G) (x' x : D) :
    point a b d g' x' = point a b d g x ↔
      ∃ α : A, g' = g * a.toHom α ∧ x = b.toHom α * x' := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨α, hg, hx⟩ := Quotient.exact h
    change 1 * g' * (a.toHom α)⁻¹ = g at hg
    have hx' := congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct b d) hx
    change (b.toHom α * x' * (1 : D)⁻¹) * (1 * 1 * (d.toHom 1)⁻¹) =
      Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedPair b d x) at hx'
    exact ⟨α, mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp (by simpa using hg), by simpa using hx'.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨α, rfl, rfl⟩
    apply Quotient.sound
    refine ⟨α, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change 1 * (g * a.toHom α) * (a.toHom α)⁻¹ = g
      simp
    · change (Biset.restriction b).pair (Biset.induction d)
        (b.toHom α * x' * (1 : D)⁻¹) (1 * 1 * (d.toHom 1)⁻¹) = _
      simp [Generator.mixedPair]

private theorem act_point (q : G × F) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (word a b d).basis.act q (point a b d g x) =
      point a b d (q.1 * g) (x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹) := by
  change (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis
    (q.1 * g * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹)
    ((Biset.restriction b).pair (Biset.induction d)
      (b.toHom 1 * x * (1 : D)⁻¹) (1 * 1 * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹)) = _
  simp only [map_one, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, point]
  congr 1
  apply (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).injective
  change x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹ =
    Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedPair b d (x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹))
  simp

private abbrev action {X : Biset G F} : MulAction (G × F) X.carrier where
  smul := X.act
  one_smul := X.one_act
  mul_smul := X.mul_act

private theorem projection_formula (g : G) (x : D) :
    letI := action (X := (word a b d).basis)
    (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) (point a b d g x)).map (MonoidHom.snd G F) =
      ((MonoidHom.range b.toHom).map (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).toMonoidHom).comap d.toHom := by
  ext k
  change (∃ q : G × F, (word a b d).basis.act q (point a b d g x) = point a b d g x ∧
    q.2 = k) ↔ ∃ z : D, (∃ α : A, b.toHom α = z) ∧ x⁻¹ * z * (x⁻¹)⁻¹ = d.toHom k
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨q, k'⟩, h, rfl⟩
    rw [act_point, point_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨α, _, h⟩ := h
    change x = b.toHom α * (x * (d.toHom k')⁻¹) at h
    refine ⟨b.toHom α, ⟨α, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    have he : x * d.toHom k' = b.toHom α * x := by
      apply eq_mul_inv_iff_mul_eq.mp
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
    simpa only [inv_inv] using (show x⁻¹ * b.toHom α * x = d.toHom k' from calc
      _ = x⁻¹ * (b.toHom α * x) := mul_assoc _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [← he, inv_mul_cancel_left])
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨α, rfl⟩, h⟩
    refine ⟨(g * a.toHom α * g⁻¹, k), ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [act_point, point_eq]
    refine ⟨α, by dsimp; group, ?_⟩
    change x = b.toHom α * (x * (d.toHom k)⁻¹)
    rw [← h]
    group

private noncomputable def ambientMap (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B)
    (r : Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b)) (t : B) : (word a b d).basis.carrier → B :=
  Quotient.lift
    (fun p : G × ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis.carrier =>
      u.toHom p.1 * r.element * v.toHom (Generator.mixedProduct b d p.2) * t)
    (by
      intro p p' h
      let x := Generator.mixedProduct b d p.2
      let x' := Generator.mixedProduct b d p'.2
      have hp : point a b d p.1 x = point a b d p'.1 x' := by
        simp only [point, x, x', Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct]
        obtain ⟨g, y⟩ := p
        obtain ⟨g', y'⟩ := p'
        exact Quotient.sound h
      obtain ⟨α, hg, hx⟩ := (point_eq a b d p.1 p'.1 x x').mp hp
      change u.toHom p.1 * r.element * v.toHom x * t =
        u.toHom p'.1 * r.element * v.toHom x' * t
      have hr := r.intertwines α
      change u.toHom (a.toHom α) * r.element = r.element * v.toHom (b.toHom α) at hr
      simp only [hg, hx, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [← mul_assoc (u.toHom (a.toHom α)) r.element, hr, mul_assoc])

private theorem ambientMap_point (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B)
    (r : Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b)) (t : B) (g : G) (x : D) :
    ambientMap a b d u v r t (point a b d g x) =
      u.toHom g * r.element * v.toHom x * t := by
  change u.toHom g * r.element * v.toHom (Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedPair b d x)) * t = _
  rw [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]

private theorem ambientMap_act (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B)
    (r : Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b)) (t : B) (right : F →* B)
    (ht : ∀ k, v.toHom (d.toHom k) * t = t * right k)
    (q : G × F) (p : (word a b d).basis.carrier) :
    ambientMap a b d u v r t ((word a b d).basis.act q p) =
      u.toHom q.1 * ambientMap a b d u v r t p * (right q.2)⁻¹ := by
  obtain ⟨g, x, rfl⟩ := point_surjective a b d p
  rw [act_point, ambientMap_point, ambientMap_point]
  simp only [map_mul, map_inv]
  have hk : (v.toHom (d.toHom q.2))⁻¹ * t = t * (right q.2)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [map_inv] using ht q.2⁻¹
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [mul_assoc (u.toHom q.1 * u.toHom g * r.element), mul_assoc (v.toHom x), hk]
  group

end Basis

section Evaluation

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
variable (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B) (w : ConjEmbedding E B)
variable (r : Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b)) (t : Dot (v.comp d) (w.comp f))
variable (s : Dot (u.comp c) (w.comp e))

private abbrev upBasis := ((Word.up c).tensor (.down e)).basis
private abbrev upperMap := Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s

private noncomputable abbrev leftInner
    (finite : ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | upperMap c e u w s p = z}) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).tensor (.up d))
      (((Word.up c).tensor (.down e)).tensor (.up f)) :=
  .vertical
    (.horizontal (.mixedMultiplication u v a b [(1, r)]) (.ordinary (.id (.up d))))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate (.down u) (.up v) (.up d)))
      (.vertical (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.down u))) (.parallelUp v d w f [(1, t)]))
        (.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.down u) (.up w) (.up f)))
          (.horizontal (.compactProjection u w c e [(1, ⟨s, finite⟩)])
            (.ordinary (.id (.up f)))))))

private noncomputable abbrev leftDrawing
    (finite : ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | upperMap c e u w s p = z}) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (word a b d) (word c e f) :=
  .vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.up a) (.down b) (.up d)))
    (.vertical (leftInner a b d c e f u v w r t s finite)
      (.ordinary (.associate (.up c) (.down e) (.up f))))

private noncomputable abbrev coefficient {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (z : p.basis.carrier × q.basis.carrier) :=
  drawing.interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2

private def appendUnit (p : (upBasis c e).carrier) : (word c e f).basis.carrier :=
  Biset.associateBasis (Biset.induction c) (Biset.restriction e) (Biset.induction f)
    ((upBasis c e).pair (Biset.induction f) p 1)

private theorem appendUnit_injective : Function.Injective (appendUnit c e f) := by
  intro p p' h
  let assoc := Biset.associateBasisEquiv (Biset.induction c) (Biset.restriction e) (Biset.induction f)
  have h' : (upBasis c e).pair (Biset.induction f) p 1 =
      (upBasis c e).pair (Biset.induction f) p' 1 := by
    apply assoc.injective
    exact h
  obtain ⟨k, hp, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact h'
  change k * 1 * (f.toHom 1)⁻¹ = (1 : E) at hk
  have he : k = 1 := by simpa only [map_one, inv_one, mul_one] using hk
  change (upBasis c e).act (1, k) p = p' at hp
  rw [he] at hp
  change (upBasis c e).act 1 p = p' at hp
  exact ((upBasis c e).one_act p).symm.trans hp

private theorem appendUnit_pair (p : (upBasis c e).carrier) :
    (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.up c) (.down e) (.up f)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((upBasis c e).pair (Biset.induction f) p 1) 1) =
    Finsupp.single (appendUnit c e f p) 1 := by
  change (Biset.associate (Biset.induction c) (Biset.restriction e) (Biset.induction f) Complex
    ).toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Biset.associate, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  rfl

private theorem coefficient_on_points
    (finite : ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | upperMap c e u w s p = z})
    (g : G) (x : D) (h : G) (y : E) :
    coefficient (leftDrawing a b d c e f u v w r t s finite)
      (point a b d g x, point c e f h y) =
      @ite Complex (u.toHom g * r.element * v.toHom x * t.element =
          u.toHom h * s.element * w.toHom y) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0 := by
  classical
  let L := Generator.mixedProduct u w ∘ upperMap c e u w s
  let z := u.toHom g * r.element * v.toHom x * t.element
  have fibers (q : B) : Set.Finite {p | L p = q} := by
    refine (finite (Generator.mixedPair u w q)).subset ?_
    intro p hp
    change Generator.mixedProduct u w (upperMap c e u w s p) = q at hp
    change upperMap c e u w s p = Generator.mixedPair u w q
    rw [← hp, Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct]
  let p₀ := (Biset.induction c).pair (Biset.restriction e) h y
  have hp₀ : L p₀ = u.toHom h * s.element * w.toHom y :=
    Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair u w _
  let inLeft := ((Word.up a).tensor (.down b)).basis.pair (Biset.induction d)
    ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) g x) 1
  let outer := Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.up c) (.down e) (.up f)
  -- Lemma 6.6, equation (6.3) is stated on left-associated bases.
  -- The exterior associators only rebracket the same balanced classes.
  have hInner : (leftInner a b d c e f u v w r t s finite).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single inLeft 1) =
      ∑ p ∈ (fibers z).toFinset,
        Finsupp.single ((upBasis c e).pair (Biset.induction f) p 1) (1 : Complex) :=
    (CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluation a b d c e f u v w).1 r t s fibers g x
  change (outer.eval.toLinearMap
    ((leftInner a b d c e f u v w r t s finite).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) (.up a) (.down b) (.up d)).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1)))) (point c e f h y) = _
  rw [show (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) (.up a) (.down b) (.up d)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1) = Finsupp.single inLeft 1 from
      Diagram.eval_unassociate_single (.up a) (.down b) (.up d) g x 1 1,
    hInner, map_sum, Finset.sum_apply']
  have hout : point c e f h y = appendUnit c e f p₀ := rfl
  rw [hout]
  have hterm (p : (upBasis c e).carrier) :
      (outer.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single ((upBasis c e).pair (Biset.induction f) p 1) 1))
        (appendUnit c e f p₀) = (if p = p₀ then (1 : Complex) else 0) := by
    have hassoc := congrArg
      (fun col : (word c e f).basis.carrier →₀ Complex => col (appendUnit c e f p₀))
      (appendUnit_pair c e f p)
    refine hassoc.trans ?_
    by_cases hp : p = p₀
    · simp [hp]
    · have hne : appendUnit c e f p ≠ appendUnit c e f p₀ :=
        fun he => hp (appendUnit_injective c e f he)
      simp [hp, hne]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => hterm p)]
  simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  change (if L p₀ = z then (1 : Complex) else 0) =
    @ite Complex (z = u.toHom h * s.element * w.toHom y) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0
  rw [hp₀]
  by_cases hz : z = u.toHom h * s.element * w.toHom y
  · simp [hz]
  · simp [hz, Ne.symm hz]


end Evaluation

by
  open MackeyDiagrams MovingMergeDotProof in
  intro U inst K H G γ α target D singleton upInput downInput mergedUp mergedDown
    matchesUp matchesDown inImage
  -- Xiao § 3.2, “Moving a dot back to a branch,” archived original p. 9
  -- and revised published PDF p. 11. The two copies have distinct hashes.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=11
  -- The rendered restriction merge reverses the horizontal order and uses
  -- the inverse multiplier. No numbered Alphabeta counterpart is registered.
  -- Apply (3.1) and (3.3) at d = 1 for the right branch or e = 1 for the left.
  -- The shared identity-dot laws remove the unused mark at evaluation only.
  have transferUp {out : ConjEmbedding K G} (E : Dot (γ.comp α) out)
      (h : out = target) (p : LabelledDrawing Complex upInput (Word.up out))
      (hp : p.interpret.eval = ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up E)).interpret.eval) :
      matchesUp h p ↔ E.element = D.element := by
    subst out
    change p.interpret.eval = ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up D)).interpret.eval ↔ _
    rw [hp]
    exact ⟨detectUp, fun he => by rw [show E = D from Dot.ext he]⟩
  have transferDown {out : ConjEmbedding K G} (E : Dot (γ.comp α) out)
      (h : out = target) (p : LabelledDrawing Complex downInput (Word.down out))
      (hp : p.interpret.eval = ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down E)).interpret.eval) :
      matchesDown h p ↔ E.element = D.element := by
    subst out
    change p.interpret.eval = ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down D)).interpret.eval ↔ _
    rw [hp]
    exact ⟨detectDown, fun he => by rw [show E = D from Dot.ext he]⟩
  -- Evaluation on the unit tensor justifies cancellation in the necessity
  -- argument. The merge and singleton-label formulas give the coefficients
  -- in both orientations. A nonzero singleton coefficient detects its index.
  -- The range witness supplies e directly. Conjugation by e⁻¹ preserves H
  -- and determines β; the common effective multiplier fixes the output label.
  have rightWitness (hi : inImage) :
      ∃ (β : ConjEmbedding K H) (e : Dot α β),
        (e.whisker γ).element = D.element := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hi
    obtain ⟨β, e, he⟩ := retarget α s
    exact ⟨β, e, (congrArg γ.toHom he).trans hs⟩
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨β, e, h, hp⟩
    exact ⟨e.element, (transferUp (e.whisker γ) h (rightUp γ e) (rightSlide γ e).1).mp hp⟩
  · intro hi
    obtain ⟨β, e, he⟩ := rightWitness hi
    have h := sameTarget he
    exact ⟨β, e, h,
      (transferUp (e.whisker γ) h (rightUp γ e) (rightSlide γ e).1).mpr he⟩
  · rintro ⟨β, e, h, hp⟩
    exact ⟨e.element, (transferDown (e.whisker γ) h (rightDown γ e) (rightSlide γ e).2).mp hp⟩
  · intro hi
    obtain ⟨β, e, he⟩ := rightWitness hi
    have h := sameTarget he
    exact ⟨β, e, h,
      (transferDown (e.whisker γ) h (rightDown γ e) (rightSlide γ e).2).mpr he⟩
  · -- The new outer representative is D⁻¹γ. Its lifted dot has element D.
    obtain ⟨γ', d, hd⟩ := retarget γ D.element
    have h := sameTarget (e := liftOuter d α) hd
    have ⟨hu, hdown⟩ := leftSlide d α
    exact ⟨γ', d, h, (transferUp (liftOuter d α) h (leftUp d α) hu).mpr hd,
      (transferDown (liftOuter d α) h (leftDown d α) hdown).mpr hd⟩

namespace MovingMergeDotProof

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}

private noncomputable abbrev up {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) :=
  DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))

private noncomputable abbrev down {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) :=
  DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))

private abbrev mergeUp (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) (α : ConjEmbedding K H) :=
  LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp γ α)

private abbrev mergeDown (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) (α : ConjEmbedding K H) :=
  LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.mergeDown γ α)

private abbrev undotted {p : Word K G} :=
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (R := Complex) (Diagram.id p)

private theorem target_eq_conj {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) (k : K) :
    b.toHom k = d.element⁻¹ * a.toHom k * d.element := by
  calc
    b.toHom k = d.element⁻¹ * (d.element * b.toHom k) := by group
    _ = d.element⁻¹ * a.toHom k * d.element := by rw [← d.intertwines, mul_assoc]

private theorem rep_after {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) (x : U)
    (hx : ∀ k : K, (a.toHom k : U) = x * (k : U) * x⁻¹) (k : K) :
    (b.toHom k : U) = ((d.element : U)⁻¹ * x) * (k : U) *
      ((d.element : U)⁻¹ * x)⁻¹ := by
  rw [target_eq_conj d k]
  change (d.element : U)⁻¹ * (a.toHom k : U) * (d.element : U) = _
  rw [hx]
  group

private theorem rep_embedding (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (x : U)
    (hx : ∀ k : K, (a.toHom k : U) = x * (k : U) * x⁻¹) :
    ∃ (h : ∀ k : K, x * (k : U) * x⁻¹ ∈ G), a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator x h := by
  refine ⟨fun k => hx k ▸ (a.toHom k).property, ConjEmbedding.ext ?_⟩
  exact MonoidHom.ext fun k => Subtype.ext (hx k)

private theorem compatible_reps {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) :
    ∃ (x y : U) (hx : ∀ k : K, x * (k : U) * x⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hy : ∀ k : K, y * (k : U) * y⁻¹ ∈ G),
      a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator x hx ∧ b = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator y hy ∧
      (d.element : U) = x * y⁻¹ := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  obtain ⟨hx', ha⟩ := rep_embedding a x hx
  obtain ⟨hy, hb⟩ := rep_embedding b _ (rep_after d x hx)
  refine ⟨x, (d.element : U)⁻¹ * x, hx', hy, ha, hb, ?_⟩
  group

private abbrev liftOuter {γ γ' : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot γ γ')
    (α : ConjEmbedding K H) : Dot (γ.comp α) (γ'.comp α) :=
  ⟨d.element, fun k => d.intertwines (α.toHom k)⟩

private theorem slideBoth {γ γ' : ConjEmbedding H G} {α β : ConjEmbedding K H}
    (d : Dot γ γ') (e : Dot α β) :
    let merged := (liftOuter d α).vertical (e.whisker γ')
    (((up d).horizontal (up e)).vertical (mergeUp γ' β)).interpret.eval =
        ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up merged)).interpret.eval ∧
    (((down e).horizontal (down d)).vertical (mergeDown γ' β)).interpret.eval =
        ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down merged)).interpret.eval := by
  -- Equations (3.1) and (3.3) are registered for relative conjugators.
  -- Choose compatible representatives so that the relative elements are the given dots.
  obtain ⟨x, x', hx, hx', hγ, hγ', hd⟩ := compatible_reps d
  obtain ⟨y, y', hy, hy', hα, hβ, he⟩ := compatible_reps e
  subst γ γ' α β
  have hd_mem : x * x'⁻¹ ∈ G := hd ▸ d.element.property
  have he_mem : y * y'⁻¹ ∈ H := he ▸ e.element.property
  have hd_eq : d = Dot.ofRepresentatives x x' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd_mem :=
    Dot.ext (Subtype.ext hd)
  have he_eq : e = Dot.ofRepresentatives y y' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he_mem :=
    Dot.ext (Subtype.ext he)
  subst d e
  exact ⟨(InductionMergeDotSlide K H G x y y' hx hy hy' he_mem).1 x' hx' hd_mem,
    (RestrictionMergeDotSlide K H G x y y' hx hy hy' he_mem).1 x' hx' hd_mem⟩


private noncomputable abbrev rightUp (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) {α β : ConjEmbedding K H} (e : Dot α β) :=
  ((undotted (p := Word.up γ)).horizontal (up e)).vertical (mergeUp γ β)

private noncomputable abbrev rightDown (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) {α β : ConjEmbedding K H} (e : Dot α β) :=
  ((down e).horizontal (undotted (p := Word.down γ))).vertical (mergeDown γ β)

private noncomputable abbrev leftUp {γ γ' : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot γ γ') (α : ConjEmbedding K H) :=
  ((up d).horizontal (undotted (p := Word.up α))).vertical (mergeUp γ' α)

private noncomputable abbrev leftDown {γ γ' : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot γ γ') (α : ConjEmbedding K H) :=
  ((undotted (p := Word.down α)).horizontal (down d)).vertical (mergeDown γ' α)

private theorem rightSlide (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) {α β : ConjEmbedding K H} (e : Dot α β) :
    (rightUp γ e).interpret.eval =
      ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up (e.whisker γ))).interpret.eval ∧
    (rightDown γ e).interpret.eval =
      ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down (e.whisker γ))).interpret.eval := by
  have h : (liftOuter (Dot.id γ) α).vertical (e.whisker γ) = e.whisker γ :=
    Dot.ext (one_mul _)
  have ⟨hu, hd⟩ := slideBoth (Dot.id γ) e
  change (((up (Dot.id γ)).interpret.eval.horizontal (up e).interpret.eval).vertical
      (mergeUp γ β).interpret.eval) =
    ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up ((liftOuter (Dot.id γ) α).vertical
      (e.whisker γ)))).interpret.eval at hu
  change (((down e).interpret.eval.horizontal (down (Dot.id γ)).interpret.eval).vertical
      (mergeDown γ β).interpret.eval) =
    ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down ((liftOuter (Dot.id γ) α).vertical
      (e.whisker γ)))).interpret.eval at hd
  rw [show (up (Dot.id γ)).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (Word.up γ).basis from
    DotLabel.upDrawing_identity γ, h] at hu
  rw [show (down (Dot.id γ)).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (Word.down γ).basis from
    DotLabel.downDrawing_identity γ, h] at hd
  exact ⟨hu, hd⟩

private theorem leftSlide {γ γ' : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot γ γ') (α : ConjEmbedding K H) :
    (leftUp d α).interpret.eval =
      ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up (liftOuter d α))).interpret.eval ∧
    (leftDown d α).interpret.eval =
      ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down (liftOuter d α))).interpret.eval := by
  have h : (liftOuter d α).vertical ((Dot.id α).whisker γ') = liftOuter d α :=
    Dot.ext (by change d.element * γ'.toHom 1 = d.element; rw [map_one, mul_one])
  have ⟨hu, hd⟩ := slideBoth d (Dot.id α)
  change (((up d).interpret.eval.horizontal (up (Dot.id α)).interpret.eval).vertical
      (mergeUp γ' α).interpret.eval) =
    ((mergeUp γ α).vertical
      (up ((liftOuter d α).vertical ((Dot.id α).whisker γ')))).interpret.eval at hu
  change (((down (Dot.id α)).interpret.eval.horizontal (down d).interpret.eval).vertical
      (mergeDown γ' α).interpret.eval) =
    ((mergeDown γ α).vertical
      (down ((liftOuter d α).vertical ((Dot.id α).whisker γ')))).interpret.eval at hd
  rw [show (up (Dot.id α)).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (Word.up α).basis from
    DotLabel.upDrawing_identity α, h] at hu
  rw [show (down (Dot.id α)).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (Word.down α).basis from
    DotLabel.downDrawing_identity α, h] at hd
  exact ⟨hu, hd⟩

private theorem dotUpSingle {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) (x : G) (r : Complex) :
    (up d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r) =
      Finsupp.single (x * d.element) r := by
  dsimp only [up]
  rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing, Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply, freeLift_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single]

private theorem dotDownSingle {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) (x : G) (r : Complex) :
    (down d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r) =
      Finsupp.single (d.element⁻¹ * x) r := by
  dsimp only [down]
  rw [DotLabel.eval_downDrawing, Diagram.eval_linearDownDot_apply, freeLift_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_downDot_single]

private theorem detectUp {γ : ConjEmbedding H G} {α : ConjEmbedding K H}
    {out : ConjEmbedding K G} {E D : Dot (γ.comp α) out}
    (h : ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up E)).interpret.eval =
      ((mergeUp γ α).vertical (up D)).interpret.eval) :
    E.element = D.element := by
  let unit := Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction γ).pair (Biset.induction α) 1 1) (1 : Complex)
  have h' := congrArg (fun f => Biset.Hom.toLinearMap f unit) h
  change (up E).interpret.eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeUp γ α).eval.toLinearMap unit) =
    (up D).interpret.eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeUp γ α).eval.toLinearMap unit) at h'
  dsimp only [unit] at h'
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, map_one, one_mul] at h'
  rw [dotUpSingle E, dotUpSingle D, one_mul, one_mul] at h'
  exact Finsupp.single_left_injective (one_ne_zero : (1 : Complex) ≠ 0) h'

private theorem detectDown {γ : ConjEmbedding H G} {α : ConjEmbedding K H}
    {out : ConjEmbedding K G} {E D : Dot (γ.comp α) out}
    (h : ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down E)).interpret.eval =
      ((mergeDown γ α).vertical (down D)).interpret.eval) :
    E.element = D.element := by
  let unit := Finsupp.single ((Biset.restriction α).pair (Biset.restriction γ) 1 1) (1 : Complex)
  have h' := congrArg (fun f => Biset.Hom.toLinearMap f unit) h
  change (down E).interpret.eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeDown γ α).eval.toLinearMap unit) =
    (down D).interpret.eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeDown γ α).eval.toLinearMap unit) at h'
  dsimp only [unit] at h'
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeDown_single, map_one, one_mul] at h'
  rw [dotDownSingle E, dotDownSingle D, mul_one, mul_one] at h'
  exact inv_injective (Finsupp.single_left_injective (one_ne_zero : (1 : Complex) ≠ 0) h')

private theorem retarget (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (s : G) :
    ∃ (b : ConjEmbedding K G) (d : Dot a b), d.element = s := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  have hy (k : K) : ((s : U)⁻¹ * x) * (k : U) * ((s : U)⁻¹ * x)⁻¹ ∈ G := by
    have hm := (s⁻¹ * a.toHom k * s).property
    change (s : U)⁻¹ * (a.toHom k : U) * (s : U) ∈ G at hm
    rw [hx] at hm
    convert hm using 1
    group
  refine ⟨ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator ((s : U)⁻¹ * x) hy, ⟨s, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  intro k
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (a.toHom k : U) * (s : U) =
    (s : U) * (((s : U)⁻¹ * x) * (k : U) * ((s : U)⁻¹ * x)⁻¹)
  rw [hx]
  group

private theorem sameTarget {a b c : ConjEmbedding K G} {e : Dot a b} {d : Dot a c}
    (h : e.element = d.element) : b = c :=
  ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun k => by rw [target_eq_conj e k, target_eq_conj d k, h])

end MovingMergeDotProof

  -- (bc57d137…) and revised published PDF pp. 24–25 (6d7e8859…).
  -- Alphabeta Math numbers the replacement directions as Theorem 6.4(1)

    cases ds <;> rfl
  refine ⟨hindex, hfibers, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B r s t x y z
    exact (hleft r s t).1 x y z
  · intro B' j v w ell m n

  -- Step 1 (Theorem 6.4(1)). The join construction and finite-sum
  -- criterion use their original middle-index hypothesis. The merge
  -- and split inverses transport equality to the fixed boundary.

    obtain ⟨coeff, hc, hu⟩ := ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux.leftCoefficients a b c d e f l
    refine ⟨coeff, hc, hu, ?_⟩

    obtain ⟨ds, he⟩ := ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux.caseTwo a b c d e f r

  -- Step 3 (Theorem 6.4, final paragraph). Apply both single replacements

  · exact ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux.evaluationClasses a b c d e f
