namespace ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux

open MackeyDiagrams

universe u
noncomputable section

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U}

private abbrev ev {p q : Word K H} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap

private theorem cancelFrame {p₀ p q q₀ : Word K H}
    (pre : LabelledDrawing Complex p₀ p) (post : LabelledDrawing Complex q q₀)
    (preInv : Biset.Hom Complex p.basis p₀.basis)
    (postInv : Biset.Hom Complex q₀.basis q.basis)
    (hp : preInv.vertical pre.interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id p.basis)
    (hq : post.interpret.eval.vertical postInv = Biset.Hom.id q.basis)
    (x y : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
    ev (.vertical pre (.vertical x post)) = ev (.vertical pre (.vertical y post)) ↔
      x.interpret.eval = y.interpret.eval := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he : pre.interpret.eval.vertical (x.interpret.eval.vertical post.interpret.eval) =
        pre.interpret.eval.vertical (y.interpret.eval.vertical post.interpret.eval) :=
      Biset.Hom.ext h
    have undo (z : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
        (preInv.vertical (pre.interpret.eval.vertical
          (z.interpret.eval.vertical post.interpret.eval))).vertical postInv = z.interpret.eval := by
      rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc preInv, hp, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
        Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc, hq, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]
    have h' := congrArg (fun z => (preInv.vertical z).vertical postInv) he
    exact (undo x).symm.trans (h'.trans (undo y))
  · intro h
    exact congrArg (fun z : Biset.Hom Complex p.basis q.basis =>
      (pre.interpret.eval.vertical (z.vertical post.interpret.eval)).toLinearMap) h

private abbrev drawId (p : Word K H) : LabelledDrawing Complex p p :=
  .ordinary (.id p)

section Boundary
variable {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev bottom := ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c)
private abbrev top := ((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f)
private abbrev mergedBottom := (Word.down a).tensor (.up (b.comp c))
private abbrev mergedTop := (Word.up (d.comp e)).tensor (.down f)

private abbrev splitBottom : LabelledDrawing Complex (mergedBottom a b c) (bottom a b c) :=
  .vertical (.horizontal (drawId (.down a)) (.trivalent (.splitUp b c)))
    (.ordinary (.unassociate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)))

private abbrev mergeTop : LabelledDrawing Complex (top d e f) (mergedTop d e f) :=
  .horizontal (.trivalent (.mergeUp d e)) (drawId (.down f))

private theorem splitBottom_leftCancel :
    ((Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)).eval.vertical
      ((Diagram.id (.down a)).eval.horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp b c).eval)).vertical
      (splitBottom a b c).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (bottom a b c).basis := by
  change ((Biset.associate (Word.down a).basis (Word.up b).basis (Word.up c).basis
      Complex).vertical
      ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp b c).eval)).vertical
    (((Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal (Diagram.splitUp b c).eval).vertical
      (Biset.unassociate (Word.down a).basis (Word.up b).basis (Word.up c).basis Complex)) = _
  refine Biset.Hom.cancel_middle _ _ _ _ ?_ Biset.associate_unassociate
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  change (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal
    ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) b c).vertical (Diagram.splitUp b c)).eval = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

private theorem mergeTop_rightCancel :
    (mergeTop d e f).interpret.eval.vertical
      ((Diagram.splitUp d e).eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down f)).eval) =
      Biset.Hom.id (top d e f).basis := by
  change ((Diagram.mergeUp d e).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down f).basis)).vertical
      ((Diagram.splitUp d e).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down f).basis)) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  change ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) d e).vertical (Diagram.splitUp d e)).eval.horizontal
    (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down f).basis) = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

private theorem merged_eq_iff (x y : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom a b c) (top d e f)) :
    ev (.vertical (splitBottom a b c) (.vertical x (mergeTop d e f))) =
      ev (.vertical (splitBottom a b c) (.vertical y (mergeTop d e f))) ↔
      x.interpret.eval = y.interpret.eval :=
  cancelFrame _ _ _ _ (splitBottom_leftCancel a b c) (mergeTop_rightCancel d e f) x y

end Boundary

private theorem terms_single {I : Type*} (x : I) {w : Complex} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    ((Finsupp.single x w).support.toList.map fun y => ((Finsupp.single x w) y, y)) = [(w, x)] := by
  classical
  simp [Finsupp.support_single _ hw]

private abbrev drawSum {p q : Word K H} (ds : List (LabelledDrawing Complex p q)) :=
  match ds with
  | [] => LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.zero p q)
  | first :: rest => rest.foldl LabelledDrawing.add first

private theorem framed_add {p₀ p q q₀ : Word K H}
    (pre : LabelledDrawing Complex p₀ p) (post : LabelledDrawing Complex q q₀)
    (x y : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
    ev (.vertical pre (.vertical (.add x y) post)) =
      ev (.vertical pre (.vertical x post)) + ev (.vertical pre (.vertical y post)) := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  change ev post ((ev x + ev y) (ev pre v)) =
    ev post (ev x (ev pre v)) + ev post (ev y (ev pre v))
  exact map_add (ev post) _ _

private theorem framed_sum {p₀ p q q₀ : Word K H}
    (pre : LabelledDrawing Complex p₀ p) (post : LabelledDrawing Complex q q₀)
    (ds : List (LabelledDrawing Complex p q)) :
    ev (.vertical pre (.vertical (drawSum ds) post)) =
      (ds.map (fun z => ev (.vertical pre (.vertical z post)))).sum := by
  let value := fun z : LabelledDrawing Complex p q => ev (.vertical pre (.vertical z post))
  have hfold (rest : List (LabelledDrawing Complex p q)) (first : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
      value (rest.foldl LabelledDrawing.add first) = value first + (rest.map value).sum := by
    induction rest generalizing first with
    | nil => simp
    | cons next rest ih =>
      rw [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← add_assoc]
      exact congrArg (· + (rest.map value).sum) (framed_add pre post first next)
  cases ds with
  | nil =>
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change ev post 0 = 0
    exact map_zero _
  | cons first rest => exact hfold rest first

private def weighted {I M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Complex M]
    (v : I → M) (xs : List (Complex × I)) : M :=
  (xs.map fun term => term.1 • v term.2).sum

private theorem map_weighted {I M N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Complex M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module Complex N] (f : M →ₗ[Complex] N)
    (v : I → M) (xs : List (Complex × I)) :
    f (weighted v xs) = weighted (fun x => f (v x)) xs := by
  unfold weighted
  rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, map_smul]

private abbrev labelTerms {I : Type*} (coeff : I →₀ Complex) :=
  coeff.support.toList.map fun x => (coeff x, x)

private theorem weighted_labelTerms {I M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Complex M]
    (v : I → M) (coeff : I →₀ Complex) :
    weighted v (labelTerms coeff) = Finsupp.linearCombination Complex v coeff := by
  classical
  rw [weighted, List.map_map, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_map_toList _ _

private def applyAt {M N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module Complex M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module Complex N] (x : M) : (M →ₗ[Complex] N) →ₗ[Complex] N where
  toFun f := f x
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

private theorem compactWeighted {L P : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (r : ConjEmbedding L K) (s : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (xs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s)) :
    ev (.compactProjection a b r s xs) =
      weighted (fun x => ev (.compactProjection a b r s [(1, x)])) xs := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (xs.map fun x =>
    (x.1, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (.mixedProjection a b r s x.2.dot x.2.finite)))).eval.toLinearMap v =
    applyAt v (weighted (fun x => ev (.compactProjection a b r s [(1, x)])) xs)
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, map_weighted]
  unfold weighted
  rw [List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro x _
  let d : ScopedDiagram Complex ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)) ((Word.up r).tensor (.down s)) :=
    .ordinary (.mixedProjection a b r s x.2.dot x.2.finite)
  have hs : ev (.compactProjection a b r s [(1, x.2)]) v = d.eval.toLinearMap v := by
    change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, d)]).eval.toLinearMap v = _
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, one_smul, add_zero]
      using ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply [(1, d)] v
  exact congrArg (x.1 • ·) hs.symm

private theorem horizontalWeighted {I : Type*} {J : Subgroup U}
    {p q : Word K H} {r s : Word H J}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (e : LabelledDrawing Complex r s)
    (terms : I → LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (xs : List (Complex × I))
    (he : ev d = weighted (fun x => ev (terms x)) xs) :
    ev (.horizontal d e) = weighted (fun x => ev (.horizontal (terms x) e)) xs := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z w
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x,y⟩ => ?_)
  let v := Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair r.basis x y) w
  let tensorAt := w • (((Biset.pairLinear Complex q.basis s.basis).flip
    (ev e (Finsupp.single y 1))).comp (applyAt (Finsupp.single x (1 : Complex))))
  have h (g : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) : ev (.horizontal g e) v = tensorAt (ev g) :=
    Biset.Hom.horizontal_single g.interpret.eval e.interpret.eval x y w
  change ev (.horizontal d e) v =
    applyAt v (weighted (fun i => ev (.horizontal (terms i) e)) xs)
  rw [h, he, map_weighted, map_weighted]
  exact congrArg (fun f => weighted f xs) (funext fun i => (h (terms i)).symm)

private theorem stackWeighted {I : Type*} {p₀ p q q' q₀ : Word K H}
    (pre : LabelledDrawing Complex p₀ p) (next : LabelledDrawing Complex q q')
    (post : LabelledDrawing Complex q' q₀)
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (terms : I → LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (xs : List (Complex × I)) (he : ev d = weighted (fun x => ev (terms x)) xs) :
    ev (.vertical pre (.vertical (.vertical d next) post)) =
      weighted (fun x => ev (.vertical pre (.vertical (.vertical (terms x) next) post))) xs := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  let push := ((ev post).comp (ev next)).comp (applyAt (ev pre v))
  change push (ev d) =
    applyAt v (weighted (fun x => ev (.vertical pre (.vertical (.vertical (terms x) next) post))) xs)
  rw [he, map_weighted, map_weighted]
  rfl

private theorem firstProjectionWeighted {J L P : Subgroup U}
    {r' : Word H J} {q' : Word H J}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (r : ConjEmbedding L K) (s : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (other : LabelledDrawing Complex r' q')
    {p₀ q'₁ q₀ : Word K J}
    (pre : LabelledDrawing Complex p₀ (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor r'))
    (next : LabelledDrawing Complex (((Word.up r).tensor (.down s)).tensor q') q'₁)
    (post : LabelledDrawing Complex q'₁ q₀)
    (xs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s)) :
    let value := fun ts => ev (.vertical pre (.vertical
      (.vertical (.horizontal (.compactProjection a b r s ts) other) next) post))
    value xs = weighted (fun x => value [(1, x)]) xs := by
  exact stackWeighted pre next post _ _ xs
    (horizontalWeighted _ other _ xs (compactWeighted a b r s xs))

private theorem quotientReplacement {L R M : Type*} (lEval : L → M) (rEval : R → M)
    (hL : ∀ l, ∃ r, rEval r = lEval l) (hR : ∀ r, ∃ l, lEval l = rEval r) :
    ∃ (lr : L → R) (rl : R → L) (q : Quotient (Setoid.ker lEval) ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rEval)),
      (∀ l, rEval (lr l) = lEval l ∧
        q (Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker lEval) l) = Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker rEval) (lr l)) ∧
      (∀ r, lEval (rl r) = rEval r ∧
        q.symm (Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker rEval) r) = Quotient.mk (Setoid.ker lEval) (rl r)) := by
  choose lr hlr using hL
  choose rl hrl using hR
  let q : Quotient (Setoid.ker lEval) ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rEval) :=
    { toFun := Quotient.map lr (fun {_ _} h => (hlr _).trans (h.trans (hlr _).symm))
      invFun := Quotient.map rl (fun {_ _} h => (hrl _).trans (h.trans (hrl _).symm))
      left_inv := by
        intro x
        refine Quotient.inductionOn x (fun l => Quotient.sound ?_)
        exact (hrl (lr l)).trans (hlr l)
      right_inv := by
        intro x
        refine Quotient.inductionOn x (fun r => Quotient.sound ?_)
        exact (hlr (rl r)).trans (hrl r) }
  exact ⟨lr, rl, q, fun l => ⟨hlr l, rfl⟩, fun r => ⟨hrl r, rfl⟩⟩

end
end ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux
namespace ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux

open MackeyDiagrams

universe u
noncomputable section

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E B B' : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev atRight {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H)
    {q : Word H J} {r : Word J L} {q' : Word H J'} {r' : Word J' L}
    (x : LabelledDrawing Complex (q.tensor r) (q'.tensor r')) :=
  LabelledDrawing.vertical (.ordinary (.associate p q r))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (drawId p) x) (.ordinary (.unassociate p q' r')))

local notation "bc'" => b.comp c
local notation "ad'" => a.comp d
local notation "de'" => d.comp e

private abbrev Parameter := ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc' de' f

private abbrev transfer (p : Parameter a b c d e f) :=
  (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc' de' f p.dot p.finite).eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev expansion (coeff : Parameter a b c d e f →₀ Complex) :=
  coeff.sum (fun p weight => weight • transfer a b c d e f p)

private abbrev Drawing := LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom a b c) (top d e f)

private abbrev merged (x : Drawing a b c d e f) :=
  ev (.vertical (splitBottom a b c) (.vertical x (mergeTop d e f)))

private abbrev leftTerm (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D)
    (t : ConjEmbedding E B) (xs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s))
    (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f))
    (zs : List (Complex × Dot (r.comp t) de')) : Drawing a b c d e f :=
  .vertical (.horizontal (.compactProjection a b r s xs) (drawId (.up c)))
    (.vertical (atRight (.up r) (.compactProjection s c t f ys))
      (.horizontal (.parallelUp r t d e zs) (drawId (.down f))))

private abbrev rightTerm (j : ConjEmbedding B' A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B')
    (w : ConjEmbedding F B') (ells : List (Complex × Dot bc' (j.comp w)))
    (ms : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v))
    (ns : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)) : Drawing a b c d e f :=
  .vertical (atRight (.down a) (.parallelUp b c j w ells))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (.compactProjection a j d v ms) (drawId (.up w)))
      (atRight (.up d) (.compactProjection v w e f ns)))

private abbrev LeftLabels :=
  Σ B : Subgroup U, Σ r : ConjEmbedding B G, Σ s : ConjEmbedding B D, Σ t : ConjEmbedding E B,
    Finsupp (ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s) Complex × Finsupp (ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f) Complex ×
      DotLabel Complex (r.comp t) de'

private abbrev RightLabels :=
  Σ B' : Subgroup U, Σ j : ConjEmbedding B' A, Σ v : ConjEmbedding C B', Σ w : ConjEmbedding F B',
    DotLabel Complex bc' (j.comp w) × Finsupp (ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v) Complex ×
      Finsupp (ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f) Complex

private abbrev leftDraw : LeftLabels a b c d e f → Drawing a b c d e f :=
  fun ⟨_, r, s, t, xs, ys, zs⟩ => leftTerm a b c d e f r s t (labelTerms xs) (labelTerms ys) zs.terms

private abbrev rightDraw : RightLabels a b c d e f → Drawing a b c d e f :=
  fun ⟨_, j, v, w, ells, ms, ns⟩ => rightTerm a b c d e f j v w ells.terms (labelTerms ms) (labelTerms ns)

private abbrev middleFinite (p : Parameter a b c d e f) :=
  let conjugated := (bc').toHom.range.map (MulAut.conj p.dot.element).toMonoidHom
  ((ad').toHom.range.subgroupOf (a.toHom.range ⊓ ((ad').toHom.range ⊔ conjugated))).FiniteIndex

private abbrev evalLeft (l : LeftLabels a b c d e f) := (leftDraw a b c d e f l).interpret.eval
private abbrev evalRight (r : RightLabels a b c d e f) := (rightDraw a b c d e f r).interpret.eval

local notation "LD" => LeftLabels a b c d e f
local notation "RD" => RightLabels a b c d e f
local notation "Draw" => Drawing a b c d e f
local notation "Param" => Parameter a b c d e f
local notation "qstar" => transfer a b c d e f
local notation "expand" => expansion a b c d e f
local notation "mergedEval'" => merged a b c d e f
local notation "leftTerm'" => leftTerm a b c d e f
local notation "leftDraw'" => leftDraw a b c d e f
local notation "rightDraw'" => rightDraw a b c d e f
local notation "leftEval'" => evalLeft a b c d e f
local notation "rightEval'" => evalRight a b c d e f
local notation "middleOK" => middleFinite a b c d e f

-- Lemma 6.3 supplies uniqueness of the transfer expansion for these exact
-- coefficient labels, with finite fibers carried by ProjectionDot.Mixed.
private theorem leftCoefficients (l : LD) :
    ∃! coeff : Param →₀ Complex, mergedEval' (leftDraw' l) = expand coeff := by
  rcases l with ⟨B, r, s, t, xs, ys, zs⟩
  exact ((EvaluationForTwoProjections a b c d e f).2.2.1 r s t).2 xs ys zs

private theorem rightCoefficients (r : RD) :
    ∃! coeff : Param →₀ Complex, mergedEval' (rightDraw' r) = expand coeff := by
  rcases r with ⟨B', j, v, w, ells, ms, ns⟩
  exact ((EvaluationForTwoProjections a b c d e f).2.2.2 j v w).2 ells ms ns

-- Theorem 6.4(1). Apply the registered join construction and middle-index test.
private theorem singleRight (p : Param) (hp : middleOK p) :
    ∃ r : RD, mergedEval' (rightDraw' r) = qstar p := by
  obtain ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, he⟩ :=
    (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).1 p hp
  exact ⟨⟨_, j, v, w, Finsupp.single ell 1, Finsupp.single m 1, Finsupp.single n 1⟩, he⟩


private theorem caseOneMerged (l : LD) (coeff : Param →₀ Complex)
    (hc : mergedEval' (leftDraw' l) = expand coeff) :
    (∃ ds : List Draw,
      (∀ x ∈ ds, ∃ r : RD, x = rightDraw' r) ∧
      mergedEval' (drawSum ds) = mergedEval' (leftDraw' l)) ↔
    ∀ p ∈ coeff.support, middleOK p := by
  rcases l with ⟨B, r, s, t, xs, ys, zs⟩
  have criterion := (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).2.2 r s t xs ys zs coeff hc
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ds, hds, he⟩
    apply criterion.mp
    refine ⟨ds, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨⟨B', j, v, w, ells, ms, ns⟩, hdraw⟩ := hds x hx
      exact ⟨B', j, v, w, ells, ms, ns, hdraw⟩
    · cases ds <;> exact he
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨ds, hds, he⟩ := criterion.mpr hs
    refine ⟨ds, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨B', j, v, w, ells, ms, ns, hdraw⟩ := hds x hx
      exact ⟨⟨B', j, v, w, ells, ms, ns⟩, hdraw⟩
    · cases ds <;> exact he

private theorem caseOne (l : LD) (coeff : Param →₀ Complex)
    (hc : mergedEval' (leftDraw' l) = expand coeff) :
    (∃ ds : List RD, (drawSum (ds.map rightDraw')).interpret.eval = leftEval' l) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ coeff.support, middleOK p := by
  refine Iff.trans ?_ (caseOneMerged a b c d e f l coeff hc)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ds, he⟩
    refine ⟨ds.map rightDraw', ?_, (merged_eq_iff a b c d e f _ _).2 he⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨r, _, hr⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact ⟨r, hr.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨ds, hds, he⟩
    have lift (xs : List Draw) (hs : ∀ x ∈ xs, ∃ r : RD, x = rightDraw' r) :
        ∃ rs : List RD, rs.map rightDraw' = xs := by
      induction xs with
      | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
      | cons x xs ih =>
        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hs x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        obtain ⟨rs, hrs⟩ := ih (fun z hz => hs z (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hz))
        exact ⟨r :: rs, by rw [List.map_cons, ← hr, hrs]⟩
    obtain ⟨rs, rfl⟩ := lift ds hds
    exact ⟨rs, (merged_eq_iff a b c d e f _ _).1 he⟩

private theorem singleCaseOne (hd : Subgroup.FiniteIndex d.toHom.range) :
    ∀ l : LD, ∃ r : RD, rightEval' r = leftEval' l := by
  obtain ⟨ell, m, n, _, _, _, _, he⟩ := (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).2.1 hd
  intro l
  obtain ⟨coeff, hc, _⟩ := leftCoefficients a b c d e f l
  let r : RD := ⟨A, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id A, ad', bc',
    Finsupp.single ell 1, Finsupp.single m 1, Finsupp.mapDomain n coeff⟩
  exact ⟨r, (merged_eq_iff a b c d e f _ _).1 ((he coeff).trans hc.symm)⟩

-- Theorem 6.4(2). Put each coefficient in the marked lower projection.
-- Balanced horizontal evaluation and stacking are linear in that mark.
private theorem leftWeighted {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
    (xs : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s))
    (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f))
    (zs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (r.comp t) de')) :
    mergedEval' (leftTerm' r s t xs ys zs) =
      weighted
        (fun x => mergedEval' (leftTerm' r s t [(1, x)] ys zs)) xs :=
  firstProjectionWeighted a b r s (drawId (.up c)) (splitBottom a b c)
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (atRight (.up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f ys))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e zs) (drawId (.down f))))
    (mergeTop d e f) xs

private theorem leftWeight (p : Param) (weight : Complex) (hw : weight ≠ 0) :
    ∃ l : LD, mergedEval' (leftDraw' l) = weight • qstar p := by
  obtain ⟨drawing, hshape, he⟩ := (CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).1 p
  obtain ⟨r, s, t, _, _, _, _, x, y, z, _, _, _, _, _, rfl⟩ := hshape
  refine ⟨⟨_, r, s, t, Finsupp.single x weight, Finsupp.single y 1, Finsupp.single z 1⟩, ?_⟩
  change mergedEval' (leftTerm' r s t (labelTerms (Finsupp.single x weight)) (labelTerms (Finsupp.single y 1))
    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single z 1))) = _
  rw [show labelTerms (Finsupp.single x weight) = [(weight, x)] from
    terms_single x hw,
    show labelTerms (Finsupp.single y (1 : Complex)) = [(1, y)] from
      terms_single y one_ne_zero,
    show MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) = [(1, z)] from
      terms_single z one_ne_zero,
    leftWeighted a b c d e f]
  change weight • mergedEval' (leftTerm' r s t [(1, x)] [(1, y)] [(1, z)]) + 0 = _
  rw [add_zero]
  exact congrArg (weight • ·) he

-- The endpoint presents its finite sum as a list of whole drawings.
-- Evaluate its additive fold and match it with the coefficient support.
private theorem caseTwo (r : RD) :
    ∃ ds : List LD, (drawSum (ds.map leftDraw')).interpret.eval = rightEval' r := by
  obtain ⟨coeff, hc, _⟩ := rightCoefficients a b c d e f r
  have hex (p : {p // p ∈ coeff.support}) :
      ∃ l : LD, mergedEval' (leftDraw' l) = coeff p.1 • qstar p.1 :=
    leftWeight a b c d e f p.1 (coeff p.1) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp p.2)
  choose build hbuild using hex
  refine ⟨coeff.support.attach.toList.map build, (merged_eq_iff a b c d e f _ _).1 ?_⟩
  change mergedEval' (drawSum ((coeff.support.attach.toList.map build).map leftDraw')) =
    mergedEval' (rightDraw' r)
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hc.symm
  refine (framed_sum (splitBottom a b c) (mergeTop d e f) _).trans ?_
  rw [List.map_map, List.map_map]
  have hmap : coeff.support.attach.toList.map (mergedEval' ∘ leftDraw' ∘ build) =
      coeff.support.attach.toList.map (fun p => coeff p.1 • qstar p.1) :=
    List.map_congr_left (fun p _ => hbuild p)
  change (coeff.support.attach.toList.map (mergedEval' ∘ leftDraw' ∘ build)).sum = _
  rw [hmap, Finset.sum_map_toList]
  exact Finset.sum_attach coeff.support (fun p => coeff p • qstar p)

-- Collect coincident lower parameters inside the one marked projection.
-- Linearity identifies the collected label with the supplier's termwise list.
private theorem singleCaseTwo (hd : Subgroup.FiniteIndex ((de').toHom.range)) :
    ∀ r : RD, ∃ l : LD, leftEval' l = rightEval' r := by
  intro r
  obtain ⟨coeff, hc, _⟩ := rightCoefficients a b c d e f r
  obtain ⟨drawing, hshape, he⟩ := (CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).2.1 hd coeff
  obtain ⟨x, y, z, _, _, _, _, rfl⟩ := hshape
  let cf := c.comp f
  let t := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id E
  let l : LD := ⟨E, de', cf, t, Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff, Finsupp.single y 1, Finsupp.single z 1⟩
  let value := fun xs => mergedEval' (leftTerm' de' cf t xs [(1, y)] [(1, z)])
  let unitValue := fun p => value [(1, p)]
  have heval : mergedEval' (leftDraw' l) = value (labelTerms (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)) := by
    change mergedEval' (leftTerm' de' cf t _ (labelTerms (Finsupp.single y 1))
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single z 1))) = _
    rw [show labelTerms (Finsupp.single y (1 : Complex)) = [(1, y)] from
      terms_single y one_ne_zero,
      show MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) = [(1, z)] from
        terms_single z one_ne_zero]
  have hcollect : value (labelTerms (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)) =
      value ((labelTerms coeff).map (fun term => (term.1, x term.2))) := by
    calc
      _ = weighted unitValue (labelTerms (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)) :=
        leftWeighted a b c d e f de' cf t _ _ _
      _ = Finsupp.linearCombination Complex (unitValue ∘ x) coeff := by
        rw [weighted_labelTerms, Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain]
      _ = weighted (unitValue ∘ x) (labelTerms coeff) :=
        (weighted_labelTerms _ _).symm
      _ = weighted unitValue ((labelTerms coeff).map (fun term => (term.1, x term.2))) := by
        simp only [weighted, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
      _ = _ := (leftWeighted a b c d e f de' cf t _ _ _).symm
  exact ⟨l, (merged_eq_iff a b c d e f _ _).1 (heval.trans (hcollect.trans (he.trans hc.symm)))⟩
private theorem evaluationClasses (h : ((de').toHom.range).FiniteIndex ∨ Finite G) :
    ∃ (lr : LD → RD) (rl : RD → LD)
      (q : Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval') ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval')),
      (∀ l, rightEval' (lr l) = leftEval' l ∧ q (Quotient.mk _ l) = Quotient.mk _ (lr l)) ∧
      (∀ r, leftEval' (rl r) = rightEval' r ∧ q.symm (Quotient.mk _ r) = Quotient.mk _ (rl r)) := by
  have hd : ((de').toHom.range).FiniteIndex := by
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact @Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite G _ _ h
  have hle : (de').toHom.range ≤ d.toHom.range := by
    rintro g ⟨v, hv⟩
    exact ⟨e.toHom v, hv⟩
  exact quotientReplacement leftEval' rightEval'
    (singleCaseOne a b c d e f (@Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_le G _ _ _ hd hle))
    (singleCaseTwo a b c d e f hd)

end
end ReplacementForTwoProjectionsAux

by
  intro U inst G K H B H' α β γ δ α' β' hα hβ hγ hδ hα' hβ'
    a b c d a' b' bottom middle top bottomWord middleWord topWord
    evalDrawing singleton lowerCrossing upperCrossing bottomMerge topSplit mergeSplit unitCancellation
  -- Xiao, §5.2, Theorem 5.4 and its preceding drawing. The archived
  -- source/mackey-bimodules.pdf has them on p. 18. The revised PDF served at
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf has them on p. 20.
  -- The four steps below follow the order of the article proof.
  -- Theorem 5.4, step 1: split then merge on the middle word. The
  -- registered split/merge result is specialized to (γ, δ) and their inclusions.
  have middleInverse :
      (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) c d).eval.vertical (Diagram.mergeUp c d).eval =
        Biset.Hom.id (Word.up middle).basis :=
    (InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits K B G γ δ hγ hδ).2.2.2.2.1
  -- Theorem 5.4, step 2: compose right multiplications in bottom-to-top order.
  -- The historical checked connection used Diagram with an earlier root
  -- artifact. Here the current merge, dot and split equations are joined
  -- by distributing each trivalent map through the finite sum while
  -- keeping each marked crossing and the single product mark as syntax.
  -- Dot.vertical provides the termwise intertwining proof for each ordered
  -- pair of supported terms used by DotLabel.compose.
  have composeCrossings (x : DotLabel Complex bottom middle)
      (y : DotLabel Complex middle top) :
      evalDrawing (.vertical (lowerCrossing x) (upperCrossing y)) =
        evalDrawing (mergeSplit (DotLabel.upDrawing (DotLabel.compose x y))) := by
    change ((LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d x.terms).interpret.eval).vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a' b' y.terms).interpret.eval =
      ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval.vertical
        (DotLabel.upDrawing (DotLabel.compose x y)).interpret.eval).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a' b').eval
    rw [eval_parallelUp_terms, eval_parallelUp_terms]
    exact Biset.Hom.merge_dot_split_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ middleInverse
      (DotLabel.upDrawing_compose x y)
  -- Theorem 5.4, step 3: a unit group-algebra product forces equal
  -- embeddings. Transport the straight strand, then use the full word
  -- equality to cancel the outside trivalent vertices.
  have cancelUnit (product : DotLabel Complex bottom top)
      (unit : Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element product = Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex)) :
      unitCancellation product := by
    obtain ⟨same, hunit⟩ := Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_unit product unit
    refine ⟨same, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval.vertical
          (DotLabel.upDrawing product).interpret.eval).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a' b').eval =
        ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval.vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.interpret
            (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun e => LabelledDrawing Complex (.up bottom) (.up e))
              (.ordinary (Diagram.id (.up bottom))) same)).eval).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a' b').eval
      rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing, hunit, eval_transported_up_id]
    · intro sameBoundary
      change ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval.vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.interpret
            (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun e => LabelledDrawing Complex (.up bottom) (.up e))
              (.ordinary (Diagram.id (.up bottom))) same)).eval).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a' b').eval =
        (LabelledDrawing.interpret
          (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w => LabelledDrawing Complex bottomWord w)
            (.ordinary (Diagram.id bottomWord)) sameBoundary)).eval
      rw [eval_transported_up_id, eval_transported_word_id]
      exact Diagram.eval_unitCrossing_sameBoundary a b a' b' same sameBoundary
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (composeCrossings (singleton x) (singleton y)).trans
        (congrArg (fun z => evalDrawing (mergeSplit (DotLabel.upDrawing z))) (compose_singletons x y))
    · intro unit
      apply cancelUnit
      change Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (Finsupp.single (x.vertical y) 1) = _
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
      exact congrArg (fun g : G => Finsupp.single g (1 : Complex)) unit
  · intro x y
    exact ⟨composeCrossings x y, cancelUnit (DotLabel.compose x y)⟩
  · intro x
    -- Theorem 5.4, step 4: the admissibility supplier gives a typed
    -- return element. Identify it with Dot.inverse using its element
    -- equation, and apply the checked single-crossing law in both orders.
    obtain ⟨y, hy, _, _, _⟩ :=
      (ParallelInductionProductDotAdmissibility G K H B H' α β γ δ α' β'
        hα hβ hγ hδ hα' hβ').2 x
    have hy' : y = x.inverse := Dot.ext hy
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d (DotLabel.terms (singleton x))).interpret.eval.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a b (DotLabel.terms (singleton y))).interpret.eval =
          (Diagram.id bottomWord).eval

      rw [eval_parallelUp_single, eval_parallelUp_single, hy']
      exact Diagram.parallelUp_return a b c d x
    · change (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a b (DotLabel.terms (singleton y))).interpret.eval.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d (DotLabel.terms (singleton x))).interpret.eval =
          (Diagram.id middleWord).eval
      dsimp only [singleton]
      have hinv : y.inverse = x := by
        apply Dot.ext
        change y.element⁻¹ = x.element
        rw [hy, inv_inv]
      rw [eval_parallelUp_single, eval_parallelUp_single, ← hinv]
      exact Diagram.parallelUp_return c d a b y

namespace ParallelReidemeisterTwoInductionProof

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G K H B : Subgroup U}
variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

-- The crossing constructor interprets a sum of complete crossings. Move the
-- fixed merge and split through that sum at the level of linear maps.
private theorem eval_parallelUp_terms
    (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (c : ConjEmbedding B G) (d : ConjEmbedding K B)
    (terms : List (R × Dot (a.comp b) (c.comp d))) :
    (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d terms).interpret.eval =
      ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := R) a b).eval.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.upDot terms).interpret.eval).vertical (Diagram.splitUp c d).eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination
      (terms.map fun (r, t) => (r, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.parallelUp a b c d t)))).eval.toLinearMap z =
    (Diagram.splitUp c d).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.finiteSum (terms.map fun (r,t) => Diagram.scale r (Diagram.upDot t))).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.mergeUp a b).eval.toLinearMap z))
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, Diagram.eval_finiteSum]
  induction terms with
  | nil => simp
  | cons term rest ih =>
    rcases term with ⟨r, t⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, map_add]
    have scaled :
        (Diagram.scale r (Diagram.upDot t)).eval.toLinearMap
            ((Diagram.mergeUp a b).eval.toLinearMap z) =
          r • (Diagram.upDot (R := R) t).eval.toLinearMap
            ((Diagram.mergeUp a b).eval.toLinearMap z) := rfl
    rw [ih, scaled, map_smul]
    rfl

private theorem eval_parallelUp_single [Nontrivial R]
    (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (c : ConjEmbedding B G) (d : ConjEmbedding K B)
    (t : Dot (a.comp b) (c.comp d)) :
    (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d
        (DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single t (1 : R)))).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.parallelUp a b c d t (R := R)).eval := by
  classical
  have h : DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single t (1 : R)) =
      (Finsupp.single t (1 : R)).support.toList.map
        (fun p => ((Finsupp.single t (1 : R)) p, p)) := rfl
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination
      ((DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single t (1 : R))).map
        fun (r, p) => (r, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.parallelUp a b c d p)))).eval.toLinearMap z = _
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, h, Finsupp.support_single _ one_ne_zero]
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval]

private theorem compose_singletons
    {a b c : ConjEmbedding K G} (x : Dot a b) (y : Dot b c) :
    DotLabel.compose (Finsupp.single x (1 : R)) (Finsupp.single y 1) =
      Finsupp.single (x.vertical y) 1 := by
  unfold DotLabel.compose Dot.linearProduct
  rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index, Finsupp.sum_single_index]
  · rw [mul_one]
  · simp
  · simp

private theorem eval_transported_up_id {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (same : a = b) :
    (LabelledDrawing.interpret
      (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun e => LabelledDrawing R (.up a) (.up e))
        (.ordinary (Diagram.id (.up a))) same)).eval = (Diagram.transportUpId same).eval := by
  cases same
  rfl

private theorem eval_transported_word_id {p q : Word G K} (same : p = q) :
    (LabelledDrawing.interpret
      (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w => LabelledDrawing R p w)
        (.ordinary (Diagram.id p)) same)).eval =
    (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w => Diagram R p w) (Diagram.id p) same).eval := by
  cases same
  rfl

end ParallelReidemeisterTwoInductionProof

open MackeyDiagrams ParallelReidemeisterTwoInductionProof

CurlAcrossTrivalentVertex.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G γ α hγ hα a b ba leftStrand rightStrand mergedStrand
    leftId rightId mergedId merge split rightCurl evalDrawing
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro L _ inK imageK imageL _ _ _
    -- Xiao § 3.2 (archived p. 9, revised published p. 11) uses the
    -- index of the image of L in H. Injectivity identifies the relative
    -- factor with the index of L.subgroupOf K. Mathlib orders the factors
    -- in the other order.
    change (inK.map a.toHom).index = a.toHom.range.index * inK.index
    exact (inK.index_map_of_injective a.injective).trans (Nat.mul_comm _ _)
  · open MackeyDiagrams in
    have evalCurl {A B M : Subgroup U} (strand : ConjEmbedding A B)
        (loop : ConjEmbedding M A) (finite : loop.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
        evalDrawing (rightCurl strand loop finite) =
          (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.up strand).basis).scale
            (loop.toHom.range.index : Complex) := by
      -- Theorem 4.1, (4.1) (archived p. 14, revised published p. 16),
      -- evaluates the finite undotted curl. The registered theorem is
      -- phrased using explicit conjugators. Recover representatives of
      -- both actual strand labels and keep the inner range's finite index.
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := strand.hasRepresentative
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := loop.hasRepresentative
      have hsMem (x : A) : s * (x : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ B :=
        hs x ▸ (strand.toHom x).property
      have hdMem (x : M) : d * (x : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ A :=
        hd x ▸ (loop.toHom x).property
      have hsEq : strand = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hsMem :=
        ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hs x))
      have hdEq : loop = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hdMem :=
        ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hd x))
      cases hsEq
      cases hdEq
      exact RightUpReidemeisterCurl M A B d s hdMem hsMem finite
    open MackeyDiagrams in
    have moveAcross {X Y : Biset G K}
        (f : Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (g : Biset.Hom Complex Y X)
        (branch : Biset.Hom Complex X X) (merged : Biset.Hom Complex Y Y)
        (n : Complex) (hBranch : branch = (Biset.Hom.id X).scale n)
        (hMerged : merged = (Biset.Hom.id Y).scale n) :
        branch.vertical f = f.vertical merged ∧
          g.vertical branch = merged.vertical g := by
      -- Section 1.2 identifies the typed merge and split maps. Linearity
      -- proves the slide for any pair of maps with these types, bypassing
      -- the inverse identities of InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits.
      simp only [hBranch, hMerged, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left,
        Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right, Biset.Hom.vertical_id, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
        and_self]
    intro M mergedLoop mergedImage finiteMerged mergedIndex curlMerged
    have hMerged := evalCurl ba mergedLoop finiteMerged
    refine ⟨hMerged, ?_, ?_⟩
    · open MackeyDiagrams in
      intro N rightLoop rightImage finiteRight rightIndex curlRight curlOnRight
      have hRight := evalCurl a rightLoop finiteRight
      refine ⟨hRight, ?_⟩
      intro hIndex
      have hBranch : evalDrawing curlOnRight =
          (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (leftStrand.tensor rightStrand).basis).scale
            (mergedIndex : Complex) := by
        change (Biset.Hom.id leftStrand.basis).horizontal (evalDrawing curlRight) = _
        rw [hRight, Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_right, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
        change (Biset.Hom.id _).scale (rightIndex : Complex) = _
        rw [hIndex]
      exact moveAcross (evalDrawing merge) (evalDrawing split)
        (evalDrawing curlOnRight) (evalDrawing curlMerged) _ hBranch hMerged
    · open MackeyDiagrams in
      intro N leftLoop leftImage finiteLeft leftIndex curlLeft curlOnLeft
      have hLeft := evalCurl b leftLoop finiteLeft
      refine ⟨hLeft, ?_⟩
      intro hIndex
      -- Example 3.1 has unequal indices on the two branches. Use the
      -- given equality for this placement as for the right branch.
      have hBranch : evalDrawing curlOnLeft =
          (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (leftStrand.tensor rightStrand).basis).scale
            (mergedIndex : Complex) := by
        change (evalDrawing curlLeft).horizontal (Biset.Hom.id rightStrand.basis) = _
        rw [hLeft, Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_left, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]
        change (Biset.Hom.id _).scale (leftIndex : Complex) = _
        rw [hIndex]
      exact moveAcross (evalDrawing merge) (evalDrawing split)
        (evalDrawing curlOnLeft) (evalDrawing curlMerged) _ hBranch hMerged

    -- original source/mackey-bimodules.pdf, pp. 7–8, and the revised
    -- published PDF, pp. 9–10, matching article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf.

    refine ⟨?_, undotted, ?_⟩

        ext h
        change (∃ k : K, loop.toHom k = h) ↔ (h : U) ∈ K
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩

        · intro hk

      -- coset calculation. Use this equality at the merge, then use
      -- interchange to carry the full reverse cup with its fixed loop.
      -- This gives the same map without choosing a transversal again.
      -- The three marks are coefficient-one singleton labels as specified
      -- by the proposition. The proof compares their maps at fixed endpoints.

            ((insideDot.horizontal loopIdentity).interpret.eval.vertical (upper b).interpret.eval) = _

          dot.interpret.eval.scale (S.index : Complex)
        rw [show (curl a).interpret.eval =
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a).basis).scale
            (S.index : Complex) from undotted,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id_vertical]

    -- Xiao (3.1)–(3.4). Each supplier's first conjunct is the two-leg

    exact ⟨(InductionMergeDotSlide K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he).1 γ' hγ' hd,
      (InductionSplitDotSlide K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he).1 γ' hγ' hd,
      (RestrictionMergeDotSlide K H G γ α β hγ hα hβ he).1 γ' hγ' hd,

namespace RightCurlAndDotSlideSupport

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}

private def liftDot {a b : ConjEmbedding H G} (loop : ConjEmbedding K H) (d : Dot a b) :
    Dot (a.comp loop) (b.comp loop) :=
  ⟨d.element, fun k => d.intertwines (loop.toHom k)⟩

private theorem singleton_eval {a b : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot a b) :
    (DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).eval := by
  rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing]
  apply Diagram.eval_ext
  intro x r
  rw [Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply, freeLift_single, one_smul]

private theorem insert_slide {a b : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot a b) :
    ((Diagram.insertRightUnit (R := Complex) (.up a)).vertical
      ((Diagram.upDot d).horizontal (.id (.empty H)))).eval =
      ((Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).vertical (.insertRightUnit (.up b))).eval := by
  apply Diagram.eval_ext
  intro x r
  change G at x
  change ((Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).horizontal (.id (.empty H))).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.insertRightUnit (R := Complex) (.up a)).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r)) =
    (Diagram.insertRightUnit (R := Complex) (.up b)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r))
  have insert (p : ConjEmbedding H G) (z : G) :
      (Diagram.insertRightUnit (R := Complex) (.up p)).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z r) =
        Finsupp.single ((Word.up p).basis.pair (Word.empty H).basis z 1) r :=
    by
      change (Biset.insertRightUnit (Word.up p).basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
      rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  rw [insert a x, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single (R := Complex) d x r, insert]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

private theorem unassociate_slide {a b : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot a b)
    (loop : ConjEmbedding K H) :
    let p := Word.up a
    let p' := Word.up b
    let q := Word.up loop
    let t := Word.down loop
    let dot := Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d
    (((dot.horizontal (.id (q.tensor t))).vertical (.unassociate p' q t))).eval =
      ((Diagram.unassociate p q t).vertical ((dot.horizontal (.id q)).horizontal (.id t))).eval := by
  intro p p' q t dot
  apply Diagram.eval_ext
  intro w r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨x, yz⟩ => ?_)
  refine Quotient.inductionOn yz (fun ⟨y, z⟩ => ?_)
  change G at x
  change H at y z
  change (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) p' q t).eval.toLinearMap
      ((dot.horizontal (.id (q.tensor t))).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (q.basis.tensor t.basis) x (q.basis.pair t.basis y z)) r)) =
    ((dot.horizontal (.id q)).horizontal (.id t)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) p q t).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (q.basis.tensor t.basis) x (q.basis.pair t.basis y z)) r))
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, Diagram.eval_unassociate_single,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single]
  rw [show dot = Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d from rfl,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single (R := Complex) d x 1,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply (q.tensor t), Diagram.eval_id_apply q, Diagram.eval_id_apply t]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, one_smul,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact Diagram.eval_unassociate_single p' q t (x * d.element) y z r

-- This is the basis identity in Xiao's proof of (3.1), with the loop leg
-- unchanged. The intertwining equation holds for every element of H.
private theorem merge_slide {a b : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot a b)
    (loop : ConjEmbedding K H) :
    (((Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).horizontal (.id (.up loop))).vertical
      (.mergeUp b loop)).eval =
      ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a loop).vertical (.upDot (liftDot loop d))).eval := by
  apply Diagram.eval_ext
  intro w r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change G at x
  change H at y
  change (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) b loop).eval.toLinearMap
      (((Diagram.upDot d).horizontal (.id (.up loop))).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up loop).basis x y) r)) =
    (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) (liftDot loop d)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.mergeUp a loop).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up loop).basis x y) r))
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single]
  change Finsupp.single ((x * d.element) * b.toHom y) r =
    Finsupp.single ((x * a.toHom y) * d.element) r
  rw [mul_assoc, ← d.intertwines y, ← mul_assoc]

private theorem paste {L M : Type u} [Group L] [Group M]
    {X₀ X₁ X₂ Y₀ Y₁ Y₂ : Biset L M}
    {f₁ : Biset.Hom Complex X₀ X₁} {f₂ : Biset.Hom Complex X₁ X₂}
    {g₁ : Biset.Hom Complex Y₀ Y₁} {g₂ : Biset.Hom Complex Y₁ Y₂}
    {d₀ : Biset.Hom Complex X₀ Y₀} {d₁ : Biset.Hom Complex X₁ Y₁}
    {d₂ : Biset.Hom Complex X₂ Y₂}
    (h₁ : d₀.vertical g₁ = f₁.vertical d₁) (h₂ : d₁.vertical g₂ = f₂.vertical d₂) :
    d₀.vertical (g₁.vertical g₂) = (f₁.vertical f₂).vertical d₂ := by
  rw [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc d₀, h₁, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc f₁, h₂,
    ← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc f₁]

private theorem tensor_square {L M N : Type u} [Group L] [Group M] [Group N]
    {X₀ X₁ X₂ X₃ : Biset L M} (Z : Biset M N)
    {f₁ : Biset.Hom Complex X₀ X₁} {f₂ : Biset.Hom Complex X₁ X₃}
    {g₁ : Biset.Hom Complex X₀ X₂} {g₂ : Biset.Hom Complex X₂ X₃}
    (h : f₁.vertical f₂ = g₁.vertical g₂) :
    (f₁.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Z)).vertical (f₂.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Z)) =
      (g₁.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Z)).vertical (g₂.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Z)) := by
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, h]

-- Expand the lower junction into unit, cup, reassociation and merge. The
-- cup stays on the same loop and its finite-fiber sum is carried by interchange.
private theorem lower_slide {a b : ConjEmbedding H G} (d : Dot a b)
    (loop : ConjEmbedding K H) (finite : loop.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    let lower := fun p : ConjEmbedding H G =>
      LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown p loop finite)
    let mark := fun {L M : Subgroup U} {p q : ConjEmbedding L M} (e : Dot p q) =>
      DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex))
    let loopIdentity := LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.down loop))
    (mark d).interpret.eval.vertical (lower b).interpret.eval =
      (lower a).interpret.eval.vertical
        ((mark (liftDot loop d)).horizontal loopIdentity).interpret.eval := by
  intro lower mark loopIdentity
  change (DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval.vertical
      (lower b).interpret.eval =
    (lower a).interpret.eval.vertical
      ((DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single (liftDot loop d) (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval.horizontal
        (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down loop).basis))
  rw [singleton_eval d, singleton_eval (liftDot loop d)]
  let t := (Word.down loop).basis
  let cup := Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) loop finite
  have cup_slide := Biset.Hom.horizontal_disjoint (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).eval cup.eval
  have merge_square :
      ((Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) d).horizontal (.id (.up loop))).eval.vertical
        (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) b loop).eval =
      (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a loop).eval.vertical
        (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) (liftDot loop d)).eval :=
    merge_slide d loop
  have squares := paste (insert_slide d).symm (paste cup_slide
    (paste (unassociate_slide d loop) (tensor_square t merge_square)))
  exact squares

end RightCurlAndDotSlideSupport

ParabolicRightOrbitMultiplicity.proof:
by
  classical
  intro Sinf U blockSym parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b d c e f
    up down tensor comp ga ad df gc ce ef bottom top X Y Pair input output pair
    orbit stabilizer projected swaps coefficient matrix RightData labels representative
    toA toF toC restricts image isInclusion Fiber lowerMap finiteFibers drawId eval
    rightDiagram rightCount realizes LeftUpperFiber leftDiagram
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair := OrbitMultiplicity.action a b d c e f
  haveI : Finite A := OrbitMultiplicity.parabolic_finite hA
  haveI : Finite F := OrbitMultiplicity.parabolic_finite hF
  let supplier := RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer G A D F C E a b d c e f
  have invariant (M : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (z z' : Pair) :
      z' ∈ orbit z → coefficient M z' = coefficient M z :=
    supplier.1 M z z'
  have normalized (z : Pair) : ∃ r t s, z ∈ orbit (pair r t s) := supplier.2.1 z
  have orbit_eq {z z' : Pair} (hz : z ∈ orbit z') : orbit z = orbit z' :=
    MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hz
  have orbit_self (z : Pair) : z ∈ orbit z := MulAction.mem_orbit_self z
  have extremal (z : Pair) : IsGreatest
      {K : Subgroup U | parabolic K ∧ K ≤ projected z} (swaps (projected z)) := by
    letI := OrbitMultiplicity.projected_finite a b d c e f z
    exact OrbitMultiplicity.parabolic_extremal (projected z)
  -- Ian Xiao, Proposition 8.7 and proof, archived source/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- pp. 39–40 and revised published PDF pp. 41–42.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-three-unscaled
  -- The portal presents the proof in paragraphs. Steps 1–6 refer to its
  -- normalization, vertex, fiber, minimization, and expansion arguments,
  -- with the expansion checked last because its Lean statement uses the
  -- typed indexed drawing and the coefficient formula.
  -- Steps 1–3 of § 8.3. Use the normalized representative and the graph from
  -- Theorem 6.7. Finite boundary groups make every lower projection finite.
  -- Step 4. Identify the exact hits in the right drawing with a coset-tower
  -- fiber. The inverse in the F coordinate reconciles the two action conventions.
  have arbitrary (B' : Subgroup U) (data : RightData B') :
      image data ≤ projected (representative data) ∧
      realizes data (orbit (representative data))
        ((image data).relIndex (projected (representative data))) ∧
      ∀ g x y, rightCount data g x y =
        @ite Nat ((input g x, y) ∈ orbit (representative data))
          (Classical.propDecidable _) ((image data).relIndex (projected (representative data))) 0 := by
    rcases data with ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩
    obtain ⟨hle, ⟨fin, hc⟩, hcount⟩ := OrbitMultiplicity.right_eval a b d c e f i j k r t s
    exact ⟨hle, ⟨rfl, fin, hc⟩, hcount⟩
  have restrictRealizes {P K : Subgroup U} (hK : K ≤ P) (full : RightData P)
      (hj : isInclusion full) (z : Pair) (hz : representative full = z)
      (hP : P = projected z) :
      ∃ term : RightData K, restricts term full hK ∧ isInclusion term ∧
        realizes term (orbit z) (K.relIndex P) := by
    rcases full with ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩
    let i' := OrbitMultiplicity.restrictEmbedding hK i
    let j' := OrbitMultiplicity.restrictEmbedding hK j
    let k' := OrbitMultiplicity.restrictEmbedding hK k
    let r' := OrbitMultiplicity.restrictDot hK b d i j r
    let t' := OrbitMultiplicity.restrictDot hK a c i k t
    let s' := OrbitMultiplicity.restrictDot hK e f k j s
    let term : RightData K := ⟨i',j',k',r',t',s'⟩
    have hInc : isInclusion term := fun p => hj (Subgroup.inclusion hK p)
    have hImage : image term = K := by
      ext p
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
        change (toF term k : U) ∈ K
        rw [hInc k]
        exact k.property
      · intro hp
        exact ⟨⟨p,hp⟩, hInc ⟨p,hp⟩⟩
    have hrep : representative term = z := hz
    have ht := (arbitrary K term).2.1
    rw [hrep, hImage, ← hP] at ht
    exact ⟨term, ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩, hInc, ht⟩
  refine ⟨invariant, normalized, ?_, fun B' _ data => arbitrary B' data, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r t s z P L
    obtain ⟨equations, _, _, i, j, k, rd, td, sd, hj, hr, ht, hs, graph, _, _⟩ :=
      supplier.2.2.1 r t s
    let full : RightData P := ⟨i,j,k,rd,td,sd⟩
    have he : labels full = (r,t,s) := Prod.ext hr (Prod.ext ht hs)
    have hrep : representative full = z := by
      change pair (labels full).1 (labels full).2.1 (labels full).2.2 = pair r t s
      rw [he]
    have hL := (extremal z).1
    refine ⟨equations, full, he, hj, graph, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro K hK _
      obtain ⟨term, hrest, _, hreal⟩ := restrictRealizes hK full hj z hrep rfl
      exact ⟨term, hrest, hreal⟩
    · obtain ⟨term, hrest, hinc, hreal⟩ := restrictRealizes hL.2 full hj z hrep rfl
      exact ⟨hL.2, term, hL.1, hrest, hinc, hreal⟩
  · -- Step 5. Lemma 7.2 supplies the greatest parabolic subgroup.
    -- Since the projected stabilizer is finite, the relative indices are
    -- positive ordinary natural numbers. One orbit entry recovers the integer.
    intro z P n
    letI : Finite P := OrbitMultiplicity.projected_finite a b d c e f z
    have hL := extremal z
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, fun z' hz' =>
      OrbitMultiplicity.orbit_index_transport a b d c e f z z' hz'⟩
    · obtain ⟨r,t,s,hz⟩ := normalized z
      let z₀ := pair r t s
      have ho : orbit z₀ = orbit z := (orbit_eq hz).symm
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, i, j, k, rd, td, sd, hj, hr, ht, hs, _, _, _⟩ :=
        supplier.2.2.1 r t s
      let full : RightData (projected z₀) := ⟨i,j,k,rd,td,sd⟩
      have he : labels full = (r,t,s) := Prod.ext hr (Prod.ext ht hs)
      have hrep : representative full = z₀ := by
        change pair (labels full).1 (labels full).2.1 (labels full).2.2 = pair r t s
        rw [he]
      have hL₀ := (extremal z₀).1
      obtain ⟨term, _, _, hreal⟩ := restrictRealizes hL₀.2 full hj z₀ hrep rfl
      have hi := OrbitMultiplicity.orbit_index_transport a b d c e f z₀ z hz
      change n = (swaps (projected z₀)).relIndex (projected z₀) at hi
      rw [ho, ← hi] at hreal
      exact ⟨swaps (projected z₀), term, hL₀.1, hreal⟩
    · rintro m ⟨B', term, hp, ho, finite, hm⟩
      let z₀ := representative term
      let P₀ := projected z₀
      let K := image term
      letI : Finite P₀ := OrbitMultiplicity.projected_finite a b d c e f z₀
      letI : Finite (swaps P₀) :=
        Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion (extremal z₀).1.2)
          (Subgroup.inclusion_injective (extremal z₀).1.2)
      obtain ⟨hKP, ⟨_, fin', he⟩, _⟩ := arbitrary B' term
      have hpK : parabolic K := OrbitMultiplicity.conjugate_parabolic (by
        rcases term with ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩
        exact j) hp
      have hz₀ : z₀ ∈ orbit z := ho ▸ orbit_self z₀
      have hme : m = K.relIndex P₀ := by
        have h := (hm z₀).symm.trans (he z₀)
        change matrix (orbit z) m z₀ = matrix (orbit z₀) (K.relIndex P₀) z₀ at h
        have h' : (m : Complex) = (K.relIndex P₀ : Complex) := by
          simpa only [matrix, if_pos hz₀, if_pos (orbit_self z₀)] using h
        exact Nat.cast_injective h'
      have hKL : K ≤ swaps P₀ := (extremal z₀).2 ⟨hpK, hKP⟩
      have hi := OrbitMultiplicity.orbit_index_transport a b d c e f z z₀ hz₀
      change (swaps P₀).relIndex P₀ = n at hi
      change n ≤ m
      rw [hme, ← hi, ← Subgroup.relIndex_mul_relIndex K (swaps P₀) P₀ hKL (extremal z₀).1.2]
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero orbitMultiplicityFinite)
    · change (swaps P).relIndex P = 1 ↔ parabolic P
      rw [Subgroup.relIndex_eq_one]
      exact ⟨fun h => le_antisymm h hL.1.2 ▸ hL.1.1,
        fun hP => hL.2 ⟨hP, le_rfl⟩⟩
  · -- Step 6. Use the Case 5 supplier on the actual left drawing. Its
    -- finite-fiber witness and the endpoint witness are proof-irrelevant.
    -- The index set is the finite set of supported orbits of the pair basis.
    intro B hB u v w r t s finite M S
    haveI : Finite G := OrbitMultiplicity.parabolic_finite hG
    haveI : Finite D := OrbitMultiplicity.parabolic_finite hD
    haveI : Finite E := OrbitMultiplicity.parabolic_finite hE
    letI : Finite X.carrier := OrbitMultiplicity.finite_word_of_groups a b d
    letI : Finite Y.carrier := OrbitMultiplicity.finite_word_of_groups c e f
    obtain ⟨fin', sourceMap, targetMap, _, _, _, _, _, supported, _⟩ :=
      SupportedLeftOrbitProjectedStabilizer hG hA hD hF hC hE hB a b d c e f u v w r t s
    have oneOn (z : Pair) (hz : coefficient M z ≠ 0) : coefficient M z = 1 :=
      (supported z hz).2.2.2.2
    let valid (O : Set Pair) (Dg : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) :=
      ∃ (r₀ : D) (t₀ : G) (s₀ : E),
        let z := pair r₀ t₀ s₀
        let P := projected z
        O = orbit z ∧ parabolic P ∧
        ∃ (data : RightData P) (fiberProof : finiteFibers data),
          labels data = (r₀, t₀, s₀) ∧ isInclusion data ∧ Dg = rightDiagram data fiberProof
    have terms (O : ↥S) :
        ∃ Dg, valid O.val Dg ∧ ∀ z',
          coefficient (eval Dg) z' = matrix O.val 1 z' := by
      obtain ⟨z, hO, hz⟩ := O.property
      obtain ⟨r₀,t₀,s₀,hnorm⟩ := normalized z
      let z₀ := pair r₀ t₀ s₀
      have hO' : O.val = orbit z₀ := hO.trans (orbit_eq hnorm)
      have hz₀ : coefficient M z₀ ≠ 0 := by
        rw [← invariant M z₀ z hnorm]
        exact hz
      have hpar := (supported z₀ hz₀).2.2.2.1
      change OrbitMultiplicity.Parabolic ((Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.snd G F) (stabilizer z₀)).map F.subtype) at hpar
      rw [Subgroup.map_map] at hpar
      obtain ⟨_, _, _, i, j, k, rd, td, sd, hj, hr, ht, hs, _, _, fullEval⟩ :=
        supplier.2.2.1 r₀ t₀ s₀
      obtain ⟨_, fin, hcoef⟩ := fullEval M hz₀
      let data : RightData (projected z₀) := ⟨i,j,k,rd,td,sd⟩
      refine ⟨rightDiagram data fin, ⟨r₀,t₀,s₀,hO',hpar,data,fin,
        Prod.ext hr (Prod.ext ht hs),hj,rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      intro z'
      rw [hO']
      simpa only [matrix, Nat.cast_one] using hcoef z'
    obtain ⟨expansion, hall, hvalid, heval⟩ :=
      OrbitMultiplicity.indexed_expansion a b d c e f M (invariant M) oneOn valid terms
    refine ⟨expansion, hall, ?_, heval⟩
    intro O
    obtain ⟨hO, hc⟩ := hvalid O
    obtain ⟨x, g, y, horbit, hpar, dat, fin, hlab, hinc, hdraw⟩ := hO
    exact ⟨x,g,y,horbit,hpar,dat,fin,hlab,hinc,hdraw,hc⟩
