private theorem orbitMultiplicityFinite {W : Type*} [Group W]
    {H K : Subgroup W} [Finite K] : H.relIndex K ≠ 0 := by
  rw [Subgroup.relIndex, Subgroup.index_eq_card]
  exact Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

namespace OrbitMultiplicity

open MackeyDiagrams

private abbrev Sinf := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev blockSym (X : Finset Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ X))
private abbrev ParabolicPerm (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
    H = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l)
private abbrev Parabolic (H : Subgroup Sinf) := ParabolicPerm (H.map Sinf.subtype)
private abbrev swaps (P : Subgroup Sinf) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ : Sinf | σ ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)}

private theorem parabolic_finite {H : Subgroup Sinf} (hH : Parabolic H) : Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, hblocks⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have hsub : H.map Sinf.subtype ≤ blockSym X := by
    rw [hblocks]
    refine iSup_le fun i σ hs => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
    let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ
    have moved_mem (x : Nat) (hx : σ x ≠ x) : x ∈ X := by
      by_contra hn
      have hi : x ∉ blocks i := fun hx' => hn (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx'⟩)
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hi)
    have preserves (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · rw [h]
      · have hy : σ (σ x) ≠ σ x := fun hh => h (σ.injective hh)
        exact iff_of_true (moved_mem (σ x) hy) (moved_mem x h)
    exact ⟨σ.subtypePerm preserves, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserves moved_mem⟩
  let : Finite (blockSym X) :=
    (Set.finite_range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))).to_subtype
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun h : H => (⟨(h.val : Equiv.Perm Nat), hsub ⟨h.val, h.property, rfl⟩⟩ : blockSym X))
    (fun _ _ hh => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y : blockSym X => y.val) hh)))

private theorem parabolic_extremal (P : Subgroup Sinf) [Finite P] :
    IsGreatest {K : Subgroup Sinf | Parabolic K ∧ K ≤ P} (swaps P) := by
  classical
  let Q := P.map Sinf.subtype
  letI : Finite Q := Finite.of_surjective (fun p : P => (⟨p.val.val, ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩⟩ : Q))
    (by rintro ⟨_, i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hQ : Q ≤ Sinf := fun _ ⟨p, _, hp⟩ => hp ▸ p.property
  have unionWitness (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :
      ParabolicPerm H ↔ ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
        (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
        (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧ H = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩
      exact ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, n, blocks, hn, hd, by simp, he⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, n, blocks, hn, hd, _, he⟩
      exact ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩
  have hmap : (swaps P).map Sinf.subtype =
      Subgroup.closure {σ | σ ∈ Q ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ} := by
    rw [MonoidHom.map_closure]
    congr 1
    ext σ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hs⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hs⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hs⟩
      exact ⟨p, ⟨hp, hs⟩, rfl⟩
  have h := (ExtremalParabolicsOfFiniteGroup Q hQ).1
  rw [← hmap] at h
  refine ⟨⟨(unionWitness _).mpr h.1.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact (Subgroup.map_le_map_iff_of_injective Sinf.subtype_injective).mp h.1.2
  · intro K hK
    exact (Subgroup.map_le_map_iff_of_injective Sinf.subtype_injective).mp
      (h.2 ⟨(unionWitness _).mp hK.1, Subgroup.map_mono hK.2⟩)

private theorem conjugate_parabolic {B F : Subgroup Sinf} (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (hB : Parabolic B) : Parabolic ((F.subtype.comp j.toHom).range) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := j.hasRepresentative
  let conj := (MulAut.conj (q : Equiv.Perm Nat)).toMonoidHom
  have hmap : ((F.subtype.comp j.toHom).range).map Sinf.subtype =
      (B.map Sinf.subtype).map conj := by
    ext σ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p.val.val, ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩, (congrArg Subtype.val (hq p)).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨j.toHom ⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, rfl⟩, congrArg Subtype.val (hq ⟨p, hp⟩)⟩
  have hcarrier : ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
      (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
      (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧ B.map Sinf.subtype = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l) := by
    obtain ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩ := hB
    exact ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, n, blocks, hn, hd, by simp, he⟩
  obtain ⟨_, n, blocks, hn, hd, _, he⟩ := FiniteParabolicClosure.1 (B.map Sinf.subtype) hcarrier q
  exact ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, hmap.trans he⟩

section Geometry

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)

private abbrev word := (Word.up a).tensor ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d))
private abbrev point (g : G) (x : D) : (word a b d).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b |>.tensor (.up d)).basis) g (Generator.mixedPair b d x)
private abbrev Pair := (word a b d).basis.carrier × (word c e f).basis.carrier
private abbrev action : MulAction (G × F) (Pair a b d c e f) where
  smul q z := ((word a b d).basis.act q z.1, (word c e f).basis.act q z.2)
  one_smul z := Prod.ext ((word a b d).basis.one_act z.1) ((word c e f).basis.one_act z.2)
  mul_smul q q' z := Prod.ext ((word a b d).basis.mul_act q q' z.1)
    ((word c e f).basis.mul_act q q' z.2)

private abbrev orbit (z : Pair a b d c e f) :=
  letI := action a b d c e f
  MulAction.orbit (G × F) z
private abbrev stabilizer (z : Pair a b d c e f) :=
  @MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) _ _ (action a b d c e f) z
private abbrev projectHom (G F : Subgroup U) := F.subtype.comp (MonoidHom.snd G F)
private abbrev projected (z : Pair a b d c e f) :=
  (stabilizer a b d c e f z).map (projectHom G F)
private abbrev base (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) : Pair a b d c e f :=
  (point a b d 1 r, point c e f t s)

private theorem point_surjective (z : (word a b d).basis.carrier) :
    ∃ g x, point a b d g x = z := by
  obtain ⟨⟨g, y⟩, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).symm.surjective y
  exact ⟨g, x, rfl⟩

private noncomputable abbrev coefficient (M : Biset.Hom Complex (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis)
    (z : Pair a b d c e f) : Complex := M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2
private noncomputable abbrev matrix (O : Set (Pair a b d c e f)) (n : Nat)
    (z : Pair a b d c e f) : Complex := @ite _ (z ∈ O) (Classical.propDecidable _) n 0
private noncomputable abbrev eval (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex (word a b d) (word c e f)) :=
  drawing.interpret.eval
private abbrev fiber (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) :=
  ((Word.up i).tensor (.down j)).basis.carrier
private abbrev innerPoint (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (v : A × F) :
    fiber i j := (Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) v.1 v.2
private abbrev lowerMap (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) := Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r
private abbrev outputOf (g : G) (t : G) (s : E) (v : A × F) :=
  point c e f (g * a.toHom v.1 * t) (s * f.toHom v.2)
private abbrev FiniteFibers (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) := ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | lowerMap b d i j r w = z}
private noncomputable abbrev hits (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : G) (s : E) (g : G) (x : D)
    (y : (word c e f).basis.carrier) : Set (fiber i j) :=
  {w | lowerMap b d i j r w = Generator.mixedPair b d x ∧
    outputOf a c e f g t s (Quotient.out w) = y}

private theorem finite_of_bases [Finite A] [Finite F]
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) : Finite (fiber i j) :=
  Finite.of_surjective (innerPoint i j) (Quotient.exists_rep)

private theorem finiteFibers_of_bases [Finite A] [Finite F]
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) :
    FiniteFibers b d i j r := by
  letI := finite_of_bases i j
  exact fun _ => Set.toFinite _

private theorem act_point (q : G × F) (g : G) (x : D) :
    (word a b d).basis.act q (point a b d g x) =
      point a b d (q.1 * g) (x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹) := by
  change (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis
    (q.1 * g * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹)
    ((Biset.restriction b).pair (Biset.induction d)
      (b.toHom 1 * x * (1 : D)⁻¹) (1 * 1 * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹)) = _
  simp only [map_one, inv_one, mul_one, one_mul, point]
  congr 1
  apply (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).injective
  change x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹ =
    Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedPair b d (x * (d.toHom q.2)⁻¹))
  simp

private abbrev diagonal (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) :
    B →* A × F := i.toHom.prod j.toHom
private abbrev phi : A × F →* G × F :=
  a.toHom.prodMap (MonoidHom.id F)

private theorem inner_eq (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (v w : A × F) :
    innerPoint i j (v.1, v.2⁻¹) = innerPoint i j (w.1, w.2⁻¹) ↔
      v⁻¹ * w ∈ (diagonal i j).range := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hq⟩ := Quotient.exact h
    change 1 * v.1 * (i.toHom p)⁻¹ = w.1 at hp
    change j.toHom p * v.2⁻¹ * (1 : F)⁻¹ = w.2⁻¹ at hq
    refine ⟨p⁻¹, Prod.ext ?_ ?_⟩
    · change i.toHom p⁻¹ = v.1⁻¹ * w.1
      simp only [one_mul] at hp
      rw [← hp, map_inv, inv_mul_cancel_left]
    · change j.toHom p⁻¹ = v.2⁻¹ * w.2
      simp only [inv_one, mul_one] at hq
      rw [map_inv, ← inv_inv w.2, ← hq, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    apply Quotient.sound
    have hv : w = v * diagonal i j p := by rw [hp, mul_inv_cancel_left]
    refine ⟨p⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change 1 * v.1 * (i.toHom p⁻¹)⁻¹ = w.1
      rw [hv]
      simp [diagonal]
    · change j.toHom p⁻¹ * v.2⁻¹ * (1 : F)⁻¹ = w.2⁻¹
      rw [hv]
      simp [diagonal, mul_inv_rev]

private noncomputable def innerEquiv (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) :
    (A × F) ⧸ (diagonal i j).range ≃ fiber i j :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (Quotient.lift (fun v : A × F => innerPoint i j (v.1, v.2⁻¹))
    fun v w hv => (inner_eq i j v w).mpr ((QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply).mp hv)) ⟨
    fun v w => Quotient.inductionOn₂ v w (fun v w h =>
      Quotient.sound ((QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply).mpr ((inner_eq i j v w).mp h))),
    fun w => by
      obtain ⟨⟨p,q⟩, hw⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep w
      refine ⟨QuotientGroup.mk (p,q⁻¹), ?_⟩
      change innerPoint i j (p, (q⁻¹)⁻¹) = w
      rw [inv_inv]
      exact hw⟩

private theorem count_tower {H : Type*} [Group H] {K P : Subgroup H} (h : K ≤ P)
    (base : H) :
    Nat.card {w : H ⧸ K // (Subgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE h w).1 = QuotientGroup.mk base} =
      K.relIndex P := by
  let E := Subgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE h
  let E' : {w : H ⧸ K // (E w).1 = QuotientGroup.mk base} ≃ (P ⧸ K.subgroupOf P) :=
    { toFun := fun w => (E w.1).2
      invFun := fun q => ⟨E.symm (QuotientGroup.mk base, q), by simp⟩
      left_inv := fun w => Subtype.ext (E.injective (by
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact Prod.ext w.property.symm rfl))
      right_inv := fun q => congrArg Prod.snd (E.apply_symm_apply (QuotientGroup.mk base, q)) }
  exact (Nat.card_congr E').trans (Subgroup.index_eq_card _).symm

private theorem hit_eq_parameters
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (tDot : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (sDot : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) (g : G) (x : D)
    (y : (word c e f).basis.carrier)
    (input_eq : ∀ (g g' : G) (x : D) (h : F),
      point a b d g' (r.element * d.toHom h) = point a b d g x ↔
        ∃ α : A, g' = g * a.toHom α ∧ x = b.toHom α * r.element * d.toHom h)
    (v : A × F) :
    letI := action a b d c e f
    innerPoint i j (v.1, v.2⁻¹) ∈ hits a b d c e f i j r tDot.element sDot.element g x y ↔
      ((g, 1) * phi (F := F) a v) • base a b d c e f r.element tDot.element sDot.element =
        (point a b d g x, y) := by
  letI := action a b d c e f
  let t := tDot.element
  let s := sDot.element
  let w := innerPoint i j (v.1, v.2⁻¹)
  let u : A × F := Quotient.out w
  have hbalance : innerPoint i j u = w := Quotient.out_eq' w
  have hx : lowerMap b d i j r w = Generator.mixedPair b d x ↔
      b.toHom v.1 * r.element * d.toHom v.2⁻¹ = x :=
    (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).symm.injective.eq_iff
  have hy : outputOf a c e f g t s u = outputOf a c e f g t s (v.1,v.2⁻¹) := by
    obtain ⟨p, h₁, h₂⟩ := Quotient.exact hbalance
    change 1 * u.1 * (i.toHom p)⁻¹ = v.1 at h₁
    change j.toHom p * u.2 * (1 : F)⁻¹ = v.2⁻¹ at h₂
    simp only [one_mul, mul_one, inv_one] at h₁ h₂
    apply Quotient.sound
    refine ⟨k.toHom p, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change 1 * (g * a.toHom u.1 * t) * (c.toHom (k.toHom p))⁻¹ =
        g * a.toHom v.1 * t
      have ht : a.toHom (i.toHom p) * t = t * c.toHom (k.toHom p) :=
        tDot.intertwines p
      rw [← h₁, map_mul, map_inv, one_mul]
      have ht' : t * (c.toHom (k.toHom p))⁻¹ = (a.toHom (i.toHom p))⁻¹ * t := by
        calc
          _ = (a.toHom (i.toHom p))⁻¹ * (t * c.toHom (k.toHom p)) *
            (c.toHom (k.toHom p))⁻¹ := by rw [← ht]; group
          _ = _ := by group
      rw [mul_assoc (g * a.toHom u.1) t _, ht']
      group
    · change (Biset.restriction e).pair (Biset.induction f)
        (e.toHom (k.toHom p) * (s * f.toHom u.2) * (1 : E)⁻¹)
        (1 * 1 * (f.toHom 1)⁻¹) = _
      have hs : e.toHom (k.toHom p) * s = s * f.toHom (j.toHom p) :=
        sDot.intertwines p
      simp only [inv_one, map_one, mul_one, one_mul]
      rw [← mul_assoc, hs, mul_assoc, ← map_mul, h₂]
      rfl
  change (lowerMap b d i j r w = _ ∧ outputOf a c e f g t s u = y) ↔ _
  rw [hx, hy]
  change (_ ∧ _) ↔ ((word a b d).basis.act _ _, (word c e f).basis.act _ _) = _
  rw [act_point, act_point, Prod.mk.injEq]
  change (_ ∧ _) ↔
    point a b d (g * a.toHom v.1 * 1) (r.element * (d.toHom (1 * v.2))⁻¹) =
      point a b d g x ∧
    point c e f (g * a.toHom v.1 * t) (s * (f.toHom (1 * v.2))⁻¹) = y
  simp only [mul_one, one_mul, ← map_inv, input_eq, outputOf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    exact ⟨⟨v.1, rfl, hx.symm⟩, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨α, hα, hx⟩, hy⟩
    have he : v.1 = α := a.injective (mul_left_cancel hα)
    exact ⟨by simpa only [he] using hx.symm, hy⟩

private theorem count_of_lift
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) (g : G) (x : D) (y : (word c e f).basis.carrier)
    (input_eq : ∀ (g g' : G) (x : D) (h : F),
      point a b d g' (r.element * d.toHom h) = point a b d g x ↔
        ∃ α : A, g' = g * a.toHom α ∧ x = b.toHom α * r.element * d.toHom h)
    (v₀ : A × F)
    (lift : letI := action a b d c e f
      ((g, 1) * phi (F := F) a v₀) • base a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element =
        (point a b d g x, y)) :
    let S := (stabilizer a b d c e f (base a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element)).comap (phi a)
    let T := (diagonal i j).range
    (T ≤ S) → Nat.card (hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y) = T.relIndex S := by
  letI := action a b d c e f
  intro S T hTS
  let E := innerEquiv i j
  let z := base a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element
  have eq_act (v : A × F) :
      ((g, 1) * phi (F := F) a v) • z = (point a b d g x, y) ↔ v₀⁻¹ * v ∈ S := by
    rw [← lift]
    change _ ↔ phi a (v₀⁻¹ * v) • z = z
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, mul_smul, mul_smul, smul_left_cancel_iff]
    rw [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff]
  have eq_mem (q : (A × F) ⧸ T) :
      E q ∈ hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y ↔
        (Subgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE hTS q).1 = QuotientGroup.mk v₀ := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn q fun v => ?_
    change innerPoint i j (v.1, v.2⁻¹) ∈ _ ↔ QuotientGroup.mk v = QuotientGroup.mk v₀
    rw [hit_eq_parameters a b d c e f i j k r t s g x y input_eq, eq_act, eq_comm,
      QuotientGroup.eq]
  exact (Nat.card_congr (E.subtypeEquiv (fun q => (eq_mem q).symm)).symm).trans (count_tower hTS v₀)

private theorem index_on_range {W V : Type*} [Group W] [Group V] {S T : Subgroup W}
    (hTS : T ≤ S) (m : W →* V) (hm : Function.Injective (m.comp S.subtype)) :
    (T.map m).relIndex (S.map m) = T.relIndex S := by
  have h := Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective (T.subgroupOf S) (⊤ : Subgroup S) hm
  rwa [← Subgroup.map_map, Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le hTS, ← Subgroup.map_map,
    Subgroup.map_top, S.range_subtype, Subgroup.relIndex_top_right] at h

private theorem right_count
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) :
    let z := base a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element
    let P := projected a b d c e f z
    let K := (F.subtype.comp j.toHom).range
    K ≤ P ∧ ∀ (g : G) (x : D) (y : (word c e f).basis.carrier),
      Nat.card (hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y) =
        @ite Nat ((point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f z)
          (Classical.propDecidable _) (K.relIndex P) 0 := by
  classical
  letI := action a b d c e f
  intro z P K
  obtain ⟨_, orbit_range, input_eq, iP, jP, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, graph, _, _⟩ :=
    (RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer G A D F C E a b d c e f).2.2.1
      r.element t.element s.element
  let S := (stabilizer a b d c e f z).comap (phi a)
  let T := (diagonal i j).range
  let m := F.subtype.comp (MonoidHom.snd A F)
  have hS : S = (diagonal iP jP).range := by
    ext v
    change phi a v ∈ stabilizer a b d c e f z ↔ _
    rw [graph]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      refine ⟨p, Prod.ext (a.injective ?_) ?_⟩
      · exact (congrArg Prod.fst hp).symm
      · exact (congrArg Prod.snd hp).symm
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hTS : T ≤ S := by
    intro v hv
    let L := hit_eq_parameters a b d c e f i j k r t s 1 r.element
      (point c e f t.element s.element) input_eq
    have h := (L 1).mpr (by
      change (((1 : G), (1 : F)) * phi a 1) • z = z
      rw [map_one, mul_one]
      exact one_smul _ _)
    have he := (inner_eq i j 1 v).mpr (by simpa only [inv_one, one_mul] using hv)
    rw [he] at h
    have hh := (L v).mp h
    change (1 * phi a v) • z = z at hh
    change phi a v • z = z
    simpa only [one_mul] using hh
  have hmapT : T.map m = K := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨diagonal i j p, ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hmapS : S.map m = P := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨phi a v, hv, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := (graph q).mp hq
      exact ⟨diagonal iP jP p, (graph _).mpr ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hm : Function.Injective (m.comp S.subtype) := by
    rintro ⟨v, hv⟩ ⟨w, hw⟩ h
    rw [hS] at hv hw
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hv
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hw
    have hp : p = q := jP.injective (Subtype.ext h)
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (diagonal iP jP) hp)
  have hindex : K.relIndex P = T.relIndex S := by
    simpa only [hmapT, hmapS] using index_on_range hTS m hm
  have hKP : K ≤ P := by
    rw [← hmapT, ← hmapS]
    exact Subgroup.map_mono hTS
  refine ⟨hKP, fun g x y => ?_⟩
  by_cases hy : (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f z
  · change orbit a b d c e f z = _ at orbit_range
    have hr := hy
    rw [orbit_range] at hr
    obtain ⟨⟨g', h⟩, he⟩ := hr
    obtain ⟨α, hα, hx⟩ := (input_eq g g' x h).mp (congrArg Prod.fst he)
    let v₀ : A × F := (α, h⁻¹)
    have lift : ((g, 1) * phi (F := F) a v₀) • z = (point a b d g x, y) := by
      change ((word a b d).basis.act _ _, (word c e f).basis.act _ _) = _
      rw [act_point, act_point]
      change (point a b d ((g * a.toHom α) * 1) (r.element * (d.toHom (1 * h⁻¹))⁻¹),
        point c e f ((g * a.toHom α) * t.element) (s.element * (f.toHom (1 * h⁻¹))⁻¹)) = _
      simpa only [one_mul, mul_one, map_inv, inv_inv, ← hα] using he
    rw [if_pos hy, hindex]
    exact count_of_lift a b d c e f i j k r t s g x y input_eq v₀ lift hTS
  · rw [if_neg hy]
    haveI : IsEmpty (hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y) := ⟨fun w => by
      obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩, huv⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep w.val
      have hw : innerPoint i j (u,(v⁻¹)⁻¹) = w.val := by
        rw [inv_inv]
        exact huv
      have h := (hit_eq_parameters a b d c e f i j k r t s g x y input_eq (u,v⁻¹)).mp
        (hw ▸ w.property)
      exact hy ⟨_, h⟩⟩
    exact Nat.card_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inl inferInstance)

private abbrev drawId {A F : Subgroup U} (p : Word A F) :=
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)

private noncomputable abbrev drawing
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) (fin : FiniteFibers b d i j r) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (word a b d) (word c e f) :=
  let ga := Word.up a
  let gc := Word.up c
  let ai := Word.up i
  let fj := Word.down j
  let ck := Word.up k
  let lower := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) b d i j [(1, ⟨r, fin⟩)]
  let center := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := Complex) a i c k [(1, t)]
  let upper := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) e f k j [(1, s)]
  LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga) lower)
    (LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
      (LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.horizontal center (drawId fj))
        (LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
          (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc) upper))))

private theorem drawing_count
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) (fin : FiniteFibers b d i j r)
    (g : G) (x : D) (y : (word c e f).basis.carrier) :
    coefficient a b d c e f (eval a b d c e f (drawing a b d c e f i j k r t s fin))
        (point a b d g x, y) =
      (Nat.card (hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y) : Complex) := by
  classical
  have eq (x' : D) (w : fiber i j) :
      Generator.mixedProduct b d (lowerMap b d i j r w) = x' ↔
        lowerMap b d i j r w = Generator.mixedPair b d x' := by
    constructor
    · intro he
      apply (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).injective
      exact he.trans (Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair b d x').symm
    · intro he
      rw [he, Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
  have h (x' : D) : Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedProduct b d (lowerMap b d i j r w) = x'} :=
    (fin (Generator.mixedPair b d x')).subset (fun w hw => (eq x' w).mp hw)
  have hset : (h x).toFinset = (fin (Generator.mixedPair b d x)).toFinset := by
    ext w
    simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using eq x w
  let target : fiber i j → (word c e f).basis.carrier := fun w =>
    outputOf a c e f g t.element s.element (Quotient.out w)
  let column : Finset (fiber i j) := (fin (Generator.mixedPair b d x)).toFinset
  let H := hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y
  have hf : H.Finite := (fin (Generator.mixedPair b d x)).subset fun _ hw => hw.1
  have hfilter : column.filter (fun w => target w = y) = hf.toFinset := by
    apply Finset.ext
    intro w
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, column, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] <;> rfl
  have supplied := (CaseSixRightShapeEvaluation G A D F C E B a b d c e f i j k).1 r h t s g x
  change (drawing a b d c e f i j k r t s fin).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1) =
      ∑ w ∈ (h x).toFinset, Finsupp.single (target w) 1 at supplied
  rw [hset] at supplied
  change (drawing a b d c e f i j k r t s fin).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (point a b d g x) 1) y = (Nat.card H : Complex)
  rw [supplied, Finset.sum_apply']
  simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  change (∑ w ∈ column.filter (fun w => target w = y), (1 : Complex)) = _
  letI := hf.fintype
  rw [hfilter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Set.Finite.card_toFinset hf]
  exact congrArg (Nat.cast : Nat → Complex) (Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := H)).symm

private theorem right_eval [Finite A] [Finite F]
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) :
    let z := base a b d c e f r.element t.element s.element
    let P := projected a b d c e f z
    let K := (F.subtype.comp j.toHom).range
    K ≤ P ∧
    (∃ fin : FiniteFibers b d i j r, ∀ z',
      coefficient a b d c e f (eval a b d c e f (drawing a b d c e f i j k r t s fin)) z' =
        matrix a b d c e f (orbit a b d c e f z) (K.relIndex P) z') ∧
    ∀ g x y, Nat.card (hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y) =
      @ite Nat ((point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f z)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) (K.relIndex P) 0 := by
  classical
  intro z P K
  obtain ⟨hKP, hcount⟩ := right_count a b d c e f i j k r t s
  let fin := finiteFibers_of_bases b d i j r
  refine ⟨hKP, ⟨fin, ?_⟩, hcount⟩
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  obtain ⟨g, x, rfl⟩ := point_surjective a b d x
  change coefficient a b d c e f (eval a b d c e f (drawing a b d c e f i j k r t s fin))
    (point a b d g x, y) = matrix a b d c e f (orbit a b d c e f z) (K.relIndex P) (point a b d g x, y)
  have h := hcount g x y
  change Nat.card (hits a b d c e f i j r t.element s.element g x y) =
      @ite Nat ((point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f z) (Classical.propDecidable _) (K.relIndex P) 0 at h
  rw [drawing_count, h]
  by_cases hy : (point a b d g x, y) ∈ orbit a b d c e f z <;>
    simp only [matrix, hy, if_true, if_false, Nat.cast_zero]

end Geometry
private theorem swaps_map_conj (q : Sinf) (P : Subgroup Sinf) :
    swaps (P.map (MulAut.conj q).toMonoidHom) =
      (swaps P).map (MulAut.conj q).toMonoidHom := by
  rw [swaps, swaps, MonoidHom.map_closure]
  congr 1
  have transposition (σ : Sinf) :
      Equiv.Perm.IsSwap ((MulAut.conj q σ : Sinf) : Equiv.Perm Nat) ↔
        Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) := by
    have forward (g σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) (h : Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ) :
        Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (g * σ * g⁻¹) := by
      obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩ := h
      exact ⟨g x, g y, fun h => hxy (g.injective h), Equiv.swap_apply_apply g x y |>.symm⟩
    change Equiv.Perm.IsSwap ((q : Equiv.Perm Nat) * σ.val * (q : Equiv.Perm Nat)⁻¹) ↔ _
    exact ⟨fun h => by simpa [mul_assoc] using forward (q : Equiv.Perm Nat)⁻¹ _ h,
      forward q.val σ.val⟩
  ext σ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hs⟩
    exact ⟨x, ⟨hx, (transposition x).mp hs⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hx, hs⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, (transposition x).mpr hs⟩

private def restrictEmbedding {W : Type*} [Group W] {P K A : Subgroup W}
    (hK : K ≤ P) (i : ConjEmbedding P A) : ConjEmbedding K A :=
  ⟨i.toHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hK), by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := i.hasRepresentative
    exact ⟨q, fun k => hq (Subgroup.inclusion hK k)⟩⟩

private def restrictDot {W : Type*} [Group W] {P K A F D : Subgroup W}
    (hK : K ≤ P) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (i : ConjEmbedding P A) (j : ConjEmbedding P F) (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) :
    Dot (b.comp (restrictEmbedding hK i)) (d.comp (restrictEmbedding hK j)) :=
  ⟨r.element, fun k => r.intertwines (Subgroup.inclusion hK k)⟩

private theorem finite_word_of_groups {W : Type*} [Group W] {G A D F : Subgroup W}
    [Finite G] [Finite D]
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D) :
    Finite (word a b d).basis.carrier :=
  Finite.of_surjective (fun p : G × D => point a b d p.1 p.2) (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨g, x', h⟩ := point_surjective a b d x
    exact ⟨(g, x'), h⟩)

private theorem projected_finite {W : Type*} [Group W] {G A D F C E : Subgroup W}
    [Finite F] (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
    (z : Pair a b d c e f) : Finite (projected a b d c e f z) := by
  let P := projected a b d c e f z
  have hPF : P ≤ F := by
    rintro x ⟨q, _, rfl⟩
    exact q.2.property
  exact Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion hPF) (Subgroup.inclusion_injective hPF)

private theorem orbit_index_transport {G A D F C E : Subgroup Sinf}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
    (z z' : Pair a b d c e f) (hz' : z' ∈ orbit a b d c e f z) :
    (swaps (projected a b d c e f z')).relIndex (projected a b d c e f z') =
      (swaps (projected a b d c e f z)).relIndex (projected a b d c e f z) := by
  letI := action a b d c e f
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hz'
  let qF : Sinf := q.2
  let J := (MulAut.conj qF).toMonoidHom
  have conj_proj : (projectHom G F).comp (MulAut.conj q).toMonoidHom =
      J.comp (projectHom G F) := by ext v; rfl
  have he : projected a b d c e f (q • z) = (projected a b d c e f z).map J := by
    unfold projected stabilizer
    rw [MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj, Subgroup.map_map, conj_proj,
      Subgroup.map_map]
  rw [he, swaps_map_conj]
  exact Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ (MulAut.conj qF).injective

private theorem indexed_expansion {W : Type*} [Group W] {G A D F C E : Subgroup W}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
    [Finite (Pair a b d c e f)]
    (M : Biset.Hom Complex (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis)
    (invariant : ∀ z z', z' ∈ orbit a b d c e f z →
      coefficient a b d c e f M z' = coefficient a b d c e f M z)
    (oneOn : ∀ z, coefficient a b d c e f M z ≠ 0 → coefficient a b d c e f M z = 1)
    (valid : Set (Pair a b d c e f) → LabelledDrawing Complex (word a b d) (word c e f) → Prop) :
    let S : Set (Set (Pair a b d c e f)) :=
      {O | ∃ z, O = orbit a b d c e f z ∧ coefficient a b d c e f M z ≠ 0}
    (∀ O : ↥S, ∃ D, valid O.val D ∧ ∀ z',
      coefficient a b d c e f (eval a b d c e f D) z' =
        matrix a b d c e f O.val 1 z') →
    ∃ expansion : IndexedDrawing Complex (word a b d) (word c e f) ↥S,
      (∀ O : ↥S, O ∈ expansion.indices) ∧
      (∀ O : ↥S, valid O.val (expansion.summand O) ∧ ∀ z',
        coefficient a b d c e f (eval a b d c e f (expansion.summand O)) z' =
          matrix a b d c e f O.val 1 z') ∧
      M.toLinearMap = expansion.eval := by
  classical
  letI := action a b d c e f
  intro S terms
  choose D hD using terms
  letI : Fintype ↥S := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let expansion : IndexedDrawing Complex (word a b d) (word c e f) ↥S :=
    ⟨Finset.univ, D⟩
  refine ⟨expansion, fun O => Finset.mem_univ O, hD, ?_⟩
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro x q
  rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one x q, map_smul, map_smul]
  congr 1
  ext y
  let z : Pair a b d c e f := (x,y)
  let coef := coefficient a b d c e f M
  let I := matrix a b d c e f
  change coef z = (expansion.eval (Finsupp.single x 1)) y
  rw [IndexedDrawing.eval_apply, Finset.sum_apply']
  change coef z = ∑ O : ↥S, coefficient a b d c e f (eval a b d c e f (D O)) z
  simp_rw [fun O => (hD O).2 z]
  change coef z = ∑ O : ↥S, I O.val 1 z
  by_cases h : coef z = 0
  · rw [h, Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    intro O _
    apply if_neg
    intro hz
    obtain ⟨z', hO, hz'⟩ := O.property
    rw [hO] at hz
    exact hz' ((invariant z' z hz).symm.trans h)
  · let O : ↥S := ⟨orbit a b d c e f z, ⟨z,rfl,h⟩⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single O]
    · have hz : z ∈ orbit a b d c e f z := MulAction.mem_orbit_self z
      change coef z = @ite Complex (z ∈ orbit a b d c e f z)
        (Classical.propDecidable _) ((1 : Nat) : Complex) 0
      rw [if_pos hz, Nat.cast_one]
      exact oneOn z h
    · intro O' _ hne
      apply if_neg
      intro hz
      obtain ⟨z', hO', _⟩ := O'.property
      rw [hO'] at hz
      exact hne (Subtype.ext (hO'.trans (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hz).symm))
    · simp

end OrbitMultiplicity

external.usage: count_tower identifies the fiber of the coset projection with the quotient of the full stabilizer by the smaller balancing subgroup. The vertex conditions give inclusion, and the inverse on the F coordinate makes the balance classes left cosets.
count_tower converts the natural cardinality of the identified quotient into its relative index. Finiteness of the projected stabilizer also gives positive relative index in the minimum argument.

index_on_range applies this to the projection restricted to the full stabilizer graph. The F embedding of that graph is injective. The same theorem transports indices using a conjugation automorphism for another orbit representative.

Apply with the parabolic image K below the swap-generated subgroup L below P, as supplied by the verified parabolic extremal theorem. Positive relative index of K in L shows that the multiplicity at L is minimal.

MultiplicationCapBend.proof:
by
  intro U _ K H G α γ hα hγ a g ga upG upA upGA downA downG downGA
    straight leftCap leftSplit left rightCup rightBranch rightCap right
  exact (open MackeyDiagrams MackeyDiagrams.Diagram in by
    -- Xiao, § 3.5, Proposition 3.4, multiplication-cap row. It is on p. 12 of
    -- the archived original in source/ and p. 14 of the current published PDF.
    -- The published bytes match article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf. The two
    -- versions give the same shapes and the same tensor calculation for this row.
    --
    -- Alphabeta Math, thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products, steps
    -- 4.1 and 5.1. The typed evaluations already descend to the balanced
    -- quotient. Apply generator uniqueness on its complex linearization using
    -- eval_ext_on_generators, then use quotient induction to present a generator.
    apply eval_ext_on_generators
    intro z
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z ?_
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    change G at x
    change H at y
    change left.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (upGA.basis.pair downA.basis x y) 1) =
      right.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (upGA.basis.pair downA.basis x y) 1)
    -- The paper suppresses rebracketing and unitors. On the left, splitUp
    -- inserts 1 in H, the small cap multiplies in H, and rightUnit applies
    -- the right H action along g.toHom.
    have hLeft : left.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (upGA.basis.pair downA.basis x y) 1) =
        Finsupp.single (x * g.toHom y) 1 := by
      change (rightUnit (R := Complex) upG).eval.toLinearMap
        ((horizontal (id upG) (multiplicationCap a)).eval.toLinearMap
          ((associate upG upA downA).eval.toLinearMap
            ((horizontal (splitUp g a) (id downA)).eval.toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (upGA.basis.pair downA.basis x y) (1 : Complex))))) = _
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (splitUp g a) (id downA) x y 1,
        one_smul, eval_splitUp_single, eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
      rw [eval_associate_single upG upA downA x 1 y 1]
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (id upG) (multiplicationCap a), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
        eval_multiplicationCap_single a 1 y 1, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
        eval_rightUnit_single upG]
      change Finsupp.single (1 * x * (g.toHom y⁻¹)⁻¹) 1 = _
      simp only [one_mul, map_inv, inv_inv]
    -- These are the basis formulas underlying InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits
    -- and InductionRestrictionAdjunction. The bend uses splitUp on the left
    -- and mergeDown on the right, so the route's mergeUp and splitDown formulas
    -- are replaced by eval_splitUp_single and eval_mergeDown_single.
    -- On the right the ordinary cup at 1 inserts (1, 1) by map_one.
    have hBranch : rightBranch.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =
        Finsupp.single (downGA.basis.pair upG.basis (g.toHom y) 1) 1 := by
      have hInsert : (insertRightUnit (R := Complex) downA).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =
          Finsupp.single (downA.basis.pair (Biset.regular H) y 1) 1 := by
        change (Biset.insertRightUnit downA.basis Complex).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) = _
        rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
      change (horizontal (mergeDown g a) (id upG)).eval.toLinearMap
        ((unassociate downA downG upG).eval.toLinearMap
          ((horizontal (id downA) (ordinaryCup g)).eval.toLinearMap
            ((insertRightUnit downA).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y (1 : Complex))))) = _
      rw [hInsert, eval_horizontal_single (id downA) (ordinaryCup g) y 1 1,
        one_smul, eval_id_apply, eval_ordinaryCup_single g 1 1, map_one,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_unassociate_single downA downG upG y 1 1 1]
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (mergeDown g a) (id upG), one_smul,
        eval_mergeDown_single g a y 1 1, mul_one, eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
    -- The large cap multiplies in G and the left unitor acts on the retained 1.
    have hRight : right.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (upGA.basis.pair downA.basis x y) 1) =
        Finsupp.single (x * g.toHom y) 1 := by
      change (leftUnit (R := Complex) upG).eval.toLinearMap
        ((horizontal (multiplicationCap ga) (id upG)).eval.toLinearMap
          ((unassociate upGA downGA upG).eval.toLinearMap
            ((horizontal (id upGA) rightBranch).eval.toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (upGA.basis.pair downA.basis x y) (1 : Complex))))) = _
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (id upGA) rightBranch x y 1, one_smul,
        eval_id_apply, hBranch, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
      rw [eval_unassociate_single upGA downGA upG x (g.toHom y) 1 1]
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (multiplicationCap ga) (id upG), one_smul,
        eval_multiplicationCap_single ga x (g.toHom y) 1, eval_id_apply,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_leftUnit_single upG]
      change Finsupp.single ((x * g.toHom y) * 1 * (g.toHom 1)⁻¹) 1 = _
      simp only [mul_one, map_one, inv_one]
    exact hLeft.trans hRight.symm
  )

TraceCapBend.proof:
by
  open MackeyDiagrams MackeyDiagrams.Diagram TraceCapBendSupport in
  intro U _ K H G a b finite
  -- Xiao, §3.5, Proposition 3.4, trace-cap row. Archived PDF pp. 12–13
  -- (bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2)
  -- and revised published PDF pp. 14–15
  -- (6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e)
  -- give the same ordered boundary K–G–H to K–H and the same trace calculation.
  -- Step 3.1 of Alphabeta Math's module tensor universal property factors
  -- through the balance relations. The shared evaluator handles that descent.
  -- Step 4.1 compares maps on elementary tensors. Here Quotient.inductionOn
  -- gives representatives of balanced pairs and eval_ext_on_generators
  -- extends the comparison linearly. Step 5.1 needs no choice for descent.
  -- The finite transversal below comes from the reverse-cup formula.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  change ((BentVertex.traceCap b a).expand (R := Complex)).eval =
    (vertical (horizontal (id (.down (b.comp a))) ((BentVertex.reverseCup b a finite).expand))
      (tail a b)).eval
  classical
  -- Use the registered reverse-adjunction theorem only for its cup formula
  -- and unique right transversal, instantiated at the inner finite-index image.
  -- The companion merges/splits theorem builds from the same shared basis rules.
  -- Those rules apply here directly to a and b, without choosing conjugators
  -- for the merge or split. The trace tests use the coordinator's basis rules.
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hcup⟩ := cup_transversal a finite
  apply eval_ext_on_generators
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change G at x y
  let input := Finsupp.single ((Word.down (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y) (1 : Complex)
  change ((BentVertex.traceCap b a).expand (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap input =
    (vertical (horizontal (id (.down (b.comp a))) ((BentVertex.reverseCup b a finite).expand))
      (tail a b)).eval.toLinearMap input
  dsimp only [input]
  rw [left_single a b x y, right_sum a b finite x y T hcup]
  let term (t : H) : H →₀ Complex :=
    (leftUnit (R := Complex) (.down a)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.empty K).basis (Word.down a).basis
        (Generator.traceBasis Complex (b.comp a) (x * (y * b.toHom t⁻¹))) (Finsupp.single t 1))
  change Generator.traceBasis Complex b (x * y) = ∑ t ∈ T, term t
  -- Multiplying by the image of t⁻¹ reduces the large trace to a
  -- test on the corresponding right coset in H when x * y is in the image.
  have product (t : H) :
      x * (y * b.toHom t⁻¹) = (x * y) * (b.toHom t)⁻¹ := by
    rw [map_inv, mul_assoc]
  have zeroTerm (t : H) (hout : ¬ ∃ k : K, (b.comp a).toHom k = x * (y * b.toHom t⁻¹)) :
      term t = 0 := by
    dsimp only [term]
    rw [Generator.traceBasis_outside Complex (b.comp a) _ hout, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
  by_cases hin : ∃ h : H, b.toHom h = x * y
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hin
    rw [← hh, Generator.traceBasis_image]
    -- Exactly one representative survives the large trace.
    obtain ⟨t, ht, unique⟩ := hT h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ht
    have htProduct : x * (y * b.toHom (t.val)⁻¹) = (b.comp a).toHom k := by
      rw [product, ← hh, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, ← hk, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply]
    have hterm : term t.val = Finsupp.single h 1 := by
      dsimp only [term]
      rw [htProduct, Generator.traceBasis_image, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
        eval_leftUnit_single]
      change Finsupp.single (a.toHom k * t.val * (1 : H)⁻¹) 1 = _
      rw [hk, inv_one, mul_one, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single t.val, hterm]
    · intro s hs hst
      apply zeroTerm
      rintro ⟨l, hl⟩
      rw [product, ← hh, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] at hl
      have hm : h * s⁻¹ ∈ a.toHom.range := ⟨l, b.injective hl⟩
      exact hst (congrArg Subtype.val (unique ⟨s, hs⟩ hm))
    · exact fun hmissing => (hmissing t.property).elim
  · -- The composite image is contained in the outer image, which is
    -- invariant under multiplication by b.toHom t.
    rw [Generator.traceBasis_outside Complex b _ hin]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro t _
    apply zeroTerm
    rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [product, ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] at hk
    apply hin
    refine ⟨a.toHom k * t, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul, hk, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]

private theorem cup_transversal (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    ∃ T : Finset H, (∀ h : H, ∃! t : {t // t ∈ T}, h * t.val⁻¹ ∈ a.toHom.range) ∧
      (reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1) =
        ∑ t ∈ T, Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.down a).basis t⁻¹ t) 1 := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  have hs' (h : K) : s * (h : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ H := hs h ▸ (a.toHom h).property
  have ha : a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hs' :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun h => Subtype.ext (hs h))
  subst a
  have h := (FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction.{u, 0} K H s hs').2.2.2.2 finite
  obtain ⟨⟨T, hT⟩, _, _, hcup⟩ := h
  refine ⟨T, hT, ?_⟩
  have hsum := ((hcup T hT).1 1).1
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, one_mul] at hsum
  rw [hsum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _

    (rightUnit (R := Complex) (.down a)).eval.toLinearMap

    (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.down a).basis (Word.empty H).basis (Finsupp.single 1 1))

    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro t c
    change (rightUnit (R := Complex) (.down a)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.down a).basis (Word.empty H).basis
        (Finsupp.single 1 1) (Finsupp.single t c)) = Finsupp.single t c
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_rightUnit_single]
    change Finsupp.single (a.toHom 1 * 1 * (t⁻¹)⁻¹) c = _

      (Finsupp.single ((Word.down (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y) 1) =

  change (vertical (horizontal (splitDown b a) (id (.up b)))
    (vertical (associate (.down a) (.down b) (.up b))
      (vertical (horizontal (id (.down a)) (traceCap b)) (rightUnit (.down a))))).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single ((Word.down (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y) 1) = _
  rw [eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply,
    eval_horizontal_single (splitDown b a) (id (.up b)) x y 1, one_smul,

  change (Biset.insertRightUnit (Word.up b).basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _

    (hc : (reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ T, Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.down a).basis t⁻¹ t) 1) :
    ((BentVertex.reverseCup b a finite).expand (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1) =

  rw [eval_vertical_apply,
    eval_horizontal_single (id (.down (b.comp a))) ((BentVertex.reverseCup b a finite).expand) x y 1,

InductionBimoduleOrbitSumBasis.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst H G α β hα hβ A B a b φ ψ orbit OrbitIndex orbitSum HomSpace
  -- Xiao, Proposition 3.3, archived PDF p. 10 and revised published PDF p. 12.
  -- The project inventory records no Alphabeta Math numbered proof for this endpoint.
  -- The first paragraph evaluates a regular left-module map at 1. The finite orbit
  -- sets are indices. Representatives only read coefficients.
  have onA := ((InductionRestrictionBimoduleStrands.{_, 0, 0}).1 H G α hα).1
  have onB := ((InductionRestrictionBimoduleStrands.{_, 0, 0}).1 H G β hβ).1
  -- Whole intertwiners are compared in the group algebra by their coefficients.
  have intertwiner (y : B) := OrbitSumBasisProof.coeff_intertwines a b y onA onB
  have selfMem (g : G) : g ∈ orbit g := OrbitSumBasisProof.mem_twistOrbit a b g
  have orbitEq {g z : G} (hz : z ∈ orbit g) : orbit z = orbit g :=
    OrbitSumBasisProof.twistOrbit_eq a b hz
  let repr : OrbitIndex → G := fun i => i.property.choose
  have reprOrbit (i : OrbitIndex) : (i.val : Set G) = orbit (repr i) := i.property.choose_spec
  have memRepr (i : OrbitIndex) : repr i ∈ i.val :=
    show repr i ∈ (i.val : Set G) from (reprOrbit i).symm ▸ selfMem (repr i)
  have eqIndex {i j : OrbitIndex} {g : G} (hi : g ∈ i.val) (hj : g ∈ j.val) : i = j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finset.coe_injective
    have hi' : g ∈ orbit (repr i) := reprOrbit i ▸ (show g ∈ (i.val : Set G) from hi)
    have hj' : g ∈ orbit (repr j) := reprOrbit j ▸ (show g ∈ (j.val : Set G) from hj)
    exact (reprOrbit i).trans ((orbitEq hi').symm.trans
      ((orbitEq hj').trans (reprOrbit j).symm))
  have reprInj : Function.Injective repr := by
    intro i j h
    exact eqIndex (memRepr i) (h.symm ▸ memRepr j)
  have orbitCoeff (i : OrbitIndex) (g : G) :
      (orbitSum i).coeff g = if g ∈ i.val then 1 else 0 :=
    OrbitSumBasisProof.coeff_orbitSum _ _
  have multiplier (f : HomSpace) (x : B) : f.val x = x * f.val 1 := by
    have hf := f.property.1 x 1
    rwa [mul_one] at hf
  have invariant (f : HomSpace) (h : H) (g : G) :
      (f.val 1).coeff (OrbitSumBasisProof.twist a b h g) = (f.val 1).coeff g := by
    apply (intertwiner (f.val 1)).mp
    intro r
    have hr := f.property.2 r 1
    rw [one_mul, multiplier] at hr
    exact hr
  have mulMem (i : OrbitIndex) :
      ∀ (h : H) (g : G), (orbitSum i).coeff (OrbitSumBasisProof.twist a b h g) =
        (orbitSum i).coeff g := by
    intro h g
    have heq := orbitEq (g := g) (z := OrbitSumBasisProof.twist a b h g) ⟨h, rfl⟩
    have hm (z : G) : z ∈ i.val ↔ orbit z = orbit (repr i) := by
      change z ∈ (i.val : Set G) ↔ _
      rw [reprOrbit]
      exact ⟨orbitEq, fun he => he ▸ selfMem z⟩
    simp only [orbitCoeff, hm, heq]
  let v (i : OrbitIndex) : HomSpace :=
    ⟨{ toFun := fun x => x * orbitSum i
       map_add' := fun x y => add_mul x y _
       map_smul' := fun c x => smul_mul_assoc c x _ },
      fun s x => mul_assoc s x _, fun r x => by
        change (x * φ r) * orbitSum i = (x * orbitSum i) * ψ r
        rw [mul_assoc, (intertwiner (orbitSum i)).mpr (mulMem i) r,
          ← mul_assoc]⟩
  let evalCoeff (g : G) : HomSpace →ₗ[Complex] Complex :=
    { toFun := fun f => (f.val 1).coeff g
      map_add' := fun f f' => rfl
      map_smul' := fun c f => rfl }
  have evV (g : G) (i : OrbitIndex) :
      evalCoeff g (v i) = if g ∈ i.val then 1 else 0 := by
    change ((1 : B) * orbitSum i).coeff g = _
    rw [one_mul, orbitCoeff]
  let assemble : (OrbitIndex →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] HomSpace := MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex v
  have coefficient (g : G) (w : OrbitIndex →₀ Complex) :
      evalCoeff g (assemble w) = w.sum (fun i c => c * if g ∈ i.val then 1 else 0) := by
    have he : (evalCoeff g).comp assemble =
        MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (fun i => if g ∈ i.val then 1 else 0) := by
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
      intro i c
      change evalCoeff g (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex v (Finsupp.single i c)) = _
      simp only [MackeyDiagrams.freeLift_single, map_smul, evV]
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, he]
    rfl
  have coeffInOrbit (i : OrbitIndex) (g : G) (hg : g ∈ i.val) (w : OrbitIndex →₀ Complex) :
      evalCoeff g (assemble w) = w i := by
    rw [coefficient]
    have he (j : OrbitIndex) (c : Complex) :
        c * (if g ∈ j.val then 1 else 0) = if j = i then c else 0 := by
      by_cases hj : g ∈ j.val
      · have heq := eqIndex hj hg
        subst j
        simp [hg]
      · have hne : j ≠ i := fun h => hj (h.symm ▸ hg)
        simp [hj, hne]
    simp only [he, Finsupp.sum_ite_eq']
    split
    · rfl
    · exact (Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp ‹i ∉ w.support›).symm
  have assembleInj : Function.Injective assemble := by
    intro w w' hw
    ext i
    rw [← coeffInOrbit i (repr i) (memRepr i) w, ← coeffInOrbit i (repr i) (memRepr i) w', hw]
  have assembleSurj : Function.Surjective assemble := by
    intro f
    have hfin : (Function.support (fun i : OrbitIndex => (f.val 1).coeff (repr i))).Finite :=
      by
        apply (((f.val 1).coeff.support.finite_toSet).preimage reprInj.injOn).subset
        intro i hi
        exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hi
    let w : OrbitIndex →₀ Complex := Finsupp.ofSupportFinite _ hfin
    have coeffW (i : OrbitIndex) : w i = (f.val 1).coeff (repr i) := by
      rw [show (w : OrbitIndex → Complex) = _ from Finsupp.ofSupportFinite_coe]
    have horbit (g : G) (hg : (f.val 1).coeff g ≠ 0) :
        ∃ i : OrbitIndex, g ∈ i.val := by
      have hsub : orbit g ⊆ (f.val 1).coeff.support := by
        rintro _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
        exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr ((invariant f h g).symm ▸ hg)
      have hfinite : (orbit g).Finite := (f.val 1).coeff.support.finite_toSet.subset hsub
      exact ⟨⟨hfinite.toFinset, g, hfinite.coe_toFinset⟩, hfinite.mem_toFinset.mpr (selfMem g)⟩
    refine ⟨w, Subtype.ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)⟩
    rw [multiplier, multiplier f]
    congr 1
    apply MonoidAlgebra.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro g
    change evalCoeff g (assemble w) = (f.val 1).coeff g
    by_cases hg : ∃ i : OrbitIndex, g ∈ i.val
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hg
      have hmem : g ∈ orbit (repr i) := reprOrbit i ▸ (show g ∈ (i.val : Set G) from hi)
      obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := hmem
      rw [coeffInOrbit _ _ hi, coeffW]
      exact (invariant f h (repr i)).symm
    · have hz : (f.val 1).coeff g = 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hg (horbit g hn)
      rw [coefficient, hz]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      simp [show g ∉ i.val from fun hi => hg ⟨i, hi⟩]
  let basis := (Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := Complex) (ι := OrbitIndex)).map
    (LinearEquiv.ofBijective assemble ⟨assembleInj, assembleSurj⟩)
  have basisApply (i : OrbitIndex) (x : B) : (basis i).val x = x * orbitSum i := by
    have he : basis i = v i := by
      change assemble ((Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := Complex) (ι := OrbitIndex)) i) = v i
      rw [Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne]
      change MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex v (Finsupp.single i 1) = v i
      rw [MackeyDiagrams.freeLift_single, one_smul]
    rw [he]
    rfl
  refine ⟨basis, basisApply, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g
    -- The registered group-element dot criterion identifies the fixed points.
    have hd := ((GroupElementDotCriterion H G α β hα hβ).2.1 g).2.2.2
    rw [← hd]
    constructor
    · intro h
      ext z
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
        apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
        change OrbitSumBasisProof.twist a b k g = g
        unfold OrbitSumBasisProof.twist
        rw [h k, mul_inv_cancel_right]
      · intro hz
        exact (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz).symm ▸ selfMem g
    · intro he h
      have hz : OrbitSumBasisProof.twist a b h g ∈ ({g} : Set G) := he ▸ ⟨h, rfl⟩
      have hz' := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
      unfold OrbitSumBasisProof.twist at hz'
      exact (mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul.mp hz')
  · intro hfin i
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := OrbitSumBasisProof.realize a b hfin (repr i) i.val (reprOrbit i)
    exact ⟨d, fun x => (hd x).trans (congrArg MonoidAlgebra.coeff (basisApply i x)).symm⟩

namespace OrbitSumBasisProof

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {H G : Subgroup U}

private def twist (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (h : H) (g : G) : G :=
  a.toHom h * g * (b.toHom h)⁻¹

@[instance_reducible] private def twistAction (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) : MulAction H G where
  smul := twist a b
  one_smul g := by
    change twist a b 1 g = g
    simp [twist]
  mul_smul h k g := by
    change twist a b (h * k) g = twist a b h (twist a b k g)
    simp only [twist, map_mul, mul_inv_rev]
    group

private def twistStabilizer (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) : Subgroup H :=
  letI := twistAction a b
  MulAction.stabilizer H g

private theorem mem_twistOrbit (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) :
    g ∈ Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g) :=
  ⟨1, (twistAction a b).one_smul g⟩

private theorem twistOrbit_eq (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) {g z : G}
    (hz : z ∈ Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h z) = Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g) := by
  let _ := twistAction a b
  exact MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hz

private theorem coeff_intertwines (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (y : MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
    (onA : ∀ (h : H) (c : Complex),
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom (MonoidAlgebra.single h c) =
        MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom h) c)
    (onB : ∀ (h : H) (c : Complex),
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex b.toHom (MonoidAlgebra.single h c) =
        MonoidAlgebra.single (b.toHom h) c) :
    (∀ r : MonoidAlgebra Complex H,
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom r * y =
        y * MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex b.toHom r) ↔
    (∀ (h : H) (g : G), (y.coeff) (twist a b h g) = (y.coeff) g) := by
  constructor
  · intro hy h g
    have he := hy (MonoidAlgebra.single h 1)
    rw [onA, onB] at he
    have hc := congrArg (fun x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G => x.coeff (a.toHom h * g)) he
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply,
      one_mul, mul_one, inv_mul_cancel_left] at hc
    exact hc.symm
  · intro hy r
    induction r using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add r s hr hs => simp only [map_add, add_mul, mul_add, hr, hs]
    | single h c =>
      apply MonoidAlgebra.ext
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro z
      rw [onA, onB, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single_mul_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_mul_single_apply]
      have hev := hy h ((a.toHom h)⁻¹ * z)
      simp only [twist, mul_inv_cancel_left] at hev
      rw [hev, mul_comm]

private theorem coeff_orbitSum (s : Finset G) (z : G) [Decidable (z ∈ s)] :
    (∑ g ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)).coeff z =
      if z ∈ s then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split <;> simp_all

end OrbitSumBasisProof

open MackeyDiagrams Diagram
open scoped Classical Pointwise

noncomputable section

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {H G : Subgroup U}

private def trivialEmbedding (H : Subgroup U) : ConjEmbedding (⊥ : Subgroup U) H :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun h => by
    have hh : (h : U) = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp h.property
    simp [hh])

private theorem trivial_arg (h : (⊥ : Subgroup U)) : h = 1 :=
  Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp h.property)

private def middleDot (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) :
    Dot (a.comp (trivialEmbedding H)) (b.comp (trivialEmbedding H)) where
  element := g
  intertwines h := by rw [trivial_arg h, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]

private def capPair (H : Subgroup U) (h : H) :
    (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis.carrier :=
  (Word.up (trivialEmbedding H)).basis.pair (Word.down (trivialEmbedding H)).basis h h⁻¹

private theorem cup_single [Fintype H] (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    (reverseCup (R := Complex) (trivialEmbedding H) finite).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) = ∑ h : H, Finsupp.single (capPair H h) 1 := by
  classical
  let t := trivialEmbedding H
  let fiber := Generator.multiplicationCap_finiteFiber t finite
  change (Generator.reverseCup Complex t finite).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) = _
  unfold Generator.reverseCup
  rw [Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun h _ => capPair H h) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro h _
    apply (fiber 1).mem_toFinset.mpr
    change h * h⁻¹ = 1
    exact mul_inv_cancel h
  · intro h _ k _ he
    have he' : (Biset.induction t).pair (Biset.restriction t) h h⁻¹ =
        (Biset.induction t).pair (Biset.restriction t) k k⁻¹ := he
    obtain ⟨z, hz, _⟩ := Quotient.exact he'
    change 1 * h * (t.toHom z)⁻¹ = k at hz
    simpa [trivial_arg z] using hz
  · intro w hw
    obtain ⟨⟨h,k⟩, hw'⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep w
    have hw'' : (Biset.induction t).pair (Biset.restriction t) h k = w := hw'
    have hmul := (fiber 1).mem_toFinset.mp hw
    change Generator.multiplicationCapBasis t w = 1 at hmul
    rw [← hw''] at hmul
    change h * k = 1 at hmul
    have hk : k = h⁻¹ := inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul |>.symm
    refine ⟨h, Finset.mem_univ h, ?_⟩
    change (Biset.induction t).pair (Biset.restriction t) h h⁻¹ = w
    rw [← hk, hw'']
  · intros
    rfl

private def openCup (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    Diagram Complex (.up a) ((Word.up a).tensor (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H))) :=
  (insertRightUnit (.up a)).vertical
    (.horizontal (.id (.up a)) (.reverseCup (trivialEmbedding H) finite))

private theorem openCup_single [Fintype H] (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (x : G) :
    (openCup a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      ∑ h : H, Finsupp.single
        ((Word.up a).basis.pair (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis x (capPair H h)) 1 := by
  classical
  let p := Word.up a
  have he : (insertRightUnit (R := Complex) p).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (Biset.regular H) x 1) 1 := by
    change (Biset.insertRightUnit p.basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  unfold openCup
  rw [eval_vertical_apply, he, eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, eval_id_apply, cup_single, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single Complex p.basis (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis x (capPair H h),
    one_mul]

private def orbitTail (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H))) (.up b) :=
  let t := trivialEmbedding H
  (unassociate (.up a) (.up t) (.down t)).vertical
    ((horizontal (mergeUp a t) (id (.down t))).vertical
      ((horizontal (upDot (middleDot a b g)) (id (.down t))).vertical
        ((horizontal (splitUp b t) (id (.down t))).vertical
          ((associate (.up b) (.up t) (.down t)).vertical
            ((horizontal (id (.up b)) (multiplicationCap t)).vertical
              (rightUnit (.up b)))))))

private theorem orbitTail_single (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g x : G) (h : H) :
    (orbitTail a b g).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single
      ((Word.up a).basis.pair (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis x (capPair H h)) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (x * twist a b h g) 1 := by
  let t := trivialEmbedding H
  let p := Word.up a
  let q := Word.up b
  let u := Word.up t
  let v := Word.down t
  let d := middleDot a b g
  let input := Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (u.basis.tensor v.basis) x (u.basis.pair v.basis h h⁻¹))
    (1 : Complex)
  change (rightUnit q).eval.toLinearMap
    ((horizontal (id q) (multiplicationCap t)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((associate q u v).eval.toLinearMap
        ((horizontal (splitUp b t) (id v)).eval.toLinearMap
          ((horizontal (upDot d) (id v)).eval.toLinearMap
            ((horizontal (mergeUp a t) (id v)).eval.toLinearMap
              ((unassociate p u v).eval.toLinearMap input)))))) = _
  dsimp only [input]
  rw [eval_unassociate_single p u v x h h⁻¹ 1]
  rw [eval_horizontal_single (mergeUp a t) (id v), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
    eval_mergeUp_single a t x h 1, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [eval_horizontal_single (upDot d) (id v), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
    eval_upDot_single d (x * a.toHom h) 1, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [eval_horizontal_single (splitUp b t) (id v), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
    eval_splitUp_single b t, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [eval_associate_single q u v, eval_horizontal_single (id q) (multiplicationCap t),
    one_smul, eval_id_apply, eval_multiplicationCap_single t 1 h⁻¹ 1,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_rightUnit_single q]
  change Finsupp.single (1 * (x * a.toHom h * g) * (b.toHom (h⁻¹⁻¹))⁻¹) (1 * 1 : Complex) = _
  simp [twist, mul_assoc]

-- Orbit-stabilizer identifies the fiber at z with the coset of a chosen
-- preimage. Translating that coset gives exactly the stabilizer of g.
private theorem fiberCard [Fintype H] (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g z : G)
    (hz : z ∈ Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun h : H => twist a b h g = z)).card =
      Nat.card (twistStabilizer a b g) := by
  classical
  let _ := twistAction a b
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hz
  let S := MulAction.stabilizer H g
  let e := MulAction.orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer H g
  let T := Finset.univ.filter fun h : H => twist a b h g = twist a b k g
  have heq (h : H) : h ∈ T ↔ h ∈ k • (S : Set H) := by
    rw [mem_leftCoset_iff]
    change h ∈ T ↔ k⁻¹ * h ∈ S
    rw [← QuotientGroup.eq (s := S)]
    rw [← e.symm.injective.eq_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]
    change h ∈ T ↔ twist a b k g = twist a b h g
    simp [T, eq_comm]
  change T.card = Nat.card S
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe T, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Nat.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight heq).trans (S.leftCosetEquivSubgroup k))

private theorem sum_twist [Fintype H] (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G)
    (s : Finset G) (hs : (s : Set G) = Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    (∑ h : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h g) (1 : Complex)) =
      (Nat.card (twistStabilizer a b g) : Complex) •
        ∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex) := by
  classical
  let S := twistStabilizer a b g
  apply MonoidAlgebra.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro z
  have hc :
      (∑ h : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h g) (1 : Complex)).coeff z =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun h : H => twist a b h g = z).card : Complex) := by
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
      Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero]
  rw [hc]
  change _ = (Nat.card S : Complex) * (∑ w ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single w (1 : Complex)).coeff z
  rw [coeff_orbitSum]
  by_cases hz : z ∈ s
  · have hm : z ∈ Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g) :=
      hs ▸ (show z ∈ (s : Set G) from hz)
    rw [ite_eq_left hz, mul_one, fiberCard a b g z hm]
  · have he : (Finset.univ.filter (fun h : H => twist a b h g = z)) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
      intro h _ he
      exact hz (show z ∈ (s : Set G) from hs.symm ▸ ⟨h, he⟩)
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, ite_eq_right hz, mul_zero]

-- Proposition 3.3's second paragraph inserts the right cup, merges, dots,
-- splits and caps. The first coordinate h of the cup pair is the inverse of
-- the paper's t. The inserted unitors and associators type the same wiring.
private theorem realize (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (hfin : Finite H) (g : G)
    (s : Finset G) (hs : (s : Set G) = Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    ∃ d : Diagram Complex (Word.up a) (Word.up b), ∀ x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
      d.eval.toLinearMap x.coeff =
        (x * ∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex)).coeff := by
  classical
  let _ : Fintype H := Fintype.ofFinite H
  let S := twistStabilizer a b g
  let finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex := inferInstance
  let d := (openCup a finite).vertical (orbitTail a b g)
  let c : Complex := Nat.card S
  let y := ∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex)
  have c_ne : c ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Nat.card_pos.ne'
  have hsum : (∑ h : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h g) (1 : Complex)) = c • y :=
    sum_twist a b g s hs
  have heval (x : G) : d.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.single x 1 * (c • y)).coeff := by
    change (orbitTail a b g).eval.toLinearMap
      ((openCup a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) = _
    rw [openCup_single, map_sum, ← hsum, Finset.mul_sum,
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro h _
    rw [orbitTail_single, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
    rfl
  let normalized := Diagram.scale c⁻¹ d
  let E := MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex (M := G) (S := Complex)
  let rightMul : MonoidAlgebra Complex G →ₗ[Complex] MonoidAlgebra Complex G :=
    { toFun := fun x => x * y
      map_add' := fun x x' => add_mul x x' _
      map_smul' := fun k x => smul_mul_assoc k x _ }
  have normalEval : normalized.eval.toLinearMap =
      E.toLinearMap.comp (rightMul.comp E.symm.toLinearMap) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro x r
    have hr : Finsupp.single x r = r • Finsupp.single x (1 : Complex) := by simp
    rw [hr, map_smul, map_smul]
    congr 1
    change c⁻¹ • d.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) = (MonoidAlgebra.single x 1 * y).coeff
    rw [heval, mul_smul_comm]
    change c⁻¹ • (c • (MonoidAlgebra.single x 1 * y).coeff) = _
    rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ c_ne, one_smul]
  refine ⟨normalized, fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [normalEval]
  change E (rightMul (E.symm (E x))) = _
  rw [E.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

end

end OrbitSumBasisProof

external.usage: In InductionBimoduleOrbitSumBasis, use Finsupp.ofSupportFinite to build the orbit-indexed coordinates of the value of a bimodule map at 1. Finite support follows by pulling back the coefficient support along the injective choice of one representative per distinct finite orbit. This gives the surjectivity of the map assembling finite sums of the proposed basis vectors.

In InductionBimoduleOrbitSumBasis, use the checked orbit equivalence for the twisted H-action on G. Its inverse sends the coset of h to h acting on the chosen representative. Consequently the fiber over an orbit point is one left coset of its stabilizer. In the finite-H branch, translating that coset computes the coefficient of each group element in the reverse-cup composite, and the nonzero stabilizer order supplies the normalizing scalar.

OrdinaryCupBend.proof:
(by
  intro U _ K H G α γ composite upAlpha downAlpha upGamma downGamma
    upComposite downComposite output left rightBranch right
  exact (open MackeyDiagrams MackeyDiagrams.Diagram in by
    -- Xiao, § 3.5, Proposition 3.4, Ordinary cup. The diagram row is on p. 12
    -- of the archived original in source/ and p. 14 of the revised published
    -- PDF. The corresponding computations are on pp. 13 and 15 respectively.
    -- The download matches article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf. The archived
    -- original has a different SHA-256 digest.
    -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
    --
    -- Alphabeta Math, tensor-product universal property, Steps 3.1 and 4.1.
    -- The project already handles descent through the balance relation in
    -- the biset quotient and enforces additivity by Complex-linear extension.
    -- Use the generator uniqueness in Step 5.1 on the input word, whose
    -- basis consists of elements of H with coefficient one.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
    apply eval_ext_on_generators
    intro x
    change H at x
    -- The paper suppresses the unitors and rebracketing. The project basis
    -- formulas for the ordinary cup, multiplication cap, mergeUp and splitDown
    -- apply directly to the supplied embeddings, at arbitrary index. They
    -- give the computations behind the two registered prerequisite results
    -- without specializing their statements to conjugator representatives.
    have hLeft : left.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
        Finsupp.single (downGamma.basis.pair upComposite.basis 1 (γ.toHom x)) 1 := by
      change (horizontal (id downGamma) (mergeUp γ α)).eval.toLinearMap
        ((associate downGamma upGamma upAlpha).eval.toLinearMap
          ((horizontal (ordinaryCup γ) (id upAlpha)).eval.toLinearMap
            ((insertLeftUnit (R := Complex) upAlpha).eval.toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single x 1)))) = _
      rw [eval_insertLeftUnit_single upAlpha,
        eval_horizontal_single (ordinaryCup γ) (id upAlpha) 1 x 1,
        one_smul, eval_ordinaryCup_single γ 1 1, map_one, eval_id_apply,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
        eval_associate_single downGamma upGamma upAlpha 1 1 x 1]
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (id downGamma) (mergeUp γ α), one_smul,
        eval_id_apply, eval_mergeUp_single γ α 1 x 1, one_mul,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
    have hBranch : rightBranch.eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (upAlpha.basis.pair downComposite.basis x 1) 1) =
        Finsupp.single (γ.toHom x) 1 := by
      change (leftUnit (R := Complex) downGamma).eval.toLinearMap
        ((horizontal (multiplicationCap α) (id downGamma)).eval.toLinearMap
          ((unassociate upAlpha downAlpha downGamma).eval.toLinearMap
            ((horizontal (id upAlpha) (splitDown γ α)).eval.toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (upAlpha.basis.pair downComposite.basis x 1) 1)))) = _
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (id upAlpha) (splitDown γ α) x 1 1,
        one_smul, eval_id_apply, eval_splitDown_single γ α 1 1,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
        eval_unassociate_single upAlpha downAlpha downGamma x 1 1 1]
      rw [eval_horizontal_single (multiplicationCap α) (id downGamma), one_smul,
        eval_multiplicationCap_single α x 1 1, mul_one, eval_id_apply,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_leftUnit_single downGamma]
      change Finsupp.single (γ.toHom x * 1 * (1 : G)⁻¹) 1 = _
      simp only [inv_one, mul_one]
    have hRight : right.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
        Finsupp.single (downGamma.basis.pair upComposite.basis (γ.toHom x) 1) 1 := by
      have hInsert : (insertRightUnit (R := Complex) upAlpha).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single x 1) =
          Finsupp.single (upAlpha.basis.pair (Biset.regular K) x 1) 1 := by
        change (Biset.insertRightUnit upAlpha.basis Complex).toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single x 1) = _
        rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
      change (horizontal rightBranch (id upComposite)).eval.toLinearMap
        ((unassociate upAlpha downComposite upComposite).eval.toLinearMap
          ((horizontal (id upAlpha) (ordinaryCup composite)).eval.toLinearMap
            ((insertRightUnit (R := Complex) upAlpha).eval.toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single x 1)))) = _
      rw [hInsert, eval_horizontal_single (id upAlpha) (ordinaryCup composite) x 1 1,
        one_smul, eval_id_apply, eval_ordinaryCup_single composite 1 1, map_one,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
        eval_unassociate_single upAlpha downComposite upComposite x 1 1 1]
      rw [eval_horizontal_single rightBranch (id upComposite), one_smul,
        hBranch, eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
    rw [hLeft, hRight]
    -- The middle group is G on both strands. Its two regular middle actions
    -- identify the two output basis pairs by the balance relation.
    apply congrArg (fun z => Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex))
    change (Biset.restriction γ).pair (Biset.induction composite) 1 (γ.toHom x) =
      (Biset.restriction γ).pair (Biset.induction composite) (γ.toHom x) 1
    simpa [Biset.restriction, Biset.induction] using
      ((Biset.restriction γ).pair_balance (Biset.induction composite) (γ.toHom x) 1 1).symm
  ))

ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegio.proof:
by
  classical
  open MackeyDiagrams OutsideRegionsAux in
  intro P finitary U parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC _hE a b c d e f
    comp bc ad de image conjugate p element lower maximum minimum index
    up down tensor basisMap finiteFibers
  let _ : Finite G := parabolic_finite hG
  let _ : Finite A := parabolic_finite hA
  let _ : Finite D := parabolic_finite hD
  let _ : Finite F := parabolic_finite hF
  let hp : finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p) :=
    ((EvaluationForTwoProjections a b c d e f).1 p).2.1.mpr index
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  intro outside inside vertical horizontal identity parallel project multiply atRight Left Right
    transportLeft transportRight leftFinite rightFinite leftProject rightProject leftMultiply
    rightMultiply targetProject targetMultiply evalProject evalMultiply leftProjectRegions
    rightProjectRegions leftMultiplyRegions rightMultiplyRegions firstProjectionUnitFibers
  let parameter : ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f := ⟨p, hp⟩
  -- Xiao, Proposition 8.6, archived original p. 38 (bc57d13777e7df14…),
  -- revised published p. 40 (6d7e885955f23ae6…). The Alphabeta Math
  -- rendering gives the proof in prose and refers to the numbered Cases
  -- 1–4 of Theorems 6.4 and 6.5. These cases fix the two directions and
  -- the two crossing orientations. Compare regions after transport into A.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-three-outside
  -- The relative-index hypothesis supplies the target fiber witness by
  -- the registered Lemma 6.3. All witness diagrams retain their vertices.
  -- Prop. 7.1's meet and join suppliers use partitions of a common support,
  -- so the local adapter pads the two block families with singleton blocks.
  obtain ⟨minParabolic, maxParabolic⟩ :=
    parabolic_region_bounds a b c d element hG hD hF hC
  -- Case 1 and its Case 3 reversal. The registered Theorem 6.4(1)
  -- constructs the right shape at the join, with dots (p⁻¹, 1, 1).
  -- Its middle index is finite in a subgroup of the finite group A.
  obtain ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n, hj, hright⟩ :=
    right_witness a b c d e f parameter
  let rmin : Right := ⟨⟨minimum.map A.subtype, minParabolic⟩, j, v, w, ell, m.dot, n.dot⟩
  have rminFinite : rightFinite rmin := ⟨m.finite, n.finite⟩
  have minP : minimum ∈ rightProjectRegions :=
    ⟨rmin, rminFinite, hj, (right_project_eval a b c d e f parameter ell m n).2 hright⟩
  have minM : minimum ∈ rightMultiplyRegions :=
    ⟨rmin, hj, (right_mul_eval a b c d e f parameter ell m.dot n.dot).2 hright⟩
  -- Case 2 and its Case 4 reversal. The full-intersection supplier
  -- gives the maximal Case 2 witness. Its restricted-embedding construction
  -- is carried out here for every intermediate parabolic H. Finite domains
  -- justify both transfer maps, and the same dots give the opposite map.
  have leftInterval : ∀ H : Subgroup A, parabolic (H.map A.subtype) →
      lower ≤ H → H ≤ maximum → H ∈ leftProjectRegions ∧ H ∈ leftMultiplyRegions := by
    intro H hH hlo hhi
    obtain ⟨r, s, t, x, y, z, htrans, hparam⟩ := left_witness a b c d e f p H hlo hhi
    let l : Left := ⟨⟨H.map A.subtype, hH⟩, r, s, t, x.dot, y.dot, z⟩
    have hfinite : leftFinite l := ⟨x.finite, y.finite⟩
    exact ⟨⟨l, hfinite, htrans, (left_project_eval a b c d e f parameter x y z).2 hparam⟩,
      ⟨l, htrans, (left_mul_eval a b c d e f parameter x.dot y.dot z).2 hparam⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨maxP, maxM⟩ := leftInterval maximum maxParabolic (lower_le_max a b c d e f p) le_rfl
  -- Lemma 6.3 and Theorem 6.5 identify the effective group element by the
  -- unit balanced pair. The coefficient and column checks are local since
  -- the replacement suppliers package existence and equality classes.
  -- In particular no inference about internal groups is made from a mere
  -- existence of a replacement at an unrelated region.
  refine ⟨⟨minP, ?_⟩, ⟨minM, ?_⟩, ⟨maxP, ?_⟩, ⟨maxM, ?_⟩, leftInterval, ?_⟩
  · rintro H ⟨⟨⟨B, hB⟩, j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩, hm, rfl, he⟩
    have h := (right_project_eval a b c d e f parameter ell ⟨m, hm.1⟩ ⟨n, hm.2⟩).1 he
    change rightBound a b c d p.element ≤ conj m.element j.toHom.range
    rw [← h]
    exact bound_right a b c d e f ell m n
  · rintro H ⟨⟨⟨B, hB⟩, j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩, rfl, he⟩
    have h := (right_mul_eval a b c d e f parameter ell m n).1 he
    change rightBound a b c d p.element ≤ conj m.element j.toHom.range
    rw [← h]
    exact bound_right a b c d e f ell m n
  · rintro H ⟨⟨⟨B, hB⟩, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩, hx, rfl, he⟩
    have h := (left_project_eval a b c d e f parameter ⟨x, hx.1⟩ ⟨y, hx.2⟩ z).1 he
    change conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range ≤ leftBound a b p.element
    rw [← h]
    exact bound_left a b c d e f x y z
  · rintro H ⟨⟨⟨B, hB⟩, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩, rfl, he⟩
    have h := (left_mul_eval a b c d e f parameter x y z).1 he
    change conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range ≤ leftBound a b p.element
    rw [← h]
    exact bound_left a b c d e f x y z
  · rintro ⟨⟨B, hB⟩, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ hx he hmax
    have h := (left_project_eval a b c d e f parameter ⟨x, hx.1⟩ ⟨y, hx.2⟩ z).1 he
    change conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = leftBound a b p.element at hmax
    rw [← h] at hmax
    -- The first crossing's common images now come from the full
    -- intersection. The project's mixed-basis injectivity lemma applies.
    have hinj := first_injective a b c d e f x y z hmax
    change ∀ u ∈ Set.range (basisMap a b r s x), ∃! w, basisMap a b r s x w = u
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
