open MackeyDiagrams

section
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private theorem finite_mixed {K H P L : Subgroup U} [Finite K] [Finite H]
    (α : ConjEmbedding K P) (β : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (x : Dot (α.comp l) (β.comp r)) :
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β l r x w = z} := by
  let _ : Finite ((Word.up l).tensor (.down r)).basis.carrier :=
    Finite.of_surjective (fun p : K × H => (Biset.induction l).pair (Biset.restriction r) p.1 p.2)
      (fun w => Quotient.exists_rep w)
  exact fun _ => Set.toFinite _

private theorem lower_le_max (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f)) :
    (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range ≤ leftBound a b p.element := by
  apply le_inf (range_comp_le a (d.comp e))
  rw [dot_ranges p]
  exact Subgroup.map_mono (range_comp_le b (c.comp f))

-- The Case 2 supplier constructs the full intersection. For the interval
-- here, use inverses of the given embeddings restricted to any H in the
-- interval, and construct both singleton crossings on this same group.
private theorem left_witness [Finite G] [Finite D] [Finite F]
    (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f)) (H : Subgroup A)
    (hlo : (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range ≤ H) (hhi : H ≤ leftBound a b p.element) :
    let B := H.map A.subtype
    ∃ (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s) (y : ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f)
      (z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e)),
      conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = H ∧
        leftParameter a b c d e f x.dot y.dot z = p.element := by
  intro B
  let j := inclusion H
  have hj : j.toHom.range = H := inclusion_range H
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := lift_through a j (by
    rw [hj]
    exact hhi.trans inf_le_left)
  let _ : Finite B := Finite.of_injective r.toHom r.injective
  have hs' : (conjugated j p.element⁻¹).toHom.range ≤ b.toHom.range := by
    rw [conjugated_range, hj]
    calc
      _ ≤ conj p.element⁻¹ (conj p.element b.toHom.range) :=
        Subgroup.map_mono (hhi.trans inf_le_right)
      _ = _ := by rw [conj_mul, inv_mul_cancel, conj_one]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := lift_through b (conjugated j p.element⁻¹) hs'
  let t := restrictTo (a.comp (d.comp e)) H hlo
  have hjt : j.comp t = a.comp (d.comp e) := ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun _ => rfl)
  have ht₁ : r.comp t = d.comp e := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply a.injective
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding B A => m.toHom (t.toHom v)) hr
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding E A => m.toHom v) hjt
    exact h₁.trans h₂
  have hbs (v : B) : b.toHom (s.toHom v) =
      p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom v * p.element := by
    have hv := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding B A => m.toHom v) hs
    change b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom v * (p.element⁻¹)⁻¹ at hv
    rwa [inv_inv] at hv
  have ht₂ : s.comp t = c.comp f := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply b.injective
    change b.toHom (s.toHom (t.toHom v)) = ((b.comp c).comp f).toHom v
    rw [hbs]
    change p.element⁻¹ * (j.comp t).toHom v * p.element = _
    rw [hjt, mul_assoc, p.intertwines, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  let x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s) := ⟨p.element, by
    intro v
    rw [hr]
    change j.toHom v * p.element = p.element * b.toHom (s.toHom v)
    rw [hbs]
    group⟩
  let y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f) := ⟨1, by intro v; rw [ht₂, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e) := ⟨1, by intro v; rw [ht₁, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  refine ⟨r, s, t, ⟨x, finite_mixed a b r s x⟩, ⟨y, finite_mixed s c t f y⟩, z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change conj (a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = H
    rw [inv_one, map_one, conj_one, hr, hj]
  · change a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹ * p.element * b.toHom (1 : D) = p.element
    rw [inv_one, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]

private theorem right_witness [Finite A]
    (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f) :
    let S := rightBound a b c d p.dot.element
    let B := S.map A.subtype
    ∃ (j : ConjEmbedding B A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B) (w : ConjEmbedding F B)
      (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w)) (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed a j d v)
      (n : ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f),
      conj m.dot.element j.toHom.range = S ∧
      rightParameter a b c d e f ell m.dot n.dot = p.dot.element := by
  intro S B
  -- Theorem 6.4(1) supplies the join construction once the middle
  -- intersection has finite index. Its ambient group is a subgroup of A.
  have hindex : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
      ((a.comp d).toHom.range.subgroupOf (a.toHom.range ⊓ S)) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n, hj, _, _, he, hm, hn, _, _⟩ :=
    (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).1 p hindex
  refine ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : j = inclusion S :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun u => Subtype.ext (hj u))
    rw [hm, conj_one, h, inclusion_range]
  · unfold rightParameter
    simp only [he, hm, hn, map_one, one_mul, inv_inv]

end
end OutsideRegionsAux

external.usage: In Proposition 8.6, two padded blocks on opposite sides that contain the same point are adjacent. Their equal connected components establish pairwise disjointness of the join blocks.
In Proposition 8.6, choose a representative vertex of a component. Its nonempty block supplies a point of the filtered join block.

Embed a parabolic subgroup in the permutation group of the finite union of its blocks. Each block permutation preserves the union and fixes its complement, so it is the extension of its restriction. This proves finiteness used for the Case 1 middle index and the two Case 2 projection domains.

ThreeInductionReidemeisterThree.proof:
by
  intro U inst G A D F C E repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF
    hGA hAD hDF hGC hCE hEF ga ad df gc ce ef bottomPair topPair
    word bottom top straight merge split splitBottom mergeTop mergedEvaluation multiplier
    crossing crossLeft crossRight LeftLabels RightLabels leftDiagram rightDiagram
    leftMultiplier rightMultiplier leftEval rightEval leftSetoid rightSetoid
  -- Theorem 6.2, § 6.1, archived PDF p. 20 and revised published PDF p. 22.
  -- The two diagrams appear on archived p. 19 and revised p. 21.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#thm:reidemeister-three
  -- The published proof is unnumbered. The numbers below index its three
  -- arguments in source order: descent, independence, and the round trips.
  -- The fourth conjunct of the registered multiplier theorem identifies
  -- equality of maps with equality at 1 for these six fixed boundary labels.
  -- It supplies the merged evaluation comparison directly, including
  -- cancellation of the boundary merge and split. The setoids here use
  -- Setoid.ker on individual admissible labellings. The diagram vector-space
  -- quotient from the route concerns finite expressions in drawings.
  have eval_iff (d e : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) :
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret d) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret e) ↔
        multiplier d = multiplier e :=
    (ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers G A D F C E repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF
      hGA hAD hDF hGC hCE hEF).2.2.2.1 d e
  obtain ⟨φ, ψ, hφ, hψ, hleft, hright⟩ :=
    MultipliersUnderRelabelling G A D F C E repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF
      hGA hAD hDF hGC hCE hEF
  -- Step 1. The registered Lemma 6.1 uses the same termwise eligible dot
  -- language and crosses the same ordered pairs as leftDiagram and rightDiagram.
  have forwardEval (d : LeftLabels) : rightEval (φ d) = leftEval d :=
    (eval_iff (rightDiagram (φ d)) (leftDiagram d)).2 (hφ d)
  have backwardEval (e : RightLabels) : leftEval (ψ e) = rightEval e :=
    (eval_iff (leftDiagram (ψ e)) (rightDiagram e)).2 (hψ e)
  let forward : Quotient leftSetoid → Quotient rightSetoid :=
    Quotient.map φ (fun {d d'} (h : leftEval d = leftEval d') =>
      (forwardEval d).trans (h.trans (forwardEval d').symm))
  let backward : Quotient rightSetoid → Quotient leftSetoid :=
    Quotient.map ψ (fun {e e'} (h : rightEval e = rightEval e') =>
      (backwardEval e).trans (h.trans (backwardEval e').symm))
  -- Step 3. Quotient induction reduces the inverse laws to Lemma 6.1's
  -- round-trip equalities for the same two boundary evaluations.
  let classes : Equiv (Quotient leftSetoid) (Quotient rightSetoid) :=
    { toFun := forward
      invFun := backward
      left_inv := fun q => Quotient.inductionOn q fun d => by
        change Quotient.mk leftSetoid (ψ (φ d)) = Quotient.mk leftSetoid d
        exact Quotient.sound ((eval_iff (leftDiagram (ψ (φ d))) (leftDiagram d)).2 (hleft d))
      right_inv := fun q => Quotient.inductionOn q fun e => by
        change Quotient.mk rightSetoid (φ (ψ e)) = Quotient.mk rightSetoid e
        exact Quotient.sound ((eval_iff (rightDiagram (φ (ψ e))) (rightDiagram e)).2 (hright e)) }
  refine ⟨φ, ψ, classes, hφ, hψ, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  -- Step 2. Any admissible replacement evaluating to the input map agrees
  -- with the chosen output in the corresponding evaluation quotient.
  · intro d e he
    change Quotient.mk rightSetoid (φ d) = Quotient.mk rightSetoid e
    exact Quotient.sound ((forwardEval d).trans he.symm)
  · intro e d hd
    change Quotient.mk leftSetoid (ψ e) = Quotient.mk leftSetoid d
    exact Quotient.sound ((backwardEval e).trans hd.symm)

by
  intro U inst K H B H' G α β γ δ α' β' hα hβ hγ hδ hα' hβ' a b c f a' b' u v w
    evalDrawing singleton twoCrossings mergeDotSplit
  -- Xiao, § 5.2, gives this restriction case immediately after Theorem 5.4's proof.
  -- The archived original has it on p. 18. The revised published PDF has it on p. 20.
  -- The two PDF files have different hashes. Their restriction paragraphs agree.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- No numbered Alphabeta Math proof is supplied for this endpoint. The steps below
  -- follow Xiao's calculation.
  -- Step 1: expand the two marked crossings at their typed boundaries. The drawing
  -- evaluator sums whole crossings, so first pass the fixed split through the finite sum.
  -- Step 2: cancel the split and merge on the middle chain through B, then compose
  -- the eligible finite labels termwise in stacking order. The middle cancellation
  -- specializes splitDown_mergeDown to c and f. Each ordered product in
  -- downDrawing_compose uses Dot.vertical at the shared embedding v.
  have merged (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u v)
      (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex v w) :
      evalDrawing (twoCrossings D E) =
        evalDrawing (mergeDotSplit (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose D E)) := by
    let lower := (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing D).interpret.eval
    let upper := (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing E).interpret.eval
    let product := (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose D E)).interpret.eval
    let bottomMerge := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) a b).eval
    let middleSplit := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) c f).eval
    let middleMerge := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) c f).eval
    let topSplit := (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) a' b').eval
    change ((MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown a b c f
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms D)).interpret.eval).vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown c f a' b'
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms E)).interpret.eval =
      bottomMerge.vertical (product.vertical topSplit)
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.parallelRIIRestriction_evalCrossing,
      MackeyDiagrams.parallelRIIRestriction_evalCrossing]
    have middle : middleSplit.vertical middleMerge =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down v).basis :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown_mergeDown c f
    have dots : lower.vertical upper = product :=
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing_compose D E
    simpa only [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc] using
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.merge_dot_split_comp
        bottomMerge lower middleSplit middleMerge upper topSplit product middle dots

  intro d e dNode eNode product
  constructor
  · have product_eq : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose (singleton d) (singleton e) =
        product := by
      change MackeyDiagrams.Dot.linearProduct (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))
        (Finsupp.single e 1) = Finsupp.single (d.vertical e) 1
      simp [MackeyDiagrams.Dot.linearProduct, Finsupp.sum_single_index]
    simpa only [product_eq] using merged (singleton d) (singleton e)
  -- Step 3: transport the inverse left multiplication calculation from the historical
  -- Diagram connection to the marked singleton drawings. The root build has changed
  -- since that receipt. The singleton adapter checks the connection in the current
  -- imports, using eval_downDot_groupAlgebra directly. The law (de)⁻¹ = e⁻¹d⁻¹
  -- supplies the stacking order.
  · intro x first second dInv eInv
    have hd : evalDrawing dNode = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) d).eval :=
      MackeyDiagrams.parallelRIIRestriction_evalSingleton d
    have he : evalDrawing eNode = (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) e).eval :=
      MackeyDiagrams.parallelRIIRestriction_evalSingleton e
    have h₁ : first = (dInv * x).coeff := by
      change (evalDrawing dNode).toLinearMap x.coeff = _
      rw [hd]
      exact MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_downDot_groupAlgebra d x
    have h₂ : second = (eInv * (dInv * x)).coeff := by
      change (evalDrawing eNode).toLinearMap first = _
      rw [he, h₁]
      exact MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval_downDot_groupAlgebra e (dInv * x)
    refine ⟨h₁, h₂, ?_⟩
    rw [h₂, ← mul_assoc]
    change (MonoidAlgebra.single e.element⁻¹ (1 : Complex) *
      MonoidAlgebra.single d.element⁻¹ 1 * x).coeff = _
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, mul_inv_rev]

namespace MackeyDiagrams

private theorem parallelRIIRestriction_evalCrossing {U : Type*} [Group U]
    {K H H' G : Subgroup U} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding H' G) (b' : ConjEmbedding K H')
    (label : DotLabel R (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :
    (LabelledDrawing.parallelDown a b a' b' label.terms).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.mergeDown (R := R) a b).eval.vertical
        (label.downDrawing.interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitDown a' b').eval) := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (label.terms.map fun (r, d) =>
      (r, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.parallelDown a b a' b' d)))).eval.toLinearMap x =
    (Diagram.splitDown (R := R) a' b').eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.finiteSum (label.terms.map fun (r, d) =>
        Diagram.scale r (Diagram.downDot d))).eval.toLinearMap
          ((Diagram.mergeDown (R := R) a b).eval.toLinearMap x))
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, Diagram.eval_finiteSum]
  generalize label.terms = terms
  induction terms with
  | nil => simp
  | cons term terms ih =>
    rcases term with ⟨r, d⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, map_add, ih]
    congr 1
    change r • (Diagram.splitDown (R := R) a' b').eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.downDot d).eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeDown a b).eval.toLinearMap x)) =
      (Diagram.splitDown (R := R) a' b').eval.toLinearMap
        (r • (Diagram.downDot d).eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeDown a b).eval.toLinearMap x))
    rw [map_smul]

private theorem parallelRIIRestriction_evalSingleton {U : Type*} [Group U]
    {K G : Subgroup U} {p q : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot p q) :
    (DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval =
      (Diagram.downDot (R := Complex) d).eval := by
  rw [DotLabel.eval_downDrawing]
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact (Diagram.eval_linearDownDot_apply (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex)) x).trans (by
    rw [freeLift_single, one_smul])

end MackeyDiagrams

ReverseCupBend.proof:
by
  open MackeyDiagrams MackeyDiagrams.Diagram ReverseCupBendSupport in
  intro U _ K H G a b
  dsimp only
  intro finite
  -- Xiao, §3.5, Proposition 3.4, reverse-cup row. The archived original
  -- PDF has the diagrams on p. 12 and the computation on p. 13
  -- (SHA256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2).
  -- The revised published PDF has them on pp. 14 and 15 respectively
  -- (SHA256 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e).
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  --
  -- Alphabeta Math's module tensor universal property, Steps 3.1 and 4.1,
  -- descends along the balance relations. The shared biset tensor already
  -- performs that descent, and pair_balance applies it to the two basis
  -- representatives of the right unital insertion. As in Step 5.1, equality
  -- follows on generators, here the group elements with coefficient one.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  --
  -- FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction supplies the right transversal and the
  -- cup formula on group elements after transport to a conjugating
  -- representative. The shared merge/split basis rules underlying
  -- InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits apply directly to a and b.
  -- The associate and trace basis rules apply to the resulting pairs.
  -- Its cup formula uses rightCosetEquivCapFiber and computes transfer
  -- coefficients with transferBasis_apply. The public projection of
  -- that formula already gives the required sum over representatives.
  have finiteAlpha : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex := by
    let := finite
    have h : ((b.comp a).toHom.range.comap b.toHom).FiniteIndex := inferInstance
    change ((b.toHom.comp a.toHom).range.comap b.toHom).FiniteIndex at h
    rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective b.injective] at h
    exact h
  change ((BentVertex.reverseCup b a finiteAlpha).expand (R := Complex)).eval =
    (rightBend a b finite).eval
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨S, hS⟩, cupLarge⟩ := cupTransversal (b.comp a) finite
  have cupSmall := (cupTransversal a finiteAlpha).2
  -- The article chooses a product transversal and isolates the slice
  -- indexed by the identity coset. For an arbitrary large transversal,
  -- pull back that slice along b.toHom. This gives the same surviving
  -- terms without requiring a separate choice of outer representatives.
  let T := S.preimage b.toHom b.injective.injOn
  have memT (t : H) : t ∈ T ↔ b.toHom t ∈ S := Finset.mem_preimage
  have cosetTest (x y : H) :
      b.toHom x * (b.toHom y)⁻¹ ∈ (b.comp a).toHom.range ↔
        x * y⁻¹ ∈ a.toHom.range := by
    rw [← map_inv, ← map_mul]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact ⟨k, b.injective hk⟩
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact ⟨k, congrArg b.toHom hk⟩
  have hT : RightTransversal a T := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨s, hs, unique⟩ := hS (b.toHom h)
    have hsImage : s.val ∈ b.toHom.range := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hs
      refine ⟨(a.toHom k)⁻¹ * h, ?_⟩
      rw [map_mul, map_inv, ← ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, hk]
      group
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsImage
    have htT : t ∈ T := (memT t).2 (ht.symm ▸ s.property)
    refine ⟨⟨t, htT⟩, (cosetTest h t).1 ?_, ?_⟩
    · rwa [ht]
    · intro u hu
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply b.injective
      have he := unique ⟨b.toHom u.val, (memT u.val).1 u.property⟩ ((cosetTest h u.val).2 hu)
      exact (congrArg Subtype.val he).trans ht.symm
  have smallAtOne := cupSmall T hT (1 : H)
  simp only [one_mul] at smallAtOne
  apply eval_ext_on_generators
  intro g
  change G at g
  rw [leftSum a b finiteAlpha g T smallAtOne, rightSum a b finite g S (cupLarge S hS g)]
  calc
    _ = ∑ s ∈ S.filter (fun s => s ∈ b.toHom.range), rightTerm a b g s := by
      refine Finset.sum_bij (fun t _ => b.toHom t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro t ht
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨(memT t).1 ht, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩
      · intro t _ u _ he
        exact b.injective he
      · intro s hs
        obtain ⟨hsS, t, ht⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hs
        exact ⟨t, (memT t).2 (ht.symm ▸ hsS), ht⟩
      · intro t _
        simp only [rightTerm, Generator.traceBasis_image, outputSingle]
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
    _ = _ := by
      refine Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _) ?_
      intro s hs hsFiltered
      have hsOutside : ¬ ∃ t : H, b.toHom t = s := by
        intro himage
        exact hsFiltered (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hs, himage⟩)
      simp only [rightTerm, Generator.traceBasis_outside Complex b s hsOutside, map_zero]

namespace ReverseCupBendSupport

open MackeyDiagrams MackeyDiagrams.Diagram

universe u
noncomputable section
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}

private abbrev RightTransversal {A B : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding A B) (T : Finset B) :=
  ∀ g : B, ∃! t : {t // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ a.toHom.range

-- Use the registered cup formula, transporting it along the equality between
-- the given embedding and the embedding defined by its conjugating representative.
private theorem cupTransversal {A B : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding A B)
    (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    (∃ T, RightTransversal a T) ∧
    ∀ (T : Finset B), RightTransversal a T → ∀ g : B,
      (reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
        ∑ t ∈ T, Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.down a).basis (g * t⁻¹) t) 1 := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  have hs' (h : A) : s * (h : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ B := hs h ▸ (a.toHom h).property
  have ha : a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hs' :=
    ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun h => Subtype.ext (hs h))
  subst a
  obtain ⟨hExists, _, _, hcup⟩ :=
    (FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction.{u, 0} A B s hs').2.2.2.2 finite
  refine ⟨hExists, fun T hT g => ?_⟩
  have h := ((hcup T hT).1 g).1
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single] at h
  rw [h]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

variable (a : ConjEmbedding K H) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)

private abbrev rightBend (finite : (b.comp a).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    Diagram Complex (.up b) ((Word.up (b.comp a)).tensor (.down a)) :=
  .vertical (.insertLeftUnit (.up b))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (.reverseCup (b.comp a) finite) (.id (.up b)))
      (.vertical (.associate (.up (b.comp a)) (.down (b.comp a)) (.up b))
        (.horizontal (.id (.up (b.comp a))) ((BentVertex.traceCap b a).expand))))

private abbrev outputSingle (x : G) (t : H) :
    ((Word.up (b.comp a)).tensor (.down a)).basis.carrier →₀ Complex :=
  Finsupp.single ((Word.up (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.down a).basis x t) 1

private theorem leftSum (finite : a.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (g : G) (T : Finset H)
    (hcup : (reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ T, Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.down a).basis t⁻¹ t) 1) :
    ((BentVertex.reverseCup b a finite).expand (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ T, outputSingle a b (g * (b.toHom t)⁻¹) t := by
  have hunit :
      (insertRightUnit (R := Complex) (.up b)).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
        Finsupp.single ((Word.up b).basis.pair (Word.empty H).basis g 1) 1 := by
    change (Biset.insertRightUnit (Word.up b).basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
    exact Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single _ _ _ _
  change (vertical (insertRightUnit (.up b))
    (vertical (horizontal (id (.up b)) (reverseCup a finite))
      (vertical (unassociate (.up b) (.up a) (.down a))
        (horizontal (mergeUp b a) (id (.down a)))))).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) = _
  rw [eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply,
    hunit, eval_horizontal_single (id (.up b)) (reverseCup a finite) g 1 1,
    one_smul, eval_id_apply, hcup, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_unassociate_single (.up b) (.up a) (.down a) g t⁻¹ t 1,
    eval_horizontal_single (mergeUp b a) (id (.down a)) _ t 1, one_smul,
    eval_mergeUp_single, eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, map_inv]

private theorem traceBranch (t : G) :
    ((BentVertex.traceCap b a).expand (R := Complex)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Word.down (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis t 1) 1) =
        Generator.traceBasis Complex b t := by
  let f := (rightUnit (R := Complex) (.down a)).eval.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.down a).basis (Word.empty H).basis (Finsupp.single 1 1))
  have hf : f = LinearMap.id := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro h c
    change (rightUnit (R := Complex) (.down a)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.down a).basis (Word.empty H).basis
        (Finsupp.single 1 1) (Finsupp.single h c)) = Finsupp.single h c
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_rightUnit_single]
    change Finsupp.single (a.toHom 1 * 1 * (h⁻¹)⁻¹) c = _
    simp
  change (vertical (horizontal (splitDown b a) (id (.up b)))
    (vertical (associate (.down a) (.down b) (.up b))
      (vertical (horizontal (id (.down a)) (traceCap b)) (rightUnit (.down a))))).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single ((Word.down (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis t 1) 1) = _
  rw [eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply,
    eval_horizontal_single (splitDown b a) (id (.up b)) t 1 1, one_smul,
    eval_splitDown_single, eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
    eval_associate_single (.down a) (.down b) (.up b) 1 t 1 1,
    eval_horizontal_single (id (.down a)) (traceCap b) 1
      ((Word.down b).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis t 1) 1,
    one_smul, eval_id_apply, eval_traceCap_single, one_smul, mul_one]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hf _

private abbrev rightTerm (g t : G) :
    ((Word.up (b.comp a)).tensor (.down a)).basis.carrier →₀ Complex :=
  Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.up (b.comp a)).basis (Word.down a).basis
    (Finsupp.single (g * t⁻¹) 1) (Generator.traceBasis Complex b t)

private theorem rightSum (finite : (b.comp a).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (g : G) (S : Finset G)
    (hcup : (reverseCup (R := Complex) (b.comp a) finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ S, Finsupp.single
        ((Word.up (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.down (b.comp a)).basis (g * t⁻¹) t) 1) :
    (rightBend a b finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single g 1) = ∑ t ∈ S, rightTerm a b g t := by
  -- In the balanced tensor product, 1 ⊗ g is represented by g ⊗ 1.
  have hbalance : (Biset.regular G).pair (Word.up b).basis g 1 =
      (Biset.regular G).pair (Word.up b).basis 1 g := by
    have h := (Biset.regular G).pair_balance (Word.up b).basis g 1 1
    change (Biset.regular G).pair (Word.up b).basis (1 * 1 * (g⁻¹)⁻¹) 1 =
      (Biset.regular G).pair (Word.up b).basis 1 (g * 1 * (b.toHom 1)⁻¹) at h
    simpa only [inv_inv, one_mul, map_one, inv_one, mul_one] using h
  unfold rightBend
  rw [eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply, eval_vertical_apply, eval_insertLeftUnit_single,
    ← hbalance,
    eval_horizontal_single (reverseCup (b.comp a) finite) (id (.up b)) g 1 1,
    one_smul, eval_id_apply, hcup]
  let pairWithOne := (Biset.pairLinear Complex
    ((Word.up (b.comp a)).tensor (.down (b.comp a))).basis (Word.up b).basis).flip
      (Finsupp.single 1 1)
  let tail := (horizontal (R := Complex) (id (.up (b.comp a)))
      ((BentVertex.traceCap b a).expand)).eval.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    (associate (R := Complex) (.up (b.comp a)) (.down (b.comp a)) (.up b)).eval.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    pairWithOne
  change tail (∑ t ∈ S, Finsupp.single
    ((Word.up (b.comp a)).basis.pair (Word.down (b.comp a)).basis (g * t⁻¹) t) 1) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  simp only [tail, pairWithOne, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one,
    eval_associate_single (.up (b.comp a)) (.down (b.comp a)) (.up b) (g * t⁻¹) t 1 1,
    eval_horizontal_single (id (.up (b.comp a))) ((BentVertex.traceCap b a).expand) _ _ 1,
    one_smul, eval_id_apply, traceBranch]

end
end ReverseCupBendSupport

  intro P finitary U parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f

    rightLabels left right firstFiberIsSingleton indices maximalLeftLabels
  -- Alphabeta Math, Proposition 8.6. The archived original (bc57d137…) has
  -- the calculation on p. 38 and the projection diagram on p. 39. The revised
  -- published PDF (6d7e8859…) has them on pp. 40–41. The portal proof is in
  -- prose and refers to Lemma 6.3 and the numbered Cases 1–2 of Theorem 6.4.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-three-outside
  let _ : Finite A := parabolic_finite hA
  let _ : Finite G := parabolic_finite hG
  let _ : Finite D := parabolic_finite hD
  let _ : Finite F := parabolic_finite hF
  have targetIndex : (lower.subgroupOf (image a ⊓ other)).FiniteIndex := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨hp, hExtremal⟩ :=
    ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f p targetIndex
  let parameter : ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f := ⟨p, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨minParabolic, maxParabolic⟩ := parabolic_region_bounds a b c d element hG hD hF hC
  -- Step 1. Case 1 of Theorem 6.4 gives the right composite at the join.
  -- Its middle index is finite in the finite ambient group A.
  have middleIndex : ((image ad).subgroupOf (image a ⊓ minimum)).FiniteIndex := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n, hj, hv, hw, hell, hm, hn, _, _⟩ :=
    (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).1 parameter middleIndex
  let rr : Right := ⟨j, v, w, ell, m.dot, n.dot⟩
  have hr : rightFinite rr := ⟨m.finite, n.finite⟩
  have hrightLabels : rightLabels rr :=
    ⟨hj, ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext hv), hw, hell, hm, hn⟩
  have hrightParam : rightParameter a b c d e f ell m.dot n.dot = p.element := by
    change m.dot.element * j.toHom n.dot.element * ell.element⁻¹ = p.element
    rw [hell, hm, hn, map_one, mul_one, one_mul, inv_inv]
  have heRight : evaluate (right rr hr) = evaluate (target hp) :=
    (right_project_eval a b c d e f parameter ell m n).2 hrightParam
  refine ⟨minParabolic, hp, rr, hr, hrightLabels, heRight, ?_⟩
  have hIndices : ∀ (l : Left) (hl : leftFinite l),

    rintro ⟨⟨B, hB⟩, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ hl he
    have hparam :=
      (left_project_eval a b c d e f parameter ⟨x, hl.1⟩ ⟨y, hl.2⟩ z).1 (he.trans heRight)
    -- Step 2. Lemma 6.3 identifies the effective crossing element of the
    -- three vertices. The registered fiber calculation already supplies the
    -- quotient cardinalities. Transport the two pairs of stabilizers separately
    -- along injective maps, applying each calculation on its own image.
    let H := conjugate (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (image (comp a r))

      transportIndices a b c d e f x y z p hparam

    have hFiniteSecond : (lower.subgroupOf (H ⊓ other)).FiniteIndex := inferInstance
    refine ⟨hlo, hhi, hboth, hFiniteFirst, hFiniteSecond, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact fun u hu =>
        (crossingFiberSize a b r s ⟨x, hl.1⟩ u hu).trans hfirst
    · exact fun u hu =>
        (crossingFiberSize s c t f ⟨y, hl.2⟩ u hu).trans hsecond

      have hOne : H.relIndex maximum = 1 := by
        rw [heq, Subgroup.relIndex_self]

          leftBound a b (leftParameter a b c d e f x y z) := by
        rw [hparam]
        exact heq

      -- Generator.injective_mixedMultiplicationBasis via first_injective.
      have hinj := first_injective a b c d e f x y z hmax
      refine ⟨hOne, ?_⟩
      rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨w, rfl, fun w' hw' => hinj hw'⟩
  refine ⟨hIndices, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Step 3. Proposition 8.6 supplies every point of the interval.
    intro H hH hlo hhi
    obtain ⟨l, hl, htrans, he⟩ := (hExtremal.2.2.2.2.1 H hH hlo hhi).1
    exact ⟨l, hl, htrans, he.trans heRight.symm⟩
  · -- Step 4. Case 2 uses the full intersection. Expose the labels (p, 1, 1)
    -- from the restricted-embedding construction for this particular witness.
    obtain ⟨r, s, t, x, y, z, htrans, hparam, hx, hy, hz⟩ :=
      labelledLeftWitness a b c d e f p maximum (lower_le_max a b c d e f p) le_rfl
    let ll : Left := ⟨⟨maximum.map A.subtype, maxParabolic⟩, r, s, t, x.dot, y.dot, z⟩
    have hl : leftFinite ll := ⟨x.finite, y.finite⟩
    have heLeft : evaluate (left ll hl) = evaluate (target hp) :=
      (left_project_eval a b c d e f parameter x y z).2 hparam
    have he := heLeft.trans heRight.symm
    have hmax := (hIndices ll hl he).2.2.2.2.2.2 htrans
    exact ⟨ll, hl, htrans, ⟨hx, hy, hz⟩, he, hmax⟩

-- The compiled prerequisites keep their calculation lemmas private.
-- Mathlib reexports Batteries' open-private command, which lets these
-- adapters refer to the checked declarations in their original modules.
open private parabolic_region_bounds parabolic_finite left_project_eval right_project_eval
  left_bound_transport dot_ranges range_comp_le conj OutsideRegionsAux.conj_mul first_injective lower_le_max
  leftParameter rightParameter leftBound from Proofs.ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions

open private inclusion inclusion_range lift_through conjugated conjugated_range restrictTo
  finite_mixed conj_one from Proofs.ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions

namespace ParabolicCaseTwoProjectionFiberIndicesAux

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U]

private theorem crossingFiberSize {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :
    ∀ z ∈ Set.range (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r p.dot),
      Nat.card {w // Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r p.dot w = z} =
        (a.comp l).toHom.range.relIndex (leftBound a b p.dot.element) := by
  intro z hz
  -- Lemma 6.3 and (6.1). Insert identities to use the registered calculation
  -- for one crossing. The mixed basis coordinate equivalence preserves fibers.
  have h := (EvaluationForTwoProjections a b (ConjEmbedding.id H) l (ConjEmbedding.id L) r).2.1
    p (Generator.mixedProduct a b z) |>.2 (by
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hz
      exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
  refine (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun w => ?_))).trans h
  exact ⟨congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct a b), fun he => (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).injective he⟩

private theorem mapConjugate {X Y : Type*} [Group X] [Group Y]
    (m : X →* Y) (g : X) (H : Subgroup X) :
    (conj g H).map m = conj (m g) (H.map m) := by
  change (H.map (MulAut.conj g).toMonoidHom).map m =
    (H.map m).map (MulAut.conj (m g)).toMonoidHom
  rw [Subgroup.map_map, Subgroup.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext u
  change m (g * u * g⁻¹) = m g * m u * (m g)⁻¹
  simp

section
variable {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
  (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)
variable {r : ConjEmbedding B G} {s : ConjEmbedding B D} {t : ConjEmbedding E B}

private theorem transportIndices
    (x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s)) (y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f))
    (z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e))
    (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f))
    (hParameter : leftParameter a b c d e f x y z = p.element) :
    let H := conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range
    let other := conj p.element (b.comp c).toHom.range
    let lower := (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range
    let maximum := leftBound a b p.element
    lower ≤ H ∧ H ≤ maximum ∧ lower ≤ H ⊓ other ∧
      (a.comp r).toHom.range.relIndex (leftBound a b x.element) = H.relIndex maximum ∧
      (s.comp t).toHom.range.relIndex (leftBound s c y.element) = lower.relIndex (H ⊓ other) := by
  intro H other lower maximum
  let q := a.toHom z.element⁻¹
  let k := q * x.element
  have hk : k * b.toHom y.element = p.element := hParameter
  have hMaximum : conj q (leftBound a b x.element) = maximum :=
    (left_bound_transport a b x.element z.element⁻¹ y.element).trans
      (congrArg (leftBound a b) hk)
  have hSub : (a.comp r).toHom.range ≤ leftBound a b x.element := by
    refine le_inf (range_comp_le a r) ?_
    rw [dot_ranges x]
    exact Subgroup.map_mono (range_comp_le b s)
  have hFirst : (a.comp r).toHom.range.relIndex (leftBound a b x.element) =
      H.relIndex maximum := by
    rw [← hMaximum]
    exact (Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ (MulAut.conj q).injective).symm
  -- For the second crossing the injection is b followed by conjugation
  -- by a(z⁻¹)x. The y-conjugate of c(F) then maps to p(bc)(F)p⁻¹.
  let φ : D →* A := (MulAut.conj k).toMonoidHom.comp b.toHom
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := (MulAut.conj k).injective.comp b.injective
  have φ_map (S : Subgroup D) : S.map φ = conj k (S.map b.toHom) :=
    (Subgroup.map_map _ _ _).symm
  have hImage {J : Subgroup U} (m : ConjEmbedding J B) :
      (s.comp m).toHom.range.map φ = conj q (a.comp (r.comp m)).toHom.range := by
    rw [φ_map, MonoidHom.map_range]
    change conj (q * x.element) (b.comp (s.comp m)).toHom.range = _
    let dot : Dot (a.comp (r.comp m)) (b.comp (s.comp m)) :=
      ⟨x.element, fun v => x.intertwines (m.toHom v)⟩
    rw [← OutsideRegionsAux.conj_mul]
    exact congrArg (conj q) (dot_ranges dot).symm
  have hs : s.toHom.range.map φ = H := hImage (ConjEmbedding.id B)
  have hc : (conj y.element c.toHom.range).map φ = other := by
    rw [φ_map, mapConjugate, MonoidHom.map_range, OutsideRegionsAux.conj_mul, hk]
    rfl
  have hLower : (s.comp t).toHom.range.map φ = lower := by
    rw [hImage]
    have h := congrArg (fun S => conj q (S.map a.toHom)) (dot_ranges z)
    change conj q ((r.comp t).toHom.range.map a.toHom) =
      conj q ((conj z.element (d.comp e).toHom.range).map a.toHom) at h
    rw [mapConjugate, OutsideRegionsAux.conj_mul] at h
    change _ = conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹ * a.toHom z.element) _ at h
    rw [← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one] at h
    change conj q ((r.comp t).toHom.range.map a.toHom) =
      conj 1 ((d.comp e).toHom.range.map a.toHom) at h
    rw [MonoidHom.map_range, MonoidHom.map_range] at h
    rw [conj_one] at h
    exact h
  have hSecondUpper : (leftBound s c y.element).map φ = H ⊓ other := by
    change (s.toHom.range ⊓ conj y.element c.toHom.range).map φ = _
    rw [Subgroup.map_inf _ _ _ hφ, hs, hc]
  have hSecondLower : (s.comp t).toHom.range ≤ leftBound s c y.element := by
    refine le_inf (range_comp_le s t) ?_
    rw [dot_ranges y]
    exact Subgroup.map_mono (range_comp_le c f)
  have hBoth : lower ≤ H ⊓ other := by
    rw [← hLower, ← hSecondUpper]
    exact Subgroup.map_mono hSecondLower
  refine ⟨hBoth.trans inf_le_left, ?_, hBoth, hFirst, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hMaximum]
    exact Subgroup.map_mono hSub
  · rw [← hLower, ← hSecondUpper]
    exact (Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ hφ).symm

-- Keep the three actual labels of the restricted-embedding construction
-- from Proposition 8.6 for the maximal witness requested by this endpoint.
private theorem labelledLeftWitness [Finite G] [Finite D] [Finite F]
    (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f)) (H : Subgroup A)
    (hlo : (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range ≤ H) (hhi : H ≤ leftBound a b p.element) :
    let B := H.map A.subtype
    ∃ (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s) (y : ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f)
      (z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e)),
      conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = H ∧
        leftParameter a b c d e f x.dot y.dot z = p.element ∧
        x.dot.element = p.element ∧ y.dot.element = 1 ∧ z.element = 1 := by
  intro B
  let j := inclusion H
  have hj : j.toHom.range = H := inclusion_range H
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := lift_through a j (by
    rw [hj]
    exact hhi.trans inf_le_left)
  let _ : Finite B := Finite.of_injective r.toHom r.injective
  have hs' : (conjugated j p.element⁻¹).toHom.range ≤ b.toHom.range := by
    rw [conjugated_range, hj]
    calc
      _ ≤ conj p.element⁻¹ (conj p.element b.toHom.range) :=
        Subgroup.map_mono (hhi.trans inf_le_right)
      _ = _ := by rw [OutsideRegionsAux.conj_mul, inv_mul_cancel, conj_one]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := lift_through b (conjugated j p.element⁻¹) hs'
  let t := restrictTo (a.comp (d.comp e)) H hlo
  have hjt : j.comp t = a.comp (d.comp e) := ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun _ => rfl)
  have ht₁ : r.comp t = d.comp e := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply a.injective
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding B A => m.toHom (t.toHom v)) hr
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding E A => m.toHom v) hjt
    exact h₁.trans h₂
  have hbs (v : B) : b.toHom (s.toHom v) =
      p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom v * p.element := by
    have hv := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding B A => m.toHom v) hs
    change b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom v * (p.element⁻¹)⁻¹ at hv
    rwa [inv_inv] at hv
  have ht₂ : s.comp t = c.comp f := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply b.injective
    change b.toHom (s.toHom (t.toHom v)) = ((b.comp c).comp f).toHom v
    rw [hbs]
    change p.element⁻¹ * (j.comp t).toHom v * p.element = _
    rw [hjt, mul_assoc, p.intertwines, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  let x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s) := ⟨p.element, by
    intro v
    rw [hr]
    change j.toHom v * p.element = p.element * b.toHom (s.toHom v)
    rw [hbs]
    group⟩
  let y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f) := ⟨1, by intro v; rw [ht₂, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e) := ⟨1, by intro v; rw [ht₁, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  refine ⟨r, s, t, ⟨x, finite_mixed a b r s x⟩, ⟨y, finite_mixed s c t f y⟩, z, ?_, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · change conj (a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = H
    rw [inv_one, map_one, conj_one, hr, hj]
  · change a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹ * p.element * b.toHom (1 : D) = p.element
    rw [inv_one, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]

end
end ParabolicCaseTwoProjectionFiberIndicesAux

external.usage: In transportIndices, transport the first stabilizer quotient along conjugation by a(z⁻¹) and the second along b followed by conjugation by a(z⁻¹)x. The first map is an automorphism. The second is injective by ConjEmbedding.injective for b and injectivity of the conjugation automorphism. The transported subgroups are identified before applying the corresponding index formulas.

ParabolicCommonRightRegionForLinearLabel.proof:
by
  classical
  open MackeyDiagrams CommonRightRegionAux in
  intro finitary U parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f
    comp hom bc ad de cf idE image p₀ coeff Support element terms containing
    up down tensor outside inside vertical horizontal identity atRight eval basisMap finiteFibers x y z
  -- Xiao, §8.3 after Example 8.4, archived PDF p. 39 (bc57d13777e7df14…)
  -- and the revised published PDF p. 41 (6d7e885955f23ae6…). The portal
  -- inventory has no exact numbered Alphabeta Math entry for the paragraph.
  -- Use the Case 1 projection and Case 3 multiplication wiring of Theorems
  -- 6.4 and 6.5, and Lemma 6.3 for the projection parameters. The original
  -- paragraph uses the same two fixed marks at every term of the label.
  let _ : Finite G := parabolic_finite hG
  let _ : Finite D := parabolic_finite hD
  let _ : Finite F := parabolic_finite hF
  let _ : Finite C := parabolic_finite hC
  let _ : Finite E := parabolic_finite hE
  have hf (p : Support) : finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p.val) :=
    finite_mixed a bc de f p.val
  have hx (p : Support) : finiteFibers (basisMap a b de cf (x p)) :=
    finite_mixed a b de cf (x p)
  have hy : finiteFibers (basisMap cf c idE f y) := finite_mixed cf c idE f y
  refine ⟨hf, hx, hy, ?_⟩
  intro leftProject leftMultiply placed
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := leastContaining hA (image ad)
    ((image bc).map (MulAut.conj p₀).toMonoidHom) (fun p : Support => element p * p₀⁻¹)
  have hH' : IsLeast containing H := hH
  have necessary : placed ⊆ containing := by
    rintro K ⟨B, hB, u, v, w, ell, m, n, hK, hell, hm, hn, _⟩
    subst K
    refine ⟨parabolic_embedding u hB, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨k, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨hom v k, ?_⟩
      have he := m.intertwines k
      change hom ad k * m.element = m.element * hom u (hom v k) at he
      simpa only [hm, mul_one, one_mul] using he.symm
    · rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨k, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨hom w k, ?_⟩
      have he := ell.inverse.intertwines k
      change hom u (hom w k) * ell.element⁻¹ = ell.element⁻¹ * hom bc k at he
      rw [hell, inv_inv] at he
      change hom u (hom w k) = p₀ * hom bc k * p₀⁻¹
      rw [← he, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    · intro p
      exact ⟨(n p).element, by rw [hn p, mul_inv_cancel_right]⟩
  -- Conversely use inclusion of the candidate and factor the two boundary
  -- embeddings through it. Cancellation in A justifies each third dot.
  have sufficient : containing ⊆ placed := by
    rintro K ⟨hK, hAd, hBc, hDiff⟩
    let B := K.map A.subtype
    let u := inclusion K
    let v := restrictTo ad K hAd
    let w := restrictTo (conjugated bc p₀) K (by rwa [conjugated_range])
    have hv (k : C) : hom u (hom v k) = hom ad k := rfl
    have hw (k : F) : hom u (hom w k) = p₀ * hom bc k * p₀⁻¹ := rfl
    let ell : Dot bc (comp u w) := ⟨p₀⁻¹, by
      intro k
      change hom bc k * p₀⁻¹ = p₀⁻¹ * hom u (hom w k)
      rw [hw, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left]⟩
    let m : Dot ad (comp u v) := ⟨1, by intro k; simp only [mul_one, one_mul]; exact (hv k).symm⟩
    let nElement (p : Support) : B :=
      ⟨((element p * p₀⁻¹ : A) : U), ⟨element p * p₀⁻¹, hDiff p, rfl⟩⟩
    have hn (p : Support) : element p = hom u (nElement p) * p₀ := by
      change element p = (element p * p₀⁻¹) * p₀
      rw [inv_mul_cancel_right]
    let n (p : Support) : Dot (comp v e) (comp w f) := ⟨nElement p, by
      intro k
      apply u.injective
      rw [map_mul, map_mul]
      change hom u (hom v (hom e k)) * (element p * p₀⁻¹) =
        (element p * p₀⁻¹) * hom u (hom w (hom f k))
      rw [hv, hw]
      have he := p.val.intertwines k
      change hom ad (hom e k) * element p = element p * hom bc (hom f k) at he
      calc
        _ = (hom ad (hom e k) * element p) * p₀⁻¹ := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = (element p * hom bc (hom f k)) * p₀⁻¹ := by rw [he]
        _ = _ := by group⟩
    let _ : Finite A := parabolic_finite hA
    let _ : Finite B := Finite.of_injective u.toHom u.injective
    have hm : finiteFibers (basisMap a u d v m) := finite_mixed a u d v m
    have hthird (p : Support) : finiteFibers (basisMap v w e f (n p)) :=
      finite_mixed v w e f (n p)
    refine ⟨B, hK, u, v, w, ell, m, n, inclusion_range K, rfl, rfl, hn, hm, hthird, ?_⟩
    -- Lemma 6.3 identifies the backwards transfer parameter and Case 3
    -- gives the same forward multiplication parameter. The local comparison
    -- fixes the marks that the public replacement suppliers leave existential.
    -- Apply it to the reviewed support list with each original coefficient.
    let entries := (Finset.toList (Finset.attach (Finsupp.support coeff))).map
      (fun p : Support => (coeff p.val, p))
    have helem (p : Support) : rightParameter a b c d e f ell m (n p) = element p := by
      change 1 * hom u (nElement p) * (p₀⁻¹)⁻¹ = element p
      simpa only [one_mul, inv_inv] using (hn p).symm
    have hc := comparePlaced a b c d e f entries (fun p : Support => p.val)
      hf hx hy u v w ell m n hm hthird helem
    simpa only [entries, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using hc
  exact ⟨H, hH', ⟨sufficient hH'.1, fun _ h => hH'.2 (necessary h)⟩⟩

private abbrev conj {V : Type*} [Group V] (p : V) (H : Subgroup V) :=
  H.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev leftParameter {r : ConjEmbedding B G} {s : ConjEmbedding B D}
    {t : ConjEmbedding E B} (x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s))
    (y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f)) (z : Dot (r.comp t) (d.comp e)) :=
  a.toHom z.element⁻¹ * x.element * b.toHom y.element

private abbrev rightParameter {j : ConjEmbedding B A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B} (ell : Dot (b.comp c) (j.comp w))
    (m : Dot (a.comp d) (j.comp v)) (n : Dot (v.comp e) (w.comp f)) :=
  m.element * j.toHom n.element * ell.element⁻¹

end

variable {U : Type*} [Group U]

private def inclusion {K : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup K) : ConjEmbedding (S.map K.subtype) K :=
  ⟨Subgroup.inclusion (Subgroup.map_subtype_le S), ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩

private theorem inclusion_mem {K : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup K) (v : S.map K.subtype) :
    (inclusion S).toHom v ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := v.property
  exact (Subtype.ext he : x = (inclusion S).toHom v) ▸ hx

private theorem inclusion_range {K : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup K) :
    (inclusion S).toHom.range = S := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact inclusion_mem S v
  · intro v hv
    exact ⟨⟨(v : U), ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

private def restrictTo {K L : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (S : Subgroup L)
    (h : a.toHom.range ≤ S) : ConjEmbedding K (S.map L.subtype) :=
  ⟨(L.subtype.comp a.toHom).codRestrict _ (fun x => ⟨a.toHom x, h ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩),
    a.hasRepresentative⟩

private def conjugated {K L : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (p : L) :
    ConjEmbedding K L :=
  ⟨(MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom.comp a.toHom, by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
    refine ⟨(p : U) * s, fun x => ?_⟩
    change (p : U) * (a.toHom x : U) * (p : U)⁻¹ = _
    rw [hs]
    group⟩

private theorem conjugated_range {K L : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (p : L) :
    (conjugated a p).toHom.range = conj p a.toHom.range :=
  (MonoidHom.map_range _ _).symm


end

private abbrev Perm := Equiv.Perm Nat
private abbrev Finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Perm | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev blockSym (X : Finset Nat) : Subgroup Perm :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X))

private abbrev ParabolicPerm (H : Subgroup Perm) :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    H = ⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)

private abbrev Parabolic (H : Subgroup Finitary) := ParabolicPerm (H.map Finitary.subtype)

private theorem parabolicPerm_iff (H : Subgroup Perm) : ParabolicPerm H ↔
    ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∃ (k : Nat) (blocks : Fin k → Finset Nat),
      (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
      (∀ m, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧ H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩
    exact ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, k, blocks, hn, hd, fun m => by simp, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, k, blocks, hn, hd, _, he⟩
    exact ⟨k, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩

private theorem commonRegion_parabolic_conj {H : Subgroup Perm} (hH : ParabolicPerm H)
    (q : Finitary) : ParabolicPerm (conj (q : Perm) H) :=
  (parabolicPerm_iff _).2 (FiniteParabolicClosure.1 H ((parabolicPerm_iff H).1 hH) q)

private theorem parabolic_finite {H : Subgroup Finitary} (hH : Parabolic H) : Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, hblocks⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have hsub : H.map Finitary.subtype ≤ blockSym X := by
    rw [hblocks]
    refine iSup_le fun i σ hs => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
    let σ : Perm := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ
    have moved_mem (x : Nat) (hx : σ x ≠ x) : x ∈ X := by
      by_contra hn
      have hi : x ∉ blocks i := fun hx' => hn (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx'⟩)
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hi)
    have preserves (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · rw [h]
      · have hy : σ (σ x) ≠ σ x := fun hh => h (σ.injective hh)
        exact iff_of_true (moved_mem (σ x) hy) (moved_mem x h)
    exact ⟨σ.subtypePerm preserves, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserves moved_mem⟩
  let _ : Finite (blockSym X) :=
    (Set.finite_range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))).to_subtype
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun h : H => (⟨(h.val : Perm), hsub ⟨h.val, h.property, rfl⟩⟩ : blockSym X))
    (fun _ _ hh => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y : blockSym X => y.val) hh)))

open MackeyDiagrams

private theorem parabolic_embedding {H K : Subgroup Finitary}
    (i : ConjEmbedding H K) (hH : Parabolic H) : Parabolic (i.toHom.range.map K.subtype) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := i.hasRepresentative
  have hr : (i.toHom.range.map K.subtype).map Finitary.subtype =
      conj (q : Perm) (H.map Finitary.subtype) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y.val, ⟨y.val, y.property, rfl⟩, congrArg Finitary.subtype (hq y).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      let x : H := ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨(i.toHom x : Finitary), ⟨i.toHom x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, congrArg Finitary.subtype (hq x)⟩
  show ParabolicPerm _
  rw [hr]
  exact commonRegion_parabolic_conj hH q

private abbrev Vec (X : Type*) := X →₀ Complex

-- A contravariant basis map acts by precomposition on coefficients.
private def Pulls {X Y : Type*} (L : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Vec Y) (y : Y) (x : X) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, L v y = v x

private theorem pulls_single {X Y : Type*} (L : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Vec Y) (y : Y) (x : X)
    (h : ∀ i : X, L (Finsupp.single i 1) y = Finsupp.single i (1 : Complex) x) :
    Pulls L y x := by
  let l := (Finsupp.lapply y : Vec Y →ₗ[Complex] Complex).comp L
  have he : l = (Finsupp.lapply x : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Complex) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro i w
    have hs : Finsupp.single i w = w • Finsupp.single i (1 : Complex) := by
      simp [Finsupp.smul_single]
    rw [hs, map_smul, map_smul]
    exact congrArg (w • ·) (h i)
  exact fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun he v

private theorem pulls_of_single {X Y : Type*} {L : Vec X →ₗ[Complex] Vec Y}
    {forward : X → Y} {x : X} {y : Y} (inv : ∀ i, forward i = y ↔ i = x)
    (h : ∀ i : X, L (Finsupp.single i 1) = Finsupp.single (forward i) 1) :
    Pulls L y x := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  intro i
  rw [h i]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, inv]

private theorem pulls_mixed {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K P) (b : ConjEmbedding H P)
    (d : ConjEmbedding L K) (e : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (p : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b d e)
    (y : ((Word.up d).tensor (.down e)).basis.carrier) :
    Pulls (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b d e p.dot p.finite).eval.toLinearMap
      y (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot y) := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  intro i
  change (Biset.Hom.transfer Complex (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot)
    (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b d e p.dot) p.finite).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single i 1) y = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases h : i = Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b d e p.dot y
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

section Balanced
variable {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
variable {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}

-- The unchanged strand makes the balancing parameter unique at a fixed output
-- representative. Thus no orbit multiplicity is introduced by tensoring a pullback.
private theorem pulls_horizontal_right (L : Biset.Hom Complex X X')
    (free : ∀ (s : Y.carrier) (h : H), Y.act (h, 1) s = s → h = 1)
    {x' : X'.carrier} {x : X.carrier} (hx : Pulls L.toLinearMap x' x) (s : Y.carrier) :
    Pulls (L.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Y)).toLinearMap (X'.pair Y x' s) (X.pair Y x s) := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  refine fun z => Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨i,t⟩ => ?_)
  change (L.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Y)).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y i t) 1)
    (X'.pair Y x' s) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1))
    (Finsupp.single t 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) = Finsupp.single (X.pair Y i t) 1 (X.pair Y x s)
  by_cases ht : ∃ h : H, Y.act (h, 1) t = s
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := ht
    have he : X.pair Y i t = X.pair Y (X.act (1,h) i) s := by
      rw [← hh, Biset.pair_orbit]
    have heval : ∀ v : Vec X'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y v (Finsupp.single s 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) = v x' := by
      apply pulls_single ((Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y).flip (Finsupp.single s 1))
      intro j
      change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (Finsupp.single j 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)
        (X'.pair Y x' s) = _
      rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one]
      have hi : X'.pair Y j s = X'.pair Y x' s ↔ j = x' := by
        constructor
        · intro hp
          obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
          have hk1 := free s k hs
          subst k
          exact (X'.one_act j).symm.trans hk
        · intro hp
          rw [hp]
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
    -- Rechoose the input representative before using the horizontal basis formula.
    have hre := congrArg (fun w => (L.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id Y)).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single w 1) (X'.pair Y x' s)) he
    rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul] at hre
    change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1))
      (Finsupp.single t 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.act (1,h) i) 1))
      (Finsupp.single s 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) at hre
    rw [hre, heval, hx _ , he]
    have hi : X.pair Y (X.act (1,h) i) s = X.pair Y x s ↔ X.act (1,h) i = x := by
      constructor
      · intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        have hk1 := free s k hs
        subst k
        exact (X.one_act _).symm.trans hk
      · intro hp
        rw [hp]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
  · have heval : ∀ v : Vec X'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y v (Finsupp.single t 1) (X'.pair Y x' s) = 0 := by
      have he : (Finsupp.lapply (X'.pair Y x' s) : Vec (X'.tensor Y).carrier →ₗ[Complex] Complex).comp
          ((Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y).flip (Finsupp.single t 1)) = 0 := by
        apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
        intro j r
        change Biset.pairLinear Complex X' Y (Finsupp.single j r) (Finsupp.single t 1)
          (X'.pair Y x' s) = 0
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
        intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun he v
    rw [heval, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
    intro hp
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
    exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩

private theorem pulls_horizontal_left (L : Biset.Hom Complex Y Y')
    (free : ∀ (s : X.carrier) (h : H), X.act (1, h) s = s → h = 1)
    {y' : Y'.carrier} {y : Y.carrier} (hy : Pulls L.toLinearMap y' y) (s : X.carrier) :
    Pulls ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal L).toLinearMap (X.pair Y' s y') (X.pair Y s y) := by
  classical
  apply pulls_single
  refine fun z => Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨t,i⟩ => ?_)
  change ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal L).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y t i) 1)
    (X.pair Y' s y') = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  change Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1)
    (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1)) (X.pair Y' s y') = Finsupp.single (X.pair Y t i) 1 (X.pair Y s y)
  by_cases ht : ∃ h : H, X.act (1, h) t = s
  · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := ht
    have he : X.pair Y t i = X.pair Y s (Y.act (h,1) i) := by
      rw [← hh, Biset.pair_orbit]
    have heval : ∀ v : Vec Y'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single s 1) v (X.pair Y' s y') = v y' := by
      apply pulls_single (Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single s 1))
      intro j
      rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
      have hi : X.pair Y' s j = X.pair Y' s y' ↔ j = y' := by
        constructor
        · intro hp
          obtain ⟨k, hs, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
          have hk1 := free s k hs
          subst k
          exact (Y'.one_act j).symm.trans hk
        · intro hp
          rw [hp]
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
    have hre := congrArg (fun w => ((Biset.Hom.id X).horizontal L).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single w 1) (X.pair Y' s y')) he
    rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul] at hre
    change Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1)
      (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single i 1)) (X.pair Y' s y') =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single s 1)
      (L.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (Y.act (h,1) i) 1)) (X.pair Y' s y') at hre
    rw [hre, heval, hy _ , he]
    have hi : X.pair Y s (Y.act (h,1) i) = X.pair Y s y ↔ Y.act (h,1) i = y := by
      constructor
      · intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, hs, hk⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        have hk1 := free s k hs
        subst k
        exact (Y.one_act _).symm.trans hk
      · intro hp
        rw [hp]
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, hi]
  · have heval : ∀ v : Vec Y'.carrier,
        Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1) v (X.pair Y' s y') = 0 := by
      have he : (Finsupp.lapply (X.pair Y' s y') : Vec (X.tensor Y').carrier →ₗ[Complex] Complex).comp
          (Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1)) = 0 := by
        apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
        intro j r
        change Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y' (Finsupp.single t 1) (Finsupp.single j r)
          (X.pair Y' s y') = 0
        rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
        intro hp
        obtain ⟨k, hk, _⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
        exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact fun v => LinearMap.congr_fun he v
    rw [heval, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right]
    intro hp
    obtain ⟨k, hk, _⟩ := Quotient.exact hp
    exact ht ⟨k, hk⟩

end Balanced
