Bound the support of the evaluated right-input label by the images of its eligible terms. Every image lies in H, so the coefficient at the outside transposition vanishes.

FiniteOrbitSumDiagram.proof:
by
  open MackeyDiagrams FiniteOrbitSumDiagramSupport in
  intro U _ H G α β hα hβ A B a b φ ψ action orbit OrbitIndex orbitSum HomSpace
  classical
  -- Xiao, § 3.4, proof of Proposition 3.3. The endpoint is on archived p. 10
  -- (SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2)
  -- and current published p. 12 (SHA-256 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e).
  -- The registered orbit-basis theorem supplies the first paragraph, including
  -- the singleton criterion. Its existential realization does not specify the
  -- syntax, so the second paragraph computes this particular composite.
  obtain ⟨basis, basisApply, singletonDot, _⟩ := InductionBimoduleOrbitSumBasis H G α β hα hβ
  refine ⟨basis, basisApply, singletonDot, ?_⟩
  intro hfin T j finite p q up down groupElements g finiteOrbit i order dot cup merge dotStep split cap d sumOverH
  let _ : Fintype H := Fintype.ofFinite H
  have sumAsTwists : sumOverH =
      ∑ t : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b t⁻¹ g) (1 : Complex) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    simp only [twist, map_inv, inv_inv]
  have heval (x : B) : d.eval.toLinearMap x.coeff = (x * sumOverH).coeff := by
    -- Both bracketings evaluate by the same sequence of maps. The inserted
    -- unitors and associators type the unchanged wiring.
    rw [sumAsTwists]
    calc
      _ = ((openCup a finite).vertical (orbitTail a b g)).eval.toLinearMap x.coeff := by
        change (Diagram.vertical (Diagram.insertRightUnit p)
          (Diagram.vertical cup (orbitTail a b g))).eval.toLinearMap x.coeff = _
        rfl
      _ = _ := composite_eval a b finite g x
  have hsum : sumOverH = order • orbitSum i :=
    sumAsTwists.trans (sum_inv_twist a b g i.val (Set.Finite.coe_toFinset finiteOrbit))
  have horder : order ≠ 0 := by
    let _ : Nonempty {h : H // action h g = g} := ⟨⟨1, by simp [action]⟩⟩
    exact Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Nat.card_pos.ne'
  refine ⟨isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr horder, fun x => ⟨heval x, congrArg (x * ·) hsum⟩, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change order⁻¹ • d.eval.toLinearMap x.coeff = ((basis i).val x).coeff
  rw [heval, hsum, mul_smul_comm, basisApply]
  change order⁻¹ • (order • (x * orbitSum i).coeff) = (x * orbitSum i).coeff
  rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ horder, one_smul]
FiniteOrbitSumDiagram.support:
namespace FiniteOrbitSumDiagramSupport

open MackeyDiagrams Diagram
open scoped Classical Pointwise

noncomputable section

universe u

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {H G : Subgroup U}

private def twist (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (h : H) (g : G) : G :=
  a.toHom h * g * (b.toHom h)⁻¹

@[instance_reducible] private def twistAction (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) : MulAction H G where
  smul := twist a b
  one_smul g := by
    change twist a b 1 g = g
    simp [twist]
  mul_smul h k g := by
    change twist a b (h * k) g = twist a b h (twist a b k g)
    simp only [twist, map_mul, mul_inv_rev]
    group

private def twistStabilizer (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) : Subgroup H :=
  letI := twistAction a b
  MulAction.stabilizer H g

private theorem coeff_orbitSum (s : Finset G) (z : G) [Decidable (z ∈ s)] :
    (∑ g ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)).coeff z =
      if z ∈ s then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
  split <;> simp_all

private def trivialEmbedding (H : Subgroup U) : ConjEmbedding (⊥ : Subgroup U) H :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun h => by
    have hh : (h : U) = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp h.property
    simp [hh])

private theorem trivial_arg (h : (⊥ : Subgroup U)) : h = 1 :=
  Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp h.property)

private def middleDot (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) :
    Dot (a.comp (trivialEmbedding H)) (b.comp (trivialEmbedding H)) where
  element := g
  intertwines h := by rw [trivial_arg h, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]

-- Specialize the registered reverse-cup formula at 1, with all of H as the
-- transversal. Its pair (t⁻¹,t) uses the paper's parameter t directly.
private theorem cup_single [Fintype H] (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    (reverseCup (R := Complex) (trivialEmbedding H) finite).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) =
      ∑ t : H, Finsupp.single ((Word.up (trivialEmbedding H)).basis.pair
        (Word.down (trivialEmbedding H)).basis t⁻¹ t) 1 := by
  let j := trivialEmbedding H
  have hmem (x : H) : x ∈ j.toHom.range ↔ x = 1 := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
      rw [trivial_arg s, map_one]
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨1, map_one _⟩
  have htrans : ∀ x : H, ∃! t : {t : H // t ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset H)},
      x * t.val⁻¹ ∈ j.toHom.range := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨⟨x, Finset.mem_univ x⟩, (hmem _).2 (mul_inv_cancel x), ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [inv_inv] using inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left ((hmem _).1 ht)
  have adj := (FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction.{u, 0} (⊥ : Subgroup U) H 1 (by
    intro s
    simp [(Subgroup.mem_bot.mp s.property : (s : U) = 1)])).2.2.2.2 finite
  dsimp only at adj
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hcup⟩ := adj
  have he := ((hcup Finset.univ htrans).1 (1 : H)).1
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single] at he
  refine he.trans ?_
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _
  change Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.up j).basis (Word.down j).basis
    (MonoidAlgebra.single ((1 : H) * t⁻¹) (1 : Complex)).coeff
    (MonoidAlgebra.single t (1 : Complex)).coeff =
    Finsupp.single ((Word.up j).basis.pair (Word.down j).basis t⁻¹ t) 1
  rw [one_mul, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    Biset.pairLinear_single Complex (Word.up j).basis (Word.down j).basis t⁻¹ t, one_mul]

private def capPair (H : Subgroup U) (t : H) :
    (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis.carrier :=
  (Word.up (trivialEmbedding H)).basis.pair (Word.down (trivialEmbedding H)).basis t⁻¹ t

private def openCup (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    Diagram Complex (.up a) ((Word.up a).tensor (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H))) :=
  (insertRightUnit (.up a)).vertical
    (.horizontal (.id (.up a)) (.reverseCup (trivialEmbedding H) finite))

private theorem openCup_single [Fintype H] (a : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (x : G) :
    (openCup a finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      ∑ h : H, Finsupp.single
        ((Word.up a).basis.pair (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis x (capPair H h)) 1 := by
  classical
  let p := Word.up a
  have he : (insertRightUnit (R := Complex) p).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (Biset.regular H) x 1) 1 := by
    change (Biset.insertRightUnit p.basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  unfold openCup
  rw [eval_vertical_apply, he, eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, eval_id_apply, cup_single, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro h _
  change Biset.pairLinear Complex p.basis (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis
    (Finsupp.single x 1) (Finsupp.single (capPair H h) 1) = _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single Complex p.basis (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis x (capPair H h),
    one_mul]

private def orbitTail (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H))) (.up b) :=
  let t := trivialEmbedding H
  (unassociate (.up a) (.up t) (.down t)).vertical
    ((horizontal (mergeUp a t) (id (.down t))).vertical
      ((horizontal (upDot (middleDot a b g)) (id (.down t))).vertical
        ((horizontal (splitUp b t) (id (.down t))).vertical
          ((associate (.up b) (.up t) (.down t)).vertical
            ((horizontal (id (.up b)) (multiplicationCap t)).vertical
              (rightUnit (.up b)))))))

private theorem orbitTail_single (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g x : G) (h : H) :
    (orbitTail a b g).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single
      ((Word.up a).basis.pair (reverseCupWord (trivialEmbedding H)).basis x (capPair H h)) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (x * twist a b h⁻¹ g) 1 := by
  let t := trivialEmbedding H
  let p := Word.up a
  let q := Word.up b
  let u := Word.up t
  let v := Word.down t
  let d := middleDot a b g
  let input := Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (u.basis.tensor v.basis) x (u.basis.pair v.basis h⁻¹ h))
    (1 : Complex)
  change (rightUnit q).eval.toLinearMap
    ((horizontal (id q) (multiplicationCap t)).eval.toLinearMap
      ((associate q u v).eval.toLinearMap
        ((horizontal (splitUp b t) (id v)).eval.toLinearMap
          ((horizontal (upDot d) (id v)).eval.toLinearMap
            ((horizontal (mergeUp a t) (id v)).eval.toLinearMap
              ((unassociate p u v).eval.toLinearMap input)))))) = _
  dsimp only [input]
  rw [eval_unassociate_single p u v x h⁻¹ h 1]
  rw [eval_horizontal_single (mergeUp a t) (id v), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
    eval_mergeUp_single a t x h⁻¹ 1, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [eval_horizontal_single (upDot d) (id v), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
    eval_upDot_single d (x * a.toHom h⁻¹) 1, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [eval_horizontal_single (splitUp b t) (id v), one_smul, eval_id_apply,
    eval_splitUp_single b t, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [eval_associate_single q u v, eval_horizontal_single (id q) (multiplicationCap t),
    one_smul, eval_id_apply, eval_multiplicationCap_single t 1 h 1,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, eval_rightUnit_single q]
  change Finsupp.single (1 * (x * a.toHom h⁻¹ * g) * (b.toHom (h⁻¹))⁻¹) (1 * 1 : Complex) = _
  simp [twist, mul_assoc]

-- Orbit-stabilizer identifies the fiber at z with the coset of a chosen
-- preimage. Translating that coset gives exactly the stabilizer of g.
private theorem fiberCard [Fintype H] (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g z : G)
    (hz : z ∈ Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun h : H => twist a b h g = z)).card =
      Nat.card (twistStabilizer a b g) := by
  classical
  let _ := twistAction a b
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hz
  let S := MulAction.stabilizer H g
  let e := MulAction.orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer H g
  let T := Finset.univ.filter fun h : H => twist a b h g = twist a b k g
  have heq (h : H) : h ∈ T ↔ h ∈ k • (S : Set H) := by
    rw [mem_leftCoset_iff]
    change h ∈ T ↔ k⁻¹ * h ∈ S
    rw [← QuotientGroup.eq (s := S)]
    rw [← e.symm.injective.eq_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]
    change h ∈ T ↔ twist a b k g = twist a b h g
    simp [T, eq_comm]
  change T.card = Nat.card S
  rw [← Fintype.card_coe T, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Nat.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight heq).trans (S.leftCosetEquivSubgroup k))

private theorem sum_twist [Fintype H] (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G)
    (s : Finset G) (hs : (s : Set G) = Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    (∑ h : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h g) (1 : Complex)) =
      (Nat.card (twistStabilizer a b g) : Complex) •
        ∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex) := by
  classical
  let S := twistStabilizer a b g
  apply MonoidAlgebra.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro z
  have hc :
      (∑ h : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h g) (1 : Complex)).coeff z =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun h : H => twist a b h g = z).card : Complex) := by
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
      Finsupp.single_apply, Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero]
  rw [hc]
  change _ = (Nat.card S : Complex) * (∑ w ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single w (1 : Complex)).coeff z
  rw [coeff_orbitSum]
  by_cases hz : z ∈ s
  · have hm : z ∈ Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g) :=
      hs ▸ (show z ∈ (s : Set G) from hz)
    rw [ite_eq_left hz, mul_one, fiberCard a b g z hm]
  · have he : (Finset.univ.filter (fun h : H => twist a b h g = z)) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
      intro h _ he
      exact hz (show z ∈ (s : Set G) from hs.symm ▸ ⟨h, he⟩)
    rw [he, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, ite_eq_right hz, mul_zero]

private theorem sum_inv_twist [Fintype H] (a b : ConjEmbedding H G) (g : G)
    (s : Finset G) (hs : (s : Set G) = Set.range (fun h : H => twist a b h g)) :
    (∑ h : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h⁻¹ g) (1 : Complex)) =
      (Nat.card {h : H // twist a b h g = g} : Complex) •
        ∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex) := by
  exact (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.inv H)
    (fun h : H => MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b h g) (1 : Complex))).trans
    (sum_twist a b g s hs)

-- Alphabeta Math, Universal property of M ⊗[R] N, Steps 3.1 and 4.1
-- check balancing and descend to the quotient. Here the shared Biset
-- constructors supply the balance and descent proofs for each map.
-- Step 5.1 determines the descended map on elementary tensors. Here
-- MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear extends the singleton calculation using
-- linearity of the composite and of right multiplication by the fixed sum.
private theorem composite_eval [Fintype H] (a b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (finite : (trivialEmbedding H).toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (g : G)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) :
    ((openCup a finite).vertical (orbitTail a b g)).eval.toLinearMap x.coeff =
      (x * ∑ t : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b t⁻¹ g) (1 : Complex)).coeff := by
  let y := ∑ t : H, MonoidAlgebra.single (twist a b t⁻¹ g) (1 : Complex)
  change ((openCup a finite).vertical (orbitTail a b g)).eval.toLinearMap x.coeff = (x * y).coeff
  induction x using MonoidAlgebra.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, map_add, add_mul, hx, hx']
  | single z r =>
    have hsingle := MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single (R := Complex) z r
    have hr : Finsupp.single z r = r • Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex) := by simp
    have hr' : MonoidAlgebra.single z r = r • MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex) := by simp
    rw [hsingle, hr, map_smul, hr', smul_mul_assoc, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [eval_vertical_apply, openCup_single, map_sum]
    dsimp only [y]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    rw [orbitTail_single, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul]
    rfl

end

  -- evaluated equalities directly. The coordinator's BentVertex.expand
  -- and TrivalentVertex.expand describe the same left-hand composites,

  -- Alphabeta Math, module tensor universal property, Steps 3.1, 4.1 and 5.1.
  -- The shared biset quotient enforces balance over the middle group, and
  -- complex linearization enforces additivity. The suppliers then use
  -- equality on the resulting generators to identify the evaluated maps.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  · -- Multiplication cap has arbitrary index. Its supplier is expressed
    -- using actual conjugators, so recover representatives of both embeddings.
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := α.hasRepresentative
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := γ.hasRepresentative
    have haMem (k : K) : a * (k : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ H :=
      ha k ▸ (α.toHom k).property
    have hgMem (h : H) : g * (h : U) * g⁻¹ ∈ G :=

namespace CurlJoinIntersectionProof

open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped Pointwise

private abbrev finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev U := ↥finitary
private abbrev ambientBlock (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S))
private abbrev blockSym (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup U :=
  Subgroup.comap finitary.subtype (ambientBlock S)
private abbrev blockGroup (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) : Subgroup U :=
  ⨆ S : ↥P, blockSym (S : Finset Nat)
private abbrev partition (T : Finset Nat) (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) : Prop :=
  (∀ S ∈ P, S.Nonempty) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ V ∈ P, S ≠ V → Disjoint S V) ∧
    (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ S ∈ P, x ∈ S)

private theorem uniqueBlock {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {x : Nat} {S V : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ P) (hV : V ∈ P) (hxS : x ∈ S) (hxV : x ∈ V) :
    S = V := by
  by_contra hn
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (h.2.1 S hS V hV hn) hxS hxV

private theorem perm_mem_iff {S : Set Nat} (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, σ x ∈ S) (hi : ∀ x ∈ S, σ⁻¹ x ∈ S) (x : Nat) :
    σ x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ S := by
  refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, h x⟩
  simpa only [Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hi (σ x) hx

private theorem action_of_mem {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {σ : U} (hσ : σ ∈ blockGroup P) :
    (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ S, (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ T, (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x) := by
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun S : ↥P => blockSym (S : Finset Nat))
    (C := fun f : U =>
      (∀ S ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ S, (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ T, (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x)) hσ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro S f hf
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := (show (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) ∈ ambientBlock S from hf)
    rw [← hτ]
    constructor
    · intro V hV x hx
      by_cases he : V = S.val
      · subst V
        exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem τ x).2 hx
      · rwa [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ (fun hs =>
          he (uniqueBlock h hV S.property hx hs))]
    · intro x hx
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ
        (fun hs => hx ((h.2.2 x).2 ⟨S, S.property, hs⟩))
  · exact ⟨fun _ _ _ hx => hx, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  · exact fun f g hf hg =>
      ⟨fun S hS x hx => hf.1 S hS _ (hg.1 S hS x hx),
        fun x hx => show (f : Equiv.Perm Nat) ((g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x) = x by
          rw [hg.2 x hx, hf.2 x hx]⟩

private theorem action_iff {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {σ : U} (hσ : σ ∈ blockGroup P) {S : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ P) (x : Nat) :
    (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ S :=
  perm_mem_iff (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) ((action_of_mem h hσ).1 S hS)
    ((action_of_mem h ((blockGroup P).inv_mem hσ)).1 S hS) x

private theorem mem_ambientSwap {S : Finset Nat} {x y : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) :
    Equiv.swap x y ∈ ambientBlock S :=
  ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩

private theorem ambientBlock_le_finitary (S : Finset Nat) : ambientBlock S ≤ finitary := by
  rintro σ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
  apply mem_closure_isSwap'.mpr
  exact S.finite_toSet.subset (fun x hx => by
    by_contra h
    exact hx ((MulAction.mem_fixedBy).2 (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ h)))

private theorem map_blockGroup (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) :
    (blockGroup P).map finitary.subtype = ⨆ S : ↥P, ambientBlock (S : Finset Nat) := by
  rw [show blockGroup P = ⨆ S : ↥P, blockSym (S : Finset Nat) from rfl, Subgroup.map_iSup]
  congr 1
  funext S
  apply Subgroup.map_comap_eq_self
  rw [Subgroup.range_subtype]
  exact ambientBlock_le_finitary S

-- Alphabeta Math, transpositions generate the symmetric group, Steps 1.1,
-- 2.1 and 3.1 (https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group).
-- The numbered proof expands finite cycles into transpositions and passes
-- to the generated subgroup. For permutations of Nat, apply the checked
-- finite-support swap-closure criterion to the set of genuine internal
-- swaps. The carrier bounds the moved points. Each moved point and its
-- image lie in the same block, so their swap gives the orbit witness.
private theorem ambient_mem_of_action {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P)
    {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat}
    (preserve : ∀ S ∈ P, ∀ x ∈ S, σ x ∈ S)
    (fixes : ∀ x ∉ T, σ x = x) : σ ∈ (blockGroup P).map finitary.subtype := by
  rw [map_blockGroup]
  let swaps : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    {f | ∃ S ∈ P, ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ f = Equiv.swap x y}
  have genuine : ∀ f ∈ swaps, Equiv.Perm.IsSwap f := by
    rintro f ⟨S, hS, x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩
  have hle : Subgroup.closure swaps ≤ ⨆ S : ↥P, ambientBlock (S : Finset Nat) := by
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).2
    rintro f ⟨S, hS, x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
    exact Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨S, hS⟩ : ↥P) (mem_ambientSwap hx hy)
  apply hle
  refine (mem_closure_isSwap genuine).2 ⟨T.finite_toSet.subset ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    by_contra ht
    exact hx ((MulAction.mem_fixedBy).2 (fixes x ht))
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : σ x = x
    · rw [hx]
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit_self x
    · have ht : x ∈ T := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hx (fixes x hn)
      obtain ⟨S, hS, hs⟩ := (h.2.2 x).1 ht
      have hswap : Equiv.swap x (σ x) ∈ Subgroup.closure swaps :=
        Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨S, hS, x, hs, σ x, preserve S hS x hs, Ne.symm hx, rfl⟩
      exact MulAction.mem_orbit_iff.mpr ⟨⟨_, hswap⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩

private theorem blockGroup_finite {T : Finset Nat} {P : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T P) :
    Finite ↥(blockGroup P) := by
  have carrier (σ : blockGroup P) (x : Nat) : (σ.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ T ↔ x ∈ T := by
    rw [h.2.2, h.2.2]
    exact exists_congr fun S => and_congr_right fun hS => action_iff h σ.property hS x
  let restrict (σ : blockGroup P) : Equiv.Perm ↥T :=
    (σ.val : Equiv.Perm Nat).subtypePerm (carrier σ)
  refine Finite.of_injective restrict ?_
  intro σ τ he
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ T
  · exact congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm ↥T => (p ⟨x, hx⟩).val) he
  · rw [(action_of_mem h σ.property).2 x hx, (action_of_mem h τ.property).2 x hx]

private abbrev ambientFamily {ι : Type} (F : ι → Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  ⨆ i, ambientBlock (F i)

private theorem ambient_image {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (F : ι → Finset Nat) :
    (blockGroup (Finset.univ.image F)).map finitary.subtype = ambientFamily F := by
  rw [map_blockGroup]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine iSup_le fun S => ?_
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp S.property
    exact hi ▸ le_iSup (fun i => ambientBlock (F i)) i
  · exact iSup_le fun i => le_iSup (fun S : ↥(Finset.univ.image F) => ambientBlock S)
      ⟨F i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩

-- The registered closure theorem is in ambient permutations, so transfer
-- its join through the injective subtype map from the finitary group.
private theorem join_partition {T : Finset Nat} {P Q : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hp : partition T P) (hq : partition T Q) :
    ∃ R, partition T R ∧ blockGroup P ⊔ blockGroup Q = blockGroup R := by
  classical
  have asIndexed (V : Finset (Finset Nat)) (h : partition T V) :
      ∃ (n : Nat) (F : Fin n → Finset Nat),
        Finset.univ.image F = V ∧
        (∀ i, (F i).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (F i) (F j)) ∧
        (∀ x, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ F i) := by
    let e := (Fintype.equivFin (↥V)).symm
    let F (i : Fin (Fintype.card ↥V)) := (e i).val
    have image : Finset.univ.image F = V := by
      ext S
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => hi ▸ (e i).property,
        fun hs => ⟨e.symm ⟨S, hs⟩, congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply ⟨S, hs⟩)⟩⟩
    refine ⟨Fintype.card ↥V, F, image, fun i => h.1 _ (e i).property, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      exact h.2.1 _ (e i).property _ (e j).property
        (fun he => hij (e.injective (Subtype.ext he)))
    · intro x
      rw [h.2.2]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩
        exact ⟨e.symm ⟨S, hS⟩, by simpa [F] using hxS⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨F i, (e i).property, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨n, F, hFP, hf, hdF, htF⟩ := asIndexed P hp
  obtain ⟨m, E, hEQ, he, hdE, htE⟩ := asIndexed Q hq
  have supplier := FiniteParabolicClosure.2 T (ambientFamily F) (ambientFamily E)
    ⟨n, F, hf, hdF, htF, rfl⟩ ⟨m, E, he, hdE, htE, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k, D, hd, hdD, htD, hjoin⟩ := supplier.2
  let R := Finset.univ.image D
  refine ⟨R, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro S hS
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hS
    exact hd i
  · intro S hS V hV hn
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hS
    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hV
    exact hdD (fun hij => hn (congrArg D hij))
  · intro x
    rw [htD]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨D i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩, hi⟩
    · rintro ⟨S, hs, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
      exact ⟨i, hx⟩
  · apply Subgroup.map_subtype_inj.mp
    rw [Subgroup.map_sup, ← hFP, ← hEQ, ambient_image, ambient_image, ambient_image]
    exact hjoin

private abbrev productSet (A B : Subgroup U) : Set U :=
  Set.image2 (fun x y : U => x * y) (A : Set U) (B : Set U)

private abbrev orbit (J : Subgroup U) (x : Nat) : Set Nat :=
  {y | ∃ j : ↥J, ((j : U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = y}

private theorem product_subset_join (A B : Subgroup U) :
    productSet A B ⊆ (↑(A ⊔ B) : Set U) := by
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
  exact (A ⊔ B).mul_mem ((show A ≤ A ⊔ B from le_sup_left) ha) ((show B ≤ A ⊔ B from le_sup_right) hb)

private theorem block_orbit {T : Finset Nat} {R : Finset (Finset Nat)} (h : partition T R)
    {S : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ R) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) :
    (S : Set Nat) = orbit (blockGroup R) x := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    have hswap := mem_ambientSwap hx (show y ∈ S from hy)
    let u : U := ⟨Equiv.swap x y, ambientBlock_le_finitary S hswap⟩
    exact ⟨⟨u, Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨S, hS⟩ : ↥R) hswap⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact (action_of_mem h j.property).1 S hS x hx

-- A transposition between different parts of both partitions cannot lie in
-- AB. This is the paper's double-coset obstruction at the identity coset.
-- The obstruction is witnessed by one finite cell S ∩ V. A factorization
-- would make b⁻¹ inject that cell into itself while missing x.
private theorem not_cross_swap {T : Finset Nat} {P Q : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hp : partition T P) (hq : partition T Q)
    {S V : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ P) (hV : V ∈ Q)
    {x y : Nat} (hxS : x ∈ S) (hxV : x ∈ V) (hyS : y ∉ S) (hyV : y ∉ V)
    {u : U} (hu : (u : Equiv.Perm Nat) = Equiv.swap x y)
    (hab : u ∈ productSet (blockGroup P) (blockGroup Q)) : False := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, e⟩ := hab
  have hswap (w : Nat) : Equiv.swap x y w =
      (a : Equiv.Perm Nat) ((b : Equiv.Perm Nat) w) :=
    congrArg (fun f : Equiv.Perm Nat => f w)
      (hu.symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val e).symm)
  let cell := S ∩ V
  have pre (z : ↥cell) :
      ((b : Equiv.Perm Nat).symm z.val ∈ cell) ∧ (b : Equiv.Perm Nat).symm z.val ≠ x := by
    obtain ⟨hzS, hzV⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp z.property
    let w := (b : Equiv.Perm Nat).symm z.val
    have bw : (b : Equiv.Perm Nat) w = z.val := (b : Equiv.Perm Nat).apply_symm_apply _
    have hwV : w ∈ V := (action_iff hq hb hV w).mp (bw.symm ▸ hzV)
    have hs : Equiv.swap x y w ∈ S := by
      rw [hswap w, bw]
      exact (action_of_mem hp ha).1 S hS _ hzS
    have hne : w ≠ x := by
      intro h
      rw [h, Equiv.swap_apply_left] at hs
      exact hyS hs
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (b := y) hne (fun h => hyV (h ▸ hwV))] at hs
    exact ⟨Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hs, hwV⟩, hne⟩
  let f (z : ↥cell) : ↥cell := ⟨(b : Equiv.Perm Nat).symm z.val, (pre z).1⟩
  have inj : Function.Injective f := fun z w e =>
    Subtype.ext ((b : Equiv.Perm Nat).symm.injective (congrArg Subtype.val e))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Finite.surjective_of_injective inj ⟨x, Finset.mem_inter.mpr ⟨hxS, hxV⟩⟩
  exact (pre z).2 (congrArg Subtype.val hz)

private theorem block_whole_of_product {T : Finset Nat} {P Q R : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hp : partition T P) (hq : partition T Q) (hr : partition T R)
    (hjoin : blockGroup P ⊔ blockGroup Q = blockGroup R)
    (hprod : productSet (blockGroup P) (blockGroup Q) = (↑(blockGroup R) : Set U))
    {C : Finset Nat} (hC : C ∈ R) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ C) (hxt : x ∈ T) :
    C ∈ P ∪ Q := by
  classical
  have covers (z : Nat) (hz : z ∈ C) {S V : Finset Nat} (hS : S ∈ P) (hV : V ∈ Q)
      (hzS : z ∈ S) (hzV : z ∈ V) (w : Nat) (hw : w ∈ C) : w ∈ S ∨ w ∈ V := by
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    have hswap := mem_ambientSwap hz hw
    let u : U := ⟨Equiv.swap z w, ambientBlock_le_finitary C hswap⟩
    have hu : u ∈ blockGroup R := Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨C, hC⟩ : ↥R) hswap
    have hab : u ∈ productSet (blockGroup P) (blockGroup Q) :=
      hprod.symm ▸ (show u ∈ (↑(blockGroup R) : Set U) from hu)
    exact not_cross_swap hp hq hS hV hzS hzV hn.1 hn.2 rfl hab
  have subsetC {S : Finset Nat} (hxS : x ∈ S)
      (hle : blockSym S ≤ blockGroup R) : S ⊆ C := by
    intro y hy
    have hswap := mem_ambientSwap hxS hy
    let u : U := ⟨Equiv.swap x y, ambientBlock_le_finitary S hswap⟩
    have hy' := (action_of_mem hr (hle (show u ∈ blockSym S from hswap))).1 C hC x hx
    exact (Equiv.swap_apply_left x y) ▸ hy'
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ := (hp.2.2 x).mp hxt
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV⟩ := (hq.2.2 x).mp hxt
  have hSC : S ⊆ C := subsetC hxS (hjoin ▸
    (le_iSup (fun S : ↥P => blockSym S) ⟨S, hS⟩).trans le_sup_left)
  have hVC : V ⊆ C := subsetC hxV (hjoin ▸
    (le_iSup (fun V : ↥Q => blockSym V) ⟨V, hV⟩).trans le_sup_right)
  by_cases hCS : C ⊆ S
  · exact Finset.mem_union_left Q ((Finset.Subset.antisymm hSC hCS) ▸ hS)
  by_cases hCV : C ⊆ V
  · exact Finset.mem_union_right P ((Finset.Subset.antisymm hVC hCV) ▸ hV)
  simp only [Finset.subset_iff, not_forall] at hCS hCV
  obtain ⟨y, hyC, hyS⟩ := hCS
  obtain ⟨z, hzC, hzV⟩ := hCV
  have hyV := (covers x hx hS hV hxS hxV y hyC).resolve_left hyS
  have hzS := (covers x hx hS hV hxS hxV z hzC).resolve_right hzV
  have hyt : y ∈ T := (hr.2.2 y).mpr ⟨C, hC, hyC⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hyW⟩ := (hp.2.2 y).mp hyt
  have hzW : z ∉ W := fun h => hyS ((uniqueBlock hp hW hS h hzS) ▸ hyW)
  exact False.elim ((covers y hyC hW hV hyW hyV z hzC).elim hzW hzV)

private theorem orbit_apply {J : Subgroup U} (j : J) (x : Nat) :
    orbit J ((j.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) x) = orbit J x := by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    exact ⟨g * j, hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    refine ⟨g * j⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change (g.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) ((j.val : Equiv.Perm Nat).symm
      ((j.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) x)) = y
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, hg]

private theorem product_eq_join {T : Finset Nat} {P Q R : Finset (Finset Nat)}
    (hp : partition T P) (hq : partition T Q) (hr : partition T R)
    (hjoin : blockGroup P ⊔ blockGroup Q = blockGroup R) :
    productSet (blockGroup P) (blockGroup Q) = (↑(blockGroup P ⊔ blockGroup Q) : Set U) ↔
      ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ V ∈ P ∪ Q, (V : Set Nat) = orbit (blockGroup P ⊔ blockGroup Q) x := by
  classical
  rw [hjoin]
  constructor
  · intro hab x hx
    obtain ⟨C, hC, hxC⟩ := (hr.2.2 x).mp hx
    exact ⟨C, block_whole_of_product hp hq hr hjoin hab hC hxC hx, block_orbit hr hC hxC⟩
  · intro hall
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm (hjoin ▸ product_subset_join _ _)
    intro u hu
    let J := blockGroup R
    let j : J := ⟨u, hu⟩
    let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := u
    -- On each join orbit, assign σ to the P factor if that orbit is
    -- an entire P-part. The remaining orbits use the Q factor.
    let chooseP : Set Nat := {x | ∃ S ∈ P, (S : Set Nat) = orbit J x}
    have stable (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ chooseP ↔ x ∈ chooseP := by
      change (∃ S ∈ P, (S : Set Nat) = orbit J ((j.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) x)) ↔ _
      exact iff_of_eq (congrArg (fun O => ∃ S ∈ P, (S : Set Nat) = O) (orbit_apply j x))
    let a := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (σ.subtypePerm stable)
    let b := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (σ.subtypePerm (p := fun x => x ∉ chooseP) (fun x => not_congr (stable x)))
    have actA (x : Nat) (hx : x ∈ chooseP) : a x = σ x :=
      Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem _ hx
    have actB (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ chooseP) : b x = σ x :=
      Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem (p := fun y => y ∉ chooseP) _ hx
    have fixA (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ chooseP) : a x = x :=
      Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ hx
    have fixB (x : Nat) (hx : x ∈ chooseP) : b x = x :=
      Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ (not_not_intro hx)
    have hjx (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ orbit J x := ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hself (x : Nat) : x ∈ orbit J x := ⟨1, rfl⟩
    have ma : a ∈ (blockGroup P).map finitary.subtype := by
      apply ambient_mem_of_action hp
      · intro S hS x hxS
        by_cases hx : x ∈ chooseP
        · rw [actA x hx]
          obtain ⟨V, hV, he⟩ := hx
          have hv : x ∈ V := by
            change x ∈ (V : Set Nat)
            rw [he]
            exact hself x
          have hs := uniqueBlock hp hV hS hv hxS
          rw [← hs]
          change σ x ∈ (V : Set Nat)
          rw [he]
          exact hjx x
        · rwa [fixA x hx]
      · intro x hx
        by_cases h : x ∈ chooseP
        · rw [actA x h]
          exact (action_of_mem hr hu).2 x hx
        · exact fixA x h
    have mb : b ∈ (blockGroup Q).map finitary.subtype := by
      apply ambient_mem_of_action hq
      · intro V hV x hxV
        by_cases hx : x ∈ chooseP
        · rwa [fixB x hx]
        · have hxt := (hq.2.2 x).mpr ⟨V, hV, hxV⟩
          obtain ⟨W, hW, he⟩ := hall x hxt
          have hWQ := (Finset.mem_union.mp hW).resolve_left (fun hp => hx ⟨W, hp, he⟩)
          have hw : x ∈ W := by
            change x ∈ (W : Set Nat)
            rw [he]
            exact hself x
          have hv := uniqueBlock hq hWQ hV hw hxV
          rw [actB x hx, ← hv]
          change σ x ∈ (W : Set Nat)
          rw [he]
          exact hjx x
      · intro x hx
        by_cases h : x ∈ chooseP
        · exact fixB x h
        · rw [actB x h]
          exact (action_of_mem hr hu).2 x hx
    obtain ⟨a', ha', hea⟩ := ma
    obtain ⟨b', hb', heb⟩ := mb
    refine ⟨a', ha', b', hb', Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    change (a' : Equiv.Perm Nat) * (b' : Equiv.Perm Nat) = σ
    change (a' : Equiv.Perm Nat) = a at hea
    change (b' : Equiv.Perm Nat) = b at heb
    rw [hea, heb]
    ext x
    change a (b x) = σ x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ chooseP
    · rw [fixB x hx, actA x hx]
    · rw [actB x hx, fixA (σ x) (fun h => hx ((stable x).mp h))]

universe u

-- Count the left cosets aB in AB using their representatives in A.
-- The coset map on A identifies two representatives exactly when the
-- inverse of the first times the second lies in B ∩ A.
private theorem card_product_mul_card_inf {V : Type u} [Group V] (A B : Subgroup V) :
    Nat.card ↑(Set.image2 (fun a b : V => a * b) (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) *
      Nat.card ↥(A ⊓ B) = Nat.card ↥A * Nat.card ↥B := by
  let q : (A ⧸ B.subgroupOf A) → (V ⧸ B) :=
    Quotient.map' Subtype.val (by
      intro x y
      simp only [QuotientGroup.leftRel_eq, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
      exact id)
  have hq : Function.Injective q := by
    intro x y
    refine QuotientGroup.induction_on x (fun a => ?_)
    refine QuotientGroup.induction_on y (fun b => ?_)
    intro e
    change QuotientGroup.mk (s := B) (a : V) = QuotientGroup.mk (b : V) at e
    exact QuotientGroup.eq.mpr ((QuotientGroup.eq (s := B)).mp e)
  let S : Set (V ⧸ B) := QuotientGroup.mk '' (A : Set V)
  have hrange : Set.range q = S := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
      refine QuotientGroup.induction_on c (fun a => ?_)
      exact ⟨a.val, a.property, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk ⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩
  have hcard : Nat.card ↑S = B.relIndex A := by
    rw [← hrange]
    exact (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofInjective q hq)).symm
  have hidx := Subgroup.relIndex_mul_card B A
  rw [inf_comm B A] at hidx
  rw [Set.image2_mul, Subgroup.card_mul_eq_card_subgroup_mul_card_quotient,
    show (QuotientGroup.mk '' (A : Set V) : Set (V ⧸ B)) = S from rfl, hcard,
    mul_assoc, hidx, mul_comm]

private theorem scalar_one_iff (A B : Subgroup U) [Finite ↥(A ⊔ B)] :
    (Nat.card ↑(productSet A B) : Complex) / (Nat.card ↥(A ⊔ B) : Complex) = 1 ↔
      productSet A B = (↑(A ⊔ B) : Set U) := by
  have hJ : (Nat.card ↥(A ⊔ B) : Complex) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.card_pos (α := ↥(A ⊔ B))).ne'
  rw [div_eq_iff hJ, one_mul]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc : Nat.card ↑(productSet A B) = Nat.card ↥(A ⊔ B) := by exact_mod_cast h
    exact Set.eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le (product_subset_join A B) hc.symm.le
      (Set.toFinite _)
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    rfl

private theorem inclusion_index {V : Type u} [Group V] {L H : Subgroup V}
    (d : ConjEmbedding L H) (hle : L ≤ H)
    (hd : d.toHom = Subgroup.inclusion hle) :
    d.toHom.range.index * Nat.card ↥L = Nat.card ↥H := by
  rw [hd]
  have range : (Subgroup.inclusion hle).range = L.subgroupOf H := by
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => hy ▸ y.property, fun hx => ⟨⟨x.val, hx⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [range, ← Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe hle).toEquiv]
  exact Subgroup.index_mul_card _

private theorem index_product {A B H : Subgroup U} [Finite ↥H]
    (a : A ≤ H) (b : B ≤ H)
    (iA iB iI iJ : Nat)
    (eA : iA * Nat.card ↥A = Nat.card ↥H)
    (eB : iB * Nat.card ↥B = Nat.card ↥H)
    (eI : iI * Nat.card ↥(A ⊓ B) = Nat.card ↥H)
    (eJ : iJ * Nat.card ↥(A ⊔ B) = Nat.card ↥H) :
    (iI : Complex) * (iJ : Complex) =
      ((Nat.card ↑(productSet A B) : Complex) / (Nat.card ↥(A ⊔ B) : Complex)) *
        ((iA : Complex) * (iB : Complex)) := by
  let _ : Finite ↥A := Finite.of_injective _ (Subgroup.inclusion_injective a)
  let _ : Finite ↥B := Finite.of_injective _ (Subgroup.inclusion_injective b)
  let _ : Finite ↥(A ⊓ B) := Finite.of_injective _
    (Subgroup.inclusion_injective (inf_le_left.trans a : A ⊓ B ≤ H))
  let _ : Finite ↥(A ⊔ B) := Finite.of_injective _ (Subgroup.inclusion_injective (sup_le a b))
  have nz (L : Subgroup U) [Finite ↥L] : (Nat.card ↥L : Complex) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.card_pos (α := ↥L)).ne'
  have index (L : Subgroup U) [Finite ↥L] (i : Nat) (e : i * Nat.card ↥L = Nat.card ↥H) :
      (i : Complex) = (Nat.card ↥H : Complex) / (Nat.card ↥L : Complex) :=
    (eq_div_iff (nz L)).mpr (by exact_mod_cast e)
  have hp := card_product_mul_card_inf A B
  have hp' : (Nat.card ↑(productSet A B) : Complex) * (Nat.card ↥(A ⊓ B) : Complex) =
      (Nat.card ↥A : Complex) * (Nat.card ↥B : Complex) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  rw [index A iA eA, index B iB eB, index (A ⊓ B) iI eI, index (A ⊔ B) iJ eJ]
  field_simp [nz A, nz B, nz (A ⊓ B), nz (A ⊔ B)]
  apply (div_eq_iff (nz (A ⊓ B))).2
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using congrArg
    (fun z : Complex => (Nat.card ↥H : Complex)^2 * z) hp'.symm

private noncomputable abbrev eval {V : Type u} [Group V] {K H : Subgroup V} {p q : Word K H}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  d.interpret.eval

private noncomputable abbrev indexedCurls {V : Type u} [Group V] {L H G : Subgroup V}
    (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (d : ConjEmbedding L H) (f : Subgroup.FiniteIndex d.toHom.range) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (Word.up a) (Word.up a) ×
    LabelledDrawing Complex (Word.down a) (Word.down a) :=
  (.vertical (.trivalent (.upToUpDown a d f)) (.trivalent (.upDownToUp a d)),
   .vertical (.trivalent (.downToUpDown a d f)) (.trivalent (.upDownToDown a d)))

-- ParabolicCurlsFromBlockRefinements computes a refinement ratio using
-- a shared carrier for H and the internal image. Here H can come from
-- a separate carrier, so use ReidemeisterOne, the checked declaration
-- used by that supplier for its direct curls. Its hypotheses are the
-- two conjugators and finite index of the internal image.
private theorem inclusion_curls {V : Type u} [Group V] {L H G : Subgroup V}
    (α : V) (hα : ∀ x : H, α * (x : V) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (d : ConjEmbedding L H) (hle : L ≤ H) (hd : d.toHom = Subgroup.inclusion hle)
    (f : Subgroup.FiniteIndex d.toHom.range) :
    let a := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let c := indexedCurls a d f
    let n : Complex := d.toHom.range.index
    eval c.1 = (Biset.Hom.id (Word.up a).basis).scale n ∧
      eval c.2 = (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).scale n := by
  let hδ : ∀ x : L, (1 : V) * (x : V) * 1⁻¹ ∈ H := fun x => by
    simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using hle x.property
  have ed : d = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 hδ := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    rw [hd]
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_apply, Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]
  subst d
  have ev := ReidemeisterOne L H G 1 α hδ hα
  exact ⟨ev.1 f, ev.2.2.2 f⟩

private theorem scaled_id_comp {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    (X : Biset K H) (r s : Complex) :
    ((Biset.Hom.id X).scale r).vertical ((Biset.Hom.id X).scale s) =
      (Biset.Hom.id X).scale (s * r) := by
  rw [Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change r • (s • x) = (s * r) • x
  rw [smul_smul, mul_comm r s]

private theorem scaled_id_scale {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    (X : Biset K H) (r s : Complex) :
    ((Biset.Hom.id X).scale r).scale s = (Biset.Hom.id X).scale (s * r) := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext

by

  have hn : 1 ≤ n := hm.trans hmn
  have hcut : n < n + m := by omega
  -- Xiao, §7.3 and Example 7.4 (archived pp. 30–31, revised published
  -- pp. 32–33). Alphabeta Math's §7.2 steps 1–2 split the ordered
  -- row blocks and match the ordered column pieces at the matrix sizes.
  -- The registered standard-representative theorem uses the matrix
  -- classification to certify §7.3's reverse-pairing recursion.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-double-cosets
  -- Here both cuts are n. Positivity of m gives nonempty parent blocks,
  -- and m ≤ n identifies the supplier's swap bound with m.
  have standard := StandardTwoBlockRepresentatives (n + m) n n hn hcut hn hcut
  dsimp only at standard
  generalize hbound : Nat.min (Nat.min n n) (n + m - Nat.max n n) = bound at standard
  have hbound' : bound = m := hbound.symm.trans (by
    simp only [Nat.min_self, Nat.max_self, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.min_eq_right hmn])
  clear hbound
  subst bound
  simp only [Nat.min_self, Nat.max_self] at standard
  obtain ⟨left, right, σ, hlabels, hzero, hsucc, _, hbij, _, hcells⟩ := standard
  refine ⟨left, right, σ, hlabels, hzero, hsucc, hbij, ?_⟩
  -- Each specified swap removes n-j from the first-block image and adds
  -- n+j+1. Keep the finite carrier and interval filters symbolic.
  have himage (i : Fin (m + 1)) (x : ↥X) :
      ((σ i).symm x).val ≤ n ↔ x.val ≤ n - i.val ∨ (n < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n + i.val) := by
    induction i using Fin.induction generalizing x with
    | zero =>
        rw [hzero]
        change x.val ≤ n ↔ x.val ≤ n - 0 ∨ (n < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n + 0)
        omega
    | succ j ih =>
        rw [hsucc]
        have hj := j.isLt
        exact equalTwoBlockSwapStep (by omega) (left j) (right j)

  have hkₙ : k ≤ n := hk.trans hmn

    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr

    change x ∈ equalTwoBlockInterval (n + m) (n + 1) (n + m) at hy
    have h₁ := (equalTwoBlockMemInterval.mp hx).2
    have h₂ := (equalTwoBlockMemInterval.mp hy).1

  have h01' : C 0 1 = interval (n - k + 1) n := h01
  have h10' : C 1 0 = interval (n + 1) (n + k) := h10
  have h11' : C 1 1 = interval (n + k + 1) (n + m) := h11

  have hs00' : (C 0 0).card = n - k := by
    change ((C 0 0).card : Int) = (n : Int) - (k : Int) at hs00
    omega
  have hs01' : (C 0 1).card = k := by
    change ((C 0 1).card : Int) = (n : Int) - ((n : Int) - (k : Int)) at hs01
    omega
  have hs10' : (C 1 0).card = k := by
    change ((C 1 0).card : Int) = (n : Int) - ((n : Int) - (k : Int)) at hs10
    omega
  have hs11' : (C 1 1).card = m - k := by
    change ((C 1 1).card : Int) =
      ((n + m : Nat) : Int) - (n : Int) - (n : Int) + ((n : Int) - (k : Int)) at hs11
    omega

  -- group extends to the identity, so adjoining it adds a trivial factor.
  have hAll : L = ⨆ p : Fin 2 × Fin 2, blockSym (C p.1 p.2) :=

private abbrev equalTwoBlockFactor {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A : Finset α) :
    Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : α => x ∈ A))

private theorem equalTwoBlockAllFactors {α ι : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (A : ι → Finset α) :
    (⨆ p : {p : ι // (A p).Nonempty}, equalTwoBlockFactor (A p.val)) =
      ⨆ p, equalTwoBlockFactor (A p) := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun p => le_iSup (fun i => equalTwoBlockFactor (A i)) p.val
  · apply iSup_le
    intro p
    by_cases hp : (A p).Nonempty
    · exact le_iSup (fun i : {i : ι // (A i).Nonempty} =>
        equalTwoBlockFactor (A i.val)) ⟨p, hp⟩
    · apply le_trans ?_ bot_le
      rintro g ⟨f, rfl⟩
      apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr (Equiv.ext fun x => ?_)
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f (fun hx => hp ⟨x, hx⟩)

private noncomputable def equalTwoBlockProduct {α ι : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι]
    (A : ι → Finset α) (hA : Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (A i) (A j)) :
    ↥(⨆ i, equalTwoBlockFactor (A i)) ≃* ((i : ι) → Equiv.Perm ↥(A i)) := by
  let extend (i : ι) : Equiv.Perm ↥(A i) →* Equiv.Perm α := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype
  have fixOutside (i : ι) (f : Equiv.Perm ↥(A i)) (x : α) (hx : x ∉ A i) :
      extend i f x = x := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f hx
  have commute : Pairwise fun i j => ∀ f g, Commute (extend i f) (extend j g) := by
    intro i j hij f g
    apply Equiv.Perm.Disjoint.commute
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A i
    · exact Or.inr (fixOutside j g x (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hA hij) hx))
    · exact Or.inl (fixOutside i f x hx)
  have independent : iSupIndep fun i => (extend i).range := by
    intro i
    rw [disjoint_iff_inf_le]
    rintro g ⟨⟨f, rfl⟩, hg⟩
    apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr (Equiv.ext fun x => ?_)
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A i
    · have fixes : (⨆ j, ⨆ _ : j ≠ i, (extend j).range) ≤
          MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm α) x := by
        refine iSup_le fun j => iSup_le fun hji => ?_
        rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
        exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mpr
          (fixOutside j u x (Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hA hji.symm) hx))
      exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (fixes hg)
    · exact fixOutside i f x hx
  let extendAll := MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod extend commute
  have hRange : extendAll.range = ⨆ i, equalTwoBlockFactor (A i) :=
    MonoidHom.noncommPiCoprod_range extend
  have hInj : Function.Injective extendAll :=
    MonoidHom.injective_noncommPiCoprod_of_iSupIndep extend independent
      (fun _ => Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_injective)
  exact (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hRange.symm).trans (MonoidHom.ofInjective hInj).symm

private theorem equalTwoBlockSupPair {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] (f : Fin 2 → α) :
    (⨆ r, f r) = f 0 ⊔ f 1 := by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le ?_) (sup_le (le_iSup f 0) (le_iSup f 1))
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · exact le_sup_left
  · exact le_sup_right

private def equalTwoBlockPair (P : Fin 2 → Type*) [∀ i, Mul (P i)] :
    ((i : Fin 2) → P i) ≃* P 0 × P 1 where
  toEquiv := piFinTwoEquiv P
  map_mul' _ _ := rfl

private def equalTwoBlockRowOrder (P : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Type*)
    [∀ i j, MulOneClass (P i j)] :
    ((p : Fin 2 × Fin 2) → P p.1 p.2) ≃* P 0 0 × P 0 1 × P 1 0 × P 1 1 := by
  let curry : ((p : Fin 2 × Fin 2) → P p.1 p.2) ≃* ((i j : Fin 2) → P i j) :=
    { toFun := fun f i j => f (i, j)
      invFun := fun f p => f p.1 p.2
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  exact curry.trans ((equalTwoBlockPair _).trans
    (((equalTwoBlockPair _).prodCongr (equalTwoBlockPair _)).trans MulEquiv.prodAssoc))

private abbrev equalTwoBlockInterval (N l h : Nat) : Finset ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N) :=
  Finset.filter (fun x => l ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ h) Finset.univ

private theorem equalTwoBlockMemInterval {N l h : Nat} {x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N)} :
    x ∈ equalTwoBlockInterval N l h ↔ l ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ h := by
  simp [equalTwoBlockInterval]

private theorem equalTwoBlockSwapStep {N n j : Nat} (hj : j < n)
    (a b : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N)) (ha : a.val = n - j) (hb : b.val = n + j + 1)
    (f : Equiv.Perm ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N))
    (hf : ∀ x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N), (f.symm x).val ≤ n ↔
      x.val ≤ n - j ∨ (n < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n + j))
    (x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N)) :
    ((Equiv.swap a b * f).symm x).val ≤ n ↔
      x.val ≤ n - (j + 1) ∨ (n < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n + (j + 1)) := by
  change (f.symm (Equiv.swap a b x)).val ≤ n ↔ _
  rw [hf, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  split_ifs with hx hy
  · subst x
    omega
  · subst x
    omega
  · have hx' : x.val ≠ a.val := fun h => hx (Subtype.ext h)
    have hy' : x.val ≠ b.val := fun h => hy (Subtype.ext h)
    omega

private abbrev equalTwoBlockPartition (N n : Nat) (r : Fin 2) :
    Finset ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N) :=
  if r = 0 then equalTwoBlockInterval N 1 n else equalTwoBlockInterval N (n + 1) N

private theorem equalTwoBlockCellIntervals {N n k : Nat} (hk : k ≤ n)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N))
    (hσ : ∀ x : ↥(Finset.Icc 1 N), (σ.symm x).val ≤ n ↔
      x.val ≤ n - k ∨ (n < x.val ∧ x.val ≤ n + k)) :
    let C := fun r c => equalTwoBlockPartition N n r ∩
      (equalTwoBlockPartition N n c).map σ.toEmbedding
    C 0 0 = equalTwoBlockInterval N 1 (n - k) ∧
    C 0 1 = equalTwoBlockInterval N (n - k + 1) n ∧
    C 1 0 = equalTwoBlockInterval N (n + 1) (n + k) ∧
    C 1 1 = equalTwoBlockInterval N (n + k + 1) N := by
  intro C
  have first : equalTwoBlockPartition N n 0 = equalTwoBlockInterval N 1 n := rfl
  have second : equalTwoBlockPartition N n 1 = equalTwoBlockInterval N (n + 1) N := rfl
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    ext x <;>
    obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property <;>
    obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (σ.symm x).property <;>
    have hcompl : n + 1 ≤ (σ.symm x).val ↔ ¬ (σ.symm x).val ≤ n := by omega
  all_goals
    simp only [C, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_map_equiv, first, second,
      equalTwoBlockMemInterval, hcompl, hσ x]
    omega

private theorem equalTwoBlockCellsDisjoint {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (B : Fin 2 → Finset α) (hB : Disjoint (B 0) (B 1)) (σ : Equiv.Perm α) :
    Pairwise (fun p q : Fin 2 × Fin 2 =>
      Disjoint (B p.1 ∩ (B p.2).map σ.toEmbedding) (B q.1 ∩ (B q.2).map σ.toEmbedding)) := by
  have hd : Pairwise (fun r c => Disjoint (B r) (B c)) := by
    intro r c hrc
    fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c
    · exact (hrc rfl).elim
    · exact hB
    · exact hB.symm
    · exact (hrc rfl).elim
  intro p q hpq
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hy
  obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hx
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := Finset.mem_inter.mp hy
  by_cases h : p.1 = q.1
  · have h' : p.2 ≠ q.2 := fun h₂ => hpq (Prod.ext h h₂)
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd h') (Finset.mem_map_equiv.mp hx₂)
      (Finset.mem_map_equiv.mp hy₂)
  · exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd h) hx₁ hy₁

private theorem sharedRestriction_compose_transport {U : Type*} [Group U]
    {K G : Subgroup U} {u v v' w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G}
    (h : v = v') (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u v)

    MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose
      (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u m) D h)
      (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex m w) E h) =
    MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose D E := by
  cases h
  rfl

private abbrev sharedRestriction_blockSym (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S))

private abbrev sharedRestriction_Parabolic (J : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    J = ⨆ i, sharedRestriction_blockSym (blocks i)

private def sharedRestriction_swaps (S : Finset Nat) : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  {σ | ∃ x ∈ S, ∃ y ∈ S, x ≠ y ∧ σ = Equiv.swap x y}

private theorem sharedRestriction_block_generated (S : Finset Nat) :
    sharedRestriction_blockSym S = Subgroup.closure (sharedRestriction_swaps S) := by
  let extend := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)
  -- Alphabeta Math, "Every finite permutation is a product of transpositions",
  -- steps 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1. Apply Mathlib's finite generation theorem on the
  -- block subtype, then identify the extended generators by their endpoints.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
  have generators : extend '' {σ | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ} = sharedRestriction_swaps S := by
    ext σ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, x.property, y, y.property, fun h => hxy (Subtype.ext h),
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq x y⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy, rfl⟩
      let x' : ↥S := ⟨x, hx⟩
      let y' : ↥S := ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨Equiv.swap x' y', ⟨x', y', fun h => hxy (congrArg Subtype.val h), rfl⟩,
        Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq x' y'⟩
  rw [← generators, ← MonoidHom.map_closure, Equiv.Perm.closure_isSwap, Subgroup.map_top]

private theorem sharedRestriction_fixes_outside {J : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)}
    (hJ : sharedRestriction_Parabolic J) :
    ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∀ (x : Nat), x ∉ X → ∀ σ ∈ J, σ x = x := by
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, rfl⟩ := hJ
  classical
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, fun x hx σ hσ => ?_⟩
  have hle : (⨆ i, sharedRestriction_blockSym (blocks i)) ≤
      MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm Nat) x := by
    apply iSup_le
    rintro i _ ⟨τ, rfl⟩
    exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ
      (fun hi => hx (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hi⟩))
  exact hle hσ

private theorem sharedRestriction_conj_le_generated
    {J K : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} (hK : sharedRestriction_Parabolic K)
    (v : Equiv.Perm Nat)
    (h : K.map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom ≤ J) :
    K.map (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom ≤
      Subgroup.closure {σ | σ ∈ J ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ} := by
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, rfl⟩ := hK
  rw [Subgroup.map_iSup] at h ⊢
  apply iSup_le
  intro i
  have hi := (le_iSup (fun j => (sharedRestriction_blockSym (blocks j)).map
    (MulAut.conj v).toMonoidHom) i).trans h
  rw [sharedRestriction_block_generated, MonoidHom.map_closure]
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
  rintro σ ⟨τ, hτ, rfl⟩
  have inJ := hi ⟨τ, (sharedRestriction_block_generated (blocks i)).symm ▸
    Subgroup.subset_closure hτ, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨x, _, y, _, hxy, rfl⟩ := hτ
  exact Subgroup.subset_closure
    ⟨inJ, v x, v y, fun he => hxy (v.injective he), (Equiv.swap_apply_apply v x y).symm⟩

private theorem sharedRestriction_parabolic_of_swaps {J : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)}
    (X : Finset Nat) (fixes : ∀ x, x ∉ X → ∀ σ ∈ J, σ x = x)
    (generated : Subgroup.closure {σ | σ ∈ J ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ} = J) :
    sharedRestriction_Parabolic J := by
  classical
  -- The binary join supplier requires two partitions of a common carrier.
  -- For a whole family, use the orbits directly on the finite carrier of G.
  -- Alphabeta Math's adjacent-transposition proof, steps 1.1 and 2.1, uses
  -- endpoint swaps along consecutive letters. Here the swap-closure orbit
  -- criterion supplies endpoint swaps in the orbits of J.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-adjacent-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
  let rel : Setoid ↥X := (MulAction.orbitRel J Nat).comap Subtype.val
  let Class := Quotient rel
  let cls : ↥X → Class := Quotient.mk rel
  let block (c : Class) : Finset Nat :=
    X.filter (fun x => ∃ hx : x ∈ X, cls ⟨x, hx⟩ = c)
  have memBlock {x : Nat} {c : Class} :
      x ∈ block c ↔ ∃ hx : x ∈ X, cls ⟨x, hx⟩ = c := by
    change x ∈ X.filter (fun y => ∃ hy : y ∈ X, cls ⟨y, hy⟩ = c) ↔ _
    rw [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨And.right, fun h => ⟨h.choose, h⟩⟩
  have nonempty (c : Class) : (block c).Nonempty := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn c fun x => ?_
    exact ⟨x, memBlock.mpr ⟨x.property, rfl⟩⟩
  have disjoint : Pairwise (fun c d => Disjoint (block c) (block d)) := by
    intro c d hcd
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hx hy
    obtain ⟨_, hc⟩ := memBlock.mp hx
    obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := memBlock.mp hy
    exact hcd (hc.symm.trans hd)
  have swap_in (c : Class) {x y : Nat} (hx : x ∈ block c) (hy : y ∈ block c) :
      Equiv.swap x y ∈ J := by
    obtain ⟨hx, hxc⟩ := memBlock.mp hx
    obtain ⟨hy, hyc⟩ := memBlock.mp hy
    have hxy : rel ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ := Quotient.exact (hxc.trans hyc.symm)
    change MulAction.orbitRel J Nat x y at hxy
    rw [MulAction.orbitRel_apply] at hxy
    have hs : ∀ σ ∈ {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | σ ∈ J ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ},
        Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ := fun _ hσ => hσ.2
    rw [← generated] at hxy ⊢
    exact (swap_mem_closure_isSwap hs).mpr hxy
  have allBlocks : J = ⨆ c, sharedRestriction_blockSym (block c) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← generated]
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro σ ⟨hσ, ⟨x, y, hxy, rfl⟩⟩
      have hx : x ∈ X := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hxy ((Equiv.swap_apply_left x y).symm.trans (fixes x hn _ hσ)).symm
      have hy : y ∈ X := by
        by_contra hn
        exact hxy ((Equiv.swap_apply_right x y).symm.trans (fixes y hn _ hσ))
      have eqClass : cls ⟨x, hx⟩ = cls ⟨y, hy⟩ := by
        apply Quotient.sound
        change MulAction.orbitRel J Nat x y
        exact MulAction.orbitRel_apply.mpr ⟨⟨Equiv.swap x y, hσ⟩, Equiv.swap_apply_right x y⟩
      let c := cls ⟨y, hy⟩
      have hxc : x ∈ block c := memBlock.mpr ⟨hx, eqClass⟩
      have hyc : y ∈ block c := memBlock.mpr ⟨hy, rfl⟩
      exact (le_iSup (fun d => sharedRestriction_blockSym (block d)) c)
        ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨x, hxc⟩ ⟨y, hyc⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩
    · apply iSup_le
      intro c
      rw [sharedRestriction_block_generated]
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro σ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, _, rfl⟩
      exact swap_in c hx hy
  let _ : Fintype Class := Fintype.ofFinite Class
  let e := (Fintype.equivFin Class).symm
  refine ⟨Fintype.card Class, block ∘ e, fun i => nonempty (e i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun i j hij => disjoint (fun h => hij (e.injective h))
  · exact allBlocks.trans (e.iSup_comp (g := fun c => sharedRestriction_blockSym (block c))).symm

external.usage: Proposition 8.4. Generate the full permutation group of each finite block subtype by genuine swaps before extending them to permutations of Nat.
Proposition 8.4. Every generator of the ambient join is a genuine swap. Two points in the same orbit therefore have their swap in the join, giving the full symmetric group on each orbit block.
Proposition 8.4. Extending a swap in a finite block subtype gives the swap of its ambient endpoints. This identifies the block generators and puts each join generator in its orbit block subgroup.
Proposition 8.4. Conjugation sends a genuine swap to the swap of the two transported distinct endpoints. This checks the generator hypothesis on the join of conjugate parabolic images.
