namespace MoritaCoherence

abbrev Structure (B A : RingCat.{u}) (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) := Bimodule.{u,u,u}.1 B A M
abbrev Bimod (B A : RingCat.{u}) := Sigma (Structure B A)

variable {A B C D E : RingCat.{u}}

abbrev left (M : Bimod B A) := M.2.1.smul
abbrev right (M : Bimod B A) (a : A) := M.2.2.val.smul (MulOpposite.op a)

private theorem act_comm (M : Bimod B A) (b : B) (a : A) (m : M.1) :
    right M a (left M b m) = left M b (right M a m) :=
  M.2.2.property.smul_comm (MulOpposite.op a) b m

private def leftHom (M : Bimod B A) (b : B) : AddMonoidHom M.1 M.1 :=
  letI : Module B M.1 := M.2.1
  DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom M.1 b

private def rightHom (M : Bimod B A) (a : A) : AddMonoidHom M.1 M.1 :=
  letI : Module (MulOpposite A) M.1 := M.2.2.val
  DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom M.1 (MulOpposite.op a)

abbrev Equivariant (M N : Bimod B A) (f : M.1 → N.1) :=
  (∀ (b : B) (m : M.1), f (left M b m) = left N b (f m)) ∧
  (∀ (a : A) (m : M.1), f (right M a m) = right N a (f m))

abbrev Hom (M N : Bimod B A) := { f : AddMonoidHom M.1 N.1 // Equivariant M N f }
abbrev Iso (M N : Bimod B A) := { e : AddEquiv M.1 N.1 // Equivariant M N e }

private def isoHom {M N : Bimod B A} (e : Iso M N) : Hom M N :=
  ⟨e.val.toAddMonoidHom, e.property⟩

private def idMap (M : Bimod B A) : Hom M M :=
  ⟨AddMonoidHom.id M.1, ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩⟩

private def comp {M N P : Bimod B A} (g : Hom N P) (f : Hom M N) : Hom M P :=
  ⟨g.val.comp f.val,
    ⟨fun b m => (congrArg g.val (f.property.1 b m)).trans (g.property.1 b (f.val m)),
     fun a m => (congrArg g.val (f.property.2 a m)).trans (g.property.2 a (f.val m))⟩⟩

private theorem comp_apply {M N P : Bimod B A} (g : Hom N P) (f : Hom M N) (x : M.1) :
    (comp g f).val x = g.val (f.val x) := rfl

private noncomputable abbrev regular (A : RingCat.{u}) : Bimod A A :=
  ⟨AddCommGrpCat.of A, (Bimodule.{u,u,u}.2.1 A).val⟩

private theorem regular_left (b x : A) : left (regular A) b x = b * x :=
  (Bimodule.{u,u,u}.2.1 A).property.1 b x

private theorem regular_right (a x : A) : right (regular A) a x = x * a :=
  (Bimodule.{u,u,u}.2.1 A).property.2 x a

private def IsBalanced (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (T : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (t : G.1 → F.1 → T) :=
  (∀ (g g' : G.1) (f : F.1), t (g + g') f = t g f + t g' f) ∧
  (∀ (g : G.1) (f f' : F.1), t g (f + f') = t g f + t g f') ∧
  (∀ (b : B) (g : G.1) (f : F.1), t (right G b g) f = t g (left F b f))

/- F5 and the route's explicit quotient. Commutativity is imposed alongside
   the two additivity relations and balance, so the free group supplies an
   actual lift without choosing a lift from an existence proposition. -/
private def relation (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (x y : FreeAddGroup (Prod G.1 F.1)) :=
  let gen := fun (g : G.1) (f : F.1) => FreeAddGroup.of (g, f)
  (∃ p q : FreeAddGroup (Prod G.1 F.1), x = p + q ∧ y = q + p) ∨
  (∃ (g g' : G.1) (f : F.1), x = gen (g + g') f ∧ y = gen g f + gen g' f) ∨
  (∃ (g : G.1) (f f' : F.1), x = gen g (f + f') ∧ y = gen g f + gen g f') ∨
  (∃ (b : B) (g : G.1) (f : F.1), x = gen (right G b g) f ∧ y = gen g (left F b f))

private def congruence (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) := addConGen (relation G F)

private def underlying (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) : AddCommGrpCat.{u} :=
  let c := congruence G F
  letI : AddCommGroup c.Quotient :=
    { AddCon.addGroup c with
      add_comm := fun x y => Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y fun p q =>
        Quotient.sound (s := c.toSetoid) (AddConGen.Rel.of _ _ (Or.inl ⟨p, q, rfl, rfl⟩)) }
  AddCommGrpCat.of c.Quotient

private def pure (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) : underlying G F :=
  Quotient.mk (congruence G F).toSetoid (FreeAddGroup.of (g, f))

private theorem pure_add_left (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (g g' : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    pure G F (g + g') f = pure G F g f + pure G F g' f :=
  Quotient.sound (s := (congruence G F).toSetoid)
    (AddConGen.Rel.of _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨g, g', f, rfl, rfl⟩)))

private theorem pure_add_right (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (g : G.1) (f f' : F.1) :
    pure G F g (f + f') = pure G F g f + pure G F g f' :=
  Quotient.sound (s := (congruence G F).toSetoid)
    (AddConGen.Rel.of _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨g, f, f', rfl, rfl⟩))))

private theorem pure_balance (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (b : B) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    pure G F (right G b g) f = pure G F g (left F b f) :=
  Quotient.sound (s := (congruence G F).toSetoid)
    (AddConGen.Rel.of _ _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨b, g, f, rfl, rfl⟩))))

private def pureLeft (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (f : F.1) :
    AddMonoidHom G.1 (underlying G F) :=
  AddMonoidHom.mk' (fun g => pure G F g f) (fun g g' => pure_add_left G F g g' f)

private def pureRight (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (g : G.1) :
    AddMonoidHom F.1 (underlying G F) :=
  AddMonoidHom.mk' (pure G F g) (pure_add_right G F g)

private theorem pure_balanced (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    IsBalanced G F (underlying G F) (pure G F) :=
  ⟨pure_add_left G F, pure_add_right G F, pure_balance G F⟩

private def lift (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (T : AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (t : G.1 → F.1 → T) (ht : IsBalanced G F T t) :
    AddMonoidHom (underlying G F) T := by
  let l : AddMonoidHom (FreeAddGroup (Prod G.1 F.1)) T :=
    FreeAddGroup.lift (fun p => t p.1 p.2)
  have he (g : G.1) (f : F.1) : l (FreeAddGroup.of (g, f)) = t g f :=
    FreeAddGroup.lift_apply_of
  refine AddCon.lift (congruence G F) l (AddCon.addConGen_le.2 ?_)
  intro x y h
  change l x = l y
  rcases h with ⟨p, q, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨g, g', f, rfl, rfl⟩ |
    ⟨g, f, f', rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, g, f, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rw [map_add, map_add, add_comm]
  · simpa only [map_add, he] using ht.1 g g' f
  · simpa only [map_add, he] using ht.2.1 g f f'
  · simpa only [he] using ht.2.2 b g f

private theorem lift_pure (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (T : AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (t : G.1 → F.1 → T) (ht : IsBalanced G F T t) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    lift G F T t ht (pure G F g f) = t g f := by
  change FreeAddGroup.lift (fun p : Prod G.1 F.1 => t p.1 p.2)
    (FreeAddGroup.of (g, f)) = t g f
  exact FreeAddGroup.lift_apply_of

private theorem tensor_ext {T : Type*} [AddMonoid T] {G : Bimod C B} {F : Bimod B A}
    (s t : AddMonoidHom (underlying G F) T)
    (h : ∀ g f, s (pure G F g f) = t (pure G F g f)) : s = t := by
  let q : AddMonoidHom (FreeAddGroup (Prod G.1 F.1)) (underlying G F) :=
    (congruence G F).mk'
  have eq : s.comp q = t.comp q :=
    FreeAddGroup.ext_hom _ _ (fun p => h p.1 p.2)
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  exact Quotient.inductionOn x (fun w => DFunLike.congr_fun eq w)

private theorem lift_unique (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (T : AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (t : G.1 → F.1 → T) (ht : IsBalanced G F T t) :
    ∃! l : AddMonoidHom (underlying G F) T, ∀ g f, l (pure G F g f) = t g f :=
  ⟨lift G F T t ht, lift_pure G F T t ht,
    fun _ hl => tensor_ext _ _ (fun g f => (hl g f).trans (lift_pure G F T t ht g f).symm)⟩

private theorem finite_sum (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (x : underlying G F) :
    ∃ terms : List (Prod G.1 F.1), x = (terms.map (fun p => pure G F p.1 p.2)).sum := by
  let q : AddMonoidHom (FreeAddGroup (Prod G.1 F.1)) (underlying G F) :=
    (congruence G F).mk'
  refine Quotient.inductionOn x (fun w => ?_)
  change ∃ terms : List (Prod G.1 F.1), q w = (terms.map (fun p => pure G F p.1 p.2)).sum
  induction w using FreeAddGroup.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨[], map_zero q⟩
  | of p => exact ⟨[p], (add_zero _).symm⟩
  | neg_of p _ =>
    refine ⟨[(-p.1, p.2)], ?_⟩
    change q (-FreeAddGroup.of p) = pure G F (-p.1) p.2 + 0
    rw [map_neg, add_zero]
    exact (map_neg (pureLeft G F p.2) p.1).symm
  | add x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨xs, hxs⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨ys, hys⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨xs ++ ys, by rw [map_add, hxs, hys, List.map_append, List.sum_append]⟩

/- F1. The outer actions descend because each commutes with the appropriate
   middle action. Their module laws are equalities of additive maps. -/
private def outerLeft (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (c : C) :
    AddMonoidHom (underlying G F) (underlying G F) :=
  lift G F (underlying G F) (fun g f => pure G F (left G c g) f) (by
    refine ⟨?_, fun g f f' => pure_add_right G F (left G c g) f f', ?_⟩
    · intro g g' f
      change pure G F (leftHom G c (g + g')) f = _
      rw [map_add, pure_add_left]
      rfl
    · intro b g f
      dsimp only
      rw [← act_comm, pure_balance])

private theorem outerLeft_pure (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (c : C) (g : G.1)
    (f : F.1) : outerLeft G F c (pure G F g f) = pure G F (left G c g) f :=
  lift_pure G F _ _ _ g f

private def outerRight (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (a : A) :
    AddMonoidHom (underlying G F) (underlying G F) :=
  lift G F (underlying G F) (fun g f => pure G F g (right F a f)) (by
    refine ⟨fun g g' f => pure_add_left G F g g' (right F a f), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro g f f'
      change pure G F g (rightHom F a (f + f')) = _
      rw [map_add, pure_add_right]
      rfl
    · intro b g f
      dsimp only
      rw [pure_balance, act_comm])

private theorem outerRight_pure (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (a : A) (g : G.1)
    (f : F.1) : outerRight G F a (pure G F g f) = pure G F g (right F a f) :=
  lift_pure G F _ _ _ g f

@[instance_reducible] private def moduleFromMaps {R X : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid X]
    (act : R → AddMonoidHom X X) (one : act 1 = AddMonoidHom.id X)
    (mul : ∀ r s, act (r * s) = (act r).comp (act s))
    (add : ∀ r s, act (r + s) = act r + act s)
    (zero : act 0 = 0) : Module R X where
  smul r x := act r x
  one_smul x := DFunLike.congr_fun one x
  mul_smul r s x := DFunLike.congr_fun (mul r s) x
  smul_zero r := map_zero (act r)
  smul_add r x y := map_add (act r) x y
  add_smul r s x := DFunLike.congr_fun (add r s) x
  zero_smul x := DFunLike.congr_fun zero x

@[instance_reducible] private def leftModule (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) : Module C (underlying G F) := by
  letI : Module C G.1 := G.2.1
  refine moduleFromMaps (outerLeft G F) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    rw [outerLeft_pure]
    change pure G F ((1 : C) • g) f = pure G F g f
    rw [one_smul]
  · intro r s
    apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerLeft_pure]
    change pure G F ((r * s) • g) f = pure G F (r • (s • g)) f
    rw [mul_smul]
  · intro r s
    apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, outerLeft_pure]
    change pure G F ((r + s) • g) f = pure G F (r • g) f + pure G F (s • g) f
    rw [add_smul, pure_add_left]
  · apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    rw [outerLeft_pure]
    change pureLeft G F f ((0 : C) • g) = 0
    rw [zero_smul, map_zero]

@[instance_reducible] private def rightModule (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    Module (MulOpposite A) (underlying G F) := by
  letI : Module (MulOpposite A) F.1 := F.2.2.val
  refine moduleFromMaps (fun r => outerRight G F (MulOpposite.unop r)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    rw [outerRight_pure]
    change pure G F g ((1 : MulOpposite A) • f) = pure G F g f
    rw [one_smul]
  · intro r s
    apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerRight_pure]
    change pure G F g ((r * s) • f) = pure G F g (r • (s • f))
    rw [mul_smul]
  · intro r s
    apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply, outerRight_pure]
    change pure G F g ((r + s) • f) = pure G F g (r • f) + pure G F g (s • f)
    rw [add_smul, pure_add_right]
  · apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    rw [outerRight_pure]
    change pureRight G F g ((0 : MulOpposite A) • f) = 0
    rw [zero_smul, map_zero]

private def actions (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) : Structure C A (underlying G F) := by
  letI : Module C (underlying G F) := leftModule G F
  letI : Module (MulOpposite A) (underlying G F) := rightModule G F
  refine ⟨leftModule G F, ⟨rightModule G F, ?_⟩⟩
  show SMulCommClass (MulOpposite A) C (underlying G F)
  constructor
  intro a c x
  have commute : (outerRight G F (MulOpposite.unop a)).comp (outerLeft G F c) =
      (outerLeft G F c).comp (outerRight G F (MulOpposite.unop a)) := by
    apply tensor_ext
    intro g f
    simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerLeft_pure, outerRight_pure]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun commute x

private abbrev tensor (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) : Bimod C A :=
  ⟨underlying G F, actions G F⟩

private theorem left_pure (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (c : C) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    left (tensor G F) c (pure G F g f) = pure G F (left G c g) f :=
  outerLeft_pure G F c g f

private theorem right_pure (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (a : A) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    right (tensor G F) a (pure G F g f) = pure G F g (right F a f) :=
  outerRight_pure G F a g f

private theorem hom_ext {G : Bimod C B} {F : Bimod B A} {T : Bimod C A}
    (s t : Hom (tensor G F) T)
    (h : ∀ g f, s.val (pure G F g f) = t.val (pure G F g f)) : s = t :=
  Subtype.ext (tensor_ext s.val t.val h)

private theorem equivariant_of_pure {G : Bimod C B} {F : Bimod B A} {T : Bimod C A}
    (l : AddMonoidHom (tensor G F).1 T.1)
    (hl : ∀ c g f, l (pure G F (left G c g) f) = left T c (l (pure G F g f)))
    (hr : ∀ a g f, l (pure G F g (right F a f)) = right T a (l (pure G F g f))) :
    Equivariant (tensor G F) T l := by
  constructor
  · intro c x
    have eq : l.comp (outerLeft G F c) = (leftHom T c).comp l := by
      apply tensor_ext
      intro g f
      change l (outerLeft G F c (pure G F g f)) = left T c (l (pure G F g f))
      rw [outerLeft_pure]
      exact hl c g f
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x
  · intro a x
    have eq : l.comp (outerRight G F a) = (rightHom T a).comp l := by
      apply tensor_ext
      intro g f
      change l (outerRight G F a (pure G F g f)) = right T a (l (pure G F g f))
      rw [outerRight_pure]
      exact hr a g f
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x

/-- Comparing on pure pairs suffices, including when the target is a group of maps. -/
private theorem tensor_ext_left {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X]
    {H : Bimod D C} {G : Bimod C B} {F : Bimod B A}
    (s t : AddMonoidHom (tensor (tensor H G) F).1 X)
    (he : ∀ h g f, s (pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f) =
      t (pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f)) : s = t := by
  apply tensor_ext
  intro x f
  have eq : s.comp (pureLeft (tensor H G) F f) =
      t.comp (pureLeft (tensor H G) F f) := tensor_ext _ _ (fun h g => he h g f)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x

private theorem tensor_ext_right {X : Type*} [AddCommGroup X]
    {H : Bimod D C} {G : Bimod C B} {F : Bimod B A}
    (s t : AddMonoidHom (tensor H (tensor G F)).1 X)
    (he : ∀ h g f, s (pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f)) =
      t (pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f))) : s = t := by
  apply tensor_ext
  intro h x
  have eq : s.comp (pureRight H (tensor G F) h) =
      t.comp (pureRight H (tensor G F) h) := tensor_ext _ _ (he h)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x

/- Portal step 1.3 (F1, F4). Construct the map from the balanced pairing
   and check both functor laws by evaluating on elementary tensors. -/
private def mapAdd {G G' : Bimod C B} {F F' : Bimod B A}
    (g : Hom G G') (f : Hom F F') : AddMonoidHom (tensor G F).1 (tensor G' F').1 :=
  lift G F (underlying G' F') (fun x y => pure G' F' (g.val x) (f.val y)) (by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x x' y
      dsimp only
      rw [map_add, pure_add_left]
    · intro x y y'
      dsimp only
      rw [map_add, pure_add_right]
    · intro b x y
      dsimp only
      rw [g.property.2, f.property.1, pure_balance])

private theorem mapAdd_pure {G G' : Bimod C B} {F F' : Bimod B A}
    (g : Hom G G') (f : Hom F F') (x : G.1) (y : F.1) :
    mapAdd g f (pure G F x y) = pure G' F' (g.val x) (f.val y) :=
  lift_pure G F _ _ _ x y

private def tensorMap {G G' : Bimod C B} {F F' : Bimod B A}
    (g : Hom G G') (f : Hom F F') : Hom (tensor G F) (tensor G' F') :=
  ⟨mapAdd g f, equivariant_of_pure (mapAdd g f)
    (fun c x y => by rw [mapAdd_pure, mapAdd_pure, left_pure, g.property.1])
    (fun a x y => by rw [mapAdd_pure, mapAdd_pure, right_pure, f.property.2])⟩

private theorem tensorMap_pure {G G' : Bimod C B} {F F' : Bimod B A}
    (g : Hom G G') (f : Hom F F') (x : G.1) (y : F.1) :
    (tensorMap g f).val (pure G F x y) = pure G' F' (g.val x) (f.val y) :=
  mapAdd_pure g f x y

private theorem tensorMap_id (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    tensorMap (idMap G) (idMap F) = idMap (tensor G F) := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro g f
  rw [tensorMap_pure]
  rfl

private theorem tensorMap_comp {G G' G'' : Bimod C B} {F F' F'' : Bimod B A}
    (g : Hom G G') (g' : Hom G' G'') (f : Hom F F') (f' : Hom F' F'') :
    tensorMap (comp g' g) (comp f' f) = comp (tensorMap g' f') (tensorMap g f) := by
  apply hom_ext
  intro x y
  rw [comp_apply (tensorMap g' f') (tensorMap g f), tensorMap_pure (comp g' g),
    tensorMap_pure g f x y, tensorMap_pure g' f']
  rfl

/- Portal step 1.1 (F1, F2). BalancedTensorAssociativity guides the
   successive lifts. Its Finsupp quotient differs from the reviewed
   quotient, and its axiom audit includes Classical.choice. Each inverse
   is constructed here by lifting in the opposite order. -/
private def assocInner (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (f : F.1) :
    AddMonoidHom (tensor H G).1 (tensor H (tensor G F)).1 :=
  lift H G (underlying H (tensor G F))
    (fun h g => pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f)) (by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h h' g
        dsimp only
        rw [pure_add_left]
      · intro h g g'
        dsimp only
        rw [pure_add_left, pure_add_right]
      · intro c h g
        dsimp only
        rw [pure_balance, left_pure])

private theorem assocInner_pure (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (h : H.1) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    assocInner H G F f (pure H G h g) = pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f) :=
  lift_pure H G _ _ _ h g

private def assocForward (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    AddMonoidHom (tensor (tensor H G) F).1 (tensor H (tensor G F)).1 :=
  lift (tensor H G) F (underlying H (tensor G F))
    (fun x f => assocInner H G F f x) (by
      refine ⟨fun x y f => map_add (assocInner H G F f) x y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro x f f'
        have eq : assocInner H G F (f + f') = assocInner H G F f + assocInner H G F f' := by
          apply tensor_ext
          intro h g
          simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
          rw [assocInner_pure H G F, assocInner_pure H G F, assocInner_pure H G F,
            pure_add_right, pure_add_right]
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x
      · intro b x f
        have eq : (assocInner H G F f).comp (outerRight H G b) =
            assocInner H G F (left F b f) := by
          apply tensor_ext
          intro h g
          rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerRight_pure, assocInner_pure H G F,
            assocInner_pure H G F, pure_balance]
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x)

private theorem assocForward_pure (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (h : H.1) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    assocForward H G F (pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f) =
      pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f) :=
  (lift_pure (tensor H G) F _ _ _ (pure H G h g) f).trans (assocInner_pure H G F h g f)

private def assocInvInner (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) (h : H.1) :
    AddMonoidHom (tensor G F).1 (tensor (tensor H G) F).1 :=
  lift G F (underlying (tensor H G) F)
    (fun g f => pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f) (by
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro g g' f
        dsimp only
        rw [pure_add_right, pure_add_left]
      · intro g f f'
        dsimp only
        rw [pure_add_right]
      · intro b g f
        dsimp only
        rw [← right_pure H G b, pure_balance])

private theorem assocInvInner_pure (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (h : H.1) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    assocInvInner H G F h (pure G F g f) = pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f :=
  lift_pure G F _ _ _ g f

private def assocInverse (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    AddMonoidHom (tensor H (tensor G F)).1 (tensor (tensor H G) F).1 :=
  lift H (tensor G F) (underlying (tensor H G) F)
    (fun h x => assocInvInner H G F h x) (by
      refine ⟨?_, fun h x y => map_add (assocInvInner H G F h) x y, ?_⟩
      · intro h h' x
        have eq : assocInvInner H G F (h + h') = assocInvInner H G F h + assocInvInner H G F h' := by
          apply tensor_ext
          intro g f
          simp only [AddMonoidHom.add_apply]
          rw [assocInvInner_pure H G F, assocInvInner_pure H G F, assocInvInner_pure H G F,
            pure_add_left, pure_add_left]
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x
      · intro c h x
        have eq : assocInvInner H G F (right H c h) =
            (assocInvInner H G F h).comp (outerLeft G F c) := by
          apply tensor_ext
          intro g f
          rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerLeft_pure, assocInvInner_pure H G F,
            assocInvInner_pure H G F, pure_balance]
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x)

private theorem assocInverse_pure (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (h : H.1) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    assocInverse H G F (pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f)) =
      pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f :=
  (lift_pure H (tensor G F) _ _ _ h (pure G F g f)).trans (assocInvInner_pure H G F h g f)

private def assoc (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    Iso (tensor (tensor H G) F) (tensor H (tensor G F)) := by
  let fw := assocForward H G F
  let bw := assocInverse H G F
  have bwfw : bw.comp fw = AddMonoidHom.id _ :=
    tensor_ext_left _ _ (fun h g f => by
      simp only [bw, fw, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      rw [assocForward_pure H G F, assocInverse_pure H G F])
  have fwbw : fw.comp bw = AddMonoidHom.id _ :=
    tensor_ext_right _ _ (fun h g f => by
      simp only [bw, fw, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      rw [assocInverse_pure H G F, assocForward_pure H G F])
  let e : AddEquiv (tensor (tensor H G) F).1 (tensor H (tensor G F)).1 :=
    { fw with
      invFun := bw
      left_inv := DFunLike.congr_fun bwfw
      right_inv := DFunLike.congr_fun fwbw }
  refine ⟨e, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro d x
    have eq : fw.comp (outerLeft (tensor H G) F d) =
        (outerLeft H (tensor G F) d).comp fw := by
      apply tensor_ext_left
      intro h g f
      simp only [fw, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerLeft_pure, left_pure]
      rw [assocForward_pure H G F, assocForward_pure H G F, outerLeft_pure]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x
  · intro a x
    have eq : fw.comp (outerRight (tensor H G) F a) =
        (outerRight H (tensor G F) a).comp fw := by
      apply tensor_ext_left
      intro h g f
      simp only [fw, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, outerRight_pure]
      rw [assocForward_pure H G F, assocForward_pure H G F, outerRight_pure, right_pure]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun eq x

private theorem assoc_pure (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (h : H.1) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    (assoc H G F).val (pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f) =
      pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f) :=
  assocForward_pure H G F h g f

/- Portal step 1.2 (F1, F3). The regular actions from Bimodule verify the
   balancing equations. The inverses are the additive maps inserting 1. -/
private noncomputable def leftUnitAdd (F : Bimod B A) : AddMonoidHom (tensor (regular B) F).1 F.1 := by
  letI : Module B F.1 := F.2.1
  refine lift (regular B) F F.1 (fun b f => left F b f) ?_
  refine ⟨fun b b' f => add_smul b b' f, fun b f f' => smul_add b f f', ?_⟩
  intro r b f
  dsimp only
  rw [regular_right]
  exact mul_smul b r f

private theorem leftUnitAdd_pure (F : Bimod B A) (b : B) (f : F.1) :
    leftUnitAdd F (pure (regular B) F b f) = left F b f :=
  lift_pure (regular B) F _ _ _ b f

private noncomputable def leftUnitor (F : Bimod B A) : Iso (tensor (regular B) F) F := by
  letI : Module B F.1 := F.2.1
  let fw := leftUnitAdd F
  let bw := pureRight (regular B) F 1
  have bwfw : bw.comp fw = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply tensor_ext (G := regular B) (F := F)
    intro b f
    change pure (regular B) F 1 (leftUnitAdd F (pure (regular B) F b f)) =
      pure (regular B) F b f
    rw [leftUnitAdd_pure F, ← pure_balance (regular B) F b, regular_right, one_mul]
  let e : AddEquiv (tensor (regular B) F).1 F.1 :=
    { fw with
      invFun := bw
      left_inv := DFunLike.congr_fun bwfw
      right_inv := fun f =>
        (leftUnitAdd_pure F 1 f).trans (one_smul B f) }
  refine ⟨e, equivariant_of_pure (G := regular B) (F := F) (T := F) fw ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro r b f
    change leftUnitAdd F (pure (regular B) F (left (regular B) r b) f) =
      left F r (leftUnitAdd F (pure (regular B) F b f))
    rw [leftUnitAdd_pure F, leftUnitAdd_pure F, regular_left]
    exact mul_smul r b f
  · intro a b f
    change leftUnitAdd F (pure (regular B) F b (right F a f)) =
      right F a (leftUnitAdd F (pure (regular B) F b f))
    rw [leftUnitAdd_pure F, leftUnitAdd_pure F]
    exact (act_comm F b a f).symm

private theorem leftUnitor_pure (F : Bimod B A) (b : B) (f : F.1) :
    (leftUnitor F).val (pure (regular B) F b f) = left F b f :=
  leftUnitAdd_pure F b f

private noncomputable def rightUnitAdd (F : Bimod B A) : AddMonoidHom (tensor F (regular A)).1 F.1 := by
  letI : Module (MulOpposite A) F.1 := F.2.2.val
  refine lift F (regular A) F.1 (fun f a => right F a f) ?_
  refine ⟨fun f f' a => smul_add (MulOpposite.op a) f f',
    fun f a a' => add_smul (MulOpposite.op a) (MulOpposite.op a') f, ?_⟩
  intro r f a
  dsimp only
  rw [regular_left]
  exact (mul_smul (MulOpposite.op a) (MulOpposite.op r) f).symm

private theorem rightUnitAdd_pure (F : Bimod B A) (f : F.1) (a : A) :
    rightUnitAdd F (pure F (regular A) f a) = right F a f :=
  lift_pure F (regular A) _ _ _ f a

private noncomputable def rightUnitor (F : Bimod B A) : Iso (tensor F (regular A)) F := by
  letI : Module (MulOpposite A) F.1 := F.2.2.val
  let fw := rightUnitAdd F
  let bw := pureLeft F (regular A) 1
  have bwfw : bw.comp fw = AddMonoidHom.id _ := by
    apply tensor_ext (G := F) (F := regular A)
    intro f a
    change pure F (regular A) (rightUnitAdd F (pure F (regular A) f a)) 1 =
      pure F (regular A) f a
    rw [rightUnitAdd_pure F, pure_balance F (regular A) a, regular_left, mul_one]
  let e : AddEquiv (tensor F (regular A)).1 F.1 :=
    { fw with
      invFun := bw
      left_inv := DFunLike.congr_fun bwfw
      right_inv := fun f =>
        (rightUnitAdd_pure F f 1).trans (one_smul (MulOpposite A) f) }
  refine ⟨e, equivariant_of_pure (G := F) (F := regular A) (T := F) fw ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro b f a
    change rightUnitAdd F (pure F (regular A) (left F b f) a) =
      left F b (rightUnitAdd F (pure F (regular A) f a))
    rw [rightUnitAdd_pure F, rightUnitAdd_pure F]
    exact act_comm F b a f
  · intro r f a
    change rightUnitAdd F (pure F (regular A) f (right (regular A) r a)) =
      right F r (rightUnitAdd F (pure F (regular A) f a))
    rw [rightUnitAdd_pure F, rightUnitAdd_pure F, regular_right]
    exact mul_smul (MulOpposite.op r) (MulOpposite.op a) f

private theorem rightUnitor_pure (F : Bimod B A) (f : F.1) (a : A) :
    (rightUnitor F).val (pure F (regular A) f a) = right F a f :=
  rightUnitAdd_pure F f a

private theorem assocHom_pure (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A)
    (h : H.1) (g : G.1) (f : F.1) :
    (isoHom (assoc H G F)).val (pure (tensor H G) F (pure H G h g) f) =
      pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f) :=
  assoc_pure H G F h g f

private theorem leftUnitorHom_pure (F : Bimod B A) (b : B) (f : F.1) :
    (isoHom (leftUnitor F)).val (pure (regular B) F b f) = left F b f :=
  leftUnitor_pure F b f

private theorem rightUnitorHom_pure (F : Bimod B A) (f : F.1) (a : A) :
    (isoHom (rightUnitor F)).val (pure F (regular A) f a) = right F a f :=
  rightUnitor_pure F f a

/- The naturality parts of steps 1.1 and 1.2 follow by comparing the
   composites on pure tensors. -/
private theorem assoc_natural {H H' : Bimod D C} {G G' : Bimod C B} {F F' : Bimod B A}
    (h : Hom H H') (g : Hom G G') (f : Hom F F') :
    comp (isoHom (assoc H' G' F')) (tensorMap (tensorMap h g) f) =
      comp (tensorMap h (tensorMap g f)) (isoHom (assoc H G F)) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply tensor_ext_left
  intro x y z
  rw [comp_apply (isoHom (assoc H' G' F')), comp_apply (tensorMap h (tensorMap g f)),
    tensorMap_pure (tensorMap h g) f, tensorMap_pure h g,
    assocHom_pure H' G' F', assocHom_pure H G F,
    tensorMap_pure h (tensorMap g f), tensorMap_pure g f]

private theorem leftUnitor_natural {F F' : Bimod B A} (f : Hom F F') :
    comp (isoHom (leftUnitor F')) (tensorMap (idMap (regular B)) f) =
      comp f (isoHom (leftUnitor F)) := by
  apply hom_ext (G := regular B) (F := F)
  intro b x
  rw [comp_apply (isoHom (leftUnitor F')), comp_apply f,
    tensorMap_pure (idMap (regular B)) f, leftUnitorHom_pure F', leftUnitorHom_pure F,
    f.property.1]
  rfl

private theorem rightUnitor_natural {F F' : Bimod B A} (f : Hom F F') :
    comp (isoHom (rightUnitor F')) (tensorMap f (idMap (regular A))) =
      comp f (isoHom (rightUnitor F)) := by
  apply hom_ext (G := F) (F := regular A)
  intro x a
  rw [comp_apply (isoHom (rightUnitor F')), comp_apply f,
    tensorMap_pure f (idMap (regular A)), rightUnitorHom_pure F', rightUnitorHom_pure F,
    f.property.2]
  rfl

/- Portal step 2.1. Extend equality from the four-fold pure tensors,
   first through the two outer tensor factors, then through K tensor H. -/
private theorem pentagon (K : Bimod E D) (H : Bimod D C) (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    comp (isoHom (assoc K H (tensor G F))) (isoHom (assoc (tensor K H) G F)) =
      comp (tensorMap (idMap K) (isoHom (assoc H G F)))
        (comp (isoHom (assoc K (tensor H G) F))
          (tensorMap (isoHom (assoc K H G)) (idMap F))) := by
  let lhs := comp (isoHom (assoc K H (tensor G F))) (isoHom (assoc (tensor K H) G F))
  let rhs := comp (tensorMap (idMap K) (isoHom (assoc H G F)))
    (comp (isoHom (assoc K (tensor H G) F))
      (tensorMap (isoHom (assoc K H G)) (idMap F)))
  change lhs = rhs
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply tensor_ext_left (H := tensor K H) (G := G) (F := F)
  intro t g f
  let ins := (pureLeft (tensor (tensor K H) G) F f).comp (pureLeft (tensor K H) G g)
  have he : lhs.val.comp ins = rhs.val.comp ins := by
    apply tensor_ext (G := K) (F := H)
    intro k h
    let x := pure (tensor (tensor K H) G) F (pure (tensor K H) G (pure K H k h) g) f
    change lhs.val x = rhs.val x
    dsimp only [lhs, rhs, x]
    rw [comp_apply (isoHom (assoc K H (tensor G F))),
      comp_apply (tensorMap (idMap K) (isoHom (assoc H G F))),
      comp_apply (isoHom (assoc K (tensor H G) F)),
      assocHom_pure (tensor K H) G F, assocHom_pure K H (tensor G F),
      tensorMap_pure (isoHom (assoc K H G)) (idMap F), assocHom_pure K H G]
    change pure K (tensor H (tensor G F)) k (pure H (tensor G F) h (pure G F g f)) =
      (tensorMap (idMap K) (isoHom (assoc H G F))).val
        ((isoHom (assoc K (tensor H G) F)).val
          (pure (tensor K (tensor H G)) F (pure K (tensor H G) k (pure H G h g)) f))
    rw [assocHom_pure K (tensor H G) F,
      tensorMap_pure (idMap K) (isoHom (assoc H G F)), assocHom_pure H G F]
    rfl
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he t

/- Portal step 2.2. The pure-triple images coincide by the middle-ring
   balancing relation. -/
private theorem triangle (G : Bimod C B) (F : Bimod B A) :
    comp (tensorMap (idMap G) (isoHom (leftUnitor F))) (isoHom (assoc G (regular B) F)) =
      tensorMap (isoHom (rightUnitor G)) (idMap F) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply tensor_ext_left (H := G) (G := regular B) (F := F)
  intro g b f
  rw [comp_apply (tensorMap (idMap G) (isoHom (leftUnitor F))),
    assocHom_pure G (regular B) F,
    tensorMap_pure (idMap G) (isoHom (leftUnitor F)),
    tensorMap_pure (isoHom (rightUnitor G)) (idMap F),
    leftUnitorHom_pure F, rightUnitorHom_pure G]
  exact (pure_balance G F b g f).symm

end MoritaCoherence

external.usage: Extend a pairing from the generators to an additive homomorphism before descending to the balanced quotient. The generator formula computes the lift, and free-group extensionality applied to both composites with the quotient map gives tensor extensionality.
Prove the finite-sum assertion on quotient representatives. Use the empty list, singleton lists, a negated first factor for the negated generator, and list concatenation for addition.
Descend the free additive homomorphism after verifying all four generating relations in its kernel. This constructs the balanced lift without extracting data from a proposition.

  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- The paper evaluates the two junctions using a coset sum and moves
  -- right multiplication past the inner factors by intertwining.

NormalizedTrivalentCurl.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G γ α hγ hα left right merged normalizes
  open MackeyDiagrams in
  have normalize {A B : Subgroup U} (strand : ConjEmbedding A B) :
      normalizes strand := by
    intro M loop
    -- Theorem 4.1, (4.1), gives the scalar evaluation (archived p. 14,
    -- published revision p. 16). The § 4 normalization (archived p. 15,
    -- published revision p. 17) cancels that scalar over ℂ using the finite
    -- index of the loop image in A. The registered result uses
    -- Subgroup.index_ne_zero for this cancellation and takes explicit
    -- conjugators. Recover them and identify the embeddings by their homs.
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := strand.hasRepresentative
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := loop.hasRepresentative
    have hsMem (a : A) : s * (a : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ B :=
      hs a ▸ (strand.toHom a).property
    have hdMem (m : M) : d * (m : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ A :=
      hd m ▸ (loop.toHom m).property
    have hsEq : strand = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hsMem :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun a => Subtype.ext (hs a))
    have hdEq : loop = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hdMem :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun m => Subtype.ext (hd m))
    cases hsEq
    cases hdEq
    intro image finite curl straight
    -- The right-up projection is the same pair of typed trivalent
    -- junctions, with the reciprocal applied to the whole drawing.
    exact (NormalizedIndexValuedReidemeisterCurls M A B d s hdMem hsMem finite).1
  -- Xiao § 3.2, after Example 3.1 (archived p. 9, published revision p. 12).
  -- Apply the registered cancellation separately at the three placements.
  -- The slide in CurlAcrossTrivalentVertex assumes equal indices, and
  -- Example 3.1 shows that the branch indices can differ.
  exact ⟨normalize left, normalize right, normalize merged⟩

CurlWithCentralizingDot.proof:
by
  open MackeyDiagrams CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport in
  intro U _ K H G δ α hδ hα inner outer S lift basis finite
  -- Xiao §3.1, the paragraph after Proposition 3.1's curl calculation:
  -- archived original PDF p. 8, published 28 November revision pp. 10–11
  -- (SHA-256 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61).
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- The revision permits commutation after addition for the endomorphism
  -- in this calculation. The middle mark uses the separate AlgebraUpDot
  -- evaluator with that whole-algebra hypothesis. The comparison uses
  -- equality of evaluations, and the sliding mark uses the finite
  -- termwise eligible DotLabel.
  -- RightCurlAndDotSlide supplies only the inclusion-index clause.
  refine ⟨((RightCurlAndDotSlide K H G).1 δ α hδ hα finite).1, ?_⟩
  intro a ha middle curl transversal term T hT trace
  have hcentral : ∀ y : MonoidAlgebra Complex H, Commute y trace :=
    CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport.trace_central inner a ha T hT
  refine ⟨hcentral, ?_⟩
  intro traceLabel straight
  -- Alphabeta Math, Module tensor universal property, Steps 3.1, 4.1
  -- and 5.1, motivates descent through balancing and checking generators.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  -- Here the shared Biset.pairLinear has already descended. The
  -- finite-index witness and unique right transversal are passed to
  -- FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction at the inner embedding; its first cup
  -- formula at 1 already packages Generator.rightCosetEquivCapFiber's
  -- reindexing of the multiplication-cap fiber.
  have cup :
      (Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) inner finite).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1) =
        ∑ t ∈ T, Biset.pairLinear Complex (Word.up inner).basis (Word.down inner).basis
          (Finsupp.single t⁻¹ 1) (Finsupp.single t 1) := by
    -- The spare module universe can be 0 in this diagram calculation.
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hCup⟩ := (FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction.{_, 0} K H δ hδ).2.2.2.2 finite
    simpa only [inner, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, one_mul] using ((hCup T hT).1 1).1
  have hEval : curl.eval = (straight outer).eval := by
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro g c
    change G at g
    have hc : Finsupp.single g c = c • Finsupp.single g (1 : Complex) := by
      simp [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hc, map_smul, map_smul]
    apply congrArg (c • ·)
    exact CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport.curl_basis outer inner middle finite T cup g
  refine ⟨hEval, ?_, CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport.summand_invariant inner a ha, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [hEval]
    change (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) * lift outer trace).coeff = _
    rw [MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_coeff]
  · intro β hβ outer' d dot slideBelow slideAbove
    exact CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport.trace_slide traceLabel d
CurlWithCentralizingDot.support:
namespace CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport

open MackeyDiagrams

universe u

noncomputable section

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}

private abbrev basis {A : Subgroup U} (x : A) : MonoidAlgebra Complex A :=
  MonoidAlgebra.single x 1

private abbrev lift {A B : Subgroup U} (p : ConjEmbedding A B) :=
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex p.toHom

private theorem basis_mul {A : Subgroup U} (x y : A) :
    basis (x * y) = basis x * basis y := by
  simp only [basis, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, mul_one]

private theorem lift_basis {A B : Subgroup U} (p : ConjEmbedding A B) (x : A) :
    lift p (basis x) = basis (p.toHom x) :=
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single

private def summand (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (t : H) :=
  basis t⁻¹ * a * basis t

private theorem summand_mul (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (s t : H) :
    summand a (s * t) = basis t⁻¹ * summand a s * basis t := by
  simp only [summand, mul_inv_rev, basis_mul, mul_assoc]

private theorem summand_invariant (inner : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)
    (ha : ∀ y : MonoidAlgebra Complex K, Commute (lift inner y) a)
    (t : H) (ℓ : inner.toHom.range) :
    summand a ((ℓ : H) * t) = summand a t := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ℓ.property
  have comm : basis (ℓ : H) * a = a * basis (ℓ : H) := by
    simpa only [lift_basis, hk] using (ha (basis k)).eq
  have cancel : summand a (ℓ : H) = a := by
    rw [summand, mul_assoc, ← comm, ← mul_assoc, ← basis_mul, inv_mul_cancel]
    change (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) * a = a
    exact one_mul a
  rw [summand_mul, cancel]
  rfl

private abbrev IsTransversal (S : Subgroup H) (T : Finset H) :=
  ∀ h : H, ∃! t : {t : H // t ∈ T}, h * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S

-- Right multiplication transports each coset. The two directions of
-- transport are inverse by the uniqueness in the chosen transversal.
private theorem sum_transversal_mul (S : Subgroup H) (T : Finset H)
    (hT : IsTransversal S T) {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : H → M)
    (hf : ∀ (t : H) (ℓ : S), f ((ℓ : H) * t) = f t) (g : H) :
    (∑ t ∈ T, f (t * g)) = ∑ t ∈ T, f t := by
  classical
  let rep (x : H) := Classical.choose (hT x)
  have hrep (x : H) : x * (rep x : H)⁻¹ ∈ S := (Classical.choose_spec (hT x)).1
  have huniq (x : H) (t : {t : H // t ∈ T}) (ht : x * (t : H)⁻¹ ∈ S) :
      t = rep x := (Classical.choose_spec (hT x)).2 t ht
  have back (g : H) (t : {t : H // t ∈ T}) :
      rep ((rep ((t : H) * g) : H) * g⁻¹) = t := by
    apply (huniq _ t _).symm
    have he : (rep ((t : H) * g) : H) * g⁻¹ * (t : H)⁻¹ =
        ((t : H) * g * (rep ((t : H) * g) : H)⁻¹)⁻¹ := by group
    rw [he]
    exact S.inv_mem (hrep _)
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun t _ => (rep (t * g) : H)) (fun t _ => (rep (t * g)).property)
    ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro t ht s hs he
    have hs' : rep (t * g) = rep (s * g) := Subtype.ext he
    have hb : (⟨t, ht⟩ : {x : H // x ∈ T}) = ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
      (back g ⟨t, ht⟩).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun r : {x : H // x ∈ T} =>
        rep ((r : H) * g⁻¹)) hs').trans (back g ⟨s, hs⟩))
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hb
  · intro t ht
    refine ⟨rep (t * g⁻¹), (rep (t * g⁻¹)).property, ?_⟩
    have ht' : rep ((rep (t * g⁻¹) : H) * g) = ⟨t, ht⟩ := by
      simpa only [inv_inv] using back g⁻¹ ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ht'
  · intro t _
    let ℓ : S := ⟨t * g * (rep (t * g) : H)⁻¹, hrep _⟩
    have hℓ : (ℓ : H) * (rep (t * g) : H) = t * g := by
      dsimp [ℓ]
      group
    exact (congrArg f hℓ).symm.trans (hf _ ℓ)

private theorem trace_central (inner : ConjEmbedding K H) (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)
    (ha : ∀ y : MonoidAlgebra Complex K, Commute (lift inner y) a)
    (T : Finset H) (hT : IsTransversal inner.toHom.range T) :
    ∀ y : MonoidAlgebra Complex H, Commute y (∑ t ∈ T, summand a t) := by
  let trace := ∑ t ∈ T, summand a t
  have conjugate (g : H) : basis g⁻¹ * trace * basis g = trace := by
    change basis g⁻¹ * (∑ t ∈ T, summand a t) * basis g = _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
    simp_rw [← summand_mul]
    exact sum_transversal_mul _ T hT (summand a) (summand_invariant inner a ha) g
  have central_basis (g : H) : basis g * trace = trace * basis g := by
    calc
      basis g * trace = basis g * (basis g⁻¹ * trace * basis g) :=
        congrArg (basis g * ·) (conjugate g).symm
      _ = trace * basis g := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← basis_mul, mul_inv_cancel]
        change (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) * trace * basis g = trace * basis g
        rw [one_mul]
  intro y
  change y * trace = trace * y
  refine MonoidAlgebra.induction_on (motive := fun z => z * trace = trace * z) y ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro g
    exact central_basis g
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [add_mul, mul_add, hx, hy]
  · intro r x hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, hx]

private abbrev pair {A B C : Subgroup U} (p : Word A B) (q : Word B C) :=
  Biset.pairLinear Complex p.basis q.basis

private abbrev ev {A B : Subgroup U} {p q : Word A B} (d : Diagram Complex p q) :=
  d.eval.toLinearMap

variable (outer : ConjEmbedding H G) (inner : ConjEmbedding K H)

local notation "up" => Word.up outer
local notation "hk" => Word.up inner
local notation "kh" => Word.down inner
local notation "merged" => Word.up (outer.comp inner)
local notation "emptyH" => Word.empty H

private theorem dot_curl_tail_single (z : G) (t : H) (c : Complex) :
    ev (Diagram.rightUnit up)
      (ev (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id up) (Diagram.multiplicationCap inner))
        (ev (Diagram.associate up hk kh)
          (ev (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.splitUp outer inner) (Diagram.id kh))
            (pair merged kh (Finsupp.single z c) (Finsupp.single t 1))))) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.single z c * basis (outer.toHom t)).coeff := by
  simp only [ev, pair]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single (R := Complex) (merged).basis (kh).basis z t c 1, mul_one]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.splitUp outer inner) (Diagram.id kh),
    Diagram.eval_splitUp_single, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Biset.pairLinear_single (R := Complex) (Word.tensor up hk).basis (kh).basis _ t 1 1, one_mul]
  simp only [map_smul]
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single up hk kh,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id up) (Diagram.multiplicationCap inner),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_multiplicationCap_single,
    one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single (R := Complex) (up).basis (emptyH).basis z t 1 1,
    one_mul, Diagram.eval_rightUnit_single]
  have action : (up).basis.act (1, t⁻¹) z = z * outer.toHom t := by
    change 1 * z * (outer.toHom t⁻¹)⁻¹ = z * outer.toHom t
    simp
  rw [action]
  simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single,
    mul_one, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single]

private theorem dot_curl_tail (x : G →₀ Complex) (t : H) :
    ev (Diagram.rightUnit up)
      (ev (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id up) (Diagram.multiplicationCap inner))
        (ev (Diagram.associate up hk kh)
          (ev (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.splitUp outer inner) (Diagram.id kh))
            (pair merged kh x (Finsupp.single t 1))))) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff x * basis (outer.toHom t)).coeff := by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy =>
    have hpair :
        pair merged kh (x + y) (Finsupp.single t 1) =
          pair merged kh x (Finsupp.single t 1) + pair merged kh y (Finsupp.single t 1) :=
      LinearMap.congr_fun ((pair merged kh).map_add x y) _
    rw [hpair, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy,
      MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_add, add_mul, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_add]
  | single z c => exact dot_curl_tail_single outer inner z t c


private def curlTail (middle : AlgebraUpDot Complex inner inner) :
    ScopedDiagram Complex (Word.tensor up (Word.tensor hk kh)) up :=
  .vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate up hk kh))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (.horizontal (.mergeUp outer inner) (.id kh)))
      (.vertical (.horizontal (.algebraUpDot (middle.whisker outer)) (.ordinary (.id kh)))
        (.vertical (.ordinary (.horizontal (.splitUp outer inner) (.id kh)))
          (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate up hk kh))
            (.vertical (.ordinary (.horizontal (.id up) (.multiplicationCap inner)))
              (.ordinary (.rightUnit up)))))))

-- The generator computation inserts the algebra-intertwiner evaluator
-- between the merge and split, with the downward factor carried through.
private theorem curl_term (middle : AlgebraUpDot Complex inner inner)
    (g : G) (t : H) :
    (curlTail outer inner middle).eval.toLinearMap
      (pair up (Word.tensor hk kh) (Finsupp.single g 1)
        (pair hk kh (Finsupp.single t⁻¹ 1) (Finsupp.single t 1))) =
      (basis g * lift outer (summand middle.label t)).coeff := by
  simp only [curlTail, ScopedDiagram.eval, Biset.Hom.vertical, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [show (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp outer inner) (Diagram.id kh) :
      Diagram Complex _ _).eval =
      (Diagram.mergeUp outer inner : Diagram Complex _ _).eval.horizontal
        (Diagram.id kh).eval from rfl]
  simp only [pair]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single (R := Complex) (hk).basis (kh).basis t⁻¹ t 1 1, one_mul,
    Biset.pairLinear_single (R := Complex) (up).basis (Word.tensor hk kh).basis g _ 1 1, one_mul,
    Diagram.eval_unassociate_single up hk kh]
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single (R := Complex) (merged).basis (kh).basis _ t 1 1, one_mul]
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, AlgebraUpDot.eval_apply, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  rw [dot_curl_tail outer inner]
  simp only [MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff_coeff, summand, map_mul, lift_basis]
  change (basis (g * outer.toHom t⁻¹) * lift outer middle.label *
    basis (outer.toHom t)).coeff = _
  simp only [basis_mul, mul_assoc]

private theorem curl_basis (middle : AlgebraUpDot Complex inner inner)
    (finite : inner.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) (T : Finset H)
    (cup : ev (Diagram.reverseCup inner finite) (Finsupp.single 1 1) =
      ∑ t ∈ T, pair hk kh (Finsupp.single t⁻¹ 1) (Finsupp.single t 1))
    (g : G) :
    (ScopedDiagram.rightCurlUp (RightCurlLabel.algebraDot outer middle) finite).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single g 1) = (basis g * lift outer (∑ t ∈ T, summand middle.label t)).coeff := by
  have insert : ev (Diagram.insertRightUnit up) (Finsupp.single g 1) =
      Finsupp.single ((up).basis.pair (emptyH).basis g 1) 1 := by
    change (Biset.insertRightUnit (up).basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
    rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  change (curlTail outer inner middle).eval.toLinearMap
    (ev (Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.id up) (Diagram.reverseCup inner finite))
      (ev (Diagram.insertRightUnit up) (Finsupp.single g 1))) = _
  rw [insert, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id up) (Diagram.reverseCup inner finite),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  change (curlTail outer inner middle).eval.toLinearMap
    (pair up (Word.tensor hk kh) (Finsupp.single g 1)
      (ev (Diagram.reverseCup inner finite) (Finsupp.single 1 1))) = _
  rw [cup, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  change _ = (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex) (∑ t ∈ T, basis g *
    lift outer (summand middle.label t))
  rw [map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => curl_term outer inner middle g t)

private theorem groupDot_intertwines_algebra {p q : ConjEmbedding H G}
    (d : Dot p q) (b : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) :
    lift p b * basis d.element = basis d.element * lift q b := by
  induction b using MonoidAlgebra.induction_on with
  | of h =>
    change lift p (basis h) * basis d.element = basis d.element * lift q (basis h)
    rw [lift_basis, lift_basis, ← basis_mul, ← basis_mul, d.intertwines]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, add_mul, mul_add, hx, hy]
  | smul r x hx =>
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, hx]

-- Each supported term of the sliding label intertwines the two lifted
-- algebra traces. Linearity assembles the equality at the fixed boundary.
private theorem trace_slide {p q : ConjEmbedding H G}
    (trace : AlgebraUpDot Complex (ConjEmbedding.id H) (ConjEmbedding.id H))
    (d : DotLabel Complex p q) :
    let dot := (DotLabel.upDrawing d).interpret
    let straight := fun r : ConjEmbedding H G => ScopedDiagram.algebraUpDot (trace.whisker r)
    (dot.vertical (straight q)).eval = ((straight p).vertical dot).eval := by
  dsimp only
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (trace.whisker q).eval.toLinearMap
      ((DotLabel.upDrawing d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x) =
    (DotLabel.upDrawing d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      ((trace.whisker p).eval.toLinearMap x)
  rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing, Diagram.linearUpDot, Diagram.eval_finiteSum,
    Diagram.eval_finiteSum, map_list_sum]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro e _
  change (trace.whisker q).eval.toLinearMap (d e • ev (Diagram.upDot e) x) =
    d e • ev (Diagram.upDot e) ((trace.whisker p).eval.toLinearMap x)
  rw [map_smul]
  simp only [ev, ← AlgebraUpDot.eval_ofGroupDot]
  change d e • (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff x * basis e.element * lift q trace.label).coeff =
    d e • (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff x * lift p trace.label * basis e.element).coeff
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, groupDot_intertwines_algebra e]

end

end CurlWithCentralizingDotSupport

DifferentCurlIndices.proof:
by
  -- Xiao, Example 3.1 (archived original p. 9, 28 November revision p. 12).
  -- Section 3.2 immediately before the example specifies an undotted right
  -- curl on each input, with right regions K and H respectively.
  intro U G H K L leftStrand rightStrand rightLoop leftLoop rightCurl
  open MackeyDiagrams in
  have eval_expansion {A B M : Subgroup U} (strand : ConjEmbedding A B)
      (loop : ConjEmbedding M A) (finite : loop.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
      (rightCurl strand loop finite).eval =
        ((LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
            (TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown strand loop finite)).vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp strand loop))).interpret.eval := by
    -- Expand the two bent vertices. Interchange combines merge and split
    -- beside the downward identity, and associativity matches the explicit curl.
    let down := Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Word.down loop).basis
    have hMiddle := Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical
      (Generator.mergeUp Complex strand loop) down (Generator.splitUp Complex strand loop) down
    dsimp only [down] at hMiddle
    rw [Biset.Hom.id_vertical] at hMiddle
    simp only [rightCurl, LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval,
      TrivalentVertex.expand, BentVertex.expand, Diagram.eval,
      ← hMiddle, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]
  -- Use the reviewed Multiplicative (ZMod 2) model and compute the
  -- two extremal subgroup indices directly in that model.
  -- Alphabeta Math, steps 1.1 and 1.2, count the quotient of a group
  -- by itself and by its trivial subgroup, respectively.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/ex-index-of-the-trivial-subgroups
  have hRightIndex : rightLoop.toHom.range.index = 1 := by
    change (MonoidHom.id K).range.index = 1
    have hRange : (MonoidHom.id K).range = ⊤ :=
      MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr fun x => ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [hRange, Subgroup.index_top]
  have hLeftRange : leftLoop.toHom.range = (⊥ : Subgroup H) := by
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hx : (x : U) = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp x.property
    simp [leftLoop, hx]
  -- H is the top subgroup of a finite group of order two, as required
  -- for the cardinality argument in step 1.2. Mathlib computes the index
  -- via the quotient equivalence with H.
  have hLeftIndex : leftLoop.toHom.range.index = 2 := by
    rw [hLeftRange, Subgroup.index_bot]
    change Nat.card (⊤ : Subgroup U) = 2
    rw [Subgroup.card_top]
    change Nat.card (ZMod 2) = 2
    exact Nat.card_zmod 2
  have hγ : ∀ x : H, (1 : U) * (x : U) * (1 : U)⁻¹ ∈ G := by
    intro x
    simp [G]
  have hα : ∀ x : K, (1 : U) * (x : U) * (1 : U)⁻¹ ∈ H := by
    intro x
    simp [H, G]
  -- Both loop images have finite index because their ambient groups
  -- are finite. The right loop also supplies the supplier's merged-loop
  -- parameter, since the merged strand has right region K.
  have finiteRight : rightLoop.toHom.range.FiniteIndex := inferInstance
  have finiteLeft : leftLoop.toHom.range.FiniteIndex := inferInstance
  have hCurls :=
    (CurlAcrossTrivalentVertex K H G (1 : U) (1 : U) hγ hα).2 L rightLoop finiteRight
  -- Select the two full scalar evaluations at their respective boundaries.
  -- The supplier uses equality of indices only for the subsequent slide.
  have hRight := (hCurls.2.1 L rightLoop finiteRight).1
  have hLeft := (hCurls.2.2 L leftLoop finiteLeft).1
  constructor
  · rw [eval_expansion]
    simpa only [hRightIndex, Nat.cast_one] using! hRight
  · rw [eval_expansion]
    simpa only [hLeftIndex, Nat.cast_ofNat] using! hLeft

external.usage: The right loop maps onto K, whose quotient by itself has one class. The left loop has trivial image in H, so its index is the cardinality of H.
Identifies the cardinality of the reviewed C₂ model via the top subgroup and the underlying type of Multiplicative (ZMod 2).

MovingSplitDotToOutputBranch.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G α γ b hα hγ hb hD D outer inner input merged inputDot singleton
    upTop downTop dotThenSplitUp dotThenSplitDown evalUpAtInput evalDownAtInput
  -- Xiao, § 3.2, “Moving a dot back to a branch,” archived original p. 9
  -- and published 28 November revision p. 11. No numbered Alphabeta proof
  -- steps are registered for this endpoint. The construction uses (3.2) and (3.4).
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=11
  have hInputDot : inputDot.element = D := rfl
  constructor
  · intro newInner sameInput rightLabel splitThenRightUp splitThenRightDown matchEq
    -- Apply the target merge to both split evaluations at the unit.
    -- This uses splitUp_mergeUp and splitDown_mergeDown, the inverse laws
    -- on the single strand. The other inverse laws act on two strands.
    -- For a finite right label the resulting coefficients are pushed through
    -- the outer embedding term by term. Downward, the indices use inverses.
    rcases matchEq with hu | hd
    · have h := congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap hu
      change dotThenSplitUp.interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
        (show LabelledDrawing Complex (.up input) upTop from
          sameInput ▸ splitThenRightUp).interpret.eval.toLinearMap at h
      rw [castUp] at h
      exact hInputDot ▸ rightUpNecessary outer newInner inner inputDot rightLabel h
    · have h := congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap hd
      change dotThenSplitDown.interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
        (show LabelledDrawing Complex (.down input) downTop from
          sameInput ▸ splitThenRightDown).interpret.eval.toLinearMap at h
      rw [castDown] at h
      exact hInputDot ▸ rightDownNecessary outer newInner inner inputDot rightLabel h
  · intro leftRepresentative
    -- Factor the given input representative, keeping the inner label fixed.
    have hFactor : b = leftRepresentative * γ := by
      change b = (b * γ⁻¹) * γ
      group
    have hLeftRep : leftRepresentative = (D : U) * α := by
      change b * γ⁻¹ = (b * (α * γ)⁻¹) * α
      group
    refine ⟨hFactor, hLeftRep, ?_⟩
    have hLeft (h : H) : leftRepresentative * (h : U) * leftRepresentative⁻¹ ∈ G := by
      have hm := (D * outer.toHom h * D⁻¹).property
      change (D : U) * (α * (h : U) * α⁻¹) * (D : U)⁻¹ ∈ G at hm
      rw [hLeftRep]
      convert hm using 1
      group
    refine ⟨hLeft, ?_⟩
    intro newOuter
    have sameInput : newOuter.comp inner = input := by
      apply ConjEmbedding.ext
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro k
      apply Subtype.ext
      change leftRepresentative * (γ * (k : U) * γ⁻¹) * leftRepresentative⁻¹ =
        b * (k : U) * b⁻¹
      rw [hFactor]
      group
    have hRel : leftRepresentative * α⁻¹ = (D : U) := by rw [hLeftRep, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
    have hRelMem : leftRepresentative * α⁻¹ ∈ G := by rw [hRel]; exact D.property
    let leftDot : Dot newOuter outer :=
      Dot.ofRepresentatives leftRepresentative α (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hRelMem
    have hDot : leftDot.element = D := Subtype.ext hRel
    refine ⟨sameInput, leftDot, hDot, ?_⟩
    intro splitThenLeftUp splitThenLeftDown
    let stem : Dot (newOuter.comp inner) merged :=
      ⟨leftDot.element, fun k => leftDot.intertwines (inner.toHom k)⟩
    have ⟨hu, hd⟩ := leftSlide leftRepresentative α γ hLeft hα hγ hRelMem
    -- The replacement has the same input embedding. On the underlying
    -- free modules, the lifted dot and the original dot have multiplier D.
    have sameUp : (up inputDot).interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
        (up stem).interpret.eval.toLinearMap := by
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
      intro x r
      rw [upSingle, upSingle, hInputDot, show stem.element = D from hDot]
    have sameDown : (down inputDot).interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
        (down stem).interpret.eval.toLinearMap := by
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
      intro x r
      rw [downSingle, downSingle, hInputDot, show stem.element = D from hDot]
    constructor
    · apply Biset.Hom.ext
      change dotThenSplitUp.interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
        (show LabelledDrawing Complex (.up input) upTop from
          sameInput ▸ splitThenLeftUp).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      rw [castUp]
      have h := congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap hu.symm
      change (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) outer inner).eval.toLinearMap.comp
        (up inputDot).interpret.eval.toLinearMap = _
      rw [sameUp]
      exact h
    · apply Biset.Hom.ext
      change dotThenSplitDown.interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
        (show LabelledDrawing Complex (.down input) downTop from
          sameInput ▸ splitThenLeftDown).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      rw [castDown]
      have h := congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap hd.symm
      change (Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) outer inner).eval.toLinearMap.comp
        (down inputDot).interpret.eval.toLinearMap = _
      rw [sameDown]
      exact h
MovingSplitDotToOutputBranch.support:
namespace MovingSplitDotProof

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}

private noncomputable abbrev up {A B : Subgroup U} {a b : ConjEmbedding A B} (d : Dot a b) :=
  DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))

private noncomputable abbrev down {A B : Subgroup U} {a b : ConjEmbedding A B} (d : Dot a b) :=
  DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))

private theorem upSingle {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) (x : G) (r : Complex) :
    (up d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r) =
      Finsupp.single (x * d.element) r := by
  dsimp only [up]
  rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing, Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply, freeLift_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single]

private theorem downSingle {a b : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot a b) (x : G) (r : Complex) :
    (down d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x r) =
      Finsupp.single (d.element⁻¹ * x) r := by
  dsimp only [down]
  rw [DotLabel.eval_downDrawing, Diagram.eval_linearDownDot_apply, freeLift_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_downDot_single]

-- An embedding changes the biset action. Its up and down carriers are both G.
private theorem castUp {p q : ConjEmbedding K G} (h : p = q) {w : Word G K}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (.up p) w) :
    (show LabelledDrawing Complex (.up q) w from h ▸ d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
      d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem castDown {p q : ConjEmbedding K G} (h : p = q) {w : Word K G}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (.down p) w) :
    (show LabelledDrawing Complex (.down q) w from h ▸ d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap =
      d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem imageCoeff {ι : Type*} (outer : ConjEmbedding H G) (index : ι → H)
    (label : ι →₀ Complex) (q : G) (outside : q ∉ outer.toHom.range) :
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (fun i => outer.toHom (index i)) label) q = 0 := by
  apply Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
  exact outside ⟨index i, hi⟩

private theorem mapLabel {ι : Type*} (label : ι →₀ Complex) (index : ι → H)
    (target : H → G) (f : (H →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] G →₀ Complex)
    (basis : ∀ y, f (Finsupp.single y 1) = Finsupp.single (target y) 1) :
    f ((label.support.toList.map fun i => label i • Finsupp.single (index i) 1).sum) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (fun i => target (index i)) label := by
  classical
  rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map, ← List.sum_toFinset _ label.support.nodup_toList,
    Finset.toList_toFinset, Finsupp.mapDomain, Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  change f (label i • Finsupp.single (index i) 1) = _
  rw [map_smul, basis, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

private theorem rightUpUnit (outer : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
      (((Diagram.id (R := Complex) (.up outer)).eval.horizontal
          (DotLabel.upDrawing label).interpret.eval).toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) outer a).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (fun d => outer.toHom d.element) label := by
  rw [Diagram.eval_splitUp_single, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  let pairAtOne := Biset.pairLinear Complex (Biset.induction outer) (Biset.induction b)
    (Finsupp.single 1 1)
  let merge := (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
  change merge (pairAtOne ((DotLabel.upDrawing label).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single 1 1))) = _
  rw [DotLabel.upDrawing_basis]
  simp only [one_mul]
  change (merge.comp pairAtOne) _ = _
  apply mapLabel label (fun d => d.element) outer.toHom
  intro y
  change merge (pairAtOne (Finsupp.single y 1)) = _
  dsimp only [merge, pairAtOne]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, one_mul]

private theorem rightDownUnit (outer : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    (Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
      (((DotLabel.downDrawing label).interpret.eval.horizontal
          (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (.down outer)).eval).toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) outer a).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (fun d => outer.toHom d.element⁻¹) label := by
  rw [Diagram.eval_splitDown_single, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  let pairAtOne := (Biset.pairLinear Complex (Biset.restriction b) (Biset.restriction outer)).flip
    (Finsupp.single 1 1)
  let merge := (Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
  change merge (pairAtOne ((DotLabel.downDrawing label).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single 1 1))) = _
  rw [DotLabel.downDrawing_basis]
  simp only [mul_one]
  change (merge.comp pairAtOne) _ = _
  apply mapLabel label (fun d => d.element⁻¹) outer.toHom
  intro y
  change merge (pairAtOne (Finsupp.single y 1)) = _
  dsimp only [merge, pairAtOne, LinearMap.flip_apply]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_mergeDown_single, mul_one]

private theorem rightUpNecessary (outer : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    {p : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot p (outer.comp b)) (label : DotLabel Complex a b)
    (eq : ((up d).interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitUp outer b).eval).toLinearMap =
      ((Diagram.splitUp outer a).eval.vertical
        ((Diagram.id (.up outer)).eval.horizontal (DotLabel.upDrawing label).interpret.eval)
        ).toLinearMap) :
    d.element ∈ outer.toHom.range := by
  let merge := (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
  have h := congrArg (fun f => merge (f (Finsupp.single 1 1))) eq
  change merge ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
      ((up d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) =
    merge (((Diagram.id (.up outer)).eval.horizontal (DotLabel.upDrawing label).interpret.eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) outer a).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) at h
  rw [upSingle, one_mul, rightUpUnit outer a b label] at h
  have cancel := congrArg (fun f => f.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single d.element 1))
    (Diagram.splitUp_mergeUp (R := Complex) outer b)
  change merge ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single d.element 1)) = Finsupp.single d.element 1 at cancel
  rw [cancel] at h
  by_contra outside
  have coefficient := congrArg (fun f : G →₀ Complex => f d.element) h
  change (Finsupp.single d.element (1 : Complex)) d.element =
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (fun t => outer.toHom t.element) label) d.element at coefficient
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, imageCoeff outer (fun t => t.element) label _ outside] at coefficient
  exact one_ne_zero coefficient

private theorem rightDownNecessary (outer : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    {p : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot p (outer.comp b)) (label : DotLabel Complex a b)
    (eq : ((down d).interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitDown outer b).eval).toLinearMap =
      ((Diagram.splitDown outer a).eval.vertical
        ((DotLabel.downDrawing label).interpret.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down outer)).eval)
        ).toLinearMap) :
    d.element ∈ outer.toHom.range := by
  let merge := (Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
  have h := congrArg (fun f => merge (f (Finsupp.single 1 1))) eq
  change merge ((Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
      ((down d).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) =
    merge (((DotLabel.downDrawing label).interpret.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down outer)).eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) outer a).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) at h
  rw [downSingle, mul_one, rightDownUnit outer a b label] at h
  have cancel := congrArg (fun f => f.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single d.element⁻¹ 1))
    (Diagram.splitDown_mergeDown (R := Complex) outer b)
  change merge ((Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) outer b).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single d.element⁻¹ 1)) = Finsupp.single d.element⁻¹ 1 at cancel
  rw [cancel] at h
  by_contra outside
  have invOutside : d.element⁻¹ ∉ outer.toHom.range := by
    intro hin
    exact outside (by simpa only [inv_inv] using outer.toHom.range.inv_mem hin)
  have coefficient := congrArg (fun f : G →₀ Complex => f d.element⁻¹) h
  change (Finsupp.single d.element⁻¹ (1 : Complex)) d.element⁻¹ =
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (fun t => outer.toHom t.element⁻¹) label) d.element⁻¹ at coefficient
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, imageCoeff outer (fun t => t.element⁻¹) label _ invOutside] at coefficient
  exact one_ne_zero coefficient

private theorem leftSlide (x y z : U)
    (hx : ∀ h : H, x * (h : U) * x⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hy : ∀ h : H, y * (h : U) * y⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hz : ∀ k : K, z * (k : U) * z⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hxy : x * y⁻¹ ∈ G) :
    let a := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator x hx
    let b := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator y hy
    let c := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator z hz
    let d : Dot a b := Dot.ofRepresentatives x y (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hxy
    let stem : Dot (a.comp c) (b.comp c) := ⟨d.element, fun k => d.intertwines (c.toHom k)⟩
    ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a c).eval.vertical
        ((up d).interpret.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.up c)).eval) =
      (up stem).interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitUp b c).eval) ∧
    ((Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) a c).eval.vertical
        ((Diagram.id (.down c)).eval.horizontal (down d).interpret.eval) =
      (down stem).interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitDown b c).eval) := by
  intro a b c d stem
  -- InductionSplitDotSlide and RestrictionSplitDotSlide give (3.2) and
  -- (3.4) with the same inner representative z on both sides and e = 1.
  -- Remove that mark at evaluation only, using the shared identity-dot laws.
  have hzz : z * z⁻¹ ∈ H := by simp
  let e : Dot c c := Dot.ofRepresentatives z z (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hzz
  have he : e = Dot.id c := by
    apply Dot.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    change z * z⁻¹ = 1
    exact mul_inv_cancel z
  have hu := (InductionSplitDotSlide K H G x z z hx hz hz hzz).1 y hy hxy
  have hd := (RestrictionSplitDotSlide K H G x z z hx hz hz hzz).1 y hy hxy
  change (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a c).eval.vertical
      ((up d).interpret.eval.horizontal (up e).interpret.eval) =
    (up (stem.vertical (e.whisker b))).interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitUp b c).eval at hu
  change (Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) a c).eval.vertical
      ((down e).interpret.eval.horizontal (down d).interpret.eval) =
    (down (stem.vertical (e.whisker b))).interpret.eval.vertical (Diagram.splitDown b c).eval at hd
  have hstem : stem.vertical ((Dot.id c).whisker b) = stem := by
    apply Dot.ext
    change stem.element * b.toHom 1 = stem.element
    rw [map_one, mul_one]
  rw [he, hstem, show (up (Dot.id c)).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (Word.up c).basis
    from DotLabel.upDrawing_identity c] at hu
  rw [he, hstem, show (down (Dot.id c)).interpret.eval = Biset.Hom.id (Word.down c).basis
    from DotLabel.downDrawing_identity c] at hd
  exact ⟨hu, hd⟩

end MovingSplitDotProof

open MackeyDiagrams MovingSplitDotProof
