BlockSwapOrbitSumWithoutGroupDot.proof:
by
  open BlockSwapOrbitSumSupport MackeyDiagrams in
  intro B₁ B₂ B₃ B₄ X Y U blockSym H G swap α β
  classical
  -- Xiao, Example 3.3 and Proposition 3.3 in § 3.4, archived p. 10.
  -- In the 28 November 2026 revision the example is on p. 13 and the
  -- proposition and its proof are on p. 12.
  -- These locators refer to separate PDFs. The revision has SHA-256
  -- 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61.
  -- The example has no numbered Alphabeta Math counterpart in the task context.
  -- Check the block images first so both conjugation embeddings have target G.
  let kα : Fin 4 → Fin 2 := ![0, 1, 0, 1]
  let kβ : Fin 4 → Fin 2 := ![0, 0, 1, 1]
  have hαMaps (i : Fin 4) : Set.MapsTo α.val (X i) (Y (kα i)) := by
    fin_cases i <;> intro x hx <;> simp [X, B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄] at hx <;>
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [Y, kα, B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄, α, swap, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have hβMaps (i : Fin 4) : Set.MapsTo β.val (X i) (Y (kβ i)) := by
    fin_cases i <;> intro x hx <;>
      simp [X, Y, kβ, B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄, β] at hx ⊢ <;> omega
  have hα : ∀ h : H, α * h.val * α⁻¹ ∈ G := conjugatesInto X Y α kα hαMaps
  have hβ : ∀ h : H, β * h.val * β⁻¹ ∈ G := conjugatesInto X Y β kβ hβMaps
  refine ⟨hα, hβ, ?_⟩
  intro a b orbit
  -- Every target factor preserves both blocks because the blocks are disjoint.
  have hY : Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (Y j) (Y k)) := by
    intro j k hjk
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;>
      intro x hx hy <;> simp [Y, B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄] at hx hy <;> omega
  have hpres (g : G) (j : Fin 2) : Set.MapsTo g.val.val (Y j) (Y j) :=
    preservesBlocks Y hY j g.property
  let t₀ := swap 4 5 (by decide)
  have ht₀ : t₀ ∈ blockSym (X 1) := by
    apply swapInBlock (i := 4) (j := 5) rfl <;> simp [X, B₂]
  let t : H := ⟨t₀, Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem 1 ht₀⟩
  have ha : (a.toHom t).val.val = Equiv.swap 7 8 := by
    change α.val * Equiv.swap 4 5 * α.val⁻¹ = Equiv.swap 7 8
    rw [← Equiv.swap_apply_apply]
    rfl
  have hb : (b.toHom t).val.val = Equiv.swap 4 5 := by
    change (1 : Equiv.Perm Nat) * Equiv.swap 4 5 * 1⁻¹ = Equiv.swap 4 5
    simp
  refine ⟨hpres, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨t, rfl, ha, hb⟩
  · -- Use the named transposition from the example directly. The blockwise
    -- criterion also applies to these disjoint nonempty families. The single
    -- intertwining equation here uses the already computed images of t.
    rintro ⟨d⟩
    have hp : d.element.val.val 4 ∈ Y 0 := hpres d.element 0 (by simp [Y, B₁, B₂])
    have hn₇ : d.element.val.val 4 ≠ 7 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hp
      simp [Y, B₁, B₂] at hp
    have hn₈ : d.element.val.val 4 ≠ 8 := by
      intro h
      rw [h] at hp
      simp [Y, B₁, B₂] at hp
    have heq := congrArg (fun g : G => g.val.val 4) (d.intertwines t)
    change (a.toHom t).val.val (d.element.val.val 4) =
      d.element.val.val ((b.toHom t).val.val 4) at heq
    rw [ha, hb, Equiv.swap_apply_left, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hn₇ hn₈] at heq
    exact (by decide : (4 : Nat) ≠ 5) (d.element.val.val.injective heq)
  · -- Finiteness of the source supplies the reverse cup for the trivial
    -- subgroup in FiniteOrbitSumDiagram. Its scaled composite realizes the
    -- distinct orbit sum, using the basis comparison inherited from
    -- InductionBimoduleOrbitSumBasis. The supplier gives pointwise evaluation
    -- on the whole group algebra. Diagram.eval_ext is unnecessary here.
    let S : Set Nat := (Finset.range 13 : Set Nat)
    have hbound : H ≤ blockSym S := by
      refine iSup_le fun i => fixingSubgroup_antitone (↥U) Nat (Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr ?_)
      intro x hx
      fin_cases i <;> simp [X, B₁, B₂, B₃, B₄, S] at hx ⊢ <;> omega
    let _ : Finite H := finiteOfBound hbound (Finset.range 13).finite_toSet
    obtain ⟨s, hs, d, hd⟩ := orbitDiagram H G α β hα hβ (1 : G)
    refine ⟨s, hs, d, ?_, hd⟩
    have hmem : (1 : G) ∈ (s : Set G) := by
      rw [hs]
      exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    -- The identity occurs once in the distinct orbit sum. Evaluating at the
    -- algebra unit and reading the identity coefficient gives 1.
    intro hz
    have hx := hd (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
    rw [hz, LinearMap.zero_apply, one_mul] at hx
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun f : G →₀ Complex => f 1) hx
    rw [Finsupp.zero_apply, nonzeroAtIdentity s hmem] at hcoeff
    exact zero_ne_one hcoeff
BlockSwapOrbitSumWithoutGroupDot.support:
namespace BlockSwapOrbitSumSupport

open MackeyDiagrams

private abbrev U : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}

private abbrev block (B : Set Nat) : Subgroup ↥U :=
  fixingSubgroup (↥U) Bᶜ

private theorem fixesOutside {B : Set Nat} {p : ↥U} (hp : p ∈ block B)
    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ B) : p.val x = x :=
  (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mp hp x hx

private theorem mapsBlock {B : Set Nat} {p : ↥U} (hp : p ∈ block B) :
    Set.MapsTo p.val B B := by
  intro x hx
  by_contra hout
  exact hout ((p.val.injective (fixesOutside hp hout)).symm ▸ hx)

private theorem preservesBlocks {ι : Type*} (Y : ι → Set Nat)
    (hY : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Y i) (Y j))) (j : ι)
    {p : ↥U} (hp : p ∈ ⨆ i, block (Y i)) : Set.MapsTo p.val (Y j) (Y j) := by
  refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun i => block (Y i))
    (C := fun q => Set.MapsTo q.val (Y j) (Y j)) hp ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i q hq
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst i
      exact mapsBlock hq
    · intro x hx
      have hout : x ∉ Y i := fun hi => Set.disjoint_left.mp (hY hij) hi hx
      exact (fixesOutside hq hout).symm ▸ hx
  · exact fun _ hx => hx
  · exact fun _ _ hq hr _ hx => hq (hr hx)

private theorem conjugatesInto {ι κ : Type*} (X : ι → Set Nat) (Y : κ → Set Nat)
    (p : ↥U) (k : ι → κ) (hmaps : ∀ i, Set.MapsTo p.val (X i) (Y (k i)))
    (h : ↥(⨆ i, block (X i))) : p * h.val * p⁻¹ ∈ ⨆ j, block (Y j) := by
  let G : Subgroup ↥U := ⨆ j, block (Y j)
  have hle : (⨆ i, block (X i)) ≤ G.comap (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom := by
    refine iSup_le fun i q hq => ?_
    change p * q * p⁻¹ ∈ G
    refine Subgroup.mem_iSup_of_mem (k i) ?_
    apply (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mpr
    intro x hx
    have hout : (p.val⁻¹ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∉ X i := by
      intro hmem
      apply hx
      simpa using hmaps i hmem
    change (p.val * q.val * p.val⁻¹) x = x
    simp only [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    rw [fixesOutside hq hout]
    exact p.val.apply_symm_apply x
  exact hle h.property

private theorem finiteOfBound {H : Subgroup ↥U} {S : Set Nat}
    (hle : H ≤ block S) (hS : S.Finite) : Finite H := by
  classical
  let _ : Finite S := hS
  let restrict := (Equiv.Perm.subtypeEquivSubtypePerm (· ∈ S)).symm
  let asPerm : H → {p : Equiv.Perm Nat // ∀ x, x ∉ S → p x = x} :=
    fun p => ⟨p.val.val, fun _ hx => fixesOutside (hle p.property) hx⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective asPerm := by
    intro p q hpq
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hpq
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hv)
  exact Finite.of_injective (restrict ∘ asPerm) (restrict.injective.comp hinj)

private theorem swapInBlock {B : Set Nat} {i j : Nat} {p : ↥U}
    (hp : p.val = Equiv.swap i j) (hi : i ∈ B) (hj : j ∈ B) : p ∈ block B := by
  apply (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mpr
  intro x hx
  change p.val x = x
  rw [hp]
  exact Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (fun h => hx (h.symm ▸ hi)) (fun h => hx (h.symm ▸ hj))

private theorem orbitDiagram {V : Type*} [Group V] (H G : Subgroup V) [Finite H]
    (α β : V) (hα : ∀ h : H, α * h.val * α⁻¹ ∈ G) (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * h.val * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (g : G) :
    let a := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let b := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let orbit := Set.range (fun h : H => a.toHom h * g * (b.toHom h)⁻¹)
    ∃ s : Finset G, (s : Set G) = orbit ∧
      ∃ d : Diagram Complex (Word.up a) (Word.up b),
        ∀ x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G, d.eval.toLinearMap x.coeff =
          (x * ∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex)).coeff := by
  intro a b orbit
  obtain ⟨basis, hbasis, _, hdiagram⟩ := FiniteOrbitSumDiagram H G α β hα hβ
  -- Alphabeta Math, Orbit-stabiliser, steps 1.1, 2.1 and 3.1
  -- (https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-orbit-stabilizer). Step 2.1 uses the
  -- range description of the orbit. Finiteness here comes from the separate
  -- hypothesis Finite H. FiniteOrbitSumDiagram checks the twisted left action
  -- using the two homomorphisms and uses the coset equivalence in steps 1.1
  -- and 3.1 to count each fiber before dividing by the stabilizer order.
  have hfinite : orbit.Finite := Set.finite_range _
  have hscaled := (hdiagram g).2.2
  refine ⟨hfinite.toFinset, hfinite.coe_toFinset, _, fun x => (hscaled x).trans ?_⟩
  exact congrArg MonoidAlgebra.coeff (hbasis ⟨hfinite.toFinset, ⟨g, hfinite.coe_toFinset⟩⟩ x)

private theorem nonzeroAtIdentity {G : Type*} [Group G] (s : Finset G) (hs : 1 ∈ s) :
    (∑ z ∈ s, MonoidAlgebra.single z (1 : Complex)).coeff 1 = 1 := by
  classical
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.coeff_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  simp [Finsupp.single_apply, hs]

end BlockSwapOrbitSumSupport

DotBetweenImagesInOneBlock.proof:
by
  -- Example 3.4 [ex:dot-in-one-block], archived PDF p. 11 and
  -- published 28 November revision p. 13. The HTML presents the example
  -- in one sentence. Its first claim is witnessed by paper label 3,
  -- encoded by 2 in Fin 4.
  intro U B H G α β a b
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hβ₁ : β (1 : Fin 4) = 2 := Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _
    have h₂ : (2 : Fin 4) ∈ Finset.image (fun x => β x) B :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨1, by simp [B], hβ₁⟩
    rw [← heq] at h₂
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx₂⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp h₂
    have hx' : x = 2 := hx₂
    subst x
    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 4) ∉ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4))) hx
  -- For the dot claim, implement the sufficiency construction in §3.4
  -- directly. The target has one block, so the ambient swap already
  -- extends the partial bijection from the beta image to the alpha image.
  -- BlockwiseGroupElementDotCriterion concerns finitary permutations of
  -- Nat and gives Nonempty for the dot type. This example requires a
  -- specified element in S₄. The shared ofRepresentatives constructor
  -- checks the intertwining equation from the two conjugation formulas.
  · have hinv : β⁻¹ = β := Equiv.symm_swap _ _
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl)
        (Subgroup.mem_top _)
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    change (1 : U) * β⁻¹ = β
    rw [one_mul, hinv]

StrongerEmbeddingConditionSlideObstructi.proof:
by
  classical
  intro Sfin U B blockSym K H G β swapInU α conj
  -- Xiao §3.4, Example 3.5 (ex:stronger-slide-obstruction), archived PDF
  -- p. 11 and published 28 November revision p. 13. The four blocks are
  -- from Example 3.3. The marked positions follow the §3.2 induction merge
  -- drawing (archive p. 9, revision p. 11), which depicts (3.1) with the
  -- outer strand unchanged. The plan supplies no numbered Alphabeta proof.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=13
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#ex:stronger-slide-obstruction
  have eachInside (i : Fin 4) : Blocks i ⊆ Carrier := by
    intro n hn
    change 3 * (i : Nat) + 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * (i : Nat) + 3 at hn
    change 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 12
    have hi := i.isLt
    omega
  have hKH : K ≤ H := by
    change (⨆ i, Block (Blocks i)) ≤
      Block (Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1) ⊔ Block (Blocks 2 ∪ Blocks 3)
    refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
    fin_cases i
    · exact (blockMono (fun _ h => Or.inl h)).trans le_sup_left
    · exact (blockMono (fun _ h => Or.inr h)).trans le_sup_left
    · exact (blockMono (fun _ h => Or.inl h)).trans le_sup_right
    · exact (blockMono (fun _ h => Or.inr h)).trans le_sup_right
  have hHG : H ≤ G :=
    sup_le (blockMono (Set.union_subset (eachInside 0) (eachInside 1)))
      (blockMono (Set.union_subset (eachInside 2) (eachInside 3)))
  have hα : α ∈ G := by
    apply (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mpr
    intro x hx
    change ¬ (1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 12) at hx
    exact blockSwapFix (by omega)
  have hOutside : α ∉ H := by
    intro h
    have h4 : 4 ∈ Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1 := Or.inr (by decide : 4 ∈ Blocks 1)
    have h7 := stabilizeFirst h h4
    have he : blockSwap.1 4 = 7 := by decide
    change blockSwap.1 4 ∈ Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1 at h7
    rw [he] at h7
    exact (by decide : 7 ∉ Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1) h7
  -- The support claim uses the first part of BlockwiseGroupElementDotCriterion
  -- with the single target block [1,12]. Every source block has three points.
  -- FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks works in the full permutation group with
  -- ranges on Finset subtypes. The stabilizer conjugation lemma works directly
  -- for these fixing subgroups inside the finitary ambient group.
  refine ⟨?_, blockSwapNormalizes, hOutside, hKH, hHG, hα, ?_⟩
  · intro σ hσ
    have hp := preserveCarrier σ hσ (hKH.trans hHG)
    change Conjugate (σ * (1 : U)⁻¹) H ≤ G
    rw [inv_one, mul_one]
    exact conjugateInside hHG hp
  · intro ιKH ιHG incl target input
    have hOuter (x : H) : (ιHG.toHom x : U) = (x : U) := by
      dsimp only [ιHG]
      simp only [MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_apply, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]
    have hIncl (k : K) :
        (incl.toHom k : U) = (1 : U) * (k : U) * (1 : U)⁻¹ := by
      change (ιHG.toHom (ιKH.toHom k) : U) = _
      rw [hOuter]
      rfl
    -- The right-multiplication convention uses the relative element α⁻¹.
    -- Here the three disjoint transpositions make α⁻¹ equal to α.
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot incl target :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives 1 α hIncl (fun _ => rfl)
        (by
          change (1 : ↥Finitary) * blockSwap⁻¹ ∈ G
          rw [one_mul, blockSwapInvolutive]
          exact hα)
    have hd : d.element = (⟨α, hα⟩ : G) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (1 : U) * α⁻¹ = α
      rw [one_mul]
      exact blockSwapInvolutive
    refine ⟨d, hd, ?_⟩
    intro onMerged
    rintro ⟨b, label, boundary, heval⟩
    -- MovingMergeDotBackToBranch gives the singleton slide criterion. The
    -- owner-clarified right mark has arbitrary finite coefficients. Evaluate
    -- both typed composites on the balanced unit tensor, using (3.1)'s
    -- multiplication and the finite-label basis formula.
    let units := Finsupp.single
      ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ιHG).pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ιKH) 1 1)
      (1 : Complex)
    have ht := trunkUnit ιHG ιKH d
    have hr := rightBranchUnit ιHG ιKH b label target boundary
    have hAtUnits := congrArg (fun f => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap f units) heval
    change _ = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap onMerged.interpret.eval units at hAtUnits
    dsimp only [onMerged] at hAtUnits
    rw [hr, ht] at hAtUnits
    have hzero : Finsupp.mapDomain (fun term => ιHG.toHom term.element) label d.element = 0 := by
      by_contra hnonzero
      have hs := Finsupp.mapDomain_support (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hnonzero)
      obtain ⟨term, _, hterm⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
      apply hOutside
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hterm
      rw [hOuter, hd] at hval
      change (term.element : U) = α at hval
      rw [← hval]
      exact term.element.property
    have hCoeff := DFunLike.congr_fun hAtUnits d.element
    change Finsupp.mapDomain (fun term => ιHG.toHom term.element) label d.element =
      Finsupp.single d.element (1 : Complex) d.element at hCoeff
    rw [hzero, Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hCoeff
    exact zero_ne_one hCoeff
StrongerEmbeddingConditionSlideObstructi.support:
namespace StrongerEmbeddingSlideProof

open scoped Pointwise

private abbrev Finitary : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}

private abbrev Block (X : Set Nat) : Subgroup ↥Finitary :=
  fixingSubgroup (↥Finitary) Xᶜ

private abbrev Blocks (i : Fin 4) : Set Nat :=
  Set.Icc (3 * (i : Nat) + 1) (3 * (i : Nat) + 3)

private abbrev Carrier : Set Nat := Set.Icc 1 12

private abbrev Conjugate (p : ↥Finitary) (L : Subgroup ↥Finitary) :=
  L.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom

private def swapInFinitary (i j : Nat) (hij : i ≠ j) : ↥Finitary :=
  ⟨Equiv.swap i j, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩⟩

private def blockSwap : ↥Finitary :=
  swapInFinitary 4 7 (by decide) * swapInFinitary 5 8 (by decide) *
    swapInFinitary 6 9 (by decide)

private theorem fixOutside {X : Set Nat} {p : ↥Finitary}
    (hp : p ∈ Block X) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ X) : p.1 x = x :=
  (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mp hp x hx

private theorem blockMono {X Y : Set Nat} (h : X ⊆ Y) : Block X ≤ Block Y :=
  fixingSubgroup_antitone (↥Finitary) Nat (Set.compl_subset_compl.mpr h)

private theorem blocksDisjoint : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (Blocks i) (Blocks j)) := by
  intro i j hij
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro n hi hj
  change 3 * (i : Nat) + 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * (i : Nat) + 3 at hi
  change 3 * (j : Nat) + 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * (j : Nat) + 3 at hj
  exact hij (Fin.ext (by omega))

private theorem blocksNontrivial (i : Fin 4) : Set.Nontrivial (Blocks i) := by
  refine ⟨3 * (i : Nat) + 1, ?_, 3 * (i : Nat) + 2, ?_, by omega⟩
  · change 3 * (i : Nat) + 1 ≤ _ ∧ _ ≤ 3 * (i : Nat) + 3
    omega
  · change 3 * (i : Nat) + 1 ≤ _ ∧ _ ≤ 3 * (i : Nat) + 3
    omega

private theorem covered {n : Nat} (hn : n ∈ Carrier) : ∃ i, n ∈ Blocks i := by
  change 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 12 at hn
  let i : Fin 4 := ⟨(n - 1) / 3, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  change 3 * ((n - 1) / 3) + 1 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 3 * ((n - 1) / 3) + 3
  omega

private theorem preserveCarrier (p : ↥Finitary)
    (hp : Conjugate p (⨆ i, Block (Blocks i)) ≤ Block Carrier)
    (hKG : (⨆ i, Block (Blocks i)) ≤ Block Carrier) :
    Set.MapsTo p.1 Carrier Carrier := by
  have step := BlockwiseGroupElementDotCriterion Blocks (fun _ : Unit => Carrier)
    (fun i => (blocksNontrivial i).nonempty)
    (fun _ => ⟨1, by decide⟩) blocksDisjoint
    (fun i j hij => absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hij)
  have hG : (⨆ _ : Unit, Block Carrier) = Block Carrier := iSup_const
  have hp' (k : ↥(⨆ i, Block (Blocks i))) :
      p * k.1 * p⁻¹ ∈ (⨆ _ : Unit, Block Carrier) := by
    rw [hG]
    exact hp (Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨k.1, k.2, rfl⟩)
  have h1 (k : ↥(⨆ i, Block (Blocks i))) :
      1 * k.1 * (1 : ↥Finitary)⁻¹ ∈ (⨆ _ : Unit, Block Carrier) := by
    simpa only [hG, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using hKG k.2
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := covered hn
  obtain ⟨_, hblock⟩ := ((step p 1 hp' h1).1 i (blocksNontrivial i)).1
  exact hblock hi

private theorem conjugateInside {L : Subgroup ↥Finitary} (hL : L ≤ Block Carrier)
    {p : ↥Finitary} (hp : Set.MapsTo p.1 Carrier Carrier) :
    Conjugate p L ≤ Block Carrier := by
  rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  apply (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff _).mpr
  intro z hz
  have hz' : p.1.symm z ∉ Carrier := fun h => hz (p.1.apply_symm_apply z ▸ hp h)
  change p.1 (q.1 (p.1.symm z)) = z
  rw [fixOutside (hL hq) hz', p.1.apply_symm_apply]

private theorem blockSwapFix {x : Nat}
    (hx : x < 4 ∨ 9 < x) : blockSwap.1 x = x := by
  change Equiv.swap 4 7 (Equiv.swap 5 8 (Equiv.swap 6 9 x)) = x
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (by omega : x ≠ 6) (by omega : x ≠ 9),
    Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (by omega : x ≠ 5) (by omega : x ≠ 8),
    Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (by omega : x ≠ 4) (by omega : x ≠ 7)]

private theorem blockSwapInvolutive : blockSwap⁻¹ = blockSwap := by
  apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  change blockSwap.1 (blockSwap.1 x) = x
  by_cases hx : 4 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 9
  · obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hx
    interval_cases x <;> decide
  · have hfix := blockSwapFix (x := x) (by omega)
    rw [hfix, hfix]

private theorem conjugateBlock (p : ↥Finitary) (X Y : Set Nat)
    (h : p • X = Y) : Conjugate p (Block X) = Block Y :=
  SubMulAction.fixingSubgroup_map_conj_eq (by rw [Set.smul_set_compl, h])

private theorem blockSwapBlocks (i : Fin 4) :
    blockSwap • Blocks i = Blocks (Equiv.swap 1 2 i) := by
  have h (j : Fin 4) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ Blocks j) :
      blockSwap.1 x ∈ Blocks (Equiv.swap 1 2 j) := by
    change 3 * (j : Nat) + 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 3 * (j : Nat) + 3 at hx
    change 3 * ((Equiv.swap 1 2 j : Fin 4) : Nat) + 1 ≤ blockSwap.1 x ∧
      blockSwap.1 x ≤ 3 * ((Equiv.swap 1 2 j : Fin 4) : Nat) + 3
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := hx
    fin_cases j <;> norm_num at hlo hhi <;> interval_cases x <;> decide
  ext x
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem, blockSwapInvolutive]
  change blockSwap.1 x ∈ Blocks i ↔ x ∈ Blocks (Equiv.swap 1 2 i)
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have he : blockSwap.1 (blockSwap.1 x) = x := by
      have he' : blockSwap⁻¹.1 (blockSwap.1 x) = x := blockSwap.1.symm_apply_apply x
      rw [blockSwapInvolutive] at he'
      exact he'
    exact he ▸ h i hx
  · intro hx
    simpa only [Equiv.swap_apply_self] using h (Equiv.swap 1 2 i) hx

private theorem blockSwapNormalizes :
    Conjugate blockSwap (⨆ i, Block (Blocks i)) = ⨆ i, Block (Blocks i) := by
  unfold Conjugate
  rw [Subgroup.map_iSup]
  have he (i : Fin 4) :
      (Block (Blocks i)).map (MulAut.conj blockSwap).toMonoidHom =
        Block (Blocks (Equiv.swap 1 2 i)) :=
    conjugateBlock blockSwap _ _ (blockSwapBlocks i)
  simp only [he]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact iSup_le fun i => le_iSup (fun j => Block (Blocks j)) (Equiv.swap 1 2 i)
  · refine iSup_le fun i => ?_
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := (Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 4) 2).surjective i
    exact le_iSup (fun j => Block (Blocks (Equiv.swap 1 2 j))) j

private theorem blockPreserves {X : Set Nat} {p : ↥Finitary} (hp : p ∈ Block X) :
    Set.MapsTo p.1 X X := by
  intro x hx
  by_contra h
  have he : x = p.1 x := p.1.injective (fixOutside hp h).symm
  exact h (he ▸ hx)

private theorem stabilizeFirst {p : ↥Finitary}
    (hp : p ∈ Block (Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1) ⊔ Block (Blocks 2 ∪ Blocks 3)) :
    Set.MapsTo p.1 (Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1) (Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1) := by
  let L := Blocks 0 ∪ Blocks 1
  let R := Blocks 2 ∪ Blocks 3
  have hd : Disjoint L R := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro x (h0 | h1) (h2 | h3)
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (blocksDisjoint (by decide : (0 : Fin 4) ≠ 2)) h0 h2
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (blocksDisjoint (by decide : (0 : Fin 4) ≠ 3)) h0 h3
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (blocksDisjoint (by decide : (1 : Fin 4) ≠ 2)) h1 h2
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (blocksDisjoint (by decide : (1 : Fin 4) ≠ 3)) h1 h3
  let stabilizer := MulAction.stabilizer (↥Finitary) L
  have stabilizes (q : ↥Finitary) (hq : Set.MapsTo q.1 L L)
      (hqInv : Set.MapsTo (q⁻¹).1 L L) : q ∈ stabilizer := by
    apply MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mpr
    ext x
    rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
    change (q⁻¹).1 x ∈ L ↔ x ∈ L
    exact ⟨fun hx => q.1.apply_symm_apply x ▸ hq hx, fun hx => hqInv hx⟩
  have fixes (q : ↥Finitary) (hq : q ∈ Block R) : Set.MapsTo q.1 L L := by
    intro x hx
    rw [fixOutside hq (Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hx)]
    exact hx
  have hs : Block L ⊔ Block R ≤ stabilizer :=
    sup_le (fun q hq => stabilizes q (blockPreserves hq) (blockPreserves ((Block L).inv_mem hq)))
      (fun q hq => stabilizes q (fixes q hq) (fixes q⁻¹ ((Block R).inv_mem hq)))
  have hp' := MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp (hs hp)
  intro x hx
  change p • x ∈ L
  rw [← hp']
  exact Set.smul_mem_smul_set hx

open MackeyDiagrams

section Evaluation

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}

-- The local unit-evaluation argument from RightInputDotSlideObstruction
-- works at a distinct target embedding too. Check it here with that boundary.
private theorem trunkUnit (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) (a : ConjEmbedding K H)
    {target : ConjEmbedding K G} (d : Dot (γ.comp a) target) :
    ((LabelledDrawing.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp γ a)).vertical
      (DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex)))).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction γ).pair (Biset.induction a) 1 1) 1) =
      Finsupp.single d.element 1 := by
  change (DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.mergeUp γ a).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction γ).pair (Biset.induction a) 1 1) 1)) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, map_one, one_mul, DotLabel.eval_upDrawing,
    Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply, freeLift_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single, one_mul]

-- The output of an up strand has carrier G for every target embedding.
-- Eliminate the output equality before evaluating the transported drawing.
private theorem rightBranchUnit (γ : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (label : DotLabel Complex a b) (target : ConjEmbedding K G)
    (h : γ.comp b = target) :
    let A := ((LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (Word.up γ))).horizontal
      (DotLabel.upDrawing label)).vertical
      (LabelledDrawing.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp γ b))
    (LabelledDrawing.interpret
      (Eq.ndrec (motive := fun out =>
        LabelledDrawing Complex ((Word.up γ).tensor (Word.up a)) (Word.up out))
        A h)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction γ).pair (Biset.induction a) 1 1) 1) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (fun term => γ.toHom term.element) label := by
  subst target
  classical
  let outer := Biset.induction γ
  let inner := Biset.induction b
  let merge := (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) γ b).eval.toLinearMap
  let dot := (DotLabel.upDrawing label).interpret.eval
  let straight := (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.up γ)).eval
  let pairAtOne := Biset.pairLinear Complex outer inner (Finsupp.single 1 1)
  change merge ((straight.horizontal dot).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (outer.pair (Biset.induction a) 1 1) 1)) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  change merge (pairAtOne (dot.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1))) = _
  rw [show dot.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single 1 1) =
      (label.support.toList.map (fun d => label d • Finsupp.single d.element 1)).sum by
    simpa only [dot, one_mul] using DotLabel.upDrawing_basis label (1 : H)]
  change (merge.comp pairAtOne)
      ((label.support.toList.map (fun d => label d • Finsupp.single d.element 1)).sum) = _
  rw [map_list_sum, List.map_map, ← List.sum_toFinset _ label.support.nodup_toList,
    Finset.toList_toFinset, Finsupp.mapDomain, Finsupp.sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
  change merge (pairAtOne (label d • Finsupp.single d.element 1)) = _
  rw [map_smul, map_smul]
  dsimp only [pairAtOne, merge, outer, inner]
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, one_mul,
    Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

end Evaluation

external.usage: Conjugate each fixing subgroup inside the ambient finitary permutation group by transporting the complement of its block. Reindex the supremum using the induced swap of the two middle blocks.

StraightMixedTrivalentVertices.proof:
by
  -- Xiao, §3.5, straight-segment figure following Proposition 3.4.
  -- Archived original pp. 12–13 (pairs, then straight junctions).
  -- Published 28 November revision pp. 14–15, SHA-256
  -- 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- Alphabeta Math, tensor product universal property, Steps 3.1, 4.1,
  -- and 5.1: verify balance and additivity, descend through the relations,
  -- and identify the map on generators.
  -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-universal-property-of-module-tensor-products
  -- Here the shared evaluator imposes middle-group balance by a biset
  -- quotient, then complex linearization imposes additivity. The compiled
  -- TrivalentBendIdentities supplies the resulting map equalities, so the
  -- generator computations from Proposition 3.4 are used through that theorem.
  intro U _ K H G α γ
  obtain ⟨multiplication, ordinary, trace, reverse⟩ :=
    TrivalentBendIdentities K H G α γ
  -- LabelledDrawing.interpret uses the ordinary scoped evaluator on
  -- TrivalentVertex.expand, which uses BentVertex.expand for these four
  -- orientations. This reduces directly; eval_bentVertex concerns the
  -- separate ScopedDiagram.bentVertex constructor.
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- Multiplication cap (upper left), at arbitrary index.
    exact ⟨rfl, multiplication⟩
  · -- Trace cap (upper right), with the index required by the smaller cup.
    intro finiteAlpha
    exact ⟨rfl, trace finiteAlpha⟩
  · -- Ordinary cup (lower left), at arbitrary index.
    exact ⟨rfl, ordinary⟩
  · -- Reverse cup (lower right), with the composite index. The endpoint
    -- and supplier pull back this index along γ. The resulting witnesses
    -- for the smaller cup are definitionally equal by proof irrelevance.
    intro finiteComposite
    exact ⟨rfl, reverse finiteComposite⟩

MackeyIdentityDiagram.proof:
(by
  intro U inst K H G α β Kα Hβ hK hH a b A B J σ reps L l r d down up M Mj
  let crossing (j : J) := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
  have injective (j : J) : Function.Injective (crossing j) := by
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Generator.injective_mixedMultiplicationBasis
    intro k h he
    let ell := α * (k : U) * α⁻¹
    have hleft : ell ∈ Kα := ⟨k,k.property,rfl⟩
    have hright : ell ∈ Subgroup.map
        (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H := by
      refine ⟨h,h.property,?_⟩
      have hh := congrArg Subtype.val he
      change α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ =
        (σ j : U) * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹) * (σ j : U)⁻¹ at hh
      change ((σ j : U) * β) * (h : U) * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = ell
      change ((σ j : U) * β) * (h : U) * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ =
        α * (k : U) * α⁻¹
      rw [hh]
      group
    refine ⟨⟨ell, hleft, hright⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change α⁻¹ * (α * (k : U) * α⁻¹) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ = (k : U)
    group
  have hf (j : J) (z : M.basis.carrier) : Set.Finite {w | crossing j w = z} :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.finiteFiber_of_injective a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (injective j) z
  have equivariant (j : J) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
  have rangeCriterion (j : J) (z : M.basis.carrier) :
      z ∈ Set.range (crossing j) ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z) = j := by
    let g := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z
    have hz := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct a b z
    change z ∈ Set.range (crossing j) ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j
    rw [← hz]
    change MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g ∈ Set.range (crossing j) ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j
    rw [MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedRange_eq_doubleCoset a b (l j) (r j) (d j)]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k,h,hg⟩
      have hc : DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = DoubleCoset.mk A B g := by
        apply DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
        refine ⟨a.toHom k, ⟨k,k.property,rfl⟩, b.toHom h, ⟨h,h.property,rfl⟩, ?_⟩
        exact hg
      exact hc.symm.trans (reps j)
    · intro hg
      have hc : DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = DoubleCoset.mk A B g :=
        (reps j).trans hg.symm
      obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,hg⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp hc
      change (x : U) ∈ Kα at hx
      change (y : U) ∈ Hβ at hy
      obtain ⟨k,hk,hx⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨h,hh,hy⟩ := hy
      have hx' : a.toHom ⟨k,hk⟩ = x := Subtype.ext hx
      have hy' : b.toHom ⟨h,hh⟩ = y := Subtype.ext hy
      exact ⟨⟨k,hk⟩, ⟨h,hh⟩, by rw [hx', hy']; exact hg⟩
  have partition (z : M.basis.carrier) : ∃! j : J, z ∈ Set.range (crossing j) := by
    let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
    exact ⟨j, (rangeCriterion j z).mpr rfl,
      fun i hi => ((rangeCriterion i z).mp hi).symm⟩
  refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
  intro inclusion projection straight crossed term
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · classical
    have pointwise (x : M.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
        ∃ finite : Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)), x = ∑ j ∈ finite.toFinset, term x j :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.sum_partition_projections
        (R := Complex) (fun j => (Mj j).basis) crossing equivariant hf injective partition x
    choose finite hsum using pointwise
    refine ⟨finite, fun x => ?_⟩
    have hs : straight.eval = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id M.basis :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id down.basis up.basis
    rw [hs]
    exact hsum x
  · intro j
    exact MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.inclusion_projection (crossing j)
      (equivariant j) (hf j) (injective j)
  · intro i j hij
    have disj : Disjoint (Set.range (crossing j)) (Set.range (crossing i)) := by
      apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro y hyj hyi
      exact hij (((rangeCriterion i y).mp hyi).symm.trans ((rangeCriterion j y).mp hyj))
    exact MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.projection_between_disjoint (crossing j)
      (equivariant j) (hf j) (crossing i) (equivariant i) disj)

SupportBoundsForInverseProduct.proof:
by
  intro A B C blockSym G H Ghat bound conjugate α β γ
  -- Xiao, Example 3.7, archived PDF p. 11 and 28 November revision p. 13.
  -- Alphabeta Math, https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group,
  -- step 1.1 checks a product of swaps pointwise, with the rightmost factor first.
  -- The swaps are given here, so the finite-carrier decomposition in step 2.1
  -- is unnecessary. On Nat we check the complement of each finite block.
  -- SupportBoundsUnderComposition treats six-point blocks and β = 1.
  -- Its conclusion supplies no containment for these two-point blocks.
  have memA (x : Nat) : x ∈ A ↔ 1 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2 := Finset.mem_Icc
  have memB (x : Nat) : x ∈ B ↔ 3 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 4 := Finset.mem_Icc
  have memC (x : Nat) : x ∈ C ↔ 5 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 6 := Finset.mem_Icc
  have oneA := (memA 1).mpr (by decide)
  have twoA := (memA 2).mpr (by decide)
  have threeB := (memB 3).mpr (by decide)
  have fourB := (memB 4).mpr (by decide)
  have fiveC := (memC 5).mpr (by decide)
  have memPair (x : Nat) : x ∈ A ↔ x = 1 ∨ x = 2 := by
    rw [memA]
    omega
  have blockOfFix (S : Finset Nat) (p : Equiv.Perm Nat)
      (fix : ∀ x, x ∉ S → p x = x) : p ∈ blockSym S := by
    let e := Equiv.Perm.subtypeEquivSubtypePerm (fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)
    exact ⟨e.symm ⟨p, fix⟩, congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply ⟨p, fix⟩)⟩
  have blockFix (S : Finset Nat) (p : Equiv.Perm Nat) (hp : p ∈ blockSym S)
      (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ S) : p x = x := by
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hp
    exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f hx
  have swapFix {S : Finset Nat} {u v : Nat} (hu : u ∈ S) (hv : v ∈ S)
      (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ S) : Equiv.swap u v x = x :=
    Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (fun h => hx (h.symm ▸ hu)) (fun h => hx (h.symm ▸ hv))
  let U := A ∪ B ∪ C
  have oneU : 1 ∈ U := Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ oneA)
  have twoU : 2 ∈ U := Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_left _ twoA)
  have threeU : 3 ∈ U := Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ threeB)
  have fourU : 4 ∈ U := Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_union_right _ fourB)
  have fiveU : 5 ∈ U := Finset.mem_union_right _ fiveC
  have αhat : α ∈ Ghat := by
    apply blockOfFix U α
    intro x hx
    by_contra moved
    change (Equiv.swap 1 3 * Equiv.swap 2 4 : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ≠ x at moved
    rcases Equiv.Perm.set_support_mul_subset _ _ moved with h | h
    · exact h (swapFix oneU threeU x hx)
    · exact h (swapFix twoU fourU x hx)
  have βhat : β ∈ Ghat := blockOfFix U β (swapFix fourU fiveU)
  have boundOfHat (p : Equiv.Perm Nat) (hp : p ∈ Ghat) : p ∈ bound :=
    ⟨p, hp, 1, H.one_mem, mul_one p⟩
  have transport (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) (T : Finset Nat)
      (maps : ∀ x ∈ A, σ x ∈ T) : conjugate σ H ≤ blockSym T := by
    rintro q ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    apply blockOfFix T
    intro x hx
    have outside : σ.symm x ∉ A :=
      fun h => hx (by simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using maps (σ.symm x) h)
    change σ (p (σ.symm x)) = x
    rw [blockFix A p hp _ outside, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have αone : α 1 = 3 := by
    simp [α, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have αtwo : α 2 = 4 := by
    simp [α, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have βone : β 1 = 1 := by
    simp [β, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have βtwo : β 2 = 2 := by
    simp [β, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have embα : conjugate α H ≤ G := by
    refine (transport α B ?_).trans (le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_right)
    intro x hx
    rcases (memPair x).mp hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact αone.symm ▸ threeB
    · exact αtwo.symm ▸ fourB
  have embβ : conjugate β H ≤ G := by
    refine (transport β A ?_).trans (le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_left)
    intro x hx
    rcases (memPair x).mp hx with rfl | rfl
    · exact βone.symm ▸ oneA
    · exact βtwo.symm ▸ twoA
  -- The inverse-support equality identifies the moved points of α⁻¹. To get
  -- the exact image under β * α⁻¹, compute the two inverse images via α's
  -- forward action and then apply β.
  have αinvOne : α.symm 1 = 3 := by
    apply α.injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simp [α, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have αinvTwo : α.symm 2 = 4 := by
    apply α.injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    simp [α, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have γone : γ 1 = 3 := by
    change β (α.symm 1) = 3
    simp [αinvOne, β, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have γtwo : γ 2 = 5 := by
    change β (α.symm 2) = 5
    simp [αinvTwo, β]
  have image : Finset.image γ A = ({3, 5} : Finset Nat) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, memPair]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl | rfl, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl (h.symm.trans γone)
      · exact Or.inr (h.symm.trans γtwo)
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨1, Or.inl rfl, γone⟩
      · exact ⟨2, Or.inr rfl, γtwo⟩
  -- The target preserves B setwise. The conjugate of (1 2) takes 3 out of B.
  let preservesB : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
    { carrier := {p | ∀ x, p x ∈ B ↔ x ∈ B}
      one_mem' := fun _ => Iff.rfl
      mul_mem' := fun hp hq x => (hp _).trans (hq x)
      inv_mem' := fun {p} hp x => by
        change p.symm x ∈ B ↔ x ∈ B
        simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using (hp (p.symm x)).symm }
  have preserveOther (S : Finset Nat) (hd : Disjoint S B) : blockSym S ≤ preservesB := by
    intro p hp x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ S
    · obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := hp
      exact iff_of_false
        (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd ((Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem f x).mpr hx))
        (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hd hx)
    · rw [blockFix S p hp x hx]
  have preserveOwn : blockSym B ≤ preservesB := by
    rintro p ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem f
  have disjointAB : Disjoint A B := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hxA hxB
    have := (memA x).mp hxA
    have := (memB x).mp hxB
    omega
  have disjointCB : Disjoint C B := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro x hxC hxB
    have := (memC x).mp hxC
    have := (memB x).mp hxB
    omega
  have preserveG : G ≤ preservesB :=
    sup_le (sup_le (preserveOther A disjointAB) preserveOwn) (preserveOther C disjointCB)
  refine ⟨boundOfHat α αhat, boundOfHat β βhat, embα, embβ, image, ?_⟩
  intro contained
  let τ : Equiv.Perm Nat := Equiv.swap 1 2
  have τH : τ ∈ H := blockOfFix A τ (swapFix oneA twoA)
  have swapIn : (Equiv.swap 3 5 : Equiv.Perm Nat) ∈ conjugate γ H := by
    refine ⟨τ, τH, ?_⟩
    change γ * Equiv.swap 1 2 * γ⁻¹ = Equiv.swap 3 5
    rw [← Equiv.swap_apply_apply, γone, γtwo]
  have h := preserveG (contained swapIn) 3
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left] at h
  have fiveNotB : 5 ∉ B := fun hx => (by decide : ¬ (5 ≤ 4)) ((memB 5).mp hx).2
  exact fiveNotB (h.mpr threeB)

external.usage: For the product (1 3)(2 4) on Nat, any moved point lies in the support of one of the two factors. Both supports are contained in the union of the three two-point blocks.
With the decidable predicate x ∈ S for a Finset of Nat, restrict a permutation fixing the complement of S and extend it back to obtain a witness in the range defining blockSym S.

For a permutation on a block subtype, identity extension fixes the complement pointwise and preserves membership in the block. This proves that each factor of G preserves {3, 4} setwise and verifies the complement-fixing property used in conjugating H.
Compute the conjugate of the source transposition (1 2) by β * α⁻¹ as the ambient transposition (3 5), using the two checked point images.

CommonMackeyIntersectionSum.proof:
(by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G α β conjugate hα hβ a b A B J σ hσ Lj left right dot
    kg gk gh M inner finiteFibers inclusion projection outer full cupProjection
  have hK (k : K) : α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G := (a.toHom k).property
  have hH (h : H) : β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G := (b.toHom h).property
  let f (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) :=
    Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS) (dot j S hS)
  let orbit (j : J) := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  -- Xiao, §5.1, “Smaller internal groups and intersections” (archived
  -- p. 17, revised published p. 19), invokes Proposition 5.1. The reviewed
  -- plan has no numbered Alphabeta Math proof for this endpoint.
  -- Steps 1–4 of the registered MixedCrossingComposites proof identify the
  -- multiplication and finite transfer on basis vectors. The registered
  -- smaller-group supplier gives their composite after fixing this exact
  -- representative, including the image and the relative fiber cardinality.
  have data (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) (h : S.IsFiniteRelIndex (Lj j)) :
      (∃ (hf : finiteFibers j S hS) (hfJ : finiteFibers j (Lj j) (full j)),
        (outer j S hS hf).eval =
          (Diagram.scale (S.relIndex (Lj j) : Complex) (outer j (Lj j) (full j) hfJ)).eval) ∧
      Set.range (fun w => Generator.mixedProduct a b (f j S hS w)) = orbit j ∧
      (∀ g ∈ orbit j, Nat.card {w | Generator.mixedProduct a b (f j S hS w) = g}
        = S.relIndex (Lj j)) := by
    obtain ⟨hf, hfJ, houter, hRange, _, _, hCard, _, _⟩ :=
      MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup K H G α β hK hH σ hσ j S hS h
    exact ⟨⟨hf, hfJ, houter⟩, hRange, fun g hg => (hCard g hg).1⟩
  refine ⟨fun j S hS h => (data j S hS h).1, ?_⟩
  intro J₀ _ I L hL
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    have hInv : (β⁻¹ * (σ i.val : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (β⁻¹ * (σ j.val : U)⁻¹) =
        (σ i.val : U) * (σ j.val : U)⁻¹ := by group
    exact (ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator_eq_iff _ _ _ _).trans (by rw [hInv])
  intro hIndex
  choose hfL hfJ hOuter using fun j : I => (data j.val L (hL j) (hIndex j)).1
  refine ⟨hfL, hfJ, ?_⟩
  intro n restricted usual normalized V term
  have hNorm (j : I) : (normalized j).eval = (usual j).eval := by
    have : L.IsFiniteRelIndex (Lj j.val) := hIndex j
    have hn : n j ≠ 0 := by
      change (L.relIndex (Lj j.val) : Complex) ≠ 0
      exact_mod_cast (Subgroup.index_ne_zero (H := L.subgroupOf (Lj j.val)) :
        L.relIndex (Lj j.val) ≠ 0)
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change (n j)⁻¹ • ((restricted j).eval.toLinearMap x) = (usual j).eval.toLinearMap x
    rw [hOuter j]
    change (n j)⁻¹ • (n j • (usual j).eval.toLinearMap x) = _
    rw [← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
  have orbit_iff (j : J) (g : G) : g ∈ orbit j ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j := by
    calc
      g ∈ orbit j ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B g = DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) := by
        constructor
        · intro hg
          exact (DoubleCoset.eq.mpr (DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset.mp hg)).symm
        · intro hg
          exact DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset.mpr (DoubleCoset.eq.mp hg.symm)
      _ ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j := by rw [hσ j]
  have range_iff (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j)
      (hi : S.IsFiniteRelIndex (Lj j)) (z : M.basis.carrier) :
      z ∈ Set.range (f j S hS) ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct a b z) = j := by
    let e := Generator.mixedEquiv a b
    change z ∈ Set.range (f j S hS) ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B (e z) = j
    rw [← orbit_iff, ← (data j S hS hi).2.1]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => ⟨w, congrArg e hw⟩,
      fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => ⟨w, e.injective hw⟩⟩
  have hOrth (i j : I) (hij : i ≠ j) :
      (Diagram.vertical (inclusion i.val L (hL i)) (projection j.val L (hL j) (hfL j))).eval =
        (Diagram.zero (inner i.val L (hL i)) (inner j.val L (hL j))).eval := by
    apply Biset.Hom.projection_between_disjoint (f j.val L (hL j))
      (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b _ _ _) (hfL j)
      (f i.val L (hL i)) (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b _ _ _)
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hzj hzi
    exact hij (Subtype.ext (((range_iff i.val L (hL i) (hIndex i) z).mp hzi).symm.trans
      ((range_iff j.val L (hL j) (hIndex j) z).mp hzj)))
  have hSelf (j : J) : (Lj j).IsFiniteRelIndex (Lj j) :=
    inferInstance
  have hColumn (z : M.basis.carrier) (j : I) :
      term usual (Finsupp.single z 1) j =
        if j.val = DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
        then Finsupp.single z 1 else 0 := by
    rw [show term usual (Finsupp.single z 1) j =
        Finsupp.single z ((hfJ j z).toFinset.card : Complex) from
      Diagram.projection_then_inclusion_single Complex a b _ _ _ (hfJ j) z]
    by_cases h : j.val = DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
    · rw [ite_eq_left h]
      have hs : {w | f j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val) w = z} =
          {w | Generator.mixedProduct a b (f j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val) w) =
            Generator.mixedProduct a b z} :=
        Set.ext fun w => (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).injective.eq_iff.symm
      have hc : (hfJ j z).toFinset.card = 1 := by
        calc
          _ = Nat.card {w | f j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val) w = z} :=
            CommonMackeyIntersectionSumAux.cardFiber _ (hfJ j z)
          _ = 1 := by
            rw [hs, (data j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val) (hSelf j.val)).2.2 _
              ((orbit_iff j.val _).mpr h.symm), Subgroup.relIndex_self]
      rw [hc, Nat.cast_one]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h]
      have hempty : (hfJ j z).toFinset = ∅ := by
        apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro w hw
        exact h (((range_iff j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val) (hSelf j.val) z).mp
          ⟨w, (hfJ j z).mem_toFinset.mp hw⟩).symm)
      rw [hempty, Finset.card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, Finsupp.single_zero]
  have hTerm (x : V) : term normalized x = term usual x :=
    funext fun j => congrArg (fun m => m.toLinearMap x) (hNorm j)
  have hBasis (z : M.basis.carrier) :
      Function.support (term usual (Finsupp.single z 1)) =
        {j : I | j.val = DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct a b z)} := by
    ext j
    change (term usual (Finsupp.single z 1) j ≠ 0) ↔ _
    rw [hColumn]
    by_cases h : j.val = DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]
  -- MackeyIdentityDiagram sums a complete partition and uses comap
  -- subgroups to index its quotient. The selected family need not cover
  -- the basis. Use its basis-support argument on the selected subtype.
  -- Active indices inject into the finite image of the support of x.
  let coset := fun z : M.basis.carrier => DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
  have finiteJ (x : V) : Set.Finite (Function.support (term usual x)) := by
    have hb : Set.Finite {j : I | j.val ∈ x.support.image coset} :=
      (x.support.image coset).finite_toSet.preimage Subtype.val_injective.injOn
    apply hb.subset
    intro j hj
    by_contra h
    apply hj
    have hs : (∑ z ∈ x.support, Finsupp.single z (x z)) = x := Finsupp.sum_single x
    change (usual j).eval.toLinearMap x = 0
    rw [← hs, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro z hz
    have hne : j.val ≠ coset z := fun he => h (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨z, hz, he.symm⟩)
    have hp : Finsupp.single z (x z) = (x z) • Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex) := by
      simp [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [hp, map_smul]
    change (x z) • term usual (Finsupp.single z 1) j = 0
    rw [hColumn, ite_eq_right hne, smul_zero]
  have finiteL (x : V) : Set.Finite (Function.support (term normalized x)) :=
    hTerm x ▸ finiteJ x
  refine ⟨hNorm, hOrth, ?_, ⟨finiteL, finiteJ, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    exact ⟨(congrArg Function.support (hTerm _)).trans (hBasis z), hBasis z⟩
  · intro sumL sumJ x
    change (∑ j ∈ (finiteL x).toFinset, term normalized x j) =
      (∑ j ∈ (finiteJ x).toFinset, term usual x j)
    have hFinset : (finiteL x).toFinset = (finiteJ x).toFinset := by
      ext j
      simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, hTerm x]
    rw [hFinset, hTerm x]
  · intro hJ₀ cupsL cupsJ indices withCupL withCupJ sumL sumJ
    have hCups (j : I) :
        (withCupL j).eval = (normalized j).eval ∧ (withCupJ j).eval = (usual j).eval := by
      exact ⟨CommonMackeyIntersectionSumAux.scaledCupOuter_eval a b
        (left j.val L (hL j)) (right j.val L (hL j)) (dot j.val L (hL j))
        (cupsL j) (hfL j) (n j)⁻¹,
        CommonMackeyIntersectionSumAux.cupOuter_eval a b
          (left j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val)) (right j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val))
          (dot j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val)) (cupsJ j) (hfJ j)⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hCups⟩
    change (∑ j ∈ indices, (withCupL j).eval.toLinearMap) =
      (∑ j ∈ indices, (withCupJ j).eval.toLinearMap)
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    exact congrArg MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      ((hCups j).1.trans ((hNorm j).trans (hCups j).2.symm)))

namespace CommonMackeyIntersectionSumAux

open MackeyDiagrams

noncomputable section

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H G S : Subgroup U}

private def cupProjection (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding S K) (r : ConjEmbedding S H)
    (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) (hc : r.toHom.range.FiniteIndex) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)) ((Word.up l).tensor (.down r)) :=
  let kg := Word.down a
  let gk := Word.up a
  let gh := Word.up b
  let kl := Word.up l
  let hl := Word.up r
  let lh := Word.down r
  let target := kl.tensor lh
  let insertCup := (Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (.insertRightUnit gh)).vertical
    (Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (Diagram.horizontal (.id gh) (.reverseCup r hc)))
  let rebracket := Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (.unassociate gh hl lh)
  let insertDot := Diagram.horizontal (.id kg)
    (Diagram.horizontal ((Diagram.mergeUp b r).vertical
      ((Diagram.upDot d.inverse).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a l))) (.id lh))
  let prepareTrace := (Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (.associate gk kl lh)).vertical
    (.unassociate kg gk target)
  let trace := (Diagram.horizontal (.traceCap a) (.id target)).vertical (.leftUnit target)
  insertCup.vertical (rebracket.vertical (insertDot.vertical (prepareTrace.vertical trace)))

private theorem insertRightUnit_single {A B : Subgroup U} (p : Word A B) (x : p.basis.carrier) :
    (Diagram.insertRightUnit (R := Complex) p).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (Biset.regular B) x 1) 1 := by
  change (Biset.insertRightUnit p.basis Complex).toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Biset.insertRightUnit, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]

private theorem cupProjection_eval (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding S K) (r : ConjEmbedding S H)
    (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) (hc : r.toHom.range.FiniteIndex)
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z}) :
    (cupProjection a b l r d hc).eval = (Diagram.mixedProjection a b l r d hf).eval := by
  classical
  let kg := Word.down a
  let gk := Word.up a
  let gh := Word.up b
  let kl := Word.up l
  let hl := Word.up r
  let lh := Word.down r
  let M := kg.tensor gh
  let target := kl.tensor lh
  let C := reverseCupWord r
  let cup : Diagram Complex (.empty H) C := .reverseCup r hc
  let prep : Diagram Complex M (kg.tensor (gh.tensor C)) :=
    (Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (.insertRightUnit gh)).vertical
      (Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (Diagram.horizontal (.id gh) cup))
  let middle : Diagram Complex (gh.tensor hl) (gk.tensor kl) :=
    (Diagram.mergeUp b r).vertical ((Diagram.upDot d.inverse).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a l))
  let tail' : Diagram Complex (kg.tensor (gh.tensor C)) target :=
    (Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (.unassociate gh hl lh)).vertical
      ((Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (Diagram.horizontal middle (.id lh))).vertical
        (((Diagram.horizontal (.id kg) (.associate gk kl lh)).vertical
          (.unassociate kg gk target)).vertical
          ((Diagram.horizontal (.traceCap a) (.id target)).vertical (.leftUnit target))))
  let tail := Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b l r d
  let scope := RightCupTrace.ofFiniteAfter tail
    (RightCupTrace.mixedProjectionTail_finiteAfter (R := Complex) a b l r d hf)
  -- Proposition 5.1 uses the transfer through the surviving fiber. At
  -- finite right index the checked cup agrees with the scoped transfer.
  -- Compare the article's placement of the split and trace on each cup term.
  have hscope : scope.eval = (Diagram.mixedProjection a b l r d hf).eval :=
    ScopedDiagram.eval_expandedMixedProjection a b l r d hf
  rw [← hscope, RightCupTrace.eval_eq_reverseCup scope hc]
  apply Diagram.eval_ext_on_generators
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_
  let fiber := Generator.multiplicationCap_finiteFiber r hc (1 : H)
  have hcup : cup.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) =
      ∑ s ∈ fiber.toFinset, Finsupp.single s (1 : Complex) := by
    change (Generator.reverseCup Complex r hc).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) = _
    rw [Generator.reverseCup, Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum]
  have hprep (x y : G) :
      prep.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (kg.basis.pair gh.basis x y) 1) =
        ∑ s ∈ fiber.toFinset,
          Finsupp.single (kg.basis.pair (gh.tensor C).basis x (gh.basis.pair C.basis y s)) 1 := by
    dsimp only [prep]
    rw [Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
      Diagram.eval_id_apply, insertRightUnit_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
      Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
      Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
      hcup, map_sum, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  change tail'.eval.toLinearMap (prep.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (kg.basis.pair gh.basis x y) 1)) =
    tail.eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.horizontal (.id M) cup).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.insertRightUnit M).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (kg.basis.pair gh.basis x y) 1)))
  rw [hprep, map_sum, insertRightUnit_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, hcup, map_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  refine Quotient.inductionOn s fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => ?_
  change tail'.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (kg.basis.pair (gh.tensor C).basis x
        (gh.basis.pair C.basis y (hl.basis.pair lh.basis h₁ h₂))) 1) =
    tail.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (M.basis.pair C.basis
      (kg.basis.pair gh.basis x y) (hl.basis.pair lh.basis h₁ h₂)) 1)
  let v := y * b.toHom h₁ * d.element⁻¹
  have hmiddle : middle.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (gh.basis.pair hl.basis y h₁) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (gk.basis.pair kl.basis v 1) 1 := by
    dsimp only [middle]
    rw [Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply,
      Diagram.eval_upDot_single, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single]
    rfl
  rw [show tail.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (M.basis.pair C.basis
      (kg.basis.pair gh.basis x y) (hl.basis.pair lh.basis h₁ h₂)) 1) = _ from
    Diagram.eval_mixedProjectionTail_single a b l r d x y h₁ h₂]
  dsimp only [tail']
  rw [Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply,
    Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id kg) (Diagram.unassociate gh hl lh),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_unassociate_single,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id kg) (Diagram.horizontal middle (Diagram.id lh)),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single middle (Diagram.id lh), one_smul, hmiddle,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id kg) (Diagram.associate gk kl lh),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_associate_single,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_unassociate_single]
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.traceCap a) (Diagram.id target),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_traceCap_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.traceCapOnLeft a l) (Diagram.id lh),
    one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply]
  by_cases himage : ∃ k, a.toHom k = x * v
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := himage
    rw [← hk, Generator.traceBasis_image, Diagram.eval_traceCapOnLeft_image a l x v k hk.symm,
      Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul,
      Diagram.eval_leftUnit_single]
    change Finsupp.single ((target.basis.act (k, 1)) (kl.basis.pair lh.basis 1 h₂)) 1 =
      Finsupp.single (kl.basis.pair lh.basis k h₂) 1
    congr 1
    change ((kl.basis.tensor lh.basis).act (k, 1)) (kl.basis.pair lh.basis 1 h₂) = _
    rw [Biset.act_pair, show lh.basis.act (1, 1) h₂ = h₂ from
      lh.basis.one_act h₂]
    change kl.basis.pair lh.basis (k * 1 * (l.toHom 1)⁻¹) h₂ = _
    simp
  · rw [Generator.traceBasis_outside Complex a _ himage,
      Diagram.eval_traceCapOnLeft_outside a l x v himage]
    simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

private theorem cupOuter_eval (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding S K) (r : ConjEmbedding S H) (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r))
    (hc : r.toHom.range.FiniteIndex)
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z}) :
    ((cupProjection a b l r d hc).vertical (Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d)).eval =
      ((Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf).vertical
        (Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d)).eval :=
  congrArg (fun p => p.vertical (Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d).eval)
    (cupProjection_eval a b l r d hc hf)

private theorem scaledCupOuter_eval (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding S K) (r : ConjEmbedding S H) (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r))
    (hc : r.toHom.range.FiniteIndex)
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z}) (c : Complex) :
    (Diagram.scale c ((cupProjection a b l r d hc).vertical
      (Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d))).eval =
      (Diagram.scale c ((Diagram.mixedProjection a b l r d hf).vertical
        (Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d))).eval :=
  congrArg (Biset.Hom.scale c) (cupOuter_eval a b l r d hc hf)

private theorem sumDiagram_eval_eq {I : Type*} {M : Word K H}
    (left right : I → Diagram Complex M M) (h : ∀ j, (left j).eval = (right j).eval)
    (indices : List I) :
    (indices.foldr (fun j acc => Diagram.add (left j) acc) (Diagram.zero M M)).eval =
      (indices.foldr (fun j acc => Diagram.add (right j) acc) (Diagram.zero M M)).eval := by
  induction indices with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j js ih =>
    change (left j).eval.add _ = (right j).eval.add _
    rw [h j, ih]

private theorem cardFiber {X : Type*} (s : Set X) (hs : s.Finite) :
    hs.toFinset.card = Nat.card s :=
  (Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card s hs).symm

end

MackeyOrthogonalityDiagram.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U _ K H G α β Kα Hβ hK hH a b A B J σ hσ L C I hRep hTrans l r d
    kg gh kl lh M Mj elementaryTensor surviving leftMiddle expandedInclusion finiteProjection
    cupContribution
  /- Ian Xiao, § 2.2, Theorem 2.2 and Lemma 2.3. Equations (2.3) and
     (2.6) are on pp. 5 and 7 of the archived original PDF and pp. 7
     and 9 of the revised published PDF, respectively. The reverse
     composite is below (2.6) in both copies and is diagram-07 on the
     Alphabeta Math article. Its proof is unnumbered prose with numbered
     equations. The lower inclusion carries σᵢ and the upper projection
     carries σⱼ⁻¹. Both marks use coefficient-one labels in the shared
     finite complex dot language.
     See https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#eq:second-chain
     and https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf. -/
  -- Equation (2.3) uses the indicated partition of G. The ordinary identity
  -- supplier proves pointwise finiteness and both reverse-order identities
  -- for the exact intersections (2.2) and representative family (2.1).
  obtain ⟨hf, hglobal, hdiag, hoff⟩ := MackeyIdentityDiagram K H G α β hK hH σ hσ
  let ordinaryInc (j : J) : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M :=
    .mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
  let ordinaryProj (j : J) : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j) :=
    .mixedProjection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (hf j)
  let traceArg (j : J) (g : G) (i : I j) : U :=
    α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹ * α
  have crossing (j : J) : ∃ hs : ∀ g : G, Set.Finite (surviving j g),
      (∀ z : M.basis.carrier, Function.support (cupContribution j z) =
        surviving j (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z)) ∧
      (∀ (k : K) (h : H), (ordinaryInc j).eval.toLinearMap (elementaryTensor j k h) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b (a.toHom k * σ j * b.toHom h)) 1) ∧
      (∀ g : G, (ordinaryProj j).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g) 1) =
          ∑ i ∈ (hs g).toFinset.attach,
            elementaryTensor j
              ⟨traceArg j g i.val, (hs g).mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩ (hRep j i.val)) := by
    -- The crossing supplier uses the very same indexed transversal (2.4).
    obtain ⟨hf', hs, hsupport, hι, hp, _, _, _⟩ :=
      MackeyInclusionAndProjectionCrossings K H G α β hK hH σ hσ I hRep hTrans j
    have hι' := MackeyCrossingProof.compact_inclusion a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
    have hp' := MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) hf'
    refine ⟨hs, hsupport, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro k h
      exact (congrArg (fun f => f.toLinearMap (elementaryTensor j k h)) hι').symm.trans (hι k h)
    · intro g
      exact (congrArg (fun f => f.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g) 1)) hp').symm.trans (hp g).2
  choose hs hsupport hι hp using crossing
  have hfinite (j : J) (z : M.basis.carrier) :
      Set.Finite (Function.support (cupContribution j z)) :=
    (hsupport j z).symm ▸ hs j (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
  refine ⟨hf, hfinite, ?_⟩
  intro inclusion projectionLabel projection expandedProjection reverseCrossings expandedReverse
    evaluate term straight
  have hinc (j : J) : evaluate (inclusion j) = (ordinaryInc j).eval :=
    MackeyCrossingProof.compact_inclusion a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
  have hproj (j : J) : evaluate (projection j) = (ordinaryProj j).eval :=
    MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (hf j)
  have hExpandedInc (j : J) : evaluate (inclusion j) = evaluate (expandedInclusion j) :=
    (hinc j).trans (MackeyCrossingProof.eval_inclusion_expansion a b (l j) (r j) (d j)).symm
  have hExpandedProj (j : J) : evaluate (projection j) = evaluate (expandedProjection j) :=
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.eval_expandProjection a b (l j) (r j)
      (projectionLabel j) .junction .junction).symm
  have hReverse (i j : J) : evaluate (reverseCrossings i j) =
      (ordinaryInc i).eval.vertical (ordinaryProj j).eval := by
    change (evaluate (inclusion i)).vertical (evaluate (projection j)) = _
    rw [hinc, hproj]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hExpandedProj, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- MackeySummandProjection proves the fixed-j formula (2.5).
    -- Here MackeyIdentityDiagram directly supplies the pointwise sum
    -- in (2.3) with its support, using the same double-coset partition.
    let ordinaryTerm (x : M.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) (j : J) :=
      ((ordinaryProj j).eval.vertical (ordinaryInc j).eval).toLinearMap x
    have hterm (x : M.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) : term x = ordinaryTerm x := by
      funext j
      change ((evaluate (projection j)).vertical (evaluate (inclusion j))).toLinearMap x = _
      rw [hproj, hinc]
    let ordinaryStraight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
      .horizontal (.id kg) (.id gh)
    have hstraight : ordinaryStraight.eval = evaluate straight :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id kg.basis gh.basis
    change ∃ fin : ∀ x, Set.Finite (Function.support (ordinaryTerm x)),
      ∀ x, ordinaryStraight.eval.toLinearMap x = ∑ j ∈ (fin x).toFinset, ordinaryTerm x j
      at hglobal
    obtain ⟨finite, hsum⟩ := hglobal
    let finite' (x : M.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) : Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)) :=
      (hterm x).symm ▸ finite x
    refine ⟨finite', fun x => ?_⟩
    have hindices : (finite x).toFinset = (finite' x).toFinset := by
      ext j
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, hterm]
    calc
      _ = ordinaryStraight.eval.toLinearMap x :=
        congrArg (fun f => f.toLinearMap x) hstraight.symm
      _ = ∑ j ∈ (finite x).toFinset, ordinaryTerm x j := hsum x
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hindices]
        exact congrArg ((finite' x).toFinset.sum) (hterm x).symm
  · intro j
    exact (hReverse j j).trans (hdiag j)
  · intro i j hij
    exact (hReverse i j).trans (hoff i j hij)
  · intro i j
    exact MackeyOrthogonalityProof.vertical_eval (hExpandedInc i) (hExpandedProj j)
  · -- The reverse cup is evaluated on surviving indices at this input.
    -- This is the termwise trace described after (2.4) when the index
    -- can be infinite. The typed junction frame evaluates that composite.
    -- Normalize the input and identify each attached summand with its
    -- trace term using the test in Lemma 2.3.
    intro j z
    refine ⟨hsupport j z, ?_⟩
    let g := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z
    have hz : MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g = z :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct a b z
    have hindices : (hs j g).toFinset = (hfinite j z).toFinset := by
      ext i
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, hsupport]
    rw [← hExpandedProj, hproj]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ (hs j g).toFinset.attach,
          elementaryTensor j ⟨traceArg j g i.val, (hs j g).mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩
            (hRep j i.val) := by simpa only [hz] using hp j g
      _ = ∑ i ∈ (hs j g).toFinset.attach, cupContribution j z i.val := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        let k : K := ⟨traceArg j g i.val, (hs j g).mem_toFinset.mp i.property⟩
        have ht : a.toHom k = g * (b.toHom (hRep j i.val)⁻¹ * (d j).element⁻¹) :=
          (MackeyCrossingProof.trace_eq_iff a b (l j) (r j) (d j) α β
            (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) g (hRep j i.val) k).mpr rfl
        have ht' := MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.projectionTerm_image (R := Complex)
          a b (l j) (r j) (d j) g (hRep j i.val) k ht
        change _ = MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.term
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b (l j) (r j) (d j))
          z (MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.unitPair (r j) (hRep j i.val))
        rw [← hz, ht']
      _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_attach, hindices]
  · -- The separate ordinary trivalent expansion requires the supplied
    -- finite index of the image of the right embedding.
    intro i j hi
    have hFiniteProj : evaluate (projection j) = evaluate (finiteProjection j hi) :=
      (hproj j).trans (MackeyCrossingProof.eval_finite_expansion
        a b (l j) (r j) (d j) hi (hf j)).symm
    exact MackeyOrthogonalityProof.vertical_eval (hExpandedInc i) hFiniteProj
  · -- In (2.6), use the actual representative of the right coset of h.
    -- Conjugation returns its correction to L j, and balancing moves it
    -- between the two tensor factors.
    intro j k h s g
    obtain ⟨u, hu, _⟩ := hTrans j h
    obtain ⟨ell, hell, he⟩ := hu
    let ellValue := (s : U) * β * (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹
    change (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * ell * (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ =
      (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ at he
    have heq : ellValue = ell := by
      calc
        ellValue = (s : U) * β * ((h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹) * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ := by
          dsimp only [ellValue]
          group
        _ = ell := by
          rw [← he]
          group
    have hℓ : ellValue ∈ L j := heq.symm ▸ hell
    let ℓ : L j := ⟨ellValue, hℓ⟩
    have hright : (r j).toHom ℓ * hRep j u = h := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * ellValue * (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ * (hRep j u : U) = (h : U)
      dsimp only [ellValue]
      group
    have hleft : (↑(k * (l j).toHom ℓ) : U) = traceArg j g u := by
      change (k : U) * (α⁻¹ * ellValue * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) =
        α⁻¹ * ((α * (k : U) * α⁻¹) * (s : U) * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹)) *
          β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α
      dsimp only [ellValue]
      group
    have huSurv : u ∈ surviving j g := by
      change traceArg j g u ∈ K
      rw [← hleft]
      exact (k * (l j).toHom ℓ).property
    have hclass : DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j := by
      have h : DoubleCoset.mk A B s = DoubleCoset.mk A B g :=
        DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨a.toHom k, ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩,
          b.toHom h, ⟨h, h.property, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact h.symm.trans (hσ j)
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ :=
      (SurvivingCosetRepresentative K H G α β hK hH σ hσ I hRep hTrans j g).1 hclass
    have hunique (t : I j) (ht : t ∈ surviving j g) : t = u :=
      (hi t ht).trans (hi u huSurv).symm
    refine ⟨u, huSurv, hunique, hℓ, ?_, ?_, congrArg (elementaryTensor j k) hright⟩
    · have hsingle : (ordinaryProj j).eval.toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g) 1) =
            elementaryTensor j (k * (l j).toHom ℓ) (hRep j u) := by
        let indices := (hs j g).toFinset
        let lift (t : {t // t ∈ indices}) :=
          elementaryTensor j ⟨traceArg j g t.val, (hs j g).mem_toFinset.mp t.property⟩ (hRep j t.val)
        let picked : {t // t ∈ indices} := ⟨u, (hs j g).mem_toFinset.mpr huSurv⟩
        have honly : indices.attach = {picked} := by
          ext t
          simp only [Finset.mem_attach, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff]
          exact Subtype.ext (hunique t.val ((hs j g).mem_toFinset.mp t.property))
        calc
          _ = ∑ t ∈ indices.attach, lift t := hp j g
          _ = lift picked := by rw [honly, Finset.sum_singleton]
          _ = _ := by
            change elementaryTensor j ⟨traceArg j g u, _⟩ (hRep j u) = _
            rw [show (⟨traceArg j g u, (hs j g).mem_toFinset.mp picked.property⟩ : K) =
              k * (l j).toHom ℓ from Subtype.ext hleft.symm]
      rw [hReverse]
      change (ordinaryProj j).eval.toLinearMap
        ((ordinaryInc j).eval.toLinearMap (elementaryTensor j k h)) = _
      rw [hι, hsingle]
    · change Finsupp.single ((kl j).basis.pair (lh j).basis
          (k * (l j).toHom ℓ) (hRep j u)) (1 : Complex) =
        Finsupp.single ((kl j).basis.pair (lh j).basis
          k ((r j).toHom ℓ * hRep j u)) 1
      apply congrArg (fun z => Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex))
      have hb := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair_balance (kl j).basis (lh j).basis ℓ k (hRep j u)
      change (kl j).basis.pair (lh j).basis
          (1 * k * ((l j).toHom ℓ⁻¹)⁻¹) (hRep j u) =
        (kl j).basis.pair (lh j).basis k ((r j).toHom ℓ * hRep j u * (1 : H)⁻¹) at hb
      simpa only [one_mul, map_inv, inv_inv, inv_one, mul_one] using hb
MackeyOrthogonalityDiagram.support:
namespace MackeyOrthogonalityProof

open MackeyDiagrams

private theorem vertical_eval {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U}
    {p q t : Word K H}
    {f : LabelledDrawing Complex p q} {g : LabelledDrawing Complex q t}
    {f' : LabelledDrawing Complex p q} {g' : LabelledDrawing Complex q t}
    (hf : f.interpret.eval = f'.interpret.eval)
    (hg : g.interpret.eval = g'.interpret.eval) :
    (LabelledDrawing.vertical f g).interpret.eval =
      (LabelledDrawing.vertical f' g').interpret.eval := by
  change f.interpret.eval.vertical g.interpret.eval =
    f'.interpret.eval.vertical g'.interpret.eval
  rw [hf, hg]

end MackeyOrthogonalityProof

DotSlidePreorderNotSymmetric.support:
/-
Ian Xiao, §3.3, Proposition 3.2 and Example 3.2, archived source PDF p. 10
(SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2)
and published 28 November revision p. 12
(SHA-256 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61).
The slide is equation (3.1) on archived p. 8 and published p. 10.
https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=12
The Alphabeta Math entry gives the two proof paragraphs of Proposition 3.2
and no separately numbered steps. The proof below follows its references
to (3.1) and Example 3.2.
https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:preorder-not-symmetric

The coordinator route uses the exact positioned event list of the right-input
fiber. The two events share a strand, so the disjoint exchange relation
cannot switch them. Associators and unitors have empty event code. Check
their evaluations on the balanced biset basis before removing them at the
ordered labelled boundary. The intermediate word in the typed cut carries
the same labels into the dot and merge normal forms. Recover its input
width from the fiber's shape equality, since the event list alone admits
extra stationary strands.

The working declarations integrate the local checked cut, structural
coherence, singleton-dot and singleton-merge helper proofs. The proof uses
Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical for the cut, the boundary reordering
cancellation equations for the stage evaluations, and
ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff to transfer evaluation equalities.
The forward implication uses Diagram.mergeUp_slide_right, the arbitrary
eligible-dot lemma used by the registered InductionMergeDotSlide. The
registered statement specializes to dots formed from chosen representatives.
The reverse implication applies RightInputDotSlideObstruction with the
same fixed inclusions and the coefficient-one swap of the last two points.
Use the full-fiber witness definition of the relation throughout, which gives
the inclusion criterion proved in FixedBoundaryReplacementPreorder.
The checked Lean connection uses the current project declarations.
-/

namespace DotSlidePreorderProof

open MackeyDiagrams

universe u
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {A B C D : Subgroup U}

private abbrev mark (n : Nat) : PlanarEvent := .vertex n .upDot
private abbrev join (n : Nat) : PlanarEvent := .vertex n (.trivalent .mergeUp)
private abbrev rightCode : PlanarCode.Code := [mark 1, join 0]

private theorem rigid_rightCode {a b : PlanarCode.Code} (h : PlanarCode.Equivalent a b) :
    (∀ l r, l ++ a ++ r = rightCode → a = b) ∧
    (∀ l r, l ++ b ++ r = rightCode → a = b) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  | symm h ih =>
    exact ⟨fun l r e => (ih.2 l r e).symm, fun l r e => (ih.1 l r e).symm⟩
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    constructor
    · intro l r e
      have h₁ := ih₁.1 l r e
      exact h₁.trans (ih₂.1 l r (h₁ ▸ e))
    · intro l r e
      have h₂ := ih₂.2 l r e
      exact (ih₁.2 l r (h₂.symm ▸ e)).trans h₂
  | context l r h ih =>
    exact ⟨fun l' r' e => congrArg (fun x => l ++ x ++ r)
      (ih.1 (l' ++ l) (r ++ r') (by simpa only [List.append_assoc] using e)),
      fun l' r' e => congrArg (fun x => l ++ x ++ r)
      (ih.2 (l' ++ l) (r ++ r') (by simpa only [List.append_assoc] using e))⟩
  | exchange before after i gap left right =>
    constructor <;> intro l r e <;>
      have hlen := congrArg List.length e <;>
      simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen <;>
      have hb : before = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega) <;>
      have ha : after = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega) <;>
      have hl : l = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega) <;>
      have hr : r = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega) <;>
      subst before <;> subst after <;> subst l <;> subst r <;>
      simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.cons.injEq] at e
    · have h₁ := congrArg PlanarEvent.position e.1
      have h₂ := congrArg PlanarEvent.position e.2.1
      cases left <;> cases right <;> simp [PlanarEvent.place, PlanarEvent.position] at h₁ h₂ <;> omega
    · have h₁ := congrArg PlanarEvent.position e.1
      have h₂ := congrArg PlanarEvent.position e.2.1
      have hk : left.place i = join 0 := e.2.1
      have hind : (left.place i).inputs.length = 2 := by rw [hk]; rfl
      cases left <;> cases right <;> simp [PlanarEvent.place, PlanarEvent.position, PlanarEvent.inputs] at h₁ h₂ hind ⊢ <;> omega
  | @scale i below above a b _ _ =>
    constructor <;> intro l r e
    · have hm : PlanarEvent.scale i below above a ∈ rightCode := by rw [← e]; simp
      simp at hm
    · have hm : PlanarEvent.scale i below above b ∈ rightCode := by rw [← e]; simp
      simp at hm
  | @add i below above a b c d _ _ _ _ =>
    constructor <;> intro l r e
    · have hm : PlanarEvent.add i below above a c ∈ rightCode := by rw [← e]; simp
      simp at hm
    · have hm : PlanarEvent.add i below above b d ∈ rightCode := by rw [← e]; simp
      simp at hm

private theorem code_eq_of_right {a : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid a = Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid rightCode) :
    a = rightCode :=
  (rigid_rightCode (Quotient.exact h)).2 [] [] rfl

private theorem inputs_stack {s t : DrawingShape} (h : s.outputs = t.inputs) :
    (s.stack t).inputs = s.inputs := by
  induction s with
  | straight => exact h.symm
  | vertical a b ia ib =>
    cases t <;> rfl
  | vertex | horizontal | zero | add | scale =>
    cases t <;> rfl

private theorem outputs_stack {s t : DrawingShape} (h : s.outputs = t.inputs) :
    (s.stack t).outputs = t.outputs := by
  induction s with
  | straight => rfl
  | vertical a b ia ib =>
    cases t <;> first | exact h | exact ib h
  | vertex | horizontal | zero | add | scale =>
    cases t <;> first | exact h | rfl

private theorem inputs_juxtapose (s t : DrawingShape) :
    (s.juxtapose t).inputs = s.inputs ++ t.inputs := by
  induction s with
  | straight l =>
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.inputs]
    | cons x xs =>
      cases t with
      | straight r => cases r <;> simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.inputs]
      | _ => rfl
  | horizontal a b ia ib =>
    cases t with
    | straight r =>
      cases r <;> simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.inputs, ib, List.append_assoc]
    | _ => simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.inputs, ib, List.append_assoc]
  | vertex | vertical | zero | add | scale =>
    cases t with
    | straight r => cases r <;> simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.inputs]
    | _ => rfl

private theorem outputs_juxtapose (s t : DrawingShape) :
    (s.juxtapose t).outputs = s.outputs ++ t.outputs := by
  induction s with
  | straight l =>
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.outputs]
    | cons x xs =>
      cases t with
      | straight r => cases r <;> simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.outputs]
      | _ => rfl
  | horizontal a b ia ib =>
    cases t with
    | straight r =>
      cases r <;> simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.outputs, ib, List.append_assoc]
    | _ => simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.outputs, ib, List.append_assoc]
  | vertex | vertical | zero | add | scale =>
    cases t with
    | straight r => cases r <;> simp [DrawingShape.juxtapose, DrawingShape.outputs]
    | _ => rfl

private theorem shift_append (i : Nat) (a b : PlanarCode.Code) :
    PlanarCode.shift i (a ++ b) = PlanarCode.shift i a ++ PlanarCode.shift i b :=
  List.map_append

private theorem shift_shift (i j : Nat) (a : PlanarCode.Code) :
    PlanarCode.shift i (PlanarCode.shift j a) = PlanarCode.shift (i+j) a := by
