    let padded := (ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.empty G))).horizontal merge
    let ins : Diagram Complex p ((Word.empty G).tensor p) := .insertLeftUnit p
    let rem : Diagram Complex ((Word.empty G).tensor q) q := .leftUnit q
    have he : ((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded |>.vertical (.ordinary rem)).eval =
        merge.eval := pad_left_eval merge.eval
    have hm : MergeAt p.boundary q.boundary (normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem))) := by
      have hn : normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem)) =
          normalize merge := (ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff _ _).2 he
      rw [hn]
      exact MergeAt.vertex H l a
    rw [normalize_vertical, normalize_vertical] at hm
    have hpad := remove_padding (empty (.ordinary ins) rfl) (empty (.ordinary rem) rfl) hm
    dsimp only [padded] at hpad
    rw [normalize_horizontal, normalize_id] at hpad
    exact hpad

private theorem merge_pad_right (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U)
    {p q : Boundary G K} {f : MergeBoundaryMap p q} (h : MergeAt p q f) :
    MergeAt (p.append (.empty K)) (q.append (.empty K))
      (juxtaposeMap f (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Boundary.empty K).word.basis)) := by
  cases h with
  | vertex H l a =>
    let p := upPair l a
    let q := Word.up (l.comp a)
    let merge : ScopedDiagram Complex p q := .ordinary (.mergeUp l a)
    let padded := merge.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.empty K)))
    let ins : Diagram Complex p (p.tensor (.empty K)) := .insertRightUnit p
    let rem : Diagram Complex (q.tensor (.empty K)) q := .rightUnit q
    have he : ((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded |>.vertical (.ordinary rem)).eval =
        merge.eval := pad_right_eval merge.eval
    have hm : MergeAt p.boundary q.boundary (normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem))) := by
      have hn : normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem)) =
          normalize merge := (ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff _ _).2 he
      rw [hn]
      exact MergeAt.vertex H l a
    rw [normalize_vertical, normalize_vertical] at hm
    have hpad := remove_padding (empty (.ordinary ins) rfl) (empty (.ordinary rem) rfl) hm
    dsimp only [padded] at hpad
    rw [normalize_horizontal, normalize_id] at hpad
    exact hpad

private def boundaryDirs : {G K : Subgroup U} → Boundary G K → List Bool
  | _, _, .empty _ => []
  | _, _, .cons (.up _) rest => true :: boundaryDirs rest
  | _, _, .cons (.down _) rest => false :: boundaryDirs rest

private theorem boundaryDirs_append (p : Boundary G H) (q : Boundary H K) :
    boundaryDirs (p.append q) = boundaryDirs p ++ boundaryDirs q := by
  induction p with
  | empty => rfl
  | cons s rest ih => cases s <;> simp only [Boundary.append, boundaryDirs, ih, List.cons_append]

private theorem word_boundaryDirs (p : Word G K) : boundaryDirs p.boundary = p.directions := by
  induction p with
  | empty | up | down => rfl
  | tensor p q hp hq => simp only [Word.boundary, Word.directions, boundaryDirs_append, hp, hq]

private theorem merge_input_dirs {p q : Boundary G K} {f : MergeBoundaryMap p q}
    (h : MergeAt p q f) : boundaryDirs p = [true, true] := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem merge_horizontal_left
    (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U)
    {p q : Boundary G H} {r s : Boundary H K}
    {f : MergeBoundaryMap p q} {g : MergeBoundaryMap r s}
    (hf : MergeAt p q f) (hg : StraightAt r s g) (hr : boundaryDirs r = []) :
    MergeAt (p.append r) (q.append s) (juxtaposeMap f g) := by
  cases hg
  rename_i r
  cases r with
  | empty => exact merge_pad_right empty hf
  | cons t tail => cases t <;> cases hr

private theorem merge_horizontal_right
    (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U)
    {p q : Boundary G H} {r s : Boundary H K}
    {f : MergeBoundaryMap p q} {g : MergeBoundaryMap r s}
    (hf : StraightAt p q f) (hg : MergeAt r s g) (hp : boundaryDirs p = []) :
    MergeAt (p.append r) (q.append s) (juxtaposeMap f g) := by
  cases hf
  rename_i p
  cases p with
  | empty => exact merge_pad_left empty hg
  | cons t tail => cases t <;> cases hp

private theorem append_singleton {x y : PlanarCode.Code} {v : PlanarEvent}
    (h : x ++ y = [v]) : (x = [] ∧ y = [v]) ∨ (x = [v] ∧ y = []) := by
  cases x with
  | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | cons w xs =>
    have ⟨hw, ht⟩ := List.cons.inj h
    have ⟨hx, hy⟩ := List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp ht
    exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [hw, hx], hy⟩

private theorem shift_eq_nil {n : Nat} {x : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : PlanarCode.shift n x = []) : x = [] := by
  cases x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es => cases h

private theorem shift_merge {n : Nat} {x : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : PlanarCode.shift n x = [join 0]) : x = [join 0] := by
  cases x with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons e es =>
    have ⟨he, ht⟩ := List.cons.inj h
    have hn : n + e.position = 0 := by
      have hh := congrArg PlanarEvent.position he
      cases e <;> exact hh
    have hn' : n = 0 := by omega
    rwa [hn', shift_zero] at h

private def MergeClaim {p q : Word G K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) : Prop :=
  code d.erase = [join 0] → p.directions.length ≤ 2 →
    MergeAt p.boundary q.boundary (normalize d.interpret)

private theorem merge_vertical_step (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U)
    {p q r : Word G K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (e : LabelledDrawing Complex q r)
    (hd : MergeClaim d) (he : MergeClaim e) : MergeClaim (d.vertical e) := by
  intro hc hw
  rw [drawing_code_vert] at hc
  change MergeAt p.boundary r.boundary (normalize (d.interpret.vertical e.interpret))
  rw [normalize_vertical]
  rcases append_singleton hc with ⟨hd₀, he₁⟩ | ⟨hd₁, he₀⟩
  · have h := empty d hd₀
    have hdirs := congrArg boundaryDirs (straight_boundary_eq h)
    rw [word_boundaryDirs, word_boundaryDirs] at hdirs
    exact vertical_straight_left h (he he₁ (hdirs ▸ hw))
  · exact vertical_straight_right (hd hd₁ hw) (empty e he₀)

private theorem merge_horizontal_step (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U)
    {p q : Word G H} {r s : Word H K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (e : LabelledDrawing Complex r s) (hd : MergeClaim d) (he : MergeClaim e) :
    MergeClaim (d.horizontal e) := by
  intro hc hw
  rw [drawing_code_horiz] at hc
  change (p.directions ++ r.directions).length ≤ 2 at hw
  rw [List.length_append] at hw
  change MergeAt (p.boundary.append r.boundary) (q.boundary.append s.boundary)
    (normalize (d.interpret.horizontal e.interpret))
  rw [normalize_horizontal]
  rcases append_singleton hc with ⟨hd₀, he₁⟩ | ⟨hd₁, he₀⟩
  · have h := he (shift_merge he₁) (by omega)
    have hlen := congrArg List.length (merge_input_dirs h)
    rw [word_boundaryDirs] at hlen
    have hp : p.directions.length = 0 := by
      change r.directions.length = 2 at hlen
      omega
    exact merge_horizontal_right empty (empty d hd₀) h
      (by rw [word_boundaryDirs]; exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hp)
  · have h := hd hd₁ (by omega)
    have hlen := congrArg List.length (merge_input_dirs h)
    rw [word_boundaryDirs] at hlen
    have hr : r.directions.length = 0 := by
      change p.directions.length = 2 at hlen
      omega
    exact merge_horizontal_left empty h (empty e (shift_eq_nil he₀))
      (by rw [word_boundaryDirs]; exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hr)

private theorem diagram_merge (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U) {p q : Word G K}
    (d : Diagram Complex p q) : MergeClaim (.ordinary d) := by
  induction d with
  | mergeUp l a => exact fun _ _ => MergeAt.vertex _ l a
  | vertical d e hd he => exact merge_vertical_step empty (.ordinary d) (.ordinary e) hd he
  | horizontal d e hd he => exact merge_horizontal_step empty (.ordinary d) (.ordinary e) hd he
  | id | upDot | downDot | splitUp | mergeDown | splitDown | multiplicationCap | traceCap
  | reverseCup | ordinaryCup | leftUnit | rightUnit | insertLeftUnit | insertRightUnit
  | associate | unassociate | mixedMultiplication | mixedProjection | zero | add | scale =>
    intro hc
    cases hc

private theorem expanded_no_singleton_merge (n : Nat) (opening : ProjectionOpening)
    (closing : ProjectionClosing) :
    PlanarCode.encode (DrawingShape.expandedProjectionGeometry n opening closing) ≠ [join 0] := by
  cases opening <;>
    simp only [DrawingShape.expandedProjectionGeometry, encode_stack]
  all_goals
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg List.head? h
    cases hh

private theorem drawing_merge (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U) {p q : Word G K}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) : MergeClaim d := by
  induction d with
  | ordinary d => exact diagram_merge empty d
  | trivalent v =>
    cases v with
    | mergeUp l a => exact fun _ _ => MergeAt.vertex _ l a
    | _ => intro hc; cases hc
  | bentVertex v => cases v <;> intro hc <;> cases hc
  | vertical d e hd he => exact merge_vertical_step empty d e hd he
  | horizontal d e hd he => exact merge_horizontal_step empty d e hd he
  | expandedProjection _ _ _ _ _ opening closing =>
    exact fun h => (expanded_no_singleton_merge _ opening closing h).elim
  | expandedProjectionChain _ _ _ _ _ _ opening closing =>
    exact fun h => (expanded_no_singleton_merge _ opening closing h).elim
  | expandedLinearDotProjection _ _ _ _ _ _ opening closing =>
    exact fun h => (expanded_no_singleton_merge _ opening closing h).elim
  | parallelUpChain _ _ _ _ labels =>
    intro h
    change PlanarCode.encode ((DrawingShape.vertex .mergeUp).stack
      ((DrawingShape.upwardDots labels.length).stack (.vertex .splitUp))) = [join 0] at h
    rw [encode_stack, encode_stack] at h
    change join 0 :: (PlanarCode.encode (DrawingShape.upwardDots labels.length) ++
      [.vertex 0 (.trivalent .splitUp)]) = [join 0] at h
    have ht := (List.cons.inj h).2
    have hs := (List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp ht).2
    cases hs
  | parallelDownChain _ _ _ _ labels =>
    intro h
    change PlanarCode.encode ((DrawingShape.vertex .mergeDown).stack
      ((DrawingShape.downwardDots labels.length).stack (.vertex .splitDown))) = [join 0] at h
    rw [encode_stack] at h
    have hh := congrArg List.head? h
    cases hh
  | upDot | downDot | parallelUp | parallelDown | mixedMultiplication | rightCurlUp
  | compactProjection | add | scale =>
    intro hc
    cases hc

private theorem mergeAt_witness {p q : Boundary G K} {f : MergeBoundaryMap p q}
    (h : MergeAt p q f) :
    ∃ (M : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding M G) (a : ConjEmbedding K M)
      (hp : p = (upPair l a).boundary) (hq : q = (Word.up (l.comp a)).boundary),
      cast (congrArg₂ (fun b c : Boundary G K => MergeBoundaryMap b c) hp hq) f =
        normalize (ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.mergeUp l a)) := by
  cases h with
  | vertex M l a => exact ⟨M, l, a, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Normalize a singleton merge at any parenthesization of its ordered inputs
and output. The stronger width-bound hypothesis suffices. -/
private theorem singleton_merge_normal_form (empty : EmptyCodeStraight U)
    {p q : Word G K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (hc : code d.erase = [join 0]) (hw : p.directions.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ (M : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding M G) (a : ConjEmbedding K M)
      (hp : p.boundary = (upPair l a).boundary)
      (hq : q.boundary = (Word.up (l.comp a)).boundary),
      cast (congrArg₂ (fun b c : Boundary G K => MergeBoundaryMap b c) hp hq)
          d.interpret.atBoundary.eval =
        (LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp l a)).interpret.atBoundary.eval :=
  mergeAt_witness (drawing_merge empty d hc hw)

private theorem straightAt_of_eq {p q : Boundary G K} {f : MergeBoundaryMap p q}
    (h : p = q)
    (he : cast (congrArg (fun b => MergeBoundaryMap p b) h.symm) f = Biset.Hom.id _) :
    StraightAt p q f := by
  subst q
  change f = Biset.Hom.id _ at he
  subst f
  exact StraightAt.id p


end DotSlidePreorderProof

namespace DotSlidePreorderBridge

open MackeyDiagrams

universe u
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G H' : Subgroup U}

private def rightShape : PlanarShape :=
  ⟨[true,true], [true],
    Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid [.vertex 1 .upDot, .vertex 0 (.trivalent .mergeUp)]⟩

private def trunkShape : PlanarShape :=
  ⟨[true,true], [true],
    Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid [.vertex 0 (.trivalent .mergeUp), .vertex 0 .upDot]⟩

private abbrev pair (l : ConjEmbedding H G) (a : ConjEmbedding K H) : Word G K :=
  (Word.up l).tensor (.up a)

private noncomputable def branch (l : ConjEmbedding H G)
    {a b : ConjEmbedding K H} (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (pair l a) (.up (l.comp b)) :=
  (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.up l))) (DotLabel.upDrawing label)).vertical
    (.trivalent (.mergeUp l b))

private noncomputable def trunk (l : ConjEmbedding H G)
    {a b : ConjEmbedding K H} (terms : List (Complex × Dot (l.comp a) (l.comp b))) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (pair l a) (.up (l.comp b)) :=
  (LabelledDrawing.trivalent (.mergeUp l a)).vertical (.upDot terms)

private theorem branch_shape (l : ConjEmbedding H G)
    {a b : ConjEmbedding K H} (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    (branch l label).planarShape = rightShape := rfl

private theorem trunk_shape (l : ConjEmbedding H G)
    {a b : ConjEmbedding K H} (terms : List (Complex × Dot (l.comp a) (l.comp b))) :
    (trunk l terms).planarShape = trunkShape := rfl

/- Proposition 3.2, first proof paragraph, applies the right-leg case of
   (3.1). The registered InductionMergeDotSlide specializes to dots formed
   from named representatives. The shared Diagram.mergeUp_slide_right
   takes any eligible Dot, exactly the hypothesis supplied by each term
   in the finite label. Extend that equality by linearity term by term. -/
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
private theorem slide (l : ConjEmbedding H G) {a b : ConjEmbedding K H}
    (label : DotLabel Complex a b) :
    (branch l label).interpret.eval =
      (trunk l (label.terms.map fun (r,d) => (r, d.whisker l))).interpret.eval := by
  let pre := (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.up l)).eval
  let after := (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) l b).eval
  let before := (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) l a).eval
  let terms := label.terms
  have hl (terms : List (Complex × Dot a b)) :
      ((pre.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot terms).eval).vertical after :
        Biset.Hom Complex (pair l a).basis (Word.up (l.comp b)).basis) =
      before.vertical (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot
        (terms.map fun (r,d) => (r, d.whisker l))).eval := by
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro x c
    refine Quotient.inductionOn x (fun z => ?_)
    rcases z with ⟨x,y⟩
    let input := Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction l).pair (Biset.induction a) x y) c
    let combine := Biset.pairLinear Complex (Biset.induction l) (Biset.induction b)
      (Finsupp.single x 1)
    change after.toLinearMap ((pre.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot terms).eval).toLinearMap input) =
      (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot _).eval.toLinearMap (before.toLinearMap input)
    rw [show (pre.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot terms).eval).toLinearMap input =
      c • combine ((ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot terms).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1))
        from Biset.Hom.horizontal_single _ _ x y c]
    have weighted {X Y : ConjEmbedding K H}
        (ts : List (Complex × Dot X Y)) (z : H →₀ Complex) :
        (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot ts).eval.toLinearMap z =
          (ts.map fun (r,d) => r • (Diagram.upDot d).eval.toLinearMap z).sum := by
      change (Diagram.finiteSum (ts.map fun (r,d) => Diagram.scale r (.upDot d))).eval.toLinearMap z = _
      rw [Diagram.eval_finiteSum, List.map_map]
      apply congrArg List.sum
      apply List.map_congr_left
      rintro ⟨r,d⟩ _
      rfl
    have weighted' {X Y : ConjEmbedding K G}
        (ts : List (Complex × Dot X Y)) (z : G →₀ Complex) :
        (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot ts).eval.toLinearMap z =
          (ts.map fun (r,d) => r • (Diagram.upDot d).eval.toLinearMap z).sum := by
      change (Diagram.finiteSum (ts.map fun (r,d) => Diagram.scale r (.upDot d))).eval.toLinearMap z = _
      rw [Diagram.eval_finiteSum, List.map_map]
      apply congrArg List.sum
      apply List.map_congr_left
      rintro ⟨r,d⟩ _
      rfl
    rw [weighted, weighted']
    simp only [List.map_map]
    -- The tensor product and the following merge are linear in this label.
    induction terms with
    | nil => simp
    | cons term tail ih =>
      obtain ⟨r,d⟩ := term
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, map_add, smul_add, ← ih]
      congr 1
      have h := congrArg (fun f : Biset.Hom Complex
          (pair l a).basis (Word.up (l.comp b)).basis =>
          f.toLinearMap input) (Diagram.mergeUp_slide_right (R := Complex) l d)
      change after.toLinearMap ((pre.horizontal (Diagram.upDot d).eval).toLinearMap input) =
        (Diagram.upDot (d.whisker l)).eval.toLinearMap (before.toLinearMap input) at h
      rw [show (pre.horizontal (Diagram.upDot d).eval).toLinearMap input =
        c • combine ((Diagram.upDot d).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1))
        from Biset.Hom.horizontal_single _ _ x y c] at h
      simp only [map_smul] at h ⊢
      rw [smul_comm c r, h]
      rfl
  exact hl terms

private theorem branchBoundary_inj (l : ConjEmbedding H G) (a : ConjEmbedding K H)
    (l' : ConjEmbedding H' G) (a' : ConjEmbedding K H')
    (h : (pair l' a').boundary = (pair l a).boundary) :
    ∃ _he : H' = H, HEq l' l ∧ HEq a' a := by
  change Boundary.cons (.up l') (Boundary.cons (.up a') (.empty K)) =
    Boundary.cons (.up l) (Boundary.cons (.up a) (.empty K)) at h
  injection h with _ e _ hhead hrest
  subst H'
  have hl : l' = l := by
    have h := eq_of_heq hhead
    injection h
  have ha : a' = a := by
    have h := eq_of_heq hrest
    injection h with _ _ _ hhead _
    injection hhead
  exact ⟨rfl, heq_of_eq hl, heq_of_eq ha⟩

private theorem upBoundary_inj (a b : ConjEmbedding K G)
    (h : (Word.up a).boundary = (Word.up b).boundary) : a = b := by
  change Boundary.cons (.up a) (.empty K) = Boundary.cons (.up b) (.empty K) at h
  injection h with _ _ _ hhead _
  injection hhead

/-- Exact normal-form hypothesis on the full right-input shape fiber. -/
def NormalForm (U : Type u) [Group U] : Prop :=
  ∀ (G K : Subgroup U) (p q : Boundary G K)
    (v : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p q rightShape),
    ∃ (H : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
      (label : DotLabel Complex a b) (hp : (pair l a).boundary = p)
      (hq : (Word.up (l.comp b)).boundary = q),
      v.interpret.eval =
        (show LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p q rightShape
          from ⟨_, _, branch l label, hp, hq, branch_shape l label⟩).interpret.eval

/- FixedBoundaryReplacementPreorder identifies replacement with inclusion
   of attained maps. Work directly with its equivalent witness formulation
   so that the constructed trunk drawing and both transports are explicit. -/
private theorem forward (normal : NormalForm U) :
    LabelledDrawing.PlanarReplaces (U := U) Complex rightShape trunkShape := by
  intro G K p q v
  obtain ⟨H,l,a,b,label,hp,hq,hv⟩ := normal G K p q v
  refine ⟨⟨_, _, trunk l (label.terms.map fun (r,d) => (r, d.whisker l)),
    hp, hq, trunk_shape _ _⟩, hv.trans ?_⟩
  subst p
  subst q
  apply (ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff _ _).2
  exact slide l label


private theorem reverseAt (normal : NormalForm U) (l : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (a : ConjEmbedding K H) (d : Dot (l.comp a) (l.comp a))
    (obstruction : ∀ label : DotLabel Complex a a,
      (branch l label).interpret.eval ≠
        ((LabelledDrawing.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp l a)).vertical
          (DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex)))).interpret.eval) :
    ¬ LabelledDrawing.PlanarReplaces (U := U) Complex trunkShape rightShape := by
  intro repl
  let p := (pair l a).boundary
  let q := (Word.up (l.comp a)).boundary
  let bad : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p q trunkShape :=
    ⟨_, _, (LabelledDrawing.trivalent (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp l a)).vertical
        (DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))), rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := repl G K p q bad
  obtain ⟨J,l',a',b,label,hp,hq,hn⟩ := normal G K p q v
  obtain ⟨hJ,hl,ha⟩ := branchBoundary_inj l a l' a' hp
  subst J
  have hl' := eq_of_heq hl
  have ha' := eq_of_heq ha
  subst l'
  subst a'
  have hb : b = a :=
    Diagram.mergeUp_rightEmbedding_eq l (upBoundary_inj _ _ hq)
  subst b
  apply obstruction label
  apply (ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff _ _).1
  exact (hv.trans hn).symm

private abbrev S4 := Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)
private abbrev large : Subgroup S4 := ⊤
private abbrev middle : Subgroup S4 := MulAction.stabilizer S4 (3 : Fin 4)
private abbrev small : Subgroup S4 := middle ⊓ MulAction.stabilizer S4 (2 : Fin 4)
private def outer : ConjEmbedding middle large :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun _ => Subgroup.mem_top _)
private def inner : ConjEmbedding small middle :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (by
    intro k
    simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using (inf_le_left : small ≤ middle) k.property)

/- Proposition 3.2, second proof paragraph, invokes Example 3.2. The
   registered RightInputDotSlideObstruction gives the coefficient-one
   swap in S4 and excludes every admissible finite label at its fixed
   two-input boundary. The fixed bottom boundary determines the outer
   embedding and input right embedding. Injectivity of the outer
   embedding then fixes the right embedding after the dot. -/
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
private theorem reverse (normal : NormalForm S4) :
    ¬ LabelledDrawing.PlanarReplaces (U := S4) Complex trunkShape rightShape := by
  obtain ⟨d, _, _, hd⟩ := RightInputDotSlideObstruction.2.2.2
  refine reverseAt normal outer inner d fun label => ?_
  exact (hd inner label rfl).2.2


/-- A checked reduction of both clauses of Proposition 3.2 to the same
right-input normal form. The trunk counterexample is already in ordinary
merge-and-dot form, so there is no need to invert that shape fiber. -/
private theorem proposition32
    (normal : ∀ {V : Type u} [Group V], NormalForm V)
    (finiteNormal : NormalForm S4) :
    (let boundary : List Bool × List Bool := ([true, true], [true])
let S4 := Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)
let G : Subgroup S4 := ⊤
let H := MulAction.stabilizer S4 (3 : Fin 4)
let K := H ⊓ MulAction.stabilizer S4 (2 : Fin 4)
let left : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G :=
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun _ => Subgroup.mem_top _)
let right : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H :=
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (by
    intro k
    simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using
      (inf_le_left : K ≤ H) (Subtype.property k))
let leftWire := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up left))
let merge := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
  (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp left right)
let rightDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
  (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) right)
let trunkDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
  (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.identity (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp left right))
let rightMarked := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal leftWire rightDot) merge
let trunkMarked := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical merge trunkDot
let A₄ : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := S4) Complex boundary :=
  ⟨MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape rightMarked, ⟨G, K, _, _, rightMarked, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
let B₄ : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := S4) Complex boundary :=
  ⟨MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape trunkMarked, ⟨G, K, _, _, trunkMarked, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
(∀ {U : Type u} [Group U],
  let T : Subgroup U := ⊤
  let embedding := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id T
  let wire := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up embedding))
  let merge := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)

  let rightMarked := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal wire rightDot) merge

  let A : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := U) Complex boundary :=
    ⟨Subtype.val A₄, ⟨T, T, _, _, rightMarked, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  let B : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := U) Complex boundary :=
    ⟨Subtype.val B₄, ⟨T, T, _, _, trunkMarked, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces A B) ∧
¬ MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ShapeReplaces B₄ A₄) := by
  change (∀ {V : Type u} [Group V],
      LabelledDrawing.PlanarReplaces (U := V) Complex rightShape trunkShape) ∧
    ¬ LabelledDrawing.PlanarReplaces (U := S4) Complex trunkShape rightShape
  exact ⟨fun {_} _ => forward normal, reverse finiteNormal⟩


/-- Remaining normal form, for two stages with a common typed word. -/
def StagedNormalForm (U : Type u) [Group U] : Prop :=
  ∀ (G K : Subgroup U) {p m q : Word G K}
    (below : LabelledDrawing Complex p m) (above : LabelledDrawing Complex m q),
    p.directions = [true, true] →
    PlanarCode.encode below.erase.geometry = [.vertex 1 .upDot] →
    PlanarCode.encode above.erase.geometry = [.vertex 0 (.trivalent .mergeUp)] →
    ∃ (H : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding H G) (a b : ConjEmbedding K H)
      (label : DotLabel Complex a b) (hp : (pair l a).boundary = p.boundary)
      (hq : (Word.up (l.comp b)).boundary = q.boundary),
      (below.vertical above).interpret.atBoundary.eval =
        (show LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p.boundary q.boundary rightShape
          from ⟨_, _, branch l label, hp, hq, branch_shape l label⟩).interpret.eval

theorem normalForm_of_staged (normal : StagedNormalForm U) : NormalForm U := by
  rintro G K _ _ ⟨p, q, d, rfl, rfl, hs⟩
  let v : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p.boundary q.boundary rightShape :=
    ⟨p, q, d, rfl, rfl, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨m, below, above, hb, ha, he⟩ := DotSlidePreorderProof.factor_rightFiber v
  have hw : p.directions = [true, true] := congrArg PlanarShape.bottom hs

private abbrev BoundaryHom (p q : Boundary G K) :=
  Biset.Hom Complex p.word.basis q.word.basis

private theorem heq_of_hom_cast {p q p' q' : Boundary G K}
    (hp : p = p') (hq : q = q') {f : BoundaryHom p q} {g : BoundaryHom p' q'}
    (h : cast (congrArg₂ (fun b c : Boundary G K => BoundaryHom b c) hp hq) f = g) :
    HEq f g := by
  subst p'
  subst q'
  exact heq_of_eq h

private theorem vertical_heq {p m q p' m' q' : Boundary G K}
    (hp : p = p') (hm : m = m') (hq : q = q')
    {f : BoundaryHom p m} {f' : BoundaryHom p' m'}
    {g : BoundaryHom m q} {g' : BoundaryHom m' q'}
    (hf : HEq f f') (hg : HEq g g') :
    HEq (f.vertical g) (f'.vertical g') := by
  subst p'
  subst m'
  subst q'
  rw [eq_of_heq hf, eq_of_heq hg]

/- Proposition 3.2 uses (3.1) on the displayed right-input drawing.
   For the full planar fiber, first cut its rigid event list and normalize the
   two typed stages. The source shape provides the width-two hypothesis.
   On the shared middle word the two normalized ordered boundaries agree,
   including both embedding labels. Transport both evaluations through that
   common boundary before composing. -/
private theorem stagedNormalForm : StagedNormalForm U := by
  intro G K p m q below above hw hb ha
  let v : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p.boundary m.boundary below.planarShape :=
    ⟨p, m, below, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨H, l, a, b, label, hp, hm, hd⟩ :=
    normalizeRightDot (dot_empty_coherence (U := U)) v hb hw
  have hmw : m.directions.length ≤ 2 := by
    have h := congrArg boundaryDirections hm
    rw [boundaryDirections_word, boundaryDirections_word] at h
    rw [← h]
    change 2 ≤ 2
    exact le_rfl
  obtain ⟨J, l', b', hm', hq, he⟩ :=
    singleton_merge_normal_form (merge_empty_coherence (U := U)) above ha hmw
  obtain ⟨hJ, hl, hb'⟩ := branchBoundary_inj l b l' b' (hm'.symm.trans hm.symm)
  subst J
  have hl' := eq_of_heq hl
  have hb'' := eq_of_heq hb'
  subst l'
  subst b'
  let dotStage : LabelledDrawing Complex (pair l a) (pair l b) :=
    (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (.up l))).horizontal label.upDrawing
  let mergeStage : LabelledDrawing Complex (pair l b) (.up (l.comp b)) :=
    .trivalent (.mergeUp l b)
  let dotRep : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p.boundary m.boundary singletonRightShape :=
    ⟨_, _, dotStage, hp, hm, rfl⟩
  have hd' : HEq below.interpret.atBoundary.eval dotStage.interpret.atBoundary.eval :=
    (heq_of_eq (show below.interpret.atBoundary.eval = dotRep.interpret.eval from hd)).trans
      (atBoundary_eval_heq dotRep)
  have he' : HEq above.interpret.atBoundary.eval mergeStage.interpret.atBoundary.eval :=
    heq_of_hom_cast hm' hq he
  let rep : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex p.boundary q.boundary rightShape :=
    ⟨_, _, branch l label, hp, hq.symm, branch_shape l label⟩
  refine ⟨H, l, a, b, label, hp, hq.symm, ?_⟩
  have hv := vertical_heq hp.symm hm.symm hq hd' he'
  rw [← normalize_vertical below.interpret above.interpret,
    ← normalize_vertical dotStage.interpret mergeStage.interpret] at hv
  exact eq_of_heq (hv.trans (atBoundary_eval_heq rep).symm)

private theorem wholeFiber : NormalForm U := normalForm_of_staged stagedNormalForm

end DotSlidePreorderBridge

by
  -- Xiao §6.1 (archived p. 19, published 28 November revision p. 21)
  -- cites Khovanov, Proposition 7, equation (36), top-right identity
  -- (arXiv:1009.3295, p. 31). This endpoint has no matching numbered
  -- Alphabeta proof in the route. The adjacent-transposition argument
  -- applies over Complex and includes n = 0.
  intro n X U S G H J F nested inclusion a b c p q r word i j k leftSwap rightSwap ab bc
  have hij : i ≠ j := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    change n = n + 1 at hv
    omega
  have hik : i ≠ k := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    change n = n + 2 at hv
    omega
  have hjk : j ≠ k := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    change n + 1 = n + 2 at hv
    omega
  -- Each swap has to be in its own target region and fix the source action
  -- by conjugation. The right swap fixes the last point of Fin (n+3).
  have rightMem : rightSwap ∈ H := by
    change Equiv.swap i j ∈ fixingSubgroup U {t : X | n + 2 ≤ t.val}
    apply (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff U).2
    intro t ht
    change n + 2 ≤ t.val at ht
    have hti : t ≠ i := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      change t.val = n at hv
      omega
    have htj : t ≠ j := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      change t.val = n + 1 at hv
      omega
    exact Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hti htj
  have fixes {m : Nat} (u : S m) (t : X) (ht : m ≤ t.val) : (u : U) t = t :=
    (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff U).mp u.property t ht
  -- Diagram.upDot uses the coefficient-one singleton case of the shared
  -- dot language. The two eligibility proofs use the endpoints fixed by
  -- each source subgroup and Mathlib's permutation transport of a swap.
  let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ab ab :=
    ⟨⟨leftSwap, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, fun u => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : U) * Equiv.swap j k = Equiv.swap j k * (u : U)
      rw [Equiv.mul_swap_eq_swap_mul, fixes u j (by change n + 1 ≤ n + 1; omega),
        fixes u k (by change n + 1 ≤ n + 2; omega)]⟩
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc bc :=
    ⟨⟨rightSwap, rightMem⟩, fun u => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : U) * Equiv.swap i j = Equiv.swap i j * (u : U)
      rw [Equiv.mul_swap_eq_swap_mul, fixes u i (by change n ≤ n; omega),
        fixes u j (by change n ≤ n + 1; omega)]⟩
  refine ⟨d, e, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  apply StandardSymmetricBraidProof.braid a b c d e
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Equiv.swap i j * Equiv.swap j k * Equiv.swap i j =
    Equiv.swap j k * Equiv.swap i j * Equiv.swap j k
  calc
    Equiv.swap i j * Equiv.swap j k * Equiv.swap i j =
        Equiv.swap j i * Equiv.swap k j * Equiv.swap j i := by
      rw [Equiv.swap_comm j i, Equiv.swap_comm k j]
    _ = Equiv.swap i k := Equiv.swap_mul_swap_mul_swap hjk.symm hik.symm
    _ = Equiv.swap k i := Equiv.swap_comm _ _
    _ = Equiv.swap j k * Equiv.swap i j * Equiv.swap j k :=
      (Equiv.swap_mul_swap_mul_swap hij hik).symm

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G H J F : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding H G) (b : ConjEmbedding J H) (c : ConjEmbedding F J)

private abbrev cross (d : Dot (a.comp b) (a.comp b)) :
    Diagram Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (.up b)) ((Word.up a).tensor (.up b)) :=
  (Diagram.mergeUp a b).vertical ((Diagram.upDot d).vertical (Diagram.splitUp a b))

private abbrev left (d : Dot (a.comp b) (a.comp b)) :=
  (cross a b d).horizontal (Diagram.id (.up c))

private abbrev right (e : Dot (b.comp c) (b.comp c)) :=
  (Diagram.associate (.up a) (.up b) (.up c)).vertical
    (((Diagram.id (.up a)).horizontal (cross b c e)).vertical
      (Diagram.unassociate (.up a) (.up b) (.up c)))

private abbrev triple (x : G) (y : H) (z : J) :
    (((Word.up a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c)).basis.carrier :=
  ((Word.up a).basis.tensor (Word.up b).basis).pair (Word.up c).basis
    ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y) z

private theorem pair_normal (x : G) (y : H) :
    (Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y =
      (Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis (x * a.toHom y) 1 := by
  symm
  simpa [Word.basis, Biset.induction] using
    (Word.up a).basis.pair_balance (Word.up b).basis y x 1

-- Balance the third coordinate into the second, then the second into
-- the first. This is the three-strand merge and split on representatives.
private theorem triple_normal (x : G) (y : H) (z : J) :
    triple a b c x y z = triple a b c (x * a.toHom (y * b.toHom z)) 1 1 := by
  have moveRight : triple a b c x (y * b.toHom z) 1 = triple a b c x y z := by
    simpa [Biset.act_pair, Word.basis, Biset.induction] using
      ((Word.up a).basis.tensor (Word.up b).basis).pair_balance (Word.up c).basis
        z ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y) 1
  rw [← moveRight]
  exact congrArg (fun xy => ((Word.up a).basis.tensor (Word.up b).basis).pair
    (Word.up c).basis xy 1) (pair_normal a b x (y * b.toHom z))

-- The parallel-crossing composition supplier composes two crossings on
-- the same pair. Here the active pair alternates and the right crossing
-- changes parentheses. Compute each crossing using the checked merge,
-- dot, split and associator basis equations, then compose the resulting
-- right multiplications in stacking order.
private theorem cross_single (d : Dot (a.comp b) (a.comp b)) (x : G) (y : H)
    (r : Complex) :
    (cross a b d).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis x y) r) =
    Finsupp.single ((Word.up a).basis.pair (Word.up b).basis
      (x * a.toHom y * d.element) 1) r := by
  unfold cross
  rw [Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply]
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single a b x y r,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single]

private theorem left_single (d : Dot (a.comp b) (a.comp b)) (x : G) (r : Complex) :
    (left a b c d).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (triple a b c x 1 1) r) =
      Finsupp.single (triple a b c (x * d.element) 1 1) r := by
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (cross a b d) (Diagram.id (.up c)),
    cross_single a b, Diagram.eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single]
  simp only [map_one, mul_one, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul]

private theorem right_single (e : Dot (b.comp c) (b.comp c)) (x : G) (r : Complex) :
    (right a b c e).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (triple a b c x 1 1) r) =
      Finsupp.single (triple a b c (x * a.toHom e.element) 1 1) r := by
  unfold right
  rw [Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply]
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single (.up a) (.up b) (.up c),
    Diagram.eval_horizontal_single (Diagram.id (.up a)) (cross b c e),
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, cross_single b c, Biset.pairLinear_single]
  simp only [map_one, one_mul, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [Diagram.eval_unassociate_single (.up a) (.up b) (.up c)]
  exact congrArg (fun xy => Finsupp.single
    (((Word.up a).basis.tensor (Word.up b).basis).pair (Word.up c).basis xy 1) r)
    (pair_normal a b x e.element)

private theorem braid (d : Dot (a.comp b) (a.comp b)) (e : Dot (b.comp c) (b.comp c))
    (h : a.toHom e.element * d.element * a.toHom e.element =
      d.element * a.toHom e.element * d.element) :
    ((right a b c e).vertical ((left a b c d).vertical (right a b c e))).eval =
      ((left a b c d).vertical ((right a b c e).vertical (left a b c d))).eval := by
  apply Diagram.eval_ext
  intro v r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn v (fun pair => ?_)
  rcases pair with ⟨xy, z⟩
  refine Quotient.inductionOn xy (fun pair => ?_)
  rcases pair with ⟨x, y⟩
  change
    (((right a b c e).vertical ((left a b c d).vertical (right a b c e))).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (triple a b c x y z) r)) =
    (((left a b c d).vertical ((right a b c e).vertical (left a b c d))).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (triple a b c x y z) r))
  rw [triple_normal a b c]
  rw [Diagram.eval_vertical_apply (right a b c e) ((left a b c d).vertical (right a b c e)),
    Diagram.eval_vertical_apply (left a b c d) (right a b c e),
    Diagram.eval_vertical_apply (left a b c d) ((right a b c e).vertical (left a b c d)),
    Diagram.eval_vertical_apply (right a b c e) (left a b c d),
    right_single, left_single, right_single, left_single, right_single, left_single]
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using congrArg
    (fun t => Finsupp.single (triple a b c ((x * a.toHom (y * b.toHom z)) * t) 1 1) r) h

end

end StandardSymmetricBraidProof

by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G α β Kα Hβ hK hH a b A B J σ reps L l r down up M Mj
    W Wj V Vj groupAlgebra coordinates groupAlgebraAction Mod Res Ind summand
  -- Xiao, Section 2.2, Theorem 2.2 and the proof following Lemma 2.3.
  -- Equations (2.1)–(2.3) occur on page 5 of the archived original
  -- and page 7 of the revised published PDF.
  refine ⟨GeneralizedMackeySupport.mixedCoordinates_action a b, ?_⟩
  let d (j : J) : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (a.comp (l j)) (b.comp (r j)) :=
    ⟨σ j, by
      intro ℓ
      apply Subtype.ext
      change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
        (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
      group⟩
  -- The checked identity supplier packages the two composites in (2.3),
  -- including the finite support on each vector. Its proof implements the
  -- surviving terms (2.4)–(2.6) by their common multiplication fiber.
  obtain ⟨hf, hsum, hdiag, hoff⟩ := MackeyIdentityDiagram K H G α β hK hH σ reps
  let p (j : J) : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j) :=
    .mixedProjection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (hf j)
  let i (j : J) : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M :=
    .mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
  -- The compact crossings are the coefficient-one labels checked by
  -- MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection and compact_inclusion.
  -- The finite fiber permits the compact projection at arbitrary index.
  refine ⟨p, i, hsum, hdiag, hoff, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨finite, sum⟩ := hsum
    let inc (j : J) : Vj j →ₗ[Complex] V := (i j).eval.toLinearMap
    let proj (j : J) : V →ₗ[Complex] Vj j := (p j).eval.toLinearMap
    have diag (j : J) (y : Vj j) : proj j (inc j y) = y :=
      congrArg (fun f : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex (Wj j) (Wj j) => f.toLinearMap y) (hdiag j)
    have off (j k : J) (h : j ≠ k) (y : Vj j) : proj k (inc j y) = 0 :=
      congrArg (fun f : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex (Wj j) (Wj k) => f.toLinearMap y) (hoff j k h)
    have addUp (x : V) : x = ∑ j ∈ (finite x).toFinset, inc j (proj j x) := by
      have straight :
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up)).eval =
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.id W :=
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.horizontal_id down.basis up.basis
      have hx := sum x
      change _ = ∑ j ∈ (finite x).toFinset, inc j (proj j x) at hx
      exact (congrArg (fun f : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex W W => f.toLinearMap x) straight).symm.trans hx
    let equiv := MackeyDiagrams.orthogonalDirectSum inc proj finite addUp diag off
    have coord (x : V) (j : J) : equiv x j = proj j x :=
      MackeyDiagrams.orthogonalDirectSum_apply inc proj finite addUp diag off x j
    refine ⟨coordinates.symm.trans equiv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x j
      change equiv (coordinates.symm (coordinates x)) j = proj j x
      rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, coord]
    · intro g x j
      have hx := GeneralizedMackeySupport.mixedCoordinates_action a b g (coordinates.symm x)
      change coordinates (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex W g (coordinates.symm x)) =
        groupAlgebraAction g (coordinates (coordinates.symm x)) at hx
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hx
      change equiv (coordinates.symm (groupAlgebraAction g x)) j =
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (Wj j) g (equiv (coordinates.symm x) j)
      rw [← hx, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, coord, coord]
      exact (p j).eval.commutes g (coordinates.symm x)
  · -- The last paragraph after (2.6) tensors the decomposition on the right.
    -- The proof uses Mathlib's induced representation presentation. Its pure
    -- tensor at g is indexed by g⁻¹, and the coproduct inclusions send k ⊗ x
    -- to a(k)σⱼ ⊗ x. Descent on balanced pairs gives the coproduct property.
    have index_mul (j : J) (k : K) (h : H) :
        DoubleCoset.mk A B (a.toHom k * σ j * b.toHom h) = j := by
      have hj : DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = DoubleCoset.mk A B (a.toHom k * σ j * b.toHom h) :=
        DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨a.toHom k, ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩,
          b.toHom h, ⟨h, h.property, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact hj.symm.trans (reps j)
    have factor (g : G) : ∃ (j : J) (k : K) (h : H), a.toHom k * σ j * b.toHom h = g := by
      let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B g
      obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,hg⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp (reps j)
      change (x : U) ∈ Kα at hx
      change (y : U) ∈ Hβ at hy
      obtain ⟨k,hk,hx⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨h,hh,hy⟩ := hy
      have hx' : a.toHom ⟨k,hk⟩ = x := Subtype.ext hx
      have hy' : b.toHom ⟨h,hh⟩ = y := Subtype.ext hy
      exact ⟨j, ⟨k,hk⟩, ⟨h,hh⟩, by rw [hx', hy']; exact hg.symm⟩
    have intersection (j : J) (k : K) (h : H)
        (e : a.toHom k = σ j * b.toHom h * (σ j)⁻¹) :
        ∃ t : L j, (l j).toHom t = k := by
      let ell := α * (k : U) * α⁻¹
      have hleft : ell ∈ Kα := ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩
      have hright : ell ∈ Subgroup.map
          (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H := by
        refine ⟨h, h.property, ?_⟩
        have he := congrArg Subtype.val e
        change α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ =
          (σ j : U) * (β * (h : U) * β⁻¹) * (σ j : U)⁻¹ at he
        change ((σ j : U) * β) * (h : U) * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = α * (k : U) * α⁻¹
        rw [he]
        group
      refine ⟨⟨ell, hleft, hright⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      change α⁻¹ * (α * (k : U) * α⁻¹) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ = (k : U)
      group
    have bijective := GeneralizedMackeySupport.multiplication_bijective a b l r σ
      (fun j => (d j).intertwines) (DoubleCoset.mk A B) index_mul factor intersection
    let adjA := (GeneralizedMackeySupport.existsModuleAdjunction.{u,v} a).some
    let adjR (j : J) := (GeneralizedMackeySupport.existsModuleAdjunction.{u,v} (r j)).some
    exact ⟨GeneralizedMackeySupport.moduleMackey a.toHom b.toHom (fun j => (l j).toHom)
      (fun j => (r j).toHom) σ (fun j => (d j).intertwines) bijective adjA adjR⟩

variable {H K G L : Type u} [Group H] [Group K] [Group G] [Group L]

private abbrev pure (b : H →* G) (X : Rep.{v} Complex H) (g : G) :=
  IndV.mk b X.ρ g⁻¹

private theorem pure_balance (b : H →* G) (X : Rep.{v} Complex H) (g : G) (h : H)
    (x : X) : pure b X (g * b h) x = pure b X g (X.ρ h x) := by
  change Coinvariants.mk (Representation.tprod ((leftRegular Complex G).comp b) X.ρ) ((MonoidAlgebra.single ((g * b h)⁻¹) (1 : Complex)) ⊗ₜ[Complex] x) = _
  rw [mul_inv_rev]
  simpa [ofMulAction_single] using Coinvariants.mk_inv_tmul ((leftRegular Complex G).comp b) X.ρ
    (.single g⁻¹ 1) x h

private theorem pure_act (b : H →* G) (X : Rep.{v} Complex H) (g t : G) (x : X) :
    ind b X.ρ t (pure b X g x) = pure b X (t * g) x := by
  simp [pure, mul_inv_rev]

private theorem pure_map (b : H →* G) {X Y : Rep.{v} Complex H} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : G) (x : X) :
    (Rep.indMap b f).hom (pure b X g x) = pure b Y g (f.hom x) := rfl

private theorem pure_ext (b : H →* G) (X : Rep.{v} Complex H)
    {Y : Type v} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module Complex Y]
    {f f' : IndV b X.ρ →ₗ[Complex] Y}
    (h : ∀ g x, f (pure b X g x) = f' (pure b X g x)) : f = f' := by
  apply IndV.hom_ext
  intro g
  exact LinearMap.ext (fun x => by simpa only [pure, inv_inv, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] using h g⁻¹ x)

private def liftPure (b : H →* G) (X : Rep.{v} Complex H)
    {Y : Type v} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module Complex Y]
    (F : G → X →ₗ[Complex] Y)
    (bal : ∀ g h x, F (g * b h) x = F g (X.ρ h x)) :
    IndV b X.ρ →ₗ[Complex] Y :=
  Coinvariants.lift _
    (TensorProduct.lift ((Finsupp.lift _ _ _ fun g => F g⁻¹) ∘ₗ
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap)) (by
    intro h
    ext g x
    simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, MonoidAlgebra.lsingle_apply]
    simp [ofMulAction_single, mul_inv_rev, ← map_inv, bal, ← mul_apply_eq_comp,
      ← map_mul])

private theorem liftPure_apply (b : H →* G) (X : Rep.{v} Complex H)
    {Y : Type v} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module Complex Y]
    (F : G → X →ₗ[Complex] Y) (bal : ∀ g h x, F (g * b h) x = F g (X.ρ h x))
    (g : G) (x : X) :
    liftPure b X F bal (pure b X g x) = F g x := by
  simp [liftPure, pure, IndV.mk]

section Cofan

variable {J : Type u} {S : J → Type u} [∀ j, Group (S j)]
variable (a : K →* G) (b : H →* G)
variable (l : ∀ j, S j →* K) (r : ∀ j, S j →* H) (s : J → G)
variable (intertwines : ∀ j t, a (l j t) * s j = s j * b (r j t))

private abbrev mainRep : Rep.{max u v} Complex H ⥤ Rep.{max u v} Complex K :=
  Rep.indFunctor Complex b ⋙ Rep.resFunctor a

private abbrev summandRep (j : J) : Rep.{max u v} Complex H ⥤ Rep.{max u v} Complex K :=
  Rep.resFunctor (r j) ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex (l j)

include intertwines in
private theorem inclusionBalance (j : J) (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (k : K) (t : S j)
    (x : X) : pure b X (a (k * l j t) * s j) x = pure b X (a k * s j) (X.ρ (r j t) x) := by
  rw [map_mul, mul_assoc, intertwines, ← mul_assoc]
  exact pure_balance b X _ _ x

private def inclusionAt (j : J) (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) :
    (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ (mainRep a b).obj X := by
  let Z := Rep.res (r j) X
  let F := liftPure (l j) Z (fun k => pure b X (a k * s j))
    (inclusionBalance a b l r s intertwines j X)
  refine Rep.ofHom ⟨F, ?_⟩
  intro t
  apply pure_ext (l j) Z
  intro k x
  change F (ind (l j) Z.ρ t (pure (l j) Z k x)) =
    ind b X.ρ (a t) (F (pure (l j) Z k x))
  dsimp only [F]
  rw [pure_act, liftPure_apply, liftPure_apply, pure_act, map_mul, mul_assoc]
private theorem inclusionAt_pure (j : J) (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (k : K) (x : X) :
    (inclusionAt a b l r s intertwines j X).hom
      (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k x) = pure b X (a k * s j) x := by
  unfold inclusionAt
  rw [Rep.hom_ofHom]
  exact liftPure_apply (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) (fun k' => pure b X (a k' * s j))
    (inclusionBalance a b l r s intertwines j X) k x

private def inclusionRep (j : J) : summandRep.{u,v} l r j ⟶ mainRep.{u,v} a b where
  app := inclusionAt a b l r s intertwines j
  naturality X Y f := by
    apply Rep.hom_ext
    apply Representation.IntertwiningMap.ext
    apply pure_ext (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X)
    intro k x
    change (inclusionAt a b l r s intertwines j Y).hom
        ((Rep.indMap (l j) (Rep.resMap (r j) f)).hom (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k x)) =
      (Rep.indMap b f).hom ((inclusionAt a b l r s intertwines j X).hom
        (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k x))
    rw [pure_map, inclusionAt_pure, inclusionAt_pure, pure_map, Rep.resMap_hom_apply]

-- Work with balanced pairs of group elements, before linearization.
private def summandBasis (j : J) : Setoid (K × H) where
  r p q := ∃ t : S j, p.1 * (l j t)⁻¹ = q.1 ∧ r j t * p.2 = q.2
  iseqv := by
    constructor
    · intro p
      exact ⟨1, by simp, by simp⟩
    · rintro p q ⟨t, ht, hr⟩
      exact ⟨t⁻¹, by rw [← ht]; simp, by rw [← hr]; simp⟩
    · rintro p q w ⟨t, ht, hr⟩ ⟨t', ht', hr'⟩
      exact ⟨t' * t, by rw [← ht', ← ht]; simp [mul_assoc],
        by rw [← hr', ← hr]; simp [mul_assoc]⟩

private def toGroup (q : Σ j, Quotient (summandBasis l r j)) : G :=
  Quotient.liftOn q.2 (fun p => a p.1 * s q.1 * b p.2) (by
    rintro p w ⟨t, ht, hr⟩
    rw [← ht, ← hr, map_mul, map_inv, map_mul]
    have ht' := intertwines q.1 t
    symm
    calc
      _ = a p.1 * ((a (l q.1 t))⁻¹ * (s q.1 * b (r q.1 t))) * b p.2 := by
        simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [← ht', inv_mul_cancel_left])

variable (bijective : Function.Bijective (toGroup a b l r s intertwines))

private def descentOnPair (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y)
    (q : Σ j, Quotient (summandBasis l r j)) : X →ₗ[Complex] Y :=
  Quotient.liftOn q.2 (fun p => (f q.1).hom.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    pure (l q.1) (Rep.res (r q.1) X) p.1 ∘ₗ X.ρ p.2) (by
    rintro p w ⟨t, ht, hr⟩
    rw [← ht, ← hr, ← map_inv]
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change (f q.1).hom
        (pure (l q.1) (Rep.res (r q.1) X) p.1 (X.ρ p.2 x)) =
      (f q.1).hom
        (pure (l q.1) (Rep.res (r q.1) X) (p.1 * l q.1 t⁻¹)
          (X.ρ (r q.1 t * p.2) x))
    rw [pure_balance]
    congr 2
    change X.ρ p.2 x =
      X.ρ (r q.1 t⁻¹) (X.ρ (r q.1 t * p.2) x)
    rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, ← map_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
      map_one, one_mul])

private def descentOnGroup (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y) : G → X →ₗ[Complex] Y :=
  fun g => descentOnPair l r X Y f ((Equiv.ofBijective _ bijective).symm g)

private theorem descentOnGroup_apply (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y) (j : J) (k : K) (h : H) (x : X) :
    descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f (a k * s j * b h) x =
      (f j).hom (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k (X.ρ h x)) := by
  let q : Σ j, Quotient (summandBasis l r j) := ⟨j, Quotient.mk _ (k,h)⟩
  change descentOnPair l r X Y f
    ((Equiv.ofBijective _ bijective).symm ((Equiv.ofBijective _ bijective) q)) x = _
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

include bijective in
private theorem exists_factor (g : G) : ∃ j k h, a k * s j * b h = g := by
  obtain ⟨⟨j,q⟩, rfl⟩ := bijective.2 g
  refine Quotient.inductionOn q (fun p => ?_)
  exact ⟨j,p.1,p.2,rfl⟩

private theorem descentOnGroup_balance (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y) (g : G) (h : H) (x : X) :
    descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f (g * b h) x =
      descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f g (X.ρ h x) := by
  obtain ⟨j,k,h',rfl⟩ := exists_factor a b l r s intertwines bijective g
  rw [mul_assoc (a k * s j), ← map_mul, descentOnGroup_apply, descentOnGroup_apply,
    map_mul, mul_apply_eq_comp]

private theorem descentOnGroup_equivariant (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y) (k : K) (g : G) (x : X) :
    descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f (a k * g) x =
      Y.ρ k (descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f g x) := by
  obtain ⟨j,k',h,rfl⟩ := exists_factor a b l r s intertwines bijective g
  rw [← mul_assoc (a k), ← mul_assoc (a k), ← map_mul,
    descentOnGroup_apply, descentOnGroup_apply, ← Rep.hom_comm_apply]
  congr 1
  exact (pure_act (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k' k (X.ρ h x)).symm

private def descentAt (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y) : (mainRep a b).obj X ⟶ Y := by
  let F := liftPure b X (descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f)
    (descentOnGroup_balance a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f)
  refine Rep.ofHom ⟨F, ?_⟩
  intro k
  apply pure_ext b X
  intro g x
  change F (ind b X.ρ (a k) (pure b X g x)) = Y.ρ k (F (pure b X g x))
  dsimp only [F]
  rw [pure_act, liftPure_apply, liftPure_apply]
  exact descentOnGroup_equivariant a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f k g x
private theorem descentAt_pure (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex H) (Y : Rep.{max u v} Complex K)
    (f : ∀ j, (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ Y) (g : G) (x : X) :
    (descentAt a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f).hom (pure b X g x) =
      descentOnGroup a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f g x := by
  unfold descentAt
  rw [Rep.hom_ofHom]
  exact liftPure_apply b X _ (descentOnGroup_balance a b l r s intertwines bijective X Y f) g x

private def repCofan : Cofan (summandRep.{u,v} l r) :=
  Cofan.mk (mainRep a b) (inclusionRep a b l r s intertwines)

private def repCofanIsColimit :
    IsColimit (repCofan.{u,v} a b l r s intertwines) := by
  apply evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits
  intro X
  refine ⟨fun c => descentAt a b l r s intertwines bijective X c.pt
    (fun j => c.ι.app ⟨j⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro c ⟨j⟩
    apply Rep.hom_ext
    apply Representation.IntertwiningMap.ext
    apply pure_ext (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X)
    intro k x
    change (descentAt a b l r s intertwines bijective X c.pt _).hom
        ((inclusionAt a b l r s intertwines j X).hom (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k x)) =
      (c.ι.app ⟨j⟩).hom (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k x)
    rw [inclusionAt_pure, descentAt_pure, ← mul_one (a k * s j), ← map_one b,
      descentOnGroup_apply, map_one]
    rfl
  · intro c f hf
    apply Rep.hom_ext
    apply Representation.IntertwiningMap.ext
    apply pure_ext b X
    intro g x
    obtain ⟨j,k,h,rfl⟩ := exists_factor a b l r s intertwines bijective g
    change f.hom (pure b X (a k * s j * b h) x) =
      (descentAt a b l r s intertwines bijective X c.pt _).hom
        (pure b X (a k * s j * b h) x)
    rw [descentAt_pure, descentOnGroup_apply, pure_balance, ← inclusionAt_pure a b l r s intertwines]
    have hj := hf (Discrete.mk j)
    exact congrArg (fun z : (summandRep l r j).obj X ⟶ c.pt =>
      z.hom (pure (l j) (Rep.res (r j) X) k (X.ρ h x))) hj

end Cofan

section Modules

private abbrev Mod (G : Type u) [Group G] := ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
private abbrev ofMod (G : Type u) [Group G] : Mod.{u,v} G ⥤ Rep.{max u v} Complex G :=
  Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra
private abbrev toMod (G : Type u) [Group G] : Rep.{max u v} Complex G ⥤ Mod.{u,v} G :=
  Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra
private abbrev indMod (f : H →* G) : Mod.{u,v} H ⥤ Mod.{u,v} G :=
  (ofMod H ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex f) ⋙ toMod G
private abbrev resMod (f : H →* G) : Mod.{u,v} G ⥤ Mod.{u,v} H :=
  ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom
private abbrev repEquiv (G : Type u) [Group G] : Rep.{max u v} Complex G ≌ Mod.{u,v} G :=
  Rep.equivalenceModuleMonoidAlgebra

private def adjointRestriction (f : H →* G) (adj : indMod.{u,v} f ⊣ resMod.{u,v} f) :
    (ofMod G ⋙ Rep.resFunctor f ⋙ toMod H) ≅ resMod.{u,v} f :=
  Adjunction.rightAdjointUniq
    (((repEquiv.{u,v} H).symm.toAdjunction.comp (Rep.indResAdjunction Complex f)).comp
      (repEquiv.{u,v} G).toAdjunction) adj

private theorem existsModuleAdjunction {U : Type u} [Group U] {S T : Subgroup U}
    (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T) :
    Nonempty (indMod.{u,v} f.toHom ⊣ resMod.{u,v} f.toHom) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := f.hasRepresentative
  have hm (x : S) : a * (x : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ T := ha x ▸ (f.toHom x).property
  have hf : f = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a hm := by
    apply MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ext
    exact MonoidHom.ext (fun x => Subtype.ext (ha x))
  rw [hf]
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, adj, _, _⟩ := InductionRestrictionAdjunction.{u,v} S T a hm
  exact ⟨adj⟩

private def insertModuleEquiv (P : Mod.{u,v} H ⥤ Rep.{max u v} Complex G)
    (Q : Rep.{max u v} Complex G ⥤ Mod.{u,v} K) :
    (P ⋙ Q) ≅ (P ⋙ toMod G) ⋙ (ofMod G ⋙ Q) :=
  Functor.isoWhiskerLeft P ((Functor.leftUnitor Q).symm ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (repEquiv.{u,v} G).unitIso Q)

private def moduleMackey {J : Type u} {S : J → Type u} [∀ j, Group (S j)]
    (a : K →* G) (b : H →* G) (l : ∀ j, S j →* K) (r : ∀ j, S j →* H)
    (s : J → G) (intertwines : ∀ j t, a (l j t) * s j = s j * b (r j t))
    (bijective : Function.Bijective (toGroup a b l r s intertwines))
    (adjA : indMod.{u,v} a ⊣ resMod.{u,v} a)
    (adjR : ∀ j, indMod.{u,v} (r j) ⊣ resMod.{u,v} (r j)) :
    (indMod.{u,v} b ⋙ resMod.{u,v} a) ≅
      sigmaObj (fun j => resMod.{u,v} (r j) ⋙ indMod.{u,v} (l j)) := by
  let P := (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ (Rep.{max u v} Complex K)).obj (ofMod.{u,v} H)
  let Q := (Functor.whiskeringRight (Mod.{u,v} H) _ _).obj (toMod.{u,v} K)
  let c := repCofan.{u,v} a b l r s intertwines
  let F := Discrete.functor (summandRep.{u,v} l r)
  have hc : IsColimit c := repCofanIsColimit a b l r s intertwines bijective
  have hm : IsColimit ((P ⋙ Q).mapCocone c) := by
    letI : (toMod.{u,v} K).IsEquivalence := (repEquiv.{u,v} K).isEquivalence_functor
    exact isColimitOfPreserves (P ⋙ Q) hc
  let diagram := Discrete.functor (fun j => resMod.{u,v} (r j) ⋙ indMod.{u,v} (l j))
  have hmain : (P ⋙ Q).obj c.pt ≅ indMod.{u,v} b ⋙ resMod.{u,v} a := by
    exact (insertModuleEquiv (ofMod H ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex b)
      (Rep.resFunctor a ⋙ toMod K)) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (indMod b) (adjointRestriction a adjA)
  have hsummand : F ⋙ (P ⋙ Q) ≅ diagram := by
    apply Discrete.natIso
    intro j
    exact (insertModuleEquiv (ofMod H ⋙ Rep.resFunctor (r j.as))
      (Rep.indFunctor Complex (l j.as) ⋙ toMod K)) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (adjointRestriction (r j.as) (adjR j.as)) (indMod (l j.as))
  exact hmain.symm ≪≫ hm.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _) ≪≫
    HasColimit.isoOfNatIso hsummand

end Modules

section Biset

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)

private theorem mixedProduct_action (g : K × H)
    (z : ((Biset.restriction a).tensor (Biset.induction b)).carrier) :
    Generator.mixedProduct a b (((Biset.restriction a).tensor (Biset.induction b)).act g z) =
      a.toHom g.1 * Generator.mixedProduct a b z * (b.toHom g.2)⁻¹ := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun p => ?_)
  change (a.toHom g.1 * p.1 * (1 : G)⁻¹) * (1 * p.2 * (b.toHom g.2)⁻¹) =
    a.toHom g.1 * (p.1 * p.2) * (b.toHom g.2)⁻¹
  simp [mul_assoc]

private theorem mixedCoordinates_action (g : K × H)
    (x : Finsupp ((Biset.restriction a).tensor (Biset.induction b)).carrier Complex) :
    let coord := (Finsupp.domLCongr (Generator.mixedEquiv a b)).trans
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm
    coord ((Biset.restriction a |>.tensor (Biset.induction b)).actLinear Complex g x) =
      MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G (a.toHom g.1) * coord x *
        MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((b.toHom g.2)⁻¹) := by
  intro coord
  have single (z : ((Biset.restriction a).tensor (Biset.induction b)).carrier) (c : Complex) :
      coord (Finsupp.single z c) = MonoidAlgebra.single (Generator.mixedProduct a b z) c := by
    change (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm
      (Finsupp.domLCongr (Generator.mixedEquiv a b) (Finsupp.single z c)) = _
    rw [Finsupp.domLCongr_single]
    rfl
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy, mul_add, add_mul]
  | single z c =>
    rw [Biset.actLinear_single, single, single, mixedProduct_action]
    simp only [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, mul_one]

private def sharedBasis {J : Type u} {S : J → Subgroup U}
    (l : ∀ j, ConjEmbedding (S j) K) (r : ∀ j, ConjEmbedding (S j) H) (j : J) :
    Quotient (summandBasis (fun i => (l i).toHom) (fun i => (r i).toHom) j) ≃
      ((Biset.induction (l j)).tensor (Biset.restriction (r j))).carrier :=
  Quotient.congrRight (fun p q => by
    change (∃ t : S j, p.1 * ((l j).toHom t)⁻¹ = q.1 ∧ (r j).toHom t * p.2 = q.2) ↔
      (∃ t : S j, (1 : K) * p.1 * ((l j).toHom t)⁻¹ = q.1 ∧
        (r j).toHom t * p.2 * (1 : H)⁻¹ = q.2)
    simp)
private theorem multiplication_bijective {J : Type u} {S : J → Subgroup U}
    (l : ∀ j, ConjEmbedding (S j) K) (r : ∀ j, ConjEmbedding (S j) H)
    (s : J → G) (ht : ∀ j t, a.toHom ((l j).toHom t) * s j = s j * b.toHom ((r j).toHom t))
    (index : G → J) (index_mul : ∀ j k h, index (a.toHom k * s j * b.toHom h) = j)
    (factor : ∀ g : G, ∃ j k h, a.toHom k * s j * b.toHom h = g)
    (intersection : ∀ j (k : K) (h : H),
      a.toHom k = s j * b.toHom h * (s j)⁻¹ → ∃ t, (l j).toHom t = k) :
    Function.Bijective
      (toGroup a.toHom b.toHom (fun j => (l j).toHom) (fun j => (r j).toHom) s ht) := by
  let f := toGroup a.toHom b.toHom (fun j => (l j).toHom) (fun j => (r j).toHom) s ht
  let d (j : J) : Dot (a.comp (l j)) (b.comp (r j)) := ⟨s j, ht j⟩
  have factorIndex (j : J) (q : Quotient (summandBasis
      (fun j => (l j).toHom) (fun j => (r j).toHom) j)) :
      index (f ⟨j,q⟩) = j := Quotient.inductionOn q (fun p => index_mul j p.1 p.2)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, x⟩ ⟨j, y⟩ he
    have hij : i = j := (factorIndex i x).symm.trans ((congrArg index he).trans (factorIndex j y))
    subst j
    apply congrArg (Sigma.mk i)
    apply (sharedBasis l r i).injective
    apply Generator.injective_mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l i) (r i) (d i) (intersection i)
    apply (Generator.mixedEquiv a b).injective
    revert he
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y (fun p q he => ?_)
    change Generator.mixedProduct a b (Generator.mixedPair a b
        (a.toHom p.1 * s i * b.toHom p.2)) =
      Generator.mixedProduct a b (Generator.mixedPair a b
        (a.toHom q.1 * s i * b.toHom q.2))
    change a.toHom p.1 * s i * b.toHom p.2 = a.toHom q.1 * s i * b.toHom q.2 at he
    simpa only [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair] using he
  · intro g
    obtain ⟨j,k,h,hg⟩ := factor g
    exact ⟨⟨j, Quotient.mk _ (k,h)⟩, hg⟩

end Biset

MixedReidemeisterTwoMackeyCancellation.proof:
(by
  classical
  intro U inst K H G α β conjSubgroup Kα Hβ hK hH eα eβ A B J σ reps orbit
    L a b l r d n down up M Mj W Wj V groupAlgebra coordinates qBasis q
  -- Xiao, §5.1, “Mackey cancellation” (archived original PDF p. 16,
  -- revised published PDF p. 18), specializes Proposition 5.1 to the
  -- full intersections of (2.2). The plan records no Alphabeta Math entry
  -- with numbered steps for this endpoint. The steps below follow Xiao's
  -- specialization and the splitting equations (2.3).
  -- Step 1. Match the two-sided group action at the original boundary.
  have action := (GeneralizedMackeyDecomposition.{u, 0} K H G α β hK hH σ reps).1
  -- Step 2. Use the chosen section to identify membership in each orbit.
  have orbitClass (j : J) (g : G) : g ∈ orbit j ↔ DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j := by
    change g ∈ DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G) ↔ _
    rw [DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset]
    refine (DoubleCoset.eq (H := A) (K := B) (a := σ j) (b := g)).symm.trans ?_
    rw [reps j]
    exact eq_comm
  have dotElement (j : J) : (d j).element = σ j := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ = (σ j : U)
    group
  have indexOne (j : J) : n j = 1 := by
    change (conjSubgroup (α * α⁻¹) (L j)).relIndex
      (Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup (((d j).element : U) * β) H) = 1
    rw [dotElement, mul_inv_cancel]
    change (conjSubgroup 1 (L j)).relIndex (L j) = 1
    have himage : conjSubgroup 1 (L j) = L j := by
      change (L j).map (MulAut.conj (1 : U)).toMonoidHom = L j
      have hconj : (MulAut.conj (1 : U)).toMonoidHom = MonoidHom.id U := by
        ext x
        change 1 * x * (1 : U)⁻¹ = x
        simp
      rw [hconj, Subgroup.map_id]
    rw [himage, Subgroup.relIndex_self]

  -- general MixedCrossingComposites theorem uses image-subgroup quotients
  -- and a finite relative-index hypothesis. Here the registered
  -- MackeyIdentityDiagram already gives all three composites at these
  -- comap-subgroup quotients, once the two dot presentations are identified.

    apply Generator.injective_mixedMultiplicationBasis
    intro k h he

    let ell := α * (k : U) * α⁻¹
    have hleft : ell ∈ Kα := ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩
    have hright : ell ∈ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H := by
      refine ⟨h, h.property, ?_⟩
      have hh := congrArg Subtype.val he

      change ((σ j : U) * β) * (h : U) * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ =
        α * (k : U) * α⁻¹
      rw [hh]
      group

    apply Subtype.ext
    change α⁻¹ * (α * (k : U) * α⁻¹) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ = (k : U)
    group
  have rangeOrbit (j : J) (g : G) : g ∈ Set.range (q j) ↔ g ∈ orbit j := by
    have hrange : g ∈ Set.range (q j) ↔ Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g ∈
        Set.range (qBasis j) := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨w, (Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis j w)).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨w, hw⟩

    rw [hrange, Generator.mixedRange_eq_doubleCoset, DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset]
    simp only [dotElement]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, h, hg⟩

    · rintro ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hg⟩

      change (y : U) ∈ Hβ at hy

      obtain ⟨h, hh, hy⟩ := hy

      have hy' : eβ.toHom ⟨h, hh⟩ = y := Subtype.ext hy

  refine ⟨action, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g
    let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B g
    exact ⟨j, (orbitClass j g).mpr rfl, fun i hi => ((orbitClass i g).mp hi).symm⟩
  · intro j
    refine ⟨dotElement j, indexOne j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w _

    · exact ((Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective.comp (injective j)).injOn

      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (rangeOrbit j g).mpr hg

      Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ (l j) (r j) (d₀ j) w = z}) at hf₀
    let hf (j : J) (z : W.carrier) : Set.Finite {w | qBasis j w = z} :=
      by simpa only [hd] using hf₀ j z
    refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
    intro ι p straight straightj eval summands finiteSupport
    let io (j : J) : Diagram Complex (Mj j) M :=
      .mixedMultiplication eα eβ (l j) (r j) (d₀ j)
    let po (j : J) : Diagram Complex M (Mj j) :=
      .mixedProjection eα eβ (l j) (r j) (d₀ j) (hf₀ j)
    have ei (j : J) : eval (ι j) = (io j).eval := by
      change (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ (l j) (r j) [(1, d j)]).interpret.eval =
        (Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ (l j) (r j) (d₀ j)).eval
      rw [hd]
      exact MackeyCrossingProof.compact_inclusion eα eβ (l j) (r j) (d j)
    have ep (j : J) : eval (p j) = (po j).eval := by
      change (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ (l j) (r j)
        [(1, ⟨d j, hf j⟩)]).interpret.eval = (po j).eval
      rw [MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection]
      have congr_projection
          (d₁ d₂ : Dot (eα.comp (l j)) (eβ.comp (r j))) (h : d₁ = d₂)
          (h₁ : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ (l j) (r j) d₁ w = z})
          (h₂ : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ (l j) (r j) d₂ w = z}) :
          Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ (l j) (r j) d₁ h₁ =
            Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ (l j) (r j) d₂ h₂ := by
        cases h
        rfl
      exact congrArg Diagram.eval (congr_projection _ _ (hd j).symm (hf j) (hf₀ j))
    have ecomp {p q t : Word K H} (f : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
        (g : LabelledDrawing Complex q t) :
        eval (LabelledDrawing.vertical f g) = (eval f).vertical (eval g) := rfl
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro j
      rw [ecomp, ei, ep]
      have hs : eval (straightj j) = Biset.Hom.id (Wj j) :=
        Biset.Hom.horizontal_id (Word.up (l j)).basis (Word.down (r j)).basis
      rw [hs]
      exact hdiag₀ j
    · intro i j hij
      rw [ecomp, ei, ep]
      exact hoff₀ i j hij
    · -- Step 4. Evaluate the exact finite support of the labelled sum on
      -- each input. This implements the paper's pointwise sum over all cosets.
      let term (x : V) (j : J) := (eval (summands j)).toLinearMap x
      let ordinary (x : V) (j : J) :=
        (Diagram.vertical (po j) (io j)).eval.toLinearMap x
      have hterm (x : V) : term x = ordinary x := by
        funext j
        change (eval (LabelledDrawing.vertical (p j) (ι j))).toLinearMap x = _
        rw [ecomp, ep, ei]
        rfl
      obtain ⟨finite₀, sum₀⟩ := hsum₀
      have finite : finiteSupport summands := fun x => by
        change Set.Finite (Function.support (term x))
        rw [hterm]
        exact finite₀ x
      refine ⟨finite, ?_⟩
      intro sum
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
      intro x
      change (∑ j ∈ (finite x).toFinset, term x j) = _
      have indices : (finite x).toFinset = (finite₀ x).toFinset := by
        ext j
        simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
        change j ∈ Function.support (term x) ↔ j ∈ Function.support (ordinary x)
        rw [hterm]
      rw [indices, hterm]
      exact (sum₀ x).symm)

variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U}

private theorem eval_sum (M : Word K H) {J : Type u}
    (drawings : J → LabelledDrawing Complex M M) (indices : Finset J)
    (x : M.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    ((List.foldr LabelledDrawing.add (.ordinary (Diagram.zero M M))
      (List.map drawings indices.toList)).interpret.eval).toLinearMap x =
        ∑ j ∈ indices, (drawings j).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x := by
  classical
  let term (j : J) := (drawings j).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x
  have evalList (L : List J) :
      ((List.foldr LabelledDrawing.add (.ordinary (Diagram.zero M M))
        (L.map drawings)).interpret.eval).toLinearMap x = (L.map term).sum := by
    induction L with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons j L ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldr_cons, List.sum_cons]
      change term j +
          (List.foldr LabelledDrawing.add (.ordinary (Diagram.zero M M))
            (L.map drawings)).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x = term j + (L.map term).sum
      rw [ih]
  rw [evalList]
  conv_rhs => rw [← indices.toList_toFinset, List.sum_toFinset _ indices.nodup_toList]

MackeyDecompositionWithParabolicRepresen.proof:
by
  classical
  intro P Finitary conj conjugate blockSym forward backward Mod Res Ind
    K H G α β X g r c D A B hnD hnA hnB hdD hdA hdB hcD hcA hcB Kα Hβ
    hG hA hB hK hH left right Q rows cols row col Mat J rank αmap βmap
  -- Xiao, Theorem 7.4 (archived PDF p. 32, revised published PDF p. 34)
  -- uses Prop. 7.3 in each ambient block. The archived and revised PDFs
  -- have different checksums and pagination. No separate numbered
  -- Alphabeta Math proof is recorded for this endpoint.
  -- The product formula yields the refinements and quotient coordinates.
  have splitData := ProductParabolicDoubleCosets X g r c D A B hnD hnA hnB
    hdD hdA hdB hcD hcA hcB
  have hLeA : (iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a))) ≤ iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i)) :=
    hA ▸ hG ▸ hK
  have hLeB : (iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))) ≤ iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i)) :=
    hB ▸ hG ▸ hH
  -- Transport the statement along the common ambient subgroup equality.
  obtain ⟨refA, refB, split, cosets, classes, _, _, split_val, _, cosets_mk,
    count, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ := splitData hLeA hLeB
  subst G
  have partA (i : Fin g) := ParabolicMackeyAssembly.restrictedPartition D A hdD hnA hdA refA
    (fun i x hx => (hcA x).mp ((hcD x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)) i
  have partB (i : Fin g) := ParabolicMackeyAssembly.restrictedPartition D B hdD hnB hdB refB
    (fun i x hx => (hcB x).mp ((hcD x).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩)) i
  -- Prop. 7.3, steps 1 and 2: split rows and columns into ordered
  -- consecutive pieces and match corresponding pieces in order. The
  -- product supplier uses the identity in one-coset blocks (§7.3);
  -- Theorem 7.4 asks for the ordered matching even in those blocks.
  -- A row [0,1] and columns [1], [0] give one double coset, and
  -- the matching sends 1 to 0 and 0 to 1. Use the tableau section
  -- in all blocks to retain the endpoint's rank equations.
  have ordered (i : Fin g) := ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives (D i)
    (rows i).card (cols i).card (row i) (col i)
    (partA i).1 (partB i).1 (partA i).2.1 (partB i).2.1 (partA i).2.2 (partB i).2.2
  choose localClass localCount localSection using ordered
  choose tableau tableau_class tableau_rank using localSection
  have class_eq (i : Fin g) : localClass i = classes i := by
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro q
    refine Quotient.inductionOn' q (fun p => ?_)
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext a b
    exact (localCount i p a b).trans (count i p a b).symm
  have isA : left = Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype _) (iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a))) :=
    congrArg (Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype _)) hA
  have isB : right = Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype _) (iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))) :=
    congrArg (Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype _)) hB
  -- Reindex with the coordinate classifications, transporting the quotient
  -- along equality of the ambient left and right subgroups.
  let qEquiv : Q ≃ _ := ParabolicMackeyAssembly.cosetCongr isA isB
  have q_mk s : qEquiv (DoubleCoset.mk left right s) = DoubleCoset.mk _ _ s :=
    ParabolicMackeyAssembly.cosetCongr_mk isA isB s
  let classify : Q ≃ J := (qEquiv.trans cosets).trans (Equiv.piCongrRight classes)
  let σ : J → _ := fun R => split.symm (fun i => tableau i (R i))
  have hsplit (R : J) (i : Fin g) : split (σ R) i = tableau i (R i) :=
    congrFun (split.apply_symm_apply _) i
  have hclass (s) (i : Fin g) :
      classify (DoubleCoset.mk left right s) i = classes i (cosets (DoubleCoset.mk _ _ s) i) :=
    congrArg (fun q => classes i (cosets q i)) (q_mk s)
  have hσ (R : J) : DoubleCoset.mk left right (σ R) = classify.symm R := by
    apply classify.injective
    rw [classify.apply_symm_apply]
    funext i
    rw [hclass, cosets_mk, hsplit, ← class_eq i, tableau_class]
    exact (localClass i).apply_symm_apply (R i)
  refine ⟨split, classify, σ, split_val, ?_, hσ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s i a b
    rw [hclass, cosets_mk]
    exact count i (split s i) a b
  · intro R i a b x y
    rw [hsplit]
    exact tableau_rank i (R i) a b x y
  · intro L lambdaMap muMap
    have hDX (i : Fin g) : D i ⊆ X := fun _ hx => (hcD _).mpr ⟨i, hx⟩
    have preserve (s : ↥(iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i)))) (x : Nat) (hx : x ∈ X) :
        (s : P) x ∈ X := by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (hcD x).mp hx
      let y : ↥(D i) := ⟨x, hi⟩
      have e := split_val s i y
      exact hDX i (e ▸ (split s i y).property)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro R
      let s := σ R
      have hs := ParabolicMackeyAssembly.productFinitary X D hDX (s : P) s.property
      have hsX (x : Nat) : x ∈ X ↔ (s : P) x ∈ X := by
        refine ⟨preserve s x, fun hx => ?_⟩
        have hh := preserve s⁻¹ ((s : P) x) hx
        change (s : P).symm ((s : P) x) ∈ X at hh
        simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hh
      change Kα ⊓ ParabolicMackeyAssembly.conjugate ((s : P) * (β : P)) H = _
      rw [ParabolicMackeyAssembly.conjugate_mul]
      change Kα ⊓ ParabolicMackeyAssembly.conjugate (s : P) Hβ = _
      rw [hA, hB]
      exact ParabolicMackeyAssembly.intersection X A B hnA hnB hdA hdB hcA hcB (s : P) hs hsX
    · exact ParabolicMackeyAssembly.mackeyIso K H _ (α : P) (β : P) hK hH classify σ hσ
    · intro hα hβ
      exact ParabolicMackeyAssembly.inclusionIso K H _ (α : P) (β : P) hK hH σ hα hβ
        (ParabolicMackeyAssembly.mackeyIso K H _ (α : P) (β : P) hK hH classify σ hσ)
