namespace ParabolicMackeyAssembly

private abbrev P := Equiv.Perm Nat
private abbrev conj {U : Type} [Group U] (p : U) := MulAut.conj p
private abbrev conjugate {U : Type} [Group U] (p : U) (S : Subgroup U) :=
  S.map (conj p).toMonoidHom
private abbrev blockSym (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup P :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
private abbrev forward {U : Type} [Group U] {S T : Subgroup U}
    (p : U) (hp : conjugate p S ≤ T) : S →* T :=
  (Subgroup.inclusion hp).comp (MonoidHom.subgroupMap (conj p).toMonoidHom S)
private abbrev backward {U : Type} [Group U] {S T : Subgroup U}
    (p : U) (hp : T ≤ conjugate p S) : T →* S :=
  (MulEquiv.subgroupMap (conj p) S).symm.toMonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hp)

private theorem backward_val {U : Type} [Group U] {S T : Subgroup U}
    (p : U) (hp : T ≤ conjugate p S) (t : T) :
    (backward p hp t : U) = p⁻¹ * (t : U) * p := by
  exact MulAut.conj_inv_apply p (t : U)

private abbrev indices {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun a => A a ⊆ D i)

private abbrev blockIndex {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) :=
  Finset.orderIsoOfFin (indices D A i) rfl

private abbrev part {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (indices D A i).card) :=
  (A ((blockIndex D A i) a).val).subtype (fun n => n ∈ D i)

private theorem restrictedPartition {g r : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)))
    (ha : ∀ a, (A a).Nonempty) (hda : Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (A a) (A b)))
    (href : ∀ a, ∃ i, A a ⊆ D i) (hcover : ∀ i x, x ∈ D i → ∃ a, x ∈ A a)
    (i : Fin g) :
    (∀ a, (part D A i a).Nonempty) ∧
      Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (part D A i a) (part D A i b)) ∧
      ∀ x : ↥(D i), ∃ a, x ∈ part D A i a := by
  let e := blockIndex D A i
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ha (e a).val
    exact ⟨⟨x, (Finset.mem_filter.mp (e a).property).2 hx⟩, Finset.mem_subtype.mpr hx⟩
  · intro a b hab
    have hne : (e a).val ≠ (e b).val := fun h => hab (e.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hx hy =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hda hne) (Finset.mem_subtype.mp hx) (Finset.mem_subtype.mp hy)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨a, hxa⟩ := hcover i x.val x.property
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := href a
    have hij : i = j := by
      by_contra h
      exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd h) x.property (hj hxa)
    subst j
    let b : ↥(indices D A i) := ⟨a, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩⟩
    refine ⟨e.symm b, Finset.mem_subtype.mpr ?_⟩
    change x.val ∈ A (e (e.symm b)).val
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hxa

private theorem productFinitary (X : Finset Nat) {g : Nat} (D : Fin g → Finset Nat)
    (hD : ∀ i, D i ⊆ X) (s : P) (hs : s ∈ iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i))) :
    s ∈ Subgroup.closure {p : P | p.IsSwap} := by
  have hf : ∀ x, x ∉ X → s x = x := by
    refine Subgroup.iSup_induction _ (C := fun p : P => ∀ x, x ∉ X → p x = x) hs ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro i _ ⟨p, rfl⟩ x hx
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem p (fun hxD => hx (hD i hxD))
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
    · intro p q hp hq x hx
      change p (q x) = x
      rw [hq x hx, hp x hx]
  exact mem_closure_isSwap'.mpr (X.finite_toSet.subset fun x hx => by
    by_contra hn
    exact hx (hf x hn))

private theorem intersection (X : Finset Nat) {r c : Nat}
    (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (B : Fin c → Finset Nat)
    (ha : ∀ a, (A a).Nonempty) (hb : ∀ b, (B b).Nonempty)
    (hda : Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (A a) (A b)))
    (hdb : Pairwise (fun a b => Disjoint (B a) (B b)))
    (hca : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, x ∈ A a) (hcb : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, x ∈ B b)
    (s : P) (hs : s ∈ Subgroup.closure {p : P | p.IsSwap})
    (hsX : ∀ x, x ∈ X ↔ s x ∈ X) :
    (iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a))) ⊓ conjugate s (iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))) =
      iSup (fun a => iSup (fun b => blockSym (A a ∩ (B b).map s.toEmbedding))) := by
  let C (b : Fin c) := (B b).map s.toEmbedding
  have hconj := FiniteParabolicConjugateBlocks B hb hdb ⟨s, hs⟩
  change conjugate s (iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))) =
    iSup (fun b => blockSym ((B b).image s)) at hconj
  have hconj' : conjugate s (iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b))) =
      iSup (fun b => blockSym (C b)) := by
    rw [hconj]
    congr 1
    funext b
    exact congrArg blockSym (Finset.map_eq_image s.toEmbedding (B b)).symm
  rw [hconj']
  -- ParabolicMackeyIntersectionBlocks computes the intersection on Sym(X).
  -- The factors here already lie in Perm Nat. Its registered Prop. 7.1
  -- supplier FiniteParabolicIntersectionBlocks applies to this carrier directly.

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits

private abbrev Mod (S : Type) [Group S] := ModuleCat.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
private noncomputable abbrev Res {S T : Type} [Group S] [Group T] (f : S →* T) :
    Mod.{v} T ⥤ Mod.{v} S :=
  ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom
private noncomputable abbrev Ind {S T : Type} [Group S] [Group T] (f : S →* T) :
    Mod.{v} S ⥤ Mod.{v} T :=
  (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S) ⋙
    Rep.indFunctor Complex f) ⋙ Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)

private theorem mackeyIso {U : Type} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hK : conjugate α K ≤ G) (hH : conjugate β H ≤ G)
    {J : Type}
    (classify : DoubleCoset.Quotient
      (Subgroup.comap G.subtype (conjugate α K) : Set G)
      (Subgroup.comap G.subtype (conjugate β H) : Set G) ≃ J)
    (σ : J → G)
    (hσ : ∀ R, DoubleCoset.mk (Subgroup.comap G.subtype (conjugate α K))
      (Subgroup.comap G.subtype (conjugate β H)) (σ R) = classify.symm R) :
    let L := fun R : J => conjugate α K ⊓ conjugate ((σ R : U) * β) H
    Nonempty ((Ind.{v} (forward β hH) ⋙ Res.{v} (forward α hK)) ≅
      sigmaObj (fun R : J =>
        Res.{v} (backward ((σ R : U) * β) (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_right)) ⋙
          Ind.{v} (backward α (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_left)))) := by
  intro L
  let s := σ ∘ classify
  have hs j := (hσ (classify j)).trans (classify.symm_apply_apply j)
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, ⟨iso⟩⟩ :=
    GeneralizedMackeyDecomposition.{0,v} K H G α β hK hH s hs
  let l := fun R : J => backward α (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_left)
  let m := fun R : J => backward ((σ R : U) * β) (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_right)
  let F := fun R : J => Res.{v} (m R) ⋙ Ind.{v} (l R)
  -- Theorem 2.2 uses quotient indices and typed conjugation embeddings.
  -- Identify their homomorphisms before transporting the actual coproduct.
  have hIso : Nonempty ((Ind.{v} (forward β hH) ⋙ Res.{v} (forward α hK)) ≅
      sigmaObj (fun j => F (classify j))) := by
    have hl (j) (w : ∀ t : L (classify j), α⁻¹ * (t : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K) :
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α⁻¹ w).toHom = l (classify j) := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro t
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [backward_val]
      change α⁻¹ * (t : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ = _
      rw [inv_inv]
    have hm (j) (w : ∀ t : L (classify j),
        (β⁻¹ * (s j : U)⁻¹) * (t : U) * (β⁻¹ * (s j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H) :
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β⁻¹ * (s j : U)⁻¹) w).toHom =
          m (classify j) := by
      apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro t
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [backward_val]
      change (β⁻¹ * (s j : U)⁻¹) * (t : U) * (β⁻¹ * (s j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ =
        ((s j : U) * β)⁻¹ * (t : U) * ((s j : U) * β)
      group
    simp only [hl, hm] at iso
    exact ⟨iso⟩
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := hIso
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ Sigma.whiskerEquiv classify (fun _ => Iso.refl _)⟩

private theorem conjugate_mul {U : Type} [Group U] (p q : U) (H : Subgroup U) :
    conjugate (p * q) H = conjugate p (conjugate q H) := by
  change H.map (conj (p * q)).toMonoidHom =
    (H.map (conj q).toMonoidHom).map (conj p).toMonoidHom
  rw [Subgroup.map_map]
  congr 1
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  change (p * q) * x * (p * q)⁻¹ = p * (q * x * q⁻¹) * p⁻¹
  group

private theorem conjugate_eq_of_forward {U : Type} [Group U] {S T : Subgroup U}
    (p : U) (h : conjugate p S ≤ T) (hf : ∀ x : S, (forward p h x : U) = x) :
    conjugate p S = S := by
  apply Subgroup.ext
  intro y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    change (forward p h ⟨x, hx⟩ : U) ∈ S
    rw [hf ⟨x, hx⟩]
    exact hx
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨y, hy, hf ⟨y, hy⟩⟩

private theorem inclusionIso {U : Type} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hK : conjugate α K ≤ G) (hH : conjugate β H ≤ G)
    {J : Type} (σ : J → G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, (forward α hK k : U) = k)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, (forward β hH h : U) = h) :
    let L := fun R : J => conjugate α K ⊓ conjugate ((σ R : U) * β) H
    let T := fun R : J => conjugate (σ R : U)⁻¹ (L R)
    let transport : ∀ R : J, L R →* T R := fun R =>
      MonoidHom.subgroupMap (conj (σ R : U)⁻¹).toMonoidHom (L R)
    Nonempty ((Ind.{v} (forward β hH) ⋙ Res.{v} (forward α hK)) ≅
      sigmaObj (fun R : J =>
        Res.{v} (backward ((σ R : U) * β) (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_right)) ⋙
          Ind.{v} (backward α (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_left)))) →
    ∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hHG : H ≤ G) (hLK : ∀ R : J, L R ≤ K)
      (hTH : ∀ R : J, T R ≤ H),
      Nonempty ((Ind.{v} (Subgroup.inclusion hHG) ⋙ Res.{v} (Subgroup.inclusion hKG)) ≅
        sigmaObj (fun R =>
          (Res.{v} (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R)) ⋙ Res.{v} (transport R)) ⋙
            Ind.{v} (Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R)))) := by
  rintro L T transport ⟨iso⟩
  have eqK := conjugate_eq_of_forward α hK hα
  have eqH := conjugate_eq_of_forward β hH hβ
  have hKG : K ≤ G := eqK ▸ hK
  have hHG : H ≤ G := eqH ▸ hH
  have hLK (R : J) : L R ≤ K := eqK ▸ (show L R ≤ conjugate α K from inf_le_left)
  let l := fun R : J => backward α (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_left)
  let m := fun R : J => backward ((σ R : U) * β) (show L R ≤ _ from inf_le_right)
  have hα' : forward α hK = Subgroup.inclusion hKG :=
    MonoidHom.ext fun k => Subtype.ext (hα k)
  have hβ' : forward β hH = Subgroup.inclusion hHG :=
    MonoidHom.ext fun h => Subtype.ext (hβ h)
  have hl (R : J) : l R = Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R) := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro t
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc
      (l R t : U) = α * (l R t : U) * α⁻¹ := (hα (l R t)).symm
      _ = t := by
        dsimp only [l]
        rw [backward_val]
        group
  have hm (R : J) (t : L R) : (m R t : U) = (transport R t : U) := by
    calc
      (m R t : U) = β * (m R t : U) * β⁻¹ := (hβ (m R t)).symm
      _ = (transport R t : U) := by
        dsimp only [m]
        rw [backward_val]
        change β * (((σ R : U) * β)⁻¹ * (t : U) * ((σ R : U) * β)) * β⁻¹ =
          (σ R : U)⁻¹ * (t : U) * ((σ R : U)⁻¹)⁻¹
        group
  have hTH (R : J) : T R ≤ H := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    change (transport R ⟨t, ht⟩ : U) ∈ H
    rw [← hm R ⟨t, ht⟩]
    exact (m R ⟨t, ht⟩).property
  have hfactor (R : J) : m R = (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R)).comp (transport R) :=
    MonoidHom.ext fun t => Subtype.ext (hm R t)
  -- The inclusion case factors the very same maps on the group algebra.
  -- Restriction of scalars in the resulting order uses Mathlib's comparison.
  have summand (R : J) : (Res.{v} (m R) ⋙ Ind.{v} (l R)) ≅
      (Res.{v} (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R)) ⋙ Res.{v} (transport R)) ⋙
        Ind.{v} (Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R)) := by
    rw [hl R]
    apply Functor.isoWhiskerRight
    apply ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'
    change (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (m R)).toRingHom =
      (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R))).toRingHom.comp
        (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (transport R)).toRingHom
    rw [hfactor R]
    exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
      (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom_comp (transport R) (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R)))
  change (Ind.{v} (forward β hH) ⋙ Res.{v} (forward α hK)) ≅
    sigmaObj (fun R => Res.{v} (m R) ⋙ Ind.{v} (l R)) at iso
  rw [hα', hβ'] at iso
  exact ⟨hKG, hHG, hLK, hTH, ⟨iso ≪≫ Sigma.mapIso summand⟩⟩

private def cosetCongr {G : Type} [Group G] {K H K' H' : Subgroup G}
    (hK : K = K') (hH : H = H') :
    DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G) ≃
      DoubleCoset.Quotient (K' : Set G) (H' : Set G) := by
  subst K'
  subst H'
  exact Equiv.refl _

private theorem cosetCongr_mk {G : Type} [Group G] {K H K' H' : Subgroup G}
    (hK : K = K') (hH : H = H') (s : G) :
    cosetCongr hK hH (DoubleCoset.mk K H s) = DoubleCoset.mk K' H' s := by
  subst K'
  subst H'
  rfl

end ParabolicMackeyAssembly

OrdinaryMackeyDecomposition.proof:
by
  classical
  intro G inst K H I σ reps L incLK μ Mod Res Ind F S regular regularH regularG
    rightMulH tmul targetBasis summandTmul
  -- Xiao, Theorem 2.1, p. 5 of the archived original and p. 7 of the
  -- published 28 November revision.
  -- Specialize the checked coproduct construction of Theorem 2.2 to the
  -- two inclusions. Equations (2.1) and (2.2) give the coset partition and
  -- its stabilizers, which identify the balanced pairs used for (2.3).
  have balance (i : I) (t : L i) :
      (incLK i t : G) * σ i = σ i * (μ i t : G) := by
    change (t : G) * σ i = σ i * ((σ i)⁻¹ * (t : G) * ((σ i)⁻¹)⁻¹)
    group
  have intersection (i : I) (k : K) (h : H)
      (he : (k : G) = σ i * (h : G) * (σ i)⁻¹) : ∃ t : L i, incLK i t = k := by
    exact ⟨⟨k, k.property, ⟨h, h.property, he.symm⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  have bijective := OrdinaryMackeySupport.ordinaryBijective K H incLK μ σ balance reps intersection
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := OrdinaryMackeySupport.coproduct.{u,v} K.subtype H.subtype incLK μ σ
    balance bijective
  -- Mathlib induction indexes the first tensor factor by its inverse.
  -- For the regular module the checked comparison evaluates g ⊗ x as
  -- g times the image of x, and intertwines right multiplication.
  let c := OrdinaryMackeySupport.regularComparison.{u,v} K.subtype H.subtype
  refine ⟨e, c, ?_, OrdinaryMackeySupport.regularComparison_right K.subtype H.subtype, ?_⟩
  · intro g
    change c.hom (OrdinaryMackeySupport.tmul H.subtype regularH g (ULift.up 1)) = _
    rw [OrdinaryMackeySupport.regularComparison_apply_pure]
    change ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G g *
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex H.subtype 1) = _
    rw [map_one, mul_one]
  · intro i k h
    change c.hom (e.inv.app regularH
      ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι S i).app regularH
        (OrdinaryMackeySupport.tmul (incLK i) ((Res (μ i)).obj regularH) k
          (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex H h))))) = _
    rw [he i regularH k, OrdinaryMackeySupport.regularComparison_apply_pure]
    change ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((k : G) * σ i) *
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex H.subtype (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex H h)) = _
    simp [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single]

universe u v
noncomputable section

-- The coproduct legs and their generator formula are available in the
-- implementation of the registered GeneralizedMackeyDecomposition supplier.
-- Its checked source has SHA-256
-- 044084754209ae3de60b4056dbe9a817bdf369063bb483e8ffaa6e945a2557b2.
local macro "mackey_impl%" id:ident : term => do
  let n := (Lean.Name.num `_private.Proofs.GeneralizedMackeyDecomposition 0) ++
    `GeneralizedMackeySupport ++ id.getId
  return Lean.mkIdent n

variable {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B]

abbrev Mod (A : Type u) [Group A] := ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A)
private abbrev ofMod (A : Type u) [Group A] : Mod.{u,v} A ⥤ Rep.{max u v} Complex A :=
  Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra
private abbrev toMod (A : Type u) [Group A] : Rep.{max u v} Complex A ⥤ Mod.{u,v} A :=
  Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra
abbrev indMod (f : A →* B) : Mod.{u,v} A ⥤ Mod.{u,v} B :=
  (ofMod A ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex f) ⋙ toMod B
abbrev resMod (f : A →* B) : Mod.{u,v} B ⥤ Mod.{u,v} A :=
  ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom

abbrev pure (f : A →* B) (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex A) (g : B) :=
  IndV.mk f X.ρ g⁻¹

abbrev tmul (f : A →* B) (M : Mod.{u,v} A) (b : B) (m : M) :
    (indMod f).obj M :=
  let X := (ofMod A).obj M
  (ind f X.ρ).asModuleEquiv.symm
    (pure f X b ((RestrictScalars.addEquiv Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) M).symm m))

private theorem algebra_of (f : A →* B) (a : A) :
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A a) =
      MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B (f a) := by
  simp [MonoidAlgebra.of_apply]

private theorem ofMod_act (M : Mod.{u,v} A) (a : A) (x : (ofMod A).obj M) :
    ((ofMod A).obj M).ρ a x = (show M from MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A a • (show M from x)) := by
  change ofModule M a x = _
  rw [ofModule, MonoidAlgebra.lift_symm_apply]
  rfl

private def resRepApp (f : A →* B) (M : Mod.{u,v} B) :
    Rep.res f ((ofMod B).obj M) ≅ (ofMod A).obj ((resMod f).obj M) := by
  refine Rep.mkIso (ρ := (Rep.res f ((ofMod B).obj M)).ρ)
    (σ := ((ofMod A).obj ((resMod f).obj M)).ρ) (.mk ?_ ?_)
  · refine
      { toFun := fun x => x
        invFun := fun x => x
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun _ => rfl
        map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
        map_smul' := ?_ }
    intro z x
    change (algebraMap Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex B) z) • (show M from x) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f
        (algebraMap Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) z)) • (show M from x)
    rw [AlgHom.commutes]
  · intro a
    ext x
    change ((ofMod B).obj M).ρ (f a) x =
      ((ofMod A).obj ((resMod f).obj M)).ρ a x
    have hL := ofMod_act M (f a) x
    have hR := ofMod_act ((resMod f).obj M) a x
    change _ = MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f
      (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A a) • (show M from x) at hR
    exact hL.trans ((congrArg (fun y : MonoidAlgebra Complex B => y • (show M from x))
      (algebra_of f a).symm).trans hR.symm)

private def resRep (f : A →* B) :
    (ofMod.{u,v} B ⋙ Rep.resFunctor f) ≅ (resMod.{u,v} f ⋙ ofMod.{u,v} A) :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (resRepApp f) (by
    intro X Y g
    apply Rep.hom_ext
    apply IntertwiningMap.ext
    exact LinearMap.ext (fun x => rfl))

private theorem resAct (f : A →* B) (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex B)
    (r : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) :
    (Rep.res f X).ρ.asAlgebraHom r =
      X.ρ.asAlgebraHom (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f r) := by
  let h := MonoidAlgebra.lift Complex (Module.End Complex X) A
  have he : (Rep.res f X).ρ.asAlgebraHom =
      X.ρ.asAlgebraHom.comp (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f) := by
    apply h.symm.injective
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro a
    simp only [h, MonoidAlgebra.lift_symm_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply,
      ← MonoidAlgebra.of_apply, algebra_of, asAlgebraHom_of]
    rfl
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun he r

private def resModApp (f : A →* B) (X : Rep.{max u v} Complex B) :
    (toMod A).obj (Rep.res f X) ≅ (resMod f).obj ((toMod B).obj X) := by
  let Y := (toMod A).obj (Rep.res f X)
  let Z := (resMod f).obj ((toMod B).obj X)
  refine LinearEquiv.toModuleIso (show Y ≃ₗ[MonoidAlgebra Complex A] Z from ?_)
  refine
    { toFun := fun x => x
      invFun := fun x => x
      left_inv := fun _ => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := ?_ }
  intro r x
  change (Rep.res f X).ρ.asAlgebraHom r x =
    X.ρ.asAlgebraHom (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f r) x
  rw [resAct]

private def resToMod (f : A →* B) :
    (Rep.resFunctor f ⋙ toMod.{u,v} A) ≅ (toMod.{u,v} B ⋙ resMod.{u,v} f) :=
  NatIso.ofComponents (resModApp f) (by
    intro X Y g
    ext x
    rfl)

section Coproduct
variable {K H G : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group G]
variable {J : Type u} {L : J → Type u} [∀ j, Group (L j)]
variable (a : K →* G) (b : H →* G) (l : ∀ j, L j →* K) (r : ∀ j, L j →* H)
variable (s : J → G) (balance : ∀ j t, a (l j t) * s j = s j * b (r j t))

-- The coset partition and stabilizer identification are the hypotheses of
-- the balanced-pair construction in the proof of Theorem 2.2.
-- Use repCofanIsColimit for the coproduct and inclusionAt_pure for its legs.
-- The scalar-restriction comparisons above act by identity on the carriers,
-- so the generator formula survives transport from Rep to ModuleCat.
theorem coproduct
    (bijective : Function.Bijective ((mackey_impl% toGroup) a b l r s balance)) :
    ∃ e : (indMod.{u,v} b ⋙ resMod.{u,v} a) ≅
        sigmaObj (fun j => resMod.{u,v} (r j) ⋙ indMod.{u,v} (l j)),
      ∀ (j : J) (M : Mod.{u,v} H) (k : K) (x : M),
        e.inv.app M ((Sigma.ι (fun j => resMod (r j) ⋙ indMod (l j)) j).app M
          (tmul (l j) ((resMod (r j)).obj M) k x)) =
        tmul b M (a k * s j) x := by
  let P := (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ (Rep.{max u v} Complex K)).obj (ofMod.{u,v} H)
  let Q := (Functor.whiskeringRight (Mod.{u,v} H) _ _).obj (toMod.{u,v} K)
  let c := (mackey_impl% repCofan) a b l r s balance
  have hc : IsColimit c := (mackey_impl% repCofanIsColimit) a b l r s balance bijective
  let D := (P ⋙ Q).mapCocone c
  have hD : IsColimit D := isColimitOfPreserves (P ⋙ Q) hc
  let T := fun j => resMod.{u,v} (r j) ⋙ indMod.{u,v} (l j)
  let F : Mod.{u,v} H ⥤ Mod.{u,v} K := indMod b ⋙ resMod a
  let main : D.pt ≅ F :=
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (ofMod H ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex b) (resToMod a)
  let summand : Discrete.functor (fun j => Rep.resFunctor (r j) ⋙ Rep.indFunctor Complex (l j)) ⋙
      (P ⋙ Q) ≅ Discrete.functor T :=
    Discrete.natIso fun j =>
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (resRep (r j.as)) (Rep.indFunctor Complex (l j.as) ⋙ toMod K)
  let e₀ := hD.coconePointUniqueUpToIso (colimit.isColimit _)
  let e₁ := HasColimit.isoOfNatIso summand
  let e : F ≅ sigmaObj T := main.symm ≪≫ e₀ ≪≫ e₁
  have legs (j : J) :
      Sigma.ι T j ≫ e.inv = (summand.inv.app ⟨j⟩ ≫ D.ι.app ⟨j⟩) ≫ main.hom := by
    change colimit.ι (Discrete.functor T) ⟨j⟩ ≫ (e₁.inv ≫ e₀.inv ≫ main.hom) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, HasColimit.ι_isoOfNatIso_inv, Category.assoc,
      ← Category.assoc (colimit.ι _ _) e₀.inv,
      colimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_inv hD, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  intro j M k x
  have h := congrArg (fun f : T j ⟶ F =>
    f.app M (tmul (l j) ((resMod (r j)).obj M) k x)) (legs j)
  exact h.trans ((mackey_impl% inclusionAt_pure) a b l r s balance j ((ofMod H).obj M) k x)

end Coproduct

section Regular

abbrev regular (A : Type u) [Group A] : Mod.{u,v} A :=
  ModuleCat.of (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (ULift.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A))

abbrev rightMul (x : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) : regular.{u,v} A ⟶ regular.{u,v} A :=
  (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{v,u} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A)).map
    (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulRight (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) x))

private abbrev regRep (A : Type u) [Group A] := (ofMod A).obj (regular.{u,v} A)

private def regDown : regRep.{u,v} A ≃ₗ[Complex] MonoidAlgebra Complex A :=
  { toFun := ULift.down
    invFun := ULift.up
    left_inv := fun _ => rfl
    right_inv := fun _ => rfl
    map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
    map_smul' := fun z x => Algebra.smul_def z x.down |>.symm }

private def regBasis (A : Type u) [Group A] : Module.Basis A Complex (regRep.{u,v} A) :=
  (MonoidAlgebra.basis A Complex).map regDown.symm

private theorem regBasis_apply (a : A) :
    regBasis.{u,v} A a = ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A a) := rfl

private theorem reg_act (a : A) (x : regRep.{u,v} A) :
    (regRep.{u,v} A).ρ a x = ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A a * x.down) :=
  ofMod_act (regular A) a x

private abbrev alg (b : A →* B) := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex b

private def regProduct (b : A →* B) (g : B) :
    regRep.{u,v} A →ₗ[Complex] regRep.{u,v} B :=
  regDown.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
    LinearMap.mulLeft Complex (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g) ∘ₗ
      (alg b).toLinearMap ∘ₗ regDown.toLinearMap

private theorem regProduct_apply (b : A →* B) (g : B) (x : regRep.{u,v} A) :
    regProduct b g x = ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b x.down) := rfl

private theorem regProduct_balance (b : A →* B) (g : B) (h : A) (x : regRep.{u,v} A) :
    regProduct b (g * b h) x = regProduct b g ((regRep A).ρ h x) := by
  rw [regProduct_apply, regProduct_apply]
  erw [reg_act]
  change ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B (g * b h) * alg b x.down) =
    ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A h * x.down))
  simp only [map_mul, alg, algebra_of, mul_assoc]

private def regForward (b : A →* B) :
    IndV b (regRep.{u,v} A).ρ →ₗ[Complex] regRep.{u,v} B :=
  (mackey_impl% liftPure) b (regRep A) (regProduct b) (regProduct_balance b)

private theorem regForward_pure (b : A →* B) (g : B) (x : regRep.{u,v} A) :
    regForward b (pure b (regRep A) g x) =
      ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b x.down) :=
  (mackey_impl% liftPure_apply) b (regRep A) (regProduct b) (regProduct_balance b) g x

private def regBackward (b : A →* B) :
    regRep.{u,v} B →ₗ[Complex] IndV b (regRep.{u,v} A).ρ :=
  (regBasis B).constr Complex
    (fun g => pure b (regRep A) g (ULift.up (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex A)))

private theorem regBackward_basis (b : A →* B) (g : B) :
    regBackward b (regBasis.{u,v} B g) =
      pure b (regRep A) g (ULift.up (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex A)) := by
  exact Module.Basis.constr_basis _ _ _ _

private def regIso (b : A →* B) : Rep.ind b (regRep.{u,v} A) ≅ regRep.{u,v} B := by
  refine Rep.mkIso (ρ := (Rep.ind b (regRep A)).ρ) (σ := (regRep B).ρ)
    (.mk { regForward b with invFun := regBackward b, left_inv := ?_, right_inv := ?_ } ?_)
  · have h : regBackward b ∘ₗ regForward b = LinearMap.id := by
      apply (mackey_impl% pure_ext) b (regRep A)
      intro g
      have hx : (regBackward b ∘ₗ regForward b) ∘ₗ pure b (regRep A) g =
          pure b (regRep A) g := by
        apply (regBasis A).ext
        intro h
        change regBackward b (regForward b (pure b (regRep A) g (regBasis A h))) = _
        rw [regForward_pure, regBasis_apply]
        change regBackward b (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g *
          alg b (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A h))) = _
        rw [alg, algebra_of, ← map_mul, ← regBasis_apply, regBackward_basis]
        erw [(mackey_impl% pure_balance), reg_act]
        change pure b (regRep A) g (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A h * 1)) =
          pure b (regRep A) g (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex A h))
        rw [mul_one]
      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hx
    exact fun x => DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  · have h : regForward b ∘ₗ regBackward b = LinearMap.id := by
      apply (regBasis B).ext
      intro g
      change regForward b (regBackward b (regBasis B g)) = regBasis B g
      rw [regBackward_basis]
      erw [regForward_pure, regBasis_apply]
      change ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b 1) = _
      rw [map_one, mul_one]
    exact fun x => DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  · intro t
    apply (mackey_impl% pure_ext) b (regRep A)
    intro g x
    change regForward b (ind b (regRep A).ρ t (pure b (regRep A) g x)) =
      (regRep B).ρ t (regForward b (pure b (regRep A) g x))
    rw [(mackey_impl% pure_act), regForward_pure]
    rw [reg_act]
    erw [regForward_pure]
    change ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B (t * g) * alg b x.down) =
      ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B t * (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b x.down))
    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]

variable {K : Type u} [Group K]

def regularComparison (a : K →* B) (b : A →* B) :
    (indMod.{u,v} b ⋙ resMod.{u,v} a).obj (regular A) ≅ (resMod a).obj (regular B) :=
  (resMod a).mapIso ((toMod B).mapIso (regIso b) ≪≫ Rep.counitIso (regular B))

theorem regularComparison_apply_pure (a : K →* B) (b : A →* B) (g : B) (x : regular.{u,v} A) :
    (regularComparison a b).hom (tmul b (regular A) g x) =
      ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b x.down) :=
  regForward_pure b g x

theorem regularComparison_right (a : K →* B) (b : A →* B)
    (y : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (x : (indMod.{u,v} b ⋙ resMod.{u,v} a).obj (regular A)) :
    (regularComparison a b).hom (((indMod b ⋙ resMod a).map (rightMul y)) x) =
      ULift.up (((regularComparison a b).hom x).down * alg b y) := by
  let f := (ofMod A).map (rightMul.{u,v} y)
  have h : regForward b ∘ₗ (Rep.indMap b f).hom.toLinearMap =
      (regDown.symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.mulRight Complex (alg b y) ∘ₗ
        regDown.toLinearMap) ∘ₗ regForward b := by
    apply (mackey_impl% pure_ext) b (regRep A)
    intro g z
    change regForward b ((Rep.indMap b f).hom (pure b (regRep A) g z)) =
      ULift.up ((regForward b (pure b (regRep A) g z)).down * alg b y)
    rw [(mackey_impl% pure_map), regForward_pure, regForward_pure]
    change ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b (z.down * y)) =
      ULift.up ((MonoidAlgebra.of Complex B g * alg b z.down) * alg b y)
    rw [map_mul, mul_assoc]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

end Regular

section Subgroups

variable {G : Type u} [Group G] (K H : Subgroup G)
variable {L : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G) → Type u} [∀ j, Group (L j)]
variable (l : ∀ j, L j →* K) (r : ∀ j, L j →* H)
variable (s : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G) → G)
variable (balance : ∀ j t, (l j t : G) * s j = s j * (r j t : G))

-- The ordinary multiplication map lands directly in G. In this inclusion
-- case the intersection witness identifies equal products as balanced pairs.
theorem ordinaryBijective (reps : ∀ j, DoubleCoset.mk K H (s j) = j)
    (intersection : ∀ j (k : K) (h : H), (k : G) = s j * (h : G) * (s j)⁻¹ →
      ∃ t, l j t = k) :
    Function.Bijective ((mackey_impl% toGroup) K.subtype H.subtype l r s balance) := by
  let f := (mackey_impl% toGroup) K.subtype H.subtype l r s balance
  have index_mul (j) (k : K) (h : H) :
      DoubleCoset.mk K H ((k : G) * s j * (h : G)) = j := by
    have hcoset : DoubleCoset.mk K H (s j) = DoubleCoset.mk K H ((k : G) * s j * (h : G)) :=
      DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨(k : G), k.property, (h : G), h.property, rfl⟩
    exact hcoset.symm.trans (reps j)
  have index (j) (q : Quotient ((mackey_impl% summandBasis) l r j)) :
      DoubleCoset.mk K H (f ⟨j, q⟩) = j :=
    Quotient.inductionOn q fun p => index_mul j p.1 p.2
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, x⟩ ⟨j, y⟩ he
    have hij : i = j := (index i x).symm.trans ((congrArg (DoubleCoset.mk K H) he).trans (index j y))
    subst j
    apply congrArg (Sigma.mk i)
    revert he
    refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y (fun p q he => ?_)
    change (p.1 : G) * s i * (p.2 : G) = (q.1 : G) * s i * (q.2 : G) at he
    have hs : (↑(q.1⁻¹ * p.1) : G) = s i * (↑(q.2 * p.2⁻¹) : G) * (s i)⁻¹ := by
      change (q.1 : G)⁻¹ * (p.1 : G) = s i * ((q.2 : G) * (p.2 : G)⁻¹) * (s i)⁻¹
      have hh := congrArg (fun z : G => (q.1 : G)⁻¹ * z * (p.2 : G)⁻¹ * (s i)⁻¹) he
      convert hh using 1 <;> group
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := intersection i (q.1⁻¹ * p.1) (q.2 * p.2⁻¹) hs
    have hr : r i t = q.2 * p.2⁻¹ := by
      have h := balance i t
      rw [ht, hs, inv_mul_cancel_right] at h
      exact Subtype.ext (mul_left_cancel h.symm)
    apply Quotient.sound
    change ∃ t : L i, p.1 * (l i t)⁻¹ = q.1 ∧ r i t * p.2 = q.2
    exact ⟨t, by rw [ht]; group, by rw [hr]; group⟩
  · intro g
    let j := DoubleCoset.mk K H g
    obtain ⟨k, hk, h, hh, he⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp (reps j)
    exact ⟨⟨j, Quotient.mk _ (⟨k, hk⟩, ⟨h, hh⟩)⟩, he.symm⟩

end Subgroups

end

namespace CaseOneExample
open MackeyDiagrams

abbrev N := Fin 2 → Multiplicative Int

def swaps : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* MulAut N :=
  { toFun := fun σ =>
      { toFun := fun x i => x (Equiv.symm σ i)
        invFun := fun x i => x (σ i)
        left_inv := fun x => funext fun i => congrArg x (Equiv.symm_apply_apply σ i)
        right_inv := fun x => funext fun i => congrArg x (Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i)
        map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    map_one' := rfl
    map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }

abbrev U := SemidirectProduct N (Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) swaps
abbrev base : N →* U := SemidirectProduct.inl
abbrev permutations : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* U := SemidirectProduct.inr
abbrev G := MonoidHom.range base
abbrev C := Subgroup.map base (MonoidHom.ker (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun _ : Fin 2 => Multiplicative Int) 1))
abbrev D := MonoidHom.range permutations

theorem C_le_G : C ≤ G := Subgroup.map_le_range _ _

theorem card_D : Nat.card D = 2 := by
  change Nat.card ↑(Set.range permutations) = 2
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofInjective permutations SemidirectProduct.inr_injective),
    Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  rfl

theorem join_top : C ⊔ D = ⊤ := by
  classical
  apply top_unique
  intro u _
  let τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) := Equiv.swap 0 1
  have hτ : permutations τ ∈ C ⊔ D := (le_sup_right : D ≤ C ⊔ D) ⟨τ, rfl⟩
  let x : N := fun i => if i = 0 then u.left 0 else 1
  let y : N := fun i => if i = 0 then u.left 1 else 1
  have hx : base x ∈ C ⊔ D := (le_sup_left : C ≤ C ⊔ D) ⟨x, by simp [x], rfl⟩
  have hy : base y ∈ C ⊔ D := (le_sup_left : C ≤ C ⊔ D) ⟨y, by simp [y], rfl⟩
  have hz : base (swaps τ y) ∈ C ⊔ D := by
    rw [SemidirectProduct.inl_aut]
    exact (C ⊔ D).mul_mem ((C ⊔ D).mul_mem hτ hy) ((C ⊔ D).inv_mem hτ)
  have hprod : x * swaps τ y = u.left := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · change u.left 0 * 1 = u.left 0
      rw [mul_one]
    · change 1 * u.left 1 = u.left 1
      rw [one_mul]
  rw [← SemidirectProduct.inl_left_mul_inr_right u, ← hprod, map_mul]
  exact (C ⊔ D).mul_mem ((C ⊔ D).mul_mem hx hz) ((le_sup_right : D ≤ C ⊔ D) ⟨_, rfl⟩)

theorem infinite_index : ¬ (C.subgroupOf G).FiniteIndex := by
  let second : G →* Multiplicative Int :=
    (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun _ : Fin 2 => Multiplicative Int) 1).comp
      { toFun := fun g => g.1.left
        map_one' := rfl
        map_mul' := by
          rintro ⟨g, n, rfl⟩ ⟨h, m, rfl⟩
          change (base n * base m).left = n * m
          rw [← map_mul]
          rfl }
  have hker : second.ker = C.subgroupOf G := by
    ext g
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := g.2
    have hg : g.1.left = n := by rw [← hn]; rfl
    change g.1.left 1 = 1 ↔ g.1 ∈ C
    rw [hg]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨n, h, hn⟩
    · rintro ⟨m, hm, hmg⟩
      rwa [← SemidirectProduct.inl_injective (hmg.trans hn.symm)]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective second := by
    intro z
    exact ⟨⟨base (fun _ => z), ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← hker]
  intro h
  let _ : Finite (Multiplicative Int) :=
    Finite.of_equiv (G ⧸ second.ker)
      (QuotientGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective second hsurj).toEquiv
  let _ : Finite Int := Finite.of_equiv (Multiplicative Int) Multiplicative.toAdd
  exact not_finite Int

theorem product_injective : Function.Injective (fun gh : G × D => (gh.1 : U) * (gh.2 : U)) := by
  rintro ⟨g, h⟩ ⟨g', h'⟩ heq
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := g.2
  obtain ⟨n', hn'⟩ := g'.2
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h.2
  obtain ⟨σ', hσ'⟩ := h'.2
  change (g : U) * (h : U) = (g' : U) * (h' : U) at heq
  rw [← hn, ← hn', ← hσ, ← hσ'] at heq
  rw [← SemidirectProduct.mk_eq_inl_mul_inr, ← SemidirectProduct.mk_eq_inl_mul_inr] at heq
  have h₁ := congrArg SemidirectProduct.left heq
  have h₂ := congrArg SemidirectProduct.right heq
  change n = n' at h₁
  change σ = σ' at h₂
  subst n' σ'
  exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (hn.symm.trans hn')) (Subtype.ext (hσ.symm.trans hσ'))

private theorem perm_fix_zero (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (h : σ 0 = 0) : σ = 1 := by
  have h₁ : σ 1 = 1 := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ (σ 1) with hh | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · have he : (1 : Fin 2) = 0 := σ.injective (hh.trans h.symm)
      exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0) he |> False.elim
    · have hi' : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hi, hi']
      rfl
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact h
  · exact h₁

private theorem perm_not_one (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (h : σ ≠ 1) :
    σ = Equiv.swap 0 1 := by
  have h₀ : σ 0 = 1 := by
    have hne : σ 0 ≠ 0 := fun h₀ => h (perm_fix_zero σ h₀)
    omega
  have h₁ : σ 1 = 0 := by
    have hne : σ 1 ≠ 1 := fun h₁ => (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)
      (σ.injective (h₁.trans h₀.symm))
    omega
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact h₀
  · exact h₁

private theorem subgroup_of_line_and_swap (J : Subgroup U) (hC : C ≤ J)
    (q : U) (hq : q ∈ J) (hqr : q.right ≠ 1) : J = ⊤ := by
  classical
  let τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) := Equiv.swap 0 1
  have hright : q.right = τ := perm_not_one q.right hqr
  have hall (u : N) : base u ∈ J := by
    let x : N := fun i => if i = 0 then u 0 else 1
    let y : N := fun i => if i = 0 then u 1 else 1
    have hx : base x ∈ J := hC ⟨x, by simp [x], rfl⟩
    have hy : base y ∈ J := hC ⟨y, by simp [y], rfl⟩
    have hz : base (swaps τ y) ∈ J := by
      have he : q * base y * q⁻¹ = base (swaps τ y) := by
        have hsplit : q = base q.left * permutations τ := by
          simpa only [hright] using (SemidirectProduct.inl_left_mul_inr_right q).symm
        calc
          q * base y * q⁻¹ =
              base q.left * (permutations τ * base y * (permutations τ)⁻¹) * (base q.left)⁻¹ := by
            conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
            group
          _ = base (swaps τ y) := by
            rw [← map_inv, ← SemidirectProduct.inl_aut, ← map_inv, ← map_mul, ← map_mul]
            rw [mul_comm q.left, mul_inv_cancel_right]
      rw [← he]
      exact J.mul_mem (J.mul_mem hq hy) (J.inv_mem hq)
    have he : x * swaps τ y = u := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · change u 0 * 1 = u 0
        rw [mul_one]
      · change 1 * u 1 = u 1
        rw [one_mul]
    rw [← he, map_mul]
    exact J.mul_mem hx hz
  have hswap : permutations τ ∈ J := by
    have hm := J.mul_mem (J.inv_mem (hall q.left)) hq
    have he : (base q.left)⁻¹ * q = permutations τ := by
      apply (inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul).mpr
      simpa only [hright] using (SemidirectProduct.inl_left_mul_inr_right q).symm
    rwa [he] at hm
  apply top_unique
  intro u _
  rw [← SemidirectProduct.inl_left_mul_inr_right u]
  apply J.mul_mem (hall u.left)
  by_cases h : u.right = 1
  · rw [h, map_one]
    exact J.one_mem
  · rw [perm_not_one u.right h]
    exact hswap

theorem conjugate_join_top (p : U) :
    C ⊔ D.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom = ⊤ := by
  let τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) := Equiv.swap 0 1
  let q := (MulAut.conj p) (permutations τ)
  apply subgroup_of_line_and_swap _ le_sup_left q
  · have hq : q ∈ D.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom :=
      ⟨permutations τ, ⟨τ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact (le_sup_right : D.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom ≤ _) hq
  · change (p * permutations τ * p⁻¹).right ≠ 1
    simp only [SemidirectProduct.mul_right, SemidirectProduct.inv_right, SemidirectProduct.right_inr]
    intro h
    apply (by decide : Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1 ≠ 1)
    calc
      τ = p.right⁻¹ * (p.right * τ * p.right⁻¹) * p.right := by group
      _ = 1 := by rw [h]; simp

def incl {H K : Subgroup V} (h : H ≤ K) : ConjEmbedding H K :=
  ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩

theorem range_incl {H K : Subgroup V} (h : H ≤ K) :
    (incl h).toHom.range = H.subgroupOf K := Subgroup.inclusion_range h

theorem range_bot {K : Subgroup V} :
    (incl (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup V) ≤ K)).toHom.range = ⊥ := by
  rw [range_incl, Subgroup.bot_subgroupOf]

theorem comp_incl {H K L : Subgroup V} (h : H ≤ K) (k : K ≤ L) :
    (incl k).comp (incl h) = incl (h.trans k) := by
  apply ConjEmbedding.ext
  ext x
  rfl

theorem comp_id_incl {H K : Subgroup V} (h : H ≤ K) :
    (incl h).comp (ConjEmbedding.id H) = incl h := by
  apply ConjEmbedding.ext
  ext x
  rfl

abbrev A : Subgroup U := ⊤
abbrev E : Subgroup U := ⊥
abbrev a := incl (le_top : G ≤ A)
abbrev b := incl (le_top : D ≤ A)
abbrev c := ConjEmbedding.id D
abbrev d := incl C_le_G
abbrev e := incl (bot_le : E ≤ C)
abbrev f := incl (bot_le : E ≤ D)
abbrev r := incl (bot_le : E ≤ G)
abbrev s := incl (bot_le : E ≤ D)
abbrev t := ConjEmbedding.id E

theorem cup_index : s.toHom.range.index = 2 ∧ f.toHom.range.index = 2 := by
  rw [range_bot, Subgroup.index_bot, card_D]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem top_join :
    (a.comp d).toHom.range ⊔ (b.comp c).toHom.range = ⊤ := by
  rw [comp_incl, comp_id_incl, range_incl, range_incl,
    ← Subgroup.subgroupOf_sup (le_top : C ≤ A) (le_top : D ≤ A),
    join_top, Subgroup.subgroupOf_self]

theorem formula_relIndex :
    (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex (a.toHom.range ⊓ ((a.comp d).toHom.range ⊔
      (b.comp c).toHom.range)) = C.relIndex G := by
  rw [top_join, inf_top_eq, comp_incl, range_incl, range_incl,
    ← Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ A.subtype_injective,
    Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le (le_top : C ≤ A),
    Subgroup.map_subgroupOf_eq_of_le (le_top : G ≤ A)]

theorem not_finite_formula :
    ¬ ((a.comp d).toHom.range.subgroupOf (a.toHom.range ⊓ ((a.comp d).toHom.range ⊔
      (b.comp c).toHom.range))).FiniteIndex := by
  rw [Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff]
  change ¬ (a.comp d).toHom.range.relIndex _ ≠ 0
  rw [formula_relIndex]
  exact fun h => infinite_index (Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mpr h)

variable {K H P L : Subgroup V}
variable (α : ConjEmbedding K P) (β : ConjEmbedding H P)
variable (η : ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : ConjEmbedding L H)

def unitDot [Subsingleton L] {P : Subgroup V} (x y : ConjEmbedding L P) : Dot x y :=
  ⟨1, fun l => by rw [Subsingleton.elim l 1, map_one, map_one]⟩

theorem mixed_injective [Subsingleton L]
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun z : K × H => α.toHom z.1 * β.toHom z.2) :
    Function.Injective (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ
      (unitDot (α.comp η) (β.comp θ))) := by
  intro x y
  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y (fun p q hpq => ?_)
  have he := congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct α β) hpq
  change Generator.mixedProduct α β (Generator.mixedPair α β (α.toHom p.1 * 1 * β.toHom p.2)) =
    Generator.mixedProduct α β (Generator.mixedPair α β (α.toHom q.1 * 1 * β.toHom q.2)) at he
  simp only [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair, mul_one] at he
  rw [hinj he]

def unitProjection [Subsingleton L]
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun z : K × H => α.toHom z.1 * β.toHom z.2) :
    ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ where
  dot := unitDot (α.comp η) (β.comp θ)
  finite y := (Set.finite_singleton y).preimage (mixed_injective α β η θ hinj).injOn

theorem unitProjection_column [Subsingleton L]
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun z : K × H => α.toHom z.1 * β.toHom z.2)
    (k : K) (h : H) :
    let p := unitProjection α β η θ hinj
    let y := (Biset.induction η).pair (Biset.restriction θ) k h
    let x := Generator.mixedPair α β (α.toHom k * β.toHom h)
    (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β η θ p.dot p.finite).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single x 1) = Finsupp.single y 1 := by
  classical
  intro p y x
  change (Biset.Hom.transfer Complex (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ p.dot)
    (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant α β η θ p.dot) p.finite).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single x 1) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul]
  ext w
  rw [Biset.Hom.transferBasis_apply]
  have hy : Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ p.dot y = x := by
    change Generator.mixedPair α β (α.toHom k * 1 * β.toHom h) = x
    rw [mul_one]
  by_cases hw : w = y
  · subst w
    rw [hy, ite_eq_left rfl, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hw, ite_eq_right]
    exact fun he => hw (mixed_injective α β η θ hinj (he.trans hy.symm))

end Units

private theorem product_inclusion_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun gh : G × D => a.toHom gh.1 * b.toHom gh.2) := by
  intro gh gh' he
  exact product_injective (congrArg Subtype.val he)

private theorem product_trivial_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun gh : E × D => s.toHom gh.1 * c.toHom gh.2) := by
  intro gh gh' he
  have h₁ : gh.1 = gh'.1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have h₂ : gh'.1 = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change s.toHom gh.1 * c.toHom gh.2 = s.toHom gh'.1 * c.toHom gh'.2 at he
  rw [h₁, h₂, map_one, one_mul, one_mul] at he
  exact Prod.ext h₁ (c.injective he)

theorem left_eval :
  let G := CaseOneExample.G
  let C := CaseOneExample.C
  let D := CaseOneExample.D
  let hCG := C_le_G
  let A : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U := ⊤
  let F : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U := D
  let B : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U := ⊥
  let E : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U := B
  let inclusion := fun {H K : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
    (⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
  let a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A := inclusion le_top
  let b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A := inclusion le_top
  let c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id D
  let d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G := inclusion hCG
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C := inclusion bot_le
  let f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F := inclusion bot_le
  let r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G := inclusion bot_le
  let s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D := inclusion bot_le
  let t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id B
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let _hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
      (drawId (down f))
  let mergedEval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup CaseOneExample.U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
  let left := fun (x : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s)
      (y : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f)
      (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s [(1, x)]) (drawId (up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f [(1, y)]))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e [(1, z)]) (drawId (down f))))
  mergedEval (left leftX leftY leftZ) =
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f [(1, leftP)]).interpret.eval.toLinearMap := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  apply Eq.trans _ (singletonMixed a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f leftP).symm
  have he : leftDotFormula a b c d e f leftX leftY leftZ = leftP.dot := by
    apply Dot.ext
    change a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹ * (1 : A) * b.toHom (1 : D) = 1

  apply LinearMap.ext

  refine Quotient.inductionOn output (fun ⟨g,h⟩ => ?_)

  have hright := pullsMixed a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f leftP ((Biset.induction (d.comp e)).pair (Biset.restriction f) g h)

private theorem range_coe_conj {H K : Subgroup U} (h : ConjEmbedding H K) :
    ∃ x : U, h.toHom.range.map K.subtype = H.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.hasRepresentative
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨g, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g, g.2, (hx g).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨h.toHom ⟨g, hg⟩, ⟨_, rfl⟩, hx ⟨g, hg⟩⟩

private theorem map_conj_mul (H : Subgroup U) (x y : U) :
    (H.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom =
      H.map (MulAut.conj (x * y)).toMonoidHom := by
  rw [Subgroup.map_map]
  apply congrArg (fun f : U →* U => H.map f)
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro z
  change x * (y * z * y⁻¹) * x⁻¹ = (x * y) * z * (x * y)⁻¹
  group

theorem middle_group_eq_top {J : Subgroup U} (v : ConjEmbedding C J)
    (w : ConjEmbedding D J) : J = ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := range_coe_conj v
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := range_coe_conj w
  let xinv := (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).toMonoidHom
  have hC : C ≤ J.map xinv := by
    have hle := Subgroup.map_mono (f := xinv)
      (show (v.toHom.range.map J.subtype) ≤ J by
        rintro _ ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
        exact z.2)
    rw [hx] at hle
    change (C.map (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).toMonoidHom ≤ _ at hle
    rw [map_conj_mul, inv_mul_cancel, map_one] at hle
    change C.map (MonoidHom.id U) ≤ _ at hle
    rwa [Subgroup.map_id] at hle
  have hD : D.map (MulAut.conj (x⁻¹ * y)).toMonoidHom ≤ J.map xinv := by
    have hle := Subgroup.map_mono (f := xinv)
      (show (w.toHom.range.map J.subtype) ≤ J by
        rintro _ ⟨z, _, rfl⟩
        exact z.2)
    rw [hy] at hle
    change (D.map (MulAut.conj y).toMonoidHom).map (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).toMonoidHom ≤ _ at hle
    rwa [map_conj_mul] at hle
  have ht := sup_le hC hD
  rw [conjugate_join_top] at ht
  apply (Subgroup.map_injective (f := xinv) (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).injective)
  rw [Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective (f := xinv) (MulAut.conj x⁻¹).surjective]
  exact top_unique ht

private theorem G_normal : G.Normal := by
  change (SemidirectProduct.inl (φ := swaps)).range.Normal
  rw [SemidirectProduct.range_inl_eq_ker_rightHom]
  infer_instance

private theorem conj_range_index {P : Subgroup U} (α : ConjEmbedding G P)
    (η : ConjEmbedding C G) :
    (α.comp η).toHom.range.relIndex α.toHom.range = C.relIndex G := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := range_coe_conj (α.comp η)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := range_coe_conj α
  let _ : G.Normal := G_normal
  have hnormal (z : U) : G.map (MulAut.conj z).toMonoidHom = G :=
    Subgroup.Normal.map_conj_eq G z
  rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective _ _ P.subtype_injective, hx, hy, hnormal y]
  let φ := (MulAut.conj x).toMonoidHom
  calc
    (C.map φ).relIndex G = (C.map φ).relIndex (G.map φ) :=
      congrArg ((C.map φ).relIndex) (hnormal x).symm
    _ = C.relIndex G := Subgroup.relIndex_map_map_of_injective (f := φ) _ _ (MulAut.conj x).injective

private theorem top_src_range {P J : Subgroup U} (hJ : J = ⊤)
    (β : ConjEmbedding J P) : β.toHom.range = ⊤ := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := β.hasRepresentative
  apply MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr
  intro u
  refine ⟨⟨z⁻¹ * u * z, hJ.symm ▸ trivial⟩, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  rw [hz]
  group

-- The middle crossing alone is impossible once the spectator up-strand
-- gives an embedding of F = D into the middle crossing's other lower group.
theorem middle_projection_empty {P J : Subgroup U} (α : ConjEmbedding G P)
    (β : ConjEmbedding J P) (η : ConjEmbedding C G) (θ : ConjEmbedding C J)
    (w : ConjEmbedding D J) (m : ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ) : False := by
  have hfinite := ((EvaluationForTwoProjections α β (ConjEmbedding.id J)
    (ConjEmbedding.id G) η θ).1 m.dot).2.1.mp m.finite
  have hrange := top_src_range (middle_group_eq_top θ w) β
  rw [Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff] at hfinite
  change (α.comp η).toHom.range.relIndex
    (α.toHom.range ⊓ β.toHom.range.map (MulAut.conj m.dot.element).toMonoidHom) ≠ 0 at hfinite
  rw [hrange, Subgroup.map_top_of_surjective _ (MulAut.conj m.dot.element).surjective,
    inf_top_eq, conj_range_index] at hfinite
  exact infinite_index (Subgroup.finiteIndex_iff.mpr hfinite)

theorem boundary_zero_iff (d : ScopedDiagram R p q) :
    d.atBoundary.eval.toLinearMap = 0 ↔ d.eval.toLinearMap = 0 := by
  let Z := ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.zero (R := R) p q)
  have hz : Z.atBoundary.eval.toLinearMap = 0 := by
    change (q.reorderToBoundary (R := R)).eval.toLinearMap.comp
      ((0 : (p.basis.carrier →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (q.basis.carrier →₀ R)).comp
        (p.reorderFromBoundary (R := R)).eval.toLinearMap) = 0
    simp
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he : d.atBoundary.eval = Z.atBoundary.eval :=
      Biset.Hom.ext (h.trans hz.symm)
    exact congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap ((ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff d Z).mp he)
  · intro h
    have he : d.eval = Z.eval := Biset.Hom.ext h
    exact (congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap ((ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff d Z).mpr he)).trans hz

theorem no_sum_zero {I M : Type*} [AddMonoid M] (v : I → M)
    (h : ∀ i, v i = 0) {target : M} (hne : target ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ ds : List I, (ds.map v).sum = target := by
  rintro ⟨ds, he⟩
  have hsum : (ds.map v).sum = 0 := by induction ds <;> simp_all
  exact hne (he.symm.trans hsum)

theorem frame_zero {V : Type*} [Group V] {K H : Subgroup V}

    (after : LabelledDrawing Complex r s)

  change after.interpret.eval.toLinearMap.comp
    (middle.interpret.eval.toLinearMap.comp before.interpret.eval.toLinearMap) = 0
