namespace TwoMackeySummandsAux

private abbrev P := Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)
private abbrev C := Multiplicative (ZMod 2)
private abbrev U := P × C
private abbrev a : P := Equiv.swap 0 1
private abbrev b : P := Equiv.swap 0 2
private abbrev K : Subgroup U := (Subgroup.zpowers a).prod ⊤
private abbrev L : Subgroup U := (⊥ : Subgroup P).prod ⊤
private abbrev s : U := (b, 1)

-- Enumerate only the six permutations by kernel reduction on Fin 3.
private theorem perm_cases (p : P) :
    p = 1 ∨ p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = a * b ∨ p = b * a ∨ p = a * b * a :=
  (by decide : ∀ p : P,
    p = 1 ∨ p = a ∨ p = b ∨ p = a * b ∨ p = b * a ∨ p = a * b * a) p

private theorem a_order : orderOf a = 2 := by
  apply orderOf_eq_prime
  · rw [pow_two, Equiv.swap_mul_self]
  · decide

private theorem mem_cyclic (p : P) : p ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a ↔ p = 1 ∨ p = a := by
  rw [mem_zpowers_iff_mem_range_orderOf, a_order]
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    have h : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by omega
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨0, by decide, pow_zero _⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by decide, pow_one _⟩

private theorem cosets_ne : DoubleCoset.mk K K (1 : U) ≠ DoubleCoset.mk K K s := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, he⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp h
  have hs : s ∈ K := by rw [he, mul_one]; exact K.mul_mem hx hy
  have hp := (mem_cyclic b).mp hs.1
  exact (by decide : ¬ (b = 1 ∨ b = a)) hp

private theorem cosets_all (j : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set U) (K : Set U)) :
    j = DoubleCoset.mk K K (1 : U) ∨ j = DoubleCoset.mk K K s := by
  induction j using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | h g =>
    change DoubleCoset.mk K K g = DoubleCoset.mk K K 1 ∨
      DoubleCoset.mk K K g = DoubleCoset.mk K K s
    have km (x : P) (hx : x = 1 ∨ x = a) (z : C) : (x,z) ∈ K :=
      ⟨(mem_cyclic x).mpr hx, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
    have left (x : P) (hx : x = 1 ∨ x = a) (e : g.1 = x) :
        DoubleCoset.mk K K g = DoubleCoset.mk K K 1 := by
      symm
      apply DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
      refine ⟨(x,g.2), km x hx _, 1, K.one_mem, ?_⟩
      rw [mul_one, mul_one]
      exact Prod.ext e rfl
    have right (x y : P) (hx : x = 1 ∨ x = a) (hy : y = 1 ∨ y = a)
        (e : g.1 = x * b * y) : DoubleCoset.mk K K g = DoubleCoset.mk K K s := by
      symm
      apply DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
      exact ⟨(x,g.2), km x hx _, (y,1), km y hy _,
        Prod.ext e (by change g.2 = g.2 * 1 * 1; simp)⟩
    rcases perm_cases g.1 with h | h | h | h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl (left 1 (Or.inl rfl) h)
    · exact Or.inl (left a (Or.inr rfl) h)
    · exact Or.inr (right 1 1 (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inl rfl) (by simpa using h))
    · exact Or.inr (right a 1 (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inl rfl) (by simpa using h))
    · exact Or.inr (right 1 a (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inr rfl) (by simpa using h))
    · exact Or.inr (right a a (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inr rfl) h)

private theorem conjugate_one {V : Type*} [Group V] (S : Subgroup V) :
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (1 : V))) S = S := by
  have h : MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (1 : V)) = MonoidHom.id V := by
    ext x
    change (1 : V) * x * 1⁻¹ = x
    simp
  rw [h, Subgroup.map_id]

private theorem intersection_s :
    K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) K = L := by
  ext x
  change (x ∈ K ∧ x ∈ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) K) ↔ x ∈ L
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hm⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := Subgroup.mem_map.mp hm
    have he' : b * y.1 * b⁻¹ = x.1 := congrArg Prod.fst he
    refine ⟨Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr ?_, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
    rcases (mem_cyclic x.1).mp hx.1 with h | h
    · exact h
    · rcases (mem_cyclic y.1).mp hy.1 with h' | h'
      · exact False.elim ((by decide : b * 1 * b⁻¹ ≠ a) ((h' ▸ he').trans h))
      · exact False.elim ((by decide : b * a * b⁻¹ ≠ a) ((h' ▸ he').trans h))
  · intro hx
    have hx' : x.1 = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp hx.1
    have hk : x ∈ K := ⟨(mem_cyclic _).mpr (Or.inl hx'), Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
    refine ⟨hk, Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hk, Prod.ext ?_ ?_⟩⟩
    · change b * x.1 * b⁻¹ = x.1
      simp [hx']
    · change (1 : C) * x.2 * 1⁻¹ = x.2
      simp

-- The product decomposition gives subgroup cardinalities 4 and 2.
private theorem index_K : L.relIndex K = 2 := by
  have hk : Nat.card K = 4 := by
    change Nat.card ((Subgroup.zpowers a).prod (⊤ : Subgroup C)) = 4
    rw [Nat.card_congr ((Subgroup.zpowers a).prodEquiv (⊤ : Subgroup C)).toEquiv,
      Nat.card_prod, Nat.card_zpowers, a_order, Subgroup.card_top]
    change 2 * Nat.card (ZMod 2) = 4
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card]
  have hl : Nat.card L = 2 := by
    change Nat.card ((⊥ : Subgroup P).prod (⊤ : Subgroup C)) = 2
    rw [Nat.card_congr ((⊥ : Subgroup P).prodEquiv (⊤ : Subgroup C)).toEquiv,
      Nat.card_prod, Subgroup.card_bot, Subgroup.card_top]
    change 1 * Nat.card (ZMod 2) = 2
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card, one_mul]
  have h := Subgroup.relIndex_mul_card L K
  have hLK : L ≤ K := Subgroup.prod_mono bot_le le_rfl
  rw [inf_eq_left.mpr hLK, hl, hk] at h
  omega

end TwoMackeySummandsAux

namespace TwoMackeySummandsAux

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {V : Type*} [Group V]

private abbrev conjugate (t : V) (K : Subgroup V) :=
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj t)) K

private abbrev top (V : Type*) [Group V] : Subgroup V := ⊤

private abbrev outerEmbedding (K : Subgroup V) : ConjEmbedding K (top V) :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun _ => Subgroup.mem_top _)

private abbrev outerWord (K : Subgroup V) :=
  (Word.down (outerEmbedding K)).tensor (.up (outerEmbedding K))

private abbrev identityDrawing (K : Subgroup V) : Diagram Complex (outerWord K) (outerWord K) :=
  Diagram.horizontal (.id (.down (outerEmbedding K))) (.id (.up (outerEmbedding K)))

private abbrev intersection (K : Subgroup V) (t : top V) :=
  conjugate 1 K ⊓ conjugate ((t : V) * 1) K

private abbrev leftEmbedding (K S : Subgroup V) (t : top V) (h : S ≤ intersection K t) :
    ConjEmbedding S K :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator ((1 : V)⁻¹) (by
    intro x
    have hx := (h x.property).1
    change (x : V) ∈ conjugate 1 K at hx
    rw [show conjugate 1 K = K from conjugate_one K] at hx
    simpa using hx)

private abbrev rightEmbedding (K S : Subgroup V) (t : top V) (h : S ≤ intersection K t) :
    ConjEmbedding S K :=
  ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator ((1 : V)⁻¹ * (t : V)⁻¹) (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := (h x.property).2
    change ((t : V) * 1) * y * ((t : V) * 1)⁻¹ = (x : V) at he
    change y ∈ K at hy
    convert hy using 1
    rw [← he]
    group)

private abbrev crossingDot (K S : Subgroup V) (t : top V) (h : S ≤ intersection K t) :
    Dot ((outerEmbedding K).comp (leftEmbedding K S t h))
      ((outerEmbedding K).comp (rightEmbedding K S t h)) :=
  ⟨t, by
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1 : V) * ((1 : V)⁻¹ * (x : V) * ((1 : V)⁻¹)⁻¹) * 1⁻¹ * (t : V) =
      (t : V) * ((1 : V) * ((1⁻¹ * (t : V)⁻¹) * (x : V) * (1⁻¹ * (t : V)⁻¹)⁻¹) * 1⁻¹)
    group⟩

private theorem fibers [Finite V] {K S : Subgroup V}
    (l r : ConjEmbedding S K) (d : Dot ((outerEmbedding K).comp l) ((outerEmbedding K).comp r)) :
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis (outerEmbedding K) (outerEmbedding K) l r d w = z} := by
  let : Finite K := Finite.of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
  let : Finite (Biset.tensor (Biset.induction l) (Biset.restriction r)).carrier := by
    change Finite (Quotient (Biset.balance (Biset.induction l) (Biset.restriction r)))
    infer_instance
  intro z
  exact Set.toFinite _

private noncomputable abbrev stack [Finite V] {K S : Subgroup V}
    (l r : ConjEmbedding S K) (d : Dot ((outerEmbedding K).comp l) ((outerEmbedding K).comp r)) :
    Diagram Complex (outerWord K) (outerWord K) :=
  .vertical (.mixedProjection _ _ l r d (fibers l r d)) (.mixedMultiplication _ _ l r d)

private noncomputable abbrev canonicalStack [Finite V] (K S : Subgroup V)
    (t : top V) (h : S ≤ intersection K t) : Diagram Complex (outerWord K) (outerWord K) :=
  stack (leftEmbedding K S t h) (rightEmbedding K S t h) (crossingDot K S t h)

private theorem stack_congr [Finite V] {K S : Subgroup V}
    {l r l' r' : ConjEmbedding S K}
    {d : Dot ((outerEmbedding K).comp l) ((outerEmbedding K).comp r)}
    {d' : Dot ((outerEmbedding K).comp l') ((outerEmbedding K).comp r')}
    (hl : l = l') (hr : r = r') (hd : d.element = d'.element) :
    stack l r d = stack l' r' d' := by
  subst l' r'
  rw [Dot.ext hd]

private abbrev A (K : Subgroup V) := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype (top V)) (conjugate 1 K)

private theorem range_eq (K : Subgroup V) : (outerEmbedding K).toHom.range = A K := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, he⟩
    exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, Subtype.ext he⟩

private abbrev J (K : Subgroup V) := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A K : Set (top V)) (A K : Set (top V))

private abbrev mk (K : Subgroup V) (t : top V) : J K := DoubleCoset.mk (A K) (A K) t

private theorem mk_eq (K : Subgroup V) (x y : top V) :
    mk K x = mk K y ↔ DoubleCoset.mk K K (x : V) = DoubleCoset.mk K K (y : V) := by
  rw [DoubleCoset.eq, DoubleCoset.eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, r, hr, h⟩
    change (l : V) ∈ conjugate 1 K at hl
    change (r : V) ∈ conjugate 1 K at hr
    rw [show conjugate 1 K = K from conjugate_one K] at hl hr
    exact ⟨l, hl, r, hr, congrArg Subtype.val h⟩
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, r, hr, h⟩
    refine ⟨⟨l, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, ?_, ⟨r, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, ?_, Subtype.ext h⟩
    · change l ∈ conjugate 1 K
      rwa [show conjugate 1 K = K from conjugate_one K]
    · change r ∈ conjugate 1 K
      rwa [show conjugate 1 K = K from conjugate_one K]

private theorem normalizeStack [Finite V] (K S : Subgroup V)
    (σ : J K → top V) (reps : ∀ j, mk K (σ j) = j)
    (j : J K) (h : S ≤ intersection K (σ j)) (hi : S.IsFiniteRelIndex (intersection K (σ j))) :
    (canonicalStack K S (σ j) h).eval =
      (Diagram.scale (S.relIndex (intersection K (σ j)) : Complex)
        (canonicalStack K (intersection K (σ j)) (σ j) le_rfl)).eval := by
  -- The two suppliers index by the embedding range and the conjugate
  -- subgroup comap, respectively. Transport the section across range_eq.
  have hRange (B : Subgroup (top V)) (hB : B = (outerEmbedding K).toHom.range)
      (τ : DoubleCoset.Quotient (B : Set (top V)) (B : Set (top V)) → top V)
      (hτ : ∀ i, DoubleCoset.mk B B (τ i) = i) (i : DoubleCoset.Quotient
        (B : Set (top V)) (B : Set (top V)))
      (hS : S ≤ intersection K (τ i)) (hIndex : S.IsFiniteRelIndex (intersection K (τ i))) :
      (canonicalStack K S (τ i) hS).eval =
        (Diagram.scale (S.relIndex (intersection K (τ i)) : Complex)
          (canonicalStack K (intersection K (τ i)) (τ i) le_rfl)).eval := by
    subst B
    obtain ⟨hf, hfJ, he⟩ := (CommonMackeyIntersectionSum K K (top V) 1 1
      (fun _ _ => Subgroup.mem_top _) (fun _ _ => Subgroup.mem_top _) τ hτ).1 i S hS hIndex
    exact he
  exact hRange (A K) (range_eq K).symm σ reps j h hi

private theorem fullIdentity [Finite V] (K : Subgroup V)
    (σ : J K → top V) (reps : ∀ j, mk K (σ j) = j)
    (j₁ j₂ : J K) (hne : j₁ ≠ j₂) (hall : ∀ j, j = j₁ ∨ j = j₂) :
    (identityDrawing K).eval = (Diagram.add
      (canonicalStack K (intersection K (σ j₁)) (σ j₁) le_rfl)
      (canonicalStack K (intersection K (σ j₂)) (σ j₂) le_rfl)).eval := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hf, ⟨finite, hid⟩, _, _⟩ :=
    MackeyIdentityDiagram K K (top V) 1 1
      (fun _ _ => Subgroup.mem_top _) (fun _ _ => Subgroup.mem_top _) σ reps
  let term (x : (outerWord K).basis.carrier →₀ Complex) (j : J K) :=
    (canonicalStack K (intersection K (σ j)) (σ j) le_rfl).eval.toLinearMap x
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (identityDrawing K).eval.toLinearMap x = term x j₁ + term x j₂
  have hs : (identityDrawing K).eval.toLinearMap x = ∑ j ∈ (finite x).toFinset, term x j := hid x
  rw [hs]
  rw [Finset.sum_subset (s₂ := {j₁, j₂})]
  · simp [hne]
  · intro j _
    rcases hall j with rfl | rfl <;> simp
  · intro j _ hj
    have hnot : j ∉ Function.support (term x) := by
      intro hmem
      exact hj ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset (finite x)).mpr hmem)
    simpa only [Function.mem_support, not_not] using hnot

end TwoMackeySummandsAux

FiniteParabolicBimoduleBicategory.proof:
by
  -- Xiao, Corollary 7.5 and § 7.5, p. 32 in the archived original and
  -- p. 34 in the published 28 November revision.
  -- Alphabeta Math, Morita bicategory coherence, steps 1.1–1.3, 2.1–2.2
  -- and 3.1. The composition supplier checks the canonical maps and laws
  -- on pure tensors for these complex representations. Its balance and
  -- lift laws apply to the same tensor witnesses, with the inverse right
  -- action on the second group factor. The general Morita theorem uses
  -- a different quotient model, so this proof takes the laws directly
  -- from the composition supplier along with its admissibility proofs.
  -- The identity-span isomorphism and the explicit double-coset formula
  -- are the two additional clauses of that supplier.
  obtain ⟨hFinitary, _, hUnitAdmissible, tensor, tmul, tensorMap, assoc,
    leftUnit, rightUnit, hTensor, hTensorMap, hId, hComp, hAssoc,
    hUnits, hAssocNatural, hUnitsNatural, hPentagon, hTriangle, _⟩ :=
    FiniteParabolicBicategoryComposition.{u}
  exact ⟨hFinitary, hUnitAdmissible, tensor, tmul, tensorMap, assoc,
    leftUnit, rightUnit, hTensor, hTensorMap, hId, hComp, hAssoc,
    hUnits, hAssocNatural, hUnitsNatural, hPentagon, hTriangle⟩

CaseSixProjectionNoLeftReplacement.proof:
by
  classical
  -- Xiao, Example 6.7, archived printed p. 28 and published 28 November
  -- revision printed p. 30. The rendered inequality compares evaluated maps.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  refine ⟨XiaoCaseSixAux.index_bounds.1, XiaoCaseSixAux.index_bounds.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro B α β γ
    exact ⟨XiaoCaseSixAux.forced β,
      fun x => ⟨XiaoCaseSixAux.embedding_coe β x, XiaoCaseSixAux.embedding_coe γ x⟩,
      XiaoCaseSixAux.leftColumnGeneral α β γ⟩
  · refine ⟨XiaoCaseSixAux.rightDot, XiaoCaseSixAux.tOne, XiaoCaseSixAux.sOne,
      rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, XiaoCaseSixAux.right_noncommutes,
      XiaoCaseSixAux.indexed_commutes, ?_⟩
    · have h := XiaoCaseSixAux.rightColumn 1
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl] at h
      exact h
    · have h := XiaoCaseSixAux.rightColumn XiaoCaseSixAux.g
      rw [ite_eq_right XiaoCaseSixAux.g_ne_one] at h
      exact h
    · have h := XiaoCaseSixAux.rightColumn 1
      rw [ite_eq_left rfl] at h
      rw [h]
      change XiaoCaseSixAux.translationIn (XiaoCaseSixAux.input 1) =
        XiaoCaseSixAux.input XiaoCaseSixAux.g
      rw [XiaoCaseSixAux.translated_column, one_mul]
    · intro terms h he
      have hc := XiaoCaseSixAux.indexed_commutes terms h
      change (XiaoCaseSixAux.sumLeft terms).eval =
        XiaoCaseSixAux.evaluate
          (XiaoCaseSixAux.right XiaoCaseSixAux.rightDot XiaoCaseSixAux.tOne XiaoCaseSixAux.sOne) at he
      rw [he] at hc
      exact XiaoCaseSixAux.right_noncommutes hc

namespace XiaoCaseSixAux
open MackeyDiagrams
noncomputable section

private abbrev U := Multiplicative (ZMod 2)

private abbrev H : Subgroup U := ⊤
private abbrev pack := fun x : U => (⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩ : H)

private abbrev b := inclusion
private abbrev d := inclusion
private abbrev c := unitEmbedding
private abbrev e := inclusion
private abbrev f := inclusion
private abbrev i := unitEmbedding
private abbrev j := unitEmbedding
private abbrev k := unitEmbedding
private abbrev upW := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
private abbrev downW := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
private abbrev tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
private abbrev compE := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
private abbrev homE := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
private abbrev bottom := tensor (upW a) (tensor (downW b) (upW d))
private abbrev top := tensor (upW c) (tensor (downW e) (upW f))
private abbrev ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
private abbrev stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
private abbrev beside := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _

    {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
    {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
    (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word L M)
    (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
  stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q w))

    (t : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (compE β d) (compE γ f)))

    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)

  ∃ (B : Subgroup U) (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T B)

    (r : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (compE α a) (compE β b)))
    (t : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (compE β d) (compE γ f)))
    (s : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)),

    (stack (onLeft (downW j) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k [(1, t)]))
      (beside (straight (upW c)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j [(1, s)]))) :
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
private abbrev input := fun x : H => Finsupp.single
  (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (downW b) (upW d))) 1
    (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)) (1 : Complex)
private abbrev output := fun x : H => Finsupp.single
  (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (downW e) (upW f))) 1
    (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f x)) (1 : Complex)
private abbrev evaluate := fun {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word T T}
    (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
    (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
private abbrev translate := fun (a₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T T)
    (b₀ d₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T H) =>

  evaluate (beside (straight (upW a₀))
    (beside (straight (downW b₀)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.upDot [(1, dot)])))
private abbrev translationIn := translate a b d
private abbrev translationOut := translate c e f
private abbrev Summand := Complex × MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top
private abbrev sumLeft := fun (terms : List Summand) =>
  (⟨Finset.univ, fun i : Fin terms.length =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (terms.get i).1 (terms.get i).2⟩ :
    MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top (Fin terms.length))

-- Example 6.7, step 2. Conjugation acts trivially in the ambient C₂.
private theorem embedding_coe {K J : Subgroup U} (a₀ : ConjEmbedding K J) (x : K) :
    (a₀.toHom x : U) = (x : U) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := a₀.hasRepresentative
  simpa [mul_comm u (x : U), mul_assoc] using hu x

private theorem forced {B : Subgroup U} (β : ConjEmbedding H B) : B = H := by
  apply top_unique
  intro x hx
  have hm := (β.toHom (⟨x, hx⟩ : H)).property
  rwa [embedding_coe] at hm

private theorem embedding_unique {K J : Subgroup U} (a₀ b₀ : ConjEmbedding K J) : a₀ = b₀ := by
  apply ConjEmbedding.ext
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  exact Subtype.ext ((embedding_coe a₀ x).trans (embedding_coe b₀ x).symm)

private theorem t_one (x : T) : x = 1 :=
  Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp x.property)

private def topEquiv : H ≃ U where
  toFun := Subtype.val
  invFun := pack
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

private theorem index_bounds :
    (0 < Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range e.toHom) ∧ Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range e.toHom) ≤ 2) ∧
    (0 < Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range j.toHom) ∧ Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range j.toHom) ≤ 2) := by
  have hr : e.toHom.range = ⊥ := by
    apply bot_unique
    rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [t_one y, map_one]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  have ht : j.toHom.range = ⊤ := MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr Function.surjective_id
  have hc : Nat.card H = 2 := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr topEquiv]
    change Nat.card (ZMod 2) = 2
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card]
  rw [hr, ht, Subgroup.index_bot, Subgroup.index_top, hc]
  decide

private abbrev idH := ConjEmbedding.id H
private abbrev Lr := Dot (inclusion.comp a) (idH.comp b)
private abbrev Lt := Dot (idH.comp d) (idH.comp f)
private abbrev Ls := ProjectionDot.Mixed inclusion idH c e
private abbrev LeftFiber := ((upW c).tensor (downW e)).basis.carrier
private abbrev QL (s : Dot (inclusion.comp c) (idH.comp e)) (w : LeftFiber) :=
  Generator.mixedProduct inclusion idH (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis inclusion idH c e s w)
private abbrev LF (y : H) : LeftFiber :=
  (Biset.induction c).pair (Biset.restriction e) 1 y

private theorem leftFiber (s : Dot (inclusion.comp c) (idH.comp e)) (z : H) :
    {w : LeftFiber | QL s w = z} = {LF (s.element⁻¹ * z)} := by
  ext w
  change QL s w = z ↔ w = LF (s.element⁻¹ * z)
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w ?_
  rintro ⟨y, v⟩
  change QL s ((Biset.induction c).pair (Biset.restriction e) y v) = z ↔
    (Biset.induction c).pair (Biset.restriction e) y v = LF (s.element⁻¹ * z)
  rw [t_one y]
  have h (v : H) : QL s (LF v) = s.element * v := by
    change (inclusion.toHom 1 * s.element * v) * 1 = s.element * v
    simp
  rw [h]
  constructor
  · intro he
    rw [← he, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  · intro he
    have he' := congrArg (QL s) he
    rwa [h, h, mul_inv_cancel_left] at he'

private theorem leftFinite (s : Dot (inclusion.comp c) (idH.comp e)) (z : H) :
    Set.Finite {w : LeftFiber | QL s w = z} := by
  rw [leftFiber]
  exact Set.finite_singleton _

private abbrev RightFiber := ((upW i).tensor (downW j)).basis.carrier
private abbrev Rr := Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)
private abbrev Rt := Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)
private abbrev Rs := Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)
private abbrev QR (r : Rr) (w : RightFiber) :=
  Generator.mixedProduct b d (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w)
private abbrev RF : RightFiber := (Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) 1 1

private theorem rightFiberUnit (w : RightFiber) : w = RF := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w ?_
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  change (Biset.induction i).pair (Biset.restriction j) x y = RF
  rw [t_one x, t_one y]

private theorem rightProduct (r : Rr) (w : RightFiber) : QR r w = r.element := by
  rw [rightFiberUnit w]
  change (b.toHom 1 * r.element * d.toHom 1) * 1 = _
  simp

private theorem rightFinite (r : Rr) (x : H) : Set.Finite {w : RightFiber | QR r w = x} :=
  (Set.finite_singleton RF).subset (fun w _ => rightFiberUnit w)

private def rOne : Rr := ⟨1, fun y => by rw [t_one y]; simp⟩
private def tOne : Rt := ⟨1, fun y => by rw [t_one y]; simp⟩
private def sOne : Rs := ⟨1, fun y => by rw [t_one y]; simp⟩
private def rightDot : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j :=
  ⟨rOne, fun z => (rightFinite rOne (Generator.mixedProduct b d z)).subset
    (fun _ hz => congrArg (Generator.mixedProduct b d) hz)⟩

private theorem g_ne_one : g ≠ 1 := by
  intro h
  have h' : (1 : ZMod 2) = 0 := congrArg (fun x : H => Multiplicative.toAdd (x : U)) h
  exact (by decide : (1 : ZMod 2) ≠ 0) h'


private abbrev nativeLeft (r : Lr) (t : Lt) (s : Ls) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor (tensor (upW a) (downW b)) (upW d))
      (tensor (tensor (upW c) (downW e)) (upW f)) :=
  stack (beside (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication inclusion idH a b [(1, r)]) (straight (upW d)))
    (stack (ordinary (Diagram.associate (downW inclusion) (upW idH) (upW d)))
      (stack (beside (straight (downW inclusion)) (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp idH d idH f [(1, t)]))
        (stack (ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (downW inclusion) (upW idH) (upW f)))
          (beside (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection inclusion idH c e [(1, s)]) (straight (upW f))))))

-- Example 6.7, step 2. Apply Xiao (6.3) through EvaluationWithOneProjection.
-- The supplier uses left bracketing. Reassociate the same pure triples on
-- both boundaries. The projection certificate is obtained from the exact
-- singleton fiber, and proof irrelevance identifies it with the given one.
private theorem leftColumn (r : Lr) (t : Lt) (s : Ls) (x : H) :
    evaluate (left inclusion idH idH [(1, r)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]) (input x) =
      output (s.dot.element⁻¹ * r.element * x * t.element) := by
  let z := inclusion.toHom 1 * r.element * idH.toHom x * t.element
  have hz : s.dot.element⁻¹ * z = s.dot.element⁻¹ * r.element * x * t.element := by
    change s.dot.element⁻¹ * (inclusion.toHom 1 * r.element * x * t.element) = _
    simp [mul_assoc]
  let v := s.dot.element⁻¹ * z
  have hfin : (leftFinite s.dot z).toFinset = {LF v} := by
    ext w
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_singleton]
    exact Set.ext_iff.mp (leftFiber s.dot z) w
  let A := (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (upW c) (downW e) (upW f)).eval.toLinearMap
  have h := (EvaluationWithOneProjection a b d c e f).1 inclusion idH idH |>.1
    r t s.dot (leftFinite s.dot) 1 x
  change evaluate (nativeLeft r t s)
      (Finsupp.single (((upW a).tensor (downW b)).basis.pair (upW d).basis
        ((upW a).basis.pair (downW b).basis 1 x) 1) 1) =
    ∑ w ∈ (leftFinite s.dot z).toFinset,
      Finsupp.single (((upW c).tensor (downW e)).basis.pair (upW f).basis w 1) (1 : Complex) at h
  change A (evaluate (nativeLeft r t s)
    ((Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) (upW a) (downW b) (upW d)).eval.toLinearMap (input x))) = _
  change A (evaluate (nativeLeft r t s)
    ((Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) (upW a) (downW b) (upW d)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single ((upW a).basis.pair ((downW b).tensor (upW d)).basis 1
        ((downW b).basis.pair (upW d).basis x 1)) 1))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_unassociate_single, h, hfin, Finset.sum_singleton]
  unfold A
  change (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (upW c) (downW e) (upW f)).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (((upW c).tensor (downW e)).basis.pair (upW f).basis
      ((upW c).basis.pair (downW e).basis 1 v) 1) 1) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single]
  change output v = _
  exact congrArg output hz

private theorem leftColumnGeneral {B : Subgroup U}
    (α : ConjEmbedding T B) (β γ : ConjEmbedding H B)
    (r : Dot (α.comp a) (β.comp b)) (t : Dot (β.comp d) (γ.comp f))
    (s : ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e) (x : H) :
    evaluate (left α β γ [(1, r)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]) (input x) =
    output ((pack (s.dot.element : U))⁻¹ * pack (r.element : U) * x * pack (t.element : U)) := by
  have hB := forced β
  change B = (⊤ : Subgroup U) at hB
  subst B
  have hα : α = inclusion := embedding_unique α inclusion
  have hβ : β = idH := embedding_unique β idH
  have hγ : γ = idH := embedding_unique γ idH
  subst α
  subst β
  subst γ
  exact leftColumn r t s x

-- Example 6.7, step 1. In (6.4) the sole possible pair in the lower
-- projection is (1,1), and its multiplication value is 1.
private theorem rightColumn (x : H) :
    evaluate (right rightDot tOne sOne) (input x) =
      if x = 1 then output 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  have h := (EvaluationWithOneProjection a b d c e f).2 T i j k |>.1
    rOne (rightFinite rOne) tOne sOne 1 x
  change evaluate (right rightDot tOne sOne) (input x) =
    ∑ w ∈ (rightFinite rOne x).toFinset,
      (let rep : T × T := Quotient.out w
       Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction c).pair ((downW e).tensor (upW f)).basis
          (1 * a.toHom rep.1 * tOne.element)
          (Generator.mixedPair e f (sOne.element * f.toHom rep.2))) (1 : Complex)) at h
  rw [h]
  have hv (w : RightFiber) : w ∈ (rightFinite rOne x).toFinset ↔ x = 1 := by
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    change QR rOne w = x ↔ x = 1
    rw [rightProduct]
    exact eq_comm
  by_cases hx : x = 1
  · rw [ite_eq_left hx]
    have hs : (rightFinite rOne x).toFinset = {RF} := by
      ext w
      rw [hv, Finset.mem_singleton]
      exact ⟨fun _ => rightFiberUnit w, fun _ => hx⟩
    rw [hs, Finset.sum_singleton]
    have hrep : (Quotient.out RF : T × T) = (1, 1) :=
      Prod.ext (t_one _) (t_one _)
    simp only [hrep, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]
    rfl
  · rw [ite_eq_right hx]
    have hs : (rightFinite rOne x).toFinset = ∅ := by
      ext w
      simp [hv, hx]
    rw [hs, Finset.sum_empty]

section WeightedFrames

variable {V : Type*} [Group V] {K J M : Subgroup V}
variable {p p' : Word K J} {q q' : Word J M}

private theorem apply_list_sum {X Y : Type*} [AddCommMonoid X] [AddCommMonoid Y]
    [Module Complex X] [Module Complex Y] (fs : List (X →ₗ[Complex] Y)) (v : X) :
    fs.sum v = (fs.map (fun f => f v)).sum := by
  induction fs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons f fs ih =>
    change f v + fs.sum v = f v + _
    rw [ih]
    rfl

private theorem frame_list_left (terms : List (Complex × ScopedDiagram Complex p p'))
    (h : Biset.Hom Complex q.basis q'.basis) :
    ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.horizontal h).toLinearMap =
      (terms.map fun (c, d) => c • (d.eval.horizontal h).toLinearMap).sum := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro w k
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w ?_
  rintro ⟨u, v⟩
  rw [apply_list_sum, List.map_map]
  change ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.horizontal h).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis u v) k) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  let F := (Biset.pairLinear Complex p'.basis q'.basis).flip (h.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single v 1))
  change k • F ((terms.map fun (c,d) => c • d.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single u 1)).sum) = _
  rw [map_list_sum, List.smul_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,d⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  change k • c • F _ = c • (_ : Biset.Hom Complex _ _).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis u v) k)
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single]
  change k • c • F _ = c • k • F _
  rw [smul_comm k c]

private theorem frame_list_right (h : Biset.Hom Complex p.basis p'.basis)
    (terms : List (Complex × ScopedDiagram Complex q q')) :
    (h.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval).toLinearMap =
      (terms.map fun (c, d) => c • (h.horizontal d.eval).toLinearMap).sum := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro w k
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w ?_
  rintro ⟨u, v⟩
  rw [apply_list_sum, List.map_map]
  change (h.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis u v) k) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  let F := Biset.pairLinear Complex p'.basis q'.basis (h.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single u 1))
  change k • F ((terms.map fun (c,d) => c • d.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single v 1)).sum) = _
  rw [map_list_sum, List.smul_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,d⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  change k • c • F _ = c • (_ : Biset.Hom Complex _ _).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair q.basis u v) k)
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single]
  change k • c • F _ = c • k • F _
  rw [smul_comm k c]

end WeightedFrames

private theorem translated_column (x : H) :
    translationIn (input x) = input (x * g) := by
  let dot : Dot d d := ⟨g, fun y => mul_comm (d.toHom y) g⟩
  let Y := (downW b).basis
  let Z := (upW d).basis
  let X := (upW a).basis
  let V := (ScopedDiagram.weightedUpDot (R := Complex) [(1, dot)]).eval
  have hv : V.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) = Finsupp.single g 1 := by
    change (Diagram.finiteSum [Diagram.scale 1 (Diagram.upDot dot)]).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) = _
    rw [Diagram.eval_finiteSum]
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil]
    change (1 : Complex) • (Diagram.upDot dot).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (1 : H) 1) + 0 = _
    rw [one_smul, add_zero, Diagram.eval_upDot_single, one_mul]
  change ((Diagram.id (R := Complex) (upW a)).eval.horizontal
      ((Diagram.id (R := Complex) (downW b)).eval.horizontal V)).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (X.pair (Y.tensor Z) 1 (Y.pair Z x 1)) 1) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, hv, one_smul, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, one_smul,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  have he : Y.pair Z x g = Generator.mixedPair b d (x * g) :=
    (Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct b d (Y.pair Z x g)).symm
  rw [he]

private theorem basis_input (w : bottom.basis.carrier) :
    ∃ x : H, w = (upW a).basis.pair ((downW b).tensor (upW d)).basis 1
      (Generator.mixedPair b d x) := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w ?_
  rintro ⟨y, v⟩
  refine ⟨Generator.mixedProduct b d v, ?_⟩
  change (upW a).basis.pair ((downW b).tensor (upW d)).basis y v = _
  rw [t_one y, Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct]

private abbrev Llow (rs : List (Complex × Lr)) :=
  onLeft (upW d) (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication inclusion idH a b rs)
private abbrev Lmid (ts : List (Complex × Lt)) :=
  beside (straight (downW inclusion)) (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp idH d idH f ts)
private abbrev Lhigh (ss : List (Complex × Ls)) :=
  onLeft (upW f) (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection inclusion idH c e ss)

private abbrev lowTerm (r : Lr) := ScopedDiagram.ordinary
  (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) inclusion idH a b r)
private abbrev midTerm (t : Lt) := ScopedDiagram.ordinary
  (Diagram.parallelUp (R := Complex) idH d idH f t)
private abbrev highTerm (s : Ls) := ScopedDiagram.ordinary
  (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) inclusion idH c e s.dot s.finite)

private theorem frame_onLeft {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
    {p : Word K J} {q : Word J L} {p' : Word K J'} {q' : Word J' L} (w : Word L M)
    (terms : List (Complex × ScopedDiagram Complex (p.tensor q) (p'.tensor q')))
    (x : ((p.tensor (q.tensor w)).basis.carrier →₀ Complex)) :
    (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) p' q' w).eval.toLinearMap
        (((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination terms).eval.horizontal (Diagram.id w).eval).toLinearMap
          ((Diagram.unassociate p q w).eval.toLinearMap x)) =
      (terms.map fun (c,d) =>
        c • (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) p' q' w).eval.toLinearMap
          ((d.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id w).eval).toLinearMap
            ((Diagram.unassociate p q w).eval.toLinearMap x))).sum := by
  rw [frame_list_left (q := w) (q' := w), apply_list_sum, map_list_sum]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,d⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]

private theorem low_list (rs : List (Complex × Lr)) (x : bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    evaluate (Llow rs) x =
      (rs.map fun (c,r) => c • evaluate (Llow [(1,r)]) x).sum := by
  change (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (downW inclusion) (upW idH) (upW d)).eval.toLinearMap
    (((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (rs.map fun (c,r) => (c, lowTerm r))).eval.horizontal
      (Diagram.id (upW d)).eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.unassociate (upW a) (downW b) (upW d)).eval.toLinearMap x)) = _
  rw [frame_onLeft, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,r⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  apply congrArg (fun z => c • z)
  have h := frame_onLeft (upW d) [(1, lowTerm r)] x
  change evaluate (Llow [(1,r)]) x = _ at h
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero, one_smul] using h.symm

private theorem mid_list (ts : List (Complex × Lt))
    (x : ((downW inclusion).tensor ((upW idH).tensor (upW d))).basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    evaluate (Lmid ts) x =
      (ts.map fun (c,t) => c • evaluate (Lmid [(1,t)]) x).sum := by
  change ((Diagram.id (R := Complex) (downW inclusion)).eval.horizontal
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (ts.map fun (c,t) => (c, midTerm t))).eval).toLinearMap x = _
  rw [frame_list_right (p := downW inclusion) (p' := downW inclusion), apply_list_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,t⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  congr 1
  have h := frame_list_right (p := downW inclusion) (p' := downW inclusion)
    (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (downW inclusion)).eval [(1, midTerm t)]
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  change evaluate (Lmid [(1,t)]) x = _ at hx
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero, one_smul] using hx.symm

private theorem high_list (ss : List (Complex × Ls))
    (x : ((downW inclusion).tensor ((upW idH).tensor (upW f))).basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    evaluate (Lhigh ss) x =
      (ss.map fun (c,s) => c • evaluate (Lhigh [(1,s)]) x).sum := by
  change (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (upW c) (downW e) (upW f)).eval.toLinearMap
    (((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (ss.map fun (c,s) => (c, highTerm s))).eval.horizontal
      (Diagram.id (upW f)).eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.unassociate (downW inclusion) (upW idH) (upW f)).eval.toLinearMap x)) = _
  rw [frame_onLeft, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,s⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  apply congrArg (fun z => c • z)
  have h := frame_onLeft (upW f) [(1, highTerm s)] x
  change evaluate (Lhigh [(1,s)]) x = _ at h
  simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero, one_smul] using h.symm

-- Example 6.7, step 3. The three finite labels are expanded by the
-- linearity of evaluation at the marked crossings. The displayed
-- indexed sum over whole drawings remains a separate scope.
private theorem left_list (rs : List (Complex × Lr)) (ts : List (Complex × Lt))
    (ss : List (Complex × Ls)) (v : bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    evaluate (left inclusion idH idH rs ts ss) v =
      (rs.map fun (cr,r) => cr • (ts.map fun (ct,t) => ct •
        (ss.map fun (cs,s) => cs •
          evaluate (left inclusion idH idH [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)]) v).sum).sum).sum := by
  change evaluate (Lhigh ss) (evaluate (Lmid ts) (evaluate (Llow rs) v)) = _
  rw [low_list, map_list_sum, map_list_sum, List.map_map, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨cr,r⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun z => cr • z)
  rw [mid_list, map_list_sum, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨ct,t⟩ _
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, map_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun z => ct • z)
  exact high_list ss _

private def weighted {I V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    (terms : List (Complex × I)) (f : I → V) : V :=
  (terms.map fun (c,i) => c • f i).sum

private theorem map_weighted {I V W : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    [AddCommMonoid W] [Module Complex W] (F : V →ₗ[Complex] W)
    (terms : List (Complex × I)) (f : I → V) :
    F (weighted terms f) = weighted terms (fun i => F (f i)) := by
  rw [weighted, weighted, map_list_sum, List.map_map]
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  rintro ⟨c,i⟩ _
  exact map_smul F c (f i)

private theorem weighted_congr {I V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    (terms : List (Complex × I)) (f g : I → V) (h : ∀ i, f i = g i) :
    weighted terms f = weighted terms g := by
  rw [show f = g from funext h]

private theorem left_commutes_on_input (rs : List (Complex × Lr)) (ts : List (Complex × Lt))
    (ss : List (Complex × Ls)) (x : H) :
    evaluate (left inclusion idH idH rs ts ss) (translationIn (input x)) =
      translationOut (evaluate (left inclusion idH idH rs ts ss) (input x)) := by
  let column (y : H) (r : Lr) (t : Lt) (s : Ls) :=
    evaluate (left inclusion idH idH [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)]) (input y)
  have h (r : Lr) (t : Lt) (s : Ls) :
      column (x * g) r t s = translationOut (column x r t s) := by
    change evaluate (left inclusion idH idH [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)]) (input (x * g)) =
      translationOut (evaluate (left inclusion idH idH [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)]) (input x))
    rw [leftColumn, leftColumn]
    change input (s.dot.element⁻¹ * r.element * (x * g) * t.element) =
      translationIn (input (s.dot.element⁻¹ * r.element * x * t.element))
    rw [translated_column]
    apply congrArg input
    ac_rfl
  rw [translated_column, left_list rs ts ss (input (x * g)), left_list rs ts ss (input x)]
  change weighted rs (fun r => weighted ts (fun t => weighted ss (column (x * g) r t))) =
    translationOut (weighted rs (fun r => weighted ts (fun t => weighted ss (column x r t))))
  rw [map_weighted]
  apply weighted_congr
  intro r
  rw [map_weighted]
  apply weighted_congr
  intro t
  rw [map_weighted]
  exact weighted_congr _ _ _ (h r t)

private theorem left_commutes (D : LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) (hD : IsLeft D) :
    (evaluate D).comp translationIn = translationOut.comp (evaluate D) := by
  obtain ⟨B, α, β, γ, rs, ts, ss, rfl⟩ := hD
  have hB := forced β
  change B = (⊤ : Subgroup U) at hB
  subst B
  have hα : α = inclusion := embedding_unique α inclusion
  have hβ : β = idH := embedding_unique β idH
  have hγ : γ = idH := embedding_unique γ idH
  subst α
  subst β
  subst γ
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro w k
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := basis_input w
  have hk : Finsupp.single ((upW a).basis.pair ((downW b).tensor (upW d)).basis 1
        (Generator.mixedPair b d x)) k = k • input x := by
    change _ = k • Finsupp.single _ 1
    simp [Finsupp.smul_single]
  rw [hk]
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [left_commutes_on_input]

-- Example 6.7, step 3. Each position of the original finite indexed
-- drawing contributes its own summand and coefficient.
private theorem indexed_commutes (terms : List Summand) (h : ∀ term ∈ terms, IsLeft term.2) :
    ((sumLeft terms).eval).comp translationIn =
      translationOut.comp ((sumLeft terms).eval) := by
  classical
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  have heval (z : bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      (sumLeft terms).eval z = ∑ idx ∈ (sumLeft terms).indices,
        (terms.get idx).1 • evaluate (terms.get idx).2 z :=
    IndexedDrawing.eval_apply (sumLeft terms) z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [heval (translationIn v), heval v, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro idx _
  let term := terms.get idx
  change term.1 • evaluate term.2 (translationIn v) =
    translationOut (term.1 • evaluate term.2 v)
  rw [map_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun z => term.1 • z)
    (LinearMap.congr_fun (left_commutes term.2 (h term (List.get_mem terms idx))) v)

private theorem right_noncommutes :
    (evaluate (right rightDot tOne sOne)).comp translationIn ≠
      translationOut.comp (evaluate (right rightDot tOne sOne)) := by
  classical
  let R := evaluate (right rightDot tOne sOne)
  have h1 : R (input 1) = output 1 := by
    have h := rightColumn 1
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl] at h
    exact h
  have hg : R (input g) = 0 := by

    rw [translated_column, one_mul]
  rw [ht] at hv

  exact hne hv.symm

end

namespace LargestCommonMixedCrossingParabolicProof

open MackeyDiagrams

private abbrev finitary := Subgroup.closure {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | g.IsSwap}
private abbrev blockSym (X : Finset Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X)).range
private abbrev HasBlocks (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    H = ⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)

private theorem finiteOfBlocks {H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} (hH : HasBlocks H) :
    Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, rfl⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have fixes (g : ↥(⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i))) (x : Nat) (hx : x ∉ X) :
      (g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x := by
    refine Subgroup.iSup_induction (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
      (C := fun f => f x = x) g.property ?_ rfl ?_
    · rintro i f ⟨f', rfl⟩
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f' fun hi =>
        hx (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩)
    · intro f g hf hg
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, hg, hf]
  have preserves (g : ↥(⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i))) (x : Nat) :
      (g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
    constructor
    · intro hgx
      by_contra hx
      exact hx (fixes g x hx ▸ hgx)
    · intro hx
      by_contra hgx
      exact hgx (show (g : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ X from
        ((g : Equiv.Perm Nat).injective (fixes g _ hgx)).symm ▸ hx)
  refine Finite.of_injective
    (fun g : ↥(⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)) => (g : Equiv.Perm Nat).subtypePerm (preserves g)) ?_
  intro g h heq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ X
  · exact congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm ↥X => (p ⟨x, hx⟩).val) heq
  · rw [fixes g x hx, fixes h x hx]

private theorem greatestSwapClosure (P : Subgroup finitary) [Finite P] :
    IsGreatest {S : Subgroup finitary | HasBlocks (S.map finitary.subtype) ∧ S ≤ P}
      (Subgroup.closure {g : finitary | g ∈ P ∧ (g : Equiv.Perm Nat).IsSwap}) := by
  classical
  let f := finitary.subtype
  let T : Set finitary := {g | g ∈ P ∧ (g : Equiv.Perm Nat).IsSwap}
  let L := Subgroup.closure T
  let Q := P.map f
  let L' := Subgroup.closure {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | g ∈ Q ∧ g.IsSwap}
  have hQ : Q ≤ finitary := by
    rintro g ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
    exact x.property
  let : Finite Q := Finite.of_surjective (fun x : P => (⟨f x.val, ⟨x.val, x.property, rfl⟩⟩ : Q))
    (by rintro ⟨g, x, hx, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hMap : L.map f = L' := by
    change (Subgroup.closure T).map f = _
    rw [MonoidHom.map_closure]
    congr 1
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, ⟨hx, hs⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hs⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx, rfl⟩, hs⟩
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hx, hs⟩, rfl⟩
  have equivalent (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :
      HasBlocks H ↔ ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
        (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
        (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧ H = ⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, blocks, hne, hd, heq⟩
      exact ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, n, blocks, hne, hd,
        fun m => by simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and], heq⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, n, blocks, hne, hd, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨n, blocks, hne, hd, heq⟩
  have hExt := (ExtremalParabolicsOfFiniteGroup Q hQ).1
  refine ⟨⟨?_, (Subgroup.closure_le P).mpr fun _ hg => hg.1⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact hMap.symm ▸ (equivalent L').mpr hExt.1.1
  · rintro S ⟨hBlocks, hSP⟩
    have hImage : S.map f ≤ L' :=
      hExt.2 ⟨(equivalent (S.map f)).mp hBlocks, Subgroup.map_mono hSP⟩
    intro g hg
    have hg' : f g ∈ L.map f := hMap ▸ hImage ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩ := hg'
    exact (show x = g from Subtype.val_injective hxeq) ▸ hx

private theorem compactOuterEval {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H G S : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G) (l : ConjEmbedding S K)
    (r : ConjEmbedding S H) (d : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r))
    (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z}) :
    (LabelledDrawing.vertical (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b l r [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)])
      (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r [(1, d)])).interpret.eval =
    (Diagram.vertical (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a b l r d hf)
      (Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b l r d)).eval := by
  exact congrArg₂ (fun p i => p.vertical i)
    (MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection a b l r d hf)
    (MackeyCrossingProof.compact_inclusion a b l r d)

end LargestCommonMixedCrossingParabolicProof

private theorem roundTripSplitMerge {U : Type*} [Group U] {G : Subgroup U}
    (e : ConjEmbedding G G) :
    let w := Word.up e

      ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) e e).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id w.basis))
    let merge := ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) e e).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id w.basis)).vertical

        Biset.Hom.id (Word.up (a.comp b)).basis :=
    Diagram.splitUp_mergeUp a b
  dsimp only [split, merge]
  refine Biset.Hom.cancel_middle _ _ _ _ ?_ (cancel ee e)
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, cancel, Biset.Hom.id_vertical, Biset.Hom.horizontal_id]

  .trivalent (.mergeUp e f)

private noncomputable abbrev split (e f : ConjEmbedding G G) : LabelledDrawing Complex
    (.up (e.comp f)) (Word.tensor (.up e) (.up f)) :=
  .trivalent (.splitUp e f)

private noncomputable abbrev crossing (e : ConjEmbedding G G)
    (d : DotLabel Complex (e.comp e) (e.comp e)) :=
  (merge e e).vertical (d.upDrawing.vertical (split e e))

private noncomputable abbrev crossLeft (e : ConjEmbedding G G)
    (d : DotLabel Complex (e.comp e) (e.comp e)) : LabelledDrawing Complex (word e) (word e) :=
  (crossing e d).horizontal (straight e)

private noncomputable abbrev crossRight (e : ConjEmbedding G G)
    (d : DotLabel Complex (e.comp e) (e.comp e)) : LabelledDrawing Complex (word e) (word e) :=
  (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.associate (.up e) (.up e) (.up e))).vertical
    (((straight e).horizontal (crossing e d)).vertical
      (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (.up e) (.up e) (.up e))))

private noncomputable abbrev multiplier {e : ConjEmbedding G G}
    (a : LabelledDrawing Complex (word e) (word e)) : MonoidAlgebra Complex G :=
  let start := (split (e.comp e) e).vertical ((split e e).horizontal (straight e))
  let finish := ((merge e e).horizontal (straight e)).vertical (merge (e.comp e) e)
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (((start.vertical (a.vertical finish)).interpret.eval).toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (1 : G) 1))

private noncomputable abbrev value {e : ConjEmbedding G G}
    (d : DotLabel Complex (e.comp e) (e.comp e)) : MonoidAlgebra Complex G :=
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element d)

private noncomputable abbrev along (e : ConjEmbedding G G) :=
  MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex e.toHom

private theorem specialize (e : ConjEmbedding G G)
    (hrep : ∀ x : G, (1 : U) * (x : U) * (1 : U)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (he : e = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 hrep) :
    (∀ d₁ d₂ d₃ : DotLabel Complex (e.comp e) (e.comp e),
      multiplier ((crossLeft e d₁).vertical ((crossRight e d₂).vertical (crossLeft e d₃))) =
        value d₁ * along e (value d₂) * value d₃) ∧
    (∀ d₁ d₂ d₃ : DotLabel Complex (e.comp e) (e.comp e),
      multiplier ((crossRight e d₁).vertical ((crossLeft e d₂).vertical (crossRight e d₃))) =
        along e (value d₁) * value d₂ * along e (value d₃)) ∧
    (∀ a b : LabelledDrawing Complex (word e) (word e),
      a.interpret.eval = b.interpret.eval ↔ multiplier a = multiplier b) := by
  subst e
  let e := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (1 : U) hrep
  have result := ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers G G G G G G
    1 1 1 1 1 1 hrep hrep hrep hrep hrep hrep
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro d₁ d₂ d₃
    exact (result.2.2.2.2.2.1 G e e e d₁ d₂ d₃).1
  · intro d₁ d₂ d₃
    exact (result.2.2.2.2.2.2 G e e e d₁ d₂ d₃).1
  · intro a b
    exact result.2.2.2.1 a b

end RoundTripEvaluation

by
  classical
  intro U inst G A D F C E ga ad df gc ce ef
  obtain ⟨sGA, hsGA, rfl⟩ := asConjugator ga
  obtain ⟨sAD, hsAD, rfl⟩ := asConjugator ad
  obtain ⟨sDF, hsDF, rfl⟩ := asConjugator df
  obtain ⟨sGC, hsGC, rfl⟩ := asConjugator gc
  obtain ⟨sCE, hsCE, rfl⟩ := asConjugator ce
  obtain ⟨sEF, hsEF, rfl⟩ := asConjugator ef
  let ga : ConjEmbedding A G := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sGA hsGA
  let ad : ConjEmbedding D A := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sAD hsAD
  let df : ConjEmbedding F D := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sDF hsDF
  let gc : ConjEmbedding C G := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sGC hsGC
  let ce : ConjEmbedding E C := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sCE hsCE
  let ef : ConjEmbedding F E := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sEF hsEF
  intro bottomPair topPair word bottom top straight merge split splitBottom mergeTop
    evaluate mergedEvaluation multiplier DotWeights crossing crossLeft crossRight
    LeftLabels RightLabels leftDiagram rightDiagram leftMultiplier rightMultiplier
    represents conjugate singleDot sameEvaluation
  -- Ian Xiao, § 6.1, “Other choices of internal group,” archived PDF p. 21
  -- and 28 November published revision p. 23.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- Numbering below follows the
  -- arguments in this unnumbered paragraph, which has no Alphabeta Math proof entry.
  -- Lemma 6.1 is the registered supplier for support, the two multiplier formulas,
  -- and equality of evaluations, so the crossing basis computations are
  -- available in assembled form. Theorem 6.2 supplies an equivalence of
  -- evaluation classes. The witnesses for these specified internal groups
  -- are constructed below.
  have laws := ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers G A D F C E sGA sAD sDF sGC sCE sEF
    hsGA hsAD hsDF hsGC hsCE hsEF
  have compare (d e : LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) :
      evaluate d = evaluate e ↔ multiplier d = multiplier e :=
    laws.2.2.2.1 d e
  have leftRule := laws.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have rightRule := laws.2.2.2.2.2.2
  have boundary := laws.1

    -- Lift the coefficients along the injection from eligible middle dots to G.
    intro right B hBG m hA hC hmB
    let gb : ConjEmbedding B G :=
      ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hBG, ⟨1, by intro h; simp⟩⟩

    let be : ConjEmbedding E B := restrictTarget topPair B (fun e => hC (ce.toHom e))
    have hbd : gb.comp bd = bottomPair :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun d => Subtype.ext rfl)
    have hbe : gb.comp be = topPair :=
      ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun e => Subtype.ext rfl)
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := idDotOfEq hbd.symm
    obtain ⟨x₃, hx₃⟩ := idDotOfEq hbe

      rcases right with ⟨B', ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩

    have middle (p : G) (hp : p ∈ m.coeff.support) (f : F) :

      let v := sGC * sCE * sEF

        (p : U) * (topPair.toHom (ef.toHom f) : U)

      have hcomm := Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff.mp (support p hp) (f : U) f.property
      change (f : U) * (u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v) = (u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v) * (f : U) at hcomm
      change (bottomPair.toHom (df.toHom f) : U) = u * (f : U) * u⁻¹ at hu
      change (topPair.toHom (ef.toHom f) : U) = v * (f : U) * v⁻¹ at hv
      rw [hu, hv]
      calc
        (u * (f : U) * u⁻¹) * (p : U) =
            u * ((f : U) * (u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v)) * v⁻¹ := by group
        _ = u * ((u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v) * (f : U)) * v⁻¹ := by rw [hcomm]
        _ = (p : U) * (v * (f : U) * v⁻¹) := by group
    obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := liftSupported hBG m hmB middle
    let left : LeftLabels := ⟨B, gb, bd, be, singleDot x₁, x₂, singleDot x₃⟩
    have leftValue : leftMultiplier left = m := by
      have formula := (leftRule B gb bd be (singleDot x₁) x₂ (singleDot x₃)).1
      change leftMultiplier left =
        MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot x₁)) *
        MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.inclusion hBG)

        MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot x₃)) at formula

      dsimp only [singleDot]
      simp only [singletonValue, hx₁, hx₂, hx₃, ← MonoidAlgebra.one_def, one_mul, mul_one]

      (compare (leftDiagram left) (rightDiagram right)).2 leftValue⟩

    -- AD, DF and CE. The primed representatives can then equal the unprimed ones.

    obtain ⟨rg, hg⟩ := gb.hasRepresentative
    obtain ⟨rd, hd⟩ := bd.hasRepresentative
    obtain ⟨re, he⟩ := be.hasRepresentative

    let rDF := rd⁻¹ * ((x₂.element : U) * (re * sEF))
    let rCE := sGC⁻¹ * ((x₃.element : U)⁻¹ * (rg * re))
    have hGA : Represents ga sGA := fun _ => rfl
    have hGC : Represents gc sGC := fun _ => rfl
    have hEF : Represents ef sEF := fun _ => rfl
    have hAD : Represents ad rAD := repFactorRight hGA (repDotLeft x₁ (repComp hg hd))
    have hDF : Represents df rDF := repFactorRight hd (repDotLeft x₂ (repComp he hEF))
    have hCE : Represents ce rCE := repFactorRight hGC (repDotRight x₃ (repComp hg he))
    have x1eq : (x₁.element : U) = sGA * rAD * rd⁻¹ * rg⁻¹ := by dsimp [rAD]; group
    have x2eq : (x₂.element : U) = rd * rDF * sEF⁻¹ * re⁻¹ := by dsimp [rDF]; group
    have x3eq : (x₃.element : U) = rg * re * rCE⁻¹ * sGC⁻¹ := by dsimp [rCE]; group
    -- Step 3. With these choices both centralizing factors in Xiao's calculation
    -- are 1. The claimed intersection and its arbitrary conjugate still apply.
    have cancelP : (p : U) * (sGC * rCE * sEF) = sGA * rAD * rDF := by
      change (x₁.element : U) * (gb.toHom x₂.element : U) * (x₃.element : U) *
        (sGC * rCE * sEF) = _
      rw [hg, x1eq, x2eq, x3eq]
      group
    refine ⟨sGA, rAD, rDF, sGC, rCE, sEF, rg, rd, re, rg, rd, re,
      hGA, hAD, hDF, hGC, hCE, hEF, hg, hd, he, hg, hd, he, x1eq, x2eq, x3eq, ?_⟩
    intro τ B'' B'
    have hA' (b : B') : (rAD * rDF * τ⁻¹) * (b : U) * (rAD * rDF * τ⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ A := by
      have hz : τ⁻¹ * (b : U) * τ ∈ B'' := mem_conjugate.mp b.property
      have hD : rDF * (τ⁻¹ * (b : U) * τ) * rDF⁻¹ ∈ D := by
        simpa only [inv_inv] using ((mem_conjugate (s := rDF⁻¹)).mp hz.1)
      have h := (ad.toHom ⟨_, hD⟩).property
      rw [hAD] at h
      convert h using 1
      group
    have hC' (b : B') : (rCE * sEF * τ⁻¹) * (b : U) * (rCE * sEF * τ⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ C := by
      have hz : τ⁻¹ * (b : U) * τ ∈ B'' := mem_conjugate.mp b.property
      have hE : sEF * (τ⁻¹ * (b : U) * τ) * sEF⁻¹ ∈ E := by
        simpa only [inv_inv] using ((mem_conjugate (s := sEF⁻¹)).mp hz.2)
      have h := (ce.toHom ⟨_, hE⟩).property
      rw [hCE] at h
      convert h using 1
      group
    have hF' (f : F) : τ * (f : U) * τ⁻¹ ∈ B' := by
      refine ⟨(f : U), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      · apply (mem_conjugate (s := rDF⁻¹)).mpr
        simpa only [inv_inv, ← hDF f] using (df.toHom f).property
      · apply (mem_conjugate (s := sEF⁻¹)).mpr
        simpa only [inv_inv, ← hEF f] using (ef.toHom f).property
    let ab' := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator _ hA'
    let cb' := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator _ hC'
    let b'f := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator _ hF'
    have hAB : Represents ab' (rAD * rDF * τ⁻¹) := fun _ => rfl
    have hCB : Represents cb' (rCE * sEF * τ⁻¹) := fun _ => rfl
    have hBF : Represents b'f τ := fun _ => rfl
    have outer₁ : ad.comp df = ab'.comp b'f := by
      apply repEq (repComp hAD hDF)
      simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_right] using (repComp hAB hBF)
    have outer₃ : cb'.comp b'f = ce.comp ef := by
      apply Eq.symm
      apply repEq (repComp hCE hEF)
      simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_right] using (repComp hCB hBF)
    obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ := idDotOfEq outer₁
    obtain ⟨y₃, hy₃⟩ := idDotOfEq outer₃
    have hpRep : sGA * (rAD * rDF * τ⁻¹) * (sGC * (rCE * sEF * τ⁻¹))⁻¹ =
        (p : U) := by
      calc
        _ = (sGA * rAD * rDF) * (sGC * rCE * sEF)⁻¹ := by group
        _ = (p : U) := by rw [← cancelP, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    let y₂ := Dot.ofRepresentatives _ _ (repComp hGA hAB) (repComp hGC hCB)
      (hpRep.symm ▸ p.property)
    have hy₂ : y₂.element = p := Subtype.ext hpRep
    let right : RightLabels := ⟨B', ab', cb', b'f, singleDot y₁, singleDot y₂, singleDot y₃⟩
    -- Step 4. Compare the two normalized products, then recover the evaluation
    -- at the same six boundary embeddings with the injectivity in Lemma 6.1.
    have leftValue : leftMultiplier left = MonoidAlgebra.single p (1 : Complex) := by
      have formula := (leftRule B gb bd be (singleDot x₁) (singleDot x₂) (singleDot x₃)).1
      change leftMultiplier left =
        MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot x₁)) *
        MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex gb.toHom
          (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot x₂))) *
        MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot x₃)) at formula
      rw [formula]
      dsimp only [singleDot]
      simp [p]
    have rightValue : rightMultiplier right = MonoidAlgebra.single p (1 : Complex) := by
      have formula := (rightRule B' ab' cb' b'f (singleDot y₁) (singleDot y₂) (singleDot y₃)).1
      change rightMultiplier right =
        MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex ga.toHom
          (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot y₁))) *
        MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot y₂)) *
        MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex gc.toHom
          (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (singleDot y₃))) at formula
      rw [formula]
      dsimp only [singleDot]
      simp only [singletonValue, hy₁, hy₂, hy₃, ← MonoidAlgebra.one_def, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]
    have equal : rightMultiplier right = leftMultiplier left := rightValue.trans leftValue.symm
    exact ⟨ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃, hAB, hCB, hBF, hy₁, hy₂, hy₃, equal,
      (compare (leftDiagram left) (rightDiagram right)).2 equal.symm⟩

namespace AlternativeThreeInductionProof

open MackeyDiagrams

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {H K L : Subgroup U}

private abbrev Represents (a : ConjEmbedding H K) (s : U) : Prop :=
  ∀ h : H, (a.toHom h : U) = s * (h : U) * s⁻¹

private theorem repEq {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} {s : U}
    (ha : Represents a s) (hb : Represents b s) : a = b :=
  ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun h => Subtype.ext ((ha h).trans (hb h).symm))

private theorem repComp {a : ConjEmbedding K L} {b : ConjEmbedding H K} {s t : U}
    (ha : Represents a s) (hb : Represents b t) : Represents (a.comp b) (s * t) := by
  intro h
  rw [ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, ha, hb]
  group

private theorem asConjugator (a : ConjEmbedding H K) :
    ∃ s : U, ∃ hs : ∀ h : H, s * (h : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ K,
      a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s hs := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  exact ⟨s, fun h => hs h ▸ (a.toHom h).property,
    repEq hs (fun _ => rfl)⟩

private theorem repDotLeft {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} (d : Dot a b) {s : U}
    (hb : Represents b s) : Represents a ((d.element : U) * s) := by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun k : K => (k : U)) (d.intertwines h)
  simp only [Subgroup.coe_mul, hb h] at he
  calc
    (a.toHom h : U) = ((a.toHom h : U) * (d.element : U)) * (d.element : U)⁻¹ := by group
    _ = ((d.element : U) * s) * (h : U) * ((d.element : U) * s)⁻¹ := by rw [he]; group

private theorem repDotRight {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} (d : Dot a b) {s : U}
    (ha : Represents a s) : Represents b ((d.element : U)⁻¹ * s) :=
  repDotLeft d.inverse ha

private theorem repFactorRight {a : ConjEmbedding K L} {b : ConjEmbedding H K} {s t : U}
    (ha : Represents a s) (hab : Represents (a.comp b) t) :
    Represents b (s⁻¹ * t) := by
  intro h
  have he := hab h
  rw [ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, ha] at he
  calc
    (b.toHom h : U) = s⁻¹ * (s * (b.toHom h : U) * s⁻¹) * s := by group
    _ = (s⁻¹ * t) * (h : U) * (s⁻¹ * t)⁻¹ := by rw [he]; group

private def restrictTarget (a : ConjEmbedding H K) (L : Subgroup U)
    (ha : ∀ h : H, (a.toHom h : U) ∈ L) : ConjEmbedding H L where
  toHom :=
    { toFun := fun h => ⟨a.toHom h, ha h⟩
      map_one' := Subtype.ext (by simp)
      map_mul' x y := Subtype.ext (by simp) }
  hasRepresentative := a.hasRepresentative

private theorem idDotOfEq {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} (h : a = b) :
    ∃ d : Dot a b, d.element = 1 := by
  subst b
  exact ⟨Dot.id a, rfl⟩

private theorem liftSupported {B G F : Subgroup U} (hBG : B ≤ G)
    {a b : ConjEmbedding F B} (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
    (hB : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, (p : U) ∈ B)
    (hDot : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, ∀ f : F,
      (a.toHom f : U) * (p : U) = (p : U) * (b.toHom f : U)) :
    ∃ x : DotLabel Complex a b,
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.inclusion hBG)
        (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element x)) = m := by
  classical
  let inc := Subgroup.inclusion hBG
  let key : Dot a b → G := fun d => inc d.element
  have injective : Function.Injective key :=
    fun _ _ heq => Dot.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun g : G => (g : U)) heq))
  have hRange : ↑m.coeff.support ⊆ Set.range key := by
    intro p hp
    let bp : B := ⟨p, hB p hp⟩
    let d : Dot a b := ⟨bp, fun f => Subtype.ext (hDot p hp f)⟩
    exact ⟨d, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  refine ⟨Finsupp.comapDomain key m.coeff injective.injOn, ?_⟩
  apply MonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
  change Finsupp.mapDomain inc (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element _) = _
  rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain key injective m.coeff hRange

private theorem singletonValue {a b : ConjEmbedding H K} (d : Dot a b) :
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single d.element 1 := by
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

private abbrev conjugate (s : U) (H : Subgroup U) : Subgroup U :=
  H.map (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom

private theorem mem_conjugate {s z : U} :
    z ∈ conjugate s H ↔ s⁻¹ * z * s ∈ H := by
  change (∃ x ∈ H, s * x * s⁻¹ = z) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hx
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨_, hz, by group⟩

end AlternativeThreeInductionProof

open MackeyDiagrams AlternativeThreeInductionProof

cosets. The middle right dot is the finite label 1 + τ at one mark. The
example gives Q₁^! + Qτ^! as a sum of maps. The list fold in the reviewed

ordered boundary. The explicit scopes and orientations therefore agree
with the source and the revision's evaluation convention.

coordinate factorization and conjugation-action calculation. Here the base
is abelian, so conjugation on it only depends on the C₂ coordinate. This
makes the intersection the full line in G and trivial in GτG.
https://alphabetamath.cc/item/prop-canonical-subgroups-of-an-external-semidirect-product

parameter. The left and right basis calculations below give the explicit
parameter and support of each weighted term, which is needed for the two
probes. The calculation uses
DoubleCoset.mem_doubleCoset on the first projection's basis coordinates.
CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstruction .1 (Theorem 6.4(2)) applies separately
to the two overall ProjectionDot.Mixed witnesses, whose finite fibers
are proved below. Each use gives its own internal subgroup.
https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#lem:three-projections
https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#thm:three-projections

For the universal shape clause we prove rigidity of the positioned event
sequence, since event count alone does not determine the crossing order.
The factorization isolates each actual singleton. Alphabeta Math's Morita
coherence steps 1.1–1.3 motivate the associator, unitor and whiskering
identities. Here the local boundary-coherence proof works on balanced
basis elements, extends linearly and removes only empty-code padding.
It adapts the project's DotSlidePreorderNotSymmetric support to the
existing driver imports. The normal forms identify the same B, r, s, t
and restriction suffix across the cuts. Collecting coefficients keeps
the same projection and parallel-crossing marks and uses the finite
fiber proof carried by each projection term. The fixed-boundary
comparison then follows by composition and the two coefficient probes.

noncomputable abbrev swap : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) :=
  Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2)

noncomputable abbrev action : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) →* MulAut (Multiplicative Int × Multiplicative Int) :=
  let act := fun i : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) =>
    if i = 1 then 1 else (MulEquiv.prodComm : MulAut (Multiplicative Int × Multiplicative Int))
  { toFun := act
    map_one' := ite_eq_left rfl
    map_mul' := by
      have cases₂ : ∀ i : Multiplicative (ZMod 2), i = 1 ∨ i = swap := by
        intro i
        change (Multiplicative.toAdd i : Fin 2) = 0 ∨ Multiplicative.toAdd i = (1 : ZMod 2)
        exact (by decide : ∀ j : Fin 2, j = 0 ∨ j = 1) (Multiplicative.toAdd i)
      have hs : swap * swap = 1 := by decide
      have hn : swap ≠ 1 := by decide
      intro i j
      rcases cases₂ i with rfl | rfl <;> rcases cases₂ j with rfl | rfl <;>
        simp only [act, one_mul, mul_one, hs, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right hn]
      rfl }
