/-!
Ian Xiao, Example 6.4 and Theorem 6.5, Cases 3 and 4.
The archived original has the example on p. 25 and Theorem 6.5 on p. 24.
The published 28 November revision (SHA-256
813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61)
has them on pp. 27 and 26 respectively:
https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=27

The coordinator supplies Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis (Mixed.lean:53)
and DotLabel.upDrawing_basis (DotLabels.lean:75). The former gives the
push-forward of each balanced pair by x * p * y at identity embeddings.
The latter gives the dot in the parallel merge, dot and split, with the
coefficient-one singleton reducing its finite sum to one column. The
intertwining equation for each mark follows from commutativity of C₂.
These columns use multiplication, so the projection fiber condition
does not enter. The associators transport pairs into and out of the
last-two-strand frame.

The published case numbers give the replacement directions. The plan has
no separate numbered Alphabeta Math proof for this example. The registered
ReplacementForTwoMultiplications gives existence of evaluation-preserving
replacements on these shapes. Its existential replacement maps alone
do not determine the labels of the explicit round trip, so the proof
uses the checked columns to compute the two multipliers in the specified
maps. Equality is checked on the entire triple balanced basis before
the boundary merge, using quotient induction and linearity. The original
and returned tuples are distinguished at the first marked label.
-/

namespace MixedMultiplicationRoundTrip
open MackeyDiagrams

universe u
variable {U : Type u} [CommGroup U] (K : Subgroup U)

private abbrev emb := ConjEmbedding.id K
private abbrev composed := (emb K).comp (emb K)
private abbrev up := Word.up (emb K)
private abbrev down := Word.down (emb K)
private abbrev bottom := ((up K).tensor (up K)).tensor (down K)
private abbrev top := ((down K).tensor (up K)).tensor (up K)

private def dot (p : K) : Dot (composed K) (composed K) :=
  ⟨p, fun h => mul_comm ((composed K).toHom h) p⟩

private noncomputable def weight (p : K) : DotLabel Complex (composed K) (composed K) :=
  Finsupp.single (dot K p) 1

private theorem identity_weight : DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) (composed K) = weight K 1 := by
  unfold DotLabel.identity weight
  rw [show Dot.id (composed K) = dot K 1 from Dot.ext rfl]

private theorem terms_weight (p : K) : (weight K p).terms = [(1, dot K p)] := by
  simp [DotLabel.terms, weight, Finsupp.support_single, Finset.toList_singleton]

variable {K}
private noncomputable abbrev run {a b : Word K K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex a b) :=
  d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev pair (a b : Word K K) := a.basis.pair b.basis

private abbrev straight (a : Word K K) : LabelledDrawing Complex a a :=
  .ordinary (.id a)

private abbrev last (a : Word K K) {b c b' c' : Word K K}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (b.tensor c) (b'.tensor c')) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex ((a.tensor b).tensor c) ((a.tensor b').tensor c') :=
  .vertical (.ordinary (.associate a b c))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (straight a) d) (.ordinary (.unassociate a b' c')))

private theorem stack_apply {a b c : Word K K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex a b)
    (e : LabelledDrawing Complex b c) (x : a.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    run (.vertical d e) x = run e (run d x) := rfl

private theorem first_column {a a' b : Word K K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex a a')
    (x : a.basis.carrier) (x' : a'.basis.carrier) (y : b.basis.carrier)
    (hd : run d (Finsupp.single x 1) = Finsupp.single x' 1) :
    run (.horizontal d (straight b)) (Finsupp.single (pair a b x y) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (pair a' b x' y) 1 := by
  change (d.interpret.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id b).eval).toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, hd,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

private theorem last_column {a b c b' c' : Word K K}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (b.tensor c) (b'.tensor c'))
    (x : a.basis.carrier) (y : b.basis.carrier) (z : c.basis.carrier)
    (y' : b'.basis.carrier) (z' : c'.basis.carrier)
    (hd : run d (Finsupp.single (pair b c y z) 1) = Finsupp.single (pair b' c' y' z') 1) :
    run (last a d) (Finsupp.single (pair (a.tensor b) c (pair a b x y) z) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (pair (a.tensor b') c' (pair a b' x y') z') 1 := by
  change (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) a b' c').eval.toLinearMap
    (((Diagram.id a).eval.horizontal d.interpret.eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.associate (R := Complex) a b c).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (pair (a.tensor b) c (pair a b x y) z) 1))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, hd, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_unassociate_single]

private theorem singleton_eval {a b : Word K K} (d : Diagram Complex a b)
    (x : a.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, ScopedDiagram.ordinary d)]).eval.toLinearMap x =
      d.eval.toLinearMap x := by
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, one_smul, add_zero]
  rfl

variable (K)
private noncomputable abbrev mixed (p : K) :=
  LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (weight K p).terms

private noncomputable abbrev parallel (p : K) :=
  LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (weight K p).terms

private theorem mixed_column (p x y : K) :
    run (mixed K p) (Finsupp.single (pair (up K) (down K) x y) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (pair (down K) (up K) (x * p * y) 1) 1 := by
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination ((weight K p).terms.map fun (c, d) =>
    (c, .ordinary (.mixedMultiplication (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) d)))).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [terms_weight]
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary
    (.mixedMultiplication (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (dot K p)))]).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [singleton_eval]
  change (Generator.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K)
    (dot K p)).toLinearMap _ = _
  unfold Generator.mixedMultiplication
  rw [Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single]
  -- The route's mixedMultiplicationBasis is defined on the balanced quotient.
  rfl

private theorem parallel_column (p x y : K) :
    run (parallel K p) (Finsupp.single (pair (up K) (up K) x y) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (pair (up K) (up K) (x * y * p) 1) 1 := by
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination ((weight K p).terms.map fun (c, d) =>
    (c, .ordinary (.parallelUp (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) d)))).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [terms_weight]
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary
    (.parallelUp (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (emb K) (dot K p)))]).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [singleton_eval, Diagram.parallelUp, Diagram.eval_vertical_apply,
    Diagram.eval_vertical_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single]
  have hd : (weight K p).upDrawing.interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (x * y) 1) = ((weight K p).terms.map fun (c, d) =>
        c • Finsupp.single (x * y * d.element) (1 : Complex)).sum := by
    simpa only [DotLabel.terms, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using
      DotLabel.upDrawing_basis (weight K p) (x * y)
  rw [terms_weight] at hd
  have hdot : (Diagram.upDot (R := Complex) (dot K p)).eval.toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (x * y) 1) = Finsupp.single (x * y * p) 1 := by
    rw [DotLabel.eval_upDrawing, Diagram.eval_linearUpDot_apply, weight, freeLift_single,
      one_smul] at hd
    simpa only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, one_smul, add_zero, dot]
      using hd
  change (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) (emb K) (emb K)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.upDot (dot K p)).eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (x * y) 1)) = _
  rw [hdot, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single]

private noncomputable def left (p q r : K) : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom K) (top K) :=
  .vertical (.horizontal (parallel K p) (straight (down K)))
    (.vertical (last (up K) (mixed K q)) (.horizontal (mixed K r) (straight (up K))))

private noncomputable def right (p q r : K) : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom K) (top K) :=
  .vertical (last (up K) (mixed K p))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (mixed K q) (straight (up K))) (last (down K) (parallel K r)))

private abbrev triple {K : Subgroup U} (a b c : Word K K) (x : a.basis.carrier) (y : b.basis.carrier)
    (z : c.basis.carrier) := pair (a.tensor b) c (pair a b x y) z

private theorem left_column (p q r x y z : K) :
    run (left K p q r) (Finsupp.single (triple (up K) (up K) (down K) x y z) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (triple (down K) (up K) (up K) (x * y * p * r * (q * z)) 1 1) 1 := by
  unfold left
  rw [stack_apply, stack_apply]
  rw [first_column (b := down K) (parallel K p) _ _ z (parallel_column K p x y)]
  rw [last_column (a := up K) (b := up K) (c := down K) (b' := down K) (c' := up K)
    (mixed K q) (x * y * p) 1 z _ _ (mixed_column K q 1 z)]
  rw [first_column (b := up K) (mixed K r) _ _ 1
    (mixed_column K r (x * y * p) (1 * q * z))]
  rw [one_mul]

private theorem right_column (p q r x y z : K) :
    run (right K p q r) (Finsupp.single (triple (up K) (up K) (down K) x y z) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (triple (down K) (up K) (up K) (x * q * (y * p * z)) r 1) 1 := by
  unfold right
  rw [stack_apply, stack_apply]
  rw [last_column (a := up K) (b := up K) (c := down K) (b' := down K) (c' := up K)
    (mixed K p) x y z _ _ (mixed_column K p y z)]
  rw [first_column (b := up K) (mixed K q) _ _ 1 (mixed_column K q x (y * p * z))]
  rw [last_column (a := down K) (b := up K) (c := up K) (b' := up K) (c' := up K)
    (parallel K r) (x * q * (y * p * z)) 1 1 _ _ (parallel_column K r 1 1)]
  simp only [one_mul]

private abbrev split : LabelledDrawing Complex
    ((Word.up (composed K)).tensor (down K)) (bottom K) :=
  .horizontal (.trivalent (.splitUp (emb K) (emb K))) (straight (down K))

private abbrev merge : LabelledDrawing Complex (top K)
    ((down K).tensor (Word.up (composed K))) :=
  .vertical (.ordinary (.associate (down K) (up K) (up K)))
    (.horizontal (straight (down K)) (.trivalent (.mergeUp (emb K) (emb K))))

private theorem split_column :
    run (split K) (Finsupp.single (pair (Word.up (composed K)) (down K) 1 1) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (triple (up K) (up K) (down K) 1 1 1) 1 := by
  change (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.splitUp (emb K) (emb K))
    (Diagram.id (down K))).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single, Diagram.eval_id_apply,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

private theorem merge_column (x y z : K) :
    run (merge K) (Finsupp.single (triple (down K) (up K) (up K) x y z) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (pair (down K) (Word.up (composed K)) x (y * z)) 1 := by
  change (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (down K))
    (Diagram.mergeUp (emb K) (emb K))).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (down K) (up K) (up K)).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single (triple (down K) (up K) (up K) x y z) 1)) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  rfl

private noncomputable def multiplier (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom K) (top K)) :
    MonoidAlgebra Complex K :=
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedProduct (emb K) (composed K))
    (run (.vertical (split K) (.vertical d (merge K)))
      (Finsupp.single (pair (Word.up (composed K)) (down K) 1 1) 1)))

private theorem left_multiplier (p : K) (hp : p * p = 1) :
    multiplier K (left K p 1 p) = 1 := by
  unfold multiplier
  rw [stack_apply, stack_apply, split_column, left_column, merge_column, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  change MonoidAlgebra.single ((1 * 1 * p * p * (1 * 1)) * (1 * 1)) (1 : Complex) = 1
  simpa only [one_mul, mul_one, hp] using
    (MonoidAlgebra.one_def (R := Complex) (M := K)).symm

private theorem right_multiplier :
    multiplier K (right K 1 1 1) = 1 := by
  unfold multiplier
  rw [stack_apply, stack_apply, split_column, right_column, merge_column, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  change MonoidAlgebra.single (((1 : K) * 1 * (1 * 1 * 1)) * (1 * 1)) (1 : Complex) = 1
  simpa only [one_mul] using (MonoidAlgebra.one_def (R := Complex) (M := K)).symm

private theorem weight_of_one :
    Finsupp.mapDomain (dot K) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex K)) = weight K 1 := by
  rw [MonoidAlgebra.one_def]
  change Finsupp.mapDomain (dot K) (Finsupp.single 1 (1 : Complex)) = _
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

private theorem weight_ne_one (p : K) (hp : p ≠ 1) : weight K p ≠ weight K 1 := by
  intro h
  have hdot : dot K p ≠ dot K 1 := fun hd => hp (congrArg Dot.element hd)
  have hc := congrArg (fun l : DotLabel Complex (composed K) (composed K) => l (dot K p)) h
  simp [weight, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hdot] at hc

private theorem left_same_eval (p : K) (hp : p * p = 1) :
    (left K 1 1 1).interpret.eval = (left K p 1 p).interpret.eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro xyz c
  have h : run (left K 1 1 1) (Finsupp.single xyz 1) =
      run (left K p 1 p) (Finsupp.single xyz 1) := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn xyz (fun ⟨xy, z⟩ => ?_)
    refine Quotient.inductionOn xy (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
    change run (left K 1 1 1) (Finsupp.single (triple (up K) (up K) (down K) x y z) 1) =
      run (left K p 1 p) (Finsupp.single (triple (up K) (up K) (down K) x y z) 1)
    rw [left_column, left_column]
    have hproduct : x * y * p * p * z = x * y * z := by
      rw [show x * y * p * p = x * y * (p * p) from mul_assoc (x * y) p p, hp, mul_one]
    simp only [one_mul, mul_one, hproduct]
  have hs : (Finsupp.single xyz c : (bottom K).basis.carrier →₀ Complex) =
      c • Finsupp.single xyz 1 := by rw [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hs, map_smul, map_smul]
  exact congrArg (c • ·) h

end MixedMultiplicationRoundTrip

OneSidedTableauCosetRepresentatives.proof:
by
  classical
  intro X r c A B hA hB hdA hdB hcA hcB G blockSym K H hH Mat rank
  -- Xiao, Example 7.3 (archived p. 30, 28 November revision p. 32).
  -- The ordered splitting and matching in Proposition 7.3 (steps 1 and 2)
  -- are supplied by ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives. A column of size
  -- one is nonempty, so that theorem applies to both covering partitions.
  obtain ⟨classify, _, hrep⟩ := ParabolicDoubleCosetRepresentatives X r c A B hA
    (fun j => Finset.card_pos.mp (by rw [hB j]; exact Nat.zero_lt_one))
    hdA hdB hcA hcB
  choose rep hclass hrank using hrep
  -- With H = ⊥, the right factor in KσH is 1. Use the quotient equality
  -- criterion in both directions to identify the matrix of a right coset.
  have rightCoset (τ : G) (R : Mat) :
      (∃ k : K, τ = (k : G) * rep R) ↔ R = classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H τ) := by
    have hquot :
        DoubleCoset.mk K H (rep R) = DoubleCoset.mk K H τ ↔
          R = classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H τ) := by
      rw [hclass R, Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rw [← hquot]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      exact DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨k, k.property, 1, H.one_mem, by simpa only [mul_one] using hk⟩
    · intro heq
      obtain ⟨k, hk, h, hh, he⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp heq
      rw [hH, Subgroup.mem_bot] at hh
      exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, by simpa only [hh, mul_one] using he⟩
  refine ⟨rep, hrank, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro τ
    refine ⟨classify (DoubleCoset.mk K H τ), (rightCoset τ _).mpr rfl, ?_⟩
    intro R hR
    exact (rightCoset τ R).mp hR
  · intro τ
    -- Inversion exchanges Kσ and σ⁻¹K and uses the same matrix R.
    have invert (R : Mat) :
        (∃ k : K, τ = (rep R)⁻¹ * (k : G)) ↔
          (∃ k : K, τ⁻¹ = (k : G) * rep R) := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
        exact ⟨k⁻¹, by
          simpa only [Subgroup.coe_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] using congrArg (fun g : G => g⁻¹) hk⟩
      · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
        exact ⟨k⁻¹, by
          simpa only [Subgroup.coe_inv, mul_inv_rev, inv_inv] using congrArg (fun g : G => g⁻¹) hk⟩
    simp_rw [invert, rightCoset]
    exact ⟨_, rfl, fun _ h => h⟩

namespace CaseFiveTwoTermsProof
open MackeyDiagrams
noncomputable section

private abbrev U := Multiplicative (ZMod 2)

private abbrev g : U := Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2)

private abbrev T : Subgroup U := ⊥

private abbrev P : Subgroup U := ⊤

private abbrev a := ConjEmbedding.id T

private abbrev b : ConjEmbedding T P :=
  { toHom := Subgroup.inclusion bot_le
    hasRepresentative := ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩ }

private abbrev p := ConjEmbedding.id P

private abbrev comp := @ConjEmbedding.comp U _

private abbrev up := @Word.up U _

private abbrev down := @Word.down U _

private abbrev tensor := @Word.tensor U _

private abbrev boundary := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up b))

private abbrev openRight := tensor (tensor (up a) (up a)) (down a)

private abbrev apex := tensor (up (comp a a)) (down a)

private abbrev drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (w : Word K H) =>
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) w)

private abbrev associate := fun {K H J F : Subgroup U}
    (x : Word K H) (y : Word H J)
    (z : Word J F) =>
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) x y z)

private abbrev unassociate := fun {K H J F : Subgroup U}
    (x : Word K H) (y : Word H J)
    (z : Word J F) =>
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) x y z)

private abbrev projectionTerm := fun {K H M L : Subgroup U}
    (f : ConjEmbedding K M) (h : ConjEmbedding H M)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (d : Dot (comp f l) (comp h r)) =>
  ({ dot := d
     finite := fun z => by
       let : Finite U := inferInstanceAs (Finite (ZMod 2))
       let : Finite ((Word.basis (tensor (up l) (down r))).carrier) := by
         change Finite (Quotient (Biset.balance
           (Biset.induction l) (Biset.restriction r)))
         infer_instance
       exact Set.toFinite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis f h l r d w = z}
    } : ProjectionDot.Mixed f h l r)

private abbrev leftUnit : Dot (comp b a) (comp p b) :=
  { element := 1
    intertwines := fun h => by
      have hh : h = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      simp [hh] }

private abbrev leftDrawing := fun
    (r : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp p b))
    (t : DotLabel Complex (comp p b) (comp p b))
    (s : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp p b)) =>
  let lower := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication b p a b
    (DotLabel.terms r)
  let middle := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp p b p b
    (DotLabel.terms t)
  let upper := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b p a b
    (List.map (fun cs => (cs.1, projectionTerm b p a b cs.2)) (DotLabel.terms s))
  (LabelledDrawing.vertical (unassociate (up a) (down b) (up b))
    (LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (LabelledDrawing.horizontal lower (drawId (up b)))
      (LabelledDrawing.vertical (associate (down b) (up p) (up b))
        (LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down b)) middle)
          (LabelledDrawing.vertical (unassociate (down b) (up p) (up b))
            (LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (LabelledDrawing.horizontal upper (drawId (up b)))
              (associate (up a) (down b) (up b))))))) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex boundary boundary)

private abbrev left := leftDrawing (Finsupp.single leftUnit 1)
  (DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) (comp p b)) (Finsupp.single leftUnit 1)

private abbrev rightBelow := fun (r : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a)) =>
  let lower := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b b a a
    (List.map (fun cr => (cr.1, projectionTerm b b a a cr.2)) (DotLabel.terms r))
  (LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (up a)) lower)
    (unassociate (up a) (up a) (down a)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex boundary openRight)

private abbrev rightAbove := fun
    (t : DotLabel Complex (comp a a) (comp a a))
    (s : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a)) =>
  let middle := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a a a a (DotLabel.terms t)
  let upper := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication b b a a (DotLabel.terms s)
  (LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (LabelledDrawing.horizontal middle (drawId (down a)))
    (LabelledDrawing.vertical (associate (up a) (up a) (down a))
      (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (up a)) upper)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex openRight boundary)

private abbrev rightDrawing := fun
    (r : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a))
    (t : DotLabel Complex (comp a a) (comp a a))
    (s : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a)) =>
  LabelledDrawing.vertical (rightBelow r) (rightAbove t s)

private abbrev eval := fun {w w' : Word T T} (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex w w') =>
  Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
    (ScopedDiagram.eval (LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))

private abbrev mergeToApex : Diagram Complex openRight apex :=
  Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp a a)
    (Diagram.id (down a))

private abbrev splitFromApex : Diagram Complex apex openRight :=
  Diagram.horizontal (Diagram.splitUp a a)
    (Diagram.id (down a))

private abbrev toApex := fun r => LinearMap.comp
  (Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (Diagram.eval mergeToApex))
  (eval (rightBelow r))

private abbrev fromApex := fun t s => LinearMap.comp (eval (rightAbove t s))
  (Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (Diagram.eval splitFromApex))

private abbrev rightDot := fun x : U =>
  ({ element := Subgroup.topEquiv.symm x
     intertwines := fun h => by
       have hh : h = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
       simp [hh] } : Dot (comp b a) (comp b a))

private abbrev singletonRight := fun r s : U =>
  rightDrawing (Finsupp.single (rightDot r) 1)
    (DotLabel.identity (R := Complex) (comp a a)) (Finsupp.single (rightDot s) 1)

private abbrev basis := fun x : U =>
  Finsupp.single
    (Biset.pair (Biset.induction a)
      (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b))) 1
      (Generator.mixedPair b b (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm x))) (1 : Complex)

private abbrev shortcut (x : P) : boundary.basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction a).pair (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b))) 1
    (Generator.mixedPair b b x)

private theorem shortcut_surjective : Function.Surjective shortcut := by
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun xy => ?_)
  obtain ⟨u, y⟩ := xy
  have hu : u = (1 : T) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst u
  exact ⟨Generator.mixedProduct b b y, congrArg
    ((Biset.induction a).pair _ 1) (Generator.mixedPair_mixedProduct b b y)⟩

private theorem shortcut_injective : Function.Injective shortcut := by
  intro x y h
  have he := congrArg (Biset.leftUnitBasis (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b)))) h
  change (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b))).act 1 (Generator.mixedPair b b x) =
    (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b))).act 1 (Generator.mixedPair b b y) at he
  simp only [Biset.one_act] at he
  exact (Generator.mixedEquiv b b).symm.injective he

private theorem basis_ext {A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] [Module Complex A]
    {f h : (boundary.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] A}
    (onBasis : ∀ x, f (basis x) = h (basis x)) : f = h := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro z
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := shortcut_surjective z
  exact onBasis (Subgroup.topEquiv x)

private theorem terms_one {H K : Subgroup U} {e f : ConjEmbedding H K} (d : Dot e f) :
    DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex)) = [(1, d)] := by
  classical
  simp [DotLabel.terms]

private theorem lift_fiber_left (x : P) :
    {w | Generator.mixedProduct b p (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b p a b leftUnit w) = x} =
      {(Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) 1 x} := by
  ext w
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun xy => ?_)
  obtain ⟨u, y⟩ := xy
  have hu : u = (1 : T) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst u
  change Generator.mixedProduct b p (Generator.mixedPair b p (b.toHom 1 * 1 * p.toHom y)) = x ↔
    ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) 1 y) ∈
      ({(Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) 1 x} : Set _)
  simp only [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair, map_one, one_mul, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  change y = x ↔ _
  constructor
  · exact congrArg ((Biset.induction a).pair _ 1)
  · intro h
    have hxy := congrArg (Biset.leftUnitBasis (Biset.restriction b)) h
    change b.toHom 1 * y * (1 : P)⁻¹ = b.toHom 1 * x * (1 : P)⁻¹ at hxy
    simpa using hxy

private abbrev xP (x : U) : P := Subgroup.topEquiv.symm x

private abbrev leftFiber (z : P) :=
  {w | Generator.mixedProduct b p (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b p a b leftUnit w) = z}

private theorem finite_leftFiber (z : P) : (leftFiber z).Finite := by
  change {w | Generator.mixedProduct b p
    (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b p a b leftUnit w) = z}.Finite
  rw [lift_fiber_left]
  exact Set.finite_singleton _

private abbrev pairWord := tensor (up a) (down b)

private abbrev leftPoint (x : U) := pairWord.basis.pair (Biset.induction b)
  ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) 1 (xP x)) 1

private abbrev nativeLeft :=
  LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication b p a b [(1, leftUnit)])
      (drawId (up b)))
    (LabelledDrawing.vertical (associate (down b) (up p) (up b))
      (LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down b))
          (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp p b p b [(1, Dot.id (comp p b))]))
        (LabelledDrawing.vertical (unassociate (down b) (up p) (up b))
          (LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b p a b [(1, projectionTerm b p a b leftUnit)])
            (drawId (up b))))))

-- Equation (6.3), steps 1–3 of the compiled left-shape calculation.
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem native_left_column (x : U) :
    eval nativeLeft (Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1) = Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1 := by
  classical
  have h := ((EvaluationWithOneProjection a b b a b b).1 b p p).1
    leftUnit (Dot.id (comp p b)) leftUnit finite_leftFiber 1 (xP x)
  let z := b.toHom 1 * leftUnit.element * p.toHom (xP x) * (Dot.id (comp p b)).element
  change eval nativeLeft (Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1) =
    ∑ w ∈ (finite_leftFiber z).toFinset,
      Finsupp.single (pairWord.basis.pair (Biset.induction b) w 1) 1 at h
  have hz : z = xP x := by
    change b.toHom 1 * 1 * xP x * 1 = _
    simp
  have hfinite : (finite_leftFiber (xP x)).toFinset =
      {(Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction b) 1 (xP x)} := by
    ext w
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    rw [show leftFiber (xP x) = _ from lift_fiber_left (xP x)]
    simp
  rw [hz, hfinite, Finset.sum_singleton] at h
  exact h

private abbrev leftIn := unassociate (up a) (down b) (up b)
private abbrev leftOut := associate (up a) (down b) (up b)

-- Prove the reassociation with the evaluated crossings left symbolic.
private theorem frame_eval {V : Type*} [Group V] {H K : Subgroup V}
    {w₀ w₁ w₂ w₃ w₄ w₅ w₆ w₇ : Word H K}
    (d₀ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₀ w₁) (d₁ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₁ w₂)
    (d₂ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₂ w₃) (d₃ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₃ w₄)
    (d₄ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₄ w₅) (d₅ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₅ w₆)
    (d₆ : LabelledDrawing Complex w₆ w₇) :
    (d₀.vertical (d₁.vertical (d₂.vertical (d₃.vertical (d₄.vertical (d₅.vertical d₆)))))).interpret.eval =
      (d₀.interpret.eval.vertical
        (d₁.vertical (d₂.vertical (d₃.vertical (d₄.vertical d₅)))).interpret.eval).vertical
        d₆.interpret.eval := by
  simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc]

set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem left_stack :
    left.interpret.eval =
      (leftIn.interpret.eval.vertical nativeLeft.interpret.eval).vertical leftOut.interpret.eval := by
  let d₁ := LabelledDrawing.horizontal (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication b p a b [(1, leftUnit)])
    (drawId (up b))
  let d₂ := associate (down b) (up p) (up b)
  let d₃ := LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down b))
    (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp p b p b [(1, Dot.id (comp p b))])
  let d₄ := unassociate (down b) (up p) (up b)
  let d₅ := LabelledDrawing.horizontal
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b p a b [(1, projectionTerm b p a b leftUnit)])
    (drawId (up b))
  let framed := leftIn.vertical (d₁.vertical (d₂.vertical (d₃.vertical (d₄.vertical
    (d₅.vertical leftOut)))))
  have syntaxEq : left = framed := by
    unfold left leftDrawing DotLabel.identity framed d₁ d₂ d₃ d₄ d₅ leftIn leftOut
    simp only [terms_one, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
  calc
    left.interpret.eval = framed.interpret.eval :=
      congrArg (fun d : LabelledDrawing Complex boundary boundary => d.interpret.eval) syntaxEq
    _ = _ := frame_eval leftIn d₁ d₂ d₃ d₄ d₅ leftOut

-- The associators carry the same representatives to and from the
-- supplier's left-associated tensor word.
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem left_column (x : U) : eval left (basis x) = basis x := by
  have hi : eval leftIn (basis x) = Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1 :=
    Diagram.eval_unassociate_single (R := Complex) (up a) (down b) (up b) 1 (xP x) 1 1
  have ho : eval leftOut (Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1) = basis x :=
    Diagram.eval_associate_single (R := Complex) (up a) (down b) (up b) 1 (xP x) 1 1
  calc
    eval left (basis x) = eval leftOut (eval nativeLeft (eval leftIn (basis x))) :=
      congrArg (fun m : Biset.Hom Complex boundary.basis boundary.basis => m.toLinearMap (basis x))
        left_stack
    _ = eval leftOut (eval nativeLeft (Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1)) :=
      congrArg (fun v => eval leftOut (eval nativeLeft v)) hi
    _ = eval leftOut (Finsupp.single (leftPoint x) 1) :=
      congrArg (fun v => eval leftOut v) (native_left_column x)
    _ = basis x := ho

private theorem lower_fiber (r x : U) :
    {w | Generator.mixedProduct b b (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b b a a (rightDot r) w) = xP x} =
      if x = r then {(Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) 1 1} else ∅ := by
  classical
  ext w
  refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun xy => ?_)
  have hxy : xy = (1, 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hxy]
  change Generator.mixedProduct b b (Generator.mixedPair b b (b.toHom 1 * xP r * b.toHom 1)) =
    xP x ↔ (Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) 1 1 ∈
      (if x = r then {(Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) 1 1} else ∅)
  simp only [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  by_cases hx : x = r
  · subst x
    simp
  · simp [hx, show xP r ≠ xP x from fun h => hx (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm.injective h).symm]

-- Equation (6.4), steps 1–3 of the compiled right-shape calculation.
-- The first crossing has a single possible preimage; the upper multiplication
-- inserts its own label independently of the label that selected the input.
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem right_column (r s x : U) :
    eval (singletonRight r s) (basis x) = if x = r then basis s else 0 := by
  classical
  let fiber (z : P) :=
    {w | Generator.mixedProduct b b (Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b b a a (rightDot r) w) = z}
  have hf (z : P) : (fiber z).Finite := by
    have h := lower_fiber r (Subgroup.topEquiv z)
    change fiber z = _ at h
    rw [h]
    split
    · exact Set.finite_singleton _
    · exact Set.finite_empty
  have h := ((EvaluationWithOneProjection a b b a b b).2 T a a a).1
    (rightDot r) hf (Dot.id (comp a a)) (rightDot s) 1 (xP x)
  let lowerPoint := (Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.restriction a) 1 1
  have hNative : eval (singletonRight r s) (basis x) =
      ∑ w ∈ (hf (xP x)).toFinset, Finsupp.single
        ((Biset.induction a).pair (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b)))
          (1 * a.toHom (Quotient.out w).1 * (Dot.id (comp a a)).element)
          (Generator.mixedPair b b ((rightDot s).element * b.toHom (Quotient.out w).2))) 1 := by
    unfold singletonRight rightDrawing rightBelow rightAbove DotLabel.identity
    simp only [terms_one, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    exact h
  have hPoint (w : (Word.basis (tensor (up a) (down a))).carrier) :
      Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up b)))
        (1 * a.toHom (Quotient.out w).1 * (Dot.id (comp a a)).element)
        (Generator.mixedPair b b ((rightDot s).element * b.toHom (Quotient.out w).2)))
        (1 : Complex) = basis s := by
    rw [show (Quotient.out w).1 = (1 : T) from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
      show (Quotient.out w).2 = (1 : T) from Subsingleton.elim _ _]
    simp only [map_one, mul_one, Dot.id]
  have hfinite : (hf (xP x)).toFinset = if x = r then {lowerPoint} else ∅ := by
    ext w
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    rw [show fiber (xP x) = _ from lower_fiber r x]
    by_cases hx : x = r <;> simp [hx, lowerPoint]
  rw [hNative, hfinite]
  by_cases hx : x = r
  · simp only [hx, ite_true, Finset.sum_singleton, hPoint]
  · simp only [hx, ite_false, Finset.sum_empty]

private def apex_equiv : apex.basis.carrier ≃ Unit := by
  let z : apex.basis.carrier :=
    (Biset.induction (comp a a)).pair (Biset.restriction a) 1 1
  refine ⟨fun _ => (), fun _ => z, ?_, fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  intro v
  refine Quotient.inductionOn v (fun xy => ?_)
  have hxy : xy = (1, 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  exact congrArg (Quotient.mk _) hxy.symm

private theorem merge_split :
    mergeToApex.eval.vertical splitFromApex.eval = Biset.Hom.id openRight.basis := by
  change ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a a).eval.horizontal
      (Biset.Hom.id ((down a).basis))).vertical
    ((Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a a).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id ((down a).basis))) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  change ((Diagram.vertical (Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a a) (Diagram.splitUp a a)).eval).horizontal
    (Biset.Hom.id ((down a).basis)) = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

-- The intermediate word still has three wires. Merge and split give the
-- article's shorter basis model of the same intermediate linear space.
-- For Step 4 the same factorization works for all three finite linear labels,
-- since each whole crossing is already a linear map with this typed boundary.
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem factor (r : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a))
    (t : DotLabel Complex (comp a a) (comp a a))
    (s : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a)) :
    eval (rightDrawing r t s) = LinearMap.comp (fromApex t s) (toApex r) := by
  have h (v : openRight.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      splitFromApex.eval.toLinearMap (mergeToApex.eval.toLinearMap v) = v := by
    exact congrArg (fun f : Biset.Hom Complex openRight.basis openRight.basis => f.toLinearMap v)
      merge_split
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  change eval (rightAbove t s) (eval (rightBelow r) v) =
    eval (rightAbove t s)
      (splitFromApex.eval.toLinearMap (mergeToApex.eval.toLinearMap (eval (rightBelow r) v)))
  rw [h]

private theorem g_ne_one : g ≠ 1 := by
  change (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0
  decide

private theorem two_elements (x : U) : x = 1 ∨ x = g := by
  let y : Fin 2 := x
  change y = 0 ∨ y = 1
  have hy := y.isLt
  have hy' : y.val = 0 ∨ y.val = 1 := by omega
  exact hy'.imp (fun h => Fin.ext h) (fun h => Fin.ext h)

-- The two basis columns are independent. Any composite through the apex
-- would express both as scalar multiples of the same column.
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem apex_obstruction
    (A : (boundary.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (apex.basis.carrier →₀ Complex))
    (B : (apex.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (boundary.basis.carrier →₀ Complex)) :
    B.comp A ≠ eval left := by
  classical
  let z := apex_equiv.symm ()
  let v := B (Finsupp.single z 1)
  have hscale (w : apex.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      w = w z • Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex) := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro q
    have hq : q = z := apex_equiv.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    subst q
    simp
  intro h
  have hcol (x : U) : (A (basis x)) z • v = basis x := by
    calc
      (A (basis x)) z • v = B (A (basis x)) := by
        rw [← map_smul]
        exact congrArg B (hscale (A (basis x))).symm
      _ = eval left (basis x) := LinearMap.congr_fun h (basis x)
      _ = basis x := left_column x
  have hx : shortcut (xP g) ≠ shortcut (xP 1) := by
    exact fun h => g_ne_one (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm.injective (shortcut_injective h))
  have eval_one := congrArg (fun w : boundary.basis.carrier →₀ Complex =>
    w (shortcut (xP 1))) (hcol 1)
  have eval_cross := congrArg (fun w : boundary.basis.carrier →₀ Complex =>
    w (shortcut (xP 1))) (hcol g)
  have eval_g := congrArg (fun w : boundary.basis.carrier →₀ Complex =>
    w (shortcut (xP g))) (hcol g)
  change (A (basis 1)) z * v (shortcut (xP 1)) =
    Finsupp.single (shortcut (xP 1)) 1 (shortcut (xP 1)) at eval_one
  change (A (basis g)) z * v (shortcut (xP 1)) =
    Finsupp.single (shortcut (xP g)) 1 (shortcut (xP 1)) at eval_cross
  change (A (basis g)) z * v (shortcut (xP g)) =
    Finsupp.single (shortcut (xP g)) 1 (shortcut (xP g)) at eval_g
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at eval_one eval_g
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hx.symm] at eval_cross
  exact (mul_ne_zero (left_ne_zero_of_mul (eval_g.trans_ne one_ne_zero))
    (right_ne_zero_of_mul (eval_one.trans_ne one_ne_zero))) eval_cross

-- The two disjoint diagonal matrix units sum to the identity on the basis.
set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
private theorem two_term_identity :
    eval left = eval (LabelledDrawing.add (singletonRight 1 1) (singletonRight g g)) := by
  classical
  apply basis_ext
  intro x
  change eval left (basis x) =
    eval (singletonRight 1 1) (basis x) + eval (singletonRight g g) (basis x)
  rw [left_column, right_column, right_column]
  by_cases hx : x = 1
  · subst x
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm g_ne_one), add_zero]
  · have hg : x = g := (two_elements x).resolve_left hx
    rw [ite_eq_right hx, ite_eq_left hg, zero_add]
    exact congrArg basis hg

private theorem main_result :
    eval left = LinearMap.id ∧
      Nonempty (apex.basis.carrier ≃ Unit) ∧
      (∀ (r : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a))
          (t : DotLabel Complex (comp a a) (comp a a))
          (s : DotLabel Complex (comp b a) (comp b a)),
        eval (rightDrawing r t s) = (fromApex t s).comp (toApex r) ∧
        eval (rightDrawing r t s) ≠ eval left) ∧
      eval left = eval (LabelledDrawing.add (singletonRight 1 1) (singletonRight g g)) ∧
      (∀ r s x : U, eval (singletonRight r s) (basis x) = if x = r then basis s else 0) := by
  refine ⟨basis_ext left_column, ⟨apex_equiv⟩, ?_, two_term_identity, right_column⟩
  intro r t s
  refine ⟨factor r t s, ?_⟩
  rw [factor r t s]
  exact apex_obstruction (toApex r) (fromApex t s)

end
end CaseFiveTwoTermsProof

MackeyConjugationExchangesFactors.proof:
by
  intro X G interval blockSym A B K point σ L conjugate
  -- Xiao, Example 7.5 (archived PDF p. 31, 28 November revision p. 33).
  -- Alphabeta Math §7.2, steps 1 and 2, split the row and column blocks
  -- into pieces of the matrix sizes and match corresponding pieces in order.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-double-cosets
  -- Here the row and column partitions are both (1–2, 3–4), each covering X
  -- with disjoint nonempty blocks. At i = 2 only the two off-diagonal cells
  -- remain. Section 7.3 uses the reverse-pairing representative for those
  -- cells. Specialize EqualTwoBlockSubgroups to certify that choice and L.
  have memInterval (lo hi : Nat) (x : ↥X) :
      x ∈ interval lo hi ↔ lo ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ hi := by
    change x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun y : ↥X => lo ≤ y.val ∧ y.val ≤ hi) ↔ _
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  have bounds (x : ↥X) : 1 ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ 4 :=
    Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property
  have hL : L = K := by
    obtain ⟨left, right, reps, labels, zero, step, _, intersections⟩ :=
      EqualTwoBlockSubgroups 2 2 (by decide) (by decide)
    have left0 : left 0 = point 2 (by decide) := Subtype.ext (labels 0).1
    have right0 : right 0 = point 3 (by decide) := Subtype.ext (labels 0).2
    have left1 : left 1 = point 1 (by decide) := Subtype.ext (labels 1).1
    have right1 : right 1 = point 4 (by decide) := Subtype.ext (labels 1).2
    have step0 : reps 1 = Equiv.swap (left 0) (right 0) * reps 0 := step 0
    have step1 : reps 2 = Equiv.swap (left 1) (right 1) * reps 1 := step 1
    have hrep : reps 2 = σ := by
      rw [step1, step0, zero, mul_one, left0, right0, left1, right1]
    let blocks : Fin 2 → Subgroup G := fun r =>
      blockSym (if r = 0 then interval 1 2 else interval 3 4)
    have hblocks : (⨆ r, blocks r) = K := by
      change (⨆ r, blocks r) = blocks 0 ⊔ blocks 1
      refine le_antisymm (iSup_le ?_) (sup_le (le_iSup blocks 0) (le_iSup blocks 1))
      intro r
      fin_cases r
      · exact le_sup_left
      · exact le_sup_right
    have emptyFactor (lo hi : Nat) (h : hi < lo) : blockSym (interval lo hi) = ⊥ := by
      apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
      rintro _ ⟨f, rfl⟩
      apply Subgroup.mem_bot.mpr
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro x
      apply Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem
      intro hx
      have := (memInterval lo hi x).mp hx
      omega
    have intersection := (intersections (2 : Fin 3)).1
    change (⨆ r, blocks r) ⊓
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (reps 2))) (⨆ r, blocks r) =
      ((blockSym (interval 1 0) ⊔ A) ⊔ B) ⊔ blockSym (interval 5 4) at intersection
    rw [hblocks, hrep, emptyFactor 1 0 (by decide), emptyFactor 5 4 (by decide),
      bot_sup_eq, sup_bot_eq] at intersection
    exact intersection
  -- Compute the action on the concrete factor inclusions by evaluating the
  -- representative and transporting the subgroup supported in each interval.
  let perm : Equiv.Perm ↥X := σ
  have reflect (x : ↥X) : (perm x).val = 5 - x.val := by
    have hx := bounds x
    have labels : x.val = 1 ∨ x.val = 2 ∨ x.val = 3 ∨ x.val = 4 := by omega
    change ((Equiv.swap (point 1 (by decide)) (point 4 (by decide)) *
      Equiv.swap (point 2 (by decide)) (point 3 (by decide))) x).val = _
    rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply]
    simp only [Equiv.swap_apply_def]
    rcases labels with h | h | h | h
    · have hx' : x = point 1 (by decide) := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hx']
      decide
    · have hx' : x = point 2 (by decide) := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hx']
      decide
    · have hx' : x = point 3 (by decide) := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hx']
      decide
    · have hx' : x = point 4 (by decide) := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hx']
      decide
  have hinv : perm⁻¹ = perm := by
    apply inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    change perm (perm x) = x
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [reflect, reflect]
    have := bounds x
    omega
  let _ : MulAction (Equiv.Perm ↥X) (Finset ↥X) := Finset.mulActionFinset
  have blockImage (lo hi : Nat) :
      perm • interval lo hi = interval (5 - hi) (5 - lo) := by
    ext x
    rw [← Finset.inv_smul_mem_iff, hinv, memInterval, memInterval]
    change lo ≤ (perm x).val ∧ (perm x).val ≤ hi ↔
      5 - hi ≤ x.val ∧ x.val ≤ 5 - lo
    rw [reflect]
    have := bounds x
    omega
  have transport (lo hi : Nat) :
      Subgroup.map conjugate (blockSym (interval lo hi)) =
        blockSym (interval (5 - hi) (5 - lo)) := by
    have h := Equiv.Perm.conj_smul_range_ofSubtype perm (interval lo hi)
    change Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj perm))
      (blockSym (interval lo hi)) = blockSym (perm • interval lo hi) at h
    rw [blockImage] at h
    change Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj perm⁻¹))
        (blockSym (interval lo hi)) = _
    rwa [hinv]
  have hAB : Subgroup.map conjugate A = B := transport 1 2
  have hBA : Subgroup.map conjugate B = A := transport 3 4
  refine ⟨hL, ?_, hAB, hBA⟩
  rw [hL]
  change Subgroup.map conjugate (A ⊔ B) = A ⊔ B
  -- The reviewed two-factor join is binary, so use map_sup here.
  rw [Subgroup.map_sup, hAB, hBA, sup_comm]

ProductParabolicsWithOneDoubleCoset.proof:
by
  intro S₂ S₄ G split P T K H
  -- Xiao, Example 7.6 (archived p. 31; published 28 November revision p. 33).
  -- Alphabeta Math's numbered construction in §7.2, steps 1–2, uses
  -- ordered cells to choose a tableau representative. In each coordinate
  -- one side is the whole block, so the cell pieces on that side are the
  -- two consecutive pairs on the other side. Matching in order gives 1.
  -- ProductParabolicDoubleCosets takes subgroups defined by partitions of
  -- a finite set in Perm Nat. For these explicit product subgroups, realize
  -- its componentwise argument by supplying the factors of every element.
  have class_one {L R : Subgroup S₄} (factor : ∀ g : S₄, ∃ l ∈ L, ∃ r ∈ R, g = l * r) :
      ∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (L : Set S₄) (R : Set S₄),
        q = DoubleCoset.mk L R 1 := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨l, hl, r, hr, h⟩ := factor q.out
    exact (DoubleCoset.out_eq' q).symm.trans
      ((DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨l, hl, r, hr, by simpa only [mul_one] using h⟩).symm)
  have both (q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G)) :
      q = DoubleCoset.mk K H 1 := by
    let g : G := q.out
    refine (DoubleCoset.out_eq' q).symm.trans (Eq.symm (DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ?_))
    refine ⟨(1, g.2), ⟨P.one_mem, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩,
      (g.1, 1), ⟨Subgroup.mem_top _, P.one_mem⟩, ?_⟩
    change g = (1, g.2) * 1 * (g.1, 1)
    apply Prod.ext
    · change g.1 = 1 * 1 * g.1
      simp only [one_mul]
    · change g.2 = g.2 * 1 * 1
      simp only [mul_one]
  -- ParabolicMackeyIntersectionBlocks computes intersections in a single
  -- symmetric group from two covering partitions and a conjugator. Here
  -- the conjugator is 1 and membership in the product gives the intersection.
  have intersection : K ⊓ H = Subgroup.prod P P := by
    apply Subgroup.ext
    intro g
    change (g.1 ∈ P ∧ g.2 ∈ T) ∧ (g.1 ∈ T ∧ g.2 ∈ P) ↔ g.1 ∈ P ∧ g.2 ∈ P
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.2.2⟩,
      fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, ⟨Subgroup.mem_top _, h.2⟩⟩⟩
  refine ⟨class_one (fun g => ⟨1, P.one_mem, g, Subgroup.mem_top _, (one_mul g).symm⟩),
    class_one (fun g => ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top _, 1, P.one_mem, (mul_one g).symm⟩),
    both, intersection, ?_⟩
  -- Each copy of P acts independently on its two disjoint Fin 2 blocks.
  have split_injective : Function.Injective split :=
    (Equiv.permCongrHom (finSumFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 2))).injective.comp
      Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom_injective
  let blockEquiv : (S₂ × S₂) ≃* P := MonoidHom.ofInjective split_injective
  exact ⟨(MulEquiv.subgroupCongr intersection).trans
    ((Subgroup.prodEquiv P P).trans (MulEquiv.prodCongr blockEquiv.symm blockEquiv.symm))⟩
