private abbrev threeCosetsRange {α : Type*} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Subgroup (Equiv.Perm α) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := p))

private theorem threeCosetsRange_mem {α : Type*} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (f : Equiv.Perm α) : f ∈ threeCosetsRange p ↔ ∀ x, ¬p x → f x = x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩ x hx
    exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem g hx
  · intro hf
    let g := Equiv.Perm.subtypeEquivSubtypePerm p
    exact ⟨g.symm ⟨f, hf⟩, congrArg Subtype.val (g.apply_symm_apply ⟨f, hf⟩)⟩

private abbrev threeCosetsHalf (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) (upper : Bool) :
    Subgroup (Equiv.Perm ↥X) :=
  threeCosetsRange (fun x : ↥X =>
    x ∈ Finset.filter (fun y : ↥X => if upper then m < y.val else y.val ≤ m) Finset.univ)

private abbrev threeCosetsSplit (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm ↥X) :=
  threeCosetsHalf X m false ⊔ threeCosetsHalf X m true

private theorem threeCosetsHalf_mem (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) (f : Equiv.Perm ↥X) :
    (f ∈ threeCosetsHalf X m false ↔ ∀ x : ↥X, m < x.val → f x = x) ∧
    (f ∈ threeCosetsHalf X m true ↔ ∀ x : ↥X, x.val ≤ m → f x = x) := by
  constructor <;> rw [threeCosetsRange_mem] <;> simp [Finset.mem_filter]

private theorem threeCosetsSplit_mem (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) (f : Equiv.Perm ↥X) :
    f ∈ threeCosetsSplit X m ↔ ∀ x : ↥X, (f x).val ≤ m ↔ x.val ≤ m := by
  let p := fun x : ↥X => x.val ≤ m
  let S : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm ↥X) :=
    { carrier := { g | ∀ x, p (g x) ↔ p x }
      one_mem' := fun _ => Iff.rfl
      mul_mem' := fun hg hh x => (hg _).trans (hh x)
      inv_mem' := fun {g} hg x => by
        change p (g.symm x) ↔ p x
        rw [← hg (g.symm x), g.apply_symm_apply] }
  have low (x : ↥X) : (x ∈ Finset.filter p Finset.univ) ↔ p x := by simp
  have high (x : ↥X) : (x ∈ Finset.filter (fun y => m < y.val) Finset.univ) ↔ ¬p x := by
    simp [p]
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hle : threeCosetsSplit X m ≤ S := by
      apply sup_le
      · rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩ x
        exact (low _).symm.trans ((Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem g x).trans (low _))
      · rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩ x
        apply not_iff_not.mp
        exact (high _).symm.trans ((Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem g x).trans (high _))
    exact hle hf
  · intro hf
    have hlo (x : ↥X) : (f x ∈ Finset.filter p Finset.univ) ↔ x ∈ Finset.filter p Finset.univ :=
      (low _).trans ((hf _).trans (low _).symm)
    have hhi (x : ↥X) : (f x ∈ Finset.filter (fun y => m < y.val) Finset.univ) ↔
        x ∈ Finset.filter (fun y => m < y.val) Finset.univ :=
      (high _).trans ((not_congr (hf _)).trans (high _).symm)
    let a := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (f.subtypePerm hlo)
    let b := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (f.subtypePerm hhi)
    have ha : a ∈ threeCosetsHalf X m false := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hb : b ∈ threeCosetsHalf X m true := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hab : a * b = f := by
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro x
      change a (b x) = f x
      by_cases hx : p x
      · rw [(threeCosetsHalf_mem X m b).2.mp hb x hx]
        exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm_of_mem hlo ((low x).mpr hx)
      · have he : b x = f x :=
          Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm_of_mem hhi ((high x).mpr hx)
        rw [he]
        exact (threeCosetsHalf_mem X m a).1.mp ha _ (Nat.lt_of_not_ge (hx ∘ (hf x).mp))
    rw [← hab]
    have ha' : threeCosetsHalf X m false ≤ threeCosetsSplit X m := le_sup_left
    have hb' : threeCosetsHalf X m true ≤ threeCosetsSplit X m := le_sup_right
    exact (threeCosetsSplit X m).mul_mem (ha' ha) (hb' hb)

private theorem threeCosets_conj_prod {U V : Type*} [Group U] [Group V]
    (A : Subgroup U) (B : Subgroup V) (u : V) :
    (A.prod B).map (MulAut.conj ((1 : U), u)).toMonoidHom =
      A.prod (B.map (MulAut.conj u).toMonoidHom) := by
  ext x
  rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, Subgroup.mem_prod, Subgroup.mem_prod, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv]
  simp [MulAut.conj_symm_apply]

private theorem threeCosets_top_right {U : Type*} [Group U] (A : Subgroup U) :
    Subsingleton (DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set U) (↑(⊤ : Subgroup U))) := by
  constructor
  intro q r
  rw [← DoubleCoset.out_eq' q, ← DoubleCoset.out_eq' r]
  exact DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
    ⟨1, A.one_mem, q.out⁻¹ * r.out, Subgroup.mem_top _, by simp⟩

private theorem threeCosets_top_left {U : Type*} [Group U] (A : Subgroup U) :
    Subsingleton (DoubleCoset.Quotient (↑(⊤ : Subgroup U)) (A : Set U)) := by
  constructor
  intro q r
  rw [← DoubleCoset.out_eq' q, ← DoubleCoset.out_eq' r]
  exact DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
    ⟨r.out * q.out⁻¹, Subgroup.mem_top _, 1, A.one_mem, by simp⟩

-- ProductParabolicDoubleCosets starts with subgroups of Perm Nat and
-- obtains a block splitting. Here G is already the split product, so
-- DoubleCoset.eq gives the coordinate factorization directly. The full
-- factors supply the first two coordinates when assembling the witnesses.
private theorem threeCosets_product {U V W I : Type*} [Group U] [Group V] [Group W]
    (A : Subgroup U) (B : Subgroup V) (C : Subgroup W) (s : I → W)
    (hs : Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk C C (s i))) :
    Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk
      (A.prod ((⊤ : Subgroup V).prod C)) ((⊤ : Subgroup U).prod (B.prod C))
      (1, 1, s i)) := by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    obtain ⟨k, hk, l, hl, he⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp h
    exact hs.1 (DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨k.2.2, hk.2.2, l.2.2, hl.2.2,
      congrArg (fun x : U × V × W => x.2.2) he⟩)
  · intro q
    let x := q.out
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hs.2 (DoubleCoset.mk C C x.2.2)
    obtain ⟨k, hk, l, hl, he⟩ := DoubleCoset.eq.mp hi
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [← DoubleCoset.out_eq' q]
    exact DoubleCoset.eq.mpr
      ⟨(1, x.2.1, k), ⟨A.one_mem, Subgroup.mem_top _, hk⟩,
        (x.1, 1, l), ⟨Subgroup.mem_top _, B.one_mem, hl⟩, Prod.ext (by change x.1 = 1 * 1 * x.1; simp)
          (Prod.ext (by change x.2.1 = x.2.1 * 1 * 1; simp) he)⟩
private abbrev threeCosetsInterval := Finset.Icc (9 : Nat) 12

private def threeCosetsShift : ↥(Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 4) ≃ ↥threeCosetsInterval where
  toFun x := ⟨x.val + 8, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)⟩
  invFun y := ⟨y.val - 8, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp y.property
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)⟩
  left_inv _ := Subtype.ext (Nat.add_sub_cancel _ _)
  right_inv y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have h := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp y.property).1
    change y.val - 8 + 8 = y.val
    omega

private abbrev threeCosetsPoint (n : Nat) (h₁ : 9 ≤ n := by decide)
    (h₂ : n ≤ 12 := by decide) : ↥threeCosetsInterval :=
  ⟨n, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h₁, h₂⟩⟩

private abbrev threeCosetsMiddle : Equiv.Perm ↥threeCosetsInterval :=
  Equiv.swap (threeCosetsPoint 10) (threeCosetsPoint 11)

private abbrev threeCosetsLast : Equiv.Perm ↥threeCosetsInterval :=
  Equiv.swap (threeCosetsPoint 9) (threeCosetsPoint 12) * threeCosetsMiddle

private abbrev threeCosetsRep (i : Fin 3) : Equiv.Perm ↥threeCosetsInterval :=
  if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then threeCosetsMiddle else threeCosetsLast

private theorem threeCosets_congr_swap {α β : Type*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (x y : α) :
    e.permCongrHom (Equiv.swap x y) = Equiv.swap (e x) (e y) := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro z
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := e.surjective z
  change e (Equiv.swap x y (e.symm (e w))) = Equiv.swap (e x) (e y) (e w)
  rw [e.symm_apply_apply, e.injective.swap_apply]

private theorem threeCosets_congr_eq {U V : Type*} [Group U] [Group V]
    (e : U ≃* V) (A : Subgroup U) (B : Subgroup V) (he : ∀ x, e x ∈ B ↔ x ∈ A)
    (x y : U) :
    DoubleCoset.mk B B (e x) = DoubleCoset.mk B B (e y) ↔
      DoubleCoset.mk A A x = DoubleCoset.mk A A y := by
  simp only [DoubleCoset.eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, r, hr, h⟩
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := e.surjective l
    obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := e.surjective r
    exact ⟨l, (he l).mp hl, r, (he r).mp hr, e.injective (by simpa only [map_mul] using h)⟩
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, r, hr, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e l, (he l).mpr hl, e r, (he r).mpr hr, by simp only [map_mul]⟩

private theorem threeCosets_local :
    Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk (threeCosetsSplit threeCosetsInterval 10)
      (threeCosetsSplit threeCosetsInterval 10) (threeCosetsRep i)) := by
  let X := Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 4
  let blocks (i : Fin 2) : Finset ↥X :=
    if i = 0 then Finset.filter (fun y : ↥X => 1 ≤ y.val ∧ y.val ≤ 2) Finset.univ
    else Finset.filter (fun y : ↥X => 3 ≤ y.val ∧ y.val ≤ 4) Finset.univ
  let factors (i : Fin 2) := threeCosetsRange (fun x : ↥X => x ∈ blocks i)
  let T : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm ↥X) := ⨆ i, factors i
  have hT : T = threeCosetsSplit X 2 := by
    have hlo : (threeCosetsRange

          Finset.univ)) = threeCosetsHalf X 2 false := by
      ext f
      rw [threeCosetsRange_mem, (threeCosetsHalf_mem X 2 f).1]
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      have h (x : ↥X) := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property).1
      simp only [h, true_and, Nat.not_le]
    have hhi : (threeCosetsRange
        (fun x : ↥X => x ∈ Finset.filter (fun y : ↥X => 3 ≤ y.val ∧ y.val ≤ 4)
          Finset.univ)) = threeCosetsHalf X 2 true := by
      ext f
      rw [threeCosetsRange_mem, (threeCosetsHalf_mem X 2 f).2]
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      have h (x : ↥X) := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property).2
      simp only [h, and_true, Nat.not_le]
      simp only [Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine iSup_le (fun i => ?_)
      fin_cases i
      · change _ ≤ threeCosetsSplit X 2
        exact hlo.trans_le le_sup_left
      · change _ ≤ threeCosetsSplit X 2
        exact hhi.trans_le le_sup_right
    · apply sup_le
      · exact hlo.symm.trans_le (le_iSup factors 0)
      · exact hhi.symm.trans_le (le_iSup factors 1)
  -- The Alphabeta Math plan records Proposition 7.3, steps 1–2, which
  -- match ordered pieces of the two partitions. The registered §7.3 theorem
  -- checks the specific transpositions against that double-coset
  -- classification. Specialize it with both split sizes 2 and shift by 8.
  obtain ⟨l, r, s, hpoints, hzero, hsucc, _, hbij, _, _⟩ :=
    StandardTwoBlockRepresentatives 4 2 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  change (∀ j : Fin 2, (l j).val = 2 - j.val ∧ (r j).val = 2 + j.val + 1) at hpoints
  change (∀ j : Fin 2, s j.succ = Equiv.swap (l j) (r j) * s j.castSucc) at hsucc
  change Function.Bijective (fun i : Fin 3 => DoubleCoset.mk T T (s i)) at hbij
  let e := threeCosetsShift.permCongrHom
  let A := threeCosetsSplit threeCosetsInterval 10
  have hmem (f : Equiv.Perm ↥X) : e f ∈ A ↔ f ∈ T := by
    rw [hT, threeCosetsSplit_mem, threeCosetsSplit_mem]
    have h (x : ↥X) : (threeCosetsShift x).val ≤ 10 ↔ x.val ≤ 2 := by
      change x.val + 8 ≤ 10 ↔ x.val ≤ 2
      omega
    have he (x : ↥X) : e f (threeCosetsShift x) = threeCosetsShift (f x) := by
      change threeCosetsShift (f (threeCosetsShift.symm (threeCosetsShift x))) = _
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    constructor
    · intro hf x
      simpa only [he, h] using hf (threeCosetsShift x)
    · intro hf y
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := threeCosetsShift.surjective y
      simpa only [he, h] using hf x
  have hleft₀ : threeCosetsShift (l (0 : Fin 2)) = threeCosetsPoint 10 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (l (0 : Fin 2)).val + 8 = 10
    exact congrArg (fun n : Nat => n + 8) (hpoints 0).1
  have hright₀ : threeCosetsShift (r (0 : Fin 2)) = threeCosetsPoint 11 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (r (0 : Fin 2)).val + 8 = 11
    exact congrArg (fun n : Nat => n + 8) (hpoints 0).2
  have hleft₁ : threeCosetsShift (l (1 : Fin 2)) = threeCosetsPoint 9 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (l (1 : Fin 2)).val + 8 = 9
    exact congrArg (fun n : Nat => n + 8) (hpoints 1).1
  have hright₁ : threeCosetsShift (r (1 : Fin 2)) = threeCosetsPoint 12 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (r (1 : Fin 2)).val + 8 = 12
    exact congrArg (fun n : Nat => n + 8) (hpoints 1).2
  have he₀ : e (s 0) = 1 := by rw [hzero, map_one]
  have he₁ : e (s 1) = threeCosetsMiddle := by
    have h := hsucc 0
    change s 1 = Equiv.swap (l (0 : Fin 2)) (r (0 : Fin 2)) * s 0 at h
    rw [h, map_mul, he₀, mul_one]
    change threeCosetsShift.permCongrHom (Equiv.swap (l (0 : Fin 2)) (r (0 : Fin 2))) = _
    rw [threeCosets_congr_swap, hleft₀, hright₀]
  have he₂ : e (s 2) = threeCosetsLast := by
    have h := hsucc 1
    change s 2 = Equiv.swap (l (1 : Fin 2)) (r (1 : Fin 2)) * s 1 at h
    rw [h, map_mul, he₁]
    change threeCosetsShift.permCongrHom (Equiv.swap (l (1 : Fin 2)) (r (1 : Fin 2))) * _ = _
    rw [threeCosets_congr_swap, hleft₁, hright₁]
  have hrep (i : Fin 3) : e (s i) = threeCosetsRep i := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact he₀
    · exact he₁
    · exact he₂
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    apply hbij.1
    apply (threeCosets_congr_eq e T A hmem (s i) (s j)).mp
    rwa [hrep, hrep]
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := e.surjective q.out
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hbij.2 (DoubleCoset.mk T T x)
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    change DoubleCoset.mk A A (threeCosetsRep i) = q
    rw [← DoubleCoset.out_eq' q, ← hx, ← hrep]
    exact (threeCosets_congr_eq e T A hmem (s i) x).mpr hi
private theorem threeCosets_points (x : ↥threeCosetsInterval) :
    x = threeCosetsPoint 9 ∨ x = threeCosetsPoint 10 ∨
      x = threeCosetsPoint 11 ∨ x = threeCosetsPoint 12 := by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property
  have h : x.val = 9 ∨ x.val = 10 ∨ x.val = 11 ∨ x.val = 12 := by omega
  rcases h with h | h | h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext h))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Subtype.ext h)))

private theorem threeCosets_middle_test (x : ↥threeCosetsInterval) :
    (threeCosetsMiddle x).val ≤ 10 ↔ x.val = 9 ∨ x.val = 11 := by
  rcases threeCosets_points x with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

private theorem threeCosets_last_test (x : ↥threeCosetsInterval) :
    (threeCosetsLast x).val ≤ 10 ↔ ¬(x.val ≤ 10) := by
  rcases threeCosets_points x with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

private theorem threeCosets_conj_split_mem (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat)
    (s f : Equiv.Perm ↥X) :
    f ∈ (threeCosetsSplit X m).map (MulAut.conj s).toMonoidHom ↔
      ∀ x : ↥X, (s.symm (f x)).val ≤ m ↔ (s.symm x).val ≤ m := by
  rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, threeCosetsSplit_mem]
  change (∀ x : ↥X, (s.symm (f (s x))).val ≤ m ↔ x.val ≤ m) ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h x
    simpa only [s.apply_symm_apply] using h (s.symm x)
  · intro h x
    simpa only [s.symm_apply_apply] using h (s x)

-- The two membership tests specify the ordered intersection cells of
-- Proposition 7.3, steps 1–2. Here only their pointwise separation is needed:
-- each point of the third ambient block has a distinct pair of memberships.
private theorem threeCosets_middle_inf :
    threeCosetsSplit threeCosetsInterval 10 ⊓
      (threeCosetsSplit threeCosetsInterval 10).map (MulAut.conj threeCosetsMiddle).toMonoidHom =
        ⊥ := by
  ext f
  rw [Subgroup.mem_inf, threeCosetsSplit_mem, threeCosets_conj_split_mem, Subgroup.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hlo, hmid⟩
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    change f x = x
    specialize hlo x
    have he := hmid x
    change (threeCosetsMiddle (f x)).val ≤ 10 ↔ (threeCosetsMiddle x).val ≤ 10 at he
    rw [threeCosets_middle_test, threeCosets_middle_test] at he
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp x.property
    obtain ⟨h₃, h₄⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp (f x).property
    apply Subtype.ext
    omega
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨fun _ => Iff.rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩

private theorem threeCosets_conj_half_swap :
    (threeCosetsHalf threeCosetsInterval 10 false).map (MulAut.conj threeCosetsLast).toMonoidHom =
      threeCosetsHalf threeCosetsInterval 10 true ∧
    (threeCosetsHalf threeCosetsInterval 10 true).map (MulAut.conj threeCosetsLast).toMonoidHom =
      threeCosetsHalf threeCosetsInterval 10 false := by
  let s := threeCosetsLast
  have hp (x : ↥threeCosetsInterval) : 10 < (s x).val ↔ x.val ≤ 10 := by
    rw [← Nat.not_le, threeCosets_last_test, not_not]
  have hq (x : ↥threeCosetsInterval) : (s x).val ≤ 10 ↔ 10 < x.val :=
    (threeCosets_last_test x).trans Nat.not_le
  have hTransport (p q : ↥threeCosetsInterval → Prop) (h : ∀ x, q (s x) ↔ p x)
      (f : Equiv.Perm ↥threeCosetsInterval) :
      (∀ x, p x → (MulAut.conj s).symm f x = x) ↔ (∀ x, q x → f x = x) := by
    constructor
    · intro hf y hy
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := s.surjective y
      have he := hf x ((h x).mp hy)
      change s.symm (f (s x)) = x at he
      rwa [Equiv.symm_apply_eq] at he
    · intro hf x hx
      change s.symm (f (s x)) = x
      rw [hf (s x) ((h x).mpr hx), s.symm_apply_apply]
  constructor <;> ext f <;> rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv]
  · rw [(threeCosetsHalf_mem _ _ _).1, (threeCosetsHalf_mem _ _ f).2]
    exact hTransport _ _ hq f
  · rw [(threeCosetsHalf_mem _ _ _).2, (threeCosetsHalf_mem _ _ f).1]
    exact hTransport _ _ hp f

  -- (archived PDF pp. 35–36, published 28 November revision pp. 37–38),
  -- invokes the smaller-group formula of §5.1.
  -- The reviewed plan supplies no numbered Alphabeta Math proof for this
  -- endpoint. Steps 1–3 of the registered MixedCrossingComposites proof
  -- use the balanced push and its finite-fiber transfer. Steps 4–5 compare

  -- MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup packages these computations with the

  -- mixedMultiplicationBasis, transferBasis_sum and

  -- particular tableau section
  -- and a functor decomposition. Here the section is already given and

  obtain ⟨hfL, hfJ, h⟩ :=
    MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup K H G α β hα hβ σ hσ j L hL hIndex

ParabolicOutsideMultiplicationDiagram.proof:
by
  classical
  open MackeyDiagrams OutsideMultiplicationProof in
  intro finitary U parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f
    comp hom bc ad de p element conjugate Bmax Pp up down tensor vertical horizontal
    ordinary identity eval bottom top parallel multiply atRight splitBottom mergeTop evaluatesAsQp
  -- Xiao, §8.3, Proposition 8.6 and the following multiplication figure,
  -- archived original pp. 38–39 and published 28 November revision pp. 40–41
  -- (SHA-256 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61).
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-three-outside
  -- This endpoint has no linked numbered Alphabeta Math proof. The author’s
  -- mirror gives a prose proof here. Use its numbered Cases 1
  -- and 2 of Theorem 6.4 for the regions, and Cases 3 and 4 of Theorem 6.5
  -- for the reversed arrows. The extremal result supplies transported
  -- attainment. The displayed label equations require specific witnesses.
  obtain ⟨parB, parP, hfinite⟩ := attainedBounds hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f p
  -- Case 2 transported by a: restrict a⁻¹ and b⁻¹ after undoing conjugation
  -- by p. The intertwining of p puts (ade)(E) inside the full intersection.
  obtain ⟨r, s, t, x, y, z, hr, hs, ht, hz, hy, hx⟩ :=
    normalizedLeft a b c d e f p
  -- Case 1: finite A supplies the middle relative index. Its projection
  -- witness packages the finite fibers; the reversed vertices only use
  -- their eligible labels. Reversal inverts the parallel dot p⁻¹.
  let _ : Finite A := parabolic_finite hA
  let q : ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f := ⟨p, hfinite⟩
  have hindex : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (ad.toHom.range.subgroupOf
        (a.toHom.range ⊓ rightBound a b c d element)) := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨j, v, w, l, m, n, hj, hv, hw, hl, hm, hn, _, _⟩ :=
    (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).1 q hindex
  have hv' (k : C) : (v.toHom k : U) = ((ad.toHom k : A) : U) :=
    (hj (v.toHom k)).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (hv k))
  have hw' (k : F) : (w.toHom k : U) = ((element * bc.toHom k * element⁻¹ : A) : U) :=
    (hj (w.toHom k)).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (hw k))
  have hl' : l.inverse.element = element := by
    change l.element⁻¹ = element
    rw [hl, inv_inv]
  refine ⟨parB, parP, r, s, t, j, v, w, z, y, x, n.dot, m.dot, l.inverse,
    hr, hs, ht, hj, hv', hw', hz, hy, hx, hn, hm, hl', ?_⟩
  intro left right
  -- Cases 3 and 4 give the group-algebra multiplier form on the merged
  -- boundary. Instantiate it at these exact typed crossings. Compute the
  -- multiplier by applying each diagram to the unit balanced pair. The
  -- checked MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention supplies the weighted
  -- multiplication columns using the same mixedMultiplicationBasis map.
  let singleton := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {i₁ i₂ : ConjEmbedding H K}
      (k : Dot i₁ i₂) => (Finsupp.single k 1 : DotLabel Complex i₁ i₂)
  have hterms {K H : Subgroup U} {i₁ i₂ : ConjEmbedding H K} (k : Dot i₁ i₂) :
      DotLabel.terms (singleton k) = [(1, k)] := by simp [singleton, DotLabel.terms]
  have leftSupplier := (ReplacementForTwoMultiplications a b c d e f).1
    ⟨Bmax, r, s, t, singleton z, singleton y, singleton x⟩
  have rightSupplier := (ReplacementForTwoMultiplications a b c d e f).2.1
    ⟨Pp, j, v, w, singleton n.dot, singleton m.dot, singleton l.inverse⟩
  change ∃ M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A, _ ∧ _ at leftSupplier rightSupplier
  obtain ⟨ML, _, hL⟩ := leftSupplier
  obtain ⟨MR, _, hR⟩ := rightSupplier
  dsimp only at hL hR
  simp only [hterms] at hL hR
  have leftUnit : ev (framedMul a b c d e f left) (col (pair (.up de) (.down f) 1 1)) =
      col (Generator.mixedPair a bc element) := by
    simpa only [hz, hy, hx, map_one, mul_one, one_mul] using
      push_left a b c d e f x y z 1 1
  have rightUnit : ev (framedMul a b c d e f right) (col (pair (.up de) (.down f) 1 1)) =
      col (Generator.mixedPair a bc element) := by
    simpa only [hn, hm, hl', map_one, mul_one, one_mul] using
      push_right a b c d e f l.inverse m.dot n.dot 1 1
  have hLeft := specializeMultiplier a b c d e f left ML hL element leftUnit
  have hRight := specializeMultiplier a b c d e f right MR hR element rightUnit
  -- Boundary merges and splits are inverse after evaluation. The
  -- singleton columns therefore determine equality at the original
  -- three-strand boundary, with all marked vertices still present.
  exact ⟨framedExt a b c d e f (fun g k => (hLeft g k).trans (hRight g k).symm), hLeft⟩

namespace OutsideMultiplicationProof
open MackeyDiagrams

-- The subgroup restriction and conjugation adapters are local versions of
-- those in Proofs/ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions.lean.
private abbrev conj {V : Type*} [Group V] (p : V) (H : Subgroup V) :=
  H.map (MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom

private theorem mem_conj {V : Type*} [Group V] {p v : V} {H : Subgroup V} :
    v ∈ conj p H ↔ p⁻¹ * v * p ∈ H := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    change p⁻¹ * (p * w * p⁻¹) * p ∈ H
    rw [show p⁻¹ * (p * w * p⁻¹) * p = w by group]
    exact hw
  · intro hv
    refine ⟨p⁻¹ * v * p, hv, ?_⟩
    change p * (p⁻¹ * v * p) * p⁻¹ = v
    group

private theorem conj_one {V : Type*} [Group V] (H : Subgroup V) : conj 1 H = H := by
  ext y
  simp only [mem_conj, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]

private theorem conj_mul {V : Type*} [Group V] (p q : V) (H : Subgroup V) :
    conj p (conj q H) = conj (p * q) H := by
  ext v
  simp only [mem_conj, mul_inv_rev]
  rw [show q⁻¹ * (p⁻¹ * v * p) * q = q⁻¹ * p⁻¹ * v * (p * q) by group]
private theorem dot_ranges {U : Type*} [Group U] {J K : Subgroup U}
    {a b : ConjEmbedding J K} (x : Dot a b) :
    a.toHom.range = conj x.element b.toHom.range := by
  have eq (v : J) : a.toHom v = x.element * b.toHom v * x.element⁻¹ := by
    rw [← x.intertwines v, mul_inv_cancel_right]
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨b.toHom v, ⟨v, rfl⟩, (eq v).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨v, rfl⟩, hv⟩
    exact ⟨v, (eq v).trans hv⟩

private theorem range_comp_le {U : Type*} [Group U] {J K L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (b : ConjEmbedding J K) :
    (a.comp b).toHom.range ≤ a.toHom.range := by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨b.toHom x, rfl⟩

section
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)
private abbrev leftBound (p : A) := a.toHom.range ⊓ conj p b.toHom.range
private abbrev rightBound (p : A) := (a.comp d).toHom.range ⊔ conj p (b.comp c).toHom.range
private def inclusion {K : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup K) : ConjEmbedding (S.map K.subtype) K :=
  ⟨Subgroup.inclusion (Subgroup.map_subtype_le S), ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩

private theorem inclusion_mem {K : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup K) (v : S.map K.subtype) :
    (inclusion S).toHom v ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := v.property
  exact (Subtype.ext he : x = (inclusion S).toHom v) ▸ hx

private theorem inclusion_range {K : Subgroup U} (S : Subgroup K) :
    (inclusion S).toHom.range = S := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    exact inclusion_mem S v
  · intro v hv
    exact ⟨⟨(v : U), ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

private def restrictTo {K L : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (S : Subgroup L)
    (h : a.toHom.range ≤ S) : ConjEmbedding K (S.map L.subtype) :=
  ⟨(L.subtype.comp a.toHom).codRestrict _ (fun x => ⟨a.toHom x, h ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩),
    a.hasRepresentative⟩

private def conjugated {K L : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (p : L) :
    ConjEmbedding K L :=
  ⟨(MulAut.conj p).toMonoidHom.comp a.toHom, by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
    refine ⟨(p : U) * s, fun x => ?_⟩
    change (p : U) * (a.toHom x : U) * (p : U)⁻¹ = _
    rw [hs]
    group⟩

private theorem conjugated_range {K L : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (p : L) :
    (conjugated a p).toHom.range = conj p a.toHom.range :=
  (MonoidHom.map_range _ _).symm

-- The inverse is conjugation by the inverse representative on the range.
private theorem lift_through {K L J : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K L) (j : ConjEmbedding J L) (h : j.toHom.range ≤ a.toHom.range) :
    ∃ r : ConjEmbedding J K, a.comp r = j := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  have candidate (x : J) : ∃ y : K, a.toHom y = j.toHom x ∧
      (y : U) = q⁻¹ * (j.toHom x : U) * q := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    have he : q * (y : U) * q⁻¹ = (j.toHom x : U) := by rw [← hq, hy]
    rw [← he]
    group
  let r : ConjEmbedding J K := ⟨
    ((MulAut.conj q⁻¹).toMonoidHom.comp (L.subtype.comp j.toHom)).codRestrict K (by
      intro x
      obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := candidate x
      change q⁻¹ * (j.toHom x : U) * (q⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
      rw [inv_inv, ← hy]
      exact y.property), by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := j.hasRepresentative
    refine ⟨q⁻¹ * w, fun x => ?_⟩
    change q⁻¹ * (j.toHom x : U) * (q⁻¹)⁻¹ = _
    rw [hw]
    group⟩
  refine ⟨r, ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => ?_)⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := candidate x
  have hr : r.toHom x = y := Subtype.ext (by
    change q⁻¹ * (j.toHom x : U) * (q⁻¹)⁻¹ = (y : U)
    rw [inv_inv, hxy])
  change a.toHom (r.toHom x) = j.toHom x
  rw [hr, hy]
private theorem lower_le_max (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f)) :
    (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range ≤ leftBound a b p.element := by
  apply le_inf (range_comp_le a (d.comp e))
  rw [dot_ranges p]
  exact Subgroup.map_mono (range_comp_le b (c.comp f))


private theorem normalizedLeft (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f)) :
    let H := leftBound a b p.element
    let B := H.map A.subtype
    ∃ (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D) (t : ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s)) (y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f))
      (z : Dot (d.comp e) (r.comp t)),
      (∀ k : B, (a.toHom (r.toHom k) : U) = (k : U)) ∧
      (∀ k : B, ((p.element * b.toHom (s.toHom k) * p.element⁻¹ : A) : U) = (k : U)) ∧
      (∀ k : E, (t.toHom k : U) = ((a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom k : U)) ∧
      z.element = 1 ∧ y.element = 1 ∧ x.element = p.element := by
  intro H B
  have hlo : (a.comp (d.comp e)).toHom.range ≤ H := lower_le_max a b c d e f p
  have hhi : H ≤ leftBound a b p.element := le_rfl
  let j := inclusion H
  have hj : j.toHom.range = H := inclusion_range H
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := lift_through a j (by
    rw [hj]
    exact hhi.trans inf_le_left)
  have hs' : (conjugated j p.element⁻¹).toHom.range ≤ b.toHom.range := by
    rw [conjugated_range, hj]
    calc
      _ ≤ conj p.element⁻¹ (conj p.element b.toHom.range) :=
        Subgroup.map_mono (hhi.trans inf_le_right)
      _ = _ := by rw [conj_mul, inv_mul_cancel, conj_one]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := lift_through b (conjugated j p.element⁻¹) hs'
  let t := restrictTo (a.comp (d.comp e)) H hlo
  have hjt : j.comp t = a.comp (d.comp e) := ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun _ => rfl)
  have ht₁ : r.comp t = d.comp e := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply a.injective
    have h₁ := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding B A => m.toHom (t.toHom v)) hr
    have h₂ := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding E A => m.toHom v) hjt
    exact h₁.trans h₂
  have hbs (v : B) : b.toHom (s.toHom v) =
      p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom v * p.element := by
    have hv := congrArg (fun m : ConjEmbedding B A => m.toHom v) hs
    change b.toHom (s.toHom v) = p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom v * (p.element⁻¹)⁻¹ at hv
    rwa [inv_inv] at hv
  have ht₂ : s.comp t = c.comp f := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro v
    apply b.injective
    change b.toHom (s.toHom (t.toHom v)) = ((b.comp c).comp f).toHom v
    rw [hbs]
    change p.element⁻¹ * (j.comp t).toHom v * p.element = _
    rw [hjt, mul_assoc, p.intertwines, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  let x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s) := ⟨p.element, by
    intro v
    rw [hr]
    change j.toHom v * p.element = p.element * b.toHom (s.toHom v)
    rw [hbs]
    group⟩
  let y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f) := ⟨1, by intro v; rw [ht₂, mul_one, one_mul]⟩

  let z : Dot (d.comp e) (r.comp t) := ⟨1, by intro v; rw [ht₁, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  refine ⟨r, s, t, x, y, z, ?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro k
    exact congrArg (fun i : ConjEmbedding B A => (i.toHom k : U)) hr
  · intro k
    rw [hbs]
    have h : p.element * (p.element⁻¹ * j.toHom k * p.element) * p.element⁻¹ = j.toHom k := by
      group
    rw [h]
    rfl

end

private abbrev Perm := Equiv.Perm Nat
private abbrev Finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Perm | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev blockSym (X : Finset Nat) : Subgroup Perm :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X))

private abbrev ParabolicPerm (H : Subgroup Perm) :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, (blocks i).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    H = ⨆ i, blockSym (blocks i)

private abbrev Parabolic (H : Subgroup Finitary) := ParabolicPerm (H.map Finitary.subtype)
private theorem parabolic_conj_perm {H : Subgroup Perm} (hH : ParabolicPerm H) (σ : Perm) :
    ParabolicPerm (conj σ H) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, X, hne, hd, rfl⟩ := hH
  have image_block (S : Finset Nat) : conj σ (blockSym S) = blockSym (S.image σ) := by
    let Y := S.image σ
    have mem_image (x : Nat) : x ∈ S ↔ σ x ∈ Y := by simp [Y]
    let e : S ≃ Y := σ.subtypeEquiv mem_image
    have commute (f : Equiv.Perm S) :
        MulAut.conj σ (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype f) = Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (e.permCongr f) := by
      apply Equiv.ext
      intro x
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := σ.surjective x
      change σ (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype f (σ.symm (σ y))) = Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (e.permCongr f) (σ y)
      rw [σ.symm_apply_apply]
      by_cases hy : y ∈ S
      · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem f hy,
          Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_mem _ ((mem_image y).mp hy)]
        change (e (f ⟨y, hy⟩) : Nat) = (e.permCongr f (e ⟨y, hy⟩) : Nat)
        simp
      · rw [Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem f hy, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem _ (fun h =>
          hy ((mem_image y).mpr h))]
    ext τ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨f, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨e.permCongr f, (commute f).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := e.permCongr.surjective g
      exact ⟨Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype f, ⟨f, rfl⟩, commute f⟩
  change ParabolicPerm (Subgroup.map _ (⨆ i, blockSym (X i)))
  rw [Subgroup.map_iSup]
  simp only [show ∀ S, (blockSym S).map (MulAut.conj σ).toMonoidHom = blockSym (S.image σ) from image_block]
  refine ⟨n, fun i => (X i).image σ, fun i => (hne i).image _, ?_, rfl⟩
  intro i j hij
  apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hi hj
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.mp (hd hij) hy (σ.injective (hxz.trans hxy.symm) ▸ hz)

private theorem parabolic_finite {H : Subgroup Finitary} (hH : Parabolic H) : Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, hblocks⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have hsub : H.map Finitary.subtype ≤ blockSym X := by
    rw [hblocks]
    refine iSup_le fun i σ hs => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
    let σ : Perm := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ
    have moved_mem (x : Nat) (hx : σ x ≠ x) : x ∈ X := by
      by_contra hn
      have hi : x ∉ blocks i := fun hx' => hn (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx'⟩)
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hi)
    have preserves (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · rw [h]
      · have hy : σ (σ x) ≠ σ x := fun hh => h (σ.injective hh)
        exact iff_of_true (moved_mem (σ x) hy) (moved_mem x h)
    exact ⟨σ.subtypePerm preserves, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserves moved_mem⟩
  let _ : Finite (blockSym X) :=
    (Set.finite_range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))).to_subtype
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun h : H => (⟨(h.val : Perm), hsub ⟨h.val, h.property, rfl⟩⟩ : blockSym X))
    (fun _ _ hh => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y : blockSym X => y.val) hh)))

open MackeyDiagrams

private theorem parabolic_embedding {H K : Subgroup Finitary}
    (i : ConjEmbedding H K) (hH : Parabolic H) : Parabolic (i.toHom.range.map K.subtype) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := i.hasRepresentative
  have hr : (i.toHom.range.map K.subtype).map Finitary.subtype =
      conj (q : Perm) (H.map Finitary.subtype) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y.val, ⟨y.val, y.property, rfl⟩, congrArg Finitary.subtype (hq y).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      let x : H := ⟨y, hy⟩
      exact ⟨(i.toHom x : Finitary), ⟨i.toHom x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, congrArg Finitary.subtype (hq x)⟩
  show ParabolicPerm _
  rw [hr]
  exact parabolic_conj_perm hH q


-- Proposition 8.6 gives the attained extremal transported groups. The
-- attaining witnesses have parabolic regions. Transport is itself a
-- conjugation-induced embedding, so these two images are parabolic.
private theorem attainedBounds {G A D F C E : Subgroup Finitary}
    (hG : Parabolic G) (hA : Parabolic A) (hD : Parabolic D) (hF : Parabolic F)
    (hC : Parabolic C) (hE : Parabolic E)
    (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)
    (p : Dot (a.comp (d.comp e)) ((b.comp c).comp f)) :
    Parabolic ((leftBound a b p.element).map A.subtype) ∧
      Parabolic ((rightBound a b c d p.element).map A.subtype) ∧
      (∀ z, Set.Finite {s | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a (b.comp c) (d.comp e) f p s = z}) := by
  let _ : Finite A := parabolic_finite hA
  rcases ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f p
    (by infer_instance) with ⟨hfinite, -, hRight, -, hLeft, -, -⟩
  rcases hLeft.1 with ⟨⟨B, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩, hB, _⟩
  rcases hRight.1 with ⟨⟨B', j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩, hP, _⟩
  change conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = leftBound a b p.element at hB
  change conj m.element j.toHom.range = rightBound a b c d p.element at hP
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hfinite⟩
  · rw [← hB, ← conjugated_range]
    exact parabolic_embedding _ B.property
  · rw [← hP, ← conjugated_range]
    exact parabolic_embedding _ B'.property


-- The singleton basis calculations use the multiplication conjunct of the
-- registered MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention and the shared merge–dot–split
-- expansion. These local specializations follow the basis calculation in
-- Proofs/ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions.lean.
noncomputable section

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H J L M G A D F C E B B' : Subgroup U}

private abbrev Vec (X : Type*) := X →₀ Complex
private abbrev ev {p q : Word K H} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev drawId (p : Word K H) : LabelledDrawing Complex p p :=
  .ordinary (.id p)

private abbrev before {p q r : Word K H} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (e : LabelledDrawing Complex q r) := LabelledDrawing.vertical d e

private abbrev atLeft {p q : Word K H} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (r : Word H J) := LabelledDrawing.horizontal d (drawId r)

private abbrev atRight (p : Word K H) {q : Word H J} {r : Word J L}
    {q' : Word H M} {r' : Word M L}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex (q.tensor r) (q'.tensor r')) :=
  before (.ordinary (.associate p q r))
    (before (.horizontal (drawId p) d) (.ordinary (.unassociate p q' r')))

private abbrev pair (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) := p.basis.pair q.basis

private abbrev triple (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) (r : Word J L)
    (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier) (z : r.basis.carrier) :=
  pair (p.tensor q) r (pair p q x y) z
private theorem sum_eval (p q : Word K H) (xs : List (Complex × Diagram Complex p q)) :
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (xs.map fun (c,d) => (c, ScopedDiagram.ordinary d))).eval.toLinearMap =
      (xs.map fun (c,d) => c • d.eval.toLinearMap).sum := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]
  simp only [List.map_map]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rcases x with ⟨c,d⟩
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rw [ih]
    rfl
private theorem singleton_parallel (a : ConjEmbedding H K) (b : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (c : ConjEmbedding J K) (d : ConjEmbedding L J) (p : Dot (a.comp b) (c.comp d)) :
    ev (.parallelUp a b c d [(1,p)]) =
      (Diagram.parallelUp (R := Complex) a b c d p).eval.toLinearMap := by
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination
    (([(1, Diagram.parallelUp (R := Complex) a b c d p)]).map
      fun (r,t) => (r, ScopedDiagram.ordinary t))).eval.toLinearMap = _
  rw [sum_eval]
  simp

variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

private abbrev bottom := ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c)
private abbrev top := ((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f)
private abbrev mergedBottom := (Word.down a).tensor (.up (b.comp c))
private abbrev mergedTop := (Word.up (d.comp e)).tensor (.down f)

private abbrev splitBottom : LabelledDrawing Complex (mergedBottom a b c) (bottom a b c) :=
  before (.horizontal (drawId (.down a)) (.trivalent (.splitUp b c)))
    (.ordinary (.unassociate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)))

private abbrev mergeTop : LabelledDrawing Complex (top d e f) (mergedTop d e f) :=
  .horizontal (.trivalent (.mergeUp d e)) (drawId (.down f))
private theorem mixedPair_coord {K H P : Subgroup U}
    (α : ConjEmbedding K P) (β : ConjEmbedding H P) (x y : P) :
    pair (.down α) (.up β) x y = Generator.mixedPair α β (x * y) := by
  apply (Generator.mixedEquiv α β).injective
  change x * y = Generator.mixedProduct α β (Generator.mixedPair α β (x * y))
  rw [Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
private abbrev mergeBottom : LabelledDrawing Complex (bottom a b c) (mergedBottom a b c) :=
  before (.ordinary (.associate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)))
    (.horizontal (drawId (.down a)) (.trivalent (.mergeUp b c)))

private abbrev splitTop : LabelledDrawing Complex (mergedTop d e f) (top d e f) :=
  .horizontal (.trivalent (.splitUp d e)) (drawId (.down f))
private abbrev col {X : Type*} (x : X) : Vec X :=
  Finsupp.single x 1

private theorem push_before {p q r : Word K H}
    (D : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (E : LabelledDrawing Complex q r)
    (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier) (z : r.basis.carrier)
    (hd : ev D (col x) = col y) (he : ev E (col y) = col z) :
    ev (before D E) (col x) = col z := by
  change ev E (ev D (col x)) = _
  rw [hd, he]

private theorem push_atLeft {p p' : Word K H} {q : Word H J}
    (D : LabelledDrawing Complex p p') (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier)
    (x' : p'.basis.carrier) (hd : ev D (col x) = col x') :
    ev (atLeft D q) (col (pair p q x y)) = col (pair p' q x' y) := by
  change (D.interpret.eval.horizontal (Diagram.id q).eval).toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_id_apply, hd,
    Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

private theorem push_atRight {p : Word K H} {q : Word H J} {s : Word J L}
    {q' : Word H M} {s' : Word M L}
    (D : LabelledDrawing Complex (q.tensor s) (q'.tensor s'))
    (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier) (z : s.basis.carrier)
    (y' : q'.basis.carrier) (z' : s'.basis.carrier)
    (hd : ev D (col (pair q s y z)) = col (pair q' s' y' z')) :
    ev (atRight p D) (col (triple p q s x y z)) = col (triple p q' s' x y' z') := by
  change (Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) p q' s').eval.toLinearMap
    (((Diagram.id p).eval.horizontal D.interpret.eval).toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.associate (R := Complex) p q s).eval.toLinearMap (col (triple p q s x y z)))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single, Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, hd, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul, Diagram.eval_unassociate_single]

private theorem push_mixed (a : ConjEmbedding K A) (b : ConjEmbedding H A)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (x : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) (g : K) (h : H) :
    ev (.mixedMultiplication a b l r [(1,x)]) (col (pair (.up l) (.down r) g h)) =
      col (pair (.down a) (.up b) (a.toHom g * x.element * b.toHom h) 1) := by
  let label : DotLabel Complex (a.comp l) (b.comp r) := Finsupp.single x 1
  have hterms : label.terms = [(1,x)] := by
    classical
    simp [label, DotLabel.terms]
  rw [← hterms]
  have hcol := ((MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention (U := U)).2.2.1 a b l r label).1
    (pair (.up l) (.down r) g h)
  rw [hterms] at hcol
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero, one_smul] at hcol
  exact hcol

private theorem push_parallel (a : ConjEmbedding H A) (b : ConjEmbedding L H)
    (j : ConjEmbedding J A) (w : ConjEmbedding L J)
    (x : Dot (a.comp b) (j.comp w)) (g : A) (h : H) :
    ev (.parallelUp a b j w [(1,x)]) (col (pair (.up a) (.up b) g h)) =
      col (pair (.up j) (.up w) (g * a.toHom h * x.element) 1) := by
  rw [singleton_parallel]
  change (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) j w).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.upDot x).eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeUp a b).eval.toLinearMap
      (col (pair (.up a) (.up b) g h)))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single]

private abbrev framedMul (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex (top d e f) (bottom a b c)) :=
  before (splitTop d e f) (before drawing (mergeBottom a b c))

private theorem push_splitTop (g : G) (h : F) :
    ev (splitTop d e f) (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h)) =
      col (triple (.up d) (.up e) (.down f) g 1 h) := by
  change (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.splitUp d e) (Diagram.id (.down f))).eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]

private theorem push_mergeBottom (x y : A) (z : D) :
    ev (mergeBottom a b c) (col (triple (.down a) (.up b) (.up c) x y z)) =
      col (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c) (x * (y * b.toHom z))) := by
  change (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (.down a)) (Diagram.mergeUp b c)).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.associate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c)).eval.toLinearMap
      (col (triple (.down a) (.up b) (.up c) x y z))) = _
  rw [Diagram.eval_associate_single, Diagram.eval_horizontal_single, one_smul,
    Diagram.eval_id_apply, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
  exact congrArg col (mixedPair_coord a (b.comp c) x (y * b.toHom z))

private abbrev leftMulDrawing (r : ConjEmbedding B G) (s : ConjEmbedding B D)
    (t : ConjEmbedding E B) (x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s))
    (y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f)) (z : Dot (d.comp e) (r.comp t)) :=
  before (atLeft (.parallelUp d e r t [(1,z)]) (.down f))
    (before (atRight (.up r) (.mixedMultiplication s c t f [(1,y)]))
      (atLeft (.mixedMultiplication a b r s [(1,x)]) (.up c)))

private abbrev rightMulDrawing (j : ConjEmbedding B A) (v : ConjEmbedding C B)
    (w : ConjEmbedding F B) (ell : Dot (j.comp w) (b.comp c))
    (m : Dot (a.comp d) (j.comp v)) (n : Dot (v.comp e) (w.comp f)) :=
  before (atRight (.up d) (.mixedMultiplication v w e f [(1,n)]))
    (before (atLeft (.mixedMultiplication a j d v [(1,m)]) (.up w))
      (atRight (.down a) (.parallelUp j w b c [(1,ell)])))

-- The forward columns of Xiao's Theorem 6.5 specialize to the same
-- parameter products as the backward coefficient calculation of Lemma 6.3.
private theorem push_left {r : ConjEmbedding B G} {s : ConjEmbedding B D}
    {t : ConjEmbedding E B} (x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s))
    (y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f)) (z : Dot (d.comp e) (r.comp t)) (g : G) (h : F) :
    ev (framedMul a b c d e f (leftMulDrawing a b c d e f r s t x y z))
      (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h)) =
      col (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)
        (a.toHom g * (a.toHom z.element * x.element * b.toHom y.element) * (b.comp c).toHom h)) := by
  let g' := g * z.element
  let t' := y.element * c.toHom h
  let q := a.toHom g' * x.element * b.toHom t'
  have h₁ := push_atLeft (.parallelUp d e r t [(1,z)])
    (q := .down f) (pair (.up d) (.up e) g 1) h (pair (.up r) (.up t) g' 1) (by
      simpa only [g', map_one, mul_one] using push_parallel d e r t z g 1)
  have h₂ := push_atRight (p := Word.up r) (.mixedMultiplication s c t f [(1,y)])
    g' 1 h t' 1 (by simpa only [t', map_one, one_mul] using push_mixed s c t f y 1 h)
  have h₃ := push_atLeft (.mixedMultiplication a b r s [(1,x)])
    (q := .up c) (pair (.up r) (.down s) g' t') 1
    (pair (.down a) (.up b) q 1) (push_mixed a b r s x g' t')
  have h₄ := push_mergeBottom a b c q 1 1
  have hEval := push_before _ _ _ _ _ (push_splitTop d e f g h)
    (push_before _ _ _ _ _ (push_before _ _ _ _ _ h₁ (push_before _ _ _ _ _ h₂ h₃)) h₄)
  simpa only [q, g', t', map_one, one_mul, mul_one, map_mul,
    ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, mul_assoc] using hEval

private theorem push_right {j : ConjEmbedding B A} {v : ConjEmbedding C B}
    {w : ConjEmbedding F B} (ell : Dot (j.comp w) (b.comp c))
    (m : Dot (a.comp d) (j.comp v)) (n : Dot (v.comp e) (w.comp f)) (g : G) (h : F) :
    ev (framedMul a b c d e f (rightMulDrawing a b c d e f j v w ell m n))
      (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g h)) =
      col (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)
        (a.toHom g * (m.element * j.toHom n.element * ell.element) * (b.comp c).toHom h)) := by
  let n' := n.element * w.toHom h
  let q := a.toHom g * m.element * j.toHom n'
  have h₁ := push_atRight (p := Word.up d) (.mixedMultiplication v w e f [(1,n)])
    g 1 h n' 1 (by simpa only [n', map_one, one_mul] using push_mixed v w e f n 1 h)
  have h₂ := push_atLeft (.mixedMultiplication a j d v [(1,m)])
    (q := .up w) (pair (.up d) (.down v) g n') 1
    (pair (.down a) (.up j) q 1) (push_mixed a j d v m g n')
  have h₃ := push_atRight (p := Word.down a) (.parallelUp j w b c [(1,ell)])
    q 1 1 ell.element 1 (by
      simpa only [map_one, mul_one, one_mul] using push_parallel j w b c ell 1 1)
  have h₄ := push_mergeBottom a b c q ell.element 1
  have hEval := push_before _ _ _ _ _ (push_splitTop d e f g h)
    (push_before _ _ _ _ _ (push_before _ _ _ _ _ h₁ (push_before _ _ _ _ _ h₂ h₃)) h₄)
  have he := ell.intertwines h
  simp only [ConjEmbedding.comp_apply] at he
  simpa only [q, n', map_one, mul_one, map_mul,
    ConjEmbedding.comp_apply, mul_assoc, he] using hEval


-- These are the boundary inverse checks used in the registered proof of
-- Theorem 6.5, specialized to the shared trivalent drawings at this boundary.
private theorem splitRightInverse :
    let S := (splitTop d e f).interpret.eval
    let M := (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.mergeUp d e)
      (Diagram.id (.down f))).eval
    M.vertical S = Biset.Hom.id (top d e f).basis := by
  dsimp only
  change ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) d e).eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down f)).eval).vertical
    ((Diagram.splitUp d e).eval.horizontal (Diagram.id (.down f)).eval) = _
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical]
  change (((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) d e).vertical (Diagram.splitUp d e)).eval).horizontal
    (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down f).basis) = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

private theorem mergeLeftInverse :
    let M := (mergeBottom a b c).interpret.eval
    let S := ((Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (.down a))
      (Diagram.splitUp b c)).vertical (Diagram.unassociate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c))).eval
    M.vertical S = Biset.Hom.id (bottom a b c).basis := by
  dsimp only
  change ((Biset.associate (Word.down a).basis (Word.up b).basis (Word.up c).basis Complex).vertical
    ((Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal (Diagram.mergeUp b c).eval)).vertical
    (((Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal (Diagram.splitUp b c).eval).vertical
      (Biset.unassociate (Word.down a).basis (Word.up b).basis (Word.up c).basis Complex)) = _
  refine Biset.Hom.cancel_middle _ _ _ _ ?_ Biset.associate_unassociate
  rw [Biset.Hom.horizontal_vertical, Biset.Hom.id_vertical]
  change (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).horizontal
    (((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) b c).vertical (Diagram.splitUp b c)).eval) = _
  rw [Diagram.mergeUp_splitUp]
  exact Biset.Hom.horizontal_id _ _

private theorem framedExt
    {D₁ D₂ : LabelledDrawing Complex (top d e f) (bottom a b c)}
    (h : ∀ (g : G) (k : F), ev (framedMul a b c d e f D₁) (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k)) =
      ev (framedMul a b c d e f D₂) (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k))) :
    D₁.interpret.eval = D₂.interpret.eval := by
  have eq : (framedMul a b c d e f D₁).interpret.eval =
      (framedMul a b c d e f D₂).interpret.eval := by
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z coef
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨g,k⟩ => ?_
    change ev (framedMul a b c d e f D₁)
        (Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k) coef) =
      ev (framedMul a b c d e f D₂) (Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k) coef)
    have hs : Finsupp.single (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k) coef =
        coef • col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k) := by
      rw [col, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [hs, map_smul, map_smul, h]
  let P := (Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.mergeUp d e)
    (Diagram.id (.down f))).eval
  let Q := ((Diagram.horizontal (R := Complex) (Diagram.id (.down a))
      (Diagram.splitUp b c)).vertical (Diagram.unassociate (.down a) (.up b) (.up c))).eval
  let S := (splitTop d e f).interpret.eval
  let T := (mergeBottom a b c).interpret.eval
  change S.vertical (D₁.interpret.eval.vertical T) = S.vertical (D₂.interpret.eval.vertical T) at eq
  have hc := congrArg (fun x => (P.vertical x).vertical Q) eq
  change (P.vertical (S.vertical (D₁.interpret.eval.vertical T))).vertical Q =
    (P.vertical (S.vertical (D₂.interpret.eval.vertical T))).vertical Q at hc
  have hP : P.vertical S = Biset.Hom.id (top d e f).basis := splitRightInverse d e f
  have hQ : T.vertical Q = Biset.Hom.id (bottom a b c).basis := mergeLeftInverse a b c
  simpa only [← Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc P S, hP, Biset.Hom.id_vertical,
    Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc _ T Q, hQ, Biset.Hom.vertical_id] using hc

private abbrev multiplierFormula (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex (top d e f) (bottom a b c))
    (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) :=
  ∀ (g : G) (k : F),
    ev (framedMul a b c d e f drawing) (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k)) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c))
        (MonoidAlgebra.single (a.toHom g) 1 * M *
          MonoidAlgebra.single ((b.comp c).toHom k) 1).coeff

-- Theorem 6.5 gives the multiplier for each diagram. Identify that
-- multiplier by the unit balanced pair, then apply its formula to all pairs.
private theorem specializeMultiplier
    (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex (top d e f) (bottom a b c))
    (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (hm : multiplierFormula a b c d e f drawing M)
    (p : A)
    (hunit : ev (framedMul a b c d e f drawing) (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) 1 1)) =
      col (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c) p)) :
    ∀ (g : G) (k : F),
      ev (framedMul a b c d e f drawing) (col (pair (.up (d.comp e)) (.down f) g k)) =
        col (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c) (a.toHom g * p * (b.comp c).toHom k)) := by
  have hm₁ := hm 1 1
  rw [hunit] at hm₁
  have he : M = MonoidAlgebra.single p 1 := by
    apply MonoidAlgebra.coeff_injective
    have hinj : Function.Injective (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)) :=
      (Generator.mixedEquiv a (b.comp c)).symm.injective
    apply Finsupp.mapDomain_injective hinj
    change Finsupp.mapDomain (Generator.mixedPair a (b.comp c)) M.coeff = _
    simpa only [map_one, show MonoidAlgebra.single (1 : A) (1 : Complex) = 1 from rfl,
      one_mul, mul_one, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, col] using hm₁.symm
  rw [he] at hm
  intro g k
  simpa only [MonoidAlgebra.single_mul_single, one_mul, MonoidAlgebra.coeff_single,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_single, col] using hm g k

end
end OutsideMultiplicationProof

ParabolicRightDiagramSpanOverCommutative.proof:
by
  classical
  intro Sinf U blockSym parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b d c e f
    up down tensor comp ga ad df gc ce ef bottom top X Y Pair input output pair
    orbit stabilizer projected swaps RightData labels representative Fiber lowerMap finiteFibers
    RightTerm rightRepresentative rightOrbit image rightImage isInclusion drawId rightDrawing
    rightDiagramOf rightDiagram RightLabels fullRightDiagram LeftUpperFiber leftDiagram
    Orbits rep P L index coefficient entry evaluate bimoduleMaps rightHom rightSpan
    integerMaps integerRightSpan
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair := pairAction X Y
  letI : Finite G := parabolic_finite hG
  letI : Finite D := parabolic_finite hD
  letI : Finite E := parabolic_finite hE
  letI : Finite F := parabolic_finite hF
  letI : Finite X.carrier := finite_word_of_groups a b d
  letI : Finite Y.carrier := finite_word_of_groups c e f
  haveI : Finite Orbits := Finite.of_surjective
    (fun z : Pair => (⟨orbit z, ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩ : Orbits)) (fun O => ⟨rep O, Subtype.ext
      (Classical.choose_spec O.property)⟩)
  letI : Fintype Orbits := Fintype.ofFinite _
  -- Xiao, Proposition 8.7 and § 8.3 “Other coefficient rings,” archived pp. 39–40
  -- and published 28 November revision pp. 41–42 (SHA-256
  -- e7712567f611d36713fb4dbf45f8b1aeefea022ea2e403462529850ebe290cc8).
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=42
  -- Steps 1–6 below follow the paragraph numbering in the checked project
  -- proof of Proposition 8.7.
  -- Steps 1–4. Keep the actual projected subgroup of the chosen representative.
  -- Left normalization uses only (g, 1), so it preserves that subgroup.
  have geometry := ParabolicRightOrbitMultiplicity G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b d c e f
  have project_le (z : Pair) : projected z ≤ F := by
    rintro p ⟨q, _, rfl⟩
    exact q.2.property
  have extremal (z : Pair) : IsGreatest {K : Subgroup U | K ≤ projected z ∧ parabolic K}
      (swaps (projected z)) := by
    letI : Finite (projected z) :=
      Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion (project_le z)) (Subgroup.inclusion_injective _)
    have h := parabolic_extremal (projected z)
    exact ⟨⟨h.1.2,h.1.1⟩, fun K hK => h.2 ⟨hK.2,hK.1⟩⟩
  have norm (O : Orbits) : ∃ r t s, orbit (pair r t s) = O.val ∧ projected (pair r t s) = P O := by
    obtain ⟨g, r, t, s, hg⟩ := normalize_left a b d c e f (rep O)
    have hOrbit : orbit (rep O) = O.val := Classical.choose_spec O.property
    have hz : pair r t s ∈ orbit (rep O) := ⟨(g,1), hg⟩
    have hp := projected_left a b d c e f (rep O) g
    change projected ((g,(1 : F)) • rep O) = P O at hp
    rw [hg] at hp
    exact ⟨r,t,s,(MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hz).trans hOrbit,hp⟩
  have transport (O : Orbits) (z : Pair) (hz : z ∈ O.val) :
      (swaps (projected z)).relIndex (projected z) = index O := by
    have h : orbit (rep O) = O.val := Classical.choose_spec O.property
    have hz' : z ∈ orbit (rep O) := by rwa [h]
    exact (geometry.2.2.2.2.1 (rep O)).2.2 z hz'
  have indexOne (O : Orbits) : index O = 1 ↔ parabolic (P O) :=
    (geometry.2.2.2.2.1 (rep O)).2.1
  -- Use the ℂ singleton formula of ParabolicRightOrbitMultiplicity with the
  -- supplier's finite-fiber witness. Transport the result through the common
  -- natural entry of the typed drawing. The cast into ℂ recovers the count,
  -- which can then be cast into any R, including positive characteristic.
  have singleton {B' : Subgroup U} (hB' : parabolic B') (data : RightData B') :
      image data ≤ projected (representative data) ∧
      ∃ fin : finiteFibers data, ∀ (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (z : Pair),
        coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagramOf R data fin)) z =
          entry R (orbit (representative data))
            ((image data).relIndex (projected (representative data)) : R) z := by
    obtain ⟨hle, ⟨_, fin, hc⟩, _⟩ := geometry.2.2.2.1 B' hB' data
    refine ⟨hle, fin, ?_⟩
    rcases data with ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩
    intro R _ z
    let data : RightData B' := ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩
    let O := orbit (representative data)
    let n := (image data).relIndex (projected (representative data))
    let val := (evalD (RightSpanProof.rightDrawing a b d c e f Nat i j k
      [(1,⟨r,fin⟩)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)])).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2
    have transferC := compatible_entry (Nat.castRingHom Complex)
      (right_cast a b d c e f (Nat.castRingHom Complex) i j k ⟨r,fin⟩ t s) z
    have transferR := compatible_entry (Nat.castRingHom R)
      (right_cast a b d c e f (Nat.castRingHom R) i j k ⟨r,fin⟩ t s) z
    change (val : R) = coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagramOf R data fin)) z at transferR
    change (val : Complex) = _ at transferC
    let cm := @ite Complex (z ∈ O) (Classical.propDecidable _) (n : Complex) 0
    have hc' : (val : Complex) = cm :=
      transferC.trans (hc z)
    change coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagramOf R data fin)) z = entry R O (n : R) z
    rw [← transferR]
    by_cases hz : z ∈ O
    · rw [show cm = (n : Complex) from ite_eq_left hz] at hc'
      rw [show entry R O (n : R) z = (n : R) from ite_eq_left hz, Nat.cast_injective hc']
    · rw [show cm = 0 from ite_eq_right hz] at hc'
      have hv : val = 0 := Nat.cast_injective (hc'.trans Nat.cast_zero.symm)
      rw [show entry R O (n : R) z = 0 from ite_eq_right hz, hv, Nat.cast_zero]
  -- Step 5. The image of a parabolic internal group is parabolic by
  -- conjugation closure. Multiplicativity in the tower gives divisibility.
  have allRight (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (T : RightTerm) :
      let P' := projected (rightRepresentative T)
      rightImage T ≤ P' ∧
      (swaps P').relIndex P' ∣ (rightImage T).relIndex P' ∧
      ∀ z, coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagram R T)) z =
        entry R (rightOrbit T) ((rightImage T).relIndex P' : R) z := by
    intro P'
    obtain ⟨leP, fin, hcoef⟩ := singleton T.property.1 T.val.2
    have pK : parabolic (rightImage T) := by
      rcases T with ⟨⟨B',i,j,k,r,t,s⟩,hB',fin⟩
      exact conjugate_parabolic j hB'
    have hL := extremal (rightRepresentative T)
    have tower := Subgroup.relIndex_mul_relIndex (rightImage T) (swaps P') P'
      (hL.2 ⟨leP,pK⟩) hL.1.1
    exact ⟨leP, ⟨(rightImage T).relIndex (swaps P'), by rw [mul_comm]; exact tower.symm⟩,
      hcoef R⟩
  have generate (O : Orbits) :
      ∃ (data : RightData (L O)) (fin : finiteFibers data),
        orbit (representative data) = O.val ∧ projected (representative data) = P O ∧
        isInclusion data ∧ ∀ (R : Type _) [CommRing R] z,
          coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagramOf R data fin)) z =
            entry R O.val (index O : R) z := by
    obtain ⟨r,t,s,hO,hP⟩ := norm O
    obtain ⟨_, full, hlab, _, _, _, hL, term, hp, hrest, hInc, _, _⟩ := geometry.2.2.1 r t s
    have hl : labels term = (r,t,s) := hrest.1.trans hlab
    have hS : swaps (projected (pair r t s)) = L O := congrArg swaps hP
    obtain ⟨data, hd, hin⟩ :
        ∃ data : RightData (L O), labels data = (r,t,s) ∧ isInclusion data :=
      hS ▸ ⟨term, hl, hInc⟩
    have hrep : representative data = pair r t s := by
      change pair (labels data).1 (labels data).2.1 (labels data).2.2 = pair r t s
      rw [hd]
    have hi : image data = L O := by
      rcases data with ⟨i,j,k,rd,td,sd⟩
      ext p
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
        change (j.toHom z : U) ∈ L O
        rw [hin z]
        exact z.property
      · intro hz
        exact ⟨⟨p,hz⟩, hin ⟨p,hz⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨_, fin, hf⟩ := singleton (extremal (rep O)).1.2 data
    refine ⟨data,fin, hrep ▸ hO, hrep ▸ hP, hin, ?_⟩
    intro R _ z
    have hc := hf R z
    rw [hrep, hO, hP, hi] at hc
    exact hc
  have minimum (O : Orbits) :
      IsLeast {n : Nat | ∃ T : RightTerm, rightOrbit T = O.val ∧
        ∀ z : Pair, coefficient (ULift Int) (evaluate (ULift Int) (rightDiagram (ULift Int) T)) z =
          entry (ULift Int) O.val (n : ULift Int) z} (index O) := by
    constructor
    · obtain ⟨data,fin,hO,_,_,hc⟩ := generate O
      exact ⟨⟨⟨L O,data⟩,(extremal (rep O)).1.2,fin⟩,hO,hc (ULift Int)⟩
    · rintro n ⟨T,hO,hn⟩
      let z := rightRepresentative T
      have self : z ∈ rightOrbit T := MulAction.mem_orbit_self z
      have hz : z ∈ O.val := hO ▸ self
      obtain ⟨_, div, hc⟩ := allRight (ULift Int) T
      have he := (hn z).symm.trans (hc z)
      rw [show entry (ULift Int) O.val (n : ULift Int) z = (n : ULift Int) from ite_eq_left hz,
        show entry (ULift Int) (rightOrbit T) ((rightImage T).relIndex (projected z) : ULift Int) z =
          ((rightImage T).relIndex (projected z) : ULift Int) from ite_eq_left self] at he
      have hdown : (n : Int) = ((rightImage T).relIndex (projected z) : Int) :=
        congrArg ULift.down he
      have eq := Nat.cast_injective hdown
      rw [transport O z hz, ← eq] at div
      haveI : Finite (projected z) :=
        Finite.of_injective (Subgroup.inclusion (project_le z)) (Subgroup.inclusion_injective _)
      have hn' : n ≠ 0 := by
        rw [eq, Subgroup.relIndex, Subgroup.index_eq_card]
        exact Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨inferInstance,inferInstance⟩
      exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn') div
  -- The finite boundary supplies all orbit coordinates. Every full drawing
  -- is a finite sum over its three label lists, retaining the projection
  -- fiber witness in each lower label. At each orbit the inclusion term
  -- realizes the ideal generator.
  let coord (R : Type _) [CommRing R] : ↥(bimoduleMaps R) ≃ₗ[R] Orbits → R :=
    coordinates R (X := X) (Y := Y)
  let basis (R : Type _) [CommRing R] := Module.Basis.ofEquivFun (coord R)
  have unitEntry (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (O : Orbits) (z : Pair) :
      coefficient R (basis R O).val z = entry R O.val 1 z := by
    change matrixEntry (basis R O).val z = _
    rw [coordinates_entry (X := X) (Y := Y) (basis R O) z]
    change (coord R) (basis R O) (orbitOf z) = _
    have hbase : basis R O = (coord R).symm (Pi.single O 1) :=
      congrFun (Module.Basis.coe_ofEquivFun (coord R)) O
    rw [hbase, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    by_cases h : orbitOf z = O
    · rw [ite_eq_left h]
      exact (ite_eq_left ((orbitOf_eq O z).mp h)).symm
    · rw [ite_eq_right h]
      exact (ite_eq_right (fun hz => h ((orbitOf_eq O z).mpr hz))).symm
  have span (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (M : ↥(bimoduleMaps R)) :
      M ∈ rightSpan R ↔ ∀ O, (basis R).repr M O ∈ Ideal.span ({(index O : R)} : Set R) := by
    apply span_coordinates (basis R) (fun O => (index O : R))
    · let Good : Submodule R ↥(bimoduleMaps R) :=
        { carrier := {M | ∀ O, coord R M O ∈ Ideal.span ({(index O : R)} : Set R)}
          zero_mem' := fun O => by simp
          add_mem' := fun hm hn O => by rw [map_add, Pi.add_apply]; exact Ideal.add_mem _ (hm O) (hn O)
          smul_mem' := fun r m hm O => by rw [map_smul, Pi.smul_apply]; exact (Ideal.span ({(index O : R)} : Set R)).smul_mem r (hm O) }
      rintro _ ⟨⟨⟨B',i,j,k,r,t,s⟩,hp⟩,rfl⟩ O
      rw [Module.Basis.ofEquivFun_repr_apply]
      have hg : asMap (evalD (RightSpanProof.rightDrawing a b d c e f R i j k r t s)) ∈ Good := by
        apply right_weighted_mem a b d c e f i j k Good
        intro r₀ t₀ s₀ Q
        let T : RightTerm := ⟨⟨B',i,j,k,r₀.dot,t₀,s₀⟩,hp,r₀.finite⟩
        obtain ⟨_, hd, hc⟩ := allRight R T
        change coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagram R T)) (rep Q) ∈ _
        rw [hc]
        by_cases hz : rep Q ∈ rightOrbit T
        · rw [show entry R (rightOrbit T) ((rightImage T).relIndex
              (projected (rightRepresentative T)) : R) (rep Q) = _ from ite_eq_left hz,
            Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
          have hOrb : orbit (rep Q) = Q.val := Classical.choose_spec Q.property
          have eQ : Q.val = rightOrbit T := hOrb.symm.trans (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr hz)
          have hz' : rightRepresentative T ∈ Q.val := eQ.symm ▸ MulAction.mem_orbit_self _
          rw [← transport Q _ hz']
          obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hd
          exact ⟨(m : R), by simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using congrArg (Nat.cast : Nat → R) hm⟩
        · rw [show entry R (rightOrbit T) ((rightImage T).relIndex
              (projected (rightRepresentative T)) : R) (rep Q) = 0 from ite_eq_right hz]
          exact Ideal.zero_mem _
      exact hg O
    · intro O
      obtain ⟨data,fin,_,_,_,hcoef⟩ := generate O
      rcases data with ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩
      let lab : {data : RightLabels R // parabolic data.1} :=
        ⟨⟨L O,i,j,k,[(1,⟨r,fin⟩)],[(1,t)],[(1,s)]⟩,(extremal (rep O)).1.2⟩
      let M : ↥(bimoduleMaps R) := asMap (rightHom R lab)
      have hm : M ∈ rightSpan R := Submodule.subset_span ⟨lab,rfl⟩
      have he : M = (index O : R) • basis R O := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
        intro x r'
        rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one x r', map_smul, map_smul]
        congr 1
        ext y
        change coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagramOf R ⟨i,j,k,r,t,s⟩ fin)) (x,y) =
          (index O : R) * coefficient R (basis R O).val (x,y)
        rw [hcoef R, unitEntry]
        by_cases hz : (x,y) ∈ O.val
        · rw [show entry R O.val (index O : R) (x,y) = _ from ite_eq_left hz,
            show entry R O.val 1 (x,y) = _ from ite_eq_left hz, mul_one]
        · rw [show entry R O.val (index O : R) (x,y) = 0 from ite_eq_right hz,
            show entry R O.val 1 (x,y) = 0 from ite_eq_right hz, mul_zero]
      exact he ▸ hm
  refine ⟨fun O => ⟨project_le _, extremal _, transport O, minimum O, indexOne O⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro R _
    exact ⟨allRight R, fun O => by
      obtain ⟨d,fin,ho,hp,hi,h⟩ := generate O
      exact ⟨d,fin,ho,hp,hi,h R⟩, basis R, unitEntry R, span R⟩
  ·
    -- Alphabeta Math's reduction modulo n example, Steps 1.1–2.1, suggests
    -- reducing each coordinate and identifying the kernel. Surjectivity and
    -- the kernel formula hold for every modulus by the ZMod declarations.
    -- The additive first isomorphism theorem then applies to the assembled
    -- surjection. ULift Int scalars act by integer multiples.
    -- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/ex-reduction-modulo-n-first-isomorphism
    apply integer_quotient (coord (ULift Int)) index
    intro M
    exact (span (ULift Int) M).trans (forall_congr' fun O => by
      rw [show (basis (ULift Int)).repr M O = coord (ULift Int) M O from
        Module.Basis.ofEquivFun_repr_apply _ _ _])
  ·
    -- Step 6. ParabolicCaseFiveCoefficientOneExpansion provides the parabolic
    -- stabilizer on each supported ℂ orbit. SupportedLeftOrbitProjectedStabilizer
    -- gives coefficient one there. The common natural coefficients identify
    -- this support with integral support and give the entries over R. Choose
    -- the indexed family at integral support before choosing R.
    intro B hB u v w r t s fin left S
    obtain ⟨expC, _, complexTerms, _⟩ :=
      (ParabolicCaseFiveCoefficientOneExpansion G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b d c e f).1
        B hB u v w r t s fin
    let M := (evalD (leftDrawing a b d c e f Complex u v w r t s fin)).toLinearMap
    let SC : Set (Set Pair) := {O | ∃ z : Pair, O = orbit z ∧ matrixEntry (X := X) (Y := Y) M z ≠ 0}
    let naturalEntry (z : Pair) : Nat :=
      (evalD (leftDrawing a b d c e f Nat u v w r t s fin)).toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2
    have complexNat (z : Pair) :
        (naturalEntry z : Complex) = matrixEntry (X := X) (Y := Y) M z :=
      compatible_entry (Nat.castRingHom Complex)
        (left_cast a b d c e f (Nat.castRingHom Complex) u v w r t s fin) z
    have ringNat (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (z : Pair) :
        (naturalEntry z : R) = coefficient R (evaluate R (left R)) z :=
      compatible_entry (Nat.castRingHom R)
        (left_cast a b d c e f (Nat.castRingHom R) u v w r t s fin) z
    have leftCoeff (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (z : Pair) (n : Nat)
        (hn : matrixEntry (X := X) (Y := Y) M z = (n : Complex)) :

namespace RightSpanProof

open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section

universe u
variable {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]

private abbrev castVector (f : R →+* S) {I : Type*} :=
  Finsupp.mapRange.addMonoidHom f.toAddMonoidHom (ι := I)

private theorem cast_single (f : R →+* S) {I : Type*} (x : I) (r : R) :
    castVector f (Finsupp.single x r) = Finsupp.single x (f r) :=
  Finsupp.mapRange_single (hf := f.map_zero)

private theorem cast_smul (f : R →+* S) {I : Type*} (r : R) (x : I →₀ R) :
    castVector f (r • x) = f r • castVector f x := by
  ext i
  exact map_mul f r (x i)

private def compatible (f : R →+* S) {I J : Type*}
    (A : (I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] J →₀ R) (B : (I →₀ S) →ₗ[S] J →₀ S) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, castVector f (A x) = B (castVector f x)

private theorem compatible_of_single (f : R →+* S) {I J : Type*}
    {A : (I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] J →₀ R} {B : (I →₀ S) →ₗ[S] J →₀ S}
    (h : ∀ i, castVector f (A (Finsupp.single i 1)) = B (Finsupp.single i 1)) :
    compatible f A B := by
  intro x
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | single i r =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one i r, map_smul, cast_smul, cast_smul, map_smul,
      cast_single, map_one, h]

private theorem compatible_comp (f : R →+* S) {I J K : Type*}
    {A : (I →₀ R) →ₗ[R] J →₀ R} {B : (I →₀ S) →ₗ[S] J →₀ S}
    {C : (J →₀ R) →ₗ[R] K →₀ R} {D : (J →₀ S) →ₗ[S] K →₀ S}
    (h : compatible f A B) (k : compatible f C D) :
    compatible f (C.comp A) (D.comp B) := fun x =>
  (k (A x)).trans (congrArg D (h x))

-- Alphabeta Math's balanced tensor associativity, Step 3.2, checks the
-- comparison on elementary balanced pairs. In this model the pairing is
-- coefficient-linear in each variable, with the middle group action imposing
-- the balancing relation. Xiao § 1.2 in the archived wording describes
-- bilinearity over the common group algebra. On a noncommutative regular
-- bimodule, right multiplication by a noncentral scalar can fail right
-- linearity (s * r ≠ r * s at 1). The published revision states ℂ-bilinearity
-- on maps. Here the argument uses coefficient-semiring bilinearity on maps.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-associativity-of-balanced-tensor-products
private theorem compatible_pair (f : R →+* S) {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
    (X : Biset K H) (Y : Biset H J) (x : X.carrier →₀ R) (y : Y.carrier →₀ R) :
    castVector f (Biset.pairLinear R X Y x y) =
      Biset.pairLinear S X Y (castVector f x) (castVector f y) := by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' h h' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, h, h']
  | single a r =>
    induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' h h' => simp only [map_add, h, h']
    | single b s => rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, cast_single, cast_single, cast_single,
        Biset.pairLinear_single, map_mul]

private abbrev homCompatible (f : R →+* S) {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    {X Y : Biset K H} (a : Biset.Hom R X Y) (b : Biset.Hom S X Y) :=
  compatible f a.toLinearMap b.toLinearMap

private theorem compatible_horizontal (f : R →+* S) {K H J : Type u}
    [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
    {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}
    {a : Biset.Hom R X X'} {b : Biset.Hom S X X'}
    {c : Biset.Hom R Y Y'} {d : Biset.Hom S Y Y'}
    (h : homCompatible f a b) (k : homCompatible f c d) :
    homCompatible f (a.horizontal c) (b.horizontal d) := by
  apply compatible_of_single
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨x,y⟩ => ?_
  change castVector f ((a.horizontal c).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) 1)) =
    (b.horizontal d).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) 1)
  simp only [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul]
  rw [compatible_pair, h, k, cast_single, cast_single, map_one]

private theorem compatible_push (f : R →+* S) {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    {X Y : Biset K H} (k : X.carrier → Y.carrier)
    (hk : ∀ g x, k (X.act g x) = Y.act g (k x)) :
    homCompatible f (Biset.Hom.ofFunction k hk) (Biset.Hom.ofFunction k hk) := by
  apply compatible_of_single
  intro x
  simp only [Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, map_one]

private theorem compatible_pull (f : R →+* S) {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
    {X Y : Biset K H} (k : X.carrier → Y.carrier)
    (hk : ∀ g x, k (X.act g x) = Y.act g (k x))
    (fin : ∀ y, Set.Finite {x | k x = y}) :
    homCompatible f (Biset.Hom.transfer R k hk fin) (Biset.Hom.transfer S k hk fin) := by
  apply compatible_of_single
  intro y
  simp only [Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum,
    map_sum, cast_single, map_one]

private abbrev evalD {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    (D : LabelledDrawing R p q) := D.interpret.eval

section Words

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H J F G A C D E B : Subgroup U}

private theorem compatible_id (f : R →+* S) (p : Word K H) :
    homCompatible f (evalD (.ordinary (.id p))) (evalD (.ordinary (.id p))) := fun _ => rfl

private theorem compatible_assoc (f : R →+* S) (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) (r : Word J F) :
    homCompatible f (evalD (.ordinary (.associate p q r)))
      (evalD (.ordinary (.associate p q r))) :=
  compatible_push f _ (by
    intro g w
    refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨xy,z⟩ => ?_)
    exact Quotient.inductionOn xy (fun _ => rfl))

private theorem compatible_unassoc (f : R →+* S) (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) (r : Word J F) :
    homCompatible f (evalD (.ordinary (.unassociate p q r)))
      (evalD (.ordinary (.unassociate p q r))) :=
  compatible_push f _ (by
    intro g w
    refine Quotient.inductionOn w (fun ⟨x,yz⟩ => ?_)
    exact Quotient.inductionOn yz (fun _ => rfl))

private theorem compatible_mult (f : R →+* S) (b : ConjEmbedding K G) (d : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (i : ConjEmbedding J K) (j : ConjEmbedding J H) (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j)) :
    homCompatible f ((Diagram.mixedMultiplication b d i j r).eval)
      ((Diagram.mixedMultiplication b d i j r).eval) :=
  compatible_push f _ (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant b d i j r)

private theorem compatible_proj (f : R →+* S) (b : ConjEmbedding K G) (d : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (i : ConjEmbedding J K) (j : ConjEmbedding J H) (r : Dot (b.comp i) (d.comp j))
    (fin : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w = z}) :
    homCompatible f ((Diagram.mixedProjection b d i j r fin).eval)
      ((Diagram.mixedProjection b d i j r fin).eval) :=
  compatible_pull f _ (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant b d i j r) fin

private theorem compatible_up (f : R →+* S) (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (i : ConjEmbedding B A)
    (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (k : ConjEmbedding B C) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)) :
    homCompatible f ((Diagram.parallelUp a i c k t).eval) ((Diagram.parallelUp a i c k t).eval) := by
  apply compatible_of_single
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨x,y⟩ => ?_
  change castVector f ((Diagram.parallelUp a i c k t).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.induction i) x y) 1)) =
      (Diagram.parallelUp a i c k t).eval.toLinearMap
        (Finsupp.single ((Biset.induction a).pair (Biset.induction i) x y) 1)
  change G at x
  change A at y
  change castVector f ((Diagram.splitUp c k).eval.toLinearMap
    ((Diagram.upDot t).eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeUp a i).eval.toLinearMap _))) =
    (Diagram.splitUp c k).eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.upDot t).eval.toLinearMap ((Diagram.mergeUp a i).eval.toLinearMap _))
  rw [Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single, Diagram.eval_mergeUp_single,
    Diagram.eval_upDot_single, Diagram.eval_upDot_single,
    Diagram.eval_splitUp_single, Diagram.eval_splitUp_single, cast_single, map_one]

private theorem singleton_label {p q : Word K H} (D : Diagram R p q) :
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, ScopedDiagram.ordinary D)]).eval = D.eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  ext x
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, ScopedDiagram.eval]

private theorem compatible_vertical (f : R →+* S) {p q r : Word K H}
    {a : LabelledDrawing R p q} {b : LabelledDrawing S p q}
    {c : LabelledDrawing R q r} {d : LabelledDrawing S q r}
    (h : homCompatible f (evalD a) (evalD b)) (k : homCompatible f (evalD c) (evalD d)) :
    homCompatible f (evalD (.vertical a c)) (evalD (.vertical b d)) :=
  compatible_comp f h k

private theorem compatible_side (f : R →+* S)
    {p p' : Word K H} {q q' : Word H J}
    {a : LabelledDrawing R p p'} {b : LabelledDrawing S p p'}
    {c : LabelledDrawing R q q'} {d : LabelledDrawing S q q'}
    (h : homCompatible f (evalD a) (evalD b)) (k : homCompatible f (evalD c) (evalD d)) :
    homCompatible f (evalD (.horizontal a c)) (evalD (.horizontal b d)) :=
  compatible_horizontal f h k

end Words
end
