universe v
variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)

private abbrev word (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D) :=
  (Word.up a).tensor ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d))

private abbrev drawId (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) :=
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := R) p)

include a b d c e f in
private abbrev rightDrawing (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] {B' : Subgroup U}
      (i : ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : ConjEmbedding B' C)
      (r : List (R × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
      (t : List (R × Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)))
      (s : List (R × Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j))) : LabelledDrawing R (word a b d) (word c e f) :=
    let ai := Word.up i
    let fj := Word.down j
    let ck := Word.up k
    let lower := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j r
    let middle := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k t
    let upper := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j s
    LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId R (Word.up a)) lower)
      (LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (Word.up a) ai fj))
        (LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.horizontal middle (drawId R fj))
          (LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.associate (Word.up c) ck fj))
            (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId R (Word.up c)) upper))))

private abbrev leftUpperFiber {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (w : ConjEmbedding E B)
      (s : Dot (u.comp c) (w.comp e)) :=
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s p = z}
private abbrev leftDrawing (R : Type v) [CommSemiring R] {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b))
      (t : Dot (v.comp d) (w.comp f))
      (s : Dot (u.comp c) (w.comp e)) (finite : leftUpperFiber c e u w s) : LabelledDrawing R (word a b d) (word c e f) :=
    let lower := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := R) u v a b [(1, r)]
    let middle := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := R) v d w f [(1, t)]
    let upper := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) u w c e [(1, ⟨s, finite⟩)]
    LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (Word.up a) (Word.down b) (Word.up d)))
      (LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (LabelledDrawing.horizontal lower (drawId R (Word.up d)))
        (LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.associate (Word.down u) (Word.up v) (Word.up d)))
          (LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId R (Word.down u)) middle)
            (LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (Word.down u) (Word.up w) (Word.up f)))
              (LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (LabelledDrawing.horizontal upper (drawId R (Word.up f)))
                (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.associate (Word.up c) (Word.down e) (Word.up f))))))))

private theorem compatible_label {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (φ : R →+* S) {p q : Word A D} (T : Diagram R p q) (T' : Diagram S p q)
    (h : homCompatible φ T.eval T'.eval) :
    homCompatible φ (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, ScopedDiagram.ordinary T)]).eval
      (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, ScopedDiagram.ordinary T')]).eval := by
  simpa only [singleton_label] using h

private theorem right_cast {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (r : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))
    (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) :
    homCompatible φ (evalD (rightDrawing a b d c e f R i j k [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)]))
      (evalD (rightDrawing a b d c e f S i j k [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)])) := by
  unfold rightDrawing
  apply compatible_vertical
  · apply compatible_side
    · exact compatible_id φ _
    · exact compatible_label φ _ _ (compatible_proj φ b d i j r.dot r.finite)
  apply compatible_vertical (k := ?_)
  · exact compatible_unassoc φ _ _ _
  apply compatible_vertical
  · apply compatible_side
    · exact compatible_label φ _ _ (compatible_up φ a i c k t)
    · exact compatible_id φ _
  apply compatible_vertical (k := ?_)
  · exact compatible_assoc φ _ _ _
  apply compatible_side
  · exact compatible_id φ _
  · exact compatible_label φ _ _ (compatible_mult φ e f k j s)

private theorem left_cast {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B)
    (w : ConjEmbedding E B) (r : Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b))
    (t : Dot (v.comp d) (w.comp f)) (s : Dot (u.comp c) (w.comp e))
    (fin : leftUpperFiber c e u w s) :
    homCompatible φ (evalD (leftDrawing a b d c e f R u v w r t s fin))
      (evalD (leftDrawing a b d c e f S u v w r t s fin)) := by
  unfold leftDrawing
  apply compatible_vertical (k := ?_)
  · exact compatible_unassoc φ _ _ _
  apply compatible_vertical
  · apply compatible_side
    · exact compatible_label φ _ _ (compatible_mult φ u v a b r)
    · exact compatible_id φ _
  apply compatible_vertical (k := ?_)
  · exact compatible_assoc φ _ _ _
  apply compatible_vertical
  · apply compatible_side
    · exact compatible_id φ _
    · exact compatible_label φ _ _ (compatible_up φ v d w f t)
  apply compatible_vertical (k := ?_)
  · exact compatible_unassoc φ _ _ _
  apply compatible_vertical
  · apply compatible_side
    · exact compatible_label φ _ _ (compatible_proj φ u w c e s fin)
    · exact compatible_id φ _
  exact compatible_assoc φ _ _ _

private theorem compatible_entry {R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
    (φ : R →+* S) {p q : Word G F} {T : LabelledDrawing R p q}
    {T' : LabelledDrawing S p q} (h : homCompatible φ (evalD T) (evalD T'))
    (z : p.basis.carrier × q.basis.carrier) :
    φ ((evalD T).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2) =
      (evalD T').toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2 := by
  have hvec := h (Finsupp.single z.1 1)
  rw [cast_single, map_one] at hvec
  have h' := DFunLike.congr_fun hvec z.2
  change φ (((evalD T).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z.1 1)) z.2) = _ at h'
  exact h'

variable {K H : Type u} [Group K] [Group H]
variable {X Y : Biset K H}

private abbrev pairAction (X Y : Biset K H) : MulAction (K × H) (X.carrier × Y.carrier) where
  smul g z := (X.act g z.1, Y.act g z.2)
  one_smul z := Prod.ext (X.one_act z.1) (Y.one_act z.2)
  mul_smul g k z := Prod.ext (X.mul_act g k z.1) (Y.mul_act g k z.2)

private local instance : MulAction (K × H) (X.carrier × Y.carrier) := pairAction X Y

private abbrev OrbitIndex (X Y : Biset K H) :=
  ↥(Set.range (MulAction.orbit (K × H) : X.carrier × Y.carrier → _))

private def orbitOf (z : X.carrier × Y.carrier) : OrbitIndex X Y :=
  ⟨MulAction.orbit (K × H) z, ⟨z, rfl⟩⟩

private def orbitRep (O : OrbitIndex X Y) : X.carrier × Y.carrier :=
  Classical.choose O.property

private theorem orbitOf_rep (O : OrbitIndex X Y) : orbitOf (orbitRep O) = O :=
  Subtype.ext (Classical.choose_spec O.property)

private theorem orbitOf_eq (O : OrbitIndex X Y) (z : X.carrier × Y.carrier) :
    orbitOf z = O ↔ z ∈ O.val := by
  rw [← orbitOf_rep O]
  exact ⟨fun h => MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mp (congrArg Subtype.val h),
    fun h => Subtype.ext (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr h)⟩

private abbrev matrixEntry {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (M : (X.carrier →₀ R) →ₗ[R] Y.carrier →₀ R) (z : X.carrier × Y.carrier) : R :=
  M (Finsupp.single z.1 1) z.2

private def equivariant (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (X Y : Biset K H) :
    Submodule R ((X.carrier →₀ R) →ₗ[R] Y.carrier →₀ R) where
  carrier := {m | ∀ g x, m (X.actLinear R g x) = Y.actLinear R g (m x)}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro m n hm hn g x
    change (m + n) (X.actLinear R g x) = Y.actLinear R g ((m + n) x)
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, hm g x, hn g x]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro r m hm g x
    change (r • m) (X.actLinear R g x) = Y.actLinear R g ((r • m) x)
    simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, hm g x]

private theorem actLinear_apply_act {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (g : K × H)
    (w : Y.carrier →₀ R) (y : Y.carrier) :
    Y.actLinear R g w (Y.act g y) = w y := by
  apply Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective
  intro a b h
  simpa only [← Y.mul_act, inv_mul_cancel, Y.one_act] using congrArg (Y.act g⁻¹) h

private theorem matrix_invariant {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (M : equivariant R X Y)
    (z : X.carrier × Y.carrier) (g : K × H) :
    matrixEntry M.val (g • z) = matrixEntry M.val z := by
  change M.val (Finsupp.single (X.act g z.1) 1) (Y.act g z.2) = _
  rw [← Biset.actLinear_single, M.property g, actLinear_apply_act]

private def coordinates (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [Finite Y.carrier] :
    equivariant R X Y ≃ₗ[R] OrbitIndex X Y → R := by
  let coord : equivariant R X Y →ₗ[R] OrbitIndex X Y → R :=
    { toFun := fun M O => matrixEntry M.val (orbitRep O)
      map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
      map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
  apply LinearEquiv.ofBijective coord
  have hM (M : equivariant R X Y) (z : X.carrier × Y.carrier) :
      matrixEntry M.val z = coord M (orbitOf z) := by
    have h := (orbitOf_eq (orbitOf z) z).mp rfl
    rw [← orbitOf_rep (orbitOf z)] at h
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h
    exact (congrArg (matrixEntry M.val) hg).symm.trans (matrix_invariant M _ g)
  constructor
  · intro M N h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro x r
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one x r, map_smul, map_smul]
    congr 1
    ext y
    exact (hM M (x,y)).trans ((congrFun h (orbitOf (x,y))).trans (hM N (x,y)).symm)
  · intro v
    let col (x : X.carrier) : Y.carrier →₀ R :=
      Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (fun y => v (orbitOf (x,y)))
    have hcol (x : X.carrier) (y : Y.carrier) : col x y = v (orbitOf (x,y)) :=
      Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite_symm_apply_apply _ _
    let M := Biset.Hom.ofBasis col (by
      intro g x
      ext y
      have sur : Function.Surjective (Y.act g) :=
        fun z => ⟨Y.act g⁻¹ z, by rw [← Y.mul_act, mul_inv_cancel, Y.one_act]⟩
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := sur y
      rw [actLinear_apply_act, hcol, hcol]
      apply congrArg v
      exact Subtype.ext (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr ⟨g,rfl⟩))
    refine ⟨⟨M.toLinearMap,M.commutes⟩, ?_⟩
    funext O
    change M.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (orbitRep O).1 1) (orbitRep O).2 = v O
    rw [Biset.Hom.ofBasis_single, one_smul, hcol, orbitOf_rep]

private theorem coordinates_entry {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Finite Y.carrier]
    (M : equivariant R X Y) (z : X.carrier × Y.carrier) :
    matrixEntry M.val z = coordinates R M (orbitOf z) := by
  have h := (orbitOf_eq (orbitOf z) z).mp rfl
  rw [← orbitOf_rep (orbitOf z)] at h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h
  exact (congrArg (matrixEntry M.val) hg).symm.trans (matrix_invariant M _ g)

private theorem span_coordinates {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {I M : Type*}
    [Finite I] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (b : Module.Basis I R M) (n : I → R)
    (s : Set M) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ i, b.repr x i ∈ Ideal.span ({n i} : Set R))
    (gen : ∀ i, n i • b i ∈ Submodule.span R s) (x : M) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span R s ↔ ∀ i, b.repr x i ∈ Ideal.span ({n i} : Set R) := by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite I
  constructor
  · refine Submodule.span_induction h (fun i => by simp) ?_ ?_
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy i
      simpa only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply] using (Ideal.span ({n i} : Set R)).add_mem (hx i) (hy i)
    · intro r x _ hx i
      simpa only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply] using (Ideal.span ({n i} : Set R)).smul_mem r (hx i)
  · intro hx
    rw [← b.sum_repr x]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro i _
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp (hx i)
    rw [hr, mul_comm, ← smul_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r (gen i)

private theorem integer_quotient {I M : Type*} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ULift Int) M]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[ULift Int] I → ULift Int) (n : I → Nat) (s : Set M)
    (hs : ∀ x, x ∈ Submodule.span (ULift Int) s ↔
      ∀ i, e x i ∈ Ideal.span ({(n i : ULift Int)} : Set (ULift Int))) :
    Nonempty ((M ⧸ AddSubgroup.closure s) ≃+ DirectSum I (fun i => ZMod (n i))) := by
  let modCoord (i : I) : M →+ ZMod (n i) :=
    { toFun := fun x => ((e x i).down : ZMod (n i))
      map_zero' := by simp
      map_add' := fun x y => by simp [map_add, ULift.add_down] }
  let p := AddMonoidHom.pi modCoord
  have hsur : Function.Surjective p := by
    intro z
    choose a ha using fun i => (ZMod.intCast_surjective (n := n i)) (z i)
    refine ⟨e.symm (fun i => ULift.up (a i)), ?_⟩
    funext i
    change (((e (e.symm fun i => ULift.up (a i))) i).down : ZMod (n i)) = z i
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
    exact ha i
  have hc : AddSubgroup.closure s = (Submodule.span (ULift Int) s).toAddSubgroup := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (AddSubgroup.closure_le _).mpr (Submodule.subset_span (R := ULift Int))
    · intro x hx
      change x ∈ Submodule.span (ULift Int) s at hx
      refine Submodule.span_induction (fun x h => AddSubgroup.subset_closure h)
        (AddSubgroup.zero_mem _) (fun x y _ _ => AddSubgroup.add_mem _) ?_ hx
      intro r x _ h
      have hr : (r.down : ULift Int) = r := rfl
      rw [← hr, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
      exact AddSubgroup.zsmul_mem _ h _
  have hk : AddSubgroup.closure s = p.ker := by
    ext x
    rw [hc]
    change x ∈ Submodule.span (ULift Int) s ↔ p x = 0
    rw [hs, funext_iff]
    apply forall_congr'
    intro i
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    change (n i : ULift Int) ∣ e x i ↔ ((e x i).down : ZMod (n i)) = 0
    rw [ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
      exact ⟨r.down, congrArg ULift.down hr⟩
    · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
      exact ⟨ULift.up r, ULift.down_injective hr⟩
  rw [hk]
  exact ⟨(QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective p hsur).trans
    (DirectSum.addEquivProd (fun i => ZMod (n i))).symm⟩
end
end RightSpanProof
namespace RightSpanProof
open MackeyDiagrams
noncomputable section
private abbrev Sinf := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev blockSym (X : Finset Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ X))
private abbrev ParabolicPerm (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
    H = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l)
private abbrev IsParabolic (H : Subgroup Sinf) := ParabolicPerm (H.map Sinf.subtype)
private abbrev swaps (P : Subgroup Sinf) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ : Sinf | σ ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)}

private theorem parabolic_finite {H : Subgroup Sinf} (hH : IsParabolic H) : Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, hblocks⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have hsub : H.map Sinf.subtype ≤ blockSym X := by
    rw [hblocks]
    refine iSup_le fun i σ hs => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
    let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ
    have moved_mem (x : Nat) (hx : σ x ≠ x) : x ∈ X := by
      by_contra hn
      have hi : x ∉ blocks i := fun hx' => hn (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx'⟩)
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hi)
    have preserves (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · rw [h]
      · have hy : σ (σ x) ≠ σ x := fun hh => h (σ.injective hh)
        exact iff_of_true (moved_mem (σ x) hy) (moved_mem x h)
    exact ⟨σ.subtypePerm preserves, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserves moved_mem⟩
  let : Finite (blockSym X) :=
    (Set.finite_range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))).to_subtype
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun h : H => (⟨(h.val : Equiv.Perm Nat), hsub ⟨h.val, h.property, rfl⟩⟩ : blockSym X))
    (fun _ _ hh => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y : blockSym X => y.val) hh)))

private theorem parabolic_extremal (P : Subgroup Sinf) [Finite P] :
    IsGreatest {K : Subgroup Sinf | IsParabolic K ∧ K ≤ P} (swaps P) := by
  classical
  let Q := P.map Sinf.subtype
  letI : Finite Q := Finite.of_surjective (fun p : P => (⟨p.val.val, ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩⟩ : Q))
    (by rintro ⟨_, i, hi, rfl⟩; exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩)
  have hQ : Q ≤ Sinf := fun _ ⟨p, _, hp⟩ => hp ▸ p.property
  have unionWitness (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :
      ParabolicPerm H ↔ ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
        (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
        (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧ H = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l) := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩
      exact ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, n, blocks, hn, hd, by simp, he⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, n, blocks, hn, hd, _, he⟩
      exact ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩
  have hmap : (swaps P).map Sinf.subtype =
      Subgroup.closure {σ | σ ∈ Q ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ} := by
    rw [MonoidHom.map_closure]
    congr 1
    ext σ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hs⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hs⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hs⟩
      exact ⟨p, ⟨hp, hs⟩, rfl⟩
  have h := (ExtremalParabolicsOfFiniteGroup Q hQ).1
  rw [← hmap] at h
  refine ⟨⟨(unionWitness _).mpr h.1.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact (Subgroup.map_le_map_iff_of_injective Sinf.subtype_injective).mp h.1.2
  · intro K hK
    exact (Subgroup.map_le_map_iff_of_injective Sinf.subtype_injective).mp
      (h.2 ⟨(unionWitness _).mp hK.1, Subgroup.map_mono hK.2⟩)

private theorem conjugate_parabolic {B F : Subgroup Sinf} (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (hB : IsParabolic B) : IsParabolic ((F.subtype.comp j.toHom).range) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := j.hasRepresentative
  let conj := (MulAut.conj (q : Equiv.Perm Nat)).toMonoidHom
  have hmap : ((F.subtype.comp j.toHom).range).map Sinf.subtype =
      (B.map Sinf.subtype).map conj := by
    ext σ
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨p, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p.val.val, ⟨p.val, p.property, rfl⟩, (congrArg Subtype.val (hq p)).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨j.toHom ⟨p, hp⟩, ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, rfl⟩, congrArg Subtype.val (hq ⟨p, hp⟩)⟩
  have hcarrier : ∃ X : Finset Nat, ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
      (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
      (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧ B.map Sinf.subtype = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l) := by
    obtain ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, he⟩ := hB
    exact ⟨Finset.univ.biUnion blocks, n, blocks, hn, hd, by simp, he⟩
  obtain ⟨_, n, blocks, hn, hd, _, he⟩ := FiniteParabolicClosure.1 (B.map Sinf.subtype) hcarrier q
  exact ⟨n, blocks, hn, hd, hmap.trans he⟩

variable {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
private abbrev point (g : G) (x : D) : (word a b d).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b |>.tensor (.up d)).basis) g (Generator.mixedPair b d x)
private theorem point_surjective (z : (word a b d).basis.carrier) :
    ∃ g x, point a b d g x = z := by
  obtain ⟨⟨g, y⟩, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).symm.surjective y
  exact ⟨g, x, rfl⟩

private theorem finite_word_of_groups {W : Type*} [Group W] {G A D F : Subgroup W}
    [Finite G] [Finite D]
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D) :
    Finite (word a b d).basis.carrier :=
  Finite.of_surjective (fun p : G × D => point a b d p.1 p.2) (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨g, x', h⟩ := point_surjective a b d x
    exact ⟨(g, x'), h⟩)


private theorem act_left (g h : G) (x : D) :
    (word a b d).basis.act (g, (1 : F)) (point a b d h x) = point a b d (g * h) x := by
  change (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis
    (g * h * (a.toHom 1)⁻¹)
    (((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis.act (1, 1) (Generator.mixedPair b d x)) = _
  simp only [map_one, inv_one, mul_one, ← Prod.one_eq_mk, Biset.one_act]

private theorem normalize_left (z : (word a b d).basis.carrier × (word c e f).basis.carrier) :
    letI := pairAction (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis
    ∃ (g : G) (r : D) (t : G) (s : E),
      (g, (1 : F)) • z = (point a b d 1 r, point c e f t s) := by
  letI := pairAction (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis
  obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := z
  obtain ⟨h, r, rfl⟩ := point_surjective a b d x
  obtain ⟨k, s, rfl⟩ := point_surjective c e f y
  refine ⟨h⁻¹, r, h⁻¹ * k, s, Prod.ext ?_ ?_⟩
  · change (word a b d).basis.act (h⁻¹, (1 : F)) (point a b d h r) = _
    rw [act_left, inv_mul_cancel]
  · exact act_left c e f h⁻¹ k s

private theorem projected_left (z : (word a b d).basis.carrier × (word c e f).basis.carrier) (g : G) :
    letI := pairAction (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis
    let π := F.subtype.comp (MonoidHom.snd G F)
    (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) ((g, (1 : F)) • z)).map π =
      (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) z).map π := by
  letI := pairAction (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis
  dsimp only
  let π := F.subtype.comp (MonoidHom.snd G F)
  change (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) ((g, (1 : F)) • z)).map π = _
  rw [MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj, Subgroup.map_map]
  congr 1
  ext q
  change (((1 : F) * q.2 * (1 : F)⁻¹ : F) : U) = (q.2 : U)
  simp

end

namespace RightSpanProof
open MackeyDiagrams
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
universe u
variable {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
variable {X X' Z : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}

private abbrev asMap (f : Biset.Hom R X X') : equivariant R X X' :=
  ⟨f.toLinearMap, f.commutes⟩

private abbrev asHom (f : equivariant R X X') : Biset.Hom R X X' :=
  ⟨f.val, f.property⟩

private def after (g : Biset.Hom R X' Z) : equivariant R X X' →ₗ[R] equivariant R X Z where
  toFun f := asMap ((asHom f).vertical g)
  map_add' x y := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    exact map_add g.toLinearMap _ _
  map_smul' r x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    exact map_smul g.toLinearMap r _

private def before (f : Biset.Hom R X X') : equivariant R X' Z →ₗ[R] equivariant R X Z where
  toFun g := asMap (f.vertical (asHom g))
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl

private def tensorLeft (f : Biset.Hom R X X') :
    equivariant R Y Y' →ₗ[R] equivariant R (X.tensor Y) (X'.tensor Y') where
  toFun g := asMap (f.horizontal (asHom g))
  map_add' g k := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z r
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨x,y⟩ => ?_
    change (f.horizontal ((asHom g).add (asHom k))).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) =
      (f.horizontal (asHom g)).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) +
      (f.horizontal (asHom k)).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r)
    simp only [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, Biset.Hom.add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, smul_add]
  map_smul' r g := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_right r f (asHom g))

private def tensorRight (g : Biset.Hom R Y Y') :
    equivariant R X X' →ₗ[R] equivariant R (X.tensor Y) (X'.tensor Y') where
  toFun f := asMap ((asHom f).horizontal g)
  map_add' f k := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z r
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z fun ⟨x,y⟩ => ?_
    change (((asHom f).add (asHom k)).horizontal g).toLinearMap
      (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) =
      ((asHom f).horizontal g).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) +
      ((asHom k).horizontal g).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r)
    simp only [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, Biset.Hom.add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, smul_add]
  map_smul' r f := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (Biset.Hom.horizontal_scale_left r (asHom f) g)

private theorem weighted_mem {U : Type*} [Group U] {K H : Subgroup U}
    {p q : Word K H} {L M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (D : L → Diagram R p q) (ls : List (R × L))
    (φ : equivariant R p.basis q.basis →ₗ[R] M) (V : Submodule R M)
    (h : ∀ d : L, φ (asMap (D d).eval) ∈ V) :
    φ (asMap (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination
      (ls.map fun (r,d) => (r, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (D d)))).eval) ∈ V := by
  induction ls with
  | nil =>
    change φ 0 ∈ V
    rw [map_zero]
    exact V.zero_mem
  | cons x xs ih =>
    change φ (x.1 • asMap (D x.2).eval + asMap
      (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (xs.map fun (r,d) => (r, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (D d)))).eval) ∈ V
    rw [map_add, map_smul]
    exact V.add_mem (V.smul_mem _ (h _)) ih

private theorem right_weighted_mem {U : Type*} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
    (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F) (k : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (V : Submodule R (equivariant R (word a b d).basis (word c e f).basis))
    (h : ∀ r t s, asMap (evalD (rightDrawing a b d c e f R i j k [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)])) ∈ V)
    (r : List (R × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (t : List (R × Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))) (s : List (R × Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j))) :
    asMap (evalD (rightDrawing a b d c e f R i j k r t s)) ∈ V := by
  let lower (r : List (R × ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)) :=
    evalD (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j r)
  let middle (t : List (R × Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k))) :=
    evalD (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k t)
  let upper (s : List (R × Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j))) :=
    evalD (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j s)
  let I₁ := Biset.Hom.id (R := R) (Word.up a).basis
  let I₂ := Biset.Hom.id (R := R) (Word.down j).basis
  let I₃ := Biset.Hom.id (R := R) (Word.up c).basis
  let α := (Diagram.unassociate (R := R) (.up a) (.up i) (.down j)).eval
  let β := (Diagram.associate (R := R) (.up c) (.up k) (.down j)).eval
  let front (r : Biset.Hom R ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis
      ((Word.up i).tensor (.down j)).basis) := I₁.horizontal r
  let mid (t : Biset.Hom R ((Word.up a).tensor (.up i)).basis
      ((Word.up c).tensor (.up k)).basis) := t.horizontal I₂
  let back (s : Biset.Hom R ((Word.up k).tensor (.down j)).basis
      ((Word.down e).tensor (.up f)).basis) := I₃.horizontal s
  let path (r : Biset.Hom R _ _) (t : Biset.Hom R _ _) (s : Biset.Hom R _ _) :=
    asMap ((front r).vertical (α.vertical ((mid t).vertical (β.vertical (back s)))))
  change path (lower r) (middle t) (upper s) ∈ V
  let slot₁ := (after (α.vertical ((mid (middle t)).vertical (β.vertical (back (upper s)))))).comp
    (tensorLeft (Y := ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis) I₁)
  apply weighted_mem (fun x : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j => .mixedProjection b d i j x.dot x.finite)
    r slot₁ V
  intro r₀
  let R₀ := (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := R) b d i j r₀.dot r₀.finite).eval
  change path R₀ (middle t) (upper s) ∈ V
  let slot₂ := (before (front R₀)).comp ((before α).comp
    ((after (β.vertical (back (upper s)))).comp (tensorRight (X' := ((Word.up c).tensor (.up k)).basis) I₂)))
  apply weighted_mem (Diagram.parallelUp a i c k) t slot₂ V
  intro t₀
  let T₀ := (Diagram.parallelUp (R := R) a i c k t₀).eval
  change path R₀ T₀ (upper s) ∈ V
  let slot₃ := (before (front R₀)).comp ((before α).comp
    ((before (mid T₀)).comp ((before β).comp (tensorLeft (Y' := ((Word.down e).tensor (.up f)).basis) I₃))))
  apply weighted_mem (Diagram.mixedMultiplication e f k j) s slot₃ V
  intro s₀
  change path R₀ T₀ (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := R) e f k j s₀).eval ∈ V
  have hr : lower [(1,r₀)] = R₀ := singleton_label _
  have ht : middle [(1,t₀)] = T₀ := singleton_label _
  have hs : upper [(1,s₀)] = (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := R) e f k j s₀).eval :=
    singleton_label _
  have used := h r₀ t₀ s₀
  change path (lower [(1,r₀)]) (middle [(1,t₀)]) (upper [(1,s₀)]) ∈ V at used
  rwa [hr, ht, hs] at used

end
end RightSpanProof

external.usage: Apply the relative-index tower to the parabolic embedding image K ≤ L ≤ P. Its product equality gives the divisibility of the singleton multiplicity by the orbit index.
Express the coordinate ideal as divisibility by the cast orbit index. Use this to assemble the span from its orbit generators and to compute the integral reduction kernel.
Compute the kernel of reduction on each integral orbit coordinate. The ULift witnesses transport divisibility by the natural orbit index between the two integer types.
Choose an integer representative at each orbit to lift every family of residues through the orbit-coordinate equivalence.
Identify ULift Int scalar multiplication with integer multiples in the comparison between additive closure and the module span of the diagram evaluations.
Identify the additive quotient by the diagram span with the codomain of the surjective coordinatewise reduction, using the checked kernel equality.
Convert the dependent product of residue groups to the direct sum by finiteness of the orbit type.

ParabolicOutsideProjectionDiagram.proof:
by
  classical
  open MackeyDiagrams in
  intro P finitary U parabolic G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f
    comp hom image conjugate bc ad de ade p element other maximum minimum Bmax Pp
    basisMap finiteFibers up down tensor vertical horizontal id projection bottom top atRight
  -- Xiao, Proposition 8.6 and the projection identity immediately after it.
  -- Archived original (bc57d137…), pp. 38–39; published 28 November revision
  -- (813c82da…), pp. 40–41. The displayed equality compares evaluations.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:parabolic-three-outside
  have hMax : parabolic Bmax :=
    (parabolic_region_bounds a b c d element hG hD hF hC).2

  -- Theorem 6.4, numbered Case 1. The registered fiber-index theorem
  -- supplies the join witness with its inclusion and (p⁻¹, 1, 1) labels.
  -- Its finite-index checks use finiteness of the ambient parabolics.
  obtain ⟨hMin, hp, ⟨u, v, w, ell, m, n⟩, ⟨hm, hn⟩,
    ⟨hu, huv, huw, hell, hmel, hnel⟩, hRight, hIndices, _, _⟩ :=
    ParabolicCaseTwoProjectionFiberIndices hG hA hD hF hC hE a b c d e f p

  -- Theorem 6.4, numbered Case 2, transported as in Proposition 8.6.
  -- The supplier's existential maximal left witness leaves its exact
  -- embeddings implicit. Use the restricted inverses on Bmax to expose
  -- all three required maps on that specific subgroup of the ambient group.
  let j := inclusion maximum
  have hj : j.toHom.range = maximum := inclusion_range maximum
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := lift_through a j (by
    rw [hj]
    exact inf_le_left)
  have hsRange : (conjugated j element⁻¹).toHom.range ≤ b.toHom.range := by
    rw [conjugated_range, hj]
    calc
      _ ≤ conj element⁻¹ (conj element b.toHom.range) := Subgroup.map_mono inf_le_right
      _ = _ := by rw [OutsideRegionsAux.conj_mul, inv_mul_cancel, conj_one]
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := lift_through b (conjugated j element⁻¹) hsRange
  let t := restrictTo ade maximum (lower_le_max a b c d e f p)
  have hjt : j.comp t = ade := ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun _ => rfl)
  have hrt : r.comp t = de := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro k
    apply a.injective
    change ((a.comp r).comp t).toHom k = ade.toHom k
    rw [hr, hjt]
  have hbs (k : Bmax) : b.toHom (s.toHom k) = element⁻¹ * j.toHom k * element := by
    have hk := congrArg (fun l : ConjEmbedding Bmax A => l.toHom k) hs
    change b.toHom (s.toHom k) = element⁻¹ * j.toHom k * (element⁻¹)⁻¹ at hk
    simpa only [inv_inv] using hk
  have hst : s.comp t = c.comp f := by
    apply ConjEmbedding.ext
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro k
    apply b.injective
    change b.toHom (s.toHom (t.toHom k)) = (bc.comp f).toHom k
    rw [hbs]
    change element⁻¹ * (j.comp t).toHom k * element = _
    rw [hjt, mul_assoc, p.intertwines, inv_mul_cancel_left]
  let x : Dot (a.comp r) (b.comp s) := ⟨element, by
    intro k
    rw [hr]
    change j.toHom k * element = element * b.toHom (s.toHom k)
    rw [hbs]
    group⟩
  let y : Dot (s.comp t) (c.comp f) := ⟨1, by intro k; rw [hst, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let z : Dot (r.comp t) de := ⟨1, by intro k; rw [hrt, mul_one, one_mul]⟩
  let _ : Finite G := parabolic_finite hG
  let _ : Finite D := parabolic_finite hD
  let _ : Finite F := parabolic_finite hF
  let _ : Finite Bmax := Finite.of_injective r.toHom r.injective
  let X : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s := ⟨x, finite_mixed a b r s x⟩
  let Y : ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f := ⟨y, finite_mixed s c t f y⟩

  -- Lemma 6.3 and (6.1). The checked effective-element calculation
  -- identifies the transfer for these exact singleton labels, including
  -- the inverse trace dot. Specialize the supplier's effective-element
  -- lemma to identify the particular parameter in Lemma 6.3.
  have hParameter : leftParameter a b c d e f x y z = p.element := by
    change a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹ * p.element * b.toHom (1 : D) = p.element
    rw [inv_one, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  have hLeft := (left_project_eval a b c d e f
    (⟨p, hp⟩ : ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f) X Y z).2 hParameter
  have hEqual := hLeft.trans hRight.symm

  -- At the maximum, the registered Case 2 calculation gives relative
  -- index one and a unique preimage in each nonempty first fiber.
  have hTransport : conj (a.toHom z.element⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = maximum := by
    change conj (a.toHom (1 : G)⁻¹) (a.comp r).toHom.range = maximum
    rw [inv_one, map_one, conj_one, hr, hj]
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, hAtMax⟩ := hIndices
    ⟨⟨Bmax, hMax⟩, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ ⟨X.finite, Y.finite⟩ hEqual
  have hSingleton := (hAtMax hTransport).2
  have hLeftInclusion (k : Bmax) : ((a.comp r).toHom k : U) = (k : U) := by
    rw [hr]
    rfl
  have hLeftConjugate (k : Bmax) :
      (MulAut.conj element ((b.comp s).toHom k) : U) = (k : U) := by
    have hk : MulAut.conj element ((b.comp s).toHom k) = j.toHom k := by
      change element * b.toHom (s.toHom k) * element⁻¹ = j.toHom k
      rw [hbs]
      group
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hk
  refine ⟨hMax, hMin, r, s, t, u, v, w, x, y, z, ell, m, n,
    X.finite, Y.finite, hm, hn, hp,
    hLeftInclusion, hLeftConjugate, (fun _ => rfl), hu, huv, huw,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, hell, hmel, hnel, hSingleton, hEqual, hLeft⟩

FiniteParabolicSingleDiagramReplacements.proof:
by
  classical
  intro finitary U blockSym parabolic Region Embedding comp up down tensor Drawing ordinary
    vertical horizontal straight evaluate onFirstTwo onLastTwo stack DotWeights parallel
    ProjectionWeights project multiply Replacements G A D F C E hG hA hD hF hC hE
  -- Xiao, § 8.3, archived original p. 37 and published 28 November revision p. 39.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#parabolic-reidemeister-three
  -- Each named replacement preserves the evaluated map. The inverse laws
  -- follow by quotient induction, using both certified evaluation equalities.
  constructor
  · intro ga ad df gc ce ef bottom top Left Right leftDiagram rightDiagram
    -- Lemma 6.1 and Theorem 6.2, archived pp. 19–20 and published pp. 21–22.
    -- ThreeInductionReidemeisterThree supplies the unrestricted quotient
    -- bijection. Here its dependency ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers
    -- gives the formulas and the equality test, and MultipliersUnderRelabelling
    -- supplies the eligible middle label. Choose G and F before taking quotients.
    obtain ⟨sga, hga, rfl⟩ := represented ga
    obtain ⟨sad, had, rfl⟩ := represented ad
    obtain ⟨sdf, hdf, rfl⟩ := represented df
    obtain ⟨sgc, hgc, rfl⟩ := represented gc
    obtain ⟨sce, hce, rfl⟩ := represented ce
    obtain ⟨sef, hef, rfl⟩ := represented ef
    let ga := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sga hga
    let ad := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sad had
    let df := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sdf hdf
    let gc := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sgc hgc
    let ce := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sce hce
    let ef := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator sef hef
    let bottomPair := ga.comp ad
    let topPair := gc.comp ce
    let deBottom := bottomPair.comp df
    let deTop := topPair.comp ef
    let splitBottom : Drawing (up deBottom) bottom :=
      vertical (.trivalent (.splitUp bottomPair df))
        (horizontal (.trivalent (.splitUp ga ad)) (straight (up df)))
    let mergeTop : Drawing top (up deTop) :=
      vertical (horizontal (.trivalent (.mergeUp gc ce)) (straight (up ef)))
        (.trivalent (.mergeUp topPair ef))
    let multiplier (x : Drawing bottom top) : MonoidAlgebra Complex G :=
      MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff ((evaluate (vertical splitBottom (vertical x mergeTop))).toLinearMap
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex G)))
    let leftExpanded : Left → Drawing bottom top :=
      fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x, y, z⟩ =>
        stack (onFirstTwo (expandedParallel ga ad gb bd x) (up df))
          (onLastTwo (up gb) (expandedParallel bd df be ef y))
          (onFirstTwo (expandedParallel gb be gc ce z) (up ef))
    let rightExpanded : Right → Drawing bottom top :=
      fun ⟨_, ab, cb, bf, x, y, z⟩ =>
        stack (onLastTwo (up ga) (expandedParallel ad df ab bf x))
          (onFirstTwo (expandedParallel ga ab gc cb y) (up bf))
          (onLastTwo (up gc) (expandedParallel cb bf ce ef z))
    -- The reviewed statement uses the compact crossing. Distribution of
    -- vertical evaluation over the weighted list proves the bridge above.
    have firstEval {K H J J' L : Subgroup U} {p : Word K J} {q : Word J H}
        {p' : Word K J'} {q' : Word J' H}
        {x y : Drawing (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')} (r : Word H L)
        (h : evaluate x = evaluate y) :
        evaluate (onFirstTwo x r) = evaluate (onFirstTwo y r) :=
      horizontalEval h rfl
    have lastEval {K H J J' L : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H)
        {q : Word H J} {r : Word J L} {q' : Word H J'} {r' : Word J' L}
        {x y : Drawing (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')} (h : evaluate x = evaluate y) :
        evaluate (onLastTwo p x) = evaluate (onLastTwo p y) :=
      verticalEval rfl (verticalEval (horizontalEval rfl h) rfl)
    have hLeftEval (l : Left) : evaluate (leftDiagram l) = evaluate (leftExpanded l) := by
      rcases l with ⟨B, gb, bd, be, x, y, z⟩
      exact verticalEval (firstEval (up df) (parallelEval ga ad gb bd x))
        (verticalEval (lastEval (up gb) (parallelEval bd df be ef y))
          (firstEval (up ef) (parallelEval gb be gc ce z)))
    have hRightEval (r : Right) : evaluate (rightDiagram r) = evaluate (rightExpanded r) := by
      rcases r with ⟨B, ab, cb, bf, x, y, z⟩
      exact verticalEval (lastEval (up ga) (parallelEval ad df ab bf x))
        (verticalEval (firstEval (up bf) (parallelEval ga ab gc cb y))
          (lastEval (up gc) (parallelEval cb bf ce ef z)))
    have supplier := ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers G A D F C E sga sad sdf sgc sce sef
      hga had hdf hgc hce hef
    have evalIff (x y : Drawing bottom top) :
        evaluate x = evaluate y ↔ multiplier x = multiplier y :=
      supplier.2.2.2.1 x y
    let allowed (p : G) :=
      (sga * sad * sdf)⁻¹ * (p : U) * (sgc * sce * sef) ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (F : Set U)
    let along {H K : Subgroup U} (a : Embedding H K) :=
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom
    let dotValue {H K : Subgroup U} {a b : Embedding H K} (x : DotWeights a b) :=
      MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain Dot.element x)
    let middle (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) : DotWeights deBottom deTop :=
      indLiftMultiplier m
    have middleValue (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
        (hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p) : dotValue (middle m) = m := by
      apply indLiftMultiplierValue m
      intro p hp
      exact indEligibleOfCentralizer (fun f => (supplier.1 f).1) (fun f => (supplier.1 f).2)
        p ((supplier.2.2.2.2.1 p).2.mpr (hm p hp))
    have dotIdentity {H K : Subgroup U} (a : Embedding H K) :
        dotValue (DotLabel.identity a) = 1 := indDotValueIdentity a
    let ab := ad.comp df
    let cb := ce.comp ef
    let idF := ConjEmbedding.id F
    let idG := ConjEmbedding.id G
    let buildRight (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) : Right :=
      ⟨⟨F, hF⟩, ab, cb, idF, DotLabel.identity ab, middle m, DotLabel.identity cb⟩
    let buildLeft (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) : Left :=
      ⟨⟨G, hG⟩, idG, bottomPair, topPair, DotLabel.identity bottomPair, middle m,
        DotLabel.identity topPair⟩
    have hRight (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p) :
        multiplier (rightExpanded (buildRight m)) = m := by
      calc
        _ = along ga (dotValue (DotLabel.identity ab)) * dotValue (middle m) *
              along gc (dotValue (DotLabel.identity cb)) :=
          (supplier.2.2.2.2.2.2 F ab cb idF (DotLabel.identity ab) (middle m) (DotLabel.identity cb)).1
        _ = m := by
          rw [dotIdentity ab, dotIdentity cb, map_one, map_one, one_mul, mul_one,
            middleValue m hm]
    have hLeft (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p) :
        multiplier (leftExpanded (buildLeft m)) = m := by
      calc
        _ = dotValue (DotLabel.identity bottomPair) * along idG (dotValue (middle m)) *
              dotValue (DotLabel.identity topPair) :=
          (supplier.2.2.2.2.2.1 G idG bottomPair topPair (DotLabel.identity bottomPair) (middle m)
            (DotLabel.identity topPair)).1
        _ = m := by
          rw [dotIdentity bottomPair, dotIdentity topPair, one_mul, mul_one, middleValue m hm]
          change MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MonoidHom.id G) m = m
          simp only [MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom_id, AlgHom.id_apply]
    apply quotientOfReplacements (fun l => evaluate (leftDiagram l))
      (fun r => evaluate (rightDiagram r)) (fun l => l.1.val) (fun r => r.1.val) G F
    · intro l
      let m := multiplier (leftExpanded l)
      have hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p := by
        rcases l with ⟨B, gb, bd, be, x, y, z⟩
        exact (supplier.2.2.2.2.2.1 B.val gb bd be x y z).2
      have h := (evalIff (rightExpanded (buildRight m)) (leftExpanded l)).2 (hRight m hm)
      exact ⟨buildRight m, rfl, (hRightEval (buildRight m)).trans (h.trans (hLeftEval l).symm)⟩
    · intro r
      let m := multiplier (rightExpanded r)
      have hm : ∀ p ∈ m.coeff.support, allowed p := by
        rcases r with ⟨B, ab, cb, bf, x, y, z⟩
        exact (supplier.2.2.2.2.2.2 B.val ab cb bf x y z).2
      have h := (evalIff (leftExpanded (buildLeft m)) (rightExpanded r)).2 (hLeft m hm)
      exact ⟨buildLeft m, rfl, (hLeftEval (buildLeft m)).trans (h.trans (hRightEval r).symm)⟩
  · intro a b c d e f bc de lower upper LeftProjection RightProjection leftProjection rightProjection
      LeftMultiplication RightMultiplication leftMultiplication rightMultiplication
    constructor
    · -- Theorem 6.4(1) and (2), archived p. 23 and published p. 25.
      -- The finite block model gives the indices of d(C) and (de)(E) in G.
      -- The p-dependent parabolic join is for the fallback single-term
      -- construction. At finite G the suppliers give the common groups A and E,
      -- which are admissible by the boundary hypotheses.
      have finiteG : Finite G := by
        obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, hblocks⟩ := hG
        exact finiteOfBlocks blocks hblocks
      have hd : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex := Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite
      have hde : (d.comp e).toHom.range.FiniteIndex := Subgroup.finiteIndex_of_finite
      apply quotientOfReplacements (fun l => evaluate (leftProjection l))
        (fun r => evaluate (rightProjection r)) (fun l => l.1.val) (fun r => r.1.val) E A
      · rintro ⟨B, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩
        obtain ⟨⟨P, j, v, w, l, m, n⟩, hP, h⟩ :=
          projectionForward a b c d e f hd ⟨B.val, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩
        change P = A at hP
        subst P
        exact ⟨⟨⟨A, hA⟩, j, v, w, l, m, n⟩, rfl, h⟩
      · rintro ⟨B, j, v, w, l, m, n⟩
        obtain ⟨⟨P, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩, hP, h⟩ :=
          projectionBackward a b c d e f hde ⟨B.val, j, v, w, l, m, n⟩
        change P = E at hP
        subst P
        exact ⟨⟨⟨E, hE⟩, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩, rfl, h⟩
    · -- Cases 3 and 4 of Theorem 6.5, archived p. 24 and published p. 26.
      -- Use the public normalization statements and their fixed-region realizers. Equality of the
      -- multipliers is converted to equality before the boundary merges.
      have supplier := ReplacementForTwoMultiplications a b c d e f
      apply quotientOfReplacements (fun l => evaluate (leftMultiplication l))
        (fun r => evaluate (rightMultiplication r)) (fun l => l.1.val) (fun r => r.1.val) E A
      · rintro ⟨B, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩
        obtain ⟨M, hM, hleft⟩ := supplier.1 ⟨B.val, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩
        obtain ⟨X, Y, Z, hright⟩ := multRealizeRight a b c d e f M hM
        exact ⟨⟨⟨A, hA⟩, ConjEmbedding.id A, a.comp d, b.comp c, X, Y, Z⟩,
          rfl, (multEvalEqIff a b c d e f hright hleft).2 rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨B, j, v, w, x, y, z⟩
        obtain ⟨M, hM, hright⟩ := supplier.2.1 ⟨B.val, j, v, w, x, y, z⟩
        obtain ⟨X, Y, Z, hleft⟩ := multRealizeLeft a b c d e f M hM
        exact ⟨⟨⟨E, hE⟩, d.comp e, c.comp f, ConjEmbedding.id E, X, Y, Z⟩,
          rfl, (multEvalEqIff a b c d e f hleft hright).2 rfl⟩
FiniteParabolicSingleDiagramReplacements.support:
namespace FiniteParabolicReplacementProof
open MackeyDiagrams

-- Every block factor fixes the complement of the finite block union.
-- Restriction to that union embeds the parabolic into a finite symmetric group.
private theorem finiteOfBlocks {S : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} {G : Subgroup S}
    {n : Nat} (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat)
    (hG : G.map S.subtype =
      ⨆ i, (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ blocks i)).range) :
    Finite G := by
  classical
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have fixes (g : G) : ∀ x : Nat, x ∉ X → ((g.val : Equiv.Perm Nat)) x = x := by
    have hg : (g.val : Equiv.Perm Nat) ∈
        ⨆ i, (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ blocks i)).range := by
      rw [← hG]
      exact ⟨g.val, g.property, rfl⟩
    refine Subgroup.iSup_induction _ (C := fun σ : Equiv.Perm Nat =>
      ∀ x : Nat, x ∉ X → σ x = x) hg ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro i _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩ x hx
      exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem σ
        (fun hxi => hx (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hxi⟩))
    · exact fun _ _ => rfl
    · intro s t hs ht x hx
      change s (t x) = x
      rw [ht x hx, hs x hx]
  let restrict := (Equiv.Perm.subtypeEquivSubtypePerm (fun x : Nat => x ∈ X)).symm
  refine Finite.of_injective (fun g : G => restrict ⟨g.val.val, fixes g⟩) ?_
  intro g h eq
  have hh := restrict.injective eq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg (fun s => s.val) hh

private theorem quotientOfReplacements {L R M S : Type}
    (leftEval : L → M) (rightEval : R → M) (leftRegion : L → S) (rightRegion : R → S)
    (B B' : S)
    (forward : ∀ l, ∃ r, rightRegion r = B' ∧ rightEval r = leftEval l)
    (backward : ∀ r, ∃ l, leftRegion l = B ∧ leftEval l = rightEval r) :
    ∃ (toRight : L → R) (toLeft : R → L)
      (classes : Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval) ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval)),
      (∀ l, rightRegion (toRight l) = B' ∧ rightEval (toRight l) = leftEval l ∧
        classes (Quotient.mk _ l) = Quotient.mk _ (toRight l)) ∧
      (∀ r, leftRegion (toLeft r) = B ∧ leftEval (toLeft r) = rightEval r ∧
        classes.symm (Quotient.mk _ r) = Quotient.mk _ (toLeft r)) := by
  choose toRight hR using forward
  choose toLeft hL using backward
  let classes : Quotient (Setoid.ker leftEval) ≃ Quotient (Setoid.ker rightEval) :=
    { toFun := Quotient.map toRight (fun {_ _} h => (hR _).2.trans (h.trans (hR _).2.symm))
      invFun := Quotient.map toLeft (fun {_ _} h => (hL _).2.trans (h.trans (hL _).2.symm))
      left_inv := fun q => Quotient.inductionOn q
        (fun l => Quotient.sound ((hL (toRight l)).2.trans (hR l).2))
      right_inv := fun q => Quotient.inductionOn q
        (fun r => Quotient.sound ((hR (toLeft r)).2.trans (hL r).2)) }
  exact ⟨toRight, toLeft, classes, fun l => ⟨(hR l).1, (hR l).2, rfl⟩,
    fun r => ⟨(hL r).1, (hL r).2, rfl⟩⟩

section InductionCrossing

variable {U : Type} [Group U] {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}

private noncomputable abbrev drawingEval {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    (x : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  x.interpret.eval

private noncomputable abbrev expandedParallel
    (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : ConjEmbedding S Q')
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex ((Word.up a).tensor (.up b)) ((Word.up a').tensor (.up b')) :=
  .vertical (.trivalent (.mergeUp a b)) (.vertical x.upDrawing (.trivalent (.splitUp a' b')))

private theorem parallelEval
    (a : ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : ConjEmbedding S Q')
    (x : DotLabel Complex (a.comp b) (a'.comp b')) :
    drawingEval (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b a' b' x.terms) =
      drawingEval (expandedParallel a b a' b' x) := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  change (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (x.terms.map fun (c, d) =>
    (c, ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.parallelUp a b a' b' d)))).eval.toLinearMap z =
    (Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a' b').eval.toLinearMap
      ((Diagram.finiteSum (x.terms.map fun (c, d) => Diagram.scale c (Diagram.upDot d))).eval.toLinearMap
        ((Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b).eval.toLinearMap z))
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, Diagram.eval_finiteSum]
  simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, map_list_sum,
    Diagram.eval, Biset.Hom.scale, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul]
  rfl

private theorem verticalEval {K H : Subgroup U} {p q r : Word K H}
    {a a' : LabelledDrawing Complex p q} {b b' : LabelledDrawing Complex q r}
    (ha : drawingEval a = drawingEval a') (hb : drawingEval b = drawingEval b') :
    drawingEval (a.vertical b) = drawingEval (a'.vertical b') :=
  congrArg₂ Biset.Hom.vertical ha hb

private theorem horizontalEval {K H J : Subgroup U}
    {p q : Word K H} {r s : Word H J}
    {a a' : LabelledDrawing Complex p q} {b b' : LabelledDrawing Complex r s}
    (ha : drawingEval a = drawingEval a') (hb : drawingEval b = drawingEval b') :
    drawingEval (a.horizontal b) = drawingEval (a'.horizontal b') :=
  congrArg₂ Biset.Hom.horizontal ha hb

private theorem represented {H K : Subgroup U} (a : ConjEmbedding H K) :
    ∃ s : U, ∃ h : ∀ x : H, s * (x : U) * s⁻¹ ∈ K,
      a = ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator s h := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := a.hasRepresentative
  let h (x : H) := hs x ▸ (a.toHom x).property
  exact ⟨s, h, ConjEmbedding.ext (MonoidHom.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (hs x))⟩

end InductionCrossing

variable {U : Type} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
  (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F)

-- Theorem 6.4(1). Use the supplier's common right group for the whole
-- coefficient function. Its public existential has forgotten the group.
private theorem projectionForward (hd : d.toHom.range.FiniteIndex)
    (l : projLeftLabels a b c d e f) :
    ∃ r : projRightLabels a b c d e f, r.1 = A ∧
      projEvalRight a b c d e f r = projEvalLeft a b c d e f l := by
  obtain ⟨ell, m, n, _, _, _, _, he⟩ := (CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).2.1 hd
  obtain ⟨coeff, hc, _, _⟩ := (ReplacementForTwoProjections a b c d e f).2.2.2.2.1 l
  let r : projRightLabels a b c d e f :=
    ⟨A, ConjEmbedding.id A, a.comp d, b.comp c,
      Finsupp.single ell 1, Finsupp.single m 1, Finsupp.mapDomain n coeff⟩
  exact ⟨r, rfl, (projMergedEqIff a b c d e f _ _).1 ((he coeff).trans hc.symm)⟩

-- Theorem 6.4(2). The common left group is E. Collect the lower projection
-- terms in one coefficient label using the supplier's linearity lemma.
private theorem projectionBackward (hd : (d.comp e).toHom.range.FiniteIndex)
    (r : projRightLabels a b c d e f) :
    ∃ l : projLeftLabels a b c d e f, l.1 = E ∧
      projEvalLeft a b c d e f l = projEvalRight a b c d e f r := by
  obtain ⟨coeff, hc, _⟩ := (ReplacementForTwoProjections a b c d e f).2.2.2.2.2.1 r
  obtain ⟨drawing, hshape, he⟩ := (CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstruction a b c d e f).2.1 hd coeff
  obtain ⟨x, y, z, _, _, _, _, rfl⟩ := hshape
  let de := d.comp e
  let cf := c.comp f
  let t := ConjEmbedding.id E
  let l : projLeftLabels a b c d e f :=
    ⟨E, de, cf, t, Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff, Finsupp.single y 1, Finsupp.single z 1⟩
  let value := fun xs => projMerged a b c d e f (projLeftTerm a b c d e f de cf t xs [(1, y)] [(1, z)])
  let unitValue := fun p => value [(1, p)]
  have heval : projMerged a b c d e f (projLeftDraw a b c d e f l) =
      value (projLabelTerms (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)) := by
    change projMerged a b c d e f (projLeftTerm a b c d e f de cf t _
      (projLabelTerms (Finsupp.single y 1)) (DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single z 1))) = _
    rw [show projLabelTerms (Finsupp.single y (1 : Complex)) = [(1, y)] from
      projTermsSingle y one_ne_zero,
      show DotLabel.terms (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) = [(1, z)] from
      projTermsSingle z one_ne_zero]
  have hcollect : value (projLabelTerms (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)) =
      value ((projLabelTerms coeff).map fun term => (term.1, x term.2)) := by
    calc
      _ = projWeighted unitValue (projLabelTerms (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)) :=
        projLeftWeighted a b c d e f de cf t _ _ _
      _ = Finsupp.linearCombination Complex (unitValue ∘ x) coeff := by
        refine (projWeightedLabelTerms unitValue (Finsupp.mapDomain x coeff)).trans ?_
        rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain]
      _ = projWeighted (unitValue ∘ x) (projLabelTerms coeff) :=
        (projWeightedLabelTerms _ _).symm
      _ = projWeighted unitValue ((projLabelTerms coeff).map fun term => (term.1, x term.2)) := by
        change ((projLabelTerms coeff).map (fun term => term.1 • unitValue (x term.2))).sum =
          (((projLabelTerms coeff).map (fun term => (term.1, x term.2))).map
            (fun term => term.1 • unitValue term.2)).sum
        simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
      _ = _ := (projLeftWeighted a b c d e f de cf t _ _ _).symm
  exact ⟨l, rfl, (projMergedEqIff a b c d e f _ _).1
    (heval.trans (hcollect.trans (he.trans hc.symm)))⟩

namespace UnequalParabolicCurlProof

open MackeyDiagrams

private abbrev finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev U := ↥finitary
private abbrev block (S : Finset Nat) : Subgroup U :=
  Subgroup.comap finitary.subtype
    (MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)))

private def extend (S : Finset Nat) : Equiv.Perm ↥S →* U :=
  (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)).codRestrict finitary (fun σ => by
    refine mem_closure_isSwap'.mpr (S.finite_toSet.subset ?_)
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    exact hx ((MulAction.mem_fixedBy).2 (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem σ hn)))

private theorem extend_range (S : Finset Nat) : (extend S).range = block S := by
  ext σ
  change (∃ τ, extend S τ = σ) ↔ ∃ τ, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ = (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)
  exact ⟨fun ⟨τ, h⟩ => ⟨τ, congrArg Subtype.val h⟩, fun ⟨τ, h⟩ => ⟨τ, Subtype.ext h⟩⟩

private noncomputable def blockEquiv (S : Finset Nat) : Equiv.Perm ↥S ≃ ↥(block S) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (fun σ => ⟨extend S σ, by
    rw [← extend_range]
    exact ⟨σ, rfl⟩⟩) (by
      constructor
      · intro σ τ h
        exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_injective (congrArg (fun x : ↥(block S) =>
          (x.val : Equiv.Perm Nat)) h)
      · intro σ
        obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := show σ.val ∈ (extend S).range by
          rw [extend_range]
          exact σ.property
        exact ⟨τ, Subtype.ext hτ⟩)

private theorem card_block (S : Finset Nat) : Nat.card ↥(block S) = S.card.factorial := by
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (blockEquiv S), Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_coe]

-- Alphabeta Math, transpositions generate the symmetric group, Steps 1.1,
-- 2.1 and 3.1. The factorization applies on the finite block subtype.
-- Swap induction packages the cycle factorization and extends each factor
-- by the identity to Nat. The generated subgroup is tested after extension.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
private theorem block_le_of_swaps (S : Finset Nat) (K : Subgroup U)
    (hs : ∀ x y : ↥S, x ≠ y → extend S (Equiv.swap x y) ∈ K) : block S ≤ K := by
  rw [← extend_range]
  rintro _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩
  induction σ using Equiv.Perm.swap_induction_on with
  | one => simpa only [map_one] using K.one_mem
  | swap_mul τ x y hxy ih =>
    rw [map_mul]
    exact K.mul_mem (hs x y hxy) ih

private abbrev transposition {S : Finset Nat} (x y : ↥S) (h : (x : Nat) ≠ (y : Nat)) : U :=
  ⟨Equiv.swap (x : Nat) (y : Nat), Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨(x : Nat), (y : Nat), h, rfl⟩⟩

private theorem extend_swap {S : Finset Nat} (x y : ↥S) (h : (x : Nat) ≠ (y : Nat)) :
    extend S (Equiv.swap x y) = transposition x y h :=
  Subtype.ext (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq x y)

private theorem block_pair {S : Finset Nat} (x y : ↥S) (h : (x : Nat) ≠ (y : Nat)) :
    block {(x : Nat), (y : Nat)} = Subgroup.zpowers (transposition x y h) := by
  let T : Finset Nat := {(x : Nat), (y : Nat)}
  let p : ↥T := ⟨x, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  let q : ↥T := ⟨y, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)⟩
  have e : extend T (Equiv.swap p q) = transposition x y h :=
    Subtype.ext (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq p q)
  have mem : extend T (Equiv.swap p q) ∈ Subgroup.zpowers (transposition x y h) :=
    e.symm ▸ Subgroup.mem_zpowers _
  have casesT (i : ↥T) : i = p ∨ i = q := by
    have hi := i.property
    change (i : Nat) ∈ {(x : Nat), (y : Nat)} at hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
    rcases hi with hi | hi
    · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext hi)
    · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext hi)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply block_le_of_swaps
    intro i j hij
    rcases casesT i with rfl | rfl <;> rcases casesT j with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact mem
    · rwa [Equiv.swap_comm]
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  · apply Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr
    rw [← e, ← extend_range]
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

private theorem fixes_outside {S : Finset Nat} {σ : U} (hσ : σ ∈ block S)
    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∉ S) : (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x := by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hσ
  change Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ = (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) at hτ
  rw [← hτ]
  exact Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hx

private theorem preserves_block {S : Finset Nat} {σ : U} (hσ : σ ∈ block S)
    {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ S) : (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hσ
  change Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ = (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) at hτ
  rw [← hτ]
  exact (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_mem_iff_mem τ x).2 hx

private abbrev S : Finset Nat := {1, 2, 3}
private abbrev p : ↥S := ⟨1, by decide⟩
private abbrev q : ↥S := ⟨2, by decide⟩
private abbrev r : ↥S := ⟨3, by decide⟩
private abbrev A := Subgroup.zpowers (transposition p q (by decide))
private abbrev B := Subgroup.zpowers (transposition q r (by decide))
private abbrev H := block S

private theorem block_A : block {1, 2} = A := block_pair p q (by decide)
private theorem block_B : block {2, 3} = B := block_pair q r (by decide)

private theorem card_A : Nat.card ↥A = 2 := by
  rw [← block_A, card_block]
  decide

private theorem card_B : Nat.card ↥B = 2 := by
  rw [← block_B, card_block]
  decide

private theorem concrete_intersection : A ⊓ B = ⊥ := by
  rw [← block_A, ← block_B]
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro σ hσ
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro x
  change (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = x
  have h1 : (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) 1 = 1 := fixes_outside hσ.2 (by decide)
  by_cases hx : x ∈ ({1, 2} : Finset Nat)
  · rcases (show x = 1 ∨ x = 2 by simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using hx)
      with rfl | rfl
    · exact h1
    · have h2 := preserves_block hσ.1 hx
      rcases (show (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) 2 = 1 ∨ (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat) 2 = 2 by
        simpa only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] using h2) with e | e
      · exact (by decide : (2 : Nat) ≠ 1) ((σ : Equiv.Perm Nat).injective (e.trans h1.symm)) |>.elim
      · exact e
  · exact fixes_outside hσ.1 hx

private theorem concrete_join (hA : A ≤ H) (hB : B ≤ H) : A ⊔ B = H := by
  apply le_antisymm (sup_le hA hB)
  have hpq : extend S (Equiv.swap p q) ∈ A ⊔ B := by
    rw [extend_swap p q (by decide)]
    exact (le_sup_left : A ≤ A ⊔ B) (Subgroup.mem_zpowers _)
  have hqr : extend S (Equiv.swap q r) ∈ A ⊔ B := by
    rw [extend_swap q r (by decide)]
    exact (le_sup_right : B ≤ A ⊔ B) (Subgroup.mem_zpowers _)
  have hpr : extend S (Equiv.swap p r) ∈ A ⊔ B := by
    -- The missing swap (13) is the conjugate of (12) by (23).
    rw [Equiv.swap_comm p r,
      ← Equiv.swap_mul_swap_mul_swap (x := p) (y := q) (z := r) (by decide) (by decide),
      map_mul, map_mul]
    exact (A ⊔ B).mul_mem ((A ⊔ B).mul_mem hqr hpq) hqr
  have casesS (i : ↥S) : i = p ∨ i = q ∨ i = r := by
    have hi := i.property
    change (i : Nat) ∈ {1, 2, 3} at hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
    rcases hi with hi | hi | hi
    · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext hi)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext hi))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Subtype.ext hi))
  apply block_le_of_swaps
  intro i j hij
  rcases casesS i with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases casesS j with rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals first | exact (hij rfl).elim | exact hpq | exact hqr | exact hpr |
    (rw [Equiv.swap_comm]; first | exact hpq | exact hqr | exact hpr)

private abbrev blockGroup (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) : Subgroup U :=
  iSup (fun V : ↥P => block (V : Finset Nat))

private abbrev partition (T : Finset Nat) (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) : Prop :=
  (∀ V ∈ P, Finset.Nonempty V) ∧
  (∀ V ∈ P, ∀ W ∈ P, V ≠ W → Disjoint V W) ∧
  (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ V ∈ P, x ∈ V)

private abbrev parabolic (L : Subgroup U) : Prop :=
  ∃ T P, partition T P ∧ L = blockGroup P

private theorem singleton_block (x : Nat) : block {x} = ⊥ := by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  apply block_le_of_swaps
  intro a b hab
  have ha : (a : Nat) = x := Finset.mem_singleton.mp a.property
  have hb : (b : Nat) = x := Finset.mem_singleton.mp b.property
  exact (hab (Subtype.ext (ha.trans hb.symm))).elim

private theorem singleton_partition (T : Finset Nat) (hT : T.Nonempty) :
    partition T {T} ∧ block T = blockGroup {T} := by
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro V hV
    rwa [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hV]
  · intro V hV W hW hne
    exact (hne ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hV).trans (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hW).symm)).elim
  · intro x
    simp
  · apply le_antisymm
    · exact le_iSup (fun V : ↥({T} : Finset (Finset Nat)) => block V.val) ⟨T, by simp⟩
    · apply iSup_le
      intro V
      rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp V.property]

private theorem pair_partition (x y z : Nat) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    partition {x, y, z} {{x, y}, {z}} ∧ block {x, y} = blockGroup {{x, y}, {z}} := by
  have hdisj : Disjoint ({x, y} : Finset Nat) {z} := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro u hu hv
    have e := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hv
    subst u
    simp [Ne.symm hxz, Ne.symm hyz] at hu
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro V hV
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hV with rfl | hV
    · exact ⟨x, by simp⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hV]
      exact ⟨z, by simp⟩
  · intro V hV W hW hne
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hV with rfl | hV <;>
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hW with rfl | hW
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · rwa [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hW]
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hV]
      exact hdisj.symm
    · exact (hne ((Finset.mem_singleton.mp hV).trans (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hW).symm)).elim
  · intro u
    constructor
    · intro hu
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hu
      rcases hu with hu | hu | hu
      · exact ⟨{x, y}, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl hu)⟩
      · exact ⟨{x, y}, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, Finset.mem_insert.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hu))⟩
      · exact ⟨{z}, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _), Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hu⟩
    · rintro ⟨V, hV, hu⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hV ⊢
      rcases hV with rfl | rfl
      · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hu
        exact hu.elim Or.inl (fun h => Or.inr (Or.inl h))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hu))
  · let P : Finset (Finset Nat) := {{x, y}, {z}}
    let pair : ↥P := ⟨{x, y}, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
    change block {x, y} = ⨆ V : ↥P, block V.val
    refine le_antisymm (le_iSup (fun V : ↥P => block V.val) pair) (iSup_le fun V => ?_)
    change block V.val ≤ block {x, y}
    have hV : V.val ∈ {{x, y}, {z}} := V.property
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hV with hV | hV
    · exact (congrArg block hV).le
    · have e := (congrArg block (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hV)).trans (singleton_block z)
      exact e.le.trans bot_le

private theorem card_product_of_inf_eq_bot {V : Type*} [Group V] (A B : Subgroup V)
    (h : A ⊓ B = ⊥) :
    Nat.card ↥(Set.image2 (fun a b : V => a * b) (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) =
      Nat.card ↥A * Nat.card ↥B := by
  let f : ↥A × ↥B → ↥(Set.image2 (fun a b : V => a * b) (A : Set V) (B : Set V)) :=
    fun x => ⟨x.1.val * x.2.val, ⟨x.1.val, x.1.property, x.2.val, x.2.property, rfl⟩⟩
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨c, d⟩ e
      have he : a.val * b.val = c.val * d.val := congrArg Subtype.val e
      have hd : a.val⁻¹ * c.val = b.val * d.val⁻¹ := by
        simpa [mul_assoc] using (congrArg (fun w => a.val⁻¹ * (w * d.val⁻¹)) he).symm
      have hm : a.val⁻¹ * c.val ∈ A ⊓ B :=
        ⟨A.mul_mem (A.inv_mem a.property) c.property, hd ▸ B.mul_mem b.property (B.inv_mem d.property)⟩
      rw [h, Subgroup.mem_bot, inv_mul_eq_one] at hm
      have hn : b.val = d.val := mul_left_cancel (hm ▸ he)
      exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hm) (Subtype.ext hn)
    · rintro ⟨_, a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩), rfl⟩
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f hf), Nat.card_prod]

private abbrev inclusion {L K : Subgroup U} (h : L ≤ K) : ConjEmbedding L K :=
  ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩

private noncomputable abbrev eval {K L : Subgroup U} {u v : Word K L}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex u v) :=
  d.interpret.eval

-- LabelledDrawing.interpret applies TrivalentVertex.expand to these same
-- ordered junctions. The comparisons below therefore use the typed
-- reverse-cup and cap composites of the project language.
private noncomputable abbrev curls {L K G : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (d : ConjEmbedding L K) (f : Subgroup.FiniteIndex d.toHom.range) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex (Word.up a) (Word.up a) ×
      LabelledDrawing Complex (Word.down a) (Word.down a) :=
  (.vertical (.trivalent (.upToUpDown a d f)) (.trivalent (.upDownToUp a d)),
   .vertical (.trivalent (.downToUpDown a d f)) (.trivalent (.upDownToDown a d)))

-- These are the two oriented composites in the example. ReidemeisterOne
-- applies with the inner conjugator 1 and finite index of the inclusion image.
private theorem eval_curls {K L G : Subgroup U}
    (α : U) (hα : ∀ x : K, α * (x : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (h : L ≤ K) (f : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion h).toHom.range) :
    let a := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let c := curls a (inclusion h) f
    let n : Complex := (inclusion h).toHom.range.index
    eval c.1 = (Biset.Hom.id (Word.up a).basis).scale n ∧
      eval c.2 = (Biset.Hom.id (Word.down a).basis).scale n := by
  let hδ : ∀ x : L, (1 : U) * (x : U) * 1⁻¹ ∈ K := fun x => by
    simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using h x.property
  -- The reviewed inclusion reduces to this identity-conjugator embedding.
  have ev := ReidemeisterOne L K G 1 α hδ hα
  exact ⟨ev.1 f, ev.2.2.2 f⟩

private theorem inclusion_index {L K : Subgroup U} (h : L ≤ K) :
    (inclusion h).toHom.range.index * Nat.card ↥L = Nat.card ↥K := by
  have e : (inclusion h).toHom.range = L.subgroupOf K := by
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => hy ▸ y.property, fun hx => ⟨⟨x.val, hx⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [e, ← Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.subgroupOfEquivOfLe h).toEquiv]
  exact Subgroup.index_mul_card _

private theorem eval_stack {K L : Subgroup U} {w : Word K L}
    (bottom top : LabelledDrawing Complex w w) (r s : Complex)
    (hr : eval bottom = (Biset.Hom.id w.basis).scale r)
    (hs : eval top = (Biset.Hom.id w.basis).scale s) :
    eval (.vertical bottom top) = eval (.scale (r * s) (.ordinary (.id (R := Complex) w))) := by
  change (eval bottom).vertical (eval top) = (Biset.Hom.id w.basis).scale (r * s)
  rw [hr, hs, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_left, Biset.Hom.vertical_scale_right, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change r • (s • x) = (r * s) • x
  exact smul_smul r s x

private theorem compare_stacks {K G L M : Subgroup U} (α : U)
    (hα : ∀ x : K, α * (x : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G) (hK : parabolic K) (hG : parabolic G)
    (T : Finset Nat) (P Q : Finset (Finset Nat))
    (hP : partition T P) (hQ : partition T Q)
    (eL : L = blockGroup P) (eM : M = blockGroup Q) (hL : L ≤ K) (hM : M ≤ K)
    (fL : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion hL).toHom.range)
    (fM : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion hM).toHom.range)
    (fI : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion (show L ⊓ M ≤ K from le_trans inf_le_left hL)).toHom.range)
    (fJ : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (inclusion (sup_le hL hM)).toHom.range) :
    let a := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let cL := curls a (inclusion hL) fL
    let cM := curls a (inclusion hM) fM
    let cI := curls a (inclusion (show L ⊓ M ≤ K from le_trans inf_le_left hL)) fI
    let cJ := curls a (inclusion (sup_le hL hM)) fJ
    let LM : Set U := Set.image2 (fun x y : U => x * y) (L : Set U) (M : Set U)
    let ratio : Complex := (Nat.card ↥LM : Complex) / (Nat.card ↥(L ⊔ M) : Complex)
    eval (.vertical cJ.1 cI.1) = eval (.scale ratio (.vertical cM.1 cL.1)) ∧
    eval (.vertical cJ.2 cI.2) = eval (.scale ratio (.vertical cM.2 cL.2)) := by
  subst L
  subst M
  obtain ⟨_gL, _gM, _gI, _gJ, hup, hdown, _⟩ :=
    ParabolicCurlJoinIntersection K G α hα hK hG T P Q hP hQ hL hM
  exact ⟨hup, hdown⟩

end UnequalParabolicCurlProof

external.usage: A permutation extended from a finite block fixes its complement, so its moved set is finite. Apply mem_closure_isSwap' over Nat to lift the extension into the finitary ambient group. Checked through the existing pinned project imports.

Apply Fintype.card_perm on the finite subtype of each block. The extension equivalence transfers the cardinalities to the block subgroups of the finitary ambient group. Checked through the existing pinned project imports.

Apply swap induction on a finite block subtype, then extend each factor by the identity. This reduces containment of the block to the extended genuine swaps. Checked through the existing pinned project imports.
Identify the extended swaps on the two- and three-point block subtypes with the corresponding ambient transpositions. Checked through the existing pinned project imports.
On the three-point subtype, conjugate (12) by (23) to get (13). The three points are distinct, as required for the swap identity. Checked through the existing pinned project imports.

ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionExample.proof:
by
  classical
  -- Xiao, Example 8.3, archived original PDF p. 38 and published 28 November
  -- revision p. 40 (https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=40).
  -- Specialize Proposition 8.5 to inclusions and p = 1. The article states the
  -- resulting subgroups directly. The group lemmas below check generation by
  -- the three transpositions and triviality of the intersection.
  -- No numbered Alphabeta Math proof is supplied for this example.
  intro finitary U blockSym parabolic conjugate embed onBlock four G liftSwap
    s₁₂ s₂₃ A D C E F p swapInFour oneMem twoMem threeMem aLe cLe inclusion
    ga ad dfEmbedding gc ce efEmbedding bottomPair topPair word bottom top
    straight merge split splitBottom mergeTop BoundaryDrawing realizes crossing crossLeft crossRight
    leftDrawing rightDrawing shapeOf leftShape rightShape singleton leftRegions rightRegions
  have hG : parabolic G :=
    ExtremalThreeInductionExample.block_parabolic four ⟨1, oneMem⟩
  have hA : parabolic A := by
    have hPair : A = onBlock {1, 2} :=
      ExtremalThreeInductionExample.pair_block (by decide : (1 : Nat) ≠ 2)
    rw [hPair]
    exact ExtremalThreeInductionExample.block_parabolic _ ⟨1, by simp⟩
  have hC : parabolic C := by
    have hPair : C = onBlock {2, 3} :=
      ExtremalThreeInductionExample.pair_block (by decide : (2 : Nat) ≠ 3)
    rw [hPair]
    exact ExtremalThreeInductionExample.block_parabolic _ ⟨2, by simp⟩
  have hF : parabolic F := ExtremalThreeInductionExample.bot_parabolic
  have atOne {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) : conjugate 1 H ≤ K := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    change (1 : U) * x * (1 : U)⁻¹ ∈ K
    simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using h hx
  have conjOne (H : Subgroup U) : conjugate 1 H = H := by
    apply le_antisymm (atOne le_rfl)
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, by simp⟩
  have hMin : conjugate ((1 : U) * 1) D ⊔ conjugate ((p : U) * 1 * 1) E =
      onBlock (Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 3) := by
    simpa only [p, Subgroup.coe_one, one_mul, conjOne] using
      (show A ⊔ C = onBlock (Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 3) from ExtremalThreeInductionExample.join_blocks)
  have hMax : conjugate (1 : U) A ⊓ conjugate ((p : U) * 1) C = (⊥ : Subgroup U) := by
    simpa only [p, Subgroup.coe_one, one_mul, conjOne] using
      (show A ⊓ C = (⊥ : Subgroup U) from ExtremalThreeInductionExample.meet_blocks)
  have central : (((1 : U) * 1 * 1)⁻¹ * (p : U) * (1 * 1 * 1)) ∈
      Subgroup.centralizer (F : Set U) := by
    simpa only [p, Subgroup.coe_one, one_mul, inv_one] using
      (Subgroup.centralizer (F : Set U)).one_mem
  obtain ⟨hLeft, hRight, _⟩ :=
    ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionRegions G A D F C E hG hA hA hF hC hC
      1 1 1 1 1 1 (atOne aLe) (atOne le_rfl) (atOne bot_le)
      (atOne cLe) (atOne le_rfl) (atOne bot_le) p central
  rw [← hMin, ← hMax]
  -- The supplier uses typed group-element dots. Converting each to a
  -- coefficient-one up label preserves its evaluation. On both sides the
  -- planar shape checks by reduction because erasure keeps the marked wiring
  -- and forgets the coefficients and the subgroup embeddings.
  constructor
  · constructor
    · obtain ⟨B, r, s, t, hB, hr, hs, ht, x, y, z, hRegion, hEval⟩ := hLeft.1
      refine ⟨B, r, s, t, hB, hr, hs, ht, x, y, z, rfl, hRegion, ?_⟩
      intro w
      have h := hEval w
      dsimp only [realizes, splitBottom, mergeTop, bottomPair, topPair, leftDrawing,
        crossLeft, crossRight, crossing, merge, split, straight, singleton]
      simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, TrivalentVertex.expand,
        Diagram.eval, ExtremalThreeInductionExample.singleton_eval] at h ⊢
      exact h
    · intro H hH
      apply hLeft.2
      obtain ⟨B, r, s, t, hB, hr, hs, ht, x, y, z, _, hRegion, hEval⟩ := hH
      refine ⟨B, r, s, t, hB, hr, hs, ht, x, y, z, hRegion, ?_⟩
      intro w
      have h := hEval w
      dsimp only [realizes, splitBottom, mergeTop, bottomPair, topPair, leftDrawing,
        crossLeft, crossRight, crossing, merge, split, straight, singleton] at h
      simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, TrivalentVertex.expand,
        Diagram.eval, ExtremalThreeInductionExample.singleton_eval] at h ⊢
      exact h
  · constructor
    · obtain ⟨B, r, s, t, hB, hr, hs, ht, x, y, z, hRegion, hEval⟩ := hRight.1
      refine ⟨B, r, s, t, hB, hr, hs, ht, x, y, z, rfl, hRegion, ?_⟩
      intro w
      have h := hEval w
      dsimp only [realizes, splitBottom, mergeTop, bottomPair, topPair, rightDrawing,
        crossLeft, crossRight, crossing, merge, split, straight, singleton]
      simp only [LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, TrivalentVertex.expand,
        Diagram.eval, ExtremalThreeInductionExample.singleton_eval] at h ⊢
      exact h
    · intro H hH
      apply hRight.2
