theorem right_named_support (lower : Lower) (middle : Middle) (upper : Upper) (g x : P)
    (hx : x ∉ Finset.image Dot.element (Finsupp.support lower)) :
    eval (LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary.diagram (rightAt lower middle upper)) (input g x) = 0 := by
  classical
  let ss := List.map (fun (t : Complex × Dot (comp a i) (comp a i)) =>
      (t.1, (⟨t.2, rightFinite t.2⟩ : ProjectionDot.Mixed a a i i))) (DotLabel.terms lower)
  let prj := (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) a a i i ss).interpret.eval
  let xx : Raw (tensor ad df) := (x,1)
  have hz : prj.toLinearMap (basisVector (tensor ad df) xx) = 0 := by
    apply projections_zero a a i i ss xx (x : U)
    · exact ⟨P,P,(x : U),1,rfl,rfl,mul_one _⟩
    · intro t ht he
      obtain ⟨term, hterm, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hterm
      apply hx
      refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d, by simpa using hd, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (congrArg (fun u : Complex × Dot (comp a i) (comp a i) => u.2.element.val) hd').trans he.symm
  suffices h : ((Diagram.id (R := Complex) ga).eval.horizontal prj).toLinearMap (input g x) = 0 by
    let second := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i p a (DotLabel.terms middle)
    let third := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication p a a i (DotLabel.terms upper)
    let tail := stack (plain (Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
      (stack (beside second (drawId fj))
        (stack (plain (Diagram.associate gc ck fj)) (beside (drawId gc) third)))
    change tail.interpret.eval.toLinearMap (((Diagram.id (R := Complex) ga).eval.horizontal prj).toLinearMap
      (input g x)) = 0
    rw [h, map_zero]
  change ((Diagram.id (R := Complex) ga).eval.horizontal prj).toLinearMap
    (basisVector bottom (g,xx)) = 0
  rw [basis_horizontal, hz, map_zero]

theorem fixed_right_code (d : RightDrawing) : (geoInfo d.diagram.erase).events = rightCode := by
  have hs := congrArg PlanarShape.wiring d.shape_eq
  change Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid (geoInfo d.diagram.erase).events =
    Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid rightCode at hs
  exact (rigid_eq (Quotient.exact hs)).2 rigid_rightCode

-- The shape fiber in the statement is wider than the explicit family in
-- ExpansionIntoRightDiagrams. Its finite-orbit iff applies only to that
-- family. Rigidity and the support induction retain arbitrary typed syntax.
theorem right_all_support (d : RightDrawing) :
    ∃ S : Finset P, ∀ g x : P, x ∉ S → evalAt (interpretRight d) (input g x) = 0 := by
  classical
  have h := support_atBoundary d
  rw [fixed_right_code d] at h
  have he := support_seq (.structural (preserve_reorder_to bottom))
    (support_seq h (.structural (preserve_reorder_from top)))
  change SupportRule
    (Biset.Hom.vertical (Word.reorderToBoundary (R := Complex) bottom).eval
      ((interpretRight d).eval.vertical (Word.reorderFromBoundary (R := Complex) top).eval))
    rightCode at he
  obtain ⟨_, S, hS⟩ := he.2 1 rfl
  let lift : U → P := fun u => ⟨u, Subgroup.mem_top u⟩
  refine ⟨S.image lift, ?_⟩
  intro g x hx
  let inp : Raw bottom := (g,x,1)
  have hx' : (x : U) ∉ S := fun hh =>
    hx (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x.val, hh, Subtype.ext rfl⟩)
  have hp : Selected (slots bottom inp) 1 (x : U) :=
    ⟨P,P,(x : U),1,rfl,rfl,mul_one _⟩
  exact hS inp (x : U) hp hx'

theorem evalAt_sum (terms : List (Complex × RightDrawing)) (v : X.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    evalAt (rightSum terms) v = (terms.map (fun t => t.1 • evalAt (interpretRight t.2) v)).sum := by
  let start := (Word.reorderToBoundary (R := Complex) bottom).eval.toLinearMap
  let finish := (Word.reorderFromBoundary (R := Complex) top).eval.toLinearMap
  induction terms with
  | nil =>
    change finish 0 = 0
    exact map_zero finish
  | cons t ts ih =>
    have split : rightSum (t::ts) = .add (.scale t.1 (interpretRight t.2)) (rightSum ts) := rfl
    rw [split, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← ih]
    change finish (t.1 • (interpretRight t.2).eval.toLinearMap (start v) +
      (rightSum ts).eval.toLinearMap (start v)) =
      t.1 • finish ((interpretRight t.2).eval.toLinearMap (start v)) +
        finish ((rightSum ts).eval.toLinearMap (start v))
    rw [map_add, map_smul]

theorem finite_right_sum (terms : List (Complex × RightDrawing)) :
    (∃ S : Finset P, ∀ g x : P, x ∉ S → evalAt (rightSum terms) (input g x) = 0) ∧
    evalAt (rightSum terms) ≠ eval left := by
  classical
  have support : ∃ S : Finset P, ∀ g x : P, x ∉ S → evalAt (rightSum terms) (input g x) = 0 := by
    induction terms with
    | nil => exact ⟨∅, fun _ _ _ => by rw [evalAt_sum]; rfl⟩
    | cons t ts ih =>
      obtain ⟨S, hs⟩ := right_all_support t.2
      obtain ⟨T, ht⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨S ∪ T, ?_⟩
      intro g x hx
      have hS : x ∉ S := fun h => hx (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl h))
      have hT : x ∉ T := fun h => hx (Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr h))
      rw [evalAt_sum, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ← evalAt_sum, hs g x hS, ht g x hT, smul_zero, add_zero]
  refine ⟨support, ?_⟩
  intro he
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := support
  have : Infinite U := by
    change Infinite Int
    infer_instance
  have : Infinite P := Infinite.of_injective (fun u : U => (⟨u,Subgroup.mem_top u⟩ : P))
    (fun _ _ h => congrArg Subtype.val h)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset S
  have hz := hS 1 x hx
  rw [he, left_column, one_mul] at hz
  exact Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero hz

theorem pointwise_finiteness (v : X.carrier →₀ Complex) :
    Set.Finite {r : P | eval (rightTerm r) v ≠ 0} := by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, Set.ofPred_false] using
      (Set.finite_empty : (∅ : Set P).Finite)
  | add v w hv hw =>
    refine (hv.union hw).subset ?_
    intro r hr
    change eval (rightTerm r) (v+w) ≠ 0 at hr
    rw [map_add] at hr
    by_cases h : eval (rightTerm r) v = 0
    · exact Or.inr (fun hw => hr (by rw [h, hw, add_zero]))
    · exact Or.inl h
  | single v c =>
    obtain ⟨g,x,rfl⟩ := input_surj v
    refine (Set.finite_singleton x).subset ?_
    intro r hr
    change eval (rightTerm r) (Finsupp.single (inputPair g x) c) ≠ 0 at hr
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul] at hr
    change c • eval (rightTerm r) (input g x) ≠ 0 at hr
    rw [right_column] at hr
    by_contra h
    have hx : x ≠ r := fun he => h (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr he.symm)
    exact hr (by rw [ite_eq_right hx, smul_zero])

-- Use the full cyclic index in the single indexed drawing. On a basis column
-- all terms away from the named index are zero. The checked linear evaluation
-- of PointwiseIndexedDrawing extends this calculation to every input.
theorem pointwise_column_sum :
    ∃ finite : ∀ v : X.carrier →₀ Complex,
      Set.Finite {x : P | eval (rightTerm x) v ≠ 0},
    let drawing : PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex bottom top P := ⟨rightTerm, finite⟩
    ∀ v : X.carrier →₀ Complex, eval left v = drawing.evalAt v := by
  classical
  refine ⟨pointwise_finiteness, ?_⟩
  let drawing : PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex bottom top P := ⟨rightTerm, pointwise_finiteness⟩
  change ∀ v : X.carrier →₀ Complex, eval left v = drawing.evalAt v
  suffices h : eval left = drawing.eval by
    intro v
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun h v).trans (drawing.eval_apply v)
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro v c
  rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul, map_smul]
  congr 1
  obtain ⟨g,x,rfl⟩ := input_surj v
  change eval left (input g x) = drawing.eval (input g x)
  rw [left_column, PointwiseIndexedDrawing.eval_apply, PointwiseIndexedDrawing.evalAt_def]
  let indices := (pointwise_finiteness (input g x)).toFinset
  change output (g*x) = ∑ r ∈ indices, eval (rightTerm r) (input g x)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x]
  · rw [right_column, ite_eq_left rfl]
  · intro r _ hr
    rw [right_column, ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hr)]
  · intro hn
    have hz : eval (rightTerm x) (input g x) = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hn ((Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).2 h)
    rw [right_column, ite_eq_left rfl] at hz
    exact False.elim (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr one_ne_zero hz)

end CaseFiveInfiniteAux

CaseFivePointwiseFiniteDiagramIdentity.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst G A D F C E a b d c e f up down tensor comp ga ad df gc ce ef bottom top
    X Y Pair input output orbit stabilizer projected coefficient MiddleLabel UpperLabel
    ProjectionTerm drawId rightDrawing eval IsRightTerm B u v w LeftUpper leftDrawing
    rs ts ss upperTerms M supported
  -- Alphabeta Math, § 6.3.1, Theorem 6.7. Steps 1–4 follow the proof in prose.
  -- The scoped drawing appears on archived p. 27 and published (28 Nov 2026) p. 29.
  -- Published p. 6 specifies equality of evaluated maps and pointwise evaluation of this sum.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=29
  let supplier := RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer G A D F C E a b d c e f
  have constant (z p : Pair) (hp : p ∈ orbit z) : coefficient M p = coefficient M z :=
    supplier.1 M z p hp
  let action : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
      mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
  have orbit_eq (z p : Pair) : orbit z = orbit p ↔ z ∈ orbit p :=
    @MulAction.orbit_eq_iff _ _ _ action z p
  -- Steps 1 and 2. Normalize the input–output pair and transport the nonzero
  -- coefficient to the normalized representative. This is the hypothesis
  -- for the checked lower finite fibers and the indicator formula from (6.4).
  have realize (O : supported) :
      ∃ (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) (weight : Complex),
        (∃ (r : D) (t : G) (s : E),
          let z := (input 1 r, output t s)
          let P := projected z
          O.val = orbit z ∧ weight = coefficient M z ∧
          ∃ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F)
            (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P C)
            (rDot : ProjectionTerm P i j) (tDot : MiddleLabel P i k) (sDot : UpperLabel P j k),
            (∀ h : P, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j h : U) = (h : U)) ∧
            MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot rDot) = r ∧
            MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element tDot = t ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element sDot = s ∧
            drawing = rightDrawing P i j k [(1, rDot)] [(1, tDot)] [(1, sDot)]) ∧
        (∀ p : Pair, orbit p = O.val → weight = coefficient M p) ∧
        ∀ p : Pair, coefficient (eval drawing) p = if p ∈ O.val then 1 else 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z, he, hz⟩ := O.property
    obtain ⟨r, t, s, hnorm⟩ := supplier.2.1 z
    let z₀ : Pair := (input 1 r, output t s)
    have h₀ : coefficient M z₀ ≠ 0 := (constant z₀ z hnorm) ▸ hz
    have he₀ : O.val = orbit z₀ := he.trans ((orbit_eq z z₀).mpr hnorm)
    obtain ⟨i, j, k, rDot, tDot, sDot, hj, hr, ht, hs, _, _, realizeAt⟩ :=
      (supplier.2.2.1 r t s).2.2.2
    obtain ⟨_, finite, indicator⟩ := realizeAt M h₀
    let lower : ProjectionTerm (projected z₀) i j := ⟨rDot, finite⟩
    let drawing := rightDrawing (projected z₀) i j k [(1, lower)] [(1, tDot)] [(1, sDot)]
    refine ⟨drawing, coefficient M z₀, ⟨r, t, s, he₀, rfl,
      i, j, k, lower, tDot, sDot, hj, hr, ht, hs, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      exact (constant z₀ p ((orbit_eq p z₀).mp (hp.trans he₀))).symm
    · intro p
      rw [he₀]
      exact indicator p
  choose diagram weight hdiagram hweight hindicator using realize
  refine ⟨⟨diagram, weight, hdiagram, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · -- Step 3. Assemble the fixed family of scaled orbit drawings. The
    -- finite set in evalAt selects values only during evaluation.
    refine CaseFivePointwiseAux.sum_orbit_drawings orbit M.toLinearMap supported weight diagram
      (fun x y h => ⟨(x, y), rfl, h⟩) (fun O x y => hweight O (x, y))
      (supplier.2.2.2.2.2 M) ?_
    intro O x y
    obtain ⟨z, he, _⟩ := O.property
    have hm : ((x, y) : Pair) ∈ O.val ↔ orbit (x, y) = O.val := by
      rw [he]
      exact (orbit_eq (x, y) z).symm
    rw [Finsupp.smul_apply]
    change weight O * coefficient (eval (diagram O)) (x, y) = _
    rw [hindicator]
    by_cases h : orbit (x, y) = O.val
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (hm.mpr h), mul_one]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun hw => h (hm.mp hw)), mul_zero]
  · -- Step 4. The supplier proves the finite orbit criterion for evaluated
    -- finite linear combinations. Reindex the evaluations by list positions
    -- so the reviewed sum keeps its scope, including empty and singleton cases.
    have criterion := (ExpansionIntoRightDiagrams G A D F C E a b d c e f M).2
    exact criterion

namespace CaseFivePointwiseAux

open MackeyDiagrams

private theorem finite_linear_support {X I V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    (L : I → (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] V)
    (h : ∀ x, Set.Finite {i | L i (Finsupp.single x 1) ≠ 0})
    (v : X →₀ Complex) : Set.Finite {i | L i v ≠ 0} := by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simpa only [map_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, Set.ofPred_false] using
      (Set.finite_empty : (∅ : Set I).Finite)
  | add v w hv hw =>
      refine (hv.union hw).subset ?_
      intro i hi
      change L i (v + w) ≠ 0 at hi
      rw [map_add] at hi
      by_cases hvi : L i v = 0
      · exact Or.inr (fun hwi => hi (by rw [hvi, hwi, add_zero]))
      · exact Or.inl hvi
  | single x c =>
      refine (h x).subset ?_
      intro i hi
      change L i (Finsupp.single x c) ≠ 0 at hi
      rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul] at hi
      exact fun hz => hi (by rw [hz, smul_zero])

private theorem sum_orbit_drawings {U : Type*} [Group U] {G F : Subgroup U}
    {bottom top : Word G F} {O : Type*}
    (orbit : bottom.basis.carrier × top.basis.carrier → O)
    (M : (bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (top.basis.carrier →₀ Complex))
    (I : Set O) (weight : I → Complex)
    (drawing : I → LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    (hit : ∀ x y, M (Finsupp.single x 1) y ≠ 0 → orbit (x, y) ∈ I)
    (weight_eq : ∀ (i : I) x y, orbit (x, y) = i.val → weight i = M (Finsupp.single x 1) y)
    (finiteOrbits : ∀ x, Set.Finite {o : O |
      ∃ y, M (Finsupp.single x 1) y ≠ 0 ∧ o = orbit (x, y)})
    (matrix : ∀ (i : I) x y,
      (weight i • (drawing i).interpret.eval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) y =
        @ite Complex (orbit (x, y) = i.val) (Classical.propDecidable _) (weight i) 0) :
    ∃ (finite : ∀ v : bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex, Set.Finite
        {i : I | weight i • (drawing i).interpret.eval.toLinearMap v ≠ 0}),
      let sum : PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex bottom top I :=
        ⟨fun i => LabelledDrawing.scale (weight i) (drawing i), finite⟩
      ∀ v, M v = sum.evalAt v := by
  classical
  let L (i : I) := weight i • (drawing i).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
  have entry (i : I) (x : bottom.basis.carrier) (y : top.basis.carrier) :
      L i (Finsupp.single x 1) y = if orbit (x, y) = i.val then weight i else 0 :=
    matrix i x y
  -- Step 3. The nonzero entries in a basis column bound the contributing
  -- orbits. Finite linear extension handles arbitrary inputs.
  have finiteColumn (x : bottom.basis.carrier) :
      Set.Finite {i : I | L i (Finsupp.single x 1) ≠ 0} := by
    apply ((finiteOrbits x).preimage (f := Subtype.val) Subtype.val_injective.injOn).subset
    intro i hi
    change L i (Finsupp.single x 1) ≠ 0 at hi
    have h : ∃ y, L i (Finsupp.single x 1) y ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! hall
      exact hi (Finsupp.ext fun y => hall y)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
    have he : orbit (x, y) = i.val := by
      by_contra hn
      exact hy ((entry i x y).trans (ite_eq_right hn))
    exact ⟨y, by rwa [entry, ite_eq_left he, weight_eq i x y he] at hy, he.symm⟩
  let finite := finite_linear_support L finiteColumn
  let sum : PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex bottom top I :=
    ⟨fun i => LabelledDrawing.scale (weight i) (drawing i), finite⟩
  refine ⟨finite, ?_⟩
  suffices h : M = sum.eval from fun v => (LinearMap.congr_fun h v).trans (sum.eval_apply v)
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro x c
  rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul, map_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [PointwiseIndexedDrawing.eval_apply, PointwiseIndexedDrawing.evalAt_def]
  change M (Finsupp.single x 1) = (finite (Finsupp.single x 1)).toFinset.sum
    (fun i => L i (Finsupp.single x 1))
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro y
  rw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  by_cases hc : M (Finsupp.single x 1) y = 0
  · rw [hc]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    by_cases he : orbit (x, y) = i.val
    · rw [entry, ite_eq_left he, weight_eq i x y he, hc]
    · rw [entry, ite_eq_right he]
  · let i : I := ⟨orbit (x, y), hit x y hc⟩
    have he : orbit (x, y) = i.val := rfl
    have hval : L i (Finsupp.single x 1) y = M (Finsupp.single x 1) y := by
      rw [entry, ite_eq_left he, weight_eq i x y he]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · exact hval.symm
    · intro j _ hj
      have hne : orbit (x, y) ≠ j.val := fun he' => hj (Subtype.ext (he'.symm.trans he))
      rw [entry, ite_eq_right hne]
    · intro hi
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hi
      have hz : L i (Finsupp.single x 1) = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hi
      exact False.elim (hc (hval.symm.trans (congrArg (fun w => w y) hz)))

private theorem finite_eval {U : Type*} [Group U] {G F : Subgroup U}
    {bottom top : Word G F} (terms : List (Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)) :
    let folded := terms.foldr
      (fun term rest => LabelledDrawing.add (LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 term.2) rest)
      (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.zero (R := Complex) bottom top))
    let indexed : IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top (Fin terms.length) :=
      ⟨Finset.univ, fun i => LabelledDrawing.scale (terms.get i).1 (terms.get i).2⟩
    folded.interpret.eval.toLinearMap = indexed.eval := by
  intro folded indexed
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  let termValue (term : Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) :=
    term.1 • term.2.interpret.eval.toLinearMap v
  have hfold (l : List (Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)) :
      (l.foldr (fun term rest => LabelledDrawing.add (LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 term.2) rest)
        (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.zero (R := Complex) bottom top))).interpret.eval.toLinearMap v =
        (l.map termValue).sum := by
    induction l with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons t l ih =>
        rw [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        change termValue t + _ = termValue t + _
        exact congrArg (termValue t + ·) ih
  rw [IndexedDrawing.eval_apply]
  change folded.interpret.eval.toLinearMap v =
    Finset.univ.sum (fun i : Fin terms.length => termValue (terms.get i))
  exact (hfold terms).trans (Fin.sum_univ_fun_getElem terms termValue).symm

end CaseFivePointwiseAux

ExpansionIntoRightDiagrams.proof:
by
  classical
  intro U inst G A D F C E a b d c e f up down tensor comp ga ad df gc ce ef bottom top
    X Y Pair orbit coefficient MiddleLabel UpperLabel ProjectionTerm drawId rightDrawing eval
    IsRightTerm M
  -- Ian Xiao, Theorem 6.7, archived PDF p. 26 and revised published PDF p. 28.
  -- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
  -- The downloaded revision matches article-revision/mackey-bimodules.pdf.
  -- The archived original has a distinct SHA-256 digest. Both pages contain
  -- the same theorem, so the reviewed Lean type is used verbatim.
  -- Alphabeta Math presents the proof in paragraphs. Steps 1–4 here follow
  -- its coefficient invariance, stabilizer construction, and two finiteness arguments.
  let supplier := RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer G A D F C E a b d c e f
  -- Step 1. The supplier checks equivariance for this very action, including
  -- the inverse on the exterior right coordinate.
  have constant (z w : Pair) (hw : w ∈ orbit z) : coefficient M w = coefficient M z :=
    supplier.1 M z w hw
  let action : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
      mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
  have orbit_eq (z w : Pair) : orbit z = orbit w ↔ z ∈ orbit w :=
    @MulAction.orbit_eq_iff _ _ _ action z w
  let supported : Set (Set Pair) := {O | ∃ z : Pair, O = orbit z ∧ coefficient M z ≠ 0}
  -- Step 2. Use the normalized pair and the projected stabilizer. The
  -- nonzero coefficient at that pair supplies the finite-fiber hypothesis.
  -- The supplier connects the typed compact projection, parallel induction
  -- crossing, and multiplication to (6.4) via CaseSixRightShapeEvaluation.
  -- EvaluationWithOneProjection gives the underlying basis formula in coordinates
  -- in D. The orbit supplier already checks the needed indicator for the exact
  -- list-labelled syntax and the finite-label converse.
  have realize (O : supported) :
      ∃ drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top,
        IsRightTerm drawing ∧ ∀ w : Pair,
          coefficient (eval drawing) w = if w ∈ O.val then 1 else 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z, he, hz⟩ := O.property
    obtain ⟨r, t, s, hz'⟩ := supplier.2.1 z
    let z₀ : Pair :=
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) 1 (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d r),
       MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) t (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f s))
    have h₀ : coefficient M z₀ ≠ 0 := (constant z₀ z hz') ▸ hz
    obtain ⟨i, j, k, rDot, tDot, sDot, _, _, _, _, _, _, realizeAt⟩ :=
      (supplier.2.2.1 r t s).2.2.2
    obtain ⟨_, finite, indicator⟩ := realizeAt M h₀
    let lower := [((1 : Complex), (⟨rDot, finite⟩ : ProjectionTerm _ i j))]
    let drawing := rightDrawing _ i j k lower [(1, tDot)] [(1, sDot)]
    refine ⟨drawing, ⟨_, i, j, k, lower, [(1, tDot)], [(1, sDot)], rfl⟩, fun w => ?_⟩
    have he' : O.val = orbit z₀ := he.trans ((orbit_eq z z₀).mpr hz')
    rw [he']
    exact indicator w
  let diagram (O : supported) := Classical.choose (realize O)
  have right (O : supported) : IsRightTerm (diagram O) := (Classical.choose_spec (realize O)).1
  let weight (O : supported) := coefficient M (Classical.choose O.property)
  have weight_eq (O : supported) (x : X.carrier) (y : Y.carrier) (h : orbit (x, y) = O.val) :
      weight O = coefficient M (x, y) := by
    have he := (Classical.choose_spec O.property).1
    exact (constant _ _ ((orbit_eq _ _).mp (h.trans he))).symm
  let L (O : supported) := weight O • (eval (diagram O)).toLinearMap
  have matrix (O : supported) (x : X.carrier) (y : Y.carrier) :
      L O (Finsupp.single x 1) y =
        if orbit (x, y) = O.val then weight O else 0 := by
    obtain ⟨z, he, _⟩ := O.property
    have hm : ((x, y) : Pair) ∈ O.val ↔ orbit (x, y) = O.val := by
      rw [he]
      exact (orbit_eq (x, y) z).symm
    have indicator := (Classical.choose_spec (realize O)).2 (x, y)
    change (weight O • (eval (diagram O)).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) y = _
    rw [Finsupp.smul_apply]
    change weight O * coefficient (eval (diagram O)) (x, y) = _
    rw [indicator]
    by_cases h : orbit (x, y) = O.val
    · rw [ite_eq_left h, ite_eq_left (hm.mpr h), mul_one]
    · rw [ite_eq_right h, ite_eq_right (fun hw => h (hm.mp hw)), mul_zero]
  -- Step 3. Finiteness for every input is obtained by a linear extension of
  -- the assembled basis columns. Each coordinate of the sum has at most
  -- one contributing orbit, though a column may involve several orbits.
  have pointwise := ExpansionIntoRightDiagramsAux.orbit_columns orbit M.toLinearMap
    supported weight L (fun x y h => ⟨(x, y), rfl, h⟩) weight_eq (supplier.2.2.2.2.2 M) matrix
  obtain ⟨finite, pointwise_sum⟩ := pointwise
  refine ⟨⟨supported, weight, diagram, right, finite, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    exact pointwise_sum v
  -- Step 4. The checked converse covers the three independent finite vertex
  -- labels and the outer finite sum. For the reverse implication, realize
  -- the finite orbit family by the specified list fold of typed drawings.
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨terms, hterms, hM⟩
    have hfold : M = eval (foldedTerms terms) := by
      apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
      change M.toLinearMap = (foldedTerms terms).interpret.eval.toLinearMap
      rw [indexed_fold]
      exact hM
    rw [hfold]
    exact supplier.2.2.2.2.1 terms hterms
  · intro h
    let all : Finset supported := @Finset.univ supported h.fintype
    obtain ⟨terms, hterms, hsum⟩ :=
      ExpansionIntoRightDiagramsAux.fold_finset weight diagram all
    refine ⟨terms, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro term ht
      obtain ⟨O, rfl⟩ := hterms term ht
      exact right O
    · change M.toLinearMap = (indexedTerms terms).eval
      rw [← indexed_fold]
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro v
      have sum := pointwise_sum
      calc
        M.toLinearMap v = (finite v).toFinset.sum (fun O => L O v) := sum v
        _ = all.sum (fun O => L O v) := by
          apply Finset.sum_subset (@Finset.subset_univ supported h.fintype _)
          intro O _ hO
          rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hO
          exact not_ne_iff.mp hO
        _ = _ := (hsum v).symm

open MackeyDiagrams
universe u
variable {U : Type u} [Group U] {G F : Subgroup U} {bottom top : Word G F}

private noncomputable def indexedTerms (terms : List (Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)) :
    IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top (Fin terms.length) :=
  ⟨Finset.univ, fun i => LabelledDrawing.scale (terms.get i).1 (terms.get i).2⟩

private noncomputable def foldedTerms (terms : List (Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)) :
    LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
  terms.foldr (fun term rest => LabelledDrawing.add (LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 term.2) rest)
    (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.zero (R := Complex) bottom top))

private theorem indexed_fold (terms : List (Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)) :
    (foldedTerms terms).interpret.eval.toLinearMap = (indexedTerms terms).eval := by
  classical
  induction terms with
  | nil =>
    change (0 : (bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (top.basis.carrier →₀ Complex)) = _
    simp [indexedTerms, IndexedDrawing.eval]
  | cons h t ih =>
    change h.1 • h.2.interpret.eval.toLinearMap + (foldedTerms t).interpret.eval.toLinearMap = _
    rw [ih]
    simp [indexedTerms, IndexedDrawing.eval, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    rfl

namespace ExpansionIntoRightDiagramsAux

open MackeyDiagrams

private theorem basis_ext {X : Type*} {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    {L M : (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] V}
    (h : ∀ x, L (Finsupp.single x 1) = M (Finsupp.single x 1)) : L = M := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro x c
  rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul, map_smul, h x]

private theorem assemble {X I V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module Complex V]
    (M : (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] V) (L : I → (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] V)
    (finiteColumn : ∀ x, Set.Finite {i : I | L i (Finsupp.single x 1) ≠ 0})
    (columnSum : ∀ x, M (Finsupp.single x 1) =
      (finiteColumn x).toFinset.sum (fun i => L i (Finsupp.single x 1))) :
    ∃ finite : ∀ v, Set.Finite {i : I | L i v ≠ 0},
      ∀ v, M v = (finite v).toFinset.sum (fun i => L i v) := by
  classical
  -- Step 3. Collect each finite column over the orbit index. Linear extension
  -- gives one finitely supported vector of contributions for every finite input.
  let column (x : X) : I →₀ V :=
    Finsupp.ofSupportFinite (fun i => L i (Finsupp.single x 1)) (finiteColumn x)
  let collect := Finsupp.linearCombination Complex column
  have collect_basis (x : X) : collect (Finsupp.single x 1) = column x := by
    simp only [collect, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
  have entry (i : I) (v : X →₀ Complex) : collect v i = L i v := by
    have he : (Finsupp.lapply (R := Complex) i).comp collect = L i := by
      apply basis_ext
      intro x
      change collect (Finsupp.single x 1) i = _
      rw [collect_basis]
      rfl
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun he v
  let total := Finsupp.lsum Complex (fun _ : I => LinearMap.id (R := Complex) (M := V))
  have total_apply (w : I →₀ V) : total w = w.support.sum (fun i => w i) := by
    rw [Finsupp.lsum_apply]
    rfl
  have hM : M = total.comp collect := by
    apply basis_ext
    intro x
    change M (Finsupp.single x 1) = total (collect (Finsupp.single x 1))
    rw [columnSum x, collect_basis, total_apply]
    rfl
  have support_eq (v : X →₀ Complex) : (↑(collect v).support : Set I) = {i | L i v ≠ 0} := by
    ext i
    change i ∈ (collect v).support ↔ L i v ≠ 0
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, entry]
  let finite (v : X →₀ Complex) : Set.Finite {i : I | L i v ≠ 0} :=
    support_eq v ▸ (collect v).support.finite_toSet
  refine ⟨finite, fun v => ?_⟩
  have hfin : (finite v).toFinset = (collect v).support := by
    ext i
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    exact (Set.ext_iff.mp (support_eq v) i).symm
  rw [hfin]
  calc
    M v = total (collect v) := LinearMap.congr_fun hM v
    _ = (collect v).support.sum (fun i => collect v i) := total_apply _
    _ = _ := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => entry i v)

private theorem orbit_columns {X Y O : Type*} (orbit : X × Y → O)
    (M : (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (Y →₀ Complex))
    (I : Set O) (weight : I → Complex)
    (L : I → (X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (Y →₀ Complex))
    (hit : ∀ x y, M (Finsupp.single x 1) y ≠ 0 → orbit (x, y) ∈ I)
    (weight_eq : ∀ (i : I) x y, orbit (x, y) = ↑i → weight i = M (Finsupp.single x 1) y)
    (finiteOrbits : ∀ x, Set.Finite {o : O |
      ∃ y, M (Finsupp.single x 1) y ≠ 0 ∧ o = orbit (x, y)})
    (matrix : ∀ (i : I) x y,
      L i (Finsupp.single x 1) y =
        @ite Complex (orbit (x, y) = ↑i) (Classical.propDecidable _) (weight i) 0) :
    ∃ finite : ∀ v, Set.Finite {i : I | L i v ≠ 0},
      ∀ v, M v = (finite v).toFinset.sum (fun i => L i v) := by
  classical
  have finiteColumn (x : X) : Set.Finite {i : I | L i (Finsupp.single x 1) ≠ 0} := by
    apply ((finiteOrbits x).preimage (f := Subtype.val) Subtype.val_injective.injOn).subset
    intro i hi
    change L i (Finsupp.single x 1) ≠ 0 at hi
    have h : ∃ y, L i (Finsupp.single x 1) y ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! hall
      exact hi (Finsupp.ext fun y => hall y)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h
    have horbit : orbit (x, y) = ↑i := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hy ((matrix i x y).trans (ite_eq_right hne))
    refine ⟨y, ?_, horbit.symm⟩
    rw [matrix, ite_eq_left horbit, weight_eq i x y horbit] at hy
    exact hy
  apply assemble M L finiteColumn
  intro x
  ext y
  rw [Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  by_cases hc : M (Finsupp.single x 1) y = 0
  · rw [hc]
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    by_cases he : orbit (x, y) = ↑i
    · rw [matrix, ite_eq_left he, weight_eq i x y he, hc]
    · rw [matrix, ite_eq_right he]
  · let i : I := ⟨orbit (x, y), hit x y hc⟩
    have he : orbit (x, y) = ↑i := rfl
    have hval : L i (Finsupp.single x 1) y = M (Finsupp.single x 1) y := by
      rw [matrix, ite_eq_left he, weight_eq i x y he]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · exact hval.symm
    · intro j _ hj
      have hne : orbit (x, y) ≠ ↑j := fun hj' => hj (Subtype.ext (hj'.symm.trans he))
      rw [matrix, ite_eq_right hne]
    · intro hi
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hi
      have hzero : L i (Finsupp.single x 1) = 0 := by simpa using hi

private theorem fold_finset {U : Type*} [Group U] {G F : Subgroup U}
    {bottom top : Word G F} {I : Type*}
    (weight : I → Complex) (diagram : I → LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    (s : Finset I) :
    ∃ terms : List (Complex × LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top),
      (∀ term ∈ terms, ∃ i, term = (weight i, diagram i)) ∧
      ∀ v : bottom.basis.carrier →₀ Complex,
        (terms.foldr (fun term rest => LabelledDrawing.add (LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 term.2) rest)

          s.sum (fun i => weight i • (diagram i).interpret.eval.toLinearMap v) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    refine ⟨[], by simp, fun v => ?_⟩
    change 0 = Finset.sum ∅ _
    simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    obtain ⟨terms, hterms, hsum⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨(weight i, diagram i) :: terms, ?_, fun v => ?_⟩
    · intro term ht
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ht with rfl | ht
      · exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
      · exact hterms term ht
    · let folded := terms.foldr
        (fun term rest => LabelledDrawing.add (LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 term.2) rest)
        (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.zero (R := Complex) bottom top))
      change weight i • (diagram i).interpret.eval.toLinearMap v +
        folded.interpret.eval.toLinearMap v = _
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
      exact congrArg (_ + ·) (hsum v)

namespace CaseFiveUnscaled

open MackeyDiagrams
noncomputable section

universe u v

variable {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R]

private abbrev castVec {ι : Type*} : (ι →₀ Nat) →+ (ι →₀ R) :=
  Finsupp.mapRange.addMonoidHom (Nat.castAddMonoidHom R)

private theorem cast_single {ι : Type*} (i : ι) (n : Nat) :
    castVec (R := R) (Finsupp.single i n) = Finsupp.single i (n : R) :=
  Finsupp.mapRange_single (hf := map_zero (Nat.castAddMonoidHom R))

private theorem cast_entry {ι : Type*} (x : ι →₀ Nat) (i : ι) :
    castVec (R := R) x i = (x i : R) := rfl

private theorem cast_nsmul {ι : Type*} (n : Nat) (v : ι →₀ Nat) :
    castVec (R := R) (n • v) = (n : R) • castVec v := by
  rw [map_nsmul, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

private def Compatible {ι κ : Type*}
    (N : (ι →₀ Nat) →ₗ[Nat] (κ →₀ Nat)) (T : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (κ →₀ R)) :=
  ∀ v, castVec (N v) = T (castVec v)

private theorem compatible_columns {ι κ : Type*}
    {N : (ι →₀ Nat) →ₗ[Nat] (κ →₀ Nat)} {T : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (κ →₀ R)}
    (h : ∀ i, castVec (N (Finsupp.single i 1)) = T (Finsupp.single i 1)) :
    Compatible N T := by
  intro v
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | single i n =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one i n, map_smul, cast_nsmul, h, cast_nsmul,
      cast_single, Nat.cast_one, map_smul]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, hp, hq, map_add, map_add]

private theorem cast_pair {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
    (X : Biset K H) (Y : Biset H J) (p : X.carrier →₀ Nat) (q : Y.carrier →₀ Nat) :
    castVec (R := R) (Biset.pairLinear Nat X Y p q) =
      Biset.pairLinear R X Y (castVec p) (castVec q) := by
  induction p using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add p p' hp hp' =>
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, hp, hp', map_add, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  | single x a =>
    induction q using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add q q' hq hq' => rw [map_add, map_add, hq, hq', map_add, map_add]
    | single y b => simp only [Biset.pairLinear_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_mul]

variable {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]

private abbrev Natural {X Y : Biset K H} (N : Biset.Hom Nat X Y) (T : Biset.Hom R X Y) :=
  Compatible N.toLinearMap T.toLinearMap

private theorem natural_vertical {X Y Z : Biset K H}
    {N : Biset.Hom Nat X Y} {M : Biset.Hom Nat Y Z}
    {T : Biset.Hom R X Y} {S : Biset.Hom R Y Z}
    (hN : Natural N T) (hM : Natural M S) :
    Natural (N.vertical M) (T.vertical S) := by
  intro v
  change castVec (M.toLinearMap (N.toLinearMap v)) = S.toLinearMap (T.toLinearMap (castVec v))
  rw [hM, hN]

private theorem natural_horizontal {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}
    {N : Biset.Hom Nat X X'} {M : Biset.Hom Nat Y Y'}
    {T : Biset.Hom R X X'} {S : Biset.Hom R Y Y'}
    (hN : Natural N T) (hM : Natural M S) :
    Natural (N.horizontal M) (T.horizontal S) := by
  apply compatible_columns
  intro z
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z ?_
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  change castVec ((N.horizontal M).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) 1)) =
    (T.horizontal S).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) 1)
  simp only [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, one_smul, cast_pair]
  rw [hN _, hM _, cast_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]

private theorem natural_id (X : Biset K H) :
    Natural (Biset.Hom.id X) (Biset.Hom.id (R := R) X) := fun _ => rfl

private theorem natural_push {X Y : Biset K H} (f : X.carrier → Y.carrier)
    (hf : ∀ g x, f (X.act g x) = Y.act g (f x)) :
    Natural (Biset.Hom.ofFunction f hf) (Biset.Hom.ofFunction (R := R) f hf) := by
  apply compatible_columns
  intro x
  simp only [Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]

private theorem natural_transfer {X Y : Biset K H} (f : X.carrier → Y.carrier)
    (hf : ∀ g x, f (X.act g x) = Y.act g (f x))
    (finite : ∀ y, Set.Finite {x | f x = y}) :
    Natural (Biset.Hom.transfer Nat f hf finite) (Biset.Hom.transfer R f hf finite) := by
  apply compatible_columns
  intro y
  simp only [Biset.Hom.transfer_single, one_smul, Biset.Hom.transferBasis_sum,
    map_sum, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]

variable {U : Type u} [Group U]

private theorem eval_singleton {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : ScopedDiagram R p q) :
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, d)]).eval = d.eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  ext v w
  simp [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply]

private abbrev drawingEval {S : Type*} [CommSemiring S]
    {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : LabelledDrawing S p q) :=
  d.interpret.eval

private def NaturalDrawing {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    (N : LabelledDrawing Nat p q) (T : LabelledDrawing R p q) :=
  Natural (drawingEval N) (drawingEval T)

private theorem natural_drawing_vertical {K H : Subgroup U} {p q s : Word K H}
    {N : LabelledDrawing Nat p q} {M : LabelledDrawing Nat q s}
    {T : LabelledDrawing R p q} {S : LabelledDrawing R q s}
    (hN : NaturalDrawing N T) (hM : NaturalDrawing M S) :
    NaturalDrawing (.vertical N M) (.vertical T S) := natural_vertical hN hM

private theorem natural_drawing_horizontal {K H J : Subgroup U}
    {p p' : Word K H} {q q' : Word H J}
    {N : LabelledDrawing Nat p p'} {M : LabelledDrawing Nat q q'}
    {T : LabelledDrawing R p p'} {S : LabelledDrawing R q q'}
    (hN : NaturalDrawing N T) (hM : NaturalDrawing M S) :
    NaturalDrawing (.horizontal N M) (.horizontal T S) := natural_horizontal hN hM

private theorem natural_drawing_id {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) :
    NaturalDrawing (.ordinary (.id p)) (.ordinary (.id p) : LabelledDrawing R p p) :=
  natural_id p.basis

private theorem natural_associate {K H J F : Subgroup U}
    (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) (r : Word J F) :
    NaturalDrawing (.ordinary (.associate p q r))
      (.ordinary (Diagram.associate (R := R) p q r)) := by
  apply compatible_columns
  intro z
  simp only [drawingEval, LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, Diagram.eval,
    Biset.associate, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]

private theorem natural_unassociate {K H J F : Subgroup U}
    (p : Word K H) (q : Word H J) (r : Word J F) :
    NaturalDrawing (.ordinary (.unassociate p q r))
      (.ordinary (Diagram.unassociate (R := R) p q r)) := by
  apply compatible_columns
  intro z
  simp only [drawingEval, LabelledDrawing.interpret, ScopedDiagram.eval, Diagram.eval,
    Biset.unassociate, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]

private theorem natural_parallel {F A C G : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (i : ConjEmbedding F A)
    (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (k : ConjEmbedding F C) (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)) :
    NaturalDrawing (.parallelUp a i c k [(1,t)])
      (LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := R) a i c k [(1,t)]) := by
  change Natural (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary (.parallelUp a i c k t))]).eval
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary (Diagram.parallelUp (R := R) a i c k t))]).eval
  rw [eval_singleton, eval_singleton]
  simp only [ScopedDiagram.eval, Diagram.parallelUp, Diagram.eval]
  apply natural_vertical (natural_vertical ?_ ?_) ?_
  · apply compatible_columns
    intro z
    rw [Generator.mergeUp, Generator.mergeUp, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]
  · apply compatible_columns
    intro z
    rw [Generator.upDot, Generator.upDot, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]
  · apply compatible_columns
    intro z
    rw [Generator.splitUp, Generator.splitUp, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single, cast_single, Nat.cast_one]

private theorem natural_multiplication {K H G L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H) (t : Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) :
    NaturalDrawing (.mixedMultiplication a b l r [(1,t)])
      (LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := R) a b l r [(1,t)]) := by
  change Natural (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary (.mixedMultiplication a b l r t))]).eval
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := R) a b l r t))]).eval
  rw [eval_singleton, eval_singleton]
  exact natural_push _ (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b l r t)

private theorem natural_projection {K H G L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H) (t : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :
    NaturalDrawing (.compactProjection a b l r [(1,t)])
      (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) a b l r [(1,t)]) := by
  change Natural
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary (.mixedProjection a b l r t.dot t.finite))]).eval
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, .ordinary (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := R) a b l r t.dot t.finite))]).eval
  rw [eval_singleton, eval_singleton]
  exact natural_transfer _ (Generator.mixedMultiplication_equivariant a b l r t.dot) t.finite

private theorem coefficient_cast {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    {N : LabelledDrawing Nat p q} {D : LabelledDrawing R p q}
    (hd : NaturalDrawing N D) (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier) :
    (drawingEval D).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) y =
      (((drawingEval N).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) y : Nat) : R) := by
  have he := congrArg (fun v : q.basis.carrier →₀ R => v y) (hd (Finsupp.single x 1))
  change castVec (R := R) ((drawingEval N).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) y =
    (drawingEval D).toLinearMap (castVec (Finsupp.single x 1)) y at he
  rw [cast_entry, cast_single, Nat.cast_one] at he
  exact he.symm

private theorem coefficient_transport {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    {N : LabelledDrawing Nat p q} {C : LabelledDrawing Complex p q} {T : LabelledDrawing R p q}
    (hc : NaturalDrawing N C) (ht : NaturalDrawing N T)
    (x : p.basis.carrier) (y : q.basis.carrier) (n : Nat)
    (h : (drawingEval C).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) y = (n : Complex)) :
    (drawingEval T).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1) y = (n : R) := by
  rw [coefficient_cast hc x y] at h
  rw [coefficient_cast ht x y, Nat.cast_injective (R := Complex) h]


private theorem linearCombination_map {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    {ι : Type*} (l : ι →₀ R) (f : ι → ScopedDiagram R p q)
    (x : p.basis.carrier →₀ R) :
    (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (l.support.toList.map (fun i => (l i, f i)))).eval.toLinearMap x =
      l.sum (fun i r => r • (f i).eval.toLinearMap x) := by
  classical
  rw [ScopedDiagram.eval_linearCombination_apply, List.map_map]
  change _ = ∑ i ∈ l.support, l i • (f i).eval.toLinearMap x
  have h := List.sum_toFinset (fun i => l i • (f i).eval.toLinearMap x) l.support.nodup_toList
  rw [Finset.toList_toFinset] at h
  exact h.symm

private theorem frame_right_sum {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
    {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J} {ι : Type*}
    (l : ι →₀ R) (N : Biset.Hom R X X') (f : ι → Biset.Hom R X X') (g : Biset.Hom R Y Y')
    (h : ∀ x, N.toLinearMap x = l.sum (fun i r => r • (f i).toLinearMap x))
    (m : (X.tensor Y).carrier →₀ R) :
    (N.horizontal g).toLinearMap m = l.sum (fun i r => r • ((f i).horizontal g).toLinearMap m) := by
  let M := l.sum (fun i r => r • ((f i).horizontal g).toLinearMap)
  have hM : (N.horizontal g).toLinearMap = M := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z r
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z ?_
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    change (N.horizontal g).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) =
      (∑ i ∈ l.support, l i • ((f i).horizontal g).toLinearMap) (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r)
    simp only [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, h,
      Finsupp.sum]
    let frame := (Biset.pairLinear R X' Y').flip (g.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single y 1))
    change r • frame (∑ i ∈ l.support, l i • (f i).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single x 1)) = _
    rw [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [map_smul, smul_comm]
    rfl
  rw [hM]
  simp only [M, Finsupp.sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]

private theorem frame_left_sum {K H J : Type u} [Group K] [Group H] [Group J]
    {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J} {ι : Type*}
    (l : ι →₀ R) (g : Biset.Hom R X X') (N : Biset.Hom R Y Y') (f : ι → Biset.Hom R Y Y')
    (h : ∀ y, N.toLinearMap y = l.sum (fun i r => r • (f i).toLinearMap y))
    (m : (X.tensor Y).carrier →₀ R) :
    (g.horizontal N).toLinearMap m = l.sum (fun i r => r • (g.horizontal (f i)).toLinearMap m) := by
  let M := l.sum (fun i r => r • (g.horizontal (f i)).toLinearMap)
  have hM : (g.horizontal N).toLinearMap = M := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z r
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z ?_
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    change (g.horizontal N).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) =
      (∑ i ∈ l.support, l i • (g.horizontal (f i)).toLinearMap) (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r)
    simp only [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, h,
      Finsupp.sum, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, map_smul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact smul_comm _ _ _
  rw [hM]
  simp only [M, Finsupp.sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]

private theorem eq_of_columns {ι κ : Type*} {f g : (ι →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (κ →₀ R)}
    (h : ∀ x y, f (Finsupp.single x 1) y = g (Finsupp.single x 1) y) : f = g := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro x r
  rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one x r, map_smul, map_smul]
  exact congrArg (r • ·) (Finsupp.ext (h x))

private theorem orbit_sum_entries {Q : Type*} {L : Type*} [Group L] [MulAction L Q]
    {S : Set (Set Q)} (finite : (Set.univ : Set S).Finite) (z : Q)
    (isOrbit : ∀ O ∈ S, ∃ w : Q, O = MulAction.orbit L w) :
    (∑ O ∈ (Set.Finite.toFinset finite),
      @ite R (z ∈ O.val) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0) =
      @ite R (MulAction.orbit L z ∈ S) (Classical.propDecidable _) 1 0 := by
  classical
  let indices := Set.Finite.toFinset finite
  have unique (O : S) (h : z ∈ O.val) : O.val = MulAction.orbit L z := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := isOrbit O.val O.property
    rw [hw] at h ⊢
    exact (MulAction.orbit_eq_iff.mpr h).symm
  by_cases hs : MulAction.orbit L z ∈ S
  · let O : S := ⟨MulAction.orbit L z, hs⟩
    change (∑ O ∈ indices, _) = _
    rw [ite_eq_left hs, Finset.sum_eq_single O, ite_eq_left (MulAction.mem_orbit_self z)]
    · intro O' _ hne
      exact ite_eq_right (fun hz => hne (Subtype.ext (unique O' hz)))
    · intro h
      exact (h (finite.mem_toFinset.mpr (Set.mem_univ _))).elim
  · rw [ite_eq_right hs]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro O _
    exact ite_eq_right (fun hz => hs (unique O hz ▸ O.property))

private abbrev caseWord {G A D F : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D) :=
  (Word.up a).tensor ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d))

private abbrev casePoint {G A D F : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (g : G) (x : D) : (caseWord a b d).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction a).pair ((Word.down b).tensor (.up d)).basis g (Generator.mixedPair b d x)

private theorem casePoint_surjective {G A D F : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (z : (caseWord a b d).basis.carrier) : ∃ g x, casePoint a b d g x = z := by
  obtain ⟨⟨g, y⟩, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Generator.mixedEquiv b d).symm.surjective y
  exact ⟨g, x, rfl⟩

private theorem caseWord_finite {G A D F : Subgroup U}
    [Finite G] [Finite D]
    (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D) :
    Finite (caseWord a b d).basis.carrier :=
  Finite.of_surjective (fun p : G × D => casePoint a b d p.1 p.2) (by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨g, x, h⟩ := casePoint_surjective a b d z
    exact ⟨(g, x), h⟩)
private abbrev Sinf := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
private abbrev blockSym (X : Finset Nat) :=
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ X))
private abbrev ParabolicPerm (H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)) :=
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ l, (blocks l).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
    H = ⨆ l, blockSym (blocks l)
private abbrev Parabolic (H : Subgroup Sinf) := ParabolicPerm (H.map Sinf.subtype)
-- The finite block-union argument from the registered orbit-multiplicity proof.
private theorem parabolic_finite {H : Subgroup Sinf} (hH : Parabolic H) : Finite H := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n, blocks, _, _, hblocks⟩ := hH
  let X := Finset.univ.biUnion blocks
  have hsub : H.map Sinf.subtype ≤ blockSym X := by
    rw [hblocks]
    refine iSup_le fun i σ hs => ?_
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hs
    let σ : Equiv.Perm Nat := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype τ
    have moved_mem (x : Nat) (hx : σ x ≠ x) : x ∈ X := by
      by_contra hn
      have hi : x ∉ blocks i := fun hx' => hn (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hx'⟩)
      exact hx (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem τ hi)
    have preserves (x : Nat) : σ x ∈ X ↔ x ∈ X := by
      by_cases h : σ x = x
      · rw [h]
      · have hy : σ (σ x) ≠ σ x := fun hh => h (σ.injective hh)
        exact iff_of_true (moved_mem (σ x) hy) (moved_mem x h)
    exact ⟨σ.subtypePerm preserves, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_subtypePerm preserves moved_mem⟩
  let : Finite (blockSym X) :=
    (Set.finite_range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))).to_subtype
  exact Finite.of_injective
    (fun h : H => (⟨(h.val : Equiv.Perm Nat), hsub ⟨h.val, h.property, rfl⟩⟩ : blockSym X))
    (fun _ _ hh => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun y : blockSym X => y.val) hh)))


section Drawings

variable {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
variable (a : ConjEmbedding A G) (b : ConjEmbedding A D) (d : ConjEmbedding F D)
variable (c : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding C E) (f : ConjEmbedding F E)
variable (u : ConjEmbedding G B) (v : ConjEmbedding D B) (w : ConjEmbedding E B)

private abbrev lowerLabel := Dot (u.comp a) (v.comp b)
private abbrev middleLabel := Dot (v.comp d) (w.comp f)
private abbrev upperLabel := Dot (u.comp c) (w.comp e)

private abbrev leftDrawing
    (rs : List (R × lowerLabel a b u v)) (ts : List (R × middleLabel d f v w))
    (ss : List (R × ProjectionDot.Mixed u w c e)) :
    LabelledDrawing R (caseWord a b d) (caseWord c e f) :=
  .vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.up a) (.down b) (.up d)))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (.mixedMultiplication u v a b rs) (.ordinary (.id (.up d))))
      (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate (.down u) (.up v) (.up d)))
        (.vertical (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.down u))) (.parallelUp v d w f ts))
          (.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.down u) (.up w) (.up f)))
            (.vertical (.horizontal (.compactProjection u w c e ss) (.ordinary (.id (.up f))))
              (.ordinary (.associate (.up c) (.down e) (.up f))))))))

private abbrev rightDrawing (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (k : ConjEmbedding B C) (r : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
    (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)) (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) :
    LabelledDrawing R (caseWord a b d) (caseWord c e f) :=
  .vertical (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.up a))) (.compactProjection b d i j [(1,r)]))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.up a) (.up i) (.down j)))
      (.vertical (.horizontal (.parallelUp a i c k [(1,t)]) (.ordinary (.id (.down j))))
        (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate (.up c) (.up k) (.down j)))
          (.horizontal (.ordinary (.id (.up c))) (.mixedMultiplication e f k j [(1,s)])))))

-- The coefficient count in the proof of Proposition 8.7 is independent of the ring.
-- Check the same singleton drawing first over Nat. Its identity and reassociation
-- columns are deterministic, and its compact projection sums over the same fiber.
private theorem natural_left (r : lowerLabel a b u v) (t : middleLabel d f v w)
    (s : ProjectionDot.Mixed u w c e) :
    NaturalDrawing (leftDrawing a b d c e f u v w [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)])
      (leftDrawing (R := R) a b d c e f u v w [(1,r)] [(1,t)] [(1,s)]) := by
  exact natural_drawing_vertical (natural_unassociate (.up a) (.down b) (.up d))
    (natural_drawing_vertical
      (natural_drawing_horizontal (natural_multiplication u v a b r) (natural_drawing_id (.up d)))
      (natural_drawing_vertical (natural_associate (.down u) (.up v) (.up d))
        (natural_drawing_vertical
          (natural_drawing_horizontal (natural_drawing_id (.down u)) (natural_parallel v d w f t))
          (natural_drawing_vertical (natural_unassociate (.down u) (.up w) (.up f))
            (natural_drawing_vertical
              (natural_drawing_horizontal (natural_projection u w c e s) (natural_drawing_id (.up f)))
              (natural_associate (.up c) (.down e) (.up f)))))))

private theorem natural_right (i : ConjEmbedding B A) (j : ConjEmbedding B F)
    (k : ConjEmbedding B C) (r : ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
    (t : Dot (a.comp i) (c.comp k)) (s : Dot (e.comp k) (f.comp j)) :
    NaturalDrawing (rightDrawing a b d c e f i j k r t s)
      (rightDrawing (R := R) a b d c e f i j k r t s) := by
  exact natural_drawing_vertical
    (natural_drawing_horizontal (natural_drawing_id (.up a)) (natural_projection b d i j r))
    (natural_drawing_vertical (natural_unassociate (.up a) (.up i) (.down j))
      (natural_drawing_vertical
        (natural_drawing_horizontal (natural_parallel a i c k t) (natural_drawing_id (.down j)))
        (natural_drawing_vertical (natural_associate (.up c) (.up k) (.down j))
          (natural_drawing_horizontal (natural_drawing_id (.up c)) (natural_multiplication e f k j s)))))

-- The wording correction in published § 1.2 makes the scalar action on
-- maps explicit. For the extension to R in § 8.3, these balanced basis
-- formulas are R-linear in each map. The group-algebra balancing remains
-- encoded by the quotient carrier used in Biset.Hom.horizontal_single.
private theorem weighted_left
    (rs : DotLabel R (u.comp a) (v.comp b)) (ts : DotLabel R (v.comp d) (w.comp f))
    (ss : DotLabel R (u.comp c) (w.comp e))
    (fin : ∀ s : upperLabel c e u w, ∀ z,
      Set.Finite {p | Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s p = z})
    (m : (caseWord a b d).basis.carrier →₀ R) :
    (drawingEval (leftDrawing a b d c e f u v w rs.terms ts.terms
      (ss.terms.map (fun (cs,s) => (cs, ⟨s, fin s⟩))))).toLinearMap m =
    rs.sum (fun r cr => ts.sum (fun t ct => ss.sum (fun s cs => (cr * ct * cs) •
      (drawingEval (leftDrawing a b d c e f u v w [(1,r)] [(1,t)]
        [(1, ⟨s, fin s⟩)] )).toLinearMap m))) := by
  classical
  let ga := Word.up a
  let ad := Word.down b
  let df := Word.up d
  let gc := Word.up c
  let ce := Word.down e
  let ef := Word.up f
  let du := Word.down u
  let uv := Word.up v
  let uw := Word.up w
  let pre := (Diagram.unassociate (R := R) ga ad df).eval.toLinearMap
  let mid₁ := (Diagram.associate (R := R) du uv df).eval.toLinearMap
  let mid₂ := (Diagram.unassociate (R := R) du uw ef).eval.toLinearMap
  let post := (Diagram.associate (R := R) gc ce ef).eval.toLinearMap
  let lower (r : lowerLabel a b u v) := ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := R) u v a b r)
  let center (t : middleLabel d f v w) := ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.parallelUp (R := R) v d w f t)
  let upper (s : upperLabel c e u w) := ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.mixedProjection (R := R) u w c e s (fin s))
  let terms {ι : Type u} {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
      (l : ι →₀ R) (Dg : ι → ScopedDiagram R p q) :=
    ScopedDiagram.linearCombination (l.support.toList.map (fun i => (l i, Dg i)))
  let L := ((terms rs lower).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id df.basis)).toLinearMap
  let M := ((Biset.Hom.id du.basis).horizontal (terms ts center).eval).toLinearMap
  let N := ((terms ss upper).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id ef.basis)).toLinearMap
  let Lr := fun r => ((lower r).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id df.basis)).toLinearMap
  let Mt := fun t => ((Biset.Hom.id du.basis).horizontal (center t).eval).toLinearMap
  let Ns := fun s => ((upper s).eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id ef.basis)).toLinearMap
  have hL x : L x = rs.sum (fun r cr => cr • Lr r x) :=
    frame_right_sum rs _ _ _ (linearCombination_map rs lower) x
  have hM x : M x = ts.sum (fun t ct => ct • Mt t x) :=
    frame_left_sum ts _ _ _ (linearCombination_map ts center) x
  have hN x : N x = ss.sum (fun s cs => cs • Ns s x) :=
    frame_right_sum ss _ _ _ (linearCombination_map ss upper) x
  have singleton r t s :
      (drawingEval (leftDrawing a b d c e f u v w [(1,r)] [(1,t)]
        [(1, ⟨s, fin s⟩)])).toLinearMap m =
      post (Ns s (mid₂ (Mt t (mid₁ (Lr r (pre m)))))) := by
    let L' := ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, lower r)]).eval.horizontal
      (Biset.Hom.id df.basis)).toLinearMap
    let M' := ((Biset.Hom.id du.basis).horizontal
      (ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, center t)]).eval).toLinearMap
    let N' := ((ScopedDiagram.linearCombination [(1, upper s)]).eval.horizontal
      (Biset.Hom.id ef.basis)).toLinearMap
    change post (N' (mid₂ (M' (mid₁ (L' (pre m)))))) = _
    dsimp only [L', M', N']
    rw [eval_singleton, eval_singleton, eval_singleton]
  have hmain :
      (drawingEval (leftDrawing a b d c e f u v w rs.terms ts.terms
        (ss.terms.map (fun (cs,s) => (cs, ⟨s, fin s⟩))))).toLinearMap m =
      post (N (mid₂ (M (mid₁ (L (pre m)))))) := by

    exact hx (hfix x hn)

      by_contra hn

private abbrev qRight (r : D)
    (p : ((Word.up (a U)).tensor (Word.down (a U))).basis.carrier) :=
  mixedProduct (fromBot D) (fromBot D)
    (mixedMultiplicationBasis (fromBot D) (fromBot D) (a U) (a U) (dot r) p)

private abbrev qLeftPoint (y : E) :
    ((Word.up (a U)).tensor (Word.down (fromBot E))).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction (a U)).pair (Biset.restriction (fromBot E)) 1 y

private abbrev qRightPoint (U : Type) [Group U] :
    ((Word.up (a U)).tensor (Word.down (a U))).basis.carrier :=
  (Biset.induction (a U)).pair (Biset.restriction (a U)) 1 1

private theorem left_representative (p : ((Word.up (a U)).tensor
    (Word.down (fromBot E))).basis.carrier) : ∃ y : E, p = qLeftPoint y := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn p (fun ⟨z, y⟩ => ?_)
  exact ⟨y, congrArg (fun t => (Biset.induction (a U)).pair (Biset.restriction (fromBot E)) t y)
    (bot_one z)⟩

private theorem right_representative (p : ((Word.up (a U)).tensor
    (Word.down (a U))).basis.carrier) : p = qRightPoint U := by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn p (fun ⟨y, z⟩ => ?_)
  change (Biset.induction (a U)).pair (Biset.restriction (a U)) y z = _
  rw [bot_one y, bot_one z]

private theorem qLeft_eq (hEB : E ≤ B) (y : E) :
    qLeft hEB (qLeftPoint y) = (incl hEB).toHom y := by
  change mixedProduct _ _ (mixedPair (fromBot B) (incl hEB)
    ((fromBot B).toHom 1 * 1 * (incl hEB).toHom y)) = _
  rw [mixedProduct_mixedPair, map_one, one_mul, one_mul]

private theorem qRight_eq (r : D) (p : ((Word.up (a U)).tensor
    (Word.down (a U))).basis.carrier) : qRight r p = r := by
  rw [right_representative p]
  change mixedProduct _ _ (mixedPair (fromBot D) (fromBot D)
    ((fromBot D).toHom 1 * r * (fromBot D).toHom 1)) = _
  rw [mixedProduct_mixedPair, map_one, one_mul, mul_one]

-- The left projection has at most one preimage since its product
-- parameter is the inclusion E → B. The right projection is defined on
-- a one-point balanced product. Both supply actual finite-fiber witnesses.
private theorem qLeft_injective (hEB : E ≤ B) : Function.Injective (qLeft hEB) := by
  intro p p' hp
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := left_representative p
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := left_representative p'
  rw [qLeft_eq, qLeft_eq] at hp
  exact congrArg qLeftPoint ((incl hEB).injective hp)

private theorem qRight_injective (r : D) : Function.Injective (qRight r) :=
  fun p p' _ => (right_representative p).trans (right_representative p').symm

private theorem finite_fiber {X Y : Type} {f : X → Y} (hf : Function.Injective f) (y : Y) :
    Set.Finite {x | f x = y} := by
  by_cases h : ∃ x, f x = y
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
    exact (Set.finite_singleton x).subset (fun z hz => Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
      (hf (hz.trans hx.symm)))
  · exact Set.finite_empty.subset (fun z hz => (h ⟨z, hz⟩).elim)

private theorem finite_mixed {L K H M : Subgroup U}
    (α : ConjEmbedding K M) (β : ConjEmbedding H M)
    (γ : ConjEmbedding L K) (δ : ConjEmbedding L H) (d : Dot (α.comp γ) (β.comp δ))
    (h : ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | mixedProduct α β (mixedMultiplicationBasis α β γ δ d p) = z})
    (z : _) : Set.Finite {p | mixedMultiplicationBasis α β γ δ d p = z} :=
  (h (mixedProduct α β z)).subset (fun _ hp => congrArg (mixedProduct α β) hp)

private abbrev drawId {H K : Subgroup U} (p : Word H K) :=
  LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)

private abbrev atLeft {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
    {p : Word K J} {q : Word J L} {p' : Word K J'} {q' : Word J' L}
    (tail : Word L M) (cross : LabelledDrawing Complex (p.tensor q) (p'.tensor q')) :=
  LabelledDrawing.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate p q tail))
    (.vertical (.horizontal cross (drawId tail)) (.ordinary (.associate p' q' tail)))

private abbrev middle (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B) (r : D) (s : E) :
    Dot ((incl hDB).comp (fromBot D)) ((incl hEB).comp (fromBot E)) :=
  dot (((incl hDB).toHom r)⁻¹ * (incl hEB).toHom s)

private abbrev leftUpper (hEB : E ≤ B) :
    ProjectionDot.Mixed (fromBot B) (incl hEB) (a U) (fromBot E) :=
  ⟨dot 1, finite_mixed _ _ _ _ _ (finite_fiber (qLeft_injective hEB))⟩

private abbrev rightLower (r : D) :
    ProjectionDot.Mixed (fromBot D) (fromBot D) (a U) (a U) :=
  ⟨dot r, finite_mixed _ _ _ _ _ (finite_fiber (qRight_injective r))⟩

private abbrev left (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B) (r : D) (s : E) :=
  LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (atLeft (.up (fromBot D)) (.mixedMultiplication (fromBot B) (incl hDB) (a U) (fromBot D)
      [(1, dot 1)]))
    (.vertical (.horizontal (drawId (.down (fromBot B)))
      (.parallelUp (incl hDB) (fromBot D) (incl hEB) (fromBot E) [(1, middle hDB hEB r s)]))
      (atLeft (.up (fromBot E)) (.compactProjection (fromBot B) (incl hEB) (a U) (fromBot E)
        [(1, leftUpper hEB)])))

private abbrev right (r : D) (s : E) :=
  LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (.horizontal (drawId (.up (a U))) (.compactProjection (fromBot D) (fromBot D) (a U) (a U)
      [(1, rightLower r)]))
    (.vertical
      (atLeft (.down (a U)) (.parallelUp (a U) (a U) (a U) (a U) [(1, dot 1)]))
      (.horizontal (drawId (.up (a U))) (.mixedMultiplication (fromBot E) (fromBot E) (a U) (a U)
        [(1, dot s)])))

private abbrev basisVector {H : Subgroup U} (x : H) :=
  Finsupp.single (Biset.pair (Biset.induction (a U))
    (Word.basis ((Word.down (fromBot H)).tensor (.up (fromBot H)))) 1
    (mixedPair (fromBot H) (fromBot H) x)) (1 : Complex)

private abbrev ev {H K : Subgroup U} {p q : Word H K} (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
  drawing.interpret.eval.toLinearMap

private abbrev location (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B) (r x : D) (s : E) :=
  (incl hDB).toHom x * (((incl hDB).toHom r)⁻¹ * (incl hEB).toHom s)

-- Ian Xiao, Example 8.7, archived source/mackey-bimodules.pdf p. 42
-- and published 28 November revision p. 44 (SHA-256
-- e7712567f611d36713fb4dbf45f8b1aeefea022ea2e403462529850ebe290cc8).
-- https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
-- The checked EvaluationWithOneProjection supplies both column formulas.
-- Its singleton branches incorporate the transfer calculation and parallel
-- right multiplication. We compute the projection fibers explicitly using
-- mixedMultiplicationBasis on balanced pairs. The trivial source makes
-- each dot eligible. The group-valued fibers supply the finiteness of the
-- balanced-target fibers required by the compact projection constructors.
-- In Lemma 6.6 (archived p. 25, published p. 27), the three operations
-- yielding (6.3) are multiplication, right translation, and projection.
-- Here they give v(x), then v(x) * (v(r)⁻¹ * w(s)), then the fiber of w.
-- The supplier brackets the first two strands together. The exterior
-- associators transport its column to the right-bracketed basis.
-- Alphabeta Math, "Associativity of tensor products for compatible
-- bimodules", steps 2.1 and 2.2, construct the two directions by
-- balancing on generators. At these typed biset boundaries the project
-- rules eval_unassociate_single and eval_associate_single already give
-- the two basis actions, which suffice to transport the supplier's column.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-associativity-of-balanced-tensor-products
private theorem left_formula (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B) (r x : D) (s : E) :
    ev (left hDB hEB r s) (basisVector x) =
      (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.up (a U)) (.down (fromBot E)) (.up (fromBot E))).eval.toLinearMap
        (∑ p ∈ (finite_fiber (qLeft_injective hEB) (location hDB hEB r x s)).toFinset,
          Finsupp.single (((Word.up (a U)).tensor (.down (fromBot E))).basis.pair
            (Word.up (fromBot E)).basis p 1) 1) := by
  let p := Word.up (a U)
  let q' := Word.down (fromBot D)
  let t := Word.up (fromBot D)
  let lower := LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (fromBot B) (incl hDB) (a U) (fromBot D)
    (R := Complex) [(1, dot 1)]
  let mid := LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (incl hDB) (fromBot D) (incl hEB) (fromBot E)
    (R := Complex) [(1, middle hDB hEB r s)]
  let upper := LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (fromBot B) (incl hEB) (a U) (fromBot E)
    (R := Complex) [(1, leftUpper hEB)]
  let source := LabelledDrawing.vertical (.horizontal lower (drawId t))
    (.vertical (.ordinary (.associate (.down (fromBot B)) (.up (incl hDB)) t))
      (.vertical (.horizontal (drawId (.down (fromBot B))) mid)
        (.vertical (.ordinary (.unassociate (.down (fromBot B)) (.up (incl hEB)) (.up (fromBot E))))
          (.horizontal upper (drawId (.up (fromBot E)))))))
  let finish := (Diagram.associate (R := Complex) (.up (a U)) (.down (fromBot E))
    (.up (fromBot E))).eval.toLinearMap
  let fiber := fun z : B =>
    ∑ y ∈ (finite_fiber (qLeft_injective hEB) z).toFinset,
      Finsupp.single (((Word.up (a U)).tensor (.down (fromBot E))).basis.pair
        (Word.up (fromBot E)).basis y 1) (1 : Complex)
  change finish (ev source ((Diagram.unassociate (R := Complex) p q' t).eval.toLinearMap
    (Finsupp.single (p.basis.pair (q'.basis.tensor t.basis) 1 (q'.basis.pair t.basis x 1)) 1))) =
      finish (fiber (location hDB hEB r x s))
  rw [Diagram.eval_unassociate_single (R := Complex) p q' t 1 x 1 1]
  have h := ((EvaluationWithOneProjection (a U) (fromBot D) (fromBot D)
    (a U) (fromBot E) (fromBot E)).1 (fromBot B) (incl hDB) (incl hEB)).1
      (dot 1) (middle hDB hEB r s) (dot 1) (finite_fiber (qLeft_injective hEB)) 1 x
  have h' : ev source
      (Finsupp.single ((p.basis.tensor q'.basis).pair t.basis (p.basis.pair q'.basis 1 x) 1) 1) =
      fiber ((fromBot B).toHom 1 * 1 * (incl hDB).toHom x *
        (middle hDB hEB r s).element) := h
  rw [h', map_one, one_mul, one_mul]

private theorem left_solution (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B)
    (hdis : ∀ z : U, z ∈ D → z ∈ E → z = 1) (r x : D) (s y : E) :
    (incl hEB).toHom y = location hDB hEB r x s ↔ x = r ∧ y = s := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : (y : U) = (x : U) * ((r : U)⁻¹ * (s : U)) := congrArg Subtype.val h
    have heq : (x : U) * (r : U)⁻¹ = (y : U) * (s : U)⁻¹ := by rw [h']; group
    have hone := hdis ((x : U) * (r : U)⁻¹)
      (D.mul_mem x.property (D.inv_mem r.property))
      (heq ▸ E.mul_mem y.property (E.inv_mem s.property))
    have hx : x = r := Subtype.ext (mul_inv_eq_one.mp hone)
    subst x
    exact ⟨rfl, (incl hEB).injective (by simpa [location, mul_assoc] using h)⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp [location, ← mul_assoc]

private theorem left_column (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B)
    (hdis : ∀ z : U, z ∈ D → z ∈ E → z = 1) (r x : D) (s : E) :
    ev (left hDB hEB r s) (basisVector x) =
      @ite _ (x = r) (Classical.propDecidable (x = r)) (basisVector s) 0 := by
  classical
  rw [left_formula]
  by_cases hx : x = r
  · have h : (finite_fiber (qLeft_injective hEB) (location hDB hEB r x s)).toFinset =
        {qLeftPoint s} := by
      ext p
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := left_representative p
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_singleton]
      change qLeft hEB (qLeftPoint y) = location hDB hEB r x s ↔ qLeftPoint y = qLeftPoint s
      rw [qLeft_eq, left_solution hDB hEB hdis]
      constructor
      · exact fun hp => congrArg qLeftPoint hp.2
      · intro hp
        exact ⟨hx, (incl hEB).injective (by simpa only [qLeft_eq] using congrArg (qLeft hEB) hp)⟩
    rw [ite_eq_left hx, h, Finset.sum_singleton]
    exact Diagram.eval_associate_single (.up (a U)) (.down (fromBot E)) (.up (fromBot E)) 1 s 1 1
  · have h : (finite_fiber (qLeft_injective hEB) (location hDB hEB r x s)).toFinset = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := left_representative p
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hp
      change qLeft hEB (qLeftPoint y) = location hDB hEB r x s at hp
      rw [qLeft_eq, left_solution hDB hEB hdis] at hp
      exact hx hp.1
    rw [ite_eq_right hx, h, Finset.sum_empty, map_zero]

-- The three operations yielding (6.4) are projection, right translation,
-- and multiplication. The projection has only the candidate [1, 1], whose
-- product parameter is r. Translation is by 1, and multiplication
-- on the surviving pair gives s. The projection parameter r is the
-- multiplication dot, corresponding to trace dot r⁻¹ by the convention
-- on p. 24 of the published revision. Each label on either side has one
-- term with coefficient 1, so the singleton formulas apply.
private theorem right_column (r x : D) (s : E) :
    ev (right r s) (basisVector x) =
      @ite _ (x = r) (Classical.propDecidable (x = r)) (basisVector s) 0 := by
  classical
  have h := ((EvaluationWithOneProjection (a U) (fromBot D) (fromBot D)
    (a U) (fromBot E) (fromBot E)).2 (T U) (a U) (a U) (a U)).1
      (dot r) (finite_fiber (qRight_injective r)) (dot 1) (dot s) 1 x
  let output := fun p : ((Word.up (a U)).tensor (Word.down (a U))).basis.carrier =>
    Finsupp.single (Biset.pair (Biset.induction (a U))
      (Word.basis ((Word.down (fromBot E)).tensor (.up (fromBot E))))
      (1 * (a U).toHom (Quotient.out p).1 * 1)
      (mixedPair (fromBot E) (fromBot E) (s * (fromBot E).toHom (Quotient.out p).2)))
      (1 : Complex)
  have h' : ev (right r s) (basisVector x) =
      ∑ p ∈ (finite_fiber (qRight_injective r) x).toFinset, output p := h
  rw [h']
  by_cases hx : x = r
  · have he : (finite_fiber (qRight_injective r) x).toFinset = {qRightPoint U} := by
      ext p
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_singleton]
      change qRight r p = x ↔ p = qRightPoint U
      rw [qRight_eq, hx]
      exact ⟨fun _ => right_representative p, fun _ => rfl⟩
    rw [ite_eq_left hx, he, Finset.sum_singleton]
    simp only [output, bot_one (Quotient.out (qRightPoint U)).1,
      bot_one (Quotient.out (qRightPoint U)).2, map_one, mul_one]
  · have he : (finite_fiber (qRight_injective r) x).toFinset = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro p hp
      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hp
      change qRight r p = x at hp
      rw [qRight_eq] at hp
      exact hx hp.symm
    rw [ite_eq_right hx, he, Finset.sum_empty]

private theorem diagrams_eq (hDB : D ≤ B) (hEB : E ≤ B)
    (hdis : ∀ z : U, z ∈ D → z ∈ E → z = 1) (r : D) (s : E) :
    (left hDB hEB r s).interpret.eval = (right r s).interpret.eval := by
  apply Biset.Hom.ext
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro t c
  refine Quotient.inductionOn t (fun ⟨g, w⟩ => ?_)
  let x := mixedProduct (fromBot D) (fromBot D) w
  change ev (left hDB hEB r s) (Finsupp.single ((Word.up (a U)).basis.pair _ g w) c) =
    ev (right r s) (Finsupp.single ((Word.up (a U)).basis.pair _ g w) c)
  rw [bot_one g, ← mixedPair_mixedProduct (fromBot D) (fromBot D) w]
  rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul, map_smul]
  exact congrArg (c • ·) ((left_column hDB hEB hdis r x s).trans (right_column r x s).symm)

-- Alphabeta Math, "Every finite permutation is a product of transpositions",
-- step 1.1 checks a product of swaps pointwise. Each factor fixes all points
-- outside its endpoints. Here closure inside the point stabilizer captures
-- that observation directly for either generator, including arbitrary inverses.
-- https://alphabetamath.cc/item/thm-transpositions-generate-the-symmetric-group
-- A permutation in both cyclic subgroups fixes every point other than 2.
-- Injectivity forces it to fix 2 as well. The registered FiniteParabolicJoinBlocks
-- identifies joins via connected components of two partitions. The endpoint
-- defines B directly as the image of the three-point symmetric group, so the
-- argument uses swap extension for the inclusions and stabilizers for the intersection.
private theorem closure_swap_fixes {S : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} {t x : S}
    {i j n : Nat} (ht : (t : Equiv.Perm Nat) = Equiv.swap i j)
    (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure {t}) (hni : n ≠ i) (hnj : n ≠ j) :
    (x : Equiv.Perm Nat) n = n := by
  let stab := (MulAction.stabilizer (Equiv.Perm Nat) n).comap (Subgroup.subtype S)
  have hle : Subgroup.closure {t} ≤ stab := (Subgroup.closure_le stab).mpr (by
    apply Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
    change (t : Equiv.Perm Nat) n = n
    rw [ht]
    exact Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hni hnj)
  exact hle hx

private theorem overlapping_swaps {S : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)} {t u x : S}
    (ht : (t : Equiv.Perm Nat) = Equiv.swap 1 2)
    (hu : (u : Equiv.Perm Nat) = Equiv.swap 2 3)
    (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure {t}) (hy : x ∈ Subgroup.closure {u}) : x = 1 := by
  have hfix (n : Nat) (hn : n ≠ 2) : (x : Equiv.Perm Nat) n = n := by
    by_cases h : n = 1
    · exact closure_swap_fixes hu hy hn (by omega)
    · exact closure_swap_fixes ht hx h hn
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro n
  change (x : Equiv.Perm Nat) n = n
  by_cases hn : n = 2
  · subst n
    by_contra h
    have he := hfix ((x : Equiv.Perm Nat) 2) h
    exact h ((x : Equiv.Perm Nat).injective he)
  · exact hfix n hn

end

end OverlapReplacementAux
