```lean
private def NormalDot {p q : Word A B} (n : Nat)
    (f : Biset.Hom Complex p.basis q.basis) : Prop :=
  ∃ (r s : Word A B) (d : DotCore n r s), Framed (p := p) (q := q) f d.drawing.interpret.eval

private theorem ShortWord.leftCore {n : Nat} {r s : Word A B} {p : Word B C}
    (d : DotCore n r s) (w : ShortWord p) (hw : (r.directions ++ p.directions).length ≤ 2) :
    NormalDot (p := r.tensor p) (q := s.tensor p) n
      (d.drawing.interpret.eval.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id p.basis)) := by
  cases w with
  | empty => exact ⟨_, _, d, stripRight _⟩
  | up a =>
    cases d with
    | single label => exact ⟨_, _, .left label a, Framed.self _⟩
    | left | right => simp [Word.directions] at hw

private theorem ShortWord.rightCore {n : Nat} {r s : Word B C} {p : Word A B}
    (w : ShortWord p) (d : DotCore n r s) (hw : (p.directions ++ r.directions).length ≤ 2) :
    NormalDot (p := p.tensor r) (q := p.tensor s) (p.directions.length + n)
      ((Biset.Hom.id p.basis).horizontal d.drawing.interpret.eval) := by
  cases w with
  | empty =>
    simp only [Word.directions, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add]
    exact ⟨_, _, d, stripLeft _⟩
  | up a =>
    cases d with
    | single label => exact ⟨_, _, .right a label, Framed.self _⟩
    | left | right => simp [Word.directions] at hw

private theorem NormalDot.vertLeft {n : Nat} {p q r : Word A B}
    (d : Wire p q) {f : Biset.Hom Complex q.basis r.basis} (h : NormalDot (p := q) (q := r) n f) :
    NormalDot (p := p) (q := r) n (d.eval.vertical f) := by
  obtain ⟨s, t, c, hf⟩ := h
  exact ⟨s, t, c, hf.vertLeft d⟩

private theorem NormalDot.vertRight {n : Nat} {p q r : Word A B}
    (d : Wire q r) {f : Biset.Hom Complex p.basis q.basis} (h : NormalDot (p := p) (q := q) n f) :
    NormalDot (p := p) (q := r) n (f.vertical d.eval) := by
  obtain ⟨s, t, c, hf⟩ := h
  exact ⟨s, t, c, hf.vertRight d⟩

private theorem NormalDot.horizRight (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {n : Nat}
    {p q : Word A B} {r s : Word B C} (d : Wire p q)
    {f : Biset.Hom Complex r.basis s.basis} (h : NormalDot (p := r) (q := s) n f)
    (hw : UpWidth (p.directions ++ r.directions)) :
    NormalDot (p := p.tensor r) (q := q.tensor s) (q.directions.length + n) (d.eval.horizontal f) := by
  obtain ⟨r', s', c, hf⟩ := h
  have hr : r.directions = r'.directions := by
    simpa only [boundaryDirections_word] using congrArg boundaryDirections (hf.boundaries hc).1
  have hp : p.directions.length ≤ 1 := by
    have hlen := hw.2
    rw [List.length_append, hr] at hlen
    have := c.positive
    omega
  obtain ⟨p', ⟨w⟩, hb⟩ := shortBoundary p.boundary
    (by simpa only [boundaryDirections_word] using hw.left)
    (by rwa [boundaryDirections_word])
  have hp' : p.directions = p'.directions := by
    simpa only [boundaryDirections_word] using congrArg boundaryDirections hb
  have hlen := hw.2
  rw [hp', hr] at hlen
  obtain ⟨v, z, c', h'⟩ := w.rightCore c hlen
  rw [← d.directions hc, hp']
  have hi := frameStraight hc d hb
  exact ⟨v, z, c',
    (hi.horizontal hf).trans h'⟩

private theorem NormalDot.horizLeft (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {n : Nat}
    {p q : Word A B} {r s : Word B C}
    {f : Biset.Hom Complex p.basis q.basis} (h : NormalDot (p := p) (q := q) n f)
    (d : Wire r s) (hw : UpWidth (p.directions ++ r.directions)) :
    NormalDot (p := p.tensor r) (q := q.tensor s) n (f.horizontal d.eval) := by
  obtain ⟨p', q', c, hf⟩ := h
  have hp : p.directions = p'.directions := by
    simpa only [boundaryDirections_word] using congrArg boundaryDirections (hf.boundaries hc).1
  have hr : r.directions.length ≤ 1 := by
    have hlen := hw.2
    rw [List.length_append, hp] at hlen
    have := c.positive
    omega
  obtain ⟨r', ⟨w⟩, hb⟩ := shortBoundary r.boundary
    (by simpa only [boundaryDirections_word] using hw.right)
    (by rwa [boundaryDirections_word])
  have hr' : r.directions = r'.directions := by
    simpa only [boundaryDirections_word] using congrArg boundaryDirections hb
  have hlen := hw.2
  rw [hp, hr'] at hlen
  obtain ⟨v, z, c', h'⟩ := ShortWord.leftCore c w hlen
  exact ⟨v, z, c', (hf.horizontal (frameStraight hc d hb)).trans h'⟩


private theorem splitSingleton {c d : PlanarCode.Code} {e : PlanarEvent}
    (h : c ++ d = [e]) : (c = [] ∧ d = [e]) ∨ (c = [e] ∧ d = []) := by
  cases c with
  | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | cons x xs =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq, List.append_eq_nil_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

private theorem shiftSingleton {i n : Nat} {c : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : PlanarCode.shift i c = [mark n]) :
    ∃ m : Nat, c = [mark m] ∧ i + m = n := by
  cases c with
  | nil => simp [PlanarCode.shift] at h
  | cons e es =>
    have ht := congrArg List.length h
    simp only [PlanarCode.shift, List.length_map, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at ht
    have hz : es = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
    subst es
    cases e <;> simp [PlanarCode.shift, PlanarEvent.place, PlanarEvent.position] at h
    next m k =>
      obtain ⟨hm, rfl⟩ := h
      exact ⟨m, rfl, hm⟩

private theorem shiftEmpty {i : Nat} {c : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : PlanarCode.shift i c = []) : c = [] := by
  simpa only [PlanarCode.shift, List.map_eq_nil_iff] using h

private theorem normalVertical (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {p q r : Word A B}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (e : LabelledDrawing Complex q r) {n : Nat}
    (h : code d.erase ++ code e.erase = [mark n]) (hw : UpWidth p.directions)
    (hd : ∀ m, code d.erase = [mark m] → UpWidth p.directions →
      NormalDot (p := p) (q := q) m d.interpret.eval)
    (he : ∀ m, code e.erase = [mark m] → UpWidth q.directions →
      NormalDot (p := q) (q := r) m e.interpret.eval) :
    NormalDot (p := p) (q := r) n (d.vertical e).interpret.eval := by
  rcases splitSingleton h with ⟨hd0, he1⟩ | ⟨hd1, he0⟩
  · let w : Wire p q := ⟨d, hd0⟩
    have hwq : UpWidth q.directions := (w.directions hc) ▸ hw
    exact NormalDot.vertLeft w (he n he1 hwq)
  · exact NormalDot.vertRight ⟨e, he0⟩ (hd n hd1 hw)

private theorem normalHorizontal (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Word A B} {r s : Word B C}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (e : LabelledDrawing Complex r s) {n : Nat}
    (h : code d.erase ++ PlanarCode.shift q.directions.length (code e.erase) = [mark n])
    (hw : UpWidth (p.directions ++ r.directions))
    (hd : ∀ m, code d.erase = [mark m] → UpWidth p.directions →
      NormalDot (p := p) (q := q) m d.interpret.eval)
    (he : ∀ m, code e.erase = [mark m] → UpWidth r.directions →
      NormalDot (p := r) (q := s) m e.interpret.eval) :
    NormalDot (p := p.tensor r) (q := q.tensor s) n (d.horizontal e).interpret.eval := by
  rcases splitSingleton h with ⟨hd0, he1⟩ | ⟨hd1, he0⟩
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := shiftSingleton he1
    exact NormalDot.horizRight hc ⟨d, hd0⟩ (he m hm hw.right) hw
  · exact NormalDot.horizLeft hc (hd n hd1 hw.left) ⟨e, shiftEmpty he0⟩ hw

private theorem ordinarySingleton (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {p q : Word A B}
    (d : Diagram Complex p q) :
    ∀ n, code d.drawing = [mark n] → UpWidth p.directions →
      NormalDot (p := p) (q := q) n d.eval := by
  induction d <;> intro n h hw
  case vertical d e hd he =>
    rw [diagram_code_vert] at h
    exact normalVertical hc (.ordinary d) (.ordinary e) h hw hd he
  case horizontal d e hd he =>
    rw [diagram_code_horiz] at h
    exact normalHorizontal hc (.ordinary d) (.ordinary e) h hw hd he
  case upDot d =>
    have h0 : n = 0 := (congrArg PlanarEvent.position (List.cons.inj h).1).symm
    subst n
    refine ⟨_, _, .single (Finsupp.single d 1), ?_⟩
    rw [eval_collectSingleton]
    exact Framed.self _
  all_goals
    simp [code, Diagram.drawing, DrawingShape.geometry, PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical] at h

private theorem drawingSingleton (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {p q : Word A B}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :
    ∀ n, code d.erase = [mark n] → UpWidth p.directions →
      NormalDot (p := p) (q := q) n d.interpret.eval := by
  induction d <;> intro n h hw
  case ordinary d => exact ordinarySingleton hc d n h hw
  case vertical d e hd he =>
    rw [drawing_code_vert] at h
    exact normalVertical hc d e h hw hd he
  case horizontal d e hd he =>
    rw [drawing_code_horiz] at h
    exact normalHorizontal hc d e h hw hd he
  case upDot ts =>
    have h0 : n = 0 := (congrArg PlanarEvent.position (List.cons.inj h).1).symm
    subst n
    refine ⟨_, _, .single (collectDot ts), ?_⟩
    rw [eval_collectDot]
    exact Framed.self _
  case trivalent v => cases v <;> simp [code, LabelledDrawing.erase, DrawingShape.geometry,
      PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical, TrivalentVertex.kind] at h
  case bentVertex v => cases v <;> simp [code, LabelledDrawing.erase, DrawingShape.geometry,
      PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical, BentVertex.kind] at h
  case parallelUpChain labels =>
    change PlanarCode.encode ((DrawingShape.vertex .mergeUp).stack _) = _ at h
    rw [encode_stack] at h
    simp [PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical] at h
  case rightCurlUp =>
    simp [code, LabelledDrawing.erase, DrawingShape.geometry, DrawingShape.rightCurlGeometry,
      DrawingShape.stack, PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical, PlanarCode.shift,
      DrawingShape.outputs, PlanarEvent.place, PlanarEvent.position] at h
  case parallelDownChain | expandedProjection | expandedProjectionChain | expandedLinearDotProjection =>
    exact False.elim (Bool.false_ne_true (hw.1 false (by simp [Word.directions])))
  all_goals
    simp [code, LabelledDrawing.erase, DrawingShape.geometry, PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical] at h

private def singletonRightShape : PlanarShape :=
  ⟨[true,true], [true,true], Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid [mark 1]⟩

private theorem atBoundary_eval_heq {P Q : Boundary A B} {s : PlanarShape}
    (v : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex P Q s) :
    HEq v.interpret.eval (canon v.diagram.interpret.eval) := by
  rcases v with ⟨p, q, d, hp, hq, hs⟩
  subst P
  subst Q
  rfl

/-- Normalize the singleton right-input-dot stage at the exact ordered labelled boundaries. -/
theorem normalizeRightDot (hc : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {P Q : Boundary A B}
    {s : PlanarShape} (v : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex P Q s)
    (h : code v.diagram.erase = [mark 1]) (hw : v.bottom.directions = [true, true]) :
    ∃ (M : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding M A) (a b : ConjEmbedding B M)
      (label : DotLabel Complex a b)
      (hp : ((Word.up l).tensor (.up a)).boundary = P)
      (hq : ((Word.up l).tensor (.up b)).boundary = Q),
      v.interpret.eval =
        (show LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex P Q singletonRightShape
          from ⟨_, _, (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (.up l))).horizontal label.upDrawing,
            hp, hq, rfl⟩).interpret.eval := by
  have hwidth : UpWidth v.bottom.directions := by
    rw [hw]
    simp [UpWidth]
  obtain ⟨r, s', c, hf⟩ := drawingSingleton hc v.diagram 1 h hwidth
  cases c with
  | right l label =>
    obtain ⟨hb, ht⟩ := hf.boundaries hc
    let rep : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex P Q singletonRightShape :=
      ⟨_, _, (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (.up l))).horizontal label.upDrawing,
        hb.symm.trans v.bottom_eq, ht.symm.trans v.top_eq, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, l, _, _, label, rep.bottom_eq, rep.top_eq, ?_⟩
    change v.interpret.eval = rep.interpret.eval
    exact eq_of_heq ((atBoundary_eval_heq v).trans ((hf.canonical hc).trans (atBoundary_eval_heq rep).symm))
```

```lean
    (h : StraightAt p q f) : p = q := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem vertical_straight_left
    {p q r : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q} {g : BoundaryMap q r}
    (hf : StraightAt p q f) (hg : MergeAt q r g) :
    MergeAt p r (f.vertical g) := by
  cases hf
  simpa only [Biset.Hom.id_vertical] using hg

private theorem vertical_straight_right
    {p q r : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q} {g : BoundaryMap q r}
    (hf : MergeAt p q f) (hg : StraightAt q r g) :
    MergeAt p r (f.vertical g) := by
  cases hg
  simpa only [Biset.Hom.vertical_id] using hf

private theorem pad_left_eval {X Y : Biset G K} (f : Biset.Hom Complex X Y) :
    ((Biset.insertLeftUnit X Complex).vertical
      ((Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular G)).horizontal f)).vertical
        (Biset.leftUnit Y Complex) = f := by
  have h (Z : Biset G K) (w : Z.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      (Biset.insertLeftUnit Z Complex).toLinearMap w =
        Biset.pairLinear Complex (Biset.regular G) Z (Finsupp.single 1 1) w := by
    apply LinearMap.congr_fun
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z c
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, one_mul]
    exact Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single _ _ _ _
  have commute : (Biset.insertLeftUnit X Complex).vertical
      ((Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular G)).horizontal f) =
      f.vertical (Biset.insertLeftUnit Y Complex) := by
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro w
    change (((Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular G)).horizontal f).toLinearMap
        ((Biset.insertLeftUnit X Complex).toLinearMap w)) =
      (Biset.insertLeftUnit Y Complex).toLinearMap (f.toLinearMap w)
    rw [h, h, Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear]
    rfl
  rw [commute, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc, Biset.insertLeftUnit_leftUnit, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]

private theorem pad_right_eval {X Y : Biset G K} (f : Biset.Hom Complex X Y) :
    ((Biset.insertRightUnit X Complex).vertical
      (f.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular K)))).vertical
        (Biset.rightUnit Y Complex) = f := by
  have h (Z : Biset G K) (w : Z.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      (Biset.insertRightUnit Z Complex).toLinearMap w =
        Biset.pairLinear Complex Z (Biset.regular K) w (Finsupp.single 1 1) := by
    change (Biset.insertRightUnit Z Complex).toLinearMap w =
      ((Biset.pairLinear Complex Z (Biset.regular K)).flip (Finsupp.single 1 1)) w
    apply LinearMap.congr_fun
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro z c
    change (Biset.insertRightUnit Z Complex).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z c) =
      Biset.pairLinear Complex Z (Biset.regular K) (Finsupp.single z c) (Finsupp.single 1 1)
    rw [Biset.pairLinear_single, mul_one]
    exact Biset.Hom.ofFunction_single _ _ _ _
  have commute : (Biset.insertRightUnit X Complex).vertical
      (f.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular K))) =
      f.vertical (Biset.insertRightUnit Y Complex) := by
    apply Biset.Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro w
    change ((f.horizontal (Biset.Hom.id (Biset.regular K))).toLinearMap
        ((Biset.insertRightUnit X Complex).toLinearMap w)) =
      (Biset.insertRightUnit Y Complex).toLinearMap (f.toLinearMap w)
    rw [h, h, Biset.Hom.horizontal_pairLinear]
    rfl
  rw [commute, Biset.Hom.vertical_assoc, Biset.insertRightUnit_rightUnit, Biset.Hom.vertical_id]

private theorem remove_padding
    {p q p' q' : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p p'} {g : BoundaryMap p' q'}
    {h : BoundaryMap q' q} (hf : StraightAt p p' f) (hh : StraightAt q' q h)
    (hm : MergeAt p q ((f.vertical g).vertical h)) : MergeAt p' q' g := by
  cases hf
  cases hh
  simpa only [Biset.Hom.id_vertical, Biset.Hom.vertical_id] using hm

private theorem merge_pad_left (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q} (h : MergeAt p q f) :
    MergeAt ((Boundary.empty G).append p) ((Boundary.empty G).append q)
      (juxtaposeMap (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Boundary.empty G).word.basis) f) := by
  cases h with
  | vertex H l a =>
    let p := upPair l a
    let q := Word.up (l.comp a)
    let merge : ScopedDiagram Complex p q := .ordinary (.mergeUp l a)
    let padded := (ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.empty G))).horizontal merge
    let ins : Diagram Complex p ((Word.empty G).tensor p) := .insertLeftUnit p
    let rem : Diagram Complex ((Word.empty G).tensor q) q := .leftUnit q
    have he : ((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded |>.vertical (.ordinary rem)).eval =
        merge.eval := pad_left_eval merge.eval
    have hm : MergeAt p.boundary q.boundary (normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem))) := by
      have hn : normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem)) =
          normalize merge := (ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff _ _).2 he
      rw [hn]
      exact MergeAt.vertex H l a
    rw [normalize_vertical, normalize_vertical] at hm
    have hpad := remove_padding (empty (.ordinary ins) rfl) (empty (.ordinary rem) rfl) hm
    dsimp only [padded] at hpad
    rw [normalize_horizontal, normalize_id] at hpad
    exact hpad

private theorem merge_pad_right (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q} (h : MergeAt p q f) :
    MergeAt (p.append (.empty K)) (q.append (.empty K))
      (juxtaposeMap f (Biset.Hom.id (R := Complex) (Boundary.empty K).word.basis)) := by
  cases h with
  | vertex H l a =>
    let p := upPair l a
    let q := Word.up (l.comp a)
    let merge : ScopedDiagram Complex p q := .ordinary (.mergeUp l a)
    let padded := merge.horizontal (ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) (Word.empty K)))
    let ins : Diagram Complex p (p.tensor (.empty K)) := .insertRightUnit p
    let rem : Diagram Complex (q.tensor (.empty K)) q := .rightUnit q
    have he : ((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded |>.vertical (.ordinary rem)).eval =
        merge.eval := pad_right_eval merge.eval
    have hm : MergeAt p.boundary q.boundary (normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem))) := by
      have hn : normalize (((ScopedDiagram.ordinary ins).vertical padded).vertical (.ordinary rem)) =
          normalize merge := (ScopedDiagram.eval_atBoundary_eq_iff _ _).2 he
      rw [hn]
      exact MergeAt.vertex H l a
    rw [normalize_vertical, normalize_vertical] at hm
    have hpad := remove_padding (empty (.ordinary ins) rfl) (empty (.ordinary rem) rfl) hm
    dsimp only [padded] at hpad
    rw [normalize_horizontal, normalize_id] at hpad
    exact hpad

private def boundaryDirs : {G K : Subgroup U} → Boundary G K → List Bool
  | _, _, .empty _ => []
  | _, _, .cons (.up _) rest => true :: boundaryDirs rest
  | _, _, .cons (.down _) rest => false :: boundaryDirs rest

private theorem boundaryDirs_append (p : Boundary G H) (q : Boundary H K) :
    boundaryDirs (p.append q) = boundaryDirs p ++ boundaryDirs q := by
  induction p with
  | empty => rfl
  | cons s rest ih => cases s <;> simp only [Boundary.append, boundaryDirs, ih, List.cons_append]

private theorem word_boundaryDirs (p : Word G K) : boundaryDirs p.boundary = p.directions := by
  induction p with
  | empty | up | down => rfl
  | tensor p q hp hq => simp only [Word.boundary, Word.directions, boundaryDirs_append, hp, hq]

private theorem merge_input_dirs {p q : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q}
    (h : MergeAt p q f) : boundaryDirs p = [true, true] := by
  cases h
  rfl

private theorem merge_horizontal_left
    (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Boundary G H} {r s : Boundary H K}
    {f : BoundaryMap p q} {g : BoundaryMap r s}
    (hf : MergeAt p q f) (hg : StraightAt r s g) (hr : boundaryDirs r = []) :
    MergeAt (p.append r) (q.append s) (juxtaposeMap f g) := by
  cases hg
  rename_i r
  cases r with
  | empty => exact merge_pad_right empty hf
  | cons t tail => cases t <;> cases hr

private theorem merge_horizontal_right
    (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Boundary G H} {r s : Boundary H K}
    {f : BoundaryMap p q} {g : BoundaryMap r s}
    (hf : StraightAt p q f) (hg : MergeAt r s g) (hp : boundaryDirs p = []) :
    MergeAt (p.append r) (q.append s) (juxtaposeMap f g) := by
  cases hf
  rename_i p
  cases p with
  | empty => exact merge_pad_left empty hg
  | cons t tail => cases t <;> cases hp

private theorem append_singleton {x y : PlanarCode.Code} {v : PlanarEvent}
    (h : x ++ y = [v]) : (x = [] ∧ y = [v]) ∨ (x = [v] ∧ y = []) := by
  cases x with
  | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | cons w xs =>
    have ⟨hw, ht⟩ := List.cons.inj h
    have ⟨hx, hy⟩ := List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp ht
    exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [hw, hx], hy⟩

private theorem shift_eq_nil {n : Nat} {x : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : PlanarCode.shift n x = []) : x = [] := by
  cases x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es => cases h

private theorem shift_merge {n : Nat} {x : PlanarCode.Code}
    (h : PlanarCode.shift n x = [join 0]) : x = [join 0] := by
  cases x with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons e es =>
    have ⟨he, ht⟩ := List.cons.inj h
    have hn : n + e.position = 0 := by
      have hh := congrArg PlanarEvent.position he
      cases e <;> exact hh
    have hn' : n = 0 := by omega
    rwa [hn', shift_zero] at h

private def MergeClaim {p q : Word G K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) : Prop :=
  code d.erase = [join 0] → p.directions.length ≤ 2 →
    MergeAt p.boundary q.boundary (normalize d.interpret)

private theorem merge_vertical_step (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q r : Word G K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) (e : LabelledDrawing Complex q r)
    (hd : MergeClaim d) (he : MergeClaim e) : MergeClaim (d.vertical e) := by
  intro hc hw
  rw [drawing_code_vert] at hc
  change MergeAt p.boundary r.boundary (normalize (d.interpret.vertical e.interpret))
  rw [normalize_vertical]
  rcases append_singleton hc with ⟨hd₀, he₁⟩ | ⟨hd₁, he₀⟩
  · have h := empty d hd₀
    have hdirs := congrArg boundaryDirs (straight_boundary_eq h)
    rw [word_boundaryDirs, word_boundaryDirs] at hdirs
    exact vertical_straight_left h (he he₁ (hdirs ▸ hw))
  · exact vertical_straight_right (hd hd₁ hw) (empty e he₀)

private theorem merge_horizontal_step (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Word G H} {r s : Word H K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (e : LabelledDrawing Complex r s) (hd : MergeClaim d) (he : MergeClaim e) :
    MergeClaim (d.horizontal e) := by
  intro hc hw
  rw [drawing_code_horiz] at hc
  change (p.directions ++ r.directions).length ≤ 2 at hw
  rw [List.length_append] at hw
  change MergeAt (p.boundary.append r.boundary) (q.boundary.append s.boundary)
    (normalize (d.interpret.horizontal e.interpret))
  rw [normalize_horizontal]
  rcases append_singleton hc with ⟨hd₀, he₁⟩ | ⟨hd₁, he₀⟩
  · have h := he (shift_merge he₁) (by omega)
    have hlen := congrArg List.length (merge_input_dirs h)
    rw [word_boundaryDirs] at hlen
    have hp : p.directions.length = 0 := by
      change r.directions.length = 2 at hlen
      omega
    exact merge_horizontal_right empty (empty d hd₀) h
      (by rw [word_boundaryDirs]; exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hp)
  · have h := hd hd₁ (by omega)
    have hlen := congrArg List.length (merge_input_dirs h)
    rw [word_boundaryDirs] at hlen
    have hr : r.directions.length = 0 := by
      change p.directions.length = 2 at hlen
      omega
    exact merge_horizontal_left empty h (empty e (shift_eq_nil he₀))
      (by rw [word_boundaryDirs]; exact List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hr)

private theorem diagram_merge (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {p q : Word G K}
    (d : Diagram Complex p q) : MergeClaim (.ordinary d) := by
  induction d with
  | mergeUp l a => exact fun _ _ => MergeAt.vertex _ l a
  | vertical d e hd he => exact merge_vertical_step empty (.ordinary d) (.ordinary e) hd he
  | horizontal d e hd he => exact merge_horizontal_step empty (.ordinary d) (.ordinary e) hd he
  | id | upDot | downDot | splitUp | mergeDown | splitDown | multiplicationCap | traceCap
  | reverseCup | ordinaryCup | leftUnit | rightUnit | insertLeftUnit | insertRightUnit
  | associate | unassociate | mixedMultiplication | mixedProjection | zero | add | scale =>
    intro hc
    cases hc

private theorem expanded_no_singleton_merge (n : Nat) (opening : ProjectionOpening)
    (closing : ProjectionClosing) :
    PlanarCode.encode (DrawingShape.expandedProjectionGeometry n opening closing) ≠ [join 0] := by
  cases opening <;>
    simp only [DrawingShape.expandedProjectionGeometry, encode_stack]
  all_goals
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg List.head? h
    cases hh

private theorem drawing_merge (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U) {p q : Word G K}
    (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q) : MergeClaim d := by
  induction d with
  | ordinary d => exact diagram_merge empty d
  | trivalent v =>
    cases v with
    | mergeUp l a => exact fun _ _ => MergeAt.vertex _ l a
    | _ => intro hc; cases hc
  | bentVertex v => cases v <;> intro hc <;> cases hc
  | vertical d e hd he => exact merge_vertical_step empty d e hd he
  | horizontal d e hd he => exact merge_horizontal_step empty d e hd he
  | expandedProjection _ _ _ _ _ opening closing =>
    exact fun h => (expanded_no_singleton_merge _ opening closing h).elim
  | expandedProjectionChain _ _ _ _ _ _ opening closing =>
    exact fun h => (expanded_no_singleton_merge _ opening closing h).elim
  | expandedLinearDotProjection _ _ _ _ _ _ opening closing =>
    exact fun h => (expanded_no_singleton_merge _ opening closing h).elim
  | parallelUpChain _ _ _ _ labels =>
    intro h
    change PlanarCode.encode ((DrawingShape.vertex .mergeUp).stack
      ((DrawingShape.upwardDots labels.length).stack (.vertex .splitUp))) = [join 0] at h
    rw [encode_stack, encode_stack] at h
    change join 0 :: (PlanarCode.encode (DrawingShape.upwardDots labels.length) ++
      [.vertex 0 (.trivalent .splitUp)]) = [join 0] at h
    have ht := (List.cons.inj h).2
    have hs := (List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp ht).2
    cases hs
  | parallelDownChain _ _ _ _ labels =>
    intro h
    change PlanarCode.encode ((DrawingShape.vertex .mergeDown).stack
      ((DrawingShape.downwardDots labels.length).stack (.vertex .splitDown))) = [join 0] at h
    rw [encode_stack] at h
    have hh := congrArg List.head? h
    cases hh
  | upDot | downDot | parallelUp | parallelDown | mixedMultiplication | rightCurlUp
  | compactProjection | add | scale =>
    intro hc
    cases hc

private theorem mergeAt_witness {p q : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q}
    (h : MergeAt p q f) :
    ∃ (M : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding M G) (a : ConjEmbedding K M)
      (hp : p = (upPair l a).boundary) (hq : q = (Word.up (l.comp a)).boundary),
      cast (congrArg₂ (fun b c : Boundary G K => BoundaryMap b c) hp hq) f =
        normalize (ScopedDiagram.ordinary (Diagram.mergeUp l a)) := by
  cases h with
  | vertex M l a => exact ⟨M, l, a, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- Normalize a singleton merge at any parenthesization of its ordered inputs
and output. The stronger width-bound hypothesis suffices. -/
private theorem singleton_merge_normal_form (empty : EmptyCodeCoherence U)
    {p q : Word G K} (d : LabelledDrawing Complex p q)
    (hc : code d.erase = [join 0]) (hw : p.directions.length ≤ 2) :
    ∃ (M : Subgroup U) (l : ConjEmbedding M G) (a : ConjEmbedding K M)
      (hp : p.boundary = (upPair l a).boundary)
      (hq : q.boundary = (Word.up (l.comp a)).boundary),
      cast (congrArg₂ (fun b c : Boundary G K => BoundaryMap b c) hp hq)
          d.interpret.atBoundary.eval =
        (LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (TrivalentVertex.mergeUp l a)).interpret.atBoundary.eval :=
  mergeAt_witness (drawing_merge empty d hc hw)

private theorem straightAt_of_eq {p q : Boundary G K} {f : BoundaryMap p q}
    (h : p = q)
    (he : cast (congrArg (fun b => BoundaryMap p b) h.symm) f = Biset.Hom.id _) :
    StraightAt p q f := by
  subst q
  change f = Biset.Hom.id _ at he
  subst f
  exact StraightAt.id p
```

```lean
import MackeyDiagrams.PlanarShape

namespace MackeyDiagrams.CaseOneTrace

universe u v

variable {U : Type u} [Group U]
variable {K H J : Subgroup U}

def width : {K H : Subgroup U} → Boundary K H → Nat
  | _, _, .empty _ => 0
  | _, _, .cons _ rest => 1 + width rest

theorem width_append (a : Boundary K H) (b : Boundary H J) :
    width (a.append b) = width a + width b := by
  induction a with
  | empty => simp [width, Boundary.append]
  | cons _ rest ih => simp [width, Boundary.append, Nat.add_assoc, ih]

theorem width_boundary (p : Word K H) : width p.boundary = p.directions.length := by
  induction p with
  | empty => rfl
  | up => rfl
  | down => rfl
  | tensor p q ihp ihq => simp [Word.boundary, Word.directions, width_append, ihp, ihq]

inductive Crossing : {K H : Subgroup U} →
    Boundary K H → Boundary K H → VertexKind → Type u
  | parallelUp {K H B B' : Subgroup U}
      (a : ConjEmbedding B K) (b : ConjEmbedding H B)
      (a' : ConjEmbedding B' K) (b' : ConjEmbedding H B') :
      Crossing ((Word.up a).tensor (.up b)).boundary
        ((Word.up a').tensor (.up b')).boundary .parallelUp
  | mixedProjection {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
      (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H)
      (label : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :
      Crossing ((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).boundary
        ((Word.up l).tensor (.down r)).boundary .mixedProjection

inductive Edge {K H : Subgroup U} :
    Boundary K H → Boundary K H → PlanarEvent → Type u
  | pad {A B : Subgroup U} {p q : Boundary A B} {kind : VertexKind}
      (pre : Boundary K A) (suffix : Boundary B H) (crossing : Crossing p q kind) :
      Edge (pre.append (p.append suffix)) (pre.append (q.append suffix))
        (.vertex (width pre) kind)

def Crossing.edge {p q : Boundary K H} {kind : VertexKind} (c : Crossing p q kind) :
    Edge p q (.vertex 0 kind) := by
  simpa only [Boundary.append, Boundary.append_empty, width] using
    (Edge.pad (.empty K) (.empty H) c)

inductive Path {K H : Subgroup U} : Boundary K H → Boundary K H → PlanarCode.Code → Type u
  | nil (p : Boundary K H) : Path p p []
  | cons {p q r : Boundary K H} {e : PlanarEvent} {es : PlanarCode.Code}
      (head : Edge p q e) (tail : Path q r es) : Path p r (e :: es)

def Path.empty {p q : Boundary K H} (h : p = q) : Path p q [] := h ▸ .nil p

def Path.append {p q r : Boundary K H} {a b : PlanarCode.Code}
    (x : Path p q a) (y : Path q r b) : Path p r (a ++ b) :=
  match x with
  | .nil _ => y
  | .cons e tail => .cons e (tail.append y)

def Edge.suffix {p q : Boundary K H} {e : PlanarEvent}
    (x : Edge p q e) (b : Boundary H J) : Edge (p.append b) (q.append b) e := by
  cases x with
  | pad pre suffix c =>
    simpa only [Boundary.append_assoc] using Edge.pad pre (suffix.append b) c

def Edge.withPrefix {p q : Boundary H J} {e : PlanarEvent}
    (x : Edge p q e) (a : Boundary K H) :
    Edge (a.append p) (a.append q) (e.place (width a + e.position)) := by
  cases x with
  | pad pre suffix c =>
    simpa only [Boundary.append_assoc, width_append, PlanarEvent.place, PlanarEvent.position]
      using Edge.pad (a.append pre) suffix c

def Path.suffix {p q : Boundary K H} {es : PlanarCode.Code}
    (x : Path p q es) (b : Boundary H J) : Path (p.append b) (q.append b) es :=
  match x with
  | .nil p => .nil (p.append b)
  | .cons e tail => .cons (e.suffix b) (tail.suffix b)

def Path.withPrefix {p q : Boundary H J} {es : PlanarCode.Code}
    (x : Path p q es) (a : Boundary K H) :
    Path (a.append p) (a.append q) (PlanarCode.shift (width a) es) :=
  match x with
  | .nil p => .nil (a.append p)
  | .cons e tail => .cons (e.withPrefix a) (tail.withPrefix a)

def Path.horizontal {p p' : Boundary K H} {q q' : Boundary H J}
    {es fs : PlanarCode.Code} (left : Path p p' es) (right : Path q q' fs) :
    Path (p.append q) (p'.append q') (es ++ PlanarCode.shift (width p') fs) :=
  (left.suffix q).append (right.withPrefix p')

theorem event_place_place (e : PlanarEvent) (j i : Nat) :
    (e.place j).place i = e.place i := by
  cases e <;> rfl

theorem event_position_place (e : PlanarEvent) (i : Nat) : (e.place i).position = i := by
  cases e <;> rfl

theorem shift_zero (es : PlanarCode.Code) : PlanarCode.shift 0 es = es := by
  induction es with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih =>
    change e.place (0 + e.position) :: PlanarCode.shift 0 es = e :: es
    rw [Nat.zero_add, ih]
    cases e <;> rfl

theorem shift_nil (n : Nat) : PlanarCode.shift n [] = [] := rfl

theorem shift_append (n : Nat) (es fs : PlanarCode.Code) :
    PlanarCode.shift n (es ++ fs) = PlanarCode.shift n es ++ PlanarCode.shift n fs :=
  List.map_append

theorem shift_shift (n m : Nat) (es : PlanarCode.Code) :
    PlanarCode.shift n (PlanarCode.shift m es) = PlanarCode.shift (n + m) es := by
  simp only [PlanarCode.shift, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    event_position_place, event_place_place, Nat.add_assoc]

theorem encode_stack (a b : DrawingShape) :
    PlanarCode.encode (a.stack b) = PlanarCode.encode a ++ PlanarCode.encode b := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack a b <;>
    simp_all [PlanarCode.encode, List.append_assoc]

theorem encode_juxtapose (a b : DrawingShape) :
    PlanarCode.encode (a.juxtapose b) =
      PlanarCode.encode a ++ PlanarCode.shift a.outputs.length (PlanarCode.encode b) := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose a b <;>
    simp_all [DrawingShape.outputs, PlanarCode.encode, shift_nil, shift_zero, shift_append, shift_shift,
      List.append_assoc]

end Codes


section OrdinaryCode

/-- A shape made of ordinary vertices with matching interfaces. -/
inductive OrdinaryForm : DrawingShape → List Bool → List Bool → Prop
  | straight (dirs : List Bool) : OrdinaryForm (.straight dirs) dirs dirs
  | vertex (k : VertexKind) (h : (DrawingShape.vertex k).geometry = .vertex k) :
      OrdinaryForm (.vertex k) k.inputs k.outputs
  | vertical {a b : DrawingShape} {i m o : List Bool} :
      OrdinaryForm a i m → OrdinaryForm b m o → OrdinaryForm (.vertical a b) i o
  | horizontal {a b : DrawingShape} {i j m o : List Bool} :
      OrdinaryForm a i j → OrdinaryForm b m o → OrdinaryForm (.horizontal a b) (i ++ m) (j ++ o)
  | zero (i o : List Bool) : OrdinaryForm (.zero i o) i o
  | add {a b : DrawingShape} {i o : List Bool} :
      OrdinaryForm a i o → OrdinaryForm b i o → OrdinaryForm (.add a b) i o
  | scale {a : DrawingShape} {i o : List Bool} :
      OrdinaryForm a i o → OrdinaryForm (.scale a) i o

theorem OrdinaryForm.inputs {s : DrawingShape} {i o : List Bool} (f : OrdinaryForm s i o) :
    s.inputs = i := by
  induction f <;> simp_all [DrawingShape.inputs]

theorem OrdinaryForm.outputs {s : DrawingShape} {i o : List Bool} (f : OrdinaryForm s i o) :
    s.outputs = o := by
  induction f <;> simp_all [DrawingShape.outputs]

theorem OrdinaryForm.stack {a b : DrawingShape} {i m o : List Bool}
    (x : OrdinaryForm a i m) (y : OrdinaryForm b m o) : OrdinaryForm (a.stack b) i o := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack a b generalizing i m o
  · cases x
    exact y
  · cases y
    exact x
  · rename_i first rest above h ih
    cases x with
    | vertical x₁ x₂ => exact .vertical x₁ (ih x₂ y)
  · exact .vertical x y

theorem OrdinaryForm.juxtapose {a b : DrawingShape} {i j m o : List Bool}
    (x : OrdinaryForm a i j) (y : OrdinaryForm b m o) :
    OrdinaryForm (a.juxtapose b) (i ++ m) (j ++ o) := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose a b generalizing i j m o
  · cases x
    exact y
  · cases y
    simpa only [List.append_nil] using x
  · cases x
    cases y
    exact .straight _
  · rename_i first rest right h ih
    cases x with
    | horizontal x₁ x₂ =>
      simpa only [List.append_assoc] using OrdinaryForm.horizontal x₁ (ih x₂ y)
  · exact .horizontal x y

theorem OrdinaryForm.geometry {s : DrawingShape} {i o : List Bool}
    (f : OrdinaryForm s i o) : OrdinaryForm s.geometry i o := by
  induction f with
  | straight => exact .straight _
  | vertex k h =>
    rw [h]
    exact .vertex k h
  | vertical _ _ ia ib => exact ia.stack ib
  | horizontal _ _ ia ib => exact ia.juxtapose ib
  | zero => exact .zero _ _
  | add _ _ ia ib => exact .add ia ib
  | scale _ ia => exact .scale ia

theorem OrdinaryForm.encode_geometry {s : DrawingShape} {i o : List Bool}
    (f : OrdinaryForm s i o) : PlanarCode.encode s.geometry = PlanarCode.encode s := by
  induction f with
  | straight => rfl
  | vertex _ h => rw [h]
  | vertical _ _ ia ib => simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, encode_stack, PlanarCode.encode, ia, ib]
  | horizontal x _ ia ib =>
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, encode_juxtapose, PlanarCode.encode,
      x.geometry.outputs, x.outputs, ia, ib]
  | zero => rfl
  | add x _ ia ib =>
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, PlanarCode.encode, x.geometry.inputs, x.inputs,
      x.geometry.outputs, x.outputs, ia, ib]
  | scale x ia =>
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, PlanarCode.encode, x.geometry.inputs, x.inputs,
      x.geometry.outputs, x.outputs, ia]

theorem ordinaryForm {R : Type v} {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : Diagram R p q) :
    OrdinaryForm d.drawing p.directions q.directions := by
  induction d with
  | id => exact .straight _
  | leftUnit => exact .straight _
  | rightUnit => simpa only [Diagram.drawing, Word.directions, List.append_nil] using OrdinaryForm.straight _
  | insertLeftUnit => exact .straight _
  | insertRightUnit => simpa only [Diagram.drawing, Word.directions, List.append_nil] using OrdinaryForm.straight _
  | associate => simpa only [Diagram.drawing, Word.directions, List.append_assoc] using OrdinaryForm.straight _
  | unassociate => simpa only [Diagram.drawing, Word.directions, List.append_assoc] using OrdinaryForm.straight _
  | vertical _ _ ix iy => exact ix.stack iy
  | horizontal _ _ ix iy => exact ix.juxtapose iy
  | zero => exact .zero _ _
  | add _ _ ix iy => exact .add ix iy
  | scale _ _ ix => exact .scale ix
  | _ => exact .vertex _ rfl

theorem encode_ordinary_geometry {R : Type v} {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
    (d : Diagram R p q) : PlanarCode.encode d.drawing.geometry = PlanarCode.encode d.drawing :=
  (ordinaryForm d).encode_geometry

end OrdinaryCode


def allowedEvent : PlanarEvent → Prop
  | .vertex _ kind => kind = .parallelUp ∨ kind = .mixedProjection
  | _ => False

def Allowed (code : PlanarCode.Code) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ code, allowedEvent e

theorem allowedEvent_place (e : PlanarEvent) (n : Nat) :
    allowedEvent (e.place n) ↔ allowedEvent e := by
  cases e <;> rfl

theorem allowed_append {a b : PlanarCode.Code} :
    Allowed (a ++ b) ↔ Allowed a ∧ Allowed b := by
  simp only [Allowed, List.mem_append]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun e he => h e (.inl he), fun e he => h e (.inr he)⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩ e (he | he)
    · exact ha e he
    · exact hb e he

theorem allowed_shift (n : Nat) {code : PlanarCode.Code} :
    Allowed (PlanarCode.shift n code) ↔ Allowed code := by
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    exact (allowedEvent_place _ _).mp (h _ (List.mem_map_of_mem he))
  · intro h e he
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
    exact (allowedEvent_place _ _).mpr (h f hf)

theorem allowed_singleton (e : PlanarEvent) : Allowed [e] ↔ allowedEvent e := by
  simp [Allowed]

theorem Path.nil_iff {p q : Boundary K H} : Nonempty (Path p q []) ↔ p = q := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨path⟩
    cases path
    rfl
  · exact fun h => ⟨Path.empty h⟩

theorem ordinaryRaw {R : Type v} {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : Diagram R p q) :
    Allowed (PlanarCode.encode d.drawing) →
      Nonempty (Path p.boundary q.boundary (PlanarCode.encode d.drawing)) := by
  induction d with
  | id => exact fun _ => ⟨.nil _⟩
  | leftUnit p => exact fun _ => ⟨Path.empty (Word.boundary_leftUnit p)⟩
  | rightUnit p => exact fun _ => ⟨Path.empty (Word.boundary_rightUnit p)⟩
  | insertLeftUnit p => exact fun _ => ⟨Path.empty (Word.boundary_leftUnit p).symm⟩
  | insertRightUnit p => exact fun _ => ⟨Path.empty (Word.boundary_rightUnit p).symm⟩
  | associate p q r => exact fun _ => ⟨Path.empty (Word.boundary_associate p q r)⟩
  | unassociate p q r => exact fun _ => ⟨Path.empty (Word.boundary_associate p q r).symm⟩
  | mixedProjection a b l r dot finite =>
    exact fun _ => ⟨.cons (Crossing.edge (.mixedProjection a b l r ⟨dot, finite⟩)) (.nil _)⟩
  | vertical d e ihd ihe =>
    simp only [Diagram.drawing, encode_stack, allowed_append]
    rintro ⟨hd, he⟩
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := ihd hd
    obtain ⟨q⟩ := ihe he
    exact ⟨p.append q⟩
  | horizontal d e ihd ihe =>
    simp only [Diagram.drawing, encode_juxtapose, allowed_append, allowed_shift]
    rintro ⟨hd, he⟩
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := ihd hd
    obtain ⟨q⟩ := ihe he
    simpa only [Word.boundary, width_boundary, (ordinaryForm d).outputs] using Nonempty.intro (p.horizontal q)
  | _ =>
    simp [Diagram.drawing, PlanarCode.encode, VertexKind.canonical, allowed_singleton, allowedEvent]

/-- Extract a typed path through the actual geometric code of an ordinary diagram. -/
theorem ordinary {R : Type v} {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : Diagram R p q)
    (h : Allowed (PlanarCode.encode d.drawing.geometry)) :
    Nonempty (Path p.boundary q.boundary (PlanarCode.encode d.drawing.geometry)) := by
  rw [encode_ordinary_geometry] at h ⊢
  exact ordinaryRaw d h

/-- An empty compact label still contributes a visible mixed projection. -/
theorem emptyCompact_code {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] {K H G L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H) :
    PlanarCode.encode (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) a b l r []).erase.geometry =
      [.vertex 0 .mixedProjection] := rfl

theorem emptyCompact_eval {R : Type v} [CommSemiring R] {K H G L : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding K G) (b : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (l : ConjEmbedding L K) (r : ConjEmbedding L H) :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) a b l r []).interpret.eval.toLinearMap = 0 := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl
```

```lean
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose <;>
    simp only [encode, DrawingShape.outputs, List.length_nil, List.length_append,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil, shift_nil, shift_zero, shift_append, shift_shift, List.append_assoc, *]

private def geomCode (s : DrawingShape) := encode s.geometry

private theorem geomCode_stack (a b : DrawingShape) :
    geomCode (a.stack b) = geomCode a ++ geomCode b := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack <;>
    simp only [geomCode, DrawingShape.geometry, encode, encode_stack, List.nil_append,
      List.append_nil, List.append_assoc] at *
  simp only [*]

private theorem geomOutputs_juxtapose (a b : DrawingShape) :
    (a.juxtapose b).geometry.outputs = a.geometry.outputs ++ b.geometry.outputs := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose <;>
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, outputs_juxtapose, DrawingShape.outputs,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc] at *
  simp only [*]

private theorem geomCode_juxtapose (a b : DrawingShape) :
    geomCode (a.juxtapose b) = geomCode a ++ shift a.geometry.outputs.length (geomCode b) := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose <;>
    simp only [geomCode, DrawingShape.geometry, encode_juxtapose, outputs_juxtapose, encode,
      DrawingShape.outputs, List.length_nil, List.length_append,
      shift_zero, shift_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_nil,
      List.append_assoc] at *
  rename_i ih
  rw [ih, shift_append, shift_shift]

private theorem stack_assoc (a b c : DrawingShape) :
    (a.stack b).stack c = a.stack (b.stack c) := by
  induction a generalizing b c <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp [stack, *]

private theorem inputs_juxtapose (a b : DrawingShape) :
    (a.juxtapose b).inputs = a.inputs ++ b.inputs := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose <;>
    simp only [DrawingShape.inputs, List.nil_append, List.append_nil, *, List.append_assoc]

private theorem geomInputs_juxtapose (a b : DrawingShape) :
    (a.juxtapose b).geometry.inputs = a.geometry.inputs ++ b.geometry.inputs := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose <;>
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, inputs_juxtapose, DrawingShape.inputs,
      List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.append_assoc] at *
  simp only [*]

private theorem inputs_stack (a b : DrawingShape) (h : a.outputs = b.inputs) :
    (a.stack b).inputs = a.inputs := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack <;> simp_all [DrawingShape.inputs, DrawingShape.outputs]

private theorem outputs_stack (a b : DrawingShape) (h : a.outputs = b.inputs) :
    (a.stack b).outputs = b.outputs := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack <;> simp_all [DrawingShape.inputs, DrawingShape.outputs]

private def VFit : DrawingShape → Prop
  | .vertical first rest => VFit rest ∧ first.geometry.outputs = rest.geometry.inputs
  | _ => True

private theorem geom_stack (a b : DrawingShape) (ha : VFit a)
    (h : a.geometry.outputs = b.geometry.inputs) :
    (a.stack b).geometry = a.geometry.stack b.geometry := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack
  · simp [geometry, stack]
  · rename_i below ds _
    simp only [geometry, DrawingShape.inputs] at h ⊢
    cases hg : below.geometry <;> try rfl
    exact congrArg DrawingShape.straight (by simpa only [hg, DrawingShape.outputs] using h)
  · rename_i first rest above _ ih
    change VFit rest ∧ first.geometry.outputs = rest.geometry.inputs at ha
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, outputs_stack _ _ ha.2] at h
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, ih ha.1 h, stack_assoc]
  · rfl

private theorem vfit_stack (a b : DrawingShape) (ha : VFit a) (hb : VFit b)
    (h : a.geometry.outputs = b.geometry.inputs) : VFit (a.stack b) := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.stack
  · exact hb
  · exact ha
  · rename_i first rest above _ ih
    change VFit rest ∧ first.geometry.outputs = rest.geometry.inputs at ha
    simp only [DrawingShape.geometry, outputs_stack _ _ ha.2] at h
    exact ⟨ih ha.1 hb h, by rw [geom_stack _ _ ha.1 h, inputs_stack _ _ h]; exact ha.2⟩
  · exact ⟨hb, h⟩

private theorem vfit_juxtapose (a b : DrawingShape) (ha : VFit a) (hb : VFit b) :
    VFit (a.juxtapose b) := by
  fun_induction DrawingShape.juxtapose <;> first | exact ha | exact hb | trivial

private def Boundary.strands : {A B : Subgroup U} → Boundary A B → Nat
  | _, _, .empty _ => 0
  | _, _, .cons _ p => 1 + Boundary.strands p

private theorem strands_append {A B C : Subgroup U} (p : Boundary A B) (q : Boundary B C) :
    Boundary.strands (p.append q) = Boundary.strands p + Boundary.strands q := by
  induction p with
  | empty => simp [Boundary.strands, Boundary.append]
  | cons s p ih => simp [Boundary.strands, Boundary.append, ih, Nat.add_assoc]

private theorem strands_boundary {A B : Subgroup U} (p : Word A B) :
    Boundary.strands p.boundary = p.directions.length := by
  induction p with
  | empty | up | down => rfl
  | tensor p q ih₁ ih₂ => simp [Word.boundary, Word.directions, strands_append, ih₁, ih₂]

private inductive Crossing : {A B : Subgroup U} → VertexKind → Boundary A B → Boundary A B → Prop
  | parallelUp {A B C D : Subgroup U}
      (b : ConjEmbedding C A) (a : ConjEmbedding B C)
      (b' : ConjEmbedding D A) (a' : ConjEmbedding B D) :
      Crossing .parallelUp (Word.tensor (.up b) (.up a)).boundary
        (Word.tensor (.up b') (.up a')).boundary
  | mixedProjection {A B C D : Subgroup U}
      (a : ConjEmbedding A C) (b : ConjEmbedding B C)
      (l : ConjEmbedding D A) (r : ConjEmbedding D B)
      (term : ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :
      Crossing .mixedProjection (Word.tensor (.down a) (.up b)).boundary
        (Word.tensor (.up l) (.down r)).boundary

private inductive Edge : PlanarEvent → Boundary K H → Boundary K H → Prop
  | padded {A B : Subgroup U} {p q : Boundary A B} {kind : VertexKind}
      (pre : Boundary K A) (suffix : Boundary B H) (c : Crossing kind p q) :
      Edge (.vertex (Boundary.strands pre) kind)
        (pre.append (p.append suffix)) (pre.append (q.append suffix))

private inductive Trace : Code → Boundary K H → Boundary K H → Prop
  | nil (p : Boundary K H) : Trace [] p p
  | cons {e : PlanarEvent} {es : Code} {p q r : Boundary K H}
      (edge : Edge e p q) (tail : Trace es q r) : Trace (e :: es) p r

private theorem Trace.append {p q r : Boundary K H} {xs ys : Code}
    (hx : Trace xs p q) (hy : Trace ys q r) : Trace (xs ++ ys) p r := by
  induction hx with
  | nil => exact hy
  | cons edge _ ih => exact .cons edge (ih hy)

private theorem Edge.padLeft {e : PlanarEvent} {p q : Boundary H J}
    (h : Edge e p q) (pre : Boundary K H) :
    Edge (e.place (Boundary.strands pre + e.position)) (pre.append p) (pre.append q) := by
  cases h with
  | padded inner suffix c =>
    simpa only [strands_append, Boundary.append_assoc, PlanarEvent.place, PlanarEvent.position]
      using (Edge.padded (pre.append inner) suffix c)

private theorem Edge.padRight {e : PlanarEvent} {p q : Boundary K H}
    (h : Edge e p q) (suffix : Boundary H J) :
    Edge e (p.append suffix) (q.append suffix) := by
  cases h with
  | padded pre inner c =>
    simpa only [Boundary.append_assoc] using (Edge.padded pre (inner.append suffix) c)

private theorem Trace.padLeft {p q : Boundary H J} {xs : Code}
    (h : Trace xs p q) (pre : Boundary K H) :
    Trace (shift (Boundary.strands pre) xs) (pre.append p) (pre.append q) := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil _
  | cons edge _ ih => exact .cons (edge.padLeft pre) ih

private theorem Trace.padRight {p q : Boundary K H} {xs : Code}
    (h : Trace xs p q) (suffix : Boundary H J) :
    Trace xs (p.append suffix) (q.append suffix) := by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact .nil _
  | cons edge _ ih => exact .cons (edge.padRight suffix) ih

private theorem Trace.one {p q : Boundary K H} {kind : VertexKind} (c : Crossing kind p q) :
    Trace [.vertex 0 kind] p q := by
  have h := Edge.padded (.empty K) (.empty H) c
  rw [Boundary.append, Boundary.append_empty, Boundary.append, Boundary.append_empty] at h
  exact .cons h (.nil _)

private def AllowedEvent : PlanarEvent → Prop
  | .vertex _ k => k = .parallelUp ∨ k = .mixedProjection
  | _ => False

private def Allowed (xs : Code) : Prop := ∀ e ∈ xs, AllowedEvent e

private theorem allowed_append (a b : Code) : Allowed (a ++ b) ↔ Allowed a ∧ Allowed b := by
  simp only [Allowed, List.mem_append, or_imp, forall_and]

private theorem allowed_shift (n : Nat) (xs : Code) : Allowed (shift n xs) ↔ Allowed xs := by
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    have hh := h (e.place (n + e.position)) (List.mem_map_of_mem he)
    cases e <;> exact hh
  · intro h e he
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp he
    have hh := h f hf
    cases f <;> exact hh

private theorem allowed_single (e : PlanarEvent) : Allowed [e] ↔ AllowedEvent e := by
  simp [Allowed]

private theorem allowed_cons (e : PlanarEvent) (es : Code) :
    Allowed (e :: es) ↔ AllowedEvent e ∧ Allowed es := by
  simp only [Allowed, List.mem_cons, or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq]

private theorem allowed_equivalent {xs ys : Code} (h : Equivalent xs ys) :
    Allowed xs ↔ Allowed ys := by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂
  | context _ _ _ ih => simp only [allowed_append, ih]
  | exchange before after i gap l r =>
    have hp (e : PlanarEvent) (n : Nat) : AllowedEvent (e.place n) ↔ AllowedEvent e := by
      cases e <;> rfl
    simp only [allowed_append, allowed_cons, hp]
    tauto
  | add | scale => simp [allowed_single, AllowedEvent]

private theorem horizontal_zero_left {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}
    (f : Biset.Hom R X X') (g : Biset.Hom R Y Y') (hf : f.toLinearMap = 0) :
    (f.horizontal g).toLinearMap = 0 := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change (f.horizontal g).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) = _
  simp [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, hf]

private theorem horizontal_zero_right {X X' : Biset K H} {Y Y' : Biset H J}
    (f : Biset.Hom R X X') (g : Biset.Hom R Y Y') (hg : g.toLinearMap = 0) :
    (f.horizontal g).toLinearMap = 0 := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro z r
  refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun ⟨x, y⟩ => ?_)
  change (f.horizontal g).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single (X.pair Y x y) r) = _
  simp [Biset.Hom.horizontal_single, hg]

private theorem compact_empty {A B C D : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding A C) (b : ConjEmbedding B C)
    (l : ConjEmbedding D A) (r : ConjEmbedding D B) :
    (LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) a b l r []).interpret.eval.toLinearMap = 0 :=
  rfl

private theorem vertical_nonzero {X Y Z : Biset K H}
    (f : Biset.Hom R X Y) (g : Biset.Hom R Y Z)
    (h : (f.vertical g).toLinearMap ≠ 0) : f.toLinearMap ≠ 0 ∧ g.toLinearMap ≠ 0 := by
  change g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap ≠ 0 at h
  exact ⟨fun hf => h (by simp only [hf, LinearMap.comp_zero]),
    fun hg => h (by simp only [hg, LinearMap.zero_comp])⟩

private def Traced (s : DrawingShape) (p q : Word K H) : Prop :=
  VFit s ∧ s.geometry.inputs = p.directions ∧ s.geometry.outputs = q.directions ∧
    Trace (geomCode s) p.boundary q.boundary

private theorem traced_straight {p q : Word K H} {ds : List Bool}
    (hi : ds = p.directions) (ho : ds = q.directions) (hpq : p.boundary = q.boundary) :
    Traced (.straight ds) p q := by
  refine ⟨trivial, hi, ho, ?_⟩
  change Trace [] p.boundary q.boundary
  rw [hpq]
  exact .nil _

private theorem traced_stack {a b : DrawingShape} {p q r : Word K H}
    (ha : Traced a p q) (hb : Traced b q r) : Traced (a.stack b) p r := by
  obtain ⟨av, ai, ao, ap⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨bv, bi, bo, bp⟩ := hb
  have link := ao.trans bi.symm
  exact ⟨vfit_stack _ _ av bv link, by rw [geom_stack _ _ av link, inputs_stack _ _ link, ai],
    by rw [geom_stack _ _ av link, outputs_stack _ _ link, bo],
    by rw [geomCode_stack]; exact ap.append bp⟩

private theorem traced_juxtapose {a b : DrawingShape} {p p' : Word K H} {q q' : Word H J}
    (ha : Traced a p p') (hb : Traced b q q') : Traced (a.juxtapose b) (p.tensor q) (p'.tensor q') := by
  obtain ⟨av, ai, ao, ap⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨bv, bi, bo, bp⟩ := hb
  refine ⟨vfit_juxtapose _ _ av bv, by rw [geomInputs_juxtapose, ai, bi]; rfl,
    by rw [geomOutputs_juxtapose, ao, bo]; rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [geomCode_juxtapose, ao, ← strands_boundary]
  exact (ap.padRight q.boundary).append (bp.padLeft p'.boundary)

private theorem ordinary_trace {p q : Word K H} (d : Diagram R p q)
    (hc : Allowed (geomCode d.drawing)) (hn : d.eval.toLinearMap ≠ 0) :
    Traced d.drawing p q := by
  induction d with
  | id p => exact traced_straight rfl rfl rfl
  | leftUnit p => exact traced_straight rfl rfl rfl
  | insertLeftUnit p => exact traced_straight rfl rfl rfl
  | rightUnit p => exact traced_straight (List.append_nil _).symm rfl (Word.boundary_rightUnit p)
  | insertRightUnit p => exact traced_straight rfl (List.append_nil _).symm (Word.boundary_rightUnit p).symm
  | associate p q r =>
    exact traced_straight rfl (List.append_assoc _ _ _) (Word.boundary_associate p q r)
  | unassociate p q r =>
    exact traced_straight (List.append_assoc _ _ _) rfl (Word.boundary_associate p q r).symm
  | mixedProjection a b l r d fin =>
    exact ⟨trivial, rfl, rfl, Trace.one (.mixedProjection a b l r ⟨d, fin⟩)⟩
  | vertical a b ia ib =>
    have hz := vertical_nonzero a.eval b.eval hn
    have hab : Allowed (geomCode a.drawing ++ geomCode b.drawing) := by
      simpa only [Diagram.drawing, geomCode_stack] using hc
    have ⟨ha, hb⟩ := (allowed_append _ _).mp hab
    exact traced_stack (ia ha hz.1) (ib hb hz.2)
  | horizontal a b ia ib =>
    have hab := hc
    simp only [Diagram.drawing, geomCode_juxtapose, allowed_append, allowed_shift] at hab
    exact traced_juxtapose (ia hab.1 (fun hf => hn (horizontal_zero_left a.eval b.eval hf)))
      (ib hab.2 (fun hg => hn (horizontal_zero_right a.eval b.eval hg)))
  | _ =>
    exfalso
    simp only [Diagram.drawing, geomCode, geometry, encode, allowed_single, AllowedEvent,
      VertexKind.canonical, reduceCtorEq, or_self] at hc

private theorem projectionGeometry_forbidden (n : Nat)
    (opening : ProjectionOpening) (closing : ProjectionClosing) :
    ¬ Allowed (encode (expandedProjectionGeometry n opening closing)) := by
  unfold expandedProjectionGeometry
  cases opening <;>
    simp [encode_stack, allowed_append, allowed_shift, encode,
      allowed_single, AllowedEvent, VertexKind.canonical]

private theorem labelled_trace {p q : Word K H} (d : LabelledDrawing R p q)
    (hc : Allowed (geomCode d.erase)) (hn : d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap ≠ 0) :
    Traced d.erase p q := by
  induction d with
  | ordinary d => exact ordinary_trace d hc hn
  | parallelUp b a b' a' labels =>
    exact ⟨trivial, rfl, rfl, Trace.one (.parallelUp b a b' a')⟩
  | compactProjection a b l r labels =>
    cases labels with
    | nil => exact (hn (compact_empty a b l r)).elim
    | cons term rest =>
      exact ⟨trivial, rfl, rfl, Trace.one (.mixedProjection a b l r term.2)⟩
  | vertical a b ia ib =>
    have hz := vertical_nonzero a.interpret.eval b.interpret.eval hn
    have hab := hc
    simp only [LabelledDrawing.erase, geomCode_stack, allowed_append] at hab
    exact traced_stack (ia hab.1 hz.1) (ib hab.2 hz.2)
  | horizontal a b ia ib =>
    have hab := hc
    simp only [LabelledDrawing.erase, geomCode_juxtapose, allowed_append, allowed_shift] at hab
    exact traced_juxtapose
      (ia hab.1 (fun hf => hn (horizontal_zero_left a.interpret.eval b.interpret.eval hf)))
      (ib hab.2 (fun hg => hn (horizontal_zero_right a.interpret.eval b.interpret.eval hg)))
  | expandedProjection a b l r marks opening closing =>
    exact (projectionGeometry_forbidden 1 opening closing hc).elim
  | expandedProjectionChain a b l r chain fin opening closing =>
    exact (projectionGeometry_forbidden chain.length opening closing hc).elim
  | expandedLinearDotProjection a b l r chain fin opening closing =>
    exact (projectionGeometry_forbidden chain.length opening closing hc).elim
  | bentVertex b =>
    exfalso
    cases b <;> simp [LabelledDrawing.erase, BentVertex.kind, geomCode, geometry, encode,
      allowed_single, AllowedEvent, VertexKind.canonical] at hc
  | _ =>
    exfalso
    simp [LabelledDrawing.erase, geomCode, geometry, rightCurlGeometry, encode_stack,
      encode, allowed_append, allowed_cons, AllowedEvent,
      VertexKind.canonical] at hc

private theorem atBoundary_zero {p q : Word K H} (d : ScopedDiagram R p q)
    (h : d.eval.toLinearMap = 0) : d.atBoundary.eval.toLinearMap = 0 := by
  unfold ScopedDiagram.atBoundary
  change (q.reorderToBoundary.eval.toLinearMap.comp
    (d.eval.toLinearMap.comp p.reorderFromBoundary.eval.toLinearMap)) = 0
  simp only [h, LinearMap.zero_comp, LinearMap.comp_zero]

private theorem planarAtBoundary_trace {p q : Boundary K H} {s : PlanarShape} {template : Code}
    (d : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary R p q s)
    (hcode : s.wiring = Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid template)
    (hc : Allowed template) (hn : d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap ≠ 0) :
    ∃ xs : Code, Equivalent xs template ∧ Trace xs p q := by
  rcases d with ⟨bottom, top, diagram, rfl, rfl, shape_eq⟩
  have he : Equivalent (geomCode diagram.erase) template :=
    Quotient.exact ((congrArg PlanarShape.wiring shape_eq).trans hcode)
  have ha := (allowed_equivalent he).mpr hc
  have ht := labelled_trace diagram ha (fun h => hn (atBoundary_zero diagram.interpret h))
  exact ⟨_, he, ht.2.2.2⟩


/-- At most three wires are live, so two allowed crossings cannot be disjoint. -/
private def OnThree (xs : Code) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ xs, AllowedEvent e ∧ e.position < 2

private theorem place_allowedEvent (e : PlanarEvent) (i : Nat) :
    AllowedEvent (e.place i) ↔ AllowedEvent e := by cases e <;> rfl

private theorem place_position (e : PlanarEvent) (i : Nat) : (e.place i).position = i := by
  cases e <;> rfl

private theorem allowed_widths (e : PlanarEvent) (h : AllowedEvent e) :
    e.inputs.length = 2 ∧ e.outputs.length = 2 := by
  cases e with
  | vertex i k =>
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | zero | add | scale => exact h.elim

private theorem onThree_forbidden (pre post : Code) (e : PlanarEvent)
    (hf : ¬ AllowedEvent e) : ¬ OnThree (pre ++ [e] ++ post) :=
  fun h => hf (h e (by simp)).1

private theorem equivalent_eq_onThree {xs ys : Code} (h : Equivalent xs ys) :
    ∀ pre post : Code,
      (OnThree (pre ++ xs ++ post) → (pre ++ xs ++ post) = (pre ++ ys ++ post)) ∧
      (OnThree (pre ++ ys ++ post) → (pre ++ ys ++ post) = (pre ++ xs ++ post)) := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact fun _ _ => ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | symm _ ih => exact fun pre post => ⟨(ih pre post).2, (ih pre post).1⟩
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro pre post
    constructor
    · intro ha
      have h₁ := (ih₁ pre post).1 ha
      exact h₁.trans ((ih₂ pre post).1 (h₁ ▸ ha))
    · intro hc
      have h₂ := (ih₂ pre post).2 hc
      exact h₂.trans ((ih₁ pre post).2 (h₂ ▸ hc))
  | context bef aft _ ih =>
    intro pre post
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using ih (pre ++ bef) (aft ++ post)
  | exchange bef aft i gap l r =>
    intro pre post
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hl := (h (l.place i) (by simp)).1
      have hr := (h (r.place (i + l.outputs.length + gap)) (by simp)).2
      rw [place_position, (allowed_widths l ((place_allowedEvent l i).1 hl)).2] at hr
      omega
    · intro h
      have hl := (h (l.place i) (by simp)).1
      have hr := (h (r.place (i + l.inputs.length + gap)) (by simp)).2
      rw [place_position, (allowed_widths l ((place_allowedEvent l i).1 hl)).1] at hr
      omega
  | @scale i below above a b _ _ =>
    intro pre post
    exact ⟨fun h => (onThree_forbidden pre post (.scale i below above a) (fun he => he) h).elim,
      fun h => (onThree_forbidden pre post (.scale i below above b) (fun he => he) h).elim⟩
  | @add i below above a b c d _ _ _ _ =>
    intro pre post
    exact ⟨fun h => (onThree_forbidden pre post (.add i below above a c) (fun he => he) h).elim,
      fun h => (onThree_forbidden pre post (.add i below above b d) (fun he => he) h).elim⟩

private def rightCode : Code :=
  [.vertex 1 .parallelUp, .vertex 0 .mixedProjection, .vertex 1 .mixedProjection]

private theorem rightCode_onThree : OnThree rightCode := by
  intro e h
  simp only [rightCode, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
  rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp [AllowedEvent, PlanarEvent.position]

private theorem rightFiber_trace {p q : Boundary K H} {s : PlanarShape}
    (d : LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary R p q s)
    (hcode : s.wiring = Quotient.mk PlanarCode.setoid rightCode)
    (hn : d.interpret.eval.toLinearMap ≠ 0) : Trace rightCode p q := by
  obtain ⟨xs, he, ht⟩ := planarAtBoundary_trace d hcode (fun e he => (rightCode_onThree e he).1) hn
  have hh := (equivalent_eq_onThree he [] []).2
  simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil] at hh
  rw [hh rightCode_onThree]
  exact ht

private theorem rightTemplate_code {A C D E F G : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding F D)
    (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E F) :
    let bc := b.comp c
    let ad := a.comp d
    let j := ConjEmbedding.id A
    let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) =>
      LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := R) p)
    let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H)
```

```lean
namespace CaseOneExample
open MackeyDiagrams

section Trace
universe u w
variable {U : Type u} [Group U]

private def Boundary.width {K H : Subgroup U} : Boundary K H → Nat
  | .empty _ => 0
  | .cons _ tail => width tail + 1

private abbrev two {K L H : Subgroup U} (s : Strand K L) (t : Strand L H) :
    Boundary K H :=
  .cons s (.cons t (.empty H))

private abbrev MixedEvidence (U : Type u) [Group U] :=
  ∀ {G J C P : Subgroup U}, ConjEmbedding G P → ConjEmbedding J P →
    ConjEmbedding C G → ConjEmbedding C J → Type w

variable (Evidence : MixedEvidence.{u, w} U)

private inductive TraceEdge :
    {K H : Subgroup U} → Nat → VertexKind → Boundary K H → Boundary K H → Prop
  | parallelUp {K H J J' L : Subgroup U}
      (a : ConjEmbedding J K) (b : ConjEmbedding L J)
      (a' : ConjEmbedding J' K) (b' : ConjEmbedding L J') (suffix : Boundary L H) :
      TraceEdge 0 .parallelUp ((two (.up a) (.up b)).append suffix)
        ((two (.up a') (.up b')).append suffix)
  | mixedProjection {K H P J C : Subgroup U}
      (α : ConjEmbedding K P) (β : ConjEmbedding J P)
      (η : ConjEmbedding C K) (θ : ConjEmbedding C J)
      (label : Evidence α β η θ) (suffix : Boundary J H) :
      TraceEdge 0 .mixedProjection ((two (.down α) (.up β)).append suffix)
        ((two (.up η) (.down θ)).append suffix)
  | prepend {K L H : Subgroup U} {pos : Nat} {kind : VertexKind}
      {p q : Boundary L H} (strand : Strand K L) (edge : TraceEdge pos kind p q) :
      TraceEdge (pos + 1) kind (.cons strand p) (.cons strand q)

private theorem TraceEdge.pad {K L H : Subgroup U} {p q : Boundary L H}
    {pos : Nat} {kind : VertexKind} (edge : TraceEdge Evidence pos kind p q)
    (pre : Boundary K L) :
    TraceEdge Evidence (pos + Boundary.width pre) kind (pre.append p) (pre.append q) := by
  induction pre with
  | empty => exact edge
  | cons strand tail ih =>
    simpa only [Boundary.width, Boundary.append, Nat.add_assoc] using
      (TraceEdge.prepend (Evidence := Evidence) strand (ih edge))

private theorem TraceEdge.appendSuffix {K L H : Subgroup U} {p q : Boundary K L}
    {pos : Nat} {kind : VertexKind} (edge : TraceEdge Evidence pos kind p q)
    (suffix : Boundary L H) :
    TraceEdge Evidence pos kind (p.append suffix) (q.append suffix) := by
  induction edge with
  | parallelUp a b a' b' rest => exact .parallelUp a b a' b' (rest.append suffix)
  | mixedProjection α β η θ label rest =>
    exact .mixedProjection α β η θ label (rest.append suffix)
  | prepend strand _ ih => exact .prepend strand (ih suffix)

private inductive TracePath {K H : Subgroup U} :
    PlanarCode.Code → Boundary K H → Boundary K H → Prop
  | nil (p : Boundary K H) : TracePath [] p p
  | cons {p q r : Boundary K H} {pos : Nat} {kind : VertexKind} {code : PlanarCode.Code}
      (edge : TraceEdge Evidence pos kind p q) (rest : TracePath code q r) :
      TracePath (.vertex pos kind :: code) p r

private theorem TracePath.append {K H : Subgroup U} {p q r : Boundary K H}
    {left right : PlanarCode.Code}
    (first : TracePath Evidence left p q) (second : TracePath Evidence right q r) :
    TracePath Evidence (left ++ right) p r := by
  induction first with
  | nil => exact second
  | cons edge _ ih => exact .cons edge (ih second)

private theorem TracePath.appendSuffix {K L H : Subgroup U} {p q : Boundary K L}
    {code : PlanarCode.Code} (path : TracePath Evidence code p q) (suffix : Boundary L H) :
    TracePath Evidence code (p.append suffix) (q.append suffix) := by
  induction path with
  | nil => exact .nil _
  | cons edge _ ih => exact .cons (edge.appendSuffix Evidence suffix) ih

private theorem TracePath.prependPrefix {K L H : Subgroup U} {p q : Boundary L H}
    {code : PlanarCode.Code} (path : TracePath Evidence code p q) (pre : Boundary K L) :
    TracePath Evidence (PlanarCode.shift (Boundary.width pre) code)
      (pre.append p) (pre.append q) := by
  induction path with
  | nil => exact .nil _
  | @cons p q r pos kind code edge _ ih =>
    have padded := edge.pad Evidence pre
    rw [Nat.add_comm] at padded
    exact .cons padded ih

private theorem trace_middle {G A C D E : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding D D)
    (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E D)
    (path : TracePath Evidence
      [.vertex 1 .parallelUp, .vertex 0 .mixedProjection, .vertex 1 .mixedProjection]
      (Boundary.cons (.down a) (two (.up b) (.up c)))
      (Boundary.cons (.up d) (two (.up e) (.down f)))) :
    ∃ (P J : Subgroup U) (α : ConjEmbedding G P) (β : ConjEmbedding J P)
      (η : ConjEmbedding C G) (θ : ConjEmbedding C J) (_w : ConjEmbedding D J),
      Nonempty (Evidence α β η θ) := by
  cases path with
  | cons first rest =>
    cases rest with
    | cons middle rest =>
      cases rest with
      | cons last tail =>
        cases tail
        cases last with
        | prepend strand last =>
          cases last with
          | mixedProjection α β η θ label suffix =>
            cases middle with
            | mixedProjection αm βm ηm θm m suffix =>
              exact ⟨_, _, αm, βm, d, α, β, ⟨m⟩⟩

private abbrev MixedWitness : MixedEvidence.{u, u} U :=
  fun α β η θ => ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ

end Trace
end CaseOneExample

namespace CaseOneExample
open MackeyDiagrams

private theorem right_trace_impossible {A E : Subgroup U}
    (a : ConjEmbedding G A) (b : ConjEmbedding D A) (c : ConjEmbedding D D)
    (d : ConjEmbedding C G) (e : ConjEmbedding E C) (f : ConjEmbedding E D)
    (path : TracePath MixedWitness
      [.vertex 1 .parallelUp, .vertex 0 .mixedProjection, .vertex 1 .mixedProjection]
      (((Word.down a).tensor (.up b)).tensor (.up c)).boundary
      (((Word.up d).tensor (.up e)).tensor (.down f)).boundary) : False := by
  obtain ⟨P, J, α, β, η, θ, w, ⟨m⟩⟩ := trace_middle MixedWitness a b c d e f path
  exact middle_projection_empty α β η θ w m

end CaseOneExample
```
